dab babyu bzha pa' dkar chag :rgyud/ 97 (27)0563 dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel/ 3slob dpon in+d+ra ཿ tis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po utsār+ya shrartse ka ra barma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos zhing bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(4 ) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(48)0564 rtog pa thams cad 'dus pa zhes bya ba sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde 1

ba'i mchog gi rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma rnam par bshad pa/ gobaco brgyad pa/ de kho na nyid ྾ tshig gi rtog pa'i rnam par bshadapa/gobacu dgu pa/ chos kyi yi ge 'byung ba'i rtog pa'i rnam par bshadapa/ 52shesteb/ ngas/re 1decad tshobadzadatshod 25/ 52sdomatshog /) zug:re tshodapa dzes:re thab 16bka 53gdod ma dang tha ma med pa'i rang bzhin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi gsang ba dang / bden pa'i rang bzhin gyis sku'i gsang ba bstan pa/ 54(pe2na sgyur/sbo /ba/stacad /pa/ sgo me dpal rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas ba'i mig 'dru bsnyan pa/ 58dpal rnam bar snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i yig 'dru bsnyan ba/ 62dpal khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas pa'i yig 'dru bstan pa/ 63dpal pad+ma gar rgya dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa'i mag 'dru bsnyan pa/ 64dpal rdo rje nyi ma 'khor dang bcas ba'i mig 'dru bsnyan ba/ 65dpal rta mchog 'khor dang bcas ba'i mig 'dru bsnyan pa/ 66nyi shu pa/ sngags 'byung ba'i rnam par bshadapa/ 67dpal rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa'i sngags 'byung ba/ 67dpal rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i sngags 'byung ba/ 77dpal khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas pa'i sngags 'byung ba/ 80dpal pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa'i sngags 'byung ba/ 88dpal rdo rje nyi ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i sngags 'byung ba/ 92dpal rta mchog 'khor dang bcas pa'i sngags 'byung ba/ 96nyer gcig pa/ gsang ba sgrub pa'i rnam par bshadapa/ 98/sgocad /khye ཿdathab/ tsho/ tshob/ste/cad 25/ 98/sgon /rtse bzang ba nyid ba/gan pa/ 982

rdo rje snying po'i gtso bo nyid bstan pa/ 99sems dang sems dpa' bstan pa/ 1༷0ting nge 'dzin bstan pa/ 100rdo rje dang rdo rje 'dzin pa bstan pa/ 101rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bstan pa/ 102byang chub spyod pa bstan pa/ 104bdud dang bdud las rgyal ba bstan pa/ 104byang chub sangs rgyas nyid bstan pa/ 105rdo rje gtum po mthar byed dang phyag na rdo rje bstan pa/ 106dang po'i rigs bskyed pa bstan pa/ 107'dod pa'i thar pa bstan pa/ 108rnam pa gsum bstan pa/ 111thams cad nyid bstan pa/ 112dang po'i snying po 'byung ba bstan pa/ 114nye ba'i snying po bstan pa/ 115nye ba'i snying po'i de kho na nyid kyi shes pa bsnyan pa/ 115gsang ba'i rang bajin rang gi snying gar dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i mtshan nyid nye ba'i snying po de nyid ces pa bsnyan pa/ 116dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa bstan pa/ 116dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa bstan pa/ 118dpal khrag 'thung gi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa bstan pa/ 119dpal pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa bstan pa/ 119dpal rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa bstan pa/ 120dpal rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa bstan pa/ 120kun tu smyor ba bsgom pa'i mtshan nyid nye ba'i snying bo'i de nyid bsnyan pa/ 1213

snying bo dang nye ba'i snying bo'i gnyis kyi ngo bo bsnyan ba/ 122nyer gnyis pa/ rjes su smyor ba dang ldan pa sgrub pa'i rtog pa'i rnam par bshadapa/ 122bde ba chen po rdo rje dam tshig don yod kyi dam tshig gi sgra'i don bstan pa/ 123dkyil 'khor gyi don rgyud la sogs pa bstan pa/ 124rtog pa'i dngos grub bstan pa/ 124gsang ba chen po lnga bstan pa/ 125bcom ldan 'das kyi rang bzhin bstan pa/ 125de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba chen po de nyid lnga bstan pa/ 126phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i yan lag gi shes pa bstan pa/ 128thams cad dgug pa'i rgyu bstan pa/ 129mchod pa chen po thams cad kyi cho ga bstan pa/ 129rang gi rig pa'i lha thams cad bsgrub pa chen po'i rgyu bstan pa/ 130thams cad rjes su bsgrub pa'i rgyu bstan pa/ 131rjes su sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i bsgrub pa thams cad kyi rgyu bstan pa/ 131rtog pa'i don bsdus pa/ 125shrī na len+d+ra na bzhugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i zhabs kyis mdzad/lhati tshwa na tīrte yis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(146) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(151)0565 sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dka' 'grelas/ //52dang po/ de kho na nyid snang ba dam pa'i yul la 'jug pa ye shes kyi phyag 4

rgya'i brtag pa'i 'grel pa/ 153gnyis pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu sbyor ba'i brtag pa'i 'grel pa/ 164gsum pa/ lha mo thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba skal ba mchog bzang po dpal rdo rje dam tshig gi brtag pa'i 'grel pa/ 167bzhi pa/ sna tshogs thams cad kyi skal ba bzang po mchog gi dngos grub ces bya ste dpal dam tshig gi brtag pa'i 'grel pa/ 171lnga pa/ gtam gyi phyag rgya zhes pa'i brtag pa'i 'grel pa/ 174drug pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'go sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi brtag pa'i 'grel pa/ 188bdun pa/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi phyag rgya shes pa'i brtag pa'i 'grel pa/ 209brgyad pa/ mchod pa thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal skal ba bzang po dam tshig gi brtag pa'i 'grel pa/ 217dgu pa/ kun tu rnam pa sna tshogs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i brtag pa'i 'grel pa/ 222bcu pa/ kun tu sna tshogs skal ba bzang po dpal dam tshig gi brtag pa'i 'grel pa/ 287slob dpon rab tu zhi ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po a tsār+ya shra ka ra warma dang / dharmā shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/5

bsdur mchan/(289) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(296)0566 dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ 297slob dpon ku ku rā dzas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po be+ebyu ka ra mosnya dang /zhu ra gyi lo tsā ba ban+de lha rin po ches rgyud 'grel dang gtugs te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(lda38) bsdura'abras re'u mig(341)0567 dpal he ru ka'i gsang ba'i don rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba 3tsoslob dpon ku ku rā dzas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po be+ekhyu ka ra sirnya dang /zhu r+ṣa gyi tsā ba ban+de lha rin po ches bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(356) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(357)0568 dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ 358slob dpon ku ku rā dzas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi— ka ra mo ha dang /zhu r+sā gyi lo tsā ba ban+de lha rin po ches bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(369) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(370)6

0569 dpal pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ 371slob dpon ku ku rā dzas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bo rnyi kā ra sirnya dang /zhu ra gyi lo tsā ba ban de lha rin po ches bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(383) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(384)0570 dpal rdo rje rin chen nyi ma'i gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ 385slob dpon r+sā po ku ku rā dzas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po thabyu ka ra sirnya dang /zhu ra gyi lo tsā ba ban+de lha rin po ches bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(397) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(398)0571 dpal rta mchog rol pa'i gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ 399slob dpon r+ṣa po ku ku rā dzas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sirnya dang /zhu r+ṣa gyi lo tsā ba bste lha rin po ches bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(409) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(411)༷572 dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i cho ga 7

lnga pa zhes bya ba/ 412dang po/ thog mar bslab par bya ba'i tshul gyis smin par bya ba'i cho ga bstan pa/ 412gnyis pa/ phyogs thams cad nas bslab par bya ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i cho ga bstan pa/ 421gsum pa/ spyod pa yongs su dag pa rnal 'byor pas bar chad bsal ba'i cho ga bstan pa/ 430bzhi pa/ 'jug pa po rnams kyi phrin las sna tshogs 'grub pa'i cho ga bstan pa/433lnga pa/ thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub bstan pa'i cho ga 441slob dpon chen po ku ku rā dzas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po 1badz+ra ha sa dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba rma rin chen mchog gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(47) bsdura'abras re'u mig(450)0573 dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i spyad/)(ba par/bozang () ཿdza bka cesabs (1 ngab 451slob dpon chen po ku ku rā dzas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po gu len+d+ra gup+ta dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dran pa nam mkhas bsgyur/phyis kyi lo tsā ba lha rin po ches bcos shing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(507) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(512)0574 sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i tshogs 8

kyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 513slob dpon chen po rgyal po in+d+ra byu tis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po unan+da gasnya dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dran pa nam mkhas bsgyur/phyis lo tsā ba lha rin po ches bcos shing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(522) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(523)0575 pa/pa' steste nges ka stu/sa (1 balnga/ (1ba thabs/ 524slob dpon chen po thu bo ra dza ha stes mdzad/bsdur mchan/(527) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(527)0576 dpal he ru ka'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 528slob dpon r+ṣa po hūṃ mdzad rdo rjes mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra sirnya dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de lha rin po ches bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(547) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(5go)0577 dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs 500slob dpon chen po hūṃ gi zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra sa ha dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba rma rin chen mchog gis bsgyur cing gtan la phab/slad kyi lo tsā ba phyi ma dag gis sum thug tu zhu chen bcos/bsdur mchan/(571) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(574)

0578 yan lag bzhi'i don snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ 575slob dpon mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa k+shi mdzad grags pas mdzad/slob dpon paṇ+ḍi ta dpal rdo rje bzhad pa dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po rma rin po che mchog gis bsgyur cing bshad nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(674) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(683)0579 dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ 684sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi —na du 'gro ba'i yan lag gi cho ga bstan pa/ ༷ 684rten gyi mtshan nyid/ 685sa'i cho ga bya ba/ 686ma' mas bcad pa/ 690:/na sreg 691srung ba'i 'khor lo/ 693gzugs brnyan kyi dkyil 'khor bya ba/ 694bsnyen pa'i tsho ga bsnyan pa/ 705dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa/ 705dbang bskur ba/ 710bum dbang / 71010

slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 710shis pa'i cho ga 710rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba/ 711dbang bskur ba'i phan yon/ 713dam tshig dang sdom pa la sogs pa sbyin pa/ 713slob dpon du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 714brtul zhugs sbyin pa/ 714rjes gnang sbyin pa/ 715dam tshig bstan pa/ 718dbang thob pa'i phan yon bstan pa/ 718dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang lha'i de kho na nyid bstan pa/ 719rjes kyi bya ba/ 723gsang dbang/ 723shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / 725dbangabazhipa/ 727khyad par gyi dam tshig bsgrag pa/ 727dkyil 'khor gyi mjug bsdu ba/ 727rteste nga/:re nga stestezug nga pa/byu1mtha nga/ casab/ba/ ngas/gcad nga / 728slob dpon chen po hūṃ mdzad rdo rjes mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra sirnya dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba lha rin po ches bsgyur zhing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(732) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(736)0580 dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i sgrub thabs yang dag par 11

grub pa zhes bya ba/ 737slob dpon chen po badz+ra hūṃ ka ra'i zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po hūṃ ka ra de nyid dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba badhe gnubs nam mkha'i snying pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(741) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(741)0581 rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog ces bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sems can thams cad kyi bde ba skyed ma zhes bya ba/ 742kha che'i mkhas pa chen po dpal rin chen rdo rjes mdzad/dpal ldan u rgyan du sbyangs pa mkhas pa ye shes rdo rje dang / lo tsā ba gnyan ban bsod nams kyis bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(794) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(800)0582 rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/ 801slob dpon chen po rgyal po in+d+ra byu tis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(804) bsdura'abras re'u mig(804)12

0583 bcom ldan 'das dpal bde ba chen po rdo rjes sems dpa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 805bsdur mchan/(820) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(821)0584 dpal rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 822slob dpon chen po thu bo rā dza ha tis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(839) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(840)rgyud/ 〈li (28)0585 sgrol ma'isgrub thabs/ 843'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dharmā badz+ra dang / bod kyi rdo lo tsā ba dge slong dar ma rin chen gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(852) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(854)0586 thugs rje chen po 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs spyi'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ 855slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(857) bsdura'abras re'u mig(858)13

0587 lha mo sgrol ma'i bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 859le'u dang po/ 'phags ma sgol ma myur zhing rab tu dpa' ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 859le'u gnyis pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 860le'u gsum pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma gser mdog can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 860le'u bzhi pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 861le'u lnga pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma hūṃ gi sgra rab tu sgogs ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 861le'u drug pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 861le'u bdun pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma gzhan 'joms ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 862le'u brgyad pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma bdud thams cad 'joms shing dbang mchog gter bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 862le'u dgu pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma mchog r+ṣa ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 863le'u bcu pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma mya ngan thams cad sel bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 863le'u bcu gcig pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma 'gro ba thams cad 'gugs shing phongs pa thams cad sel ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 86414

zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 864le'u bcu gsum pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma yongs su smin par byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 865le'u bcu bzhi pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma 'gugs pa'i khro mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 865le'u bco lnga pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma zhi ba chen mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 866le'u bcu drug pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma chags pa 'joms ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 866le'u bcu bdun pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma bde ba thams cad sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 867le'u bco brgyad pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 867le'u bcu dgu pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma sdug bsngal thamasacad bsreg pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 867le'u nyi shu pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 868le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma yongs su rdzogs par byed ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 868kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta slob dpon nyi ma sbas pas mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta ma spyodang bod kyi lo tsā ba mal gyo blo gros grags pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(869) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(870)15

0588 rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma'i sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i las kyi yan lag dang bcas pa mdor /ba/sdu/ma /pa ces/ma /bya/ /ba 8shā 1dang po/ 'phags ma sgol ma myur zhing rab tu dpa' mo zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag phyir zlog pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 871gnyis pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag yams nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 87nale'u gsum pa/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma gser mdog can gyi las kyi yan lag tshe 'phel ba'i cho ga rgyas par phye ba/ 874le'u bzhi pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag dug gsad pa'i cho ga 875le'u lnga pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la hūṃ gi sgra rab tu sgogs ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag dbang du byed pa'i cho ga 875le'u drug pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag sgrib pa yongs su sbyong ba'i cho ga 877le'u bdun pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma gzhan 'joms ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag gong du 'pho ba zhes bya ba'i cho ga 878le'u brgyad pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma bdud thams cad 'joms shing dbang mchog ster ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ 880le'u dgu pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma mchog stsol ba zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan babab/ zabapa/ /1 ba/zugathab nga/:re ཿdza ba/ 881le'u dgu pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma mya ngan thams cad sel bar byed ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga 88 16

le'u bcu pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma 'gro ba thams cad 'gugs shing phongs pa thams cad sel ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag longs spyod spel ba'i cho ga 893le'u bcu gcig pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma bkra shis thams cad sbyin ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag sbyin sreg gi cho ga 894le'u bcu gnyis pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma yongs su smin par byed pa zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag 'byung po bzlog pa/ 896le'u bcu gsum pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma 'gugs pa'i khro mo zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag bsrung ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ 897le'u bcu bzhi pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma zhi ba chen mo zhes bya ba'i las kyi pa /cad pa /bka /dribasgyu /) ཿdza pa/ ra 9ra le'u bco lnga pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma chags pa thams cad 'joms ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag blo 'phel bar byed pa'i cho ga 899le'u bcu drug pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma bde ba thams cad bsgrub pa'i lam gyi yan lag chom rkun bcing ba'i cho ga 900le'u bcu bdun pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i las spu/ kyangan 'bag (1 nad gso balnga/ —— ga 9༷1le'u bco brgyad pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba'i las kyi yan lag khri mon las thar ba byed pa'i cho ga 903le'u bcu dgu pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dngos grub thams cad ster bar byed ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag mi snang ba'i cho ga 904le'u nyi shu pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma yongs su rdzogs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i 'a sa —1 sa/na 'bab/ ma mdzag ba(1ba pa/ 904le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig gtor ma'i cho ga 90517

mnyam par sprur ba zhes bya ba'i — —rgyud kya dka' 'gral/①༄ ga /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sarba budha sa ma yo ga tan+t+ra nā ma pa— kā/bod skad du/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen kun mdzad thams cad pa/ /kun khyab mchod chen rdo rje dang / /slob dpon in+d+ra byu ti la/ /shākya bshes gnyen phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi nges pa'i tshig /bla mas bstan par mdzad du gsol/ /gsang ba zhes ni gang la bgyi/ /mchog gi zhes ni gang la bgyi/ /dgyes pa zhes ni ji ltar bshad/ /thams cad bdag nyid ji ltar bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos po gang / /sems dpa' zhes ni gang la bkyi/ /rnam pa dag ni gang dag gis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /bde ba rnam pa du ru bshad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ji lta bu/ /de ni ji ltar rang byung yin/ /14—3

gcig pu nyid ni ji lta bu/ /bcom ldan 'das sgra ji lta bu/ /che ba'i lha ni ji lta bu/ /sangs rgyas thams cad don gang lags/ /mnyam par sbyor zhes gang la bgyi/ /mkha' 'gro zhes bya gang gi ming / /sgyu ma ji ltar 'gyur ba lags/ /bde ba'i mchog ces gang la bgyi/ /de bzhin ngan par spyod pa gang / /khyed kyi chags pa med pa gang / /chags pa yang ni gang zhig lags/ /chags bral min pa'ang khyed kyis shod/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu ma ci/ /rgya 'di gnyis med theg pa yi/ /mchog ces gang la rab tu bsgrags/ /gnas rgo gang du yang dag bshad/ /zhu ba por ni 'dir gyur pa/ /'dir ni rgyud 'di'i ston pa su/ /der ni 'khor yang ji lta bu/ /rigs ni dbye ba du ru bshad/ /sngags btu ba yi rim pa gang / /stong pa'i klu zhes gang la bshad/ /brjod dang 'brel dang dgos pa dang / /sngon byung ba yi rnam drug dang / /de bzhin sna tshogs pad+ma ras—/ /ā li kā li mnyam pa'i rgya/ /mnyam med mi g.yo bstod pa dang / /de nyid min pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /shin tu de nyid ji ltar 'gyur/ /rol mo ①phyag rgya'ang bshad du gsol/ /mnyam par ma gzhag ⑤rnal 'byor dang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla dag1 /shar ba dag ni ji lta bu/ /dkyil 'khor zlum po sangs rgyas kyi/ /rdo rje can gyi zla gam ④bzhin/ /pad+mo'i dbang gis pad+mo'i dbyibs/ /rin chen mchog gi rin chen dbyibs/ / bri ba'am ⑤yang na mi bri ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni ji ltar gzhagadhi /dkyil 'khor dang ni rgyud dang ni/ /de bzhin du ni sngags rnams kyis/ /sbas dang gtso bo'i sgra ni gang / /cho ga rnams kyang bshad du gsol/ /sbyor ba'i rnam pa'ang ⑦ji lta bus—/ /rdo rje sems dpa' stobs chen yin/ /dbang phyug dang ni tshangs pa 14—4

dang / /dbang por bcas dang khyab 'jug dang / /'dod lha chung mar bcas gsol zhing / /lha mo bhi ma drug min bcas/ /mngon thon sbyar bas spyad mdzad la/ /sngon ni de la skyabs su song / /rtag tu 'di ltar g.yul 'gyed pa//der ni gsang ba ji lta bur/ /rdo rje can de brdzun pa'i tshig /phyi nas gsung bar mdzad gyur te/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' dang ①/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug zla ba dang / /thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs zhes/ /gzhan yang sngon ni gsungs pa nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa' byed pa po/ /lha gzhan gang zhig yod dam ci/ /rdo rje nyi ma mnan pa dang / /rnam par snang mdzad dpal nyid dang / /dpal ldan rdo rje mchog mnan cing / /de bzhin du yang rta mchog dang / /'jig rten dbang phyug sbrul mo dang / /byang chub de bzhin pha rol phyin/ /rkang pa rkyong ②dang gnon pa dang / /bskums ④nas 'degs pa'i stabs dag gis/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /gzugs rnams thams cad gnon par byed/ /bcom ldan lha yi rnal 'byor ni/ /mngon sum rjes su dpag pa gang / /ḍā ni nam mkhar 'gro sgra dang / /thams cad ma lus pa nyid dang / /kun tu kun nas thams cad ni/ /bdag nyid kun tu rnam pa kunaske/ /sangs rgyas brtan g.yo la sogs kun/ /kun gyi dngos por ji ltar 'gyur—/ /ji ltar sems de 'di ltar yang / /dngos bo kun la gnas par 'gyuradhi—/ /rdo rje can gyi gzhi nyid dang / /khro bo'i gzugs su ji ltar 'gyur⑤//chos kyi sku ni ji ltar bshad/ /longs spyod rdzogs pas gang zhig bya/ /sprul pa'i tshig 0ni ji lta bu/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshig ni gang / /lha yi tshig ni gang zhig ces/ /shākya'i bshes gnyen the tshom gyur/ /sngags ston rnams kyis 14—5

btus pa yis/ /bcos pa'i tshig ni gang zhig lha/ /in+d+ra bhū ①ti de nyid mkhyen//'di dag thams cad bshad du gsol/ /de nas legs so legs so zhes/ /slob dpon in+d+ra byu sketis byin/ /shākya shes rab rab ldan khyod/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi nges pa ④nyon/ /ji ltar bla mas bdag la bshad/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par bya/ /gnas ni nam mkha' lngas brgyan pa'i/ /shes rab bha ga yin par bshad/ /chos kyi 'khor lo lte ba cher/ /rdo rje can ni stong par bzhugs—/ /nyid kyi thugs ni bdag nyid can/ /bde mchog de yi zhu ba po/ /rdo rje can gyis bdag 'dod spyod/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur mdzad cing / /sprul pa'i sku ni stod pa dang / /chos kyi sku ni thig ler bcas/ /ji ltar yang dag rdzogs gyur cing / /ston pa gdan la legs bzhugs te/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas kun sbyor bshad du gsol/ /bde mchog ma mo'i tshogs bcas par/ /'dir ni zhu ba por gyur to/ /rdo rje can gyi ma ma rjol/ /rigs kyi dbye bas phye ste bshad/ /'brel ba 'jig rten pha rol te/ /dgos pa sgrub pa po rnams kyis/ /sbas pa'i sgra ni gsang ba ste/ /rdo rje can gyi sba bar bshad/ /gtso bo'i sgra ni ⑤'di ni bshad/ /mngon sum gyi ni tshig nyid do/ /gang tshe sems ni mi mthong bas/ /sbas te rjes su dpag pa ste/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs—/ /gzugs sogs sngo dang ser po dang / /dkar dang le brgan mdog tu ni/ /gang tshe sems ni mi mthong zhing / /rna ba dag gis mi thos pas/ /gang tshe sems ni ji 'dra zhes/ /rjes su dpag par de tshe 'gyur/ /gzhan yang dri bcas sna dang ni/ /lce yis tshor bar mi 'gyur zhing / /de bzhin 14—6

longs spyod bde ba dag /gzhan kyi ①sems mthong mi 'gyur la/ /kha dang ro yis ma yin zhing / /reg bya rnams kyang de bzhin te/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /gang zhig thams cad bdag nyid bzhugs/ /rjes su dpag pas sgom byed pa/ /gsang ba'i gzhung ni 'di lta bu'o/ /'di ni zhes bya'i sgra yod pas/ /la la mngon sum par 'dod te/ /rang byung kun tu snang gyur cing / de bzhin longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / /mi ru snang zhing spyod pa dang / /snom zhing myang dang bzhad pa dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs g.yul 'gyed dang / /dbang po gnyis kyis 'dod bde dang / /phyag ni brgya phrag bye ba dang / /dbu ni 'bum khrag khrir gyur cing / /tshad med zhabs gnyis zhabs bzhi dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' brtan pa dang / /g.yo ba rnams ni khyab pa zhes/ /gang phyir sngar bzhin bshad pas na/ /rtag tu mngon sum snang ba yis/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa yi④/ /mngon sum gzhung ni 'di lta bu④/ /de nas shākya'i bshes gnyen gyis/ / in+d+ra bhū rjoti la zhus pa/ /gsang ba zhes ni bshad pa de//gang gis mi la rab tu bshad/ /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /de nyid gsang ba zhes bshad pa/ sa bon lnga ni gsang ba ste/ /sbas pa'i bden pa bshad pa yin/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma gsang ba'o/ /kaṇ+ḍa ⑤ka yi dga' gsang ba/ /thams cad 'dus pa gsang ba ste/ /bde ba'i 'og ni gsang ba zhes—/ /brda yis bshad par mdzad pa yin/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi—/ /ting nge 'dzin ni mchog ces bshad/ /sems kyi rang bzhin bsam mi khyab—/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dra ba bzhin/ /bde mchog ces ni bya bar bsgrags—/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i btsun mo gang / /de ni gcig las du mar phye/ /14—7

shes rab pha rol phyin pa'ang de/ /kun mkhyen kun rtsol phra ba ste/ /snying ga'i phug gi nang na gnas/ /de ni sgyu ma'i gzugs su shes/ /sangs rgyas thams cad ston pa te/ /sngon byung ba ni rnam lnga nyid/ /bde mchog la ni yang dag bshad—/ /drug pa nyid kyang 'bum sde yi/ /tshad kun rgyud kyi nang yin ①de/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de la bshad/ /mi yi 'jig rten dag na med/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /sngon byung go rims ji lta ba/ /'di ni bden pa mchog gi tshig /skad cig tsam gyis dus gcig na/ /sngon byung ba dang gsungs pa ni⑤/ /sngon byung ba dang bde mchog gi/ /dus mang ngag du ma bshad de/ /bla ma rdo rje can bshad pa/ /ma mo rnams kyi nang du bshad/ /thams cad stong pa nyid rmongs pas/ /shin tu yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /de tshe rtag tu rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas skur ni 'dzin mdzad ⑦nas/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /khengs rjolas sems can kun grol mdzad/ /sangs rgyas srid la legs bzhag nas/ /dbugs 'byin pa ni sprul bar mdzad/ /rnam par snang mdzad dbugs 'byin bshad/ /te ru ka'i yang de nyon cig /de tshe sems can thams cad ni/ /shin tu khro gtum gdug par gyur/ /lha la sogs pa 'jigs byed cing / /bstan pa dag kyang 'jig par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /khro bo'i gzugs su rnam par phyung / /'jigs pa chen po'i dus ltar gtum/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis yongs su bskor/ /thams cad za zhing dral dub dang / /thal bar gyur pa'ang 'tsho bar byed/ /he ru ka yi dbugs 'byung buba'ang / /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi'am/ /rdo rje nyi ma rta mgrin te/ /thams cad rdo rje can las phyung / / 'di ni gtam gyi phyag 14—8

rgya las/ /'di nyid dang po bstan pa yin/ /sdud par byed pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang por bcas/ /lha chen po dang 'dod lha dag /①rdo rje can kyi zhabs dag la/ /dad pas skyabs su 'ongs gyur pa/ /ci yi phyir na de yis gsol/ /bi ma la sogs mngon thon spyad/ /bdag gis sngar ni gsol mod kyi/ /'di la the tshom gyur pa mchis/ /slob dpon gyis de skad ces smras so/ /khyab 'jug sgra ni rnam shes yin/ /tshangs pa sa bon yin par bshad/ /dbang po lus su gyur pa yin/ /bde ba thams cad 'dod pa'i lha/ /lha chen po ni sems de nyid/ /gzugs med khams la gnas pa'o/ /bi ma la sogs ming gis ni/ /shes rab kyi ①ni bha gar bshad/ /nang gi gzhung ni 'di yin la/ /phyi yi gzhan du bshad pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpas tshangs la sogs/ /mu stegs rnams ni mngon ①mnan pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rab tu 'dud par mi byed pas/ /dgos pa de yi don du ni/ /zhabs g.yon gyis ni drag rjopo mnan/ /rdo rje can gyi brdzun tshig ni/ /gang zhig rjokhyod kyis sngon dris pa/ /gang tshe lha chen mnan gyur na/ /thams cad khyab par ji ltar 'gyur0/ /rdo rje sems dpas 'gro ba kun—/ /sna tshogs gzugs su rnam sprul te/ /gti mug zhe sdang chags pa ni/ /tshangs dang khyab 'jug lha chen gyur/ /rdo rje can gyis bka' ma sprul⑦/ /lha chen mo yang stong pa yin/ /bstan pa thams cad gnon par mdzad/ /ma ni mi dang lha ma yin/ /ha ni bzhir gyur pa nyid de/ / gti mug zhe sdang chags pa ni/ /⑧de ni lus kyi dbugs gnas pa/ /bi ni rlung gi gzugs can no/ /de nyid tshangs pa'i sgra can te/ /khyab 'jug dang ni dbang po'ang yin/ /rdo 14—9

rje sems dpa'i snying gnas pa'i/ /bud med rtag par 'dod chags spyad/ /de bas brtan ①dang g.yo bcas la/ /spyod pas 'dod pa'i lhar gyur to/ /thams cad bdag nyid bzhugs nyid la/ /in+d+ra khyu ②ti'i gzhung 'di yin/ /sdud par byed pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /pad+ma gsang ba zhes bshad cing / /gsang ba 'dod par bshad pa dang / /gsang ba sa bon zhes bshad cing / /gsang ba mtshal chen zhes bshad do/ /gsang ba rnal 'byor pa yi rdzas/ /dri chu sha ste lnga po yi/ /mchog ni bdud rtsi rdzas rnams te/ /g.yo ba yi ni khams rnams kun/ /dgyes pa gzi brjid ces bshad la/ /dgyes pa bdag la'ang gnas pa'o/ /slob dpon gyis de skad ces gsungs so/ /gsang ba byang chub sems yin zhing / /mchog ni rta mchog yin par bshad/ /dgyes pa rnam par snang mdzad yin/ /thams cad sgra ni he ru ka /yi ge ra ni gnyis pa yis/ /mtshal chen pad+ma'i rigs byung ba'o/ /ba — rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /sngon byung rim pa de bzhin no/ /sdud par byed pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /thams cad khyab pa'i ye shes gang / /thams cad bdag nyid ji ltar bzhugs/ /'gro ba dang ni 'ong ba nyid/ /thugs kyi pad+ma ji ltar gnas/ /snod ni ji ltar 'bigs par 'gyur/ /mthong ba'i gtam ni ji lta bu/ /gzhan gyi grong ①du ji ltar 'gro//bdag ni the tshom chen po 'di/ /rang gi lus la rtsa rgyus su/ /bdag nyid kyis ni nang na gnas/ /'byung ba kun la gnas pa yi/ /ye shes de ni gang du gnas—/ /rnam pa gang dang gang dag gis/ /rtag tu rol cing rtse bar 'gyur//cir rjosnang brtag par mi nus la/ /phra zhing shin tu dri ma med/ /hūṃ cha bcas pa gang lags lha/ /cha med cha ni rnam spangs ⑤gang / /slob dpon gyis de 14—10

skad ces gsungs so/ /snying gar gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ/ /sa bon cha dang bcas pa yin/ /yi ge ha ni cha spangs pa/ /de bzhin cha med 'gyur yin zhes//'dul ba don yod rgyud las ni/ /phyag na rdo rjes gsungs pa yin/ /mtshan ni ldan par rab gyur zhes/ /de nyid bsdus las bshad pa yin/ /mi shigs 'du shes bral ba zhes/ /dpal mchog las kyang gsungs pa yin/ /bcom ldan de nyid 'di lta bur/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /rtag tu med cing snang ba med/ /nam mkha' lngas no rnam par brgyan/ /rkang pa'i mthil ①nas spyi bo'i bar/ /bdag nyid rtag tu brjod pa yin/ /der ni sgom par byed pa na/ /phreng ba mi dgos sngags ④mi dgos/ /gzung dang sbyin sreg las rnams dag /mchog las mchog tu ldog par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' mchog ni mya ngan 'das/ /mya ngan 'das pa yin zhes brjod/ /yid las 'das pa rdo rje che/ /rnam rtog med cing gnas med pa/ /'gyur ba med cing snang ba med—/ /chags pa med cing skye ba med/ /dmigs su med cing mtshan ma med//lus med dbang po rnam ④kyang med/ /cha med dag cing dri ma med/ /gzhan yang zhi zhing nges par rgyal/ /'chi med rga meb med rdo rje/ /nad med bstan tu med pa dang / /rma med bde sogs stong pa nyid/ /zag med de bzhin 'jig pa med/ /chags med kun 'gro gsang ba ste/ /de nyid gnas pa rnams rjospangs pa/ /cha med cha bcas las 'das pa/ /sgra dang reg pa med pa ste/ /ngo bo nyid dang 'ba' zhig gcig /de bzhin gnas su nges pa ste/ /zur gcig rjom yin zur gsum min/ /la la zlum po'i dbyibs su min/ /ring por ma yin thung ngur min/ /de bzhin yo dang drang ba min/ /tshad min rnam 14—11

par shes pa ①min/ /mdun du ma yin rgyab tu min/ /mngon sum ma yin skog tu min/ /gzung med gzung ba rnams spangs pa/ /cha tsam ma yin spu ②tsam min—/ /shin tu phra ba'i char yang min/ /'gro ba dang ni 'ong ba min/ /lam dang de bzhin lam ngan min/ /tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab par/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bzhugs/ /sdud par byed pas ①'di skad ces gsol to—/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla rnams/ /shar ba dag rgo mthong ba yis/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur zhing / /bsod nams thams cad grub par 'gyur//slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bsam gtan dus su rnal 'byor pas—/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rtag mthong ba/ /nyi zla dag ni shar ba ste/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur zhing / /bsod nams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur//gzhan dag 'dod pa'i gzhung yang ni/ /zla ba sa bon zhes bshad pa/ /nyi ma mtshal chen yin 0par 'dod/ /de nas ⑤'dres pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'byel bas sa bon mtshal chen po/ /de dag mthong ba tsam kyis ni/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur zhing / /sngags kyi gzugs kyis zos pas ni/ /bsod nams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rjoshar ba zhes bya'i ⑦sgra gang yin/ /sa bon rgyun ni min par bshad/ /bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gzhung yin te/ /in+d+ra bhū tis ④gzhung yang yin/ /rtsa ba'i ⑨rgyu bar bshad pa ni/ /de ni sna sbyor ⑩gnyis dag ste/ /de dag 'dus pa'i dus kyang ni/ /lha rnams dmigs pa dran pa'o/ /'di ni 'gro dang 'ong ba yi/ /don ni yang dag bstan pa yin//de ni lus la steng sgor yang / /rdo rje can ni rtag tu gnas/ /steng gi sgo ni 'dab ma gsum⑪/ /sgo dgu yis ni yongs bskor la⑫/ /rnyog med brtag ⑫ 74—12

par mi nus pas/ /bla ma'i kha las rnyed par 'gyur/ /rang gi bdag dbus nas rnyed pas/ /des na rang byung zhes brjod de/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gcig pu rab tu phye ①ba'i lha/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na//thams cad bdag nyid rtag par bzhugs/ /sdud par byed pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ḍā ni nam mkhar 'gro ma zhes/ /khams las mngon du rtag ④pa ste//nam mkha' kun tu spyod 'grub pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags/ /ḍi ④ni mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa'i/ /don ni ji ltar nye bar sbyar/ /de nas sgra 'di brtag bya ste/ /de la rab bshad rjordo rje dang / /slob dpon gzhan gyi gzhung dag gis⑤/ /'di ni sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /khams kyi sgra ni sa bon te/ /gcig tu brtag pa nyid kyis ni/ /bza' ba brtag rjopa de bzhin te/ /ḍā ni mkha' 'gro'i sgra yis so/ /in+d+ra byu ⑦ti'i gzhung nyon cig /ḍi ni lus zhes bshad pa yin/ /be+e ni rtag tu rdo rje 'dzin/ /ha ni gzhi ru gyur pa ste/ /rkang pa'i gzhi nas spyi bor brten/ /mi ⑧shigs gang dang gang phrad pa/ /rtag tu rang nyid brjod pa yin/ /ya ni mi mngon pa nyid de/ /mi mngon gnas las byung ba'o/ /'gro dang 'ong ba nyid dag gis/ /khams ni rang gar ⑨'gro ba'o—/ /re zhig khams zhes bya ba'i sgra/ /gsang ba'i yi ge bcu drug ste/ /ri ⑩ni 'tshal chen po yi khams/ /ha ni de bzhin reg pa'o/ /gye ni bad kan yin par bshad/ /yi ge pa ni 'khrig pa nyid⑪/ /ra ni chu yi ngo bo'o/ /me ni de bzhin tshil yin te/ /ra ni me nyid yin par bshad/ /me ni de bzhin sha nyid do/ /sa ni bshang bar bshad pa yin/ /rba ni de bzhin zhag yin la/ /ma ni pags pa nyid du bshad/ /ni ni rus pa nyid yin no/ /sa ni gci bar 14—13

gyur pa yin/ /da ni glo ba yin par bshad/ /spri ni gang gang zhes bshad pa'i//mkhal ma'i rdzas ni rab mdzes pa'o/ /rta ni khu bar gyur pa ste/ /byang chub sems las legs byung ba'o/ /khams kyi sgra ni 'di dag tu/ /in+d+ra byu ①ti'i gzhung yin no/ /bdag nyid rang gi lhar sbyor bas/ /bdag nyid rab tu bsgrub bya bar/ /rgyud 'dir yang dag bstan pa yin/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa ni/ /khrag dgyes pa yi rgyan du rkang / /rab tu 'bad de bsgrub par bya/ /dbus su rnam snang mgon po gtso/ /de dbus bde ba chen po ste/ /dngos grub dkyil 'khor bzhi po ni/ /rim pa bzhin du gzhag ①par bya/ /sdud par byed pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gtso bo khyod kyis gsungs pa yi/ /gzhung 'di slob dpon gang gis lags/ /slob dpon gyis ni 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /de ni bzhad ④pa'i rdo rje ste/ /in+d+ra byu rjoti'i gzhung yin la⑤/ /slob ma rnams la phan 'dod pas/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar bzhag dupa ni/ /in+d+ra byu ⑦ti'i bshad pa'i gzhung / /dkyil 'khor dbus su he ru ka /zla gam zhes ni bshad pa gang / /thod pa mgo yi khu bas khyab/ /zur bzhi rdo rje can dkyil 'khor/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor zlum po yin/ /pad+ma'i dbyibs zhes bshad pa ni/ /pad+ma gar dbang las byung ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum bri ba ni/ /rta mgrin gyi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /rin chen dbyibs su bya ba ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su ni/ /sgo srung ⑧bzhi ni gzhag ⑨par bya/ /sdud par byed pas yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lha mo dang / /gang gzhan he ru ka sogs kyi/ /sngags kyi 'byung ba gsang ba dang / /khro bo rnams kyi khyad par 14—14

du'o| /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /dang ①por oṃ ni yang dag sbyar/ /de ni lha mo rnams la'ang bshad/ /de nas a dang sbyar byas shing //de yi 'og tu yi ge hūṃ/ /ha ni stong pa zhes bshad de/ /mgo dang thig ler bcas byas pa'o/ /yi ge swā hār de brjod pa/ /sngags rnams kyi ni dpal byed pa'o/ /de nas phaṭa dang sbyar ba ni/ /gang gzhan khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du'o—/ /sngags kyi 'byung ba gsang ba ni/ /bdag gi de nyid la gnas so/ /sdud par byed pas yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rnam pa dag ni ji lta bu/ /lha rnams kyi ni khang par bshad/ /khang pa rnam pa du ru bshad/ /lha ni gang zhig khang pa gang / /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /lha ni lha ru sbyor ba ste/ /lha rnams kyi ni ②lha nyid do/ /khang pa dkyil 'khor zhes bshad pa—/ /bzhad skepa rdo rje'i gzhung yin no/ /in+d+ra bhū dhiti'i gzhung ji bzhin/ /lha yi khang pa de bshad bya/ /de ni lus zhes bshad pa yin/ /badz+ra ⑤rdo rje yin par bshad/ /ga ni pad+ma zhes bshad la/ /ra ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /rin chen sa bon zhes bshad cing / /rin chen pad+ma zhes bshad de/ /rin chen bcud ༷len mtshal chen dang / /dri chu sha ste lnga pa'o/ /dmar chen dang ni ga pur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar po sbyor ⑦ba dag /tshogs kyi dbus su bzhag pa ni/ /ra sa ya na kun slong ba'o/ /dus su yang dag byung ba yi/ /me tog mtshal chen yin par bshad/ /ga pur sa bon zhes bshad de/ /tsan+dan dmar po sbyar ba dag /rab tu 'bad de zos gyur na/ /bdud rtsi sman ni chen po'o/ /chags min chags dang bral ba min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs pa/ /chags pa min pa rdo rje can/ /chags dang bral min skebade ba'i 14—15

mchog /de dag phyag rgya rab sbyor ①ba/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs pa'o/ /gzhung gcig legs par bshad nas ni/ /gzhung gnyis po rgo bshad par bya/ /chags pas grol bar mi 'gyur zhing / /de bzhin sdang bas ma yin pa②/ /gti mug dbu ①ma zhes brjod de/ /de bas 'di ni spang bar bya/ /slob dpon gnyis pa'i gzhung 'di yin/ /gsum pa'i gzhung ni bshad bya ste/ /chags pa min pas sa bon te/ /chags dang bral min rdo rje chu/ /dbu mar gyur pa mtshal rjochen po/ /bzhi pa'i gzhung ni btu bar bya/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rtag tu chags par mi bya zhing / /bud med kyis ni chags bral min—/ /sgom pa dbu mar gyur pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs ni bsgrub pa yi/ /in+d+ra byu ⑤ti'i gzhung gis bshad/ /rtsa ba'i sbubs ni gtso bo gsum/ /lus kyi nang na rnam par gnas/ /de rnams kyi ni khang pa dgu/ /bcu pa bla ma'i kha las so/ /ā li kā li yongs spangs shing / /phyag rgya'i yi ge mchog yin la/ /mi shigs rdo rje can gyis ni/ /lha mo rtag tu dran par bya/ /chags pa min pas mig gi sgo/ /chags dang bral min kha nyid yin/ /dbu ma sna rjozhes bshad pa ste/ /gnas gsum dag ni spang bar bya/ /stong pa shin tu rnal 'byor yod med mthus//nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde ⑦gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang ⑧dpal khrod bdag /stong pa nam mkha' zhes brjod cing / /stong pa bdag la rnam par gnas/ /stong pa cha las 'das pa dang / /mi shigs pa yi yi ger bshad/ /stong pa dngos po med pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnams bzhugs te/ /'byung ba bzhi sogs gong po ni/ /chos kyi dbyings su rab tu brtag /a ni me long lta 14—16

bur bshad/ /sa ni mnyam pa nyid du gyur/ /pra ni sgra brnyan lta bu ste/ /so sor rtog pa 'dra bar bshad/ /kri ni bya ba byed pas na/ /de ni bya ba sgrub par 'gyur/ /rkang mthil nas ni spyi mtha' ru/ /stong pa de ni dbus na gnas//sems can kun la rnams ①gnas nas/ /rtag tu rang nyid brjod par 'gyur/ /sdud par byed pas yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni ma lus pa'i—/ /lha ni du zhig rnam par bzhugs/ /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /de la dang po nyid du dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor ④ni—/ bde mchog tī li tī la'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig bde mchog shī li tī la zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje ①bde mchog tī li kri la zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje che bde mchog tī li tī la zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal tshangs pa'i mgo rdo rje'i mda' zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje sred med kyi bu zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug ces bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje 'dod pa'i lha mo zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje pad+ma rta gdong zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje nyi ma'i me zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje chos kyi dbyings yang dag par 'tsho ba zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje gling bu byed pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje pi wang gi dubade bas rab tu rmongs pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje mu kun da ⑤zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje rdza rnga zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje me tog ces bya ba'i phyag rgya dang /dpal rdo rje bdug pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje mar me zhes bya ba'i 14—17

phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje dri zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje lcags kyu zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje zhags pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang /dpal rdo rje lcags sgrog ①ces bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / dpal rdo rje dril bu zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya ste/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /nyi shu rtsa lngas yongs su bskor/ /sangs rgyas me tog phreng brgyan pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa bshad par bya/ /dang po sangs rgyas kun brjod ma/ /gnyis pa shin tu rgyal mo ste/ /gsum pa kun tu bzang mo yin/ /bzhi pa mi zad za ma tog /rdo rje sangs rgyas kun yan lag /de bzhin zhal bzang gzung ②ma dang / /sprin chen mo ni bdun pa ste/ /brgyad pa nam mkha'i spyan yin no/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bshad nas ni/ /he ru kar grags bstan par bya/ /dkar mo kun byed rab rmongs dang / /ro langs de bzhin spos byed ma/ /gtum mo sme sha nyid yin te/ /lha mo bdun po brda yis ni/ /nges par thams cad slong byed de/ /pad+mar gnas pa brgyad pa'o/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ni/ /lha mo brgyad kyis yongs bskor te/ /rnam par lta ba rnam dag dpal/ /sgrol ma blo gros mchog gyur dang / /'khor los sgyur nyid budhi ni/ /khro gnyer can de phyag rgya'i lam/ /lha mo dpal chen lnga pa ste/ /drug pa pad+ma la gnas pa/ /'dod pa'i dbang mo bdun pa yin/ /'gro ba gsum mo brgyad pa'o/ /rdo rje nyi ma mchod pa ni/ /brgyad kyis bskor rim bdag gis bshad/ /mda' gzhu dang ni ral gri dang / /gzi brjid 'bar ba gsum pa'o/ /dbang bskur ba ni bzhi pa ste/ /lag na gtor 'chang lnga pa yin/ /lag na rgyal mtshan drug pa ste—/ /mchod pa chen po bdun pa yin/ /brgyad pa lag na nyi ma ste/ /sna 14—18

tshogs gzugs can phyag bzhi pa/ /rta mgrin mchod pa gang yin pa/ /drag po'i sbyor bas bsgrub ①pa ste/ /lha mo nyi ma drug ma spridang / /de bzhin rab tu zhi ma dang / /dga' dang gdug ④dang nag mo dang / /'dod mi spyod pa'i chung mar bcas/ /dbang po'i chung ma'ang gang yin pa/ /drag po'i sbyor bas bsgrub rjopa'o/ /pi wang rol mo'i mchog gang dang / /lcags kyu la sogs sgo srung ⑤rnams/ /'khor lo kun la thun mong ste/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga'i rim pa yin—/ /sdud par byed pas yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya'i ye shes dang / /dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes dang / dpal he ru ka'i phyag rgya'i ye shes dang / dpal pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi phyag rgya'i ye shes dang / dpal rdo rje nyi ma'i phyag rgya'i ye shes dang / dpal rta mchog gi phyag rgya'i ye shes te/ 'di dag rnam pa ji lta bus/ /tshig 'di gsungs par gyur pa yin/ /phyi yi don bstan gang zhig yinabu/ /yang na ye shes mchog gyur gang / /ye shes 'di don ji lta bar/ /'di dag thams cad bshad du gsol/ /'di la bdag ni som nyi skyes/ /khyed ni mchod par 'os pa yin/ /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /phyag rgya lha mo yin par bshad/ /ye shes rdo rjer bstan pa ste/ /rang nyid kyi ni lha mo'i gzugs—/ /rab tu dam 'khyud 'o byed cing / /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgra 'dzin pas—/ /rig pa yid dang 'dra bar 'jog /byang chub sems kyi rnam 'phrul ba//lus kyi nang du 'ong bar ⑦bsam/ /pad+ma ku mud las byung ba'i/ /rjes su sbyor bas byed par 'gyur/ /'di dag thams cad bshad pa ni/ /rnam par shes par gang gis nus/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rgya ye shes/ /tshig gis khyod la 14—19

bstan pa yin/ /sdud par byed pas yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun ngo bo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /de nyid ji ltar shes par bgyi/ /in+d+ra byu ①ti'i gzhung ni gang / /rab bzhad rdo rje ji lta bu/ /gzhan gyi gzhung gis ji ltar bshad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /de dag thams cad bshad du gsol/ /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo'i sgra/ /sa ni dpal rnam par snang mdzad dang / dpal he ru ka dang / dpal pad+ma gar kyi dbang phyug dang /dpal rdo rje nyi ma dang / dpal rta mchog ste/ 'di dag nang du zhugs pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /slob dpon gzhan gyi gzhung 'di yin/ /gnyis pa'i gzhung ni bshad par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sgra yis ni/ /bcu drug khams rnams thams cad yin/ /phung po lnga yang de bzhin te/ /'byung ba lnga la sogs pa'i lus/ /thams cad sa bon dag las byung / /mchog ni bde bas 'byung ba zhes/ /rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung yin no/ /slob dpon gnyis pa'i gzhung 'di yin/ /gsum pa gzhan kyi gzhung gi brda/ /lha ru sbyor ba'i dus su ni/ /ba spu'i bu ga'i mtshams rnams su/ /gzugs kyi rang bzhin dkyil 'khor du/ /rtag par rgyun du bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas stong phrag du ma khruni/ /phyogs bcu rnams su spro bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gnas—/ /bde ba mchog la gnas pa'o/ /slob dpon gsum pa'i gzhung 'di yin—/ /in+d+ra byu ①ti'i gzhung nyon cig /sngags pas thig gis thig btab pa'i—/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu drug par/ /a sogs k+ṣa yi mthar thug par—/ /rim gyis dgod pa blang rjobar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo ni/ /14—20

yi ge thams cad yin par bshad/ /gang tshe tha ma'i gong ma ni/ /cha ①dang thig le rnams spangs la/ /dbus su yang dag gnas pa ste/ /mi mngon phra zhing zad pa med/ /byang chub sems mchog ye shes te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mi 'jigs pa'i/ /des ni rang nyid che ba'i lha/ /mchog tu bde la rnam par bzhugs—/ /'di ni mi shigs par bshad de/ /rang byung gasbug pu che ba'i lha//sangs rgyas thams cad yi ge'i tshogs/ /go rims ji bzhin yang dag sbyar/ /yi ge kun ni bde mchog gi/ /u dang thig le rnams spangs pa/ /k+ṣa yi mtha' ni spang bya ste/ /'dis ni sa bon gzugs can no/ /ka dang ṣar ldan zad mtha' can/ /ji ltar thar pa yin par bshad/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das—/ /gcig pu rab tu che ba'i lha/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos stong pa yi④/ /yi ge nyid ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi ji bzhin don/ /in+d+ra byu gti'i gzhung bzhin bshad/ /gcig pu min par rtag tu spyod/ /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /thig le gug skyed rnams spangs pa/ /gcig pu rab tu che ba'i lha/ /rdo rje can 'dis dbus na bzhugs/ /yi ge rnams kyis kun nas bskor/ /sdud par byed pas yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rol mo rgyas btab ye shes ni/ /ji bzhin don du ji ltar sbyar/ /nges pa'i lam ston ji lta bu—/ /rol mo'i dam tshig lam gang dhilags/ /te ru ka ni dpal rol mo/ /de bzhin pad+ma'i lam dang ni/ /rgyun gyi rnga dang de bzhin gzhan/ /rgyal po'i rol mo shin tu myur/ /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /snying po phyag rgya sngags rig dang / /bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /rnam par sel la sogs bya bas/ /rol mo'i phyag rgya rab tu gnas/ /gzhung gzhan rnam pa sna 14—21

tshogs dang / /sngags btu ba yi tshig rnams dang / /rigs kyi dbye ba rnam drug dang / /bdun pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /bdag la sgrub pa bzhin du bshad/ /de nyid mchog ni nges ston pa/ /rol mo kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /rgyud kyi rol mo bla med pa'o/ /'di la slob dpon mang po'i gzhung //gzhung gzhan sngags ni yin par smra/ /in+d+ra byu ①ti'i gzhung yang gzhan/ /rab bzhad ne+erdo rje'i gzhung nyon cig /rgyud bzhin 'bab pa'i rgyun gyis ni/ /sa bon rgyun kyis ①gang 'bab pa/ /khams rnams kyi rjoni gzhir ⑤gyur pas/ /des na 'di ni rgyud ces bya/ /in+d+ra bhū ti'i rjobashad pa'i gzhung / /gang 'dir kun kyi snying la gnas/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba yi/ /dha ni sems can kun rgyun yin/ /ra ni 'od zer yin par bshad/ /ba ni rdo rje can yin te—/ /h+ye ni lus zhes bshad pa yin/ /thams cad bdag nyid de bzhin gnas—/ /brtag par mi nus shes mi nus/ /lus med dbang po rnams dang bralaske/ /rgyun gyi rol mo yin par bshad/ /brtan pa'i lam ni ji lta bu/ /brtan pa'i lam gyi rol mo dang / /slob dpon la las bshad pa ni/ /brtan pa yod dang med pa ste/ /brtan pa bden pa nges mthong dang / /brtan pa smig rgyu'i mechu lta bu/ /brtan pa thams cad sgyu ma bzhin/ /brtan pa sa bon yin bshad pa/ /rab bzhad ⑧rdo rje'i gzhung yin no/ /in+d+ra byu ⑨ti'i gzhung ji bzhin/ /de ni bshad kyis bu khyod nyon/ /'di dag ⑩cha shas drug dang di/ /brtan pa rdo rje can nyid yin/ /brtan pa stong pa yin par bshad/ /brtan pa mar me rtse lta bu/ /brtan pa dbang po'i ⑪lam nyid ces/ /bla ma'i kha las ston pa yin/ /brtan pa sems zhes bshad pa ste/ /cha dang bral zhing sbas pa 14—22

yin—/ /gsum pa gtso bo'i rol mo yin①/ /dam tshig gsum gyi rol mo ni/ /grags pa kun ni bya ba ste/ /gar gyi dus kyi rol mo yin/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i dus dang ni/ /sku gzugs rnams la mchod pa na/ /rnal 'byor de nyid ma yin sems/ /byang chub sems ni rnam spong la/ /gzhung 'di nyid ni bshad pa yin/ /gzhan yang rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung / /tri ni gru gsum yin par bshad—/ /sa ni bud med thams cad yin/ /ma ni rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /thugs la gnas pa yin par bshad/ /ya ni gang zhes bshad pa yin/ /nam mkha'i gnas kyi sa bon yin/ /sa bon nyid kyang ba yis ni/ /gang zhig bshad pa'i rdo rje can/ /bye ni lus zhes gang bshad pa/ /bud med bha ga'i dbus gnas pa/ /rab bzhad rdo rjes slob ma la/ /dam tshig gsum gyi rol mor ②bshad/ /in+d+ra bhū ①ti'i gzhung gzhan ni/ /shākya'i bshes gnyen gyis zhus pa/ /tri ni rtsa sbubs gsum yin la/ /sa ni rjothams cad yin par bshad//ma ni bdag gi yin zhes ston/ /ya ni mi shigs gang yin pa'o/ /ba ni rtsa sbubs mang po ste/ /bye ni lus kyi dbus gnas pa/ /sku dang gsung thugs gsum gyis ni/ /rdo rje can ni bsgrub par bya/ /dam tshig gsum kyi rol bshad nas/ /pad+ma'i thal mo rtogs par bya/ /pad+ma'i thal mo rol mo che/ /pad+ma'e gar dbang 'byung ba'o/ /rol mo mang po rtag ⑤par ni/ /la la sngags ni yin par smra/ /pad+ma thal mo'i sgra yang yin/ /rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung nyon cig /rkan sogs mgo nas rkang pa'i bar/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam brgyan pa'i/ /rdo rje can ni thal mo ste/ /pad+ma'i sgras ni bde mchog go/ /de dag phyag rgya rab sbyor ba/ /pad+ma thal mo de bshad pa/ /rab bzhad rdo rje'i 14—23

gzhung yin te/ /de bzhin in+d+ra byu ①ti'i gzhung / /pad+ma thal mo'i bdag nyid che—/ /shākya bshes gnyen 'di nyon cig /pad+ma'i sgra yis pad+ma ni/ /dkyil 'khor lngar ldan yin par bshad/ /de ni gnyid log shes min zhing / /lus med dbang po rnams dang bral/ /bri ba nyid kyis de bskul zhing / /thal mo de gsum gsum yin no/ /de nas rdo rje can bskul nas/ /mngal 'dzin pa ni legs par bshad/ /te ru ka dpal dang ⑤'drar bshad④/ /don mang pha rol gnon sbas pa'o/ /shrī ni dang por yang dag ldan/ /hūṃ bh+yo'i sngags ni btu bar bya/ /khro bas 'khrug pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /slob dpon bo duṣaṭa smra bar byed—/ /yi ge gsum kyi rjodangos bzlas pa'i/ /cang te'u mtshan mo rdung byed na/ /ji snyed thos pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams/ /phyogs bcu rnams su sgra yang sgrogs/ /sgra ni stong rjopar mi byed cing / /ma mo rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gnon/ /gal te rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub pa lta 'dod na/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni g.yon pas blang / /mtshal can gyis bkang thod pa thogs/ /mi yi rgyu mas lus dkris te/ /rig pa dag ni sgrub pa yi/ /sha chen dag tu phyag rgya dang / /thal bas lus la bsgos pa dang / /sha yis bkang ba'i thod pa ni/ /phyag rgya'i lag pas sbyin par bya/ /smin ma la sogs bsgoms nas ni/ /bha ga'i pad+ma mchod par bya/ /bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du sgrub ④pa'o/ /der na skeyi ge phaṭa bsgrags bya/ /shing gcig drung ngam dur khrod dam/ /chu ngogs dag gam bzhi mdo ru/ /zla ba mar ngo'i bcu bzhi la/ /rgyal dang lhan cig brtul zhugs can//brtson 'grus brtan pas bgrod pa yis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu sgrub⑨/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /de la rtag tu phyag 'tshal zhing / /yid 14—24

la gang dag 'dod pa yi/ /nam mkhar spyod pa'i dngos grub ster/ /dngos grub kyi ni sbyor ba 'dis/ /slob dpon ku ku ras bsgrub ①pa/ /shākya'i bshes gnyen khyod la bshad/ /gzhan gyis slob ma gzhan la min/ /te ru ka yi rol mo gsang / /sbyor ②ba ngag gis bshad pa yin/ /gzhung 'di ji ltar smra ba ni/ /slob dpon in+d+ra bhū sneti yin/ /slob dpon rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung / /yi ge shrī ni rig par bshad/ /he ni sa bon yin par bshad/ /ru ni mtshal chen nyid yin zhing / /ka ni sku yi rdo rje'o/ /khrag 'thung rol mo bshad pa yin/ /shākya'i bshes gnyen kyis zhus pa/ /rgyal po'i rol mo rol mo gzhan/ /shin tu myur ba bshad du gsol/ /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rgyal po'i rol mo'i dkyil 'khor du/ / rtag par rgyun du brdung bar ni/ /la la rol mo nyid du 'dod/ /la la sngags ni yin par smra/ /'di 'dra'i don gyi gzhung mang la/ /rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhan yin te/ /rā ni mtshal chen yin par bshad/ /dza ni rkang pa'i nang gnas pa/ /ba ni mtshan dag yin par bshad—/ /bye rjoni lus su gyur pa yin/ /rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung yin te/ /in+d+ra byu ti'i gzhung nyon cig /rā ni gzi brjid yin par smra/ /steng gi sgo na rnam par gnas/ /dza ni gang du skye ba ste/ /chos kyi lte ba bha ga'i nang / /ba ni khams kyi gzugs can te/ /spu'i rtse mo brgyar gyur pa'i cha/ /bye 0ni snying gi pad+ma ru/ /byang chub sems ni rjordo rje can/ /dbang po kun las rnam 'das shing / /dbang po thams cad yongs spangs pa'o⑦/ /dbang po thams cad 'dzin rgyal po/ /rgyal po'i rol mor de 'gyur ro/ /sa dang chu dang me la sogs—/ /'byung ba kun gyi rgyal po yin/ /in+d+ra bhū ti'i gzhung 'di ni/ /14—25

shākya'i bshes gnyen la bshad pa'o/ /shin tu myur ba ①ji bzhin smra/ /gzhan yang bdag gis bshad par bya/ /a ni sngags su gyur pa yin/ /ti ni 'di yis gnas pa'o/ /dhū ni mtshal chen yin par bshad/ /ta ni sa bon nyid yin pa//rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung yin te②/ /in+d+ra bhū ti'i gzhung nyon cig /a zhes bya ba'i rim pa 'dis/ /bde mchog sgron ma la sogs pa/ /ti ni dngos po gsum spangs te/ /sku gsung thugs la reg pa la/ /dha ni nges pa thams cad sterka/ /ta ni mi zad de nyid yin/ /gzugs med gyur pa'i bde ba ni/ /reg pa'i bde ba tshor ba'o/ /yod dang med pa ma yin dang / /khams gsum thams cad bdag yin zhing / /myur bar zhu bar gyur pa yin④/ /byang chub sems su rnam par 'phrul/ /shin tu myur ba'i sgrar grags pa/ /bdag gis phye ste bshad pa yin/ /in+d+ra bhū ti'i gzhung 'di ste/ /shin tu myur ba mi rtag pa'o//sdud par byed pas yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /slob dpon in+d+ra bhū ti lha/ /bdag ni be+er yang zhu bar 'tshal/ /slob dpon rab bzhad rdo rje dang / /slob dpon gzhan gyi gzhung rnams kyi/ /rol mo'i don rnams mang po dang / /ā li kā li sngags bcas dang / /gsang ba'i gzhung gi don mang dang / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni cho ga'i rim/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla dang / /ṭā ni nam mkha' 'gro ba'i sgra/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /lha yi ji bzhin bka' stsal cing / /sngags rnams kyang ni gsal bar mdzad/ /de nas shākya'i bshes gnyen la/ /slob dpon gyis ni legs zhes gnang / /'di 'dra'i gzhung ni thos pa dang / /stan ni yongs su spangs nas kyang / /pus mo sa la bzhag nas ni/ /bdag nyid 14—26

yongs su phul bar gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /gnas ni gang du bzhugs gyur pa/ /brtan g.yo kun la rol mdzad pa/ bcom ldan lha yis bshad du gsol/ /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul ba/ /shākya tshul bzhin mnyan par gyis/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs par/ /gang zhig sngar ni bshad pa nyid/ /dkyil 'khor lus ni yin par bshad/ /de ni sgo dgu dag tu 'gyur/ /de la lte ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa zhes byar bshad/ /rdo rje can ni der bzhugs pa/ /cha med cha ni rnam spangs pa/ /lus can rnams kyi nang na rol/ /lus las 'das shing gos pa med/ /la lar gzugs can dag tu bzhugs/ /la lar snang dang kha dag dang / /la lar rna ba sgra dag dang / /la lar dri chen rdo rje chu/ /la lar tshor dang bcas pa'i sems/ /la lar skom dang la lar bkres—/ /la lar khro dang la lar zhi/ /ma①la lar bde la rnam par gzigs/ /la lar bud med 'dod chags de/ /la lar gsod dang 'joms pa ste/ /la lar rol mo brdung bar mdzad/ /la lar me tog 'bras bur gnas/ /la lar rol zhing spyod par 'gyur/ /la lar srod tu rnam par gnas/ /la lar sa dang chu dang me/ /la lar 'byung ba chen po lnga/ /la lar rigs kyi bye brag gis//bram ze dang ni gdol pa dag /la lar ma dang sring mo ru/ /la lar chung ma bu mo ru/ /la lar tshangs dang dbang ldan dang / /khyab 'jug dang ni nyi ma nyid—/ /la lar zla ba skar mas bcas/ /la lar nyin dang mtshan mor gyur/ /la lar khams gsum pa rnams kun/ /byed pa po dang mi zad rgyal/ / la lar rgyu dang mi rgyu bar/ /④la lar shi ba'i dbang gis zhum/ /mi gsal stong pa'i 14—27

rdo rje can/ /la lar byang chub chen por gshegs/ /la lar pha rol bdud las rgyal/ /la lar byis pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /la lar rgas shing 'khogs pa'o—/ /la lar nad chen gyis zin pa/ /la lar sngo dang le brgan dang / /la lar dkar dang ser ba'o/ /la lar sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /la lar sgron ma gos dkar mo/ /la lar spyan dang mā ma tī/ /la lar dka' zlog zhi ba mo—/ /la lar 'dab chags mkha' lding dang / /nam mkha' dang ni mkha' 'gro nyid/ /la lar klu dang sbrul chen po/ /la lar smad 'tshong spre'u dang ni/ / la lar rmi lam mthong ba dang / /①la lar gnyid ni log pas gnas/ /la lar rlung dang mkhris pa dang / /la lar khrag dang pags par 'gyur/ /la lar mya ngan ngu ba dang / /la lar bsreg pa'i mi dag yin/ /la lar mtho ris skye ba ste/ /rnam par 'phrul ba 'di lta bu/ /thams cad bdag nyid bzhugs 'di la/ /in+d+ra byu ti'i ①bshad pa yin/ /lha gang cha ni rnam spangs pa'i/ /de yi sgyu ma sna tshogs 'di/ /rtag pa min pa rdo rje can/ /gzugs med par ni bha ga'i nang / /lte ba'i nang na pad+ma che/ /bcu drug thig gis zig btab par//yi ge dang yang mnyam sbyor bas/ /bskor ba'i bya ba byas pa yin/ /de dbus rtag tu gsang ba ni/ /'byin dang sdud pa byed pa'o/ /de ni rang nyid rdo rje can—/ /gcig pu rang 'byung che ba'i lha/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun dngos zhes//mtshan ni rab tu bshad pa yin/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa la/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /thams cad mkhyen pas 'di bshad pa'am/ /yang na mi shigs kun mkhyen pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos por ni/ /la lar lha mo'i tshogs la 'dod/ /bcom ldan lha yi rnal 'byor ni/ /sngags dang 14—28

phyag rgya bsdus pa yin/ /bsam gtan dag ni ji ltar bgyi/ /lha ni ji ltar bskyed par bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor gnas ni gang dag tu/ /lha rnams rnal 'byor bsgom pa rnams/ /gtso bo 'di dag the tshom gyur/ /de dag thams cad bshad du gsol/ /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lung dang bstan bcos shes pa dang / /snyan dngags byed pa nyid dang yang / /slob dpon mang po'i gzhung thos nas/ /bdag gi gzhung 'di zab gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin pa po/ /shākya blo gros chen po nyon/ /dang po chags las rnam rgyal zhing / /de bzhin zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal de bzhin khro ba dang / /sred dang sdug bsngal bkres skom dang / /bde ba med cing chags bral ba/ /mdza' bshes dang ni dgrar mnyam pas/ /gal te dngos grub 'dod gyur na/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /lus gnas bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dang po stong pa bsgom par bya/ /shin tu phra ba'i rlung gi ngos①/ /phra rab drug tu phye ba yis/ /sgo dgu po ni thams cad dag /rtag tu de yis dbye bar bya/ /steng gi sgor ni nges 'byung bar/ /sngags pas rtag tu bsam par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par ni/ /④bha ga'i dbus gnas bsgom par bya/ /der ni stong nyid dbus gnas par/ /bsgoms nas glu ni brjod par bya/ /stong pa yod med shin tu rnal 'byor mthus//nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig ①nye bar gnas/ /bde ④gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /oṃ las dkyil 'khor bya ba ste/ /zur gsum du ni dkyil 'khor bsgom—/ /yi ge a las pad+ma te/ /'dab brgyad lte bar bcas pa bsgom/ /14—29

rtag tu stong pa nam mkha' lnga/ /dbu dang thig ler rnam brgyan zhing / /zla ba'i phyed dang ldan pa ni/ /yi ge mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas bye ba stong phrag ni/ /phyogs bcu rnams su spro bar bya/ /rang gi ngo bo'i rigs dbye bas—/ /lha ni de ru bskyed par bya/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa dang / /brgya 'am yang na stong nyid du/ /sgrub pa po ni ci 'dod par/ /bsam gtan du ni brtag par bya/ /sngags pas yang ni rtag stong pa/ /a yis mnan cing brgyan pa la/ /ra ni stan du dgram bya ba/ bde mchog sgron ma la sogs pa/ /lha rnams bskyed pa 'di yis ni/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /rang gi lha yi rim pa yi①/ /der ni snying po brjod par bya/ /phyag rgya rnams kyis yongs bskor nas/ /sngags pas yongs su rdzogs par bsgom/ /dri chu mtshal ni chen po dang / /der ni mchod par rab tu bya/ /sha chen sa bon dag dang yang / /rtag tu mchod pa rim bzhin brtsam/ /ji srid skyo bar ma gyur par/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /slar yang bdag gis gsang sngags kyi/ /lha yi bzlas brjod dag kyang bya/ /spos dang me tog byug pa dang / /glu gar nye bar mchod pa dang / /mchod yon yang dang yang phul nas/ /de 'og lha rnams gshegs su gsol/ /sngags pas lha rnams spyan drangs nas/ /bdag gi snying ni dgang bar bya/ /sngags pa ting 'dzin la gnas nas/ /bdag nyid rnam par sel bas ni/ /stong pa nyid du bsgoms nas su/ /steng gi sgo nas zhugs par bya/ /chos kyi 'khor lo lte ba che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis yongs bskor pa/ /rang gi rigs kyi lha dag ni/ /stong pa'i dbus gnas bsgom par bya—/ /dmar chen dang ni ga pur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar po bza' bya zhing / /14—30

tshogs kyi dbus su bzhag pa ni/ /ra sa ya na kun slong ba'o/ /gang zhig de yi rigs gyur pa'i/ /bud med thams cad spyad bya ste/ /gsang sngags yi ge gsum gyi lus/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /hūṃ ①ni bha ga'i dbus gnas shing / /hūṃ las rdo rjer gyur pa ni/ /bsams nas sngags pas las rigs bya/ /cho ga yis ni rdzas rnams bza'/ /bgegs rnams 'dul ba'i khro bo ni/ /bdud rtsi thab sbyor las byung ba/ /de dang dmar chen tsan+dan bcas/ /bdud rtsi dag ni bza' ba ni/ /las rnams thams cad byed par bshad/ /de bzhin dbang dang dgug pa la/ /dang po bdud rtsi thab sbyor zhes/ grags pa sngags pas brjod par bya/ /de nas skal bzang rnal 'byor pa'i/ /sgrub pa pos ni bltas tsam gyis/ /sa stengs sdebud med ji rnyed pa①/ /'chi ba dag kyang rjes su 'gro/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs mo/ /rigs ngan spe sha khrus mkhan ma/ /'dug pa 'am ni ldang ba'ang rung / /gang du 'dod pa spyad par bya/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /phyag rgyar bcas bdag sngags rig pas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bsgrub bya zhing / /bha gar bdud rtsi bza' bar bya/ /bha ga'i pad+ma reg bya zhing / /ro 'dzin pa yang bskyod par bya/ /rnyog pa med pa'i byang chub sems/ /de yis sangs rgyas nyid 'grub 'gyur/ /de yi dus su rang gi lha'i/ /sbyor ba dag ni mi bya min/ /skye bo med cing dben pa dang / /gsang zhing bzang ba'i gnas gcig tu/ /rang gi lha yi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /byang chub sems ni rab 'bad pas/ /su la'ang sbyin par mi bya'o/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor brtul zhugs can/ /gsang sngags de yang brjod mi bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom pa 14—31

dag /'di ni byang chub yin par bstan/ /ji ltar gzugs ni rnam gnon pa//gzhan yang yang dag bshad par bya/ /slob dpon la las bshad pa ni/ /rnam snang dpal gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /cho ga bzhin du dbang bskur nas/ /bsam bzlas cho ga'i rim gyis ni/ /gang tshe de la mi 'grub ①na/ /rkang pas mnan nas bzlas byas te/ /lugs ma'am 'bur du brkos pa'ang rung / /gang gzhan khro bo'i ⑧lha rnams ni/ /slob dpon khro la zhen pa yis/ /gzugs rnams thams cad mnan par bya/ /rkang pa rkyong snedang gnon pa dang / /drag po'i sbyor bas de bzhin du/ /rdo rje nyi ma spyan rjobya zhing / /de bzhin rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin du ni rta mchog go/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa dang / /de bzhin mkha' 'gro thams cad sbyad/ /'di la slob dpon gzhung mang ste/ /gzhan dang gzhan du ston par byed/ /sngags kyis rjogazugs dag rjomanan pa la/ /'di lta bu yi don ston te/ /gzugs ni sgrub pa po yi lus/ /rigs kyi dbye bas mnan par bya/ /mnan pa sgom ⑦pa zhes bshad pas/ /bdag gis thams cad bsgom par bya/ /sngags pa grub par gyur pa ni/ /phongs pa kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rab bzhad rdo rje yis/ /gnas 'dir gzhung du gyur pa ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad dpal gyi sgra/ /sa bon nyid ni yin par bshad/ /stong pa'i rdo rje las byung bas/ /de tshe rdo rje nyi mar gyur⑧/ /de nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /pad+ma gar dbang ngo bo'ang de/ /skyes pa bud med gzugs rnams ni/ /de yis thams cad mnan pa yin/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa dang / /de bzhin mkha' 'gro ma kun spyad/ /byang chub sems kyi rnam 'phrul ba/ /de nyid byed 14—32

pa rang nyid gtso/ /gsang ba ①mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /rkang pa rkyong ④dang gnon pa dang / /bskums ④nas 'degs pa'i stobs dag gis/ /kun byed sa bon byed pa ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can 'gro bskyed pa/ /rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung yin te/ /slob dpon ku ku ra yis sdegazhan/ /dkar mo rku byed mar ldan pa'i/ /he ru ka yis kun mnan te/ /dpal ldan rnam snang tshangs la sogs/ /za zhing mtshal chen 'thung bar byed/ /rdo rje can gyi ⑤slar bslangs nas/ /thal bar gyur pa'ang 'tsho bar byed/ /bsgom bya'i gzhung ni 'di lta bu/ /grub pa slob dpon ku ku ra'i/ /slob dpon gzhan gyis bshad pa ni/ /shākya'i bshes gnyen mnyan par kyis/ /gzugs nyid rnam par snang mdzad dpal/ /sgra ni rdo rje nyi ma yin/ /dri ni rta mgrin yin par bshad/ /pags pa rus pa he ru ka /tshigs ni pad+ma gar dbang yin/ /sems ni bde ba chen po'o/ /lus kyi rjogazugs su rnam par bshad/ /gnon pa rim bzhin spyad pa'o/ /'byor pa rgyal po rol mo che/ /bud med kun kyi ⑦gsang ba'o/ /slob dpon gzhan dag 'di ltar 'dod/ /'dod chags rnam par snang mdzad yin/ /zhe sdang rdo rje rigs su bshad/ /gti mug de bzhin pad+ma'i rigs/ /nga rgyal rdo rje nyi ma yin//khro bo nyid ni he ru ka /sred pa rta mgrin yin par bshad/ /gang gzhan bud med longs spyod cing / /drag po'i sbyor bas longs spyod la/ /sna tshogs phyag rgyas yongs bskor nas/ /gzugs kyi sgra ni mtshan yin te/ /lus nyid kyang ni gzugs yin no/ /rim pa 'di yi ⑧sbyor ba yis/ /'di ni 'di 'dra ston byed pa| /slob dpon mang po'i gzhung 'di yin/ /in+d+ra bhū ⑨ti'i gzhung nyon cig /14—33

sangs rgyas kyi ①ni dkyil 'khor gcig /gnyis pa rdo rje nyi ma yi/ /gsum pa gar gyi dbang phyug gi/ /bzhi pa rta mchog nyid kyi yin/ /rdo rje 'dzin par bshad pa yi/ /he ru ka ni lnga pa yin/ /dga' ba chen po rol pa yis rdo rje sems dpa' kun nas mnan/ /gang zhig bde chen grub pa yi/ /sgrub pa po yi yon tan 'di/ /rtog pa dag ni bzhi pa ru/ /sngar ni bshad pa mdzad pa yi—/ /rkang pa rkyong sdedang gnon pa dang / /bskums nas 'degs pa'i stobs dag gis/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /khro bos thams cad mnan par bya/ /sbyor ba thams cad spyad na ①ni/ /rtag tu don ni 'grub par 'gyur//shes rab pha rol phyin pa dang / /de bzhin mkha' 'gro thams cad spyad/ /'di la mi sbyin ci yang med/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi don bya ba/ /'gro ba dang ni byed pa dang / /dpung rnams thams cad rab 'joms par/ /rdo rje can gyis gang gsungs pa/ /gang zhig bde chen grub gyur pa'i/ /sngags pa yis ni thams cad bya/ /de la ngan 'go yod min te/ /rtag tu sgrub pa por 'gyur ro//gdug pa rnams ni gdul ba'i phyir/ /khro bo'i rgyal por de sprul cing / /rdo rje pad+ma'i sbyor chen kyis/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba la/ /sngags pa gang zhig mngon slob pa/ /sems kun las ni legs byung ba/ /sangs rgyas chags pa rdo rje can/ /gang tshe sngar ni des bshad pa/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba dag /rnal 'byor yang dag ma yin sems—/ /gzugs brnyan la ni bsgom rjopa ste/ /lugs ma'am 'bur du brkos pa 'am/ /bris par gang dag gyur pa la'o/ /yang dag mchog sems rnal 'byor pa/ /byang chub sems ni rnam par bsgom/ /rang nyid kyi ni nang 14—34

dag na/ /gang zhig stong par rnam gnas pa/ /byang chub sems ni stong pa ste/ /rdo rje rnam snang rang nyid do/ /de nyid chags dang chags bral dang / /srid dang grol bar gyur pa yin/ /brtan dang g.yo ba sna tshogs pa/ /thams cad du ni 'di 'gyur ro/ /gtan tshigs des na bdag nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad nyid du shar①/ /rang gi che ba lha yi ④sgras/ /rang gi stong pa'i rdo rje can/ /bde ba'i mchog la tshig ⑦'di nyid/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad gsungs/ /bde mchog sngon ni byung ba rnams/ /mi yi 'jig rten dag tu sgogs—/ /ma lus 'jig rten gsum rgyal srid/ /'jig rten dbang phyug kun dang bcas/ / don mthong rjostobs kyis phrogs nas ni/ /de ni dad la sbyin par byed/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /phrogs nas kyang ni sbyin byed na/ /las mchog dang ni rab 'byams dang / /dngos grub dang ni ji zhig smos/ /'di ni in+d+ra bhū ⑤ti'i gzhung / /yon tan sgrub par byed pa nyid/ /dbang po gang dag gang lam gyur/ /de dang de yi ngo bor te/ /mnyam par ma bzhag sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par sbyor/ /mig gi lam gyur gzugs rnams te/ /de la rnam par snang mdzad gnas/ /rna ba rdo rje nyi ma ste/ /sgra yang der ni rab tu bsgrags/ /sna yi lam du rta mgrin te/ /dri yi lam du'ang bshad pa yin/ /lce lam pad+ma zhes bya ba/ /pad+ma gar dbang ro yang yin/ /sems kyi lam ni gzugs med par/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par gnas/ /pags pa rus pa rkang dag dang / /khrag dang rgyu ma te ru ka'o/ /de ltar dbang po lam rnams ni/ /ngo bo nyid kyis tha dad pa'o/ /mnyam par ma bzhag sbyor ba ni/ /gzhung ni mang du bshad pa yod/ /la la'i gzhung ni mi 14—35

rtag pa/ /ldang ba'am gang yang rung ba dang / /'dug dang 'chag pa dag la'ang rung / / rtag tu sangs rgyas dngos por bsgom/ /①mnyam par ma bzhag pa yi gzhung / /rab bzhad rdo rjes mnyan ②par kyis/ /dbang po gang dang gang sgom na①/ /'ongs pa'i rdzas ni yang dag blang / /de dang de ni sa bon 'gyur/ /sngags nyid mnyam par ma bzhag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos bsams la/ /thams cad rdo rje can du sbyor/ /pad+ma'i snod du bzhag nas ni/ /lag pa g.yon du sgrub pa pos/ /g.yas pa yi ni lag pa yisarjo/ /ba dan gsum pas bza' bar bya/ /rab tu bzhad pa'i rdo rje yis/ /mnyam par ma gzhag sngags su bshad/ /⑤oṃ a sa ma ṭī haṃ rjo.aḥ.a/ rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung yin te/ /gzhan dag gi ni gzhung gnyis pa/ /mnyam par ma bzhag ming gis ni/ /stong pa mi shigs pa yi gzhung / /chos kyi 'khor lo lte ba cherarka/ /des ni thams cad sad par byed/ /des na 'di ni sangs rgyas kun//mi mnyam nam mkha' la gnas pa'o/ /de yi yon tan brtag pa ni/ /mnyam med ces bya'i bstod pa yi/ /'di la gzhung ni gzhan ci'ang ⑦rung / /bdag gis ⑧bshad pa yod ma yin/ /rigs kyi dbye bar la lar 'dod/ /sku gsum du ni la la 'chad/ /a ni chos kyi sku yin la/ /ma rgo mkha' 'go la brtan pa/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i bshad pa'o/ /sa ni mnyam med mi g.yo ba'o/ /rab bzhad rdo rje'i bshad pa ni/ /a ni sa bon nyid yin la/ /sa ni skye 'go thams cad de/ /ma ni sha dang pags pa yi/ /gal te sa bon mi spyod na/ /myur tu rtag par gsod par byed/ /g.yo dang g.yo bas legs par ni/ /bha ga nyid khams rdo rje can/ /'dis ni sa bon bstan ⑨pa ste/ /de la 'dir ni bstod 14—36

bshad pa'o/ /sngon ni shākyas bskul ba yi/ /rang byung gcig pu che ba'i lha/ /sbyor ba la las bshad pa yin/ /lha nyid kyis ni rnal 'byor yin/ /la la sna tshogs pad+ma'i ras/ /gzhung du mkhas pa la la 'dod/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /phyag rgyas bstod pa 'don par byed/ /sna tshogs mchod pa du ma ste/ /ras la pad+ma bri bar bya/ /bla bye bsgrengs 1nas bri bya zhing / /bsgrub pa'i stan ni 'dzom par byed2/ /lha mo rnams kyi rang gi mtshan/ /gos dang rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa/ /bzhag nas rig pa mchod bya'i phyir/ /yang dang yang du spyad par bya/ /phyi nas mnyam med mi g.yo ba'i/ /bstod pa dbyangs su gdon par bya/ /sdud par byed pas 4yang 'di skad ces gsol to//sna tshogs ras kyis bkab pa yi/ /thams cad dag pa'i stan de ni/ /rang gi gzhung ni gang yin pa/ /rab tu brtse bas bshad du gsol/ /slob dbon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /sna tshogs rdo rje zhes bshad pa/ /pad+ma'i sgra ni bde mchog yin/ /ras kyi sgra ni pags par bshad/ /thams cad dag pa sa bon yin/ /stan ni bha ga zhes bshad de/ /gang du rnal 'byor pas rol pa/ /rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung yin te/ /in+d+ra bhū 5ti'i gzhung nyon cig /sna tshogs du ma zhes bshad de/ /bstod 6pa mkha' dang mtshungs pa'o/ /pad+ma gnas su gyur pa yin/ /ras ni de yi 7pags pa yin/ /bkab pa sgrub pa yin par bshad / /bha ga thams cad dag pa'i stan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyi lha//de nyid du ni rnam par rol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mnyam spyor ba/ /gcig pu bsdus pa'i bya ba mdzad/ /nang gi gzhung ni 'di yin te/ /phyi yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ /in+d+ra bhū 9snati'i bshad gzhung gis/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 74—37

—bya ba yin/ /tshes brgyad dang ni bcu bzhi pa/ /rnal 'byor ma dang bla ma mchod / /dmar chen tsan+dan bcas pa yi/ /rdzas ni 'di yis bza' bar byas1/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /gal te cung zad sgrub 'dod na/ /gang zhig bya ba dang bral bas/ /sgrub pa 'ga' zhig brtsam par bya/ /sbyin sreg las ni mi bya zhing / /bzlas brjod ma yin gzung ma yin/ /bsnyung ba brtul zhugs mchod med par/ /de yis dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /sdud par byed nga/sa yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan phyag mtshan bshad du gsol/ /nge bzhin 'dod chags che las byung / /de bzhin lha mo'i sngags rnams dang / /chos sgos dang ni lhung bzed nyid/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las bshad pa yi/ /nge bzhin glegs bam mkhar gsil gsung / /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces sasu ngas/ so// /'dod chags chen po las byung ba/ /gzhon nu bdag po dang 'dus khrag /tsan+dan dang ni sha chen te/ /gci ba rdo rje chu zhes bya/ /rdo rje bcas/ nga/'i dri bshad pa'o/ /pad+ma'i snod ni kā pa la/ /sgrub 4pas tshogs kyi dkyi'/ 'khor du/ /rdzas de der ni brtag par bya/ /bde mchog sa bon ho zhes bya/ /brda yi tshig gis chos gos yin/ /kye ma'o 6bde ba zhes bya ba'i/ /dza yi sa bon lhung bzed yin/ /sgon ma'i yi ge ba yang yin/ /brda yi tshig bis/ mkhar gsil yin/ /sha shi'i yi ge ha yang yin/ /sa bon lnga dang ldan gyur nga// /sangs rgyas ming gis sbas pa ste/ /de nyid ming ni glegs bam mo/ /pad+ma gar dbang phyag rgya ni/ /pad+mar ldan pa'i yi ge hūṃ/ /hūṃ bh+yo t+t+waṃ zhes btus pa'i sngags/ /sngags ni he ru ka 'byung ba'o/ /phyag rgya rnams ni dril bu nyid/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor bshad/ /rmi ṭ+wāṃ bī bi rdza rdza dze+e baṃ/ rdo rje nyi ma'i lha 7 7—38

— byed—byedabyedabyedamo rnams/ /oṃ oṃ nyid de stong pa ste/ /dze+e baṃ di do de bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor brtul zhugs can/ /de nas gsang sngags brjod par bya/ /gzhan gyi 'gros ni rol pa ste/ /yi ge u ni ring 1rab 'gyur/ /gang gzhan drag po'i spyor ba ni/ /rta mchog gi ste mtha' yas pa'o/ /sna tshogs pad+mar de bshad pa/ /bde mchog kye ma bde ba dang / /sna tshogs/ pad+ma'ang sha shi ste/ /sgrol ma de ni bzhi pa'o/ /lha mo rnams kyi sngags bshad pa/ /sa bon lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /stong pa drug par yang dag sbya/ra/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rim pa nyon/ /sngar ni bshad pa byas pa'i tshig /gnas ni shes rab bha ga ste/ /der ni pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ /lte ba la ni bde chen ngo// /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi kun du yang / /de yi rnam nga/ra bri bar bya/ /dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad / /lte ba la ni lhar bcas pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs/ can phyag bzhi pa'i//phyag rgya 'dab ma rnams la bri/ /dgu pa la ni sgra 'dzin pas/ /rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya bri/ /ngos 'a/ me tog bdug pa spos/ /lcags kyu la so/gas sgo srung bri/ /rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung yin te/ /in+d+ra byu ti'i gzhung yang yin/ /gnas 'dir gzhung ni 4'di lta bus/ /bri ba'i dkyil 'khor bya ba yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' te ru kar/ /gang zhig dbang ni bsgur gyur pa/ /de dang rnam par snang mdzad zhal/ /de yi dbus su rang gi lha/ /cho ga 'dis ni mchod bya zhing / /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mnyes par bya/ /sdud par byed pas yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan sgra ni gang du basbu/ /de bzhin der ni bcom ldan gang / /de bzhin rgyud kyi sgra dag dang / /rtog pa'i sgra yang bshad du gsol/ /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /de la 7 7—39

bha ni bha ga ste/ /ga ni nam mkha' yin par bshad/ /bān 1ni stong pa nyid rdo rje / /der ni sgra de lus de ste/ /der ni rtsa yis thig btab bo/ /ta ni byang chub sems yin la/ /tri ni rnam pa gsum pa ste/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams ni/ /gsang bar bcas — pas rtag tu brtag /rtog pa zhes bshad khang pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bya bar gsungs pas na/ /rtog pa'i sgra ni de bshad debye //ngan par spyod pa'ang mnyan par gyis/ /ngan par spyod pa smad 'tshong ma/ /gal te dngos grub sgrub 'dod na/ /dga' ston dang ni bde rnyed par/ /rang gi rdo rje can dang ldan/ /'ang gi sgra ni nges pa ste/ /smad 'tshong ma 'dis 'grub par 'gyur/ /bha ga'i nang gi rtsa sbubs gnyis/ /ngan par spyod pa yin par bshad5/ /gzhon nu'i mtshal chen sa bon dag /legs par rnyed pa nyid dga' bstan/ /las kyi rigs ni bsgoms nas su/ /bud med thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /slob dpon gnyis pa'i gzhung 'di yin/ /slob dpon rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung / /in+d+ra bhū ti'i gzhung gis ni/ /ji ltar ngan spyod 'grub par bshad/ /ngan par spyod pa rdo rje can/ /gzhir gyur sa bon ngo bo nyid / /bde mchog rtag tu spyod pa ste/ /bha ga nang gi ling gar ro/ /'ang gi sgra ni nges par te6/ /bde ba chen po de 'thob pa'o/ /rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung bshad nas/ /in+d+ra bhū ta'i gzhung nyon cig /gug skyed gnyis dang rnam bral ba/ /ngan par spyod pa rnam par bshad/ /de ni thams cad sgyu ma nyid / /bud gred gzugs su'ang de gnas pa/ /ngan par spyod pa zhes bshad de/ /stong pa rdo rje mkha' la gnas/ /rnyed pa kun dang bde spyod pas/ /ngan par spyod pa'ang 3'grub 'gyur na/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /zhi ba la ni 74— 40

smos ci dgos/ /slob dpon gzhan dag 'chad pa ni/ /yi ge gnyis ni sgom byed te/ /haṃ 3ni rdo rje can du bshad/ /a ni bud med 'di yin te/ /yi ge gnyis kyi ming dag ni/ /ngan par spyod pa rnam par bshad/ /rnyed dang bde ba thams cad kyis/ /bud med 'di ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /shākya 'di ni mngon sum du/ /rdo rje sems dpas rab tu gsungs/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid dag gis ni/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu ma bshad/ /sku ni yongs su ma bsgyur bas/ /bde mchog rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /bsgoms dang bsam gtan 'dzin pa yi2/ /de la 'dod chags yod ma yin/ /de bzhin chags dang bral ba dang / /dbu ma'ang dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /phra ba'i gzugs can mkha' la gnas/ /lha mo de ni dmigs mi 'gyur/ /bde mchog byed par byas nas ni/ /brtan dang g.yo ba rnams la gnas/ /rang gi gzugs ni yongs gyur pas/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu mar bshad/ /khams rnams dang ni lus nyid ni/ /lha mo bde mchog yin par bshad/ /sna tshogs du mar bshad pa ste/ /sangs rgyas rol mo rdo rje can/ /chos rnams rnam par mi rtog cing / /stong nyid nam mkha' 'dra ba las/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /yongs su rtog pa gsungs pa yin / /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /dbu ma dmigs par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /stong nyid gsum bshad bde mchog gi5/ /sgra brnyan lta bu'i tshig tu thos/ /dngos med mtshan ma med pa nabye/ /phyi dang nang du bcas na gnas/ /snying ga'i mkha' dang phyi rol nasabye/ /de bzhin 'char dang nub pa ru/ /rtag tu rdo rje can rol kyang / /rang gi sku ni snang mi 'gyur/ /stong nyid gcig pu'ang ma yin te/ /de bzhin sprul pa'i skur mdzad do/ /stong nyid min pa'ang ma yin sgra//14—41

chos kyi sgu ni yin par bshad/ /dbu ma ming med ces grags te/ /lte ba'i dbus na rnam par gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i ming / /bde mchog rdo rje can du bshad/ /rna'/ 'byor sgra ni mnyam spyor ba/ /u ni stong pa nyid yin pas/ /rnal 'byor stong nyid rdo rje can/ /u nyid kyang ni bde mchog go/ /cha dang thig ler rnam brgyan na/ /thabs ni thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kyis 'dus thams cad la/ /sems can kun don bla med pa/ /cha me+ed rtag tu rdo rje can/ /cha de yod pa ma yin pa/ /rlung gi gzugs su gnyid log 1nga// /de las sprul par 'gyur ba yin/ /sa bon khams rnams 'dzin byed cing / /khams rnams thams cad nyid kyang ngo / /de bas chos kyi skur 'gyur ba/ /gang tshe stong nyid thig ler bcas/ /gang tshe de yi gug skyed dang //cha dang zla phyed byung gyur pa/ /de tshe 'dir ni sku yi sgrar/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa chen por bshad/ /lte ba'i dbus na pad+ma che / /bcu drug thig gis thig btab pa/ /de dbus rtag tu stong pa yin/ / g.yas pa 4mchog la zhugs nga/ yin / /dbang po gnyis kyis mnyam sbyor bas/ /thams cad bskyed par ma/dzad nga/ yin/ /chos kyi sgu ni byung gyur nas/ /de 'og mi rnams byung ba yin//rtag tu gzugs med rdo rje can/ /rtag tu sbrum ma'i bu bzhin no/ /sdud par byed pas yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan dang / /de bzhin spyi bor nor bu 'ching / /rtag du'i sgra ni ji lta bu/ /bcom ldan bla mas bshad du gsol/ /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu 6rgyan ni/ /te ru ka yi dbang bsgur ba'o/ /slob dpon mang pos rab tu bshad/ /rab bzhad rdo rje'i gzhung yin te/ /thod pa lus 7 1—42
