kyi re'u char bum pa gang ba bzhi/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan rgyan dang mtshan mas mdzes / /re'u mig phyi ma kun du 'khor lo'i tshul/ /mtshams med rdo rje'i phreng ba dag dang ldan/ /phyi rol ra ba rim gsum gnas pa'i rgyab/ /phyi yi lcags ri rdo rje ra ba'i nang / /phyogs dang mtshams su dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /shing brgyad ngos ni zhing skyong lus phyed ston/ /gdong pa phyogs spyong brgyad kyi gdan dang mthun1/ /g.yas kyis gri gug nagayon na thod pa 'dzin/ /mtsho brgyad nang na klu brgyad lus phyed ston// /thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan phyogs su gus / /shing brgyad drung du rnal 'byor 'khor bcas gnas/ /sprin dang mchod rten rang 'byung mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /ro langs sha za 'byung po mang gnas shing / /ro dang bya khyi ce spyang rnam par 'dres/ /de dus drag byed mkha' 'gro lha tshogs la/ /'dzam bu'i gling bzhin dur khrod rnam par snang / /phyi rol dpag bsam bum pa bya dang shing / /'dod pa'i longs spyod kun gyis rnam par mdzes/ /dbus kyi pad+ma'i gdan dag la/ /dpal mchog dang po bzhugs mdzad de/ /chos kun stong nyid mtshan mar bral/ /smon med rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i/ /ting 'dzin la bzhugs byams par gnas/ /'gog pa'i rang bzhin la gnas pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bsgul mdzad de/ /mngon byang lnga yis sdogs sgur gyur/ /rang sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /a yig bcu drug gnas pa la4/ /thugs rje chen po shar byed pa'i/ /nyi dkyil ka yig sum cu bzhi/ /lce rtsa can bzhi mi gsal gnyis/ /skar ma'i gzugs 'dra bsgom par bya/ /de dag 'phro zhing 'dus pa yis/ /tshogs gnyis mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs/ /ye shes dang po gnyis ston cing / /byang chub sems 14—310

gnyis mtshan nyid do/ /gsum pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /dkar gsal dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan/ /bum par hūṃ mtshan rnam gsal ba/ /tshogs gnyis 'bras bu yongs rdzogs rtags/ /kha dog lnga ni snang ba las/ /rigs drug dkyil 'khor bsam byas pas/ /rang gi gnas rnams sbyong mdzad cing / /dkyil 'khor so so'i 'khor bcas la/ /be+er 'dus sku gsung thugs zhugs pas//rdo rje'i 'od bcas chen por gyur/ /ye shes bar pa gnyis ston cing / /byang chub sems nyid mtshan nyid do/ /lnga pa cho ga rdzogs pa las/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i kur bzhengs te/ /ye shes byang sems lnga pa las/ /phyag rgya chen por gsal ba yin/ /oṃ badz+ra a haṃ/ oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa a/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ1su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ gangs ri rdul bral me shel 'od/ /rin chen lnga yi gzer phreng mdzes / /sgeg dgyes 'dzum mig bcas pa'i bzhin/ /dkar mthing ser mchog 'bar ba'i mdangs/ /zhal mang phyag bzhi sgeg bzhad 'chang / /g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar/ /snyems bcas 4gsor zhing thugs kar brtan/ /g.yon pa kha ṭ+wāṃ rgya gram can/ /dril bu ba dan bcas pa 'khrol/ /'og ma gnyis kyis 5mda' dang gzhu/ /mtshan dpe phyag rgya lnga yis mdzes/ /stod g.yogs dar kar 6gser ris can/ /sku smad tshi 7gu'i na bza' gsol/ /rin chen phreng ba'i rked chings can/ /mgul gdub do shal dpung rgyan 9dang //phyag zhabs gdu bu se mo do/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ni/ /gnas lnga dag tu btugs 7bya ste/ /sngags kyis bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs sogs rnam par bsam/ oṃ na mo sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta gu ṇa badz+ra swa kibhā wa a kophohaṃ / lus kyi ba spu'i gnas rnams su/ /dkyil 'khor 14—311

drug gi rdul phran gnas/ /mkha' dbyengs dbang phyug phyag rgya yis/ /gnas kun byin kyis brlab par bya/ /mthe bong sems dpa'i skyil mo krung / /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug /gung mo gnyis ni mnyam par sbyar/ /lhag ma rdo rje thal mor bya/ /sor mo thams cad nang du bsnol/ /rtse mo nang du sprad byas nas / / mthe bong rdo rjes mnan pa ni/ /rmyesna dang mig phug lta bu ste/ /'di gnyis mgo bo'i gnas lngar gtugs1/ /dar dpyangs bcing zhing mtha' nas 'grol3/ /oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mo④/ hūṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa saṃ/ rat+na mā le a nyi ṣiñtsa t+t+waṃ5 / pa ṭa lo a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ badz+ra tu 6 ho/ yon tan cha la rna ba yi/ /zab mo bde mchog sku lta bur/ /phyung nas byin gyis brlabs mdzad de/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan par gyur/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yis/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya ldan byas te/ /oṃ 26hūṃ/ thugs gsal nyi ma la gnas pa'i//ye shes sems dpa' hūṃ dang bcas/ /dkyil 'khor spyan drangs lha mo yis༄ bhe/ /khrus byas dri ma gsum dag nas/ /dbang bskur 'bras bu bsam par bya/ /sangs rgyas gtsug gi nor bu'o/ /khams gsum dag na rin chen gzhan/ /sangs rgyas rin chen lta bu med/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rin po che/ /dbu rgyan du ni bde bas mchog /gzhan gyi nor min mi 'phrogs pa/ /lha yi chu ni tsa dag pa ste/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan dang / /dar dpyangs sogs kyis brgyan pa'o / /mkha' gsang hūṃ las byung ba yi87/ /rdo rje pad bcas nor bus mtshan/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad a dang bcas/ /mdog ser lte ba ze'u /sna'abru dmar/ /sha ta pa la sogs brda yis/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i spyor ldan bya/ /lha mo'i rol spyod gsang byas pas/ /dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i las bya'o/ /oṃ pra be+e sha phaṭa/14—312

a la la la ①ho/ ling ga bgreng ba rang 'byung ste/ /brla yi dbus su zhugs bye byas nas/ /ling ga rdo rjer khye byen brlabs nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sngon skyes/ /byang chub sems dpa' rngukun du dag /ma lus nye bar khyab byas nas—/ /'dod dgur bya ba rab tu mnyes/ /'od 'dus thogs ma'i gzugs la gzung / /bde ba chen po'i 'od zer las/ /lha mo bcu gnyis tshul 'dra bar—/ /phyogs dus sangs rgyas yab yum rnams/ /dga' ba chen pos mnyes par mdzad/ /rdul phran yi ge'i dbyibs su gyur/ /gang zhig zhal du zhugs pa las—/ /bde ba chen po'i gnas su 'dus/ /'khor lo bzhi nas rim bzhin spro / / 'bar ta 5ka ta'i gnas 'byung ste/ /bde chen chags dang gnyis med 'dres/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i rgyud bsregs nas/ /rigs drug so so'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub/ /rnal 'byor dag pa'i rgyud bskul zhing / /rnam gsum dkyil 'khor gsal bye bar snang / /slar 'dus gnas su gzhal yas khang //rgyan dang gdan bcas sngon bzhin 'byung / /thig les gnas su mtshan byas nas//spros pas ye shes dkyil 'khor gsal/ /hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /gsang gnas dbus kyi pad+ma la'o/ dzaḥlas lha mo bde mchog ma/ /hūṃ las e ma bde ba'o/ /baṃ las lha mo snang mdzad ma/ /hoḥ byelas slob ma mo yi rgya/ /de dag sems pa'i lduphyogs bzhi nas/ /'khril ba'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ las sangs rgyas byang chub ma/ /rgyu las chos kyi 'khor lo yin/ /ha las khams gsum rnam rgyal te/ /khaṃ las 'dod pa kun mdzad ma'o/ /de dag shar la sogs pa yi/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni re'u lkucha la'o/ /oṃ las gling bu tram̐ be+e wang /baṃ las rnga chen dz+dza rdza rnga/ /me mtshams la sogs re'u rkyemig tu/ /lha mo bzhi ni 14—313

rim bzhin bzhugs/ /a ā me tog spos me ma/ /saṃ aḥmar me dri chab ma'o/ /bar khyams mtshams kyi gnas bzhi ru/ /lha mo bzhi ni gnas pa yin/ dzaḥ3las rta mgrin 'phang mtho ma/ /hūṃ las phag gdong mche ba can/ /baṃ las nyi zla me 'bar ma/ /hoḥ༄ las thal byed sgo bzhir gnas/ /bha ga'i gnas nas spyo bya zhing / /slar 'dus phyi rol gnas la 'khod/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs 'dra ba/ /sku gnyis 'phro 'dus rang lag zhug/ /dza badz+ra tri sa ma ya phaṭa / lha mo bde mchog 'akying bag can/ /dkar mo sna tshogs rgyan dang gos//phyag gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa ste/ /'phro 'du'i 4las mdzad shar du bzhugs / /oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la hūṃ/ e ma bde ba gser gyi mdog /g.yas pas 5bdag po la 'khyud cing / /g.yon pas rdo rje rin chen 'dzin/ /'gying bcas lho yi phyogs su gnas/ /baṃ badz+ra ṇi smar ra phaṭa/ snang mdzad dmar mo g.yas pa na/ /sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon dag gis/ /'gying bcas thod pa'i snod thogs shing / /kha ṭ+wāṃ la brten nub phyogs gnas/ /hoḥ6badz+ra kā me shwa ri tram̐/ /slob ma mo 'gying ljang gu'i mdog /g.yas pas bdag po'i sku la 'khyud/ /g.yon gyi bdud rtsi'i bum pa nas/ /sangs rgyas sku 'byung byang gi phyogs/ /oṃ saṃ ma du badz+re hūṃ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas byang chub dkar dmar gsal/ /tshangs pa'i mgo bzhis mtshan pa yis/ /mda' bzhi dus gcig 'phan pa'i tshul/ /'gying bcas shar gyi re'u char gnas/ /7oṃ badz+ra me gi gu lu hūṃ/ chos kyi 'khor lo dkar ser mdangs/ /g.yas kyi gung mo'i rtse mo la/ /'khor lo rtse brgyad 'degs tshul 'dzin/ /'gying bcas lho yi re'u char gnas/ /oṃ ha sha ra ta badzi i e/ khams gsum rnam rgyal dmar skya'i mdog /g.yas na tri 14—314

shul 7rtse gsum dang / /g.yon pas rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin/ /gar mdzad nub kyi re'u char gnas/ /oṃ khaṃ badz+ra shi ri hūṃ hūṃ/ 'dod pa'i dbang mo ljang gu'i mdog /phyag gnyis dpag bsam ljon shing la/ /me tog dang bcas rlung bskyod 'dzin/ /gar mdzad byang gi ngogs su gnas/ /oṃ de 2ra ti badz+re bi la si tra tha/ gling bu sngon mo /rdo rjes mtshan/ /sna tshogs sgra sgogs me yi phyogs/ /he badz+ra ghi te te te te/ /pi wang ser mo rdo rjes mtshan/ /glu dbyangs drug ldan bden bral phyogs/ /te ra ti badz+ra ha se ha sa baṃ/ rnga chen dmar pos rdo rje rnga/ /brdung mdzad rlung mtshams la gnas pa'o/ /te ra te badz+ra ne+e tre pe pa 4sa dza1/rdza rnga ljang gu rdza rnga la/ /rdo rjes mtshan brdung dbang ldan phyogs/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe / me tog dmar ser rdo rjes mtshan/ / gzhong thogs mi yi mtshams su 6 gnas / /badz+ra dhū 7pe/ spos me dkar sngo rdo rjes mtshan/ /spos 8thogs bden bral mtshams su gnas/ /a badz+ra ā 9lo ke/ mar me dmar mo rdo rjes mtshan / /gsal 'dzin rlung gi mtshams su gnas/ /a badz+ra gadhe/ dri chab ljang gu rdo rjes mtshan/ /gang 'thor dbang ldan mtshams su gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ/ rta gdong dkar mo lcags kyu dang / /thod pa rta mgo ljang gu shar/ /oṃ badz+ra pā she hūṃ/ phag gdong sngon mo g.yas mche ba/ /g.yon zhags lho yi sgo la gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra shri kha le baṃ/ /snang ba mo dmar phyag gnyis kyis/ /nyi zla lcags sgog nub kyi phyogs/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi hoḥ / thal byed ljang gu g.yas dril bu / /g.yon pas bhan+ta 1ku bcas byang / /yang na lha mo thams cad kyang / /zla ba'i kha dog 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /brla yi sadabus ni dmar la dkar/ /phyag mchog lo ma sngon mo 'dra/ /dkar zhing ser ba'i brla dang ldan/ /lha rdzas kha 14—315

zas sna tshogs mchog /'bar ba sna tshogs 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /pad+ma sna tshogs la gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma la sogs mchog /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan dang gos/ /mu tig me tog la sogs mchog /mdzes pa'i rgyan cha sna tshogs 'chang / /mgon po ro mnyam gnas bzhugs nas/ /chos dbyings ye shes snyoms 'jug las/ /lha mo bdag po 7bskul mdzad de/ /sems can don kun rnam 'phrul mdzad/ /rjes su chags pa'i rnam mang dga' ba'i pad+mo rnams / /dag pa'i mchod pas gsal bar rjes su mchod byas pa/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i rnal 'byor bde bas bde ba grub par mdzod/ /e ma'o mchog tu bde ba'i dam tshig ngo bo nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba'i shin tu rnal 'byor skal bzang mchog dgyes pa/ /rang gi dam tshig skyon med rtag la rol cig rol cig ho / /glo bur 'khrul pas 'khor ba yi/ /'gro ba kun la dgongs nas bzhengs / /dkyil 'khor tshogs rnams gsal ba'i thuphyir/ /dbang bsgur byin gyis brlab par mdzad/ /gzugs phung chos dbyings ye shes che/ /mig la sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /rnam gsum gzugs dang rol mdzad de/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos po rnam par 'phrul/ /tshor ba kun rtog choye shes che/ /rna ba rdo rje nyi ma yin/ /rnam gsum sgra dang rol mdzad de/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos po rnam par 'phrul/ /'du shes mnyam nyid ye shes che/ /lce la pad+ma dbang phyug rgyal/ /rnam gsum ro dang rol mdzad de/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos po rnam par 'phrul/ /'du byed bya ba grub pa'i gnas/ /sna la rta mchog rol pa ste/ /rnam gsum dri dang rol mdzad byung / /brtan g.yo'i dngos bo rnam par 'phrul/ /rnam shes me long ye shes che/ /yid la rdo rje he ru ka /rnam 14—316

gsum chos dang rol mdzad de/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos po rnam par 'phrul/ /kun khyab stong pa'i ye shes che/ /lus la rdo rje sems dpa' gnas/ /rnam gsum reg dang rol mdzad de/ /brtan 1g.yo'i dngos po rnam par 'phrul/ /rnam gsum phyag rgya'i tshogs ldan zhing / /thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' gnas//rang rig dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas/ /dbang bskur rigs kyi mtshan ma bsam / /de ltar gtso dang sprul bcas pa/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs rdzogs byas nas/ /phyag rgya bzhi la gnas spro zhing / /phyag rgya'i sku rnams gsal bar mdzad/ /sbyor ba bzhi yi bye brag gis/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs par byas nas ni/ /rjes su 'gro ba'i las dag gis/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya ba yin/ /ye shes tsam la snyoms 'jug pa/ /sbyor ba zhes ni bya bar bshad/ /yum ldan byin brlabs rol pas mchod/ /gzhug pa rjes su sbyor ba'o/ /dag mdzad dkyil 'khor rdzogs mdzad nas/ /'phro 'du shin tu sbyor ba yin/ /byin brlabs dbang bskur las rdzogs pa/ /sbyor ba chen po zhes bya'o/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phro 'du yis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor sprul mdzad cing / /dzaḥbye hūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i sbyor tshogs dang / /rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcing / /stong pa shin tu rnal 'byor yod med mthus/ /nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas / /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ e bye hi bha ga wā na ma hā ka ru ṇi kā tri ke sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bde gshegs pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'gro ba ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /don gyi dbang du dgongs nas kyang / /'khor bcas gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /kā ya wāka tsit+ta 14—317

hūṃ / sgyu 'phrul dga' ba'i rdo rje rol mo'i tshogs/ /gzhan la snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par mdzes/ /a la la ho/ tshangs pa'i mchog rnams zil 1gyis gnon mdzad cing / rtog pa du ma'i sgo 'dogs gcod par mdzad/ /a la la ho/ gnyis med ye shes gnyis can rnam mtha' yas/ /snang stong bde chen mnyam nyid dbyings la rol/ /a la la ho/ kun 'byung yon tan rtsol med lhun grub snang / /rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams bkod rang las byung /a la la ho/ mdzad pa rgya chen 'gog med kun bsgrubs pas/ /tshogs bcas rol pas bya ba kun rdzogs nas/ /a la la ho/ sku gsung thugs mchog yon tan phrin las rgyan/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo a la la ho/ dpal ldan g.yon pa 'gying ba'i thabs/ /g.yas pa ba dan gsum par bya/ /sri zhur byas shing bteg pa'i mchog /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i dpal/ /'dzum dang bcas pa'i mig gis blta/ bsam g.yos thal mo sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ a ti pu ho/ ban+dha māṃ kā ro ya mi/ gu ru pa ti/a la la ho/ oṃ 'byung ba chen po thams cad 'byung / /stong gsum rdul snyed ma lus pa'i/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus spro / /me tog bdug pa mar me ma/ /dri sogs kun gyis 4mchod par bya/ /oṃ pa na pe na/ pa 5nu su ra ta/ ti pu pa ra mu/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ sa ma yo gi sidhi hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ oṃ badz+ra dhū — pe/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke/ oṃ 7badz+ra gadhe / pra tīts+tsha ho/ shī bha ga bān kha kha khā hi/ skad kyi gsangs /ni mtho dman dang / /gre 'gyur bcas shing bzlas pa yis/ /dus gsum rang bzhin mchog rnams kyis/ /hūṃ la sogs pa'i glu blang zhing / /tshig rnams kun gyis 14—318

ci 'dod par/ /ji ltar spros pa'i glu kun gyis/ /hūṃ gi glu yis phyag rgya dpal//rdo rje sems dpa' rab bsgrub pa'o/ /gling bu dang ni rgyud gcig dang / /de bzhin du ni rgyud mangs 1sogs/ /gyen du 'thor dang thur du blugs/ g.yas pa mi 'degs so so'i rgya/ /spyor ba rnam pa gsum ldan pas/ /rang gi gnas la sbyar bar bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ bde ba kun la zhen pa dang / /dngos grub thams cad rnam dag phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /zla ba nya ltar rtsa dmar sgu / /g.yas g.yon rdo rje dril 'dzin pas/ /bde ba'i cha lugs gar byed cing / /sems dpa'i skyil krung snyems bcas nas/ /dpung 'joms dngos grub thams cad 'grub/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra sa/twa s+dzadzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ zla ba'i kha dog 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /pad gnas bcas pa'i gar bcas 'khyud/ /mda' 'dzin sangs rgyas pad+ma sogs/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gos can/ / bya ba dang ni bzlog pa dang / /'phrog pa dag kyang lhag pa mdzad / /bdag la 'byung ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /yan lag thams cad 'phrog pa 'grub/ / rnam pa sna tshogs dam tshig chags/ /bde ba 'bar ba'i gar byed pas/ /bdag la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya mchog /dbus kyi lha mchog chen po'o—/ /se ral kha yi tshul bzhin du/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzung ste/ /bdag la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya ni/ / pad bcas rdo rje rgya gram mchog /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi kham phor grub/ /bdag 'khyud pa yi phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /dbus kyi lha mo mchog chen po'i/ /4gtsug lag ji lta'i rjes mthun par/ /dpal rdzogs rgya cher gar dag gis/ /mda' bzhi yongs su 'phang ba ni/ /bdud bzhi dag las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rkang pa bteg cing 14—319

'phang ba dang / /gzhibs te 'phang pa'i stabs dag gis/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgya ston 1pa ni/ /khams gsum dag la mchod 3par 'gyur/ /bya ba dang ni bzlog pa dang / /dbrog pa dag gis khyad par du/ /sna tshogs phyag rgyas gar byed cing / /khams gsum dag ni bsdu bar bya/ /lcug ma gang yang rung bzung nas/ /bdag la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /bud me+ed thams cad rtsen nas ni/ /dpag bsam shing dag yongs su 'grub/ /gling bu len pa'i tshul ston no/ /pi waṃ len pa'i tshul ston dang / /cang te'u tshul ston rnal 'byor dang / /rdza rnga tshul ston rnal 'byor pa'o/ /myang ba btung ltar byed pa dang / /sna yi myang ba rngub pa dang / /mig btsum zhen pa blta chob dang / /thams cad bdag gis myang ba'o/ /rang 'byung lha mo dang bcas pa'i/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis gnyis med 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen skal bzang dpal khyod bdag cag sgrub la rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ /kye de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag nyid bde ba mkha' 'go sgyu ma'i tshogs rnams bde ba'i mchog /'gro ba'i rgyud rnams rnam pa sna tshogs 'dul mchog grub pa bdag la grub par mdzad du gsol/ /a la la ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyor ba rnam pa sna tshogs gar rnams bstan du gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ kye ma bde mchog bde bas zung la rnam par sprul hūṃ snang bar mdzad du gsol/ /a la la la la ho/de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mkha' 'gro sgyu mas slob ma gzung du gsol/ /mdzub mos mtheb mo mnan nas ni/ /rang gi mtheb mos mdzub mo mnan/ /dpal grub spyan gyi phyag rgya ste/ /mdzub mo mig gi 'bras bur bya/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar nas/ /khong stong du ni sbyar nas su/ /sngags bcas gnas su 14—320

gzhag ①bya ste/ /rim bzhin mtha' nas dgrol bar bya/ /rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa grub par mdzod/ /oṃ uhūṃ/ dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzad②/ /mnyam pa chen po'i gnas la rol du gsol/ /rab tu dga' ba rjes su chags pa'i mda' gzhu rab tu phra ba'i rgyas btab pa'i/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sbyor ba'i bde bas myos pa'i bde bas thams cad bdag la grub par mdzod/ /rab tu bde mchog rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i longs spyod dang / /rab tu dga' ba'i dbang phyug che mchog grub pa de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu sna tshogs bde ba'i mchog rol cig ho/ /bde bas bde ba slong zhing ④rnam par rol hūṃ snang bar mdzod/ /a la la la la ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mkha' 'gro sgyu ma sna tshogs kun gyis slob ma gzung du gsol/ /kye bde ba'i mchog grub par mdzod/ e ma'o bde ba gsol/ /dam pa rab tu zhugs par mdzod/ /bdag la rab tu bde bar 'gyur/ /a la la la la ho/ e ma'o shi shi zhugs shing rjo/ /mkha' 'gro bde mchog kun du zhugs/ /la lar rab tu drag cing skye bo drag la drag pa'i bud med sku ltar rab tu snang / /'gro ba mtha' dag 'dul phyir la lar rab tu rno ba'i 'khor lo phyag na bsnams pa'i sku/ /la lar rab tu des rjoshing zhi bar mi 'gyur sbyin pa tshangs pa'i skur yang ston par mdzad—/ /la lar rab tu 'bar ba'i chags pa pad+mo'i dam tshig bdag la grub par mdzod/ /thams cad dbang bskur dbang phyug dam pa mi zad gter mchog bdag la grub par mdzad du gsol/ /kun mchog rgyal mtshan bgreng ba'i rdo rje 14—321

rin chen shin tu che ba bdag la sprul/ /lha mo kun gyi bde ba'i mchog /mdzes pa'i zhal ni rnam par 'gyur/ /bde ba myong bar rab sbyor ba/ /mdzes par blta zhing gar byed pa'o/ /lha mo kun gyi bde ba mchog /mdzes pa'i ma mchu sos mnan pa'i/ /'dzum pa'i phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes par byed/ /sna tshogs bharnya ①brtag pa las/ /sna tshogs bdud rtsi'i rnam par dag /lnga lnga lnga yi 'phro 'du yis/ /mtshan ma rnam pa lnga dang ldan/ /'od dang du ba dri dang sgra/ /lha mo'i gzugs ston bdud rtsir 'grub—/ /rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /mnyam pa'i don ldan rol bar mdzad/ /byin brlabs mtshan dang rgyan ldan pa'i/ /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya'i mchog /byin kyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /gsang ba chen po rnam par rol/ /grub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod—/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dam pa'i mchog chos can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par sprul/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa'i thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang //tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 14—322

'phang dam pa brnyes ①gyur kyang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yong mi 'gyur/ /e ma'o shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥru ṭa ma ṭa/sma ra ra ṭa/ hu lu hu lu/ pra sedha/ ṭak+ki hūṃ dza/ ka ni ku ni/ hūṃ hūṃ/ṭak+ki ni hūṃ dzaḥ hu lu hu lu/ a la la la la ho/ shudha sidha/ dar+sha ya/sarba ta gha na ④ghi/ ta ghi ghi/ ṭa ṭa ghi ghi bhe/ ta ghi ta ghi/ bhe ghi ta ta/ta ghi ta ghi/ he na don ṭak+ki snehūṃ dza/ ghi ta/ bhe don ṭak+ki rjohūṃ dza/ ṭa ⑤a la la la la ho/ ru ṭa ma ṭa/ thal mo brdab pa brtag pa'o/ /ta bhe ghi/ta ghi na ta ghi na/ ghi na ghi ta/ ghi na bhe na ghi narjo/ rgyun gyi rnga'o/ /bdag cag dam tshig 'di la mngon du zhugs pa rnams/ /bcad gtubs lus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /grib mas ④phog pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa'i//sku yi phyogs tsam mthong bas smon lam 'tsho ba dang / /gzi mdangs lus la 'jug pa bye ba stong phrag gi/ /'od kyis phog pas 'jig rten khams kun snang ba dang / /lus ngag sems dang tshe ni rdo rje rab brtan te/ /re smon thams cad dus 'dir 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la dmigs nas//thun mong 'das dang dang po brtsam/ /sems dpa' rnam pa gsum ldan par/ /rang rang sku gsung thugs kyi rtags/ /nyi dkyil thabs dang shes rab kyi/ /phreng ba gnyis dang ldan pa las/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan mas brgyan/ /14—323

gtso bos ji ltar bzlas pa bzhin/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par gnas/ /gnas dang 'khor dang 'phro ba yis/ /mthun pa'i lha tshogs mnyes mdzad cing //rigs bsdus 'gro ba'i las la sbyar/ /gtso bo'i zhal nas sbyor sngags ni/ /rang gi gsang sngags bcu bzhi pa'o/ /de bzhin lha mo so so yi/ /sngags dang 'phro 'du las ldan pa'o/ /rdzogs nas mchod bstod bskul ba dang / /gsol gdab 'gro ba'i las la sbyar/ /gnyis pa so so'i las bya ba/ /gtso sogs rim pa bzhin du ni/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang ldan byas te/ /'od kyi rig ma dang bcas shing / /gsal ba rnam pa gnyis ldan par/ /rang gi gsang sngags brjod par bya/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa s+dzadzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po'i gsang sngags yi ge bco brgyad pa'o/ /'khor gyi lha mo ma lus pa'i/ /bzlas rdzogs mchod bstod bskul bya zhing / /rang gi las la sbyar nas kyang / /so so'i gnas su bsdu bar bya/ /mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor kun gyi mchog /don dam bde ba chen po'i sku/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes kyi/ /lha nyid brtson pas bsgom par bya/ /sna rtse thig le phra mo la/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bsdu bya ste/ /yi ge mtshan ma phra mo'i bar/ /mtshan ma lnga gsal bar du gnas/ /yi ge ka sogs da yig mtha'/ /nga nya spangs nas 'jug par bya'o/ /yi ge dha sogs k+ṣa yig mtha'/ /phreng ba gnyis pa yang dag bri/ /dbus gnas par ni a yig phreng / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bkod de/ /thig le zla tshes dang ldan par—/ /tsheg drag zla ba gnyis yin te/ /a yig mi 'gyur bsgom par bya/ /dbus su rdo rje ngo bor gnas/ /de dbus rtag tu bsgom pa ni/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas 14—324

ri mor grags pa yin/ /ling ga 'greng ba rang 'byung ste/ /brla yi dbus su gzhug byas nas/ /ling ga rdo rjer byin brlabs te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sngon bskyed/ /bha gar ling ga bcug nas ni/ /der ni t+t+waṃ yig bsgom par bya/ /shin tu dga' 'dra'i gzugs dag ni/ /sku gnyis ldan par spro bya'o/ /kun kyang khyab cing dri med pas/ /byang chub sems dag brtan pa'o/ /mtshan ma rnam pa lnga yi bar/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bsgom/ /rten dang brten pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /rnam dag de nyid gsal bar brtag /dge bcu dag la rten 1bcas shing / /bden bzhi dngos po gcig tu gnas/ /rten 'byel yan lag bcu gnyis tshogs/ /rgyu 'bras sna tshogs dag pa'i dbyings//yon tan tshogs rnams kun rgyas shing / /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi khyab mdzad nas/ /chos tshogs sum cu rtsa bdun las/ /ting 'dzin bzhi por 'jug par mdzad/ /rang bzhin ye shes drug dag las/ /rigs kyi mtshan ma sna tshogs snang / /rnam thar brgyad po rten bcas shing / /rdo rje theg pa'i tshul nyid mdzes/ /mdzad pa rgya chen phrin las rnams/ /yul drug dag gi phyag rgya che/ /mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor chen bor spyod/ /thugs rje chen po'i char khebs dang / /bdud bzhi las rgyal theg chen mchog /mnyam par spyor bas tshul 'jug cing / /rtog pa'i sgrib pa sel bar mdzad/ /smon lam las grub mdzad 'phro las/ /theg chen yon tan ci yang 'byung / /mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa'i sgu/ /brten pa'i jeg pa sna tshogs sgrogs/ /dbang phyug la sogs yon tan brgya/ /phrin las bzhi yis rnam phye zhing / /rten gnas rgyu dang spyod mdzad pa'i/ /gnas kyi mtshan ma 'grub pa yin/ /chags med mdzad pas spyod kun dang / /74—325

nyon mongs mtshan mas gos pa med/ /bde chen dbyings las ma 'phros shing / /sgu gsung thugs kyi theg pa can/ /yon tan —'byung gnas 'chi med lngas/ /gang ba phyogs bzhir gnas dgod pa/ /shes lnga'i 'dod pa'i longs spyod tshogs//nyi shu bdun gyi rgyan gyis spras/ /phrin las mchod pa'i gnas gyur pa'i/ /'khor lo rang rtags mtshan mas mdzes/ /phyi yi mtshan ma tshogs dag gis/ /thams cad yon tan snang bas spras/ /sgu gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sna tshogs/ phrin 'a/sa dpag med tshogs/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /log rtog 1mtshan ma sreg par byedapa / /mtshan nyid theg sogs gzhan dag las/ /khyad nga/ra 'phags pa theg pa'i mchog /khams gsum gzhan rtog spyong mdzad cing / /lus sogs/ rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ /yon tan rgyan gyi rten dag las//sangs/ rgyas/ brgyad ngo/ sgu snang mdzad/ /dregs byed 'dus phyir rigs mtshan mnan / /snod bcud sgrol mdzad shes rab mtshon/ /srid gnas las byung rtog pa'i tshogs/ /gnyis med rang gi ngo bor mos/ /dbyings dang ye shes mnyam pa'i lha/ /snang srid gnyis med bsgo ma pa'i lha/ /thugs rje che la sprul pa'i char/ /tha ba las byung smin par mdzad/ /rang byung ye shes chen po las/ /tshogs brgyad snang ba sna tshogs nyid/ /thugs/ rje'i sprul pa dpag med kyis/ /stong gsum/ khams las 'gro bar byed/ /'byung ba'i snang ba tha dad rnams/ /thams cad rnam dag dkyil 'khor che/ 'khor ba'i rtog pas ma gos shing / /byang chub thugs rje chags pa'i rtags/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen sgu/ /zla 'dra dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan/ /chos dbyings stong pa'i ye shes las/ /rigs kyi mtshan ma bzhir snang zhing / /phrin /las tshad med rnam spyod pas/ /7 7—326

'brel pa'i don bzhin spyod par mdzad/ /khams gsum rgyal ba'i rgyan bcas pas / /cha lugs spyong zhing 'gying bar mdzad/ /ye shes lnga ldan zab mo dang / /rgya chen rigs lnga'i sgu snang mdzad/ /rang gi thugs bskul dran tshogs kyi1/ /las la rnam par rol mdzad do/ /sna tshogs kun grub sgu gsung thugs/ /khams gsum las rgyal gsung sgrogs shing / /chags phyir zhi gnas lhag mthong gi/ /mtshan nyid 'brel pa ston par mdzad/ /mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad brgyad cus rnam spras pas/ /thun mong las grub zil gnon pa'i/ /dbyings dang ye shes 'brel pa'i rgyan/ /byang chub sems sogs bla gab la/ /thugs rje'i rim pas legs spras shing / /mdzad pa'i las mang sna tshogs pas// /'gro ba'i rnam rtog spyod par ston/ /g.yas su/ bsdu ba bzhi dag dang / /g.yon du tshad med bzhi snang mdzad/ /spyi bor pha rol phyin drug dang / /gzungs dang ting 'dzin rtags sna tshogs/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas/ kun 'dus pas/ /yon tan rgyan kyi rin chen la/ /rnam pa lnga yi tshul zhugs shing //yon tan rgyan gyes spras pa yis / /rigs kyi mtshan ma mi nub phyir/ /gzugs mthun pa yi do ker can/ /yon tan sna tshogs rgyan bcas pas/ /de nyid kun kyis gzugs su ston/ /dge bcu yan lag rnam spras shing / /zhabs la rnam thar brgyad kyis brgyan/ /bden bzhis —gdu bus mdzes byas pas / /rnam thar bzhi yi rang bzhin yin5/ /dge dang pha rol phyin bcu yi/rked chings phreng ba nyi rim mdzes/ /chos bzang sum cu rtsa bdun gyis/ /tshangs skud bzhin du rgyan 6bcas shing / /ma 'dres chos bzang bco brgyad pos//rim gnyis phreng bar ldan pa yin/ /phyag rgya rnam pa bzhi ldan zhing / /'gro la 7 1—327

de don ston par mdzad/ /phung po lnga rnams rnam dag pas/ /rigs lnga'i rgyan gyis mdzes par byas/ /'byung ba che rnams rnam dag phyir/ /lha mo bzhi dang kun du 'khril/ /skye mched bcu gnyis rnam dag pas/ /nang gi lha mo'i tshogs su byung / /khams sogs spyod pa rnam dag byung / /thugs rje'i phrin las rgya chen pos/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams dgod byas nas/ /nyon mongs nyi shu dag par mdzad/ /ye shes snang ba bsam yas pas/ /sna tshogs dkyil 'khor cir yang snang / /bar chad bgegs bzhi bsrung ba dang / /dngos grub lhag par gnas pa'i phyir/ /brtson pas thun mtshams rnam pa bzhir/ /gtor ma'i las dag brtsam par bya/ /sgrib pa thams cad spyong byed cing / /tshogs kyi las rnams sdogs byed pa/ /de nyid spyod dang mthun pa'i las/ /des ni mdzad pa rgya chen 'gyur/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor zla gam la/ /dmar po'i tshon gyis kha bsgyur te/ /mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor rnam lnga yi/ /thig le dbus dang phyogs bzhi ru/ dbus su rta yi rgyal po la/ /lha chen lnga yi mtshan mas bskor / /shar du phyogs skyong zhing skyong la/ /lho ru mngon 1spyod ma mo'i tshogs/ /nub tu dbang la klu chen brgyad/ /byang du rgyas pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /rang gi gsang sngags kyis bskyed cing / /sgur gyur ye shes 'od tshogs sbyang / /sgeg mo dang ni na chung dang / /myos dang de bzhin bdud rtsi dang / /gcig pu dpa' dang 'dod chags sra/ /g.yon can bran mo de bzhin te/ /lan tsha la sogs ro kun dang / /ka ra la sogs bdud rtsi bzhin/ /bdag nyid kun gyi ro grub pa/ / ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ / sha dang chang dang ldan pa yi/ /bza' ba sna tshogs grub pa ni/ /dga' ba'i longs spyod skal mchog ste/ /tshe 14—328

yi dam pa rab tu 'grub1/ /a mra smin dang rgun 'brum dang / /pa na se dang na le ker/ /a ru ra la sogs pa yi/ /'bras bu'i phyag rgya mchog rnams dang / /kha ra sbrang rtsi byug pa yis/ /a mra la sogs tshi gus byug /ha sa ka ra'i mar la sogs/ /mnyam pa'i dri yis bsgu bar bya/ /yungs dang rgya skyegs la sogs pa'i/ /tshon gyis mthun par kha bsgyur nas/ shun pa dro ba la sogs byas / /mchod pa'i tshe na dbul bar bya/ /thod pa'i nang du sbyar byas pa'i/ /bza' btung bca' ba la sogs rnams/ /ha hoḥ4dīḥyis sreg sbyang brlab/ /mkha' 'gro'i 'khor la 5bsngo bar bya/ /gtor ma rdzas chen ma lus pa/ /dang po dri yi chus sbyangs shing / /sna tshogs sgra snyan ba dan sogs/ /bkod pa'i mchod gtor brlabs la spel/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' 6nyid/ /rta mchog gzugs su sprul byas nas/ /mdzes pa'i phyag rgya sngags ldan pa/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bsnyu bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ṭā ki be+e bh+yo/ e a ra li dza dza/ 'khor bcas bsdu bar 'ongs pa dang / /dam tshig phyag rgya rnam gsum bstan / /oṃ badz+ra gu bye dṛ 8sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ / oṃ badz+ra gu bye dṛ ⑩sh+ya ho/sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu bye dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya phaṭa/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe gabye pū dzā sga ra ṇa i rda ཿba bo kha kha khā hi/ yi las skyes pa'i gzhu 'dra'i dbyibs / /ba dan g.yo bas mtshan pa ste/ /ram̐ byung me yi dkyil 'khor 'bar / /dmar po gru gsum ram̐ kyis 5mtshan/ /shaṃ byung thod pa mtshan ldan nang / /'od gsal chags med ྾gnas pa yi7/ /mi sha la sogs phyogs dang mtshams / /a las byung ba'i zla ba dang / /hūṃ byung rdo rjes bkab byas nas/ /hūṃ oṃ tweḥt+t+waṃ bzhi rnams so/ /o āḥhūṃ/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ dīḥthā2 //7(—329

rim bzhin sngags dang phyag mtshan dang / /sgur 'gyur 'phro dang 'du ba yis/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dgug bya ste/ /rdo rje bzhugs nas snod bzang bltams1/ /zla 'dra 'od zer lnga bcas pas/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor bcas tshogs mnyes bya/ /oṃ 'jig rten kun gtso mnga' mdzad pa'i/ /'jigs byed dregs byed stobs ldan pa/ /bde gshegs sras sogs bran mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ldan snying rje can/ /dbang phyug chen po chung mar bcas/ /de bzhin khyab 'jug tshangs pa dang / /brgya byin 'dod dga' chung mar bcas/ /lha chen 'khor bcas tshogs rnams dang / /phyogs skyong brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo gsus 'dzin ma/ /dur khrod ma tshogs 'khor bcas dang / /gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad dang / /'gro ba drug po 'khor bcas rnams/ /sgu gsung thugs sogs sbyang byas nas/ /rang gi lha yi gzugs 'dzin rnams/ /gnas 'dir 'dus pa'i dam tshig can/ /mchod gtor rgyun dang bcas pa bzhes/ /dam tshig srungs shig dam tshig can/ /las la brtson pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo 'khor bcas rnams//rnal 'byor sgrub papa'i grogs mdzod cig /las mkhan rdo rje bran bcas pas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las grub cing / /theg chen gsang sngags bsrung ba dang / /nad dang gdon sogs zhi ba dang / /tshe dbang bkra shis spel ba dang / /bde legs 'bras bu grub par mdzod/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ pad+ma mu ka hūṃ hūṃ/ rta mgrin phyag rgya rnam gnyis kyis/ /las rnams dngos grub tshogs gyur cig /dngos grub dbang du byas nas ni/ /rang gi gnas la dgod par bya/ /oṃ tweḥḍā ki dī i saṃ ba lo ta pra dīts+tsha hūṃ khā hi/ oṃ āḥdīḥ5khā hi/ thugs rje chen pos gzigs 74—330

nas kyang / /sna tshogs rgyud rnams sprul mdzad pa'i/ /gar mkhan 'khor lo'i 1rgyud mnga' ba/ /drag po zhi mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sna tshogs gar gyi rnam par sprul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje la sogs mtshon chas rol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus lha yi lha mchog skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo rtsal rdzogs stobs bcu'i shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ a ti byu ho/ a la la la la ho/ thun bzhis dus su bya ba las/ /rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor mchod bstod cing / /rang las byung te mdun gzhag —nas/ /gsol btab las la bskul bar bya/ /oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol5//sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'gro ba'i don la dgongs/ /oṃ badz+ra gats+tsha muḥ6/ de nas phyag rgya rnams dgod pa/ /rim bzhin bdag la bsdu byas nas/ /rnam gsum sems dpa' hūṃ la thim/ /rim bzhin thig le mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /rjes 'byung mtshan ma'i sgur gnas te/ /mtshan med rgyan dang cha lugs gsal/ /go cha go bcings bsrung bya zhing / /dbang bskur dbu rgyan cod pan ldan/ /kai haṃ oṃ ḍū rat+na mā le a bye ṣiñtsa/ paṭa waṃ ba/ a bhi — waṃ ba hūṃ/ spyod lam kun du ma nyams par/ /lha nyid du ni bsgom par bya/ /dbang po'i snang ba yul dus rnams/ /dkyil 'khor rol pa'i tshul du brtag /bza' btung byin brlabs ma nyams bzlas/ /sgyu ma gnyis med ye shes rol/ /byed spyod tshogs gnyis rgyu ru brtag /thams cad 'gro ba'i don du spyad/ /blo mchog mkhas shing rtsal ldan pas/ /bla ma mnyes las byung ba'i don/ /tshogs gnyis dus gcig rdzogs pa yin8/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi yul la sbyor/ /gang zhig phyi yi g.yeng bral zhing / /nang gi bdag nyid gsal 'dod pas/ /mnyam 7 4—33/

bsams las rnams gdungs bsal 1nas/ /bla ma'i bdud rtsi'i ro myang bya/ /las dang po yis brtsam bya ba/ /zhi gnas mi mthun rgyu spong zhing / /lus sems bde bar bzhugs byas nas/ /skye ba'i mtshan nyid bsam par bya/ /kye ma'o rang bzhin la rmongs rnams/ /blo bur rtog pas kun du bslad/ /de bzhin yun ring goms shugs las/ /bde sdug gnyis tshogs dbang spyod pas/ /'khor ba'i nyon mongs tshogs su snang / /la las zhen chags rnam par 'khrul/ /la las spong 'dod sbug bsngal rgyu/ /la las spyod 'dod gnas ma dag /dga' ba kun la spyod rnams kyang / /lus ngag g.yeng zhing snyug bsngal rgyu/ /snang ba de mnyam pa'i don gnas na/ /sgu gsung gnyis su med pa'i lam/ /grol lam thabs la brten pa dag /bde ba'i ye shes rtogs bya'i phyir/ rtsa rlung so so'am thun mong gis/ /nyams myong bskyed par bya ba yin/ /'gro ba kun gye phung po la/ /'khor lo 2dkyil 'khor bde chen bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor mthong bar 'dod pa yis/ /phung po'i dkyil 'khor blta bar bya/ /'og tu bskyed pa'i rkyen dbang gis/ /gtum mo ram̐ bcas yang dag sbyor/ /dbyings snang ri bong 'dzin pa la/ /ye shes rdo rje rtse lnga gnas/ /dmar po oṃ sogs yig bcas pa'i/ /dbyibs can sprul sku gyen du phyogs/ /dkar po hūṃ sogs thur 4bltas pa'i/ /chos skus mngon du phyogs par mdzad/ /sgra gnas oṃ sogs yi ge tshogs/ longs sku dmar po gyen du phyogs/ /tshangs 5bug 'og tu bde ba che/ /haṃ sogs dkar po thur bltas pa'o/ /steng gi yud tsam dgag byed pas/ /rgyun mi 'chad par rdo rjer bstem/ /bskyod pa'i ba dan gnyis bsgul bas/ /'og nas yud tsam yud tsam dgag /rgyun mi 74—332

'chad par 'dren byas te/ /ri bong 'dzin pa'i khams zhus brgyan/ /bar skabs stod smad yan lag rnams/ /nyam ①chung 'bar sogs drags ②gyur na/ /cung zhig sbyor ba glod bya zhing / /g.yas g.yon steng 'og spro ba dang / /spyod lam sogs kyis bcos byas nas/ /bde 'gyur gang ①bzhin bslab par bya/ /de bzhin dbang po gzhan dag dang / /tshangs bug rten rjoganas dag kyang bsdu/ /dbye ba bzhi 'bum brten nus na⑤/ /bum pa gang bar gnas pa yin/ /'byung 'jug gnas pa'i 'phro 'du yis/ /mtshan ma gsal bar brtag par bya/ /zla ba rdo rjes rgyas pa na/ /'khor ba'i gnas su rim pa bzhin/ /g.yas g.yon sdang mig gsum bsgyur zhing / /sdigs rjomadzub hri yi sprul bas spel/ /de bzhin gling bzhi gnas spro zhing / /slar nyid bde chen gnas su bsdu/ /haṃ las 'dzag pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /dga' ba bzhi yi rim skyed ④cing / /phung po bcud bsdus k+ṣa ⑧rtser gzung ⑨/ /dga' ba ⑩chen pos rnam myos par/ /hūṃ gsum phyag rgyas 'dren byas nas/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor spro bar bya/ /dngos kun bde ba'i ros rgyas te/ /stong nyid zag med ye shes gsal/ /de ltar 'khor ba mya ngan 'das/ /bde chen stong nyid rgyas btab nas/ /rang gi mtshan nyid rnam gsal cing / /rtog pa'i mtha' las rnam par grol/ /lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes te/ /sprin med nam mkha' dri bral zhing / /brtan zhing 'bigs byed med par gnas/ /tshe 'dis sangs rgyas mngon du 'gyur/ /chags lam gzhan la brten pa yis/ /mtshan ldan rigs dang mthun pa la/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs gdams ngag 'bogs/ /glu dbyangs sman dang brdas bskul nas/ /bha ga'i mtshan mar rnam brtags te/ /phyag rgya so so'i 14—333

sbyor ba dag /lnga nas drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bar/ /sbyor thabs drug cu rtsa bzhir bcas—/ /phung po'i dkyil 'khor brtag bya ste/ /bsgrub gnas rol pa'i gnas shes bya/ /spyod pas gtum mo legs sbar bas/ /srub thabs sbyor ba 'dres pa yis/ /lnga phung sbyin sreg byas nas su/ /sprul skus lus rtog sbyong ①bar mdzad/ /gong nas gong du sbyor ba yis/ /chos dang longs spyod gnas spyod pas/ /sems dag dri ma rnam par spangs/ /bde ba chen po gnas rgyas pas④—/ /dga' dang mchog dga' rnam dga' dang / /lhan cig skyes dga' lugs su 'byung / /rdo rje dbyings mtshams sbyor ba'am/ / 'bar ta ka ta'i ①rtse mor gzung / /gling bzhis rtse rnams bsdu bya ste/ /steng gi mtshan mas blta bar bya/ /dga' ba ma skyes bar dag tu/ /ma zin zin par brten gnas bya/ /lugs bzlog hūṃ dang k+ṣaḥyis 'dren/ /gtum mo nas bzung bde chen 'bar/ /dga' ba bcu drug 'phel gyur nas/ /phyi yi gling bzhir spro bar bya/ /shes rab la la thur bltas pa'i/ /yi ge las byung dkar po yis/ /'khor lo bzhi dang sbyor byas nas/ /k+ṣaḥrtse'i gnas gzung gong ma bzhin/ /thabs ldan sa dang gyen bltas la/ /gcig 'gyur a wa dhū tīr ④zhugs/ /de la sprul pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas par byas/ /slar nyid chos kyi 'khor lo'i gnas/ /bde ba'i ye shes gzung byas te/ /zin dang brtan dang bogs dbyung dang / /dbyung du med pa'i gnas 'jog pa'o/ /phyi yi gnas kyang rgyas byas shing / /gzung med 'dzin dang bral bar gzhag /khams gsum dngos po de lta bur/ /bde ba che ⑤las gzhan ma yin/ /blo mchog sbyangs pa'i 'phro ldan pas/ /phyi nang chos kun mkha' bzhin gsal/ /snang 14—334

srid rang las rnam grol zhing / /'byung 'jug med par ye shes che/ /dbang po drug gi yul snang bas/ /de las gzhan med byang chub sems/ /rtog pa mtha' rnams 'dzin med pa'i/ /snang gsal bde ba chen po'i chos/ /gnas med btang snyoms chen po'i gnas/ /rtsol bral byang sems rtsol ①ba'i don/ /bcos med dran pa rang dgar gnas/ /chos nyid mnyam pa'i rgyan dang bcas/ /byung tshor 'gog dang rjes dran med/ /ma bcos mtha' bral bde ba'i rgyun/ /mngon sum gsal ba nyams myong ba/ /snang srid ma g.yos phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /chos kun rang bzhin de lta bur/ /bde chen rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ /gsung thugs yon tan phrin las brgyan/ /ma rtsol rgod pa chen po'i dbyibs①/ /de dus mtshan ma rnam myong ba/ /lus rtog sgra sogs snang zhing stong / /gsal ba'i don las gzhan mi 'gyur/ /chos rnams gang la chags sdang sked/ /mkha' la khyung chen gnas pa dang / /chu la nya chen 'phyo ba bzhin/ /byis pa rnams ni gzugs sogs chags/ /'bring po'i blo ldan chags bral spyod/ /gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid shes pas/ /blo mchog rnams ni grol bar 'gyur/ /gzugs brnyan lugs ma la sogs la/ /rnal 'byor 'byung bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /byang chub sems la rab brtson na/ /de las rnal 'byor lhar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje ste/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi bdag nyid yin/ /de bas thams cad bdag sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /de bas bdag nyid lhar sbyor bas/ /bdag nyid rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnams dang thams cad kyang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad du/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /sbyor ba 14—335

bzhi la legs gnas shing / /ting 'dzin nyams pa med pa'i blos/ /seng ge ri brags ①rgyu ba bzhin/ /'jigs med thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /thams cad mnyam pas spyad bya ste/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod kun gyis brgyan/ /bza' spyod kun la rol bya zhing / /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor mchod par bya/ /rnal 'byor thams cad nyer spyod pas/ /dpal ni bzhir 'gyur 'grub par 'gyur—/ /rnal 'byor kun ni bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /de yi nye bar sbyor ba ni/ /khams gsum ma lus thams cad do—/ /rnal 'byor kun gyis longs spyod kyis/ /ji ltar bde bar rten ②byed cing / /rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag nyid rab tu skemachod par bya/ /rjes su sbyor bas mchod byed cing / /rnal 'byor kun gyi bde ba dag /bdag nyid rab tu stsong byed na/ /shin tu sbyor bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid kyirjo/ /ra sa ya na'i bde ba 'dis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dpal tshe dang / /lang tsho nad med bde ba 'grub/ / sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /busangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pas na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dpal sbyor ba'i/ /mthu 'di nyid kyis thams cad du/ /mdor na phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /so so dag nas rab 'grub 'gyur/ /lta bas mi ngoms pa yi sku/ /thams cad bdag nyid ston par mdzad/ /legs so zhes pa grub pa ni/ /dam pa dag kyang rab tu sprul/ /sku gsum dbyer med las byung bas—/ /sems can kun don rnam 'phrul zhing / /mdzad pa rgya chen sna tshogs kyis—/ /don bzhin sprul pa mdzad pa yin/ /brtson ldan shes rab mchog 14—336

gyur pa'i/ /mkhas mchog rnams kyis rnyed dka'i don/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog las/ /skyes mchog gang gis drin rnyed pa'i/ /rgya mtsho las byung rin po che/ /'gro ba'i don du brtag ①byas pas/ /'jug pa po rnams dga' bar gyis/ /rgyud rgyal rnams kyi rtsa ba'i don—/ /gsang ba'i de nyid bzhi bcu gnyis/ /gces ④bsdus rtog pa bcu pa dang / /phyi ma'i phyi ma phyi ma las/ /gsang don rnam par dgod byas pas/ /'khrul rtog mi tshig bslad bral zhing / /rgyud gzhan tshig phrad tsam bkod de/ /rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin rnam par bsdebs/ /cung zad bsags las byung ba yi—/ /dri med ston ka'i zla 'dra bas/ /'gro ba'i ye shes gsal mdzad nas—/ /dpal ldan sku gsum thob par shog /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon ku ku garā dzas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan po bibyā rjoka ra saut+ta rjodang / zhu chen kyi lo tsā ba ban+de rjolha rin po ches rgyud 'grel dang gtugs te gtan la phab pa'o// //14—337

༄/ /dpal he ru ka'i gsang ba'i don rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba/ 1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra he ru ka gu t+yāze dha ro byu 2ha nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal he ru ka'i gsang ba'i don rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad 'byung gnas gsal byed cing / /gnyis med ma 'dres mdzad mthar phyir/ /stong nyid ye shes drug gi bdag /thugs mchog khro bdag phyag 'tshal te/ /dregs byed zhe sdang la sogs skyes/ /nyon mongs lam zhen ru tra sogs/ /'joms mdzad dpal ldan he ru ka'i/ /gsang don rnam bkod bshad par bya/ /rang bzhin ngang tshul bzang las byung / /gnyis med yon tan skye bas thob/ /skyabs 'gro byang sems sdom pa can/ /dbang thob dam tshig 'jigs med pa/ /theg chen gsang sngags blo gros mchog /he ru ka dpal la dga' bas/ /phyi nang g.yeng ba rab bsal te/ /rang gi 'dod don 'bras bu gnyer/ /dur khrod dang ni 74—342

lha rten dang / /ma mo'i gnas la sogs 'dug nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dgongs pa dag /rnam pa du ma 'grub par 'gyur/ /'gro la snying rje chen po yis / /bdag gzhan sgrol bar dam bcas nas/ /sbyor ldan nus mthu gsum bskyed pas/ /bdag dang 'go ba sbyang ba dang / /dbang po'i dkyil 'khor mdun dmigs te/ /dang po bya ba'i rim rdzogs sbyang / /sgrib sogs las gol dag byed pa'i/ /sems can tshad med blo yis gzung / /bar chad bgegs bsal srung byed pa'i/ /'khor lo me 'od ra ba gur/ /phyogs bcu khro bo'i tshogs bskyed pa'i/ /cho ga rang gi las bzhin bsgom/ /thams cad spros bral de bzhin nyid/ /gnyis med byang chub sems dbyings las/ /'gro la phan pa'i thugs rje'i rgyun/ /stong gsal nam mkha'i shugs ltar byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal/ /rnam 'phrul ting 'dzin gnas la bzhugs/ /e yi baṃ lo mo 1sum̐ re/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya mi 2maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ zlordo/chos 'byung nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rim bzhin brtsegs / /ri rab me 'od rgyan gsal zhing / /kha dog dbyibs rgyan mtshan mar bcas/ /bde gshegs yon tan snang ba'i gnas/ /sna tshogs pad+ma rin po che/ /'khor lo sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbus/ /khang pa rdo rje sgo khyud dang / /rta babs bzhi yis mdzes byas pa/ /sa gzhi nam mkha' logs kyi phyogs/ /rigs kyi rin chen 'tsher ba la/ /rang 'byung nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'od/ /sna lnga'i rtsig pa dra ba dang / /dra phyed rin chen pha gus mtshan/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ka ba brgyad/ /rin chen mu tig me tog phreng / /rgyal mtshan bla re rnga yab gdugs / /'dod yon lnga yi lha mo 'khyug /zla phyed rdo rje rin chen dang / /74—343

ba dan dril bu sgra snyan sgrogs/ /pho brang zla gam 1sgo can la/ /re'u mig dgu pa thod pas mtshan/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan mdzes shing / /rdo rje phreng bas rnam par mtshan/ / mtshams su bum pa gang ba bzhi/ /rigs kyi mtshan mas rnam par mjes/ /khyams bzhi cha yi mtshams bzhi dang / /sgo gnas la sogs pad+ma'i gdan/ /phyi rol ra ba'i rim gsum rgyab/ /phyogs mtshams dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /de mtha' 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang / /2rdo rje ra bas bskor ba yi / /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus pa/ /thams cad sgyu ma lta bu ste / /ji ltar sgyu ma thams cad du/ /mthong ba dag ni reg par 'gyur/ /dmigs su yod pa ma yin te/ /de bzhin 'gro ba kun gyi 4tshul/ /rnam thar sgo/ bzhi snyoms 'jug go/ /'gog gnas 'dul bya'i don bral ba/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bsgul mdzad de/ /mngon byang lha 5yis rdzogs skur gyur6/ /sems dang sems dpa'i ting 'dzin dang / /byang chub spyod pa sna tshogs nyid/ /de bzhin bdud dang bdud las rgyal/ /de ni byang chub sangs rgyas yin/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa s+dzadzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsu ra ta s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen sku//dkar zhing dmar ba'i mdongs gsal 'od/ /zhal bzhi rnams gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ /dang po rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bcas 'khrol/ /'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ /mtshan dpe phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /stod g.yogs dar ser ngang ris can7/ /sku smad tshi gu'i na bza' la rin chen phreng ba'i rked chings 'dril/ /mgul chu 9do shal dpung rgyan dang / /phyag zhabs gdu bu se mo do/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ni/ /gnas lnga dag tu 14byed3/7/

gtug bya ste/ /sngags kyi bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs sogs rnam par bsam/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāg tsit+ta gu ṇa kasgro/badz+ra swa bhā wa 1āt+pa kopho2haṃ/ lus kyi ba spu'i gnas rnams su/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi rdul phran gnas/ /mkha' dbyings dbang phyug phyag rgya yis/ /gnas kun byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ dharmā dhā —tu badz+ra swa bhā wa 5āt+ma ko3 haṃ/lag pa shin tu brkyang ba yis7/ mdzub mo gnyis ni mdud par bcings8/ /gung mo mthe bo'i rtse mo can/ /rdo rje phyag rgya yang 9bsgyur bteg /bskor zhing kun du bskor nas kyang / /khro gnyer du ni legs gzhag bya/ /hi a bhe ṣiñtsa rmā / rat+na mā le a bhe ṣiñtsa tram̐/ pa ṭa lo a bye ṣiñtsa oṃ/ badz+ra tu byu ho/byin brlabs rigs kyi dbu rgyan gyis/ /rgyu yi mgon po rdo rje 'chang / /dpal ldan he ru ka yi sku/ / cha lugs mtshan ma rgyan gsal gyur/ / khrag 'thung mthing nag 'jigs pa'i rgyal/ /'bar ba chen po 'od zer can/ /zhal g.yas zhi ba'i rang bzhin dkar/ /dbus ma mthing nag drag po'i zhal/ /g.yon pa rmongs byed ser po ste/ /rgyab ma chags mdzad dmar ba'o/ /smin mtshams khro gnyer glog bzhin 'gyu/ /spyan dmar mche gcigs 'jigs pa'i zhal / /dbu skra sma ra ser gnag las/ /sru rnams rdo rje gyen du 'khyil/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba sa'ajigs su rung / /dgod dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yis/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi gar thabs can/ /g.yas g.yon dang po rdo rje dang / /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bur bcas/ /de 'og gnyis kyis 'jigs byed kyi/ /pags pa rlung gi tshul du bskor/ /gsum pa gnyis na mda' dang gzhu/ /g.yas kyi slobazhi pas dung khrag 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi bzhi pa 14—345

thod pa ru/ /snying chen po yis bkang ba'o/ /la lar zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas gnyis rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis thod pa zhags par bcas /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ se ral kha/ /la lar rdo rje bharnya 1dmar/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la rgyab rten mdzad / /glang chen stag gi pags pa yis/ /stod smad sku yi na bzar mnabs / /klu rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba yis/ /sku yi gnas brgyad rnam spras shing / /lha chen dpa' bo'i g.yang gzhi dag /mtshan ma chen po na bzar gsol / /sgu la thal bas byugs pa la/ /khrag dang zhag gi ri mos mtshan/ /phyag rgya lnga yis 2mtshan pa la/ /snyan gang nyi zla rin chen phreng / /thun mong 4rgyan sogs tshangs 5pa la/ /khyad par rtags kyis rnam spras pa'o/ /rang byung ngo bo las byung ba'i/ /kro bye shwa ris 'jo sgeg stabs/ /sku mdog sngo skya nam mkha'i lus/ /se ral kha yi tshul dag tu/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la rgyab rten bcas/ /lag pa g.yon pas thod pa thogs/ /g.yas pas 7ba dan gsum pa'i phyag /rin chen 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis mtshan/ /phyung nas byin gyis brlabs mdzad de/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan par 'gyur/ /gnas gzhi yi ge mtshan ma sngags/ /dkyil 'khor gdan la legs gnas rnams/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i rim pa yis/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi rnam par gsal/ /lha mo'i bum pas khrus byas te/ /dbang bsgur rigs kyi bdag por bsam/ /hriḥlas skyes pa'i ling ga ni/ /rdo rje gsang lam phaṭa kyis mtshan/ /a yig dag byas bha ga'i dbyibs/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad e gnas pa/ /sna tshogs brda yis bskul byas nas/ /thabs shes gnyis med rol par mdzad/ /oṃ pra be+e sha ya 9—phaṭa/ a la la la la ho/byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor mnyes par 74—346

mdzad / /lha rnams rang la gzhug bya ste/ /gnyis ka'i dga' ba rab tu spel//khams gsum 'gro gnas dag pa dang / /rnal 'byor mtshan ma rnam par sbyang / /gsang ba'i gnas su gzhal yas khang / /rgyan sogs gdan rnams sngon bzhin 'byung / /thig les gnas su mtshan byas nas/ /spros pas yi ge'i dkyil 'khor gsal/ /s+thāḥ1las rdo rje te ru ka /gsang gnas dbus kyi pad+ma la'o/ /tweḥlas shar du go rī ma/ /dzo las tso rī lho yi phyogs/ /nub tu dzhai las pra mo ste//dzi las be+e tā 2byang du'o/ /mtshams bzhir hūṃ phaṭa sa bon las/ /puk+ka la sogs lha mo bzhi/ /ya wa ra la bzhi po las/ /mda' gnon 'dzin ma la sogs rnams/ /me mtshams sogs kyi gru chad la/ /rim pa bzhin du gnas pa yin / /a ā me tog spos me ma/ /e aḥmar me dri chab ste/ /bar 'khyams mtshams kyi gnas bzhi ru/ /lha mo bzhi ru gnas pa yin/ /dzaḥlas rta mgrin 'phang mtho ma/ /hūṃ las phag gdong mche ba can/ /baṃ las nyi zla me 'bar ma//hoḥlas thal byed sgo bzhir gnas/ /oṃ shrī te ru ka badz+ra sa ma yi hi/ sarba duṣ+ṭan sa ma ya mu tra/ pra bhān tsa 5kra hūṃ phaṭa/ phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba sbyang mdzad nas/ /yab yum sku la gzhug par bya/ /hūṃ badz+ra gu 6he sidhe ba 7ra ma hā yo gi shwa ri di/ go rī dmar ser zhi ba mo/ /zhal bzhi g.yon brkyang 9gar gyis bzhugs/ /phyag brgyad g.yas kyi mda' bzhi la/ /tshangs pa chen po'i mgo bzhi dbyangs⑩/ /hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa shwe 1 ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ma hā badz+ra ka pā la mā la ma gh+ra te saru ru/ tso rī 1 dmar ser drag pa mo/ /g.yon na lcags kyu g.yas pa yi/ /gung mos 'khor lo rtse brgyad bstod/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ la brten zhabs g.yas bteg /oṃ badz+ra ma ra yo gi dzaḥ/ phra 7mo dmar gnag phyag bzhi ma/ /14—347

dang pos 1rdo rje kham phor 'chang / /'og gnyis khu tshur 'khor lo 'degs/ /g.yas brkyang rmongs tshul gong ma phag /oṃ badz+ra pre ta ke dzi/ be+e ta dkar mo slong mdzad tshul/ /dga' ba'i gar thabs g.yas pa na/ /thod pa mtshan ldan bdud rtsis gang 4/ /g.yon pa ba dan gsum pa'i phyag /oṃ badz+ra pra ha ri ni tram̐/ puk+ka drag mo sna tshogs mdog /g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga gsor/ /g.yon pas dpag bsam lcug ma 'dzin/ /gar gyis gzigs thabs 'gyur ba bzhin / /hūṃ badz+ra shu la a ki 5bi da phaṭa/ tsaṇ+ḍa sngo gnag dbugs 'byin tshul/ /g.yas na ra skyes rdo rjes mtshan/ /rlung 'thor g.yon pas tri shul gar/ /gzhan gyi srog 'phrog las la brtson/ /hūṃ badz+ra kro dha ts+tshan+da ka ma ṭa/ gha sma ser gnag ro ldegs tshul/ /g.yas pas ral gri g.yon me thab/ /g.yon brkyang gar gyis 'gyur 6bag can/ /myur ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya pā she phaṭa/ sme sha mthing nag phyag bzhi pa/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis thod pa zhags 7par bcas/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ se ral kha / /kun kyang thod phreng sbrul gdug dang / /zhing lpags rlon pa rin chen phreng / /gdan ni sna tshogs pad+ma la/ /zhing dang nyi mas mtshan pa'o9/ /he badz+ra ra ti phaṭa/ mda' 'dzin dkar mo mda' dang gzhu/ /me mtshams phyogs kyi pad+ma la/ /baṃ ma ha rā ti badz+ra ho/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ser mo kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rdo rje dril 'phan bden bral mtshams/ /oṃ badz+ra lo tsa me yo ya/ 'khor lo 'dzin pa dmar ser mo/ /rtsibs brgyad 'dzin ma rlung gi phyogs/ /ra ma hā shrī badz+ra ra tra hri/ sna tshogs ba dan ljang gu la/ /sna tshogs ba dan 7dbang ldan mumatshalas /a badz+ra puṣ+pe/ me tog ljang ser rdo rjes mtshan/ /gzhong thogs me yi mtshams 74—348

su gnas/ /a badz+ra dhū pe/ spos ma dkar ser rdo rjes mtshan/ /pog phor bden bral phyogs su gnas/ /a 1badz+ra ā lo ke/ mar me dmar mo rdo rjes mtshan / /gsal 'dzin rlung gi mtshams su gnas/ /aḥbadz+ra gabye/ dri chab ljang gu rdo rjes mtshan/ /dag 'thor dbang ldan mtshams su gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ/ rta gdong dkar mo lcags kyu dang / /thod pa rta mgo ljang gu shar//oṃ badz+ra 2pra be+e sha hūṃ/ phag gdong sngon mo g.yas mche ba/ /g.yon zhags lho yi sgo la gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra shri kha le baṃ/ snang ba dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis/ /nyi zla lcags sgrog nub kyi phyogs/ /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi hoḥ/ thal byed ljang gu g.yas dril bu/ /g.yon pa ban+dha sku bcas byang / /lha mo 'di dag thams cad kyang / /rin chen rgyan dang na bza' bklubs / /sgu mdzes khros pa'i mtshan ma 'dzin/ /sgo ba cung zad 'gying ba'i tshul/ /mgon po ro mnyam la bzhugs nas / /chos dbyings ye shes snyoms 'jug las/ /lha mos bdag po bsgul mdzad de/ /sems can kun don rnam 'phrul mdzad/ /brten pa'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams kyi5/ /skye mched drug la sangs rgyas drug /phyag rgya bzhi yi mtshan ma dang / /rigs kyi bdag pos brgyan par bya/ /thugs kyi 'od zer 'phro 'du yis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bskul mdzad cing / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i sbyor tshogs dang / /rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcing / /stong pa shin tu yod med rnal 'byor mthu/ /nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rdo rje he ru skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.e h+ya 6hi bha ga bā na ma hā kā ru ṇi ka shrī dṛ 7byu ho/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/bde gshegs pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'gro ba ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /14—349

don gyi dbang gis dgongs nas kyang / /'khor bcas gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol / /kā ya wāka tsit+ta hūṃ/ sgyu 'phrul dga' ba'i rdo rje rol pa'i tshogs/ /gzhan la snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par mdzes/ /a la la ho/ tshangs pa'i tshogs rnams zil gyis lkuganon mdzad cing / /rtog pa du ma'i sgo 'dogs gcod par mdzad/ /a la la ho/ gnyis med ye shes gnyis can rnam mtha' yas/ /snang stong bde chen mnyam nyid dbyings la rol a la la ho/kun 'byung yon tan rtsol med lhun grub gang / /rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor rnam bkod rang las byung / /a la la ho/ mdzad pa rgya chen 'gog med kun grub pas / /tshogs bcas rol pas bya ba kun rdzogs pa/ /a la la ho/ sku gsung thugs mchog yon tan phrin las brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a la la ho/ smin ma g.yo ba 'degs tshul gyis/ /ru lu ru lur bcad dgod 'dud/ /hūṃ a ti byu ho/ ban da māṃ ka —ro ya mi gu ru pa ti/ a la la ho/ oṃ 'byung ba che las thams cad 'byung / /stong gsum rdul snyed ma lus pa'i/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dang / /dri tshogs kun gyis mchod pa'i phyir/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus spro/ /oṃ pa na pe na pe nu su ra ta ti bu pa ra mu/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma yo ga tsit+ta aḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puste/ oṃ badz+ra dhū 5pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke/badz+ra gadhe/ pra tre+ets+tsha ho/ shrī bha ga bān kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rdo rje drag po gad mo che/ /mkhur ba dbugs kyi rlung 'byin cing / /'brug gi sgra ltar zab pa yi//ru lu ru lu'i sgra brjod do/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das / /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /dam tshig las dang rnam 14—350

sbyang phyir/ /dur khrod gar gyi phyag rgya gsal/ /shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la//zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi rnal 'byor kyis/ /rnal 'byor bde mchog dam par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas khro bya 1khro bo ni/ /thal bar 'jig pa'i mchog yin te/ /sems dpa' sngon po 'bar ba'i ngang / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po snang / /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu 'khrol ba'i sgrar bcas pa/ /gos chen po dang byug pa che/ /sha chen po dang sbrang rtsi che2//dur khrod kun kyi 'byung ba yi/ /phyag rgya dpal ldan dbang phyug mchog /shin tu khro gtum gdug pa yi/ /sems can khams ni rnam sbyang phyir/ /'di ni dpal ldan he ru ka'i/ /rdo rje rgya chen dbang phyug mchog /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan dang / /sangs rgyas gtsug gi nor bu dag /dpal ldan he ru ka bcas pa'i/ /phyag rgya sna tshogs rnam 'phrul pa'o/ /se ral kha yi tshul dag tu/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la rgyab rten bcas/ /lag pa g.yon par thod pa thogs/ /g.yas pa ba dan gsum par bya/ /nam mkha'i phyag rgya rnal 'byor pa/ /nam mkha' kun du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bud med la sogs rin chen mchog /dngos po thams cad mkha' la 'byin/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi sbyor ba yis/ /bde bar 'bab pa'i gar byed pas/ /dkyil mo krung ni phyed bcas la/ /rkang pas rang gi brla mnan nas/ /legs par bsdams pa'i sbyor ba yi / /yang nas yang du bskyod pa yis/ /oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhi dang drag po rmongs pa'i mchog /dga' bar gar byed 'gyur bar 4bcas/ /shi ba ldang ba'i spyor ba yis/ /bde ba'i phyag rgya rab tu gnas/ /zhi dang drag po rmongs byed dang //gyen tu 'bugs byed gar byed lus/ /lta ba'i phyag rgya grub pa'i mchog /14—351

gsang ba'i spyor ba bde mchog gis/ /me tog bdug pa'i sbyor ba mchog /chang dang chu dang lcug ma dang / /ras dang me tog grub pa yis/ /khyad par du ni rgyas 'debs so/ /rtse gcig mnyam par spyor ba yis/ /sbyor ba'i gnyer pa bde ba bzhin/ /mngon par gtor zhing se gol brdab/ /dal bus gyen du dbugs 'byin pas/ /g.yon du blta zhing lag pas drud/ /'o byed 'khyud pa de bzhin te/ /gar byed rab tu rmongs pa dang / /zas dang gsang ba'i lus rnams dang / /tshangs pa chen po'i mgo dang ni/ /de bzhin 'jig rten gsum las rgyal/ /de bzhin sa las 'dren pa dang / /rang gi phyag rgya'i tshul bstan dang / /dur khrod dag gis gar byed dang / de bzhin rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang / /rab tu 'jigs par sreg 1pa'i me/ /las kyi phyag rgya rab tu gnas/ /dang po rgyas 'debs ma yi rgya/ /snying 'dren ma yi gnyis pa'o/ /gsum pa shin tu rmongs byed ma'i/ /de bzhin bzhi pa 'debs byed ma'i/ /lnga pa gar byed ma yi rgya/ /drug pa gsod ma yin par bshad/ /bdun pa za ba mo yi rgya/ /brgyad pa las kyi phyag rgya yin/ /mda' gnon 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i/ /lha mo bzhi po snga ma bzhin/ /me tog la sogs brgyad rnams ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyag rgya snga 4ma'i tshul/ /rang 'byung mo dang bcas pa yi/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis gnyis med 'gyur/ /gzigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyur ba'i rgyas thob la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'o byed 'khyud pas rmongs mdzad de/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bde ba'i mchod ston kun gsol la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bde mchog ngo mtshar bstan du gsol/ /rgyas btab rmongs byas mnabs su gsol/ /bde mchog ngo mtshar bde la bzhugs/ /hūṃ a la la la ltaho/ snang bar mdzod/ /rnal 14—352

'byor bde mchog sgyu mas sprul/ /dam tshig dag la 'jug tu gsol/ /nyon mongs kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ / ma lus bdag la mnabs su gsol/ /nyon mongs thams cad gsal bar mdzod/ /1so so'i ljags kyi pad+ma la/ /chos kyi snying po mtshan ma'i dkyil/ /sum+bha 2gasta ma hā na de bo hi ri mi ri4/mi ti ri ni 5shrī ye/ rdo rje thal mo gyen du dbye/ /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug /mthe bong 6gnyis kyi mche ba gcigs/ /'jigs pa rdo rje gnod sbyin ma / /sngags bcas gnas su gzhag 7byas te/ /rim bzhin mtha' nas dgrol bya'o/ /oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad grub par mdzod/ /mnyam pa'i gnas la rol du gsol/ /hūṃ rdo rje las kyi mda' gzhu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje chags pa'i dam tshig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rab tu 'jigs pa la 9phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje dril bu rab tu 'khrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs ban+dha rtag pa las/ /sna tshogs bdud rtsis rnam par bkang / /lnga lnga lnga yi 'phro 'du yis//mtshan ma rnam pa lnga dang ldan/ /'od dang du ba dri dang sgra/ /lha mo'i gzugs ston bdud rtsi bsgrub/ /rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /mnyam pa'i don la rol par mdzod/ /byin brlabs rgyan dang mtshan ldan pa'i/ /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya'i mchog /byin gyis zlobs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /gsang ba chen po rnam par rol/ /grub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yo la sogs pa'i/ /bstod pa'i glu 14—353

rnams blangs byas nas/ /sil snyan kun gyi sgra rnams dang / /gar gyi ①lha rnams mnyes par bya/ /dhe ko kai ke ko/ dhe badz+ra badz+ra/ ṣ+yor byer/ ṭ+wāṃ mā rmā shā/ hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ byo hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ bh+yo ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo②/ dhe kai kai rka kai kai kai/ dhe kai kai kai/ bdag cag dam tshig 'di la mngon du zhugs pa rnams/ /bcad gtubs ④lus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /grib mas phog pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa/ /sku yi phyogs tsam mthong bas mod la 'tsho ba dang / /gzi mdangs lus la 'jug pa bye ba stong phrag gis/ /'od kyis ④phog pas 'jig rten khams su snang ba dang / /lus ngag sems dang tshe ni rdo rje rab gnas shing //re smon thams cad dus 'dir grub par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas bzlas brjod rnam gnyis sam/ /thig le gnyis sam phra mo gnyis/ /rnam dag mtshan ma gsal ba dang / /mtshan ma med pa'i don bsam bya/ /mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor kun gyi mchog /don dam bde ba chen po'i sku/ /de bzhin dbyengs nyid ye shes kyi/ /lha nyid brtson pas bsgom par bya/ /thun bzhi'i skabs su gtor ma btang / /rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor mchod cing bstod/ /rang las phyung ste mdun bzhag nas/ /gsol btab las la bskul bar bya/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub byed⑤/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'gro ba'i don la dgongs/ /oṃ badz+ra gats+tsha muḥ/ de nas phyag rgya rnam bkod pa/ /rim bzhin bdag la bsdu byas nas/ /rnam gsum sems dpa' hūṃ la thim/ /rim bzhin thig le mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /rjes 'byung mtshan ma'i skur gnas te/ /mtshan dpe rgyan dang cha lugs la/ /go cha go bcings bsrung bya zhing / /dbang bskur dbu 14—354

rgyan cod pan ldan/ /kai haṃ oṃ bye/ oṃ rat+na ma le a nyi ṣañtsa tram̐/ oṃ pa ṭa lo ba a nyi lo ba hūṃ/ spyod lam kun du ma nyams par/ /lha nyid du ni bsgom bya ste//dbang po snang ba yul dus rnams/ /dkyil 'khor rol ba'i tshud du brtag /bza' btung byin brlabs ①ma nyams bzlas/ /sgyu ma gnyis med ye shes rol/ /byed spyod tshogs gnyis rgyu ru brtag /thams cad 'gro ba'i don phyir spyad/ /nyon mongs rba ④rlabs 'jigs las sgrol/ /skyab ④mdzad dpa' ldan te ru ka'i//don bkod 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas shog /dpal he ru ka'i gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon ku ku rā dzas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra sirnya dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā rjob ban+de lha rin po ches bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //14—355

༄ga /dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī bai ro tsa na dze+egu t+yāze dha ro byu ①ha nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bdag gsal ba gnyis med mchog /longs spyod rnam sprul bde chen sku/ /rigs kyi 'khor lo rab mdzes pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor kun 'byung gnas phyag 'tshal/ /zhi 'gog mya ngan 'das sogs 'joms/ /rgyu 'bras lam zhen dbugs sbyin mdzad—/ /dpal ldan rnam snang gsang ba'i don/ /rnam dgod sgrub thabs mchog bshad bya/ /rang bzhin ngang tshul bzang las byung / /gnyis med yon tan skye ba thob/ /skyabs 'gro byang sems sdom pa can/ /dbang thob dam tshig 'jigs med pa/ /theg chen gsang sngags blo gros mchog /rnam snang dkyil 'khor la dga' bas/ /phyi nang g.yeng ba rab bsal te/ /rang gi 'dod don 14—358

'bras bu gnyer/ /rten gnas dgon pa gtsug lag khang / /ri yi rtse rnams thams cad du/ /rnam pa du ma sna tshogs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa bsgrub par bya/ /'gro la snying rje chen po yis/ /bdag gzhan sgrol bar dam bcas nasarka/ /sbyor ldan nus mthu gsum bskyed pas/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sbyang ba dang / /dbang po'i dkyil 'khor mdun dmigs te/ /dang po bya ba'i rim rdzogs spyad/ /sgrib tshogs las sgrol dag byed pa'i/ /sems can tshad med blo yis gzung / /bar chad bgegs bsal ①srung byed pa'i/ /'khor lo me 'od ra ba gur/ /phyogs bcur khro bo'i tshogs bskyed pa'i/ /cho gas rang gi las bzhin bsgom/ /thams cad spros bral de bzhin nyid/ /gnyis med byang chub sems dbyengs las/ /'gro la khyab pa'i thugs rje'i rgyun/ /stong gsal nam mkha'i shugs ltar byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal/ /rnam 'phrul ting 'dzin gnas la zhugs/ /e yi ram̐ baṃ lo sum̐ ram̐/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya mi maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ spyo④/ chos 'byung nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rim bzhin brtsegs/ /ri rab me 'od rgyan gsal zhing //kha dog dbyibs rgyan mtshan mar bcas/ /bde gshegs yon tan snang ba'i gnas—/ /sna tshogs pad+ma rin po che/ /'khor lo sna tshogs rdo rje dbus/ /khang pa gru bzhi sgo khyud dang / /rta babs bzhi yis mdzes byas pa/ /sa gzhi ①nam mkha' logs kyi phyogs/ / rigs kyi rjorin chen 'tsher ba la/ /rang 'byung nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'od/ /sna lnga'i rtsig pa dra ba dang / /dra phyed rin chen pha gus mtshan/ /'khor los mtshan pa'i ka ba brgyad/ /rin chen mu tig me tog phreng / /rgyal mtshan bla re rnga yab gdugs/ / 'dod yon ⑤lnga yi lha mo mchog /14—359

zla phyed rdo rje rin chen dang / /ba dan dril bu'i sgra snyan sgrogs/ /pho brang 'khor lo rtse brgyad la/ /pad mtshan mu khyud 'khor lo'i phreng / /mtshams su bum pa gang ba bzhi/ /rigs kyi mtshan mas rnam par mdzes/ /bar skabs re'u cha brgyad la/ /mtshams phyed 'khor lo'i phreng bas mdzes/ /khyams kyi cha yi mtshalas bzhi dang / /sgo gnas la sogs pad+ma'i gdan/ /phyi rol ra ba rim gsum brgyan/ /phyogs mtshalas dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /de mtha' 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang / /rdo rje ra bas bskor ba'o/ /yod pa ma yin med pa min/ /dbu mar yang ni dmigs su med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin spyor ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub pa'o/ /rnam thar sgo bzhir snyoms 'jug gi/ /'gog gnas gdul bya'i don bral la/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bskul mdzad de/ /mngon byang lnga yis rdzogs skur 'gyur/ /sems dang sems dpa'i ting 'dzin dang / /byang chub spyod pa sna tshogs nyid/ /de bzhin bdud dang bdud las rgyal/ /de yi byang chub sangs rgyas yin/ /oṃ ma hā su kha ①badz+ra satwa aḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ②su ra ta ①s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen sku/ /dkar zhing dmar ba'i mdangs gsal lorjo/ /zhal bzhi rnam gzigs phyag bzhi parka/ /dang po rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bcas 'khrol/ /'og ma gnyis kyis ④mda' dang gzhu/ /mtshan dpe phyag rgya lnga yis mdzes/ /stod g.yogs dar dkar gser ris can/ /sku smad tshi rjogu'i na bza' la/ /rin chen phreng ba'i rkad chings 'dril/ /mgul du do shal dpung rgyan dang / /phyag bzhi gdu bu se mo do/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ni/ /gnas lnga dag tu gtugs ⑦bya ste/ /sngags kyi bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs sogs rnam 14—360

par bsam/ /oṃ na maḥ①sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka ciste gu ṇa kan+d+ra badz+ra swa bhā wa ②a ko3haṃ/ lus kyi ba spu'i gnas rnams su/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi rdul phran gnas/ /mkha' dbyings dbang phyug phyag rgya yis/ /gnas kun byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ dharma ①dhā tu swa bhā wa byed kolhahaṃ/ rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar te/ /lag gnyis nor bu rin chen dung / /ji ltar rigs pa mnyam sbyar nas/ /mdzub mo mthe bong rtse mo bzhi/ /yongs su bsgyur te bteg nas su/ /dpral bar legs par gzhag rjopar bya/ /khaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ rat+na mā le a rnyi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ pa ṭa lo ⑤a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ badz+ra tu6 ho/ byin brlabs rigs kyi dbu rgyan gyis/ /rgyu yi dumagon po rdo rje 'chang / /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad sku/ /cha lugs mtshan ma rgyan gsal gyur/ /zhal bzhi ser dkar ljang dmar mdog /sku mdog gangs ri nyi shar bzhin/ /phyag na chos gos lhung bzed dang / /'khar gsel dam chos glegs bam 'dzin/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal cha lugs dang / /longs spyod kun gyis nyer mdzes par/ /thun mong rgyan sogs tshang ba las/ /khyad par rtags kyis rnam spras pa'o/ /rang 'od ngo bo las byung ba'i/ / thabs dang shes rab gnyis med yum/ /⑦sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar gsal mdangs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgyu rtsal can/ /g.yas pa 'khor lo thod pa g.yon/ /rin chen rgyan sogs phreng ba dang / /na bza' ⑧dril bu rked chings ⑨can/ /phyung nas byin gyis brlabs mdzad de/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur pa/ /gnas bzhi yi ge mtshan ma sngags/ /dkyil 'khor gdan la legs gnas rnams/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis ⑩rnam par gsal/ /lha yi bum pas khrus byas te/ /dbang 14—361

bskur rigs kyi bdag por bsam/ /khaṃ ①las skyes pa'i ling ga ni/ /'khor lo gsang ④lam phaṭa kyis mtshan/ /a yig dag byas bha ga'i dbyibs/ /pad+ma'i 'dab brgyad e gnas pa/ /sna tshogs brda yis bskul byas nas/ /thabs shes gnyis med rol par mdzad/ /oṃ pra be sha phaṭa/ a la la la la ho/byang chub sems kyi 'od zer kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor mnyes par gamadzad—/ /lha rnams rang la gzhug byas te/ /gnyis ka'i dga' ba rab tu 'phel—/ /khams gsum 'gro gnas dag pa dang / /rnal 'byor mtshan ma rnam par sbyang / /gsal ba'i gnas su gzhal yas khang / /rgyan sogs gdan rnams sngon bzhin dbyung / /thig le gnas su mtshan byas na/ /spros pa yi ge'i dkyil 'khor gsal/ /khaṃ las rnam par snang mdzad de/ /gsang gnas dbus kyi pad+ma la'o/ /haṃ las sangs rgyas kun brjod ma/ /tsho las de bzhin dpa' mo ste/ /tram̐ las kun tu bzang mo yin/ /dhe las mi zad snod 'dzin ma'o—/ /saṃ las sangs rgyas kun ldan pa/ /rgyu las zhal bzang gzung ma ste/ /ha las lha mo sprin chen rjomo/ /khaṃ las nam mkha'i sbyan ma'o/ /de dag nang gi phyogs bzhi dang / /phyi nas re'u cha'i phyogs bzhir ro/ /i las rjogling bu tram̐ pi wang / /baṃ las rnga chen dze+e rdza rnga/ /me mtshams rjol sogs re'u ⑦mig tu/ /lha mo bzhi ni gnas pa yin/ /a ā me tog spos me ma/ /e aḥmar me dri chab ma'o—/ /bar khyams mtshams kyi gnas bzhi ru/ /lha mo bzhi ni gnas pa yin//dzaḥlas rta mgrin 'phang mtho ma/ /hūṃ las phag gdong mche ba can/ /baṃ las nyi zla me 'bar ma/ /hoḥlas thal byed sgo bzhir gnas/ /oṃ bhu khaṃ dzaḥ/rang gi gnas nas spro bya ste/ /slar 'dus rang gi lus la gzhug⑧ /oṃ sa tak+ṣa/14—362

sangs rgyas kun brjod chu shel mtshungs/ /rgyan mdzes lce yi phyag rgya 'dzin/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na ram̐/ dpa' bo shin tu rgyal mo mchog /gsar mdog phyag gnyis thal mo 'dzin/ /oṃ badz+ra dharma ①pa/ kun bzang pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse lnga tog /oṃ badz+ra kan+d+ra haṃ/ mi zad snod 'dzin sna tshogs mdog/rgyan dang snod kyang chos kyi dung / /oṃ satwa badz+ra/ sangs rgyas kun brgyan gur kum mdog /thugs kar sangs rgyas mi bskyod sku/ /tsho badz+ra ra ti ho/ lha mo zhal bzangs ④me long mdog /phyag gnyis me long rlung g.yab 'dzin/ /tram̐ badz+ra pad+ma/ sprin chen bai ḍūr+ya mdog mtshungs/ /phyag gnyis sprin chen ser ba 'bebs—/ /dha bi shwa badz+ra/ nam mkha'i spyan ma ser skya'i mdangs/ /phyag gnyis pad bcas mig gi rgya/ /te ra ti tsakra pi la si tra thā/ gling bu sngon mo sna tshogs sgra/ /'khor los mtshan pa'i gling bu sgogs/ /he ra ti tsakra ke te te te te①/ pi wang ser mo drug ldan dbyangs/ /'khor los mtshan pa'i pi wang bgreng / /te ra ti tsakra ha se ha sa baṃ/ rnga chen dmar mo 'khor lo'i rnga/ /phrin las so so'i tshul bzhin du/ /he ra ti tsakra ni pi rjote pa pa ba rdza/ /rdza rnga ljang gu rdza rnga ma/ /'khor los mtshan pa'i rol stabs tshul/ /a badz+ra puṣ+pe/me tog dmar ser 'khor los mtshan/ /rin chen gzhong pa gang ba 'dzin/ /a ⑤badz+ra byu rjope/ spos me dkar sngon bdug pa'i snod/ /'khor los mtshan pa g.yas su 'jog /a ⑦badz+ra ā lo ke/ mar me dmar mo 'khor los mtshan/ /snod mang mar me'i sdong po 'dzin/ /a ⑧badz+ra gadhe⑨/ dri chab ljang skya 'khor los mtshan/ /dung chos g.yon 'dzin g.yas par 'thor/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥ/rta gdong dkar mo lcags kyu dang / /thod pa rta mgo ljang gu 'dzin/ /oṃ badz+ra 14—363

pā she hūṃ/ phag gdong sngon mo ①g.yas mche ba/ /g.yon pa rin chen zhags pa 'dzin—/ /oṃ badz+ra shri ⑧kha le baṃ/ snang ba dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis/ /lcags sgog nyi ma zla bas mtshan/ /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi hoḥ①/ thal byed ljang gu g.yas dril bu/ /g.yon pas thod pa mtha' yas sku/ /kun kyang rgyan phreng na bza' dang / /rigs kyi mtshan ma 'akying bag bzhin/ /'dzum btag dgod pa'i so zur ston/ /rang gi cha lugs gar gyi rjoganas/ /mgon po ro mnyam la zhugs nas/ /chos dbyings ye shes snyoms 'jug pas/ /lha mos bdag po bskul mdzad de/ /sems can kun don rnam 'phrul mdzad/ /brten pa'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams kyi/ /skye mched drug la ⑤sangs rgyas drug /phyag rgya bzhi yi mtshan ma dang / /rigs kyi bdag pos nye bar mtshan/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bskul mdzad cing / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i sbyor tshogs dang / /rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcing / /stong pa shin tu yod med rnal 'byor mthu/ /nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rnam par snang mdzad skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.e bye hi bha ga bān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ḍi rjo6 ho/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bde gshegs pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir—/ /'gro ba ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /don kyi dbang gis dgongs nas kyang / /'khor bcas gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /kā ya wāka /sto ⑦hūṃske/ sgyu 'phrul dga' ba'i rdo rje rol mo'i tshogs/ /gzhan la snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par mdzes/ /a la la ho/ tshangs pa'i tshogs rnams zil gyis non ⑧mdzad cing / /rtog pa du ma'i sgro 'dogs gcod par mdzad/ /a 14—364

la la ho/ gnyis med ye shes gnyis can rnam ①mtha' yas/ /snang stong bde chen mnyam nyid dbyings la rol/ /a la la ho/ kun 'byung yon tan rtsol med lhun grub snang / /rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor rnam dgod rang las byung / /a la la ho/ mdzad pa rgya chen 'gog med kun grub pas/ /tshogs bsags rol pas bya ba kun rdzogs pa/ /a la la ho/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan phrin las rgyan/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo a la la ho—/ rdo rje dpal gyi thal mo sgyur/ /bsam g.yos bzhin rgyas gnas su 'dud/ /oṃ a ti pu ho/ ban+da ṭ+wāṃ lakā ro ya mi gu ru pa ti a la la ho/ oṃ 'byung ba che ④las thams cad 'byung / /stong gsum rdul snyed ma lus pa'i/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus spro/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dang / /dri tshogs kun gyis mchod par bya/ /oṃ pa na po po rjonu su ra ta ti pu par mu/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma yo ga sidha uhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhū pe⑤/badz+ra ā lo ke/ badz+ra gadhe/ pra tīts+tsha ho/ shrī bha ga bān kha kha khā nyi/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis dag girjo/ /mdzub mo mthe'u chung mdzes par bsgyur/ /rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas su/ /de bzhin g.yon pa bsgyur bar bya/ /de ni sbyor ba bteg nas ni/ /spyi bo'i mtshalas su gzhag ④par bya/ /skal ⑧bzang oṃ zhes bya ba'i glus/ /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya/ /oṃ gyi glu yi phyag rgya ni/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis ci dgar blang / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /thar pa thams cad rnam dag phyir/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya dpal du gnas/ /don dam rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ /btso ma gser gyi kha dog bzhin/ /chags med la sogs 14—365

chags chen phyir/ /dkar zhing sna tshogs gsal ba'i mdangs/ /chos kyi rgyal srid rab bsgrub pa/ /rin chen chos las lhag pa med/ /de bas theg chen byang chub sems/ /rgyal ba rdo rje rin chen can/ /g.yas pa'i mthe bong ①gung mo gnyis/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcangs pa 'di/ /sor mo kun la reg pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i phyag rgya yin par grags/ /g.yas pa'i yan lag gnon snepa yis/ /g.yon pa'i yan lag kun las rgyal/ /sems dpa'i skyikha mo krung bcas pa/ /bdud rnams thams cad 'joms par byed/ /oṃ bhu khaṃ swā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur bcangs nas su/ g.yon pas ④dgag pa kun brjod ma/ /te ru ka yi khu tshur che / /g.yon pas dgab pa dpa' mo yin/ /pad+mo rdo rje khu tshur ni/ /g.yon dgab kun tu bzang mo'o/ /rin chen 'dzin pa'i khu tshur yang / /g.yon pas dgab pa mi zad snod/ /sangs rgyas khu tshur bcangs nas su/ /dgab pa sangs rgyas kun ldan dpal/ /bud med phyag rgya bcings nas su/ /dgag pa zhal bzang gzung ⑤ma yin/ /rta mchog dpal gyi khu tshur yang / /dgab pa sprin chen me yi rgya/ /dpal grub spyan gyi khu tshur dag /dgab pa nam mkha'i spyan ma'o/ /gling bu ma tshogs lha mo yi/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin/ /rang byung lha mo dang bcas pa'i/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis gnyis med 'gyur/ /'jig rten khams mang rdul phran grangs med khyab par spros pa ni/ /rgyal ba'i don rnams rab tu phra ba'i rdul gyi grangs snyed nirjo/ /⑦srid pa'i bde chen de bzhin gshegs kun rnam 'phrul tshogs bcas kyis/ /rdul phreng grangs snyed de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul par mdzod/ /mchod pa don po thams cad 'grub par mdzod/ /ho dpal rnam par snang mdzad sbyor ba a la la la la ho/14—366

de ring grub par mdzod/ /so so'i ljags kyi pad+mo la/ /chos kyi snying pos mtshan pa'i dkyil/ /oṃ ru ru spu ①ru dz+wa la ti— sirnyi lo tsa ne+e sathāze sā dha ni swā hā/rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar nas/ /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug /mthe bo'i rtse mo mnyam par gzhag② /khong stong mi 'gyur dam pa'o/ /sngags bcas gnas su gzhag gabya ste/ /rim bzhin mtha' nas dgrol bar bya'o/ /oṃ aXhūṃ/rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa grub par mdzod/ / dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /rjomachod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad grub par mdzod / /mnyam pa chen po'i gnas la rol du gsol/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ /rdo rje chos ni glur blangs pas| /rdo rje las ni byed par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mnyam spyor ba//rab tu dga' bas blta ⑤zhing 'dzum/ /shin tu srid pa yang dag sgrub/ /gsal bar lta la gnas par mdzod/ /sna tshogs badzha brtag pa la/ /sna tshogs bdud rtsi'i rnam par dag /lnga lnga lnga duyi 'phro 'du yis/ /mtshan ma rnam pa lnga dang ldan/ /'od dang du ba dri dang sgra/ /lha yi gzugs ston bdud rtsi bsgrub/ /rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /mnyam pa'i don las rol par mdzad/ /byin brlabs mtshan dang rgyan ldan pa'i/ /mi mo rnams kyi ⑦reg bya'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs ⑧shig rnal 'byor pa/ /gsang ba chen po rnam par rol /grub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yo la sogs pa'i/ /bstod pa'i glu rnams blangs byas nas/ /sil snyan kun kyi sgra rnams dang / /gar kyis lha rnams mnyes par bya/ /e e 14—367
