saṃ—/ haṃ haṃ haṃ/ baṃ baṃ baṃ/ rda rda rda/ bdag cag dam tshig 'di la mngon du zhugs pa rnams/ /bcad gtubs ①lus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /grib mas phog pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa/ /sku yi phyogs tsam mthong na mod la 'tsho ba dang / /gzi mdangs lus la 'jug pa bye ba stong phrag gi②/ /'od kyis ④phog pas 'jig rten khams kun snang ba dang / /lus ngag sems dang tshe ni rdo rjer rab gnas te/ /re smon thams cad dus 'dir 'grub par mdzad du gsol—/ /de nas bzlas brjod rnam gnyis sam/ /thig le gnyis sam phra mo gnyis—/ /rnam dag mtshan ma gsal ba dang / /mtshan ma med pa'i don bsam bya/ /mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor kun kyi mchog /don dam bde ba chen po'i sku/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes kyi/ /lha nyid brtson pas bsgom par bya—/ /thun bzhi'i skabs su gtor ma btang / /rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor mchod bstod cing / /rang las byung te mdun bzhag nas/ /gsol btab las la bskul bar bya/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub sprularjo/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'gro ba'i don la dgongs/ /oṃ badz+ra gats+tsha muḥ/ de nas phyag rgya rnam bkod pa/ /rim bzhin bdag la bsdu byas nas/ /rnam gsum sems dpa' hūṃ la thim/ /rim bzhin thig le mnyam pa'i dbyengs/ /rjes 'byung mtshan ma'i skur gnas te/ /mtshan dpe rgyan dang cha lugs gsal/ /cho ga go bcings bsrung bya zhing / /dbang bskur dbu rgyan cod pan ldan/ /rka haṃ oṃ rtu oṃ rat+na mā le a rnyi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ pa ṭalo ba a rnyi ṣiñtsa lo ba hūṃ/ spyod lam kun du ma nyams par/ /lha nyid du ni bsgom bya ste/ /dbang po snang ba'i yul 14—368

dus rnams/ /dkyil 'khor rol pa'i tshul du brtag /bza' btung ①byin brlabs sdem nyams par/ /sgyu ma gnyis med ye shes rol/ /byed spyod tshogs gnyis rgyu ru brtag /thams cad 'gro ba'i don phyir spyad/ /dpal ldan rnam snang dkyil 'khor gyi/ /gsang don rnam par bkod byas las/ /byung ba'i dge ba dri med des/ /khams gsum sku drug rnam gsal shog /dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon ku ku rā dzas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra si ha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ①ba ban+de lha rin po ches bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //ba5ra mchan/358 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉ra / /dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi gsang don bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṇa/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ja/359 ①〈〈pe 〉stanasal/ khru〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉ts+tsha/ sne〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉thazhi/ ④〈〈be+e 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sdem gyi/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉༅na tan/36༷ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ra ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7ཿ/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ta/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉lad/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉ra ga ⑦〈〈snar 〉sngagatug361 ①〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉7na maḥ/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉dharmā/ ①〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉tha/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazhag⑤〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉7ba/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉yonas/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7thabs dang shes rab gnyis med yum//⑧〈〈pe 〉dze'ar 〉raza'/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉7cings/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉tha/362 ①〈rjope 〉sko'ar 〉khims/ sne〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉7dngas/ dze+e〈'ar 〉7/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉ra/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉7/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7nyams/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṭha/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉thazhug363 ①〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉sko〈co 〉〉dharmā/ ②〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉thazang / ske〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7te/ du〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉༅/14byed369

gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/①༄ ga /rgya gar skad du/ shrī pad+ma narte shwa ri gu h+ya aze ⑤dha ro byu he nā ma—/ bod skad du/ dpal pad+ma gar kyi dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag zhi ba zab mo'i chos/ /rgya cher drag shul 'od gsal zhing / /rab rtogs ①bya ba grub pa'i tshogs/ /gsung bdag gtso bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /gti mug la sogs rab 'joms pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi pad+mo'i sku/ /gar gyi dbang phyug sgrub pa'i thabs/ /de don 'dod pa'i don phyir bshad/ /rang bzhin ngang tshul bzang las byung / /gnyis med yon tan skye bas thob/ /skyabs 'gro byang sems sdom pa can/ /dbang thob dam tshig 'jigs med pa/ /theg chen gsang sngags blo gros mchog /gar dbang dkyil 'khor la dga' bas/ /phyi nang g.yeng ba rab bsal ④te/ /rang gi 'dod don 'bras bu gnyer/ /pad+mo 14—371

skyed mos tshal dga' dang / /chu bo dag gi mdo dag tu/ /pad+mo 'dzin pa'i dgos pa rnams/ /rnam pa du ma 'grub par 'gyur/ /'gro la snying rje chen po yis / /bdag gzhan sgol bar dam bcas nas/ /sbyor ldan nus mthu gsum bskyed pa①/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sbyang ba dang / /dbang po'i dkyil 'khor mdun dmigs te/ /dang po bya ba'i rim rdzogs spyad/ /sgrib tshogs las grol byed pa yi④/ /sems can tshad med blo yis gzung ④/ /bar chad bgegs bsal srung byed pa'i/ /'khor lo me 'od ra ba gur/ /phyogs bcur khro bo'i tshogs bskyed pa'i/ /cho gas rang gi rjolas bzhi bsgom/ /thams cad spros bral de bzhin nyid/ /gnyis med byang chub sems dbyings las/ /'gro la khyab pa'i thugs rje'i ④rgyun/ /stong gsal nam mkha'i shugs ltar 'byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal/ /rnam 'phrul ting 'dzin gnas la bzhugs—/ /e yo baṃ lo me sum̐ ram̐/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā rjota a nu rā ga ya mi maṇ+ḍa ⑦la hūṃ zlo⑧/ chos 'byung nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rim bzhin brtsegs/ /ri rab me 'od rgyan gsal zhing / /kha dog dbyibs rgyan mtshan mar bcas/ /bde gshegs yon tan snang ba'i gnas//sna tshogs pad+ma rin po che/ /'khor lo sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbus/ /khang pa gru bzhi sgo khyud dang / /rta babs bzhi yis mdzes byas pa/ /sa gzhi nam mkha' logs kyi phyogs/ /rigs kyi rin chen cher 'bar la/ /rang 'byung ⑨nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'od/ sna lnga'i rtsig pa dra ba dang / /dra byed rin chen pha gus mtshan/ /pad+mas mtshan pa'i ka ba brgyad/ /rin chen mu tig me tog phreng / /rgyal mtshan bla re rnga yab gdugs/ /'dod yon lnga yi lha mo 'khyug /zla phyed rdo rje 14—372

rin chen dang / /ba dan dril bu'i sgra snyan sgogs/ /dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /pad mtshan mu khyud pad+mo'i phreng / /mtshams su bum pa gang ba bzhi//rigs kyi mtshan mas rnam par mdzes/ /bar mtshalas pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /khyams dang sgo sogs pad+ma'i gdan/ /phyi rol ra ba rim gsum brgyan/ /phyogs mtshams dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /de mtha' 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang //rdo rje ra bas bskor ba'o/ /ji ltar pad+ma dmar po 'di/ /chags pa'i nyes pas mi gos pa/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa de bzhin du/ /gnas kyi nyes pas yong mi gos/ /rnam thar sgo bzhi snyoms 'jug gi/ /'gog gnas gdul bya'i don bral la/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bskul ①mdzad de/ /mngon byang lnga yis rdzogs skur gyur①/ /sems dang sems dpa'i ting 'dzin dang / /byang chub spyod pa sna tshogs nyid/ /de bzhin bdud dang bdud las rgyal/ /de ni byang chub sangs rgyas yin/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa ā ཿ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ0su ra te mes+t+waṃ—/ rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen sku/ /dkar zhing dmar ba'i mdangs gsal 'od/ /zhal bzhi rnam gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ /dang po rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar//rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bcas 'khrol/ /'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ /mtshan dpe phyag rgya lnga yis mdzes/ /stod g.yogs dar dkar gser ris can/ /sku smad tshi rjogu'i na bza' la/ /rin chen phreng ba'i rked chings can/ / mgur chu ⑦do shal dpung rgyan dang / /phyag zhabs gdu bu se mo do/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ni/ /gnas lnga dag tu gtugs byas te/ /sngags kyis bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs sogs rnam par bsam/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka cit+ta gu ṇa ⑧karma badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kolhahaṃ/ lus kyi ba spu'i 14—373

gnas rnams su/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi rdul phran gnas/ /mkha' dbyings dbang phyug phyag rgya yis/ /gnas kun byin kyis brlab ①par bya/ /oṃ dharma d+ma sketu badz+ra swa bhā ba atā kolhahaṃ④/ mthe bong sems dpa'i skyid mo krung / /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug /gung mo gnyis ni mnyam par sbyar/ /lhag ma rdo rje thal mo'i 'od/ /rdo rje rin chen phyag rgya 'di/ /rang byung rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'o/ /s+thāḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ rat+na mā le a rnyi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ paṭa dulo a rnyi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ badz+ra tu 6 ho/ byin brlabs ⑤rigs kyi dbu rgyan gyi⑦/ /rgyu yi mgon po rdo rje 'chang / /dpal ldan pad+ma gar dbang sku/ /cha lugs mtshan ma rgyan gsal gyur⑦/ /sku mdog dkar la dmar bzhad chags/ /zhal mang brgya phyed phyag gis mdzes/ /g.yas kyis pad+ma skerdo rje dang / /'khor lo rin chen dbyug sogs kyis/ /mtshan zhing g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis/ /pad+ma brkyang ba'i sdong bu 'dzin/ /mtshan sogs dpe byad bzang pos mdzes nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'od zer 'phro/ /rin chen la sogs rgyan phreng tshogs/ /dar gyi gos rgyan cod pan dpyangs/ /bkra shis skyil krung legs bzhugs shing / /snyems bcas chags pa'i tshul du gzigs/ /rang 'od ngo bo las byung ba'i/ /na bza' dkar mo dkar gsal mdangs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma dang / /thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin/ /rin chen rgyan sogs phreng ba dang / /na bza' dril bu'i rked cings ⑨can/ /phyung nas byin gyis brlabs mdzad de/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan par gyur/ /gnas bzhi yi ge mtshan ma sngags/ /dkyil 'khor gdan la lags ⑩gnas rnams/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i rim pa yis/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis rnam par gsal/ /lha mo'i bum pas khrus byas te/ /dbang 14—374

bskur rigs kyi bdag por bsam/ /juḥlas skyes ①pa'i ling ga ni/ /pad+ma ②gsang lam ①phaṭa kyis mtshan/ /a yis dag byas bha ga'i dbyibs/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad e gnas pa/ /sna tshogs brda yis bskul byas nas/ /thabs shes gnyis med rol par mdzad/ /oṃ pra ⑦be+e sha phaṭa/ a la la ho/ byang chub sems kyi 'od zer kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor rab mnyes par/ /lha rnams rang la gzhug ⑤bya ste/ /gnyis ka'i dga' ba rab tu spel/ /khams gsum 'gro gnas dag pa dang / /rnal 'byor mtshan ma rab tu sbyang / /gsang ba'i gnas su gzhal yas khang / /rgyan tshogs gdan rnams sngon bzhin byung rjo/ /thig le gnas su mtshan byas nas/ /spros pas yi ge'i dkyil 'khor gsal| /gsang gnas dbus kyi pad+ma la/ /byāḥlas pad+ma gar dbang phyug /dzaḥlas rnam par gzigs ma ste/ /hūṃ las de bzhin sgrol ma yin/ /baṃ las lha mo sa 'dzin te/ /de bzhin hoḥ⑦yis khro gnyer ma/ /hūṃ gis gtum pa'i dbang phyug ste/ /hes ni sna tshogs pad+ma'o/ /a las pad+ma'i na bza' ma/ /ho las pad+ma'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /de dag nang gi phyogs bzhi dang / /phyi nas pad+ma'i phyogs bzhir ro/ /oṃ las gling bu tram̐ pi wang / /baṃ las rnga chen dza rdza rnga/ /me mtshams la sogs 'dab ma bzhir/ /lha mo bzhi ni gnas pa yin/ /a ā me tog spos me ma/ /e ⑧aḥmar me dri chab ma/ /bar mtshams khyams kyi gnas bzhi ru/ /lha mo bzhi ni gnas pa yin/ /dza las rta mgrin 'phang mtho ma/ /hūṃ las phag gdong mche ba can/ /baṃ las nyi zla me 'bar ma/ /hoḥlas thal byed sgo bzhir gnas/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shurnyo ⑨pad+ma narte shwa ri tweḥdzaḥ/rang gi gnas nas spro byas te/ /slar 'dus yab yum lus la gzhug⑩ /oṃ 14—375

sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma dza/ /rnam gzigs pad+ma rā ga'i mdog① /pad+ma dmar po ②kha 'byed mdzad/ /oṃ badz+ra pad+ma dza/ sgol ma ljang gu g.yon dkur brten/ /pad+ma sdo ①'dzin g.yas pas brten/ /he padri padri baṃ/ sa 'dzin sngon mo rgyan can ma/ /chos kyi 'khor lo pad+ma dkar/ /ho pad+ma ni ra dze+e/ khro gnyer dkar mo mdung rtse gsum/ /pad+ma mthing ga skyod rjopar byed/ /hūṃ pad+ma ⑤tsaṇ+ḍi shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ pad gtum dbang phyug gangs ri'i mdog /pad+ma dmar po tri shu rjol—/ /ha ma bi shwa pad+ma mu ge si ta hūṃ phaṭa/ sna tshogs pad+ma ljang gu'i mdog /pad+ma 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'dzin/ /byā⑦ཿpad+mo padri hūṃ hūṃ e/ pad+ma na bza' gser gyi mdog /pad+ma ser po chu srin rgyal/ /ho pad+me sha kra ma hūṃ dza/ /pad+ma'i dbang phyug dmar ba'i mdog /pad+ma le brgan rdo rtse lnga/ /te ra ti pad+ma bi si tra tha/ gling bu sngon mo sna tshogs sgra/ /pad+mas mtshan pa'i ⑧gling bu sgogs//te ra ti pad+ma ge te ta ⑨te te/ pi wang ser mo drug ldan dbyangs/ /pad+mas mtshan pa'i pi wang bsgreng / /he ra ti pad+ma hā sa haṃ/ rnga chen dmar mo pad+ma'i rnga—/ /phrin las so so'i tshul bzhin brdung / /he ra ti pad+ma ni ra ⑩bye pe pa pa rdza—/ rdza rnga ljang gu rdza rnga ma/ /pad+mas mtshan pa'i rol stobs tshul/ /a badz+ra puṣ+pe—/ me tog dkar ser pad+mas mtshan/ /rin chen gzhong ⑩pa bkang ba 'dzin—/ /aḥ⑫badz+ra dhū pe/ spos me dkar sngon bdug pa'i snod/ /pad+mas mtshan pa'i g.yas su 'degs/ /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke/ mar me dmar mo pad+mas mtshan—/ /snod mang mar me'i sdong po 'dzin/ /a ⑫badz+ra gaste/ dri chab ljang skya pad+mas mtshan/ /dung chos snod 'dzin g.yas pas 'thor/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku ⑫ dzaḥ—/ rta ⑫gdong dkar mo lcags kyu dang / /thod pa rta mgo ljang gu 'dzin/ /14—376

oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ phag gdong sngon mo g.yas mche ba/ /g.yon pa pad+ma'i zhags pa 'dzin/ /oṃ badz+ra thi ①kha le baṃ④/ snang ba mo dmar phyag gnyis kyis/ /lcags sgrog nyi ma zla bas mtshan/ /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi hoḥ/ thal byed ljang gu g.yas dril bu/ /g.yon pa thod pa g.yas pa'i sku/ /kun kyang rgyan phreng na bza' dang / /rigs kyi mtshan ma 'gying bag bzhin/ / 'dzum steg dgod pa'i ①so zur ston/ /rang gi cha lugs gar gyis rjoganas/ /mgon po ro mnyam la zhugs nas/ /chos dbyings ye shes snyoms 'jug las/ /lha mos bdag po bskul mdzad de/ /sems can kun don rnam rjo'aphrul mdzad/ /brten pa'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams kyi/ /skye mched drug la sangs rgyas drug /phyag rgya bzhi yis mtshan ma dang / /rigs kyi bdag pos nye bar mtshan/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bskul mdzad de/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i sbyor tshogs dang / /rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcing / /stong pa shin tu yod med rnal 'byor mthu/ /nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig nges par gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /pad+ma gar dbang skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.e bye hi bha ga bān/ /ma hā kā rjoru ṇi ka dṛ ⑦sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bde gshegs pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir//'gro ba ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /don gyi dbang gis dgongs nas kyang / /'khor bcas gshags ⑧shing bzhugs su gsol/ /kā ya wāka ciX hūṃ/ sgyu 'phrul dga' ba'i rdo rje rol mo'i tshogs/ /gzhan la snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par mdzes/ /a la la ho/ tshangs pa'i tshogs rnams zil gyis mnon ⑨mdzad cing / /rtog pa du ma'i sgo 'dogs gcod par mdzad/ /a la la ho/14—377

gnyis med ye shes gnyis can rnam mtha' yas/ /snang stong bde chen mnyam nyid dbyings las rol/ /a la la ho/ kun 'byung yon tan rtsol med lhun grub snang / /rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor rnam dgod rang las byung / /a la la ho/mdzad pa rgya chen 'gog ①med kun grub pas/ /tshogs bcas rol pas bya ba kun rdzogs pa/ /a la la ho/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan phrin las brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a la la ho/ thal mo pad+ma kha 'bus bzhin/ / rang gi ②snying gar bcing bya ste/ /mthe bong mthe'u chung pad+ma bzhin—/ /rgyas par 'dud pa'i phyag kyang bya/ /hri ④a ti pu rjoho/ ban+ta ṭ+wāṃ dhikā ro ya mi/ gu ru pa ti/ a la la ho/ oṃ 'byung ba che las thams cad 'byung / /stong gsum rdul snyed ma lus pa'i/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus spro/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dang / /dri tshogs kun gyis mchod par bya/ /oṃ pa na pe na pa nu su ra tarjo/ sarba ta thā ga ta⑦/sa ma yo gā sidhi s+dzahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhū ⑧pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke/ badz+ra gadhe—/ pra tīts+tsha ⑨ho/ shrī bha ga bān ⑩kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis dag gi⑪/ /mdzub mo mthe'u chung mdzes bsgyur te/ /g.yas g.yon thal mo brdabs pa yis/ /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya te zhes bya ba klu yi rgya/ /thams cad dag pas rab bsgrub pa'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ⑫/rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /'dod chags thams cad rnam dag phyir/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya dpal du gnas/ /mi 'gyur dam pa dag bya'i phyir/ /shel sgong bzhin du dag pa'o/ /'dod chags thams cad bsal ba'i phyir/ /'bar ba sna tshogs 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /14—378

sangs rgyas tshe yi rin chen spras/ /gos dang sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yis/ /bde ba can bzhin dam par 'gyur/ /gar thabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /yongs su bsgyur cing gar byas pa/ /pad+ma'i mtshan mchog pad+mor bcas/ /phyag ni ①rgya rnams 'khor lo bskor/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi sbyor ba yis/ /༷kha mo krung ni phyed mar gnas/ /rgyal ba'i dngo mo krung bcas nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar byed/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shudha pad+ma narte shwa ri byāḥdza/ snyems ④pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma dmar po ci bder gzung ①/ /snying gar 'dren tshul kha dbyed pa/ /rnam par gzigs pa'i rnam dag dpal/ /snyems dupa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma sngon po ci bder gzung ⑤/ /snying gar 'dren tshul bud med rgya/ /sgol ba'i byang chub mchog yin no/ /snyems rjopa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma dkar po ci bder gzung ⑦/ /'khor lo'i rgya bcings rab tu bskor/ /rgya chen mo yi 'khor lo'o/ /snyems ⑧pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma mthing ga ⑨ci bder gzung ⑩/ /g.yas pa gar byed ba dan gsum/ /khro gnyer ma yi phyag rgya yin/ /snyems ⑪pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma dmar po ci bder gzung ⑫/ /g.yas pa tri shul ⑫tshul du bsgreng / /pad ④gtum dbang phyug bde gnon rgya/ /snyems ⑫pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma ljang gu ci bder gzung / /g.yas pas 'khor lo rtse brgyad bstod⑩/ /pad+ma dbang phyug thugs kyi rgya/ /snyems ⑩ pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma ser po ci bder gzung ⑫/ /g.yas pas gar byed chu srin bgreng / /pad+mo gnas pa'i dpal chen yin/ /snyems ⑩pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma le brgan ci bder gzung ⑩/ /snying gar 'dren 14—379

tshul rdo rje'i rgya/ /'dod pa'i dbang mo'i go ba gsum/ /gling bu ma ①sogs lha mo yi/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin/ /rang byung lha mo dang bcas pa'i//phyag rgya sngags gnyis gnyis med gyuraske/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun la sogs //sa yi ①gzugs sogs rjosna tshogs 'dzin⑤/ /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs rnams//rjo'adul mchog dngos grub mchog mnga' ba/ /sems dpa' pad+ma'i dga' ba ⑦mchog /sgyu ma'i dga' ba bstan du gsol/ /a la la ho/ kye gar dbang thar pa'i dga' ba gar mdzod cig /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag /tshangs pa 'jug sel dbang phyug bdag /nyi zla bdag lags/ a la la ho/pad+mo sgyu ma dpal rnams sna tshogs 'dul mdzad dag pa'i tshul gyis gar byed pa/ /pad+mo dam tshig dbang phyug sangs rgyas gar rnams mdzad du gsol/ /'dod chags rnam pa sbyor ba thams cad da rung rnam par sbyongs/ /pad+mo 'dzin pas mngon sum spyan sngar gar mkhan gar mdzod cig /so so'i ljags kyi pad+ma la/ /mtshan ma chos kyi snying por bcas/ /oṃ tā re tu ta tā ⑧re tu re swa ⑨hā/ rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar nas/ /gung mo mnyam par rab tu sgrub/ /mthe bong mthe'u ⑩chung 'dab ma bzhi/ /pad+ma dri med rab tu rgyas/ /sngags bcas gnas su gzhag ⑩bya ste/ /rim bzhin mtha' nas dgol bar bya'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad grub par mdzod—/ /mnyam pa chen po'i gnas la rol du gsol/ /la lar ⑫rab tu drag cing skye bo dag ⑫la drag pa'i bud med sku ltar rab tu snang / /'gro ba 14—380

mtha' yas 'dul phyir la lar rab tu rno ba'i 'khor lo phyag na bsnams pa'i sku/ /la lar rab tu nges shing zhi ba mi 'gyur sbyin pa tshangs pa'i skur yang ston par mdzod / /la lar rab tu 'bar ba'i chags pa pad+mo'i ①rgyal po'i dam tshig bdag la grub par mdzod/ /steg ④la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /mdzes pa'i bzhin ni rnam sgyur zhing / /rim gror ①byas pa steg rjopa'i mchog /steg ⑤pa'i lta bas gar byed do/ /sna tshogs brnya brtags pa la/ /sna tshogs bdud rtsis rnam par dgang / /lnga lnga lnga yi 'phro 'du yis/ /mtshan ma rnam pa lnga dang ldanaske/ /'od dang du ba sgra dang dri/ /lha mo'i gzugs ston bdud rtsi 'grub/ /rang 'byung gdod nas rnam par dag /mnyam pa'i don ldan rol par mdzod/ /byin brlabs rjorgyan dang mtshan ldan pa'i/ /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya'i mchog /byin kyis brlab ④cing rnal 'byor pa/ /gsang ba chen po ⑧rnam par rol/ /grub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yo la sogs pa'i/ /bstod pa'i glu rnams blang byas nas/ /sel snyan rnams kyi sgra rnams dang / /gar gyis lha rnams mnyes par byas/ /pad+ma pad+ma tram̐/ pad+ma pad+ma kau⑨/ pad+ma pad+ma hri/ bdag cag dam tshig 'di la mngon du zhugs pa rnams/ /bcad gtubs ⑩lus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing //grib ma phog pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa/ /sku yi phyogs tsam mthong bas mod ⑪ la 'tsho ba dang / /gzi mdangs lus la 'jug par byed pa stong phrag gis/ /'od kyis phyogs pas ⑫'jig rten khams su snang ba dang / /lus ngag sems dang tshe ni rdo rjer rab tu gnas/ /re smon thams cad dus 'dir grub par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas bzlas brjod rnam gnyis sam/ /thig le gnyis 14—381

sam phra mo gnyis/ /rnam dag mtshan ma gsal ba dang / /mtshan ma med pa'i don bsam bya/ /mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor kun gyi mchog /don dam bde ba chen po'i sku/ /de bzhin nyid dbyengs ye shes te/ /lha nyid brtson pas bsgom par bya/ /thun bzhis skabs su gtor ma gtang / /rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor mchod bstod cing / /rang las phyung ste mdun bzhag nas/ /gsol gdab las la bskul bar bya/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub sprul/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang sems can don la dgongs/ /oṃ badz+ra gats+tsha muḥ/ de nas phyag rgya rnams bkod pa/ /rim bzhin bdag la bsdu byas nas/ /rnam gsum sems dpa' hūṃ la thim/ /rim bzhin thig le mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /rjes 'byung mtshan ma'i skur gnas te/ /mtshan dpe rgyan dang cha lugs gsal/ /go cha go bcings bsrung bya zhing / /dbang bskur dbu rgyan cod pan ldan/ /shaṃ hūṃ oṃ t+t+waṃ/byā ①rat+na mā le a rnyi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ paṭa ②lo a bi snelo ba hūṃ/ spyod lam kun du ma nyams par/ /lha nyid du ni bsgom bya ste/ /dbang po snang ba'i yul dus rnams—/ /dkyil 'khor rol pa'i tshul du brtag /bza' btung byin brlabs ma nyams bzlas/ /sgyu ma gnyis med ye shes rol/ /byed spyod tshogs gnyis rgyu ru brtag /thams cad 'gro ba'i don phyir spyod/ /rnam bkod dge ba dri med mchog /mya ngan sdug bsngal las dbugs 'byin/ /bkra shis bde legs 'grub byed pas/ /rang gi dude nyid don gsal shog /dpal pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi gsang don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon ku ku rā dzas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //14—382

379 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bsnyems/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzung / rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsnyems/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzung / rjo〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉bsnyems/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉bzung / ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsnyems/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skab/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉bzung / ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsnyems/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzung / ⑫〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉zhul/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉pad+ma/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bsnyems/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snostong /⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bsnyems/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzung / ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsnyems/ du〈〈pe 〉〉bzung /38༷ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skoragyur/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pa'i/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bachog ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradul/ 0〈〈pe〉dze〈snar 〉〉warnams// ⑦〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉〉wab/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉tushī/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pathe/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉bzhag ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉drag381 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pad+ma'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bteg ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉'gror/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉btegs/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bteg du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉cisabs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉po'i/⑨〈〈snar 〉stasgyu/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gtub/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉mos/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉phog pas/382 ①〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉〉rtu trīḥ/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉paskyo/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉tha/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉rin chen rdzas kyis gang ba 'dzin/ / — nyi ma'i gzugs dang spyod/ (zhes pa'i yi ge 'di rnams deb 'di'i ldeb 390nga6wa 393nga5bar dpe bsdur byas yod/)383 ①〈〈pe 〉ri'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (496)14wa 384

ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra rat+na pra bha tu gu h+ya aze ②dha ro byu ①he nā ma/ /bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje rin chen nyi ma'i gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun bdag rnam 'phrul ston/ /mi 'gyur 'joms mdzad chags pa med/ /zag med 'byung gnas las kun dag /mun sel dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /zhen chags 'jungs dang bkren sogs 'joms/ /rin chen nor sogs sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i gsang don dgod/ /rab bsdus de 'jug don phyir bshad/ /rang bzhin ngang tshul bzang las byung / /gnyis med yon tan skye bas thob/ /skyabs 'gro byang sems sdom pa can/ /dbang thob dam tshig 'jigs med pa/ /theg chen gsang sngags blo gros mchog /rdo rje nyi ma la dga' bas/ /phyi nang g.yeng ba rab spangs te/ /rang gi 'dod don 'bras bu 14—385

gnyer—/ /rgyal po'i pho brang dga' ba dang / /pad+mo skyed mos tshal nyid du/ /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma yi/ /rgyal po'i dgos pa bsgrub par bya/ /'gro la snying rje chen po yis/ /bdag gzhan sgol bar dam bcas nas/ /sbyor ldan nus mthu gsum bskyed pas/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sbyang ba dang / /dbang po'i dkyil 'khor mdun dmigs te/ /dang po bya ba'i rim rdzogs spyad/ /sgrib sogs ①las sgrol dag byed pa'i/ /sems can tshad med blo yis gzung / /bar chad bgegs bsal srung byed pa'i/ /'khor lo me 'od ra ba gur/ /phyogs bcu khro bo'i tshogs bskyed pa'i/ /cho gas rang gi las bzhin bsgom/ /thams cad spros bral de bzhin nyid/ /gnyis med byang chub sems dbyings las//'gro la ④khyab pa'i snying rje'i rgyun/ /stong gsal nam mkha'i shugs ltar 'byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal/ /rnam 'phrul nying 'dzin gnas la ①bzhugasaske/ /e yo baṃ lo me sum̐ re/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta rjo.a nu rā rjog ya mi—/ maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ spyoX/ chos 'byung nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rim bzhin brtsegs/ /ri rab me 'od rgyan gsal zhing / /kha dog dbyibs rgyan mtshan mar bcas/ /bde gshegs yon tan snang ba'i gnas—/ /sna tshogs pad+ma rin po che/ /'khor lo sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbus/ /khang pa gru bzhi sgo khyud dang / /rta babs bzhi yis mjes byas pa/ /sa gzhi nam mkha' logs kyi phyogs/ /rigs kyi rin chen 'tsher ba la⑦ rang 'byung ④nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'od/ /sna lnga'i rtsig pa dra bar ldan/ /dra phyed rin chen pha gus mtshan/ /nor bus mtshan pa'i ka ba brgyad/ /rin chen mu tig me tog phreng / /rgyal mtshan bla re rnga yab gdugs/ /'dod yon lnga yi lha mo 14—386

'khrungs—/ /zla phyed rdo rje rin chen dang / /ba dan dril bu sgra snyan sgrogs/ /pho brang rin chen zur brgyad la/ /thig bzhis phye ba'i re'u mig brgyad/ /mabyedas phyed rin chen phreng bas mdzes/ /pad mtshan rin chen mu khyud phreng / /mtshalas su bum pa gang ba bzhi/ /rigs kyi mtshan mas rnam par mdzes/ /bar rnams cha yi mtshams bzhi dang / /sgo gnas la sogs pad+ma'i gdan/ /phyi rol ra ba rim gsum brgyan/ /phyogs brgyad dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /de mtha' 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang / /rdo rje ra bas bskor ba'o/ /shin tu gdug cing drag po la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /rnam par rgyal phyir rab tu grags/ /dngos po med par bdag sbyor bas/ /nam mkha' kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'o①/ /rnam thar sgo bzhi snyoms 'jug gi/ /'gog gnas gdul bya'i don bral laske/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bskul mdzad de/ /mngon byang lnga yis ④rdzogs skur gyur/ /sems dang sems dpa'i ting 'dzin rjodang / /byang chub spyod pa sna tshogs nyid/ /de bzhin bdud dang bdud las rgyal/ /de ni byang chub sangs rgyas yin/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa udzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdusu ra ta s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen sku//dkar zhing dmar la mdangs gsal 'od/ /zhal bzhi rnam gzigs phyag bzhi pa//dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bcas 'khrol/ /'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ /mtshan dpe phyag rgya lnga yis mdzes/ /stod g.yogs dar dkar gser ris can/ /sku smad tshi rjogu'i na bza' la/ /rin chen phreng ba'i rked chings 'dril/ /mgul du do shal dpung rgyan dang / /phyag zhabs gdu bu ⑦se mo do/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ni/ /gnas lnga dag tu gtugs ⑧bya 14—387

ste—/ /sngags kyis ①bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs sogs rnam par bsam/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ②ga tā/ kā ya wāka ciX gu ṇa kan+d+ra badz+ra swa bhā wa a kolhahaṃ④/ lus kyi ba spu'i gnas rnams su/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi rdul phran gnas/ /mkha' dbyings dbang phyug phyag rgya yis/ /gnas kun byin gyis brlab dupar bya'o/ /oṃ dharmā dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wa da kolhahaṃdu/ rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyor ba/ /mdzub mo mnyam ste phyi rol dgug /mthe bong gnyis ni rab tu brkyang rjo/ /rdo rje nor bu zhes kyang bya/ /dpral bar mi gu gzhag ⑦pa ni/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o/ /tram̐ a rnyi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ rat+na mā ⑧le a rnyi ṣiñtsa t+t+waṃ/ pa ṭa ⑨lo a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ badz+ra tu byu ho/ byin brlabs rigs kyi ⑩dbu rgyan gyi⑪/ /rgyu yi mgon po rdo rje 'chang / /dpal ldan rdo rje nyi ma ru/ /ma lus mtshan ma rgyan gsal gyur/ /gser gyi ri la nyi shar bzhin//zhal bzhi phyag bzhis rnam mdzes pa/ /g.yas na mda' dang ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon gzhu nyi dkyil rdo rjes mtshan/ /'od kyi ⑫dkyil 'khor rnam lngas bskor/ /'dzum bcas g.yon mig gyen du bteg /la lar cung zhing khros pa la/ /byi ru dmar po'i mdangs ldan sku/ /zhabs gnyis skyil krung legs bzhugs shing / /snga ma'i rgyan gyis mdzes byas pa'o/ /rang 'od ngo bo las byung ba'i/ /mthing shun mdog 'dra mā ma tī/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sge rtsal can/ /phyag gnyis rin chen thod pa 'dzin/ /rin chen sna tshogs phreng ba dang / /na bza' dril bu rked chings ⑫can/ /phyung nas byin gyis brlabs ⑫mdzad de/ thabs dang shes rab ldan par gyur/ /gnas bzhi yi ge mtshan ma sngags/ /dkyil 'khor gdan la legs gnas rnams/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i rim pa yis/ /phyag rgya bzhi 14—388

yis ①rnam par gsal/ /lha mo'i bum pas khrus byas te/ /dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag por bsam/ /t+t+waṃ sdelas bskyed pa'i ling ga ni/ /rin chen gsang ①lam phaṭa kyis mtshan/ /a yis dag byas bha ga'i dbyebs/ /pad 'dab brgyad la e gnas pa/ /sna tshogs brda yis bskul byas nas/ /thabs shes gnyis med rol par mdzad/ /tram̐ pra be+e sha phaṭa/ a la la la la rjoho/byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor mnyes par mdzad—/ /lha rnams rang la gzhug bya ste/ /gnyis ka'i dga' ba rab tu spel//khams gsum 'gro gnas dag pa dang / /rnal 'byor mtshan ma rnam par sbyang / /gsang ba'i gnas su gzhal yas khang / /rgyan sogs gdan rnams dhisngon bzhin byung rjo/ /thig le gnas su mtshan byas nas/ /spros pas ④yi ge'i dkyil 'khor gsal/ /tram̐ las rdo rje nyi ma ste/ / gsang gnas ①dbus kyi pad+ma la/ /oṃ las lha mo'i dbang bskur ma'o/ /twe⑨ཿlas de bzhin gter ldan ma/ /hoḥlas rgyal mtshan mchog ldan yin/ /haṃ ⑩las lha mo mchod chen ma'o/ /dzaḥlas lha mo mda' 'dzin te/ /hūṃ las de bzhin ral gri 'dzin/ /baṃ las lha mo nyi ma ste—/ /hoḥlas rdo rje me ⑪ma'o/ /de dag nang gi re'u cha dang / /rin chen rtse mo'i phyogs bzhir gnas/ /oṃ las gling bu tram̐ pi waṃ/ /baṃ las rnga chen dza rdza rnga//me mtshalas la sogs re'u mig tu/ /lha mo bzhi ni gnas pa yin/ /a ā ⑫me tog spos me ma/ saṃ ⑫aḥmar me dri chab ma/ /bar khyams mtshams kyi gnas bzhi ru/ /lha mo bzhi ni gnas pa yin/ /dzaḥlas rta mgrin 'phong mtho ma/ /hūṃ las phag gdong mche ba can/ /baṃ las nyi zla me 'bar ma/ /hoḥlas thal byed sgo bzhir gnas/ /oṃ sne t+ya bu sne t+ya ma hā badz+ra rat+na ba ④bha ta ta tram̐ dzaḥ/14—389

rang gi gnas nas spro bya ste/ /slar 'dus lus la yab yum gzhug /badz+ra satwa dzaḥ lha mo dbang bskur mdangs gsal dmar/ /dbu rgyan rdo rje cod pan can—/ /badz+ra rat+na hūṃ/ gter ldan dmar ser phyag gnyis na/ /rin chen gter gyi bum pa bsnams/ /badz+ra dharmā baṃ/ rgyal mtshan mchog ldan dkar mdog ma/ /rin po che yi rgyal mtshan mchog /oṃ badz+ra karma hoḥ①/ mchog chen ljang sngon rin chen mdog / pharin chen rdzas kyis gang ba 'dzin/ / oṃ pra ti badz+ra ni phaṭa/ mda' gzhu dmar ser g.yas dang g.yon/ /rang gi mtshan ma 'gengs pa'i tshul/ /oṃ badz+ra pra ti hriḥ/ rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ sngon po ste/ /ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bus mtshan/ /oṃ cit+ta ma ni ho/ rdo rje nyi ma rang gi mdog /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zer dang bcas/ /oṃ badz+ra ma kha ma hā k+ṣu/ /rdo rje me mo dmar ljang mdog /rin chen me thab 'bar ba 'dzin/ /⑤te rati rat+na ①bi si tra thā/ gling bu sngon mo sna tshogs sgra/ /nor bus mtshan pa'i gling bu sgogs/ /he rat+t+waṃ rat+na/ ge te te te te te/ pi wang ser mo drug ldan dbyangs/ /nor bus mtshan pa'i pi wang bsgreng / /he rati rat+na rjohā sa baṃ/ rnga chen dmar po nor bu'i rnga/ /phrin ⑤las so so'i tshul bzhin brdung / /te rati rat+na dṛ buh+ye pe pa pe pa dza⑦/ rdza rnga ljang gu rdza rnga la/ /nor bus mtshan pa'i rol stabs tshul/ /a badz+ra puṣ+pe/ me tog dmar ser nor bus mtshan/ /rin chen gzhong pa bkang ba 'dzin/ / a badz+ra dhū ⑧pe/ spos me dkar sngon bdug pa'i snod/ /nor bus mtshan pa g.yas su 'degs/ /a ⑨badz+ra ā lo ke tweḥ/ mar me dmar mo ⑩nor bus mtshan/ /snod mang me yi ⑩sdong bu 'dzin/ /a ⑫badz+ra gadhe/dri chab ljang skya nor bus mtshan/ /g.yon na dung chos g.yas par 'thor oṃ 14—390

badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ/ rta gdong dkar mo lcags kyu dang / /thod pa rta mgo ljang gu 'dzin/ /oṃ badz+ra pā she hūṃ/ phag gdong sngon mo g.yas mche ba/ /g.yon pa rin chen zhags pa 'dzin/ /oṃ badz+ra shrī ①kha le baṃ/ snang ba dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis/ /lcags sgrog nyi ma zla bas mtshan/ /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi hoḥl/ thal byed ljang gu g.yas dril bu/ /g.yon pas thod pa mtha' yas sku/ /kun kyang rgyan phreng na bza' dang / /rigs kyi mtshan ma 'akying bag bzhin/ /'dzum steg dgod pa'i sa ①zur ston/ /rang gi cha lugs gar gyis gnas/ /mgon po mnyam gzhag la zhugs nasarjo/ /chos dbyings ye shes snyoms 'jug pas/ /lha mos bdag po bskul mdzad de/ /sems can kun don rnam 'phrul mdzad/ /brten pa'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams kyis/ /skye mched drug la sangs rgyas drug /phyag rgya bzhi yi mtshan ma dang / /rigs kyi bdag pos nye bar mtshan/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phro 'du yis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bskul mdzad cing //dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i sbyor tshogs dang / /rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcing / /stong pa shin tu yod med rnal 'byor mthu/ /nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas//bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rdo rje nyi ma skal bzang dpal khrod bdag /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.e bye hi bha ga wān/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ rjobyu hoske/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bde gshegs pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'gro ba ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /don gyi dbang gis dgongs nas kyang / /'khor bcas gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /kā ya bāka ciX hūṃ/ sgyu 'phrul dga' ba'i rdo rje rol mo'i tshogs/ /gzhan la snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par mjes/ /a la la ho/ tshangs pa'i tshogs rnams zil kyis gnon 14—391

mdzad cing / /rtog pa du ma'i sgro 'dogs gcod par mdzod/ /a la la ho/gnyis med ye shes gnyis can rnam ①mtha' yas/ /snang stong bde chen mnyam nyid dbyings la rol/ /a la la ho/ kun 'byung yon tan sprul med lhun grub snang / /rgyan kyi dkyil 'khor rnam dgod rang las byung / /a la la hoske/ mdzad pa rgya chen 'gog med kun grub pa/ /tshogs bcas rol pas bya ba kun rdzogs pa/ /a la la ho/ sku gsung thugs mchog yon tan phrin las rgyanag/dkyil 'khor mjes pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a la la ho/ lus kyi yan lag thams cad ni/ /sa la bsnyal te phyag bya ba/ /snying ga kha dang spyi gtsug tu//thal mo sbyar zhing 'dud par bya/ /tram̐ a bhu ho/ ban+da rna ka ⑦ro ya mi/ gu ru pa ti/ a la la ho/ oṃ 'byung ba che las thams cad 'byung / /stong gsum rdul snyed ma lus pa'i/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus spro/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dang / /dri tshogs kun gyis mchod par bya/ /oṃ pa na pe na pe nu/ su ra ti pu pa ra mu/ sarba ta thā ga tags ma yo ga sirnyi uhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra byu ⑤pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke/ badz+ra gadhe—/ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ/ shrī bha ga bān/ kha kha khā hi/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis dag girjo/ /mdzub mo mthe'u chung mdzes bsgyur te/ /rdo rje rin chen thal sbyar nas/ /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya/ /ṭīḥzhes bya ba'i glu yi rgyaske/ /khams gsum rnam par rgyal bar byed/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /nor mchog rnam par sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan nyi ma'i phyag rgyar gnas/ /nam mkha'i snying po thams cad phyogs/ /re ba thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /bud 14—392

med la sogs rin chen mchog /rin chen thams cad mkha' las 'bebs /shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi nyi ma ni/ /dam pa'i don du drag por 'gyur/ /drag pos 'dul ba'i 'jig rten rnams/ /drag po nyid kyis 'grub par byed/ /nyi ma'i gzugs dang spyod ① lam dang ②/ /tshul dang gzi brjid chen por ①ston/ /gzhu dang mda' dang ral gri dang / /de bzhin du ni 'bar ba'i me /mdangs gsal 'dzum dang bcas pa'i spyanadu/ /g.yon pa 'byed cing gyen du 'degs—/ /rdo rje pus mo gnyis bcings te/ /skyil krung gdan la legs par bzhugs/ /badz+ra rat+na rjobha ta ta tram̐ dza/ dbang bskur ma yi dbu rgyan te/ /gter ldan ma yi rin chen bum/ /rgyal mtshan mchog ldan rin chen tog /mchod chen rin chen gzhong pa 'gengs/ /mda' gzhu ma dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /nyi ma mo dang me mo zhi/ /rang gi mtshan gyi phyag rgya bzhin/ /'gying rjobacas gtso bo'i phyogs su 'dud/ /gling bu ma sogs lha mo yi/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin—/ /rang byung lha mo dang bcas pas⑦/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis gnyis med gyur—/ /khams gsum kun rmi rgyal srid sna tshogs mchog gi nor ldan pas/ /'jal dum g.yul 'gyed rnam par khyad par gyis 'dul ba/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'jal dum pad+ma ⑧rnam par rgyal ba'i ⑨rgyal mtshan can/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po bde mchog sgyu ma bstan du gsol/ /sems can sprin la byang chub mchog sbyin ⑩ sna tshogs char 'be+ebs pa/ /bdag gi re ba kun sgrub myur du ston/ /a la la la la ho/ mi zad gter gyi dbang bskur khyad par bdag la 6) du gsol/ /khyad par 'di dag thams cad bud med rin chen ⑪rnams kyi phyir/ /rin chen 14—393

tshogs kun nang na bud med rin chen gcig pu mchog /bud med rin chen dag pa dam pa'i rin du thams cad 'gro/ /a la la ho/ so so'i ljags kyi pad+ma la/ /chos kyi snying po mtshan ma'i dkyil/ /t+t+waṃ pa pa ta ṭa ṭa ①tra ṭa/ rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar la/ /mdzub mo mnyam par phyir bkug ste/ /mthe bong rdo rjes g.yogs lapa ni/ /rdo rje dpal gyi nor bu yin/ /sngags bcas gnas su gzhag byas nas/ /rim bzhin mtha' ①nas dgrol bar bya'o/ /oṃ s+dzahūṃ—/ rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ /rjomanyam pa chen po'i gnas la rol du gsol/ /thams cad dbang bskur dbang phyug dam pa mi zad gter mchog bdag la grub par mdzad du gsol/ /kun mchog rgyal mtshan rnam rgyal bgreng ba rdo rje rin chen shin tu che ba bdag la mdzod/ /mche ba cung zad gcigs pa'i zhal/ /khro zhing 'dzum dang bcas pa'i bzhin/ /khro las gyur kyang bcas zhing 'dzum/ /gsal bar blta zhing legs par gnas/ /sna tshogs brnya brtags pa la/ /sna tshogs bdud rtsis rnam par bkang / /lnga lnga lnga yi 'phro 'du yis/ /mtshan ma rnam pa lnga dang ldan/ /'od dang du ba dri dang sgra—/ /lha mo'i gzugs ston bdud rtsir ⑤'grub/ /rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /mnyam pa'i don ldan rol par mdzad/ /byin rlabs rgyan dang mtshan ldan pa'i/ /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /gsang ba chen po rnam par rol/ /grub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yo la sogs 14—394

pa'i—/ /bstod pa'i glu rnams blangs ①byas nas/ /sil snyan kun gyi sgra rnams dang / /gar gyis lha rnams mnyes par bya/ /tram̐ tram̐ tram̐/ ba ba ba ba ba ba ba/ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ tra tra tra tra tra tran tra tre/ traṭa ṭa tud te②/ ta tud ①tra/ ru 0tra ṭa tra/ bdag cag dam tshig 'di la mngon du zhugs pa rnams/ /bcad gtubs lus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /grib mas phog pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa/ /sku yi phyogs tsam mthong bas mod la 'tsho ba dang / /gzi mdangs lus la 'jug par byed pa stong phrag gi⑤/ /'od kyis phog pas 'jig rten khams su snang ba dang / /lus ngag sems dang tshe ni rdo rjer rab gnas pa/ /re smon thams cad dus 'dir grub par mdzad du gsol//de nas bzlas pa rnam gnyis sam/ /thig le gnyis sam phra mo gnyis/ /rnam dag mtshan ma gsal ba dang / /mtshan ma med pa'i don bsam bya/ /mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor kun gyi mchog /don dam bde ba chen po'i sku/ /de bzhin dbyings dang ye shes kyi/ /lha nyid brtson pas bsgrub par bya/ /thun bzhi'i skabs su gtor ma gtang / /rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor mchod bstod cing / /rang las phyung buste mdun bzhag nas/ /gsol btab las la bskul bar bya /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub spyod//sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'gro ba'i don la dgongs/ /oṃ badz+ra gats+tsha muḥ/ de nas phyag rgya rnam bkod pa/ /rim bzhin bdag la bsdu byas nas/ /rnam gsum sems dpa' hūṃ la thim/ /rim bzhin thig le mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /rjes 'byung mtshan ma'i skur gnas te/ /mtshan dpe ④rgyan dang cha lugs gsal/ /go cha go bcings bsrung bya zhing / /dbang bskur dbu 14byed395

rgyan cod pan ldan①/ /shaṃ haṃ oṃ sum̐/ oṃ rat+na mā ④le a rnyi ṣiñtsa t+t+waṃ①/ pa ṭa ④lo ba a rnyi lo ba hūṃ⑤/ spyod lam kun du ma nyams par/ /lha nyid du ni bsgom bya ste/ /dbang po snang ba yul dus rnams/ /dkyil 'khor rol pa'i tshul du brtagarjo /bza' btung byen brlabs ⑦ma nyams bzlas/ /sgyu ma gnyis med ye shes rol/ /byed spyod tshogs gnyis rgyu ru brtag /thams cad 'gro ba'i don phyir spyad—/ /legs dgod ⑧sgrub thabs bsdus pa yis/ /rab spyod nor bu rin chen des—/ /khams gsum rgud pa sel mdzad nas/ /rigs kyi ⑨dkyil 'khor gsal byed shog /dpal rdo rje rin chen nyi ma'i gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po ku ku rā dzas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra sirnya dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ⑩ba ban+de lha rin po ches bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o⑪// //14—396

don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu gra la bha ta guh+ya aṣ+pe sdedha ro byu ho nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal rta mchog rol pa'i gsang ba'i don ①rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjes cha mnyam la rgyud gzigs/ /so so'i don bzhin rnam drug sogasadu/ /dbugs 'byin phrin las kun gyi bdag /rta mchog dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /lha chen dregs byed 'dul byed pa'i/ /rta yi rgyal po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rgyud las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin/ /rnal 'byor 'jug pa'i don phyir bshad/ /rang bzhin ngang tshul bzang las byung / /gnyis med yon tan skye bas thob/ /skyabs 'gro byang sems sdom pa can/ /dbang thob dam tshig 'jigs ⑤med pa/ /theg chen gsang sngags blo gros mchog /rta mchog dkyil 'khor la dga' bas/ /phyi nang g.yeng ba rab bsal te/ /rang gi 'dod don 'bras bur gnyer/ /14—399

mkhar ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin chu bo'i 'gram dag gam/ /rgyal khams gzhan las 'grub stipa ru/ /rdo rje rta ni bsgrub par bya/ /'gro la snying rje chen po yis/ /bdag gzhan bsgrub par dam bcas nas/ /sbyor ldan nus mthu gsum bskyed pas/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sbyang ba dang / /dbang po'i dkyil 'khor mdun dmigs te/ /dang po bya ba'i rim rdzogs skespyad/ /sgrib tshogs las grol dag byed pa'i/ /sems can tshad med blo yis gzung ske/ /bar chad bgegs bsal srung ④byed pa'i/ /'khor lo me 'od ra ba gur⑤/ /phyogs bcur rjokhro bo'i tshogs bskyed pa'i/ /cho ga rang gi las bzhin bsgom/ /thams cad spros bral de bzhin nyid/ /gnyis med byang chub sems dbyings las//'gro ba khyab pa'i thugs rje rgyun/ /stong gsal nam mkha'i shugs ltar 'byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal/ /rnam 'phrul ting 'dzin gnas la bzhugs—/ /e yo baṃ lo oṃ sum̐ ram̐/ /oṃ na maḥdze+esarba ta thā ga ta ⑧a nu rā ⑨ya mi maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ spyo⑫/ chos 'byung nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rim bzhin brtsegs/ /ri rab me 'od rgyan ⑪gsal zhing / /kha dog dbyibs rgyan ⑫mtshan mar bcas/ /bde gshegs yon tan snang ba'i gnas/ /sna tshogs pad+ma rin po che/ /'khor lo sna tshogs rdo rje dbus/ / pho brang ⑫gru bzhi sgo ④khyud dang / /rta babs bzhi yis mdzes byas pa/ /sa gzhi nam mkha'i skelogs kyi phyogs/ /rigs kyi rin chen 'tsher ⑩ba la/ /rang byung nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'odarka/ / sna lnga'i rtsig pa'i dra ba dang / /⑩dra phyed rin chen pha gus mtshan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje ka ba brgyad/ /rin chen mu tig me tog ⑫phreng / /rgyal mtshan bla re rnga yab gdugs/ /'dod yon lnga yi lha mo 'khyug /zla phyed rdo rje rin 14—400

chen dang / /ba dan dril bu'i sgra snyan sgrogs/ /dkyil 'khor gang yang rung ba la/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes rnam par mtshan/ /mtshams su bum pa gang ba bzhi/ /rigs kyi mtshan mas mdzes par byas/ /dbus kyi lte ba nas bzung ste/ /sgo nas bar du pad+ma'i gdan/ /dbus su lha chen yab yum brgyad/ /phyogs bzhir bsnol te rnam par bsam/ /phyi rol ra ba rim gsum brgyan/ /phyogs mtshams dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /de mtha' 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang / /rdo rje ra bas bskor ba'o/ /thams cad dag par mos pa yis①/ /sdog med stobs kyis ngo mthon ②du/ /drag shul sbyor bas mnyam sbyor bas/ /'jig rten thams cad gzhom par bya/ /rnam thar bzhi yis ne+esnyoms 'jug gi/ /'gog gnas gdul bya'i don bral ladu/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bskul mdzad de / /mngon byang lnga yi rdzogs skur gyur/ /sems dang sems dpa'i ting 'dzin dang / /byang chub spyod pa sna tshogs nyid/ /de bzhin bdud dang bdud las rgyal/ /de ni byang chub sangs rgyas yin/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa u⑤dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen sku/ /dkar zhing dmar ba'i mdangs gsal 'od/ /zhal bzhi rnam gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ /dang po rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar//rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bcas 'khrolarjo/ /'og ma gnyis kyis ④mda' dang gzhu/ /mtshan dpe phyag rgya lnga yis mdzes/ /stod g.yogs dar dkar gser skeris can//sku smad tshi ⑨gu'i na bza' gsol/ /rin chen phreng ba'i rked chings can/ /mgur chu ⑩do shal dpung rgyan dang / /phyag zhabs gdu bu se mo do/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ni/ /gnas lnga dag tu gtugs byas te⑪/ /sngags kyis ⑫bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs sogs rnam par bsam/ /oṃ na maḥ14—401

sarba ta thā ga ta ①kā ya wāka tsit+ta gu ṇa kan+d+ra badz+ra swa bhā wa a kolhahaṃ④/ /lus kyi ba spu'i gnas rnams su/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi rdul phran gnas/ /mkha' dbyings dbang phyug phyag rgya yis/ /gnas kun byin gyis brlab par bya/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wā ④byed kolhahaṃrjo/ sangs rgyas rin chen pad+mo dang / /de bzhin rdo rje rin chen dang / /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen mchog /rta mchog rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /haṃ a bhi ṣeñtsa me/ rat+na mā le a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ pa ṭa ④lo ba a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ /badz+ra tu gyi rjoho/ byin brlabs rigs kyi dbu rgyan gyi⑦/ /rgyu yi mgon po rdo rje 'chang / /dpal ldan rta mchog rol pa'i sgu/ /cha lugs mtshan ma rgyan gsal gyur/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag brgyad pa/ /de bzhin zhabs kyang rnam pa bzhi/ /g.yas pa ba dan gsum pa bgreng / /sna tshogs rdo rje ral gri mda'/ /g.yon pa khu tshur sna tshogs pad/ /mdung dang dbyug ⑧pa gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas pas gsum grub ⑨dpal mo mnan/ /gnyis pas grol ma dga' ba'o/ /g.yon pas mig gsum khyab 'jug dang / /gnyis pas tshangs pa dga' rab gnon⑩/ /zhal rnams dmar dang nag po dang //dkar zhing rta mgo ljang gu ston/ /sku yi kha dog ljang gu la/ /phyag rnams dmar zhing zhabs gnag pa'o/ /khro rtags drug cu rtsa gcig dang / /'bar ba chen po'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /rang 'od ngo bo las byung ba'i/ /dam tshig sgol ma mdog ljang skya/ /sna tshogs rdo rje thod pa thogs/ /rin chen rgyan mdzes 'jo sgog stabs/ /phyung nas byin gyis brlabs mdzad de/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan par 'gyur/ /gnas bzhi yi ge mtshan ma sngags/ /dkyil 'khor gdan la legs gnas rnams/ /spro ⑪dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya 14—402

bzhi yis ①rnam par gsal/ /lha mo'i bum pas khrus byas te/ /dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag por bsam/ /haṃ las bskyed pa'i ling ga ni/ /rgya gram gsang lam phaṭa sdekyis mtshan/ /a yis dag byas bha ga'i dbyibs/ /pad+ma'i 'dab brgyad e gnas pa/ /sna tshogs brda yis bskul byas nas/ /thabs shes gnyis med rol par mdzad/ /oṃ pra be sha phaṭa/ a la la la la ho/ byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor mnyes par mdzad/ /lha rnams rang la gzhug bya ste/ /gnyis ka'i dga' ba rab tu spel/ /khams gsum 'gro gnas dag pa dang / /rnal 'byor mtshan ma rnam par sbyang / /gsang ba'i gnas su gzhal yas khang / /rgyan sogs gdan rnams sngon bzhin 'byung / /thig les gnas su mtshan byas nas/ /spros pas yi ge'i dkyil 'khor gsal/ /hi ①las bskyed pa'i rta mchog ni/ /gsang gnas dbus kyi pad+ma la'o/ /dzi las sna tshogs pad+ma'i rgya/ /ha las sna tshogs rdo rje ma'o/ /dkyil 'khor gang yang rung ba yi/ /lha mo nyi shu'i tshogs rnams la/ /khyad par lha mo gnyis kyis lhagadu /chos kyi snying po'i phyogs su bskyed/ /oṃ sum+bha ni/sum+bha hūṃ/ phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba sbyang byas nas/ /yab yum sku la gzhug par bya//oṃ bi shwa ⑤badz+ra dharmā hoḥ/ sna tshogs pad+ma dmar skya mo/ /phyag gnyis pad+ma'i ①gar thabs ⑦sgyur/ /oṃ bi shwa badz+ra satwa aḥ/ / sna tshogs rdo rje ljang gu'i mdog/⑧sna tshogs rdo rje thod pa 'dzin/ /lha mo 'di dag thams cad kyang / /rin chen rgyan dang na bza' bklubs⑨/ /'dzum steg ⑩dgod pa'i so zur ston/ /rang gi cha lugs kun gyis ⑪gnas/ /mgon po ro mnyam la bzhugs nas/ /chos dbyings ye shes snyoms 'jug las⑫/ /lha mo bdag po bskul mdzad de/ /14—403

sems can kun don rnam 'phrul mdzad/ /rten gyi dkyil 'khor lha rnams kyi/ /skye mched drug la sangs rgyas drug /phyag rgya bzhi yi mtshan ma dang / /rigs kyi bdag pos nye bar mtshan/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bskul mdzad de/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i sbyor tshogs dang / /rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcing ①/ /stong pa shin tu yod ②med rnal 'byor mthu/ /nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rta mchog rol pa skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ e bye hi bha ga bān/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ ①sh+ya ha/ sa ma ya ho/rjos ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bde ⑤gshegs pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'gro ba ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /don kyi dbang gis dgongs nas kyang / /'khor bcas gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /kā ya wāka cis rjohūṃ/ sgyu 'phrul dga' ba'i rdo rje rol pa'i tshogs/ /gzhan la snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par mdzes /a la la ho/ tshangs pa'i tshogs rnams zil gyis gnon mdzad cing / /rtag ⑦pa du ma'i sgo 'dogs gcod par mdzad/ /a la la ho/ gnyis med ye shes gnyis can rnam mtha' yas/ /snang stong bde chen mnyam nyid dbyings la rol/ /a la la ho/ kun 'byung yon tan stsol med lhun grub snang / /rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor rnam dgod rang las byung / /a la la ho/ mdzad pa rgya chen 'gog med kun grub pas/ /tshogs bcas rol pas bya ba kun rdzogs pa/ /a la la ho—/ sku gsung thugs mchog yon tan phrin las rgyan/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a la la ho/ dpal don ⑧rdo rje 'gying ba'i thabs /'dzum pa'i mig gis phyag bya'o/ /haṃ a ti pu ho⑨/ brnya rna kā ro ya mi/ gu 14—404

ru pa ti/ a la la ho/ oṃ 'byung ba che las thams cad 'byung / /stong gsum rdul snyed ma lus pa'i/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus spro/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dang / /dri tshogs kun kyis ①mchod par bya'o/ /oṃ pa na pe na pe nu su ra ti pu pa ra mu sarba ta thā ga taske/sa ma yo ga sirnyi āḥ④hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra sgru rjope/ badz+ra ā rjolo ke/badz+ra gadhe/ pra tīts+tsha ho/ shrī dhibha ga bān kha kha khā hi/ gyen du 'thor zhing thur du 'be+ebs/ /bskor zhing de bzhin nyug pa dag /me tog bdug pa mar me mchog /dri yi mchod pa byung ba'o/ gang ngam 'on te stong ngam rung / /yang na ci 'byor pa yis kyang / /dam tshig mnyam par bsgrub pa yis/ /mchod pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /ka ka la yang tso'u ra'i ⑦dbyangs/ /de bzhin rab tu gdangs snyan dang / /ka ha la yi glu yi rgya/ /'joms pa thams cad 'grub pa'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥske/ rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /drag shul spyor bas rnam sbyong dpal/ /rta yi phyag rgyar rab tu gnas/ /thams cad pad+mo mos pa yis/ /sdig med stobs kyi ngo mthon du/ /rab tu non pa'i rtsal dag gis/ /'jig rten thams cad rab tu 'joms/ /'dod chags can la g.yem par ston/ /gdug pa rnams la gdug par 'gyur/ / zhi ba rnams la zhi bar 'gyur/ /⑨drag shul can la drag shul sbyor/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag brgyad ⑩pa/ /zhabs bzhi pa la rmig pa bzhi/ /rta mgrin rgyal po rdo rje ste/ /dbang phyug dam pa bsgrub par bya//g.yon pa'i khu tshur mdzub mo yis/ /dpal ldan pad+ma sna tshogs 'dzin/ /rdo rjer bcas shing slob ma 'grub/ /g.yas pa ba dan gsum par ⑩bya/ /g.yas 14—405

dang g.yon pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /brkyang dang bskum pa'i tshul byas nas/ /khro bo'i skyil mo krung bcas ①te/ /'jig rten thams cad rab tu 'jig /oṃ sum+bha ni/ sum+bha hūṃ/ lha mo nyi shu'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /phyag rgya ①so so'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /rang byung lha mo dang bcas pa'i/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis gnyis med 'gyur/ /stsos byed stong pas lhag par bde ba'i 'dod pa'i gzugs ston pa/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis gshin rje stong bas lhag par rab tu 'jigs//zhi ba'i skur yang tshangs pa stong pas lhag par rab tu ston/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi mchog tu de bzhin gshegs kun grub par mdzod/ /thams cad dag pas ④ngo 'thon stobs kyis non par mdzod/ /te rjote he te te/ dbang phyug thams cad rab shig rab tu shig /rab kyi rtsal gyis non pa'i stobs kyis ngo 'thon dbang phyug non/ /sbyor chen hu lu hu lu mig gsum po la gsum grub drongs/ /rab kyi rtsal kyis non pa'i stobs kyis ngo 'thon ⑤mthu chen non/ /mnyam sbyor ru tra ma tra'i snying las dpal mo drongs shig rab drongs shig /rab kyi rtsal kyis gnon pa'i stobs kyis ngo 'thon tshangs pa non/ /sbyor chen tshangs las sgrol ma drongs shig sma ra ti/ /rab kyi rtsal gyis non pa'i stobs kyis ngo 'thon dga' dbang non/ /mnyam sbyor kun gyis bdag la dga' dbang drongs/ /a la la la la buho/ gdug cing khro la rab tu gtum pa yi/ /sems can bsgral ba'i phyir sgrub zhugs/ /a la la la la ho/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ phaṭa/mdza' bo mi la bya'am mi bya yongs su rtog pa de dag med kyang bla'i⑦/ /de 'dra'i mdza' bo sgyu ma yin pas de la mdza' zhes su zhig zer/ /rgol ba gang la bya'am mi bya yongs su rtag ⑧pa de dag med kyang bla'i⑨/ /de 'dra'i rgol ba sgyu ma yin 14—406

pas de la dpa' zhes su zhig zer/ /so so'i ljags kyi pad+ma la/ /mtshan ma chos kyi snying por bcas/ /shrī pad+ma pa ①ṭa ba mu kha yo gī shwa ri/ hi nyi nyi hi hi/rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar nas/ /mthe'u chung srin lag mnyam par brgyang ②/ /mdzub mo rtse mnyam bkug pa ni/ /dpal mchog rta zhes grags pa yin/ /sngags bcas gnas su gzhag ④bya ste/ /rim bzhin mtha' nas dgrol bar bya'o//oṃ wabyuhūṃ/ rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ / mchod pa chen po thams cad grub par mdzod/ /rjomanyam pa chen po'i gnas la rol du gsol/ /la lar mkhas pa'i gzugs kyang 'dzin/ /la lar dus mtha'i dus ltar drag /la lar rgyal ba'i dbang po bzhin du zhi/ /la lar rta mchog sbyor bas 'dod pa 'grubaske/ /sna tshogs brnya brtags pa larjo/ /sna tshogs bdud rtsi'i rnam par dgang / /lnga lnga lnga yi 'phro 'du yis/ /mtshan ma rnam pa lnga dang ldan/ /'od dang du ba dri dang sgra/ /lha mo'i gzugs duston bdud rtsi 'grub/ /rang 'byung gdod nas rnam par dag /mnyam pa'i don ldan rol par mdzod/ /byin rlabs ④rgyan dang mtshan ldan pa'i/ /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /gsang ba chen po rnam par rol/ /grub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yo la sogs pa'i/ /bstod pa'i glu rnams blangs byas nas/ /sil snyan kun kyi sgra rnams dang / /gar gyis ⑧lha rnams mnyes par bya/ /ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥtra ⑨tra tra tra tra tra tra tra/ ṭa ta ba ṭa ta ba hūṃ/ ta ṭa be+e ta ṭa ⑩14—407

be+e—/ hi don/ ta ṭa ba/ ta ṭa ba/ ta ṭa ba/ ta ṭa ba/ ta ṭa ba trathā—/ bdag cag dam tshig 'di la mngon zhugs pas/ /bcad gtubs lus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /grib mas phog pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa//sku yi phyogs tsam mthong bas mod la 'tsho ba dang / /gzi mdangs lus la 'jug pa bye ba stong phrag gi/ /'od kyis phog pas 'jig rten khams su rab snang ba/ /lus ngag sems dang tshe ni rdo rjer rab gnas te/ /re smon thams cad dus 'dir thob par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas bzlas brjod rnam gnyis sam/ /thig le gnyis sam phra mo gnyis/ /rnam dag mtshan ma gsal ba dang / /mtshan ma med pa'i don bsam bya/ /mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor kun gyi mchog /don dam bde ba chen po'i sku/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes kyi/ /lha nyid brtson pas bsgom par bya/ /thun bzhi'i skabs su gtor ma gtang / /rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor mchod bstod cing / /rang las phyung ste mdun bzhag nas/ /gsol btab las la bskul bar bya/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'gro ba'i don la dgongs/ /oṃ badz+ra gatshwa ①muḥ/ de nas phyag rgya rnam ⑧bkod pa/ /rim bzhin bdag la bsdu byas ①nas/ /rnam gsum sems dpa' hūṃ la thim/ /rang bzhin thig le mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /rjes 'byung mtshan ma'i skur gnas te/ /mtshan dpe rgyan dang cha lugs gsal/ /go cha go bcings bsrung bya zhing / /dbang bskur dbu rgyan cod pan ldan/ /rka haṃ—/ oṃ sum̐ hūṃ/ rat+na mā le rjo.a rnyi ṣiñtsa t+t+waṃrjo/ oṃ ba ṭa rjolo ba a rnyi ⑦lo ba hūṃ/spyod lam kun du ma nyams par/ /lha nyid du ni bsgom bya ste/ /dbang po'i 14—408
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (498)

༄ga /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i cho ga lnga pa zhes bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba maṇ+ḍa la a nu ta bi dze+eta ra sha swa pañtsa bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i cho ga lnga pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig thog mtha' kun gzigs shing / /thams cad don 'byung gsang ba'i tshul/ /phyag rgya'i bdag nyid ma 'dres stobs/ /rigs kun 'khor lo'i gnas rdzogs shog /rang bzhin dpa' bo kun du snang / /'joms byed chos kun ma 'dres pa—/ /yon tan tshogs bdag rol pa'i sku/ /rigs kyi lha mo tshogs rgyal shog /dngos med gsang ba'i phyag rgya che/ /de dag ma lus mtha' sel mdzad/ /kun 'byung kun gyi bdag nyid don/ /thabs mang cho ga rdzogs pas ①gsal/ /der 'jug de yi gnas ldan pa/ /sgra yi rgyun kyis don tshogs bskyed/ /mngon 'byung gnas kun 'grub byed pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor thabs rnams 'jug par 14—412

bshad—/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad rjes bstan pa'i/ /'jug thabs cho ga lnga pa'i don/ /ston pa'i lung las gsal bshad pa/ /gzhung 'di bsdu bar 'os pa yin/ /don kun 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor bdag /thabs kyi cho ga mang po yis—/ /der 'jug lam kun rdzogs byed pas/ /dri med dag pa'i rgyud gzung mdzod/ /ji ltar gsang sngags legs sbyar bas/ /dngos grub tshul mang thob 'gyur ba/ /don dam bya ba mthar phyin pas/ /gzhan dag don tshogs rnam par dag /myur bar phyag rgya sngags sogs 'jug /bla med dngos grub don kun rtogs/ /bstan pa'i tshul gyis gdams pa'i rgyun/ /ji ltar bya ba'i sgo ston byed/ /shin tu sbyang dka'i las rnams dag /rang sngags rten 'brel mthu yis 'grub/ /tshul rnams ma nyes dus mtshungs 'jigs①/ /gnas dang gnas pa'i tshogs rnams rgyas/ /rgyas par 'di dag kun bstan phyir//thabs mang tshul gyis theg pa kun/ /ngo bo byang chub sems gnas skyong / /rang bzhin bskyed du med pa'i chos/ /gzhan dag theg chen mchog zhugs pas/ /sngags tshul 'dus pa'i cho ga shes/ /byin rlabs ②brda don yon tan gnas/ /dbang bskur byang chub rjes su slob/ /rang sems rnam dag dri ma med/ /gsang sngags cho ga rdzogs par 'gyur/ /des ni dngos grub kun thob cing /phrin las bya ba 'gag pa med/ /dang por bdag gzhan srung 'dod pas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnas bya/ /de dag 'grub byed yan lag gzhan/ /dngos kun gsang ba bstan pa'i sgo/ /thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba yis/ /rten gnyis dag par sbyang bya ba/ /de dag thun mong khyad par gyis/ /mngon par 'gyur ba'i don chen 'grub/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /dus 14—413

kun skyabs su 'gro byas na/ /gzhan gyi phyogs rnams 'jig byed cing / /bag med 'khrug ①pa'i nad kun zhi/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor du gyur pa'i phyir/ /rang gi sdom pa dam tshig gzung / /de yang rgya che blo dmigs te/ /ma lus khams rnams kun du spyad/ /ji srid rtog ④pa'i rgyun gnas pa/ /de srid rtog pas nyen ④par 'gyur/ /'di dag slob dpon la brten te/ /dam pa'i rjes su gzhol bar bya/ /rkang gnyis rnams kyi gtso bo mchog /sangs rgyas mchog la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhi sogs rjo'adod chags sogs 'joms pa'i /theg chen chos la skyabs su mchi/ /thugs rjes don mi gtong ba yi/ /spyod bcas dge 'dun la skyabs gsol/ /dus 'di dag nas gzung byas te/ /ji srid snying po byang chub bar/ /dad brtson gus pas de dag kun/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i don du gzung / /srog gcod pa yi sems can dang / /gzhan gyi nor la 'phrog pa dang / /'dod pa log par g.yem pa dag /sems can dmyal bar myur du 'gro/ /dbyen byed pa dang tshig rtsub dang / /brdzun du smra zhing mi sdom dang / /byis pa 'chal ⑤ba smra ba rnams/ /so so skye bo slu bas bcings /gzhan gyi spyod la brnab sems dang / /gnod sems dag ni mang ba dang / /mi gang lta ba log zhugs parjo/ /ngan 'go dag tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /des na lus kyi sdig gsum dang / /ngag gi sdig pa rnam pa bzhi/ /yid kyi gsum po ma lus rnams/ /sdog pa'i las kun zad byed 'bar⑦/ /des ni ngan 'gror lhung ⑧bas na/ /bag med las kun bshags par bgyi/ / 'di dag bdag gis mi bgyid cing / /khyagazhan la'ang gdams par mi byed de/ /dus kun ma 'dres rgya chen blos/ /nyin mtshan dran pas ⑩bshags par bya⑩/ /khyad par 14—414

so sor thar ba'i tshul/ /rtsa ba bzhi dang yan lag tshogs/ /rnam bzhi 'khor tshogs bcas sdom gang / /ci nus bdag gis blang bya zhing / /ston pa slob dpon la sogs mdun①/ /bsgo ba'i bka' don dam ②pa gzung / /ci nas 'gro kun bsgral ba'i phyir/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro'i don/ /yun ring mang du spel ba'i yid/ /phyogs rnams kun du rgyas par gzung / /stong gsum 'jig rten ma lus kyi/ /'gro drug sems can thams cad la/ /byams pa'i sems ni sngon 'gro bas/ /sdug bsngal gsum dang brgyad sogs kyis//gdungs pa rnams la blta byas la/ /bde dang sdug bsngal brje byas te/ /kun gyi bde ba thob 'gyur na/ /bdag nyid sdug bsngal gyur kyang bla'isne/ /'gro don bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/ /thabs mang rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de lta de ltar 'gro ba rnams/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang de nyid las/ /grol zhing thar bar byas nas ni/ /bde dang ldan par bya ba dang //bla med 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir/ /dang po bdag nyid bsgral byas nas/ /mi ldog sems kyis dam bcas te/ /smon pas rdzu 'phrul dpag med dang / /zhi gnas lhag mthong mngon shes sogs/ /thogs pa med par 'byung ba yis/ /myur du mthu stobs brtas rjogyur nas/ /g.yeng med 'go don brtson dubyed cing //dbugs dbyung theg chen lam la dgod/ /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas medang / /dbyer med slob dpon mnyes byas la/ /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal zhing / /gsol btab lam la gnas par bya/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal sras kun/ /ma lus phyogs nas dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis me tog phreng sogs kun/ /khyed la legs par dbul bar bgyi/ /maṇ+ḍal bzang 14—415

bcas mchod pa'i tshogs/ /gnas 'dir rgyas par bkod byas pas/ /de dag 'khor tshogs mnyes gyur cig /sdom pa'i man ngag sbyin par bsam /dus de nyid nas ji ①srid bar/ /zhal gcig par yang lan gsum sogs/ /'gro don dmigs pa rgya chen gyis/ /byang chub sems mchog bskyed par bya/ /bris sku la sogs rtse gcig tu/ /thal sbyar gus pas 'dug byas te/ /bla med byang chub 'dod pa yis/ /sems nyid rgya cher nges par bskyed/ /phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /gzhan du dbye ba med pa'i thugs/ /dus 'dir bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /skye ba 'di dang gzhan dag tu/ /sbyin pa las byung bsod nams dang / /tshud khrims las byung bsod nams dang / /bsgoms sdepa las byung bsod nams kyis/ /dge rtsa bdag gis bkyis pa dang / /bgyid du stsaX ba nyid dang ni/ /gzhan yang rjes su yi rang ba'i/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gis/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu/ /thugs mchog rin chen bskyed pa ltar/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang / /dus 'di nas ni gzung byas te/ /bla med yang dag rdzogs pa yi①/ /byang chub chen por sems bskyed de/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dhirjes su slob/ /sngon tshe 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis/ /ji ltar byang chub sems rgya chen/ /grong khyer rgyal ba'i rgyal por gyur—/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed cing / /'gro ba thams cad don du gnyer/ /de dag 'khor ba las bsgral lo/ /gnod sems dus min khro ba dang / /ser sna dang ni phrag dog nyid/ / deng nas bzung ⑤ste byang chub dag /14—416

thob 'gyur don gzhan dag kyang spang / /dge ba bcu sogs spyad bya zhing / /sdeg dang 'dod pa spang bar bya/ /tshul khrims sdom pa la dga' bas/ /sangs rgyas rjes su bslab ①par bya/ /bdag nyid myur ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /byang chub thob par mi spro zhing / /sems can gcig gi rgyu yis ni/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar gnas par bgyi/ /tshad med bsam kyis mi khyab pa/ /zhing khams rnam par sbyang bar bya/ /ming las gzung ba byas pa dag /phyogs bcu dag tu rnam mang thos—/ /bdag gi lus dang ngag gi las/ /ci nus su ni dag par bya/ /yid kyi las kyang dag bya zhing / / ma dag pa ⑦rnams mi bya'o/ /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams grol bya zhing / /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs phyung nas/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs rnams la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su 'chi/ /bdag gi ①spyin sogs 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni/ /'jug pa'i sems dag ci nus pas/ /yul ngan gnod pa ci byung yang / /de las bzlog ste yang dag bzung / /snying stobs che zhing dpa' ba yis/ /las gzhan rnam par spang bya ste/ /bsam pa rtse gcig gnas pa dang / /dad brtson dge ba'i las kun gyis/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams kun spangs shing / /shes rab rnam gsum bskyed byas nas/ /log sel ri bo thams cad 'joms/ /dran dang shes bzhin bskyed byas pas/ /rtag tu 'go don brtson par byed/ /grogs 'dis bdag gzhan grol bar byed/ /byang sems 'phel bar byed pa ni/ /rnam pa bzhir ni shes bya ste/ /srog gi phyir yang bsams ④bzhin du/ /brdzun tshig smra bar mi byed dang / /lhag ⑤pa'i bsam 14—417

pa rnam dag pas/ /dus kun du ni gnas bya zhing / /sems can rnam pa thams cad la/ /g.yo sgyus slu ①bar mi bya dang / /sems bskyed byang chub sems dpa' la/ /ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed bya zhing / /yang dag par ni yon tan dag /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rjod ②par byed/ /sems can gang zhig dge ba dang / /bkod bya de dang nyan thos sogs/ /theg pa dman par mi sbyor zhing / /yang dag byang chub sems dpa' che/ /byang sems 'grib par byed pa yang / /rnam pa bzhir ni shes bya ste/ /dam pa'i dkon mchog bla ma sogs—/ /mchod par 'os pa bslus pa dang / /'gyod pa'i gnas pa yin pa la—/ /gzhan dag nye bar sbyor ba dang / /sems bskyed byang chub sems dpa' che/ /zhe sdang tshig gis tshar gcod cing / /sems can rnam pa thams cad la/ /g.yo dang sgyu yis spyod byed pa'o/ /byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang / /de la gal te gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang nas—/ /de ni de bas ①lhag par 'gyur/ /gang gā'i bye ma grangs snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams mi gang gis/ /rin chen rdzas kyis kun bkang ste/ /ston pa mchog la phul byas pas/ /gang gis thal mo nyer sbyar nas/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /mchod pa mchog 'di khyad par 'phags/ /de la mthar thug ma mchis so/ /'khor lo dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa/ /lcags las byas pa mgo la 'khor/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa yis/ /bsal rjobar gyur zhes rab tu grags/ /byang chub sems mchog ma bskyed par/ /dge gzhan gang gis grol mi 'gyur/ /'o mas dug ni sel lo zhes/ /'jig rten pa la rab tu grags/ /de nyid sbrul gyis 'thungs pa na/ /shin tu dug ni 14—418

'phel bar byed/ /mar dang bu ram sman kyi mchog /byis pas bza' nyes dug tu 'gyur/ /'bru mar sdong bu'i phung pos kyang / /me med bar du gsal mi ①'gyur/ /shel sgong ④dag par gyur pa yang / /tshon gzhan dag gis bsgyur ba yin/ /long ba dmigs bu med pa dag④ /brgya stong gong gzhan rgyu mi nusarjo/ /rlung dang bral ba'i me nyid kyis/ /nags tshal bsreg par ga la nus—/ /gsher bral rdul kyi phung po'i tshogs/ /'du bar mi 'gyur rlung gis 'thor / /chu rnams bsags pa'i lteng ka dag /gnyen pos ⑤mod la 'joms par byed/ /sems nyid rab tu dang ba yis/ /dge ba'i bshes la brten bya ste/ /bsnyen bkur cho ga bzang po'i tshogs/ /bya ba'i khyad par gnas kun 'phags/ /mngon 'dod the tshom med pa'i yul/ /don kun gsang ba ston byed pa/ /rab tu smin pa 'di nas 'jug /bla ma'i byen rlabs mthu yis grol/ /lan grangs mang por gsol gdab cing / /phun sum tshogs pas mthu bskyed nas/ /mos pa'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i sgorarjo/ /rang rgyud dag pas sdom gnas 'dod/ /dbang bskur cho ga rdzogs pa yis/ /las kun rim bzhin mngon gnyer zhing / /phyag rgya'i bsam gtan mthu bcas pas /las kun gsang ba'i sngags rgyun 'jug /thun mong khyad par dam tshig gis/ /nyes bskyed rten gnas dag par bya/ /thams cad sdom pas rjes gzung zhing / /bdag gzhan bya ba mthar phyin brtsam/ /byang chub chen po'i gnas spyod pa/ /der 'jug de nyid lam chen sgo⑦/ /don kun ngo bo gsal byed pas/ /sgo gsum bya rgyu rtag tu brtag /'gro gnas sems can rgya chen tshogs/ /theg chen gsang bas gzung ⑧bya ste/ /mthar thug ⑨gcig tsam don gyi phyir/ /rgyal 14—419

ba'i bka' don gus pas gzung ①/ /rdo rje bla ma sangs rgyas mchog /dus gsum thugs rje gtsor ldan pas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i gnas nyid yin/ /mi mkhas phrag dog nyams pa'i gzhi/ /de rgyud gtan du nyams par 'gyur/ /thog mar don kun sgo 'jug pas/ /bcas pa'i dam tshig sdom la gzung / /thabs rnams kun kyis bstan pa'i sgo/ /mtshan med mtshan ma sna tshogs kun/ /ma nor de bzhin ston byed pa/ /rdo rje theg pa'i sngags lam rgyud/ /phyag rgya kun las mi 'da' zhing / /mchod bstod tshogs kyi bya ba shes/ /sems can don spyod 'tshe ba spang / /der 'jug thugs rjes rnam par gzung / /rtag tu rang gi lha nyid dang / /rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /stobs ldan rnams kyis spyod byed pa/ /de dag kun gyi sgor 'jug brtsam/ /rtag tu dkon mchog mchod bya zhing / /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung / /mchod rten gtsug lag khang bzang po/ /yid dga' khrugus pa'i sems kyis gnas/ /lha gzhan dag la phyag byed dang / /ngan pa'i spyod yul kun ston pa'i/ /theg dman rgyun gzhan bstan skepa'i phyir/ /don kun che ba'i gnas nyams 'gyur/ /dran tshogs shes bzhin blo gros mthus/ /dad brtson ting 'dzin bskyed byas te/ /sdom bcas sdom min gnas dag las/ /mchod brtson mthu yis rnam par grol/ /dkyil 'khor kun du ma zhugs shing / /dam tshig rnams ni spangs pa dang / /gsang ba yang dag mi shes pas/ /sgrub pa ci yang grub mi 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chos nyid dang ldan pas/ /dam tshig la ldang buskal ba ngan/ /srog chags gsad par mi bya zhing / /dkon mchog gsum ni yong mi spang / /byang chub sems kyang mi gtang ⑤ste/ /skal bzang 14—420

slob dpon spang mi bya/ /srid pa shin tu sgrub byed pa'i/ /mgon gyur rnams la bdag skyabs mchi/ /thog mar bslab par bya ba'i tshul gyis ①smin par bya ba'i cho ga ste dang po'o// //rten gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa pos/ /mngon par bsgrub bya'i gnas gang dag /rgyud las mngon par bsngags pa'i gzhi/ /phun sum tshogs pas don kun spyad/ /gnas mal phyag dar legs pa'i sar/ /rgyan sogs ④bkod pa legs dgram zhing / /'phags pa'i gnas mchog mthu ldan pa'i/ /rten gyi bya bas don kun rdzogs/ /sa chu lci ba sbyin pa'i zas①/ /legs snyoms byugs pa tshul khrims mchog /grog sbur skyon bsal rjobazod pa nyid/ /kun du spro ba'i brtson 'grus dang / /mi g.yeng brtan pa'i bsam gtan dang / /legs par ri mo shes rab rdzogs/ /pha rol phyin drug dkyil 'khor 'di/ /rtse gcig sangs rgyas rnams la dbul/ /gser mdog nad rnams kun zhi zhing / /zla ba ⑤bzhin rgyas lha mi'i rjomachod/ /khyad par bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ /thun mong dkon mchog la dmigs pas/ /dus bzhin maṇ+ḍal bzhin ⑦dag la/ /me tog sngags su bcas pas dgram/ /oṃ badz+ra re khe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra ⑧maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ rgyu⑨/dkyil 'khor bzang po gnas de nyid/ /don kyi byin rlabs mthu ldan pas/ /stan bzang legs par bshams pa la/ /khrus kyis ⑩dag byas bde bar gnas/ /rgyud dang po yi dbye ba nyid/ /brtan pas nyin rer gsum zhi ba/ /bya ba thun mong bye brag gis/ /las kun yongs su dag par brtsam/ /tho rangs mal nas legs langs te/ /bgegs kyi sbyor ba sel byed pa'i/ /sngags kyi rgyal pos 14—421

bsrung ①byas nas/ /pha rol phyin sogs ②mtha' yas spyad/ /'gro ba rgya che la dmigs te/ /tshad med bzhi nas kun du khyab/ /bag med mtshan mo'i nyes dmigs kun/ /dran pa bskyed cing bshags pa bya/ /de bzhin 'bad pas dgongs mo'i dus/ /rang rgyud dmigs pas rnam par sbyang / /rgyan rnams kun kyis legs mdzes brgyan/ /kun du gzengs bstod snedaga' ba'i yid/ /lhag pa'i lha yi nga rgyal ldan/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis bsrung byas pa'o/ /me tog la sogs bcal rjobakram zhing / /mchod tshogs gtor ma rgyas byas nas/ /ras ris la sogs glegs bam la/ /yang dag mos pa dad pa skyedarjo/ /snying ga'i sngags kyi 'od zer kyis/ /phyogs bcur khyab pa'i zla ba bsam/ /sbyor ba'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya sngags/ /gnas kun dkyil 'khor legs par bskyed/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen sangs rgyas gtso/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshogs rnams kun//sku rgyan cha lugs byin rlabs rdzogs/ /rigs kyi rjo'od zer sprul par bcas/ /thams cad rgyud kun rnam dag pas/ /pho brang dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir ldan/ /oṃ badz+ra tsakra ⑦maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ rgyu⑧/ dri chab sngags kyis stibyin brlabs pas/ /phyogs rnams kun du gsang ⑩gtor bya/ /me tog mar me mtha' rgyas pas/ /bkra shis gzi mdangs rgya cher bskyed/ /gnod byed khro bo'i sngags kyi tshogs/ /phyogs bcu ⑩phyag rgyas gnas sbyang zhing ⑩/ /bgegs kyi dngos po bsreg byas te//srung ⑫ba'i 'khor lo rgya chen tshogs/ /dga' chen dpal gyi rdo rje las/ /rdo rje se gol rnam pa gnyis/ /rang gi sngags bcas mthu ldan pas/ /lhag pa'i lhar bcas dkyil 'khor bskul/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzā hūṃ/ oṃ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /sna tshogs lhag pa'i bsam pa can/ /ma lus sems can 14—422

don mdzad pa/ /ye shes che gnas byin kyis brlabs/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ①/ oṃ e bye hi bha ga bān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ ②sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ phyogs bcu'i kun legs bzhugs pa yi/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /thugs rje che dgongs 'gro rgyud gzigs/ /thabs mkhas smon lam dbang gis spyon—/ /oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wa ④ra hūṃ/ yang dag nyid du dad mod kyang //⑦'gro ba rnams kyi don slad du/ /phyag dang zhabs ni bsil mdzad cing / /dam tshig dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir bzhugs/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mā buya/ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ pra na rā ga swā hā/ gang dag bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan/ /sku mchog gsum mnga' dus gsum nyid/ /rab mchog theg chen bla na med/ /byang chub dge tshogs thugs ldan pa/ /rig pa gsang sngags tshogs su bcas/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor mthar phyin pa/ /bsam 'das brjod par dka' ba'i tshogs—/ /gnyis med sbyor bas bstod pa'i gnas/ /thams cad don kun ston mdzad pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor kun la bdag phyag rjo'atshal/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka ciX ban+da ṭ+wāṃ ka ro ⑦mi/ sdig las ldog pa'i sems nyid kyis—/ /thal sbyar pus mo g.yas btsugs te/ /nyon mongs rgyu dang yan lag gis / /rmongs pa'i tshogs 'phel 'khrul pa bskyed/ /sgo gsum mi dge sdog pa las/ /dus kun rgyun kyis bshags par ⑧bya/ /thun mong khyad par dkon mchog gi/ /bstan la mngon par ma dad cing / /dge bshes dam pa ston pa'i mchog /khyad par zhing du gyur kun la/ /mi dge las kun gang bgyis pagi/thog med 'khor ba'i kha brgyud nas/ /rang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig pa kun/ /bdag gzhan rgyud las gang 'byung ⑩ba/ /dus 'dir bshags shing bsdom par 14—423

bya—/ /gang dag phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / /'phags pa rnams kyis byang bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ ①spo ṭa da ha na badz+ra pā paṃ ṭ+wā hā/ gnyis med ye shes dag pa'i dbyings①/ /mi 'gyur kun du dag pa'i bdag /bkod pa che snang sna tshogs gzhi①/ /don kun phyag rgya 'byung ba'i tshul/ /sprul pa phyogs bcur ma 'gags pa'i/ /dbyer med pas ni las mdzad pa/ /thams cad don kun bskyed pa'i mchog /dus 'dir skyabs su gsol ba 'debs/ /oṃ burnya bo dhi satwa/ sha ra ṇi gats+tsha mi/ badz+ra dharmā byuḥ/ skyon med rnam par dag pa'i sgo/ /rdul phran grangs med bsam 'das pa/ /bzhi 'byung ma lus lhag pa'i tshogs/ /bde gshegs kun la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū rjodza pra brta na ya ā ṭ+wāṃ nit+yā ta ⑤yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga tā sha a dhi tishā rmarjo/sarba ta thā ga tā dz+nyā na ⑦mo a bhi ṣiñtsa na tu swā hā/ skye rga na 'chi dba' ⑧klong gi/ /chu bo kun las sgol byed shog /mi shes log rtog nges bcom dag /thugs rje ⑨mgon la skyabs su mchi/ /'gro rnams kun la sman ⑩slad du/ /sems mchog rin chen bdag gis sbyang ⑪/ /dus kun srog chags rnams kyi bdag /skyabs gnas ⑫dpung gnyen skyob gyur cig /oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ud+mā da ya mi⑫/ sarba pā paṃ bi ka ta kan t+ya tra ṭa tā ④sa ma ya bo dhi tsit+ta hūṃ swā hā/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /bsod nams sna tshogs mkhas pa'i mchog /'phags dang lha mi dge spyod pa'i/ /brtul zhugs bzang po bla med pa/ /bya ba rgya chen gnas kun tshogs/ /der gzhol de nyid slob byed pa'i/ /bsod nams tshogs 'gyur gang yin pa/ /de dag kun la rjes yi rang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā pū n+ya ⑫dz+nyā na a nu mo da na pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ theg chen gsang ba 14—424

bla na med/ /rdo rje lta bu yon tan brjod/ /rnal 'byor theg pa'i lam gyur pa'i / /rin chen sgron mas gsal bar mdzod/ /dngos rtog ①rigs kun sel byed pa'i/ /ye shes nyi ma'i thugs rje bdag /dus kun rnam par grol ba yi—/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ②a dhi— na pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa sder ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ dus kun rdzogs par grol byed pa'i/ /skyob pa rnams kyi gsang ba'i sngags/ /nyi ma'i snying po dri med pas/ /rgya chen phyogs rnams khyab byed pa'i/ /nyes pa'i skyon tshogs rab tu zhi/ /de dag de las der mtshungs ston/ /ston pa 'jig rten sgron ma'i tshogs/ /dus kun mi 'gyur brtan par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ga ④ga rna/ a bye shā ya me/sarba ta thā ga ta ⑤e ta ra tā ya/ dharmā tra thā/ ste thi ra bha ba ye swā hā/ 'gro rnams kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /dge ba rgya chen gang bsags pa/ /'khor ba'i chu bo 'joms byed pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das las grol bar shog /ma lus 'di dag gcig pa'i blos/ /rnam par sbyor ba gang dang gang / /mthar thug dngos po rjozhi byed pa/ /don kun gsal ba gnyis med mchog /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pu na nit+yā ⑦ta na pū dza me gha sa mu tra skespa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swā hā/ chu rgyun sbyangs pa ku sha'i tshogs/ /gnas kun dri sbyangs dag par byed/ /so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /de dag byin gyis brlabs shing ⑨dbul/ /dkon mchog gsum nyid gtsor gyur pa/ /lhag pa'i yon tan mtha' yas tshogs/ /sangs rgyas la sogs rjes su gzung ⑩/ /rnam grol mtha' yas brjod cing bstod//rtse gcig 'dun ⑪pa'i rgyud ⑫kun du/ /'khor los gnas kun 'khor lor sbyor//dga' dang gus pa'i tshogs kun gyis/ /bsod nams rgya chen mtha' yas pa'o/ /14—425

oṃ na mo bha ga ba ti rat+na ke tu rā dzā ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ha te bhe stisamyaka saṃ budhā ④ya/ tar+ya thā oṃ rasne rasne/ ma hā rasne ④rarngo ta bha berjo/ rat+na bha ⑤ye swā hā/ lus sam yang na sems kyang rung / /ci tsam nus par bskor ba bya/ /rgya cher 'gro ba la gnas te/ /smon lam mtha' yas gdab par bya/ /de nas rten gnas tshogs rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la rnam btud cing / /'gro ba thams cad mgron du gnyer/ /de dag byang chub la gzhug rjophyir/ /rnam grangs mtha' yas 'jug pa'i sgo/ /khyad par brtan gnas skyabs 'os gzung / /bla ma dam chos sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang / /dus kun btud de skyabs ⑦gsol zhing / /mchod 'os rnams la 'dud par bgyi/ /'di dag sdig las bzlog ⑧bkyid cing / /bsod nams tshogs kun yongs su gzung / /lus can rnams la bsod nams dag /de dag kun la rjes yi rang / /lus btud thal mo sbyar byas te/ /gsang ba'i theg chen bshad pa dang / /'go rnams rab tu gzhug slad du/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la gsol/ /'di dag gis bkyis bsod nams dang / /bdag gis bkyis dang ma bgyis dang / /de gang sems can thams cad kyis⑨/ /bla med byang chub sems bskyed shog /chos kun rnam dag dri med dbang / /yongs rdzogs mi khom kun spangs nas/ /spyod pa rang dbang yod pa dang / /'tsho ba bzang po rgyu ldan shog /lus can dag ni thams cad kyang / /lag na rin chen nyid ldan zhing / /yo byad tshogs rnams mtha' yas pa⑩/ /'khor 'das srid dus gnas par shog /bud med thams cad dus kun du/ /skyes mchog byang chub sems ldan zhing / /lus can thams cad reg ⑪pa dang / /14—426

rkang par ldan pa nyid du shog /'gro rnams kha dog ldan pa rnams/ /gzugs bzang gzi ①brjid che ba dang / /blta na sdug cing nad med par/ /stobs chen tshe ring brtan par shog /thams cad thabs la ②mkhas gyur ste/ /sdug bsngal tshogs rnams las gol zhing / /dkon mchog gsum la gzhol byed par/ /sangs rgyas theg pa'i rgyan ldan shog /byams sogs snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms kun gyi gzhir gyur cing sde/ /sbyin rnams tshud khrims bzod brtson 'grus—/ /bsam gtan shes rab kyis brgyan cing / /tshogs rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /mtshan dang dpe byad gsal bar bya/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sa bcu dang / /rgyun mi 'chad par 'gro byed shog /bdag gis yon tan de dag dang / /gzhan tshogs rnam par brgyan pa'i stobs/ /nyes pa kun las grol byed cing / /sems can kun mchog byams pa'i gtso/ /sems can kun yid re ba bzhin/ /dge ba thams cad rdzogs bgyid cing / /rtag tu lus can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal rtog pa'i rgyun sel shog /khams gsum kun gyi rjoskye ba gang / /gang dag sdug bsngal nyan ⑤pa'i tshogs/ /bdag gi rjoming tsam thos pa'i dus/ /shin tu 'jigs pa med gyur cig /bdag nyid mthong zhing dran pa dang / /ming tsam grags ⑦pas gzhan dag kun/ /rab tu 'khrug med rnal ma'i yid/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges gzhol zhing / /tshe rabs kun du rjes 'brang ba'i/ /mngon shes lnga po thob par shog /sems can kun la rnam kun du/ /rtag tu phan par bgyid gyur cig /'jig rten kun la skye bo gang / /sdig pa'i rgyun zhugs 'dod gyur dag /de dag thams cad gnod med par/ /rtag tu cig car zlog gyur cig /sa chu me rlung 'byung ⑧14—427
