tshogs dang / /sman dang dgon pa'i ①shing bzhin du/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad kyi/ /rang dgar 'gag med spyod par shog /sems can rnams ni srog bzhin phongasasne/ /de dag la bdag cher phongs ①shing / /bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / /bdag dge ma lus der min cig /ji srid sems can 'ga' rjozhig kyang / gang du ma grol de srid du/ /de phyir bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub thob kyang gnas gyur cig /gang du sa gzhi legs pa'i gnas/ /der nam rten gyi las byas te/ /bar chad rkyen kun bsal nas ni/ /rigs kyi ting 'dzin bsgom par bya/ /sa gzhi 'jam zhing sbyin pa dag /gtsang ma'i gnas nas blang bya ste/ /dri zhim sngags kyi chus brlan nas/ /spyod ⑤med pha rol phyin drug spyadarjo/ /oṃ na maḥ sa marnya budhā ṭ+wāṃ⑦/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/oṃ ⑧badzod bha ba ye swā hā/ oṃ a ra dze bi ra dze swā hā/ oṃ dharma ⑨dhā tu gasgo swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra muṅka ra a ko ṭa ya swā hā/ sa gzhi byin brlab spyad pa dang / /dri gtsang chu yis bsdu ba dang / /tho bas brdung zhing gong bu'i gzugs/ /rigs kun sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /so so'i phrin las rjes mthun par/ /'phro 'du'i gnas kun skye ba dang / /⑩legs par snum bsku phyag rgya gzhug /gdab pas sku gsum gsal gyur pa'o/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod pa rgyan dang bcas/ /rol cha kun gyis mngon par bstod/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor rim bzhin gsal/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs gzhug /mchod pa'i tshogs mang legs bsngos nas//lha gnas dbang bskur byin brlab cing / / sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya che/ /⑩gtor mas mgron tshogs tshim par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥdharmā ⑫dha re swā hā/oṃ pad+ma sa ma ya a pra ti ha ta ye tha bha badzā ⑫ya swā hā/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba te badz+ra 14—428

satwa pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ①ya ar+ha te/ saṃmyaka saṃ budh+wa ②ya/ tar+ya thā/sruk+ṣa ④me sruk+ṣa dume/ sa ma ye sa ma ye/ shādhe shādhe/ dādhe dādhe⑤/ sa ma ro bā/ a na ya/ a baṃ be+e/ a baṃ be+e ya/ sho ba ti/ ma hā te dza rjoni ra ku le ni ⑦ra bā ni ra bā bu tram̐/ a dhīṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+pe te swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ⑧ta ni sha ti ti ⑨ba de dz+wa ⑩la dz+wa ⑪la dharmā dha tu gasgo swa ⑫hā/ mtha' mar bzod par ⑫gsol bya ste/ /byin rlabs brtan par mnga' gsol zhing / /bkra shis rgya cher brjod byas pas/ /de dag bsdu zhing gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ā ka sha gasgo swā hā/ oṃ ④ye dharmā he du pra bha bā he tun te ⑫ṣ+pe ta thā ga to h+ya ba data te/ṣ+pe tsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa⑩/ oṃ swa bhā ba bi shudhe/ ha ra ha ra/a ka dz+wa la/ a ka dz+wa la/ dharmā dhā tu gasgo swā hā/ bya ba'i las kun bstan ⑩ 'gyur bas/ /phrin las bzhi bcas dngos grub tshogs/ /'byung ba lnga yi khams rnams la/ /rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas gdab/ /bar skabs khrus kyi dus dag ⑫tu/ /dri bcas chu rgyun byin brlabs pas/ /bdag dang 'gro la sogs pa yi/ /phyi nang gsum gyi ⑪gnas gsum sbyang / /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā ma hā sa ma ya shrī ye ⑪hūṃ/ byang chub sems dpa' gnod ⑪gnas la/ /chu rgyun bzang po yi ni snod⑫/ /sngags bcas brgya rtsa brgyad du 'bul/ /khrus gsol zug rngu sel bar byed/ /oṃ dze+e bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ phyogs bcu'i khyon chu'i byin brlabs pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod cing / /yi dwags rgya chen gnas dmigs te/ /lan grang nyi shu rtsa gcig 'thor/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te saṃ bha ra hūṃ/⑫ slar yang zas kyi dus dag tu/ /thog mar byin brlabs dkon mchog mchod/ /srung ma rgya chen mnyes byas nas/ /14—429

lhag mas 'byung po tshim par bya/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā shā/ ār+ya nut+pan+da tātadhi—/ oṃ uhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ thams cad thugs rje'i mes bsregs nas/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dag par byed/ /oṃ las 'dod lnga'i yon tan sogs/ /rgya chen nam mkha'i khams su sprul/ /dbyer med lha yi nga rgyal kyis/ /gnas rnams kun du longs spyod bya/ /rtag tu bsam gtan la gnas pas/ /zab mo rgya mtsho'i mdo gdon cing / /sems can kun gyi don gyur pa'i/ /phyogs rnams mthun par 'gro ba'i ①sgo/ /lus ngag sems kyi bya ba kun/ /rnam grol theg pa bsod nams tshogs/ /phyogs thams cad nas bslab par bya ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i ④cho ga ste gnyis pa'o// //dga' chen dpal gyi rdo rje las/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor gnyis bcing //ting 'dzin sngags kyis bskul ba'i mthus/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gshegs 'gyur/ /phyi nang phyogs kun snang ba yi/ /gdug pa thams cad zhi byed pa/ /rang bzhin sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /byin brlabs gsal bas brtan ④par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs pa yi/ /gdan 'dzom bka' gos ⑤bgro mdzad cing / /bar chad bgegs kun gzhom dupa'i tshogs/ /rang gi gnas nas rnam par spro/ /rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri dang / /be+e con rtse gsum la sogs kyi/ /phyag rgya sngags la rnam 'phrul pas/ /thams cad 'jig cing 'thor bar byed/ /rang gi gnas gzung brtan pa'i phyir/ /rang nyid rdo rje te ru ka'i/ /gnas kun mtshan ma bzang pos brgyan/ /shin tu 'phro ba'i tshogs ⑦kun gyis/ /phyogs bcu sprul pa'i 'khor lo brjod/ /'dod pa'i rgyal 14—430

po khro bo ches/ /phyogs kun bgegs rnams gzir byas te/ /phyag rgya bzhis btab gnas su dgod/ /nyi ma la gnas khro tshogs bsgom/ /grangs med sprul pa'i tshogs ldan pas/ /phyogs bcu'i mtha' rnams gtam ①byas te/ /me ④ri 'bar ba'i mtshon char bcas/ /phyogs rnams byams pa'i lta ba yis/ /snying rje chen po'i gnas kun gsal/ /'di las lhag pa'i srung sneba'i mchog /gnyis med stong pa'i rang bzhin las/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od 'bar ba/ /zab mo'i sngags kyis mtshams byas pa'o/ /phyogs gzhan khro tshogs bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje la sogs mtshon cha dang / /nyungs kar thal ba dri yi chu/ /legs sbyangs byin brlabs rigs kyi lha/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor rab 'bar bas/ /de dag mthar phyir rjosel bar byed/ /dbyibs rjodang ye shes gnyis med pa'i/ /don kun mchog tu gsang ba'i gnas/ /rang nyid ngo bo ma bcos dbyengs/ /chos kyi rgyun gyi ting 'dzin gsal/ /phyogs rnams sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dngos byung rdo rje sems dpa' che/ /ma chags g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi/ /gnas kyi mtshan ma kun las 'phags/ /dkar dmar zhal phyag bzhi bzhis mdzes—/ /g.yas sngo g.yon dmar rgyab ser porjo/ /dang po ba dan gsum pa yis⑦—/ /phyag rgya rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin/ /gnyis pas ⑧rin chen mda' gsor zhing / /g.yon gyi dang po kha ṭ+wāṃ nyid/ rgya gram ba dan dril bu'i sgra/ /gnyis pa rin chen sna lnga'i gzhu/ /mtshan dpe phyag rgya lnga yis mdzes/ /las bzhir gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa/ /'od gsal rin chen sna lnga'i mdangs/ /rin chen phreng bas rgyan ⑨rnams spras/ /sku stod dar dkar gser ris la/ sku smad tshi ⑩gu'i na bza' nyid/ /spyi bor zla dkyil skur ldan pa⑩/ /sku yi dkyil 14—431

'khor de nyid bsngags①/ /mgrin pa'i pad+ma gsung ldan par/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor de nyid bsngags②/ /thugs ka'i nyi ma'i thugs ldan par/ / thugs kyi dkyil 'khor de nyid bsngags/ /①ye shes dkyil 'khor rten gsal ba'i—/ /sngags kyi dkyil 'khor phreng ba'i tshud/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas rnams/ /rang gi gnas kun gzhug par bya/ /byin brlabs shes pas ye shes lha/ /rang rig tshul bzhin spyan drangs te/ /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la bzhag rjonas/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /de ⑤rjes phyag rgya rnam pa bzhis/ /rang gi gnas kun brtan byas la/ /byin brlabs 'dod don gsol gdab cing / /mchod bstod mnyes pa'i rol mos mchod/ /dam tshig gsum gyi phyag rgya yis/ /mdun nas sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sngags kyi phreng ba 'khor lo'i tshul/ /'phro 'du gsal ba'i ngo bor brtag /spyod lam kun du ma nyams blos/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis med tshul bsgom zhing / /byas pa'i tshogs gnyis rgyur shes pas/ /rang gi byin rlabs brtan par bya/ /ji srid kha zas dus kun dang / /bya ba'i tshul gzhan de bzhin nyid/ /'dri klog kha don la sogs pa'i/ /don kun bsngo rjob rgya chen sogs⑦/ /rang gi dbang po'i ⑧gnas las byung / /de dag rol pa'i tshul rgyun bcas/ /ma nyams dus kun snang byed pas/ /de mtha'i chags pa grol bar 'gyur/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor rgya chen po'i/ /tshul rnams gang dag bshad pa yang / /las su bya bas 'jug pa ste/ /mi gnas gsal bar goms pa nyid/ /gdul bya'i rgyud rnams sbyang ba'i phyir/ /sngon 'byung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /rigs kyi 'khor lo gang gnas ⑨'jug /de dag bsdus dang rgya chen tshogs/ /byin 14—432

brlabs gsal bas brtan byas pa'i/ /sbyor ba'i don kun rdzogs par gnas/ /bsnyen sgrub yan lag rjes mthun pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor dag /de dag mtshan ma med pa'i gnas/ /rol pa'i byin rlabs che las 'byung / /ji srid de nyid snang ba yi/ /tshul gyis de rgyud gsal bar byed/ /don 'byung gsang ba'i kun ston pas/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /'di dag nang gi mtshan nyid de/ /thams cad spyi yi ①chos nyid don/ /nam zhig stong par 'dod pa'i dus/ /de dag dngos kun las grol ba/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis med sbyor byed cing / /byin rlabs ②mchog kun rnam par rol/ /nang gi ting 'dzin gsal ba las/ /thig le phra mo la sogs sbyor/ /dam tshig kun gyi gnas rgyas pas/ /brtan pa'i tshogs kun mthar phyin 'gyur/ /rgya chen dkyil 'khor rnam dag dang / /lha yi rnam dag gsal ba'i mthus/ /byang chub sems su sgyu ma'i dngos/ /chos rnams kun gyi mtha' bral ba'o/ /spyod pa yongs su dag pa rnal 'byor pas bar chad bsal ba'i cho ga ste gsum pa'o// //de nas bdag gzhan bsrung 'dod pas/ /dbe+en pa'i gnas su tshogs bsags shing ④/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin sbyor/ /bsnyen pa'i cho gas brtan par bya/ /dur khrod lha yi gnas rnams dang / /ma mo gnas kyi thal ba mchog /thod pa mtshan ldan sbyar bar gzhagarjo /rigs kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas bsrung / /snying po nye ba'i snying po dang / /rtsa sngags lha rnams kun gyis sbyin—/ /ting 'dzin 'phro 'du gsal rdzogs pa'i/ /brgya stong khri yi bzlas brjod bya/ /gang dag bsrung bar 'dod pa la/ /thig le 'am sor ris gsum 14—433

du shis/ /phyogs mtshams nam mkha'i sa bcings na/ /srung ①ba kun gyi bla med yin/ /de bzhin snga ma'i sbyor ldan pas/ /rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu blangs te—/ /rin chen snod bzang byin brlabs nas/ /dkyil 'khor brgyan ②pa la gzhag ①cing / /ku sha'i chu rgyun sngags thim par/ /lha rdzas zhi ba'i chu mchog gis—/ /gtor ba dang ni blugs pa dag /khrus byas phog pas sngon bzhin 'grub—/ /mi yi thod pa'i nang du ni/ /nyungs kar rgyal po sngags kyis bskyed//tshul bzhin phyung rjonas sa gzhi la/ /yun ring ⑤goms pa'i brtul zhugs rjoldan//phyag rgya'i rigs tshogs sna tshogs pa/ /rab tu grol bas gzhan dgug cing / /bzang po khrus kyi cho ga nyid/ /dus gsum bzlas brjod mtshams sbyar te/ /rigs tshogs brten gnas gdan bcas pa'i/ /rab tu sprul pa'i khro bo bskyed/ /zhi dang rgyas sogs las rnams la/ /dus bzhi rten 'brel mthun par spyad/ /de las byung ba'i rdzas rnams kyis/ /de nyid las kun byed par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo gcig pa'i phyag rgya nyid/ /byin rlabs ⑦tshogs kyis rnam par brgyan/ /rang rig snang ba'i dkyil 'khor kun/ /phyogs bcur spro zhing gsal bar bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /gnas gsum mtshan ma'i tshogs 'joms shing //phyogs mtshams bla 'og thams cad kun/ /gang 'dod de nyid ngo bor 'gyur/ /gzhug dka' bdag nyid ngan pa ⑧rnams/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ⑨byin gyis brlabs—/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la dmigs te/ /sbyor ba bzhi yis rdzogs byas pa'i/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor mnyam par spyor/ /gnas kun phyag rgya gsal ⑩bar mdzad/ /thams cad sprul pa'i byang chub sems/ /rigs rnams phyogs bcur rnam bkod pas/ /bsgrub bya gang dag de nyid la/ /gsang ba'i 14—434

gnas su sbyor bar byed/ /don mthun phyag rgya ①'di yis ni/ /'gro gnas thams cad bsrung bar 'gyur/ /chos dbyings ye shes phyag rgya las/ /'od 'bar 'khor lo'i gzhal yas khang / /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i/ /rnam par snang mdzad sbyor ldan pas/ /phyogs bcu legs par 'khor lo'i tshul/ /bla 'og dag tu byin brlabs shing ④/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus dang rgyas pa yis/ /thams cad srung ①ba bla na med/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sbyor ba las/ /zhe sdang la sogs 'joms byed pa'i/ /drag po chen po'i skur sbyor zhing / /bsdus dang rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor chesarjo/ /phyag rgya rdo rje'i tshogs spro zhing / /rang gi sngags dang rnal 'byor pas/ /brtan g.yo thams cad srung rjobar byed/ /de bzhin tshar gcod rengs pa 'grub/ /sangs rgyas gar gyi rnam 'phrul ba/ /sbyor ldan rdo rje sems dpa' bzhin/ /bsdus dang rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /gsang sngags phyag rgya bsam gtan las/ /sna tshogs pad+ma la brten bya/ phyag rgya'i tshogs kun kha 'byed pas/ /sgrib pa'i las kun rnam grol zhing / /thams cad dag pa'i las la sbyor/ /sems dpa' chen po'i cha lugs kyis/ /sems dang ngo bo la gnas bya/ /de bzhin nyid la snang ba yi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor ldan/ /rin chen tshogs 'bar brjid pa'i gnas/ /'bar ba'i lta ba'i tshul bzhugs pa/ /rdo rje rab tu drag po'i me/ /rab 'jigs 'bar ba mi bzad 'grub/ /gang dag rgyas pa'i tshul sbyor zhing / /las rnams dngos grub skyed byed pas/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus dang rgyas pa'i tshul/ /gnas rnams kun du 'phros rjopa'o/ /thams cad dag pa'i las la sbyar/ /mi gnyis ting 'dzin brtan pa'i mthus/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba/ /las kyi 14—435

phrin las kun gyi bdag /so so'i phyag rgya sngags kyis sbyor/ /ji lta'i ①phrin las grub pa yis/ /oṃ ṭaṃ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis/ /go cha bgos pa'i tshul du bya/ /gnas lngar rang gi sngags dang rgyas/ /nyis 'gyur dag tu bcings nas kyang / /sangs rgyas gtsug gi nor bu dag /dar dpyang ⑤'gying dang bcas pas dgrol//thal mo brdabs pas brtan byed pa/ /srung ④ba kun gyi bla med pa'o/ /phyi nang gdul dka' drag po'i tshogs/ /'di dag mthu yis 'jigs par 'gyur/ /thams cad kun kyis srung byed pa'i/ /bla na med pa'i go cha mchog /bsod nams ye shes las brgyud stobs/ /mthu yis thams cad 'jigs 'gyur ba/ /don kun gsang ba'i phyag rgya dang / /gsang sngags ting 'dzin gnas las skyes//rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /chos sems rtse gcig gnas pa yisadhi/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /zhi ba'i lta bas bltas nas ni/ /phyogs kyi rigs kun g.yo 'gyur zhing / /rims dhidug gdon rnams sel byed 'gyur/ /'di dag bsam gtan gyis 'grub pa/ /bsam gtan goms pa'i stobs kyis terjo//dang po las kyis sbyor byed na/ /phyag rgya sngags kyi mthu ldan pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /mthe'u ⑦chung lcags kyu rtse mos mnan/ /bsam gtan sngags kyis ⑧gnas rdzogs 'gyur/ /rtse gcig lha yi ting 'dzin gyis⑨/ /phyag rgya bsgyur te dpral bar gzhag⑩ /mi mthun gnas kun lta ba'i tshul/ /rdo rje bsdams ⑪pa bstan byas pa'i/ /mdzub mo phan tshun skam pa'i tshul/ /nad dang zug rngu ma lus kun/ /'dren byed phyag rgya'i gtso bo mchog /rtag tu rang gi ting 'dzin gnas/ /byams dang snying rje lta bar ldan/ /grub pa dpal gyi spyan bcings nas/ /mig gsal phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'dis⑫/ /shes rab ye 14—436

shes mig bskyed cing / /long ba dag kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ /rigs kyi sbyor ba mngon ldan par/ /phyag rgya'i yan lag brtan byas pas/ /glad pa'i nad rnams kun bsdus te/ /kha phyogs drang zhing btung bar bya/ /rtse gcig brten pas yang dang yang / /rdo rje khu tshur dpal sbyor bas/ /nad kyi zug rngu nad tshogs ①kun/ /gang la dmigs pa sel bar 'gyur/ /de dag kun gyi gsang sngags 'di/ /don bzhin brtson pas rna lam sdegrags/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta karma sta ma sidhi hoḥ④/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya che/ /don kun rnam par 'phrul byed pas/ /lag g.yas sems dpa'i gtsug tor bcing / /byis pa nad med bde ba'i mchog /'od 'bar pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bdud rtsi byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /lag g.yas klu yi gdengs ka bya/ /'bar ba'i tshul ston 'be+ebs par bcas/ /mi mthun gnas rnams dug rgyas btab/ /thams cad sel ba'i las byed pa'o/ /bde gshegs sku ni rigs chen pos/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgya mngon sbyar te/ /srung ④ba sngags kyi rgyud ldan dag /dga' ba'i rgyud kyis rjogrol bar 'gyur/ /drag po che mchog sbyor ba yis /mdzes pa'i phyag rgya smin mtshams gzhagadhi /ru lu'i sngags kyi don sbyar bas/ /mkha' 'gro'i las kun 'grub par 'gyur/ /'gro gzhan dud 'gro phra mo sogs/ /thams cad rigs kyis sbyangs byas te/ /rten dang sbyor ba sna ④tshogs dang / /sngags bcas bsam gtan rtse gcig mthus/ /de dag nad med bde ba dang / /gzi byin mthu rtsal phun sum tshogs/ /me tog 'bras bu skye shing rnams/ /rten 'byel cho ga ji lta bar/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis ⑧sbyor byas shing / /rig ⑨pa'i ting 'dzin bskyed pa yis/ /de dag thams cad bcud rdzogs te/ /rtag tu 14—437

gzi mdangs rgyas par 'gyur/ /pha rol gnon pa'i rtsal dag gis/ /'a la 'khor mtshon cha'i phyag rgya rnams/ /ma nyams rang gi mtshan nyid rdzogs/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang ①bya ste/ /khro bo brjid pa'i stobs ldan pas/ /mi mthun gnas kun gzhom pa'i phyir/ /ji srid brtan par ma gyur par⑦/ /de srid bsgom bzlas rtse gcig tu/ /khro bo'i tshogs kun legs gzhug cing / /'phro 'du yang yang don spyod pa/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sbyor mthus/ /sde dpung 'joms pa'i stobs rdzogs 'gyur/ /de dag dkyil 'khor ji lta bur/ /yang dag brtan pas sngags rnams dang / /phyag rgya'i stobs skyed ①sbyor byas nas//mtshon cha so so'i tshul bzhin du/ /'degs shing 'phangs pa drag po'i tshogs/ /tshar bcad bsgral zhing brlag rjopar 'gyur/ /mi gnyis ye shes che sbyor ba'i/ /zab cing rgya chen ⑤dkyil 'khor nyid/ /thog mtha'i yul las 'das pa'i dngos//dpal mchog dang po'i mtshan nyid can/ /nyon mongs drag po'i gnas tshogs bskyed—/ /don kun 'joms byed theg chen ④sku/ /cha lugs ji bzhin gsal ldan pa/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug nas/ /rnam par spros pa'i las rnams kun/ /de ltar sder bcas mnan pa'i tshul/ /rkang pa brkyang dang gnon pa dang / /bskum nas 'debs pa'i stabs dag ni/ /phrin las bzhi yi sbyor bas te/ /phyag rgya bsam gtan sngags bcas pas/ /g.yas g.yon sbyor ba'i rgya gzung zhing / /gzugs rnams gzhom zhing mnan ⑦par bya/ /rigs kun sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /las kun dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phrul/ /gzugs sogs phung po lnga rnams dang / /de rgyu nyon mongs dug lnga'i tshogs/ /yul bcas rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /thams cad gnyis med sangs rgyas su/ /14—438

yon tan phrin las rol pa'i stabs/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rnams/ /yongs bkug dbang du bsdu bya ste/ /bsam gtan sngags dang phyag rgyas ①mnan//rang bzhin gcig pa'i btsun mo rnams/ /dga' zhing longs spyod dgyes pas spyad—/ /'di dag zag med mthu ldan pas/ /gnyis med 'bras bu chen por sbyor—/ /ji snyed rgyu dang las kyi chos/ /so so'i theg pa gzhung bzhin du/ /byang chub pha rol phyin pa dang / /grub dang gzung dang mdangs rnams dang / /rigs dang phyag rgya'i khyad par kun/ /so so'i las kun spyod cing gnon/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis su med pa'i tshul/ /so so'i mthu yis sbyor byed cing / /rnam pa'i don kun las rnams stel/ /bsod nams ye shes rdzogs pa'o/ /nye bar spyod pa lha mo'i tshogs/ /don grub gsang ba kun nas 'jug /rigs mthun gtsor gzung ①sbyor ba yi/ /phyag rgya 'phrul pas de non 'gyur/ /nyon mongs gnas kun rgyu rdzogs pa/ /dregs byed lha rnams dbang mdzad de/ /rigs kun dkyil 'khor cha lugs kyi④/ /byin brlabs gsang ba lha mo dag /rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthus/ /'jig rten gsum tshogs rnam bkug cing //mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul dbrog ④bya ste/ /'da' ba med par las bzhin dgug /rigs kun phrin las rnam pa'i stobs/ /dregs byed sder bcas mnan byas te/ /chung ma rgyan tshogs yo byad rnams/ /mthu yis dbrog cing longs spyod do/ /de bzhin 'jig rten gsum dag gi/ /mthu chen sde brgyad dbang ldan sogs/ /phyogs skyong bcu po la sogs rnams/ /yud tsam zhig gis 'dir bkug ste/ /rang ⑤gi rten la sbyor bstems nas/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas dbang du byed/ /ma lus 'jig rten kun grags pa'i/ /zhi dang rgyas sogs las rnams kun/ /14byed439

de dag rnal ①'byor mthu sbyor bas/ /'bad pa med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /las kun dngos grub tshogs shes pas/ /bdag gzhan don kun sbyad pa'i rnams//mi 'jigs gnas gsum theg pa dang / /rten 'brel gsang bas kun bstan pa'o//de ltar dgug dang dbye ba dang / /gsod ②dang sgod dang rengs pa dang / /rmugs pa la sogs las rnams kun/ /'di nyid mthu yis grub par 'gyur/ /so so'i ting 'dzin sngags bcas pas/ /rten cing 'byel pas spyad byas te/ /don kun gsal bas sna tshogs pa'i/ /tshul rnams gzhan du ①brjod pa bzhin/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs kun kyi/ /thun mong cho ga bzhin gyur pa'i/ / ye shes phreng rjoba'i 'khor lo dag /byin brlabs rjotshogs bskyed brtsam par bya/ /rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa tshul bzhin du/ /rten cing dkyil 'khor la sbyor bas/ /de dag gsang sngags brjod pa gdon/ /thog mar 'khor lo tshul bzhin du/ /rtsibs brgyad bcu drug mu khyud gnyis/ /ā li kā li mnyam byas te/ /shar gyi gnas su sbyor bar bya/ /'khor lo mu khyud bzhi rnams la/ /yi ge gsang sngags rdzogs par dgod/ /drag dal ring thung tshul bzhin du/ /g.yas g.yon phreng ba thabs shes rgya/ /oṃ uhūṃ shrī de ba te badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ tra na mo swa tuste/ sarba budhā dhis ma yo gī nī na hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ rig sngags phreng bas bsgyur byas pa'i/ /'khor los gnas kun dag par 'gyur/ /'di nas dam tshig dkyil 'khor rnams/ /gsal bar bskyed cing brtan byas nas—/ /ye shes lha dang gnyis med par/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas btab cing //mchod bstod lhag gnas cho ga rdzogs/ /dus kun tshogs bsags dngos grub bzhi—/ /'jug pa po rnams kyi ⑦phrin las sna tshogs 'grub pa'i cho ga ste bzhi 14byed440

pa'o—/ / //de nas dngos grub bzang po ni/ /bdag gzhan kun la phan phyir du/ /ma nyams kun la 'jug pa'i sgo/ /don kun gsang dang spyad par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor zhing / /gzugs dbyibs thams cad ldan pa'i rgyusti/ /byin brlabs dbang bskur gnas rdzogs pas/ /sngon du bsnyen cing bsgrub ②pa dang / /rten kyi mtshan ma goms byas te/ /las kun bya ba'i sgo rnams dag /phyi rol pra se'i ①cho ga dang / /rten 'byel mthu las brtag par bya/ /'byung ba lnga yi khams kun las/ /rang rig sbyor ba'i phyag rgya sngags/ /sbyang zhing byin brlabs bsrung byas pas/ /don kun lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /yang dang yang du sngags brjod cing / /yi ge gcig pas dhikun ston 'gyur/ /de ltar phyi nang sna tshogs bdag /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor che burnams kyi/ /phyag rgyas brten ④pa'i las byas pas/ /bden brjod mtshan ma sna tshogs ston/ /nang gi ye shes zag pa med/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor che gnas sbyor/ /de nyid thugs kyi gsang ba mchog /so so'i rten la bsgrub bya ste/ /sngags bcas bden pa brjod cing brtag /don kun gsang ba ston par 'gyur/ /de dag ting 'dzin goms pa las/ /bden brjod sngags kyi mthu bskyed cing / /dus gsum chos rnams ma lus pa'i/ /rang gi ⑦tshul gyis gsal bar byed/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /dkyil 'khor phyag rgya'i cho ga rdzogs/ /so so'i rten 'brel rdzas rnams la/ /phyag rgya sngags bcas don rnams bsgrub/ /'di dag rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i mthus/ /rang gi ngo bo brten par 'gyur/ /ri 14—441

lu mig sman bcud kyis len/ /ral gri gser 'gyur la sogs rdzas/ /de dag dmigs pa'i yan lag gis/ /las kun rdzogs pa'i dngos grub 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor chen po nyams dga'i gnas/ /cho ga'i ①tshogs rnams rdzogs pa'i gzhi—/ /der ni rang gi rdzas dag las/ /don kun dngos grub skye bar 'gyur//so so'i rig pa phyag rgyar bcas/ /yun ring mtha' yis las rdzogs pa/ /ji bzhin 'jug pa'i byin rlabs ②kyis/ /bden pa'i chos kun gsal bar ston/ /phun sum tshogs pa bzhir ldan pas/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i yan lag rdzogs/ /phyi dang nang gi khrus byas nas/ /sgrub pa chen po la 'jug bya/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung bar/ /sngon du bsnyen pa rdzogs byas te/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga po dag /sha lnga'i grogs dang bcas par bsags/ /brtse mtshan dang ldan pa rnams/ /phyogs mtshams dbus kyi gnas su dgod/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor ji bzhin pa'i/ /pho brang gdan khang pa rdzogs nas/ /yig 'bru phyag mtshan sku phra mo/ /spro dang bsdu bas yongs su rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig nyid/ /gnyis med bsgoms pas gsal bar 'gyur/ /'di dag rang rang mthu skyed skepa'i/ /byin rlabs rjorten 'brel stobs rdzogs nas/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs bstems/ /dgug gzhug gnyis su med par gnas—/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ldan pas/ /srin lag dang no mthe bong rtses/ /zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs nas⑤/ /rtag pa yi ni dngos grub thob/ /tshud bzhin rigs kyi dkyil 'khor che/ /'khor lo chen po gnas rgyas par/ /bdud rtsi gsang ba bsgrub bya ste/ /rang rig rgyu rjorkyen tshogs pas so/ /bsnyen sgrub meyan lag rnam bzhi yis/ byin brlabs dkyil 'khor rdzogs byas te/ /14—442

rigs dang rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshul/ /gnyis med thabs dang shes rab gsalaske/ /'od dang du ba dri sgra rgyun/ /lha mo'i gzugs dang mang du 'phel/ /yi ge dgu dang bcu gcig dang / /bcu bdun nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs/ /bar skabs sngags kyis gsal byas pas/ /phyag rgya'i gnas kun rdzogs par 'gyur/ /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /dmar po tweḥyis ①kun sdud de/ /rta mchog yon tan rol pa'i mthus/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor kun mnyes mdzad/ /tshogs chen yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor gnas kun spro bsdu ba/ /ye shes 'khor lo gzhug byas te/ /bdud rtsi gsang ba chen po'i rgyun/ /rdo rje sems gtso lha mor bcas/ /bsdus dang rgyas pa'i 'khor lo rnams/ /de dag rigs kyis ②khyab byed pa'o/ /bdud rtsi shel sgong dze+edag pa'i gzugs/ /bsnyen sgrub yan lag rnam pa bzhi/ /cho ga'i don kun rab tu rdzogs/ /'di dag skyed dang spro ba dang / /rgya chen spros pas kun gsal zhing / /sangs rgyas rigs sogs 'gro ba'i tshogs/ /kun gyi budangos por 'di gyur cig /thams cad bsgrub pa'i bdag nyid kyi/ /ra sa ya na'i bde ba'o/ /'dis ni srung ⑤ba byas na dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas tshe gnas bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pas rjode nyid dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /cho ga rdzogs pas brtsams byas te/ /phun sum tshogs pas kun spyad rdzogs/ /mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i sku/ /cho ga shes pas bsgom par bya/ /byin rlabs ⑦rang gi ngang tshul bstan/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams rdzogs par gnas/ /rtag tu bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi/ /sbyor ba bzhi rgyun cho ga rdzogs⑧/ /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor rten sdud cing / /bzlas brjod gsal bas brtson pas 'grub/ /thod 14—443

pa mtshan dang ldan sngags pa/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor gnas su gzhag① /thabs dang shes rab 'phro 'du yis/ /phyogs kun sangs rgyas gsal bar 'gyur//nyi ma'i 'od zer sna tshogs pas/ /tshe gnas byin rlabs ④bskyed par bya/ /ye shes 'khor lo kun bsdus te/ /rang rig gnas kun rgyas par mdzad/ /'od 'bar g.yo ba la sogs kyi/ /dngos grub bzang po rtag skernams kun/ /yi ge bdun dang bcu gcig pa/ /bco lngas 'phro 'du rdzogs par 'gyur/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig ni/ /gnas kun rgyas par byed pa'i mchog /rigs kun dkyil 'khor gnas gsal bas/ /phrin las bzhi yi dngos grub 'grub/ /de dag dkyil 'khor rgya chen dang / /bsdus rjotshogs gang la mos pa bzhin/ /dmigs par bya ba'i bsgrub bya rnams/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor so so'i gnas/ /phrin las gsang ba 'di rgyud kyis/ /so so'i phrin las mnyam par sbyor/ /rang gi gsang sngags ji lta ba/ /rang gi ting 'dzin rtse gcig nyid/ /don kun gsang ba la dmigs te/ /phyag rgya'i gnas kun rdzogs par sbyad/ /des ni zhi rgyas dbang drag gi/ /dngos grub thun mong las 'phags pa'i/ /rnam pa mang po mtshan ldan zhing / /de dag las kun rdzogs par byed/ /don 'di gsang ba la brten nas/ /rgya chen sngags don tshul mang po/ /de nyid rnam kun gsal 'gyur te/ /thogs pa med par 'grub pa'o/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig gnas/ /des ni dngos grub kun sbyor zhing / /'gro ba rgya chen la dmigs pas/ /mchog gi ye shes bsgrub par bya/ /bsnyen sgrub kun gyi sngon ⑤'gro ba'i/ /cho ga rgya chen rdzogs gyur nas/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin du/ /rang rig ༷dngos grub rnam par sbyor/ /rten gyi dbye ba rnam bzhi 14—444

ste—/ /dbang po yul dus bsnyen sgrub sogs/ /rang gi 'jug pa tshul bzhin du—/ /cho ga rdzogs pa'i yan lag rnams/ /phyag rgya'i gnas kun la brten nas—/ /don dam gsang ba spyad par bya/ /gcig bzhin du ni gcig spyod pa//lhan cig spyod pa rjes spyad sdug /go rims ①so so'i khyad par dag /ma 'dres gsal bas don kun rdzogs/ /de yi dam tshig de 'byung ba/ /sdug pa'i dam tshig bdag rjes 'brang / /shin du sbyor dang sbyor chen po/ /thams cad bdag nyid dam tshig mchog /de dag tshul gyis las kun la/ /rnam par sbyor bas rdzogs par 'gyur/ /dngos grub mchog gi mchog sbyor ba/ /phyag rgya la gnas gsang bas ②'grub/ /rnal 'byor thams cad bde ba yi/ / dbang bskur bde chen las byung ba/ /rin chen tshogs rnams thams cad kyi/ /rab tu rmongs las dbang bskur 'gyur/ /lha mo kun gyi longs spyod la/ /ci bde bar ni bsten par bya/ /bdag nyid che ba'i lhar sbyor bas/ /bdag la bdag gis rab tu mchod/ /rnal 'byor thams cad bde ba yi/ /①rjes su sbyor bas mchod byed cing / /kun la myong rjobar byed pas na/ /shin tu sbyor bas rab 'grub 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag nyid kyi/ /ra sa ya na'i bde ba des—/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i butshe 'grub pa'i/ /lang tsho nad med bde mchog 'grub—/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku chen dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung snyan pa—/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs chen po/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi mchod pa che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal chen po/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi bdag /'jig rten rjodabang po kun gyi gtso/ /rin chen dbang phyug kun gyi bdag /de dag dang ni dga' spyad na/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro 'ong lding / /lha mo kun gyi grub chen 14—445

po—/ /'khor los sgyur ba ①rab tu grub/ /theg chen gsang ba gnyis med pa'i—/ /don mchog 'bras bu'i lam ston pa/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs mdzad de/ /rjes su 'jug pas spyad pa'i lam/ /'di dag don tshogs rgya chen las—/ /nye bar bstan pa'i cho ga rnams/ /bdag don sgrub pa'i thabs tsam zhig /legs bshad gsal bar byas pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gang bstan pa/ /de dag byang chub sems dpa'i yul/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /de gsal sgo rnams gzung bar 'os/ /thun mong dang mchog gi ②dngos grub bstan pa'i cho ga ste lnga pa'o// //dam pa'i bka' don rgya chen po/ /rnam kun sdud par su yis ①nus/ /de dag don ni 'dor byed pa/ /tshul ldan gsang ba'i man ngag mchog /legs bshad dri med dge ba bzang / /cho ga'i gnas kun rnam dugasal bas/ /'jig rten 'di dag kun sgol zhing / /thams cad mkhyen nyid rdzogs gyur cig /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rjes su bstan pa la 'jug pa'i cho ga lnga pa zhes bya ba/slob dpon chen po ku ku rā dzas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī badz+ra ha sa dang / sgra bsgyur kyi lo tsā rjob rma rin chen ⑦mchog gis bsgyur cing zhus te ⑦gtan la phab pa'o// //14—446

par sbyor ba'i dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga jes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sarba budha sa ma yo gī 2ni maṇ+ḍa la bi bye nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan mi mthun tshogs 'joms rgyal ba'i sku/ /ye shes dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa'i bdag /shes rab rnam 'phrul brgya dang nyi shu brgyad/ /rang 'od thabs tshogs 4sbyor de rnams phyag 'tshal5/ /rang rgyud pas 6bsgrubs drag po'i tshogs sogs 'joms/ /dbugs 'byung sna tshogs rang gi rigs las sprul//rten dang brten pa'i 'jig rten rnam 'phrul mdzad/ /khams gsum snang mdzad gtsor bcas 7phyag 'tshal te/ /dgongs mdzad gzhi lam 'bras bu gsang ba'i don/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog rgyud /dag las/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi gsang don rnam 7 74—451

bkod nas/ /tshogs bsags bsrung zhing byin rlabs gnas pa dang / /sgrub don slob ma 'a/sa su rung ba'i phyir/ /rgyud bzhis 1 yan lag phyogs mthun 'a/sa/ bsdus pa'i/ /rigs drug gzugs brnyan cho ga bshad par bya/ /bde chen sa/ngas rgyas kun gyi dngos// /rdo rje sems/ dpa' dpal gyi lha/ /rnam nga/ sna tshogs kun gye mchog /'khor lo thams cad rnam 'phrul lo/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes par ni/ /thams cad bdag nyid rjes su bsgrub/ /rten gnas phun sum tshogs/ ldan pas/ /sngon 'gro'i bsnyen pa rdzogs /byas te/ /sa/ gzhi sta sgon gnas pa dang / /gzugs brnyan dkyi'/ 'khor rtsom sgrub cing / /'jug nga/'i sbyin sreg gtor ma'i las/ /rab gnas dbang bsku/ra 'a/ sogs/ rnams / /bdag gzhan smin cing gro'/ ba'i phyir/ /dam nga/'i lung bzhin bsgrub nga/ra bya/ /gzhan don rtsom nga/'i blo ldan pa/ /rang bzhin ma/ngon nga/ra 'dus byas/ nga/'i/ /thun mong khyad par dbang thob nas/ /yon tan rtsa'/ ldan gang yang rung / /dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya sngags/ dgug mchod las spyor srung ba che/ /myur du gshegs su gsol ba yi/ /de nyid bcu sogs/ las/ la ma/khas// /khyad nga/ra las kyi rim pa yis/ /gsal mdzad rgya chen 'gro la dmigs/ /rgya mtsho ri rab nor bu dze+eng / /nam mkha' sa gzhi gser bzhin gnas/ /des/ shing 'jam la snyan par smra/ /dad brtson shes rab dang ldan nga/sa/ /thos bas/ma bsgom pa'i las la brtson / /sems can kun la byams sems can/ /snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms gnas/ /pha rol phyin pa drug ldan zhing / /dkyil 'khor rgyud dang bla ma dang / /zab mo'i chos la rtse gcig dga'/ /bstan bcos kun la 'jigs med cing / /brtan —po byang 7 (—7 32

——byedabyed byed———byedachub don gnyer bas/ /dang ba'i bla ma dri med la/ /lan gsum yon bcas gsol ba gdab/ /rigs kyi bu khyod 'byor ldan nam / /dgos pa'i rdzas rnams gang yod smos/ /ma tshogs pa rnams rnyed 'gyur na/ /phun sum tshogs dus gzung bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor kun du ma zhugs shing / /dam tshig rnams ni spangs pa dang / /gsang ba yang dag mi shes pas/ /sgrub pa ci yang mi 'grub ngo// /kun du sna tshogs ska'/ bzang por/ /bdag rang bsgrubs pas skal ba bzang / /bdag med chos nyid dang ldan nga/sa// /dam tshig la sdang skal ba ngan/ /srid pa shin tu bsgrubs nga/sa na/ /skal pa bzang sa/ngas/ rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /skal ngan nyan thos 'jig rten na/ /shin tu yo/ngas su mya ngan 'das/ /rtog pa thams cad bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /ska'/ bzang phyag na rdo rje dpal / /stong pa nyid la rab spyor bas// /rang rgyang/ rnams/ na ska 'a/ ba ngan/ /'dod chags thams/ cad rnam dag pas/ /ska'/ bzang spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / /log par lta dang ldan nga/sa/ na/ /skal ngan ru/ stegs 'jig rten rnams / /dam pa'i nor mchog sdud nga/'i phyir/ /be+el bzang rdo rje nyi ma dpal / /bdag gi bu la'ang ma chags pas/ /ska'/ ngan dka' thub spyod nga/ kun / /rgyal srid mchog rnams bsdus pas na/ /rta mchog dpal ni ska la ba bzang / /bdag med yongs su 'dzin med nga/sa/ /thub nga/ thams cad be+el ba ngan / /bde ba thams cad rab bsgrub phyir/ /kun gyi slob dpon be+el ba bzang / /lta ngan dam tshig la sdang ba'i/ /slob ma thams cad skal ba ngan/ /gsang ba'i don ni yang dag nyid/ /'di ni gsal bar shes pa yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bka' bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi grub par 'gyur/ /dben 7 1byed /53

pa yi ni 1gnas dag gam/ /rang gi skyed mos tshal sogs par/ /kun du sna tshogs skal bzang po/ /kun du sna tshogs bde mchog gis/ /kun du sna tshogs dgos pa rnams/ /ci bde bar ni bsgrub par bya/ /rten dang dgon pa gtsug lag khang / /ri yi rtse rnams thams cad du4/ /rnam pa du ma sna tshogs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa bsgrub par bya/ /dur khrod dang ni lha rten dang / /ma mo'i gnas la sogs 'dug na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dgos pa dag /rnam pa du ma sgrub 5par 'gyur/ /pad+mo skyed mos tshal dag dang 6/ /chu bo dag gi mdog 7dag tu/ /pad+mo 'dzin pa'i dgos pa rnam/sa/ /rnam pa du mas 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i pho brang dga' ba dang / /pad+mo skyed mos tshal nyid du/ /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma yi/ /rgyal po'i dgos pa bsgrub par bya/ /mkhar ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin chu bo'i 'gram nga/ga gam/ /rgyal khams gzhan las grub pa ru/ /rdo rje rta ni bsgrub par bya/ /cha lugs rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /sgrub pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go bgos la/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs rab tu bsgrub/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi pad+mo dmar/ /phyag na rdo rje sna tshogs pa/ /'jig rten dbang gi kha dog dkar//rdo rje nyi ma dpal gyi ser/ /kha dog kun dang ci 'byor pa/ /bla re rgyal mtshan rgyan kyi rnams/ /thams cad rab tu sgrub pa dpal/ /rta mchog rdo rje can gyi'o//gnas dang 'khor rnams ci 'dra dang / /bkod dang 'gro ba ci 'dra dang / /'khor rnams bkod pa ci 'dra ba/ /de yi 'khor lo mchog gis mdzad/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lha rnams kyi/ /'khor lo mngon sum mthong ba las bsod nams rtag pa ci 'dra ba/ /phyis byas pa yang de bzhin no/ /snying rje byang chub /4—454

sems ldan pas/ /khams gsum gnas sogs blta byas te/ /rgyu rkyen 'bras bu rnam dag pa'i/ /chos bdag med pa'i rnam par bsam/ /rigs kyi rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i/ /rnam gsum nus pa mthu bskyed de/ /phyag rgya mthu ldan dag pa'i phyir/ /g.yas pa'i nyi ma drug skyil 1du/ /hūṃ oṃ juḥs+thā 2t+t+waṃ haṃ las/ /rigs drug sangs rgyas bskyed par bya/ /g.yon pa'i zla dkyil drug dbus su/ /mi 'gyur a dkar gsal 'bar bas/ /rigs mthun lha mo drug bsam bya/ /'phro 'du mdzad bcas gnyis med 'gyur/ /sgra gnas chos kyi phyag rgya che—/ /thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan ma yis/ /gnas gsum byin 5brlabs rgyan dzibyas te/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sbyang ba yi/ /sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin la gnas bya/ /dbang po mdun du dgug byas nas/ /'phags dang sems can la dmigs te/ /bcu bzhi'i bya ba rgya chen tshogs/ /yongs su dag pa'i gsum gnas gzhag /srung ba'i 'khor los mtshams bcad nas/ /bzhi yi ting 'dzin rten dang bcas/ /spyor ba bzhi la legs gnas shing / /dmigs pa gsum gyi bya ba spyad / /gtso bo gang gi dkyil 'khor rtsom/ /de nyid bzlas brjod 'bum yin te/ /'khor gyi lha mo'i tshogs rnams la/ /re re la yang khri 'am stong / /gzhan yang bsnyen pa rnam lnga ste/ /grangs dus mtshan ma mthong ba dang / /gnang ba thob dang 'gog pa yi/ /'khor lo goms pa las byung bas/ /rang sems dag pas gtor ma brtsom⑩/ /thun bzhi'i spyor bas 'jug byas te/ /cho ga yan lag sngon 'go rnams/ /sdogs pas dkyil 'khor las dag brtsam/ /so so'i rigs kyi sbyor ldan pas/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don ched du/ /tshogs rdzogs bar chad bsal ba dang / /74byed455

lha mnyes las kun grub bya'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor sa gzhi brtag par bya/ /des ni bkra shis phun sum tshogs/ /so so'i rang gnas nyams dga' ba/ /nags tshal me tog lcug ma'i ri/ / chu rgyun g.yas su 'khyil pa'i ljongs1/ /rin chen 'byung gnas rgya mtsho'i ngogs/ /me tog 'bras bzang nyams dga' ba'i / /de bzhin dgon pa'i gnas mchog ni/ /sa gzhi chags med dbus mtho zhing / /phyag rgya chen bo'i rig 'dzin rtags/ /shar dang byang gzhol dngos/ grub gnas/ /lho nub gzhol ba'i 'jig rten pa/ /nub byang mtho bas/ 'a/sa/ phra mo/ /shar mtho dbus dma' 'grub mi 'gyur/ /nam mkha' 'khor lo rtse brgyad pa/ /sgrub gnas las mthun so so/'i dbyibs5/ /pus nub tsam du bsko byas te/ /slar la sa des dgang nga/'am/ /chu rgyun gang ba dri ldan 'a// /mnyam gzhag rdo rje dril 'dzin shar/ /gom pa brgya yi gnas nas lo/ga /sngags bcas/ mtshan ma brtag cing sbyang / /gzhan yang rnam shes phyag rgya dang / /ye shes phyag rgyas brtag par bya/ /rgyal po'am yul gyi bdag po la/ /slong ngam/ rin gyis nyo bar bya/ /bar chad med pa'i sa dbus su/ /rang rig lha yi spyor ldan nga/sa// /rgyan bcas so so'i skyil krung gis/ /'gying zhing nga rgyal gnas byas nas/ /sa yi lha tshogs srung ma la/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma dbul bar bya/ /khyad par las kyi bdag po dang / /snying rje lan chags gyur pa dag /ma/ lus dgug cing tshim byas nas/ /bsgo zhing 'tshe ba rin gyis brdzangs / /dri yi chu yis legs gtor zhing / /sbyor ba bzhi la legs gnas pas/ /bdud rtsis rdzas kyis sbyang bya zhing / /yi ge gsum gyis dag par bya/ /lho 'phye'i rim pa shes byas la/ /dngos grub rab 'bring gsum don 7 1—/56

byed—snye— —byed sde———du / /mgrin lto pus mo man chad de/ /gnas gzhan spang par bya ba yin/ /rus pa gseg ma gyo mo dang / /so' ba pha rgan sa ro bsal/ /sa gnyen 'jam zhing snum sres te/ /dri yi chus gdab dgad zhing bcag /dkyil 'khor gnas kyi tshad mnyam bya/ /sor bzhi khru gang lus phyed tshad/ /bskos pa'i tshad mnyam 'phang du bstod/ /rin chen dri sbyor snying por gzhug /chos/ nyid dag pa'i sngags brjod pa'i/ /dri yi chu yis legs byugs/ nga/ra/ sna tshogs mchod gtor nyer sbyar nas/ /rna'/ 'byor grogs bzhi dang bcas nga/sa/ /rang rig gtso 'khor lnga bsgoms te/ /sa/ gzhi byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ/ ṣ+ṭṛ ga ga na khaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nam mkha' dag pa'i rang bzhin las// /'byung ba rim brtsegs 4ri rab ste/ /rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba dang / /bla re gur bcas 'od 'phro ba'o/ /rdo rje gtams pa dgye byas te/ /rang gi gnas/ su/ gzhag nga/ra bya / /oṃ me di ni badz+ra bha ba badz+ra ban+dha hūṃ/ tha'/ mo sa la lan gsum du/ /lha mo rgyan rnams kun gyis mdzes/ /mdog ser bum nga/'i mtshan ma can/ /lus phyed sa la bton byas te/ /mdun na bka' nyan tshul gnas la/ /mchod gtor zhabs bsil sogs/ dbu'/ zhing / /ji srid 'a/sa/ rdzogs rnams/ kyi bar/ /de srid dpang por gsol ba gdab/ /skyob spyo pa sa/ngas rgyas thams cad kyi/ / spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad nga/ra gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa 'a// /lha mo khyod ni dpang du shog /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag kyang bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /lan gsum gsol ba btab byas nas/ /lha mo dgyes 'apas mdangs phyung ste/ /slob dpon chen po'i dkyil 'khor mdzod/ /dga' ba chen pos las bsgrubs 7‘4—457

shing / /bcu gnyis rgyan gyis 1mdzes byas pa'i/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin dpa' bo yis / /dkyil 'khor bdag por gnas pa la/ /phyogs bzhi'i lha mo bstod cing bsgul/ /oṃ byams chen nam mkha'i rigs sbyor ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal 'jigs 2pa'i gnas/ /rnam 'byed gsal ba'i chos mchog can/ /yang dag ye shes spyod pas grol/ /a la la la la ho/ oṃ thugs rje'i gnas mchog dag pa'i dngos/ /mnyam nyid chos kun 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /yon tan rin chen mchog ston pa'i/ /rnam 'phrul chos las rab tu grol/ /a la la la la ho/oṃ dga' ba'i pad+mos mtshan ldan pa/ /kun rtog dngos gsal chags pa med/ /rdo rje gsang gsum sngags 'don pa'i/ /brjod 'byung tshig las 'das pa'o/ /a la la la la ho/ oṃ btang snyoms gnas ngan dra ba sel/ /phrin las bdag po stobs 5dang ldan/ /bya ba'i ye shes mthar mdzad cing / /'phrul pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol/ /a la la la la ho/ oṃ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gtso/ /sdig pa thams cad las gol zhing / /bsod nams dngos grub 'grub pa yi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /mthong dga' mthong ba grol byed pa/ /lam mchog gsang ba chen po'i tshogs/ /bdag nyid chen pos bstan du gsol/ /a la la la la ho/ dkyil 'khor gang yang rung ba'i bdag /sna tshogs rta mchog rol pa'i sgu/ /'jigs pa'i cha lugs mtshon cha 'bar/ /ma las 6kun la bka' bsgo zhing / /mig gi rdzi ma 'den pa yis/ /'bar ba'i lta bas gar byas nas/ /rab tu myur bar g.yo mdzad cing / /dgug gzhug spros pas rol pa'i tshogs/ /ma ta a yi 'phro 'du yis9/ /rdo rje me 'od rlung 74—458

sogs kyis/ /bshigs 1gtor ra ba sa gzhir bcas/ /bskor zhing bskor ba'i rnam par gnas/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dril 'khrol zhing / /sum+bha ni yi sngags brjod de/ /khro tshogs rang gi gzugs 'dzin cing / /mtshon cha 'bar ba rnams spros pa'o/ /hūṃ lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po dang / /dri za srin po sha za'i tshogs / /gshin rje ma mo mkha' 'go'i tshogs/ /gnod sbyin drag po ma lus rnams / /gang dag sa gzhi 'dir gnas pa/ /srung byed pa nayi bdag po'i bka' / /thos pa tsam gyis mar du dengs/ /nga yi bka' la 'da' ma byed/ /gang zhig gnas pa'i mthu bo che/ /rdo rje dril bu 4kha ṭ+wāṃ gas/ /thal ba'i tshogs bzhin bshigs ltapar byed/ /rab 'bar khro bo'i gnas 'joms pa'i/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs 'di yis/ /gang dang gang gis bdag tshig bcag /'dod gsum skyes rnams dgas byas te/ /'jig par 'gyur phyir gzhan 'dis med—/ /sa la yongs su bskor 6byas te/ /bgegs med bya phyir phur pas gdab / /oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa/ tī la ya kri la ya/sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya/ badz+ra dha ro ādz+nyā pa ya ti/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gsum brjod dbang ldan mtshams dag nas/ /thugs non sngags bcas lan gsum bskor/ /rkang pa bskyod nas lag pa baspyod//cung zad ngo mtshar zur mig tshul/ /rab dga' 'brang bas smin ma 'degs/ /g.yas 'dren g.yon 'dren mig gi gar7/ /brla rgyas nu ma 'gying ba dang / /kha yi pad+ma 'dzum bcas pa/ /dkar dmar mche ba gnyer ba dang / /so yi phreng zlum ljags bsgyur zhing / /rta mchog rol pa'i gar thabs kyis/ /khams gsum 'dul ba rmad du byung / /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /gar 14byed/59

sogs rnam 'phrul bsam yas kyis/ /drag po'i tshogs 'joms gnas sbyor zhing //rang gi las gnas bsrung bar bya/ /ba yi rnam lnga dri bsres pa'i/ /bdud rtsi rdzas sogs kyis byugs nas1/ /lha gnas dri yi thig le la/ /me tog sngags dang bcas pa dgram / /mchod pa'i rnam grangs legs bkod nas/ /srung —ba'i 'khor lo bsam par bya/ /gzhi zherten sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung bsgom/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor la dmigs shing / /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor mnyes pa bya/ /so so'i bstod pa sgra snyan tshul/ /rigs drug dkyil 'khor so so'i dbyangs/ /pus mo sa la btsugs 7byas nas/ /g.yas pas spos snod bteg byas te/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i lha rnams la/ /tshig 'dis gsol ba gdab par bya/ /thugs rje chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /ma lus sems can don mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras dang bcas/ /stobs mchog rgya chen rnams la bstod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i//rigs bdag che ge'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon gyur las rnams 'grub pa'i phyir//rdo rje gsang ba bdag gis bris/ /brtse bas slob ma rnam phyir dang / /bdag nyid rnams la mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan khyod la bdag gus te/ /dgyes mdzad 'ongs par gyur pa las/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bya ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i phyir/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems sogs 9dang / /gsang sngags gsang ba'i lha nyid dang / /'byung sogs rka'ajig rten skyong ba dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi skyerjes dga' ba/ /bstan la gnas pa'i 'gro ba dag1 / gang dag rdo rje'i spyan ldan pa/ /che ge mo yi dkyil 'khor gtso/ /don grub gsang ba bdag gis brtsam/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /14—460

gnang bar mdzad pa'i 'os lags so/ /lan gsum gsol ba gdab byas nas/ /dri zhim me tog phreng ba dang / /1legs sbyar mchod pas mnyes pa dag /dbang por brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /bu khyod tshul ldan snod yin pas/ /theg chen gsang ba'i gzhung 'di nyon/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /sdogs sangs rgyas rdzogs 'das rnams dang //de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'go la phan phyir gnas bzhugs pa/ /de kun gsang sngags zab mo yi cho ga bzang po'i 'di rtogs nas/ /skye mchog rang gi gnas nyid du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med pas4/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med pa/ /bcom ldan che ge'i dkyil 'khor kyis/ /bdud tshogs shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen mtha' dag rnam bcom pas/ /de phyir kun mkhyen ye shes phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu skyabs su 'gro bar gyis/ /rnal 'byor mkha' 'go gsang sngags can/ / rigs kyi dkyil 'khor so so yi/ /5'khor lor 6bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid rnams / /kun la skyabs su 'gro bar gyis/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo 'khor bcas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ / khyod kyis skyabs su 7'gro bar gyis/ /ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung 3ste/ /ji srid snying po byang chub par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med par—/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /slob ma sbyor dang dngos gzhi 9 yis / /dbang po yan lag rnam bkod de/ /bsod nams tshogs mchog rgya 14byed461

chen po/ /yan lag bcu bzhis dag par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum po gzung 1bar bya/ /bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bgyid la rjes su yi rang ba/ /mgon po'i spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas tshogs rnams dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /bsgom bzlas la sogs bsod nams la/ /dang bas rab tu yi rang ngo / /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bgyid cing / /tshogs spyod byang chub sems dpa' la/ /bdag ni gus par skyabs su 'chi —/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ji lta bar/ /skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /thugs mchog byang chub rgya chen po/ /'gro ba rgya chen don la dmigs/ /mgon rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ma lus phyogs bzhugs dkyil 'khor rnams/ /dus 'di nyid nas sangs rgyas par/ /bla med rgya che dang bas gzigs/ /ji ltar dus gsum bde gshegs rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan par gzung bar bkyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /ding 3nas brtsams te bzung bye nas ni/ /nam du yang ni mi spang ngo / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu kyephyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung — bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung / bar bya/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong 74—7162

ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu1/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ / byang chub chen po las byung bas/ / pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bya/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i la/sa kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /bdag gis 5sdom pa ma lus gzung 6/ /ma gol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi/ /ma brgal ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /thams cad mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas myur grub nas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba rnams/ /bla med byang chub dgod par bgyi/ /gnas gsum mtshan ma'i yi ger bcas/ /rdo rje sngags bcas dri yis 7byugs/ /mgo bor me tog mdun du spos/ /mar me dris byug snying ga ru/ /u dus+thā ra la sogs shing / /drang po gas med 'bu rjes bral/ /sor tshad bcu gnyis dri yis byugs / /rtse mo me tog bcas pa la/ /rigs 7sngags mang du bzlas byas te/ /bden 7pa bdar nas byin pa dang / /me tog la sogs byin byas la/ /bya ba'i bye brag rim bzhin bstan/ /shar phyogs kha bltas mi smra bar/ /bca' zhing so rtsi'i skyon bsal nas/ /lci bas sa gzhi ba ko 7tsam/ /rnam lngas maṇ+ḍal byas pa ru/ /phan tshun dag tu mi blta 1 zhing / /drang po'i mdun du tshems shing dor/ /de tshe mtshan ma'i bye brag ni/ /rtse mo bdag la bstan pa dang / /rtse mo gyen du phyogs gyur na/ /mchog gi dngos grub mtshan ma yin/ /gzhan du kha bstan dngos grub 'bring / /mtshams dang byang du bltas pa na / /14—163

'jig rten pa yi las 'grub 'gyur/ /rtse mo thur du bstan pas ni/ /sa 'og dngos grub nges par 'gyur/ /phyogs bzhi'i rtse mo bye brag gis/ /las bzhi'i mtshan ma shes par bya/ /dri chab byin brlabs sngags ldan pa'i/ /'thor 'thung bakhyor gsum kha bshal bya/ /oṃ hri bi shudha sarba dharmā pā pa ni tsā byu bi shwa 2dha ya/ sarba pi kal pa a pa nā ya hūṃ/ yi ge sngags kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /ku sha sngas dang stan du sbyin/ /hūṃ āḥ.oṃ a hi a/ hriḥ.a t+t+waṃ4/ a haṃ a/sarba ruta te ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rang sngags yi ge gsum bzlas pa'i/ /srung sgud mdud pa gsum ldan pa/ /sku 5sha gsum 'gyur sbom phra'i tshad/ /dpung par bsrung ba'i don phyir bcing / /kun mkhyen 'jig rten khams 'byung ba/ /u duwā 6ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can dpag med don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed nus pa'o/ /bskal pa bye ba grangs med du/ /gang gis sdig pa spyong byas pa'ang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong bas ni/ /de dag thams cad zad par 'gyur/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /mnyam par gyur pa gzhan gang yod/ /tshe 'di nyid la sngags bzlas pas/ /bla med gnas su 'gro 'gyur 8te/ /sbug bsngal kun 'byung nyam / thag pa'i/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas ngan sdong 7bar 'gyur/ /des na spyod mchog las 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu brtan pas na/ /de ring khyod ni rnyed pa mchog /bdag nyid chen po thob par 'gyur / /gang gi rgyal ba thams cad ni/ /sras bcas rnams kyis bstan pa ni / /blo mchog ldan pas yo ngas bzung ste/ /gnas ni bdag nyid chen po la///(byed46

theg don gsang ba'i gnas dag tu/ / de ring ①'gro bar 'gyur ba yin/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /theg chen gsang ba cher 'byung ba②/ /byed ni 'gro bar gyur pas ④na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sta gon gnas mchog de nyid du/ /mchog dudabul gtor ma btang byas te/ /ku sha'i sngas stan legs pa la/ /mi smra dge ba'i sems bcas gyis⑤/ /seng ge'i nyal stabs legs pa yisarjo/ /rmi lam mtshan ma brtag par bya/ /slob dpon nang du bzhugs mnyam gzhag⑦ /dkyil 'khor mchod cing bstod par bya// de ltar skematshan ma bzang mthong na/ yi rang dngos grub rab 'bring bstan/ /ngan pa'i ltas dag sbyin sreg dang / /gtor ma sngags dang phyag rgyas bzlog /ba yi rnam lnga dri bsres chu/ /sngags kyis sbyangs pas dag par bya/ /mkha' dbyings dbang phyug phyag rgya yis/ /gnas kun byin kyis brlab ⑨par bya/ /oṃ dharmā sgyu tu badz+ra ⑩swa bhā wa /khya kolhahaṃ⑪/ gser dngul zangs lcags la sogs pa'i—/ /rin chen rgyan las byung ba'am/ /'byor med sa las byas pa ru/ /bum pa mgrin ring lto ba zlum/ /nag po dri bral kha gyed can/ /dri zhim tshon dkar gyis byugs shing / /pad+ma'i lte ⑫bas mtshan pas rgyan⑫/ grangs ④ bzhin tshogs pas legs gnas la/ /rigs kyi cho gas byen brlab cing / /cha rigs ⑫nyi shu rtsa bdun bsag /bum pa lha yi gnas yin te/ /kha rgyan ⑩ mgul chings rta babs brgyan/ /gzungs thag thugs rje chen po'i rtags/ /sman lnga thugs rje byang chub sems/ /'bru rnams lha yi rang bzhin yin/ /rin chen rnam lnga sku yi 'od/ /snying po ye shes thugs kyi dbyings/ /spos sogs byed khrims yon tan rgyal/ /rang gi gnas su dgram byas nas/ /rigs kyi 14byed465

dkyil 'khor dgug ①gzhug rnams/ /dam tshig lha dang gnyis med par/ /mchod bstod bzlas pas mnyes byas te/ /brgya stong brgya lhag grangs tshad nas/ /sngags kyi chu dang gnyis med gyur/ /ras gtsang me tog bcal ②bkram zhing / /shing bzang ④lo ma 'bras bur bcas/ /rdo rje gzungs skud phreng bas mtshan/ /bgegs bskrad bdug mchog bsrung bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pa'i rjes thogs la/ /rten rnams lha yi rim pas dgram/ /bskrad bsrung sbyang zhing tshe bzung brjo/ /byang nas g.yon skor sgo bzhir gzhag⑤ /mchod dang khrus kyi las dag kun/ /phyi mtshams khyams kyi gnas dag tu/ /las kun pa ni kun ldan pa/ /rnam rgyal rang gi gnas mchog mdzes/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid kun ldan zhing / / yang dag ye shes de nyid shes/ /rjorang gi lha yi sbyor ldan pas—/ /shes rab mtshan ldan bcu gnyis brgyan/ /thig skud sar pa tshad ldan pas/ /sngags bcas lha mos bkal ⑦byas pa'i/ /ring thung dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur la/ /sbom phra sgo yi nyi shu cha/ /rin chen thod pa'i snod gzhag ⑧la/ /rigs kyi yi ge'i sngags kyis bskyed/ /sru tra mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ oṃ yasahūṃ/ mig gi blta bas bkug byas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rigs rnams gzhug ⑨par bya/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i lcags kyu yis/ /gnyis med gcig tu gnas pa dag /mchod dbul ⑩bstod pas mnyes byas nas/ /gtso ba'i sngags brjod bsgril bar bya/ /oṃ dip+ta ⑪driji saṃ ku sha dzaḥ.oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ⑫sru tra mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ oṃ ā ཿhūṃ—/ sgrub pa'i grogs mchog nus gnas pas/ /de nyid gsum gyis gsang sngags bzla/ /dzaḥgadags gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ /rang gi smin mtshams drang por 'dren/ /stobs mchog dpa' bo dgongs su gsol/ /rdo 14—466

rje thig gi sgra ldan pas/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor legs grub cing / /'gro ba'i don la bskul bar mdzad/ /oṃ a byo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmā/ sga ra sga ①ra a nu ga ta sarba dharmā/ a t+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭha ④sarba dharmā hūṃ/ grogs mchog rdo rje phyag rgya yis/ /dza gsum lte ba'i gnas su 'dren/ /rdo rje khu tshur sar gzhag dze+ecing / /dang po'i thig skud gdab par bya/ /shar nub lho byang thig bzhi yis/ /logs dang mtshalas su gdab par bya/ /dang po cha chen bcu drug las / /khyams kyi snam bu ma gtogs pa/ /cha bran bzhi bubazhir dgod byas la⑤//phyi nas bcu drug rta babs sgorjo/ /rtsig pa rgyan ⑦bcas g.yon pa nas/ /ra ba dur khrod ci rigs brtag /dbu ma rang gi rigs 'khor lo/ /dkyil 'khor so so'i cha bzhin bgo⑧/ /thig gdab cho ga rdzogs byas nas/ /ye shes skud pa mchod bstod cing / /phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin gsang sngags kyis/ /rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ /rigs kyi nga rgyal sbyor ldan pas/ /mig gnyis nyi zla'i lta ⑨ba yis/ /s+thā ⑩bcas sgo dang cha rnams dbye/ /oṃ badz+ra be+e ga a kra ma hūṃ/ oṃ thams cad rnam 'phrul rang bzhin mchog /dngos med zhi ba'i 'od ldan gsal/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gter chen 'byin/ /dkyil 'khor dag par byin gyis brlabs⑪/ /mnyam pa'i sngags blo rnams gsal bas/ /nyes pa'i zug rngu dag par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor thig gdab shes rab can/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid 'grub cing / /shar nub byang gi phyogs rnams su/ /thig bzhi btab pas dkyil 'khor brgyad/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag ji lta bar/ /rab tu brtag par ⑫su zhig nus/ /rang gi lha yi rang bzhin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor brtag par 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid rang gi lhar sbyor bas/ /14—467

dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /cho ga lhag gam ma tshang ①na'ang / /nyes pa med de 'grub par 'gyur/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /tshad ldan rnam par phyed pa la/ /rnam 'khor phreng ba'i ra bas mdzes/ /rta babs brgyad kyis rnam spras shing / /bar khyams cha chen gcig gi tshad/ /ka ba mchog brgyad gdung rnams la/ /so so'i mtshan ma'i phreng bas brgyan/ /rin chen rdor sogs tog ger bcas/ /kun du sna tshogs skal bzang po②/ /kun du sna tshogs 'khor lo can/ kun du sna tshogs grub pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor kun du sna tshogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor rlum po sangs rgyas kyi/ /rdo rje can gyi zla gam ①bzhin/ /pad+ma dbang gi pad+mo'i dbyebs/ /rin chen mchog gi rin chen dbyibs—/ /ji ltar 'dod pa ci 'byor pa/ /ji lta'i dus dang ci bde bar/ /dkyil 'khor kun du gnas pa dpal/ /rta mchog phyag rgya rdo rje'o/ /rin chen lnga sogs phye ma rnams/ /snod mdzes legs par blugs byas te/ /cho ga gsum rmis rigs kyi lha/ /spyan mig 'bar bas dgug byas te/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis med gzhugadu /mchod bstod rang gi gnas nas dbye/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ dkar po mthing ga dmar ser ljang / /rigs drug so so'i dbye ba yis/ /pañtsa rang gi go rims bzhin/ /byang shar mtshalas nas brtsams nas ni/ /hūṃ brjod rdor 'dzin g.yon gyis bris/ /re khā ma yo ma 'dres par/ /mchod dbul thod pas bkab nas ni/ /bden pa brjod cing blta bar bya/ /'di ni chos dbyings rnam par dag /sems can khams na ⑤rab sgrol byed/ /dpal ldan rgyal po che ge mo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnasaske/ /yang dag bden pa'i byen rlabs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor las rnams 14—468

shis par mdzod/ /thig ni phyi nas btab pa la/ /tshon rtsi nang nas dgye bar ①bya| /dang po slob dpon kyis bri zhing / /phyi nas ci bder ②shes pas bri/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol bas/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsam/ /rtse gcig las su rung byas te/ /mtho zhing drang ba'i rgyan bcas pa'o/ /re khā ①dma' bas mi 'grub cing / /yon pos gdung ba skyed par byed/ /chad pas slob dpon slob ma dag /'chi 'am na bar 'gyur ba yin/ /lhag chad las ni nad 'byung zhing / /phyogs 'khrul rmongs pa'i las su 'gyur/ /pad+ma rjoso so'i gdan dag la/ /rigs kyi mtshan mas brgyan pa dang / /kun du sna tshogs skal ⑤bzang po/ /rang 'byung rnams kyi mtshan ma'i rgya/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i/ /lha mo rnams kyi bde ba'i mchog /gzhu dang mda' dang de bzhin te/ /skal bzang de bzhin skal ba bzang / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rdo rje rgya gram de bzhin no/ /pad+ma rgya gram dpag med che'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi tshe sgrub pa/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya'i tshogs bsgrubs nas/ /mda' dang de bzhin tshangs pa'i mgo/ /de bzhin 'khor lo'i rjophyag rgya dang / /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya'i mchog /dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma dang / /pad+mo rta mgrin 'phang mtho ba/ /rta mgrin ljang gu de bzhin no/ /phag gi mche ba grub pa dang / /zla ba nyi ma de bzhin te/ /rin chen sna tshogs snod chen du/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ra sa yin/ /thams cad bdag nyid myong skal bzang / /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya'i tshogs gzhan no/ /gling bu dang ni pi wang dang / /ku mu ta dang muñtsa ra/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dang / /sna tshogs dri rnams de bzhin no/ /rim bzhin snying po sngags bcas 14—469

pas—/ /rang rang mtshan ma sngags bcas dgod/ mtshalas bzhir bum pa gang ba bzhi/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi thod par bcas/ /rgyan bcas mchod pa ma lus pa/ /phyogs mtshams steng 'og gnas su dgod/ /chos gos dang ni lhung bzed dang / /de bzhin du ni 'khar gsil ①dang / /dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam dag /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya'i tshogs bzhin ②no/ /de bzhin lce yi phyag rgya dang / /cha lang dang ni rnga yab dang / /rdo rje dang ni rin chen sgon/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya'i tshogs gzhan no/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan dang / /me long dang ni rlung yab dang / /rdo rje ser po sprin dang bcas/ /de bzhin mig gi phyag rgya'o/ /lha mo rdo rje glang sogs kyang / /'khor lo'i mtshan mas bsgyur te dgod/ /rdo rje 'bar ba kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /thod pa kham phor de bzhin no/ /dmar chen po dang snying chen po/ /sha chen po yang de bzhin no/ /rnon po mda' dang de bzhin 'dren/ /chang dang chu yang de bzhin te/ /lcug ma rlung gis bskyod pa dang / /rang ④dang de bzhin me dag dang / /rdo rje 'bar ba kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bur bcas/ /'khor lo rtse brgyad rnon po ④dang / /sna tshogs ba dan dril bur bcas/ /me tog ma ⑤sogs lha mo brgyad—/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /pad+ma sna tshogs dmar po dang / / ljang gu de bzhin dkar po dang / /rjomathing kha ser po le brgan dag /pad+ma'i mtshan mchog rnam pa bdun/ /pad+ma'i snying po bud med brgya/ /de bzhin chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /bsad cing dpal ⑦bskyed rdo rje dag /pad+ma'i mtshan ma'i tshogs gzhan no/ /pad+mo dmar po tri shu la/ /pad+ma sna tshogs 'khor lo che/ /pad+ma ser po chu srin rgyal/ /pad+ma le brgan rdor rtse lnga/ /gling 14—470

bu la sogs pad+mas mtshan/ /bcu gnyis la sogs dgod par bya/ /gzhu dang mda' dang ral gri dang / /de bzhin du ni 'bar ba'i me/ /dbang bskur gter dang rgyal mtshan dag /mchod pa'i mtshan mas bsdu ba dang / /mda' dang gzhu dang ral gri dang / /rdo rje nyi ma'i ①'od zer bcas/ /rin chen gling bu la sogs rnams/ /so so'i gnas su dgod par bya/ /sna tshogs rgya gram la sogs brgyad/ /de bzhin sna tshogs pad+ma dang / /rdo rje rgya gram de bzhin te/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya grub pa gnyis/ /dkyil 'khor gang gi gnas zhugs pa/ /lha mo'i mtshan ma rab bstan te/ /khyad par las kyi mtshan ma dang / /yi ge'i rigs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /kha dog rigs kyis rnam 'byed cing // mtshan ma'i phreng bas mdzes byas pa/ /bar khyams sa gzhi dkar po la/ /dbus ni kha dog lnga ldan pa'o/ /shar sgo kar ti 'od gsal zhing / /gser mdog lho yi sgo phyogs brjid/ /nub sgo pu sha rā ga'i mdog /byang sgo in dra nī la'o/ /rta babs rgyan bcas mtshan ma'i tshogs/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i mtshan dang ldan—/ /pad+ma rdo rje me 'od kyi/ /kha dog rang bzhin rnam par gnas/ /dur khrod phyogs mdog khyad par dang / /thun mong dbye bas rnam bstan pa'o/ /'dod 'byung bdud rtsi'i mdog can la/ /phyi yi ra ba bai ḍūr+ya/ /de ni sna tshogs bum pa dang / /mchod pa'i tshogs mang rab dgod cing / /rgyan sogs phreng bas mdzes byas la②/ /sna tshogs me tog sngags bcas dgram/ /me tog dkar dang dmar ba dang / /mthing ga ser po kun bsdus pa/ /me tog phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la spro/ /rgya skyegs mthing ga ljang gu'i tshogs/ /tshon sna lnga yis btsos ①pa dang / /dkar po lnga yi phyag rgya dang //14—471

snga ma bzhin du mnyam par 'grub/ /khams las byung ba thams cad dang / /srog dang rtsa ba de bzhin te/ /rnam par mdzes shing dri zhim pa/ /snga ma bzhin du mnyam par 'grub/ /tsan+dan gnyis dang gla rtsi dang / /ga pur na ga la la ti/ /bdug ①pa bu ram dang sbyar ba/ /las rnams thams cad las 'grub pa'o/ /gar dang tri dang gu gul dang / /sardza ga pur gla rtsi dgaske /rdzas 'di dag las btsos pa'i mar/ /mar me byas na snang ba bskyed④/ tsan+dan gur kum dupri ka dang / /ga pur dang ni gla rtsi dag /btsos pa'i bdug pa bsgrub pa ste/ /spos kyi phyag rgya spos mchog 'gyur/ /ka ko la dang sug smel dang / / gla sgang ga pur gla rtsi dang / /khru'adi rnams zhib tu btags pa ni/ /seng ldeng bu ram dag dang sbyor/ /shing tsa pa ṭa lo ma dang / /na le sham dang ga pur sbyar/ /ha sa ka ri'i shing mngar rjogyis/ /sbrus pa kha yi spos yin no/ /me tog dmar ⑦po sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la sna tshogs pa/ /'jig rten dbang la kha dog dkar—/ /ser po mkha' las byung ba la/ /tsan+dan bdug pa sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la du ru ka /spyan ras gzigs la ka pi ta/ /lce pog rdo rje nyi ma la//mar me skephreng ba sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la mar me bdun/ /spyan ras gzigs la mar me brgyad/ /stong ni rdo rje nyi ma la/ /sangs rgyas rnams la tsan+dan spos/ /rdo rje can la gur kum ⑨yin/ /spyan ras gzigs la tsan+dan dmar—/ /ga pur rdo rje nyi ma la/ /me tog phreng dang bdug pa kun/ /de bzhin mar me thams cad dang / /spos ⑩rnams thams cad ji snyed pa/ /rdo rje can la dbul du rung / /srung ⑩ba'i 'khor lo'i cho ga yis/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas bcas bsrung byas nas/ /sta gon nam mkhar ⑫bteg pa rnams/ /rang 14—472

gi gnas su ma nor dgod/ /gzhi rten sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang / /ye shes dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ / mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'i/ /①dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i las rdzogs na④/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor gsal ne+eb gdab/ /rgyan bcas rdo rje dril thogs pas—/ /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags bcas kyis/ /bskang rjozhing stang stabs sbyor ldan pas/ /dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor zhing bstod/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub pa shis byas shing / /las 'grub bar chad bsal ④ba'i phyir/ /gtor ma'i cho ga rgya chen pos/ /'jig rten pa yi mchod sbyin bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs bzhi ru/ /so so'i maṇ+ḍal legs dgod de/ /shar du chu dkyil dkar po'i tshul/ /lte rjob gru gsum zla gam gsum/ /gru bzhi bar khyams sgo dang bcas—/ /rin chen phreng ba'i rgyan tshogs mdzes/ /gtso bo'i mdun du lha chen po/ ko dze+elas byung ba drag po yi/ /mig gsum tri shul dgra sta dang / /ral gri thod pa sha khrag bcas/ /sngo skya thod pa zhags pas dkris/ /nyi zla rin chen phreng bas mdzes/ /dbu ma ljang skya thod pa thogs/ /na ra'i rgyan bcas rnam 'khril ⑧gnas/ /g.yas su tshangs pa oṃ las byung / /gser mdog gdong bzhi phreng bas mdzes/ /khams gsum skyob tshul rnam 'grub ma/ /mdzes ma kun gzugs rin chen 'dzin/ /dbang po mig stong a las byung / /rdo rje rtse gsum zla 'dra'i mdangs/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod kun la rol/ /sha tsi dkar mo rin chen dang / /g.yon du ha las khyab 'jug ste/ /nag po drag chen khros pa'i gzugs/ /'khor lo rtse gsum mda' dang gzhu/ /gzugs chen chen mo pad+ma'i mdog /'dod dbang dam pa las byung ba'i/ /ser skya sna 14—473

tshogs rgyan gos can/ /snang ba'i mda' 'dzin mos pa'i dpung / /drag mo gnas rgyal rin chen skyes/ /kun kyang rang rigs g.yog ①'khor dang / /stan dang longs spyod tshogs bcas pa'o/ /dbang po dkar skya rtse gsum 'dzin/ /gshin rje sngo nag thod dbyug ②gdengs/ /chu lha dmar ser zhags pa thogs/ /gnod sbyin ljang gu in+d+ra nirag/ /dbang ldan ser skya rin chen mdzod/ /me lha dmar ser bgrang phreng bum/ /rlung lha dud kha ba dan phreng / /bden bral ljang sngon rin chen dbyig /rgyan bcas bzhon pa chung ma'i tshogs/ /las mdzad g.yog 'khor bran dang bcas/ /sgo bzhi nyi ma zla ba'i lha/ /sa bdag sa yi lha mo gnas/ /rang mdog mtshan ma rgyan dang bcasarjo/ /g.yog 'khor bzhon pa'i gnas la 'khod/ /lho phyogs dkyil 'khor zur gsum gnag /gru gsum zla gam khyams dang snod/ /mdun du las dag mkha' 'gro ma/ /g.yas su rdo rje rin chen ma/ /g.yon du pad+ma sna tshogs ma'i/ /mkha' 'gro lnga rnams 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams kyi khyams dag la/ /dur khrod mkha' 'gro chen mo brgyad/ /sgo bzhi'i gnas srung ⑤drag mo'i tshogs/ /ru lu ru lu'i sgra 'don ma/ /kun kyang bh+yo las rnam 'phrul zhing / /mdog nag gri gug thod pa thogs/ /mi yi thod phreng legs pas mtshan/ /dam tshig mtshan ma g.yog 'khor bcas/ /nub kyi pad+ma dmar po la/ /klu brgyad yi ge phu las byung / /sna tshogs sbrul mgo gdengs ka can/ /phyogs mdog rin chen snye ma dang / /bcas pa'i thal mos phyogs su gus/ /nor bu'i rgyan phreng chung ma dang / /longs spyod g.yog 'khor bcas pa yis/ /rang gi las bzhin rnam par spyod/ /byang du ma ḍal 'byung chen dbyibs/ /ser po bar khyams drug pa 14—474

la—/ /a dri su tri pre du las/ /'gro ba drug po ma lus pa/ /sgor ①bzhir 'byung po ma lus rnams/ /gzugs gzhag ①rid pa mi sdug dgod/ /rang rig sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /sbyang zhing byin brlabs sku rdzogs par/ /byas nas rang rigs ⑦bdag pos brgyan/ /rang gi rigs las rnam par dag /sgeg mo rjodang ni na chung dang / /mos dang de bzhin bdud rtsi dang / /gcig pu pa ⑤dang 'dod chags sra/ /g.yon can bran rjomo de bzhin te/ /lan tsha la sogs ro kun dang / /ka ra la sogs bdud rtsi sbyin/ / bdag nyid kun gyis ro grub pas/ /⑦ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /sha dang chang du ldan pa yi// bza' ba sna tshogs grub pa ni/ /dag pa'i longs spyod skal mchog ste/ /tshe yi dam tshig rab tu grub/ /a phra smin dang rgun 'bru dang / /pa na sa dang ni li ger| /a ru ka la sogs pa yi/ /'bru yi phyag rgya mchog rnams dang / /kha ra sbrang rtsi'i byug pa yi/ /⑧a mra la sogs tshi ⑨gur bcug /ha sa ka ri mar la sogs/ /mnyam pa'i dri yis bsku bar bya/ /spang ⑩dang rgya skyegs la sogs pa'i—/ /tshon gyis mthun par kha bsgyur nas/ /shun pa gro ga la sogs byas/ /mchod pa'i tshe ⑪na dbul bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams la spos dbul ba/ /sha dang chang ni ⑫rnam par spang / /gru dang sil snyan grub pa dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /sha dang chang du bcas par ni/ /gtor ma'i mchod rten sna tshogs pa'o/ /bdag gi dbang phyug skal bzang po/ /rdo rje las ni dpal grub pa'o/ /bshos dang gtor ma dkar po dang / /pad+ma'i me tog ldan pa ni/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang gtso bo la/ /phul nas dgos pa thams cad 'grub/ /rgyal po kha zas sna tshogs pa/ /sha dang chang du ldan pa dag /14—475

glu dang sel snyan skal bzang kun/ / rdo rje lta stangs nyi ma yi/ /①rdo rje nyi ma'i 'khor la dbul/ /kha zas kun gyi ro rnams dang / /sha dang sha yi mchog rnam dag④ /sha yi sbyor ba sha skam tshogs/ /bshos dag rdo rje rta la dbul—/ /thod pa snod du sbyar ba yi/ /bza' btung bca' ba sna tshogs rnams①—/ /ha hoḥbyā yis bsregs sbyangs brlabasarjo/ /mgron tshogs rnams la bsngo bar bya/ /mchod pa rdzas chen ma lus pa/ dang po dri yi rjochus sbyangs pa/ /sna tshogs sgra snyan rjob dan tshogs/ /bkod pa'i mchod gtor byin brlabs spel/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /rta mchog gzugs su sprul byas nas/ /mchod pa'i tshe na dbul bar bya/ /mgron gyi tshogs rnams bsdu bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ye/ e a ra li bh+yo a a dza dza/ 'khor bcas bsdus pas 'ongs pa dang / /dam tshig phyag rgya rnam gsum bstan/ /oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dṛ ⑦sh+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ—/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dṛ ⑧byu ho sa ma ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dṛ ⑨byu ho sa ma ya phaṭa/ i dam ⑩puṣ+pe dhū pe dī pe ⑪gadhe pū dza spa ra ṇa ar+ghaṃ ba lo khā nyi/ yo las bskyed pa'i gzhu 'dra dbyibs/ /ba dan g.yo bas mtshan pa'i ⑫steng / /ram̐ byung me yi dkyil 'khor dmar/ /'bar ba gru gsum ra yis mtshan/ /rka ⑫byung thod pa mtshan ldan nang / /'od gsal chags med la gnas pa'i/ /mi 'chi lnga sogs phyogs dang mtshams/ /a las byung ba'i zla ba dang / /hūṃ las rdo rje dgab par bya/ /hūṃ oṃ byā④ཿbyā tram̐ haṃ bzhi pa'o/ /oṃ ā hūṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ s+thā thā⑩/rim bzhin sngags dang mtshan ma dang / /sku gyur 'phro dang 'du ba yis/ /ye shes bdud rtsi bkug byas te/ /rdo rje bzhugs nas snod bzang gtams⑩/ /zla 'dra 'od zer lnga bcas pas/ /dkyil 'khor tshogs bcas mnyes par bya/ /14—476

oṃ'ajig rten kun gyi gtso mdzad pa'i/ /'jigs don dregs byed stobs ldan pa//bde gshegs sras mchog bran mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ldan snying rje can/ /dbang phyug chen mo ①chung mar bcas/ /de bzhin khyab 'jug tshangs pa dang / /brgya byin 'dod khams chung mar bcas/ /lha chen 'khor dang bcas tshogs dang / /phyogs skyong brgyad po 'khor bcas dang / /klu don brgyad po 'khor bcas dang / /mkha' 'gro drag po gsum 'dzin ma/ /dur khrod ma mo'i tshogs bcas dang / /gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad dang / /mkha' 'gro drug po 'khor bcas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs sogs sbyang ②byas nas/ /rang gi lha yi gzugs 'dzin rnams/ /gnas 'dir 'dus pa'i dam tshig can/ /mchod gtor rgyun dang bcas pa bzhes/ /dam tshig srungs shig dam tshig can/ /las la sogs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /mkha' 'go chen mo ①'khor bcas rnams—/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cing / /las mdzad rdo rje bran mdzad pas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las grub cing / /theg chen gsang sngags bsrung ba dang / /nad dang gdon sogs zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bkra shis spel ba dang / /bde legs 'bras bu grub par mdzod/ /oṃ t+parjohūṃ pad+ma ba mu khi hūṃ trīḥ⑤—/ rta mgrin phyag rgya rnam gnyis kyis/ /las rnams dngos grub tshogs gyur cig /dngos grub dbang du byas nas ni/ /rang gi gnas la dgod par bya—/ /oṃ s+thā dubadz+ra ḍā ki ni rma ba lo ta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ khā hi/ oṃ ha hri ha khā nyi/thugs rje chen pos gzigs nas kyang / /sna tshogs rgyud rnams sprul mdzad pa'i//gar mkhan 'khor lo'i rgyud mnga' ba/ /drag po zhi mdzad byed lags so/ /sna tshogs gar gyis rnam par 'phrul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje la sogs mtshon chas 14—477

rol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus lha yi lha ①mchog skyong sdel phyag 'tshal lo /dpa' rtsal rdzogs bcu shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ a ti byu ho/ a la la la la ho/ oṃ shing gcig ④dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri bo'i sul dang 'bab chu'i gling / /khyim grong grong gi ngogs gnas sogs/ /zhing khams gong khams stong pa dag /sems can snod dang thang sogs pa/ /chu yi gnas mal khyad par du/ /drag po nag po drag chen morjo/ /ma mo dang ni mnyam par gnas/ /nag po gadrugs ⑤pa 'jigs su rung / /dga' las 'das dang log 'dren ma/ /gdol pa chen mo rjolam pa kyi/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dbang phyug ma/ /g.yon ldan mar me 'jigs ⑦byed ma/ /gong du gnas pa'i rnal 'byor tshogs/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs 'dzin 'jigs chen mo/ /mche ba gzugs ngan 'jigs pa nyid/ /thod pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ba dang / /mthu chen lag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /lag na dgra sta ral gri dang / /rdo rje mtshon cha gzhu yi lag /mkha' 'gro chen po ⑧de nyid che/ /las rnams rjes su sgrub par byed/ /rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor rgyal chen po/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen las/ /skyon med rnal 'byor 'byin pa mo/ /thams cad gnas nas tshogs pa rnams/ /rang gi dam tshig las mdzod cig /oṃ kak+ka bhā na/ basbarnya na/ kha ṣ+ṭha ⑨da na/sarba dubla rgo/ ha na ha na/ gha gha ghā ta ya/ a mu ka gya/ shāsnya ⑩ku ru/hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dz+wa la swā hā/ oṃ lhahūṃ muḥbadz+ra gats+tsha/ dkyil 'khor chen po thog ma dang / /bar dang tha ma'i gnas rnams su/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod dang / /las kun pa yi sbyin sreg brtsam/ /gsang sngags kyis ni 'grub byed cing / /sbyin sreg las kyis ⑪'bras bu 'byin/ /sgrub pa thams 14—478

cad don yod par/ /sngags bzlas sbyin sreg shis pa yin/ /bzlas brjod grangs ni bcur 'gyur te/ /sbyin sreg sngags grangs bcu cha'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar phyogs su/ /las kun pa ①dang rgyas pa brtsam byang du zhi ba lhor mngon spyod/ /nub tu dbang dang dgug pa'i las/ /thab khung gi ni nang rgya ru/ /khru gang zabs su phyed brko zhing / /kha khyer rim gsum bskyed byas la/ /rim bzhin sor ni bzhi skebazhir gnas/ /zhi la rlum po rgyas gru bzhi//dbang la zla gam gru gsum drag /dkar ser dmar gnag rim bzhin no/ /las kun dbyebs dang mdog kun ldan/ /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /rdo rjes mtshan cing phreng bas brgyan/ /tsan+dan dkar po dan da ka'i/ /shing sogs 'o ma dang ldan pa'i/ /mngar gsum dri yi chus byugs pa'i/ /zhi ba'i khang pa zlum por brtsig /gser zhing bil ba ma dan dang / /'bras bu me tog dang bcas pa/ /gi wang dzā ti ser po'i shing / /rgyas la rin chen zur brgyad dbyibs/ /rgun shing kham bu dhi ka ri/ /nags kyi lcug ma dri mar sogs//gur kum ④dri sogs dmar po'i mdog /dbang la rtse gsum zla gam dbyibs/ /bse shun sta ru marga ti/ /seng ldeng sgrug po 0'bras bu'i shing / /chag gas gdug ⑤pa'i rdzas bcas pas/ /drag pa'i dudabyebs bzhin bstan pa'o/ /rtse mo'i cha las byung ba 'ab/ /sor bzhi brgyad dang bcu drug gnyis/ /so sor dmar gyis byugs pa la/ /me tog dri bcas brgyan par bya/ /thab ⑧kyi phyi rol nye 'khor dag /ku sha rgyan dang mtshon cha dang / /me long rnga ma yol ba bcas//tshon sna lnga yi thag pas bskor/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dri/ /sman mar 'bru rnams bdud rtsi chang / /me tog rim gyis brgyan pa dang / /til 'bru nyungs 14—479

kar mngar gsum rdzas/ /'o ma 'bras chang zho mar chan/ /gro 'bras ma sha nas so ba/ /bil ba ku sha star ka drur①/ /dzā ti pha la 'bras bu gsum/ /u dum nags kyi lcug sogs shing / /rin chen phreng ba ba dan sogs/ /mi 'chi lnga dang lcags kyu bcas/ /sgrub pa po yi mdun du gzhag② /g.yas su rdo rje dril bu dang / /yam shing til 'bru rlung g.yab gzhag④ /g.yon du me tog dri chu dubacas/ / drur ba ku ⑤sha'i chun po dgarjo /mchod yon yan lag brgyad ldan pa/ /mchod rdzas kun gyi sna la dgod/ /hūṃ bzhi'i sbyor ⑦bas bgegs bsal zhing / /rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs ⑧gnas su dgod/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba las/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ⑨byas nas/ /chas gos lnga po bgos byas te/ /phyag rgya lnga sogs rgyan gyis mtshan/ /bdud rtsi'i ri lu khar bcug cing / /dbang po kun la thig les ⑩mtshan/ /snyoms 'jug phyag rgya'i tshul bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sogs rnam pas/ /byams pa'i sems sogs nyer gzhag ⑩ste/ /dus bzhi'i bye brag dbye ba yis/ /so so'i stan la legs gnas pas/ /phyogs bzhir lta tshul las la dmigs/ /ku sha rus pa mtshan ma'i dbyebs/ /dag byed g.yon pa'i ming med brgyan/ /lus ngag yid gsum mthu bskyed cing / /bdag dang 'gro ba sbyangs byas nas/ /'phags dang sems can la dmigs te/ /mdzad pa rgya chen rab spyod do/ /gzhi rten spyor ba la gnas pas/ /dmigs pa gsum gyi las rdzogs nas/ /rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /thams cad byin gyis brlab par bya/ /mdun du dpal mchog las byung ba'i/ /re bskyed las dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /dkar ser dmar gnag go rims bzhin/ /zhi rgyas las mdzad me lha bskyed/ /14—480

mig gsum gdong bzhi ral pa can/ /gsus po che la phyag bzhi pa/ /mi 'jigs bgrang phreng spyi blugs dang / /dbyug pa srad bu'i phreng ba thogs/ /sum mdo ris mtshan yum dang 'khril/ /pad+ma'i gdan la rnam par gnas/ /dbang bskur byen brlabs dbu rgyan can/ /me ri 'bar bas ①mtshan bcas pa'o—/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i ②sbyor ba dang / /sngags sogs ④'od zer phyag rgya yis//snga ma'i cha lugs 'dra ba yi/ /lha nyid gnas su dgug rjopar bya/ /g.yas ni mi 'jigs sbyin pa las/ /mthe bong srin lag rtsar bzung bskyod/ /oṃ e bye nyi/ ma hā ju ta/ de ba ṛ ṣi dī dza satwa/ ma ti kri ta a nu ma hā sa nod tota ⑤ba bha/ oṃ ba bha ka asna ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kro dhi ༷shwa ri sarba dra bye shwa ⑦dha ya swā hā/ gnod mdzes sngags kyis bgegs bskrad de/ /gnyis med phyag rgya bzhi yis gdab/ /dge 'dun rgyal po smad 'tshong dang / /rigs ngan shan pa'i rigs dag gam/ /me long me shel gtsub shing dang / /rdo lcags sbyor ba'i me blangs ⑧nas/ /g.yas nas lan gsum bskor byas te/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas rlung g.yab g.yab/ /oṃ a ṭak+ki hūṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ⑨/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/oṃ a dz+nyā na dzā la ram̐/ g.yas pas ku sha chun po yis/ /phyogs rnams kun du bsang gtor bya/ /lag gnyis mchod yon phyag rgya yis/ /dung chos blangs te dbul bar bya/ /dgang gzar rgyar ni so ⑩bzhi la/ /zabs su sor gnyis tshad brkos pas/ /rtse mo rgyun 'jug sor bzhi pa/ /pad 'dab bug pa mthe'u ⑩chung tshad/ /rang gi phreng ba'i mtshan mas bskor/ /khru gang rdo rje rin chen bcas/ /blugs gzar sor gnyis phyed brkos shing / /pad 'dab rdo rje'i mtshan mas brgyan/ /thog ma bar dang mtha' mar bcas/ /bar du 14—481

rdzas gzhan sna tshogs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhu ta dzā ①la sarba rnyi ⑧smi ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ me sbar ba yi don ched du/ /dgang blugs gsum mam gabadun phul la/ /bgags rjokyi mtshan ma brtags byas te/ bzlog ⑤gzir mnan pa'i las rnams bya/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta asna ye swā hā/ dgang blugs dbul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha tsā ya swā hā/ til gyi'o/ oṃ asna ye badz+ra dz+nyā rjon swā hā/ yam shing gi'o/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/til dang mar bsres pa'i 'o/ /oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zho'i 'o/ /oṃ sarba si ma te swā hā/ ku sha'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūr ⑦ba'i myu gu mar gyis byugs pa'i 'o/ /oṃ ma hā be+e ga ye ⑧swā hā/ nas kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye swā hā—/ gro'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya ⑨swā hā/ 'bras so ba'i 'o/ /oṃ ma hā ba khā ya swā hā/ ma sha'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras so ba'i 'o oṃ pu she ye swā hā/ 'bras ma grus pa dang mar bsres pa'i 'o/ /oṃ ma hā sho pa ye swā hā/ bil ba dang star ga'i ⑩'o/ /rdzas gzhan sna tshogs gang yin dag /rigs kyi gtso bo'i gsang sngags sam/ /yi ge bdun nam lnga yis sam rang ming sbyar bas dbul bar bya/ /oṃ pra ba ra sata kā ra pra tīts+tsha ho swā hā/ zhes bya bas yang dgang blugs dbul lo/ /de nas nye reg sogs dag byas/ /mchod pa lnga yis mnyes pa dang / /bden pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod byas nas/ /rang gi las la rab tu bskul/ /lag gnyis thal sbyar bskyod byas te/ /rdzas rnams lan gsum sbyang bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra kri li kri li bi ma la ri ⑪ti badz+ra ṭak+ki ni z-i ⑫da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ me gnas gzhal yas gdan bcas la/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor rim bzhin dgod⑫/ /bzhugs ⑫gsol zhabs bsil sogs 14—482

dbul zhing / /mchod bstod cho ga rgya chen bya/ /las kyi cho ga bzhin du ni/ /me gnas khang pa gdan bskyed ①cing / /dam tshig dkyil 'khor rim bzhin dgodaske/ /ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren tshogs/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgyas mnyes pa dag /so so'i las la rnam par sbyar/ /rang gi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor dag /sbyor sngags mtha' ma'i gnas su spel/ /yam shing 'od la dbul byas te/ /til zho nas ni phyag tu'o/ /ku sha drur ba sdegatsug tor la/ /mar khu nas gro so ba dang / /ma sha ka sogs zhal du dbul/ /zhu ba'i rdzas kun de bzhin no/ /spos rnams shangs la me tog spyan/ /dri mchog dkar dmar me yi 'od/ /mchod yon 'thor 'thung phyag tu dbul/ /bdud rtsi ljags la gos mchog sku/ /rin chen phreng ba dbu dang snyan/ /rol mo'i rdzas rnams mdun du'o/ /de nas slob dpon la sogs pa'i/ /sdig pa'i gzugs brnyan sbyangs ④byas nas/ / bsrungs shing dushis pa'i las kun dang / /'dod don gang yin gsol ba gdab—/ /slar yang mchod cing bstod byas te/ /dgang blugs phul te mnyes par bya/ /gzugs brnyan gnas nas spyan drangs pa/ /slar nyid rang gi gnas su dgod/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bsdus pa dag /dam tshig lha dang gnyis su dbye/ /mchod bstod phyag rgyas gshegs su gsol/ /bskyed pa'i rim bzhin bsdu bar bya/ /mthar yang me lha mchod bya ste/ /gshegs gsol rang gi gnas su bsdu/ /sna tshogs rgyan rnams thams cad kyis/ /gnas kyi sa gzhi nyer mdzes par/ /slob dpon khrus byas rgyan gyis bklubs⑤/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin sbyor ldan pas/ /rab gnas bya bar 'os pa dang / /sna tshogs mchod pa'i rdzas rnams bsagasarjo/ /rdo rje khro bor byin brlabs pa'i/ /mtshan 14—483
