ma'i rdzas kyis bgegs rnams bskrad/ /tshogs bsags srung ①ba'i 'khor lo dang / /gzhi rten sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /ye shes lha dmigs las rdzogs nas/ /rab gnas rten rnams sbyang bar bya/ /bsang gtor sngags kyis gtor byas nas/ /nyungs kar sngags bcas lan gsum du/ /kham phor me yi nang du bsreg /slar yang chu yis shis par bya/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye ④swā hā/ ba yi rnam lnga legs sbyar ba/ /'dag chal rnam lnga bdud rtsi'i ①sbyar—/ / dūr ba'i ④pir gyis sku byugs te/ /brlan 'jig pa la me long ngos//hūṃ oṃ tweḥs+thāḥtram̐ ho⑤/ oṃ rnam ༷dag ku sha'i chu rgyun gyis/ /dri ma'i mtshan ma dag par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka byusto ⑦sho dha rgo badz+ra swā hā/ dri zhim sbyar ba'i mar byugs te/ /skyu ru ra yi 'dag chal dang / /shun pa lnga yi rdzas rnams kyis/ /dngos sam me long gzugs brnyan phyi⑧/ /mdun gyi sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor rnams/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mnyes byas te/ /sta gon gnas shing dgongs bya'i phyir/ /spos snod bzung ste gsol ba gdab/ /ji ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /dga' ldan gnas nas byon mdzad ⑨de/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin 'dir yang bzhugs ⑩su gsol—/ /mgon mchog gnas 'dir bzhugs nas kyang / /me tog la sogs mchod bzhes ⑪la/ /'di don gzung ⑫bar bya ba dang / /byang chub sems mchog 'phel bar mdzad/ /bcom ldan rdo rje che ge mo/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod⑫/ /mgon po thugs rje brtse ba yis/ /nang par rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /bka' drin cho ga 14—484

bya bar 'os/ /'gro ba'i 'khor nas sgol mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /gang dag gsang sngags kyi lha dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha tshogs dang / /'byung po rdzogs sangs rgyas bstan pa/ /mngon par dga' ba'i gnas bstan pa/ /rdo rje'i spyan dang ldan pa'i tshogs/ /rdo rje che ge mo bdag gis/ /rig ①pa'i rgyal po che ge mo'i/ /rab gnas yo byad ci 'byor zhing / /'gro la phan phyir bgyid par 'tshal/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs rjes nye bar dgongs nas kyang / /rab tu gnas pa'i las rnams la/ /byen gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /sku gzugs lugs ma la sogs rnams/ /gzhi rten sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rang rig lha yi rnam par bsam/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis brtan ②par bya/ /pu ti rigs kyi lha nyid las/ /gsung sogs yi ge'i rnam par gyur/ /mchod rten la sogs gzhir ④bcas pa/ /mos pa'i lha rnams gang yang rung / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃḥhoḥ'i sbyor ba yis/ /lha rnams brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /mchod cing bstod pas mnyes pa dang / /sngags mang brjod cing na bza' g.yogs④/ /de nas snga dro'i dus su ni/ /snga ma'i sbyor bcas tshig gis bskul/ /bzhengs gsol gos sogs bsal byas nas/ /sngar bzhin bsgom ④bzlas mchod sogs bya/ /ji ltar bltams ⑤ma thag tu ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ dri med ras kyis rlan phyis shing / /dri zhim rdzas kyis byug par bya/ /dngul snod mar dkar sgrang rtsis bkang / /gser thur rtser blangs spyan la byug /oṃ tsakyu sa 14—485

man+ta tsagru bi sho dha ni swā hā/ me yi sreg ①khang bzang po ru/ /rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dbul bar bya/ /oṃ ru ru sgru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha si— lo tsa na sarba aza sā dha ②ne+e swā hā/ oṃ me lha'i me tog shin tu dmar/ /lha yi dri yis nye bar byugs/ /me tog bzang po 'di bzhes la/ /gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ mar me 'od bzang 'bar ba ni/ /ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms byed pa⑦/ /lha yi mig 'byed dam pa 'di/ /bdag la dgongs te bzhengs su gsol/ /oṃ tsan+dan gur kum rjosbyar ba yi/ /dri mchog bdug pa 'di bzhes la/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams tshim pa'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs la ⑤bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sna tshogs lha yi dri ldan pa/ /sna tshogs ga pur gyis ni brgyan/ /sna tshogs hūṃ las yang dag byung / /dri mchog 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ kha dog dri dang ror ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba'i bye brag sna tshogs rnams/ /zhal zas thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe t+pahūṃ/oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ ā rjohūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke stosahūṃ/⑦ oṃ badz+ra gadhe stosahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e — bye 26⑧hūṃ/ oṃ dpag bsam shing sogs rgyu las byung / /lha yi na bza' rin thang ⑨'phags/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog dang mtshungs/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan sogs dbul/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ye swā hā/ de nas mchod pa'i rol mo'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs rnam par dbul bya zhing / /dga' ba'i glu dang dbyangs kyis dbul/ /bkra shis 'don zhing bskor ba bya/ /dbang bskur lnga yi cho ga yis/ /byin brlabs bskyed de brtan par bya/ /sbyin sreg gtor ma la sogs pas/ /las bsgrub bar chad bsal ⑩bar bya/ /sngags bcas ⑩byin rlabs ⑫bskyed 'dod pas/ /khrus byas rgyan kyis brgyan par bya/ /14—486

mchod pa gtor ma'i tshogs bshams nas/ /ting 'dzin rim pas bskyed par bya//dbang bskur byin rlabs ①rdzogs byas te/ /dgug gzhug mchod cing brtan par bya/ /rang gi gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bkra shis glu bcas brjod par bya/ /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis de ni skye dgu'i zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis ②mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin kyis ④mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de rgo 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /sems can kun la phan phyir byang chub mchog ④mnga' ba'i⑤/ /don rnams ma lus mtshungs par brtul ba yang rjoldan pa/ /tshogs kyi las dgyes thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis de ⑦ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lhas bskor ba yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmad du grags pa'i che ba'i lha yis mngon bstod pa/ /bsam yas dge bsgrubs bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /dgyes shing nam phyed grong khyer mchog nas mngon byung ste/ /dka' thub tshal du 14—487

mardon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' ba/ /be+eḍūr+ya ltar sngo ba'i rtsa bting steng na bzhugs/ /skyi mo krung bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /chu bo'i 'gram na tsar+ṣa'i phreng ①gis yongs bskor ba/ /shin tu rmad du byung ba'i srid pa sel mdzad pa/ /klu yi rgyal pos phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs/ /mang po btul dze+ete sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la/ /bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des — skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs te/ /nam gyi tho rangs bdud bzhi po dag rnam btul nas/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyen wā rā ṇa sīr skedrang srong mchog bzhugs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog bstan pa yi bkra shis gang / /lha yul dang 'dir shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa/ /bkra shis des kyang skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /mu stegs byed pa kun gyi nga rgyal gzhom rjopa dang / /'gro la bde ba bskyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag /nye bar ston pa rgyal ba'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir mtho ris nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye 14—488

dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba mchog tu nyer gshegs pa / /man+d+ra ①ra ba'i me tog mang pos mngon gtor ba/ /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon par bstod pa'i stibakra shis gang / /bkra shis des kyang skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lha dbang klu dang mi yi dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /rigs rdzogs slob ma'i don gyi phyir/ /bsrungs shing dgongs mo khrus byas te/ /dris byugs phreng thogs rgyan btags shing / /dri bzang stan bde'i ④gnas dag tu/ /bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga'i rim/ /brtan pa yan lag kun rdzogs pa'i/ /'dod chags chen po las byung ba'i/ /'khor lo de nyid gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /gang gis shes na slob ma rnams/ /gzhug phyir gtso sogs rnam par shes/ /oṃ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i dbyings/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rigs mchog mgon po bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dag pa ste/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis sgrubs rjoshig /'dod chags dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdong nas grol ba'i de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun kyi bdag /byang chub mchog tu bdag sgrubs ⑤shig /dngos grub chen po kun gyi rgyal/ /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje can bdag 14—489

bdag mdzod cig /sems can kun yid khyab pa'o/ /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab nyid de/ /'dod chags bral ba'i dam tshig mchog /mchod pa'i gar tshogs glu bcas pa/ /dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i bstod pa bya/ /shes rab thabs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /bden pa'i byin rlabs ①chen po yis/ /mgon chogs ②'phrul pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'dod pa thams cad skong byed shog /thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /④gzung 'dzin rab spangs brjod du med/ /rgyu dang rkyen las byung ba dag /chos nyid de kho nyid las byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal ba dri med gnas/ /sems can kun gyis rjomathong bar shog /dbang bskur phyi nang gsang chen dang / /gsang chen rim bzhin rgyud las skyes/ /sngon gyi bla ma dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /mchod cing yon gyis mnyes par bya/ /tshogs kyi ston mo sbyin sreg ⑤mchog /las mang nang du dmigs par mchod/ /kun gyi slob dpon la gnas pas/ /'khor lor 'jug par byed pa na/ /sgo mtshalas maṇ+ḍal stegs byas te/ /slob ma sgo drung bum pas bsang / /mchod pa'i sbyor ba rnam rjomang dang / /lha mo bzhi po dag gis ni/ /me tog la sogs mchod byas nas/ /slob ma thams cad gzung bar bya/ /de nas gdong ni mdzes pa dag /ā ⑦khaṃ bī ra hūṃ bzlas pa'i—/ /ras bzang so so'i rigs mthun pas/ /legs par bsgrims te gnas par bya/ /dngos grub 'dod pas ci 'dod pas/ /snying po'i khar ni kun bskyod ⑧nas/ /rin chen me tog kun phreng 'dzin/ /rtse gcig brtan pa'i sems bskyed nas/ /dkyil 'khor 'dod pa'i slob ma la/ /gsang ba 14—490

yang dag mtha' yas mchog /thog ma nyid du gsal brjod pa/ /bu khyod ci la dga' zhes dri/ /skal ba bzang la bdag dga' zhes/ /'jug pa pos kyang smra bar bya/ /bla mas bu la slar smras pa/ /de yis khyod la ci zhig bya/ /sangs mchog sras bcas dam tshig las/ /yon phul thugs rjes bdag la dgongs/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum rang bzhin mchog /slob dpon mgon la bdag skyabs mchi—/ /skal bzang lha mo tshogs bcas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol—/ /rgyal ba kun gyis gnas bzhugs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor chen po nyams dga' ba/ /snying po'i grong khyer chen po 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /de nas yol ba'i nang mtshams su/ /las kyi rdo rjes gzhug par bya/ /gsang ba yang dag 'di shes nas/ /ji ltar 'dod pa rab tu gzhug/gsang ba yang dag mi shes na①/ /g.yas pa yis ni gzhug par bya/ /oṃ sarba yo ga ciX da da ya mi hūṃ/ thog med dus nas 'khor ba yi/ /bdag gis ②sdig pa'i las gang bgyis/ /bgyid pa yi rang dus 'dir bshags①/ /phyin chad mi bgyid sdom rab gzung / /rgyal ba sras tshogs dge rtsa'i gzhidu/ /'gro gzhan legs byas gang yin parjo/ /de dag kun la yi rang ste/ /byang chub chen por bdag gis bsngo/ /sangs rgyas tshogs rdzogs dge 'dun la/ /bdag ni dus gsum skyabs su mchi/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal bcad pa dang / /dge ba'i tshogs mang spel ba'i phyir/ /byang sems gnyis med don bskyed nas/ /'gro don di rjoring dus 'dir gnyer/ /sangs rgyas gyur nas bdag gis ni/ /'go rnams srid pa'i gnas nas gdon/ /rdo rje me tog phreng bcas pas /14—491

slob ma'i snying gar gzhag ①ste bsgo/ /bde gshegs kun gyis khyod nyid ni/ /de ring byin gyis brlabs pas na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang chen 'di/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu ma zhugs shing / /dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /nam yang smra bar bya ba min/ /oṃ su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ①/ ho sidhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la ①yang dag zhugs mdzad de/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /oṃ sa ma ya u da—/ 'di ni spyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis grub/ /oṃ uhūṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ badz+ra ā su rjoka ta ju ⑤tha/ di ring phyin chad khyod nyid kyi—/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nga yin pas/ /gang zhig bsgo ba'i las rnams byos//nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /gal te cung zhig brnyas na ni/ /dus min 'chi zhing dmyal bar 'gyur/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rjothugs/ /sku dang gsung 'phrul las mdzad pa/ /phyag rgya'i cho ga gang dag gis/ /di ring bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /rkang thil ⑦snying ga mgrin spyi bor/ /sa bon las byung 'byung bzhi'i khams/ /so so'i sa bon mtshan 'dogs par/ /rta yi rgyal po'i sngags kyis bsrung / /rdo rje 'dzin cing dril bu dkrol/ /a be+e sha ya stam+bha ⑧dang / /ra bzhi dza la yang gnyis hūṃ/ /a ha sto ⑨sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ /sku yi mtshan mas g.yo 'gyur zhing / / bdag gis ⑩sngags bcas tshig rnams brjod//thugs kyis mngon par shes pa gsal/ /gsum sngags brtan pa'i las la sbyor/ /rnal 'byor bcas dang gsang bcas pa'i/ /bdag gi ye shes brgya bsgrubs nas//ji lta'i tshul gyis gar byed pas/ /slob ma rnams la bde ba sbyin/ /slob ma 14—492

dam pas deng phyin chad/ /phyag rgya'i ye shes rjes bzung bas/ /rnam par snang mdzad mchog sbyin du/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi bdag nyid 'grub/ /de nas bdag gis rab bsgrubs nas/ /kun gyi slob dpon la gnas pa/ /ji lta'i tshad kyis 'jug pa yi/ /bden pa'i chos ni brjod par bya/ /mgon mchog gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /slob ma mchog 'di gzhug par bgyi/ /rigs kyi lha yi bye brag dang / /bsod ①nams gang yin de bzhin shog /de bzhin dngos grub mtshan ma dag /snying po'i gnas 'di legs ston par/ /kha dog dbyebs kyi bye brag gis/ /mtshan ma snang las las mthun 'grub⑧/ /dngos grub ji lta thob 'dod pas/ /slob ma me tog 'thor du gzhug /lha mo gang la lhung ba ni/ /lha de de yis 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/sku stod sku smad yan lag gam/ /de ltar mtshan sgo'i gnas rnams sogs/ /dngos grub rim pa bye brag ste/ /ra ba las 'das lan gsum bskyang ④/ /slar nyid phreng ba'i me tog gis/ /slob ma'i mgo la bcings te brgyan/ /stobs ldan sems dpa'i rgyal po che/ /phreng ba 'di dang ldan par gyis/ /oṃ rat+na mā le a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐rjo/ gser gyi thur ma'i oṃ sogs kyis/ /spus mtshan dri ma bsal ⑤bar bya/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson mdzad de/ /mig gi sgrib g.yogs dukun bsal nas/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu dz+nyā na pra be sha phaṭa/ gdong g.yogs legs par bsal byas nas/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor blta bar bya/ /legs par ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /me tog gang la lhang ba ni/ /de nyid khyod kyi rigs kyi lha/ /rta mgrin 'phang mtho nas bzung 14—493

ste—/ /gtso bo'i bar du ming rnams bstan/ /de nas ro dang zas dang gnabyed//glu dang ṅgal snyan la sogs pa/ /de dag mgon po rnams la dbul/ /rdo rje bla ma chen po dag /sbyor ba'i rdzas kyis mnyes byas shing / /bdag dang gzhan yang 'dod dgus mchod/ /bu byed dang bas rab gus bskyed/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po legs par ltos/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam spyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i rigs mchog 'dzin/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'byed/ /dam tshig 'dzin cing rjes chags dang //gsang sngags snying po 'dzin par ②gyis/ /blo ldan yon mchod thogs pa yis/ /bla ma'i zhabs gus gsol ba gdab/ /rgyal ba kun gyis gsang ba'i lam/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo mchog /yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /de ring dbang bskur gnang ba yi/ /dus la bab pa'i 'os pa lags/ /dpa' bo chen pos ④mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur rim bzhin bdag la spyod/ /rig pa chen po'i las bsgrubs nas/ /dngos grub tshogs rnams shes pa dang / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis rdo rje slob dpon gzung / /'jug pa'i sgo yi phyogs nyid du/ /khru dos chod pa dbus kyi tshad/ /slob ma'i stegs bu sgo dang bcas/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad mtshan ma bri/ /seng ge sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan/ /gnyis med gus pa'i sems bcas gzhagarjo /'phan gdugs me tog phreng sogs dang / /sna tshogs gos kyis nye bar brgyan/ /dri chu nyungs kar sbyin sreg dang / /ku sha'i chu yis shis par bya/ /bdud rtsi'i sngags kyis bsrurnga ba dang / /de nyid gsum gyis sbyang bar bya/ /chos nyid rnam dag sbyor ba las/ /rigs kyi lha ru bsgom par 14—494

bya—/ /mchod dbyangs rol mo ṅgal snyan tshogs/ /bkra shis tshigs bcad rgya chen gdon/ /rnam rgyal bum sogs ①khrus gsol zhing / /phyi yi bum pas dbang bskur bya/ /til gyi gang bu bzhin gang ba'i/ / rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni/ /④'di nyid la ni blugs bsams te/ /bag chags ma lus dag gyur cig /ye shes sems dpa'i gnas 'byung bas/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dgug byas te/ /gnyis med sbyor ba'i byin stobs kyis/ /mtshon byed rtags kyi zla ba gdan/ /rigs mthun dang po lha mo bzhi/ /phyogs bzhi nas ni dbang bskur mdzad/ /oṃ lha yi chu ni rnam dag pa/ /rdo rje gsang gsum gnas las byung / /rig pa'i lha mo tshogs ldan pa'i/ /rang bzhin gcig tu gyur pa yin/ /oṃ badz+ra a nyi shiñtsa mi/ byang chub sems nyid dag pa'i rgyun/ /rang gi ye shes rnam par gsal/ /me long ye shes rang bzhin gyi/ /mi bskyod ngo bo chu yi dbang / /khams kyi rang bzhin thams cad dang / /srog dang rtsa ba de bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas rin chen dbang bskur ba/ /mkhas pas rnam pa sna tshogs brtag /spyi bo dang ni dpral ba dag /lhan ①pa gnyis dang dpral ba ru//sangs rgyas rin chen thams cad kyi/ /dbu rgyan mi 'gyur dam pa'o/ /khams kyi rang bzhin thams cad dang / /srog dang rtsa ba de bzhin te/ /thod pa rin chen dbu rgyan can/ /sangs rgyas gtsug gi nor bu dag /kun du sna tshogs bla mar ni/ /kun gyi slob dpon kun la bya/ /rin chen ngo mtshar gcig las byas/de bzhin sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /sangs rgyas pad+mor dbang bskur bas/ /slob ma thams cad dbang bskur ro/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen phyed/ /rdo rje'i rigs la rdo rje yin/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sangs rgyas sku/ /nor bu 14—495

'dzin kyi nor bu yin/ /sangs rgyas rin chen pad+mo dang / /rdo rje nor bu de bzhin du/ /thams cad mchog ni rta mchog la/ /rang gi dbang bskur bsdus pa'o—/ /blugs pa dang ni byas pa dang / /brdung pa'am yang na bris pa'ang rung / /sna tshogs rab tu legs pa 'di/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya rab tu brtag /sangs rgyas rin chen dbang bskur bas/ /ji lta bar ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen las byung dbu rgyan che/ /thor gtsug dbu rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i/ /dar dbyang ②dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ba ra ta ka badz+ra a ra li ho/ a nyi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin gyi/ /nyi ma'i ngo bo dbu rgyan no/ /rdo rje rtse lnga byin brlabs pa/ /g.yas pa slob ma'i snying gar gtug④ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba chen po'i don/ /di ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu grub phyir gzung bar gyisadu/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ ༷a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ slar nyid slob ma'i lag g.yas gtad/ /lan gsum gtod de thugs kar gzung rjo/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag po'i bdag /kun rtog ye shes rang bzhin kyi/ /gar dbang ngo bo'i ⑦rdo rje'i dbang / /dril bu mdun gzhag ⑧byin brlabs te/ /dkrol zhing slob ma'i lag g.yon gtad/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bcang bar bya/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /oṃ a dhi ba ti s+t+waṃ/ a rnyi ṣiñtsa mi/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' rnams/ /srid pa'i dam 14—496

pa byed par 'gyur/ /bya ba'i ye shes rang bzhin kyi/ /rta mchog ngo bo dril bu'i dbang / /rdo rje dril bu bsnol ba'i phyag /spyor bcas slob ma'i mgo bor gzhag① /gang phyir chos rnams rnam dag pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rang bzhin nyid/ /dbang po'i spyod yul ④gang dang gang / /bde mchog sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /oṃ ṭīche ge mo a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ badz+ra tsā ma a rnyi ṣe ka ta ya hoske/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin gyi/ /rnam snang ngo bo ming gi dbang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi tshig gis kyang / /rgyas mi thebs shing mi rmongs ④te/ /de la gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas mna' ni bsgags byas nas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mthun pa yisarjo /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' stsal te/ /dam tshig sdom pa sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /sdom pa nyams par khyod byed pa/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin/ /lha rnams dang ni mi dag dang / /de bzhin rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /de dag la ni snying ring ⑤nas/ /snying las khrag chen 'thung bar 'gyur/ /sems can khams ni ma lus don/ /srid pa shin tu dag bya'i phyir/ /mi 'gog chos nyid sbyor ba yis—/ /rtag pa nyid ni bsgrub rjopar bya/ /rang gi ngo bo yongs spangs shing / /dka' thub kyis ni gzir mi bya/ /ci bde bar ni bde bar spyad/ /'di ni phyi dus sangs rgyas yin/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod thams cad la⑦/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /sdig pa med kyis khyed ma 'jigs/ /dam tshig 'da' bar dka' ba'o/ /mgon khyod thugs rje'i rang bzhin kyis/ /dkyil 'khor slob dpon dbang bskur sogs/ /bdag gzhan don gyi bya ba rnams/ /14—497

grub byed dbang bskur bdag la stsol①/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya che/ /zung shig ⑦yang dag gzung bar gyis/ /di ring rdo rje slob dpon che/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams gzung ④bar gyis/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na rjoganas/ /rtag tu khyod kyis kyang bzung ste/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ⑤ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ rjodha ra ya mi—/ hi hi hi nyi ho/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khrod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bskyed/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ⑦a/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /dam tshig phyag rgya zhes byar brjod/ /lus kun brtan byed gang zhig ni/ /phyag rgyar ⑧rab tu grags pa yin/ /oṃ ma hā kā ya wāka tsit+ta ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ/ mchod tshogs gar bskor bstod dang bcas/ /dgyes pa'i brtul zhugs dbang mchog ⑨go/ /sems dpa'i nga rgyal rnal 'byor pas⑩—/ /snyems bcas me tog phreng 'phang bya/ /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras bcas kun nas rnam par rol/ /rdo rje sems sogs rab sbyor bas/ /bdag bstod bde chen mchod pa mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra lā su hūṃ/sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /bcom ldan kun du mi 'bral te/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /mā phye hūṃ/lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu dbyangs snyan pa'i tshig brjod pas/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i dngos grub mchog /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /gi badz+ra gī ti hūṃ/ gar bcas thal mo sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar byos/ /sangs rgyas ⑪'dus pa'i phrin ⑫las kyi/ /gar dbang tshul bzhin 14—498

bsgyur bar gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra dri bye ①hūṃ/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos 'bul ma/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs par tshim/ /lus can bde gshegs cha 'dra bar//ye shes can gyis tshim par gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū ②pe hūṃ/ me tog sangs rgyas rnams su 'thor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs pa'i sgo/ /mtshan bzang dpe byad kun ldan pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku thob 'gyur/ /zlo ④badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ—/ chos kyi mig 'byed sgron rjogasal bas/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru/ /sems can ma rig mun 'thoms ⑤pa'i/ /ye shes snang ba gsal bar gyis/ /pra badz+ra ā lo ke hūṃ/ rgyal ba rnams la dri sbyor zhing / /tshul khrims phung po shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yis/ /byang chub lus can rnams la byug /a badz+ra gadhe hūṃ/ bdag gzhan dngos dugrub las kyi tshogs/ /thun mong 'bring po tshogs gyur pa'i/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang dgug pa dang / /sdang gnod nges pa'i las kun dang / /'byed rmongs bskrad pa'i cho ga rnams/ /thogs pa med par bsgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /thog ⑦med mi 'bying sgeskas 'jeg cing / /gser 'gyur ri lu nyi zla gzung / /char dbab la sogs las kyi tshogs/ /rnam shes bsgrub dang ye shes bsgrub/ /phyag rgya shes pa'i dngos grub dang / /thams cad bsgrub cing grol ba yi/ /don nyid yang dag grol bar gyis/ /rgyal ba kun kyi gnas 'jug cing / /sku gsung thugs mchog yon tan rgyas/ /phrin las gzhan dag sbyor ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dngos grub gnang / /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ne+e ⑨tra a ba ha ra pa ṭa lo ⑩tweḥ/ chos 14—499

rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /rang bzhin med cing bdag med pa/ /chos rnams de bzhin shes byas nas①/ /sems can don la yang dag byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam sbyor ba yi①/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog ④pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid gtso/ /rigs kyi yi ge mtshan ldan pa'i/ /mda' 'phang ba dang 'khor lo gnon/ /g.yas pas ④dung gi sgra 'byin zhing / /g.yon par rang gi glegs bam mo/ oṃ pha rol phyin drug las rnams kyis/ /sems can kun don rab sbyor zhing / /'khor ba'i rgyun gcod mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor/ /the tshom rtog tshogs gcod mdzad pa'i/ /chos kyi dung ni sgra sgrogs shing / /gsang sngags snying po'i gsang chen 'di/ /snod ldan kun la rab tu shod/ /des ni rgyal ba thams cad la/ /phan 'dogs rjodrin du gzo zhes bya/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /khyod la rtag tu srung bar mdzod/ /mdor na 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /sems can kun gyi don kyi phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs su/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /rdo rje gnas su bde gshegs rin/ /pad+mo las kyi rjes su gnang ⑥/ /'di ltar nga yis khyod lung bstan/ /rdo rje dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /dngos po mchog tu bsgrub ⑦pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las grol/ /sgeche ge mo zhes bya ba ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 14—500

byur byu ba swaḥ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /dus gcig tu ni lung bstan pas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sngags bcas mthus/ /skad cig dus kyi lung bstan mdzad/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis nam yang bya ma yin/ /ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa①/ de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /sngags sogs rgyud rnams 'dzin par gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par bsrungs/ /sems can kun la snying brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ /rtse gcig nan tan bskyed nas ni/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'diraske/ /zhugs shing mthong la sogs pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur zhing / /khyed rnams rab tu dgyes par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin kyang 'chi ba yod med cing / /mtshungs med thub par mi 'gyur te—/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin ②tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las 'das so/ /byang chub sems ni yongs mi spang ①/ /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ste/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur the tshom med/ /dam pa'i chos dag mi smad cing / /ma gus spang zhing dor mi bya/ /mi shes snod min rmongs pa la/ /nam yang bstan par mi bya'o—/ /rdo rje dril bu mi spang ste/ /slob dpon dag la gus par gyis/ /khams gsum kyi ni rgyal srid che/ /bdag por rgyal chen dbang bskur zhing / /bdud rnams thams cad las rgyal bas/ /grong khyen mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /'di yis spyod rnams dus 'di ru/ /sangs rgyas thob par the tshom med/ /14—501

dbang bskur rjes thob dbugs phyung bas/ /slob ma yon 'byung rgyal por 'gyur//slob dpon blo gros dam tshig ldan/ /brtan g.yo'i mtha' las rnam par grol/ /lam mchog 'jug sogs dbugs dbyung ste/ /ngal ba'i gnas ngan kun du spangasaske/ /rigs kyi 'khor gang yin pa yi/ /brten pa'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin nyid/ /rten gnas khang pa rgyan bcas pa'i/ /rnam dag rang bzhin rgyan bstan cing / /bskyed pa'i las lam bye brag sogs/ /slob dpon phyogs gcig nas 'jug pa'i/ /rig pa'i yan lag rgyud don bzhin/ /slob dpon dbang bskur don du bstan/ /de nas sna tshogs rgyan rnams dang / /mchod pa kun dang gtor ma kun/ /snga ma bzhin du phul byas te/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams bstod par bya/ /kun du sna tshogs bla ma la/ /yon mchog bdag gis dbul bar bya/ /gang la yongs su gtang dka' ba/ /de ni mchog tu bshad pa yin/ /gang dang gang ni sdug pa'i mchog /yang na shin tu khyad par can/ /de dang de ni bla ma la/ /de ni zad par 'dod pas dbul/ /yang na de ni 'dod gyur pa'am/ /'on te sems la dgos ①pa dag /de bzhin yang na dgos par bya/ /de ni chung yang mchog yin no/ /gal te de la mchog bdog la—/ /de yang ngan pa'i yon dbul na/ /kun gyi slob dpon brnyas pas na/ /de ni rtag tu sdug bsngal thob/ /bu mo shin tu brgyan pa'am/ /de bzhin chung ma sdug pa dag /phul nas rin kyis bslu dze+eb ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog gi yon/ /mi chen dag ni phul nas su/ /slar yang rin gyis bslu ⑦ba ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rjodapal sbyor ba/ /yon de mchog gi yon yin no/ /mu tig zangs dang nor bu dang / /shin tu dkar dang ras zung dang / /de bzhin rta 14—502

ni dkar po dang / /pad+ma can gyi yon mchog yin/ /rgyal srid longs spyod gter rnams dang / /gos dang rgyan gyi tshogs rnams dang / /de bzhin mchod pa thams cad dang / /rdo rje nyi ma'i yon yin no/ /rta mchog shin tu brgyan pa'am—/ /glang po ①shin tu brgyan pa dang / /shing rta rin chen bkang ba dag /rta yi rgyal po'i yon yin no/ /de nas dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /dris byugs maṇ+ḍal legs bshams nas/ /sna tshogs rgyan sogs me tog bkram/ /bla ma bde ba'i stan la gzhag② /shes rab phun sum mtshan ldan pa/ /snod ldan dbang thob dam tshig gnas/ /yon bcas bla ma la phul nas/ /ston mo'i g.yos sogs dga' longs spyod/ /rdo rje yol bas bar bcad la/ /gus pas rgyang ④nas gsol ba gdab/ /dpal ldan mgon po bde ba che/ /bde chen bde ba'i gnas la bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i bde spyod mdzod/ /byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyis/ /yang dag don mchog rnam dag pa/ /ji ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yi/ /mchog gi dbang ni rjobaskur ba bzhin0/ /de bzhin bdag sogs 'gro kun gyi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri med mchog /ma rig rtog pa'i rab rib sil/ /gang gis byang chub bla med pa/ /de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod/ /blo gros thugs rje chen po yis/ /brtse ba'i gsung gis slar brjod pa/ /bu spyod ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bde chen sbyin/ /ting 'dzin sbyor sngags gsal ba yis/ /rang gi gnas su legs par sdod/ /de nas phyi nang khrus sogs kyis/ /dam tshig lha mo sbyang byas nas/ /nyungs kar sngags kyis bgegs bskrad cing / /sbyor ba rjes sbyor 14—503

gyis bskyed de/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs ①rdzogs byas nas/ /rol pa'i brdas bskul spro ba bskyed/ /gnyis med sbyor ba'i byang chub sems/ /slob ma'i kha ru dbab par bya/ /ji ltar rgyal ba bde gshegs kyis/ /rang gi sras mchog dbang bskur zhing / /byang chub sems de dag pa'i chu/ /rtog tshogs dri ma dag par byas/ /oṃ ma hā bo dhi dziX sa ma ya a bhi ④ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ a ho su kha zhes brjod cing / /longs spyod gnas la gzhug byas te/ /rigs kyi cha lugs gsal ba dag /chu zla sgyu ma'i rnam pa bzhin/ /rdzogs rim bcud rdzogs bla ma mchog /'gro ba skyob pa'i blo ldan pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gsang gnas don/ /slob mas rgyud la rab bskul mdzad/ /mtshan ldan yul ①bcas bla ma la/ /mchod cing gsol ba gdab par bya/ /kye kye mgon po bde ba che/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /phyag rgya mi phyed rab sgrub pa/ /mngon sum nyams myong bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bdag nyid chen pos ji lta bar/ /gtso bos bdag la mdzad du gsol/ /rtog pa'i dri mas bsgribs rjopa rnams/ /byang chub chu yis dag par mdzod/ /rig mthun mtshan ldan byin brlabs pa'i/ /lha mo bu yi lag tu gtad/ /dga' ba'i gnas chen lha mo 'di/ /sna tshogs sgyu rtsal yid du 'ong / /legs par zung shig ④blo gros mchog /dga' bde'i mchod pa rab tu gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /'gro ba 'di medag thams cad 'gyur/ /de bas khyod kyis 'di nyid du/ /nam yang 'bral bar mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /lha mos grogs la dga' ba'i bzhin/ /rgyas mdzad pad+ma kha phye bstan/ /khyod kyis nus sam rdo 14—504

rje can/ /dri chen dri chu'i bza' btung dang / /raka ta ga pur māṃ ①sa dang / /bud med rnams la dad gus dang / /bha gar 'o byed mi rtog pa/ /smros shig grogs po bde ba can/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /khu khrag la sogs bza' ba dang / /bud med rnams la rtag gus shing / / bha ga'i ④pad+mar 'o bgyid cing / /rmad byung gsang ④ba'i pad+ma 'di/ /thams cad bde bar yang dag ldan—/ /rtag tu rim bzhin 'di spyod na/ /de nyid bde chen 'bral mi 'gyur//chos dbyings 'di rgo rnam par dag /sems can thams cad rnam par grol④/ /bde chen rgyal ba 'di nyid ni/ /dngos po kun kyi rang bzhin gnasarjo/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /pad+ma la bzhugs rab tu rgyas/ /bha ga'i mkha' dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings/ /'byung ba rjolnga po rgyan bzhin dgod/ /lte ba ze'u 'bru ge sar zlum/ /'dab ma brgyad sogs rnam par mdzes/ /de yi dbus su gnas pa ni/ /de nyid bdud rtsi bde chen gzugs/ /bhaspru mok+ṣa ho/dbe+en pa'i gnas mchog dri bcas brgyan/ /yol ba'i ra ba stan bde la/ /thabs shes sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /rjes su sbyor dang sbyor chen bsgom/ /ka ma la yi gtsug lag gzhung / /rim gyis bde ba'i ye shes bskyed/ /dngos grub shis dang mi shis las/ /yi ge lnga bcu'i mtshan ma brtag④ /ye shes 'di ni shin tu phra/ /snying rje chen po mkha' 'dra zhing / /rdul bral thar pa zhi ba chos//rang gi rang bzhin de nyid do/ /byang sems rdo rje lce yis blang / /mchod yon dbul bskor gtang rag gtang / /bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis/ /dbang bzhi'i rim pa bstan pa'i phyir/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /rnam gsum phyag rgya gang rung las/ /gnyis med bde ba'i ye shes don/ /14—505

mngon sum nyams myong rgyud las ①babyed/ / rnal 'byor bde ba thams cad kyis//dbang bskur bde chen las byung ba'i/ /rin chen tshogs rnams thams cad kyis//rab tu myos pas dbang bskur 'gyur/ /②de don rtog pa bdun pa las/ /rgyas par bstan pa'i gzhung bzhin bslab/ /phyi nang gsang ba gsang chen gyi/ /dbang bskur dam pa bzhi dag las/ /rgyud gzhan la las bum pa dang / /gsang ba shes rab ye shes dang / /bde chen bzhi pa zhes brjod de/ /de don rang bzhin mtshungs pa'o/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad ①par bya/ /ma byin par yang blang bar bya/ /'dod pas log par g.yem par bya/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /rdo rje bla ma byang chub sems/ /srog gi phyir yang byang chub semasaske/ /dran pa gsal bas gzung byas nas/ /lhag pa'i lha bzhin rin chen tog /phyi dang nang gi sbyin sreg dang / /gtor ma'i las rnams rdzogs byas nas/ /rab tu gces pa'i rin chen sogs/ /bla ma'i zhabs la btud te dbul—/ /deng rjonas brtsams te dus kun du/ /bla ma bzang la rab gus dang / /thugs rje brtse ba nyer bzhag nas/ /bdag la dgongs shing gzigs par mdzod/ /'gro ba kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /smon lam rgya chen gdab par bya/ /dkyil 'khor rnam ⑤gsum rim pa bzhin/ /bsdu ba'i cho ga rgya cher bya/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi'i bye brag gis/ /mgron tshogs ma lus dgug par bya/ /bkra shis glu gar rol mo'i tshogs/ /de nyid longs spyod nye bar gnas/ /mgon pos ji ltar rnam bkod pa/ /de don gsang ba rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ /rab bsdus dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /dri med yan lag rgyas pa'i tshul/ /rnal 'byor 'jug pa'i yan lag tu/ /bstan pa'i dge bas 'gro ba rnams/ /rang gi ye shes 14byed506
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (5༷༷)ci 14—512

par sbyor ba'i tshogs kyi cho ga zhes bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba budha sa ma ya yo gī ga ṇa ④bi dhi nā ma/bod skad du/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i tshogs kyi cho ga zhes sdebya ba/ dpal mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bde chen sems dpa'i mchog /sangs rgyas sras mchog 'khor lo'i gnas/ /rnam 'phrul cho ga ston mdzad pa'i/ /sku gsung dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mchog gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog las/ /tshogs kyi cho ga bshad par bya/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde 'byung ba/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag ④nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs pas/ /kun ldan tshogs kyi 'khor lo yi⑤/ /rigs kyi bkod pa so so'i gnas/ /phun sum tshogs par bstan pa 'am/ /14—513

yang na bde ba'i gnas dag tu/ /skyed mos tshal la sogs par bsgrub/ /mar ngo'i brgyad dang bcu bzhi dang / /yar ngo'i brgyad dang bcu mtshalas gnyis/ /der ni dang po gdan bshams te/ /'jam zhing reg na bde 'gyur ba'i/ /sna tshogs pad+ma ras kyis g.yogs/ /de ni thams cad dag pa'i gdan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i snang ba bde/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i pho brang mchog /rin chen rgyan la sogs pas spras/ /dril bu rgyal mtshan mchog ldan pa'i/ /bla re dam pa bres pa na/ /rdo rje tshig dang mchog la sogs/ /glu dang sil snyan rnam par 'phrul/ /me tog bdug pa'i sbyor ba dang / /mar me dri la sogs ldan par/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog bsgrub/ /slob dpon mgon la legs zhus nas/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i rjes 'jug cing / /sangs rgyas brda dang ldan pa yis/ /me tog thogs te 'gro la bskul/ /rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad kun/ /dga' zhing dang ba'i sems bcas kyis①/ /do nub bdag gi gnas dag tu/ /tshogs kyi cho ga mdzad par gsol/ /e ma bu ni snying rje che/ /gal te lag pa'i phreng ston na/ /'du bar bya zhes smra ba yin/ /phreng ba mngon par btang byas nas/ /dam tshig la gnas brtul zhugs bzang //dpa' bo gzhan don spyod pa'o/ /de nas nub mo 'dus pa dang / /phyi nas 'dag chal dri chab chus/ /khrus byas me tog gis brgyan cing / /rnal 'byor dag chos sngags kyis sbyang / /de nas nang gi khrus byas te/ /sngags kyis bsrungs shing ④byin brlabs nas/ /dam tshig tshogs rnams bskang gso zhing / /rim bzhin nang du 'gro bar bya/ /dam tshig brda sogs brtag pa'i phyir/ /khro 14—514

bo'i rgyan ①sngon las mkhan gnyis/ /rig ④pa'i sngags brjod tho ba ①'dzin/ /bsrung ba'i don phyir sgo 'gram gnyis/ /kye rjokhro rgyal rgyan sngon dag gis mdzes/ /dam tshig rnam par spyod pa po⑤/ /dngos grub rin chen dbyug to 'dzin/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo 'du rjobar mdzod/ /mkha' mdzes rnal 'byor ma dkyil du/ /dam pa'i mtshan ldan bdag thong shig⑦ /oṃ ma hā sa ⑧ya hūṃ/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/rdo rje slob ma chen po dang / /rang gi grogs mchog lha rnams la/ /bskor zhing phyag 'tshal rang nyid kyi/ /stan la gus pa'i sems kyis 'dug /yon bdag las mkhan gang rung gis/ /sa gzhi legs bsham dri bcas chus/ /khru gang la sogs tshad mnyam pa'i/ /maṇ+ḍal rgyan dang bcas par bsham/ /rdo rje brjid ⑨gnon sngags kyis ni/ /bsang sbyang bsrung zhing byen kyis zlob⑩/ /rig pa chad dag rnam phye la/ /dkyil 'khor sngags kyis me tog dgram⑪/ /oṃ badz+ra ri khe hūṃ/ 'jig rten pa yi maṇ+ḍal ni/ /de yi 'og tu brtsam par bya/ /phyogs bzhir dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi'am/ /yang na gcig tu dgod par bya/ /dbus su rta mchog lha mo ste/ /zla gam lha mchog chen po'i gnas/ /bar khyams ⑫dang por phyogs skyong lha/ /gnyis par mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams te/ /gsum par klu rgyal 'khor bcas tshogs/ /bzhi par 'gro drug bgegs tshogs so//so so'i las dang mthun pa yi/ /tshogs pa'i rgyan rnams dgram par bya/ /mchod yon mchod tshogs ⑫rim gro dang / /nya sha la sogs bza' ba dang / /chang rtsi stsos byed phreng ba dang / /g.yon du nye bar dgod par bya/ /g.yas pa dag tu chu yi snod/ /ku sha'i chun po ④nyungs kar bcas/ /mdun du mchod yon bzed zhal dang / /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /mchod pa'i phyag 14—515

rgya'i shes tshogs rnams/ /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang po la/ /mchod pa kun gyi gtor ma'i tshogs/ /phyag rgya shes pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /'jig rten pa yi dkyil 'khor la/ /bgod ①de bsrung sbyang shis par bya/ /bsod nams tshogs kyis dag byas nas/ /srung ②ba'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /gzhi rten sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor sbyor ldan pas/ /bsgom pa'i yan lag ma nyams par/ /rigs kyi rnam par bsgom par bya/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor la dmigs shing / /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'i①/ /dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rjolas bya'o/ /chang la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams/ /mdun nas phyag tu ci rigs dbul/ /ltos shig rnal 'byor rgyan mdzes rnams/ /'di la rnam rtog yod ma yin/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams/ /rang bzhin gcig pas lhan cig bza'/ /oṃ ma hā sa ma ya/ ku ru ku ru dha ro ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ bde gshegs de ni sdig med cing / /'dod chags sogs pa'i skyon dang bral/ /gzung 'dzin dri ma rnam par spangs/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi lag gnyis kyis/ /pad+ma'i bskor ba byas nas ni/ /rol par ⑤bcas pas bza' ba bzung / /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /ji bzhin du ni 'jug par bya'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo ldan pas—/ /chang sogs rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabarjo/ /g.yo zhing 'bar ba'i gzugs can dang / /khyad par du ni bskor ba nyid/ /shel gyi gzugs kyis byin brlab cing / /thams cad bdud rtsi'i ngo bor brtag /de nyid yang dag spyod pa 'dis/ /rnal 'byor pa ni kun nas bdag /ji ltar bde bar brjod par bya/ /sgyu ma lta bu mdzes pa yi/ /'o byed sogs sbyor kun 'a da pa/ /14—516

sems can don du yang dag spyad/ /de nas mna' ni bsgags byas nas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mthun pa yi/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' pa pa/ /dam tshig dam ①pa sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam spyor ba'i/ /sdom pa nyams par khyed byed pa/ /ji snyad ②sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin/ /lha dag dang ni mi dag dang / /de bzhin rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /de dag la ni snying ring ①nas/ /snying nas khrag chen 'thungs pa yin/ /bdag gi ngo bo yongs spangs shing / /dka' thub kyis ni gzir mi bya/ /ci bde bar ni bde bar spyad/ /'di ni phyi dus sangs rgyas yin—/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod thams cad la/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /sdig med stobs kyis khyod ma 'jigs/ /dam tshig 'da' bar dka' ba'o/ /tshogs kyi dpa' bo'i ston mo las/ /slob dpon las kyi rim pa'o| /de nas khrus byas dri yi lus/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i gos dang rgyan/ /sna tshogs rnam par bgos nas rjoni/ /me tog phreng ldan kha dri zhim/ /sems can khams ni ma lus donasde/ /srid pa shin du dag bya'i phyir/ /mi 'gog chos nyid sbyor ba yis/ /mnyam pa nyid du bsgrub par bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa//rta babs bzhi yis mdzes par byasadu/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+mo sogs/ /sgo srung ⑦dang ni ldan par bya/ /rang gi lha dang 'dra ba yi/ /bud med dag ni legs bsgrubs pas/ /skal bzang rang gi phyag rgyas mtshan/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor brtag par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /sbyor ba'i dbang phyug rnam 'phrul bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal kyi lha/ /de ni rnam par 'phrul bar mdzad/ /brtan zhing grub pa'i slong byed pa/ /kun nas slong 14—517

ba'i bde ba ni/ /stong pa shin tu ①rnal 'byor yod med mthus/ /nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs ①su gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal ①bzang dpal khyod bdag /oṃ e bye ti bha ga bān rjom hā kā ⑤ru ṇi ka tri sh+ya ho rjos ma ya s+t+waṃḥdzaḥhūṃḥbaṃ hoḥ sa ma ya ⑦s+t+waṃ/de nas yang dag rab ⑧gsal bas/ /bud med dag ni bzhi rnams la/ /gar gyi ⑨phyag rgya'i mchod pa yis/ /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ uhūṃ—/ rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad grub par mdzod/ /glu yi phyag rgya 'di ni dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la gnas te/ /mchod pa ma lus byed pa yi/ /rab 'byams ⑩las la sbyor du rung / /gang dag grub par ma gyur dang / /mchod pa dag ni mi 'byor ba/ /phyag rgya 'di yis mchod byas nas⑪/ /mchod pa thams cad myur du 'grub/ /de nas ro mchog bza' btung nas/ /glu tshig sil snyan la sogs pa⑫/ /de dag mgon po rnams la dbul/ /dkyil 'khor tshogs bcas dbyer med blos/ /rdo rje bla ma chen po dang / /bdag gzhan tshogs la ⑫'dod dgus mchod/ /rnam pa mang po'i 'dod chags rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa ⑫med par 'dul skemakhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mkha' 'go sgyu mas thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul/ /te na te te hūṃ/ rnam pa mang po rab tu dga' ba'i rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul/ /14—518

hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ rnam pa mang po khro bo'i rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu ma thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul/ /ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ rnam pa mang po srog gi rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog ①sgyu mas thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul//haṃ sdeshi shwa bi shwa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa te no gapa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ phyo me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sirnyi me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma dusu tsa me tsit+t+waṃ/ sre yaḥku ru hūṃ/ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga bān⑤/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā rjome muñtsa/ badz+rī ⑦bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa 26⑧/ de nas zos shing 'thungs pa yi/ /lhag ma'i ⑨tshogs rnams kun bsdus te/ /gong du bkod pa'i gtor ⑩ma dang / /so sor byin brlabs bsngo bar bya/ /ha ho ⑪s+thāḥyi sbyor ba yis/ /bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dod lnga'i tshogs/ /mdzes pa'i phyag rgya smin mtshams gnas/ /sngags bcas mgron tshogs bsdu bar bya/ /oṃ ha nyi ru lu ru lu dzaḥ⑫hūṃ baṃ hoḥ⑫ badz+ra ḍā ki ni bh+yo/ e a ra li ⑫ho dza dza/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥspyo.ā kaḍa bhā ya/ ā kaḍa bhā pra be+e sha ya/ pra be+e sha ya/ brnya ya brnya ya/⑩ to ṣa ya/to ṣa ya/ mo ha ya/ mo ha ya/ e a ra li ⑩ho/ hri hri hri/ hūṃ las rngam chen 'bar ba'i sku ston cing / /'jig rten lha chen yab yum zhabs kyis gnon—/ /drag po'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /dbu mang spyorta skad 'tsher zhing gar mdzad pa/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od mnga' sku la rdzogs/ /khro rgyal 'khor bcas ma lus gshegs su gsol/ / 'jigs byed ⑪dbang phyug 14—519

chen po dang / /de bzhin tshangs pa brgya byin sogs/ /khyab 'jug 'dod dga'i dbang phyug dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha dang klu/ gang dag rdzu 'phrul mthu mnga' rnams/ /bran mngags g.yog dang chung mar bcas /dpa' bo'i spyan sngar dam bcas bzhin/ /rang gi dam tshig dran byos la①/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsrung ba'i ②phyir/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'od zer sngags kyis sbyang byas nas/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor mngon par gsal/ /oṃ kak+ka bye na/ basban dha na ①khaṣ+ṭhad na/ sarba duṣ+ṭan—/ ha na ha na/ gha gha ghā ta ya/ a mu ka sgyu/ shārnyi rjoku ru/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dza swā hā/ bdud rtsi bsam gtan dmigs nas ni/ /bdud rtsis kha ni dag par bya/ /oṃ gu ru tro ta khā hi/ sa ma ya bre sha khā nyi/ bhak+ṣa ⑤su gan/bhu ta k+ṣe tre pra ti stem+bha ya khā rjonyi/ lhag ma kha chu'i tshogs kyis bran/ /dgyes pa'i longs spyod rnam par rol/ /oṃ 'jig rten kun gtso mnga' mdzad pa'i/ /lha chen dregs byed stobs ldan pa/ /bde gshegs sras sogs bran mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ldan snying rje can/ /dbang phyug chen po chung mar bcas de bzhin khyab 'jug tshangs pa dang / /brgya byin 'dod dga' chung mar bcas/ /lha chen 'khor bcas tshogs rnams dang / /phyogs skyong brgyad po 'khor bcas dang / /klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang / /mkha' 'gro chen mo gsus 'dzin ma/ /dur khrod ma mo'i ⑦tshogs bcas dang / /gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad dang / /'gro ba sdug po 'khor bcas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs sogs sbyang byas nas/ /rang gi lha yi gzugs 'dzin rnams/ /gnas 'dir 'dus pa'i dam tshig can/ /mchod gtor rgyan ⑧dang bcas pa bzhes/ /dam 14—520

tshig srungs shig ①dam tshig can/ /las la sogs pa'i ④mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnal 'byor bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /las mdzad rdo rje bran bcas pas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las grub cing //theg chen gsang sngags bsrung ba dang / /nad dang gnod sogs zhi ba dang / /tshe dbang bkra shis spel ba dang / /bde legs 'bras bu grub par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭan/ ghi na ghi na/ gats+tsha hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas sna tshogs gar gyi rgya/ /dga' ①mdzes stobs kyis bsgyur bya zhing / /sna tshogs glu rnams snyan pa'i dbyangs—/ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis legs par blang rjo/ /rdo rje thal mo legs sbyar ba/ /rang gi snying gar gzhag ⑤nas su/ /sems can thams cad la dmigs te/ /smon lam rgya chen gdab par bya/ /sems can thams cad sdig med cing / /dus kun du ni bde gyur cig /sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad 'gyur ba'i/ /lam de nyid la zhugs nas kyang / /ma sgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar shog /kun kyis rig rjo'adzin bgrod byas nas/ /sku gsung 'bras bu skye 'gyur zhing / /rnal 'byor gtsug lag dam tshig la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /dkyil 'khor rim bzhin bsdu bya ste/ /ye shes lha tshogs gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig gsal mnyes bsrung bar bya/ /gzugs brnyan dben pa'i gnas su gzhag⑦ /oṃ byed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub byed/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang sems can don la dgongs/ /oṃ lhahūṃ muḥbadz+ra gats+tsha muḥ/ gsang mchod ⑧snying po dri ma med/ /tshogs gnyis gcig tu rab spyod pa⑨/ /ye shes bla ma'i rtsal rdzogs don/ /dpa' bo longs spyod spyad 14—521

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra ②he ru ka nā ma no pi ka /bod skad du—/ dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos dang dngos med rtog bral zhing / /thugs rje mdzad pa sna tshogs snang / /thabs mkhas khro ston rgyal ba'i sku/ /ma lus 'jigs la phyag 'tshal te/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i rjes 'gro ba/ /de nyid sgrub thabs cho gar bcas—/ /rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i bde skyed don①/ /cung zad 'jug pa'i don phyir bshad/ /theg mchog bubla ma bzang las byung / /yon tan stobs sogs kun nas mdzes/ /rab tu sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor mchog /'dod pa'i lha la dad mos 'dud/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs la sogs kyi/ /thabs mkhas yan lag rnam spyad pas/ /de nas ⑤goms byed las rdzogs te/ /kun du 'khor lo mthar phyin 'gyur/ /byams sogs tshad med bzhi rnams kyis/ /14—524

'gro rnams thams cad nye bar gzung / /shin tu dag pa'i gnas nyid du/ /bde ba'i stan la legs par gnas/ /yang dag dkyil 'khor bzang po nyid①/ /yang dag khrus kyi cho ga dang / /yang dag mchod rgyan gtor mar bcas/ /yang dag phyag rgya sngags sogs ldan/ /thams cad yul kun rnam dag pa'i/ /byang chub sems nyid brtan pa las/ /thugs rje nyi ma'i mtha' yas zer/ /thams cad yul kun khyab par gsal/ /yi ge hūṃ gi 'phro 'du las/ /srung sdeba'i 'khor lo rgya chen po/ /'khor lo me 'od mtshon cha'i phreng / /khro tshogs sprul bcas tshom ①rngam tshogs/ /phyogs bcur bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ /hūṃ bzhi'i phyag rgya sngags kyis bsrung / /rigs kyi yi ge mtshan mar bcas phra mo'i skur gsal 'phro 'du yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu byas te/ /gtum rngam khros pa'i cha lugs can/ /thams cad gcig tu sbyor ba'i mthus/ /dam tshig rgyal po he ru ka /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mthing ga'i bumadangs/ /'od 'bar dur khrod rgyan kyis brjid/ /khro rtags mtshan ma kun rdzogs shing / /nyams dgu'i rngam brjid tshul dang bcas/ /spyan dmar mche gatshigs khro gnyer can—/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs/ /g.yon pa ⑤snod bcud kha ṭ+wāṃ bcas/ /klu rgyal brgyad kyis nyer ④mdzes shing / /sru rnams rdo rje 'od 'bar ba khro bo'i dkyil 'khor phyogs bcur spro/ /rdo rje phreng ba phyag rgya lnga/ /rigs kyi dbu rgyan sems dpar bcas/ /gnas gsum 'od gsal dag byed pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor la gnas sku gsung thugs/ /phyogs bcur spro zhing bsdus pa'i mthus—/ /byin brlabs gnas gsum brtan par 'gyur/ /snying ga'i 'od zer rgya chen pos/ /rigs kyi khro bo kun bsdus te/ /rang gi gnas su brtan 14—525

byas nas/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub gsol ba gdab/ /phyi nang mchod pa sna tshogs kun/ /rgya chen ①spro zhing dag par dbul/ /tshad med bzhi yi phyag rgya yis—/ /sku gsung thugs su sbyor bar bya/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa'i mtshan ma la/ /sngags kyi 'khor lo spro zhing bsdu/ /oṃ shrī te ru ka tī ②swā hā/ mar me'i ④phreng ba 'khor ba'i tshul/ /yan lag rdzogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /dngos grub mtshan ma kun ston cing / /yang dag byang chub brtan rjopar 'gyur/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus pa/ /thams cad sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /ji ltar sgyu ma thams cad du/ /mthong ba dag ni reg par 'gyur/ /dmigs su yod pa ma yin te/ /de bzhin 'gro ba kun gyi tshud/ /bud med la sogs rin chen mchog/mkha' las dngos grub thams cad spyod/ /dngos po med par bdag sbyor bas/ /nam mkha' kun dang mnyam par sbyor⑤/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /shin tu bstan pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /spyod lam kun du ma nyams par/ /rnal 'byor yang dag ting 'dzin gnas/ /rnam pa mang po'i yul can 0kun/ /thabs dang shes rab rol mo'i tshogs/ /bza' btung dag pa'i ting 'dzin gyis//dkyil 'khor thams cad tshim 'gyur cing / /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen la//'gro rnams dag par nye bar sbyor/ /kun du cha lugs chu zla bzhin/ /ma gos chags pa med pa'i rgyal/ /thams cad chos rnams blang ⑦dor med/ /bya ba'i lam rdzogs mthar phyin 'gyur/ /tshe 'dir yon tan chos kun dang / /rig ⑧'dzin go 'phang mngon par brnyes/ /thams cad sbyor ba'i rgyud chen po/ /de nyid nges par bstan pa'i don/ /phyag rgya gcig pa'i sgrub thabs mchog /14—526

yang dag rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis 'jug /legs par bsdus pa'i bsod nams kyis//khams gsum thams cad bcom ldan 'das/ /stobs mchog dpal ldan he ru kur / /yang dag nyid du grol gyur cig /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po thu bo ra dza ha stis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/524 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉posnar 〉〉sa / /dpal he ru ga'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wabadz+ra/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stedo/ bya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉chen/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stananas/525 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stanang / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉thasrung / ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsam/ du〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉ka'i/⑤〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉〈ra/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉tes/526 ①〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉zur/ ②〈〈pe 〉state/ 〈〈snar 〉nyam/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉tshe/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bstan/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skospyod/ bya〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉po yul bcas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉blangs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rigs/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (502)14wa 527

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra te ru ka sā dha na ④nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal he ru ka'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po bde chen las byung ba'i/ /rigs sku ye shes kun gyi bdag /dregs ④byed rgyu 'bras 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /stobs chen khro rgyal dpal la 'dud/ /yang dag grub pa'i las gzhung girjo/ /bsnyen sgrub bzhi yi rim pa las/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dgos don 'brel pa'i sgo nas bshad/ /rtsod dus ⑤sems can gdul rjodaka' zhing / /log pa'i lam la gnas dag la/ /mdzad spyod zhi bas mi 'dul phyir/ /khro bo'i phrin las bstan pa yin/ /de nyid grub ⑦pa'i gzhung dag las⑧/ /log rtog 'khrul pas bslad pa dag /nges pa'i gzhung don rtogs bya'i phyir/ /legs bsdus bstan pa gsal ⑨bar bya/ /'jug pa'i rnal 'byor rtsal ldan dang ⑩//14—528

shes rab kyis ni blo phye nas/ /nges par brtag ①pa'i sa gzhi las/ /bla mas nges pa'i lung 'di bstan/ /snum ②pa yi ni dam tshig dang / /gtsang dang 'jigs pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /de dag goms nas nyams su blang / /grub pa'i dbang phyug phun sum tshogs/ /blo zhan shes rab chung bas ni/ /bsgrubs kyang grub par mi 'gyur te①/ /phung byed gnyi ga bsregs pas na/ /de bas gzhan du bstan pa min/ /dur khrod dang ni lha rten dang / /ma mo'i gnas la sogs 'dug nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dgos pa dag /rnam pa du mar 'grub par 'gyur/ /phyi dang nang gi rdzas bsags nas/ /rang rgyud dag pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bgegs tshogs nye bar zhi bya dang / /tshogs bsags bsrung ba'i don ched du/ /'byung po'i gtor ma btang dunas ni/ /gsang ba'i don gyi las rnams bya/ /bdag nyid rang gi lhar sbyor bas/ /lus ngag yid gsum mthu bskyed cing / /bdag dang 'gro ba sbyang byas nas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i rnam par bsam/ /snying ga'i sngags kyi 'phro 'du yis/ /dkyil 'khor mdun du bsam byas nas/ /rtse gcig sems kyis mchod sogs dang / /'gro don spyod pa rgya cher bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa/ /thugs rje che dang ldan pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lnga la sogs pa yi/ /zhi ba'i mchod pas mnyes byas te/ /bsnyen pa'i dus su goms byas nas/ /'khor bcas mchod pa rdzogs par bya /de yang spyi dang so so yi/ /sgrub pa'i bye brag rnam gnyis te/ /bsdus dang rgyas la dga' ba yi/ /dbye ba gnyis su shes par bya/ /dang por chos kyi dbyings nyid la/ /dmigs pa med pa'i don gyis bsgom/ /dngos po med par bdag sbyor bas/ /nam mkha' kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'o/ /oṃ ma hā shu ⑤n+ya tā dz+nyā na 14—529

badz+ra swa bhā wa a kophohaṃ①/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis/ /thams cad du ni khyab pa las/ /chos kun stong gsal rang bzhin med/ /mi dmigs snying rje chen po'i ngang / /oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ā kophohaṃ②/ skad cig ma yis skur gnas te/ /hūṃ gi 'od zer 'phros pa'i mthus/ /rdo rje rgya gram sa gzhi la/ /ra ba gur dang bla re dang / /phyogs bcur me 'od 'bar ba yi/ /mtshon cha'i phreng bas 'khor bar bsgom/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mkha' dbyings sna tshogs la gnas nas/ /cir yang gyur pa'i yig 'bru las/ /'od zer tshul du spros nas kyang / /ma lus nye bar ③khyab byas te/ /re zhig ④rngam pa'i tshul du dgongs/ /e las mkha' dbyings gru gsum dkar/ /bzang po'i mkha' dbyings gyen bgreng nas/ /yi las rlung dkyil gzhu yi dbyibs/ /dud kha sra mkhregs sgrol ma'i mkha'/ / re las me 'od dmar ser las gru gsum gos dkar nam mkha'i dbyings/ /⑤baṃ las chu dkyil dkar zhing byum/ /bum pas mtshan pa mā ma krirjo/ /lam las gser gyi sa gzhi ste/ /gru bzhi spyan la rdo rjes mtshan/ /khaṃ las rak+ta'i dba' klong 'khyil/ /'dod chags chen po'i rang bzhin rtags/ /shaṃ byung ke ra rus ri rab ste/ /rin chen rgyan spras rdo rjes mtshan/ /⑦de dbus spyo ⑧las gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi sgo dang sgo khyud can/ /rin chen thod pa sna tshogs dang / /nyi zla rdo rje'i rgyan gyis mdzes//dkyil 'khor zla gam gnas pa la/ /re'u mig dgu pa rdo rjes mdzes/ /sna tshogs lha mo'i phreng ba dang / /'phan ⑨gdugs rnga yab rta babs ldan/ /zhing 'phrul tshangs pa'i g.yang gzhi sogs/ /dur khrod rgyan gyis 'jigs par brgyan//rin chen ka gdung tog dang bcas/ /'dod ⑩yon sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /14—530

dkyil 'khor phyi rim ①gnas brgyad ②du/ /dur khrod shing dang zhing skyong dang / /phyogs skyong rnal 'byor mtsho dang sprin/ /klu rgyal la sogs gnas brgyad du/ /sha za 'byung po gshin rje dang / /mkha' 'gro bya khyi ①ro la sogs/ /ce spyang khro tshogs ④sgra 'byin cing / /ro ye tshogs la longs spyod mdzad/ /rang byung mchod rten dang bcas pa⑤/ /phreng ba rim gsum phyi rol gnas/ /de dbus 'khor lo'i lte ba la/ /pad+ma dregs rjobyed nyi zla'i steng / /dpal mchog dang po gnas gyur nas/ /sprul pa'i ting 'dzin la gnas mdzad/ /chos rnams thams cad rnam brtags na/ /dngos med mtshan ma kun dang bral/ /byang sems ye shes dang po'i gzugs/ /ā li zla dkyil gsal bar bsgom/ /byang sems ye shes gnyis pa'i rtags⑦/ /de steng kā li nyi mar bcas mtshan dang dpe byad gsal ba'i don/ /mdzad pa'i 'phro 'dur bcas pa'o de dag 'od du gyur pa las/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /dkar po bum pa hūṃ gis mtshan—/ /badz+ra a haṃ/ gdod ma tha ma med pa'i dbyings/ /dang po rdo rje chen po yin/ /'od zer lnga yi 'phro 'du yis/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi las mdzad nas/ /sku gsung thugs dbyings bzhugs pa las/ /'od zer phreng mdzes brjid pa'i mchog /de la sku mchog phyag rgya yi/ /sngags kyi yi ge brjod par bya/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa a/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsu ra ta s+t+waṃ/ de dag ye shes byang chub sems/ /mngon byang lnga yi bdag nyid do/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' che/ /dkar dmar zhal lnga phyag bzhi pa/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas| /'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ /rin chen rgyan dang na bza' can/ /dbu la rin chen phreng bas mdzes/ /lus kyi ba spu'i ④gnas 14—531

rnams su/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi rdul phran gnas/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ni/ /gnas lnga dag tu gtugs ①bya ste/ /sngags kyis bde ②gshegs thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs sogs rnam par bsam①/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ④ya wāka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kopho⑤haṃ/ rang 'od yum dang 'khril pa yi—/ /gsang rjoganas hūṃ dang ās ⑦brgyan te/ /ye shes rdo rje phaṭa dang bcas//rtse mo nor bu 'bar bas mtshan/ /rnam thar pad+ma e dkyil can/ /mdog ser lte ba ze'u 'bru dmar/ /sa ma ya sogs brdas bskul nas/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ⑧rol pa bya/ /oṃ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a la la la la ho/ bde ba chen po'i 'od zer kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mnyes mdzad nas/ /'gro ba'i lus ngag yid gsum sbyang / /sku gsung thugs kyi rgyan gyis brjid/ /thams cad 'od kyis be+er bsdus nas/ /stong gsum til gong ⑨'bru 'dra rnams/ /sangs rgyas drug gi gsung du gyur/ /ba spu'i bu ga kun du thim/ /thugs ka'i gnas su zhugs pa dag /bde ba chen po'i gnas nas babs/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba'i mes⑩/ /sku dang bcas pa 'od du gyur/ /sngon gyi goms shugs lha mo bzhis/ /phyogs bzhi nas ni bskul mdzad de/ /stong pa shin tu rnal 'byor yod med mthu/ /nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal ⑪bzang dpal khyod bdag /ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud bskul nas/ /thugs rjes 'gro la gzigs mdzad de/ /'bras bu'i sems dpa' snga ma bzhin/ /cho ga gsum gyis ⑫gsal bar bya/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje se gol phyag rgyas ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar 14—532

mdzad—/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa// /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas rgyanabye / /shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo las/ /khro bor de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ /khro bo'i tshul can khros pas kyang / /'jig rten gsum dag sreg byed na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad khros pa yis/ /khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos/ /de nas sna yi rtse mo la/ /yid ni yang dag brtan par gzung / /sna yi 47dbugs ring dro ba lasarngo/ /rgyal ba'i spyor ba'i phyag rgya 'byung / /bcom ldan de nyid rnal 'byor pas/ /rdo rje khro bor bsgyur nas phyung / /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa ma ya teḥsarba duṣ+ṭa/ sa ma ya mu dra pra 7sgo dza ka hūṃ phaṭa/ snga ma las ni gnas gyur te7//bskal pa'i me dpung 'khrigs pa bzhin/ /khrag 'thung mthing nag 'jigs pa'i skushe—/ /'bar ba chen po'i 'od zer can/ /zhal g.yas zhi ba'i rang bzhin dkar/ /dbus ma mthing nag 7nag po'i zhal/ /g.yon pa rmongs byed ser po ste/ /rgyab ma chags mdzad dmar po'o/ /smin mtshams khro gnyer glog bzhin 'gyuchi spe/ /spyan gsum khro gnyer mche gcigs zhal/ /dbu skra sma ra ser nag 1nyemadzes/ /spu rnams rdo rje gyen du 'khyil/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba 7'jigs su rung / /dgod 6dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi—/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gar thabs can/ /g.yas g.yon dang pos rdo rje dang / /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bur bcas/ /de 'og gnyis kyis 'jigs byed kyi/ /pags pa bklubs ⑫kyi tshul du bskoram/ /gsum pa gnyis na mda' dang gzhu/ /g.yas kyi bzhi pas dung khrag 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi bzhi pas thod pa ru/ /snying chen po yis bkang ba'o/ /la lar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /mthing nag 1 14—533

'jigs pa'i me 'od can/ /g.yas nga/sa 1ba dan gsum pa phyar / /rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar phreng can/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bur bcas/ /thod pa gang ba g.yon pa na / /'bar ba chen po skra 'bar ba/ /thod pa mang po'i dbu rgyan can/ /'jigs pa chen po'i dus ltar drag /dur khrod bzhin du rab tu 'jigs/ /zhal rnams sna tshogs 'gyur ba dang / /'bar ba'i lta bas gar byed pa/ /rdo rje rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /dril bu'i sgra ni gsil ba yis/ /thams cad phab nas slar yang ni/ /thal bar gyur nga/'ang 'tsho bar byed/ /gti mug dbang mdzad theg chen brgyan/ /glang chen ko rlon stod g.yogs mnabs/ /'dod chags gzhan gyi rgol ba'i tshogs/ /tshar bcad stag gi pags pa yin/ /nga rgyal thugs rjes 'gro sgol rtags/ /'jigs byed chen po'i tsha ra ma/ /zhe sdang gzung 'dzin rnam dag pas/ /gnas brgyad sbrul kyi phreng ba can/ /chags pa gnyis dang ldan pa yis / /sgu la rak+ta'i thig les brgyan/ /phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa yis/ /thal ba'i tshom bus mtshan pa yin/ /byang sems gnyis med 5dri bral don/ /zhag gi ri mos spras pa'o/ /phrag dog sku gsung rgyan ldan pas/ /thod phreng thod dang se ral thogs/ /dregs byed zil gyis mnan pa'i phyir/ /nyi zla snyan kyi gong rgyan byas/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yi/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgyar ldan byas te/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i spyor ba yis/ /bdag gi slar ni bdag nyid bya/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ thugs gsal nyi ma la gnas pa'i/ /ye shes sems dpa' dī6ཿdang bcas/ /'od zer 'phro 'du'i spyor ba yis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ /lha mos bdud rtsi'i bum pas dkris7/ /thod phreng la gnas rigs lngas brgyan/ /lag pa shin tu brkyang ba yis/ /mdzub mo 74—534

gnyis ni mdud par snabacing / /gung mo mthe bo'i rtse mo can/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su bsgyur/ /bteg nas khro gnyer lag bzhag ste/ /hi bcas dbang bskur sngags brjod bya/ /yab yum mkha' gsang hi dang as / /rdo rje pad+mar bskyed byas nas/ /liṅga 'greng ba rang byung ba/ /brla yi dbus su bsgom byas nas/ /liṅga pad+ma 4byin brlabs te/ /khrag 'thung 5'dra ba'i gzugs skye'o/ /byang chub sems de kun du dgod/ /ma lus nye bar khyab byas nas—/ /'dod par bya ba 6rab tu mnyes/ /'od 'dus 7thog ma'i gzugs la gzung / /gsang gnas so so'i gdan dag la/ /chos kyi snying po'i lha gnas bskyed/ /trīḥ las dpal chen he ru ka /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su dgod/ /s+thāḥlas lha mo go rī ma/ /snoḥlas de bzhin tso rī ma/ /dzhaiḥlas lha mo pra mo yin/ /sto las be+et+ta 9phyogs bzhir dgod/ /mtshams su hūṃ phaṭa las byung ba'i/ /lha mo puk+ka la sogs bzhi/ /mo khaṃ yo ram̐ las byung ba'i/ /phyi rol mda' 'dzin la sogs bskyed/ /a ā saṃ aḥbazhi po las/ /lha mo me tog la sogs rnams/ /dzaḥt+t+waṃ baṃ hoḥyi ge las/ /sgo bzhir rta mgrin 'phang mtho sogs/ /bha ga la ni liṅga gzhag— /liṅga rdo rjer byin brlabs nas/ /khrag 'thung 'dra ba'i sku gnyis ni/ /spro zhing rang la thim par bya/ /tsū badz+ra gu h+ya sidhi sapa ra ma yo ge shwa ri tweḥ / go rī dkar ser zhi ba'i mdangs/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad brjid pa'i stongs—/ /g.yon brkyang gar gyis bzhugs mdzad cing / /mda' bzhi dus gcig bkang ba la/ /tshangs pa'i mgo bzhi sbyangs pa ste/ /'phro 'du dang bcas mdun du bzhugs/ /hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi shwa ri kha ṭ+wāṃ gi ma hā badz+ra ka pā la mā la ku ru ku ru p+lu dhīḥ/ tso ri dmar po drag po'i 771—mi 35

zhal / /g.yon pas lcags kyu kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khyud/ /g.yas pa'i gung mos rtsibs brgyad bstod/ /g.yas bteg lkugayon stobs lho yi phyogs/ /hūṃ badz+ra nā rā ya ni dz+ra2/ pra mo dbu gnyis gong ma phag /'og ma dmar po phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse gsum bsnams— / /g.yon gyi dang pos kham phor 'chang / /'og gnyis khu tshur so sor 'chang / /'khor lo 'dzin cing bteg pa'i tshul/ /g.yas brkyang stabs zibacas nub phyogs su/ /rmongs tshul mdog dmar pad+ma la/ /hūṃ badz+ra pa tā ke dza/ bait+ta chomadog dkar slong tshul gzigs/ /g.yas na 5kham phor bdud rtsi'i gang / /g.yon pa ba dan gsum pa mdzad/ /dga' bzhin byang gi phyogs su gnas/ /hūṃ badz+ra ha ri ni ma ṭa/ puk+ka drag po gar byed tshul/ /bol bzhi brla dpung dkar ba la/ /lus sbubs kyenya bzhi dmar ba ste/ /phyag mchog lo ma sngon po 'dra/ /g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar/ /g.yon pas dpag bsam lcug ma 'dzin/ /gar gyi gzugs thabs 'gyur dang bcas / /me mtshams 'khor lo'i stan la gnas/ /hūṃ badz+ra shu le gra rnyi ta ma ta/tsan+dan gyen du dbugs 'byin tshul/ /gzhan gyi srog 'phrog kha dog gnag /g.yas pas ra skyes rdo rjes mtshan/ /rlung 'thor rdo rje khu tshur 'dzin/ /g.yon pas tri shul gar dang bcas/ /bden bral 'khor lo'i stan la gnas/ /hūṃ badz+ra ki shi tshin+da 9ma ta/ ghasma ro ldan tshul du gzigs/ /ser nag g.yas pas ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon pa me thabs g.yon brkyang tshul/ /rlung mtshams 'khor lo'i stan la gnas/ /hūṃ badz+ra pe mā la pā she ma ta/ sme sha kun gyi las mdzad ma//khrag 'thung dpal dang 'dra ba ste/ /g.yas pas rdo rje dung khrag gsol/ /g.yon gyis thod pa zhags par bcas/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ se ral kha/ /dbang ldan 14—536

'khor lo'i rtsibs la gnas/ /kun kyang thod phreng sbrul dang bcas/ /zhing lpags rlon pa gos su gsol/ /gdan ni pad+ma sna tshogs la/ /zhing dang nyi mas mtshan pa'o/ /ho badz+ra ra ti paṃ/ mda' 'dzin dkar mo mda' dang gzhu//me mtshams phyogs kyi gru chad 1la/ /oṃ ma hā ra ta badz+re ho/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ser mo kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rdo rje dril can bden bral mtshams/ /oṃ badz+ra lo tsa ne+e yo ya/ 'khor lo 'dzin ma dmar ser mo/ /rtsib brgyad 'dzin pa rlung gi phyogs/ ram̐ ma hā shrī badzi hi/ sna tshogs ba dan ljang gu la/ /sna tshogs 'phan dril dbang ldan mtshams—/ /ā ཿbadz+ra puste/ me tog ser mo me tog snod/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa bar khyams me/ /ā ཿbadz+ra dhū pi / spos me sngon mo rdo rje pog /khyams kyi bden bral pad gnas pa'i/ /āḥ4badz+ra ā lo ke/ mar me dmar mo rdo rje sgron/ /bar khyams thurlung phyogs pad+mar gnas/ /ā ཿbadz+ra gadhe/ dri chab ljang gu dag byed 'thor7/ /bar khyams dbang ldan pad+mar gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ/ shar sgo rta mgrin 'phang mtho dkar/ /g.yas na rta gdong g.yon lcags kyu/ /oṃ badz+ra pā she hūṃ/ lhor 9sgor phag gdong sngon mo ste/ /g.yas pas mche ba g.yon zhags 'dzin/ /oṃ badz+ra shrī 1 kha le paṃ/ nub sgor snang byed dmar mo ni/ /phyag gnyis nyi zla lcags sgrog 'dzin/ /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi 7 hoḥ—/ byang sgor thal byed mdog ljang gu/ /sangs rgyas gzugs dang dril bu'o//lha mo 'di dag thams cad kyang / /rin chen rgyan dang na bzas bklubs1 / /sku mdzes khros pa'i mtshan ma nga'adzin/ /sgo ba cung zhig 'gying muba'i tshul/ /kun mkhyen ye shes las grub phyir/ /'khor lo'i lha rnams thams cad kyi/ /mig la sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /rna bar rdo rje nyi ma yin/ /kha la pad+ma 14—537

gar dbang phyug /sna la rta mchog rol pa ste/ /lus ni rdo rje te ru ka /yid la rdo rje sems dpa' gnas/ /gnas gsum phyag rgya'i tshogs ldan zhing / /thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' gnas/ /rang rig dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas / /dbang bsgur rigs kyi mtshan ma bsam/ /gnyis med 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ slong ba dal gyis bskul mdzad cing / /mdzes pa'i phyag rgya gyen du bgreng / /smin mtshams dbus su gtad par bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ shrī 1he ru ka /ma hā badz+ra/ ā kaṣ+ṭha 2ya/ ā kazlu ya/ pra be+e sha ya pra be+e sha ya/ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ badz+ra ḍā ki rgo/ z-i da ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ shrī te ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭi sa ma ya mu ḍa pra ban tsa —kra hūṃ phaṭa/ ye shes can gyi spyod yul nas/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas/ /sems can don slad dam tshig dgongs/ /gnas 'dir brtse phyir gshegs su gsol/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya 5g.yas nas bskor/ /gar bcas thal mo lan gsum brdab/ /oṃ e bye hi bha ga bān/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ ru lu 6ru lu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ7/ e bye hi/ dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ shrī te ru ka /e bye hi/dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ e ā ra yi ho/ hri tri hri/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs he ru ka /chos sgu zhi ba'i ngang las kyang / /gzugs sku 'jigs tshul bstan du gsol/ /thugs rje che la thabs mkhas pas/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ /tshogs rje tshogs bdag dpal dang ldan/ /tshogs kyi slob dpon gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes rtogs pa'i khyad par las/ /sprul pa mang po'i tshogs dang gshegs/ /thod phreng phyag rgya bcings pa las/ /g.yas nas rim bzhin bskor bar bya/ /74—du38

oṃ shrī te ru ka ma hā badz+ra/ sarba duṣ+ṭan/ sa ma ya mu dra/ pra pe sha ya/ shrī te ru ka hūṃ phaṭa/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ shrī he ru ka /ma hā badz+ra/ sarba duṣ+ṭan/sa ma ya mu dra/ pra wan 1tsakra/ shrī te ru ka t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ bde gshegs pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir/ 'gro ba ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /don gyi dbang du dgongs nas kyang / /'khor bcas ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje thal mo bskyed nas kyang / /sor mo bsgol te bskyod par bya/ /oṃ shrī te ru ka /ma hā badz+ra sa ma ya hi/ sa/rba dubye 2na/ sa ma ya mu dra/ pra ban tsakra hūṃ/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ sems can don phyir nan tan mchog bskyed cing //ye shes thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang / /mi gnyis don phyir dngos grub mchog gi gnas/ /bdag la stsal 5zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings pa las/ /mthe bong mthe'u / chung so sor bsgreng / /oṃ shrī he ru ka /ma hā badz+ra/ sarba dubye 7na/ sa ma ya rdaṣ+ṭa/ a pabye pa ya hūṃ phaṭa / che mchog mnyam sbyor 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /thugs rje khros pas gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /gsang sngags rmad byung drag po'i phrin las rnams / /lhun kyis grub par byin kyis brlab tu gsol/ /dam tshig phyag rgya rnam gsum ni/ /rim bzhin bcings te bskul bar bya/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dṛ sh+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dṛ sh+ya sa ma ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra gra h+ya dṛ sh+ya sa ma ya phaṭa/dam tshig sa la bzhes pa yi / /dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin ma bsrungs sam/ /grub pa'i mchog dag ma stsal na// /sgu gsung thugs dang 'gal ba'o/ / zhig par gyur par gdon mi za/ /zil gnon bsrung zhing bsdigs 1pa'i phyir/ /las kyi phyag rgya rnam gsum bcing / /1 4—539

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥlku/ shrī te ru ka /ma hā badz+ra/ sarba duṣ+ṭan/ sa ma ya mu dra/pra ban tsakra/ bag sha ya/ bag sha —ya/ bi t+t+waṃ sa ya/ bi t+t+waṃ sa ya/he bha ga bān/ bu ta k+ṣe tiṭaṃ ༄pā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sku gsung thugs su bdag sbyor bas / /pho brang dkyil 'khor rang las sprul/ /nga ni bdud kyi bdud bdag ste / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas ngas bsdus pa'os/ /oṃ shrī ka ra mu ka sha ra yā ya na maḥ/ oṃ shrī rā ga sa ma yā ya na maḥ/ oṃ shrī badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga pra dz+wa snal yā ya na maḥ/ oṃ shrī badz+ra garnya dhe 3pra dzā la yā ya na maḥ/ a ti pu ho/ pra ti pu (ho / sarba ta thā ga ta/ ban+ta rna kā ro ya mi/ ma hā yo gī ni/ a la la ho/oṃ bdag med phyogs bral don dam thugs chud cing / /byams dang snying rjes dgra zin mi mnga' yang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir dus las mi 'da' ba'i/ /'jigs byed he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i lus can gar 1rnga yang thogs med cing / /'dod dgur sgyur nyu5ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che/ /ma srid mubyams ma'i tshul gyis grogs mdzad pa'i / /phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /dam tshig la sdang rnam sbyang phyir/ /dur khrod gar gyi phyag rgya gsal/ /sangs rgyas khro byung khro ba tshini/ /thal bar 'jig ༷pa'i mchog yin te/ /sems dpa' sngon po 'bar ba can/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dmar po snang / /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu 'khrol ba'i sgrar bcas pa/ /gos chen po dang bklubs 7pa che/ /sha chen po dang sbrang rtsi che/ /dur khrod kun gyi 'byung po che/ /phyag rgya dpal ldan dbang phyug mchog /shin tu khro gtum gdug pa yi/ /sems can khams ni rnam sbyang zhing / /'di ni 14byed540

dpal ldan he ru ka'i/ /rdo rje rgya chen dbang phyug mchog /se ral kha yi tshul dag tu/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la rgyab brten bcas/ /lag pa g.yon par thod pa thogs/ /g.yas pa ba dan gsum pa byas/ /nam mkha'i phyag rgya rnal 'byor pa/ /nam mkha' kun du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bud med la sogs rin chen mchog /dngos po thams cad mkha' 1las 'byin/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi spyor ba yis /bde ba dbab pa'i gar byed pa/ /skyil mo krung ni phyed bcas la/ /rkang pa rang gi brlas mnan pa'o/ /zhi dang drag po rmongs pa'i mchog /dga' ba'i gar byed sgyu mar bcas/ /shi ba'i ro sdang bsgyur ba yis/ /bde ba'i phyag rgya rab tu gnas/ /zhi dang drag po rmongs byed dang / /gyen du dbugs 'byin gar byed lus/ /lta ba'i phyag rgya grub pa'i mchog /gsang ba'i sbyor ba bde mchog go/ /tshangs pa chen po'i mgo dang ni/ /de bzhin 'jig rten gsum las rgyal/ /de bzhin sa las 'dren pa dang / /rang gi phyag rgya'i tshul bstan dang / /dur khrod dag gi gar byed dang / /de bzhin rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang / /rab tu 'jigs pa bsreg pa'i me/ /las kyi phyag rgyar rab tu gnas / /gzigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyur ba'i rgyas thob la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'o byed 'khyud pas rmongs mdzad de/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bde ba'i mchod ston kun gsol la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bde mchog ngo mtshar bstan tu gsol/ /rgyab btab rmongs byed mnabs su gsol/ /bde mchog ngo mtshar bde bar bzhugs—/ /hūṃ a la la la la ho snang bar mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bde mchog sgyu mas sprul/ /dam tshig dag la 'jug tu gsol/ /nyon mongs kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /ma lus bdag la mnabs su gsol/ /nyon mongs thams cad 14—541

bsal bar mdzod/ /rdo rje thal mo gyen du dbye/ /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug /mthe bong gnyis kyi mche ba gcigs/ /'jigs pa'i rdo rje gnod sbyin ma'o/ /yi ge brgya pa dang ldan pa'i/ /dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgya ni/ /lha rnams kun gyi gnas dag tu/ /sngags dang spyor te bskul bar bya/ /oṃ ba na dzi/ pe nu su ra ta/ ti pu pa ra mu/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ sa ma ya yo gi sed+dhi āḥ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad grub par mdzod/ /a la la ste mchod par 'bul/ /a la la ste dam tshig skongs4/ /a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ /a la la ste dngos grub stsol/ /dgyes mnyam longs spyod mchog la rol/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga puste pu dhū pe dhu/ ā 5lo ke dhīḥ/ gadhe shaṃ/ badz+ra khāgye hūṃ/ badz+ra gī ti trīḥ/badz+ra dri 6h+ye aḥ/ a la la la la ho/ bde bar gshegs pa khro rgyal gtso/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes kyi/ /srid pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ/sarba tad khaṃ uṅga te/ spa ra ṇa hi 7rma ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ 'byung ba lnga las thams cad 'byung / /rang las ma byung gang yang med/ /gtsang sme 9dri rtog kun bral ba'i/ /bdud rtsi byang chub sems chen pos/ /bdag sogs gnyis med mchod pa'i phyir/ /mnyam pa chen po'i rgyan la rol/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūṃ/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāka sedhi āḥ/ tsit+ta sernyi hūṃ/oṃ shrī he ru ka i rda dhū pa puṣ+pe/ 1 dī pa/ gan+dha/ ba bo 7ta/ pra tīts+tsha ho/14byed542

— sdeshri bha ga bān/ kha kha kha/ khā hi khā hi khā hi/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra/ ā 2be+e sha ya/ ā/ be sha ya/ pra be+e sha ya/ pra be+e sha ya/ pra tīts+tsha ho/ shrī bān/ kha kha kha/ khā hi khā+e hi khā hi/ sgog pa dpa' bo mi sdug 'jigs su rung / /dgod dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed pa dang / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la sogs pa'i/ /sgu'i dngos po shin tu bsgyur ba yi4/ /gar byas grub po rna'/ 'byor pa/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gtso bo che /bza' 5ba la sogs snying po can/ /rma sa la so/gas bro mchog ྾/ /me tog la sogs tsan+dan phreng / /bzang dgur dbul lo bzhes su gso'// /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par brjod/ /oṃ shin tu brgyan pa'i rigs dang mtshan ldan mchog /bkra shis dbyangs dang gar gyis bskyod pa yis//lha mo rdul snyed phyogs bcur spro byas nas/ /byang sems bde ba'i mchod pa'i rnam par rol/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ ma hā su kha bo bye tsit+ta a la la la la ho/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan drangs te/ /dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru/ /zhing chen gsar snying 7snyi rar bcas/ /dmar gyi ar+gha rgya mtsho bskyil/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /ma lus bzhes nas bsnams 9su gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ shrī te ru ka /ma hā badz+ra/ sarba duṣ+ṭan/ sa ma ya mu dra/mā ra kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ z-i da ya pi pa hūṃ phaṭa/ nga ni za byed chen po ste/ /khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang / /gdul ka ba dag gdul bya'i phyir/ /sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ pobaṃ hoḥ/ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sa 74—543
