ma ya/ ma hā rma sa1/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā tsit+ta/ ma hā ba su ta/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho/ kha kha kha/ le le le/ hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ bh+yo/ ko ta sha /ko ta pa—/ ko ta ko ta/ ba sa pa/ ki ra rā ga /ko la sha /ko la ba/ ko la ko la ba/ ka la ba/ sh+tsatha/ rnam dag sgrib sbyang srid gsum skyon bral zhing / /ston ka'i zla gsal dri med zhal mnga' ba /bcom ldan bde gshegs dri med rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbyings/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yab/ /shes rab lha mo rigs kyi yum rnams dang //phyag rgya gtum chen rngam pa'i tshogs la sogs/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi zhing rnams rdzogs/ /dgyes shing shārol pa'i dus mchod 6sbyar ba 'di/ /bzhes te a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra i sa hūṃ/ be+e sa hūṃ/ sa ma ya bag sha 7hūṃ/ ru lu ru lu /hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ pra ti dzaḥhūṃ 9baṃ hoḥ/ye shes mnyam nyid chos sku dag pa las/ /log rtog dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste/ /bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs ngo bor smin/ /de bzlog don du rgyal ba'i dam mnos pas / /rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs dang 1ci 'gal ba/ /thugs rje'i ngang can rnams la bzod par gsol/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 7dpal chen 1rtete ru ka /khyod kyi thugs rje nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa yis/ /'gro la brtser dgongs tshangs par sprul du gsol/ /bdag cag dam tshig 'di la mngon du zhugs pa rnams/ /bcad gtubs lus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /grib mas phog thupa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa/ /sku yi phyogs tsam mthong bas mod la 'tsho ba dang / /gzi mdangs lus la 'jug pa bye ba stong phrag gitsha/ /'od kyis phog pas 'jig 14byed5 4sgyu

rten khams su snang ba dang / /lus ngag sems dang tshe ni rdo rje rab gnas te/ /re 0na thams cad dus 'dir grub par mdzad du gsol/ /ye shes sems dpa'i sngags 'khor lo/ /lha rnams kun gyi gnas zhugs pa/ /yan lag rnam gsum ldan byas te/ /gsal ba gnyis kyi sgo nas brtsam/ /dang po rten dang brten pa'i sngags/ /'khor lo'i tshul ldan shes rab thabs①/ /yi ge mtshan ma sku yi gnas/ /bgrang dang bgrang ba las 'das pa'o/ /rtse gcig gnas su 'khor ba dang / /langs dang rgyu dang 'phro ba las/ /mchod bskul las mdzad bsdu byed cing / /dkyil 'khor gsal bar gyur ba'o/ /las kyi sbyor ba snekun sbyor zhing / /dbyangs drug blangs pas don drug gsal/ /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ—/ thun mong gi snying po phrin las kun la 'jug pa'i yi ge 'bru brgyad pa'o/ /so so'i las la snyoms 'jug nas/ /rang gi mtshan ma sngags dang bcas/ /'phro 'dus rang gi las mdzad cing / /sku gsung thugs ldan bzlas par bya/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra sa ma ya hi/ sarba duṣ+ṭhan dze+es ya mu dra pra ba rjodza ka hūṃ phaṭa/khyad par gyi snying po rtsa ba'i sngags yi ge nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o/ /sngags gzhan rim bzhin gsal ldan pas/ /go rims 'khrul med bzlas brjod bya/ /las rdzogs mchod bstod bskul bya zhing / /rang gi gnas su bsdu bar bya/ /mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor kun kyi mchog /don dam bde ba chen po'i sku/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes sku/ /lha nyid brtson pas bsgom par bya/ /gzhan yang thig le'am phra mo dag /lha dang dkyil 'khor rnam dag gi/ /mtshan mas dmigs pa sbyang byas te/ /chos sku'i phyag rgya chen por gnas/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal byas nas/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pas grub byed pa'i/ /tshogs kyi 14—545

dga' bde'i longs spyod kyis/ /rnal 'byor tshogs kun mnyes byas so1/ /rta mchog mkha' 'go'i tshogs bcas pa/ /lhag ma'i mchod pas mnyes byas nas//rang gi las la sbyar byas te/ /dngos grub don phyir mtshams su gzhag2 /gang zhig thun bzhi la sogs par/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid bsgoms pas ni/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor rim bzhin bsdu//slar nyid sbyor ldan bsrung byas te/ /spyod lam rnal 'byor gnas par bya/ /tshogs 'gyur spyod lam bya ba yis/ /dus kun du ni 'go don brtsam/ /sa stengs 'gro la grags pa yis/ /'gro la 4thugs rje rnam dag ston/ /rnam bkod rgya mtsho 'khrug 5'dra las/ /bde ba'i grol lam stong 6gsal mdzad/ /srin bus gong khyer gsal min yang / /dman rnams don phyir cung zad zhig /sgrub don dam pa'i gzhung gsal byas/ /grags sogs ngan rtog blos ma yin/ /thugs rje'i dgongs mdzad ji lta bzhin/ /ngal ba las byung nyi zer gyis/ /khams gsum mun sogs sel 7mdzad nas/ /yang dag grub pa'i 'bras thob shog /dpal he ru ka'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po t+t+waṃ mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya 8ka ra sirnya dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de lha rin po ches bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //14—546

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī he ru ka sā dha na/ bod skad du/ dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /bde chen las byung 'gro ba'i mgon/ /ye shes sku rigs kun gyi dngos//rgyu 'bras dregs sogs sne'ajoms mdzad pa'i/ /khro rgyal stobs chen dpal la 'dud—/ /yang dag grub pa'i las gzhung gis/ /bsnyen sgrub ①bzhi yi tshul 'jug parjo/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor rnam 'phrul bcas/ /dgos 'dod du'abyel pa'i sgo nas bshad/ /rtsod dus log pa'i stobs rgyas pa'i/ /gdul ①dka' rgyun srang shing me ltar/ /mdzad spyod zhi bas mi thul bar/ /thugs sprul shugs kyis las bstan mdzad/ /de nyid sgrub gzhung phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /bdud rtsi bcud bral 'khrul rtog slad/ /des gzhung don rtogs spyod sgo gsal/ /tshul gyis legs bsdus bstan pa dbye/ /'jug pa'i rnal 'byor rtsal 'chang ba/ /14—550

shes rab don ni blo phye nas/ /nges par brtags pa'i sa gzhi la/ /bla ma nges pas lung 'di bstan/ /snum pa yi ni dam tshig dang ①/ /gtsang dang 'jigs pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /de dag goms nas nyams su blang / /sgrub pa'i dbang phyug phun sum tshogs/ /blo zhan shes rab chung bas ni/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur ste/ /phung ②byed gnyi ga bsregs pas na/ /de bas gzhan du bstan pa min/ /dur khrod dang ni lha rten dang / /ma mo'i gnas la sogs 'dug na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dgos ④pa dag /rnam pa du ma 'grub par 'gyur/ /phyi dang nang gi rdzas bsags nas/ /rang rgyud sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bgegs tshogs nye bar zhi bya dang / /tshogs bsags bsrung ba'i don ched du/ /'byung po'i gtor ma btang nas ni/ /gsang ba don kyi las rnams bya/ /bdag nyid rang gi lhar sbyor rjol/ /lus ngag yid gsum mthu bskyed cing / /gnas gsum 'gro ba sbyang byas nas/ /rang bzhin rnam dag lha yi sku/ /rnam gsum sems dpa'i 'phro 'du yis⑤/ /dkyil 'khor mdun gyi zla dkyil gzhagarjo /rtse gcig sems kyis mchod sogs dang / /'gro don spyod pa rgya chen bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor gsal ⑦zhing / /rdo rje se gol gtogs pa'i mthus/ /thams cad 'dus pa khro bo'i sku/ /thugs sngags mtshon cha'i tshogs spro mdzad/ /rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba gur/ /bla re mtshon cha me 'od 'phro/ /'khor los ⑧sgyur ba gdan bcas la/ /rigs kyi khro bo rab 'jigs pa'o/ /dang po chos kyi dbyings nyid la/ /dmigs pa med pa'i don kyis bsgom/ /dngos po med par bdag sbyor bar⑨/ /nam mkha' kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'o/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa a kopho⑩haṃ/ chos kyi 14—551

dbyings kyi ye shes kyis/ /thams cad kun la'ang khyab par bsam chos kun stong gsal rang bzhin med/ /mi dmigs snying rje chen po'i ngang oṃ dharma jo tu swa bhā wa byed kolha①haṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mkha' dbyings sna tshogs la gnas nas②/ /cir yang gyur pa'i yig 'bru las/ /'od zer tshud du spros nas kyang / /ma lus nye ba khyab byas te/ /re zhing rngam pa'i tshud du dgongs/ /e las mkha' dbyings gru gsum dkar/ /bzang po'i mkha' dbyings gyen bgreng nas/ /yi las rlung dkyil gzhu yi dbyibs/ /dung kha sra mkhregs sgrol ma'i mkha'/ /baṃ las chu dkyil dkar zhing byum/ /bum pas mtshan pa mā ma tī/ /lo las gser gyi sa gzhi ste/ /gru bzhi spyan ma rdo rjes mtshan/ /khaṃ las rak+ta'i dba' klong 'khyil/ /'dod chags chen po'i rang bzhin rtags/ /ka byung keng rus ri rab ste/ /rin chen rgyan spras rdo rjes mtshan/ /ram̐ las me tog dmar ser 'bar/ /gru gsum ras mtshan gos dkar dbyings①/ /dbus su spyo 0las gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi sgo khang sgo khyud can/ /rin chen thod pa sna tshogs mkhregs/ /nyi zla rdo rje'i rgyan gyis mdzes—/ /pad gdugs rnga yab rta babs ldan/ /'dod yon sna tshogs rgyan kyis mdzes/ /dkyil 'khor zla gam ⑤sgo can la/ /re'u cha dgu pa rdo rje rjophreng //rin chen ka ⑦gdung rdo rje tog /sna bdun mchod pa'i rgyan phreng tshogs/ /zhing sprul tshangs pa'i g.yang gzhi sogs/ /dur khrod rgyan gyis 'jigs par brgyan—/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim gnas brgyad du/ /dur khrod zhing dang zhing skyong dang / /phyogs skyong rnal 'byor mtsho dang sprin/ /klu rgyal de dag gnas brgyad du/ /sha za 'byung po gshin rje dang / /mkha' 'gro bya khyi ro langs 14—552

sogs—/ /ce spyang khro sogs sgra 'byin cing / /ro yi tshogs la longs spyod mdzad—/ /rang 'byung mchod rten dang bcas pa/ /phreng ba rim gsum phyi rol gnas/ /dkyil 'khor dbus kyi lte ba la/ /pad gdan dregs byed nyi zla'i steng / /dpal mchog dang po gnas gyur nas/ /'phrul ①pa'i ting 'dzin la gnas mdzad/ /chos rnams thams cad rnam brtags na/ /dngos med mtshan ma kun rtog bral/ /zla dkyil ā li gsal ba dang / /nyi dkyil kā li gnas pa dag /spro dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /mtshan bzang dpe byad gsal ba'i don/ /thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa las/ /'od dpung kha dog sna lnga nyid/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /dkar po bum par hūṃ gis mtshan/ /gdod ②ma tha ma med pa'i dbyings/ /dang po'i rdo rje chen po yin/ /badz+ra a hi①/'od zer drug gi 'phro 'du yisarjo/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi las mdzad nas/ /sku gsung thugs dbyings zhugs pa las/ /'od zer phreng mdzes brjid pa'i mchog /de las sku mchog phyag rgya che/ /sngags kyi 'khor los gsal bar byas//ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsu ra ta s+t+waṃ/ de dag ye shes byang chub sems/ /mngon byang lnga yi bdag nyid do/ /bde gshegs rigs kun rdo rje'i dngos/ /nyon mongs dri bral chags pa'i bzhin/ /g.yas sngo g.yon dmar rgyab zhal ser/ /phyag bzhi rdo rje rtse lnga bsgyings/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ba dan dril/ /'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ /rin chen rgyan sogs na bza' bklubasarjo/ /thor tshugs mtshan dpe phyag rgyas spras/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i cho ga ni/ /gnas lnga dag tu gtugs rjobyas te/ /sngags kyis bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs sogs rnam par bsam/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta gu ṇa ⑦14—553

karma—/ badz+ra swa bhā wa āX kolhahaṃ①/ lus kyi ba sru'i gnas rnams su/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi rdul phran gnas/ /mkha' dbyengs dbang phyug phyag rgya yis//gnas kun byen kyis brlab ④par bya/ /oṃ dharma jo ①tu swa dh+wa ba ā kolhahaṃrjo/rang gi 'od gsal phyag rgya yumarjo/ /'khril pa'i phyag rgya hūṃ las brgyan/ /ye shes rdo rje rtse lngas phaṭa/ /rin chen zur brgyad 'bar bas mtshan/ /rnam thar pad+ma e dkyil can/ /mdog ser lte ba ze'u rjo'abru dmar/ /sa ma ya sogs brdas bskul nas/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs rol pa bya/ /oṃ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a la la la la ho/ byang sems bde chen 'od zer kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mnyes mdzad nas/ /'gro ba'i lus ngag yid rtog sbyang / /sku gsung thugs kyi 'od brgyan ⑦brjid/ /thams cad 'od kyis slar bsdus nas/ /stong gsum til gong 'bru 'dra ⑧rnams/ /sangs rgyas drug gsung ⑨yi ge'i tshogs/ /ba spu'i bu ga kun du thim/ /thugs ka'i gnas su zhu ba dag /bde chen gnas 'dus rim bzhin bcas/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba'i mes/ /sku bcas 'od dpung kha dog lnga/ /sngon gyi goms shugs lha mo bzhis/ /phyogs bzhi nas ni bskul mdzad de/ /stong pa shin tu rnal 'byor yod med mthu/ /nam mkha' nyid ⑩du dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs ⑪su gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal khyod ⑩bdag /ye shes gsang ⑫ba'i rgyud bskul nas/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i rgyud gzigs te/ /'bras bu'i phyag rgya snga ma bzhin/ /cho ga rdzogs pas gsal bar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje se gol gtogs byas te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar mdzad/ /'jig 14—554

rten khams ni ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas brgyan①/ /shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo las/ /khro bor de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ /khro bo'i tshul can khros pas kyang / /'jig rten gsum dag sreg byed na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad khros pa yis/ /khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos/ /de nas sna yi rtse mo la / /yid ni brtan par yang dag gzung ②/ /sku sneyi dbugs rings dro rjob las—/ /rgyal ba'i sbyor ba phyag rgya 'byung / /bcom ldan de nyid rnal 'byor pas—/ /rdo rje khro bor bsgyur nas byung / /oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sa ma ya ti/sarba duṣ+ṭa ⑤sa ma ya mu dra/ pra baṃ dza ka rjophaṭa/ snga ma las ni gnas 'gyur te/ / skal ba'i ⑦me dpung 'khrigs pa'i tshul/ /dbu skra sma ra ser gnag mdzes④/ /spu rnams rdo rje gyen du 'khyil/ /sgeg pa dpa' bo 'jigs su rung / /dgod ⑨dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gar thabs can/ /g.yas g.yon dang pos rdo rje dang / /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bur bcas/ /gnyis pa dag na 'jigs byed kyi/ /pags pa rlung gi tshad du bskor/ /gsum pas dbang bskur dbu rgyan chu/ /tha ma gnyis na dung chen khrag /thod pa ⑩sha chen snying gis bkang / /dur khrod gar gyi phyag rgyar bsgyur//la lar zhal gcig zhal gsum sku/ /mthing nag ⑩'jigs pa'i me 'od 'bar/ /g.yas pa ba dan gsum pa phyag /rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar phreng can/ rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bu bcas/ /thod khrag gang ba g.yon pa na/ /'bar ba chen po skra 'bar ba—/ /thod pa mang po'i dbu rgyan can/ /'jigs pa chen po'i dus ltar drag /dur khrod bzhin du rab tu 'jigs/ /zhal rnams sna tshogs 'gyur ba dang / /14—555

'bar ba'i lta bas gar byas pa/ /rdo rje rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /dril bu'i sgra ni gsil ba yis/ /thams cad phab nas slar yang ni/ /thal bar 'gyur ba'ang ①'tsho bar byed/ /gti mug dbang mdzad theg chen rgyan/ /glang chen ko rlon stod g.yogs mnabs/ /'dod chags gzhan gyis rgol ba'i tshogs/ /tshar gcod stag gi sham thabs yin/ /nga rgyal thugs rjes 'gro sgol phyir/ /'jigs byed chen po'i g.yang gzhi gyon/ /zhe sdang gzung 'dzin rnam dag pas/ /gnas brgyad sbrul gyi phreng ba can/ /chags pa gnyis spangs gnyis ldan pas/ /khrag gi thig les tshom bur brgyan/ /phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa yin②/ /thal ba'i tshom bu'i mtshan ma can/ /byang sems gnyis dang mi 'bral don/ /zhag gi ri mos spras pa'o/ /phrag dog sku gsung rgyan ldan phyir/ /thod phreng thod dang se ral thogs/ /dregs byed tshogs rnams zil mnan pa'i/ /nyi zlas snyan gyi gong rgyan byas/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yi/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgyar ldan byas te/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i sbyor ba skeyis/ /bdag gi lhar ni bdag nyid bya/ /oṃ s+dzahūṃ/ thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i/ /ye shes sems dpa' hūṃ dang bcas/ /'od zer 'phro 'du'i sbyor ba yisarjo/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ /lha mos bdud rtsi rjobum pas khrus/ /rin chen dbu rgyan rtse mo gcigadu /rdo rje phreng ba'i rigs dag dang / /thod phreng la gnas rigs lngas brgyan/ /lag pa shin tu brkyang pa yis/ /mdzub ⑦mo gnyis ni mdud par bcing / /grung ⑧mos mthe bo'i rtse mo mnan/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su bsgyur/ /bteg ⑨nas khro gnyer la bzhag ste/ /nyi bcas dbang bskur sngags brjod ⑩bya/ /yab yum mkha' gsang ⑪nyi dang as/ /rdo 14—556

rje pad+mo babyed byas la/ /liṅga 'greng ba rang byung pa/ /brla yi dbus su gzhug byas te/ /dbyings dang ye shes sbyor ba las/ /ho ru ka yi dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /byang chub sems de kun du dag /ma lus nye bar sbyang byas nas| /'dod par bya ba rab tu mnyes/ /'od 'dus thog ma'i gzugs la gzung / /gsang gnas ①so so'i gdan dag la/ /chos kyi snying pos lha rnams bskyed—/ /ti las dpal chen te ru ka /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su dgod—/ /s+thāḥlas lha mo dkar mo ste/ /de bzhin sno las rkun mo yin/ /stoḥlas lha mo rmongs byed ma/ /rnyi las thal byed phyogs bzhir ro/ /mtshams su hūṃ phaṭa las byung ba'i/ /spos byed la sogs lha mo bzhi/ /oṃ khaṃ yam̐ ④ram̐ las byung ④lha mo bzhi/ /mda' 'dzin la sogs phyi rol mtshams/ /a ā saṃ aḥyi ge las/ /lha mo me tog la sogs bzhi/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ④bzhi rnams las/ /sgo bzhir rta mgrin 'phang mtho sogs/ /bha ga la ni liṅga gzhagarjo /liṅga rdo rjer byin brlabs nas/ /he ru ka yi sku gnyis dag /spro zhing rang la bstem rjopar bya/ /oṃ he ru ka badz+ra sa ma ya hi sarba duṭ+wān ⑦sa ma ya mu dra pra ⑧paṃ dza ka hūṃ phaṭa / sgo⑨dkar mo dkar ser zhi ba'i mdangs/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad 'jigs pa'i stabs⑩/ /g.yon brkyang gar gyis bzhugs par mdzad/ /mda' bzhi dus gcig bkang ba la/ /tshangs pa'i mgo bzhi dpyangs pa ste/ /spro zhing bsdus pas shar ⑪du bzhugs/ /hūṃ badz+ra gu h+ya sidha ⑫pa ra ma yo gi shwa ri dz+dza—/ rkun mo dmar ser drag mo'i zhal/ /g.yon pas lcags kyu kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khyud/g.yas pa'i gung mos rtse brgyad bstod/ /g.yas bteg stabs gnon lho yi phyogs//hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi/ shwa ri kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ma hā badz+ra ka pā la mā la ku lu ru khru n+ni dz+dza/14—557

rmongs byed mdog gnyis gong ma phag /'og ma dmar mo phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje gsum/ /g.yon kyi dang pos kham phor 'chang /'og ①gnyis khu tshur ro la gtod/ /g.yas bteg stobs gnon lho yi phyogs/ /rmongs tshul nub kyi phyogs su'o/ /hūṃ badz+ra na rā ②ya ni rnyi dzha①/ thal byed mdog dkar slong tshul gzigs/ /g.yas na thod pa bdud rtsis bkang / /g.yon pa ba dan gsum pa'i gar/ /dga' ba'i bzhin bcas byang gi phyogs/ /hūṃ badz+ra pa ta ke dz+dza/ spos mo drag mo gar byed tshud/ /bol bzhi brla dpung dkar ba la/ /lus sbubs dmar gsal yan lag sngo/ /rdo rje rtse lnga dpag bsam shing / /g.yas g.yon gar gyi bsgyur rjob bcas/ /me mtshams 'khor lo'i stan la gnas/ /hūṃ badz+ra shu li gra bhan+da ma ṭa dz+dza/ ro khrod ro rtags tshul 'chang zhing / /ser nag ⑤g.yas pa ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon pa me thab rjordo rjes mtshan/ /g.yon brkyang rlung mtshalas 'khor lo ston/ /hūṃ badz+ra ki shits+tsha ⑦ta ma ṭa dz+dza/ kun spyod kun gyi las mdzad cing / /g.yas pas rdo rje dung khrag gsolaske/ /g.yon gyis thod pa zhags par bcas/ /zhal bzhi mthing nag ⑧gtso bo'i bzhin/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ se ral kha/ /dbang ldan 'khor lo'i rtsibs la gnas—/ /hūṃ badz+ra pe ⑨mā la bā she ma ṭa sgo / kun kyang thod phreng sbrul mdud dang / /g.yang gzhi brgyangs ⑪te gos su gon/ /gdan ni sna tshogs pad+ma la/ /yi dwags nyi mas mtshan pa'o⑫/ /mda' 'dzin dkar mo mda' dang gzhu/ /me yi mtshams kyi gru chad la/ /he badz+ra ra ti baṃ dz+dza/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ser mo kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rdo rje dril can bden bral mtshams/ /baṃ ⑫ma hā ra ta badz+re ho dz+dza/ 'khor lo 'dzin ma ④dmar ser mo/ /rtsibs brgyad 'dzin pa rlung gi phyogs/ /oṃ badz+ra 14—558

lo tsa rgo yi ①ya sgo / sna tshogs ba dan ljang gu la/ /sna tshogs 'phan dril dbang ldan phyogs/ /re ma hā shrī badz+ra hiḥsgodza①/ me tog ser mo me tog snod//rdo rjes mtshan pa bar khyams me/ /a badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ dz+dza/ spos me sngon mo rdo rje pog /bar khyams bden bral pad gnas pa'o/ /a badz+ra byu dupa dz+dzaḥ/ mar me ⑤dmar mo rdo rje sgron/ /bar khyams rlung phyogs pad+mar gnasarjo/ /a badz+ra ā ⑦lo ke dz+dza/ dri chab ljang gu dag byed snod/ /'thor byed dbang ldan pad+mar gnas/ /a badz+ra gadhe dz+dza/ shar sgor rta mgrin 'phang mtho dkar/ /g.yas na rta gdong g.yon lcags kyu/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku shi sgo / lho sgor phag ⑧gdong sngon mo ste/ /g.yas pas mche ba g.yon zhags 'dzin/ /oṃ badz+ra pā she ⑨hūṃ dz+dza/ nub sgor snang byed dmar mo ni/ /phyag gnyis nyi zla lcags sgrog 'dzin/ /oṃ badz+ra shri kha li ⑩baṃ dz+dza/ byang sgor ⑪thal byed mdog ljang gu/ /sangs rgyas gzugs bcas dril bu 'khrol/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ⑩hoḥdz+dza/ phyi yi lha mo bcu gnyis tshogs—/ /rin chen rgyan phreng na bza' bklubs⑫/ /khro brjid 'dzum bag mtshan ma 'dzin/ /sgo ba cung zhig 'gying ba'i tshul/ /kun mkhyen ye shes las grub phyir/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams thams cad kyi/ /mig la sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /rna ba rdo rje nyi ma yin/ /kha la pad+ma gar dbang phyug /sna la rta mchog rol pa'o/ /yid la rdo rje he ru ka /lus la rdo rje sems dpa' gnas/ /gnas gsum phyag rgya'i tshogs gsal bas/ /thugs kar sems dpa' gsum sngags bcas/ /rang rig dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas/ /dbang bskur rigs kyi mtshan ma bsam/ /dga' chen dpal gyi rdo rje las/ /rdo rje se gol gar dang bcas/ /dpung mgor lan gsum bsnyu ba'i rgya/ /gnyis med 'od 14—559

zer lcags kyus dgug /ye shes can gyi spyod yul can/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas/ /sems can don slad dam tshig dgongs/ /gnas 'dir brtse phyir gshegs su gsol/ /mdzes pa'i phyag rgya gyen du bgreng / /smin mtshams dbus su gtad par bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ shrī ①te ru ka /ma hā badz+ra—/ ā kardzu ②ya/ ā kardzu sneya/ pra be+e sha ya/ pra be+e sha ya/ brnya ya/brnya ya/ to ṣa ya/ to ṣa ya/ badz+wa ḍā ki nī rgo/ z-i rjod yi ⑤hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa—/ oṃ te ru ka badz+ra sa ma ya nyi/ sarba dustu sa ma ya dumu dra pra baṃ dza ka hūṃ phaṭa / pad+ma'i phyag rgyas g.yas nas bskor/ /gar thabs thal mos lan gsum gdab/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs he ru ka /chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las kyang / /gzugs sku 'jigs tshul bstan du gsol/ /thugs rje chen po thabs mkhas pas/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ /tshogs rje tshogs bdag dpal dang ldan/ /tshogs kyi slob dpon gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes rtogs pa'i khyad par lasame/ /sprul pa mang po'i tshogs dang gshegs/ /oṃ e bye nyi bha ga bān ⑧dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ⑨/ ru lu ru lu dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ e he ⑩bye ti dṛ ⑪byu hoḥ⑫/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/e he bye hi a ra li ⑫ho/ hri hri hri/ thod phreng phyag rgya bcings pa las/ /g.yas nas rim bzhin bskor bar bya/ /bde gshegs pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir—/ /'gro ba ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /don gyi dbang gis dgongs nas kyang / /'khor bcas gshegs rnams bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan⑫/ sa ma ya mu dra a be sha ya/ a be sha ya/ pra be+e sha ya⑫/shrī te ru ka hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje thal mo bskyed byas nas/ /sol ⑩mo bsnol 14—560

bsdams bskyod ①par bya/ /sems can don phyir nan tan mchog bskyed cing //ye shes thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang / /mi gnyis don gyi dngos grub mchog gi gnas/ /bdag la sprul zhing ④brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ te ru ka badz+ra sa ma ya hi/ sarba duṣ+ṭan sa ma ya mu dra pra ban tsakra hūṃ phaṭa/ kā ya bāka tsit+ta/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ/ rdo rje khu tshur bcings pa las/ /mthe bo mthe'u ④chung bsgreng bar bya/ /hūṃ che rjomachog mnyam sbyor 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /thugs rje khros pas gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /gsang sngags rmad byung drag po'i phrin las rnams/ /lhun gyis grub par byin kyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ shrī te ru ka /ma hā badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan⑤/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a ba ste ba rjohūṃ phaṭa/dam tshig phyag rgya rnam gsum ni/ /rim bzhin bcings te bskul bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dṛ ⑦sh+ya ho sa ⑧ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra guh+ya sa ya ⑨ho/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya tri sa ma ya phaṭa/ dam tshig sa la bzhengs pa yi/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas—/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin ma bsrungs ⑩sam/ /grub pa'i mchog dag ma stsal na/ /sku gsung thugs dang ⑪'gal bar ro/ /zhig par gyur par gdon mi za/ /zil gnon bsrung zhing bsdig ⑫pa'i phyir/ /las kyi phyag rgya rnam gsum bcing / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ⑫/ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba duṭ+wān ④sa ma ya mu dra ⑫ma re pra ba ⑫na tsakra/ bag sha ya bag sha ⑩ya/ bi t+t+waṃ sa ⑫ya bi t+t+waṃ sa ⑪ya—/ byu ta k+ṣe ti pra ti s+t+waṃ ⑩bha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sku gsung thugs su bdag sbyor ⑫bas / /pho brang dkyil 'khor rang las sprul/ /nga ni bdud kyi bdud bdag ste / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas ngas ⑫bsdus pa'o/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra ka ra mu ka sha ra yā ya na maḥ/ oṃ shrī badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga pra dzā lā ya na maḥ⑫/ oṃ shrī badz+ra gaste pra 14—561

dzā la ①ya na maḥ/ a ti bhu ho/ sarba ta thā ga ta ban+da māṃ sdekā ro ya mi ma hā yo gi ni a la la ho/ pra ti bhu ho/ smin ma g.yon pa 'degs tshul gyis/ /ru lu ru lu bcas pas ①'dud/ /oṃ bdag med phyogs bral don dam ④thugs chud cing / /byams dang snying rjes sgra ⑤zin mi mnga' yang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir dus las mi 'da' ba'i/ /'jigs byed te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing / /'dod dgur sgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che/ /ma sring byams ma'i tshul gyis grogs mdzad pa'irjo/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /haṃ a ti bhu ho/ tshad med bzhi yi phyag rgya yis/ /gnyis su med par bstan byas nas/ /dman pa'i phyag rgya rnam pa bzhis/ /rang gi de nyid las sbyor ba'i/ /rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /dam tshig la sdang rnam sbyang phyir/ /dur khrod gar kyi phyag rgyar gsal/ /sangs rgyas khro 'byung khro ba ni//thal bar 'jig ⑦pa'i mchog yin te/ /sems dpa' sngon mo 'bar ba can/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dmar po snang / /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu 'khrol ④ba'i sgrar bcas pa/ /gos chen po dang blugs pa che/ /sha chen po dang sbrang rtsi che/ /dur khrod kun gyi 'byung po yis/ /phyag rgya dpal ldan dbang phyug mchog /shin tu khro gtum gdug pa yi/ /sems can khams ni rnam sbyang phyir/ /'di ni dpal ldan he ru ka'i/ /rdo rje rgya chen dbang phyug mchog /se ral kha yi tshul dag tu/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la rgyab rten bcas/ /lag pa g.yon pas ⑨thod pa thogs/ /g.yas pa ba dan gsum par byas/ /nam mkha'i phyag rgya rnal 'byor pa/ /nam mkha' ⑩kun du 'go bar 'gyur/ /bud 14—562

med la sogs rin chen mchog /dngos po thams cad mkha' las 'byin/ /g.yas dang g.yon kyi sbyor ba yis/ /bde bar 'bab pa'i ①gar byed pas/ /skyil mo krung ni phyed bcas la/ /rkang pa rang gi brlas mnan pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā ṭīhe ru ka sa ma ya hi/ sarba duṭ+wā②/ sa ma ya mu dra/ pra baṃ ①ka hūṃ phaṭa/ma hā mu rjohi/ dkar mo thug ⑤mchog zhi ba'i mdangs/ /gzigs byed phyogs kun gar bsgyur zhing / /mda' bzhi dus gcig 'phangs pa yis/ /bdud bzhi dag las rgyal bar byed/ /hūṃ badz+ra gu h+ya sidhi pa ra ma yo ge shwa ri tweḥ/ ma hā mu dra tweḥ/ rkun mo rgyas mdzad drag po'i bzhin/ /thugs rje skyo bas 'gro gnas 'dren/ /khams gsum las rgyal rjoganon pa'i stabs/ /kun du myur ba'i tshogs pa bstod/ /hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi ⑦shwa ri kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ma hā badz+ra ka pā la mā la ku ru lu ru phru sno/ ma hā mu dra ⑧sno/ rmongs byed dbang gis chags tshad 'chang //zhal gnyis mthun pa'i stabs bcas pas/ /gnas gsum rnam dag sku gsum sbyor—/ /bdud rtsi bcud ldan 'khor lo'i rgya/ /hūṃ badz+ra a na ra ya ni rnyi/thal byed drag mo slong ba'i tshul/ /snod bcud bde ba chen por rol ba dan gsum pa'i gar thabs kyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dga' mdangs gsal/ /hūṃ badz+ra pa ta ke dza/ ma hā mu dra hi/ spos mo phrin las rnam 'phrul zhing / /kun snang gsal bas drag pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rigs 'byung lnga yi mtshan/ /kun 'byung gar thabs 'gyur bar bcas/ /hūṃ badz+ra ha ra ni phaṭa/ ma hā ru tra tī⑨/ gtum mo 'dod pa'i las la brtson/ /gzhan gyi srog 'phrog 'gyur ba med/ /'thor byed rigs kyi mtshan ma can/ /gar bcas rtse gsum dbugs 'byin tshul/ /hūṃ badz+ra shu la ⑩gra bhan+di ma ṭa/ ma hā ru tra ti⑪/ ri 14—563

khrod chos nyid ro myong bas/ /shes rab mtshon chas kun gcod cing / /sreg byed rigs kyi phyag rgya 'chang / /rigs kyi tshul rmis gar byed pa'o/ /hūṃ badz+ra ki shi khyung phaṭa/ ma hā ru tra ti/ kun spyod tshul rnams kun gyis rol/ /dbyings dang ye shes chags pa'i las/ /stong gsum mi gtong 'ching byed pa'i/ /'jigs byed rngam pa'i cha lugs can/ /hūṃ badz+ra pe mā la pā she phaṭa/ ma hā ru tra hi/ byams pa'i mda' 'dzin sgeg pa'i tshul/ /ma bcos zung du 'jug pa'i gzhu/ /mnyam nyid 'phro bas kun brtson pa'i/ /rtse gcig phrin las 'gyur ba med/ /te badz+ra ra ti baṃ/ ma hā ru tra hi/ thugs rje sna tshogs khyab pa yi/ /sgrar bcas sku gsung thugs rgyal byed/ /gnas gsum las rgyud dag byed pa'i/ /yon tan kun gnas 'phrul pa'i mchog /baṃ ma hā ra ta ①badz+ra ho/ma hā ru tra nyi/ dga' byed myur ba'i brtul zhugs 'chang / /las rgyud gcod byed theg pa'i mchog /zab cing rgya che kun tshul gyis/ /yon tan brgyad 'dzin byed pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra lo tsa ne+e yi yas/ ma hā ru tra hi/ btang ④snyoms sna tshogs phrin las sku/ /gzugs mdzes spyod pa'i sgra rjodang bcas/ /dag byed phrin las bsnyengs pa med/ /thams cad ye shes rnam spros pa'o/ /ram̐ ma hā badzi hirjoḥ/ ma hā ru tra hiḥdhi/ sbyin pa'i mchog rnams rnam par grol/ /gzugs mchog lha rdzas me tog rgya/ /sa gzhi mdun rol g.yas g.yon bstod/ /sna tshogs spungs pa 'thor ⑦byed pa'o/ /a badz+ra puṣ+pe/ ma hā ru tra hi/ tshul khrims dri mchog tshim byed pa'i/ /bdug spos legs par sbyar ba'i mchog /g.yas skor ⑧bteg ste phyogs bcur bsgyur/ /mdun du phyogs par sngo byed pa'o//a badz+ra byu ⑨pa/ ma hā ru tra ti/ bzod gsol ⑩shes rab ting nge 'dzin/ /14—564

phun tshogs sel byed me mar rgya/ /kun du bskor ba'i gar bsgyur zhing / /thugs ka'i mtshan ma gsal ston pa'i/ /a ①badz+ra ā lo ke hūṃ/ ma hā ru tra hi/brtson 'grus rtse gcig 'gyur ba med/ /chos kun dag byed byug pa'i dri/ /srin mtheb sprad skenas rtse gsum 'thor/ /phyogs kun dngos bcas rnam dag 'gyur—/ /a ⑦badz+ra gadhe/ ma hā ru tra rjohi/ pad+ma brnya'i bdud rtsi bstod/ /myang ba rngub pa ltar byed cing / /lcags kyu'i phyag rgya rdo rjer bcas/ /dgug pa'i tshul mchog las grub pa'orjo/ /oṃ badz+ra e rjoku shi ⑦dzaḥm hā ru tra hi⑧/ rdo rje mche ba gcigs pa'i rgya/ /sna yi myang ba rngub pa yis⑨/ /rin chen zhags pa gsol ka'i tshul/ /rang gi las la sbyor byed pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pā she hūṃ/ ma hā ru tra hi/ rdo rje lcags sgrog nyi zlar bcas/ /mig mtshungs zhen par lta ba yis—/ /khams gsum kun la gzigs pa'i rgya/ /phyag rgya'i las kyis ⑩bstan byed pa'i⑪/ /badz+ra shri khaṃ ⑫le baṃ/ ma hā ru tra hi/ mtshams ldan sku mchog ⑫ bdud rtsis bkang / /thams cad bdag nyid myang ba yis/ /ston pa'i gsung ⑫dbyangs kun du sgrogs/ /thal 'jig ⑫rgyud rnams slar 'tsho mdzad/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ⑩hoḥ/ ma hā ru tra ti/ gzigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa yi rgyas thob la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'o byed 'khyud pas rmongs mdzad de/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bde ba'i mchod ston kun gsol la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bde mchog ngo mtshar bstan du gsol/ /rgyas btab rmongs byed mnabs su gsal⑩/ /bde mchog ngo mtshar bde bar bzhugs/ /hūṃ a la la la la ho/ snang bar mdzod/ rnal 'byor bde mchog sgyu mas sprul/ /dam tshig dag ⑫la 'jug tu gsol/ /nyon mongs kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /ma lus pa ni mnabs ⑪su gsol/ /nyon 14—565

mongs thams cad tshogasal bar mdzad/ / gsung gnas bye pad+ma rdo rje la/ /sa bon gsang sngags 'phro 'dur bcas/ /rgyal ba'i gsung tshogs gnyis med pa'i//rdo rje gsang gsum tshig 'don pa'o1/ /oṃ sum+bha gasta ma t+na de bi hi ri mi ti ri shrī 4ye hi swā hā/ badz+ra dzi swā hā/ oṃ bāka badz+ra āḥhūṃ/ rdo rje thal mo gyen du dbye/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni rtse mo dgug /mje bo gnyis kyi mche ba gcigs/ /'jigs pa'i rdo rje gnod sbyin ma/ /yi ge brgya sngags ldan pa yi/ /dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgyas ni/ /lha rnams kun gyi gnas dag tu/ /rnam gsum mthu yis bskul bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcas pa las/ /mje'u chung gnyis ni rab brkyang nas/ /so so'i gsang sngags spyor ba yi/ /las kyi sngags bcas don spyor ba'o / /cholag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis dag gi thu/ /mdzub mo mthe 7 chung mdzes bsgyur bye te/ /rdo rje thal mo gyen du dgrol/ /mchod pa'i gtor ma kun gyi tshul/ /oṃ pa na pe na/ pe nu su ru ta/ pu pa ra mu/ sarba ta thā ga ta / sa ma ya/ yo ga sidha āḥ/hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃḥ⑩/ rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 1nyadam pa grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad grub par mdzad du gsol/ /a la la ste mchod par 'bul/ /a la la ste dam tshig bskangs⑩/ /a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ /a la la ste dngos grub sprul/ /dgyes mnyam longs spyod mchog la rol/ /oṃ shrī ra ga badz+ra a puṣ+pepu/ a dhū pa dhū/ a ⑩ā lo ke s+thāḥ/a gabye mubadz+ra ra ti paṃ/ baṃ ma hā ra ta badz+ra ho/ oṃ badz+ra lo tsa na skyeyi ya/ ram̐ ma hā shrī hi/ a la la ho/ bde bar gshegs so khro rgyal gtso/ /rgyal ba rgya 14byed566

mtsho ye shes kyi/ /srid pa rgya rmyematsho thams cad kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā bye te bh+yo bi shwa mu kha snobh+yaḥsarba tad khaṃ uṅga te smra ra na chohi saṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ 'byung ba lnga las thams cad 'byung / /rang las ma byung gang yang med/ /gtsang sme'i dri rtog kun bral ba'i/ /bdud rtsi byang chub sems chen pos/ /bdag sogs gnyis med mchod pa'i phyir/ /mnyam pa chen po'i rgyan phyol rol/ /oṃ na maḥsarba pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ kā ya sidhi oṃ/ oṃ bāka sidhi yi / oṃ tset+ta sedhi hūṃ/ oṃ shrī te ru ka i rda dhū tshipa put+pa dī pa/ garnya/ ba li ta/ pra dz+wat+t+waṃts+tsha ho/ shrī bha ga bān kha kha kha le le le/khā ti khā hi khā hi/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ shrī he ru ka /ma hā badz+ra ྅ā 8snabe+e sha ya/ā shesnabe sha ya/ pra be+e sha ya/ pra be+e sha ya/ pra tīts+tsha ho/ shrī bha ga bān/ kha kha kha/ khā hi khā nyi khā hi / sgeg pa tsodapa' bo mi sdug ⑩'jigs su rung nyu2/ /dgod 6dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed pa dang / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la sogs pa skye/ /sku yi dngos po shin tu bsgyur ba yipa/ /gar byas grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gtso bo che/ /bza' ba la sogs snying po can/ /māṃ ⑫sa la sogs bro mchog stsol/ /me tog la sogs tsan+dan phreng / /bzang 1nadagur dbul gyis bzhengs 7su gsol/ /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod/ /hūṃ shin tu brgyan pa'i rigs dang mtshan ldan mchog /bkra shis dbyangs dang gar gyis mchod byas pa'i/ /lha mo rdul snyed phyogs bcur spros byas pa'i/ /byang sems bde ba'i mchod pa bye rnam par rgyal nye//hūṃ hūṃ ma hā su kha bo dhi dhi tsit+ta a la la ho/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /14—567

dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas / /dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru/ /zhing chen gsar rnying 3snyi rar bcas / /dmar gyi ar+gha rgya mtshor bskyil/ /mkha' 'go 'bar ba'i 2tshogs bcas rnams/ /ma lus bzhes nas bsnams su gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭhan —sa ma ya mu dra ma ram̐ 5kha kha kha/ khā hi khā hi khā hi / z-i da ya pi pa hūṃ phaṭa/ nga ni za byed chen po ste/ /khams gsum dz+wam lus bsgral ba dang / /gdul dka' ma lus gdul ba'i phyir/ /sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ shrī he ru ka /ma hā badz+ra/ sa ma ya/ma hā māṃ sa/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā tsit+ta/ ma hā ba su ta/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta/ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho/ kha kha kha/ le le le ho/ bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ bh+yo/ ko tak+ṣa/ ko ta ba/9 ko ta ko ta/ pa sa pa sa/ ka ti ra ga1 /ko lāk+ṣa/ ko la ba/ ko la ko la/ ka la pa/ sh+tsaṭhas/ rnam dag sgrib sbyangs srid gsum skyon bral zhing / /ston ka'i zla gsal dri med zhal mnga' ba/ /bcom ldan bde gshegs rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbyings/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yab//shes rab lha mo rigs kyi yum rnams dang / /phyag rgya gtum chen rngam pa'i 'khor lo sogs/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi zhing rab sdogs/ /dgyes shing rol pa'i dus mchog 1 sbyar ba yi/ /bzhes te a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra e sa hā/ pe sa hu—/ sa ma ya bag sha mahūṃ/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ pra tīts+tsha ho/ ye nas mnyam nyid chos sku dag pa la/ /log rtog dbang gis sgo medang skur btab ste/ /bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs ngo bor smin/ /de bzlog don phyir rgyal ba'i dam mnos pas7/ /rgyal ba zhi khro'i 14—568

thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /thugs rje'i ngang can rnams la bzod par gsol/ /bcom ldan dpal ldan rdo rje te ru ka /khyod kyi thugs rje nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam—/ /mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa yis/ /'gro la brtser nyadagongs tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /bdag cag dam tshig 'di la mngon du zhugs pa rnams/ /bcad gtubs rīlus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing //grib mas phog pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa/ /sku yi phyogs tsam dran pas mod la 'tsho ba dang / /gzi mdangs lus la 'jug pa bye ba stong phrag gi / /'od kyis phog pas 'jig rten khams 'dir snang ba dang / /lus ngag sems dang tshe ni rdo rjer rab brten te/ /re smon thams cad dus 'dir grub par mdzad du gsol—/ /rnam gsum sems dpa' sngags kyi phreng / /dkyil 'khor kun gye gnas zhugs pa/ /yan lag rnam gsum spro bsdu yi/ /gsal ba gnyis kyi sgo nas brtsam/ /rim gyis rten nyid rten sngags dag /'khor lo'i tshul ldan shes rab thabs/ /yi ge mtshan ma sgu yi gnas/ /bgrang zhing grangs 'das tshogs spyod pa'o/ /rtse gabyug gnas su 'khor ba las/ /langs shing 'khrul 'khor 'phro ba dag /mnyes bskul 5las mdzad bsdu byed cing / /dkyil 'khor gsal bar gyur pa'o/ /las kyi sbyor ba kun spyor zhing / /dbyangs drug blangs pas don drug gsal/ /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ thun mong bsnyen pa las kun la/ /'jug pa'i yig 'bru brgyad pa'o/ /so so'i las la snyoms 'jug las/ /rang gi mtshan ma sngags phreng gnyis/ /'phro 'dus rigs mthun las mdzad nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas brjod brtsam/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka /badz+ra sa ma ya hri 6sarba duṣ+ṭa sa ma ya mu 3dra pra paṃ tsakra hūṃ phaṭa/ khyad 14—569

par gtso bo'i snying po'i sngags/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o/ /gzhan yang rim bzhin sngags gsal bas/ /go rims 'khrul med brjod par bya/ /bzlas rdzogs mchod bstod ①bskul byas nas/ /rang gi gnas su bsdu bar bya/ /gzhan yang thig le phra mo'i tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor lha ni rnam dag kun/ /mtshan bcas dmigs pa'i las sbyangs pas/ /chos sku'i phyag rgya rngugasal gyur bsgom—/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal byas nas/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas 'grub byed pa'i/ /dga' bde'i longs spyod tshogs 'gyur bas/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod mnyes par bya/ /rta mchog mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas pa/ /lhag ma'i mchod pas mnyes pa dag /rang gi las la sbyar bya ste / /dngos grub don phyir mtshams su gzhagabye /mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor kun gyi mchog /don dam bde ba chen po'i sku/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes kyi/ /lha nyid brtson pas bsgom par bya'o/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /ji ltar sgyu ma thams cad du/ /mthong ba dang ni reg par 'gyur/ /dmigs su yod pa ma yin te/ /de bzhin 'go ba kun gyi tshul/ /gang zhig thun bzhi la sogs par/ /dkyil 'khor 'di nyid bsgoms pas ni/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol zhing / /dam tshig dkyil 'khor rim bzhin du / /slar nyid spyor ldan bsrung byebyas te/ /spyod lam rnal 'byor gnas par bya / /tshogs 'gyur spyod mthun bya ba yis/ /dus kun du ni 'gro don brtsam//mgon mchog sa stengs ṣ+yokun grags pas/ /thugs rjes 'gro don rnam dag ston/ /rgya mtsho 'khrug kye'adra rnam log pas/ /nges don rnam par bkod ⑦pa'i sgo/ /14—570

don gsal srin bus grong khyer min/ /dman sogs ma 'ongs gzung bya'i phyir/ /sgrub don dam pa'i gzhung gsal byas/ /khe 1grags ngan rtog 2 blos ma yin/ /thugs rje mchog gi dgongs mdzad bzhin/ /ngal ba'i dge sogs nyi zer gyis/ /khams gsum mun tshogs bsal 'gyur zhing / /yang dag grub pa'i 'bras thob shog /dpal he ru ka'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon chen po hūṃ gi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra sa ha dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā jib rma rin chen 5mchog gis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o/ /slad kyi lo tsā cho ba phyi ma dag 3gis sum thug tu zhu chen bcos pa'o// //bsdur mchan/55༷ nyumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos par ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i sgrubs pa'i thabs bzhugs so/ / — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshogs/ —〈〈snar 〉〉grub/ nga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/ 7khru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ran/ ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kudul/551 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thar/ rnyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaphung / — 〈〈snar 〉thagos/ ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyar/ 3〈〈pe 〉tha/tshe 〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhag sngo〈〈pe 〉ra sal/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bo/ spu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa spyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈sar 〉7ཿ/552 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabyebs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉rgyu/ ye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉khim/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje'i/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi/553 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈po ra 〉ma la/ bye 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉d+kudod/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sko〈co 〉lko/ zu〈〈pe 〉( / 〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i—/ cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanaza' klubs/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatugs/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ku ma/554 ①〈〈pe 〉ra ko haṃ/ 〈〈snar 〉ra ko haṃ/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/ ༷〈〈pe 〉〉dharma dha/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dharmā dha/ cho〈〈pe 〉mo ko haṃ/ 〈'ar 〉ramat+ma ko haṃ/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzal/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ze/ spyo〈〈pe 〉〉14—571

0578༄༅/ /yan lag bzhi'i don snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsa tu ra t+t+waṃ gāze ā 2lo ka nā ma/ bod skad du / yan lag bzhi'i don snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' mnyam gsal ba gnyis med pa'i / /yon tan rin chen sna tshogs gzhi/ /thams cad rang bzhin bde chen sku/ /bkod pa kun snang rol ston 'dud/ /bstan pa'i snying po dri med bka' / /gsang don gsang ba kun gyi mchog /bsdu zhing de ngan gsal mdzad pa'i/ /mchog rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bde mchog rgyud dag las/ /rim 'jug sgrub chen don bkod pa'i/ /tshig don rtogs dka'i rim pa dag /rnam gsum dgu yi gzhung gsal phyir/ /bsnyen sgrub cho ga'i rim rgyas par/ /dngos gzhi dgongs mdzad sbrel bsdus pa/ /dam pa'i rjes 'brangs mtha' gnyis bsal/ /gzhung bral 'khrul sogs dgag phyir bshad/ /14—575

bskal pa bye ba grangs med par/ /sangs rgyas thams cad ma thob pa/ /phyag rgya'i cho ga gang dag gis/ tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /de ni bdag gis brtag par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun dag bde ba'i mchog /bdag nyid bzhin du bsgrubs pa las/ /sangs rgyas kun dag bde mchog go/ /rnal 'byor yang dag ma yin semasaṭ+wā/ /lha la dmigs par byed pa bdag /rnal 'byor gzugs brnyan rang bzhin te/ /lugs ma la sogs rnal 'byor skye/ /yang dag mchog sems rnal 'byor pa/ /lha la dmigs par byed pa dag /rang gi dam tshig bdag sbyor bas/ /mi 'gyur dam pa grub par 'gyur/ /gzugs brnyan lugs ma la sogs la/ /rnal 'byor 'byung bar mi 'gyur kyi/ /byang chub sems la rab brtson na/ /de las rnal 'byor lhar 'gyur ro/ /chos rnams thams cad snang grol dbyengs/ /kun gsal stong nyid zung 'jug dngos / /rang bzhin ma bcos lhun gyis grub/ /bde ba chen po mchog gi rgya//byang sems mkha' dbyings dag pa las/ /yon tan ma rtsal kun 'byung snang / /sna tshogs snang ba ris ma 'grub/ /rtog dpyod zhen chags yul las 'das/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs te/ /shes rab pha rol phyin spyor ba/ /thabs kyi snying rje'i bdag nyid rnams/ /de bas de ni snying rje'i thabs/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par gsal/ /'di ni rnal 'byor bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /yang dag grub pa gcig pu nyid/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sbyar/ /rtog pa'i cho ga thams cad la/ /grub pa dam pa mchog gi mchog /sna tshogs las kyi 5sbyor ba yirngo/ /cho ga sna tshogs 'dod pa yis/ /14—576

sems can rnams ni 'dul ba dang / /bde ba thams cad bsgrub ①pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan rnal 'byor de nyid ni/ / sangs rgyas thams cad ④rnam 'phrul bas//sems can kun don rnam 'phrul nas/ /myur du shin tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /'das dus bskal pa rim bzhin du/ /log pa'i lam zhugs rnam drug pos/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ga phung byed cing / /dregs byed chen por gyur pa la/ /thabs gzhan dag gis mi 'dul phyir/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje chen po yis/ /dgongs mdzad gsang ba bla ma'i mchog /rnam 'phrul chen po bstan pa yin/ /sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa la/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gcig pu rab tu che ba'i lha/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs mdzad mchog /'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud chen dag /rim bzhin brda ④don gsal mdzad cing / /nges rjoskyes phyag rgyas gtan la dbab/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor gsal gyur nas/ /rten mchog gi ni don sbyar nas/ /yan lag bzhi snang bcu drug tshogs/ /rgyu rkyen tshogs 'bras mdzad bcas rdzogs//gang zhig yun rings sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /snying rje chen po'i goms shugs can/ /dad brtson lta bas blo gsal zhing / /des rjobartags dkyil 'khor dbang thob pas—/ /smin lam rdzogs byed 'gyur med gnas/ /bla mas bsgo ba'i don bzhin spyod/ /bdag gzhan don sgrub lam la gnas/ /blo gros mchog gyur gsang ba'i snod/ /dkyil 'khor theg par ma zhugs shing / /dam tshig spangs shing gsang don rmongs/ /shes rab che dang snying rje bral/ /log sman gus pa med spangs bya/ /gang du 'bras bu phun tshogs shing / /dben dupa'i dgon pa 14—577

nyams dga' ba/ /gzhan dbang dgra yi tsher ma med/ /chu mchog shing gis ①mdzes byas par/ /kun du sna tshogs skal bzang por/ /kun du sna tshogs bde mchog gis/ /kun du sna tshogs dgos pa rnams/ /ci bde ⑦bar ni bsgrub par bya/ /rten dang dgon pa gtsug lag khang / /ri yi rtse ①rnams thams cad du—/ /rnam pa du ma sna tshogs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa bsgrub par bya /pad+ma'i skyed mos tshal dga' dang / /chu bo dag gi mdo dag tu/ /pad+ma 'dzin pa'i dgos pa rnams/ /rnam pa du mar 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i pho brang dga' ba dang / /pad+mo skyed mos tshal rjonyid du/ /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma yis/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bsgrub par bya/ /mkhar ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin chu bo'i 'gram dag gam/ /rgyal khams gzhan las grub pa ru/ /rdo rje rta ni bsgrub par bya/ /yul 'khor yo byad rgyan ⑤bcas dang / /cha lugs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /gnas kyi sa rjogazhi mdzes byas te/ /sgrub pa'i skyes bu dbye ba las/ /sgrub pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /bdag gzhan bya ba sna tshogs 'grub//gzhan don dmigs pa'i las la ni/ /slob dpon de nyid bcu sogs shes/ /tshad ldan rang rgyud dag pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor dbang bskur sgrub pa dang / /phrin las tshogs bsags bsrung don du/ /bsnyen 'gro bsnyen pa rdzogs byas pas//sa gzhi sa bon la 'jug cing / /yang dag dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yi/ /gzhung bzhin 'jug par bya ba ste/ /rtog pa sna tshogs las 'phros pa'o/ /bdag don bya ba de las gzhan/ /sa gzhi sta gon sngon brtsams phyir⑦/ /bdag nyid rang gi lhar sbyor bas/ /lus ngag yid gsum mthu bskyed cing / /bdag dang 'gro ba ④sbyang byas nas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i rnam par bsam/ /bya ba'i rgyud 14—578

sogs gsungs pa yi/ /gtor sbyin chen po'i cho ga yis/ /mgron tshogs bzhi po tshim byas nas/ /bsgo ba'i phrin las drag tu bya/ /phyogs bzhir srung ba'i ①stegs bu la/ /bsrung ba'i yi ge brtsams te gzhag② /yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gsang ba'i dam can so so nas/ /'du ba las ni ma gtogs shing / /nyan pa las ni mi dbang ba'i/ /bgegs dang 'byung po thams cad kun/ /da lta nyid du so sor dngas①/ /ji ste bka' las 'das gyur na/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang / /rdo rje mtshon chen 'bar ba yis//gtan du brlag cing phung bar 'gyur/ /hūṃ badz+ra dz+wa rjol ram̐ yi/ khaṃ tsakra bi shwa hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ thabs dang shes rab sgrub rjopa pos/ /phyi dang nang gi rjobaskang bshags kyis/ /rin chen snod mdzes dri yang ⑦bsgribs/ /rnam dag ris gsal ji bzhin pa'o/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /dkyil 'khor mdun du dgug ⑧bya ste/ /dga' chen dpal las byung ba yi/ /se gol dpung mgor lan gsum gtogs⑨/ /rdo rje bcing skyo'i se gol gyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ⑩hūṃ/ oṃ thams cad spros bral de nyid che/ /mkha' mnyam ye shes rtogs med mchog /gnyis snang so sor smin dgongs mdzad/ /thugs rjes 0na lam thabs mkhas pas/ /dbang po'i gzhu bzhin ci 'dul ston/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /lha mo dag mchog dam pa'i lha/ /dkyil 'khor tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol/ /dzaḥ⑩ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ oṃ e bye hi ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa ma ya s+t+waṃ⑫/ sna tshogs gar las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje thal mo spyi bor sbyar/ /oṃ rdo rje rgyal po yon tan mchog /byang chub mchog ston 'dren mdzad cing / /nyon mongs mtsho skems sgron mas brgyan/ /14—579

thugs rje can la skyabs su mchi/ /phyogs bcu kun na bzhugs pa yi/ /rdzogs sangs thub pa sras tshogs bcas/ /thugs rje chen po mnga' rnams la/ /gus par phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /oṃ a ti ①bhu hūṃ/ oṃ hriḥhriḥtram̐ hūṃ②/mtshon cha drug gi tshul 'dra yi①/ /thal mo kha yi gnas su gtug /oṃ na maḥsarba tro ta rjohūṃ/ oṃ hriḥhriḥtram̐ ho/ mchod pa so so'i rjes mthun par/ /lha mo gar bcas phyag rgya bcing / /oṃ stong gsum mi mjed gnas 'di dang / /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi/ /las kyi longs spyod mngon rgyud dang //sangs rgyas yon tan snang ba yi/ /mchod rdzas bzang po khyad par can/ /dngos su sbyar tshogs sems kyis sprul/ /me tog gzugs mdzes kha dog dang / /dbyibs rnams sna tshogs mtha' yas mchog /bdug spos dri mchog khyad par can—/ /so so'i rgyu las byung ba'i dri/ /mar me rin chen shing gi 'od/ /mun pa'i tshogs 'joms gsal byed rgyun/ /dri mchog bzang pos sbyar ba chu/ /rnam rtog dri ma dag byed rgyun/ /bza' btung sna tshogs rgyu las byung / /tshim byed ro mchog brgya ldan rdzas/ /yan lag brgyad ldan khrus kyi ⑤chu/ /mchod yon tshul du dga' bde'i mchog /dkyil 'khor kun la legs 'bul na/ /mgon po thugs rje can dukyis bzhes⑦/ /oṃ badz+ra puste oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke tweḥ/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe hoḥ⑧/ oṃ badz+ra na blu ⑨h+ye tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra nyi/ sman dang 'bru yi rnam pa dang / /bla re na bza' rgyal mtshan gdugs—/ /ba dan phreng ba sna tshogs dang / /do shal dpung rgyan sor gdub ⑩spras—/ /dam pa rnams kyi longs spyod rkyen/ /bsod nams mthu las byung ba yi/ /yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /nor bu rin chen 'khor 14—580

lo'i mchog /blon po dmag dpon btsun mo bzang 7/ /rta mchog glang po rin chen mchog /rnam spras nye ba'i rin chen bdun/ /bkra shis rdzas mchog bcu drug mchog /bum pa bzang po rgyan la sogs/ /pa ṭa'i phreng ba mdzes sogs rnams/ /dkyil 'khor kun la legs 'bul na/ /mgon po thugs rje can gyis bzhes/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te stso/ a lo ka ra ya na pe nu hūṃ swā hā/ bo dhe 3sna t+t+waṃ sha rat+na /kyime gha 4 ra na hūṃ/ oṃ sna tshogs gzug mdzes sgra snyan zhing / /dri zhim ro mchog brgya ldan pa/ /reg bya'i bde ba sprin phung bzhin/ /nam mkha' gang bar byung ba dang / /gang gzhan 'gro ba drug po dag /lha tshogs lha mor bcas 'gyur bas/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis legs mdzes par glu dbyangs tshigs su bcad pa dang / /khro rngutshogs gar gyis bskyod byas pa'i/ /stong gsum rdul snyed sprul byas rnams/ /dkyil 'khor kun la legs 'bul na/ /mgon po thugs rje can gyis bzhes/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shā mu khe byeḥtresnasarba ta da khaṃ a te spa ra ṇa hi oṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ rigs lnga'i dam tshig rdzas chen po/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i dbyings)/ /rgyud lnga'i sems can kun grol zhing / /rgyud lnga'i sems can bdud rtsi 'di/ /snying po tshim byed bcud kyi mchog /byang chub sems sogs bde ba'i rgyun/ /ma lus kun kyi reg bya las/ /rol pa sna tshogs snang ba dang / /srid gsum brtan g.yo'i dngos po dang / /nyon mongs sgo gsum spyod tshogs dang / /phung po khams dang skye mched kyi/ /gzugs bzang mchod sprin thams cad kun/ /sku lnga rigs lnga ye shes lnga/ /lha mo sras bcas ngo bo nyid/ /'khor 'das snang ba'i dkyil 'khor kun/ /sna tshogs dngos med byang chub sems/ /gnyis su med 14—581

par 'bul lags na/ /mnyam nyid blang dor med pas bzhes/ /oṃ na maḥsarba pañtsa rā sa ya na a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha t+t+waṃ/ brda med rtse gcig sems nges par/ /rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar/ /hūṃ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can gyi/ /mgon po'i spyan sngar bshags pa ni/ /thog ma med nas dus 'di'i bar/ /mi dge las kyi dbang song ste/ /nyon mongs sgo gsum skyes pa yi/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga/ /lta log sgo skur zhen log gis/ /rnam grol lam las gol gyur dang / /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs tshogs/ /shes dang mi spang hūṃgazhan gzung dang / /bgyid dang bgyid du stsal ba dang / /gang gzhan rjes su yi rang bshags/ /mgon po rnams kyi spyan lam du/ /rang bzhin kha na ma tho sdig /mi 'chab rngurim bzhin nges bshags shing / /phyis kyang mi byed sdom pa gzung 1/ /bcas sdom so sor thar pa las rtsa ba yan lag nyams pa dang / /skyabs 'go mkhan sogs slob dpon spangs/ /dad pa'i dge 'dun dbyen sogs dang / /log tsho nyes byas phra la sogs/ /tshul khrims zhig 'gyur las rnams bshags/ /hūṃ byang chub sems sogs ma skyes shing //sdom pa rnam par spangs pa dang / /pha rol phyin gzhung nyams pa yi/ /log pa'i lam la zhugs pa dang / /tshangs pa'i gnas nas bsdu ba bzhi/ /lam sogs sum cu rtsa bdun dang / /ma 'dres 'bras bu mdzad par bcas/ /smod spangs sdig rnams dus 'dir bshags/ /hūṃ gsang ldan rdo rje che ge mos/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod 'gal zhing rngu/ /lha spangs mched la 'khus pa dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya spangs pa dang / /snod min gsang ba bsgrags la sogs/ /gnyis gsum nyi shu rtsa brgyad tshogasasnye/ /yan lag cha shas nyams las 'das/ /14—582

'khyed sems nges par bshags par bgyi/ /oṃ na 3maḥkā ya wāka tsit+ta sarba pā paṃ shudzha shudha hūṃ swā hwa/ 'das dang da ltar ma byon tshogs/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyi/ /dad brtson shes rab che bskyed byung / /rgyu 'bras tshogs gnyis bsags byas nas/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs dang / /khyad par gsang sngags mdzad pa yis/ /'gro rnams lam gnyis mdzad thob la/ /bdag gi rjes su yi rang ngo / /lam gzhan 'phags pa rang rgyal dang / /nyan thos so so skye bo yi/ /dge bsam sgom sogs gang spyad la/ /phrag dog med par rjes yi rang / /phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi/ /mgon po thugs rje'i dbang gis ni/ /'gro ba'i mos pa bzhin ston cing / /sngon gyi smon lam ji lta bar/ /dam chos btsun par mdzad pa'i ched/ /bskul ba'i sa la bzhugs pa dang / /ji ltar tshangs pa'i rgyal tshogs kyis2/ /chos 'khor 'gro ba'i don bskor phyir/ /gser gyi 'khor lo stong ldan phul/ /'jig rten mgon la bdag gsol 'debs/ /rgyal ba bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ /thog ma 'di nas tha ma'i bar/ /mdzad pa rnam gsum mthar phyin nas/ /sku lnga ye shes chen por ni/ /myur du sprul pa bsdu bzhed rnams/ /'go rnams kun gyi don slad du/ /bskal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /gzugs mang sprul sku'i tshul bzhugs shing / /mtshan dpe cho 'phrul mi 'jigs stobs/ /bkra shis tshogs kyis rgyas mdzad cing / /rtag tu nyi zla sgrib gsal ltar/ /snyoms mdzad 'gro ba'i mun sel mdzod/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de lta de ltar 'gro ba rnams/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang de nyid las/ /bsgral zhing thar par byas nas ni/ /bde tshogs ldan par bya ba dang / /bla med 'bras bu bskyed 74—583

bya'i phyir/ /dang po thabs kyis bdag bsgral nas/ /smon lam rdzu 'phrul dpag med dang / /zhi gnas lhag mthong mngon shes sogs/ /thogs pa med par 'byung ba yis/ /myur du mthu stobs brtas 3gyur nas/ /g.yel med 'gro don brtson byed cing / /thams cad dbugs dbyung byas nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas bkod pa'o/ /phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /bla ma rdo rje lcam dral dang / /dkyil 'khor tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /skye ba 'di dang gzhan dag tu/ /dge rtsa spyi dang khyad par don/ /sngon snabagyis bgyid la rjes yi rang / /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs/ /rgyal ba sras bcas tshogs gyur pas/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu/ /thugs mchog rin chen bskyed pa ltar/ /bla med yang dag rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub chen por sems bskyed de/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi rjes su slob/ /mdor na 'gro ba ma lus pa / /sku gsum 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi sprul pa yis//rnam par rol pa'i don gnas bya/ /de las byung ba'i 'bras bzang mchog /kun mkhyen gnas mchog snyoms mdzad pa/ /dngos rnams gang la'ang chags med de/ /byang chub sems dpa'i las chen pos/ /'go ba thams cad bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas thob shog /sna tshogs snang grags rnam grol ba/ /dbyings na cho 'phrul dgag med kyang 4/ /de yi cho 'phrul de nyid pas / /nam mkha'i mtha' ltar sngo dang bral/ /'khor gsum yongs su dag par ni/ /mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i ngang / /thams cad 'du 'bral med pa yi/ /don nyid ngo bo lcun grub shog /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gzhibs te/ /14—584

mazeb chen bsgrengs nas g.yob par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra gats+tsha muḥ/ rdo rje snathal mos lan gsum du/ /mi drag smad gnyis brdab par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tu 6 hoḥ2/ma lus 'gro ba thams cad la/ /mnyam snyoms nyid du dmigs nas kyang / /byams pa'i sems ni nyer gnas pas/ /sdug bsngal gsum dang brgyad dag gis//gdungs pa'i nyam bye/thag gang yin pa/ /de dag snyug bsngal med 'dod phyir/ /sems can grangs med skur sprul nas/ /'od zer mthu dang rdzu 'phrul tshogs/ /dpag med sprul pas don mthun tshul/ /byams pa chen pos khyab par bya/ /rnam gsum snying rje chen po yis/ /de dag bde ba thob byas te/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga sogs kyi4/ /bde ba dag la sprul 'ubya ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen ltar/ /sems can grangs med skur sprul nas/ /'od zer mthu dang rdzu 'phrul tshogs/ /'phangs med sems can kun la gtang / /don ldan dga' ba chen po'i blos/ /reg pas 'gro ba'i bag chags kun/ /rim gyis byang sems lam rnam bdun/ /myur bar byang chub rdzogs mthar phyin/ /sku dang ye shes phun sum tshogs/ /bkod pa'i yon tan dpag med snang / /gzhir gyur btang snyoms chen po'i blos/ /ngan pa'i mtshan rtags rnam bral nas//gsal sems snyoms gnas bral ba med/ /rang bzhin byang sems mnyam pa'i dbyings—/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin chen po yis/ /mtha' las grol ba'i sams nyid bskyed/ /'di ni tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi las/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i tshad med bzhi/ /snying po sngags kyis spro byas la/ /rig mebacas 'od zer khyab par gnas / /phyogs gzhan rtog pa sna tshogs kyisamo/ /rkang dang sreg byemanan cho ga dang / /gsar bu shis par byas pa'i las/ /las kyi cho ga gzhan bstan 14—585

pa'o / /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dga' ba'i rdo rje las byung ba'i/ /dpung mgor se gol brdab 1byas nas/ /rdo rje bcing — kyo'i se gol sgras/ /'jig rten khams rgo ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas kun/ /dam tshig mchog gi gsang sngags kyis/ /til gyi gong bu bzhin du rgyas/ /shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi rnal 'byor pas/ /khro bor de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ /khro bo'i tshul can khros pas kyang / /'jig rten gsum dag sreg byed na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad khros pa yis/ /khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos/ /de nas sna rtse'i rtse mo la/ /yid ni brtan par yang dag zung / /sna yi dbugs rings dro ba las/ /rgyal bas phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'byung / /bcom ldan de nyid rnal 'byor pas/ /rdo rje khro bor bsgyur nas phyung / /dpal chen rdo rje he ru ka /'bar bas thal ba rab tu 'jug rte /sems dpa' sngon mo 'bar ba'i ngang / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po 'bar/ /dur khrod kyi ni me dang 'dra/ /'bar ba chen po skra 'bar ba/ /thod pa mang po'i dbu rgyan can/ /'jigs pa chen po'i dus ltar drag /dur khrod bzhin du rab tu 'jigs/ /khro la sogs pa'i tshul ldan pa/ /zhal rnams sna tshogs 'gyur ba dang / /smin ma khro gnyer bcas par bsgyur/ /'bar ba'i lta bas gar byas pas/ /gu lang dbang chen de dbang bcas/ /nyi zla gshin rje'i tshangs par bcas/ /gnas bcas byedag ni 'bar bcas nas/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu bshig /rdo rje rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /dril bu'i sgra ni gsel ba yis/ /thams cad phab nas be+er yang ni/ /thal bar gyur pa'ang lte'atsho bar byed/ /g.yas gnyis lcags kyu ral gri ste/ /14byed586

g.yon gnyis zhags pa thod pa thogs/ /'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ /brkyang bsgum nyi ma'i gdan la gnas/ /de yi 'bar ba'i nyi ma las/ /byung ba'i grib ma mi zad pa/ /bskyed nas ma lus bdud la sogs/ /gdug pa rnams kyi khrag za nus/ /rang sngags 'od zer g.yo ba'i mthus/ /shin tu bgegs med sa mthong nas/ /rdo rje sa gzhi ra sogs bsgom/ /'khor lo me 'od mtshon char bcas/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po dregs chen pos/ /sum+bha ni yi 1sngags brjod cing / /brjid gnon khro ba chen po'i tshul/ /phyogs bcu'i bgegs ༄ rnams bkug mdzad nas/ /pho mor bsnol te nyi mar bkod/ /so so'i tshogs bcas myos par mdzad/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa hūṃ/kṛt+tha pa ya kṛt+tha pa ya/ ā na ya hoḥ sna bha ga bān/ bir+ya rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/in+d+ra ye dzaḥ/ yā ma ya ༄dzaḥb ru ṇa choye dzaḥ/ ku be+e ra ye dzaḥ/ abhe ye dzaḥ/ nairja ti ye 6dzaḥ/ ba ya be+e —ye dzaḥ/ i shwa na ye dzaḥ/ tsan+d+ra ye dzaḥ/srur+ya na ye dzaḥ/ su ri ta 9ye dzaḥ/ a dhi pa ta na ye dzaḥ/ ye shes che las sprul pa'i sku/ /zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar mthing nag sgu/ /rdo rje thod khrag ral gri zhags/ /tho ba lcags kyu g.yas dang g.yon/ /dur khrod 'jigs pa'i cha lugs brgyan/ /oṃ badz+ra gro dha bi dzā skyaya hūṃ/ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūṃ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya kṛ wa rmye hūṃ/ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ tshin+da khyun+da hūṃ phaṭa/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha bhā la daṇ+ḍa hūṃ da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya ā 5tsa la hūṃ/ ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a ba ra dzi te hūṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha snyehūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra krodha tre+e lokya bi dza ya hūṃ bin+da 14—587

bin+da hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra hūṃ gardza gardza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha ma hā pa la hūṃ sgo ṭa sgo ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi rnam 'phrul bas/ /rdo rje tho ba phyag bsnams shing / /phyogs mtshams steng 'og btab nas ni/ /rang gi gnas su nges par 'debs/ /oṃ badz+ra gha gha ghā shāta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭhan — phaṭa / badz+ra dha ro ā 4dz+nyā ba ya ti/ kā ya bāka tsit+ta badz+ra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon cha me 'od 'phro//rigs lhamathun khro bo'i 'khor tshogs dang / /dbang bskur rigs kyi skus brgyan pa'o / /sangs rgyas kun kyi dam tshig dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snang ba bde / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha rdzas mchog /rin chen rgyan la sogs pas brgyan / /dril bu rgyal mtshan mchog ldan pa'i/ /bla re dam pa byes pas na/ /rdo rje tshig dang mchod la sogs/ /glu dang sil snyan rnam par 'phrul/ /me tog bdug pa'i spyor ba dang / /mar me dri la sogs par ldan/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog sgrub/ /me tog dkar dang dmar ba dang / /mthing ga khuser po kun bsdus pa/ /me tog phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga las 'phro/ /rgya skyegs mthing ga 7ljang gu'i mchog /tshon sna bzhi yis btsos 3pa dang / /dkar po lnga yi phyag rgya dag /snga ma bzhin du mnyam par 'gyur/ /khams las byung ba thams cad dang //srog dang rtsa ba de bzhin te/ /rnam par mdzes shing dri zhim pa/ /snga ma bzhin du mnyam pa 'grub/ /tsan+dan gnyis dang gla rtsi dang / /ga pur na ka la la gyi/ /bdug pa bu ram dang sbyar ba/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub pa'o/ /garnya dri dang gu gul dag /sardza ga pur gla rtsi dang / /rdzas 'di dag la btsos pa'i 14—588

mar—/ /me mar byas na snang ba skyed/ /tsan+dan gur kum pri ka dang / /ga pur dang ni gla rtsi dag /btsos pa'i bdug pa bsgrub ①pa ste/ /spos kyi phyag rgyas spos mchog 'gyur/ /kak+ko la dang sug smel dang / /gla sgang ga bur gla rtsi dang / /'di dag zhib tu btags pa ni/ /seng ldeng bu ram dag dang sbyar/ /shing tsha pa tra lo 'dra dang / /na le sham dang ga pur sbyar/ /ha sa ka ri shing mngar gyis/ /sbrus pa kha yi spos yin no/ /me tog dmar po sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la sna tshogs pa/ /'jig rten dbang la kha dog dkar/ /ser po mkha' las byung ba la/ /tsan+dan bdug pa sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la tu ru dze+e—/ /spyan ras gzigs la ka pi ta/ /lce pog ④rdo rje nyi ma la/ /mar me'i phreng ba sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la mar me bdun/ /spyan ras gzigs la mar me brgya/ /stong ni rdo rje nyi ma la/ /sangs rgyas rnams la tsan+dan spos/ /rdo rje can la gur gum yin/ /spyan ras gzigs la tsan+dan dmar—/ /ga pur rdo rje nyi ma la/ /me tog kun dang bdug pa kun/ /de bzhin mar me thams cad dang / /sgos rnams thams cad ji snyed pa/ /rdo rje rta la dbul du rung / /sgeg mo dang ni na chung dang / /mos dang de bzhin bdud rtsi dang / /gcig pu dpa' dang 'dod chags sra/ /g.yon can bran mo de bzhin te/ /lan tshwa rjol sogs ro kun dang / /ka ra la sogs bdud rtsi sbyin / /bdag nyid kun gyi ro 'grub pa/ /sha dang chang du ldan pa yi/ /bza' ba sna tshogs 'grub pa ni/ /dga' ba'i longs spyod skal mchog ste/ /tshe yi dam tshig rab tu bsgrub/ /a mra smin dang rgun 'brum dang / /pa na se dang na le kar/ /a ka ru la sogs pa yi/ /'bras bu'i phyag rgya thams cad 'grub//14—589

kha ①ra sbrang rtsis byugs pa rnam/ /a mra la sogs tshi 1gu byug /ha sa rjoka ri mar la ⑤sogs/ /mnyam pa'i dri yis bsku rjobar bya/ /yung dang rgya skyegs la sogs pa'i/ /tshon gyis mthun par kha bsgyur ⑦nas/ /shun pa gro ga la sogs byas—/ /mchod pa'i tshe na dbul bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams la bshos ⑧dbul ba/ /sha dang chang ni rnam par spangs/ /glu dang sil snyan grub pa dang //gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /sha dang chang du bcas pa ni/ /gtor ma'i mchog ste tshogs pa'o/ /bdag gi phyug ste ⑨skal bzang po/ /rdo rje las ni dpal grub pa'o/ /bshos dang gtor ma dkar po dang / /pad+ma me tog ldan pa ni/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang gtso bo la/ /phul na ⑩dgos pa thams cad 'grub/ /rgyal po kha zas la sogs pa/ /sha dang chang du ldan pa dang / /glu dang sil snyan skal bzang dag /rdo rje nyi ma'i 'khor la 'bul⑪/ /kha zas kun gyi ro kun dang / /sha dang sha yi mchog rnams dang / /sha yi sbyor ba sha skam dang / /bshos dag rdo rje lha la dbul/ /gzhan yang bza' btung longs spyod tshogs/ /g.yos kyi ston mo mang du bsham/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs kun nas/ /spos chen sil snyan phreng thogs shing / /gar dbyangs dro ⑫thabs drug 'gyur rtse/ /gzings ⑫bstod dga' ba'i bzhin rgyas spyod/ /hūṃ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab/ /khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab//dam tshig bskang ba'i dus la bab/ /dngos grub 30 ba'i dus la bab/ /mthu chen mthu stobs bcom ldan 'das/ / byin chen byin rlobs bcom ldan 'das/ /④dbang ⑫chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das/ /dngos grub mchog 10 bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag gi las rnams gang sgrub ⑩pa/ /'bras bu dus 'dir 14—590

mchis par mdzod/ /a la la ho bha ga bān/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ ye nas rnam pa kun ldan pa'i/ /gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gsal la brtan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gnyis med brda 1yis mtshan par byos / /oṃ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /phyogs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dbus rnams kyi / /skye 'gro rdul snyed gnas pa kun/ /bde gshegs lnga yi dkyil 'khor dbyings / /phyogs dus kun nas tshogs pa'i lha/ /gnyis su med pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ oṃ hri tram̐ haṃ/ a ti bhu ho/ pra ti bhu ho / ta thā ga to gu ru pa ti a la la ho/ lus ngag spyi dang khyad par gyi/ /gsang sngags brda yi phyag rgya 'dzin/ /byin rlabs mtshan ma gsal grub phyir/ /phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid spyad par bya/ /te ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad du/ /dam tshig rtags kyi mtshan ma yi/ /dpal gyi chas brgyad rgyan dang bcas / /'khor ba'i rgyu rkyen 'bras bu rnams/ /thugs rjes rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir/ /spyi dang khyad par rtags dag dang / /don gyi sgo nas gzhom par mdzad / /sems nyid bde ba chen po'i gnas/ /phung po dur khrod gzhal yas khang / /dga' ba chen po'i glu dang gar/ /dngos kyang mchod pa'i rdzas su bsngo4/ /dbang bsgyur 5chen po'i ting 'dzin sogs/ /thams cad tshul bzhin byin brlabs 6te/ /cir yang gyur pa'i yig 'bru las/ /'bar ba'i khang pa rnam par brjid/ /rang 'od sa bon so so las/ /bkod pa'i rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor che/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang chen pos/ /bsgrub rdzas de dag byin gyis brlabs/ /gro dhe shwa ri dag byed kyis/ /mtshan ma'i gnas kun sbyang par bya/ /mtshan ldan pad+ma'i pho brang du/ /'chi med lcags kyu tshogs pa dag /74—591

dpa' bo 'bru dgu'i 'phro 'du yis/ /thams cad bdud rtsi byang chub sems/ /mchod dang gtor tshogs zhal zas rnams/ /kun bzang dkyil 'khor rnam par dag /oṃ ma hā badz+ra tsakra maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ hūṃ oṃ hi hri tram̐ haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃlku/ oṃ ma hā kre dhe shwa ri sarba trab bye shwa dha ya āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ te hūṃ hri tha/oṃ te dzo ba lo te bha la bha ti gu h+ya sa ma ya swā hā/ so so'i ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang //sngags kyis gsal bar byas nas ni/ /sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnas rnams su/ /de dag so sor dgod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro rdzogs byas nas/ /bsnyen sgrub yan lag rnam bzhi yis/ /las kun 'bras bu'i gnas sbyor ba'i/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ /dang po chos kyi dbyings nyid la/ /dmigs pa med pa'i don kyis bsgom/ /dngos po med par bdag sbyor bas/ /nam mkha' kun dang 1mnyam spyor ba'o/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā ④ dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā shāwa a kolhaspyohaṃ/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis/ /thams cad du yang khyab byas la/ /chos kun stong gsal rang bzhin med/ /mi dmigs snying rje chen po'i ngang / /oṃ dharma dh+wa tu swa bhā wa āt+ma kophokruhaṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mkha' dbyings sna tshogs la gnas nas/ /cir yang gyur pa'i yig 'bru bsam/ /'od zer tshul du 'phros nas kyang / /ma lus nye bar khyab byas te/ /re zhing dam pa'i tshul du dgongs/ /e 'byung mkha' dbyings gru gsum dkar/ /gyen bsgreng bzang po'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /yo 'byung rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbyibs/ /dud kha sra mkhregs sgrol ma'i mkha'/ /baṃ las chu dkyil dkar zhing zlum/ /bum pas mtshan pa mā ma tī'u/ /lo las gser gyi sa gzhi ste/ /gru bzhi spyan ma rdo rjes mtshan/ /khaṃ las sna tshogs can gyi shematsho/ /14—592

lcags ri mu khyud nor bus mtshan/ /sum̐ las ri rab bang rim spyog /rin chen sna tshogs rgyu las grub/ /ram̐ las me dkyil dkar ser 'bar/ /zur mang 1gos dkar nam mkha'i dbyings/ /sra mkhregs rdo rje'i gzhi stengs la/ /kun 'byung 'khor lo sna tshogs 'bum/ /de dbus zlo las gzhal yas khang / /ye shes rin chen sna tshogs rgyan/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor gnas rnams su/ /re'u mig 'khor lo mtshungs pa brgyad/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i tshogs kyis brgyan/ /sna tshogs pad+ma gdan gyis 4mtshan/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim gnas brgyad du/ /dur khrod shing dang zhing skyong dang / /phyogs skyong rnal 'byor mtsho dang sprin/ /klu rgyal de dag gnas brgyad du/ /sha za 'byung po gshin rje dang / /mkha' 'gro bya khyi ro langs dang / /ce spyang khros pa'i sgra 'byin cing / /ro yi tshogs la longs spyod mdzad/ /rang 'byung mchod rten dang bcas pa/ /phreng ba rim gsum phyi rol gyi/ /ra ba'i mtshams su gnas pa las/ /kun 'byung rgyan gyis 5mtshan spras pa'o/ /de dbus 'khor lo'i lte ba la/ /pad zla nyi ma'i gdan stengs su/ /dpal mchog dang po gnas mdzad nas/ /'phrul dga'i ting 'dzin mngon par ston/ /chos rnams thams cad rnam brtags na/ /dngos med mtshan ma kun dang bral/ /zla dkyil ā li bcu drug bzhi/ /nyi dkyil kā lis brgyan pa'i 'od/ /'phro 'du mdzad par bcas pa yis/ /nyis 'gyur mtshan dang dpe byad gsal/ /de dag 'od du gyur pa la/ /'od phung 6kha dog sna lnga nyid/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /dkar po bum par hūṃ gis mtshan/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i dbyings/ /dang po rdo rje chen po yin/ /badz+ra a haṃ/'od zer lnga yi 'phro 'du yis/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi las mdzad nas/ /sku 14—593

gsung thugs dbyings zhugs pa las/ /'od zer phreng mdzes brjid pa'i mchog /de las sku mchog phyag rgya yis/ /sngags kyi yi ge brjod par bya/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa a/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ de dag ye shes byang chub sems//mngon byang lnga yi bdag nyid do/ /shel mdog dkar te 1'od 'bar ba'i/ /ri bo nyi ma'i mdangs chags pa/ /bzhin 'dzum snum zhing nyams tshogs rgyas/ /chags tshul dar la bab pa bzhin/ /zhal phyag mtshungs zhing sngon dmar ser/ /g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar/ /g.yon pa kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bur bcas/ /'og ma gnyis kyis rdomada' dang gzhu/ /rin chen rgyan dang na bza' dang / /mgul du do shal dpung rgyan dang / /phyag zhabs gdu bu se mo do/ /mtshan dpe phyag rgya lnga yis 4mdzes/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ni/ /gnas lnga dag tu gtugs 5bya ste / /sngags kyis bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /sgu gsung thugs sogs rnam par bsam/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya waka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko37haṃ/ lus kyi ba sru'i gnas rnams su/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi rdul phran gnas/ /mkha' dbyings dbang phyug phyag rgya yis/ /gnas kun byin gyes brlab par bya/ /oṃ dharmā 8dha tu swa bhā wa akhya kopho9haṃ/ rang 'od yum dang 'khril ba las/ /gsang gnas hūṃ dang ās 7brgyan te/ /ye shes rdo rje phaṭa dang bcas/ /rtse mo nor bu 'bar bas mtshan/ /rnam thar pad+ma e dkyil can / /mdog ser lte ba ze'u 1'bru dmar/ /sa ma ya sogs brdas bskul nas / /dza sahūṃ baṃ hoḥs rol ba bya/ /oṃ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a la la la la ho/bde ba chen po'i 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mnyes mdzad de/ /'gro ba'i lus ngag yid rtog sbyangs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rgyun sagyis brjid/ /14byed594

stong gsum til gang 'bru 'dra rnams/ /thams cad 'od kyis slar bsdus nas/ /sa/ngas rgyas drug gi yi ger gyur/ /ba sru'i bu ga kun du thim/ /thugs ka'i gnas su zhu ba dag / bde ba chen po'i gnas nas bab/ /rta'adod chags chen po dga' ba'i dras/ /sgu dang bcas pa 'od du gyur/ /sngon kyi goms shugs lha mo bzhis / /phyogs bzhi nas ni bskul byas te/ /stong pa shin tu rnal 'byor yod med mthu/ /nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs nga/ bzhengs/ su gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /ye shes gsal ba'i rgyud bsgul nas/ /thugs rjes 'gro la dmigs mdzad de/ /rgyu yi rjes mthun mgon po'i sku/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhengs par 'gyur/ /mtshan ma rgyan sogs cha lugs dang / /sgu mdog phyag mtshan snga ma bzhin/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yis4/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgyar ldan byas te/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bdag gi lhar ni bdag nyid bya/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ / thugs gsal nyi ma la gnas pa'i/ /ye shes sems dpa' t+t+waṃ sngags bcas/ /gsang ba'i phyag rgya rnam pa bzhis/ /las kun grub byed dngos grub gsal/ /'od zer 'phro 'du'i spyor ba yis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ /thugs ka nas byung lha mo bzhis/ /bdud rtsi bum pas khrus byas nas/ /gnas gsum dbang bsgur dri bral byas/ /slar 'dus tshangs bug gnas su thim/ /mthe bo sems dpa'i skyil mo krung / /mdzub mo gnyis ni 6rtse mo dgug /gung mo gnyis ni mnyam par sbyar/ /lhag ma rdo rje thal mo bya/ /spyi bo dang ni dpral ba dang / /lhan 7pa gnyis dang ltag par sbyar/ /oṃ a rnyi ṣiñtsa saṃ/ sor mo thams cad nang du bsnol/ /rtse mo 74—595

ngos rnams kun sprad nas/ /mthe bong rdo rjes mnan pa ni/ /sna dang mig phugs lta bu ste/ /gong bzhin mgo bo'i gnas lngar gtugasahūṃ/ /rin chen thod phreng skur bcas 'gyur/ /hūṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mo/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rin chen mchog /dpung rgyan kun du brgyan par bya/ /oṃ rat+na mā le a bhe ṣiñtsa t+t+waṃ/dbu rgyan bcings pas bcings nas ni/ /'gying zhing mtha' nas grol bar bya/ /oṃ pa ṭa lo ba a bhi ṣiñtsa t+t+waṃ/ dar gyi mtha' ma dpyangs pa ltar/ /byas nas thal mo brdab par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tu bye 4ho/ khams gsum dag na rin chen gzhan / /sangs rgyas rin chen lta bu med/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rin po che/ /dbu rgyan can ni de bas mchog /gzhan gyi nor min mi 'phrog pa/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa ste/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan dang / /sangs rgyas gtsug gi nor bu yi5/ /rjes su chags pa'i rnam mang dga' ba'i pad+mo rnams/ /dga' ba mchod pas gsal bar rjes su mchod byas pas/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i rnal 'byor bde bas bde grub mdzod/ /e ma'o mchog tu bde ba'i dam tshig ngo bo nyid / /mchog tu bde ba'i rnal 'byor skal bzang mchog dgyes pa/ /rang gi dam tshig rtag la rol cig rol cig ho/ /yab yum gsang gnas hūṃ dang dzaḥs6 / /rdo rje pad+ma bskyed byas nas/ /liṅga 'greng bar rang byung ba/ /brla yi dbus su gzhug byas te/ /ling ga rdo rjer byin brlabs nas/ /rdo rje sems sogs sku bstod do/ /byang chub sems de kun du dag /ma lus nye bar khyab byas nas/ /'dod par bya ba rab tu mnyes/ /'od 'dus thog ma'i gzugs la gzung / /gnas nas so so'i gdan dag la/ /chos kyi snying pos lha rnams bskyed/ /hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ / skyil krung thudabus kyi 14—596

gdan la'o/ /dzaḥlas dpal ldan bde mchog ma/ /hūṃ las e ma bde mchog ma/ /baṃ las lha mo snang mdzad ma/ /hoḥlas de bzhin slob ma'o1/ /'di dag gtso bo'i phyogs bzhi yi/ /re'u cha'i gdan la rim bzhin gnas/ /oṃ las sangs rgyas byang chub ma/ /rgyu las chos kyi 'khor lo ste/ /haṃ las khams gsum rnam rgyal yin/ /khaṃ las 'dod pa kun mdzad ma'o/ /'di dag shar la sogs pa yi//re'u mig 'khor lo'i rtse la gnas/ /oṃ las gling bu t+t+waṃ pi wang 4 baṃ las rnga chen rdza rnga ma/ /lha mo 'di bzhi me mtshams kyi/ /'khor lo'i rtse la rim bzhin gnas/ /a las me tog ā spos ma5/ /saṃ las mar me i dri chab/ /'di dag mtshams kyi gnas bzhi ru/ /rim pa bzhin du bskyed pa'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs sgo bzhi ru/ /rta mgrin 'phang mtho la sogs bskyed/ /bha gar liṅga bcug byas nas/ /der ni mtshan ma bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rgya che/ /sku gnyis ldan pa spro bar bya/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa s+dzadzaḥt+t+waṃ baṃ hoḥ/su ra ta s+t+waṃ 6dza/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa dang / /thabs la mkhas pa'i phrin las kyis/ /'dul phyir rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /skye ba dag gi rigs yin no/ /bde mchog 'gying bcas gar mdangs can/ /g.yon pas gzhu 'dzin g.yas mda' 'dren/ /rin chen phreng mdzes gos rgyan bklubs7/ /phyogs bcur 'gro ba'i don dbyung spro/ /dzaḥbadz+ra tijo sa ma ke madz+dza/ mthar phyin rigs mthun las mdzad ma/ /slar (sna'adus shar gyi gdan la gnas/ /e ma bde ba gser gyi mdog /g.yas pas ༄ snaliṅga rdo rje mtshan/ /g.yon pas bha ga rin chen snod/ /bde spros 'gying bcas lho phyogs su/ /hūṃ badz+ra tī li shī la hūṃ dz+dza 1 /snang mdzad dmar po g.yas pa na/ /sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon dag gis/ /'gying 74—597

bcas thod pa'i snod bdud rtsi/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rten 1nub phyogs gnas/ /baṃ badz+re ni sma ra ra ta dz+dza/ slob ma mo ni mdog ljang ser/ /g.yas kyis mda' bcas bdag po 'khyud/ /g.yon pas dkyil tshul bdud rtsi'i snod/ /sangs rgyas sgu 'dzin byang gi phyogs/ /ho badz+ra kā me shwa ri tram̐ dza/ kun kyang rgyan bcas zhi ba'i mdangs/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'bar bas mdzes/ /chags pa bzhin 'dzum stegs pa'i mchog /bdag bo chags tshul skul 4bar byed/ /sangs rgyas byang chub dkar mdangs dmar/ /tshangs pa'i mgo bzhis mtshan pa yi/ /mda' bzhi dus gcig 'phen pa'i tshul/ /'phro 'dus 'khor lo'i shar phyogs gnas5 / oṃ a ha /tshom du badz+re hūṃ s+t+waṃ dz+dza / chos kyi 'khor lo dkar mdangs/ ser / /g.yas pa'i gung mo'i rtse mo la/ /'khor lo rtse brgyad gnyis brtsegs/ bstod / /'khor lo'i lho phyogs rtse la gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra me bhe gu lu gu lu bye dz+dza/khams gsum rnam rgyal dmar skya'i mdog /g.yas gnyis tri shul 8rtse gsum stong / /g.yon pas rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin/ /gar mdzad 'khor lo'i nub phyogs gnas / /oṃ ma hā sha ra ti badz+re oṃ oṃ dz+dza/ 'dod pa'i dbang mo ljang gu'i mdog /phyag gnyis dpag bsam me tog shing / /lcug ma rlung gis bskyod pa 'dzin / /gar mdzad 'khor lo'i byang du gnas/ /oṃ khaṃ badz+ra shi shi ri hūṃ hūṃ dz+dza / gling bu sngon mo rdo rjes mtshan/ /sna tshogs sgra sgrogs me yi phyogs/ /e te ra ti badz+ra bi la se ni tra ṭa dz+dza/ pi wang ser mo rdo rjes mtshan/ /glu dbyangs drug ldan bden bral phyogs/ /he ra ti badz+ra te te to dz+dza/ rdza rnga dmar mo rdo rje'i rnga/ /brdung mdzad rlung mtshams la gnas pa'o/ /he ra ti badz+ra hā sa ha baṃ dza/ rdza rnga ljang gu rdza rnga la/ /rdo rjes mtshan brdung dbang 74—598

ldan phyogs/ /he ra ti badz+ra dṛ h+ye 1pe pa pe pa dze+e dz+dza/ me tog dmar ser rdo rjes mtshan/ /gzhong thogs me yi mtshams su gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra 2puṣ+pe dz+dza/spos me dkar sngon rdo rjes mtshan/ /spos thogs bden bral mtshams su gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe dz+dza4/ mar me dmar mo 5rdo rjes mtshan/ /gsal 'dzin rlung gi mtshams su gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke dz+dza/ dri chab 6ljang gu rdo rjes mtshan/ /dga' — 'thor dbang ldan mtshams su gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra gadhe dz+dza/ rta mgrin 'phang mtho dkar mdangs can/ /lcags kyu rta mgo ljang gu shar/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dz+dza / phag gdong nag mo zhags pa g.yon/ /g.yas pas mche ba lho yi sgor/ /oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ dz+dza/ snang ba dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis/ /nyi zla lcags sgrog nub kyi phyogs/ /oṃ badz+ra shri kha le paṃ dz+dza / thal byed ljang gu g.yas dril bu/ /g.yon pas bhan+dha sku bcas byang / /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi hoḥdz+dza—/ lha mo 'di dag mdzes pa'i mdangs/ /rin chen rgyan dang phreng bas brgyan/ /kun mkhyen ye shes las grub phyir/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams thams cad kyi/ /mig la sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /rna ba rdo rje nyi ma rgya 5/ /kha la pad+ma gar dbang phyug /sna la rta mchog rol pa mchog /yid la rdo rje he ru ka /lus la rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /gnas gsum phyag rgya'i tshogs ldan zhing / /thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' gnas/ /rang rigs dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas/ /dbang bsgur rigs kyi mtshan ma bsam/ /lag gnyis gar thabs bskyed ྾byas te / /g.yas g.yon mdun rol bskor bar bya/ /rdo rje bcing ba'i rgya gnyis lasatre / /rdo rje se gol brdab par bya/ /dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa khyab pa'i sku/ /spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang / /thugs 14—599

rje'i ngang nyid chos sku dag pa las/ /ye shes sgyu mar ⑨rol cing gshegs su gsol—/ /bsnyengs pa mi mnga' stobs bcu'i shugs ldan zhing / /ma 'dres sangs rgyas chos rnams rab tu rdzogs/ /dpa' bo chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang thabs cig ④gshegs su gsol/ /thugs rje chen po'i sgu mnga' gsung gnyis rdzogs/ /mi 'jigs thugs mnga' seng ge bskyod du med/ /gdug pa'i tshogs mang zil gyis gnon mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan 'gro la brtse slad gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ e bye hi bha ga bān1/ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ḍi 5 sh+ya ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje gar las byung ba yi/ /dgug gzhug bcing dang pad+ma'i rgya/ /bde gshegs pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'gro ba ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /don gyi dbang gis dgongs nas kyang / /'khor bcas gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ aX⑤hūṃ/ kā ya bāka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ/ dpal ldan g.yon pa 'akying ba'i thabs/ /g.yas pa ba dan gsum pa phyar⑨/ /sri zhur bcas shing steg ⑦pa'i mchog /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dpal/ /'dzum dang bcas pa'i mig gis blta/ /bsam g.yos thal mo sbyar bar bya/ /sgyu 'phrul dga' ba'i rdo rje rol mo'i tshogs/ /gzhan la snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par mdzes/ /tshangs pa'i tshogs rnams zil gyis gnon mdzad pa'i/ /rtog pa du ma'i sgro 'dogs gcod par mdzad/ /gnyis med ye shes gnyis can rnam dumatha' yas/ /snang stong gnyis med bde chen dbyings la rol/ /kun 'byung yon tan spyod med lhun 'grub ⑨snang / /rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor rnam bkod rang las byung / /mdzad pa rgya chen grogs ⑫med kun grub pas/ /tshogs bcas rol pas bya ba kun rdzogs mdzad/ /sna tshogs 14—600
