sku sprul rigs kyi sku gnas mchog /zab cing rgya che gsung dbyangs rdo rje'i glu/ /ye shes zag med thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /rin chen tshogs kyis legs spras kun 'byung zhing / /bdag gzhan spyod tshogs las rnams 'bras mthar phyin//dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ a ti bhu ho/sarba ta thā ga ta rgo kā ro ya mi a la la ho/ oṃ a ti ju hūṃ/ ta thā ga tā 1sa ma yo ga sidhi āḥhūṃ/ skad kyi gsangs —ni mtho dman dang / /gre 'gyur hūṃ bcas /sogs pa'i glus/ /'gying la sogs pa'i tshul bcas nas/ /ji lta'i tshul bzhin gar byed cing / /bskor ba'i gar rnams sna tshogs kyis/ /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya/ /oṃ pa na pe na pe nu su ra ta/ di pu par mu/sarba ta thā ga ta/ sa ma yo ga sidhi āḥhūṃ/ gyen du 'thor dang thur du 'be+ebs//gsal med 4'degs sogs so so'i rgya/ /gling bu dang ni rgyud gcig dang / /rgyud mangs ltargyud drug sil snyan brdung / /dngos 'byor 'phrul pa gang yang rung / /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor mnyes par bya/ /oṃ ā 6hūṃ/ rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dam pa grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ / mchod pa chen po thams cad grub par mdzod/ /7a la la ste mchod par 'bul/ /a la la ste dam tshig bskangs8/ /a la la ste dgyes par mdzod9sna / /a la la ste dngos grub stsol/ /dgyes mnyam longs spyod mchog la rol—/ /oṃ shrī rā ga hūṃ/ a 13badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/ a 5badz+ra dhū pe dhu/ a badz+ra ā lo ke tweḥ a 1/badz+ra gadhe shaṃ/ oṃ he ra ti badz+ra pi la si na tra ṭa/ he ra d+ku ti badz+ra ghi te te to/ te ra ti badz+ra hā se ha ha pe/ te ra ti badz+ra 1 t+ya tshape pe pe 14byed601

pa dze+e1/ a la la la la ho/ tshad med bzhi yi phyag rgya yis/ /dkyil 'khor mdun bsgul g.yo byas nas/ /dga' ba'i khams snyoms 'od dpung tshogs/ /ma 'dres so so'i gnas su bstem/ /t+t+waṃ sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /bde ba kun la zhen pa dang / /dngos grub thams/ cad rnam dag phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bde ba'i mchog /zla ba nya ltar rtsa dmar sgu/ /'dod chags kun la chags pa'i phyir/ /chags pa chen po'i bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya 'di/ /dmar po sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar bstod / /kha ṭ+wāṃ ba dan dril bskyod sgra/ /'gying tshul sku yi gnas su brtan/ /lhag mthong thabs kyi mnga' gsor zhing / /zhi gnas shes rab gzhu yis mdzes/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi spyor ba yis/ /bde ba'i cha lugs gar byed cing / /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung bcas nas/ /dpung rnams thams cad rab tu 'joms/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satā aḥ/ dzaḥt+t+waṃ baṃ hoḥ /su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ ma hā sru tra hūṃ s+t+waṃ/ zla ba'i kha dog 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /dngos grub thams cad dag pa dang / /pad+mo 'dod chags rnam dag phyir/ /brla yi dbus ni dkar la dmar/ /phyag mchog lo ma sngon po 'dra/ /de bzhin bde bar dbang phyug dang / /bde bar reg pa'i dbang phyug pas/ /dkar zhing ser ba'i brla dang ldan/ /lha rdzas sna tshogs kha dog mchog /'bar ba sna tshogs 'khrugs pa'i 'od/ /pad+mo sna tshogs la gnas pa/ /thams cad dag par rab tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma la sogs mchog /rin chen sna 74—602

tshogs rgyan dang gos/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pas so/ /mi mjed la sogs brgyan pa bzhin/ /bya ba dang ni bzlog pa dang / /dbrog pa dag kyang khyab par mdzad/ /bdag la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /yan lag thams cad 'phrog pa 'grub/ /dzaḥbadz+re 1driṣ+ṭi sa ma ya 2ke ma ṭa/ ma hā mu tra hūṃ/ rnam pa sna tshog dam tshig chags/ /bde ba 'bab pa'i gar byed pa4/ /bdag la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya mchog /dbus kyi lha mchog chen mo'o/ /hūṃ badz+ra tī li tī li hūṃ/ ma hā mu tra hūṃ/ se ral kha yi tshul dag tu/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzung ste//bdag la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /pad bcas rdo rje rgya gram 5mchog /baṃ ba dz+re ṇi sma 6ra rata ṭa/ ma hā mu dra 7hūṃ/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi kham phor grub/ /bdag la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje sem/sa dang/'a dpal spyor ba/ /dbus kyi lha mo mchog chen mo/ /hoḥbadz+ra kā me/ shwa ri t+t+waṃ / ma hā nu/ dra t+t+waṃ/gtsug lag ji lta'i rjes mthun par/ /dpa'/ rdzogs/ rgya che gar dag bis// /mda' bzhi yongs su 'phang 1 nas ni/ /bdud bzhi las ni rgyal bar 'gyur/ /oṃ i ma du badz+re hūṃ hūṃ/ ma hā nu/ dra rkahūṃ/ rkang pa bteg cing phang pa dang / /bshig ste 'phang pa'i stabs dag gis/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgya bstod nas/ ni/ /khams gsum dag las mchongs ripar 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra me+e bhe rka5gu 'u/ gu 'u/ hūṃ/ma hā mu dra dzit+t+waṃ/ bya ba dang ni bzlog pa dang / /darngog pa dag bi khyad par du / /sna tshogs phyag rgya gar byed cing / /khams gsum dag ni basbu bar bya/ /oṃ ma hā shwa rka ra da badz+re oṃ oṃ/ ma hā mu dra hūṃ/ lcags kyus gang yang rung bzung nas/ /bdag la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /bud med thams cad rtsen nas ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yongs su 'grub/ /oṃ khaṃ badz+ra she shi ri rna hūṃ 7 (byed603

hūṃ / ma hā mu dra 1hūṃ/ gling bu len pa'i tshul ston cing / /ji ltar 'bab pa'i gar byed pas/ /stabs gtugs rīglu bcas bsgrings zhe pa'i tshul/ /yid 'phrog sngags kyis las mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ he ra ti 4badz+ra bi la 3si na tra ṭa/ ma hā mu tra hūṃ/ pi wang len pa'i tshul ston cing / /ji ltar 'bab pa'i gar byed pas / /sna tshogs bsgyur cing de don 'phrul/ /dga' dbyangs bsgyur bas gnas gsum bskyod/ /he badz+ra bhe te te to/ ma hā mu dra thuhūṃ/ cang te'i tshul ston rnal 'byor pa'i/ /ji ltar dbab pa'i gar byed pas/ /sgu gsung jeg chen rgyud ston pa'i/ /phyag rgya gar gyis kun las rgyal/ /oṃ he rā ti badz+ra hā se ha ha paṃ/ ma hā mu dra t+t+waṃ/ rdza rnga'i tshul ston rnal 'byor pa/ /ji ltar 'bab pa'i gar byed cing / /g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab blta ba'i bzhin/ /bzhi spyor glu bcas kun bstan pa'o/ /oṃ te rā 9ti badz+ra dṛ te pe te pe pe paṃ dzaḥ ma hā mu dra hūṃ/ cang te'u'i tshul ston rnal 'byor pas/ /sasbyin pa'i mchog gnas rnam par grol/ /gzugs mchog lha rdzas me tog rgya/ /sa gzhi mdun rol g.yas g.yon bstod / /sna tshogs dpung —pa 'thor byed pa'o/ /he ra ti badz+ra puste/ ma hā mu dra hūṃ/ tshul khrims dri mchog tshim byed pa'i/ /bdud mchog spos legs sbyar ba'i mchog /g.yas skor 5bteg te phyogs bcur bsgyur/ /mdun du phyogs par sngo byed pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū slopa ma hā mu dra hūṃ/ bzod gsol shes rab ting nge 'dzin/ /mun tshogs gsal byed mar me'i rgya 8/ /kun du bskor rteba'i gar bsgyur zhing / /thugs ka'i mtshan ma gsal ston pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke/ ma hā mu dra hūṃ/ brtson 'grus rtse gcig 'gyur ba med/ /chos kun dag byed byug pa'i dri/ /srin mjeb rang 74—604

gnas rtse gsum 'thor/ /phyogs kun dngos ni bcos dag 'gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe1 / ma hā mu dra 2hūṃ/ pad+ma can de'i bdud rtsi bstod/ /myang ba rngub pa ltar byed pa'i/ /be+egs kyu'i phyag rgya rdo rjer bcas/ /'gugs pa'i tshul las grub pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥ/ ma hā mu dra hūṃ/ rdo rje mche ba 'jigs pa'i rgya/ /sna yi myang ba'i rngub pa yis/ /rin chen zhags bcas gsol ka'i tshul/ /rang gi las la spyor byed pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pā she hūṃ/ ma hā mu dra hūṃ/ rdo rje lcags sgog nyi zlar bcas/ /mig btsums zhen par blta ba yis / /khams gsum kun la gzigs pa'i rgya/ /phyag rgya'i las kyis bsten byed pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra shri kha le baṃ/ ma hā mu dra hūṃ/ mtshan ldan sku mchog bdud rtsis bkang / /thams cad bdag nyid myang ba yis/ /stong pa gsung dbyangs rgyun mi 'chad/ /thal 'jig rgyud rnams slar 'tsho mdzad/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ho4ཿma hā mu dra t+t+waṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /bdag cag sgrub la rtog 5par mdzad du gsol/ /kye de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag nyid bde/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma sna tshogs bde ba'i mchog /'gro ba'i rgyud rnams rnam pa sna tshogs 'dul/ /dngos 6grub bdag la grub par mdzad du gsol/ /a la la ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyor ba rnams/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gar rnams bstan du gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ kye bde ba chen po'i mchog kun gyi/ /bde bas zung la rnam par 'phrul par mdzad7/ /hūṃ snang bar mdzad du gsol/ /a la la ho/ bde gshegs mkha' 'gro slob ma gzung du gsol/ /mtshan ma'i yi ge pad+ma'i dkyil/ /kun gyi rtse la bsgom byas nas/ /'od zer 'phro 'du'i sbyor ba yis/ /rang sngags chos kyi phyag rgyar bcas/ /oṃ 74byed605

na mo badz+ra sarba stu ta sarba bud+dhi bh+yaḥhūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi//spyor ba'i sngags kyi mthu dag gis/ / la sogs she7mchod pa ma lus pa lus pa med par kun la sbyar/ /mdzub mos mthe bo mnan nas ni/ /rang gi mje bos mdzub mo mnan/ /dpal grub can gyi phyag rgya ste/ /mdzub mo mig gi 'bras bur bya/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam sprur nas/ /khong stong du ni byas nas su//gsang sngags dam tshig spyor bzhag thuste/ /rim bzhin mtha' nas grol bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe — no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dro 4rto me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo chome bha ba/ a nu rasto me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo 6me bha ba/sarba sidhi me 7pra yats+tsha/ sarba karmā su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ she ya 8bheḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga bān9/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī —bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ/ srin lag mthe'u shānyechung yan lag dbus/ /mthe bo legs par gzhag 1 par bya/ /de nas khu tshur bcings 12nas ni/ /mdzub mo legs par dgug par bya/ /gsang sngags la sogs spyor byas pas/ /so so'i las la gzhug bya ste/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i 'ching grol gyis/ /rang gi phrin las kun spyod pa'o/ /dman pa'i phyag rgya rnam pa bzhis/ /dngos grub sna tshogs las spyor ba'o/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes kyis/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bye 7ཿsarba tarja uṅga te sahi saṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ 'byung ba lnga las thams cad 'byung / /rang las ma byung gang yang med/ /gtsang sme'i ltedri rtog kun bral ba'i/ /bdud rtsi byang chub sems chen pos/ /bdag sogs gnyis med mchod pa'i phyir/ /14—606

mnyam pa chen pos gnas la rol/ /hūṃ ma hā su kha bo bye tsit+ta a la la ho a la la ho / o mnyam med mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rjes 1bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam pa med pa'i chos mchog can/ /oṃ yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yang mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol2/ /oṃ rtag tu dri ma med pa'i thugs rje shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don grub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje 4chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /oṃ tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yis/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog tu stsol 5mdzad cing / /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yongs mi 'gyur/ /oṃ e ma'o shin tu bzang po'i dngos grub mchog dang ldan / /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang na go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ /khams gsum rnams la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum bsgrib 6pa med par rab mkhyen pa/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /o phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mtha' klas par/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub la/ /ji ltar thugs kyi dbang phyug bzhin/ /de nyid spyod par bdag gyur cig /ji srid thog ma med dus nas/ /'khor ba yi ni mthar thug par/ /de srid sems can phan pa nyid/ /mtha' yas spyod par bdag 7 4—607

gyur cig /sngags kyi tshul kyis sems can rnams/ /de tshe bdag gis dul 'gyur zhing / /kun gyis rig 1'dzin gnas thob nas/ /de nyid mgon po mthong bar shog /lha rnams kun gyi gnas zhugs pa'i/ /ye shes sems dpa'i sngags 'khor lo/ /nyi zla rten dang brten pa'i sngags/ /'khor lo'i tshul ldan shes rab thabs/ / yi ge — mtshan ma sku yi gnas/ /yan lag rnam gsum ldan byas te/ /gsal ba nyid kyi sgo nas brtsam4/ /bgrang ba las ni 'das pa'o/ /rtse gabyug gnas su 'khor ba dang / /las dang rgyu dang 'phro ba las / /mchod bskul las mdzad bsdu byed cing / /dkyil 'khor gsal bar gyur pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa ma hā sa ma ya āḥhūṃ swā hā/ thun mong gi gsang sngags yi ge bcu bzhi pa'o/ /so so'i las la snyoms zhugs 5nas/ /rang gi thun mtshan 6sngags yig bcas/ /'phro 'dus rang gi las mdzad nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsal grub pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa āḥ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ7/ khyad par gyi snying po yi ge bco brgyad pa'o/ /sngags gzhan rim bzhin gsal ldan pas/ /go rims 'khrul med bzlas brjod bya/ /las rdzogs mchod bstod bskul byas nas/ /rang gi gnas su bsnyu bar bya/ /thun mtshams gzhan du bsam bya ba/ /bzlas brjod khyad par phyed pa'i tshad/ /bzhi'am drug tu rim bzhin bzla/ /kun bzang mchod pa nas brtsams te/ /de mthar phyin pa'i las rdzogs nas/ /glu gar dbyangs kyis dngos grub bskul/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal byas nas/ /tshogs gnyis sdogs par sgrub byed pa'i / /tshogs kyi dga' bde'i longs spyod kyis/ /rnal 'byer bcas pa mnyes par bya/ /lha rnams mnyes shing tshim pa dang / /las kun bsgrub par 14—608

bya ba'i phyir/ las rnams ma lus bsdus pa yi/ /sbyin sreg ①cho ga rgyas par brtsam—/ /rta mchog mkha' 'go 'khor bcas la②/ /lhag pa'i mchod pas mnyes byas nas/ /rang gi las la sbyar bya ste/ /dngos grub don phyir mtshams su gzhag① /nang par dkyil 'khor mchod bstod cing / /bskor bcas rgyun du bshags te gdon/ /ye shes dam tshig gnyis med bsdu/ /rdul tshon gtsang ma'i gnas su gzhagarjo /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /ji lta'i gzugs dang dbyibs su ldan/ /bde ba nyid kyis kun du ⑤bdag /kun gyis ⑥bdag la gzhug par bya/ /chags pa med cing ma chags med/ /dbu mar yang ni dmigs su med/ /bud med kun gyi rgyu sbyor 'di/ /gnyis su med pa'i theg pa'i mchog /mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor kun gyi gzhi/ /don dam bde ba chen po'i sku/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes kyi/ /lha nyid brtson pas bsgom par bya—/ /mdzod gnas dpa' bo'i gzugs brnyan mchog /rin chen sna lnga'i phreng bas 'khrigs/ /tshon dze+egang zla nyi'i gdan la gnas/ /pho brang sgo bzhi gdan pad+ma/ /chos kyi snying po nyi shu gcig / zla mdangs ④'khor lo'i tshul 'chang ba'o⑨/ /mi gsal gsal ba'i rnam par brtag /'phro 'dus rigs kyi skur rdzogs shing / /rgyan chas cha lugs gsal byas te/ /rang gi phrin las spro byed pa'o/ /phyag rgya bzhi rdzogs dbang bskur ldan/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor gnyis med bstem/ /mchod bstod las la bskul gsal 'grub/ /yun ring ⑩mtshan ma lnga yi mthar/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la dmigs te/ /kun rmi gsang ba'i mdzod rgyas par/ /dmigs pa gcig bzhin gsal ba ru/ /brten par gyur nas spro bar bya/ /rgya cher gnas gsum rdo rje la/ /bum pa'i khang par 14byed609

dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /rim bzhin gtso bo'i rnam pa gnas/ /'khor gyi lha mo mthar thug par/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis med rdzogs pa'i mthar/ /mnyes mdzad 'gro ba'i don la sbyar/ /dpa' bo mtshan ma gsang gsum sngags/ /'phro 'du'i phreng ba kun 'khor bas/ / 'gal me'i ①'khor lo'i rnam pa bzhin//gnas kun bar chad med par brtsam/ /smig rgyu du ba srin bu me/ /mar me zla nyi'i 'od bzhin du/ /thig le rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /phyag rgya chen po'i lam la sbyor/ /gnyis med rol pa'i mkha' gsang du/ /gtso bo'i mtshan ma gsal gyur nas/ bum par rten dang brten pa'i lha/ /gtso bo nas bzung 1 rim par bsgom/ /phyag rgya rgyan chas cha lugs kyi/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa dang / /phyag rgya bzhis mtshan dbang bskur 'bras/ /skye mched byin brlabs gsal bar bya/ /ye shes lha dang sbyor gnas nas/ /dman pa'i phyag rgya bzhi yis gdab/ /mchod bstod 'gro ba'i don spro ba/ /rim bzhin mtshan ma lnga yi bar/ /lha rnams kun sbyor gnas rgyas par/ /rnam gcig bskul blugasal ji lta bar/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i tshul brtan pa/ /phra rags dkyil 'khor mthar phyin pa'o/ /des ni phrin las dngos grub kyi/ /phra mo'i las kun brtsams pas 'grub/ /de ltar thig le phra mo'i tshul/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi rnam dag gibu/ /mtshan mas dmigs pa sbyang byas te/ /chos sku'i phyag rgya chen por gnasarka/ /gang zag bzhi yi ⑤dbye ba yis/ /rang gi phrin las sbyor ba'i mthus/ /bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi rdzogs te/ /mchog gyur phyag rgya bzhi mthar phyin/ /bsnyen sgrub sbyor ba bzhi dag gis/ dang po'i dkyil 'khor mnyes byas pa/ /spyi yi bsnyen pa dang po ste/ /thun mong bzhi yi rjodakyil 'khor yin/ /rnal 14—610

'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgrub 'dod pas/ /bar chad med par zhi rgyas dbang / /phrin las sna tshogs sgo dag nas/ /nye ba'i bsnyen ①pa brtsam pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi yi las la 'jug /dang po zhi ba chen po'i las/ /rgyud sbyang bsrung zhing lhag gnas dang / /dngos grub shis pa brtag pa'i phyir/ /rnam snang dkyil 'khor nye bar bsnyen/ /de bzhin nyid nas brtsam bya ste/ /phreng bas brgyan pa'i bar du bsgom/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor dbyings dag ni/ /re'u mig zlum po 'khor los brgyan/ /'khor lo'i phreng bas rnam par spras/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan gyis mtshan/ /phyi rol ra ba dur khrod dang / /kun 'byung khor ②yug tu bzhis mtshan/ /mngon par byang chub rnam lnga yis/ /mgon po rgyu yi sems dpa' bskyed④/ /sku mdog rgyan cha nas bzung ste/ /byin rlabs rdzogs pas dag par bya/ /rang 'od rig ma bskyed pa nas/ /lha mos bskul ba'i mthar thug brtsam/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i rgyud gzigs te/ /khaṃ dang 'khor lo las byung ste/ /zhing oṃ rgyu dhikhaṃ gis bskyed pa'i/ /'dul phyir rnam snang mdzad du gyur/ /gser mdog zhal bzhi phyag bzhi mdzes/ /zhal gsum dkar dmar ljang gu'i mdog /chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la/ /sna tshogs mtshan mas brgyan pa'am/ /lhung bzed khar rjogasil chos gos dang / /dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam 'dzin/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan dang gos/ /mtshan dpe phyag rgya lnga yis rjospras/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / /ye shes sems dpa' sngags dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ⑦dbang bskur zhing / /dbu la rigs kyi bdag pos brgyan//rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar te/ /lag gnyis nor bu rin chen du/ /ji ltar 14—611

rigs ①pas mnyam sbyar nas/ /mdzub mo ④maze bo rtse mo bzhi/ /yongs su bsgyur te bteg nas su/ /dpral ba'i gnas su gzhag dze+epar bya/ /oṃ a nyi ṣiñtsa māṃrjo/ rin chen myu gu 'khor lo'i phreng / /dar dpyangs ⑤dgyes pa'i thal mor bcas/ /rang 'od yum dang 'khril ba nas/ /gnas nas khaṃ dang shaṃ brgyan te/ /liṅga 'bar ba'i rin chen phaṭa/ /rtse mo 'khor lo rnam par mdzes/ /rnam thar pad+ma e dkyil can/ /mdog ser lte ba ze'u du'abru dmar/ /sa ma ya sogs brdas bskul nas/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs rol pa bya/ /liṅga 'greng ba rang 'byung ⑦ba/ /brla yi dbus su gzhug byas nas/ /liṅga mtshan mar byin brlabs te/ /rdo rje dbyengs dag sngon skye'o⑧/ /gsang gnas so so'i gdan dag la/ /chos kyi snying pos lha rnams bskyed/ /khaṃ las rnam par snang mdzad nyid—/ /dbus kyi gdan la bsgom par bya/ /shaṃ las sangs rgyas dbyangs ma ste—/ /ram̐ las de bzhin dpal mo ma/ /rma las kun du bzang mo yin/ /dze+e las zad med snod 'dzin ma'o/ /'di bzhi'i gtso bo'i phyogs rnams su/ /pho brang pad+ma bzhi la gnas/ /haṃ las sangs rgyas sku ldan ma/ /tsho ⑨las lha mo zhal mdzes mo/ /tram̐ las de bzhin sprin chen mo/ /rda las nam mkha'i spyan ma yin—/ /gling bu ma sogs lha mo rnams/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor bzhin—/ /bha gar liṅga bcug byas nas/ /der ni mtshan ma bsgom par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzugs 'dra ba'i/ /sku gnyis ldan pa spro bya'o/ /oṃ khyu khaṃ dz+dza/ phyogs bcur don byas 'dus pa dag /gtso bo yab yum la gzhug bya//sangs rgyas dbyangs ma chu shel mdangs/ /rgyan mdzes lce yi phyag rgyas mtshan/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa shaṃ dz+dza/ dpal mo gser mdog phyag gnyis kyis/ /cha lang 'khrol 14—612

zhing gar mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na ram̐ dz+dza/ kun du bzang mo dmar gsal mdangs / /phyag gnyis rdo rje rin po che/ /oṃ badz+ra dharmā 1mo dz+dza/ zad med snod 'dzin sna tshogs mdog /rgyan chas snod dang dung 'dzin pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra karma dze+e dz+dza/ 'di bzhi dbus kyi lha mo ste/ /phyag rgya'i sku dang 'khril bar 2bzhugs / /sangs rgyas sku ldan me long mdog /phyag gnyis mi bskyod thugs kar 'dzin/ /haṃ satwa badz+ra dz+dza/ zhal mdzes sngo skya phyag gnyis kyis/ /me long mdangs gsal rlung yab 'dzin/ /tsha 4badz+ra rasne 5dz+dza/ sprin chen bai dru 6r+ya mdog phyag /rdo rje'i sprin las ser ba 'be+ebs / /tai badz+ra pad+me dz+dza/nam mkha'i spyan ma gur gum mdog /phyag na pad+ma la gnas spyan/ /rda bi shwa badz+ra dz+dza/ 'di dag phyogs kyi 'khor lo la/ /rim pa bzhin du dgod par bya/ /lha mo 'di dag mdzes pa'i mdangs/ /rin chen dar dang phreng bas brgyan/ /byen brlabs / dbang bsgur rdzogs byas pas/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor gsal bar gyur/ /spyor bas rang rig dkyil 'khor bsgul/ /zhi ba'i tshul bcas mdun du bzhugs/ /rdo rje dpal byu thal mo bsgyur/ /bsam pa g.yos pas phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ a ti bhu oṃ/ gar bsgyur rdo rje thal mo bsgyur/ /g.yon skor 7spyi bo'i mtshams su gzhag /skal bzang oṃ zhes bya ba'i glu/ /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya/ /tshad med bzhi yi spyor ba yis/ /lha rnams gnyis su med par gyur/ /oṃ rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /thar pa thams cad rnam dag phyir/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya dpal du gnas/ /don dam rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ btso ma gser gyi kha dog bzhin/ /chags med la sogs chags chen phyir/ /dkar zhing sna 74—613

tshogs gsal ba'i mdangs/ /chos kyi rgyal srid rab bsgrub pa/ /rin chen chos las lhag pa med/ /de bas 1jeg chen byang chub sems/ /rgyal ba rdo rje rin chen can/ /g.yas pa'i mje bong gung mo gnyis/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcangs pa yis/ /sor mo kun la reg pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i phyag rgya yin par grags / /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gsal yin / /g.yas pa'i yan lag gnon pa yis/ /g.yon pa'i yan lag kun las rgyas/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung bcas na/ /dpung rnams thams/ cad 'joms par byed/ /oṃ byu khaṃ ma hā mu dra oṃ/ rdo rje khu tshur bcangs nas kyang / /lag pa g.yon pas bkab nas ni/ /sangs rgyas kun brjod dngos grub rnams/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa shaṃ ma hā mu dra 4oṃ/de bzhin dpal ldan he ru ka'i/ /rdo rje khya tshur chen po dgab / /dpa' bo ma yis/ dngos grub rnams/ /ma lus lus/ pa med par 'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na re ma hā mu dra oṃ/ pad+mo'i bud rnged khu tshur ni/ /de bzhin lag pa g.yon pas dgab/ / /byang chub spyod pa rab grub rnams/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub / /oṃ badz+ra dharma māṃ ma hā mu dra oṃ/ rin chen 'dzin pa'i khu tshur yang / /lag pa g.yon pas bkab ranas ni/ /sangs rgyas nor kun dngos grub rnams/ /ma lus/ lus pa rnged par 'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra karma ma hā mu dra oṃ/ sangs rgyas khu tshur bcangs nas su/ /lag pa g.yon pas bkab nas ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gye tshe sgrub pa/ /ma lus lus pa med pa 'grub/ /haṃ satwa badz+ra ma hā mu dra oṃ / bud med phyag rgya bcings nas su/ /lag pa g.yon pas bkab na ni/ /dngos grub thams cad myur 'grub pa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /7 4—6/ /

tsho 1badz+ra rasne ma hā mu dra oṃ/ rta mchog dpal gyi khu tshur yang / /lag pa g.yon pas bkab nas ni/ /thams cad 'gugs 4pa rab bsgrub pa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /t+t+waṃ 5badz+ra pad+me ma hā mu dra 6oṃ/ dpal grub 7spyan gyi khu tshur yang / /lag pa g.yon pas bkab na ni/ /snang ba thams cad rab 'grub 'gyur/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /rda bi shwa badz+ra 8ma hā mu dra oṃ/ oṃ 'jig rten khams mang rdul phran snyed/ /grangs med khyab par spros pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i don rnams rab dag tu/ /phra ba'i rdul kyi grangs snyed pa/ /sprul pa'i sgu rnams rab dag tu/ /phra ba'i rdul gyi grangs snyed ni/ /srid pa bde chen de bzhin gshegs/ /rnam 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs/ kyis/ /rdul phran grangs snyed de bzhin gshegs/ /rnam par 'phrul pas rol mdzad do/ /rnam par snang mdzad dpal spyor ba/ /a la la ho bde grub mdzod/ /oṃ ru ru sgu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sidhe lots+tsha ne+e sarba arja sidhe / ni swā hā/ rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar nas / /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug /mthe bo'i rtse mo mnyam par bzhagarka /khong stong mi 'gyur dam pa po/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzhag nas kyang / /sngags bcas rim bzhin grol bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur legs bcings la/ /bdag gi mje bo nang nas gzhug1 /zhi ba'i las rnams bsgrub pa yis/ /phyag rgya sngags rnams mnyam spyor ba'o/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs dag /byen brlabs sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul/ /mnyam med mi g.yo la sogs pa'i/ /bstod pa'i phyag rgyas mnyes par bya/ /smon lam rgya chen btab byas nas/ /bzlas brjod thig le phra mo dang / /dkyil 'khor de nyid gang rung gis/ /mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor brtan par bya/ /sgrib sbyang bde ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /14—6/bye

rin chen bum pa byabs 3pa'i dzas/ /sngags kyi pra ti me tog phreng / /bza' btung phyag rgya bdud rtsi'i tshogs/ /lam mnyes mgron tshim las grub byed/ /tshogs dang sbyin sreg lhag ma'i las/ /las rdzogs mchod bstod bskul byas shing / /rang gi gnas su bsdus nas ni/ /mtshan ma kun dang yongs bral ba'i/ /mnyam nyid dbyings su gnas par bya/ /yod pa ma yin med pa min/ /dbu mar yang ni dmigs su med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin spyor ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub pa'o/ /thams cad dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ /pad+ma gar dbang mchod byas te/ /chags bcas bsdus shing gzung byas nas/ /tshe yi cho ga rgya cher bya/ /gzhi yi ting 2'dzin rim pa nas/ /phreng bas brgyan pa'i bar du bsgom/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor dbyibs dag ni/ /re'u cha dgu dang pad+mas bskor / /pad+ma'i lcug ma mu khyud mdzes/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan gyis mtshan/ /phyi rol ra ba dur khrod dang / /kun 'byung khor yug tu bzhis mtshan/ /mngon par byang chub rnam lnga yis/ /mgon po rgyu yi sems dpa' bskyed/ /sgu mdog rgyan cha nas bzung ste/ /byin brlabs rdzogs pas dag par bya/ /rang 'od rig ma bskyed pa nas/ /lha mos bskul ba'i mthar thug brtsam / /thugs rjes 'gro la dmigs nas bzhengs/ /dhī5ཿdang pad+mo las byung ba'o/ /oṃ swa bhā wa bi shudha pad+ma narte shwa re twe6ཿ/ dpal ldan pad+ma gar dbang phyug /zla gsal shel mdangs zhal bco lnga/ /lnga bcu gnyis ldan mtshan bcas gar/ /zhal 7bzhi mnyam pa'i pad+ma la/ /zla mdog dmar mdangs zhal bzhi pa/ /phyag g.yas nyi shu rtsa lnga na/ /pad+ma rdo rje sogs kyis mtshan/ /kha dog bdun ldan nyi shu lnga/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gos bklubs/ /mtshan dpe phyag rgya 14—616

lnga yis spras/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / /ye shes sems dpa' sngags dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur zhing / /dbu la rigs kyi bdag pos brgyan/ /mje bong sems dpa'i skyil mo krung / /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug /gung mo gnyis ni mnyam par sbyar/ /lhag ma rdo rje thal mo'i 'od / /rdo rje rin chen phyag rgya 'di/ /rang 'byung rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'o / /oṃ a bye ṣiñtsa hriḥ/ pad+ma'i myu gu phyag rgya'i phreng / /dar dpyangs dgyes pa'i thal mo bcas/ /rang 'od yum dang 'khril ba las/ /gsang gnas dhīḥ1dang dzaḥs brgyan te/ /pad+ma 'bar ba phaṭa dang bcas/ /rnam thar pad+ma e dkyil can/ /mdog ser lte ba ze'u 2'bru dmar/ /brdas bskul byin brlabs rol par mdzad/ /liṅga bsgreng ba rang byung ba/ /brla yi dbus su gzhug byas nas/ /liṅga pad+mor byin brlabs te/ /pad+mo gar bdag sngon skye'o / /gsang gnas so so'i gdan dag la/ /chos kyi snying pos lha rnams bskyed / /trīḥlas pad+ma gar dbang phyug /gsang gnas dbus kyi gdan la bsgom / /dzaḥyis rnam par gzigs pa ste/ /hūṃ gis lha mo sgrol ma'o/ /baṃ gyis lha mo rgyan bcas ma/ /hoḥyis khro gnyer chen mo'o/ /t+t+waṃ gis gtum pa'i dbang phyug ma/ /tes ni sna tshogs pad+ma yin/ /a las pad+ma'i na bza' ste/ /hoḥyis 'dod pa'i dbang mo'o/ /gling bu ma la sogs pa yi/ /lha mo gzhan rnams snga ma bzhin/ /bha gar liṅga bcug byas nas/ /der ni dhīḥyig bsgom par bya/ /pad+ma gar dbang gzugs 'dra ba/ /sgu gnyis ldan par spro ba'o/ /oṃ swa bhā wa bi shudhe pad+ma narte 4shwa ri dz+dza/ phyogs bcur don byas 'dus pa dag /gtso bo yab yum gzhug par bya/ /rnam gzigs dkar dmar mdangs ldan pa/ /71—6/7

g.yon pas pad+mar g.yas 'byed shar/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga te pad+me dz+dza/ sgol ma dkar gsal g.yon dkur brten/ /ut+pal 1sngo g.yas bud med lho/ /oṃ badz+ra pad+me dz+dza/ rgyan can dmar mo g.yon pad dkar/ /g.yas pas 'khor lo rtse brgyad nub/ /he pad+me pad+me paṃ dz+dza/ khro gnyer ljang gu g.yon pa mthing /dkur brten g.yas pas rtse gsum byang / /ho pad+ma ni ra dza dz+dza/ pad gtum dbang phyug mthing ga g.yon/ /pad+ma g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin/ /hūṃ pad+ma tsaṇ+ḍi shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa dz+dza/ sna tshogs pad+ma sngon mo g.yon/ /sna tshogs pad 'dzin g.yas 'khor lo/ /he ma hā be+e shwa pad+ma mu dre sidhe pahūṃ phaṭa dz+dza/ pad+ma'i na bza' ser mo g.yon/ /pad mthing g.yas pas chu srin rgyal/ /dhīḥpad+ma pad+me hūṃ saṃ dz+dza/rdo rje nga/d+ma dbang phyug ljang / /g.yon na pad+ma g.yas rdo rje/ /ho pad+me bi shwa kra ma hūṃ dz+dza/ 'di bzhi phyi rol pad+ma yi/ /shar sogs rim bzhin gnas pa'o/ /'od 'bar sna tshogs 'khrugs 'od bcas/ /pad+ma rgyan bcas phreng bas mdzes/ /dbang bsgur byin brlabs rdzogs byas te/ /dbu la rigs kyi bdag pos mtshan//spyor bas rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bskul/ /chags pa'i tshul bcas mdun du bzhugs / /thal mo pad+ma kha 'bus bzhin/ rang gi 'byor ldan snying gar bcing / /mje bo mje'u chung 'dab ma bzhin/ /rgyas par 'dud pa'i phyag kyang bya/ /oṃ a ti bhu dī ཿ/ gar bsgyur g.yas g.yon thal mos brdag /nga/d+mo gar gyi mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad med bzhi yi spyor ba yis/ /lha rnams gnyis su med par bya/ /trī ཿ rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 5de bzhin gshegs/ /'dod chags thams cad rnam dag phyir//pad+ma'i phyag rgya dpal du gnas/ /mi 'gyur dam pa dag pa'i phyir/ /shel sgong 7 7—6/8

bzhin du dag pa 'dra/ /'dod chags thams cad bsal ba'i phyir/ /'bar ba sna tshogs 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /sangs rgyas rin chen rab tu spras/ /gos dang sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yib/ /bde ba can bzhin dam par 'gyur/ /gar thabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /yongs su bsgyur zhing gar byas pa/ /pad+ma'i mtshan mchog pad+mor bcas/ /phyag ni rgya rnams 'khor lo bskor/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi spyor ba yis /dkyil mo krung ni phyed mar bcas/ /oṃ swa bhā wa bi shudhe pad+ma narte shwa ri dhīḥm hā mu dra dhī ཿ/ snyems pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma dmar ngo/ ci bder gzung / /rang gi snying gar 'don 4pa'i tshul/ /g.yas pas 'dab ma kha 'byed pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā pad+me dz+dzaḥ/ ma hā mu dra dhīḥ/ snyems/ 5pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yi6/ /skyil mo krung ni phyed mar bya/ /pad+ma sngon po ci bder gzung / /rang gi snying gar 'dren tshul gyis/ /bud med phyag rgya bcing bar bya / /hūṃ badz+ra pad+me ma hā mu dra dhī ཿ/ snyems nga/'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma dkar po ci bder gzung 1 / /'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /he nga/d+me pad+me baṃ ma hā mu dra dhīḥ/ snyems rka pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma mthing ga ci bder gzung rka / /g.yas/ pa rab tu gar byed pa/ /dpal gyi phyag rgya ba dan gsum/ /ho pad+ma ni ra dze+e ma hā mu dra dhīḥ/ snyems 5pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma dmar po ci bder gzung sa / /g.yas pas rdo rje stod byed cing / /gzhan dag zil gnon 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /hūṃ pad+ma tsaṇ+ḍi shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ ma hā mu dra dhīḥ/ snyems pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /sna tshogs pad+ma ci bder gzung / /g.yas kyi 7 7byed6/9

'khor lo'i phyag rgya yis/ /khams gsum phrin las gnon pa'o/ /he ma hā bi shwa pad+ma mu dre sid+dhā 1hūṃ phaṭa/ ma hā mu dra s+thāḥ/ snyems pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis / /pad+ma mthing ga ci bder gzung / /g.yas pas rab tu gar byed pas/ /chu srin tshul du bsgreng bar bya/ /twe4ཿpad+me pad+me hūṃ āḥm hā mu dra dīḥ/ snyems 5pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /pad+ma le brgan ci bder gzung 6/ /rang gi snying gar 'dren tshul gyis— / /rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /ho pad+mo 8shwa tra ma hūṃ dz+dza / ma hā mu dra tweḥ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la / /sogs pa'i gzugs mchog sna tshogs 'dzin/ /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs kyisaki/ /'dul mchog dngos grub mchog mnga' ba/ /sems dpa' pad+mo dga' ba'i mchog /sgyu ma'i dga' ba bstan du gsol/ /a la la ho/ e ma ho /gar dbang thar pa'i gar mdzod cig /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag /tshangs pa 'jug sel dbang phyug bdag /nyi zla bdag lags a la la ho/ /pad+mo sgyu ma dpal sna tshogs/ /'dul mdzad dga' ba'i tshul dgar mdzod/ /pad+mo dam tshig sangs rgyas kyi—/ /dbang phyug gar rnams mdzad du gsol/ /'dod chags rnam par spyong ba dag /thams cad da rung rnam par sbyo nga / /pad+mo 'dzin pas mngon sum du/ /spyan sngar gar mkhan gar mdzod cig /oṃ tā re tut+ta re swā hā/ rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar nas/ /gong ma mnyam pa rab tu bsgrub / /mje bo mthe'u chung 'dab ma bzhi/ /pad+ma dri med rab tu rgyas/ /brdeg pa'i khu tshur bcangs pa las/ /mthe bo dag la gung mo gzhags /pad+ma'i khu tshur grub pa ste/ /thams cad grub 7pa'i las la sbyar/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs dag /byin rlabs sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul/ /74byed620

mnyam med mi g.yo la sogs pa'i/ /bstod pa'i phyag rgya mnyes par bya/ /rton lam rgyas gdab byas nas ni/ /bzlas brjod thig le phra mo dang / /dkyil 'khor de nyid gang rung gis/ /mtshan ma'i dmigs pa brtan par bya/ /pho brang bkra shis mtshan ldan du/ /pad+ma la gnas gsang ba'i ming / /bdud rtsis bkang ba bsgrub pa'i mchog /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor phyag rgyar ①bcas/ /gsang sngags mtha' rgyan ma nyams par/ /'phro 'du'i dmigs pa gsal ldan zhing / /bskul tshig glu dbyangs phyag rgya'i gar/ /bza' btung tshogs bcas rol pas spyad/ /lha mnyes mgron tshim las grub byed/ /tshogs sgrub sbyin sreg lhag ma'i las/ /las rdzogs mchod bstod bskul byas shing / /rang gi gnas su bsdus nas ni/ /mtshan ma kun dang yongs bral ba'i/ /gnyis med dbyings su gnas par bya/ /ji ltar pad+ma dmar po 'di/ /chags pa'i nyes pas mi gos ②pa/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas de bzhin du/ /gnas kyi nyes pas yong ④mi gos/ /thams cad rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i tshogs sgrub ste / /dpal dang gzi mdangs kun grub pa'i/ /rgyas pa'i longs spyod dgod par bya/ /gzhi yi ting 'dzin nas bzung ste/ /phreng bas brgyan pa'i bar du bsgom / /pho brang nang gi mtshan bcas sogs/ /rin chen 'bar ba cha brgyad pa/ /nyis rjorim lte ba re'u cha dgu /rin chen phreng ba mu khyud 'dzin/ /ka ba mchog brgyad rin chen tog /sna bdun pad+ma'i gdan gyis mtshan/ /phyi rol rab tu dur khrod dang / /kun 'byung khor yug tu bzhis mtshan/ /mngon par byang chub rnam lnga yis/ /mgon po rgyu yi sems dpa' bskyed/ /sku mdog rgyan cha nas bzung ste/ /byin rlabs ⑤sprul pas dag par bsgom/ /rang 'od 14—621

rig ma bskyed pa nas/ /lha mos bskul ba'i mthar thug brtsam①/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i rgyud gzigs te/ /haṃ yig nor bu mda' las byung / /oṃ sispya bhu sispya bhu/ ṅgabye sa ma si5 shaske /ma hā badz+ra rat+na bha wā ta dze+et+t+waṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje nyi ma rgyal/ /gser mdog zhal bzhi phyag mdzes mtshungs/ /g.yas pas mda' gsor g.yon gzhu 'dzin/ /'dzum bubacas g.yon mig gyen du gzigs—/ /g.yas kyi 'og mas ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon pa pad+ma nyi dkyil la/ /rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar ba gnas/ /zhabs gnyis rgyal po'i dngo mo krung / /khro mdangs pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bar bas mtshan/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan dang gos/ /mtshan dpe phyag rgya lnga yis mtshan/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / /ye shes sems dpa' sngags dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi dbang bskur zhing / /dbu la rigs kyi bdag pos brgyan/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar nas/ /mdzub gnyis mnyam ste phyi ru dgu/ /mthe bong gnyis ni rab tu brkyang / /rdo rje nor bu dpral bar gzhag⑤ /oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa t+t+waṃbu/rin chen myu gu'i phyag rgya phreng / /dar dbe+engs dges pa'i thal mor bcas/ /rang 'od yum dang 'khril ba las/ /gsang gnas twe⑦ཿdang as brgyan ④te/ /rin chen 'bar ba ⑨phaṭa dang bcas/ /brdas bskul gnyis med rol ba mdzad//liṅga bgreng ⑩ba rang byung ba/ /brla yi dbus su gzhug byas nas/ /liṅga rin chen byin brlabs te/ /rdo rje nyi mar bdag mngon ⑪bskyed/ /gsang gnas so so'i gdan dag la/ /chos kyi snying pos lha rnams bskyed/ /t+t+waṃ las rdo rje nyi ma ste/ /gsang gnas dbus kyi gdan la'o⑫/ /dzaḥlas lha mo dbang bskur ma//hūṃ gis lha mo gter ldan mchog /baṃ las rgyal mtshan mchog ldan ste⑫/ /hoḥ④ 14—622

las lha mo mchod chen mo/ /de bzhin oṃ las mda' 'dzin rgyal/ /tweḥ①las ral gri 'dzin ma yid/ /ho yis lha mo nyi ma ste/ /haṃ las rdo rje me ma'o/ /lhag pa'i lha mo gling sogs rnams/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /bha gar liṅga bcug nas ni/ /der ni lta yig bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i gzugs 'dra ba/ /sku gnyis ldan par spro bya'o/ /oṃ sidh+ya bhu sibye byu sebye sa ma ④bi5 sha /ma hā badz+ra rat+na bha ba ta ta tram̐ dz+dza/ phyogs bcur don mdzad 'dus pa dag /gtso bo yab yum la gzhug bya/ /lha mo dbang bskur dkar gsal mdangs—/ /dbu rgyan rtse lnga bum pa'i chu/ /badz+ra satwa dzaḥ①dz+dza/ gter ldan ser mo phyag gnyis na/ /rin chen gter gyi bum pa thogs/ /badz+ra rat+na hūṃ dz+dza/rgyal mtshan mchog ldan dmar ba'i mdangs/ /rgyal mtshan rin chen tog bcas 'dzin—/ /badz+ra rat+na ma baṃ dz+dza/ mchod chen ljang sngon rin chen snod/ /rin chen mchod rjordzas gang ba 'dzin/ /badz+ra karma hoḥbyadz+dza/ de dag gtso bo'i phyogs bzhi yi/ re'u cha'i pad+ma dag la gnas/ /mda' gzhu dmar ser mtshan thun rjophyag /shar gyi phyogs kyi rtse la dgod/ /oṃ pra ti badz+ra ni ma ta dz+dza/rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ be+eḍūr+ya/ ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ lho yi rtse/ /oṃ badz+ra pra ti tweḥ⑦dz+dza/ rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser mdangs/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub kyi phyogs/ /oṃ byudha ma ni ho dz+dza/ rdo rje me mo ljang ser mdog /rdo rje snod bcas mi ⑧'dzin byang / /oṃ badz+ra ma ṣa hā ṭaṃ dz+dza/ phyi rol shar sogs pad+ma'i gdan/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i rtsibs la gnas/ /'od 'bar sna tshogs 'khrugs 'od bcas/ /rin chen rgyan phreng na bza' bklubs⑨/ /byin rlabs ⑩dbang bskur rigs bdag ⑪ gis—/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor gsal bar 'gyur/ /sbyor bas rang gi dkyil 14—623

'khor bskul/ /rgyal ba'i tshul brjid gdan la bzhugs/ /lus kun sa la bsnyal byas te/ /gnas gsum thal sbyar ①phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ a ti bhu t+t+waṃ④/gar bsgyur rin chen thal sbyar nas/ /nyi ma'i tshogs mnyes mchod pa dbul/ /tshad med bzhi yi sbyor ba yis/ /lha rnams gnyis su med par bya/ /ṭ+wāṃ ④rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /nor mchog rnam par sbyang ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i phyag rgyar gnas/ /nam mkha'i snying po thams cad phyogs/ /re ba thams cad yongs rdzogs par/ /bud med la sogs rin chen mchog /rin chen thams cad mkha' las 'be+ebasag/drag po 'dus pa'i 'jig rten rnams/ /drag po nyid kyis sgrub par byed/ /nyi ma'i gzugs dang spyod lam dang / /tshul dang ⑤gzi brjid chen po ston/ /rdo rje gzhu dang mda' mchog dag /shin tu legs par bzung ba ste/ /mdangs gsal 'dzum dang bcas pa'i spyan/ /g.yon pas 'byed cing gyen du 'degasabu//rdo rje pus mo gnyis gzhibs ⑦te/ /rgyal po'i skyil mo krung bcas nas/ /rang gi stan la 'dug nas ⑧ni/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gzhig par bya/ /oṃ sesgye bhu sispya bhu sispya sa ma siju ⑨sha /ma hā badz+ra rat+na bha wa tata t+t+waṃ⑩/ ma hā mu dra t+t+waṃ⑪/ khams gsum gnas kun dag mdzad cing / /chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba'i⑫/ /ye shes lngas mtshan rgyan gyis spras/ /skyon gyis ma gos sgrib tshogs spangs/ /badz+ra satwa dzaḥm hā mu dra ⑫tram̐/ rgyal srid kun la longs spyod cing / /'phags pa'i nor tshogs zag pa med/ /rang bzhin mi 'gyur lhun grub rgyas/ /rtag tu 'gyur med rnam par spyod/ /badz+ra rat+na hūṃ ma hā mu dra tram̐—/ chos kun mtshan ma las rgyal zhing / /yon tan tshogs ldan nub pa med//14—624

chags pa'i thugs rjes kun khyab mdzad/ /mchog gi mtshan mas mnyes pa'i tshal//badz+ra dharmā baṃ ma hā mu dra ①tram̐/ mnyes mdzad phrin las kun spyod cing / /kun 'byung yon tan snod bcud sogs/ /rnam kun spungs pa'i sprin chen po/ /sna tshogs las mdzad 'gyur ba med/ /badz+ra karmā snehoḥ ma hā mu dra tram̐/ thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa'i mchog /rgya chen zab mo'i dbyings su sbyor/ /chags pa'i skyon bral rgyas byed mdangs/ /thugs rjes mdzad pas bshol ba med//oṃ pra ti badz+ra ni phaṭa/ ma hā mu dra ①tram̐/ sku gsung thugs mchog rtags ldan pas—/ /sna tshogs sgrar bcas khams gsum gnon/ /shes rab mtshon tshogs g.yul las rgyal/ /don dam 'gyur med mkha' 'gro ma/ /oṃ badz+ra pra ti triḥm hā mu dra tram̐/ sra brtan mi shigs 'gro rgyud khyab/ /'od mdangs gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor can/ /lhag pa'i thugs gnyis dbri dkrol rjomed/ /de nyid bzhin 'das tshul ston pa'o/ /oṃ ciX ⑤ma ni ho ma hā mu dra tram̐/ drag po bskal pas 'khrigs byas nas/ /mi mthun gnas kyi rgyud kun bsreg /kun spyod yon tan mthar phyin pa'i/ /gsung gsum rten bcas 'gro la ston/ /oṃ badz+ra ma ṣā ma hā khye ma hā mu dra tram̐/ tram̐ khams gsum kun kyi rgyal srid bdag /sna tshogs mchog gi nor ldan pas/ /'jal dum ④g.yul 'gyed la sogs pa'i/ /rnam mang sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'jal dum ④las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan can/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i rgyal po yi/ /bde mchog sgyu ma bstan du gsol/ /sems can sprin la byang chub sems/ /mchog sbyin sna tshogs char 'be+ebs pa/ /bdag gi re ba thams cad bsgrubaske/ /myur ston a la la la ho/ /mi zad gter kyi dbang bskur ba/ /khyad par bdag la bstan 14—625

du gsol/ /hūṃ pa pa ta ta tra tra ①ta ta/ tai tai ṭ+wā hā/ rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar ④la/ /mdzub mo mnyam par phyir bkug ste/ /mthe bo rdo rje g.yogs pa ni// rdo rje dpal gyi nor bu yin/ /①rdo rje khu tshur rin chen mchog /'be+ebs pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'o/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs bdag /byin rlabs rjosngags dang phyag rgya 'bul/ /mnyam med mi g.yo la sogs pa'i/ /bstod pa'i phyag rgyas mnyes par bya/ /smon lam rgya chen btab byas nas/ /slar brjod thig le phra mo dang / /dkyil 'khor de nyid gang rung gis/ /mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor brtan par bya/ /'byor tshogs yon tan rgyas pa'i phyir//rin chen snod bzang legs spras par/ /dkyil 'khor pho brang thig gis dbye/ /bza' btung brda sbyor bdud rtsis bkang / /rigs kyi bsgom bzlas 'phro 'dur bcas—/ /glu gar dbyangs kyi sprul par bya/ /gnyis med rol pas longs spyod sbung / /rten gyi dkyil 'khor bcang bar bya/ /lha mnyes mgron tshim ⑤las grub byed/ /tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg lhag ma'i las/ /las rdzogs mchod bstod bskul byas shing / /rang gi gnas su bsdus nas ni/ /mtshan ma kun dang yongs bral ba'i/ /mnyam nyid dbyings su gnas par bya/ /shin tu gdug cing drag po rjol/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi sbyor ba ni/ /rnam par rgyal phyir rab tu drag /sna tshogs las rnams brtsam pa'i phyir/ /rta mchog dkyil 'khor mchod bya ste/ /bro ⑦gar phyag rgya'i tshogs bcas pas/ /rang gi las gzhung rnam par 'phrul/ /de bzhin nyid nas brtsam bya ste/ /phreng bas brgyan pa'i bar du bsgom/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor dbyibs dag ni/ /sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad mjes/ /'khor los mtshan 14—626

pa mu khyud mchog /rim gnyis rgya gram pad+ma'i gdan/ /phyi rol ra ba dur khrod dang / /kun 'byung khor ①yug gru bzhis mtshan②/ /mngon par byang chub rnam lnga yis/ /mgon po rgyu yi sems dpa' bskyed/ /sku mdog rgyan cha ①nas bzung ste/ /byin brlabs rdzogs pas dag par bya/ /rang 'od rig ma bskyed pa nasabu/ /lha mos bskul ba'i mthar thug brtsamarjo/ /thugs rjes 'gro rgyud gzigs mdzad de/ /haṃ yig rgya gram las byung ba'o/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/rta mchog ljang ser zhal gsum pa/ /dbus steng rta mgo ljang sngon bcas/ /bgegs bcas drag tshul zhi mdangs khros/ /lag ngar brgyad pa dpa' bo'i mchog /g.yas pas ba dan gsum pa'i phyag /'degs pa'i tshul du mdzad pa dang / /gnyis pa rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin/ /'og ma gnyis na ral gri mda'/ /g.yon gyis sna tshogs pad+ma dang / / shag ti rjortse gcig be+e con gzhu/ /g.yas kyi rmig ⑦pa dang po yis/ /dngos grub gsum dang dpal mo gnon/ /gnyis pas zhi la dga' ba mo/ /g.yon pas drag po khyab 'jug dang / /gnyis pas tshangs pa 'dod pa'i lha/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan ⑧dang gos/ /khro 'dzum phyag rgya lnga yis spras/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / /ye shes sems dpa' sngags dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas kun kyis dbang bskur zhing / /dbu la rigs kyi bdag pos brgyan/ /sangs rgyas rin chen pad+mo dbang ⑨/ /de bzhin rdo rje rin chen dang / /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen mchog /rta mchog rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa haṃ/ rgya gram phreng ba'i phyag rgya dang //dar dpyangs dgyes pa'i thal mor bcas/ /rang 'od yum dang 'khril ba las/ /gsang gnas hūṃ dang as brgyan ⑩te/ /rgya gram 'bar ba ⑪phaṭa dang bcas/ /14—627

rnam par thar pa e dkyil can/ /sa ma ya sogs brdas bskul nas/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ①sa rol pa bya/ /liṅga 'greng ba rang 'byung ba/ /brla yi dbus su gzhug bya ste/ /liṅga sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /rta yi rgyal por bdag sngon bskyed/ /gsang gnas so so'i gdan dag la/ /chos kyi snying pos lha rnams bskyed/ /haṃ gi rta mchog rgyal po ste/ /gsang gnas dbus kyi gdan la'o/ /dz+re las sna tshogs pad+ma'i rgya/ /ha las sna tshogs rdo rje ma/ /khyad par rta yi lha mo ste/ /g.yas g.yon phyogs kyi pad+ma la'o/ /'khor gzhan rigs rnams gang rung gi/ /lha mo nyi shu gong ma bzhin/ /bha gar liṅga bcug nas ni/ /der ni hūṃ yig bsgom par bya/ /rta mchog rol pa'i gzugs dag ni/ /sku gnyis ldan pas spro bya'o④—/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ dz+dza/ phyogs bcur don byas 'dus pa dag /gtso bo yab yum la gzhug bya/ /sna tshogs pad+ma ljang ser 'phro① mtshan mthun phyag rgya g.yas kyi phyogs/ /oṃ bhi sha badz+ra dha bo sgorjo/ sna tshogs rdo rje ljang sngon 'phro/ /mtshan mthun phyag 'dzin g.yon gyi phyogs/ /oṃ rnyi sha badz+ra satwa dz+dza/ 'khor gzhan lha mo tshogs bcas pa⑦/ /sna tshogs rdo rje rgyan ④phreng mdzes—/ /byin rlabs ⑦dbang bskur rdzogs byas pas/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor gsal bar snang / /sbyor bas rang rigs dkyil 'khor bskul/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis mdun du bzhugs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'gying ba'i ⑧thabs/ /'dzum pa'i mig gis phyag bya'o/ /oṃ a ti bhu haṃ/ gang ngam 'on te stong yang rung / /yang na ci 'byor pa yis kyang / /dam tshig mnyam par bsgrub ⑨pa yis/ /mchod pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /tshad med bzhi yi sbyor ba yis lha rnams gnyis su med par bya/ /hūṃ rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo 14—628

rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /drag shul sbyor bas rnam sbyor ba/ /rta mchog phyag rgyas rab tu gnas/ /thams cad pad+mo mos pa yis/ /sdig med stobs kyi ngo 'thon du/ /rab tu gnon pa'i stsal ①dag gis/ /'jig rten thams cad rab tu 'joms/ /'dod chags can la g.yem par ston/ /gdug pa rnams las gdug par 'gyur/ /zhi ba rnams la zhi ba'i mchog /drag shul can la drag shul sbyor/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /zhal ①bzhi pa la rmig pa bzhi/ /rta mgrin rgyal po chen po ste/ /dbang phyug dam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur mdzub mo yis/ /dpal ldan pad+ma sna tshogs 'dzin—/ /rdo rjer bcas shing slong ba 'grub/ /g.yas pas ba dan gsum pa ④byas—/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /brkyang bskum pa yi rjotshul byas nas—/ /khro bo'i skyil mo krung bcas te/ /'jig rten thams cad rab tu bshig /haṃ myos ⑤byed stong pas lhag pa yirjo/ /bde bar 'dod pa'i gzugs ston pa/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis gshin rje'i tshogs/ /stong pas lhag par rab tu 'jigs/ /zhi ba'i skur yang tshangs pa'i tshogs/ /stong pas shin tu lhag par ston/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi mchog dag tu/ /de bzhin gshegs kun grub par mdzod/ /thams cad dag par mos pa yis/ /ngo 'thon stobs kyis non pas gnon/ /i hi i hi dbang phyug tshogs/ /thams cad rab shig rab tu shig /rab kyi rtsal kyis non pa yi/ /stobs kyi ngo 'thon dbang phyug gnon—/ /sbyor chen hu lu hu lu yi/ /mig gsum pa las gsum grub drongs//rab kyi rtsal gyis mngon gnon pa'i/ /stobs kyis ngo 'thon mthu chen gnon/ /mnyam sbyor ru tra ⑦ma snying las/ /dpal mo drongs shig rab drongs shig /14—629

——— ———— — ———byedabyed—byed——byed— —— —byedabyed—rab kyi rtsa'/ gyes gnon pa yis/ /stobs/ kyi ngo 'thon tshangs nga/ gnon/ /spyor chen tshangs nga/'i sgyu 1 ma/ 'a/sa/ /sgrol ma drongs/ shig sma ra ta/ /rab kyi rtsal gyis gnon nga/ yi/ /stobs kyis ngo 'thon dga' dbang gnon/ /mnyam/ spyor kun gyis/ bdag la dga'/ /drongs/ shig a la la la ho/ gdug cig khyo la rab gtum nga/'i/ /sems/ can bsgra'/ ba'i phyir bsgrub 5 zhugs/ /a/ 'a 'a ho a 'a/ la 'a/ ho/ oṃ sum+bha rgo su/m+bha hūṃ phaṭa/ ma hā mu dra haṃ/ ma/dza' bo mi 'a/ bya ba'ang min/ /yo/ngas rtog de dag med kyang blatsho / /de 'dra'i ma/dza' bo sgyu bzhin pas/ /de la mdza' zhes/ su zhig zer/ /thol ba mi la bya ba min/ /yo/ngas/ su/ rtog nga/ me+ed kyang bla / /de 'dra'i rgo' ba sgrub bzhin nga/sa// /de 'a/ su zhig nga/ zhes/ zer/ /oṃ shrī nga d+ma ba ṭa ba nu/ kha yo/ gi shwa ri hi hi lha hi haṃ/ rdo rje thal mo ma/nyam/ sbya ra nas// /mthe'u chung srin lag mnyam/ par brkyang / /mdzub mo rtse bsnyams bkug nga/ ni/ /dang/'a/ mchog rta zhes/ grags/ nga yin/ /rdo rje khu tshur dang/nga/ bcings/ 'a / /sor mo tham/sa cad yo/ngas su/ bzung / /de/ ltar phyag rgya gong ma dang / /rang rang las/ 'a/ sbya/ra bar bya/ /phyi nang gas/nga ba'i ma/chod tshogs/ dag /byin rlabs sngags dang phyag rgyas/ 1 dbul/ /mnyam med mi g.yo la sogs nga/'i/ /bstod nga/'i phyag rgyas mnyes/ par bya/ /smon 'a/ma/ rgya chen gdab byas/ nas// /bzlas/ brjod thig le phra mo dang / /dkyi'/ 'khor de nyid gang rung gis// /mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor brtan nga/ra bya/ glu gar bro sngags phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i bzhin ltar rka 'dzum/ /las kyi bskul tshig dang bcas pa'i/ /sna tshogs stang stabs 'phro 'du'i gar/ /lha mnyes ཿmgron tshim 'a/sa grub byed/ /tshogs ྾dang sbyin sreg lhag ma'i las/ /7 1byed630

——— —— — byed—— — — — —las sdogs ma/chod bstod bsgul byas/ shing / /rang gi gnas su basbus nas ni/ /mtshan ma kun dang yongs bral ba'i/ /mnyam/ nyid dbyengs/ su gnas par bya/ /thams cad dag par mos pa yis/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon du/ /drag shu'/ spyor bas mnyam sbyar bas/ /'jig rten tham/sa cad gzhom nga/ra byed/ /phyag rgya sgrub nga/'i dus/ su rgo/ /snga ma las/ rgo gnas/ bsgyur te/ /babe+e'/ ba me dpung 'khrigs nga/ bzhin/ /'bar ba'i tshogs/ ni rnam par bsam/ /gzhi dang rten nga/'i ting 'dzin nyid/ /spyor ba bzhi yis/ gas/'a/ byas/ te/ /dam tshig 'phro 'du'i yan lag dag /mngon su/ma snang ba lta ra gnas/ nas// /ye shes/ dkyil 'khor la dmigs/ shing / /ma/dun nas/ gnyis/ med dkyi'/ 'khor gyi/ /cho ga sdogs/ par spyad byas pas// /ye she'/ dkyi'/ 'khor bsgrub par bya/ /'khor bcas mchod nga/ rdzogs nas/ rgo/ /bsnyen pa'i lung bzhin brtson nga/sa/ 'bad / /bsnyen par gnas/ nga/'i dbang thob nas// /bsgo ma dbyangs yi ge 'bru brgyad bstan/ /'phro 'du'i yan lag kun ldan nga/sa/ /dbyangs/ drug blangs pas don drug gas/la/ /snga gas mchog yi she'i 'bru brjod nga/sa/ /des ni drag po'i dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /dge ma/chog dngos grub kun basbus te/ /gnas gsum bskor zhing gsang mchog sgrub/ /khyad par gsang sngags rim pa bzhin / /'phro 'du mchod bstod bsku'/ tshig ldan/ /mthar 5 phyin gsang sngags rgyal po yis/ /las kyi spyor ba kun brtsam bya/ /mnyes shing mgron tshim las grub byed/ /tshogs dang sbyin sreg lhag nga/'i las/ /las rdzogs mchod bstod bskul byas shing / /rang gi gnas su bsdus nas ni/ /mtshan ma kun dang yongs bral ba'i/ /mnyam nyid dbyings su gnas par bya/ /thams cad 7 (byed63/

—nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus pa/ /thams cad sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /ji ltar sgyu ma thams cad du/ /mthong ba dang ni reg par 'gyur/ /dmigs su yod pa ma yin te/ /de bzhin 'gro ba kun kyi tshul/ /dbugs dbyung dkyil 'khor rnam drug dag1 /sbyor ba bzhi dang ldan par bya/ /spyor dang rjes su spyor ba dang / /shin tu spyor dang spyor chen po/ /ye shes tsam la snyoms 'jug pa/ /spyor ba zhes ni bshad nga/ yin/ /yum ldan byin brlabs rol nga/sa mchod/ /gzhug pa rjes su spyor ba'o / /dag mdzad dkyi'/ 'khor rdzogs byas nas// /'phro 'du shin tu spyor ba yin/ /byin brlabs/ dbang bsgur las rdzogs pa/ /sbyo ra ba chen ngo/ zhes bya'o / /sgrub nga/ dngos grub tshu'/ bzhin du/ /mtshan brtags gsal ba'i gnas shes pas/ /bdag gzhan don tshogs las sbyar te/ /ze rdog mtha' kun bra'/ bas blang / /de bzhin nyid nas brtsam bya ste/ /phreng bas brgyan nga/'i bar du bsgom/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor dbyibs dag ni/ /thig bzhis rnam par phye ba la/ /so so'i pho brang ji lta bar/ /rigs bsnyus dkyil 'khor rgyas/ pa'i tshul/ /dbus/ su rigs bdag 'khor lo ste/ /shar du de bzhin gshegs nga/'i rigs/ /lho phyogs rdo rje drag po'i tshogs/ /nub tu pad+ma rnam dag chos/ /byang phyogs yon tan rin chen mdzod/ /shar mtshams bzhi dkyil sbud pa'i tshul/ /lho mtshams drag po sreg byed ltar/ /nub mtshams dbang mdzad g.yo ba'i bzhin/ /byang mtshams rgyas pa dbang chen ltar/ /rang rang phreng bas mdzes par bya/ /pho brang kha dog rin chen bzhi/ /sna tshogs pad+ma gdan gyis mtshan/ /phyi rol ra ba dur khrod dang / /kun 'byung 74byed632

—khor yug tu bzhis mtshan/ /mngon par byang chub rnam lnga yis/ /mgon po rgyu yi 1sems dpa' bskyed/ /sgu mdog rgyan cha nas bzung ste/ /byin rlabs 2rdzogs pas dag par bya/ /rang 'od rig ma bskyed pa nas/ /lha mos bsgul ba'i mthar thug par/ /thugs rjes 'gro rgyud la gzigs nas/ /'od kyi gong bu las 'phro ba'i/ /thig le rin chen sna lnga'i mdangs/ /phyogs mtshams dbus kyi lte ba la / /yi ge 'phro 'dus mtshan ma ste/ /sngags kyi phyag rgya chen ngo/'i sku/ /sgu mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha 4dang / /cha 'u/gas so/ so/'i dkyi' 'khor bzhin/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / /ye shes/ sems dang/'a snga gas dang bcas/ /sa/ngas rgyas/ kun gyis dbang bsku ra zhing / /dbu 'a/ rigs kyi bdag pos mtshan/ /so so'i dbang bsgur phyag rgya dang / /rang gi gas/nga sngags bcas pa'o/ /rin chen myu gu la so/gas/ dang / /dar dpyangs dgyes pa'i thal mor bcas/ /so so'i yum dang 'khyel ba las/ /gsang gnas byin rlabs snye bcas bskul te/ /snyoms/ 'jug chos/ kyi snying ngo/ las/ /rigs dgu'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsgom/ /phyi nang sngags/ kyis/ spro mdzad nas// /rang rig dkyil 'khor gnas la 'khod/ /byin rlabs/ dbang bskur rdzogs byas pas / /dam tshig dkyil 'khor gsal bar 'gyur/ /ye shes dkyi'/ 'khor rgyas dmigs pas/ /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor mnyes/ nga/ra bya/ /gnyis med dkyil 'khor rgyas btab nas/ /cho ga lhag mas mnyes par bya/ /rnam shes ye shes bye brag gis/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi rim/ nga/ bzhin/ /yi ge gcig nga/'i sngags bzlas shing / /las bzhi'i bskul sngags gsang ba la/ /mtha' brgyan gyur pas gsol gdab cing / /bar skabs mchod bstod 'phro 'du dang / /glu 1 1—633

——— —— byedabyedabyedabyed——dbyangs gar gyis bskul bar bya/ /rnam shes ye shes bye brag gis/ /mtshan ma/ gang rung gsa'/ bar brtag /rdo rjes mi mthun 'joms/ byed cing / /'khor 'o/sa khams gsum gtso bor 'gyur/ /mda' yis phra bar 'bigs byed cing / /ra'/ gris lha min grong khyer 'joms// /pad+mas lha mo la sogs 'gugs/ /rtse gsum lha dbang du'/ 'gyur zhing / /bum pas bkra shis bdud rtsi 'grub/ /rgya gram sa 'og gser 'gyur rtsi/ /nyi mas gser mdog 'od dang ldan/ /be+egs/ kyus srid nga/'i rtse mor 'gro/ /nor bus grong khyer rgyas nga/ra byed/ /me+e long ma/ngon nga/ra shes nga/ 'grub/ /pi wang 1 sna tshogs gsung sgrogs shing / /gling bus/ chos/ kyi tshig brjod nga/'o/ /gzhan yang gzugs sogs mang bshad nga/'i/ /yu/'a drug snang ba'i ma/tshan ma kun/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang las sbyar zhing / /brtson lda na bar chad med nga/sa gzung / /g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor la//yab yu/ma sa/ bon bcu gnyis bsgom/ /zung du spros shing 'dus/ pa las/ /rigs/ kyi lha tshogs/ snyoms 'jug pa'o/ /sor mo phan tshun spyor rdzas cabasnol/ /gnyis/ med rdo rje thal mo'i rgya/ /de rjes rdo rje bsdams nga/ las// /g.yo/na ma/dzub rtse mo'i nang dag tu/ /g.yas pa'i mje bo'i mtshan ma gzhug /legs/ bsdams/ spyod 5pa dga' chen dpal/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thun mong sngon 'gro'i yan lag yin/ /dga' chen dpal gyi rdo rje las/ /gung mo bcings nga/'i nang du gzhug /mthe bong mje'u chung ste mo can/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su bsgyur6/ /de las gung mo lcags kyu ni/ /snying gar spyor ba dgug pa'i mchog /rdo rje bsdams pa byas nas ni/ /gung mo bcings pa'i nang du gzhug /mje'u chung mje bo'i rtse mo can/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su 7 1byed631

long rnga ma yol bar bcas/ /tshon cha sna lnga'i thag pas bskor1/ /g.yas su rdo rje dril bu dang / /yam shing til dang rlung yab gzhag2 /g.yon du dri chu me tog dang / / drur ba ku sha'i chun po gzhag5 /mdun du mchod pa rnam lnga dang / /mchod rdzas gzhan yang gzhag par bya/ /mchod yon yan lag brgyad ldan pa/ /dri sna me tog dkar po dang / /zho dang drur bas bkang ba dang / /'bras dkar yungs kar mar dang zho/ /mchod rdzas kun gyi sna ba dgod / /bgegs bsal bsrung sbyang byen gyis brlab/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal byas nas/ /chas gos lnga po dbu rgyan phreng / /phyag rgya lnga sogs rgyan gyis mchan1 / /mdun du dpal mchog las byung ba'i/ /rja skyes las dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /dkar ser dmar gnag go rims bzhin/ /zhi sogs las mdzad me lha bskyed/ /mig gsum gdong bzhi rim pa can/ /gsus po che la phyag bzhi pa/ /mi 'jigs rgya phreng spyi blugs dang / / dbyig pa srad bu'i phreng ba thogs/ /snying ga sum mdo yum dang 'khyel/ /pad+ma'i gdan la rnam par gnas/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs dbu rgyan bcas/ /me ri 'bar bas mtshan pa'o/ /dam tshig sems dpa'i gzugs 'dra ba'i/ /ye shes 'phrul pa spyan drangs nas/ /thab kyi logs su gzhag byas la/ /bsang gtor mchod yon zhabs bsil dang //nye reg phul te phyag rgya bzhi15/ /gnyis su med par bstan par bya7/ /oṃ ṭa ki hūṃ dza hūṃḥ/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ na/ sa ya 9ya s+t+waṃ/ g.yas pas ku sha'i chun po bzung / /phyogs rnams kun du bsang gtor bya/ /so so'i las dang mthun pa'i me/ /rlung yab ba dan dang bcas sbar/ /oṃ dz+nyā na dz+wa la ram̐ lag 14—643

gnyis mchod yon phyag rgya yis/ /dung chos blangs te dbul bar bya/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar tshad ldan la/ /mtshan ma'i ye shes brgyan byas te/ /'od bcas mar khus bkang nas ni/ /lan gsum lha yi zhal du bstem/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ1/ agha 2ye swā hā/ dgang blugs kyi sngags so/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga yi tshogs/ /so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul/ /oṃ asna ye swā hā/yam shing gi'o/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da —ha na badzā 4ya swā hā/ pā pa da 5ha na swā hā/til dang mar bsres pa'i 6'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā 7yu ṣe swā hā/ drur ba'i myu gu mar gyis byugs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puste ye swā hā/ 'bras ma grus pa dang / /mar bsres pa'i 9'o/ /oṃ sarba saṃ pa de —swā hā/ zho'i 'o/ /oṃ a pra ti ha ta ni ha dha badzā ya swā hā/ ku sha rkyang pa'i 'o/ /oṃ pra ba ra saṅka ra pra tits+tsha ho zhes pa yang dgang blugs so/ /nye reg la sogs byas nas ni/ /dpa' bo rdo rje dril 'khrol zhing / /bstod pa'i phyag rgyas mnyes byas nas/ /gar dbyangs rol mos bskul bar bya/ /lag gnyis lto spyor spyod 7byas te/ /rdzas rnams lan gsum sbyang bar bya/ /oṃ ki lī ki lī/ bi ma la ri'u tri / ta ki ni z-i da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas dkyil 'khor gang yin pa'i/ /lha rnams me yi gnas su gzhug— /gong ma'i dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhin/ /rang gnas gdan la legs bzhugs sam/ /ma 'byel me lha'i khang pa ru/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor rim bzhin bsam/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ /dgug gzhug la sogs gnyis med par/ /mchod bstod las rnams sngon bzhin las/ /gsang sngags mtha' sngags skul tshig bcas/ /oṃ lha yi me lha shin tu tshogs/ /lha yi dri yis nye bar byugs/ /me tog bzang po 'di bzhes la/ /gnas 'di nyid 14byed644

du bzhugs lhasu gsol/ /oṃ mar me 'od zer 'bar ba ni/ /ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms byed pa'i/ /lha yi mig 'byed dam pa 'di/ /bdag la dgongs te bzhes ri su gsol/ /oṃ tsan+dan ga pur bcas pa yi/ /dri mchog bdug spos dam pa yi/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams tshim pa'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs la bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sna tshogs lha yi dri ldan pa/ /sna tshogs ga pur gyis ni brgyan / /sna tshogs hūṃ las yang dag byung / /dri mchog 'di dag bzhes su gsol / /oṃ kha dog dri dang ror ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba'i bye brag sna tshogs dag /zhal zas phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhi4/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes 5su gsol / /lha rnams mnyes shing tshim pa dang / /'dod pa'i 'bras bu gsol btab cing / /mchod bstod bskul tshig las byas te/ /snga ma'i dkyil 'khor gnas su dgod/ /gal te ma 'byel 6spyan drangs lha/ /thugs ka nas bton kha la bzhag /zhal bsil la sogs dbul byas te/ /sngar bzhin gshegs gsol 7bsdus pa dag /sngags dang phyag rgyas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol / /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ aX9bhehūṃ/ badz+ra gats+tsha mu⑩ཿ/ rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu byas nas/ /lhag mas me lha mchod byas te/ /sngar bzhin gshegs gsol basbus pa dag /mnyam nyid rang 1la gnas par bya'o/ /de nas las kyi rdo rje yis/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol mtshams dag tu/ /khor yug zlum po'i rim pa la/ /drags byed mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /pho brang gdan dang mtshan ma'i rtags/ /rin chen rgyan tshogs phreng bar bcas/ /sna tshogs bza' btung gtor ma'i 14—645

tshogs / /lhag ma'i tshogs bcas dgram par bya/ /rdzas rnams tshogs nas dri yis bsang / /bdud rtsi'i rgyun dbab 1sbyang zhing bsrung / /dbus kyi lha tshogs rdo rje'i steng / /haṃ las rta mchog rgyal po bsgom/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dug gsum 'byung bzhi rang rtags phreng / /sgo bzhi bar khyams phyi rol sgo/ /rang gi mtshan mas mdzes par byas/ /mdun du dbang phyug chen po ste/ /g.yas su tshangs pa brgya byin lha/ /g.yon du khyab 'jug 'dod lha ste/ /chung ma bzhon pa la gnas pa'i/ /mtshan ma rgyan bcas 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /rang gi sa bon sngags las skyes/ /dbang ldan me lha'i rgyal po dang / /srin po'i rgyal po rlung gi bdag /chung ma bzhon 4pa'i gdan dang bcas/ /lho'am shar du lha chen brgyad/ /lho ru gshin rje ma mo'i tshogs / /nub phyogs pho nya klu yi 'khor/ /byang du gnod sbyin chen po brgyad//sgo bzhir nyi zla sa bdag che/ /sa yi lha mo gnas pa'o/ /phyi khyams 5ma tshogs dbang phyug rnams/ /sgo bzhir mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi/ /kun kyang rgyan bcas cha lugs dang / /lag cha bzhon 6par bcas pa yi/ /chung ma khyo dang bran tshogs g.yog7 /gsang sngags las bskyed gsal bar dgod/ /dgug cing gnas su gzhug 9byas nas/ /zil gnon dam tshig phyag rgya bstan/ /mchod bstod las la bskul byas nas/ /rta mgrin phyag rgya rnam gnyis bcing / /hūṃ khro las rnga tshan 1'bar ba'i skur ston cing / /'jigs byed lha chen yab yum zhabs kyis gnon / /drag po'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs ston mdzad pa'i/ /dbu mang rta skad 'tsher zhing gar mdzad pa/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od mdangs sgu la rdzogs / /khro rgyal 'khor bcas ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha 74byed646

hūṃ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ① / ā kadzha ya/ ā karta ya/ pra be+e sha ya pra be+e sha ya/ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ oṃ e ā ra li byeho/hri hri hri/ oṃ 'jigs byed lha chen dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin tshangs pa brgya byin dang / /khyab 'jug 'dod dga'i dbang phyug dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha klu dang / /gnod sbyin gshin rje ma mo'i kyetshogs/ /mtshams kyi dbang ldan la sogs pa'i/ /gal te rdzu 'phrul mthu mnga' rnams/ /bran tshogs g.yog dang chung mar bcas/ /dpa' bo'i spyan sngar dam bcas bzhin/ /rang gi dam tshig rang byos la/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsrung ba'i phyir/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ya hi/ ru lu ru lu dzachoḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki dre 5 bh+yo e a ra li dzaḥdzaḥthu / oṃ ḍā ki — ā kār+ṣa mu ya ā kār+ṣa rkyeya/ pra be+e sha ya pra be+e sha ya/ brnya ya ban+dha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/mo ha na mo ha na/ sarba na ta ki she7nan/ z-i da ya hūṃ phaṭa dza dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ṭa ⑩ ki ni hūṃ dzaḥ/ ṭa 7ki phyag rgyas dgug pa'o/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka /ma hā badz+ra/sarba duṣ+ṭan sa ma ya mu dra pra pañtsa shā kra hūṃ phaṭa/ he ru ka'i phyag rgyas zil kyis mnan pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ba ta mu kha/ ā kā ra ṣa skyeya/ ā kār+ṣa /4ya/pra be+e sha ya/ pra be+e sha ya/ ban+dha ya/ ban+dha ya/ to ṣa ya/ to ṣa ya/sarba bhe tre ki nan/ z-i rmyed ya na/ ha ha hi hi/ oṃ aXhūṃ7/ rta mgrin phyag rgyas dbang du bsdu ba'o/ /rdo rje phur pa gdab byas pas/ /bgegs kun g.yo ba med par byas/ /ye shes mes bsregs bdud rtsis gsos/ /sbyang zhing byin brlabs lha yi skur/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / /rigs kyi bdag po'i mtshan mas brgyan/ /snga ma'i phyag rgya'i cha lugs las/ /'od mdangs rgyan 14—647

chas 'bar ba yi1/ /'khor bcas bsdus pa'i dga' 'gyur kun/ /dam tshig lha dang gnyis med spyor/ /oṃ thugs rje chen pos gzigs nas kyang / /sna tshogs rnam par 'phrul mdzad cing / /gar mkhan 'khor lo'i rgyud mnga' ba'i//drag po'i zhi mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs gar gyis rnam par 'phrul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje la sogs mtshon chas rol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus lha yi lha mchog skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo rtsal rdzogs stobs bcu'i shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /haṃ a ti bu ho/ a la la ho/ ma lus mchod gtor rdzas rnams kun/ /ho 4ho hriḥyis bsregs sbyangs 5brlab/ /rin chen dbyibs mdzes spras pa'i snod/ /'dod lnga'i longs spyod bdud rtsi'i mtsho /lha mos 'khril ba'i dgyes stobs shing / /kun bzang mchod sprin gang bar dmigs / /dang po 6dri yi chus bsangs nas/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog 'thor/ /so so'i ting 'dzin phyag rgyas 7sngags/ /mchod gtor rim bzhin dbul bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra puste/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe/ oṃ badz+ra gasgo9/oṃ badz+ra nai be+e h+yerkabla dza spa ra ṇa swā hā/ oṃ tar+ya thā/ na ma badz+ra ma hā de ba/badz+ra biju / badz+ra pra ma/ badz+ra rta.in+d+ra/ badz+ra kā ma de ba/ badz+ra a yu dha/badz+ra mā ya / badz+ra sho 5dha/ badz+ra bye sar wa/ badz+ra ga na pa ti/ badz+ra rnya sha kṛ ba/ badz+ra pā sha kā la/ badz+ra ku ma ra/ badz+ra ya ma rā dza/ badz+ra ya ma ka 7 la / badz+ra ya ma dubyen7/ badz+ra ya ma kro dha/ badz+ra ya ma tsa kra/ badz+ra ya ma shu —8la/ badz+ra ya ma sa/ ra/ badz+ra ya ma mu ram̐/ badz+ra nā ga tsa kra/ badz+ra nā 1 ga ba su ka /badz+ra nā ga karko ṭa/ badz+ra nā 1ga pad+ma/ badz+ra nā ga ma hā pad+ma/badz+ra nā ga shaṃ kha pā la/ badz+ra nā ga ga yu/ badz+ra nā ga ku li ka /badz+ra nā ga ba 74—648

la ta/ badz+ra nā ga gu su/ badz+ra ya ma ṇi bha dra ①ye/ badz+ra pūr+ṇa bha dra 1ye—/ badz+ra da na dha ya/ badz+ra ma hā dh+wa ①dzan/ badz+ra dzi bi ku larnya ya/ badz+ra rdza ④bha la mu kharnya ya/ badz+ra rdza bha la dz+wa 'byu ⑤ya/ badz+ra ki li mi li ni/ badz+ra agha 3 ye—/ badz+ra nidṛ ⑦ti/ badz+ra bai ram̐ ba/ badz+ra yī sha na ye/ badz+ra nā ga u li ka /badz+ra nā ga pa la ti/ badz+ra sur+ya ba/ badz+ra tsan+d+ra ba/ badz+ra gi tsi tri/ badz+ra pra ti bi de ba/ badz+ra ḍā ki byā kā la badz+ra bh+yo/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī kā lal rat+na bh+yo/badz+ra ḍā ki nī kā 'ul pad+ma bh+yo/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī kā ⑫ la karma bh+yo/ sa pā ri wa skyer/i rda dhū pa/ put+pa⑫/ dī paṃ/ gar+ghaṃ/ nai bi bye⑫/ di san ⑫ka tai/ pa shā pra ha re/ pra tits+tsha/ yu ba sum̐ dza/ na ma sarba satwa/ nan ba 8/ti/ ras+t+ya⑪/su bar+ṇa/ dh+ya na rgya n+ya/ a yu yo ba na/ a rokya/ sad su lha bhekhaṃ/a ⑫ pa ha ra rka/ shārnyi ku ru/ puṣ+ṭi ⑪ku ru/ pa shaṃ ku sum̐ bu / mā hūṃr ya / sarba karma atho sirnyi hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ thams cad gnyis med thugs rje'i mchog/rdo rje gsang gsum gnas las byung / /dam pa'i dka' spyod byang chub sems/ /drag po'i gzung 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /dam tshig bstan pa gnas bsrung zhing / /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i las mdzad ma/ /don kun phrin las sngags kyi mthus / /'gro ba'i gnas kun rnam par dag /byang chub spyod pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs—/ /dam bcas phrin las sna tshogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'go sgyu ma'i don ston mdzad/ /oṃ shin tu drag chen sprul pa'i sku/ /khams gsum gnas kun g.yo mdzad pa/ /kai las sprul pa'i lha chen po/ /dkar ser khyu mchog gdan la bzhugs/ /zhal phyag mtshungs par tri shu ( rtel/ /dgra sta ral gri thod khrag sha /spyan gsum ral pa thod phreng 14—649

rgyan / /rin chen sna tshogs gos kyis bklubs// /zla ba phyed pa'i ru mtshon can / /sgeg dgyes chags pa'i gzi mdangs kyis/ /u ma ljang skya thod pa thogs / /zhi ba rin chen rgyan bcas 'khril/ /stobs ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir 'dus pa rnams/ /mchod gtor rgyun bcas 'di bzhes shig /rang gi dam tshig dran byos la/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun dang / /thun mong dngos grub 'dod pa'i don/ /bdag sogs rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus thogs med grub par mdzod/ /oṃ khams gsum gtso bo 'byin byed lha/ /oṃ las sprul pa'i tshangs pa che/ /gser mdog gdong bzhi phreng bas mdzes/ /g.yas gnyis pad ser ral gri thogs/ /g.yon gnyis 'khor lo rin chen 'od/ /ngang pa zla ba'i khri stengs gnas/ /khams gsum bskyod tshul rnam grub ma/ /mdzes ma kun gzugs yum dang 'khril//oṃ byang chub sems dpa' gtso bo mchog /a las sprul pa'i lha dbang rgyal/ /dkar gsal zla rgyas mdangs dbang 4phyug /gos rgyan rin chen tshogs kyis bklubs5 / /g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum rin/ /g.yon gnyis rin chen phreng ba bum / /glang chen rin chen khri stengs 7na/ /sha rtsi dkar mo'i rin chen pad/ /'khril tshul 'dod pa'i longs spyod tshogs/ /rin chen sna bdun tshogs la rol/ /oṃ stobs ldan drag po mthu bo che/ /haṃ las sprul pa khyab 'jug gtso/ /mthing nag khro bo'i tshul 'chang ba8/ /'khor lo rtse gsum mda' dang gzhu/ /'jigs pa'i cha lugs gos rgyan bklubs9/ /ri dwags shing rta rin chen khri/ /gzugs 'dzin drag mo pad+ma 'dzin/ /mtshon cha 'khrigs pa'i phreng ba can/ /oṃ ma lus 'dod tshogs kun gyi bdag /t+t+waṃ las 7 4—6pya0

byung ba'i 'dod lha mchog /ser skya sna tshogs rgyan gyis bklubs1/ /g.yas gnyis mda' mchog rin bo che/ /g.yon gnyis rin chen gzhu pad+ma/ /'dod dpung rin chen kun la spyod/ /drag po gnas rgyal rin chen skyes/ /rin chen khri bcas rta yi tshogs/ /lha yi 2bdud sogs mos pa'i dpung / /yan lag bzhi bcas las mdzad pa/ /oṃ shar gye phyogs nas lha chen tshogs/ /gsang ba'i bka' 'dzin dam tshig can/ /a yig sngags kyis sprul pa rnams/ /zhi ba'i rgyan bcas byang sems gsal/ /rdo rje mtshon cha gser mdog 'od/ /zhal phyag bzhi pa rdo rje rin/ /pad+ma bum pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rin chen gos rgyan yum dang bcas/ /rgyal po chen po'i tshul 'dzin cing / /glang chen rin chen stegs la gnas/ /rdo rje sgyu ma sngo bsangs mdog /g.yas gnyis 'khor lo ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis dung dang pad+mo thogs/ /nyi ma'i 'od mdangs stan la gnas/ /dbu rgyan phreng ba gos kyis bklubs4/ /btsun mo'i 'khor tshogs sum cu gnyis/ /rdo rje glang sna dkar ser mdangs/ /g.yas gnyis gtun shing ral gri dang / /g.yon gnyis phreng ba rin chen 'khor/ /chu srin rin chen pad+ma'i khri/ /mche gcigs khro tshul drag po spyan/ /btsun mo gtum chen bdud rtsi'i snod/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed khro bo'i mchog /sngo nag me+e 'od 'bar ba'i phreng / /g.yas gnyis rtse gsum 'khor lo myur5/ /g.yon gnyis mtshon cha me 'od phreng / /ma mo'i gdan la yum dang 'khril/ /thod rus sbrul gyi phreng bas brgyan/ /rdo rje tshogs bdag ljang ser sku/ /rin chen gos rgyan 'jigs pa'i tshogs/ /g.yas gnyis bdud rtsi rin po che/ /g.yon gnyis zla ba rtse gsum mdung 6/ /rdo rje brag chen rlung dkyil myur/ /btsun mo 7 4—65/

stobs chen brgyad kyi dbus/ /rdo rje srin mo sngo skya'i 'od/ /srid gsum thal byed rnga skad sgogs/ /g.yas gnyis gri gug dbyug pa 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis pad+mo'i 1thod pa 'chang / /thub dka' srin po'i gdan la gnas/ /yum bcas rgyan phreng 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /rdo rje zhags pa gnas kun rgyal/ /mdog gnag mi lpags thod pa'i rgyan/ /g.yas gnyis zhags pa rtse gsum 'od/ /g.yon gnyis gri gug thod pa'i snod/ /lus ngan sprul pa'i khri la gnas/ /yum tshogs pho nya gtso bo brgyad/ /rdo rje gzhon nu gdong drug lha/ /dmar ser zhi ba'i rgyan kyis mdzes/ /g.yas na rin chen pad+ma mda'/ /g.yon na phreng ba bum bzang gzhu/ /ngang pa pad+mo rdzing bcas gdan/ /phyag rgya yum sogs gnas drug ma/ /oṃ lho yi rgyal chen gshin rje'i tshogs/ /byang sems yang las 'phrul ba'i gzugs/ /khro bo 'joms byed rgyan phreng bklubs / /'jigs pa'i gzugs mchog khro gnyer 'gyur/ /mche gatshigs phe sgrogs spyan gsum bgrad / /ser skya'i skra 'bar sma ra can/ /ma tshogs yum bcas thal zhag khrag /lus byugs thod phreng ma he'i gdan/ /rdo rje gshin rje'i rgyal chen po/ /sngo nag 'khor lo ral gri 'dzin/ /rdo rje gshin rje dus kyi tshogs/ /mdog dmar glegs bam khram shing thogs/ /rdo rje gshin rje sdang ba 'joms ser skya rtse gsum ba dan dril/ /rdo rje gshin rje khro bo mchog /sngo nag ral gri thod khrag sha /rdo rje gshin rje 'khor lo'i bdag /dud ka 'khor lo phreng ba me/ /rdo rje gshin rje mdung 'dzin gnon/ /sngo skya mdung rtse gsum pa rlung / /rdo rje gshin rje mda' 'dzin rgyal/ /dmar skya mda' gzhu glog phreng rgyan/ /rdo rje gshin rje thub pa che/ /sngo nag —gri gug thod khrag sprin/ /dur khrod gnas che 574—652

gtum pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro 'jigs byed brgyad rnams kun/ /mdog nag mun pa'i tshogs ltar gtibs/ /lag na gri gug thod khrag sha /dus 'dzin 'chi bdag zlog 2byed cing / /ma mo 2—sbed pa'i gdon la brtson/ /oṃ nub phyogs rdo rje klu yi tshogs/ /byang chub sems sogs phuḥ las sbrul/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs byin rlabs can/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i sbrul mgo'i 5rgyan/ /pho brang rin chen khang mdzes na/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rdzing bu'i tshogs/ /btsun mo yum tshogs dga' ba rnams/ /rin chen pad+ma'i skyed tshal gnas/ /rdo rje mtha' yas sngo bsangs 6mdog /sbrul zhags rin chen bum pa thogs/ /rdo rje nor rgyas mdog dkar la/ /nor bu rtse dgu phreng ba'i tshul/ /rdo rje 'jog po dmar mdangs can/ /sprin phung rin chen char 'be+ebs mdzed7/ /rdo rje karko ṭa nag po/ /rin chen phreng ba pad+ma'i rgya/ /rdo rje pad+ma chu shel mdangs/ /'dod pa'i zhal zas bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rdo rje pad chen dkar skya'i mdangs/ /me tog at+pal sgra snyan sgrogs/ /rdo rje dung skyong gser gyi 9mdog /phreng ba ljon shing me tog rgyan/ /rdo rje rigs ldan sna tshogs sku/ /chu srin rin chen gter mdzod sbyor/ /oṃ byang gi gnod sbyin 'jigs pa'i gtso/ /pho brang rin chen gnas kyi bdag /mi'u thung gzugs ⑩'dra stobs ldan pa/ /byang sems rigs sogs haṃ las sprul/ /rin chen bum tshogs nor bu'i tshogs/ /pad+ma bdun brtsegs 13rin chen khri/ /dpag bsam rgyan phreng bum pa'i lho/ /rgyal blon btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /rdo rje gang bzang chu shel mdog /rin chen mkha' mdzod zla gsal mdangs/ /rdo rje bum bzang gser lta bu/ /rtse gsum bum pa lag na 'dzin/ /rdo rje nor bzang bai ḍūr+ya/ /nor bu rin chen 14byed653

phreng ba'i tshogs/ /rdo rje rnam thos gser kyi mdangs/ /mchod rten rin chen dbyig ①pa thogs/ /rdo rje lus ngan ljang skya'i 'od/ /rin chen dbyug pa lcug ma'i rgyun/ /rdo rje gnon 'jigs mthing shun mdog /ral gri ut+pal me tog phreng / /rdo rje gnon gnas nyi ma'i mdangs/ /shing thog ne+e'u le'i rkyal ④bu 'thor—/ /rdo rje sde bzang in+d+ra'i mdog /glegs bam rin chen bum pa'i chu/ /khro gnyer spyan dmar dbu skra 'khyil①/ /mche ba cung zad 'dzum mdangs brgyan//rin chen go cha mtshon sna tshogs/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod kun gyis myos/ /oṃ mtshams kyi rgyal chen dpa' bo'i dpung / /rang gi 'khor tshogs 'dul mdzad pa//byang chub sems sogs gzhan don mdzad/ /sa bon a ri yo ming las/ /'phrul bas byin rlabs rjogazugs dang ldan/ /gtso bo rang rig ⑤rgyan gyis mdzes—/ /rdo rje me lha dmar ser 'od/ /bgrang phreng spyi blugs srad bus brgyan—/ /rdo rje srin po dmar ser 'od/ /chu srin pad+ma 'jigs byed gzugs//rdo rje rlung lha dud kha'i mdog /ba dan phreng ba kha mang rgya/ /rdo rje dbang ldan in+d+ra rin/ /be+e con rtse gsum 'od phreng 'khrigs/ /btsun mo'i 'khor tshogs las mdzad pa/ /ra skyes chu srin sha ba dang / /mi ro'i stan la rin chen brgyan//'dod pa'i longs spyod dga' rtser rol/ /oṃ sgo bzhi pho nya mthun pa'i grogs/ /rnal 'byor dam can skyong mdzad pa/ /steng 'og nyin mtshan dus 'byed cing / /byang chub sems sogs rjospyod ldan pas/ /tshad med bzhi yis rnam par rol/ /sa bon sum̐ rtsa pra tai las/ /'byung ba'i gzi brjid 'od po che/ /btsun mo dam pa'i gnas longs spyod/ /blon po ded dpon dpung bcas pas/ /dam chos bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ /rdo rje nyi ma me shel mdangs/ /pad+ma rin chen 14—654

shing rtar ldan/ /rdo rje zla ba chu shel 'od/ /bdud rtsi ku mu ngang ①pa'i khri/ /rdo rje sa 'dzin gser kyi mdog /bum pa bgrang phreng pad+ma'i gdan/ /rdo rje thags ②bzangs btsod kyi mdog /go stimatshon 'brug gi khri la gnas/ /'jig rten gsum la mnga' mdzad pa'i/ /stobs ldan phrin las myur ba'i tshul/ /oṃ bde gshegs sras tshogs bka' nyan bran/ /mkha' 'gro'i rgyal po rgyal mo rnams / /rnam pa rang gi gzugs nyid la/ /rang bzhin bde gshegs sku gsung thugs/ /phyag rgya rnam bzhi dbu rgyan rjodang / /rigs kyi bdag por dbang bskur ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i sras tshogs thugs rje can/ /bka' gsang dam tshig bran ⑤byos la/ /rmad byung mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rig rjo'adzin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /dgra bgegs nad gdon bar chad rnams/ /phrin las kun kyis 'dul mdzad cing / /tshe dbang bkra shis bde legs tshogs//dus kun du ni rgyas par mdzod/ /oṃ phyi rol ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i sku/ /thams cad 'phrul pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug phrin las kyis⑦/ /rtag tu rang gi don brtson zhing / /drag po mkha' 'go'i tshogs bsdus pas/ /gzhan don las la rnam par rol/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /gsod don sha khrag las la brtson/ /shar gyi rdo rje sgyu 'phrul gtso/ /gzugs chen nam mkha'i gos gyon ma/ /keng rus rnam par 'gyur ba dang / /mkha' chen 'dra ba'i sgyu ma che/ /rdo rje'i thog 'be+ebs mthu rtsal can/ /mun pa'i tshogs 'joms snang ba'i sku/ /rdo rje rigs tshogs mkha' 'gro'i rgyal/ /dkar mo rdo rje rtse gsum dang / /'khor lo gtun ⑧shing gri gug mtshon/ /mda' rnon lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /ral gri thod dbyug mdung 'phen ma/ /14—655

mi mgo rgyu ma'i phreng ba thogs/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon cha me ltar 'phro/ /gtum pa'i rngam ①tshig 'brug bzhin sgogs/ /shar gyi gnas mchog lhun po'i rtse/ /dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i las mdzod cig /lho phyogs rin chen 'od mdzes brgyan—/ /byang chub gnas bsrung rdzu 'phrul che/ /khro gnyer 'jigs pa'i sprul pa can/ /gshin rje'i tshogs 'joms mche ba thogs/ /'od chen khams gsum khyab pa mo/ /rin chen dbyug pa'i glu dbyangs sgogs/ /sngon 'gro ral gri thod khrag 'thung / /'khor lo ste ra ②me thab dang / /bdud kyi khram shing zhags pa bdun/ /rtse gsum mgo thod dum bu dang / /dra ba lcags kyu 'bar ba thogs/ /'jigs pa'i 'od 'bar rin chen gnas/ /rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i klung gnas ①spyon/ /ban chen yi dwags gdan rnams su/ sprul pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer ltar/ /dam bcas phrin las skabs ⑦la bab/ /nub phyogs pad+ma'i 'dod chags ma/ /rdo rje keng rus gnas kun 'joms/ /shugs 'chang rlung gi grong khyer bdag /sgrub pa'i gsang 'dzin phyag rgya can/ / ro yi ⑤phreng bas bskyod pa'i gnasabu/ /mtshon cha glog gi phreng ⑦thogs ma/ /dmar po ⑧thod dbyig ⑨rgyu ma'i phreng / gri gug 'then thag zangs dung dang / /mkha' lding mi snying khrag 'dzag ma/ /mda' yi me tog lcug ma dang / /rdo rje'i phreng ba thod dbyug 'chang / /ro yi nags tshal lcug ma can/ /khams gsum 'khrug pa'i khrag mtsho nas/ /dbang po srid gsum chags mdzad spyon/ /byang gi rdo rje las mchog gtso/ /kun du bzang mo yid kyi shugs/ /rdo rje gnod byed dpa' mo'i mchog /dpal ldan bzang mo'i rgyan cha can/ /'bar ba'i spyan can drag po'i gzugs/ /las rnams kun la mnga' mdzad rgyal/ /ljang gnag rdo rje rgya 14—656

gram khrag /me ri 'bar bcas lcags kyu zhags/ /gnod sbyin dbyug pa bdud rtsi dang / /be con zla dkyil thag mdung dri/ /'khrul 'khor me tog lcug ma dang / /rtse gsum ba dan mi yi rkang / /gnod byed stobs mchog 'jigs pa'i ri/ /byang gi gtum 'phrul rol ba'i tshogs/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro gzugs can rnams/ /dam tshig mchog gi gnas grub mdzod/ /oṃ budha ḍā khri ①ni man ba ④lo ta pra tits+tsha ho oṃ phaṭa khā nyi①/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā tī rjoni man ba lo lta ⑤pra tits+tsha ho hūṃ rjophaṭa khā hi⑦/ oṃ rat+na ḍā kri ni man ba dze+elo ta pra tits+tsha ho hūṃ ⑨phaṭa khā hi⑩—/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki ⑪ni ma ⑫na ba bo ta pra ⑫tits+tsha ho hūṃ phaṭa kha ti⑫/ oṃ karma ḍā tī ni man ba lo ta pra tits+tsha ho hūṃ phaṭa khā hi⑫/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ⑫/ ā be sha ya/ā be+e sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra tits+tsha ho/ shrī bha ga bān/ kha kha kha/ le le le/ khā nyi khā hi khā hi⑩/ oṃ ghu ru tro ha ka /sa ma ya pra sha khā nyi/ bag sha spyosu nan/ burnya k+ṣe ṭa pra tiṭaṃ pa ya khā nyi⑪/ pad+ma'i phyag rgyas kha chus mchod pa'o/ /lag gnyis rgyab sbyar snying gar gtad/ /mdzub bsnol srin lag mig gi tshul/ /gung mtheb gnyis gdangs rtse sprad kha/ /mthe'u chung gyen du bsgreng ba'i rgyas/ /'jig rten pa yi las tshogs rnams/ /phyogs kun dngos grub rgyas byed pa'o/ /oṃ pad+ma ba mu karma sidhi hūṃ/ phyag rgya bdun rol bsgyur byas te/ /mtheb gung mdzub srin gong bzhin sbyar/ /dngos grub mchog rnams dbang byas pas/ /rten ⑫byed mi 'bral kun spyod mdzod/ /oṃ pad+ma ba mu khe a be sha ya tweḥ⑪/ rdo rje khu tshur bcangs pa yi mthe bo ⑫rtse bzhi mche ba'i tshul/ /mchod gtor phyogs kun gnas bsgyur bas/ /las kun bya ba mthar phyin 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra e sa hūṃ/ pū sa hūṃ/ sa ma ya bag sha ⑫14—657

hūṃ—/ oṃ ru ①lu ru lu hūṃ byo hūṃ/ phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin sngags bcas ldan/ /gtor ma'i las bskul gnas su btang / /slar log dkyil 'khor ma nyams blos//bkra shis dngos grub bskul bar bya/ /oṃ dngos grub dbang phyug yang dag bden pa'i stobs/ /phun sum tshogs pa kun du 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /stobs mchog mi 'jigs gdon bral 'tshe ba med/ /bcom ldan bkra shis mi 'gyur brtan par shog /oṃ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sdesbyor ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba chen po'i mchog /dkyil 'khor phyag rgya gsang sngags sbyor ba'i mthus/ /rigs kun bkra shis mi 'gyur brtan par shog /oṃ thams cad dngos snegrub don tshogs rgya chen po/ /thun mong sdemangon shes rnam lnga sgo gsal zhing / /gser 'gyur bum pa bcud len bdud rtsi'i tshogs/ /bcu drug bkra shis mi 'gyur brtan par shog /oṃ mtshan mchog dpe byad mi 'gyur brtan zhing brjid/ /bdud 'dul bkra shis gdugs mchog rgyal mtshan dung / /'khor lo dpal be+e'u gser nya bum pa mtshon/ /nye ba'i bkra shis mi 'gyur brtan par shog /oṃ zhi rgyas dbang drag mnan bzlog las rnams kun/ /thams cad skad cig mthu yis grub 'gyur ⑤zhing / /bdag gzhan cha lugs gnas kun sbyor byed pa'i/ /phrin las bkra shis mi 'gyur brtan par shog /oṃ rgyal ba thams cad gnyis med mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /ye shes sku mchog rigs dang sprul pa'i tshogs/ /ma 'dres dngos grub 'bras bzang dpe dang bral//snyoms 'jug mi 'gyur bkra shis brtan par shog /las rdzogs rnal 'byor pho mo kunaske/ /lu gu rgyud kyi phyag rgyas 'brel/ /oṃ mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /'gyur ba med pa lhun gyis grub pa dang / /rab 'byam rjorgyal ba'i 14—658
