bka' la dbang thob nas/ /'go ba yongs kyi dpal du 'gyur bar shog /'di lta bu yi man ngag lung ston cing / /bka' drin che ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / /srog gi lu gu rgyud kyi 'brel pa rnams/ /'og min lhun kyis grub pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /dus gsum 'du 'bral med par 'grogs pa dang //gsang chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /bla med sku gsung thugs mchog grub gyur nas/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pas 'gro rnams sgrol byed shog /rang rig ①dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dag /phrin las bcu drug gnas 'jug cing / /phyag rgya gsang sngags 'khrul 'khor sbyor/ /bsam gtan bya ba'i las bzhin du/ /bdag gzhan don 'gyur dus tshod ①shes/ /cho ga rten 'brel rdzogs par spyad④//de yang rten gyi dbye ba yis/ /bsam gtan bzlas brjod sbyin sreg dang / /las sbyor 'khrul 'khor rdzas las sgrub/ /mos sogs goms pa'i shugs kyis 'jug /dang por sbyor ba mthun pa'i las/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga rdzogs/ /las kyi yan lag dag byas na/ /rung rjozhing byin gyis brlabs pa tsam/ /gsang ba las dang mthun gnas su/ /grogs sogs dbang bskur byin brlabs ldan / /mos pas byang chub mchog sems bskyed/ /dad brtson blo gros 'gyur ba med/ /gsang ba'i phyag rgya rgya chen sgo⑤/ /tshul bzhin the tshom med pas 'grub—/ /de ltar byin rlabs rjomyur ba'i mthus/ /las kyi rtog tshogs rab 'jig ⑦pa'o/ /sbyor ba ji snyed yod pa kun/ /byed pa rnam pa sna tshogs la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyi rgyu⑤/ /dngos grub thams cad rab grub pa'o/ /bya ba dang ni bzlog pa dang / /khyad par du ni dbrog pa dang / /yan lag kun du byed pa'i nang / /des ni nor rnams kun kyang dbrog /'o byed 'khyud 14byed659

pa la sogs pas/ /khams gsum pa yang rgyas 'debs so/ /thar par byed cing gsod par byed/ /sbyor ba'i longs spyod thams cad kyis/ /khams gsum po ni ma lus par/ /rgyas btab rbongs byas blangs nas su/ /gar byas nas ni za bar byed/ /sbyor ba kun gyi bde myong bas/ /khams gsum pa ni ma lus par/ /rgyas btab rmongs byas zos pa dang / /thal bar gyur pa'ang 'tsho bar byed/ /sbyor ba thams cad phyag rgya yis/ /rigs mchog gtso bo'i lha mor bcas / /sna tshogs phrin las ma lus la/ /rang gi tshul bzhin rnam par sbyar//ras dang gro ga shing sogs la/ /gur gum gi'u ②wang tshon sna las/ /bdag gzhan pho mo la dmigs te/ /rten gyi gsang sngags sbyor bcas bri/ /mu khyud phreng ba rim gsum nang / /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad nyis 'gyur brtsegs/ /rang gi ④mtshan mas brgyan par bri/ /'khor lo lte ba rnams la ni/ /rigs bdag rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sngags/ /'khor lo gnyis par yi ge brgya/ /sna tshogs mtshams bzhir zhal bzhi pa/ /mu khyud nang mar phreng ba'i sngags/ /gnyis par yi ge ma mo rnams/ /gsum pa rigs kyi mtshon cha phreng / /bar mtshalas bsgrub bya'i ming gsol 'debs/ /de la phreng rjoba'i gsang sngags che/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba gnyis/ /rigs gzhan dkyil 'khor phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /thams cad shar nas g.yas su bskor/ /oṃ t+pahūṃ shrī de ba ta/ badz+ra satwa sto tra na mo ⑤stu sti sarba bu—/ sa ma yo gī na ma hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ lhahūṃ shrī badz+ra swa byosbya te su rā ga na mo sarba burnya sa ma yo gī dz+wa la saṃ bhā rjor na ma hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā rā ga mu ga ta/ shrī be+e ro tsa na/sarba tsa kra sa ma yo ga rā ga i ti na ma oṃ khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ yasahūṃ ka ru ṇa a ma la 14—660

krodha 1shrī he ru ka /sarba badzod sa ma yo gī 2ni sto tra na mo stu ta na ma hi hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ t+pa hūṃ shrī pad+ma rā ga shudhe shurnyo sarba ma hā rā ga pad+mo sa ma yo gī ni na ma hi 5hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ lnga hūṃ shrī badz+ra bha ba ta o dza nya tot+ta rat+na 7sa ma yo gī ni na ma tram̐ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ shrī a shod pa ra kra ma sarba bi shwa sa ma yo gī ma hā rā ga na ma haṃ hūṃ swā hā/ rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ldan pas/ /rten gyi sbyor ba rang nyid bzhin/ /rdzogs par dgug gzhug brtan byas nas/ /byin brlabs dbang bskur shis byas la/ /mchod dbul bstod cing gsol ba gdab9//grangs kyi bzlas brjod sdogs pa dang / /tshogs bsags bsrung ba la rbo —gdon//sgrub pos gzungs bzlas mchod par bya/ /spyor ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal rdzogs pas / /chas gos rgyan chas rdzas bsag cing / /rdo rje 'khrul 'khor sngags kyi mthus / /phyi rol dgra bgegs bdud dpung tshogs/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog nang gi las/ /kun sbyor phyag rgya 'khrul 'khor sngags/ /bsam gtan rigs kyi cho ga ltar/ /yang dag brtson pa mthu yis 'jig /sa chu me rlung 'byung sogs 7'khrug /thams cad zhi ba'i gnas su 'gyur/ /las mchog khro bo'i sbyor bcas pas/ /gtor ma gos dang mar me zas/ /yungs kar thal chen sngags kyi mthus/ /bgegs la bka' bsgo bskrad par bya/ /zhag bdun la sogs dus kyi mthar/ /sdig pa'i gzugs brnyan 'byung zhing sbyang / /me dang chu yis shis byas te/ /phyi nang las bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /ming rus dag la gtan gzhag ⑫cing / /sngags kyi chu yis khrus byas te/ /dri mchog me tog bzang ldan dang / /gsang sngags 'khor los gnas kun brgyan/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams byin brlabs nas/ /gos byas phreng ba gdags par bya/ /14byed661

dkyil 'khor gnas su rim pa bzhin/ /'jug pa'i cho ga tshul bzhin du/ /gsang ba'i sngags blo ldan pa yis/ /ro la mchod rdzas cho ga rdzogs/ /dkyil 'khor chen por rigs dbang sogs/ /bya ba'i cho ga skabs kyi don/ /'khor lo rdzogs pa'i gnas brtsams pas1/ /bsreg khang rigs mchog pho brang du/ /ma lus dkyil 'khor gnyis med rdzogs/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug bstem / /rnal 'byor grogs sogs rgyan bcas pas/ /bza' btung rgyan dang bgo ba rnams/ /byin brlabs rim gyis lhar gsal zhing / /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod chen dbul/ /las sngags mtha' rgyan 'byel ba'i mthus/ /stong gsum 'gro gnas sbyang bar bya/ /me lha mnyes pas las rdzogs te/ /dngos grub 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yos bstod byas nas//smon lam rgya mtsho don mthar dbyung / /dkyil 'khor rnam gsum rdzogs byas pas//bde chen byang chub sems nyid sku/ /sngags kyis dag pa'i sku gdung rnams/ /sku gsung thugs ldan phyag rgya che/ /bskal par mi gnas phyag rgya rdzogs/ /rgyan sogs mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal spyor ba/ /ji ltar gzugs dang dbyibs ldan pas/ /dur khrod lha yi gnas rnams dang / /ma mo'i gnas kyi 4thal ba mchog /thams cad bral ba'i srung 5ba ni/ /thig le'am so so'i ris gsum bya/ /phyogs mtshams nam mkha' sa bcings na/ /srung ba kun gyi bla med pa'o/ /rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu yi 7'gram/ /lha rjas zhi ba'i chu mchog gis/ /gtor ba dang ni blugs pa dang / /khrus byas pa dang phog pa yis/ /phyogs mtshams nam mkha' sa bcings na/ /srung 8ba kun gyi bla med pa'o/ /mi yi thod pa'i nang du ni/ /yungs kar bskyed nas blang bar 14—662

— byed—— — ————bya / /bza' btung lus la byugs 1pa dang / /phyogs bcur gtor bas bsrung bar 'gyur/ /dpa' bo gcig pa'i rten rnams kyis/ /spyo ra ba gsu/ma ldan srung 2ba'i mchog /de bzhin dkyil 'khor rgyas pas kyang / /tham/sa cad rgyas/ 'debs rdor sems mchog /sangs rgyas kun bdag spyor ldan pas/ /phyogs bcu legs pa'i 'khor lo'i tshul/ /bla dang 'og tu byen brlabs nas// /bsrungs/ bas sa/ngas rgyas kun dgongs 'gyur/ /te/ ru dpal gyi rnams 'phru'/ bas / /thams cad kun du kun gyi bdag /thams cad bsru/nga ba mi 'gyur che//mi mthun gdon sogs mod la zhi/ /sna tshogs/ nga d+mo kha 'byed pas/ /sgrib nga/ med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /'bar bas blta ba'i tshu'/ zhugs 4na/ /rdo rje 'bar ba mi bzad 'grub/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis/ babyungs nas// /go cha bgo ba'i tshul du bya/ /'di yis srung ba byas/ nas ni/ /rdo rje sems/ dang/'a dang/'a/ dang 'dra/ /mi chod pa dang mi phyed pa'i/ /rdo rje'i sgu ni rab tu 'grub/ /dus rnams kun du 'gro gzhan dag /bsod nams tshe 'phel longs spyod tshogs///'khrul 'khor phyag rgya sngags kyi mthus/ /bde gshegs 'khor los sgyur rgya'/ stobs / /lha dbang klu yi dbang sogs kyis/ /'dod yon rin chen gter sogs dpal/ /lang tsho tshe dbang nad med bde/ /yon tan rgyas pa'i tshogs 'phel 'gyur/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rin chen phreng / /mu khyud yi ge'i phreng bas mdzes/ /rigs mchog lha yi mtshan ma sngags/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas nga/'i tshul du dgod/ /bsam bya bris shing bkod pa dag /byin brlabs brtan par 'gyur med gnas/ /chos sems pa yi tshul ston byung / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dag dang / /zhi sogs lta bas bltas na ni/ /rims dug nad kun 74byed663

rnam par sel/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /mthe'u chung lcags kyu lta bur sbrelahūṃ/ /mdzub mo bsnyams pa'i rtse mo mnan/ /nad rnams thams cad zlog 5par byed/ /yongs su bsgyur rngute bteg nas su/ /dpral bar legs par gzhag bya par bya/ /ma lus lus pa med pa yikhya/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar byed/ /rdo rje bsdams pa byas pa las/ /mdzub mo phan tshun mngon phyogs pa/ /zug rngu kun las grol 'gyur zhing / /nad rnams kun gyi 6 gnod pa med/ /grub pa dpal gyi ④spyan bcings nas/ /de yi zu phyir mig long bas mthong / /sbyor ldan khu tshur dam pa yis/ /be+ed nas kha nas drangs te btung //de bzhin rims gnod dug rnams kun/ /sbyor ldan khu tshur tshul kyis btung / /oṃ sarba ta thā gabha tsubheta mis ho/ 'di ni rna bar bzlas pa'i mchog /zug rngu med cing 'bar ba'i mchog /lag g.yas sems dpa'i gtsug tor bcing / /byis pa nad med bde bar bsrung / /g.yas pa klu'i mgo ⑫gdengs ka brgya/ /'bar ba'i tshul ston 'be+ebs bcas pas/ /dug gi las rnams 'dul byed de/ /'chi ba'ang 'tsho bar byed pa'i mchog /g.yas pa'i mthe bo gung mo gnyis/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcings pa yi/ /gung mo la ni reg byas te/ /gdon rnams kun las thal bar skya'agyur/ /ba dan gsum po gnyis bcings nas/ /gung mo gnyis ni mdud par bcings/ /mdzub mo mthe'u chung rtse mo can/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs bsgyur bteg /smin mtshams bzhag pas mkha' 'gro yi/ /las rnams ma lus lus med 'grub/ /sbyor ba sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthus/ /glang po bya rta ske'agro ba'i tshogs/ /skyed tshal me tog ldum ra rnams/ /thams cad gso ba bla na med/ /thams cad bdag nyid kun sbyor ba'i/ /gnas 14—664

gsum 'khrul 'khor bsdu ba'i rgya/ /thun mong khams gsum las las byung / /dus 'dir dngos grub las tshogs 'joms/ /mchog gi phyag rgya ye shes sku/ /'dod don 'bras bu 'di spyor dpal/ /chags pa gnyis tshul longs spyad pas/ /'bras bzang mdzad pa chen po 'grub/ /khu tshur snying gar bcings pa ni/ /bud med phyag rgyar de bshad de/ /bud med spyor ba ma lus pa/ /lus pa med pa thams cad 'grub/ /g.yon pa 'gying ba'i tshul du byas/ /lag g.yas bdag gi snying gar ni/ /gyen du drang ba'i tshul byas nas/ /bud me+ed thams cad dbang du gyur/ /dpal ldan pad+ma sna tshogs 'dzin/ /g.yon pa brdeg 1pa'i khu tshur dang / /g.yas pa ldang ba 'grub pa dang / /sangs rgyas dbang phyug ting 'dzin bya/ /g.yon pa dril bu sgra sgrogs shing / /g.yas pa yi ni lag pa yis/ /rdo rje gyen du gsor zhing bskor/ /sgyu ma thams cad dbyung bar bya/ /lag pa g.yon pa brla la gzhag /lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo yi4/ /sbyor ba sngags kyi mdangs bcas pa/ /mi dge'i las rnams sel bar byed/ /bdag gi snying gar 'dren tshul du/ /g.yon pa nor bu rin chen 'dzin/ /g.yas nas de rdzogs rin chen bdun/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed//bdag gi snying gar 'dren tshul du/ /pad+mo 5sna tshogs dam pa 6'dzin/ /g.yas pa rdo rje 'gying ba yis/ /dbang phyug dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /drag po'i las kyis 7'dul mdzad pa'i/ /mtshon cha gsang sngags spu gris so / /gnod gdug phyi nang dgra bgegs sogs/ /thal bar gyur pa'ang 'ching bar byed / /mtshon cha lnga yi phyag rgya yis/ /khams gsum 'dul byed rgyal bar 'gyur / /dbyibs dang bde blag sbyor ba dang / /kun du spyor dang 'dren 14—665

dang myur/ /'gyed 1dang 'phen dang gsal ba yis/ /drag po'i las rnams kun la spyor/ /drag shul sbyor bas gnon pa yi/ /'khrul 'khor sbyor ba sngags ldan pas/ /rkang pa brkyang dang gnon pa dang / /bskum nas 'degs 4pa'i stabs dag gis/ /g.yas g.yon spyor ba'i phyag rgya ches/ /gzugs rnams thams cad mnan par bya/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo mngon du/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyu 'bras dang / /byang chub pha rol phyin sogs dang / /lha chen tshogs bcas mnan byas te/ /dga' sdug lha mo'i tshogs bcas dang / /yon tan longs spyod spyad par bya'o/ /rdo rje snying po gzhan 'joms byed/ /phyir bzlog rnam par rgyal ba'i mthus/ /'khor lo sngags phreng phyag rgya dang / /spyor ba kun gyis spro byed pas/ /nyam nga 5lag dang bde phyogs dang / /thad ka de bzhin gyen du 'degs/ /'di dag bzlog pa'i phyag rgya ste/ /gnas gsum dag ni bzlog par bya/ /mar ma 6bdud rtsi rdzas rnams kyis/ /dngos grub blangs nas lha rnams la/ /mchod bstod gtong 7rag bro gar dang / /dga' ba'i 'gying bcas blang bar bya/ /smin ma mig dang so dang mchu/ /kha dang lus dang rkang lag gis/ /cha lugs bzhin du gar byed pas/ /phyag rgya yongs su grol ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la dmigs nas/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhin/ /rdzogs par phyung ste mdun bzhag nas/ /rim bzhin mchod bstod gshegs su gsol/ /phyag rgya sngags bcas tshigs bcad kyis / /dgyes shing brtan par 'gro la gzigs/ /phyi rol ra ba rten gnas bcas / /dam tshig dkyil 'khor rim bzhin bsdu/ /slar nyid bde ba chen bo'i sku/ /thams cad phyag rgya yab yum gnas/ /dpal ldan g.yon pa 'akying 14—666

dang bcas/ /dpal ldan lag pa g.yas pa yis/ /pad+mo khu tshur dpral bar bzhag /bdag gi mig ni gyen du blta1/ /ke haṃ rin chen rgya gram gnyis/ /spyi bo snying ga'i gnas rnams spro/ /oṃ sum̐ rdo rje khu tshur gyis/ /go cha bgos pa bcing par bya/ /spyi bo dang ni dpral ba gnyis/ /glo gnyis dang ni rgyab tu gnyis / /rdo rje phreng bas bcings pa dang / /sangs rgyas gtsug gi nor bu dag /dar dpyangs tshul du bcings na ni/ /bsgyings dang bcas pas mtha' nas dgrol/ /dar dpyangs dkar dmar bzhi 'bur zhing / /thal mo brdabs pas brtan par bya/ /rdzas rnams legs par bkrol 2nas kyang / /rdul tshon chu bo chen por dor/ /ba yi rnam lngas legs byug cing / /mchod rdzas rten sogs byu mang sbed/ /khro bo mchod bstod phur pa bton/ /bdud rtsis khrus gsol gzi byin bskyed/ /phyogs skyong rgyal po gsol bskyed mchod / /mnyes byas zhi sems gshegs su gsol/ /rang gi lha yi spyor ldan pas/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bkang byas te/ /brda yi mtshams la sogs pa dgrol/ /srung ma tshogs mchod gtong 4rag gtang / /spyod lam ma nyams dkyil 'khor blos—/ /mdzad spyod tshogs chen gnyis su brtag /bkra shis rgya chen gdon bya zhing / /pha rol phyin sogs mchod sbyin bsgrags/ /mtshan rtog 5bdud rnams 'joms mdzad cing / /bsnyen sgrub kun gyi don gsal sbyor/ /tshogs dbang dkyil 'khor las la mkhas/ /dngos grub gding ldan rgyal po bzhi/ /sgu gsung thugs lam ma nyams par/ /dus kun rgyun bzlas rgyun sbrel zhing / /dngos kun sbyor ba'i las kun mkhas/ /gong ma'i gtsang 'chang rgyal jeb 6las /mtshams bcad bskang gso'i dngos sbyang bsham7/ /gtor dang las brtson /4—667

mkha' 'gro bskang / /bar skabs dkyil 'khor dbyibs gso lkumachod/ /thun mtshams bzlas brjod las rdo rje/ /spyan yangs lha gsal gsang sngags gdon/ /gus pas rtag tu lha mnyes brtson/ /grogs kyis bsgo ba'i las sbyin spyod/ /rtog bral gzung thub phyag rgya gsal/ /nges /don zab mo'i gsang ba mchog / rim mam 4yang na cig car du/ /mchog gi rnal 'byor sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dis bde gshegs yul la sbyor/ /dka' ba kun kyis ma rnyed pa'i/ /dam pa'i nor bu rin po che/ /gang gi 5drin kyis bdag la rnyed/ /ya mtshan rmad byung 7ston pa'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bde chen po/ /'di la khrus dang bsdams mi dgos/ /dka' thub dka' ba spyad mi dgos/ /dka' thub sdom pa 9med pa dang / /bde ba dang ni dga' bas 'grub/ /de bas ji ltar 'dod spyod cing / /kun za de bzhin thams cad spyod/ /spyod pa byu dgar —'dod par byed/ /g.yo ba dag kyang ci dgar byed/ /langs pa dang ni 'dug pa dang / /'chag gam ji ltar gnas kyang rung / /dgod dam rab tu smra ba dang / /gang la ji ltar spyod kyang rung / /dkyil 'khor du yang ma zhugs pa'am/ /sgrib pa kun dang ldan pa yang / /rang gi lhar ni bdag sbyor na/ /bsod nams chung yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nyid rnal 'byor 'di yis ni/ /thams cad 'grub par byed pas na1 / /ngan zos ngan spyod thams cad kyis/ /nyes pa dag tu yang mi 'gyur / /bud med kun gyi sgyu loma'i rgya/ /'di ni gnyis med theg pa'i mchog/sgyu ma dag ni thams cad pas/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par che/ /ngo bo nyid kyi mthu dag dang / /rang bzhin gyis ni de 'grub pa'o/ /'jig rten gsum 74—668

'dir bud med 'dis/ /gus par byed pa dag tu 'gyur/ /chags med chags dang bral ba min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so/ /thams cad ma lus phyag rgya yi/ /thams cad ma lus bde mchog yin/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje ste/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi bdag nyid yin/ /bde bas thams cad bdag spyor bas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sbyor bas/ /dbab pa thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bde ba'i mchog /de bas bde ba nyid kyi phyir/ /sangs rgyas bde ba kun thob bo/ /kun du kun nas thams cad ni/ /bdag nyid rtag tu rnam pa kun/ /sangs rgyas la sogs brtan g.yo kun—/ /kun gyi dngos por bdag gyur to/ /sems dang sems dpa' 1ting 'dzin dang / /byang chub spyod pa sna tshogs nyid/ /de bzhin bdud dang bdud las rgyal/ /de ni byang chub sangs rgyas yin/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin nyid dang / /de bzhin pad+ma pad+ma 'chang / /nor bu nor bu 'dzin nyid dang / /de dag gi yang rigs yin no/ /dngos grub brlabs chen phrin las tshogs / /grangs med rgya chen don spyod pas/ /bdag gzhan bya ba kun rdzogs par/ /ye shes 'khor lo tshogs chen sa/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i don gsal 'grub/ /mchog gi bsnyen sgrub phyag rgya bzhi/ /zung 'jug gnyis med rdzogs pa'i mthus/ /dngos grub rgya chen zab mo mtshan/ /lha mo kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /skal bzang mchog ni 'dod pa ste/ /yang dag sbyor ba bde myong ba/ /'dod chags ther zug brtan pa can/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gzugs chen dang / /dbyangs dang dri dang ro dag kyang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi reg bya'i mchog /bdag gi 14—669

spyad par de spyod do/ /dkyil 'khor rgya chen brtan pa'i blos1/ /rigs mchog mnyes pa'i tshul la spyad/ /cung zad spyor ba klog pa na/ /sgo gsum bsod nams tshogs 'gyur ba'i/ /pha rol phyin drug smon lam sogs/ /'gro don spyod pa rgya chen brtsam/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid kyi4/ /ra sa ya ni bde ba 'dis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dpal tshe dang / /lang tsho nad med bde mchog grub/ /kun du kun nas thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam spyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /rtag tu de ni 'grub par 'gyur / /'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnams dang thams cad dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad du/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdag don mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /rigs drug dkyil 'khor rgya chen dang / /gzhan don 'jig rten bde longs spyod/ /lha chen kum/ gyi rgyal srid tshogs/ /thams cad dmar mdzad dbang bsgyur zhing / /'dod don gzhan la sbyin par mdzad/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /phrogs nas kyang ni sbyin mdzad na/ /las mchog dag ni rab 'byams dang / /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /mdzad spyod mtha' yas sngags tshul dag /las dang 'bras bu'i rjes 'gro byed/ /yan lag bzhi yi don snang ba/ /'jug byed bzhi las 'bras bu'i tshul/ /rten gyi sgrub po snang ba bzhi/ /bsnyen sgrub phyag rgya lam rim dang / /sa yi khyad par dngos grub 'bras/ /phrin las bzhi snang bcu drug tshogs/ /gsang ba bla na med pa'i tshul/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis brgya nyi shu/ /rtsa brgyad yang dag grub pa'i gzhung / /sgrub gzhung rgyas 'bring bsdus pa dang / /shin tu bsdus pa'i ngang tshul can/ /go rims gnas skabs 74—670

dbye bar shes/ /thog mar sgrub blo phun tshogs pas/ /rten gyi yan lag bzhi ldan 'jug /tshogs bsags rnal 'byor sbyor rnal 'byor/ /mthong gsal rnal 'byor brtan rnal 'byor/ /rim bzhin goms pa gsal ba'i sgo/ /dang por sbyor dang brtan pa dang / /yang dag ye shes rnam par grol/ /mtshan ma rtags kyis goms byas pa'i/ /bcu drug 'jug pa'i bye brag gis/ /theg chen nyes don zung sdud sbyor/ /'gro drug rang rgyud brtags pa'i tshul/ /jeg dman snang ba phyogs gcig pa/ /blo gros zab mo rgya chen don/ /nges 'byung zung 'jug mang po'i sgo/ /snang ba tshul mthun khyad par can/ /rnam pa'i chags bsal mtha' las 1grol/ /nyams myang rim gyis zhen chags bral/ /snang ba bzhi las bcu drug tshogs/ /bdag nyid gzhan tshogs gnyis kar 'brel//chags sdang btang snyoms tshul gyis 'jug /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog lam dang / /rten 'brel rgyu 'bras bzlog pa'i tshul/ /bden gnyis rnam shes bden brdzun brtag/ /sgyu ma gnyis su med pa'i dngos/ /dkyil 'khor chu zla 'od gsal sku/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i dbyings/ /sku gsum mdzad pa mdzad pa yis/ /theg pa'i snang ba ma 'gags pa'o/ /bsnyen pa las la spyor byas nas/ /nye bsnyen gsal bar gyur pa las/ /sgrub pa snga ma'i gnas 'gyur te / /sgrub chen 'bras bu la spyod pa'o/ /rim 'jug bsnyen sgrub bcu gnyis kyis / /dkyil 'khor rgya chen gnas spyor zhing / /zung 'jug bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar snang / /tshad med phyag rgya dman pa'i rgya/ /gsang ba'i phyag rgya mchog gi rgyas/ /gsal 'debs rgyal po mchog gi sgu/ /bzhi yis bcu drug sdogs byed pa'o/ /dang po sgu gsal 74—67sde

brtan pa dang / /dam tshig ye shes gnyis med mnyes/ /sku gsung thugs mchog byin brlabs mthus1/ /bde gshegs rigs mchog ye shes sbyor/ /thabs kyis rgya che lam bgrod cing / /shes rab zab mo'i lam la 'jug /zung du 'brel pas phyag rgya'i lam/ /gnyis med bgrod pa'i lam mchog yin/ /rgyu rkyen gnyis med tshogs gnyis sdogs/ /tshul bzhis bcu drug lam du 'gyur/ /tshogs drug rnam par spyor ba yis/ /yon tan tshogs rdzogs don gsal sa/ /rig 'dzin sangs rgyas sa yi mthar/ /bzhi las bdun drug brgyad du snang / /rgyu 'bras dbye bas bcu drug tshogs/ /rim sbyar cig car thob pa'i tshul/ /mos spyod lam la sbyor ba dang / /sar chud las la spyod pa dang / /rnam smin phyag rgya chen po dang / /bya ba mthar phyin sangs rgyas sa/ /tshe 'dis rig 'dzin gnas sbyor zhing / /de nas sangs rgyas sa drug rdzogs/ /'jig rten thun mong bdag don dang / /gzhan don mchog 'gyur dngos grub bzang / /bdag gzhan las snang sgo bzhi nas/ /bcu drug tshogs la longs spyod mdzad/ /mkha' 'gro tshogs med stobs ldan zhing / /mi mthun rkyen gyis 'jig pa med/ /ral gri mig sman rkang mgyogs bum/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud len rig 'dzin gser//sku gsung thugs sogs mi 'jigs stobs/ /phra zhing khyab mdzad dpal gyi gzhi/ /kun du brtan pas bdag gzhan don/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod rdzogs/ /phrin las bzhi spyod bcu drug tshogs/ /'bad pa med pa'i tshul gyis 'grub/ /mnyes shing srung mdzad btang dang 1la/ /gso ba stobs 'phel rgyal byed brtan//dgug cing rengs shing rmongs pa dang / /dbye mnan bskrad dang pham byed pa'o/ /dam pas rgyud don rgya chen tshogs/ /pad mdzes nyi mas rgyas ltar byas/ /bde 14—672

mchog mkha' 'gro'i don bstan las/ /khyad par lhag pa gzhan du med/ /de nyid cung zhing gsal ba'i phyir/ /tshul 'jug dam pa'i rjes 'brangs ①te/ /rtogs par sla don mtha' gnyis bral/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bzod par mdzod—/ /kun mchog rgya chen dri med dge/ /ston ka'i zla gsal sgrib bral ltar/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /mnyam par sbyor ba'i gnas thob shog /yan lag bzhi'i don snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa hūṃ mdzad grags pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //mnga' bdag btsan ①po byang chub sems dpa'i bkas dpal bsam yas kyi 'chim ④phu ru dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dbon paṇ+ḍi ta dpal rdo rje bzhad pa dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā bub chen po rma rin chen mchog gis dbang sgrub dang bcas par bsgyur cing bshad nas gtan la phab pa'o// //14byed673

par sprur ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub — — —pa' ram pa zhas bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sarba budha sa ma yo gi maṇ+ḍal sā dha na kra ma nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang ④mnyam par sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma 'gags rnam 'phrul ye shes chen po'i 'od/ /zab cing rgya che gsung dbyangs sna tshogs sgrogs/ /yon tan rgyan gyis cho 'phrul mdzad 1mthar phyin/ /rigs drug lha mo'i tshogs bcas rgyal gyur cig /theg chen gsang ba'i lam mchog gsal mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pas nges pa'i dgongs mdzad 'grol/ /'khor 'das ma spangs las grol dhirgyal chen po/ /rim bzhin brgyud pa'i dam pa rnams la 'dud/ /rgyud mchog sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang mdzod las/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i las kyi rjorim pa dag /legs bsdus rnam 'grel sogs kyis gsal rjobyas kyang / /phyag rgya chen po'i 14—684

sgrub thabs gsal ma bstan/ /dam pas ma 'ongs rnams la brtser dgongasash+tsar//sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag mdor ①bsdus te/ /rgya mtsho rgya chen bdud rtsi thigs pa'i tshul/ /yang dag sgrub don yan lag phyogs gcig bshad/ /dam pa'i gsung ②dang rgyud la mi bsten cing / /dgos 'brel yan lag 'thad pa'i sgrub med par/ /rang dgar smyos tshig khwa bzhin smra byed pa/ /gsang don smos phyir log 'dren gtso bor grags/ /dgongs pa'i rim pas sgrub don ma bshad kyang //tshogs pas las rgyas myur ba'i cho ga yis/ /brten pa'i stobs kyis dus mtshungs grol byed pa/ /khyad par thabs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bstan bshad/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis ④dgongs mdzad ji bzhin pa'i/ /yang dag sgrub pa'i bsnyen sgrub cho ga las/ /dang po rten kyi mtshan nyid ldan pa yis/ /sgrub pa chen po'i las la 'jug par bya/ /de dag ji bzhin legs par spyod pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'di las dang dngos grub phun tshogs gnas/ /rig 'dzin gnas thob sangs rgyas sar 'gro zhing / /zag med yon tan phrin las go bar ston/ /gang zhig rgyal ba rnams kyi rjes su 'jug pa dag gis ni nges pa'i don du bshad pa'i theg pa dag kyang phyag rgya bzhi dang tshad mas bsgrubs te bla ma brgyud pa la brten par bya'o—/ /de la dang po rten gyi dumatshan nyid ni/ /zhi zhing des la gsong por smra ba dang / /sgyu sogs med pas gzhan don brtson pa dang / /nga rgyal khro gtum dang bral zhing rjo/ /'gro ba kun gyi yid 'ong bsadhi/ /dam pa'i bshes gnyen la brten te skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang /sdom pa blang ba dag bya'o/ /de nas theg pa chen po la mos pa'i shugs kyis dad pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / yang dag pa'i lta bas shes rab gsum bskyed 14—685

cing snod kyi dri ma stidag bsal ②bar byas nas rdo rje theg pa la mos pas de nyid kyi bla ma dam pa la brten te dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / dbang bzhi rim pa bzhin du thob par bya ba dang / de dag gi dam tshig ji skad bstan pa bzhin du gnas pas 'gro ba thams cad bsgral zhing byang chub kyi lam la dgod par bya ba'i phyir rdo rje theg pa las bshad pa'i don bzhin du bdag bsgral bar bya ste/dad pa la skyo dub med pa dang / brtson 'grus la thang lhod med pa dang / lta ba la dbye gsal med pa dang / spyod pa la 'gron theb ①med pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar dam bcas te/ bsgrub rjopa rim pa'i gdams ngag mnos shing lta ba'i mtshan nyid dang / sgom pa'i mtshan nyid dang / spyod pa'i mtshan nyid dang / sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid dag the tshom med par nyams su blang ngo dhi/ /des bdag dang gzhan dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor bya ba'i cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor ji lta ba bzhin shes shing bsgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / phyag rgya rnam pa bzhi shes pas rgyas gdab pa dang / sngags rnam pa bzhis dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang / ye shes kyi ༷lha la sogs pa rnams dgug pa dang / mchod pa gsum gyi rim pa shes pas lha dang slob dpon mnyes par bya ba dang / las sna tshogs kyi bya ba la sbyor ba'i cho ga dang / bdag dang gzhan la sogs pa ma lus pa ⑦rnams gang 'dod pa dag ⑧bsrung ba'i cho ga dang /slar bsdu ba'i cho ga dang / gshegs su gsol ba'i cho ga rnams la mkhas shing byang bar byas nas bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu bca' ⑨zhing bsgrub par bya'o/ /de yang rdo rje rgyal po dang / rgyal theb kyi thosprem zin par gyur nas/14—686

gnas shar ①dang byang du gzhol zhing phyogs gzhan mtho bar gyur pa nags tshal phun sum tshogs par 'khor ⑤dang / yum dang / yo byad dang rgyan chas dag ①phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas las la sbyar ro/ /de la gnas ni rnal 'byor pa rjodag shin tu nyams dga' bar gyur pa'i sa gzhi pad+ma 'dra ba las dbus mtho zhing nam mkha' 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa ltar mngon pa/ shar dang byang du gzhol zhing phyogs gzhan mtho bar gyur pa nags tshal bzang po me tog dang ⑤'bras bu'i tshogs kyis brgyan cing / chu rgyun gsal bas mtha' bzhi rgyas pa'i ri'am/ ljongs sam thang la sogs pa rin po che dang sman 'bras kyis brgyan pa ni shin tu bkra shis par 'gyur rorjo/ /de las gzhan pa'i las phra mo dag sgrub pa la ni rigs so so'i gnas dang mthun par bya'o/ /der shis pa dang mi shis pa'i ltas brtag pa'i phyir sa pus nub tsam du brkos la slar sa des dgong ba'am dri chu bzang po dang sbyar bas bkang ste/ mnyam par gzhag ⑦pas rdo rje dril bu gzung ⑧zhing rang gi sngags brjod nas mi drag par gom pa ⑨brgya'i gnas nas log ste blta bar bya'o/ /de las ma legs pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba dag la ni g.yas g.yon gyi gnas su spo bar bya zhing / pra sen la sog pas pas ⑩brtag go/ /de nas bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis snod dag par bya ba'i phyir/ sku'i rten gzugs pa dang gsung gi sgra bsgrags pa dang / mchod sbyin chen po rgya cher gtang zhing / gtor ma'i tshogs kyis mgron rnams tshim par bya'o/ /de nas yang rnam par shes pa'i phyag rgya'am/ ye shes kyi phyag rgyas kyang brtags nas shin tu dge bar gyur pa der sa bslang bar ⑪bya'o/ /gal te mtshan ma ngan pa 14—687

lta bu zhig na rgo zhi ba dang drag pos gdul bar bya zhing de dag gi sbyin sreg la sogs pas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /yul gyi bdag bo rgyal po la sogs pa dag la ni bslang ba'am/ rin gyis nyo ba dang ①/ mi snang ba ②la ni rang gi lha'i sbyor bas gtor ma btang ste/ mgron rnams tshim nas las la bsgo zhing de las khyad par du sa'i lha mo dang / sa bdag ta pa la'i 'khor rnams la babe+engs nas de dag mnyes par bya'o/ /de nas ①sa gzhi de dag tu dri chab byin gyis brlabs pa sngags kyis gtor zhing / ting nge 'dzin gsal ba'i 'phro 'dus bdud rtsi dang / yi ge gsum gyis sbyang ba byas nas dkyil 'khor ji tsam 'dod pa'i rgyar sa gzhi brkos te/dngos grub rab ④'bring gi don du/ khru do dang / khru gang dang ⑤/ sor bzhi'i tshad tsam du brkos pa'i tshad 'phang du brtsig par bya'o/ /de'i dus su rus pa dang / gseg ma dang / gyo mo dang / sol ba dang / sa ro rnams bsal te dri zhim pa'i chu dang / sa mnyen rjo'ajam pa sbyin po dang bsres nas brtsigs te/ sman dang / rin po che dang / dri rnams snying po ru gzhug go/ /yang chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i don bsam zhing ④/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudheḥsarba dharmāḥ⑤swa bhā ba shu bye⑨྅haṃ zhes brjod de/ dri'i chus byug par bya'o/ /de nas mchod gtor sna tshogs nye bar sbyang zhing / rigs kyi rgyan ⑩dang ldan pa lngas rang nyid rgyan kyis brgyan te/ sa gzhi byen gyis brlab ⑪pa'i don du—/ spyo ⑫ga ga na/ paṃ uhūṃ/ zhes brjod cing nam mkha' stong pa'i rang bzhin las 'byung ⑫ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ri rab dang bcas pa brtan par gnas shing / rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / ra ba dang / gur la me 'od dang 14—688

bcas par bsam mo/ /de nas sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gnas pa la phyogs bzhi/ de'i sngags dang phyag rgya ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje bcings pa sa la bzhag ste/ oṃ me di ①ni badzi bha ba badz+ra brnya hūṃ zhes pa'o/ /de nas bdag nyid kyi mdun du sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo bum pa 'dzin pa bka' nyan pa'i tshul du gnas pa las zhal bsil dang mchod yon phul zhing gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi④/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa dang / /lha mo khyod ni dpang ④du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa de bzhin bdag gis bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ ji srid las ma grub pa'i bar du bzhugs dusu gsol ba dang / lha mo dgyes nas mdangs phyung ste slar smras pa/ khyed rnams dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub par gyis shig ces brjod par bsam mo/ /de nas sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gnas pa la phyogs bzhi'i rnal 'byor pa rgyan gyis brgyan zhing / lha mo bzhi'i nga rgyal dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ oṃ byams chen nam mkha'i rigs sbyor ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal 'jigs pa'i skyobasarjo/ /rnam 'byed gsal ba'i chos mchog can/ /yang dag ye shes spyod pa grol/ /a la la la la ho/ oṃ snying rje'i gnas mchog dag pa'i dngos—/ /mnyam nyid chos kun 'byung ba yirjo/ /yon tan rin chen mdzod ston pa'i/ /rnam 'phrul chos las rab tu grol/ /a la la la la ho/ oṃ dga' ba'i pad+mo mtshan ldan pa/ /kun rtog dngos gsal chags pa med/ /rdo rje gsang gsum gnas gdon pa'i/ /brjod 'byung tshig ⑦las 'das pa'o/ /14byed689

a la la la la ho/ oṃ btang snyoms gnas ngan dra ba sel/ /phrin las bdag po stobs rdzogs pa/ /bya ba'i ye shes mthar mdzad cing / /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol/ /①a la la la la ho/ oṃ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gtso/ /spyig pa thams cad las grol sdezhing / /bsod nams dngos grub kun 'byung ba'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /mthong dga' mthong bas ①grol byed pa/ /lam ④mchog gsang ba chen po'i tshogs/ /bdag nyid chen pos bstan du gsol/ /a la la la la ho/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin las khro bo rta mchog rol pa'i skur bsgom zhing phyogs bcur bsgyings ba'i tshul gyis gnas te/ mig g.yas par ma las byung ba'i nyi ma'i mes thams cad bsreg pa dang / mig g.yon par a las byung ba'i zla ba'i chus dag pa dang / sna'i rtse mor yi ⑤las byung ba'i rlung gis thams cad 'thor zhing phyag gis mtshon cha khrol nas spro ba mdzad do/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ hūṃ ༷lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po dang / /dri za srin po sha za'i tshogs/ /gshin rje ma mo mkha' 'gro gdug⑦ /gnod byed drag po ma lus rnams/ /gang dag sa gzhi 'dir gnas pa/ /srung byed pa yi bdag po'i bka'/ /thos pa tsam gyis myur du dengs/ /nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed/ /gang zhig gnas pa'i mthu bo che/ /rdo rje tho ba ⑧kha ṭ+wāṃ gas/ /thal ba'i tshogs bzhin bshig ⑨par byed/ /rab 'bar khro bo'i gnas 'joms pa'o—/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs 'di yis/ / gal te gang gis dam tshig 14—690

bcag /①'dod gsum skyes rnams gsad ②bya ste/ 'jig par 'gyur phyir gzhan du dengs①/ /zhes lan gsum brjod cing sa gzhi bskor te phyogs skyong bcu dag gnas lngar bsdus te/ khro bo stobs po che rjodang sprin sgra la sogs pa'i phur bus gdab bo/ /oṃ badz+ra gha gha ⑤ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭi phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya/ sarba pa rjopaṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya badz+ra dha ro ādz+nyā pa ya ti/kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kri la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing / sum+bha'i ⑦sngags kyis bkug ste/ dbang ldan gyi mtshalas nas brtsam par bya'o/ /de nas dpal he ru kar bsgom zhing mkha' 'gro ma brgyad dang bcas pa'i stong stabs kyis thams cad bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas las kyi rdo rjes phyi rol gyi stegs bu la mchod gtor bshams te/ dkon mchog gsum dpang skepor bzhag nas/ tshangs pa dang / brgya byin la sogs pa'i srung ⑨ma rnams dgug cing mchod pa dang /'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad la cha gcig dbul ba dang / lan chags kyi bgegs rigs rnams la gtor ma bsngos nas khyad par kyi gtor ma bzhi rgyal po sde bzhi la dbul zhing rten la gzhag ⑩ste/ mnga' gsol nas phyi mtshams bcad do/ /de nas stegs bu tshad dang ldan pa legs par brtsigs te/ phyogs bzhir sbyin sreg gi thab khung bzhi dang / mtshams su rta mchog lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor brtsam par bya'o/ /de nas legs par brtsigs shing ⑪byugs nas ba'i rnam pa lnga dang / dri zhim po'i spos dang / sman rnams bsres te byug cing / de'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga'i chu byin gyis brlabs pas byug go/ /de nas lha rnams kyi 14—691

gnas su rig pas thig gdab cing bdud rtsi lngas dbus su thig le gru bzhi pa lha mo nyi shu'i gnas su zlum por byas la/ de la lha so so'i sngags kyis me tog dgram par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su mchod pa'i tshogs dgram zhing / sbyang ba dang /bsrung ba dang / byin gyis brlabs pa dang / gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin dang /rten gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar byas nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs pa dang / /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs pas mnyes par byas nas bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo/ /de yang pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs te/ g.yas pas spos thogs la / g.yon pas dril bu dkrol zhing tshig 'di brjod do/ /thugs rje chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /ma lus sems can don mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras dang bcas/ /stobs mchog rgyal chen rnams la bstod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam spyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon gyur las rnams grub pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje gsang ba bdag gis bri/ /brtse bas slob ma rnams phyir dang / /bdag nyid rnams la mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan khyed la bdag gus te/ /dgyes mdzad 'os par gyur pa lags/ /bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ /bya ba chen po 'khor lo'i phyir/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems sogs 1dang / /gsang sngags gsang ba'i lha nyid dang / /'byung tshogs 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rjes dga' ba/ /bstan la dga' ba'i 'go ba dag /gang dag rdo rje'i spyan ldan pa'i / /rigs rnams 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso/ /don grub gsang ba bdag gis brtsam/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /gnang bar mdzad 74—692

pa'i 'os lags so/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ yang mchod pa cung zad phul te brtan par bzhugs su gsol lo/ /de nas mchod rdzas dang /rnal 'byor pa'i rgyan cha dang / dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan chas dang 1/ bum pa dang / yo byad dang / las kyi phyag rgya dang / rnal 'byor pa'i tshogs rnams 'tshogs par byas nas de'i rjes la phrin las rnam pa bzhi'am/ yang na gang dgos pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams stan bde ba la gnas te/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor bas lus ngag yid gsum mthu babyed cing / bdag dang 'gro ba sbyang ba dang / dbang po dgug pa dang / 'phags pa la tshogs bsags pa dang / sems can thams cad la tshogs bsags pa rnams bya'o/ /yang rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom zhing lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs la/ bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa dang / tshogs kyi mchod pas nyams pa bskang ba dang /gang dag dam tshig ma 'dres pa dag ni bsre mnan bya zhing gsar bu dag 'jug pa la ni rigs pa'i dbang lnga dam tshig dang bcas pa spyin pa yin 4no/ /de nas srung zhiba'i 'khor lo'i sbyor bas mtshams kyi las bya ste/ phur pa dar gyi cod 6pan can bcu 7la khro bo chen po bcur bskyed cing ye shes kyi khro bo dgug gzhug gnyis su med par byas nas mchod cing bstod de8/ bzlas brjod rdzogs par phul bas mnyes shing brtan par byas nas phyogs skyong gi gzugs la gdug pa'i sems phab ste gdab par bya'o/ /14—693

de nas gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor brtsam par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje jeg nga/'i sgor zhugs pa'i 1rnal 'byor gyi sgrub nga/ po dag rgyan chas/ phyag rgya'i tshogs dang / chas gos lnga dang / srad bu dang / thal bas mtshan cing rdo rje rgyal theb 2yum/ dang bcas pas rang gi lha gsal bar byas la/ thig sgud ras sar pa'i rgyu 'a/sa byung ba sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs nas bka'/ nga/ra bya ste/ring thung ni dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur la/ sgom phra ni sgo'i nyi shu'i tshad do/ /de ltar kha dog lnga'i dog nga/ byas/ nas rin po che'i sgod du bzhag ste/ rigs kyi yi ges lhar bskyed cing sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs nas lha rnams dgug gzhug byas la/ mchod cing bstod nas bsgril bar bya'o/ /oṃ dībe+e 4dṛṣ+ṭi saṃ ku sha dzaḥ.oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tram̐ mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ dang po shar nas nub tu brkyang ste gdab par bya'o/ /de yang thabs kyi gsang gnas nas / shes rab kyi gsang ba'i gnas su drangs te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ dza dza zhes brjod do/ /stobs mchog dpa' bo dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje thig gi sgra ldan pas/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor legs grub cing / /'gro ba'i don la bskul bar mdzad/ /oṃ ma hā bo bye tsit+ta sarba satwa 0hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing / thig skor dang bcas pas nam mkha' la btab ste/ dkyil 'khor bkod nas/ gzod sa gzhi la gdab par bya'o/ /de yang dang por shar nas nub tu brkyang ba'i thig go/ /de'i phyogs mtshams tshad pa'i phyir cha bzhir byas te/ bar mtshams gnyis nas phyed kyi 1 tshad kyis ni lho byang du btsal te/ der thig gnyis pa btab po1 / / der thig gnyis kyang phyed kyi tshad kyis ngos bzhi'i thig rtse nas tshad pas mtshams kyi zur bzhi dod par 'gyur ro/ /de'i rjes la shar dang nub dang byang dang lho'i 74byed694

phyogs bzhi dag dang / mtshams bzhir gdab cing / de las phyogs thig 1bzhi'i rtse mo'i tshad kyis 2ni cha bzhi'i tshad du 'gyur te/ de dag kyang lo ma gtub pa'i thig gis cha chen sum cu rtsa gnyis la cha 'bring dang cha bran so so'i gzhung bzhin dbye zhing / de'i 'og ma'i he ru ka dang / rdo rje nyi ma la ni 4 bran gnyis ma phyes pa'i snam bu'o/ /rab 5rim pa gsum dang / 'khor yug rnams ni cha bran re re'i tshad kyis 'khor ba'o/ /6dur khrod 7ni cha bran bzhi'i tshad do/ /de ltar thig gi las rdzogs nas/ /ye shes kyi skud pa 8mchod cing bstod do 1/ /slar gshegs su gsol nas/ lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas mig gnyis la nyi zla bsam zhing / tī zhes brjod nas blta ba byas nas/ rdo rje slong ba'i phyag rgya bcings te/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ga a kra ma hūṃ/ zhes pas ri mo de gdeg par bya'o/ /de nas phyogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du dmigs nas tshig 'dis dag par bya'o/ /oṃ thams cad rang bzhin rnam 'phrul mchog /dngos med zhi ba 'od ldan gsal / rdo rje 'dzin pa gter chen 'byin/ /dkyil 'khor dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /mnyam pa'i sngags blo rnam gsal bas—/ /nyes pa'i zug rngu dag par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod cing thams cad lha'i rang bzhin du brtag ste/ des ni cho ga lhag ma dang / ma tshang ba kha skong bar byed do/ /de nas cha dbye bar bya ste/ phyi rol gru bzhi sgo dang bcas pa la /ra ba rim gsum dur khrod kyis brgyan pa/ /dbus su pho brang rim pas phye ba ste/ /dkyil 'khor so so'i dbyibs bzhin du/ /pho brang gi ra ba dang / mtshams 12 'byed pa dang / gsang lam gyi phreng ba'o/ /de la tshon gyi cho ga ni/ rin po che sna lnga'am1 / tshon rtsi gang yang rung 14—695

ba dag snod lnga'i nang du blugs te/ phyogs phyogs su bzhag nas yi ge la sogs pa'i lha'i skur bskyed cing ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bkug ste mchod cing bstod nas rang gi gnas su dgram mo/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ dang po tshon gyi go rims ni/ lag pa g.yon pas/ dkar po dang / mthing ga dang /dmar po dang / ser po dang / ljang gu'i rim gyis pañtsa re khā bris te/mchod cing thod pas bkab 1nas mtshan ma'i ltas brtag go/ /'di ni chos dbyings rnam par dag /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /dpal ldan rgyal po che ge mo'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /yang dag bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor las rnams shis par mdzod/ /ces brjod cing bteg 2ste blta bar bya'o/ /de yang thig ni phyi nas gdab cing /tshon ni nang nas dgye ste/ dang po rdo rje rgyal theb kyis bri zhing / phyi nas ci 4bde bar bri ste mtho zhing drang bar bya'o/ /gang zhig re khā dma' ba dang / yo ba dang / chad pa dang / 'khrul pa dag gis ni mi 'grub po/ /de ltar tshon rtsi lnga'i mchog dag ni dbus su btab ste/ kha dog phyogs kyis phye la/ mu khyud sngon po dag la ni rdo rje dkar po bri'o/ /dkyil 'khor de'i phreng ba dmar po la rtsibs mchan 5ljang gu dang / gru chad ser po'o/ /gzhan dag kyang so so'i rigs kyis shes par 'gyur ro/ /sgo bzhi ni dkar po dang / ser po dang /dmar po dang / ljang gu'o/ /rta babs ni kha dog nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /pad+ma'i phreng ba ni kha dog sna tshogs pa'o/ /rdo rje'i ra ba ni sngo la dkar po'i phreng bas mdzes pa'o/ /me ri ni dmar ser ro/ /dur khrod ni phyogs kyi mdog go/ / tshozhing skyong ni nag po'o / /phyogs skyong ba dang klu la sogs pa ni rang gi rigs 74—696

bzhin no/ /'dod 'byung gi gnas ni ser po la phyi'i ra ba ni sngo gnag go/ /de dag gi gnas rnams su ni rten kyi 1mtshan ma gang rung gzhag 2go/ /des dkyil 'khor byu rgyan la sogs pa dag kyang byin gyis brlabs te dgod par bya'o/ /gzhan yang mchod pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya zhes pa dang / mchod pa thams cad kyi gtor ma'i 4rdzas dag kyang byin gyis brlabs te gzhag 5par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor la sogs pa bsrung bar bya zhing sta gon gyi lha rnams dkyil 'khor gyi 6gnas su dgod do/ /yang rdo rje rgyal pos 7 gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rten gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / dmigs pa dang po gnyis kyis dkyil 'khor mnyes par byas nas gsol ba gdab po/ /de nas rnal 'byor pho mo rgyan dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu thogs te yi ge brgya pas bskang zhing / stang stabs dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la lan bdun du bskor ro/ /de nas rdo rje rgyal po dang /rgyal theb 9dang / las kyi phyag rgya dang / las kyi rdo rje dang / /brda spyor ba dang / rdul phyag la sogs pa so sor phye ste/ so sor gdan bsham zhing dgod par bya'o/ /de dag snga ma'i gnas ji lta ba las/ phyis mi 'gyur bar rang rang gi rnal 'byor gyis 'khod cing phyogs kun nas langs te/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dag gis byin phab nas/ gnas dang dkyil 'khor la sogs pa mnga' gsol lo/ /de nas gsang ba'i theg pa'i 'jug sgo shes pas/ gzhan las dpag par bya ba'i phyir brda sgo dbye/ tha mal gyi tshig spang zhing / rdo rje rgyal theb kyi sgo nas lus kyi brda la gnas par bya zhing / phyogs bzhi nas phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba gdab ste/ spyor ba'i gar thabs kyis gnas par bya'o/ /gzhan yang dur khrod kyi bdag po la sogs pa gdul ba'i phyir dpal he ru ka la 74—697

sogs pa'i nga rgyal gyis glang po che'i stod g.yogs la sogs pas lus mtshan par bya ste/ sngags kyis sbyang zhing byin kyis byebarlabs nas/ gti mug dag par bya ba dang / 'dod chags dag par bya ba dang / nga rgyal dag par bya ba'i phyir ni mnabs pa'i rgyan bgo'o 37/ /zhe sdang dag par bya ba'i phyir dang / phrag dog dag par bya ba'i phyir ni gdags pa'i rgyan 1bgo'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i chags pa dang / byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral zhing srid pa gsum gdul ba'i phyir ni byug pa'i rgyan zibago'o/ /des ni dur khrod la 5dngos po gdul zhing rang gi don ston pa'o/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la bsdus nas dmigs su med pa'i don la gnas pa las/ yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag gis bslang bar bsams nas rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bzhengs te 'di shaṃbarjod do/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor na/ /'byung ba lnga yi mtshan nyid las/ /zhi ba'i lha ni lhan ne+e ba'i/ /thugs rje 'gro kun de las skyes/ /de tshe sems can thams cad ni/ /shin tu khro drag gtum par 'gyur/ /de tshe sems can thams cad ni/ /shin tu chags shing zhen par 'gyur/ /de tshe sems can thams cad ni/ /shin tu gti mug che bar 'gyur/ /de ltar dug gsum bdo ba la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te / /shes rab thabs kyi nyi ma las/ /rnam par rgyal phyir rab tu drag /oṃ ma hā shrī te ru ka sa ma ya gro dha ha la ha la hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod nas/ thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa las/ /rngam pa'i sgra sgogs 'u te/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ mi rtag pematshan nyid bstan skyepa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i khro bo za byed cing / /'jigs pa'i mtshon cha 'od dpung 'khrigs/ /zhal du stong 14—698

khams ma lus thim/ /zad par byed cing stong bar byed/ /rgas rgud brlag par byed pa'o/ /glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ /myur ba'i za byed chen po lngas//skye rga na 'chi 'joms byed cing / /brlag cing za byed stong par byed/ /rigs chen za byed khros pa'i tshe/ /sku ni sngo skya thal ba'i ngang / /'od zer mang po rab tu 'khrigs/ /ru lu ru lus ma lus 1za/ /'bar ba'i mkha' 'gro tshogs bcas pas/ /bsreg cing 'jigs pa 'thor zhing 'khrud/ /gang 'dir bskal pa kun brlag tshe/ /gzhan zhig 'ongs 'jigs ma yin te/ /za byed khros pa lnga po yis/ /zhal du stong khams ma lus thim/ /oṃ budha 2shrī he ru ka sa ma ya kro dha oṃ oṃ ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i khro bo smug nag /phyag na 'khor lo dang / thod 4khrag 'dzin pa grangs med pa'i tshogs rnams sprul pa dang bcas par gnas so/ /oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka sa ma ya kro dha hūṃ hūṃ ru lu phaṭa/ lag pa g.yas pa la rdo rje khro bo sku 5sngo skya/ lag na rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thogs pa grangs med pa'i tshogs sprul pa dang bcas par ro6//oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka sa ma ya kro dha tram̐ tram̐ he he hūṃ phaṭa/ lag pa g.yon pa na rin po che khro bo ser nag7 /tri shu 8la dang / ral gri thogs pa grangs med pa/sprul pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa'o// /oṃ pad+ma shrī 7he ru ka sa ma ya gro dha tweḥdhīḥ11da ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ rkang pa g.yon pa la pad+ma'i khro bo dmar nag /phyag na ral gri rtse gsum dang / gtun shing thogs pa grangs med pa sprul par bcas pa'o2/ /o karma shrī he ru ka sa ma ya kro dha haṃ haṃ rak+ṣa ka hūṃ phaṭa/ rkang pa g.yas pa la las kyi khro bo ljang nag phyag na sna tshogs rdo rje dang / lcags kyu thogs pa grangs med pa sprul pa dang bcas pa'o/ /oṃ shrī bye ra ba 7hūṃ ma hā de ba hūṃ phaṭa/14byed699

mtshan ma la lha chen po mdog dkar po/ lag na tri shu rmyel dang / thod pa thogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /oṃ bidri 'ukam pa la tsa kra hūṃ phaṭa/ snying gar khyab 'jug mthing nag /lag na 'khor lo dang / thod pa thogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /oṃ rak+ṣa ③da sha kṛ ba hūṃ phaṭa/ mgrin par srin po'i rgyal po ljang skya/ lag na dgra sta dang / tho ba thogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'o/oṃ ma hā thupa sha ha la hūṃ phaṭa/ sku'i gnas su bzhugs pa nag po sngo skya lag na zhags pa dang thod pa thogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /phye oṃ badz+ra bye ra hūṃ phaṭa/brla gnyis la rdo rje 'jigs byed rnam par 'jigs pa ljang skya/ rdo rje rtse gsum dang thod pa thogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /de dag kun kyang rang rang gi yum dang 'khril ba'i tshul du gnas so/ /lag pa'i sor mo bcu la mche ba can lnga dang / sder mo can lnga dag sngags 'dis gsal bar bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā dhe ki shā ri bi ka ma ru sha ha ha he he ru lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ye shes glog gi dkyil 'khor dang / /'jigs pa'i khro bo gtum po'i tshogs/ /cir yang gyur pa'i mtshon cha yis/ /sbug bsngal gnas rnams rab tu bcom/ ma rungs h+phu dur khrod gzhig pa'i phyir//stong gsum gnas rnams bsgral bar bya/ /'jigs ⑦ byed drag shul chen po yis/ /khams gsum cig car bsgral nas kyang / /za byed chen po'i zhal du ni/ /'gro kun yud tsam cig la 'dren/ /'gro dang mi 'gro'i snod bcud 'di/ /'jigs byed khyed lngas kun za na/ /dngos por gyur pa'i bgegs 'di kun/ /ngas bstabs khyed kyis 2yul la gsol/ /ngan song gsum gyi 'jigs byed du/ /sems can nyon mongs sdang byed pas/ /de phyir nga ni rdo rje che/ /zhe sdang zhes ni grags pa yin/ /ngan song 'jigs pa chen po ru/ /sems can thams cad 14—700

rmongs byed pa/ /de phyir nga ni gti mug che/ /rtag tu thub pa mchog yin no/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags stsos pa rnams/ /'dod chags nyid kyis mtshams sbyor bas / /de phyir chos kyi rdo rje ni/ /'dod chags chen po'i mchog yin no/ /bde chen sbyin pa'i sprin gyis ni/ /sems can thams cad nga rgyal bskyed/ /nam mkha' bde bas bsdus pa'i phyir/ /bde chen 'dod pa nga yin no/ /ro la sogs pa mnyam sbyor bas/ /phrag dog rdo rje gdon mi za/ /sna tshogs las kyi khro bo'i sku/ /phrag dog chen po'i mchog yin no/ /nga ni dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sgu/ /ye shes rno dbal 1mtshon cha yis / /log rtog 'khor ba'i rgyun gcod do/ /chos nyid mnyam nyid nam mkha' la/ /ye shes glog gi 'od 'phro ba/ /gnas med dmigs pa yod ma yin//brtse ba med cing brten pa med/ /oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te te tun hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba na ra ka ga te he tun hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba na ra ka ga te te tun hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba durga sarba karma sarba kle sha stson+da ts+tshan+da hūṃ phaṭa / sarba bir+ya ts+tshan+da stson+da 4hūṃ phaṭa/ sarba bir+ya 5khaspyo ts+tshan+da s+thā 6hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ tri bi shwa mū 7la tshin+da stson+da hūṃ phaṭa/ dpal chen 'bar ba rgyal po'i sku/ /rngam brjid khros pa'i cha lugs 'bar/ /gar dgu dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan/ /shes rab sgu dang 'khril sbyor zhing / /'jo tshul gar mdzad lta bu yis / /bdud dang srin po 'dul bar mdzad/ /ma tang la sogs bgegs byed rnams/ /gzugs dang bcas pa'i tshogs bsdus te/ /pra ti ta yi phyag rgya yis/ /nges par gzugs la dbab par bya/ /gzugs brnyan bri la sogs pa la/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis mnyes byas nas/ /sngags dang 'od 'phro phyag rgya yis/ /de yi 'khor 14—701

tshogs bsdu bar bya'o/ /rdo rje be+egs kyu'i phyag rgya babyungs te gyen du bteg nas/oṃ ma hā shaṃ pa la dha ri shwa ya hūṃ/ ā kār+ṣa 1ya hūṃ dzaḥzhes brjod cing / rdo rje gshog pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas zil gyis mnan cing bstem mo/ /'phags pa thams cad bdag la gson/ /'byung po mang po kun nyon cig /stobs chen dpal ldan he ru ka'i/ rdo rje rnon po 'jam dpal gyi/ /thugs rje dang ni shes rab dang / /thabs la mkhas pa'i byin rlabs 2kyis/ /bdag dang 'gro ba bsrung bar mdzod/ /'gro ba rnams kyi tshe dang srog /gson po'i bde ba gcod byed pa'i/ /bdud dang srin po 'khor bcas kun/ /bcom zhing gsang ba'i gnyen po ni/ /bde gshegs thugs kyi dngos grub mchog /srid gsum thal byed rngam pa des/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ drag po mi bzad pas/ /bdud dang srin po 'khor bcas dang / /gshin rje bcom zhing bsad nas ni/ /ro yang lho yi 'dzam gling du/ /bor nas sa gzhir gyur pa ni/ /dur khrod chen po brgyad yin no/ /mgo ni lho nub mtshams su bstan/ /rkang pa byang shar mtshams su bstan/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon mtshams su bstan/ /nyams shing 'bod 'grogs brgyal bar 'gyur/ /oṃ sarba pā baṃ ka ra he ta pa bi shwa ma ta ka ru dra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā pa ka ra he ta pa bi shwa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ru dra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ ka ra he ta pa bi shwa ā kār+ṣa 4ru dra hūṃ phaṭa/ gnas kyi sgo ni su yis bcad / /sems kyi bdag pos bcad dam ci/ /gzung 'dzin rkang pa bsnol ba las/ /yul las 'das pa'i zhabs kyis dbye/ /de nas g.yas su bskor te/ste ba'i phyogs su e gru gsum gyi sgo phye nas lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas rnam par shes pa drangs te/ oṃ ma hā tso thusha phyung zhes gnas gsum gyi zhing khams gang rung du 14—702

rigs 1lhun gyis grub pa'i sras su bya'o/ /de nas khog pa gzhal yas khang du byas te/ rnal 'byor pa rnams nang du bzhugs nas/ nang khrol gyi tshogs rnams dug gsum rnam par dag pa 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyis 3/mchod par dmigs shing / dga' ba'i glu gar dang rol mos mchod par bya'o/ /de nas lha thams cad la bstod cing bskul ba'i phyir rdo rje'i glu blang ste/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la rgyab rten bcas/ /nam mkha'i phyag rgya rnal 'byor pas/ /nam mkha' kun las grol ba 'grub/ /dngos po thams cad mkha' byin pa/ /mkha' las sgyu ma kun blangs nas/ /lus pa med par der za'o/ / gaṇ+ḍi hoḥ/ ghaṇ+ḍi hoḥ /ghaṇ+ḍi'i 4sgra yis sgrol bar mdzad/ /la lar mkhas pa'i gzugs kyang 'dzin/ /la lar tshangs pa bzhin du zhi/ /la lar gshin rje bzhin du rngam/ /la lar dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /'jig rten khams ni stong dag na/ mi sdug rigs kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ma'i tshogs bcas kyis/ /ma lus lus pa med par sgrol/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs rnams 5za byed kyi tshogs dang 'jigs byed kyi zhal du dbul ba ni/bstabs su gsol cig te ru ka /gang la bya ba'i dngos po 'di/ /phra man gshed ma khyed rnams kyis/ /dbang dang rig sngags byin brlabs te/ /rig sngags kyis ni rmongs mdzad nas/ /drag po las kyis sgrub byed cing / /'di la sogs pa rnams la yang / /de dag longs spyod rgyan du 'bul/ /sha dang rkang khrag 'dod pa rnams/ /rig sngags kyis ni byin brlabs nas/ /'tsho ba phrogs nas ci bde bar/ /khyed kyis de la longs spyod cig /bharnya snabacud yangs zab pa na/ /khor yug gtos kyi dngos po 'di/ /bdud rtsi'i rang 14—703

bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ /'jigs byed dka' zlog dgyes shing rol/ /rdo rje gsum 'bar sku gsung thugs/ /srid gsum 'joms mdzod tri shu 1la/ /dug gsum rtsad nas gcad pa'i phyir/ /khams gsum cig car bsgral bar bya/ /'jigs byed drag shul chen po yis/ /khams gsum cig car bsgral nas kyang / /za byed chen po'i zhal du ni/ /'gro kun yud tsam cig la 'dren/ /'gro dang mi 'gro'i snod bcud 'di/ / 'jigs byed 2 khyed lngas kun za na/ /dngos por gyur pa'i bgegs 'di kun/ /ngas bstabs khyed kyis yul la bzhes/ /oṃ ma hā shrī te ru ka ha ha ha ha ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ bh+yo khā hi khā hi/ shar phyogs 'jig rten lam sgo na/ /yang dag thar lam gcod byed pa/ /'byung po gtum po nga rgyal can/ /khyod ni sgrib pa kun la bsgribs / /yang dag thar lam ye shes kyi/ /khungs brtag rtsad bcad bdag las byung / /bdag 'dzin bdag gi rtog pa rnams/ /bdag med stong pa'i tho bas gzham/ /āt+man 4hi ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra 5badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kopho6haṃ/ chos kun rtag tu rang gi ngo bos stong / /rgyal ba'i sras rnams dngos po rnam par 'jigs/ /srid pa ji bzhin yong ye stong pa ste/ /nyi che'i stong nyid mu stegs can rnams kyi'o/ /'dod pa'i khams stong pa nyid do/ /gzugs kyi khams stong pa nyid do/ /gzugs med pa'i khams stong pa nyid do/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi lus stong pa nyid do/ /ngag stong pa nyid do/ /sems stong pa nyid do/ /gang dag stong 7nyid mi shes pa/ /de yis mya ngan 'das mi shes/ /de phyir dngos po dngos med pas/ /'jigs pas stong nyid shes par bya/ /chen po stong pa zhes bya ba/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rdzogs byed pa'o/ /de bas rnam pa 74—704

thams cad du/ /stong nyid rjes su dran par bya/ /oṃ dharma ①jo tu badz+ra ④swa bhā wa ā kolhagahaṃ zhes pas/ mtshan ma'i rtog tshogs kun mi rtog ye shes kyis gzhom par bya'o/ /de bas bharnya ④mtshan dang ldan pa dag byin gyis brlab cing /rang rang gi gnas su me mar dang bcas pas dgram pa dang / /dur khrod chen po brgyad dag ⑤dgod do/ /shar du rkang pa g.yas pa'o/ /lhor lag pa g.yas pa'o—/ /nub tu lag pa g.yon pa'o/ /byang du rkang pa g.yon pa'o/ /shar lhor dku g.yas pa'o/ /lho nub tu mgo bo'o/ /nub byang du dku g.yon pa'o/ /byang shar du mtshan ma'o/ /de ltar dug gsum gyi rten rjobasags nas/ zhing skyong la sogs pa'i gzugs bri bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang dbang sgyur ⑦chen po'i ting nge 'dzin las hūṃ ⑧gyi 'phro 'dus gnas byin gyis brlab ⑨pa dang / rnal 'byor pa thams cad rang gi lhar bsgom pa dang / sgrub rdzas thams cad yi ge gsum gyis bsregs shing sbyangs nas ⑩byin gyis brlab ⑪pa dang / lha mo kro dhi shwa ris byin gyis brlabs pa'i dri chab kyis dag par bya ba dang / bdud rtsi sbyang ba dang / tshogs kyi zhal zas byin gyis brlab ⑫pa rnams sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis rdzogs par byas nas sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi ⑫so so'i gnas su dgram par bya'o/ /de dag gis ⑫ni sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i yan lag gi cho ga bstan pa yin no/ /da ni bsnyen pa'i cho ga bstan pa'i phyir phyag rgya lngas mtshan cing chos gos lnga bgos te/ byed ba'i don du dam bcas nas dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rten gyi ting nge 'dzin 14—705

dang / brten pa'i ting 'dzin dang / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs pa'i bya ba dang / mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs pa'i bya ba dang / / gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs pa'i bya ba dang ①/ las la ②sbyor ba dang /thun mong gi bzlas brjod dang / khyad par kyi bzlas brjod dang / de dag rdzogs nas mchod cing bstod pa byas la/ lha rnams la thugs dam bskul bar bya/gal te rnal 'byor pa mtshan ma thob pa zhig gis 'jug na ni thig le 'am/ phra mo'am—/ rnam par dag pa spyad par bya'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi cho ga dang /sbyin sreg dang / lhag ma'i ①las dag pa'i rjobasgom pa dang / cho ga rdzogs pa'i las la sbyar ro/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i phyir gong du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa tsam las ma byas pa dag la ni snga ma bzhin ⑤dus su bar mtshams su gzhag 0nas rig pa'i dbang ⑦ bskur ba dang / de bzhin du gang thob pa nas brtsams te/ rdzogs pa'i bar du sbyang bar ④bya'o/ /de dag gi rim pa ni 'di ltar yin te/ dang po gong rol du 'jug pa'i cho ga la/ rdo rje rgyal po dang / /rgyal theb ⑨cho ga rdzogs pas slob ma yongs su sbyangs ⑩pa dang / bar khang gi sgo mtshams su maṇ+ḍal bshams pa la bzhag ste/ byang gi sgo drung na gnas pa'i bum pas bsangs nas/ rigs kyi lha mchod cing gsol ba btab nas shis par bya'o/ /de nas ras ⑪dmar po'am/ dkar po ser po ⑫dag la/ a ⑫khaṃ bī ra hūṃ hūṃ/zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs nas gdong g.yogs te/ rin po che'i phreng ba thogs nas theg pa chen por mos shing sems bskyed pas gnas pa la slob dpon gyis dri ste/ kye khyod ci la dga' bas 'dir 'jug pa yin zhes pa dang /14—706

slob mas kyang bdag skal ba bzang po la dga' bas 'jug pa'o zhes so/ /slar brjod pa de ①khyod la ci dgos zhes so/ /des kyang smras pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dngos grub 'dod pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /yang brjod pa②/ bde gshegs sras bcas dam tshig pas/ /yon dbul thugs rjes bdag la dgongs/ /sangs rgyas sku gsung rang bzhin mchog /slob dpon mgon la skyabs su mchi/ /skal bzang lha mo'i tshogs bcas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes pa dang / slar brjod pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi gnas bzhugs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor chen po nyams dga' ba/ /snying po'i grong khyer chen po 'dir/ /bdag gis skeslob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas las kyi rdo rjes lag pa g.yas pa nas bzung ste/ oṃ sarba yo ga ciX da da rjoya mi hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing yol ba'i nang du gzhug ste/ /dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor bzhag la 'di skad brjod do/ /oṃ thog ma med dus 'khor ba'i gnas/ /bdag gis bsags pa'i las gang gis/ /bgyid byed yi rang dus 'dir bshags/ /phyin chad mi bgyid sdom pa gzung / /rgyal ba sras sogs dge rtsa bzhi/ /'gro gzhan legs byas gang yin pa⑤/ /de dag kun la rjes yi rang / /byang chub chen por bdag gis bsngo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /bdag gis dus 'dir skyabs su gsol/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal bcad pa dang / /dge ba'i tshogs mang spel ba'i phyir/ /byang chub bde chen don bskyed nas/ /'gro rnams di ring don du rjoganyer/ /sangs rgyas gyur nas bdag gis ni/ /'gro rnams srid pa'i gnas nas gnon⑦/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje ⑧14—707

me tog gi ①phreng ba dang bcas pa slob ma'i snying gar bzhag ste/ oṃ bde gshegs kun gyis khyod nyid ni/ /di ⑦ring byin gyis brlabs pa na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang chen 'di/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu ma zhugs shing / /dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /nams kyang smra bar bya ba min/ /oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su skekhaṃ/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs mdzad de/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /oṃ ma hā sa ma ya u da ka ṭha④/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ/badz+ra u da ka ta hri ṭha/ de ring phyin chad khyod nyid kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nga yin pas/ /gang zhig bsgo ba'i las rnams byos/ /de ⑤la brnyas par ma byed cig /gal te cung zhig brnyas byas na/ /dus min 'chi zhing dmyal bar lhung / /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes thugs/ /sku dang gsung 'phrul las mdzad pa/ /phyag rgya'i cho ga gang dag gis/ /di ring bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /zhes brjod de/slob ma'i snying gar bde gshegs bzhugs pa dang / bdud rtsi byen gyis brlabs pas—/ dngos grub sbyin zhing dam tshig bsgrag par bya'oX/ /de nas snying ga dang / rkang mthil dang / mgrin pa dang / spyi bo rnams su 'byung ba'i sa bon gyi mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas yang / sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ zhes pas bsrung zhing rdo rje dril bu dgrol te/ oṃ dz+nyā na ā be sha ya ste bha ya ra ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ⑦ya hūṃ ā ha oṃ⑧/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad brjod do//nam zhig ye shes babs pa'i tshe ni sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rtags 14—708

ston par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis bden pa brjod par bya ste/mgon mchog gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /slob ma'i mchog 'di gzhug par bgyi/ /rigs kyi lha yi bye brag dang / /bsod nams gang yin de bzhin shog① /de bzhin dngos grub mtshan pa dag /snying po'i gnas 'dir legs par ston/ /zhes brjod cing kha dog dang dbyibs kyi bye brag la brtags te/des rang gi las dag grub par shes so/ /de nas me tog ②phreng ba dkyil 'khor du dor te/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ①/ zhes pas lha gang la babs pa de yi dam du blang bar bya'o/ /de yang gtso bo la bab na ni mchog gi dngos grub 'grub cing /bar mtshams dag gis ni 'bring gi rjolas 'grub la/ ra ba las 'das pa dag gis ni slar bskyar te lan gsum du dor zhing / gang zhig dkyil 'khor rjol ma bab pa dag ni chus shis par byas te slar gtang bar bya'o/ /yang phreng ba de blangs te slob ma'i mgo la bcings nas/ kye sems dpa' chen po phreng ba 'di dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig /oṃ rat+na mā le a rnyi ṣiñtsa ṭ+wāṃrjo/ zhes brjod do/ /yi ge oṃ gyis bskyed pa'i gser rmi thur ma phras mtshan pas ⑦dri ma bsal nas/oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' byed nyid kyi/ /mig dbyed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /sgrib g.yogs ling thog kun bsal nas/ /rdo rje mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu tshwa na pra be sha phaṭa/ ces brjod do/ /gdong ⑧g.yogs bsal nas/dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i phyir sgo dbye ste/ bu spyod dkyil 'khor legs par ltos//thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /phreng ba gang la bab pa ni/ /de nyid byed kyi rigs kyi lha/ /zhes ⑨shar phyogs kyi sgo nas brtsams shing gtso bo'i bar du lha rnams kyi mtshan ⑩bstan par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la bza' ba dang btung ba ⑪la 14—709

sogs pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs kyis lha dang slob dpon dang / rnal 'byor pa dag stsos par byas nas/ slob dpon la sems dad pa'i sgo nas bdag gi skal ba ji ltar lags pa bstan du gsol zhes brjod par bya'o/ /der slar brjod pa/bu byed dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i rigs mchog 'dzin/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos rnams thams cad mngon du 'ashar//dam tshig ting 'dzin rjes chags dang / /gsang sngags snying po 'dzin par gyis//zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i don du/ slob ma yon dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab ste/ rgyal ba kun kyi ①gsang ba'i lam/ /'go ba skyob la gzi brjid can—/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo mchog /yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas—/ /de ring dbang bskur gnang ba yi/ /dus la bab par 'os pa lags—/ /dpa' bo chen pos mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur rim bzhin bdag la spyod/ /rig pa chen pos las bsgrubs ②nas/ /dngos grub mchog rnams shis pa dang / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis rdo rje slob dpon gzung / /zhes brjod do/ /de nas shar gyi phyogs kyi sgo drung du/ khru do tsam gyis chod par dbang stegs dkyil 'khor gyi lte ba dang mnyam par brtsigs te/pad+ma 'dab brgyad sgo dang bcas pa bris nas/ seng ge'i khri la pad+mas mtshan pa'i ①gdan la bsham zhing slob ma bzhag ste/ 'phan gdugs dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang / gos sna tshogs kyis mdzes par 14—710

byas nas/ spos chus sbyangs te/ yungs kar kyi sbyin sreg dang / ku sha'i chus shis pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /yang bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs pa'i chu 'thor zhing / rta mchog gi sngags kyis bsrungs nas yi ge gsum gyis sbyang bar bya zhing / chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin las rigs kyi lhar bskyed de/ mchod dbyangs dang / rol mo'i sil snyan du bcas pas bum pa'i nang nas chu blangs te/ dung chos la sogs par blugs la tshigs su bcad pa brjod par bya'o/ /til kyi gong bu bzhin gang ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i bum pa bzung nas ni/ /'di gnyis la ni drugs byas las/ /bag chags ma lus dag gyur cig /ces phyi'i bum pa'i chus khrus byas nas/ yang sa bon gyi gsang sngags las byung ba'i lcags kyus ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bkug ste/ mdun rol du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhag nas gnyis su med pa'i rol pa mdzad cing / byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis lha'i bum pa bkang ste/ gar dang dbyangs su bcas pas phyogs bzhi nas khrus mdzad do / /oṃ lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /rdo rje gsang gsum gnas las byung / /rig pa'i lha mo tshogs ldan pa'i/ /rang bzhin gcig tu gyur pa yin/ /oṃ badz+ra a rnyi ṣiñtsā 1mi/ zhes brjod do/ /des ni me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i 2byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo ston te/chu'i dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rin po che'i rgyu las byas pa'am/ gzhan dag las byung ba gang yang rung ste/ dbu rgyan rtse lnga pa sangs rgyas lnga'i mtshan ma dang / dar 14—711

dpyangs su bcas pa byin kyis brlabs te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'dis sbyin par bya'o / /oṃ sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen las byung dbu rgyan chen/ /thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa'i/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra da ra ta ka rmyebadz+ra a ra li ho a rnyi ṣiñtsa t+t+waṃ bhe//zhes brjod nas/ /de'i rjes la thod pa'i mtshan ma drug dang bcas pa'i dar dpyangs kyis bcings te/ oṃ sangs rgyas kun kyi ye shes rtags/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sngon bskyed/ /rig pa'i ye shes mtshan ma'i rtags/ /hūṃ badz+ra ka pā la a t+ta ṣi.ā+oṃ — mi/ des ni so sor kun du rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin dpal rdo rje nyi ma byang chub sems kyi ngo bo dbu rgyan kyis dbang bskur pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa rnam par sbyang zhing byin gyis brlabs pa/ lag pa g.yas par gsor zhing / slob ma'i snying gar gtugs te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba chen po'i don/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu grub phyir gzung bar gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣi.ā+oṃ zimi/zhes brjod do/ slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par gtad nas lan gsum gsor te thugs kar bzung ngo / /oṃ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /ces brjod cing don bzhin du bsam par bya'o / /des ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin dpal pad+ma gar kyi dbang phyug gi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa rdo rje'i dbang ngo / /de nas dril bu sbyang zhing byin kyis brlabs pa dkrol zhing slob ma'i lag pa 14—712

g.yon par gtad la/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bcang bar gyis/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /oṃ a bye pa ti two a bhe ṣi.ā+oṃ 1mi/ zhes brjod cing de nyid rnam par dag pa bstan pa'i phyir/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems can rnams/ /dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin rta mchog rol pa'i ngo bo mtshon par byed pa dril bu'i dbang ngo / /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu gnyis gzung ba'i phyag rgya bstan te—/ thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba'i 'phro 'du dang bcas par slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag nas/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ gang phyir chos rnams rnam dag pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rang bzhin nyid/ /dbang po'i spyod yul gang dag gang / /bde mchog sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /oṃ dpal che ge mo a nyi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta ya ho zhes so/ /de ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa ming gi dbang bskur ba'o/ /de ltar dbang bskur ba'i phan yon ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i bde mchog kyang / /rgyas mi thebs shing mi rmongs te/ /de la gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /de dam tshig dang sdom pa la sogs pa sbyin par bya ba'i 4phyir/ dang por 14—713

mna' bsgag cing sdom pa sbyin pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad gsung dbyangs gcig pa'i sgo nas gsungs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i1/ /sdom pa nyams par byed byed pa/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin/ /lha rnams dang ni mi dag dang / /de bzhin rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /de dag la ni snying rings nas/ /snying la khrag chen 'thung ba zhig /sems can khams ni ma lus don/ /srid pa shin tu dag bya'i phyir/ /mi 'gog chos nyid sbyor ba yis/ /rtag pa nyid du bsgrub par bya/ /rang gi ngo bo yongs spangs shing / /dka' thub kyis ni gzir mi bya/ /ci byebade bar ni bde bar spyad/ /'di ni phyi dus sangs rgyas yin/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod thams cad la/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /sdig med stobs kyis khyed ma 'jigs/ /dam tshig 'da' bar dka' ba'o/ /zhes brjod cing sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig rnam pa gsum rgyas par bstan par bya'o/ /des ni slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon du bya zhing / bdag dang gzhan kyi don grub par 'dod pas bla ma la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ mgon khyod thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor slob dpon dbang bskur sogs/ /bdag gzhan don du bya ba rnams/ /'grub byed dbang bskur bdag la spyod/ /zhes pa dang /slar brjod pa/ rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya che/ /zung shig yang dag gzung bar kyis//di ring rdo rje slob dpon che/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar mdzod/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na bsnams/ /rtag 14—714

tu khyod kyis kyang gzung 1ste/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ sarba zheta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi 4rjes 'akror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi a e 5 ṣa two dha ra ya mi ti hi hi hi hoḥ6/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /dam tshig phyag rgya zhes byar brjod/ /lus kun brtan byed gang zhig ni/ /phyag rgyar rab tu grags pa yin/ /oṃ ma hā kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brtul zhugs rnam pa gsum byin nas7/ mchod pa'i tshogs dang / bstod pa'i gar thabs kyis lha rnams mnyes par bya'o/ /de nas rjes su gnang ba sbyin par bya ste/ bdag gzhan don sgrub las kyi tshogs / /thun mong 'bring po mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag dgug pa dang / /sdang gnon rengs pa'i las kun dang / /dbye rmongs bskrad pa'i cho ga rnams/ /thogs pa med par bsgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /thog med mi 'byin skas 'dzeg dang / /gsar 'gyur ril bu nyi zla gzung / /char dbab la sogs las kyi tshogs/ /rnam shas sgrub dang ye shes sgrub/ /phyag rgya shes pa'i don sgrub dag /thams cad dngos grub 'gro ba yi—/ /don nyid yang dag spyod par kyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gnas 'jug cing / /skya gsung thugs mchog yon tan rgyan/ /phrin las bdag gzhan gnas sbyor ba'i//mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dngos grub sgrub/ /ces brjod do/ /de nas yang snga ma bzhin du mig dbye bar bya ste/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal 74—715

po yis/ /mig nad ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis lkuni mi shes pa'i/ /ling tog rgyal bas sel bar mdzad/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a ba ha ra pa ṭa lo byāḥ — /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /gzung 'dzin rnam bral brjod med du/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /rang bzhin med cing dag med pa/ /chos rnams de bzhin shes byas nas/ /sems can don ni yang dag byos/ /des na sangs rgyas sras su skye/ /zhes brjod de mig phye ba'i rjes la/ /chos thams cad kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bur snang ba la rjes su spyod par gnang ba'o/ /yang don dam pa dang yi dam gyi lha ji ltar gnas pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dag dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs— / /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid gtso/ /zhes brjod cing / de nyid kyi don bstan par bya'o/ /yang lha mo bde mchog mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mda' gzhu byin te/phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og tu 'gengs shing 'phen pa'i tshul byas nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdan la 'dug ste/ lag pa g.yas par dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par thusbyor ba'i glegs bam sbyin zhing /g.yon par dung byin te sgra bsgrag 3par bya'o/ /oṃ pha rol phyin drug las rnams kyis / /sems can don kun mnyam sbyor zhing / /'khor ba'i rgyun gcod mya ngan 'das/ /oṃ chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor/ /je tshom rtog tshogs gcod 14—7/6

mdzad pa'i/ /chos kyi dung gi sgra bsgrags ①pas/ /gsang sngags gsang chen snying po'i don/ /snod ldan kun la rab tu shod/ /des ni rgyal ba thams cad la / /phan 'dogs drin len mdzad pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /khrod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces brjod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la rigs kyi dkyil 'khor lnga bskor bar gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ /mdor na 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs su/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo bskor du snegasol/ /zhes ne+erigs lnga'i gnas su sbyar bar bya'o/ /da ni lung bstan pa las/ dang po slob dpon gyis bsgo ba ni/ 'di ltar nga yis khyod lung bstan/ /rdo rje dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /dngos po mchog tu bsgrub rjopa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro gnas las grol/ /kye che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ bhusgu ba swaḥ/ de'i rjes la dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang phyogs bcu nas gsung dbyangs mthun pa'i sgra skad kyis lung bstan par mdzad de/ kye rigs kyi bu khyod kyi srid pa tha ma ni 'di yin te/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i theg pa la zhugs pas phyag rgya chen po dang /gsang sngags kyi mthus rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis chags pa rnam pa gnyis dang 'bral bar mi bya ste/ de dag gi las la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis nam yang bya ba min/ /ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon dang / /sngags sogs rgyud rnams 'dzin par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang /14—717

lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse bar /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ /rtse gcig nan tan bskyed nas ni/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /zhes brjod do/ /des ni lung bstan pa'o/ /da ①ni dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir/ dang po dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i phan yon brjod par bya'o/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs shing mthong ba la sogs pas/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol zhing / /byed rnams rab tu dge bar gnas/ /zhes brjod do②/ /de nas don bzhin du spyad pa'i phan yon bstan pa'i phyir/ gzengs bstod pa ni①/ bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyi nas 'chi ba yang med cing //mtshungs med thub par mi 'gyur te/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa nas/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las 'das so/ /da ni de dag gi dam tshig bshad par bya ste/ byang chub sems ni yong mi spang / /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya che/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur the rnam med/ /dam pa'i chos dag mi smad cing / /ma gus spang zhing dor mi bya/ /mi shes snod min rmongs pa la/ /nam yang bstan par mi bya'o/ /rdo rje dril bu mi spang ste/ /slob dpon dag la gus par gyis/ /zhes pa'i don bstan par bya'o/ /de ltar slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa'i phan yon ni/ khams gsum gyi lhini rgyal srid che/ /bdag po rgyal chen dbang bskur zhing / /bdud rnams 14—718

thams cad las rgyal bar/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /'di yis khyed rnams dus 'di ru/ /sangs rgyas thob par the tshom med/ /dbang bskur rjes thob dbugs phyung bas/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon blo gros dam tshig ldan/ /brtan g.yo'i mtha' las rnam par grol/ /lam mchog 'jug stobs dbugs phyin te/ /ngan pa'i gnas ngan kun spangs pa'o—/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas gdams ngag bstan pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang lha'i de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/ de la dang po dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid ni gru bzhi par gnas pas/ che ba'i yon tan thams cad kyis rgyas par byas ①zhing sgo rnam pa bzhi yis byams pa dang / snying rje dang / /dga' ba dang /btang snyoms kyi mtshan nyid can no/ /rta babs nas chos kyi 'khor lo'i bar du ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i tshul du gnas pa ni byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi bar du bgrod nas rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhir 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid can no/ /rin po che sna lnga'i rtsig pa las 'od ⑤kha dog nyi shu rtsa lnga dang bcas pa 'phro ba ni/ rang bzhin ye shes drug gi byin rlabs ⑦las rigs kyi mtshan ma sna tshogs su snang ba'i rang bzhin no/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ka ba brgyad ni rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi rang bzhin la/ rdo rje theg pa'i tshul gyis mtshan pa'o—/ /rin po che dang / mu tig dang / me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa ni mdzad pa rgya chen po'i phrin las rnams yon tan las byung ba'i tshul lo/ /'dod pa'i yon tan drug gi lha mo ni/ /yul drug rnam par ④dag pa'i snang ba'o/ /14—719

gdugs snying rje chen po'i char khab ①dang / rgyal mtshan bdud rnam bzhi las rgyal zhing thog ②pa'i mchog ston pa'i mtshan ma dang / bla re mnyam pa nyid du tshul gcig par spyod pa'i tshul/ rnga yab rnam par rtog pa'i sbrang ma sel bar mdzad pa dang / zla ba phyed pa rdo rjes smon lam rgya chen po 'gro ba'i don du theg pa chen po'i sngags kyi sgo nas don mdzad pa dang / rdo rje rin po che dbyig ①pa la ba dan dpyangs pas mtshan dang dpe byad phun sum tshogs pa'i rtags dang ldan pa'o/ /de la dril bu sgra snyan pa phyogs bcur sgogs pa ni theg pa sna tshogs kyi don ston pa'o/ /re'u rjocha brgyad kyi mtshan ma ni sku'i dbang phyug dang /gsung gi dbang phyug dang / thugs kyi dbang phyug la sogs pa'i yon tan brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /thig bzhis legs par phye ba ni/ /phrin las bzhi'i snang ba'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i mtshan ma dang / mu khyud rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba ni chags pa med pa'i phrin las kun du don spyad kyang nyon mongs pa'i mtshan mas ma gos shing bde ba chen po'i dbyings las sku gsung thugs kyi theg pa ston par mdzad pa'o/ /bum pa rgyan gyis mdzes shing bdud rtsi'i bcud dang ldan pas che ba'i yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi ye shes rnam pa lnga'i don las yon tan gyi snang ba ma 'gags shing 'dod pa'i longs spyod sna tshogs su 'phro ba'o/ /bar du re'u ⑤mig 'khor lo'i tshul du gnas pa ni phrin las dang mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur cing rang gi phyag rgya mdzes par gyur pa'o—/ /phyi rol pad+ma la sogs pa'i phreng ba dag ni chos thams cad rnam par dag pa'i yon tan gyi snang ba ston pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las dang bcas pa'i rnam pa dang / ye shes kyi byen rlabs rjokyis mi mthun pa'i rnam par 14—720
