rtog pa thams cad sel bar mdzad pa'o/ /phyi rol kyi dur khrod chen po dag gis ni thams cad gsang sngags kyi theg par 'du zhing theg pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul du khams gsum gyi zhen rtog sbyang ba dang / phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga dag rnam par dag pa'i ngo bor bstan pa'o/ /zhing dang zhing skyong dag gis yon tan ma 'gags pa'i rten la sangs rgyas brgyad kyi snang ba ston pa'o//mtsho dang klu brgyad ni srid pa'i gnas kyi rtog pa'i tshogs dag gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi don ston pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pho mo dag gis ni dbyings dang ye shes zung lkudu 'brel pa'i don gyis chos thams cad 'dus par bstan pa'o//sprin dang mchod rten la sogs pa'i rnam pa dag gis ni thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa'i 'phro 'du dang ye shes kyi snang ba brgyad bstan pa'o/ /bya khyi dang mkha' 'gro la sogs pa sna tshogs pas ni thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa dang / yon tan gyi rtsal ma 'gags pa'i phrin las kyi tshogs rnam par 'phro ba bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar rten kyi mtshan nyid rgya cher bstan danas brten pa'i rang bzhin dag shes par bya ba'i phyir dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dkar dmar gyi mdangs dang ldan pas byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin la rtog pa'i mtshan mas ma gos shing thugs rje chen pos chags pa'i las mdzad pa'o/ /rin po che'i kha dog sna lnga'i 'od zer mdzes pas brgyan pa ni ye shes rnam pa lnga'i snang ba las rigs kyi mtshan ma sna tshogs ston pa'o/ /zhal bzhi dang / phyag 4bzhi'i rnam pa can du byung bas phrin las rnam pa bzhi dang / tshad med pa dag gi sgo nas 'gro ba dbugs 'byin pa'o/ /sgeg pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis khams gsum las rgyal zhing /rang gi cha lugs bcom par mdzad pa'o/ /phyag bzhi'i mtshon cha dag gis ye 14—721

shes rnam pa lnga'i che ba las rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor snang bar mdzad pa dang /thugs rje chen pos rtse gcig tu/ sems kyi las la dgongs pa dang / sku gsung thugs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas khams gsum las rgyal 1bhete/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i tshul ston pa dang / zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i las kyis bskul ba dang / de'i mtshan nyid gzhan la ston par mdzad pa'o/ /mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dag gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul gyis mdzes shing byang chub sems dukyi mchog tu gyur pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rnam pa dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas stod g.yogs dang mdzad pa sna tshogs kyi las mnga' bas smad g.yogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi'i phrin las dag la spyod pas dpung pa rin po ches mdzes pa'o/ /gzhan yang rin po che'i ske rags dang / mgur chu dang / do shal gyis dge ba bcu dang / pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi don ston par byed pa'o/ /phyag dang zhabs la gdu bus mdzes shing se 4mo do bcus mtshan pa ni 5bden pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / dge ba bcu yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtags so/ /dbu la rin po che'i rgyan dang / phreng ba dang / thod pa dang / rigs kyi bdag po dag gis brgyan pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / rigs rnam pa lnga dang / rigs kyi mtshan mas lhag par gyur pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / ye shes sems dpa' dang / sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa ni phyag rgya bzhi'i sgo nas de nyid kyi don bstan par mdzad pa dang / phung po lnga rnam par 14—722

dag pa'i rang bzhin du bzhugs 1pa'o/ /gzhan yang 'byung ba rnam pa bzhi rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas khyad par kyi phrin las bzhis 'gro ba'i don bya ba'i phyir rigs kyi lha mo bzhi dang / skye mched la sogs pa zag pa dang bcas pa rnam par dag par ༄ mdzad cing rigs dang ye shes kyi snang ba yon tan gyi tshogs rnam par 'phrul ba las byung ba'i phrin las 1kyis gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i phyir phrin las sna tshogs dang bcas par bstan pa yin no/ /dkyil 'khor so so'i lha rnams dag par bstan par bya'o/ /de ltar rnam par dag pa'i mtshan nyid bstan nas slob dpon gyi las su bya ba ni dbang bskur ba dang / rab tu gnas pa dang / phrin las rtsom pa 4dang /sgrub pa'i rim pa dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa gzhan dag gi las 5bya ba rnams kyang rgya cher bstan par bya'o/ /de nas lha dang slob dpon la ci 'byor ba'i yon gyis mchod cing rjes su yi rang dbul bar bya'o/ /des ni slob dpon du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bstan pa yin no/ /da ni nye ba'i bsnyen pa'i skabs su dbang rdzogs par ma byas pa dang /gang zhig rdzogs pa dag gis gnas par 'dod na dbe+en pa'i gnas su dris legs par byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la me tog la sogs pa bkram zhing bde ba'i stan brtsegs pa la bla ma bzhugs 7nas/ /shes rab ma mtshan dang ldan pa dag phul te / mchod pa dang / ston mo la sogs pa'i longs spyod kyis dgyes par byas nas/ ras kyi yol ba la sogs pas bar bcad pa'i rgyab nas gsol ba 14—723

gdab par bya'o/ /dpal ldan mgon po bde ba che/ /bde chen bde ba'i gnas la bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i bde sprul mdzod/ /byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyi/ /yang dag don mchog rnam dag pa 1/ /ji ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yi/ /mchog gi dbang ni bskur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin bdag sogs 'gro kun gyi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri med mchog /ma rig rtog pa'i rab rib sel/ /gang gis byang chub bla med pa/ /de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba dang / de la slar yang smras nas/ bu khyod ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bde chen sbyin/ /ting 'dzin sbyor sngags gsal ba yis/ /rang gi gnas su legs par bstod bhe/ /ces so / /de nas phyi nang gi 4khrus byas te/ dam tshig gi lha mo sbyangs nas sngags dang bcas pa'i yungs kar gyis 5bgegs bskrad cing sbyor ba dang / rjes su sbyor bas yab 6yum gnyis kyi sku bskyed par bya'o/ /yang dbang bskur ba dang /byin kyis brlab pa dag rdzogs par byas nas rol pa'i brdas bskul zhing / spro ba bskyed cing rigs kyi nga rgyal mnyam 7pa'i sgo nas gnyis su med par sbyor ba'i byang chub kyi sems slob ma'i lce la gzhag 3bhepar bya'o/ /ji ltar rgyal ba bde gshegs kyis/ /rang gi sras sogs dbang bskur bzhin/ /byang chub sems de dag pa'i chus/ /rnam rtog dri ma dag par bya9/ /oṃ ma hā bobye tsit+ta sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod pa dang / slob mas kyang a ho su kha zhes brjod cing mid snade/ rigs kyi cha lugs gsal bar chu'i zla ba'am sgyu ma'i rnam pa bzhin du gnas pa'o/ /des ni gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /14byed724

yang rdzogs pa'i rim pa thob par 'dod pas rdo rje bla ma mchog tu gyur pa la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa'i tshogs kyis rdo rje bla ma dang / phyag rgya mo mtshan dang ldan pa mnyes par byas nas/ tshig 'di brjod par bya'o/ /kye kye mgon po bde ba che/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /phyag rgya mi phyed rab sgrub pa/ /mngon sum nyams myong bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bdag nyid chen pos ji lta bar/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin mdzod/ /rtog pa'i dri mas bsgribs pa rnams/ /byang sems chu yis dag par mdzod/ / ces pa dang /1 des kyang rigs dang mthun pa'i yum byin gyis brlabs la slob ma'i lag tu gtad de/ dga' ba'i gnas chen lha mo 'di/ /sna tshogs sgyu rtsal yid du 'ong 3/ /legs par zung shig blo gros can/ /dga' bde'i mchod pa rab tu gyis/ /thabs gzhan kyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /'gro ba thams cad 'di las 'byung / /de bas khyod kyis 'di nyid dang / /nam yang 'bral bar mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi snyedangos grub med/ /ces pa'o/ /de nas lha mos gogs la dag 'a ba'i bzhin gyis bltas te/'dzum pa dang bcas par bha ga phye zhing bstan nas/ khyod kyis nus sam rdo rje can—/ /dri chen dri chu'i bza' btung dang / /rak+ta ga pur rmā 4sa dang /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha gar 'o byed mi rtog gam/ /smros shig grogs po bde ba can/ zhes pa dang / des kyang slar smras pa/ lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /khu khrag la sogs za ba dang / /bud med rnams la rtag 14—725

gus shing / /bha ga'i pad+ma 'o bkyid do/ /zhes so/ /lha mos be+er brjod pa1/rmad byung gsang ba'i pad+ma 'di/ /thams cad bde bar yang dag ldan/ /rtag tu rim bzhin 'di spyod na/ /de nyid bde chen 'bral mi gyurabye / /chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can thams cad rnam par grol/ /bde chen rgyal po 'di nyid ni/ /dngos po kun gyi rang 'byung gnas/ /nang tregi rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ /pad+ma la bzhugs rab tu rgyas/ /bha ga'i mkha' dbyings nam mkha' bzhin/ /'byung ba bzhi po rgyan bzhin bkod/ /lte ba'i ze'u 'bru ge sar zlum/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad rnam par mdzes/ /de yi dbus su gnas pa ni/ /de nyid bdud rtsi chen po'i gzugs/ /bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas gnas dbe+en par rgyan bzang po bris shing / dri zhim po'i chus gtor la 4stan bde ba la gnas te/ khang pa'am yol ba la sogs pa gang yang rung bas bsgribs la/ thabs dang shes rab kyi sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rjes su spyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sbyor ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dag rim pa bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas 'dod pa'i gtsug lag dang mthun par bde ba'i ye shes 5bskyed cing shis pa dang / mi shis pa'i mtshan ma dag yi ge lnga bcu'i gnas gang la bab pa'i sgo nas brtags te/ ma ning gi yi ge dag la bab na ni slar bskyar bar bya'o/ /de ltar bde ba chen po'i don byang chub kyi sems phab nas tshigs su bcad pa 'dis btung bar bya'o/ /ye shes 'di ni shin tu phra/ /rdo rje snying po mkha' 'dra zhing / /rdul bral thar pa zhi ba'i mchog /rang gi rang bzhin de nyid do/ / zhes so/ / de'i rjes la rdo rje slob dpon la yon phul te/ thabs dang shes rab dang / dga' ba 14—726

dang bcas bskor ba byas te/ gtong rag gtang ngo / /de nas dbang bzhi pa dag bla ma'i gdams ngag las byung ba bzhin du phyag rgya rnam 2gsum gang yang rung ba la brten te/ rang gi nyams su myong bas me long gi dkyil 'khor bzhin du gnas pa la yun ring du gsal bar brtag go/ /des ni zag pa med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po'i sku skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir / rnal 'byor bde ba thams cad kyi/ /dbang bskur bde chen las byung ba / /rin chen tshogs rnams thams cad kyis/ /rab tu mos par dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de nas khyad par gyi dam tshig bsgrag par bya ste/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya/ /ma byin par yang blang bar bya/ /'dod la log par g.yem par bya/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /rdo rje bla ma byang chub sems/ /srog gi phyir yang gtang mi bya/ /dran pa gsal bas gzung byas nas/ /lhag pa'i lha bzhin rin chen tog /ces brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gye lha rnams la mchod pa dang / tshogs kyi rim pa dang 1/ yon gyi tshogs dbul zhing bskor ba byas te/ glu gar dang / bkra shis la sogs pa brjod nas mgron gyi tshogs rnams la gtor ma sbyin zhing dkyil 'khor bsdu bar bya'o/ /de dag gis ni gnas skabs kyi bye brag mang bar 'jug pa'i don rnams 14—727

phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bstan pa yin pas gang zag gi bye brag gis so so'i gnas skabs shes par bya ste/ /phyi mtshams dang / bar mtshams dang /nang gi mtshams su cho ga ma nor ba'i sgo nas dbang bskur ba dang sgrub pa bsdebs pa ni lam gyi man ngag go/ /de dag ni dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o / / hūṃd ni nye ba'i bsnyen pa brtsam pa las bye dang po rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas zhi ba'i las la 'jug pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor dang chas gos lnga dag bsgyur zhing zhi ba'i mchod pa dang / rdzas dag bsags nas/ gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rten gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /— ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs pa dang / mdun kyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs pa dang / gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs pa'i bya bas mnyes par byas 4nas lha so so'i bzlas brjod kyis zhi ba'i las la sbyar zhing / mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang / bskul ba dang / tshogs kyi cho ga dang / sbyin sreg dang / lhag ma'i las dang / dkyil 'khor bsdu ba rnams rim pa bzhin bya'o / /de ltar dbang dang / rgyas pa dang / las sna tshogs pa dag la yang so so'i rdzas dang / chas gos lnga dag bsgyur zhing dkyil 'khor bsgom pa dang /cho ga'i gzhung bsrang ba dang / bzlas brjod kyis so so'i las la sbyor ba dang /mchod bstod dang / bskul ba la sogs pa'i las rnams rdzogs par byas nas/dkyil 'khor bsdu ba rnams rim pa bzhin du rdzogs par bya'o/ /de ltar so so'i skabs su rdzas la brten pa'i las dag bsgrub cing / ci 14—728

'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa po don la sbyor ba'i phyir snga ma las zhal bsgyur te/ chas gos lnga 3dang / dkyil 'khor dang /mchod rdzas dang / rgyan cha dang / cha lugs kyi bye brag dag khro bo'i rnam pa dang — mthun par dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis mtshon cing gnas te/ rdo rje rgyal po dang / rgyal theb ④dang / las kyi rdo rjes rang gi las la 'jug par bya'o—/ /de nas me mar 5dang / bharnya dang / rdzas dang / dngos grub kyi phyag rgya dag dgram zhing byin bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa dang / yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / spyan drang ba la sogs pa'i cho gas mnyes par bya ba dang / bzlas brjod kyi rnam pa gsal bar byas nas dbyangs drug gis bskul ba dang / mchod byung bstod pa dang /bskul ba dang / tshogs kyi cho ga dang / sbyin sreg dang / lhag pa'i las rnams rdzogs par byas nas/ de ltar dkyil 'khor drug gi bzlas brjod kyi rim pa ni zhag gcig la nyin mtshan dus drug tu bcad de/ thun mong dang khyad par gyi 6bzlas pa dag rab 'bring bsdus rgyas kyis brtsam zhing thog ma'i dus su ni bsgom pa dang / bzlas pa'i yan lag rdzogs par byas nas thun tha ma gnyis la ni kun du bzang po'i mchod pa nas brtsams te mthar rdzogs par bya'o/ /de yang bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i dus su bzlas pa'i grang mnyam par ji srid mtshan ma'i rtags ma 3gsal gyi bar du brtsam zhing / nye ba'i bsnyen pa dag la ni ji ltar 'tsham par thun mong gi bsnyen pa las bzhi'i sgo nas bskul ba dang / khyad par du lha so so'i sngags brjod par bya'o/ /sgrub pa'i dus su yang bzlas pa gnyis rdzogs par gyur nas/ las bzhi'i bskul bas mthar dbyung ngo / /de 14—729

nas mtshan gcig gi rmyecho gas sgrub pa chen po brtsam par bya ste/ rigs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dran par byas nas/ de nas gnyis su med pa'i tshul du sbyor ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsdus te/ dbang po lnga la thig le bya'o/ /de dag ni thams cad dag pa'i sbyor bas bdag nyid lus la dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor drug gi sbyor bas rim pa bzhin yi ge gcig pa'i sngags brjod cing / las thams cad dngos grub du bya ba dang /dngos grub thams cad dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ /phyag rgya rim pa bzhin du bcings te / rnam shes kyi phyag rgya shes pa la sogs pas brtags nas/ so so'i mtshan ma dag so so'i phyag rgya dang sbyor bas dbab 4cing dbyangs drug bro gar dang bcas pas dngos grub kyi stsol byang bya ste/ mchod cing bstod nas mtshan ltas byung ba'i dus su dngos grub gang yin pa'i sgo nas blangs te/ dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de'i dus su phan gnod byed pa'i mtshan ma ngo shes par byas nas re dogs med pa'i sems kyis dngos grub blang ba dang / bgegs bzlog pa'i cho ga dag brtsam par bya'o/ /gal te ma 5grub bam mi gsal na zhi ba dang /rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / drag po dang / mnan pa dang / bzlas pa'i cho gas bsgrub par bya ba'am/ sbyin sreg gis shis par bya'o/ /skabs skabs su mtshams kyi 5cho ga dang / dri chab la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs dz+wapa dang /mkha' 'gro ma bskyang ba dang / sbyin sreg dang / bskang bshags rnams ni las kyi rdo rjes bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa chen po mthar phyin nas dkyil 'khor gye mtha' ma bskor zhing 'di dang phyi mar mi 'bral ba'i smon lam gdab bo/ /yang rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa la sogs — pas lhag chad bskang zhing bshags 14—730

byang byas nas bkra shis brjod cing dngos grub kyi lhag ma blangs te rnal 'byor pas longs spyod do/ /slar yang mchod pa'i tshogs rnams lha dang / bla ma la phul te bstod pa byas nas/ bro gar dang rdo rje'i glus dgyes par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bton nas mdun du bzhag ste/ mchod cing bstod nas—/ bkra shis brjod cing gshegs su gsol zhing / dam tshig gi nyadakyil 'khor rim pa bzhin bsdus nas gzugs brnyan gyi 2rdzas rnams dang / tshon rtsi dag bsdus te gsang ba'i gnas su dngos grub kyi rdzas su gzhag go/ / yang na chu bo chen por rol mo dang bcas pas gshegs so/ /4de'i rjes la rdzas dang maṇ+ḍal legs par dag pa'i tshogs bya ba gzhan gyis ma mthong bar bya'o5/ /yang khro bo bcu las mchod cing bstod de/ phur pa bsdus la cod pan bkrol zhing khrus byas nas brda dang mtshams 6dgrol bar bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma rgya chen po bshams te/ mgron tshogs rnams bsdus la bsngos nas mnyes pas las la gzhag go/ /yang khyad par gyi srung ma dag la bsngos te/ rten la gzhag 9pa'i rgyal po bzhi dang / phur bus 7btab pa'i phyogs skyong rnams mnyes nas/ /rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis bkra shis brjod cing bkra shis 'don pa dang / chos sbyin brjod pa dang / 'gro ba'i don du smon lam gdab pa dang / spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ma nyams par bya'o / /dang po'i rnal 'byor snga ma'i rim bzhin bka'/ /legs bstan rjes mthun dam pas gsal byas gang / /de don sgrub rim snga ma'i gzhung nyid bzhin//khyad par lhag pa cung zhig brjod pa med/ /'on kyang go rims mi gsal legs bsdebs pas/ /dang po gang du bdag pas dman sogs rnams/ /tshegs med 1 1—731

be+e blubs las chen bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sgrub pa'i rim pa gus pas blang bar mdzod//tshe 'dis phyag rgya chen po'i lam bsgrub duphyir/ /de yi cho ga dri med legs bshad pa1 / /dga' mdzes pad dkar yid 'ong tshogs rgyas la/ /de 'dod bstan pa'i don thob tshim bzhin shog /dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par spyor ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa dang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga phyazhes bya ba slob dpon chen po hūṃ mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan bo bir+ya ka ra sirnya dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba lha rin po ches bsgyur zhing gtan la phab pa'o //bsdur mchan/684 hūṃmatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa bzhugs so// bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gidang / bye sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra shad/ bya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉/sgol/ rngu〈〈pe 〉she las la/ 〈〈snar 〉ye 'i las la 'u 〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganas/685 ngh+ru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ran/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rasungs/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snyes/tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ ñtsa〈〈pe 〉glong zhing / 〈〈snar 〉'angs zhing /686 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'am pa/ 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉stanasal/ 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉d+kugro 'theb/ bya〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉sgrub—/ phya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bangs so/ thu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉kyis/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gipa bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dag 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄sa cang / pa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/687 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉rishar/ dā 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ba/ 1〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉7dag ce〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉 nyid—/ phye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7dang / hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉to/ tsu〈〈snar 〉thazhag 3bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung //〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ra/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesags/ skye1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga slab par/688 3sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'am/ da 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ba/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkarab/14—732

༄ga /dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i sgrub thabs yang dag par grub pa zhes bya ba/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ sirnyi ma hā shrī he ru ka no pi ka nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i sgrub thabs yang dag par grub pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das khrag 'thung chen po la phyag 'tshal lo yang dag grub pa gcig pu nyid/ /sangs rgyas bde chen kun 'dus pa/ /rnal 'byor zab mo sku gsum rdzogs/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog de'i/ /shes rab kyi ni blo phye nas/ /nges par rtogs pa'i sa gzhi las/ /bla mas nges pa'i lung 'di bstan/ /snum pa yi ni dam tshig dang / /gtsang dang 'jigs pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /de dag goms nas nyams su blang / /blo zhan shes rab chung bas ni/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /phung byed gnyis ka bsregs pas na/ /de bas gzhan du bstan pa min/ /phun sum tshogs pa bzhi ldan nas/ /rdzas dang sa gzhi brtag pa ②ni/ /cir yang 'gyur ba'i yig 'bru 14—737

bsam / /'od zer tshul du 'phros nas kyang / /ma lus khyab pas mnyes byas te—/ /re dang dam pa'i tshul zhes dgongs/ /'od zer de dag bsdus nas kyang / /dur khrod sa ru brtag par bya/ /'byung po'i gtor ma btang nas kyang / /gsang ba'i don gyi las rnams bya/ /dkyil 'khor nub phyogs de bzhin gzhi/ /kham phor ri mo bris pa dgu/ /snang ba'i 'od dang bcas par dgramaske/ /rdzas kyis mdzes par 'khor bar bzhag /mig gi rten yang mngon par bya/ /de nas dur khrod bdag po dag /phyag rgya che dang ldan pa yis/ /ci rigs su ni las rnams bya/ /mi dmigs chos la blo brtags shing / /ye shes can gyi byin stobs kyis/ /thams cad tshul bzhin byin brlabs nas/ /rtogs pa'i blo can de dag gis/ /srog lus man chad rdzas kyi rnams/ /bla ma mnyes par bya phyir dbul/ /dngos grub 'dod pas gsol ba gdab/ /slob dpon ji bzhin stan bder gnas/ /rdo rje'i tshul du dbang can sbyin/ /g.yog phyogs gnas la tshul bzhin du/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sbyar/ /gar mkhan tshul 'dra sgyu ma'i rgya/ /de la 'ja' tshon bzhin du gsal/ /'dod chags ye shes gsal ba'i phyir/ /'bar ba sna tshogs 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /thim pas rgyal mor byin gyis brlabs/ /ye shes dam tshig chen po yis/ /bde mchog sgyu ma'i brdas mtshon te/ /pad+mo ①rin chen ldan byas nas/ /dbyings kyi bde chen 'byung bya ste/ /rang rig ye shes de la 'od/ /ji bzhin mkha' la gsal ba dag /dri med nyi ma'i 'od pas 'tsher/ / byang chub sems de kun du dag /②khams gsum rab tu 'das nas kyang / /ma lus snying rjes khyab byas te/ /'dod par bya ba rab tu mnyes/ /'od 'dus thog ma'i gzugs la 14—738

bzung ①/ /de dag dngos grub chen po bas/ /ji ltar 'dod par nan tan bya//dbang thob mdzes pa de dag gis/ /dul ba'i sems su bzhag nas kyang / /dam tshig chen pos bde bar gnas/ /bsnyen par gnang ba'i dbang thob nas/ /sgom dbyangs yi ge 'bru brgyad bstan/ /ston pas bstan pa'i lung bzhin du/ /sgom rgyud gsal bar ci nus bya/ /lhag pa'i rtags kyis kun mtshon nas/ /grub rdzas de dag byin gyis brlab/ /dmigs med rtogs pa'i gdeng can gyis/ /sku mchog 'bar ba'i tshul du bsam/ /khams gsum khrag tu dmigs nas ni/ /dur khrod kun du khyab par bsam/ /dngos ni a ru byen brlabs nas/ /rin chen gsal bar shar ba dang / /byang chub sems ni 'od zer spro/ /mos pa'i thugs la mnyes bsams nas/ /'od 'dus thog ma'i gzugs la gzung / /phyag mtshan snying po pho ①mo dag /bstan par red nas mkha' la gzhag① /bskul ba'i rang bzhin kun 'dus pas/ /des kyang spro ba'i las rnams byed/ /dngos kyang mchod pa'i rdzas su bsngo/ /sangs rgyas tshe 'dis bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sku gsum sa la goms par bya/ /dang por chos kyi dbyings nyid la/ /dmigs pa med pa'i don gyis bsgom/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis/ /thams cad du yang khyab par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa/ /dkyil 'khor lnga la sogs pa'i 'khor/ /zhi ba'i mchod pas mnyes pa dag /bsnyen pa'i don du de dag byung du/ /sgrub ⑤pas bstan pa'i lung bzhin du/ /sku mdog so so'i phyag mtshan dang / /rgyan dang cha lugs gsal ba dang / /bskyed rdzogs grub pa'i lha dag bsgom/ /dngos grub dam pa blang ba'i phyir/ /snga ma las ni gnas bsgyur te/ /bskal ba'i me dpung 'khrigs pa bzhin/ /'bar ba'i 14—739

tshogs ni rnam par bsam/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ /bzhugs ①dang rten ①dang mi g.yo ba/ /dam tshig zil gnon phyag byed dang / /mchod dang bstod dang bza' ba dang / /tshul rigs goms pa'i blo dag gis/ /ci rigs su ni brtan par bya/ /dam tshig mchog gi mchod pa dang / /bskul tshig dbyangs kyis de dag mnyes/ /'khor bcas mchod pa rdzogs nas ni/ /bsnyen pa'i lung bzhin brtson par 'bad/ /zhag grangs dus ni brtags ①pa'o//mtshan ma brtan ④po byung ba na/ /sgrub pa chen po brtsam par bya/ /bar chad byed pa'i bgegs chen yang / /'jigs pa med pa'i sems kyis bzlog /dngos grub sbyin pa'i gzugs can yang / /re dang dogs pa la sogs pa/ /ngan pa'i don gyi sems mi 'byung / /phan gnod byed pa rnam ⑤gnyis po/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dag ni/ rnam pa gsum po byung ba ni/ /dogs dang chags pa'i sems spangs te/ /bye brag tu ni shes par bya/ /nyams kyi phyag rgyas rang don spyadadu/ /gal te 'byung po mnan par bya/ /kun kyang sems can don du bsngo/ /sgrub pa chen po yang dag grub pa zhes bya ba/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po badz+ra hūṃ ka ra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bod kyi lha btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi bka' lung gis dpal na len+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang du/⑦ rgya gar gyi mkhan po hūṃ ka ra de nyid dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba badhe gnubs skenam mkha'i snying pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //14—740

༄/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par spyor ba mkha' 'akro ma sgyu ma bde mchog ces bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sems can thams cad kyi bde ba skyed ma jes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ /shrī sarba budha sa ma yo ga ḍā ki bhā dzā la saṃ bha ra ma hā tan+t+ra rā dza 4nā ma maṇ+ḍal no pi 5ka sarba satwa su kho ta ya nā ma/ bod skad du / rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba / mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog ces bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sems can thams cad kyi bde ba skyed ma zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus bdud rnams spro zhing bsnyu ba mdzad nas rgyal gyur cing / /bde gshegs rnams kyi thugs khral bsgyungs nas bde mdzad rgyal gyur te/ /rdo rje'i spyor ba rang gi yan lag dga' mdzad rgyal gyur nas/ /khrag gi btung 6bas myos shing btsun mo la spyod rgyal bar gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam spyor ba/ /zab cing rgya che yon tan can/ /myur du byang chub rab sgrub pa/ /kun du nub po nyid mthong nas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga'i rim 'di ni/ /sems 14—742

can thams cad sngon 'gro ba'i/ /bde ba skyed ma zhes bya ba/ /kha cig rjes su gzung phyir yin/ /de nyib/ kyis ni rjes bzung 7ste/ /gang phyir de yis rjes bzung bas/ /ma lus sdig pa zad pas na/ /'di ni bdag gi sa—gus par byas//gang phyir de yi gzugs sku ni/ /bris pa'i thang ka la sogs te/ /de yi yon tan dran sgo nas/ /de gzugs kha dog can du 'gyur/ /de rigs som nyi med pa dang / /mchog tu yid dga' skyed pa de/ /rigs med yon tan med gyur cing / /kha cig rnam par 'khrul par 'gyur/ /des na rab rgyas gyur pa ni—/ /gang zhig 'di ni dgos min te/ /de lta na yang brgya lam na/ /kha cig la ni dgos par 'gyur/ /brtse med khro la gdug pa dang / /le lo chags sdang ldan pa yi1/ /de sogs skyon ni rnam spangs te/ /mtshan nyid kun dang ldan pa yi / /slob dbon sangs rgyas las dngos pa'i/ /mkhas pa yis ni bya ba yin//zhi dang rgyas dang rab gnas sogs/ /'dod dang don byed nus rnams kyi/ /slob mas dkyil 'khor bris pa la/ /lan gnyis lan gsum bar gsol gdab/ /sngon du bsnyen pas bgegs gzhom dang / /tshogs ni bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo'i sngags 'bum bzlas/ /yang na lhag pa'i lha ru mtshon/ /gzhan gyi yang ni khri yin te/ /'di ni sngon du bsnyen par brjod/ /gza' dang skar sogs bzang po la/ /mkhas pa yis ni brtsam byas te/ /zla ba drug dang gza' bzhi dang / /skar ma rnams ni bcu bzhi dang / /tshes grangs bdun du phye ba la/ /rab gnas la sogs rgyas par gsungs/ /dpyid zla ra ba 'bring dgun chung / /dbyar zla ra ba 4'bring dgun zla5/ /gza' lag bla ma pa ba sangs/ /zla ba'i gza' rnams 'di dag go/ /rgyal dang me 14byed743

bzhi lha mtshams dang / /snar nyum bya gzhug nam bye gru dang / /chu smad sgon dang khrums dang lag /lnga pa bdun pa bcu rnams dang / /gang zhig gsum dang 'gengs pa dang / /zla ba nya dang bcu gsum ste 5/ /tshes grangs bdun ni dge ba yin/ /ji ltar sngar brjod skal bzang ni/ /rjes su mthun par spyad bya ste/ /gzhan du slob dpon rdzas 'dod pas/ /dmyal ba nyid du thong ba yin//de lta'i rim pas spyad bya ste/ /ri dang grong khyer gong rdal dang / /sa phyogs yid dang mthun pa ru/ /sa gzhi yongs su gzung bar byebya/ /thal ba rus dum gtun bu rnams/ /shin tu dag pa nyid du bya/ /lho dang chu la thug pa ru/ /sa ni shar dang byang du nub/ /dngos po kun la kun rdzob tu/ /rigs ni rnam pa bzhir brjod do/ /dmangs rigs nas ni bram ze'i bar/ /gnag ser dmar dang dkar po'o/ /de nas dri ni shes byas te/ /gnag dang chu rul paṭa dri dang / /bzhi pa yid 'ong drir brjod de5/ /ro yang yongs ni brtag par bya/ /sgyur zhing rtsub pa dmangs zhwarigs 'gyur/ /mngar ba rje rigs kyang yin te/ /tsha ba yang ni rgyal rigs la/ /gzhan ni kha zhing bska ba yin/ /zhi dang rgyas dang de bzhin dbang / /mngon spyod kyang ni 'dod pa ste/ /sa ni 'di ltar rim brjod pa/ /brkos nas yang ni dgang bar bya/ /ji ltar kha dog brjod sogs rim/ /mkhas pas bsang gtor bya ba ste/ nag po ji ltar brjod pa ni/ /ser po bu ram nyid yin no/ /dkar po'i don phyir tsan+dan nyid/dmar po pad+ma'i chu nyid dang / /dmar po tsan+dan dag gis te/ /'di ni gnyis kar shes par bya/ /ser po la ni gur kum ste/ /nag po yang ni brjod par bya/ /sha rul pa yi chu nyid do/ /de bzhin ro don brjod bya ste/ /nag 14—744

po ji ltar brjod pa ni/ /ser po bu ram nyid yin no/ /dmar po la ni tsha ba gsum—/ /dkar po ji ltar brjod nyid yin/ /sa la phur gdab bsrung ba'i phyir/ /de 1ni bdag gis brjod par bya/ /n+ya gro dha phur zhi ba la/ /rgyas pa a shwat+tha 2shing ste/ /dbang la seng ldeng phur bu gnas—/ /gsad pa la ni rus pa'o/ /zhi ba la sogs bye brag gis/ /de nas bum pa brjod bya ste/ /zhi ba la ni shel rang bzhin/ /rgyas pa la ni dngul du gragasardo sna/ /dbang la gser gyi rang bzhin te/ /gsad pa la ni thod pa yin//dngul la sogs pa med gyur na/ /sa yi rang bzhin rtsa mi gnag /tsan+dan dang ni gur kum dang / /de bzhin tsan+dan dmar po dang / /dur khrod sol ba'i phye ma yis/ /mkhas pa yis ni byug par bya/ /zhi ba snga dro bya ba ste/ /rgyas pa de yi de ma thag /de nas dbang gi las yin te/ /dgongs ka bsad pa'i las yin no/ /de nas mchod yon snod bshad de/ /ji ltar khams dang tshad gyur pa//shel dang dngul dang gser dang ni/ /rim pa bzhin du lcags nyid do/ /pad+ma'i rnam pa dngul yin te/ /sor ni bcu gnyis pa nyid do/ /'dab ma yang ni bzhi bzhi ste/ /zhi ba la sogs lha gzugs ni/ /ji ltar de 4ni brjod par bya/ /zhi ba la sogs dkar po ste/ /zhi ba'i rang bzhin mnyam gzhag 5pa'o / /rgyas pa la ni ser po ste/ /mchog tu gter sogs dgug pa'o/ /dbang la chags pa'i sems kyis te/ /kha dog dmar zhing 'bar ba'o/ /gsad pa kha dog nag po ste/ /'khrugs shing 'jigs pa nyid yin no/ /thig skud khru brgyad par gsungs te/ /gzhon nu ma yis bkal ba yis/ /du ma rab tu bkal nas ni/ /slob dpon mtheb sor bcu gnyis cha'o/ /'dug 14—745

stangs ji ltar gsungs pa ni/ /rim bzhin ji ltar brjod par bya/ /zhi ba sems dpa'i skyil krung ste/ /rgyas la de bzhin rdor skyil krung / /dbang la g.yon pa'i stang hūṃstabs te/ /skyil krung stan la legs gnas pa'o/ /g.yas pas gdengs te bsnyal ba ni/ /gsad pa la mchog lha min bzhin/ /ji ltar go rims bzhin du ni/ /bdag gis bzlas phreng brjod bya ste/ /zhi ba la ni shel rang bzhin/ /rgyas la mu tig 'bras bur brjod/ /dbang la bo de tse ru bshad / /gsad pa mi yi rus pa yin/ /gser dang dngul dang mu tig dang / /mthin shun dang ni byi ru ste/ /rin bo che ni lngar brjod nas/ /kha rgyan lnga ni brjod par bya/ /'dzam bu na da bil ba —dang / / sgyur zhing sa bon gang ba'o / /'bru ni til dang gro dang ni/ /sran ma nas dang 'bras su brjod/ /de lta'i 4rim pas myur ba ru/ /mkhas pa yis ni gzhan don bya/ /gang zhig rang don dgos byed na/ /rmongs pas dmyal ba nyid du lhang / /dri chu sbrang rtsi 'o ma dang / /dag pa'i chu dang me tog dkar/ gzhan kyi las kyi rim tshul te//ji ltar brjod pa'i rim gang yin/ /ji ltar brjod pa'i bzed zhal du/ /mngon par bsngags te dri yis bdug /me tog spos dang de bzhin me/ /dri yi 5dung sogs g.yas su bzhag /sngags kyi mchod yon snod ni g.yon/ /bzed zhal mdun du gzhag 6par bya/ /yi ge gsum gyi sngags kyis ni/ /mchod yon snod la bsngags par bya/ /zhi la mthar ni wa shaṃ 7de/ /rgyas la mthar ni bh+yo bshad do/ /dbang la mthar ni dīḥ yig ste/ /bsad pa'i mthar ni hūṃ phaṭa do//dang po dri chu dbul bar bya/ /sbrang dang 'o ma gnyis pa'o/ /dag pa'i tshul ni gsum pa ste/ /me tog dang bcas bzhi par ro/ /dung chos nas ni dri yi chu/ /14—746

bzed zhal du ni dbul bar bya/ /zhal bsel 'thor 'thung 'o ma sbrang / /yang ni bsang gtor chu nyid do/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar bya phyir dang / /gdug pa rnams ni zhi phyir dang / /sa la sogs pa brtag pa'i phyir/ /gnas bsrung rim pa brjod par bya/ /thog mar rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /bdag gi gnas ni bsrung bar bya/ /phyi lhanas sa sogs gzung ba ni/ /legs par mnyam par gzhag snyepar bya/ /rtag pa'i sa rduru phyin nas ni/ /'jam pa'i stan la legs 'dug nas/ /dag blos shar du kha bltas te/ /rta mchog gi ni ting 'dzin du/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bsam bya ste / /yan lag la yang dgod par bya/ /oṃ yig kha dog dkar po yis /sa bon bral bar bsam par bya/ /āḥthu yig kha dog dmar po ni/ /longs spyod 'khor lor dgod par bya/ /t+t+waṃ yig kha dog nag po ni/ /snying ga'i dkyil du dgod par bya/ /hoḥpyeyig kha dog ser po ni/ /lte ba'i 'khor lor dgod pa'o/ /hūṃ pya k+shi spyi gtsug gsang ba ni/ /ljang dang sngo ba de bzhin te/ /'khor lo drug tu rim bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khor drug ni bsgom byas te/ /sa gzhi rnams ni yongs gyur pas/ /mkhas pa yis ni rdo rje spro/ /rdo rje de las 'phros pa yi⑦/ /rdo rje 'bar ba mi bzad zupas/ /phyogs bcur kun du gnas pa yi⑪/ /bgegs kun 'bar bas bsreg par bya/ /der gnas yul gyi ming gi tshuming / /mkhas pa yis ni shes byas te/ /thog ma nyid du zhing skyong la / /gtor ma byin te gtang bar bya/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ a mu ka nyu/ /ya sa pa ri wā mur ya/ i rda ba bo ⑫gar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ a k+ṣa sgo 6/ dād snye ma te/ sa pa ri ⑫wa ra shrī kṛ ha a gats+tshan+tu 7dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ i rda ba bong kṛdzā 14—747

tu khā rda hūṃtu sa pa ri wā 3bheri/ sarba satwa rgo/ shīrnyi rngupuṣ+ṭi/ rak+ṣa warna 5go puṣ+ṭi ka ro tu ka /i rda be+e trergo ta thāpeg twa ba he5/ maṇ+ḍa la bhu sum̐/ tiṣ+ṭha tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dhā ra ā rngudz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ bshad par gyur pa'i rim pa yis / /srung ba'i 'khor lo bsam bya ste/ /rlung sogs dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ /ji srid mthong ba'i bar du ni/ /'khor lo'i mthar ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /ra ba lnga yang de bzhin no/ /'og gi cha yi rtse gsum la/ /steng gi mda' yi dra ba'o/ /ha ya ra ba la rgyu las/ /mkhas pas mkha' sogs dgod bya ste/ /yang na yi ge gsum nyid dang / /ha gnyis steng dang 'og tu'o/ /shes rab can gyis srung bsgoms nas/ /zlo// yig sa bon las byung ba'i/ /gzhal yas khang yang bsgom bya ste/ /der ni paṃ skyes pad+ma'o/ /de steng ram̐ las nyi dkyil 'khor/ /der ni a las zla dkyil 'khor / /hūṃ bsam dag las rta mchog ste/ /bde mchog ma dang mnyam spyor ba'otsha / /zhal bzhi pa la dpung pa bzhi/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /rta mgrin rgyal po chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po don 1 grub pa'o/ /dpal ldan sna tshogs pad 'chang zhing / /g.yon 'og mdun du ral gri'o/ /g.yas pas rdo rje dang bcas 'phyar/ /g.yas 'og ba dan gsum par bya/ /de snying pad+ma 7nyid bsgom ste/ /hūṃ las khro bo chen po ni/ /gdug cing rab tu mi bzad pa'i/ /khro bo bcu ni spro bar bya/ /ma lus bgegs ni gzhom pa dang / /bdud bzhi zad par mdzad pa ste/ /'jigs pa'i dus mtha'i me 'bar bas/ /log 'dren bgegs ni bsreg par bya/ /mkha' khyab 'od zer tshogs 'phro ba'i/ /de yi 'khor lo bsgoms nas ni/ /bdud sogs rnam par bcom byas te/ /de 74—748

nas mnyam par gzhag ①par bya/ /oṃ snyahūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣa hraḥhraḥhraḥ hraḥr pyar ra ra/badz+ra a na la sar+pā zhuwa ran/ sar+bha dharma ④pra la ya sa bhā ⑤ba saspru mā re ka ya ka bispyo bi nā ⑥ya ka di rgo/ dā sha dik+ka ⑦ta māṃ kā ya wāka tsit+ta ni/ da ha da ha/pa tsa pa tsa/ bhasmi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 'di ni bgegs bsreg ④pa'i sngags so//log 'dren kyi ni bgegs la sogs/ /rdo rje lcags kyus ⑨bkug byas te/ /rdo rje zhags pas bcings byas nas/ /bcing ba kun kyis bcing bar bsgom/ /khro rgyal rdo rje phur bu ni/ /lte smad dbal ⑩gyi rang bzhin te/ /phyogs bcu'i ⑪ gdug pa'i bgegs steng du/ /son par rnam par bsgom par bya/ /oṃ gha gha ghā 8ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṭ+wāṃ phaṭa0/ ṅgā la tī la ya san+d+ra pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra khri la ya badz+ra dha rod ā ④dz+nyā pa ya ti/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra tī la ya /dzu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra kri la ya ā ⑩ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ phyogs mtshams phur bus bsrung ba ⑫la/ /khro bo rnams la bka' pal ⑫bsgo/ /blo ldan khro rgyal bsam bya ste/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ hūṃ kro dhe ⑪bye haṃ/ gro ta nā ma dz+nyā na da ka ya swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ta thā ga tā rak+ṣa tsa kra swa bhā wa ātā ko3haṃ byezhes nga rgyal brtan par bskyed par bya'o/ /'chad par 'gyur ba'i rim pa yis /de nas de la gtor ma sbyin/ /dag cing rtogs la sbar byas te/ /bdud rtsir byas te bsgrub par bya/ /thog mar thal mo sbyar ⑪byas te/ /de nas rnam par phyag rgya bcing / /oṃ ā hūṃ hoḥ uspyo ṣa ༄ 5susgyu ni susgyu/ ya mārnya ka /bispyon+ta / 3 ka /pad+mān+ta 3 ka /bispyon+ta ⑫ka /ā ⑫tsa la/ ni la daṇ+ḍa pya / ṭa ki rā dza/ma hā ba la dza bh+ya/ i rda ba bo gar+ghaṃ 3/puṣ+pe dhū paṃ dī paṃ ak+ṣa tai dā da ma hi/ te dza ā gats+tsha spyos pa ri wā ra kyesī rgyu/ i rda ba 3 lo/ greṇ+ḍi du khā dan+tu thut+pā ban+tu/ dzaḥ14—749

hūṃ baṃ hoḥ saṃ tro ①pā da sabyu satwa ②rna/ shārnyi/ puṣ+ṭi⑦/ rak+ṣa wa ra na guste ku rban+tu④—/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas g.yas g.yon rkang gnyis la/ /hūṃ hūṃ dag las byung ba yi⑤/ /rdo rje rkang mthil la gnas pas/ /rdo rje'i 'gros kyis gar bya'o/ /de nas g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang dang / /mnyam dang mi mnyam pa dag dang / /zlum po dang ni zla gam dang / /rus sbal rjorkang stabs ⑦gcig par bya/ /me tog dri sogs bshams nas ni/ / baṃ las sa yi lha mo ni⑧/ /mkhas pas sa ni bod par bya/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi⑨/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par las/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur//dngos grub thams cad rab bsgrub ⑩phyir/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor 'bri bar 'tshad—/ /btsun mo dang bcas byang chub sems/ /de dag thugs rje ldan pa dang / /phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa ni⑪/ /bde gshegs rnams la gsol ba gdab—/ /kun du thogs med gzigs pa yi/ /mgon po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma dbang bskur la sogs dang / /bdag gis dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / /las rnams thams cad rab bsgrub ⑫phyir/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /sngags pas slar yang mchod bshams nas/ /rdo rje sa ni mdzes gyur pa/ /spyan drangs nas ni phyis mchod de/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ lo hūṃ badz+ra bhū mi tiṣ+ṭha ⑫hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dhā ra ā ④dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/de nas yang / bum pa'i lhag par gnas pa ste/ /sngags pas sngar brjod bum pa ni/ /grangs ni nyi shu rtsa gcig ste/ /yang na lnga'am dgu nyid du/ /dngos grub 'dod pa rnams kyis bya/ /ji ltar mtshan ma de bri ba/ / rim pa ⑫14—750

bzhin du brjod par bya/ /gzhu dang 'khor lo de bzhin gri/ /thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang / /dpag bsam shing dang sha chen dang / /de bzhin bdun pa lcang lo yin/ /thog ma tha mar rdo rje ste/ /lcags kyu de bzhin zhags pa dang //lcags sgrog dril bu de bzhin no/ /las kun pa ni gcig nyid de/ /mkhas pas mchod yon sogs kyis mchod/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ①ni dbus phyogs su/ /mkhas pas rnam rgyal bum bzhag ste/ /rdo rjer me tog phreng bcings la/ /bum steng blo dang ldan pas gzhag② /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang sngags ni/ /brgyad brgya nyid du bzlas par bya/ /de bzhin brgya rtsa brgyad du ni/ /dkyil 'khor pa yis bzlas par bya/ /de nas yang ni rdo rje'i thig /dkyil 'khor kyi ni shar gyi char/ /go rī'i ①sngags kyis gzhug dunas ni/ /mchod yon sogs kyis mchod par bya/ /de nas gzhan yang rdo rje'i rdul/ /nub kyi phyogs su gzhag ⑤bya ste/ /mchod yon sogs kyis mchod par bya/ /de nas lho phyogs nyid du ni/ /slob mas maṇ+ḍal byas nas ni/ /chom rkun ma yi sngags ldan pas/ /rdo rje rtse lnga gzhag dubya ste/ /mchod yon sogs kyis mchod par bya/ /de nas byang gi phyogs su ni/ /ro langs ma yi gsang sngags kyis/ /rdo rje dril bu gzhag ⑦bya ste/ /mchod yon sogs kyis mchod par bya/ /de nas gsang sngags ldan pa yi⑧/ /slob ma maṇ+ḍal byas nas ni/ /me tog phreng ba lag thogs nas/ /pus mo g.yas pa sar btsugs te/ /rdo rje bla ma'i bdud rtsi'i thigs/ /de lta bu ni mnyam par bya/ /kha cig sngags ni sgrub phyir dang / /bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan/ /gzhan du 'jig rten don gnyer ba/ /dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug par byed/ /'jig rten pha rol 14—751

dor gnyer ba/ /dad pas mang du gnyer ba yis/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/ /tshe 'dis 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /tshe 'dis 'dod par 'gyur ba la/ /'jig rten pha rol don mi 'gyur/ /skyes bu 'jig rten pha rol gnyer//tshe 'di yi ni 'bras bu rgyas/ /de ltar gus pa dang bcas te/ /chos ni mnyam khyapar byas nas su/ /lus ngag bsdams pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /mdun du tshul bzhin gnas par bya/ /slob ma rang gis lus bcug ste/ /rdo rje'i lam nas pad+mar gdon/ /de las bde gshegs zhu ba yi/ /dbang bskur dkyil 'khor shar sgor gdon/ /de nas thal sbyar pus btsug ②nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la/ /'di lta bu yi tshig dag gis/ /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /bdag gi ston pa dpa' chen khyod/ /bde mchog ma dang mnyam sbyor la/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po yis ni bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la sprul/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /skyabs gsum po ni bdag la stsol/ /gathar pa chen po'i grong khyer du/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /de nas slob ma gtso gyur pa/ /de la bod pa byas nas ni/ /mnyam par gzhag ④pa'i sems kyis su/ /'di lta bu yi tshigs bcad bya/ khu tshur rdo rje theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags pa yi tshul chen ni/ /khyod ni theg chen snod yin na/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /dus gsum rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag gis ni gsang sngags kyirjo/ /cho ga bzang po de mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bo byang chub 14—752

shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyesalku/ /gsang sngags spyod pa ②mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang 1de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob pa'i she phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de nas bdurda rtsi thab 'u sbyor gyi/ /sngags kyis stso mngon par bsngags ④pa yi/ /a shwat+tha 5 la sogs pa'i shing / /shun pa ma nyams rma med pa/ /tshad ni bcu gnyis sor tshad la/ /me tog phreng bas rtse bcings pa/ /mkhas pa yis ni rim bzhin du/ /slob ma rnams la sbyin par bya// tshom bu'i steng du dor ba ni/ /kyegang yang mdun du lhung gyur na/ /de yis mchog gi dngos grub yin/ /de bzhin shar du rtse bltas na/ /de la dngos grub 'bring du bshad/ /de ltar phyogs mtshams rtse bltas na/ /'jig rten pa yi dngos grub 'dod/ /de ltar so shing dor ba las/ /gang zhig kha yi 'og bltas na⑩/ /de yis sa 'og dngos grub ni/ /som nyi med pa nyid du brjod/ /de rjes rdo rje slob ma la/ /dri yi ⑩chu yis 'thor 7'thung dang / /dri chu 'chor skyogasum sbyin bya ste/ /oṃ hūṃ bi shudha dharma 6 san+d+ra bi ka lpan/ a pa na yaskye/ saṃ shwa ⑫dha ya sadze+e bi kalpa na a na ya hūṃ/ de nas yang ni nyer bye'adug ste/ /bdud rtsi thab ⑫ sbyor gsang sngags kyis/ /ku sha'i rtse la rab bsngags te/ /de nas sngas dang ⑪stan du sbyin/ /de nyid bzlas pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /bsrung skud mdud pa gsum ldan pa/ /de dag bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams kyis dpung par bcing / /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /ma byung 'byung bar ma gyur pa'i/ /bdud rtsi yi ni rol gyur pa'i/ /chos bshad pas ni gzengs ⑫bstod bya/ /gal te kun mkhyen 'jig rten du/ /ma byung 'byung 14—753

bar mi 'gyur te/ /brgya rmyelam na ni res 'ga' zhig /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin / /gang phyir gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul/ /gang phyir mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed nus pa/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa yin / /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngar gyi sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ba yis/ /de dag thams cad byang bar 'gyur/ /gang dag spyod pa'i mchog 'di la/ /blo gos shin tu mi g.yo bas/ /sdug bsngal ma lus 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /dman pa grong khyer de dag gcod/ /de ring khyod kyis mnyam med pas2/ /rnyed pa mnyam med chen po rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyis nirngu/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su skye ste skye ba med/ /de phyir khyed ni theg chen la/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /'di yis khyod rnams bgrod gyur nas/ /ye shes bla na med pa thob/ /de ltar slob ma la brjod nas/ /de yis khyedon la gus pas mnyan / /de ltar tshul bzhin mnyan nas ni/ /yang na ④ 'di ltar brjod par bya / /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdog pa thams cad cho so sor bshags / /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung 6/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ / byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /)bdag dang gzhan don bsgrub dāpa'i phyir/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /sems can thams cad mgron gnyer nas/ /byang chub sems ni tsho bskyed par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir ⑫bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub spyod mchog spyad par bgyi/ /de ltar gsum la skyab 'go bas 7/ /lan gsum mang ⑫du 14—754

brjod par bya/ /de rjes de ma thag tu ni/ /yang ni de rmyeltar bya ba yin/ /de rjes rdo rje slob ma ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yis rnguni bsngags/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ bispyo ta kṛta bye hūṃ/ zhes bya'i sngags kyis bsrung bar bya/ /de dag snying ga gog ma dang / /spyi bo yi ni gnas rnams su/ /zla ba snyerdo rje pad+ma dang / /'khor lo'i rang bzhin dgod par bya/ /de dag rnams kyi lte ba la/ /yi ge oṃ āḥhūṃ bsam par bya/ /de nas slob dpon stan langs nas/ /rdo rje 'byed pa g.yas bzung ste / /slob ma'i snying ga lkog ma dang / /spyi bo yi ni gnas gsum du7bye / /rdo rje yis kyeni reg bya zhing klu/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod par bya/ /de nas spyi bor me tog dang / /mdun du spos ni dbul ba dang te/ /de bzhin snying gar mar me dang / /rim kyebazhin dri rnams dbul bar bya/ de nas ku sha'i stan dag la/ /slob ma nyal du bcug bya ste⑩/ /cung zad 7rmi lam sus mthong ba/ /nang par nga la smros shig ces/ /rim bzhin du ni smra bya ste8/ /de dag rang gi gnas su btang / /slob ma lhag par gnas byas nas/ /las gzhan la ni 'jug par bya//slob ma bskul ba byas nas ni/ /dge 7dang mi dge ⑩ mtshan ma rnams/ /so so'i don ni brtag skye pa'i phyir/ /slob dpon rang gi gnas nyal te/ /dkyil 'khor sa yi phyogs kyi cha/ /lho yi phyogs na tshemakhas pa yis tre/ /byang rtephyogs su ni sngas bstan / te/ /lho sde phyogs su ni rkang pa'o/ /mchod yon la sogs phul nas ni/ /gnas ni lhag par gnas par bya/ /oṃ ho kā tshem la gasgo sha ye badz+ra su ka ma ni da tra na kye ka ra mi ya ta thā ga ta te na kred ta so ༄ rteha ha swā hā/dngos sam yang na rmi lam du/ /de bzhin du ni rtags mthong dang / /slob ma yis kyang de ltar te/ /gnyis ka'ang dpyad 3par bya ba yin/ /de ltar 3 14—755

mtshan ma ngan gyur nasalku/ /slob dpon gyis ni khri bzlas te/ /gtor ma chen po byin byas nas/ /phyis ni de 3ltar dge ba yin/ /de nas dkyil 'khor de nyid dekye/ /sngar kyi lha rnams rim bkod ④de/ /'khor lo bsgom thupa'i steng du ni/ /blo chen gyis ni bsam par bya/ /lte ba phyagayon pa'i khu tshur kyis/ /bla mas thig gi sna bzung ste④/ /sngags kyi bum pa kun gyi chus/ /khang pa'i nang du bsang gtor bya/ /oṃ sarba sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/las kyi thig gis rim bye 7bzhin du/ /ye shes thig ni brkyang bar bya⑨/ /badz+ra sa ma ya sru tram̐ ma ti ⑩kra ma hūṃ/ ye shes kyi thig gdab pa'i sngags so/ /de nas de rjes nyid du ni/ /gong du bstan pa'i thig nyid kyis/ /mkhas pas mnyam par rab bzhag nas/ /las kyi thig ni gdab par bya/ /de la re zhig sngags bzlas pa'i/ srad bu mtha' ma dkar ldan pas/ /dkar ba'i rdzas la sbang byas te/ /yid kyis gtso bo'i gsang sngags bzlas/ /he ru ka yi gnas bsams te/ /khu tshur g.yon du thig gdab bya/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung ste/ /dzaḥyis sgrub 0pa'i lag tu gtad6/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid dmigs te/ shar bltas rdo rje'i thig gdab bya/ /slar yang slob dpon lhor 'dug ste/ /byang du bltas te gnyis pa gdab/ /me yi ⑫phyogs kyi char gnas nas—/ /mkhas pas byang du kha bltas te/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor thig gdab pa—/ /de nas yang ni bya ba yin/ /rlung phyogs gnas la lhor bltas te/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi thig gdab bo/ /de nyid du ni 'dug byas te/ /byang gi phyogs kyi thig gdab bo/ /yang ni me phyogs 'dug nas ni/ /lho phyogs kyi ni thig gdab ste/ /kha khyer gyi ni thig dag kyang / /shes rab can gyis 14—756

gdab par bya/ /slar yang me mtshams su 'dug ste/ /rlung gi mtshams kyi bar 1gdab cing / /de bzhin bden bral mtshams 'dug nas/ /dbang ldan mtshams kyi thig gdab bya/ /slob dpon dang ni de yi cha/ /bskor phyogs su ni 'gro bar bya/ /dang po cha chen brgyad du ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bgo byas te—/ /de nas de rjes nyid du ni/ /sgrub pa po yis de la blta/ /slar yang de la bcu drug char/ /bgo bya slar yang nyis 'gyur du/ /mdor na thig rkang tshang ba ru/ /mkhas pa yis ni gdab par bya/ yang na bcu drug cha chen la/ /rtsa ba'i tshangs thig nas bzung ste/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor rdzogs par ni/ /legs par thig ni gdab par bya/ /tshangs thig nas ni drangs pa yi/ /cha ni bzhi pa legs bzung ste/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi rang bzhin du/ /mkhas pa yis ni gdab par bya/ /de yi cha chen lnga pa ni/ /nyi shu char ni bgo bya ste/ /dang po tshon rtsi cha nyid yinabye / /gnyis bzhi de bzhin rim bzhin no/ /de yi cha chen drug pa ni/ /nyi shu bzhir ni gdab bya ste/ /cha gnyis sa ni dra phyed yin/ /de nas gnyis ni rim bzhin no/ /cha chen bdun pa brgyad pa ni/ /sum cu gnyis su gdab bya ste/ /rta babs su ni shes bya zhing / /lhag ma ci rigs shes par bya/ /gzhan yang tshangs thig nas bzung — ste/ /'khor lo'i thig gdab rim pa ni/ /rta babs bar du gdab par bya/ /lhag ma'ang ci rigs shes par bya/ /slar yang 'khor lo'i lte dbus kyi/ /cha drug rnam par phyin nas ni/ /de nas bdud rtsis skyong ④ nul bya/ /de nas de la thig gdab po/ /cha chen brgyad dang bcu drug tu/ /de la thig ni gdab bya ste/ /de nyid sum cu bzhi nyid du/ /mkhas pa yis khyani slar thig gdab/ /cha chung phyi rol gcig tre714—757

dor ba/ /rdo rje ra ba'i thig yin te/ /de nas cha chung lnga gnyis ni/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i thig yin no/ /de bzhin du ni lte ba ste/ /nang gi cha gcig ge sar yin / /de ltar cha chung lnga gnyis la/ /'dab ma'i bar yang shes par bya/ /dbang ldan mtshams nas brtsams nas ni/ /g.yas skor gyis ni bskor bya ste/ /dkyil 'khor kyi ni thig rnams la/ /ye shes thig ni bstem par bya/ /de nas de rjes nyid du ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon mnyam gzhag rtepas/ /hi hi'i sgra ni brjod bya zhing / /yid kyis sgo ni dbye bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ 4 a khaṃ 'dis ni/ /rdul tshon kyang ni bsgrub bya ste/ /ji ltar tshogs pa rnyed gyur nas/ /dag pa'i dri rnams dbul bar bya/ /gsal bcas lha yi phyag rgyas rgo/ /sngags ni brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /dril dkrol rdo rje gsor ba dang / /rdo rje'i — glus ni skul byed cing / /dmar ba'i gos bcas gtor byin te/ /'di lta bu ni bsam par bya/ /'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /thams cad khams ni rnam dag pa/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas gnas/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis thog mar/ /dbang ldan nas ni bskor bya ste/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo'i 4rjes 'brangs nas/ /sngags pas rdul tshon bri bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra lhas ma ya hūṃ/ phyis ni slob ma bzang po yis 6 ci rigs par ni bri bar bya/ /drang dang 'khyog dang chad pa dang / /phra dang sbom pa nyer mtshon te/ /spom po yis ni nad 'gyur zhing / /phra na nor rnams zad par 'gyur/ /'khyog 7na 'thab rtsod 'byung 'gyur zhing / /chad na slob dpon slob ma 'chi/ /de la sogs pa'i skyon spangs nas/ /rdul tshon ri mo dgye bar bya/ /shar du sngon po chen po ste 37/ /lhor ni ser po 'byung ba yin/ /74—758

nub tu dmar po chen po ste/ /byang du ljang gu nyid 'byung ba'o/ /dbus ni zla ba'i 'od ltar te/ /'di ni rdul tshon rim par brjod/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /slob dpon 'khor lo'i shar du 'dug /rnam snang mdzad sogs ting 'dzin kyis/ /sgo bzhi rnams su legs 'dug ste/ /gru bzhi yi ni mtshams rnams su/ /dam chos klog pa bzhi yang gzhag1 /dam tshig la 'das 'jigs pa yis/ /slob mar gyur pa gzhug mi bya / /g.yas pas rdo rje gsor bya zhing / /g.yon pa yis ni dril bu dkrol/ /sngags ni oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi ra ṇa ra ṇa —/ pra ra ṇa pra ra ṇa/ saṃ pra ra ṇa pyasaṃ pra ra ṇazhe/ sat+tha budha 9k+ṣe tra ye pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pā ra 7mi tā/nā bye snad saṃ bhā ba be+e badz+ra dha da ba ya/ saṃ to ṣa na hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rkang pa 'deg dang 'jog pa dang / /lta ba bzhin dang khro ba yisatsu/ /slar ni sa gzhi mnan bya ste/ /sngags rig 5 snapas ni gnas par bya/ /gzhan gyi rim 'di dag gis ni/ /sgo gzhan du yang shes par bya/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i rkang pa yis/ /rtag tu 'akyings 11shing bsgyings par bya/ /oṃ hūṃ zhes bya ba dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon chen po'i sngags so/ /g.yas brkyang ba dang g.yon brkyang dang / /lta stangs ji ltar sngon bzhin brjod/ /oṃ hūṃ a phaṭa/ ces bya ba ni shar phyogs kyi slob dpon kyi sngags so/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam rkang stabs dang / /gtum zhing rab rmongs lta stangs ste/ /oṃ hūṃ a phaṭa ces bya ba ni lho phyogs kyi slob dpon gyi sngags so/ /zlum po dang ni rus sbal dang / /dga' ba'i gar dang lta bcas te/ /oṃ hūṃ a a a phaṭa ces bya ba ni nub kyi slob dpon gyi sngags so/ /lta ba rnam par rgyu ba dang / /shi ba lta bu de bzhin te/ /rkang pa dag gis gar 14—759

sngon brjod ⑨pa yi rim pa yis/ /blo dang ldan pas bsrung byas te/ /srung 2ba'i khro bo rnams la ni/ /de nas bka' ni bsgo bar bya/ /bdag nyid gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gzugs brnyan bzhin du bdag nyid lta/ /dang po du snying gar pad+ma la/ /de steng ④zla rdzogs dkyil 'khor bsam/ /der ni hūṃ byung rdo rje ste/ de las 'od zer spro bar bya/ /'od gsal me tog bdug sogs kyis 'a/ /rang gi ming bzhin rnal 'byor mas/ /dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa yipya / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa yis/ /mchod pa byas te bsdu bar bya/ /de nas bdun po dag bya ste/ /gzhan yang de nyid mchod par bya/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min37/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs te/ /chos rnams skye ba med pa ru/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu bsam bya ste / / sos ka'i 3dus kyi nyin gung gi/ /nam mkha' la ni sprin med ltar/ /sems nyid brtan par byas nas ni/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā ⑨ dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa cha ko3⑩haṃ/ stong nyid ngang las byung ba yi/ /11rlung dang me dang chu dang sas/ /gzhal yas dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /sngon bzhin mnyam par gzhag 7 pa yis/ /de nas gzhal yas khang bsam bya/ /skar ma lta bur 'od gsal ba'o/ /de nas sems tsam bsam bya ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid la/ /lha mo glu yis bskul bar bya/ /stong pa shin du rnal 'byor yod 1/med mthu/ /nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig 6nye bar gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /zla rdzogs 'od zer ltar 'bar zhing / /shes rab chags pas dmar ba'i zhal/ /phyag gnyis rang gi rig 6 'khyud cing / /14—761

rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /dpa' bo gzhu dang mda' bsnams shing / /rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /de nas kun gyis de mthong ste/ /de dag bred nas 'ongs par gyur/ /bdud ༄kyidang phung byed 'jigs pa rnams/ / nyam thag gsol ba 2'debs par byed/ /de nas gsol 'debs gnas nas ni//snying rje khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /cung zad dus su gnas nas ni/ /sna yi dbugs rings dro bton te/ /bcom ldan de nyid rnal 'byor pas/ /rdo rje khro bo bsgyur nas phyung / /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rdo rje che/ /'bar bas thal ba rab tu 'jigs/ /sems dpa' sngon po 'bar ba'i ngang / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po 'bar/ /'jigs pa'i dus kyi me dang mtshungs/ /'bar ba chen po'i skra 'bar ba/ /thod pa'i dbu rgyan gyis mdzes pa'o/ /legs par 'jigs mdzad sangs rgyas skal bzang khro bo'i ming ni te ru ka /phyogs rnams bdud rnams thal bar 'jig sngumadzad 'di ni skye dgu'i bdag po ste/ /rtag tu dga' ba dang ldan gar mdzad 'gying dang bcas pa'i sku/ /glang chen rus pa sna tshogs rgyan bklubs 5dur khrod yan lag can/ /zhal lnga phyag ni bcu pa la/ /kha dog sngo zhing 'jigs pa yi6/ /spyan gsum smin 7ma ser ba ste/ /lus la thal bas nye bar byugs/ mche 9snab cung zad gcigs pa la/ /gar dgu yi ni tshul dang ldan/ /rang 'od zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i/ /shes rab dga' bas gcig mdzes pa'o/ /gnag cing ser la dmar zhing ljang / /g.yon skor 1 gyis ni zhal bzhi yin/ /dkar zhing zhi ba steng zhal ste/ /phung po'i bdud rnams rab tu bcings/ /na ra'i pags pa'i 2gos 'chang zhing / /gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bur bcas/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ /glo sgang muganyis 14—762

por 'dzin pa yin/ /gnyis kyis lcags kyu zhags pa ste/ /gnyis kyis cang te'u thod pa 'chang / /mgo gnyis steng du he ru ka /phyed krung bcas pa'i gar gyis bzhugs/ /brla gnyis mnyam par gzhag 1nas ni/ /bde ba chen po'i go 'phang 7gnas/ /g.yon pas thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'chang / /g.yas pas ba dan gsum pa'o/ /in+d+ra shebhā la'i kha dog la/ /dur khrod du ba lta bu ste/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra ba'i/ /na tshod mdzes shing sgeg pa'o/ /de lta'i lha mo dang mnyam pa'i/ /ji ltar khros par gyur pa ni/ /de nyid du ni bkug byas te—/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i khrag 'thung bskyed/ /brgyad pa'i mtha' ni 4thig ler bcas/ /dbyangs yig lnga dang mnyam ldan pa/ /hūṃ yig gtso bor chogyur pa las/ /go rī'i 4dkar mo dbyung bar bya/ /mdun du gzhu dang mda' 'dzin cing / /tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'bigs par byed/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /phyag bzhi yis dz+wani rnam par mdzes/ /gar gyi sbyor ba la gzigs shing / /g.yas brkyang pa yis rnam par bzhugs/ /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa la/ /'og tu de nyid sbyor ba yi/ /tshogs bcas la ni chom rkun ma/ /g.yas su kha dog dmar mo ste/ /'khor lo srid gsum brgal sdigs 9mdzub/ /g.yas gnyis par ni lcang lo ste/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub phyag rgya la/ /de bzhin g.yon pa ba dan no/ /gnyis pa yi ni sbyang ba las/ /zla ba'i kha dog rmad byung ba'i/ /ro langs ma ni g.yon du ste/ /phyed krung bcas pa'i gar gyes bzhugs/ /bdud rtsi chen po ldugs mdzad nas/ /snga ma bzhin du thal mdzad cing / /slar yang slong bar mdzad pa yis1 / /lcang lo yang ni gnyis pa ste / /g.yas pa gzhan ni 7rgyal mtshan yin/ /rdo rje yis ni mtshan gyur pa'i//14—763

g.yon gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'o/ /lnga pa yi ni dang po la/ /lnga pa yis ni ldan par bya/ /'di ni sa bon rgyal po ste/ /thig le bcas las 'di ni 'byung / /puk+ka sī 2ni me mtshams su/ /gzugs mdzes zla ba'i kha dog la/ /dkar ba'i lus la zhal sngo ba/ /g.yon brkyang pa yis bzhugs par mdzad/ /lcang lo dang ni ba dan bcas/ /g.yas dang de bzhin g.yon par te/ /dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni sngon bzhin no/ /gsum pa yi ni dang po la/ /thig le dang ni ldan pa las—/ /gtum mo kha dog sngon mo ni/ /bden bral gyi ni mtshams su gnas/ /g.yas brkyang pa yis gnas pa ste/ /phyag gnyis sha dang btung ba 'dzin/ /dur khrod me dang rgyal mtshan thab/ /rtag tu g.yon pa mdzes pa'o/ /dang po yi ni gnyis pa la/ /thig les rnam par brgyan pa ste/ /sa bon de las za phod ma/ /kha dog ljang la cung zad skya/ /rlung mtshams g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs shing / /phyag gnyis kyis ni gar mdzad ma/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi 1'og ma yis/ /lcang lo de bzhin rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po la/ /thig le dang ni ldan pa las/ /las kyi phyag rgya dbang ldan du/ /he ru ka dpal zhal gcig ste/ /glang po'i thod pas dbu brgyan cing / /sku tshe 'jigs par mdzad pa mo/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje lcang lo dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje thod pa'o/ /thams cad nam mkha'i gos 'chang zhing / /sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ldan/ /rgyu ma'i rgyu thod chen po yi/ /phreng bas lus la rnam par brgyan/ /zhal gcig ma la spyan gsum ma/ /sgeg pa'i rgyan kyis brgyan pa ste/ /thams cad mdzes pas phun tshogs shing / /'dzum zhing rnam par 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /zhi ba drag por rab rmongs gtum/ /dga' zhing 14—764

gar byed 'gyur dang bcas/ /shi ba bung ba lta bu yi/ /zhal gyi phyag rgya rnam par gnas/ /zhi dang drag po rmongs byed dang / /gar byed bsgyings shing lta bar mdzad/ /yi ge bzhi las byung ba yi/ /phyi rol mtshams kyi lha mo ni/ /so so rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /rang gi phyag rgyas rol pa yis ṭ+wā/ /pi wang la sogs sngags rnams ni/ /ha ho dī2ཿhūṃ 'di ru gnas/ /a āḥsaṃ a 'di sngon bzhin//me tog sogs su brtag 1par bya/ /de rnams nang gi phyogs gyur pa/ /rdo rje me tog sogs de bzhin/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'adi las kyang / /sgo srung krurnams ni 'byung ba yin/ /ring du 'go sogs de dag gicho/ /kha dog mtshan ma brjod par bya/ /gling bu ma ni dmar mo la/ /gling bu'i sgra ni dar brtson ma/ /pi wang ma ni dkar mo la/ /pi wang la ni mngon par brtson/ /rdza rnga mo ni dkar mo la/ / mu kun+da bye 7ni de bzhin ljang / /lha mo de rnams nang nas ni/ /me tog spos dang mar me dri/ /dkar dang du ba lta bu dang / /gsum pa gser gyi mdog can te/ /dri ma dmar mo gur gum gyi/ /cung zad rab tu 'dres pa'o/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi sgo ru ni/ /ring du 'gro ma lcags kyu 'chang / /g.yon pas lcug ma 'dzin pa la/ /cung zad khro dang bcas pa'o/ /nag mo 'gugs par byed ma la/ /g.yon brkyang pa yis gnas pa'o/ /lho yi phyogs kyi sgo ru ni/ /ser mo rdo rje gdong can ma/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /lcags kyu kha dog ser mo 'dzin/ /g.yon pas mche ba 'dzin pa ste/ /rdo rje gdong can zhes bya ba/ /bkug pa rnams ni rab 'dzud pa'o/ /de nas nub phyogs sgo ru ni/ /rdo rje sgrog ma rab tu gnas/ /phyag gnyis nyi ma zla ba 'dzin/ /de dag dbus na lcags sgrog ste/ /'di ni dmar zhing 'ching bar mdzad/ /14—765

g.yas brkyang pa yis 1bzhugs pa'o/ /mgon po phyag ni bcur brjod cing / /phyag gnyis ma yis mgul nas 'khyud— —/ /phyag bzhir ldan pa'i lha mo ni/ /brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /me tog gling bu'i rim pa yis/ /de las gzhan dus gar byed cing / /sgo bzhi dag tu gnas pas ni/ /kun nas yongs su bsrungs pa'o/ /'di rdzogs dkyil 'khor bdag nyid de/ /rigs lnga yi ni byin gyis brlabs/ /mig la sogs pa byin brlabs te/ /dbang bskur ba ni blang bar bya/ /mig la sangs rgyas byang chub ste/ /gzugs ni 'dod pa'i lcug ma yin/ /nyan par rdo rje gling bu ste/ /sgra la rdza rnga ma ru grags//sna la rdo rje me tog ste/ /dri la dri yi rnam par grags/ /lce la ring du 'go ma ste/ /ro la thal ba 'jigs ma'o/ /lus la de bzhin reg bya la/ /pra mo ha ming rnal 'byor ma/ /yid la bde mchog mar brjod de/ /chos la ri bong can ma'o/ /phung po rgyal ba lngar brjod do/ /sa la khams gsum rnam rgyal ma/ /sa yi khams la gnas pa ni/ /de bzhin lha mo ā lo ke/ /me yi khams la mar me ma//rlung la mu kun+da 4ru grags/ /mig gi rnam shes khams la ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo ma ru brjod/ /rna ba'i rnam shes khams la ni/ rdo rje pi wang 5ma ru grags/ /sna yi khams kyi rnam shes la/ /rdo rje yid ni 'phrog ma'o/ /lce yi rnam shes khams la ni/ /rdo rje gdong can lha mo brjod/ /lus kyi rnam shes khams la ni//lha mo phyag rgya'i rgya yis 6gdab/ /yid kyi rnam shes khams la ni/ /lha mo e ma bde bar gnas/ /gau rī'i 7de bzhin pra mo ha/ /de bzhin gtum mo puk+ka sī/ /za phod mar brjod de bzhin dri/ /gti mug rdo rje rgya yis gdab/ / chom rkun ro langs ma ning dang 9/ /gling bu de bzhin pi wang dang / /de bzhin lha mo rdza 74—766

rnga ma/ /zhe sdang phyag rgya rgya yis gdab/ /yid kyi rnam shes khams la ni/ /las kyi phyag rgya mar me nyid/ /lha mo bcom ldan rim go ma/ /de bzhin lha mo rdo rje gdong / /thal bas rab 'jigs ro langs ma/ /'dod chags phyag rgya'i rgya yis gdab/ / mu kun+da 1dang me tog spos/ /ser sna'i phyag rgya'i rgya yis gdab / /'jig rten gsum ni rab sgrub pa/ /'jig rten gsum gyis 2phyag byas pa/ /'jig rten gsum gyi ston pa po/ /'jig rten gsum la skyid sbyin ma//rdo rje 'dzin chen dpal rdo rje/ /sems dpa'i skal ba bzang po yis/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rin po che yi phung po yis/ /lha yi dbu rgyan zhes bya bas/ /bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol/ /de nas thod phreng dbu rgyan dang / /sangs rgyas gtsug tor de bzhin no/ /de nas lha mos mchod byas te/ /glu yi rol mos mchod par bya/ /rjes su chags pa'i pad+mo yi/ /dga' ba'i pad+mo rnam dag pas/ /mchod pa gsal ba'i rjes su mchod byas pas/ /mchog tu rnal 'byor bde bas bde ba grub par mdzod/ /kye mchog tu bde ba'i dam tshig ngo bo bde ba nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba skal bzangs mchog dgyes pa/ /kye ma mchog tu gsang ba'i bdag /rang gi dam tshig skyon med bdag la rol cig rol cig ho/ /ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi mchog /btung ba de nas dbul bar byed/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i lha mo ni/ /'o dang 'khyud pa la sogs kyis/ /skal bzangs de ni chags mdzad cing / /skyes bu'i tshul du rol par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /lha mo chen mos mgul nas 'khyud/ /sku yi rjes su 'jug par mdzad/ /lha mo kun dang mnyam ldan pa'i/ /de ni khyab bdag mchod par byed/ /phyag rgya chen 14—767

po'i sbyor ba yis/ /btsun mo kun la longs spyod mdzod/ /pad rtsa'i skud pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor sbyor bar bya/ /phyag rgya chen mo gsal 'bar ma/ /gnas la sogs par gshegs pa mo/ /sdog med zhe sdang can gus pas / /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyis bsgom/ /khrag 'thung gi ni rang bzhin gyis / /'gro ba rtsa bzhin blta bar bya/ /de yi byin rlabs lhasbyor ba yis /le lo med par bzlas par bya/ /gang zhig bla mas bka' gnang ba/ /de nas legs par sbyar byas te/ /las gang gis ni sngags kyis kyang / /gzhan du mkhas pa nyon mongs 'gyur/ /dang po rab sngags brjod par bya/ /snying po de bzhin te ru ka /rdo rje dam tshig mnyam ldan pa/ /rdo rjes gtum pa thams cad do/ /dam tshig ces bya phyag rgya ste/ /de nas nyid du rab mdzes pa /hūṃ yig de nas brjod bya ste/ / ru lu'i 2bhesgra gnyis brjod par bya/ /e bye'i byesgra gnyis de bzhin te/ /de nas hūṃ phaṭa gdon par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra ghu ha si ti zhes/ /ba ra me zhes de nas brjod/ /yo gi shwa ra ka pa la/ /ma ra da re ne ya brjod/ /ru dhi (jer zhes pa yis thuzhes/ /de nas sma sha na zhes brjod/ /wa sa na zhes de nas brjod/ /hūṃ phaṭa yi ge mtha' rten no/ /go rī zhwaphyag 'tshal badz+ra dang / /de rjes tsaṇ+ḍi shwa ri brjod/ /ka kal ma la ku mu ti/ /a ka te zhes lan gnyis brjod/ /sarba duṣ+ṭa snying por bcas—/ /hūṃ dang ru lu'i tsu tshig gnyis brjod/ /te ru ka la bod bya ste/ /hūṃ phaṭa a yig mtha' rten no/ /rkun mo rnam snang tshogs tshig gzhan/ /badz+ra a par tsi dam tshi4/ /pa ru ghu ha ka pa la/ /ma la bhar na bu shin te/ /sarba duṣ+ṭan zhes brjod do/ /mo ha ni zhes sri ye gzhan/ /e nyi e nyi yang dag 14—768

brjod—/ /sarba duṣ+ṭan wo ra ni/ /hūṃ phaṭa yi ge brjod par bya/ /rmongs byed lha mo dran bya ste/ /pra mo ha la ①oṃ zhes brjod/ /badz+ra pi te ②la yi sgra/ /phyi nas sngags yig kha gnyis so/ /sarba duṣ+ṭa zhes brjod de/ /bi gri ta phro ①sha da re ni/ bi tri te du.a lo ka ra'i tshig /mo ha na'i tshig gnyis brgyan te/ /sbyang bar byas te bklag par bya/ /da ha na bcas pa tsa dang / /pa tsa ya ti gnyis dang ni/ /ma bi lo pa'i tshig ni gcig /sa ma ya de phyi nas bzlas/ /a nu sma ra ye shes bya/ /pra be+e sha ya bklag par bya/ /yang ni man dang zhes su bzla—/ /sarba 'ang dbus su bzhag par bya/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa dang mnyam ldan pa'o—/ /rig byed rnams kyi dang po bzung ⑤/ /e nyi'i tshig ni lan gnyis bzla—/ /bcom ldan 'das ma bod par bya/ /rdo rje gsang dbang de bzhin no//rnam pa du ma'i tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /gzungs ma la ni bod par bya/ /sarba ta thā ga ta'i tshig /tshu sha'i sgra yis rjomachod pa'o/ /a nu sma re dang bcas pa'i/ /de nas sa ma ya dran bya/ /ha na ra ga'i tshig bskor bcing ⑦/ / ram̐ ga pa ri pu sker ya/ /ā ⑨be+e sha ya lan gnyis brjod/ /sarba bhū ⑫tram̐ de nas bzla/ /narta narta pa ya gnyis/ /ha ⑪gnyis tsheg drag bcas pa'o/ / ka ha'i ⑫sgra ni lan gnyis bzla/ /de nas hūṃ phaṭa bzla bar bya/ /puk+ka sī la oṃ zhes brjod/ /badz+ra dhū ⑫pa asne bzlas/ rnyi ta nyi ④ta yang dag brjod/ /sarba duṣ+ṭan spyozhes snying po/ / ā kār+ṣa yi ⑫tshig gnyis so/ /ha na'i tshig dang da ha'i tshig /pa tsa nirma tha mā ra ⑩ya/ /ma bi lasbra spyod na bcas/ /sa ma ya ni lan gnyis brjod / /hūṃ phaṭa yi ge legs brjod de/ / tsaṇ+ḍa lī ⑪sngags btu bar bya/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang badz+ra'i sgra/ /ma te ma he shwa rar ldan/ /ha ni tsheg drag 14—769

bcas pa ste/ /ha hūṃ ha rgo lan bzhir brjod/ /ru lu'i sgra ni gnyis brjod do//hūṃ gnyis bhak+ṣa sbyang bar bya/ /nirma thi ni kun la brjod/ /de nas snying po hūṃ phaṭa bzlas/ /sgra gnyis swā hā mnyam sbyar te/ /ghasma rī ①la sogs bsgrub bya/ /ghasma rī ②la oṃ bzlas shing / /sum̐ bha ni zhes sbyar bar bya/ /di pa ta sgra sa ma ya//brjod cing badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa bzla/ /gang zhig phag mo'i sngags brjod pa/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i sngags su brjod/ /gzhan gyi sngon gyi snying po ni/ /rang gi ming bcas bod pa ni/ /sngags su rnam par gzhag ①bya ste/ /oṃ dang hūṃ phaṭa thog mar ro/ /de nas me tog sogs kyis mchod/ /sngon brjod pa yi rim pa yisarjo /gtor ma sha ni thams cad dang / /bza' dang btung bar mnyam ldan pa/ /'byung po kun gyi gsang sngags sam/ /a ra li sogs sngags kyis dbul/ /de nas sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo gros ches/ /slob ma rnams ni gzhug pa'i phyir/ /bden pa 'di yis gsol btab bya/ /chos kun sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung ⑤du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las dukun du 'byung / /de bzhin nyid la nges par skyes/ /bden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma yis/ /kun gyi dri ma med mthong shog /de ltar gsol btab de rjes su/ /slob ma rnam snang du dmigs te/ /dkyil 'khor du ni gzhug ⑦pa'i phyir—/ /bla ma la ni yon dbul bya/ /yol ba yi ni phyi rol nas/ /yon gyi mchog ni blang bya ste/ /kun du sna tshogs bla ma la/ /yon kyi mchog ni dbul bar 'os/ /gang la yongs su btang dka' gang / /de ni yon kyi mchog tu bshad / /gang dang gang ni sdug pa'i mchog /yang na shin du khyad par can/ /14—770

de dang de ni bla ma la/ /de nyid mi zad 'dod pas dbul/ /yang na ci bzhed 'gyur ba'am/ /'on te thugs la dgongs pa dag /der dbul yang na dgos pa bya/ /gal te yang na de ①mchog bdag① /de dbul ba ni mchog yin no/ /bu mo shin du brgyan pa'am/ /de bzhin chung ma sdug pa dag /phul nas rin sdegyis slu ba dag /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog yin no/ /phyugs chen dag kyang 'bul byed na/ /gzhan lta smos dhikyang ci zhig dgos/ /slob ma bdag nyid du bsams te/ /de nas thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /a khaṃ bā ri ⑤hūṃ zhes pas/ /me tog phreng ba 'dzin bcug ste/ /dar gyis mig gnyis bkab byas la/ /bum pa'i chu yis bsang rjobar bya/ /kye ho su zhig bya ba'i sgras/ /de nas gzhug phyir dra ⑦bya ste/ /bde ba chen po ④skal bzang bdag /'jug pas kyang ni smra ⑨bar bya/ /slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje ni/ /bzhag nas 'di skad brjod par bya/ /oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa dā ya mi⑩/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ho sidhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ de skad byang chub sems bskyed de/ /yang na 'di ltar brjod par bya/ /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs gyur pa/ /thams cad kyis ni byin zlob kyis/ /khyod ni de bzhin gshegs kun gyis/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ma zhugs pa la ma smra zhig /mi dad par yang ma byed cig /ces ni de ltar brjod par bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya tho'adis—/ /slob ma yol ba'i nang khrid de/ /'jug 'gyur dkyil 'khor shar sgo ru/ /gzhag ⑫la 'di skad brjod par bya/ /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi/ /rigs su zhugs te de bas na/ /nga yis khyod la rdo rje yi/ /ye shes bskyed par bya ba ste/ /khyod ni ye shes gang zhig gis/ /de bzhin 14—771

gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /dngos grub kyang ni thob 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ①ci dgos/ /khrod kyang yang 'di dkyil 'khor ni/ /mthong min rnams la ma smra zhig /'on te smra bar gyur na ni/ /de ma thag tu dam tshig nyams—/ /spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas kyang / /'di skad ces ni brjod par bya/ /'di khyod rdo rje dam tshig ste/ /gal te khyod kyis 'di smras na/ /klad pa nges par 'gas 'gyur zhing / /dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ba yin/ /me tog dang bcas rdo rje ni/ /snying gar gzhag ④la 'di skad brjod/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis/ /snying la yang dag gnas pa ste/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /de skad brjod pa byas nas ni/ /mna' ni rab tu bsgag par bya/ /pad+ma'i snod du gzhag dze+epa la/ /yang ni bdud rtsi bsgrub bya ste/ /blo dang ldan pas yig gsum gyis/ /byin kyis brlabs pyapar bya ba yin/ /'di ni khyod kyi ⑤dmyal ba'i chu/ /srungs rjoshig ma bsrung sreg par byed/ /bsrungs na dngos grub kun 'grub pas/ /grub pa'i bdud rtsi chu 'thungs shig /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ te u da ka ṭha hūṃ/ de lta bu yi sngags kyis ni/ /'thung ba dang ni spyi bor sbyin/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste—/ /gzhan khrod dam tshig nyams gyur nas/ /dmyal bar 'gro bar lhang 'gyur te/ /rdo rje skad cig gis dbab bya/ /de la 'di ni rim pa yin/ /bud med khrag ldan ras la ni/ /de lta bu yis ⑦sngags kyis ni/ /sna lam bregs te bshad pa dang / /gu gul dang ni mnyam par bya/ /yi dwags me ni blang byas nas/ /de ni pad+ma'i snod du gzhag⑧ /der ni de kun blugs bya ste/ /khro bo'i cha 'dzin slob dpon gyis/ /g.yon brkyang gis ni legs 'dug na/ /14—772

de ni bdag sbyin bya ba yin/ /de rjes spos bzhin rdo rje can/ /'dir ni 'bebs 'gyur the tsho med/ /a la la la la ho①/ /sarba ta thā ga ta pi tsi da ⑤tra ḍā ki dze+edzo le/ zhes bya ba ni sku dbab pa'o/ /rnam pa mang po rab tu dga' ba'i rgyud kyis sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyisakyisgyu ma'i bde mchog sgyu ma thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul//hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ⑤/ zhes bya ba ni gsung dbab bo/ /rnam pa mang po'i rgyud kyis sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu ma thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul/ /ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/zhes bya bas thugs dbab pa'o/ /rnam pa mang po srog gi rgyud kyis sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma'i bde mchog sgyu mas rab sprul rnam par sprul/ /hūṃ shi shi bi sha hūṃ/ ye shes dbab pa'o/ /de nas mig gi dngos po ci/ /mthong ba yin zhes dri bya ste/ /dkar ser dmar dang gnag mthong na/ /zhi rgyas dbang bsad 'grub ces brjod/ /de rjes pra tits+tsha hoḥrjozhes/ brjod nas me tog dkyil 'khor dor/ /de ltar me tog dor ba las/ /mchog la sogs pa'i dngos grub bshad/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi spyi bo'am/ /spyi gtsug mdzod spur phog gyur na/ /dngos grub 'bring ni thob pa ste/ /tha ma la phog dngos grub tha/ /gzugs brnyan las ni ring 'gyur na/ /dus ring nye na nye ba ste/ /lha yis ⑦lo tsa la phog na/ /de bzhin du lang shes par bya/ /gal te lha gnyis bar phog na/ /de la me tog gar nye ba/ /de dang de yi rigs su ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni shes par bya/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol babs gyur na/ /dngos grub phran tshegs thob pa ste⑧/ /14—773

re khā rnams la phog gyur na/ /slar yang bskyar la dor bar bya/ /lan gsum bar dor de nyid du/ /babs na dngos grub med pa ste/ /phyi rol rdo rje ra ba la//phog par gyur na dngos grub med/ /ra ba'i nang du bab gyur na/ /shin tu dkar ba thob 'gyur te/ /'di dag gi ni rim pa ste/ /me tog dor ba'i rim pa'o /de nas me tog phreng blangs nas/ /slob ma'i mgo la bcing bya ste/ /pra ti kṛṇ+ḍa swa mi rma satwa/ /ma hā ba la zhes brjod bya/ /mig gnyis la ni oṃ bsgoms te/ /tshigs bcad 'di ni ①brjod par bya/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson byed pa/ /mig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad de/ /rdo rje mig ni bla na med/ /rdo rje slob ma rnams la ni/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu bstan par bya/ /rang bzhin rnam dag bdag gi lus/ /rang bzhin gyis ②ni dri ma med/ /dpa' bo pad+ma'i pho brang du/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bu ltos shig /de nas gnas dang nye gnas sogs①/ /bdag gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gnas/ /byang chub phyogs chos rtsa bdun gyi/ /chos kyi rang bzhin khrag 'thung dpal/ /yan lag dang ni yan lag rnams/ /nye bar bstan pa nyid du bya/ /bsam kyis mi khyab pa yi snod/ /thams cad bdag nyid mgon btud de//bla ma mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol/ /slob ma gsol btab de rjes la/ /dbang bskur ba ni sbyin par bya/ /rnam rgyal bum sogs blangs nas ni/ /pad+ma'i steng du chu gzhag dugo/ /hūṃ las rdo rje mi bskyod do/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis bsgom bya/ /ye shes sems gzugs sa bon gyis/ /'od zer kyis ni bskul byas te/ /ye shes sems dpa' zhugs 14—774

nas ni/ /mchod nas chu yi rang bzhin bya/ /de nyid mi bskyod pa'i tshul gyis/ /rnam shes phung po'i rang bzhin te①/ /de nas brtse chen ston pa 'dis/ /dpa' bo'i mgor ni bkru bar bya/ /oṃ sarba budha dha tai a bhi ṣiñtsa skemi/ zhes brjod par bya/ 'di ni chu'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /rol mo la sogs cod pan la—/ /rin 'byung sa bon saṃ las ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma bskyed bya ste/ /snga ma bzhin du mchod par bya/ /de nyid cod pan rang bzhin te/ /tshor ba'i phung po'i bdag nyid do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi bo ni/ /rdo rje can gyis de bsam moske/ /oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya ①sidhi pa ra ma yo gi shwa ri/ ka pā la mā la dha dhiri ni ru rnyi ⑤pre ye shra rjosha na was ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba ni cod pan gyi dbang ngo / /dz+rī ⑦las pad 'byung 'du shes te/ /bde gshegs 'od dpag med pa ni/ /rdo rje la ni bskyed bzung ste/ /slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par sbyin/ /sangs rgyas he ru ka sogs kyis/ /de ring spyod la dbang bskur bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /legs par grub phyir rdo rje zung ⑧/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /khaṃ las byung ba'i dril bu ⑨ni/ /don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin te/ /'du byed dngos po'i dril bu 'di/ /'di ni lag pa g.yon par sbyinarka/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab sgra yi rjes 'gror dran/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung ⑩/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /ces bya ba ni dril bu'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /dpa' bo lag na rdo dril ⑪can/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mchog gi mchog /rang bzhin mdzes shing dga' ba mo/ /phyag rgya chen pos byin brlabs pa'o⑫/ /'di bdag po'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs kyis/ /slob ma'i spyi bor lag bzhag ste/ /rdo 14—775

rje dril bu rdo rjer bcas/ /des kyang spyi bor gzhag ①bya ste/ /gzugs kyi phung po'i rang bzhin gyi①/ /rdo rje can gyis ming dbang bskur/ /oṃ uhoḥkhyod dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa yin no zhes bya ba ni ming gi skedabang bskur ba'o/ / de la ming ni/⑦ dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje dang /dpe med pa'i rdo rje dang / bde ba'i rdo rje dang / mnyam pa'i rdo rje dang /rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje dang / bde ba chen po'i rdo rje dang / rdo rje me dang /rdo rje sems dpa'i rdo rje dang / yan lag med pa'i rdo rje dang / ye shes rdo rje dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje'i zhal zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /mi bskyod pa'i ming ni/ bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / rnam par sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang /gnyis med rdo rje dang / 'dzum pa'i rdo rje dang / gzhi med pa'i rdo rje dang / mi phyed pa'i rdo rje dang / dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / bsgyings pa'i ⑤rdo rje dang / rang byung rdo rje dang / zhe sdang rdo rje dang / dgyes pa'i rdo rje dang /rtse ba'i rdo rje dang / thugs kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi ming ni/ rnam snang rdo rje dang / gti mug rdo rje dang / oṃ ka ra badz+ra dang / rtag pa'i rdo rje dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rdo rje dang / sangs rgyas rdo rje dang / sku'i rdo rje la sogs pa'o//snang ba mtha' yas kyi ming ni/ chags pa'i rdo rje dang / rnam par gzigs pa'i rdo rje dang / chos rdo rje dang / shes rab myu gu'i rdo rje dang / bde ba rdo rje'i myu gu dang / brtse ba'i myu gu'i ④rdo rje dang / mchog tu dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / gsung rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ming ni/ rin chen rdo rje dang / yid bzhin nor bu'i rdo rje dang / nam 14—776

mkha'i rdo rje dang / rdo rje gzi brjid dang / rdo rje chen po dang / rdo rje nyi ma dang / rdo rje yid ces bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /don yod grub pa'i ming ni / don yod rdo rje dang / dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje dang / dam tshig rdo rje dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i rdo rje dang / rdo rje las dang / rdo rje srung ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa rnams so/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ①bud med kyi ming ni/rdo rje chags pa ma dang / rdo rje glu ma dang / /rdo rje sgeg mo dang / rdo rje shugs can ma dang / rdo rje yum dang / rdo rje kong ka na dang / rdo rje bsgyings ma'o//mi bskyod pa'i ming ni/ rdo rje bdag med ma dang / rdo rje bzhad pa ma dang /rdo rje phreng ba ma dang / rdo rje myu gu ma dang / rdo rje mā ma tī zhes bya ba'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi btsun mo'i ming ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang / rdo rje go rī ②ma dang / rdo rje bzhad pa mo dang / rdo rje sprin ma dang / rdo rje spyan ma la sogs pa'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ming ni/ rin chen 'byung ma dang / rdo rje dra ba ma dang / rdo rje dbugs 'byung ma dang / rdo rje 'bar ba ma dang / rdo rje phreng ba ma zhes bya ba'o/ /snang ba mtha' yas kyi ming ni/ rdo rje chags pa mo ①dang / rdo rje glu ma dang / rdo rje ro langs ma dang / rdo rje blo ldan ma dang / rdo rje bzhad pa mo dang / rdo rje gos dkar mo zhes bya'o/ /don yod grub pa'i ming ni/ rdo rje snying po ma dang / rdo rje sgyu ma dang / rdo rje 'ching ba mo dang du/ rdo rje sgol ma zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni rnam dag dngos / /dbang lnga thob pa'i rgyu las ni/ /ma rig pa ni rnam spangs te/ /ye shes lnga ni rim gyis yin/ /blo ldan ston brjod rim pa yis/ /de nas sngags kyi ⑤dbang bskur zhing //14—777
