'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /te ru ka yi lag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu chongs/ /te ru ka yi brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ①ra ya mi/ oṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥzhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa'o/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung phyag rgya ni/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u/ /dpa' bo chen po sbyin gyis gzung / /spyod pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa'o/ /rdo rje can gyi phyag g.yon byusaske/ /chos gos ge sar nas bzung ⑧nas/ /g.yas pas mi 'jigs sbyin byas te/ /slob ma la ni dbugs dbyung ①sbyin/ /sangs rgyas kun khrod 'dir shog cig /khyod ni dpa' bo kun rang bzhin/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung zhes bya ba'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan to/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i ming gis de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur/ /bhur bhu pa swaḥ/ phyag rgya'i rgya ni rnam lnga dang / /rtag tu rdo rje'i brtul zhugs bzung rjo/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'uske/ /zung shig zung shig dpal chen po/ /rdo rje rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /dril bu'i sgra ni 'khrol ba dang / /tshangs skud rang bzhin rnal 'byor dang / /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rnal 'byor snod⑤/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung phyag rgya ni/ /phyi rol nang du yang dag gnas/ /khams gsum gyi ni rgyal chen po/ /gtso bo dpal ldan yon tan gtso/ /thams cad bdud sogs las rgyal nas/ /khyod ni mchog gi grong du gshegs/ /zhes bya ba ni lung bstan pa'o/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang chen po//dpa' po chen pos bdag la stsol/ /'gro ba mtshan ma med bya'i phyir/ /de nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bdag nyid ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /bskul ba'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /rnams 14—778

kyis mchod bkur rgya chen po/ /thogs pa rnams ni spyan drangs te/ /ye shes bdud rtsi chus gang ba'i/ /lag na bum thogs bde gshegs kyi①/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang gis bkrus par/ /dpa' bos rnam par bsam par bya /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /'jig rten kun kyis phyag byas pa①/ /gsang ba gsum gnas 'byung ba yi/ /sangs rgyas kun kyis ①sbyin par bya/ /dpa' bo kun gyis byen brlabs pa'iX/ /de nas mi bskyod cod pan gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā ⑤hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor mas ni ci 'dod par/ /kun nas rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /de nas me tog mchod sogs kyis/ /dpa' bo de ni mchod par bya/ /de nas gnod sbyin rdo rje can/ /slob mas phyag 'tshal thal mo sbyar/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su dmigs byas te/ /rtag pa'i gnang ba sbyin par bya/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /kun nas sems can thams cad la/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ltar chos kyi gnas su ni/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /las rnams gzhug rjopar bya ba ni/ /ci rigs par ni shes par bya /tshigs bcad rim pa lnga yis ni/ /khyab bdag gi ni gnang ba sbyin/ /rnal 'byor de nyid rig pa la/ /bya ba ma yin cung zad med/ /dpa' bo de nyid shes de nas/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la spyod/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /rang nyid lha mo kun rang bzhin/ /ci rigs par ni shes par bya//de phyir dngos po kun gyis ni/ /bdag nyid dpal ldan khrag 'thung mchog /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos/ /sems can ⑦gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs skete/ /de ltar 'jig rten gsum shes nas/ /sems can don ni 14—779

mnyam med kyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam spyor ba'i/ /sdom pa nyams par khyed byed pa/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin/ /lha dag dang ni mi dag dang / /de bzhin rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /de dag la ni snying rings na/ /snying las khrag chen 'thung ba yin//sems can khams ni ma lus pa/ /srid pa shin tu dag bya'i phyir/ /mi 'gog chos nyid sbyor ba yis/ /rtag pa nyid du bsgrub par bya/ /bdag gi ngo bo yongs spong ba/ /dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung ①ste/ /ci bde bas ni bder bzung na/ /'di las ma 'ongs sangs rgyas yin/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod thams cad la/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /sdig pa med kyis khyed ma 'jigs/ /dam tshig shin du 'da' dka' ba'o/ /sgrub pa gcig pu gcig la spyod/ /lhan cig spyod dang rjes la spyod/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med/ /yang dag nyid kyis rtag tu bsten④/ /slob ma'i bya ba byas de nas/ /bla ma la ni yon dbul zhing / /dngos po kun gyis phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mdza' bo kun kyang bsdu bar bya/ /zhes bya ba ni phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang ngo / /skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs dang mgon/ /khyab bdag sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /thugs rje chen po rgyu med pa/ /mgon med mgon med bka' drin mdzod—/ /gang zhig bdag chen khyod kyis ni/ /bdag la phan pa bde mdzod cig/'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs su ni/ /bying ba bdag la 'dir skyabs mdzod/ /de la 'di ni rim pa yin/ /slob dpon dpal ldan stobs chen la/ /mtshan chen dbe+en pa'i gnas su ni/ /chung ma sring mo bu mo rnams/ /mkhas pa yis ni dbul bar bya/ /phyag rgya dam tshig bsrung 'gyur ba/ /gang dang gang du rnyed 14—780

'gyur bas/ /snyoms par zhugs te gang skyes pa/ /ma skyes pa yi rang bzhin te//lha mo thams cad 'dus pa ni/ /dpa' bo thams cad gshegs pa ste/ /gang zhig kun nas byang chub sems/ /gsang ba des ni dbang bskur bya/ /'di ni dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i①/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ /khams lnga zhu ba'i rtsi sman 'di②/ /bde ba chen po yang dag nos/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras po sngon/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs rnams kyis bkrus/ /byang chub sems ni mdzes pa yis/ /de bzhin bu khyod bkru bar bya/ /e ma bde chen bde ba zhes/ /bla mas bka' gnang bsgrub par bya/ /slob ma'i rnam par rtog spong ba①/ /pad+ma la gnas rjospyad par bya/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'o / /⑤rang gi byin rlabs reg pa'am/ /gzhan gyi grub mtha' gzhan yin te/ /mchog ni rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /de phyir ston pas gtad par bya/ /lha mo phyag rgya chen po 'di/ /bde ba dpag med ster ba mo/ /rnam pa kun du bus bzung ④ste/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa gyis/ /lha mo des ni gnang byin ste/ /dpa' bo bla na med pa'i bu/ /byang chub sa bon la spyod pa/ /dpa' bo khyod ni spro 'am ci/ /rigs lnga las ni nges byung ba'i/ /rig ma la ni gus mchod dang / /bshang gci khu ba khrag la sogs/ /da lta nyid du za nus sam/ /gzhan yang dam tshig gang dang gang / /ji ltar 'dod pa bus smros shig /ji ltar 'dod pa'i dam tshig la/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /rtag tu bud med cis mi gus/ /pad+mo las ni cis mi mchod/ /de nas lha mo de mnyes te/ /skra bshig gcer bur bya ba dang / /pad+ma gsal bar byas nas ni/ /bha ga mok+ṣa hoḥzhes brjod/ /bkas gsang pad+ma'i dbus gnas ⑦pa'o/ /rtsa ni bde ba babs pa mo/ /14—781

byams pas sor mor bsgul ①bya ste/ /lce yis de nas dga' gnas bya/ /lhan cig skyes dga' byed pa mo/ /dam pa'i lha mo des bzung ②ste/ /mchog tu dga' bas myos byas nas/ /lhan cig skyes dga' dor mi bya/ /sbyang bar ma byas dor 'gyur na/ /slar yang phyir ni spyod par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma de/ /dga' mgu yid ni dgyes 'gyur te/ /spyi bor yan lag bzhag nas ni/ /rjes su gnang ba sbyin par bya/ /nga ①nas gzung ste bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob par/ /sems can kun la rmi lam ltar/ /kun gyi dngos po'i don kyis shig /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'o / /0slob dpon la sogs bye brag gis/ /dbang ni rnam pa bzhir brjod pa/ /chu la sogs pa'i bye brag gis/ /bzhi po de dag bcu bzhi yin/ /'thad pa de dag yongs bcas pas/ /rim pa 'di bzhin dam pa rnams/ /rigs pa 'di ni dor gyur na/ /thams cad dag gis sangs mi rgya/ /brtul zhugs gong nas gong gyur pa/ /bu yis rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyod/ /ces bya ba ni rig pa'i brtul zhugs so/ /chu nas phyir mi ldog pa'i mthar/ /slob dpon gyi ⑤ni dbang du brjod/ /lhag ma ji lta de ltar te/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas//'pho ba'i rim pa'i bye brag ni/ /dpa' bo'i bdag nyid las shes bya/ /dbang ni rnam pa bzhir brjod pa/ /ji ltar brtul zhugs can gus pas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab chos thob ste/ /de ni skal ba can du 'gyur/ /phyi dang nang du legs rdzogs pa/ /phyi dang nang gi rang bzhin te/ /rang bzhin chos ni thams cad la/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes brjod/ /snang ba med cing mi gsal ba/ /skye ba med cing gnas med pa/ /lnga yi de nyid rdzogs pa ste/ /rim gyis lhan skyes zad pa 014—782

med—/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' med pa/ /'gro ba brtan dang g.yo bdag nyid / /bdag med pa ru bdag med gnas/ / zhes dbang bzhi pa'o / /①dpa' bo chen po shes rab kyis/ /slob ma'i bya ba rdzogs nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol 'thon byas te/ /cho ga sbyin sreg gis rdzogs bya/ /be+er zhugs rgyal ba la bzod gsol/ /g.yon pa yis ni dril dkrol te/ /mchod pa dang ni bstod par bya/ /g.yas pa yis ni rdo rje gsor/ /tshigs bcad kyis ni gshegs su gsol/ /khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol/ /lha yi 'khor lo gshegs nas kyang / /sngags pas rdul tshon bsdu bya ste/ /gtsang ma'i snod du bzhag nas ni/ /chu bo'i rgyun la dor bar bya/ /oṃ pi li ki li hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ rdul tshon dor ba'i sngags so/ /dkyil 'khor rnam par bri ba'i sa④/ /de nas dris ni nyer byugs te/ /'byung po yi ni tshogs bcas la/ /dngos grub phyir ni gtor ma sbyin/ /oṃ in+da/dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+ṣa/ bhū ①ta/ bsno/ bā rjo.u/ rak+ṣa⑤/ tsan+da/ su dz+dza/ mā da/ pabla/ ta la pā tā le/ aṣ+ṭa/ sabe+e swā dhihā/ i rda ba dzi / bhu4/ dzigha/ phul+la/ byu ⑦pa/ māṃ sa pit+ta⑧/ a sabe+e/kadz+dza—/ sā da/ kharnyi⑨/ khu ṇi/ pheḍa/ gā da⑩/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā r+ṇa ⑪ār+yanut+pan+da ⑫tāta oṃ uhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gtor ma sbyin nas slar yang ni/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā ⑫la ya/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ shā shwa to me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ sarba ṅgarnyismre ⑫pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me 14—783

tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ bha ga bān ①sarba ta thā ga ta/ z-i da ya mi gyi tiṣ+ṭha dze+emā me sum̐ ①tsa/ baṭī ④bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa yas⑤muḥ/rab gnas dang ni sbyin sreg dang / /nges par dkyil 'khor yan lag ste—/ /dkyil 'khor de ma thag pa ni/ /sbyin sreg rab gnas brjod par bya//de nyid bcu shes slob dpon gyis/ /rab tu gnas par byar 'os te/ /gza' dhidang skar ma bzang sogs la/ /mdzes pa yis ni shes par bya/ /mgul rgyan dpung rgyan rkang gdub dang / /rna rgyan dang ni lag gdub ste/ /gser ni man cha las byas pa'i/ /sor gdub tsam ni bcing bar bya/ /thog mar re zhig slob dpon kyis⑦/ /dril bu lag par dkrol bya zhing / /g.yas pas rdo rje gsor byas te/ /cho ga de bzhin gtor ma bzhin/ /ba yi rnam lnga shing shun lnga/ /khyad par du ni dri lnga yis/ /lus can rnams ni bkru bya ste/ /mchod pa la sogs sngon bzhin dbul/ /dgongs kar yul nges shes pa ste/ /lhag par gnas par bya ba yin/ /dung chos chu yis bsang gtor gyis/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs bkru byas te/ /shin tu 'jam pa'i gos kyis ni/ /lus rnams phyi bar bya ba yin/ /ji lta'i lha rnams dmigs nas ni/ /lha yi gzugs rnams nam mkha' ste/ /'od zer gtso bos rnam spros nas/ /de yang lcags kyu'i rnam pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs kun spyan drangs te/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs thugs ka ru/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gzhug par bya//ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /dga' ldan la ni rab gnas dang / /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums ji bzhin/ /ji ltar gzugs brnyan 'dir bzhugs shig /gru bzhi pa la khru bzhi pa'o/ /de nas lhag gnas khang pa dang / /ring ba nyid 14—784

du mi bya ste/ /dpangs su khru do mtho ba ni/ /brtan par legs brkos ①skal ldan kyi/ /mkhas pa yi ni stegs bsdu bya/ /shar phyogs mngon phyogs 'dug byas te/ /lha 'di la ni mngon phyogs bya/ /rdo rje dril bu lag thogs te/ /de ma thag tu gtor ma sbyin/ /ye shes 'od zer sbyor ba yis/ /de nas lha mo mchod spros te/ /stegs bu'i gdan la gnas pa yis/ /lha rnams bkru bar bya ba yin/ /bris sku glegs bam la sogs pa/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs ji lta bar—/ /me long gzugs brnyan bkru bya ste/ /de las gzhan la dngos su yis//sngags pa rnams kyis mnyam gzhag ste/ /mdun nas lha rnams bkru bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya bi sho dha de ④swā hā/ lha rnams lha yi bdag nyid kyi/ /slar yang dris byugs bkru bya ste/ /bkra shis glu dang rol mo dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs gar mdzes pa'o/ /yo byad rnams ci nus pa ni/ /bsogs te rgyal po'i dbang bskur ro/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol te/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis bkru bar bya//oṃ sarba ta thā ①ga ta a rnyi ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ mkhas pas gser gyi thur ma ni—/ /man cha tsam gyi tshad byas la/ /oṃ ni mig la bsgom par bya 'di yis spyan ni dbye bar bya/ /oṃ tsakyu tsakyu sa man+ta tsakyu sho dha ni swā hā/ mchod yon me tog sogs mchod nas/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha rjote badzi swā hā/ 'di ni stong du bzlas byas te/ /rab tu gnas pa'i rim pa'o/ /gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing / /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi ster⑤//las rnams thams cad rab bsgrub phyir/ /sbyin sreg las rnams brtsam par bya/ /14—785

sbyin sreg med par gyur pas ni/ /dngos grub 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ /de phyir brtson pa chen po yis/ /sngags pas sbyin sreg las rnams bya/ /chu skyes rnam pa'i thab khung du/ /las rnams thams cad shis pa ste/ /khru gang tsam kyi kham bor te/ /sngags pas rab ①tu mnyam par bya/ /'og tu bskor bar bya ba'i tshad/ /khru byed kyi ④ni tshad yin te/ /brkos gapa'i dbus su pad+ma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad legs mdzes pa yi/ /de dag sngags pas thab khung steng / /sor bzhi dor bar byas nas ni/ /zheng dang dpangs su ④de bzhin te/ /sor bzhi yi ni tshad du bya/ /thab khung las byung rgyas pa yi/ /'dab ma'i rnam pa kha khyer ⑤te/ /kha khyer gyi ni phyi rol dang / /pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor bar bya/ /sngags brjod pa yi sa la ni/ /kha dog dri dang ro rnams kyis/ /gal te dngos grub 'dod gyur na/ /sngags pa yis ni bsku bar bya/ /thab khung dbus kyi pad+ma la/ /mtshan ma dgu ni bri bya ste/ /de dbus rdo rje bri bya zhing / /'dab brgyad du ni bum pa bzhin/ /kun nas gru bzhi mnyam par ni/ /shes rab can gyis tshon thig gdabarjo/ /sgo bzhi la sogs dang ldan zhing / /phyogs rnams su ni mtshan ma bri/ /pad+ma nags kyi lcug ma dang / /bgrang phreng dang ni spyi blugs dang / /ri dwags pags pa de bzhin te/ /shar gyi snam bu dag la bri//rtse gsum zla ba phyed pa dang / /rgyal mtshan dang ni ril ba dang / /de bzhin du ni mig dang ni/ /lho phyogs snam bu dag la bri/ /'khor lo dung dang gtun shing dang / /ral gri phub ⑦dang lnga pa ste/ /chu yi phyogs kyi snam bu la/ /sngags pa yis ni mtshan ma bri/ /mda' dang dril bu ba dan dang / /rma bya ra skyes de bzhin te/ /gnod sbyin byi na'i phyogs dag tu/ /mtshan ma lnga ni shes 14—786

rab can/ /mchod yon sngon sogs sngon bzhin du/ /mnyam par gzhag shāpa thams cad bya/ /dngul dang gser dang zangs rnams dang / /lcags las rim bzhin dgang gegazar te/ /med na mchod yon shing bu la/ /mkhas pa yis ni dgang gzar bya/ /mtsho skyes 'dab ma'i rnam pa la/ /yu ba sor ni nyi shu bzhi/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyi tshad ni/ /ji ltar rigs par 'gyur ba yin/ /de yi rtse mo gru bzhi la/ /rgyar ni sor bzhi pa yin te/ /kha ni sor gnyis zabs su yang / /sor gnyis bar ni shes par bya/ /rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa yis/ /dbus kyi cha ni byin gyis brlabs/ /ro yi rgyun ni lam yang yin/ /sor gcig gi ni tshad yin te/ /yu mthar rdo rje rin chen la/ /tshad ni sor drug pa yin no/ /drugs 1gzar khru gang tshad yin te/ /sboms su sor phyed pa yin no//kha ni pad+ma'i 'dab pyadabyibs te/ /zabs su sor gcig brko bar bya/ /rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i/ /yu mthar rdo rje rin chen te/ /de nas thab khung g.yog bya ste/ /chu shing 'dab ma mdzes pa'am/ /shin tu 'jam pa'i gos kyis ni—/ /thab khung rab tu g.yog par bya/ /de nas ku sha dgram bya ste/ /rtsa bar bcas shing ma nyams pa/ /kha dog ljang zhing gsar pa yi/ /ku sha sgrub pa pos ⑤brkos nas/ /thog mar shar du dgram par bya/ /gnyis pa lho yi phyogs su ste/ gsum pa nub kyi phyogs su yin/ /bzhi pa khya byang gi phyogs su'o/ /oṃ i mi ku sha shu pa ti bh+yaḥ byu ta blu ma pa wi tre te/ /budhe dhas+thā ⑦ saṃ gha a ma ri zhu/pra ti dzhai saṃ dza dgar pa ⑨shārnyi ku ru ban+tu swā hā/ ku sha dgram pa'i cho ga'o / //tshu u dusmra ⑪ra pa la sha /a mra a shat+tha kas+thār+ya/ n+ya ⑫gro dha la sogs pa yi/ /'o ma can shing 'dab bcas te/ /mnyam par mtheb rtse'i tshad tsam la/ /rtse mo 14—787

sbrang dang 'o ma dang / /mar gyis sbags pa nyid dang ni/ /dkar po'i dri yis legs byugs pa'i/ /yam shing nyer bsdogs byas nas ni/ /zhi ba la ni sbyin sreg bya/ /rnying ①pa dang ni 'dab zeg ②dang / /gas pa dang ni 'bus zos dang / /de la sogs pa'i skyon rnams ni/ /shes rab can kyis spang bar bya /nas dang 'o ma zho dang sbrang / /mar dang til dang yos 'bog dang / /mar gyis legs par sbangs ①pa ste/ /yang na mngar gsum gyis sbangs shing / /ser po'i dri yis dhibyugs pa'o/ /til dang zho zan mar ldan dag /bil ba yi ni 'bras bu dang / /sā rjolu dan du la dag dang / /zho yi spris ma dag dang ni/ /pad+ma nā dhig ge sar sogs/ /rgyas pa la ni sbyin sreg bya/ /tsan tsa ka dang a sho ka /wa ku la la sogs pa yi/ /yam shing sor lnga'i tshad tsam ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni shes par bya/ /sgyur po me tog dmar po dang / /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /gzhan yang rang gi rtog pa las/ /gsungs pa dbang la sbyin sreg bya/ /nim pa dang ni seng ldeng dang / /ba la ta ka dag dang ni/ /myos byed kyi ni shing bu dang / /kha dang tshwa dang skyur shing rnams/ /drag tu ston pa byas nas ni/ /rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba yi/ /sor bcu pa yi tshad tsam la/ /dug dang khrag dang mar khyas byug /pal ka yi ni mar khu dang / /khrag dang tshwa dang skye tshe dang / /nim pa yi ni lo ma dang / /dur khrod thal ba rkang ral ⑦dang / /rnga mo bong bu'i rtug pa dang / /skra dang zhag dang kha la sogs/ /tsher ma mi rus phye ma dang / /spu dang sha sogs ji snyed rdzas/ /dug dang khrag dang tshwa dang ni/ /skye tshe myos byed khu ba yis/ /rdzas 'di dag ni mkhas pa yis/legs pa nyid du byug par bya/ /sol ba dang ni thal ba dang / bub ⑧mas 14—788

dgra yi 1gzugs byas te/ /gtub cing gtub par byas nas ni/ /mngon spyod phyir ni sbyin sreg bya/ /mchod yon shing nyid dag dang ni/ /a shwaṅga la sogs pa'i shing / /zhi ba yi ni sbyin sreg bya/ /rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg shing bu'o/ /snum zhing sgyur la me tog bcas/ /dbang la shis pa'i shing bu yin/ /tsha zhing tsher bcas dri nga'i shing / /dur khrod kyi ni shing bu dang / /rnga mo bong bu'i rtug pa ni/ /mngon spyod kyi ni shing bu yin/ /oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭa u pa shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru swā hā / zhes bya ba ni zhi ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭi swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni rgyas pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ka ra ya swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni dbang gi sngags so / /oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūṃ/ kṛt+na 2kṛṇ+ḍi hūṃ/ kṛ1 pa ya kṛṭ+wā 4pa ya hūṃ/ā na ya ho bha ga bān 5bir+ya rā dza hūṃ/ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba ni mngon spyod kyi sngags so/ /'bar ba'i dbus kyi dkyil na ni/ /chu yi me yi mtshan nyid ni/ /dung dang kun+da zla ba bzhin6/ /spyan gsum ral pa'i thor tshugs 'chang / /phyag bzhi g.yas dbyig mi 'jigs dang / /g.yon pa bgrang phreng spyi blugs 'dzin/ /dkar dang rgyan can tshangs sgud can/ /lus kun gyi ni yan lag las/ /bdud rtsi yi ni rang bzhin kyi/ /'od zer dkar po rab 'phro ba/ /zhi ba la ni bsam par bya/ /de bzhin du 'bar ba'i dbus su sa'i dkyil 'khor la / lo las byung ba'i rang bzhin rgyas pa'i me lha sbyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ phyag g.yas pa dag na dbyig pa dang mchog sbyin 'dzin byung /g.yon pa dag na bgrang phreng dang bye blugs 'dzin pa7/ ser po'i rgyan dang mchod phyir thogs pa 'chang zhing 'od zer ser po 'phro ba/ sems can ma lus pa'i stobs dang / grags pa dang / bkra shis pa rab tu 'gengs pa rgyas pa 14—789

la bsgom par bya'o1sna/ /de bzhin du 'bar ba'i dbus su ram̐ las byung ba dbang gi me/ nyi ma gzhon nu ltar dmar ba 'od zer snadamar po 'phro ba/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa phyag bzhi pa g.yas na dbyug tho dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon na zhags pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ dmar po'i gos dang rgyan 'chang zhing phreng ba dang dris nye bar byugs pa/ mchod phyir thogs pa 'chang ba/ dbang la 'dod pas bsgom par bya'o/ /de bzhin du 'bar ba'i dbus su rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge ram̐ las byung ba'i me du ba'i mdog can/ spyan gsum pa zur gyis gzigs pa/ skra ser po gyen du badze+es pa shin tu khros shing spyan dmar ba/ mche ba gcigs shing 5bzhin bsnyer 6ba / 'khrugs shing cher 'jigs pa/ /rgyan nag pos brgyan cing mchod phyir thogs pa 'chang ba/ 'od zer nag po 'phro bas srid pa gsum khyab pa phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas na dbyug tho dang ral gri thogs pa/ g.yon na zhags pa dang spyi drugs 'dzin pa/ rlung gi me mngon spyod la bsgom 7par bya'o/ /de nas lus bkru dri zhim byug /ji ltar 'dod pa'i rgyan bgos te/ /zhi dang rgyas dang de bzhin dbang / /gsad pa yi ni las rnams la/ /ji ltar las dang rjes mthun par/ /blo ldan kyis ni sngon bzhin brjod/ /sems can kun la phan brtson pas/ /ji ltar 'dod pa thams cad bya/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo sngon bzhin du/ /sngags pa yis ni bya ba yin/ /shar phyogs su ni mngon phyogs dang / /de bzhin du ni byang du yin/ /nub phyogs su ni mngon phyogs te / /de bzhin du ni lho phyogs yin/ /zhi ba la sogs la 'dug nas/ /las bzhi po ni bya ba yin/ /de nas las dang rjes su mthun pa'i tshul kyis phyi 74byed790

rol kyi me dgug ste/ rdo rje gnod sbyin kyi sngags kyi bzlas pa'i chu ku sha'i rtse mos blangs nas bskor zhing bsang gtor lan gsum kyi bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes su gtsang zhing skams pa'i rtswa ①dang lhan cig pa'i shing la rlung yab kyis me rab tu sbar bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dzā la dzā la ⑤hūṃ zhes bya ba ni sbar ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes bya ba ni rdo rje 1 gnod sbyin gyi sngags so/ /dam tshig sems dpa' brjod pa bzhin/ /thab khung dbus su de bsams te/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang ba/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas bya ba yin/ /g.yas pa mi 'jigs rgya byas te/ /mthe bong gis ni srin lag gi/ /rtsa ba'i tshigs la reg byas te/ /yang dang yang du bskul bar bya/ /'di nyid kyi ni phyag rgya ni/ /me 'gugs pa yi mchog yin no/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs mgon po che/ /sangs rgyas bla med las bla med/ /dgang blugs 'di ni bzhes nas su/ /de nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /de nas me lha spyan drangs pa/ /dam tshig sems dpa' dang gcig tu byas te mchod yon la sogs pa phul nas/ byin pa gnyis kyi nang du bzhag la/ blugs gzar gyis dgang blugs gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sngags kyis dbul bar bya'o/ /yang dgang gzar khengs par byas la/ de'i steng du blugs gzar bzhag ste/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang mthe'u chung sbrel te/ lhag ma'i sor mo yu ba'i steng du bzhag la mar gyi dgang blugs dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas yo byad thams cad sngar brjod pa'i sngags kyis sbyin sreg bya zhing / /sngags kyi bcu chas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas bsreg rdzas dang / me tog la sogs pa dang / bshos gtsang la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o/ /rdzogs pa'i mthar oṃ hriḥzhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis mar gyi 14—791

dgang blugs nyi shu rtsa gcig gis gzi byin bskyed par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la gang ba'i dgang blugs dbul bar bya zhing / mchod yon la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o//de nas bstod cing yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub la gsol ba btab ste bzod nga/ gsol la/ oṃ badz+ra 1muḥzhes brjod de steng du gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol/ /ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol nas/ sprul pa'i me ni mchod byas te/ /bsang gtor la sogs phul byas nas/ /bsreg rdzas lhag ma bsreg par bya/ /de nas gang ba'i dgang drugs dbul te/ mchod yon la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o / /de'i rjes su yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub gsol ba btab ste/ bzod par gsol la/ dza hi dza hi zhes bya bas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /sngon du brjod pa'i rim bzhin du/ / ā radze+e hoḥ2zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /'di yi mthar ni tshogs 'khor lo/ /sngags pa yis ni bya ba ste/ /bsdus pas dngos grub kun 'grub pa/ /cung zad bdag gis brjod par bya/ /nyin re 'am ni zla ba re/ /yang na lo re dag tu ni/ /sna tshogs ston mor ldan pa la/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bya ba yin/ /dam tshig sdom pa shes pa yi/ /rang gi slob ma bla mar bcas/ /dam tshig dbus su mdor bsdu ste/ /pad+ma bde ba chen po 'di/ /thog mar rim bzhin bsgom bya ste//'byung po rnams la gtor ma gtang / /kun kyang dam tshig bdag nyid can/ /rang rang phyag rgyar ldan byas te/ /dus min yid kyis brtags nas ni/ /der ni rim pa bzhin du 'dug /me tog spos dang de bzhin me/ /dri dang 14—792

phreng ba na bza' dang / /ji ltar dmigs par gyur pa 1yi/ /bza' dang btung ba dbul bar bya/ /rim bzhin mchod pa byas nas ni/ /rang kha 'dam skyes thab khung du/ /lag pa blugs gzar tha snyad kyis/ /snod las dgang blugs dbul bar bya/ /nang gi bdag nyid sbyin sreg gis/ /lhag pa'i lha ni yid 'ong ba/ /dga' zhing bde bas spro ba yin / /dngos po kun gyis mnyes par bya/ /snod ni a yis khengs bya ste/ /mkhas pa yis ni so sor dbul/ /bla ma la gus dad cing sgrin / /thams cad yid 'ong bzod ldan zhing / /thams cad mtshungs par khrims ldan pa'i/ /slob ma las kyi rdo rjer 'dod/ /rdo ltar rnal 'byor pa kun gyis/ /spyod lam la ni mnyam gzhag 4ste/ /skam par gyur kyang brgya lam yang / /snod ni skam par mi bya'o/ /'thab pa dang ni smod pa dang / ku co'i sgra ni 'jigs pa dang / /shin tu nga rgyal dang ldan pa/ /tshogs kyi dbus su mi 5bya'o/ /slob dpon kyi ni bka' min par/ /glu dang gar ni mi bya zhing / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i gtso bo yis/ /gang la bka' gnang byin gyur na/ /de yis myur du dgongs pa ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' sbyin bya/ /brda dang brda yi tha snyad ni/ /sgrub pa po yis shes bya ste/ /shin tu rgyas par spyod bsdus las/ /'phags pa lha yis bris pa yin/ /bcom ldan 6dpal ldan rin chen rdo rje dang / /blo bzangs ma yi bka' yis rjes bzung bas/ /rnam pa sna tshogs pa yi don 7rnams bstan pa yin/ /srid pa shin tu 'jigs las sems can sgrol bar shog /rwargyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par spyor ba/ mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sems can thams cad kyi bde 74—793

ba skyed ma zhes bya ba/ kha che'i mkhas pa chen po shes bya mtha' dag la mkhas pa dpal rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dpal ldan u rgyan du sbyangs pa/ /mkhas pa ye shes rdo rje dang / /skad bsgyur rteganyan ban bsod de yis/ /bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab/ /dpal ldan mnyam sbyor rgyud chen gyis/ /dge ba shel sgong ltar thob pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar gnas shog/ //bsdur mchan/742 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈nge 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dag/ /rgyud kyi rgyal ngo/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mkha' 'gro ma bde mchog gi dkyil chog bzhugs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 4〈〈pe〉〉dzā/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatung /743 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ragazung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stags/ 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉stanang sdang ldan pa/ zi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkab/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dang /744 1〈〈pe 〉masar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhug mon/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazugs pa ra / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsā ru brjod/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ramang /745 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zod/ na〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mdo tha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉grag 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—gshanag 746 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉stangs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snga/ 〈〈pe 〉〉skyer shing / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(gas/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga zhag 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra shad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hri/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma /747 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyis/ 〈〈snar 〉ra zhag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpo'i ru/ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mas/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉to/ 6〈〈pe 〉gta/ 〈〈snar 〉staX/ 7〈〈pe 〉stanas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zad/ sgyu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 1 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sngag 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉le/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rang / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dri/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉grwa kṛ7 pa tsha tu/14byed794

༄ga /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra satwa no bi ka /bod skad du/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ gang zhig phan mdzad skyob pa'i mgon/ /thams cad don kun ston mdzad cing / /yang dag dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i mchog /rigs bdag sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal//rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i cho ga dag /rab tu sbyangs pas grol gyur cing / /de nas ye shes bzang po nyid/ /don mchog gsang ba bshad par bya/ /dam tshig 'khor lo rdzogs byas te/ /phyag rgya'i yan lag rnam sbyangs pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi cha shas dag /nye bar sbyor ba'i yul du 'gyur/ /sa phyogs mngon par dga' ba ru/ /bde ba'i stan la nyer 'dug ste/ /'gro rnams kun dgrol bsam pa yis/ /khrus rnams cho ga bzhin du spyad⑤/ /dus gsum phyogs cha'i bye brag gis/ /drug gi chos rnams rang bzhin med/ /der snang rtog pa'i cha 14—801

bral zhing / /'byung tshogs khams rnams ma skyes pa'o/ /'gro ba'i rigs rnams tha dad kyang / /mtshan nyid rten cing 'brel ba'i rgyun/ /bya dang byed tshogs yul can nyid/ /kun brtags ①ye shes chen pos non/ /thugs rje snang ba 'od ldan pa'i/ /kun 'byung rin chen phung po'i tshogs/ /rab tu sbyar bas khyab mdzad cing / /nye bar ston pa'i bdag nyid do/ /thugs kyi sngags kyis gsal byas te/ /kun nas spro ④zhing bsdus pa'i mthus/ /rdo rje sa gzhi la brten pa'i/ /ra ①ba gur sogs mtshon char bcas/ /shin tu gsal ba'i snang ba las/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya rdzogs pa nyid/ /gnyen po'i ye shes stobs dang ldan/ /'gro gnas nyon mongs rnam par dag /rigs mchog 'khor lo bzang po'i tshogs/ /kun nas bsdus pas brtan pa dag /rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid sku/ /'od 'bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgeg dang bcas/ /rin chen rgyan sogs kun gyis spras/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin/ /g.yon pa kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bu 'khrol/ /dbu rgyan rtse bran ④lnga yis brgyan/ /byang chub sems kyi cha lugs kyis/ /'od 'bar kha dog sna lnga'i mdangs/ /stod smad na bzas rnam par bklubs④/ /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /nyi zla gsal ba'i gdan dang bcas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad phun sum tshogs/ /rigs kyi sprul pas kun don mdzad/ /gnas gsum yi ge'i mtshan ma las/ /spro bsdus rigs kyi sems dpa' dag /rang gi cha lugs phreng sngags dhibacas/ /thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' nyid/ /ting 'dzin 'khor lo rdzogs pa'i gnas/ /yang dag bskul ba'i byin rlabs ⑦kyis—/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur zhing / /rigs lnga'i cod pan 14—802

rnam par mdzes/ /dam tshig phyag rgya rdzogs pa las/ /ye shes byin brlabs brtan par gzhug /lha mo mchod pas mnyes byas te/ /shin tu gar bcas rol mo'i glus/ /rigs kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs dag /yang dag bstod ①cing gnas kun brgyan/ /thugs ka'i sngags kyi phreng ba las/ /sna lnga'i phreng ba spro zhing bsdu/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ hūṃ ④swā hā/ ji srid brtan par ma gyur par/ /'od 'bar phreng bas kun du rgyas/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /dbu mar yang ni dmigs su med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor bas/ /thabs kyi snying rje'i bdag nyid rnams/ /de bas de nyid snying rje thabs/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par gsal/ /kun du 'gro dang 'dug pa dang / /nyal dang langs sogs thams cad du/ /lha yi ting 'dzin brtan byas te/ /thams cad sbyang zhing byin gyis brlab/ /bza' btung thams cad bdud rtsi'i tshogs/ /yul kun lha mo'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /bskyed la phyag rgya'i 'khor lo yis/ /bya ba'i phrin las sna tshogs kun/ /'gro gnas 'jug pa'i don bzhin spyad/ /dkyil 'khor mnyes pas mchod bya ste/ /dga' ba'i sbyin sreg tshim pa'i mchog /tshogs kyi 'khor lo brtul zhugs bzang / /yi ge phyag rgya mtshan ma'i sku/ /rnam gsum mdzad pa sku gsung thugs/ /rtag tu gsang sngags sgra ldan pas/ /phyag rgya'i gnas kun mnyam sbyor zhing / /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i//dngos grub sna tshogs nye bar 'grub/ /phyag rgya gcig pa'i bsam gtan mchog /rigs kun yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gsal byed pa'i/ /theg pa bla med dam pa'i mchog /yang dag sbyar ba'i tshul 'di yis/ /ma lus mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas te/ /dngos grub 'khrigs pa'i phreng bas brgyan①/ /14—803

0583༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ /bha ga bān 2shrī ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa sā dha nai/bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde ba kun gyi mchog rig mnyam med ye shes gzugs/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog min/ /bdag nyid kun du rtag gnas srid gsum mchog gsum gzugs / /dpal ldan tshad med bde ba'i rgya mtsho mi 'gyur ba/ /bde chen bde skyed rdo rje sems dpa' mgon po la/ /'gro ba gsum gyi mnyen gyur phyogs pas phyag byas te/ /sems can dus ngan rnyog pas nyen cing dge ster ba/ /yul la chags pa'i nyon mongs mun nag chen po rnams/ /bla ma'i lung gis ser sna'i tha 4ba 'joms 'gyur pa/ /bde byed byang chub bla med bde ba thob pa'i phyir / /'di yi sgrub pa cho ga cung zad bshad par bya/ /'jig rten mgon po 14byed805

rdo rje sems/ /skyob pa pos 1ni rnam gsum pa/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni thams cad las/ /bde 2bas thams cad lha nyid do/ /rdo rje byang chub sems 'di ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo ste/ /de bas bdag nyid kun sbyor bas/ sangs rgyas/ thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag nyid de/ /de bzhin dpa' bo thams cad pas/ /rang gi lha yi spyor ba yis/ /de bas bdag nyid bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje byin rlabs tshul gyis su/ /ting nge 'dzin ni bdag dbang bskur/ /snying po'i phyag rgya sngags rig gis/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa mchog gis bsgul/ /spyor dang rab sbyor sbyor che ba/ /rnal 'byor thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /de nyid bcu la sogs tshul gyis/ /thams cad skye 'gyur bsgrub par bya/ /'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /de bzhin dpa' bo thams cad dag /ci bder yul la longs spyod pas / /tshe 'di nyid la thos par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa' bsgrub par 'dod pas thog mar rdo rje slob dpon la bsnyen bkur ji lta ba bzhin du byas nas/ dam tshig gi sdom pa'i dbang la sogs pa mnos te/ji lta ba'i gnas sam/ jeg pa'am/ khyim mam4/ gzhal med khang ngam/skyed mos tshal gyi gnas la sogs par/ rang gi stan 'jam zhing reg na bde ba pad+ma sna tshogs kyi 'dab mas g.yogs pa de ni gdan thams cad kyi nang na bsngags 5pa ste/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' gang du rnam par rol pa sangs rgyas thams cad dang 6mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma'i bde 7blangs te/oṃ badz+ra pad+ma a sa na ma hā yo ga pi ta dh+ri zhes byin kyis brlabs nas/ stan bde ba la sbyor ba'i dbang phyug rnam par gnas te ji ltar byin gyis brlabs pa de 74—806

bzhin du thams cad kyi stan dang sbyar ro/ /mnyam par gzhag 1nas rgyal ba kun—/ /nye bar nam mkha' thams cad la/ /rdo rje se gol bcibs pa yis /rdo rje gtogs —pas bsdu bar bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas kun/ /rab tu spyor bas yang dag brjod/ /thal mo gsum kyi spyor ba yis/ /zhi ba'i thal mos mnyes par bya/ cho ga bzhin du phyag byas te/ /ci rigs mchod pa rnams byas la/ /'dod pa lnga yi yon tan rnams/ /dbang po kun nas spro bar bya/ /dngos grub thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /zhi ba'i thal mo'i spyor ba yis/ /shardza gan+dar tshul gyis su/ /rdo rje dbyangs kyis bstod 4par bya/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i snyug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dam pa'i chos mchog can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa'i thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smin lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don bsgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /tshad gred tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yis/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes 5gyur kyang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag pa yongs mi 'gyur/ /e ma'o shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang na go 'phang mchog 14—807

brnyes pas/ /khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog sprul mdzad/ /mgon po 1dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pa/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la spyod/ /de nas sngon tshe gang byas pa'i/ /sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bya/ /rgyal ba rnams ni dge mdzad la/ /ma lus rjes su yi rang bya/ /de rnams gsol gdab —par bya ba/ /skad cig skad cig sems par bya/ /ma lus pa yi dge ba rnams/ /sems can rnams la bsngo bar bya/ /de nas brtson 'grus chen po'i go bgos pa/ snying rje chen pos brlan pa'i sems gzhan la phan pa gcig pu mthar gyur pa'i mchog ma lus lus pa med pa'i 'jig rten na 5gnas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad bdag gis snyug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bya'o snyam du bsams te/ de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag po bde ba chen po dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du byas nas pad+ma'i lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi mthil la ma ṭa yi ge gnyis las nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 7cha thams cad kyis rnam par mdzes par mngon du brtags te/ de'i steng du 'dis rdo rje dang pad+mor bsam par bya ste/ oṃ ma hā su kha sa man+ta bha dra hūṃ a zhes brjod nas rdo rje'i tshig las mngon du bsdu ba dang / spro ba bya ba ni 'od zer gyi rgyan 8sna tshogs kyi phreng bas spro ba dang bsdu ba bya ste/ g.yon pa'i sor mo thams cad du yi ge sa bon lnga las gzugs mar bsam/ g.yas kyi rnams la gtso bo rnams tshul 'di bsam mo/ /i a i a e/ hūṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ tweḥ she.a/ de nas snying po 'dis rdo rje thal mo bcing bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra añdza li oṃ/ rdo rje khu tshur bsdams pa'i snying po ni/ oṃ badz+ra brnya hūṃ/ de yang snying po 'di lan gnyis /4—808

sam gsum du brjod de dbab par byin kyis brlab bo/ /oṃ badz+ra pad+ma saṃ yo ga ā be+e sha ā be+e 1snasha ma hā su kha/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ a/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbacings pa de 'bab par gyur gyi bar du brjod nas de nas snying gar dgrol bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra brnya ma hā kro dha ha na da ha pa tsa ga ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭa pra duṣ+ṭi/ me ma na sid tsa / dz+nyā na ma hā ta mon+ta ka ra pi ti tsi gi ra bi ki 3ra hūṃ/ trad ta trad te ta trad te4/ de nas rang gi lus mi shes pa'i dri ma dang bral nas zla ba lta bur yongs su dag par bsgoms te/ oṃ san+d+ra bi shud+dhi dharmā ta sa ma ya hūṃ zhes yid la brjod do/ /de nas bcings pa de slar gnyis su bcings nas mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba las lcags kyu ltar bcus te/ de bzhin du rang gi snying gar sngags 'dis grol bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ban+dha i 5gu sha ma hā kro dha 6dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas bdag nyid shin tu rnam par dag par bsams te/ ye shes yongs su dag pa tsam la dmigs nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis bdag la 'dis bskul bar bsam mo /stong pa yod med shin tu rnal 'byor mthus/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dam tshig nye bar gshegs/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /de nas de bdag gis bdag la bskul bar rig nas bdag nyid bde ba chen po rim pa 'di ltar bskyed par bya'o//hūṃ gis phyag rgya dang bcas par byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ de la phyag rgya ni rdo rje bcings pa las brkyang ste/ mthe'u chung dang srin lag gi dbus su mthe bong rtse sbyar nas/ dbab pa byas la/ snying gar dbu ma rtse mo can du byas te/ a'i pad+ma'i steng du gzhag spyogo/ /oṃ ma hā su kha sa man+ta pa tra a bhi — 74byed809

ṣiñtsa hūṃ a zhes brjod nas dbab pa'i phyag rgya bskyod do/ /yang na a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du brtags te/ sa bon rgyal po rdo rje sems dpa'i kun gzhi rnam par shes pa bzhin bsams te/ hūṃ gdan la a la sogs pas kyang 'od zer gyi rtachas brgyan pa ltar bsams nas sa bon hūṃ de las rdo rje rtse lnga par bsam mo / /hūṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ dh+ri t+t+waṃ zhes brjod pa 'dis rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dir mngon du 'grub ste / rdo rje'i ye shes de las ye shes rnam lngar gzugs dang kha dog sna tshogs su byung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po la sogs nga/ra kun du snang bar byed par bsams te/ de bdag nyid rdo rje la slar 'du'/ pas phyag rgya chen po'i tshul du gyur par bsams la / thams cad bde byed dkar ba'i phyir/ /thams cad dag la rnam dag ste/ /zla ba gang ba dkar ba'i sgu/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog tu bde/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya ni/ /dmar po sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /g.yas kyis 'dud pa'i snying ga ru/ /'dzum bcas rdo rje gsor bar mdzad/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dbyibs su gnas / /chu skyes spyan yang yid tsam rgyas/ /sangs rgyas rin chen dbu rgyan rnams / /sna tshogs rgyan gyis 4rnam par bklubs/ /rgyab tu 'od dang 'dra ba yi5 / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od kyi mchog /a las yang dag bskyed byas te//de nas kun du spro bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rin chen khams gsum ni/ /rin chen gzhan dang mtshungs pa med/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi rin po che/ /de bas dbu rgyan 6mchog ces bya/ /bdag gi gzhan gyis mi 'phrogs te/ /dag byung dang ba'i chu 'dra ba/ /ngo bo nyid kyi mthar gyur pas/ /rang bzhin kyi ni dngos grub 'grub8/ /de nas byin rlabs 9tshul gyis su/ /snying ga smin 7((byed8/0

mtshams mgrin spyi bor/ /gar bcas lag pa 'dud pa yis/ /rdo rje phyag rgya bcing bar 1bya/ /byin rlabs 2phyag rgya 'di yin te/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings byas te / /mdzub mo mthe bo'i mtshan nyid du/ /g.yas pa'i mthe bo dbang po yis/ /kha ru bcug nas bsdam par bya/ /'di yis byin gyis brlabs pa yis/ /rdo rje dga' chen thob par 'gyur/ /bde ba chen po bde byed che/ /phyi yi gsang ba rnam sdud yid/ /rdo rje dga' ba rab bcings nas/ /dbu ma bcings ba nang du gzhug /mje bo mje'u chung mnyam bsnol ba'i/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya bsgrub par bya/ /bcing ba de yis byin brlabs na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /'di yis ji ltar rigs pa yis/ /blo dang ldan pas dbang bskur bya/ /dar gyi bcing bas bcing bya ste/ /'gying dang bcas pas mtha' dgrol bya/ /dar dpyangs 'dra ba'i tshul nyid kyis/ /thal mo yis ni bstan par bya/ /sngags shes pa yis 4sngags 'di yis/ /hūṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/'di ni rang gi rigs kyi dbang bsgur ba'i byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa'o/ /mje bo sems dpa'i skyil krung las/ /mdzub mo rtse mo dgug par bya/ /gung mo mchog gnyis mnyam spyor mnyam/ /lhag ma rdo rje thal mo 'od/ /sangs rgyas rin chen dbang bskur rgya/ /rang byung ba yis dbang bskur bas/ /rgyal srid mchog gi dngos grub kun/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /spyi bo dang ni dpral ba gnyis/ /glo dang de bzhin rgyab nyid du/ /byas nas dar dpyangs tshul du bya/ /oṃ budha a bhe ṣe ke ru ru sgu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha budzha lo tsa sathru arja sā 5dha na a dzha ṣiñtsa saṃ 6swā hā/ sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur ba'o/ /rdo rje rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgyas snga ma bzhin dbang bskur ro7/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na saṃ 8rnyi ṣe 1 4byed8/ 1

ka ti ri mi ti ri ni 1shrī ya a dzha ṣiñtsa — saṃ swā hā/ rdo rje rin chen gyis dbang bskur ba'o/ /oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣe ka tā snare tu re tuṭ+wā re saṃ bhi ṣiñtsa paṃ swā hā/de'i phyag rgya ni sangs rgyas rin chen gyis dbang bskur bas dbu ma'i rtse mo phab nga/ ni pad+ma rin chen gyi phyag rgya ste/ 'dis snga ma bzhin du dbang bskur ro/ /rdo rje thal mo rab sbyar 5te/ /gnyis kyis rin chen 'dzin pa ltar/ /ji ltar rigs pas mnyam par bya/ /mthe bo'i rtse mo gdong bzhi yis/ /phyag rgya de nas rab bsgyur te/ /g.yas pa nyid du gzhag 6par bya/ /blo dang ldan pa'i sngags 'di yis/ /sngags rigs de bzhin dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ rat+na rat+na a/ bhe ṣe ke 7tram̐ tram̐/ bha bha tra tra tra tra tra tra a bye ṣiñtsa saṃ swā hā/ rin chen rigs/ kyi dbang bskur ba'o/ /rdo rje thal mo gdab pa ste/ /mdzub mo'i rtse mo yud tsam dgug /mje bo dpa' bo'i skyil krung du/ /lhag ma rnams ni 'od bzhin btang / /sngon bzhin yang ni sbyang bar bya/ /las kyi rin chen dbang bskur ba'o / /oṃ badz+ra kadz+re rat+na a bhe ṣe ke hi hi nyi hi/ shrī pad+ma ba da mu ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa saṃ swā hā/ rig sngags spyis bdag la dbang bskur bar bstan te rang bi rigs kyi thog ma nyid du dbang bskur ro9/ /de ltar bdag nyid dbang bskur bar byas nas/ go bgo bar ste/ rdo rje khu tshur brkyang ba las mgrin par bzhag ste/ oṃ badz+ra ka ba tsa yā mo haṃ baṃ yo/ zhes bya ba'i snying po brjod nas bcings pa de las mdzub mo brkyang ste/ so so 6nas gdong sprad pa mdud pa'i tshul gyis snying ga nas brtsams te/ spyi bo'i gtsug gi bar du sngags 'dis oṃ ṭaṃ ka ba tsa yo saṃ hūṃ/ lan gsum du byas na lus la cis kyang mi phyed par 'gyur ro//de nas a las bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje shin tu dga' ba ma'am rdo rje sems ma 14—8/2

babyed de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi cha lugs dang / kha dog dbyibs su ldan pa g.yas g.yon kyi pad+mo'i dbyibs can du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la snga ma bzhin du byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa bya ste/ gnyis su med pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyis brtsam par bya ba ①ni lung ngo / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ②zhes brjod cing bcing ba ni nang gi dbu ma'i lcags kyu rang gi snying gar lcags kyus drang bar bya/de nyid gdong reg pa ni zhags pa'o/ /de nyid lu gu rgyud ltar byas pa ni bcing ba'o / /de nyid rtse mo bsdams pa ni dgyes pa'o/ /'di ni gsang ba'i phyag rgya ste / phyi'i phyag rgya rnams kyis kyang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de la de rnams kyi phyag rgya ni 'di lta ①ste/ rdo rje bcing ba gnyis su bya ste/ g.yon pa'i steng du g.yas pa bzhag nas mthe'u chung bsnol ba la g.yon gyi mdzub mo bgreng ba'i tshigs nas g.yas kyi mdzub mo dgug pa ni rdo rje 'dod pa'i phyag rgya ste/ oṃ badz+ra kā ma e ku sha ka ta ka ta hūṃ dzaḥzhes pa'i snying po dang bcas pas drang bar bya'o/ /de nyid las phan tshun du mdzub mo gnyis zhags pa ltar bcings te/ oṃ badz+ra pra be+e sha ya pra be+e sha ya swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i snying po dang bcas pas gzhug go/ /de nyid las phan tshun shin tu bskums te/ oṃ badz+ra kā ma brnya brnya baṃ zhes pas bcing bar bya'o/ /de nyid las mthe'u chung gnyis lu gu rgyud ltar gzung ste rgyab sbyar ba 'di ni rdo rje dgyes pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra duji kā ma tsu ke rjosho ta ya ho/ zhes brjod nas phyag rgya des dgyes par bya ste/ bde ba'i thal mo 'am/ zhi ba'i thal mo gsum gyis dgyes pa bskyed nas mdun du rdo rje shin tu dga' ba la sogs pa mngon du blta bar bya ba'i phyir dbyangs kyis ⑤bskul bar bya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen skal bzang khyod bdag lags so sgrub rjol rtogs par mdzad du 14—813

gsol—/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag nyid bde ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma sna tshogs bde ba'i mchog /'gro ba'i rgyud rnams ①rnam pa sna tshogs 'dul mchog grub pa bdag la grub par mdzad du gsol/ /a la la ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyor ba rnam pa sna tshogs gar rnams bstan du gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃbaṃ hoḥkye ma bde mchog bde bas gzung ba rnam par sprul pa snang bar mdzad du gsol/ /a la la la la ④ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sna tshogs sgyu ma mkha' 'gro slob mas gzung du gsol/ /de nas 'jug ①pa de langs te/ ma dang ṭa las gyur pa'i mig gis nam mkha'i ngos la bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis til 'bru bzhin btags te rdo rje lcags kyu bcangs nas dzaḥhūṃbaṃ hoḥzhes brjod cing rang gi lha la mchod pa'i phyir de rnams kyi snying gar gzhug par bya'o/ /yang na rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i phyag rgya sprul te/ cho ga ji lta ba rjobazhin du byin gyis brlabs la/ dbang bskur ba la sogs pa byas/ /mchod pa brtsam par bya'o/ /mdun du zla ba'i kha dog can/ /chu skyes zhal ni 'dzum dang bcas/ /phyag rgya mda' ltar 'dren pa 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas rin chen rnams kyis brgyan/ /rgyab tu lha mo chu srin gyi/ /pad+ma dmar po 'od dang ldan/ /dpal byed dran pa sna tshogs kyi/ /sangs rgyas dbu rgyan mchog 'dzin ma/ /sngo mthing mchog gi phyag gnyis kyis/ /phyag rgya rang gis 'khyud pa yi/ /sangs rgyas dbu rgyan phreng ba la/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs⑤/ /'dud bcas g.yon nas sngo bsangs rjote/ /sangs rgyas gtsug gis rnam par spras/ /rnal 'byor 'byor ldan bsam bya ba/ /rang gi snying po rdzogs par bya/ /bzhi po de rnams ni phyag rgya phyi mo'i tshogs su bstan te gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro'i lha mo rnams phyogs 14—814

bzhir rang gi stan la pad+mo'i lo ma la gnas par bsam mo/ /pad+mo'i phyi mtshams su sgeg mo dang / phreng ba ma dang / dbyangs can ma dang / gar ma la sogs pa grwa bzhir gzhag ①go/ /de bzhin du me tog ma dang / bdug pa ma dang / mar me ma dang / sna tshogs kyi dri la sogs pa yang phyogs mtshams su gzhag ③go/ /gling bu dang / pi wang dang / cang te'u dang / rdza rnga dang /cha lang dang / dar dir dang / pa ṭa ha brdung ba la sogs pa yang phyogs phyogs su gzhag snego/ /shar kyi sgo ru bsam pa ni/ rdo rje lcags kyu 'dod pa mchog /g.yon du rdo rje zhags pa ste/ /nub tu rdo rje lcags kyu rgyud/ /byang du dril bu bshad pa ste/ /de rnams rang gi las la brtson/ /kun kyang gzugs kyi mchog ldan pa/ /rang gi lha la rjes mthun pa'i/ /rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin ldan par/ /sngags shes pas ni budagod par bya/ /rang gi lha yi spyor ldan pas/ /ci rigs mnyam par gzhag rjobya ste/ /mnyam par gzhag rjopa'i ting 'dzin nyid/ /rdo rje 'dzin du nye bar 'gyur/ /de nas ji ltar sbyor ba yi⑦/ /sbyor dgyes pa yis rol byas te/ /sbyor ba bzhi yi tshul gyis su/ /mnyam par gzhag ⑧nas rab tu bya/ /mchod pa thams cad ma 'byor na/ /phyag rgya bcing zhing mchod bya ba/ /rang nyid lha yi ngo bo la/ /de dag gis mchod dmigs par bya/ /brdung dang gar du bcas pa yis/ /steg ⑨bcas dga' bas bde ba yi/ /glu la sogs pa'i ro ldan pas/ /hūṃ a/ bde ba chen po skal bzang khyod/ /thams cad 'dod pa bzhin du 'dod chags pas/ /bcom ldan 'das la ⑩bdag bzhes shig /mchod pa thams cad kyi cho ga la sogs pa sbyor ba dang ldan pas dbul bar bya'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥru ṭa ma ṭa sma ra 14—815

tra①—/ hu lu hu lu/ pri si ta/ ta ki hūṃ/ tru ta ki ni/ hūṃ dza dza/ hu lu hu lu/ a la la ho/ shu5/ sirnya ya/ da ri sha ya/ sarba ka te ta ste ta ste ta ste/ ta ta ghi ta ghi/ ghi ghi ta/ bhe te ghi ta/ bhe na to/ ta ki hūṃ dza dza/ hu lu hu lu hu lu/ a ④la la la ho ru ṭa ma ṭa/ thal mo myur ba ste/bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba chen po la 'dis mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya'o/ /te sneghi ta ghi/ ta bhe ghi/ ta ghi ghi/ bhe ghi ta/ rgyun gyi rjobardung ba'o/ /saṃ e saṃ/ haṃ haṃ haṃ/ baṃ baṃ baṃ/ rda rda rda/dam tshig gsum gyi brdung ba ⑤ste/ 'dis ni bcom ldan 'das sku gsung thugs bskul ba'i dam tshig gsum gyi gsang ba'i sbyor ba ste/ de rnams kyi brdung ba dbyangs su blang rjozhing shardza dang de ba ti dbyangs 'dis kyang sbyor ba'i bdag nyid kyis hūṃ la sogs pa'i dbyangs kyis bskul bar bya'o/ /rjes su chags pa'i rnam klu/ mang dga' ba'i pad+mo rnam dag pa'i/ /mchod pa gsal bas rjes su mchod byas ⑧mchog /rtag pa'i rnal 'byor bde bas bde ba grub par mdzod/ kye mchog bde ba'i dam mchog rang gi ngo bo nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba'i rnal 'byor shin tu skal bzangs ⑨chog brnyes pa/ /rang gi dam tshig skyon med rtag la rol cig rol cig ho/ /kye mchog tu gsang ba'i bdag po rang gi dam tshig yin pa'i phyir//rab tu gsang ba'i lha mo mchog rnams so/ /'gro ba'i rgyud ni rnam pa sna tshogs 'dul ba gsal bar mkhyen/ /dam tshig thams cad dngos po brtan g.yo kun gyi ngo bor gyur/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid rnal 'byor bde ba sgyu ma mkha' 'gro ho/ /kye dam pa rtag pa'i dngos grub chen po rab tu bsgrubs la ⑩ston/dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkye ma ho bde mchog bde bas drongs/ /rnam par sprul pa snang bar 14—816

mdzod / /a la la la ho①/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma sna tshogs kyi/ /slob ma dag ni gsung ⑤du gsol/ /'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs bde bas bskul ba'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon kyi lag pa yis/ / 'gying ba'i dze+etshul gyis gar byas te/ /g.yon gyi mthe bo srin lag sbyar/ /g.yas kyi ba dan gsum pa yis/ /phyag rgya 'di yis btab pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun dang yang dag 'grogs/ /thams cad mchog gi dngos grub che/ /dbang phyug chen po rab tu 'grub/ /de nyid dor ba'i tshul gyis su/ /slad du brdzun pa cher byas te/ /bsgyur nas g.yas kyi 'gram pa dang / /spyi gtsug mtshalas su bzhag pa las/ /slad du gar kyi dbab tshul gyi—/ /cha lugs kun gyis rab bsgyur cing / /skal bzang hūṃ gi dbyangs ldan pas/ /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya/ /la lar zla ba dri med dkyil 'khor stong pas mdzes pa'i gzugs su snang bar snang / /la lar rab tu 'jigs pa'i nyi ma bye ba phrag dgu'i 'od zer mchog pas 'jigs/ /la lar mdangs bzangs gzi chen 0zhi bar ldan pa rgyal ba'i gzugs su snang / /la lar 'gro ba thams cad mnyam par 'jog pa'i gzugs ldan gsung mchog ldan par ston/ /rdo rje sems dpa' grub phyir 'dul mkhas ma lus bde ba'i mchog rnams las/ /a ral thams cad mnyam sbyor grub par mdzod/ /ru ṭa ta ma te a ⑤la la la ho/ rnam pa mang po 'dul bar mdzad pa'i tshul la gar mkhan mchog gis gar mdzad pa/ /dam tshig gar gyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas gar mkhan gar mdzod a la la la ho/ rnam mang bde mchog rab tu gar mdzad pa yis thar pa'i bde ba'ang thob par mdzod/ /'di yis ba dan gsum dang ldan 14—817

par gar du bya'o/ /rab tu dga' dang rjes su chags par dga' ba'i mda' gzhu rab tu phra bas rgyas btab pas/ /rab tu dga' bar sbyor ba'i bde bas myos pa bde ba thams cad bdag la grub par mdzod/ /rab tu bde ba'i rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i longs spyod dang / /rab tu dga' ba'i dbang phyug mchog tu grub pas de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs①/ /ho rta mchog ho/ kye ma ho rab tu bde ba'i rnam pa sna tshogs rol cig ho/ /de bas slong rnam par rol/ hūṃ snang bar mdzod/ /a la la la ④ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mkha' 'gro sgyu ma rnam pa sna tshogs kyi slob ma gzung du gsol/kye bde ba'i mchog grub par mdzod/ /kye ma ho bde bas bde ba sprul/ /dam pa rab tu zhugs par mdzod/ /bdag la rab tu bde bar gyur/ /a la la la ho—/ /kye ma ho shi shi bzhugs shig mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /yongs su skor—/ kun du zhugs/ de nas gar dang ldan pa yis/ /dbyangs 'di rnams kyis glur blangs shing / /dpal ldan g.yon du 'dud pa yis/ /g.yas kyi ba dan gsum du bya/ /de ltar g.yas dang g.yon tshul gyis/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung bsnyems byas te/ /steng du dor dang 'og tu dor/ /bskor ④dang de bzhin byug byas te/ /me tog bdug pa mar me mchog /dri yi mchod pa bskor ba yis/ /lhag ma gar gyi tshul gyis su/ /gling bu pi wang rdza rnga mchog /de bzhin cang te'u rnams rjodag kyang / /g.yon gyi khya tshur rab bsdams te/ /lag pa g.yas pas brdung bya ste/ /rang gi ming gis bskul bcas pas/ /sngags pas mchod pa dbul bar bya/ /zhi ba'i thal mo bde mchog gis/ /thal mo'i sbyor bas dgyes pa bskyed/ /g.yon du 'dod pas phyag bya zhing / /'dzum 14—818

dang bcas pas lta ①ba'i mig /min ma mig dang mchu gdon pa/ /kha dang lus kyi ②gdon pa yis/ /cha lugs ji bzhin gar bya ste/ /phyag rgya thams cad dbul bar bya/ /na mo stu saza buste bh+yaḥ/ zhes pas phyag rgya rab gnas te/ /mchod pa mchog gi dngos grub rnams/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /phyag rgya 'di rnams kyis btab na/ /bdag nyid dang ni yang na gzhan/ /sgrub pa po ni myur 'grub ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog 'drar 'gyur/ /langs pa'i tshe yang de bzhin du dbang bskur ba dang / srung ④ba la sogs pa byas te/ /bde ba'i thal mos dgyes pa bskyed nas ci dga' bar rjoganas par bya'o/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' sdud pa dang / /rdo rje rin chen bla med pa/ /rdo rje chos ni gsung ba dang / /rdo rje las ni byed par 'gyur/ /a ho su kha zhes pa'i ming / /rdo rje sems gang gang klog pa/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur zhing / /bsod nams rnams ni byin brlabs 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal ⑤bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs sodhi// //14—819

༄/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/1bhesngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra satwa a — snanu smṛ ti nā ma ༄bi dhi/bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gnas yul tshogs nyams dga' bar/ /kun rdzob 'phrul pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rnam dag gnyis med yul kun sbyor/ /byang chub sems byung rgyal ba'i mchog /de la de snang rol mo'i chos/ /srid mtha'i ma 5dmigs dus gsum 'gog /rnam dpyad bya ba'i rgyud ldan zhing / /rigs bdag dkyil 'khor bstod pa'i gnas/ /nges pa'i gsang mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs chen po/ /gnyis dang gnyis med theg pa'i mchog /rjes su dran pa skyed byed pa'i/ /cho ga bzang po rmad du byung / /gsang don brgyud pa'i rdo rje'i tshig /dus gsum rgyun kyi mtshan ldan bcing / /rigs bdag dkyil 'khor bstod pa'i gnas/ /'khor 14—822

ba'i bya ba kun gnas 'jug /dpa' bo gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor bzang /bsnyen sgrub yan lag dang bcas bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa'i yul//bya ba'i yan lag kun rdzogs shing / /nges pa'i gsang ba ston mdzad pa'i/ /'bras bu'i dkyil 'khor bla na med/ /thams cad dus zhes bya ba yi/ /lta ba la sogs 'byung ba'i chos/ /nyon mongs gnas kun rnam dag cing / /rang bzhin mnyam pas spros dang bral/ /yang dag sangs rgyas bde ba che/ /kun du goms pas gsal byed pa'i/ /yan lag lam 7gnyis rdzogs pa'i grogs/ /rab sbyangs pas ni 'jug 'gyur zhing / /rig 'dzin gnas kun bgrod byed cing / /rgyu rkyen cha shas kun rdzogs shing / /thun mong bye brag rkyen gyi stobs/ /snga ma las byung phyi ma'i rgyun/ /'bras bu tshogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /sa dang sar gnas rig 'dzin kun/ /rang rig sbyor ba'i tshul kyis ni/ /gsang sngags phyag rgya'i gnas kun dang / /mi mthun gnyen po bye brag mthus/ /dngos grub mtha' yas rtag ༄ ldan zhing / /ting 'dzin chos kun rdzogs pa'i mthar—/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas mthong zhing / /nges pa'i sa mchog sdogs par 'gyur/ /rigs kyi 'khor lo kun bskor zhing / /rigs kyi gnas rnams — rnam dag pas/ /rigs 4mchog yon tan bzang 5po'i tshogs/ /rigs kun rgyal bas mnyam spyor ba'o/ /yang dag nges pa'i theg pa'i 6mchog /dam pa las byung dam pa'i yul/ /de gnas tshul gyis 7phreng ba nyid/ /yang dag bde bas rgyan du byas/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dga' tshal dang / /chos kyi rgyal po'i grong khyer mchog /chos kyi 'khor lo rim 'jug pas/ /chos kyi 'bras bu bzang po nyid/ /shin tu spyor bas yang dag skyes/ /me tog tshal 14—823

—las kha dog dri/ /'dod pa'i tshogs rnams tshim gyur ltar/ /rang gnas byang chub yan lag phreng / /bsnyen dang nye bar bsnyen pa dang / /sgrub dang sgrub nga chen po yi1/ /yan lag cha shas kun sdogs pas/ /zhi sogs bye brag rnam par bkod / /sangs rgyas theg pa'i yan lag gis/ /nye bar sbyar ba'i rnal 'byor 'grub/ /sa mtshams mkhas pa'i spyod yul nyid/ /rkyen bcas stobs kyis rab tu rdzogs/ /dkyil 'khor yan lag stobs ldan pa'i/ /bla ma lhag gnas brtul zhugs can/ /yon tan rin chen 'bras bu'i bdag /byang chub mchog sems rnam dag pa/ /yang dag mos pas bstod byas te/ /sgo gsum dang bas gsol ba gdab/ /gdams pa'i yan lag kun 'dzin cing / /nye bar 'khor ba'i dga' ston mchog /dkyil 'khor chen por dgyes byas pas/ /rab tu rdzogs par 'khor lo dbang / /de nyid yan lag dam tshig bcas/ /nges par 'jug pas bstan byas pa'o/ /gsang ba'i rgyud don sna tshogs dag /'dren pa'i yan lag bla na med/ /nges par bstan pa'i phyag rgya yi/ /yan lag rdzogs pas jeg pa'i mchog /dbe+en pa yi ni gnas dag gam/ /rang ji skyed mos tshal sogs par/ /kun du sna tshogs skal bzang po/ /kun du sna tshogs bde mchog gis/ /kun du sna tshogs dgongs pa rnams/ /ci bde bar ni bsgrub par bya/ /gnas kyi nye 'khor phyag dar dang / /dri zhim chur bcas dag byas te/ /dkyil 'khor sa gzhi bzang po'i mchog /bkra shis dag byed rdzas kyis byug /phyogs bcur bla re rgyal mtshan dang / /'phan gdugs lhab lhub rnga yab dang / /rin chen me tog phreng ba'i tshogs/ /bza' btung 'dod yon rnam 'phrul pa'i/ /phyag rgya gos dang —rgyan bcas pas/ /14—824

ma lus kun du nye bar mdzes/ /thabs dang shes rab brtul zhugs mchog /bde ba'i ye shes rol mo'i dbyengs/ /rnam par 'phrul pas bsam byas pas/ /bya ba'i 'khor lo brtan par 'gyur1/ /ji snyed mchod pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /gtor mas gnas kun nyer brgyan dag /bsang sbyang bkra shis byin gyis brlab//rim bzhin sngags dang phyag rgya gnas/ /'gro gnas kun gyi nyon mongs tshogs/ /mi dge stobs sogs spyig pa'i mthus/ /gnas kun nyam thag gzir bas 'joms / /bdag gzhan kun rgyud rlag par byed/ /de dag thugs rje chen po'i blos/ /ma lus yul bcas sgol ba'i phyir/ /dran pa gcig pa'i ye shes sku//ting 'dzin dag pas rnam par grol/ /phyi nang chos rnams thams cad kyi / /rang bzhin gnyis med byang chub sems/ /der snang yul las 'das pa nyid/ /lcun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid do/ /tshul 'di rnam par spangs pa yi / /de nas de las de bzhin rgyud/ /kye ma thugs rje chen po'i yul/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa nyid/ /rnam gsum lha yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /rnam gsum sngags dang phyag rgyar sbyor/ /byin rlabs 4nus mthu rdzogs byas nas/ /bdag gzhan sbyangs shing gsal byas te/ /rigs mchog sku gsung thugs kyi bdag / yang dag 'od zer rab spyor bas/ /5gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa nyid/ /tshul gsum phyag rgya'i cha lugs kyis/ /shin tu bkod pa legs 'byung ba'i/ /tshad med bzhi yi gnas rdzogs 'gyur/ /kun nas spyan drangs brtan byas pa/ /nye bar sbyor ba'i phyag rgya nyid/ /oṃ yang dag brtan pas stobs sdogs pa'i/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i tshogs/ /thugs rjes bdag nyid rnam grol ba / /dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i las la dgyes/ /mi shes yul rnams bcom 14—825

mdzad cing / /rig pa'i gnas chen snyoms 'jug par/ /phyag rgya bde ba'i tshul sbyor bas/ /grong khyer brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/dz+nyā na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥpra be+e sha ya phaṭa/ badz+ra ā be sha ya a ā/ ji srid brtan pa'i gnas bzhugs shing / /byang chub sems mchog spel ba'i phyir/ /bkra shis lhag gnas brgyan pa yi/ /zhing khams pho brang dag par brjod/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra maṇ+ḍal pa na sa pa ri hūṃ/ rab tu gus pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /mngon par dmigs byas dag pa'i mchog /thabs dang shes rab rdzogs byed pa'i/ /yul kun rang bzhin rnam par dag /gang 'dir yon tan bsngags pa'i gnas//rgyal ba bde gshegs 'dren pa'i gtso/ /rigs mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas//ngo mtshar yul kun rnam par dag /oṃ na mo stu ste brnya 1rgo ka ro ya mi me na rā ga ho/ kun 'byung yon tan rdzogs pa yi/ /me tog 'bras bu bzang ldan zhing / /kun du bzang po'i rgyan rnams dang / /'dod pa'i lha mo rkyen ldan zhing / /yul kun chags pas —rnam grol ba/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bla med pa/ /lha dang lha mo bsam yas pas/ /phyogs bcu kun nas rnam par 'khrigs / /bya ba'i yul kun ma lus dag /yang dag bsngo ba bla na med/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyi dngos/ /gnyis su med pa'i rol pa dag /mnyam nyid rol mo'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ / mnyes pa chen po'i bdag nyid du// oṃ sarba pū 4dza me gha pra tits+tsha zheho/ thog med yun rings 'khor ba'i gnas/ /ma lus nye bar bsags pa'i tshogs/ /kun spyod gnas gsum las skyes pakhye / /thams cad yul la nye bar bshags/ /rab rtogs nye bar bsags pa'i chos/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs sdom pa dang / /nyer mdzes brgyan pa'i yan lag rnams//74—826

rab bsngags bstod pas yi rang mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi lam ston cing / /don bzhin bstan pas 'dul mdzad de/ /spyor ba'i stobs bcas shes rab tshogs / /thabs kyi theg chen bshad du gsol/ /phyogs bcu'i mgron gnas ji snyed mtha'/ /mya ngan kun sgrol mgon po rnams/ /sku gsum bstan pa'i tshul kyis ni/ /dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i dbyings/ /ma lus srid dngos 'gro ba'i tshogs 'don cing / /yang dag gnyis med brtan par byed pa'i yid/ /byang chub sems mchog bla na med pa'i don/ /yang dag brtan gnas kun du rgyas par bya/ /smin cing gol bar byed pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /khyad par lam kun yang dag rdzogs par 'gyur/ /bsnyen sgrub phyag rgya'i yan lag sna tshogs pas/ /bdag gzhan bzung 1zhing yan lag rdzogs par spyad/ /thugs rje rnam dag dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i tshogs/ /rab tu grol bas gnyis med mnyam ldan pa'i/ /thams cad mthun pa'i tshul rnams mdzad bcas pas/ /bdag gi cha shas rab tu dmigs pas dbul/ /thams cad mi gnyis ye shes chen po bdag /bya byed rtog pa'i tshogs rnams rnam dag cing / /sgyu ma rnam dag bya rtsal bde ba'i mchog /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i don rdzogs mnyam pa nyid/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib bral sangs rgyas kun/ /dngos grub phrin las yul rnams nye bar ston/ /rang gnas nyams dga' mnyam nyid mchog gi bdag /rnam dag bya ba'i tshul gyis yul las 'das/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi rto me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ sarba sirnyim+me ༷ pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ4bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa/14—827

badz+rī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ/ badz+ra gats+tsha muḥ/ rtse gcig dran pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /ma lus yul bcas rnam par grol/ /phyag rgya gsang sngags sbyor ba'i mthus/ /lha mo'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs nyid/ /'gro gnas sdug bsngal las grol zhing / /bde ba'i mchog kun mthar phyin te/ thar pa mya ngan las 'das par/ /btang stoms kun du mi dmigs pa'i/ /drag po'i tshogs bcas ma lus kun/ /rab tu zhen rtog stobs kyis 'jug /de dag thugs rje chen po yis/ /'dul byed stobs chen te ru ka /phyag rgya dbyings dang mnyam par sbyor/ /rnam par grol ba'i 1ting 'dzin gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i bgegs tshogs 'dul bar mdzad/ /yang dag dkyil 'khor brtan byas te/ /mtshon cha me 'od 'bar ba yis2/ /dkyil 'khor kun nas brgyan pa la/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po kun bsdus te/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis dbang byas nas/ /myos shing gzir gnon rnam par dgod/ /thugs kyi ye shes rab 'bar ba/ /ye shes phyag rgya'i gnas kyis 'jug /kun nas 'phro zhing basbu ba'i mthus/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor brten 'gyur ba'o/ /zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs par byed/ /rgyan cha mtshon cha'i tshogs rnams dang / /cha lugs rngam pa'i cha byad ldan/ /rigs kyi sprul pa'i bsam yas pa'o/ /gsang ba'i phyag rgya bzhi ston cing / /nges par brjod pa'i sngags rnams kyis/ /kun nas brtan pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams / /yang dag spyor bcas rdzogs par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha mu sa la khyun+da tshin+da hūṃ/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+ta brnya/ ha na ha na/ shrī te ru ka gro dhī shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ thams cad kun nas rdogs pa'i chos/ /rnam gsum yul kun rnam dag pa'i/ /byang chub sems nyid rang byung ba'i / /14—828

thams cad rdzogs pa'i gnas nyid do/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma kophohaṃ / thugs rje chen po'i rgyun gyis ni/ /thams cad khyab mdzad rin chen tshogs / /don kun snang ba'i gnas rdzogs te/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa rnam par dag /oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā 1ba āt+ma kolhahaṃ/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /'og min gnas mchog nyams dga' bar/ /phyag rgya sdogs pa'i cha lugs kyis/ /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /thugs rje chags pa'i ting 'dzin dang / /gsang ba sngags kyi byin rlabs pakyis/ /pho brang rnam par dag pa'i tshogs/ /rnam par 'phrul bas bskyed pa'i tshul/ /thugs kyi gsang sngags kun 'gyur gnas/ /rim bzhin sbyor ba'i byin rlabs kyis / /sa bon gsang sngags spro bya ste/ /rten gyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par mdzad / /e las nam mkha'i 4dkyil 'khor nyid/ /chos 'byung gru gsum gyen bsgreng dkar/ /yi las rlung dkyil gzhu yi dbyibs/ /dud kha sra mkhregs rgyal mtshan can/ /baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor 5sna tshogs 'byung / /dkar zlum kun 'byung bum pas mtshan/ /lo las dbang chen sa gzhi dbyibs/ /gru bzhi gser mdog rdo rjes brgyan/ /khaṃ las rim bzhin brtsegs pa'i mchog /kha dog dbyibs rgyan kun sdogs pa/ /sum̐ 6las ri yi rgyal po ste/ /rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'o/ /ram̐ 7las me yi dkyil 'khor mchog /dmar ser gru gsum ram̐ yig mtshan/ /de dbus zlo las gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi 9sgo khyud bcas/ /ra ba rim gsum dur khrod dang / /kun 'byung rin chen phreng bas mdzes/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor mtshan ldan pa'i/ /rgyan tshogs rnam par spras pa la/ /'od gsal thugs rje byang chub sems/ /14—829

rnam dag dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i mchog /pho brang 'khor lo'i lte dbus su/ / re'u cha'i 1phreng ba rdo rjes mdzes/ / gdan gyi dkyil 'khor rnam bkod pa'i//ma 'dres par ni dag pa'i don/ /dbus kyi 'khor lo la gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /rab tu 'od 'bar phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /rigs dang rigs bcas mnyam par sbyor/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /glu dbyangs 'od bcas bskul bar mdzad/ /thams cad rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi4/ /de gnas mtha' rnams bsrung ba'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i rol bas mnyes 'gyur zhing / /rtog med byang chub sems kyi sku/ /shes rab 'od gsal bcu drug phreng / /'od zer 'phro dang 'du ba'i mthus/ /'gro rnams bde gshegs yul sbyor te/ /rang gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis brgyan/ /thabs mchog thugs rje gsal byed phreng / /sbyor ba rnams gnyis mdzad bcas rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po nyid/ /g.yas g.yon phreng ba 'khor lo'i tshul/ /thams cad gcig tu spyor ba'i mthus/ /rin chen kha dog sna lnga po/ /hūṃ mdzes byed rdo rje'i phyag rgya rdzogs/ /dkar gsal 'od mdangs lnga yise brgyan/ /rab tu sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /phyag rgya rdzogs pa'i nga rgyal nyid/ /'od zer rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /drug bcas bcu drug gnas rnams dag /ma 'dres theg pa bsam yas kyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsdus/ /rab 'bar gsal bas brjid pa'i sku/ /gsang sngags yi ge'i phreng bas mdzes/ /oṃ ma hā su khā 5badz+ra satwa āspyoḥ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ7/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ phyag rgya chen po rdzogs pa yi/ /rdo rje sems gtso bde ba'i mchog /zhal bzhi phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes/ /dbus dkar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /g.yas sngo 14—830

g.yon dmar rgyab ser po/ /rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes/ /thugs rje chags pa'i don mdangs ldan/ /phrin las rnam bzhi cha lugs bcas/ /g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar/ /g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bu 'khor/ /'og gnyis zhig nas lhag mthong rgya/ /'od mdangs lnga yi phreng bas mdzes/ /rin chen rgyan dang na bza' dang / /phyag rgya rnam lnga mtshan dpe sdogs/ /'od kyi rig ma dang 1spyor byung / /bde ba'i rol pas kun spyod mdzad/ /mkha' dbyings dbang phyug phyag rgya yis/ /gnas kun byin gyis brlab par bya/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yi/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya ldan byas te/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bdag gi lhar ni bdag nyid bya/ /thugs gsal nyi ma la gnas pa'i/ /ye shes sems dpa' hūṃ dang bcas/ /'od zer 'phro 'du spyor ba yis/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor dgug byas te/ /gnyis med spyor ba'i byang chub sems/ /bdud rtsi'i bum bcas lha mo'i tshogs/ /gnas rnams kun du khrus byas pas/ /rigs kyi bdag pos nye bar mdzes mthe bong sems dpa'i skyil mo krung / /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug /gung mo gnyis ni mnyam par sbyor/ /lhag ma rdo rje thal mo nyid/ /spyi bo dang ni dpral ba dang //mgrin pa gnyis dang ltag par ro/ /oṃ a bi ṣiñtsa saṃ/ thod skam phyag rgyas brtan byas pas/ /rim bzhin gnas kun brgyan par bya/ /hūṃ a bi ṣiñtsa saṃ/rin chen myu gu'i phyag rgya yis/ /rgyan rnams nye bar gdags byas te/ /rin chen phreng ba dar dpyangs bcing / /rdo rje rgya gram khro bor bcas/ /ska nan rgyan thag bgos pa dang / /mnyes pa'i thal mos brtan par bya/ /oṃ rat+na mā la a bi ṣiñtsa t+t+waṃ snye/ oṃ pa tra lo ba 5a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tu byu ho/ rjes su 14—831

chags pa'i rnam mang dga' ba'i pad+ma rnams/ dag pa'i mchod pas gsal bar rjes su mchod byas pa/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i rnal 'byor bde bas 1grub par mdzod / /e ma ho mchog tu bde ba'i dam tshig ngo bo nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba'i rnal 'byor skal bzang mchog /rang gi dam tshig rtag la rol cig ho/ /mkha' gsang dbyangs dang ye shes rgya/ /sa bon rdo rje pad+mar bcas/ /liṅga 'greng ba rang 'byung ba/ /brla yi dbus su gzhug bya ste/ /liṅga rdo rjer byin brlabs pas/ /rdo rje sems sogs skur bskyed do/ /'od 'phro kun du khyab pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes mdzad cing / /'gro 4ba'i gnas chen rnam dag par/ /mkha' gsang rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /hūṃ las bskyed pa'i rdor sems 5ni/ /gsang gnas dbus kyi gdan la gzhug /oṃ las gling bu t+t+waṃ 6pi waṃ/ /baṃ las rnga chen dze+e 7rdza rnga/ /a las me tog ā 8spos me/ /saṃ 9las mar me i dri chab/ /phyogs dang mtshams su rim pa bzhin//mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad rnams so/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsgo bzhi ru/ /rta mgrin 'phang mtho la sogs bskyed/ /bha gar liṅga bcug byas nas/ /der ni mtshan ma bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya che/ /sku gnyis ldan par spro bya'o/ /kun du don mdzad 'dus pa dang / /thabs dang shes rab rdzogs par sbyor/ /gling bu sngon mo rdo rjes mtshan/ /rdo rje lcags sgog shar gyi phyogs/ /pi wang ser mo rdo rjes mtshan/ / glu dbyangs drug ldan lho yi phyogs/ /rnga chen dmar mo rdo rje'i rnga/ /brdung mdzad nub kyi phyogs na gnas/ /rdza rnga ljang gu rdza rnga la/ /rdo rjes mtshan brdung byang gi phyogs/ /me tog dmar ser rdo rjes mtshan/ /gzhong thogs me yi mtshams su gnas/ /spos me dkar sngon rdo rjes mtshan/ /14—832

pog thogs bden bral mtshams su gnas/ /mar me dmar mo rdo rjes mtshan/ /gsal 'dzin rlung gi phyogs su gnas/ /dri chab ljang khu rdo rjes mtshan/ /dag 'thor dbang ldan mtshalas su gnas/ /rta mgrin 'phang mtho dkar mdangs can / /lcags kyu rta mgo 1ljang gu shar/ /phag gdong nag mo zhags pa g.yon/ /g.yas pa mche ba lho yi sgor/ / snang ba dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis/ / nyi zla lcags sgrog nub kyi phyogs/ /thal byed ljang gu g.yas dril bu/ /g.yon pa bhan+dha dkur bcas byang 4/ /oṃ he ra ti badz+ra bi la/ si na tra tha/ he ra ti badz+ra gī 5te te tai/ he ra ti badz+ra hā su 6ha ta baṃ/ he ra ti badz+ra dṛ 7ti pe ba le ba rdza/ oṃ badz+raṣ+pe/ oṃ badz+ra dhū 8pe/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe/oṃ badz+ra saṃ 9ku sha dzaḥ/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shri kha li baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi 1hoḥ/ 'dod pa'i yon tan tshogs rnams kyis/ /rnam mdzes phreng ba'i rgyan thogs shing / /glu dbyangs rol mo'i gar du bcas/ /lha mo bcu gnyis rang snang rdzogs/ /dbang po drug la sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsang sngags phyag rgya spyor ba'i mthus/ /rigs kyi bdag po yum dang bcas/ /rnam dag mngon shes ye shes rdzogs/ /lag gnyis rol ba'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /saganas gsum rdo rje 'ching sbyor cing / /rdo rje se gol brdab bya ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bya/ /oṃ stong pa shin tu yod med rnal 'byor mthus/ /nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ e ā ralbi sabha ga lān/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ byu hoḥ5/ sa ma ya hoḥ mu/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hoḥ 8/ sgyu 'phrul 14—833

dga' ba'i rdo rje rol pa'i tshogs/ /gzhan la snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par mdzes / /tshangs pa'i tshogs rnams zil gyis gnon mdzad pa'i/ /rtog pa du ma'i sgo 'dogs gcod par mdzad/ /gnyis med ye shes gnyis can rnam mtha' yas—/ /snang stong bde chen mnyam nyid dbyings la rol/ /kun 'byung yon tan rtsol med lhun grub snang / /rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor rnam bkod rang las byung //mdzad pa rgya chen 'gog med lhun grub pas/ /tshogs bcas rol pas bya ba kun rdzogs gnas/ /sku gsung thugs mchog yon tan phrin las rgyan/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ aXhūṃ/ a ti pu ho/ sarba ta thā ga ta brnya lhargo ka ro mi/ a la la ho/ dpal ldan g.yon pa 'gying ba'i thabs//g.yas pa ba dan gsum par bya/ /sri zhu byas shing btegs pa'i mchog /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dpal/ /'dzum dang bcas pa'i mig gis blta/ /bsam pa g.yos pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das//rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes kyis/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā du ga te bh+ya/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yarngu —/ sarba takhaṃ uṅga te sga ra ṇa hi saṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ tshad med bzhi yi phyag rgya yis/ /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor mnyes pa dag /dam tshig dkyil 'khor la gzhug cing / /mnyes nas dges shing brtan par mdzod/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin mchog /phyag rgya chen po'i cha lugs ldan/ /khams gsum kun du rgyas btab cing / /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i bdag /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ ma hā mu dra s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /bdag cag sgrub ④ la rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ /rigs mchog 14—834

sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yi/ /byin rlabs dbang bskur cho 'phrul bla na med / /a la la la ho/ ljags 1kyi pad+mo mtshan bcas dkyil/ /'od zer sbyor ba'i sngags dang bcas / /oṃ na maḥsadze+e stu ta sathru budhe bh+yaḥ4hūṃ phaṭa/dpal grub spyan gyi phyag rgya nyid/ /dam tshig gnas su gzhag 5par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya hūṃ/ srin lag mthe'u chung yan lag dbus/ /mthe bong legs gzhug dam par bcings/ /rdo rje khu tshur so so yi/ /mdzub mo lcags kyu lta bur bya/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa karma mu 6dra hūṃ/ oṃ pa na pe na 7pe nu su ra ta ti du/ pa ra mu sa ma yo ga si ta āḥ hūṃ/ oṃ s+dzahūṃ/ rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad grub par mdzod/ /mnyam pa chen po'i gnas la rol du gsol/ /gyen du 'thor dang thur du 'be+ebs/ /mar me 'degs sogs so so'i rgya/ /gling bu dang ni pi wang dang / /rgyud mangs rgyud drug sil snyan dag /dngos 'byor sprul pa gang yang rung / /rim bzhin sngags dang sbyar te dbul/ /oṃ 'byung ba lnga las thams cad 'byung / /rang las ma byung gang yang med/ /gtsang sme'i dri rtog kun bral ba'i/ /bdud rtsi byang chub sems chen pos/ /bdag sogs gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ /mnyam pa chen po'i gnas la rol/ /oṃ na ma 9sarba pañtsa a mri ta āḥ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ shin tu brgyan pa'i rigs dang mtshan ldan mchog/bkra shis glu dbyangs gar gyis bskyod byas pa'i/ /lha mo rdul snyed phyogs bcur spro byas nas/ /byang sems bde ba'i mchod pas rnam par rol/ /oṃ ma hā su kha bo rnyi tsit+ta a la la ho/ oṃ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid 74—835

can / /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med pa yi chos mchog can/ /oṃ yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par spyod1/ /oṃ rtag tu dri ma med pa'i thugs rje shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don bsgrub rab tu brtson pa 2mtha' yas lhar mdzad pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu 4rnam par gnas/ /oṃ tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi//bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog pyod mdzad pa yi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yod mi 'gyur/ /oṃ shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang na go 'phang mchog brnyes 5pa/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mdon cing / /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa 6bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig la gnas brtul zhugs mchog /gsang sngags jegs pa'i spyod pa nyid/ /rab rdzogs byang chub kun don bzhin/ /'khor lo bla med sdogs gyur cig /thugs rje che mnga' thabs ldan pas/ /rigs kyi dngos po 7brtan par mdzod/ /bya ba'i ye shes mtha' las mchog /phrin las gnas chen rdzogs gyur cig /rigs kyi sems dpa' gsum ldan pa/ /phyag rgya'i mtshan ma yi ger bcas/ /'od 'phro gsal ba rnam gnyis kyis/ /thabs dang shes rab rnam gnyis rgyun/ /rin chen thig le sna tshogs 'od/ /14—836

rigs kyi 'khor lo rdzogs byed pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa s+dza dzaḥt+t+waṃ baṃ hoḥsnasu ra ta s+t+waṃ/ ye shes dkyil 'khor brtan byed pa'i2/ /yan lag cho gas kun bsdus te/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i gong bu la/ /mtshan ma rnam gsum rim bzhin rdzogs/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor spro bsdu kun/ /mtshan ma rnam pa 4lnga yi mthar/ /ji srid yul kun brtan gnas pa/ /de nas dmigs pa med pa'i mchog5 /phyag rgya'i gsang gnas dkyil 'khor du/ /yi ge mtshan ma 6phra mo sgu/ /rim bzhin rdzogs par 7las mdzad cing / /phyag rgya brtan pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /khams gsum yul bcas rnam dag pa'i/ /byang chub sems mchog bde ba'i rgyun/ /'khor lo bzhi gnas rim pa bzhin/ /dga' ba 9bzhis bskyod nyi zla'i rgya/ /gong gi phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas/ /rab tu chags pa rnam grol sems/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /gnas gsum bde ba me mar bzhin/ /rnam par spro zhing bsdu bya ste/ /'dod pa'i yan lag rdzogs pa yi/ /thig le mnyam dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /dga' bcas byang chub sems gzhi bdag /'byor tshogs yang dag sbyor ba'i mthus/ /skye 'gag ngochos kun rnam par spangs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal spyor ba/ /ji lta'i gzugs dang dbyibs su ldan/ /bde ba nyid kyi kun gyi bdag /kun gyi bdag la gzhug —par bya/ /chags pa med cing ma chags med/ /dbu mar yang ni dmigs su med/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu spyor 'dis/ /gnyis su med pa'i theg pa mchog /thun mtshams sbyor ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /rigs kyi dam tshig sngags gsal zhing / /bzlas brjod la sogs grangs kyis 'jug /ye shes rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo nyidaslo/ /dam tshig yul kun mnyam sbyor zhing / /14—837

rim dang cig car yan lag gis/ /mtshan bcas mtshan ma med gnas dag /rab tu brtan pas gnyis med rdzogs/ /mang du bsags pa'i rdzas rnams kun/ /dag pa'i snod rnams bkang byas te/ /nye bar bsgyur ba'i byin rlabs 1kyis/ /gnyis med bdud rtsi chen por bsgrub/ /bsnyen pa rab gsal rdzogs pa las/ /nye bar bsnyen pa'i byin rlabs 4rgyas/ /bsgrub pa bdag gzhan 'bras bu nyid//yang dag brtan 'gyur dga' chen po/ /'jig rten mgron tshogs ma lus pa/ /rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas dgug /gtor ma'i rdzas rnams bsags 5pa dang / /dus gcig thugs kyi mes bsregs dzishing / /gsung gi bdud rtsis dag par mdzad / /sgu yi byin rlabs 7ye shes lnga/ /nye bar bkod pa'i sprin rnams kyis/ /thams cad dkyil 'khor brtan pa'i tshogs/ /thabs kyi dkyil 'khor mnyam sbyor zhing / /shes rab yum bcas rol pa nyid/ /de dag sngags dang phyag rgya yis—/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs rdzogs par mchod/ /spyod lam kun du ma nyams blos/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor brtan byas te/ /thabs dang shes rab gar sogs kyis/ /rol pa'i 'phro 'du rgyun bzhin gnas/ /nges pa'i gsang mchog phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /nyer gsal bshad pa'i tshul dag gis/ /don kun sku gsung thugs kyi tshul/ /rab sbyangs brtan pas rdzogs pa nyid/ /mi shes dri ma kun sel cing / /yang dag ye shes gnas gsal byed/ /rigs mchog 'khor lo rdzogs pa yi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs 'di 9rgyas par shog / dpal rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ /slob dpon chen bo thu bo rā dza ha tis mdzad pa sdogs so// 1 //7 74—838

bsdur mchan//22 she7mas byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos par ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ra / /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran pa'i cho ga bzhugs/ — — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 tā/ — 〈〈pe
