rag /sgol ma'i skub thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ tā ra sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun ②sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad spangs nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa rab ster ba/ /chu las skam sar 'don pa bzhin/ /rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni gzhan rnams las/ /'di ni mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su khrus byas la/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skad cig gis bdag nyid rje btsun mar babyed la/ de'i thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du t+t+waṃ ljang gu bsam/ t+t+waṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / bla ma dang rje btsun ma spyan drangs la phyag 'tshal ba dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe yasahūṃ/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas mchod pa 14—843

dbul ba dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang /sems bskyed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya'o/ /de nas byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms tshad med pa bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ shu n+ya tā tshwa na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kolha①haṃ/zhes brjod la stong pa'i ngang las baṃ dmar po cig bsam/ de yongs su shar pa las sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i steng du a dkar po yongs su shar pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du t+t+waṃ ljang gu cig bsam/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs nas t+t+waṃ la tshur thim pas thig le dkar po cig tu gyur/ thig le de yongs su khrugyur pa las byed la sngon po'o/ /de'i steng du a dkar po cig bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cig bsam/ de'i steng du t+t+waṃ ljang gu cig bsam/ t+t+waṃ las 'od 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas sems can thams cad sgol ma'i rang bzhin du gyur te/ 'od zer tshur 'dus te t+t+waṃ la thim pas byed la dang / pad+ma'i dkyil ①dang / t+t+waṃ yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun sgol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin—/ g.yon pa da la bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum du bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bur bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas phyogs bzhi'i pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi la a dkar po bzhi yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bsam/ de nas bdag nyid kyi 14—844

lte ba nas 'od zer bzhi 'phros pa las shar du dkar po/ lhor ser po/ nub tu dmar po/ byang du nag po/ de bzhi yongs su gyur pa las yi ge bzhi ru shar te/ shar du oṃ dkar po/ lho ru tā ser po/ nub tu re dmar po/byang du tu nag po/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las shar du pad+ma dkar po/lho ru mya ngan med pa'i shing ser po/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po/ byang du gri gug nag po/ phyag mtshan de bzhi'i steng du a dkar po bzhi yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi'i steng du shar du oṃ dkar po/ lho ru tā ser po/ nub tu re dmar po/ byang du tu nag po/ phyag mtshan dang zla ba'i sa bon yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du so sor 'brang ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig ma/phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum ma/ dngo krung ①dang bcas pa/ phyag g.yas nor bu rin po che/ g.yon pa na pad+ma dkar po'i steng na rin po che'i bum pa ser po bsnams pa'o/ /lho phyogs su 'od zer can sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum ma/ gis krung ②dang bcas pa phyag g.yas na rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yon pa na mya ngan med pa'i shing ser po'o/ /nub phyogs su phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phag gi gdong pa can/sbyan gsum pa byed krung skedang bcas pa/ phyag g.yas na pad+ma dmar po/g.yon mnyam par gzhag pa'o/ /byang phyogs su ral pa gcig ma sku mdog nag mo khro mo'i zhal can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pa na gri gug bsnams pa/ g.yon pa na thod pa khrag gis rjobakang ba bsnams pa/ stag gi pags ⑤pa'i sham thabs can/ skyil krung rjodu bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas gtso mo'i thugs ka nas sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng na zla ba'i dkyil 14—845

'khor—/ de'i steng na t+t+waṃ ljang gu de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi lha lnga'i bdag nyid spyan drangs nas mdun du byon pa la mchod pa dbul bar bya ste/ /ar+ghaṃ dbul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ ā hūṃ puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/oṃ yasahūṃ dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ yasahūṃ dri paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ yasahūṃ gadhe ①pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ne+e byu bye sdepra tīts+tsha swā hā zhes mchod pa byas la snying gar ut+pa la'i phyag rgya byas la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes bya bas dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing pa dang dgyes pa byas so/ /de nas bdag gi thugs ka nas sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi t+t+waṃ ljang gu las 'od zer 'phros te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs nas/ de rnams kyi phyag na rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba thogs nas byon pa la snga ma ltar mchod pa skedabul bar bya'o/ /a rnyi ji tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga tā zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi'i bum pa chus bkang bas dbang bskur bar bsams la rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa ni gtso mo'i spyi bor don yod grub pa'o/ /so sor 'brang ma la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /'od zer can ma la ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /phag mo la snang ba mtha' yas so/ /ral gcig ma la mi bskyod rjopas dbu brgyan no/ /de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po'i steng du s+dzadamar po thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ nag po/ de nas gtso mo nyid la byin kyis brlab par bya'o/ /'khor la ni mi dgos so/ /de nas gnas rnam pa brgyad du phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ gnas brgyad na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor brgyad yod pa'o/ /de'i steng na yi ge brgyad yod pa ni kha dog 14byed846

dkar po'o—/ /①lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings te/ mthe bo gnyis mdzub mo'i steng du bzhag ②la spyi bor gtugs ④te oṃ swā hā zhes brjod pa ni spyi bo'i phyag rgya'o| /khu tshur gnyis bcings te mdzub mo gnyis rang bzhin du bkug ste rtse mo gnyis sprad 0mthe bong gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu brkyang la dpral par gtugs te tā swā hā zhes brjod pa ni dpral pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo khong stong du byas la mabe+e bong gnyis nang du bkug ste mig gnyis su gtugs shing ⑤re swā hā zhes brjod pa ni mig gi phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur gnyis bcangs te mdzub mo gnyis rang bzhin du bkug ste rtse mo gnyis sprad mthe rjobong gung mo'i steng du brkyang la mgrin par gtugs te tu ta ⑦swā hā zhes brjod pa ni mgrin pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur bcings te mthe bong gnyis dang mdzub mo gnyis gyed ⑧la dpung pa gnyis kyi steng du gtugs te tā swā hā zhes bya ba ni dpung pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo sbyar la mabe+e bong gnyis babe+eng ste gyed ⑨la snying gar ⑩gtugs te re swā hā zhes bya ba ni snying ga'i phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur gnyis bcings te mthe bong gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang ste gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pa bkug ste lte bar gtugs te tu swā hā zhes bya ba ni lte ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /khya tshur gnyis bcings te mthe bong gnyis mdzub mo'i steng du brkyang la gung mo gnyis rang sor brkyang ste rtse mo gnyis sprad la bag tsam bskum ste/ gsang ba'i gnas su gtugs la re swā hā zhes bya ba ni gsang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya bcings pa'i dgos pa ni dam tshig bsrung bar 'gyur ba dang / lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la brten ⑪par 'gyur ba dang /kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i chos thams cad sems la brten pa nyid du 'dzin pa'o/ /yang dgos ⑫pa gnyis te 'jig rten pa ⑫dang 'jig rten las 'das 14—847

pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / bdag la bdud la sogs pa'i bar chad thams cad kyis mi tshugs ①par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa'o/ /de nas bdag gi ②snying gar sna tshogs pad zla'i steng du t+t+waṃ ljang gu las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog ste sems can thams cad rje btsun ma'i gzugs su byas pas sems can thams cad kyi ④nyon mongs pa lnga dag par byas so/ /de nas tshur 'dus te t+t+waṃ la thim par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar spro ba dang bsdu bar bya'o/ /skyon bzlas pa bya ste thugs ka'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na t+t+waṃ ljang gu la yi ge bcus g.yas skor ④du bskor te mar me'i phreng ba lta bur bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re swā hā zhes brjod par bya'o/ /der yang mgyogs pa ma yin/ /bul ba ma yin par te sngags bzlas pa'i lugs gsum ste rang gis thos la gzhan gyis mi thos pa dang / rang gzhan gnyis kas thos pa dang / ngag ma yin pa'i sems kyis bzlas pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po'i dgos pa ni zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dgug pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pas ni mngon spyod 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pas ni phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs ni bye ba phrag gcig go/ /las la sbyor ba'i dus su gtso mo'i sku mdog sgyur gyi 'khor gyi mi sgyur ro/ /de yang zhi ba la oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ ma ma shārnyi ⑤ku ru swā hā zhes brjod par bya'o//rgyas pa la ni oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re bo ṣaṭa mam puzlo ku ru brjod par bya'o/ /dgra grogs por bya ba la ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re ba ṣaṭa a mu ka ba shi ku ru ba ṣaṭa ces rjobarjod par bya'o/ /dgug pa la ni oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re tshwa na a mu ka ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ⑦zhes brjod par bya'o/ /bskrad pa la ni oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re 14byed848

phu a mu ka u tsa ṭa ya phu zhes brjod par bya'o/ / bcing ba ①la dgra lus bcing ba ni/ oṃ tā ②re tut+tha re ③tu re a mu ka ste bha ya lo zhes brjod par bya'o/ /ngag bcing ba ni oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re swā hā lo a mu ka rjowā tsa ste bha ya lo zhes brjod par bya'o/ /dgra rang gi gnas su bcing ba ni/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā lo ā kar+ṣa a mu ka lo ⑤ste bha ya lo zhes brngod par bya'o/ /gsad pa la ni oṃ tā re turtswa re tu re swā rjohūṃ phaṭa a mu ka mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces brjod par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma gtang bar bya ste mdun du a dkar po yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gtor ma'i snod dngul las byas par mos par bya'o//de'i nang du a dkar po yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ /de'i steng du oṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste oṃ dang zla ba la babs pas de rnams zhu bas 'o ma lta bur gyur to/ /de nas oṃ uhūṃ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā zhes brjod de/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi lce rdo rje'i sbu gu dang ldan pas gsol bar bsam par bya'o/ /chos skyong ba rnams la ni/ oṃ a ⑦kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhadrwa t+t+waṃ ā r+ya ⑧nut+pan+da tāta oṃ ldihūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes lan gsum brjod de lce rdo rje'i sbu gu dang ldan pas gsol bar bsam par bya'o/ /thun tha ma la ni ye shes kyi lha gshegs su gsol lo/ /dam tshig sems dpa' bdag la bsdu bar bya'o/ /da ⑨ni rnam par dag pa bshad par bya'o/ /gtso mo'i zhal gcig tu byung ⑩ba ni chos thams cad ye shes gcig tu rtogs pa'o/ /sku mdog ljang gu byung ba ni las sna tshogs la dbang ba'o//phyag gnyis su byung ba ni g.yas pa kun rdzob g.yon pa don dam bden pa ⑪gnyis rtogs pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas brkyang ba ni bdud la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad 14—849

spangs pa'o/ /g.yon bskum pa ni yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa ni tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ gtso 'khor mthun pa'o//phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /g.yon pa skyabs sbyin pa ni sems can thams cad 'jigs pa las skyob pa'o/ /ut+pa la bsnams pa ni sems can thams cad dga' bar byed pa'o/ /lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu ni sems can thams cad kyi don bsgrub ①pa'i nus pa ⑦dang ldan pa'o/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan ni shes rab dang ldan pa'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan ni snying rje'i rang bzhin dang ldan pa'o/ /rigs ni don yod grub pa'i rigs so/ /phung po ni rnam par shes pa'i phung po'o/ /ye shes ni chos kyi dbyings ④rnam par dag pa'i ye shes so/ /so sor 'brang ma'i sku mdog dkar mo ni chos thams cad dri ma med pa dang ldan pa'o/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis su byung ba gtso mo dang mthun no/ /spyan gsum ni dus gsum mkhyen pa'o| /phyag g.yas pa rin po che ni sems can thams cad kyi dgos 'dod kyi re ba skong ba'o/ /phyag g.yon pa'i pad+ma dkar po ni chos thams cad skyon dang bral ba'i rtags so/ /de'i steng na rin po che'i bum pa ser po yod pa ni chos thams cad la rin po cher 'dzin pa'o/ /phung po ni gzugs kyi phung po'o/ /ye shes ni me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /rigs ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi rigs so—/ /'od zer can rjogyi sku mdog ser mo ni sems can thams cad kyi don rgyas par byed pa'o/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ni gtso mo dang mthun no/ /phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje'i ra 'og ma lnga ni phung po lnga dag pa'o/ /steng gi ra lnga ni rgyal ba rigs lnga dang ldan no/ /g.yon pa'i mya ngan med pa'i shing ni sems can thams 14—850

cad kyi ①duḥkha spong bar ②byed pa'o/ /phung po ni tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa'o/ /ye shes ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /rigs ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rigs so/ /phag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ni gtso mo dang mthun no| /sku mdog dmar mo ni 0sems can thams cad la snying rje dang ldan pa'o/ /phag gi gdong pa ni bdud thams cad 'dul ba'o/ /phyag g.yas kyi pad+ma dmar po ni chos thams cad rin po che pad+ma rā ga lta bur rtogs pa'o/ /g.yon mnyam gzhag ni chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'o/ /phung po ni 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa'o/ /ye shes ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /rigs ni snang ba mtha' yas kyi rigs so/ /ral pa gcig ma'i zhal gasbug phyag gnyis ni gtso mo dang mthun pa'o/ /khro mo'i zhal ni bdud 'dul ba'i rtags so/ /phyag g.yas kyi gri gug ni nyon mongs pa gcod pa'i rtags so/ /phyag g.yon pa'i thod pa ni rnam rtog thams cad spangs ba'i rtags so/ /sku mdog nag mo ni byams pa chen po'i rtags so/ /stag gi pags ④pa'i sham thabs ni 'khor ba khrug chol gyi rang bzhin kun rdzob kyi bden pa rtogs pa'o/ /phung po ni 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa'o/ /ye shes ni bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes so/ /rigs ni mi bskyod pa'i rigs so/ /'khor bzhi ka skyil krung ⑤du byung ba ni gzhan gyi don la shin tu brtan pa'o/ /mtshams kyi pad+ma bzhi la ut+pa la bzhi byung ba ni/ spyan ma/ mā ma tī/ gos dkar mo/ sgol ma ste lha mo bzhi'o/ /'byung ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'o/ /tshad med pa bzhi'i ngo bo'i ༷lha'i bdag nyid na ⑦rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sprul pa nyon mongs pa lnga spangs pa ste gtso mo phrag dog spangs pa'o/ /so sor 'brang ma gti mug spangs pa'o/ /'od zer can nga rgyal 14—851

spangs pa'o/ /phag mo chags pa spangs pa'o/ /ral gcig ma zhe sdang spangs pa'o—/ /de ni bskyed pa'i rim pa ste sprul pa'o/ /stong pa nyid du mos nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de yang ①ni bdag gi snying gar ②sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi t+t+waṃ ljang gu ①las 'od zer dkar po rnam snang gi rang bzhin du gtso mo'i ④lte ba nas byung bas so sor 'brang ma spyan drangs nas bdag gi ⑤dpral bar thim mo/ /yang lte ba nas 'od zer dmar po 'od ༷dpag med kyi rang bzhin du byung bas phag mo spyan drangs nas gtso mo'i ⑦mgrin par thim mo/ /yang lte ba nas 'od zer nag po mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin du byung bas ral gcig ma gtso mo'i ⑦thugs kar thim mo/ /yang lte ba nas 'od zer rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin du byung bas 'od zer can gtso mo'i ⑨lte bar thim mo/ /de nas gtso mo nyid pad+ma dang zla ba dang t+t+waṃ gi ⑩ngo bor gyur to/ /pad+ma yang zla ba la thim/⑪ zla ba ṭ+wāṃ la thim/ t+t+waṃ zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le bin+d+ra la thim mo⑫/ /bin+d+ra dmar po khab kyi rtse mo lta bur gyur te⑫/ de ni chos kyi sku'o/ /de nas rnam par rtog pa med par nyal bar bya'o/ /de nas nang par sngar ldang ba'i dus su/ nā da de thig ler song / /de t+t+waṃ du song / de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid gtso bo nyid kyis skad cig gis bskyed nas/ de'i thugs ka nas sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi t+t+waṃ las 'od 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la bsod nams kyi tshogs sogs ⑫pa la sogs pa snga ma ltar bya'o/ /rje btsun sgol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ sgol ma rgya mtsho'i rgyud nas phyung ba 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis ⑫mdzad pa rdzogs so// //14—852

༄ga /thugs rje chen po 'phags ma sgol ma'i sgrub thabs spyi'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/①༄ ga /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgol ma las kyi sbyor ba yis/ /bsrung ba'i cho ga bya ba ni/ /bde ba'i stan la ①'dug nas ni/ /rang gi snying gar ③sa bon bsam/ /de las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis//bla ma dang bcas sangs rgyas ni/ /bdag gi mdun du gsal byas la/ /'od zer de las byung ba yib/ /me tog sogs kyis mchod par bya/ /de nas sdig bshags la sogs bya/ /de nas lha ru bsgom ⑤bya ste/ /dang por chos rnams stong par bsgom/ /de 'og pad du'adab brgyad pa ⑦dang / /zla ba'i dbus su yi ge t+t+waṃ/ /sa bon de las ut+pa la/ /lte bar t+t+waṃ gis mtshan par bsgom/ /ut+pal t+t+waṃ bcas gyur pa las/ /bdag nyid sgol ma'i gzugs su bsgom/ /phyag g.yas mi ⑧'jigs ster ba'o/ /g.yon pa ut+pal bsnams pa ni/ /'dab ma rna bar ⑨ma reg pa'o/ /sku mdog ljang sngon dag tu bsgom/ /de ltar bdag 14—855

nyid bskyed pa'i mthar/ /yan lag drug tu dgod pa ni/ /oṃ ①tā re swā hā/oṃ tuṣ+ṭha re swā hā/ oṃ ②tu re swā hā/ oṃ ①tu swā hā/ oṃ ④re swā hā/ oṃ ⑤tā re ni rjoswā hā zhes bya ba rnams mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /snying ga ⑦dang / spyi bor go rims ⑧bzhin dgod do/ /de nas snying gar ⑨pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte ba la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du sa bon t+t+waṃ ljang gu ⑩bsams la/ oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re sru hā zhes sngags sum 'bum yan chod du ci nus su bzlas so/ /de nas 'khor lo bsam pa ni/ /lte ba dang bcas rtsibs brgyad la/ /mu khyud bskor ba snying gar ⑪bsam/ /'khor lo kha dog ljang sngon no⑫/ /'khor lo'i dbus kyi lte ba la/ /thog ma'i oṃ ⑫dang tha ma'i hā/ /ming dang spel te bsgom par bya/ /bsrung ba oṃ lha sbyin byal rak+ṣa hā zhes pa bsgom/ tā re tut+na re swā ⑫zhes pa rnams ni/ shar sogs rtsibs la rim bzhin dgod/ /rang gi lus la 'khor lo ni/ /yig 'bru rnams kyang ljang sngon no/ /de ltar bsgom pa goms byas nas/ /bdag nyid sgol ma'i sku dang ni/ /sngags dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo las/ /spros pa'i 'od zer dag gis ni/ /bsgrub bya'i lus la dgang bar bya/ /bsrung ba'i skabs su phreng ba'i sngags| /oṃ ⑩tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re lha ⑩sbyin la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā zhes pas bsrung ba'i las la ni/ khyad par du ni bya bar gsungs/ /spyor ba de yis rgyal po gyi/ /btson ra la sogs bsrung bar bya/ /sgol ma las kyi sbyor ba yis/ /las rnams yang dag bsgrub bya ste⑩/ /nad sogs zhi ba'i las dang ni/ /dbang du bya ba'i sbyor ba la'ang / /cho ga gong ma de nyid las/ /'khor lo la sags kha dog dang / /sngags kyi spel ba bstan par bya/ /rang gi las dang mthun par 14—856

bya/ /sgrol ma yi ni ting 'dzin gyis/ /las gzhan dag kyang bya bar nus/ /bsgrub bya shes rab zhan ①pa dang / /le lo can sogs rnams la ni/ /gong ma'i cho ga de nyid las/ /gzhan du bya bar bstan pa de②/ /'khor lo snga ①ma de nyid las/ /sngags rnams g.yon skor rjodag tu dgod/ /mu khyud la yang a sogs dgod/ /de ltar bsgom dang bzlas byas na/ /blo dman rnams ni blo ldan 'gyur/ /gzhan yang sbyor ba bya ba ni/ /'di lta bur yang bstan pa yin/ /gro ga la sogs gzhi la ni/ /'khor lo gong ma ltar bris nas/ /lus la bcang par byas na yang / /de tsam gyis kyang bsrung bar 'gyur/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags ma sgol ma'i sgrub thabs spyi'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/855 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉pos/ ①〈〈pe 〉rar/〈'ar 〉ltar/ ④〈〈pe〉las/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉mkham/ du〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉mid+ma/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7pa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉zo/⑨〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉mi/856 ①〈'ar 〉kro ②④rjo⑤〈'ar〉ye rjo〈〈pe 〉r+sā/ ⑦〈snar 〉khi/ ⑧〈shar 〉ṭham/ ⑨〈'ar 〉khir/⑩〈'ar 〉〉te ljang sa ⑪〈'ar 〉khir/ ⑫〈'ar 〉8/ ⑫〈'ar 〉ye ④〈〈pe 〉7lolhas byin/〈'ar 〉ye lha sbyin/ ⑫〈'ar 〉ye ⑫〈〈pe 〉stos byin/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉rdzas/ spyo〈'ar 〉rkus/ ⑪〈'ar 〉7sa te/857 ①〈'ar 〉razhan/ ④〈'ar 〉lte/ ①〈'ar 〉wā/ bu〈〈pe 〉thaskor/14—857
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (513)14wa 858

rtsa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①rag /rgya gar skad du/ tā re de bi sto tram̐ ④e ka bi shaṃ ①ti ka sā dha dz+wa bunā ma/ bod skad du/ lha mo sgrol ma'i bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal sgol ma myur ma dpa' mo/ /spyan ni skad cig glog dang 'dra ma/ /'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes zhal gyi/ /ge sar bye ba las ni byung ma/ /de la dang por re zhig bcom ldan 'das ma sgol ma nam mkha'i dkyil na pad+ma dmar ⑤po'i steng na bzhugs pa sku mdog dmar mo me lta bu'i 'od 'phro ba can/ zhal gcig la spyan gnyis ma phyag brgyad pa'o/ /phyag dang po gnyis sgrog par bzhengs pa'i rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu gzhan la 'phen pa rjothugs kar ⑦bkang ba/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ske'akhor lo/ bzhi pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na dung ⑨/ bzhi pa na 14—859

zhags pa bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /'phags ma sgrol ma myur zhing rab tu dpa' ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub ①thabs le'u dang po rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal ston ka'i zla ba kun tu/ /gang ba brgya ni brtsegs pa'i zhal ma//skar ma stong phrag tshogs pa rnams kyis/ /rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma /de la dang por re zhig ston ka'i ①zla ba ltar dkar ba'i sgol ma dkar mo zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma/ zhal gsum ni rtsa zhal dkar ba/① g.yas sngo zhing g.yon ser ba'o/ /phyag dang po gnyis mnyam par gzhag pa/ g.yas gnyis pa ༷kha ṭ+wāṃ ⑤ga /gsum pa na 'khor lo/ bzhi pa na rin po che/ lnga pa na rdo rje/ drug pa na me tog gi duphreng ba'o/ /g.yon kyi gnyis pa na ril ba spyi blugs| gsum pa na ut+pa la/ bzhi pa na dril bu/ lnga pa dze+en bum pa/drug pa na po ti bsnams pa'o/ /⑧'phags ma sgol ma ston ka'i ⑨zla ba ltar dkar ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs le'u gnyis pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal gser ⑩sngo chu nas skyes kyi⑪/ /pad+mas phyag ni rnam par brgyan ma—/ /sbyin pa brtson 'grus dka' thub zhi ba/ /bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul nyid ma/ /rje btsun ma ⑫sgol ma gser gyi mdog can zhal gcig phyag bcu maske/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng gi nyi ma la gnas ma/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na phreng ba thugs kar ⑫'dzin pa/ gnyis pa na ral gri/ gsum pa na mda' 'phen par mdzad ⑫pa/ bzhi pa na rdo rje/ lnga pa na dbyu gu'o/ /g.yon gyi dang po na dar dpyangs/ gnyis pa na zhags pa/ gsum pa na pad+ma/ bzhi 14—860

pa na dril bu/ lnga pa na gzhu ①bsnams pa'o/ /de yang rdo rje skyil sdekrung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma gser mdog can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba'i le'u gsum pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor/ /mtha' yas rnam par rgyal bar spyod ma/ /ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis shin tu brtan ④ma/ /pad+ma ser po dang zla ba'i dkyil na dusems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis brtan par bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma gser gyi mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas dang po mchog sbyin pa/ gnyis pa na phreng ba/ g.yon dang po na ril ba spyi blugs/ gnyis pa na dbyu ⑤gu bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste bzhi pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal tu re rjohūṃ yi ges/ /'dod dang phyogs dang nam mkha' gang ma/ /'jig rten gsum ⑦po zhabs kyis mnan te/ /lus pa med par 'gugs par nus ma/ /rje btsun ma sku mdog ser mo/ zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje skyi mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas skyabs sbyin pa/ g.yon pad+ma ser po bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgrol ma hūṃ gi sgra rab tu sgogs ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub ⑧thabs kyi le'u ste lnga pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshangs pa/ /rlung lha sna tshogs dbang phyug mchod 14—861

ma / /'byung po ro langs dri za rnams dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs kyis ①mdun nas bstod ma/ /rje btsun ma dmar mo/ pad+ma dmar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje/ gnyis pa ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po ④sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na ④zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste drug pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal traṭa ces bya dang phaṭa kyis/ /pha rol 'a la ④'khor rab tu 'joms ma/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis mnan te/ /me 'bar 'khrug pa ⑤shin tu 'bar ma/ /dze+e btsun ma nag mo/ pad+ma ser po dang dunyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ⑦g.yon brkyang pas bzhugs pa/ na bza' ser po ⑧mnabs pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can/ rkang gdub la sogs pa dang ldan pa—/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma dbu skra gyen du badze+es shing sbrul gyis brgyan pa/g.yas dang po na 'khor lo/ gnyis pa na ral gri/ g.yon dang po skye ⑨gnas kyi steng na zhags pa bsnams pa/ gnyis pa brkyang ste snyigs mdzub ⑩mdzad pa'o—/ /'phags ma sgol ma gzhan 'joms ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste bdun pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal tu res ⑩'jigs pa chen mo⑫/ /bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms ma/ /chu skyes zhal ni khro gnyer ldan mdzad/ /dgra bo thams cad ma lus gsod ma/ /rje btsun ma gser gyi mdog can zhal gcig phyag 14—862

bzhi ma/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i steng na ①chu srin la skyil mo krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ g.yas dang po na shing mya ngan med pa'i yal ga bzung ba/gnyis pa na ②rin po che bsnams shing mchog stsol ④ba/ g.yon dang po na pad+ma/gnyis pa na bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma bdud thams cad 'joms shing / dbang mchog ster bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste brgyad pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i/ /sor mos thugs kar rjornam par brgyan ma/ /ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor los brgyan pa'i/ /rang gi 'od kyi ⑤tshogs rnams 'khrugs rjom/ /rje btsun ma pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can/ pad+ma dmar po dang ⑦zla ba'i steng na bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan ma/ phyag dang po gnyis rab du dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya ste/ dang po'i phyag rgya lta bu'o/ /g.yas gnyis pas gar byed pa/ g.yon gnyis pa shing mya ngan med pa'i yal ga 'dzin pa'i phyag gis sems can thams cad la rin po che'i char rgyun 'be+ebs par mdzad pa'o / /⑧'phags ma sgrol ma mchog stsol ⑨ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste dgu pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' bas brjid pa'i/ /dbu rgyan 'od kyi phreng bas spel ma/ /bzhad pa rab bzhad tut+ta re yis/ /bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma/ /rje btsun ma dmar mo pad+ma dmar po ⑩zla ba'i steng na ⑪rol pas bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa⑫/ phyag dang po gnyis spyi bor rab tu 14—863

dga' ba'i phyag rgya bcings pa/ g.yas gnyis pa na ral gri'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa—/ g.yon gnyis pa na shing mya ngan med pa'i yal ga bzung ①ba'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma mya ngan thams cad sel bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste bcu pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal sa gzhi skyong ba'i tshogs rnams/ /thams cad 'gugs par nus pa ②nyid ma/ /khro gnyer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūṃ gis/ /phongs ①pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma/ /rje btsun ma mun pa'i mdog can nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na pad+ma la zhab7sa g.yas brkyang pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyogs mtshams brgyad nas gza' brgyad g.yas na bsnams pa'i lcags kyus 'gugs pa/ phyag g.yon pas rol pa'i zhags pa ④bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma 'gro ba thams cad 'gugs shing phongs ⑤pa thams cad sel ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste bcu gcig pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal zla ba'i dum bus dbu brgyan/ /brgyan pa thams cad shin tu 'bar ma/ /ral pa'i khrod nas ༷'od dpag med las/ /rtag par shin tu 'od ni mdzad ma/ /rje btsun ma 'phags ⑦ma gser gyi mdog can/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma/ g.yas dang po na rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pa na lcags kyu/gsum pa na rdo rje/ bzhi pa na ral gri/ g.yon dang po na rin po che thugs kar bsnams pa/ gnyis pas lcags kyu/ gsum pas dbyutsogu/ bzhi pas ⑨14—864

bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma bkra shis thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste bcu gnyis pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshad bskal pa'i mtha' ①ma'i me ltar/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba'i dbus na gnas ma/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dga'i/ /dgra yi dpung ni rnam par 'joms ma/ /rje btsun ma dmar mo pad+ma dmar po'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer dang bcas pa la g.yas brkyang pas gnas pa—/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ byun ma dang mchu gyen du rtsol bas lta ④ba/g.yas dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na mda'/ g.yon dang po na 'khor lo/ /gnyis pa na gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma yongs su smin par byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste bcu gsum pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal sa gzhi'i ngos la phyag gi/ /mthil gyis bsnun cing zhabs kyis skebardung ma/ /khro gnyer can mdzad yi ge hūṃ gis/ /rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma/ /rje btsun ma sku mdog nag mo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na pad+ma dmar ser la g.yas brkyang pa'i gar gyis yi dwags mnan cing bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum la spyan gsum mnga' ba'i rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag drug pa khro gnyer dang ldan zhing zhal dang smin ma bsdus pa can/ mi'i rgyu ma zhal du gsol zhing mi mgo'i rjocod pan can/ thod pa'i do shal dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs mnabs pa/ sbrul brgyad kyis ⑤brgyan pa/ phyogs dang mabyedas bzhir myu gu 14—865

'dzin pa/ phyag g.yas dang po ral gri/ gnyis pa lcags kyu/ gsum pa dbyu gu/ g.yon dang po khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa/ gnyis pa na ①zhags pa/gsum pa na mgo bo bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma 'gugs pa'i khro mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi sdele'u ste ④bcu bzhi pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zhi ma/ /mya ngan 'das zhi ④spyod yul nyid ma/ /swā hā oṃ dang yang dag ldan ma⑤/ /sdig pa chen mo rjo'ajoms pa nyid ma/ /rje btsun ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag drug ma/ pad+ma dkar po'i steng na zla ba la rdo rje dngo mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas dang pos phreng ba thugs kar ⑦bsnams pa/gnyis pa mchog sbyin/ gsum pa dbyu ⑧gu/ g.yon dang po na pad+ma/ gnyis pa na ril pa spyi blugs/ gsum pa po ti bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma zhi ba chen mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste bco lnga pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i/ /dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gems ma/ /yi ge bcu po'i ngag ⑨ni bkod pa'i⑩/ /rig pa ⑪hūṃ las sgrol ma nyid ma/ /rje btsun ma dmar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum ma⑫/ phyag gnyis ma/pad+ma dmar ser kyi steng na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la sems dpa'i byed mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas thugs kar ⑫rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ g.yon snying po dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma chags pa 'joms ma ⑫zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi ⑫le'u ste ⑩bcu drug pa rdzogs so// //14—866

phyag 'tshal tu re zhabs ni brdabs pas/ /hūṃ yig ①rnam pa'i sa bon nyid ma/ /ri rab man+da ra dang 'bigs byed/ /'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba nyid ma/ /rje btsun ma sku mdog dmar ser/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/pad+ma dkar po'i steng na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la sems dpa'i skyil mo ②krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar ①zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgrol ma bde ba thams cad sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi dhile'u ste ⑤bcu bdun pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal lha yis mtsho rjoyi rnam pa'i/ /ri dwags rtags can phyag na bsnams ⑦ma/ /tā ⑧ra gnyis brjod phaṭa kyi ⑨yi ges/ /dug rnams ma lus par ni sel ma/ /rje btsun ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ pad+ma dkar po dang ⑩zla ba'i gdan la ngang pa'i steng na sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis dga' ba'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa/ g.yas gnyis pas mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon gnyis pa snying po dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o/ /'phags ma sgrol ma rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi ⑪le'u ste ⑫bco brgyad pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams ⑫rgyal po/ /lha dang mi 'am ci yis bsten ma / /kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis/ /rtsod dang mi lam ngan pa sel ma/ /rje btsun ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na sems dpa'i skyil mo krung ⑫gis bzhugs pa/14—867

'od zer kyi phreng bas brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyishethugs kar skeme'i snod bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma sdug bsngal thams cad bsreg ①pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi ④le'u ste ⑤bcu dgu pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal nyi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i/ /spyan gnyis po la rjo'od rab gsal ma—/ /ha ra gnyis brjod tut+ta re yis/ /shin tu drag po'i rims ni sel ma / /rje btsun ma dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na sems dpa'i skyil mo ⑦krung gis bzhugs pa/phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi mdog can gyi bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgrol ma dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi ⑧le'u ste ⑨nyi shu pa rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal de nyid gsum rnams bkod pas/ /zhi ba'i mthu dang yang dag ldan ma/ /gdon dang ro langs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams/ /'joms pa tu re'i ⑩rab mchog nyid ma/ /rje btsun ma dkar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum pa—/ phyag gnyis pa/ /khyu mchog gi steng na pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i ⑪sham thabs mnabs ⑫pa/g.yas pa ⑫phreng ba/ g.yon ⑫rtse gsum pa bsnams pa'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma ⑫yongs su rdzogs par byed ma ⑩zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi ⑩le'u ste spyonyi shu rtsa gcig pa rdzogs so// //'phags ma sgol ma'i bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba kha 14—868

༄ga /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma'i sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i las kyi yan lag dang bcas pa mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/stirag /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin che/ /mi rtog gzhan don mthar phyin pa②/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis lha mo yi/ /tshul 'chang de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig sgrub thabs kyi/ /spyi dang so so'i cha la brten/ /las kyi yan lag dngos grub rim| /mdor bsdus bdag gis bstan par bya/ /rtsod ldan dus kyi rnal 'byor pas/ /gzhan gyis byas pa 'jig ④pa'i phyir/ /bsgrub bya'i yul gyi lha rten nam/ /gdug cing gnag pa'i rang bzhin la/ /dkyil 'khor nag po dhimada' gang tshad/ /de dbus drag po'i hom khung du/ /dug dang khrag dang nag pos byugs⑤/ /de la skyed rjoshing ra bas bskor/ /de yi dbus su bsgrub bya'i gzugs—/ /de nyid las byung rdzas rnams dang / /gzhan yang drag po'i ⑦rdzas rnams las/ /nying lag brgyad pa skye mched rdzogs/ /de yi snying gar ⑧14—871

zhing chen nam/ /dur khrod ras la drag po yi/ /rdzas dang sgyu ①gus 'khor lo bri/ /rtsibs brgyad gsang sngags spel tshig can/ /kha sbyar legs dril gzhug par bya/ /rgyus chen dag gam drag po yi/ /gzugs kyi thag pas snying gar byadrang / /lcags sam rnal 'byor gling bu yis/ /spu gus snying gar ④gtad byas nas/ /bdag nyid lha yi sbyor ldan pas/ /sbod dang sbod byed rten phral nas/ /sngar gyi gzugs la legs par gzhug /de yi steng du la gsum dang / /lung gsum sa ⑤dang chus sbrus pa'i/ /mchod rten nag po khru gang tshad/ /khri 'phang bzhi pa bum rten bcas/ /bum pa drag po'i dbyibs can de/ /rgod dang bsrung ༷dang rna ba yi/ /'gul spyodang thos ④dang bsnam ⑨pa yi/ /sdud ⑩byed rnams ni go rims ⑪bzhin/ /ngos gsum po la byug byas pa'i/ /bum pa phyogs skyong snying por bcas/ /gdugs la yi ge bcu pa ni/ /spel tshig dang bcas kyis brgyan pa/ /ji srid ma thob rab tu ⑫mnan/ /spyi dang khyad par lha rnams la/ /mchod dang bstan pa skyong ba la/ /gtor ma ⑫mnyes byas bden tshig can/ /lha yi sbyor ba rgyun mi bcad④/ /dgug dang gzhug dang bstem sogs kyi⑫/ /sbyor ba rab tu brtsam byas nas⑩/ /me tog la ni rdo char bzhin/ /cig shos myur du pham ⑩'gyur te/ /pha rol nus pa che na rung ⑫/ /nang gi mtshan ma rnyed gyur nas/ /snga ma'i gzugs de bsreg byas la/ /bdag bcas sar gzhug de yi steng / / tsi bye ⑪nag pos mnan par bya/ /oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re che ge mo a mu rka ⑥mā ra ya phaṭa/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re ā ⑥rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re che ge mo kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi brnya brnya⑫/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ dha ra dha ra—/ bi dh+wa na sa ya bi dh+wa na sa ya/ a mu kai ⑫mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/14—872

oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re ma hā pañtsa ①yak+ṣa/ stam+bha stam+bha dze+e tri ②baṃ ril mā ra ya phaṭa ku ru kukhre ③bh+yo/ 'phags ma sgro ma myur zhing rab tu dpa' rjomo zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag phyir zlog ⑤pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dang po rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yams sogs 'jig rten ma rungs rnams/ /rab tu zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi zla ba la/ /khru do khor yug maṇ+ḍal terjo/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad dbus su ni/ /'od dpag med dang 'phags ma ste/ /phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi mtshams bzhi la//yum bzhi'i mtshan ma dgod par bya/ /de yi phyi rol phyogs skyong dgod/ /grwa bzhir mda' bzhi me long bzhi/ /ral gri bzhi dang rma bya bzhi/ /tshon skud lnga yis dkri ⑦bar bya/ /bkra shis shing ngam zangs ma las/ /byas pa'i phur pa phyogs bzhir gzugs/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs dang / /me tog phreng ba la sogs pa'i/ /mchod pa'i khyad par rgya chen bsham/ /dar ram ras sam gro ga la/ /bkra shis dar dpyangs ⑧bris byas nas/ /dbus su yi ge bcu pa ste/ /g.yas dang g.yon du rigs lnga yi/ /yab dang yum du bcas pa yi/ /gsham ⑨du phyogs skyong snying ⑩po rnams/ /gur gum ⑪kyis ni bri bar bya/ /'phags ma la sogs rten bzhugs la/ /ci 'byor pa yis mchod pa ⑫ste/ /bstan skyong rnams la gtor ma sbyin/ /de nas dge slong dge 'dun nam/ /gso sbyong ldan pas bsnyen pa bya/ /khri phrag re la mchod pa dang / /gtor ma re ste gsol ba gdab/ /cha lang la sogs sngags bkod la/ /shin tu bsgrims pas bsgrags ⑫par bya/ /de ltar 'bum phrag gcig tu byas⑫/ /de yang lha yi 14—873

sbyor ldan pas/ /zhi bar bya bar 'dod pa dang / /kun du ①gtsang sbrar gnas pa yis/ /las ni 'grub par 'gyur ba ste/ /yams bdag mo la bskang ba yang / /'di la shin tu bsngags pa yin/ /de nas dkyil 'khor mtshon cha sogs/ /phyogs mtshams rnams su dgram byas te/ /mchod rten sngags bcas nang du gzhug /des ni de nyid 'grub 'gyur bar/ /rje btsun nyid kyis gsungs pa yin—/ /oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re sarba byā ②dhi pra sha ma ni shārnyi ①ku ru swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag ④yams nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo⑤/ /tshe yi snyigs mar gyur pa yi/ /mi rnams tshe ni bsring ba'i phyir/ /shin tu nyams dga'i gnas dag tu/ /phyi nang khrus ni sngon 'gro bas/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 'phags ma yi/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa rdzogs byas nas/ /sa bon las byung 'od zer gyis/ /'phags ma tshe dpag med stsol dum/ /phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams/ /de bkug mdun du pad sdong la/ /bzhugs byas yan lag bdun pa dang / /gsol ba btab nas bsnyen pa byas⑦/ /oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re ā yutsā na dha ra dha ra—/ bi dha ra bi snya ra/ ma ma prah+la ⑧dha ya de ⑨hi de hi swā hā/ de nas mar la mar blugs bzhin/ /de dang bdag nyid tha dad med/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes kyi/ /bdag nyid tshe yi dbang phyug mchog /bdag la stsal nas rgya mtsho ltar—/ /tshe yis rgyas par gyur bsams nas/ /lan grangs bdun la sogs par bstod/ /de nas rnam shes bskyod pa'i rta/ /'dod pa'i phyogs su gyur pa na/ /14—874

tha mal gsum gcig sbyor ba yis/ /ring por drangs la mthar gyis bskyil/ /'gyed pa shin tu zhi bar bya/ /de yang ma 'phos bar du'o/ /de ltar na ni zla re la/ /zhag res tshe ni 'phel 'gyur na/ /dus min 'chi sogs smos ci dgos//rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma gser mdog can gyi las kyi yan lag tshe 'phel ba'i cho ga rgyas par phye ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste gsum pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ①'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi stobs kyis srog g.yo ba/ /'bar ba'i me la chu rgyun bzhin/ /de dag gsad phyir rka ka skedang / /rgyal ba'i spyan dang asgo khyu/ /rin chen snying po rtsa ba mchog /gcig pur skyes dang sgrul gyi dug /tshes ma thog gi ④rnam snang la/ /bskyed dang brgya stong bzlas rim gyis/ /de yi khong du gtang bar bya/ /gnas lnga rnams su'ang gdab bya ste/ /dmigs pa rtse gcig sbyor ba yis/ ha la yis 'cho sgo yis bya ba④/ /rang bzhin dang ni bcos pa dang / /gyur pa'i stobs dang dri bzod dka'⑤/ /gang yang 'di yis the tshom med/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re na maḥṣa rjore ṣa ⑦re/ pi ṣa ⑧re bi ṣa ⑨re/ sarba bi ṣa ⑩gha ṭa ni ⑪swā hā⑫/'phags ma sgol ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor ⑫rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag dug gsad pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ⑫'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la gang zhig rag las pa/ /de nyid dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ /gro ga'am ni gos gzhan la/ /bcu drug rtsibs can 'khor lo bri⑫/ /pho dang mo yi snag tsha la/ /dkar po 14—875

gcig rgyug sogs bslad pas/ /dbus su gzugs dang ming yig bcas/ /rtsibs la yi ge bzhis brten pa'i/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni bri bar bya/ /phyi rol oṃ yig gsum gyi dbus/ /srad bu dmar bcings spra tshil gyis①/ /gzugs brnyan snying gar ②bcug byas la/ /seng ldeng me la dus gsum bsro/ /pho dang mo yi bye brag gis/ /rkang pa 'am no mjug ⑦sgo ru/ /zangs ma'i thur mas bru bar bya/ /sa bon 'od kyis drang ba ni/ /bsgrub bya rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbus//skra g.yengs gcer bu'i snying gar duram/ /mgrin dang mtshan mar lcags kyu 'am//zhags pa lta bur ⑤rab drangs nas/ /rlung gi shugs ldan sngags kyi mthus/ /rkang pa'i drung du lhags dubyas nas/ /ci dang ci bkyi zhes brjod brtag⑦ /chu dang rdul khrod las ⑧byung sbyar/ /dus gsum dag tu bsten ⑨bya zhing / /de nyid rdo rje'i chus sbangs la/ /de la sbyin par bya ba yin/ /de nyid dang ni skye tshe dag /ming dang bcas par sbyin sreg ⑩bya/ /yang na rdul khrod nyid kyi'o/ /rdo rje bskyod dang bde bcas dang / /mthar phyin pa dang byang chub sems/ /rgyu bzhin rdub pa'i ⑪sbyor ba ⑫yis/ /las 'di rab tu 'grub 'gyur te/ /nyi ma bdun gyis pho dang mo/ /bdun phrag gsum kyis skyes bu che/ /bdun phrag bdun gyis lha mo sogs/ /sa bla rnams kyang 'dod pa yi/ /mda' yis myos nas de mdun du/ /rang dbang med par lhung bar 'gyur/ /oṃ tā re ⑫tut+ta re tu re spyol ban a bha ⑫so a ti sgo si u du kro si ba shaṃ ka ⑩ra a mu ka su da ha ga ṭa ni/ da ha ga ṭa ni/⑩ da ha ṭa tsa rna kha bya si/ da ha ⑫a byu ni/ a sgri bye—/ ma dz+dza ke da ha la ba ⑪khaṃ/ bin+d+ra ⑦ti ba la rna pa tsa ti ba la rgo pa tsa ti sho ni haṃ/ ba la ni dar+ya ⑫ma bhā hi/ ku tro snyenī tra/ ku tro ro tri ya/ tī ba bi ⑫14—876

ti yo de na sha de na dri rgo tsa sha tan ta re/ nā ①ga re le ②ha pra ka re/ gri kyā sarba kri lta ga te tu ①da dre pa pas mā na rjoṭī/ pa la ni ⑤badhe/ pu ra sa ti t+t+waṃ0/oṃ tsi ti tsi ti bi lo dze+eli bi lo ⑧li swā hā/ a mu kai sā dha māṃ ⑨sa ri ba ram̐ me ba ⑩sa ma na swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku l+le swā hā/ 'bum phrag drug gi sbyor ldan pas/ /me tog bdug pa la sogs pa/ /gang la byin pa de dbang 'gyur/ /bza' btung gis kyang de bzhin te/ /me tog dmar po'i sbyin sreg gis/ /gang dag 'dod pa dbang du byed/ /skyes bu mchog la yungs kar bsngags⑪/ /'khar ba'i snod du sbrang rtsi mar/ /sngags dang bcas btsug dus ⑫gsum du/ /mchod dang bzlas pas don rnams 'grub/ /kham phor dung phor ⑫bcas pa la/ /brgya dang brgyad bzlas mig la byugs/ /gsod par 'dod pa'i dgra bos kyang / /bu sdug bzhin du sems par 'gyur/ /dur khrod gnas su snod chen du/ /pad+ma dkar dang chen po'i sgrum| /brgyad dang bcu bzhir bsgrub ⑩byas pa'i/ /mig sman gyis ni gzhan dbang ⑫'gyur/ /'phags ma sgol ma hūṃ gi sgra rab tu sgrogs ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag dbang du byed pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang la gser gyi g.ya' bzhin du/ /⑩thog ma med dus nas bsags pa'i/ /nyes pa'i tshogs rnams sbyang ba'i phyir/ /rab tu shis pa'i dus nyid du/ /dam tshig 'di la mi bsngags pa'i/ /longs spyod dag ni rab tu spangs⑩/ dbe+en pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor bya/ /rten dang mchod pa sna tshogs bsham/ /bar chad bsrung phyir bstan skyong la/ /rab tu shes pa'i gtor mas mchod/ /rten la rje btsun 14—877

bzhugs byas nas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /thugs rje can gyis bdag la ni/ /mi dge'i las rnams sbyang ba'i phyir/ /gso sbyong dam pa stsol ①bar mdzod/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis ji lta bar/ /bdag kyang de bzhin bsgrub par bkyi/ /gsum la drug tu rnal 'byor pas②/ /rdo rje lta bu'i tshul gyis su—/ /sdig pa ma lus zad byed pa/ /brgya dang brgyad bzlas gsol ba gdab//gnas gsum dag tu sdig pa'i gzugs/ /bris sam bsams la byab par skebya/ /yang na til gyis sreg pa 'am/ /dag byed chu yi rjosbyor bas kyang / /de yi nyes pa bkru bar bya/ /de lta ⑤na ni myur nyid du/ /dkar gyi mtsho dang ngan skyugs zagasarjoske/ /mkha' la rgyu zhing chu skyes sdud⑦/ /rtsod las rgyal ba la sogs pa'i/ /mtshan ma de yis ⑧dga' byas nas/ /dpal ldan gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo āt+yā ⑨ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ⑩ya/ ma hā satā ⑪ya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi kā ⑫ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re ma ma ⑫sarba pā paṃspyo/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ be+e sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ sarba bha ba sa murjots+tsha ⑫sha na ka rā ⑩ya swā hā/ sarba pā paṃ shārnyi ⑩ku ru ⑫swā hā/ 'phags ma sgol ma 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag sgrib pa yongs su sbyong ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste drug pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ⑪la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor srog ni g.yo ba yi/ /mtshan ma byung bar gyur pa ⑫na/ /'chi bdag bdud ni gzhom pa'i phyir/ /'gro ba rnams la srog sbyin zhing / /phyi rol dngos pos bsod nams bsags⑫/ /bde gshegs mchod rten mdzes pas brgyan/ /phyi nang 14—878

chos rnams nam mkha' ltar/ /dmigs pa med pa ①rab tu bsgom/ /des ni rkyen skyes zhi bar gsungs/ /'phen pa'i nus pa zad pa'i phyir/ /des kyang rab tu mi spong ③na/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /bshes rnams nam mkha'i glog bzhin du/ /'gyur ba'i rang bzhin shes byas nas/ /tha ma'i dus su gyur pa na/ /'dod pa'i lha yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /dkar bsil lus la phan byed pa/ /rlung la dmigs bya gnyis su drang / /sgo rnams bsdams la rab tu mnan/ /ldog pa'i tshe na bsring bar bya/ /spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga ste⑦//gnas gsum dag tu yi ge gsum/ /rten dang brten rjopa byang chub sems/ /chu la chu bzhin tha dad med/ /thig le la ni thig le bzhin/ /gyen du gcig la gcig bsdus te/ /nyi ka zhes pa'i 'bru gnyis po/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod par bya/ /gyen du phyin pas 'og min te/ /thur du phyin pas btson dong ngo ⑤//yi ge dang pos 'pho rjobya ba/ /shing la zhon bzhin khyab pa bdag /snying gar ⑦ 'dod lha'i gzugs byed te/ /mnan dang bsdam dang sbyar bzlog cing / /nam mkha'i mthongs te rab gsal la/ /yi ge gnyis kyis rab drangs nas/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis phyin par bya/ /'di ni thun mong ma yin par⑧/ /skal ldan rnams kyi lam yin te/ /bla med gsang sngags khyad par thabs/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsungs/ /des na sgrub ldan rnal 'byor pas/ /'di la ma yengs 'bad pa che/ /goms ⑨pa'i yan lag sngon 'gro bas/ /byas na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /'phags ma sgol ma gzhan 'joms ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag gong du 'pho ba zhes bya ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste bdun pa rdzogs so// //14—879

rje btsun ma ①'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar dug la dug sbyar zhing sde/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba nyon mongs te/ /de ①la de nyid kyis 'byung ④ba'i—/ /thabs kyi cho ga gang gsungs pa/ /babyed pa'i rim pa bstan pa yin⑤//pad+ma can nam dung can sogs/ /rigs gsum las skyes shes rab ma/ /bcu gnyis pa dang bcu drug pa/ /nyi shu bzhi yi lo lon pa/ /mig dkyus ring zhing dkar mdangs ldan/ /'jam mnyen 'khril ldem gzhon nu'i tshul/ /lus la ga pur ngad ldan zhing / /ngag 'jam rjes du'agro yon tan phyug /skyabs 'gro nas ni smin pa'i bar/ /ci rigs pa la de bkod nas/ /lus sogs gsum po dag byas nas/ /byang gi phyogs su de bsrungs nas/ /gru bzhi lham pa khru gang tshad/ /byi dor legs byas me tog dgram/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang mchod gzhan bcas/ /rdo rje'i khri steng de bzhag ⑦nas/ /bkru dang bkru ba'i cho ga bya//rigs kyi bdag po'i rnam pa yis/ /sa bon lcags kyu'i spro bsdu las/ /thabs dang shes rab bkug byas nas/ /gnyis pa'i ⑧tshangs pa'i bu ga gshegs/ /rab smin rdo rje pad+ma ste/ /de brtag pad+ma ⑨snying po btsal/ /de nas bde ba mnyam sbyor phyir/ /pad+ma'i ze 'bru rgyas pa dang / /ye shes rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /kha ⑩sbyar gnyis su med par bya/ /bsdams dang klod ⑪pa'i sbyor ba yis/ / gnas lngar ⑫rnam lngas khyab par bya/ /spu gus snying po bzung byas nas/ /nyams kyi stobs kyis drang bar bya/ /dga' ba bzhi yi bdag nyid kyi⑫/ /gsal la mi rtog bde ba'i mchog /gzung dang 'dzin dang dmigs bral ba/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /go rims ⑫bzhin du nyams su blangs ⑫/ /mi 14—880

'bral cung zhig bsten par bya/ /gsal ba'i ye shes ma zin na/ /rol pa'i sgra la sems gtad nas/ /cung zhig bsgom par bya ba yin/ /yang dang yang du nyams su blang / /de las mi rtog ye shes skye/ /rlung la goms pa'i sbyor ba yis—/ /rdo rje'i chu ni 'thung ba'am/ /yang na kun+da byang chub sems/ /rang gis rab tu gzhibs byas te/ /gsal bar bya ba'i yan lag dang / /goms par brtan pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /byang chub sems ni dbab bya yi/ /de las gzhan pas bde ba ni/ /rab tu gzung phyir bsrung bya ste/ /ji srid kun+da ma shor ba/ /de srid snyoms 'jug de nas ni/ /mdun bzhag ①pa la dmigs pa'am// yang na ②yid kyis spyad par bya/ /shes rab ma yang lhag pa yi/ /lha bzhin rab tu ma zhen ⑦bya/ /'di ni gsang ba bla med lam/ /tha mal rnam rtog las grol ba'i//rnal 'byor pa yis 'di sbyad pas/ /gnyis med ye shes phyag rgya che/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog bde ba'i mchog④ /ring por mi thogs thob par 'gyur/ /'phags ma sgol ma bdud thams cad 'joms shing dbang mchog ster ma ⑤zhes bya ba'i las kyi buyan lag rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ⑦'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsum rang bzhin gzugs brnyan gang / /thams cad spros dang bral yin pas/ /gang gis gang la rab gnas byas/ /ci zhig 'dir ni mchod par bya/ /sbyin bdag bsod nams spel ba dang / /sngags pas dge ba rnyed ⑧pa'i phyir/ /rab gnas bstan bcos las bshad pa/ /tha snyad tsam du byas pa yin/ /ji ltar sku gzugs yongs rdzogs nas/ /byin ma brlabs ⑨par ring gnas na/ /de 14—881

la bkra mi shis 'byung zhing / /de la bgegs kyang 'jug par 'gyur/ /de srid mchod par de mi 'os/ /de bas byin rlabs bshad par bya/ /sku gsum gzugs brnyan gang yin pa/ /bzo bos byas pa yongs rdzogs te/ /gzugs kyi sum cha'i ①cha mnyam pa'i/ /stegs bu'i steng du bzhugs su gsol/ /gza' dang nyi ma zla sogs la/ /mchod dang gtor sogs legs byas nas/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor yongs rdzogs pas/ /bum pa la ni bzlas pa bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi laṣe ka ta khrus ma ya shrī ④hūṃ/ bum pa la bzlas pa'i sngags so—/ /dri ma bkrus rjes stong par bsam/ / hūṃ s+t+waṃ ⑤khaṃ dz+rī duhūṃ rnams las/ /sku gzugs rigs lnga'i rnam par bskyed/ /sku gsum ⑦ye shes yang dbang '-ibaskuraske/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ⑨ya bi sho dha ni hūṃ swā hā/ sku phyi ba'i sngags so//oṃ phahūṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs ⑩pa dang / /ye shes pa spyan drang ba'i ⑪sngags so/ /de nas rab tu mchod nas ni/ /gsang sngags zlos shing spyan phye nas/ /be+er yang rab tu rgyas pa yis⑫/ /mchod cing rab tu gnas par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe t+pa⑫hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tho pe pohūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā ④lo ke āḥ⑫hūṃ/ oṃ ⑩badz+ra gadhe ābyu⑩hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e wi r+ya ā spyohūṃ/ mchod pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsakyu bi sho dha ya swā hā/ thur mas ⑪spyan dbye ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye ⑥swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ dī spyo khaṃ badz+rī ⑥bha ba dṛ ḍho tiṣ+ṭha bye ⑫khaṃ/ rab tu gnas pa ste me tog la bzlas la gtor zhing maṇ+ḍal dbul ba'i sngags so/ /'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byas nas kyang / /bsod nams 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/ /yon gyis bla ma mnyes par bya/ /de ltar rab tu gnas byas ⑫na/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha 14—882

rol tu/ /sems la gang ci 'dod pa yi/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras bu 'byung / / rje btsun ma ①'phags ma sgrol ma mchog stsol ②ba zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste dgu pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ④'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub che dang dngos grub gzhan/ /ma smin pa las mi 'byung bas/ /de yi cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ /snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma yis/ /maṇ+ḍal dang sbyor gzhan dag gis—/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rjobla ma la/ /rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung nas/ /snying po byang chub ma thob par/ /bla ma dam par gsol 'debs kyis/ /bdag gis ⑤bla ma mdzad du gsol/ /ma brgal rjob rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang / /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung dang / /mya ngan ma 'das bzla ba'i phyir/ /bla mar zhu ba ⑦khyod spro 'am/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal sngon 'gro bas/ /bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /'dod pa'i lha la bdun rnam dag /lam la gnas pa byas nas su/ /bgegs mthar byed kyi yang snying ni/ /de yis de la dbog par bya/ /bla ma lha yis sbyor ldan pas/ /mchod pa dang ni gtor ma yis/ /sa yi bdag po mnyes byas nas/ /snang dang mi snang sa bdag la/ /gsol ba gdab sogs rgyas par bya/ /me long dbyibs can dkyil 'khor ni/ /'dab ma bzhi ldan pad+ma ste/ /kha dog gzhan dang 'dra ba'o/ /sa 'am rin chen las byas pa'i/ /bum pa nyes pas ma gos pa/ /bsrung ba'i cho ga sngon 'gro bas/ /de dag steng du bkod byas nas/ /'bru dang spos dang snying po sman⑧/ /rin 14—883

chen lnga dang ar+gha ①dang / /mgul chings ②kha rgyan rdzogs par bya/ /de dag mi dmigs stong pa las/ /gzhal yas khang dbus ri rab steng / /de dbus pad+ma'i gdan khri la/ /dam tshig 'khor lo bskyed pa nas/ /dbang gi bar du rdzogs byas nas/ /mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba yis/ mchod pas mchod nas rtsa ba'i sngags/ /'bum phrag gcig gis ④bsnyen pa bya⑤/ /gsang sngags ye shes chu rgyun kyis/ /bum pa chos nyid gang byas nas/ /mchod dang gtor ma ci rigs bya/ /skad cig ma yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /mig tu ma dang ṭa las ni/ /nyi ma zla ba gsal byas te/ /bsnyen pa'i 'khor lo mkha' la btegarjo /sngags 'di bzlas shing gsal bar bsgom/ /oṃ badzo tiṣ+ṭha ⑦hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /bdag bskyed nas ni bgegs bskrad de/ /hūṃ lus ngag sems la gnas pa'i bgegs/ /'dir nyon nga ni dpal dang ldan/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor ba⑧/ /nga yi bka' yi dam tshig las/ /su 'das brlag 'gyur the tshom med/ /mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gdon gyi rigs su gtogs pa rnams/ /'di ru ma gnas gzhan du deng ⑨/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod cing / /khro bo'i gom ⑩stabs brgyad pa'i gar/ /rkang lag smin bskyod 'degs pa dang / /zur mig nyi ma'i dbus gnas dang / /'dzum bcas mche gatshigs phreng ba'i gar⑩/ /bskor nas ra ba gur sogs bya/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par las sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis⑫ske/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin du ni bdud kyi sde/ /pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /lha yi nga rgyal ldan pa yis/ /thig le byas 14—884

nas rdzas dgram dang / /byen rlabs ①byas nas rab bskor ④te/ /spos dril thogs nas 'di skad du/ /ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor bri/ /deng 'dir thams cad kun gshegs te/ /dngos grub 'di ni stsal du ⑦gsol/ /stegs bu'i steng dun gnas pa yis/ /phyogs bzhi nas ni gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi dngos/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs| /mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun rmi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur⑤/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /thig le byas nas dkyil 'khor steng rjo/ /ye shes 'khor lo gzhug ⑦byas nas/ /dbang bskur bar gyi cho ga yang / /byas la mchod pa dbul byas nas/ /byin gyis brlabs pa la sogs pa'i/ /bum pa'i cho ga rdzogs par bya/ /thig le re la re re ste/ /rdzas la bsang ⑧zhing gsol ba gdab/ /yol bas de bcad bdag nyid nang / /khrus byas spyod lam mdzes pa yis/ /dga' chen khyod la bdag dga'o/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul brtan pas/ /mgon po chen po bdag la stsol⑨/ /dam tshig de nyid ⑩bdag la stsol⑪/ /byang chub sems ni 14—885

bdag la stsol①/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsolasde/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po ①bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags tshul bzhin spyod pa dag /spyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gsang sngags 'di bsgoms pas/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan ma brnyes0/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung dang bcas pa⑧rab bcom ste/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs pa yis /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de yi mdun du maṇ+ḍal bya/ /slob ma mi dmigs stong pa las/ /'dod lha'i gnas gsum thig le bya/ /rang gi gsum spros phyag mtshan no/ /slob ma'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal rtenarjo/ /bsang ⑦gtor bya zhing mchod pa dbul/ /deng ⑧nas bzung ⑨nas bu khyod kyis/ /'khor ba'i nyes pa ma phog par/ /mchod pa kun dang ldan par ni/ /bu yis blo gos 'di gyis shig /de la maṇ+ḍal dbul bar bya/ /de yis so shing sor brgyad pa/ /yi ge bcu bzlas de la sbyin/ /bcad ⑩nas de der rtags ⑪shes bya/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dusmra ra'i ⑫me tog bzhin/ / brgya lam na ni res ⑫'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni ④mi 'byung srid/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ / bskal pa ⑫bye ba du ma ru/ /14—886

chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /'gro don mnyam med byed par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang theg pa chen po yi/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni 'dod par nus/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bras bu thob①/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /des na bu yis brtson par gyis/ /sngags sam srung ②skud 'khor lo yis/ /ku sha'i stan la byang shar du/ /yi ge drug bzlas nyal bar bya/ /skad cig ma yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /cho ga sngar bzhin 'khor lo gdeg /bzang po'i dris spangs thig skud la/ /'od kyis ye shes der bstems nas/ /lha mo mdzes ldan slob mas drang / /dza dza gsum brjod thig skud bskyur①/ /des kyang lan gsum brjod la blang / /snying po lnga yis gdab par bya/ /chos nyid rgyas btab tshon rtsi la/ /yi ge lnga po'i sa bon las—/ /'od 'phros ye shes gzhug par bya/ /gzhal yas lte ba ser po la/ /gtso bo'i phyag mtshan dgod par bya/ /ze 'bru dmar po las skyes pa'i/ /sna tshogs pad+ma phyogs bzhi dang / /mtshalas bzhir rigs kyi yab yum mo/ /mu khyud dmar la ral gri'i phreng / /lha snam ④gru chad sgo rnams ni/ /phyogs mtshon dag tu shes par bya/ /sgo bzhir sgo ma dgod par bya/ /rgyan la sogs ⑤pa gzhan dang 'dra/ /phyogs skyong rnams dang bkra shis kyi/ /rtags kyang rab tu dgod par bya/ /de nas rdo rje me ri ste/ /kun gyi phyi rol ༷rgya mtsho'i/ /lha yi sbyor ldan bla ma yis/ /yi ge gnyis dang bsnol ma las/ /g.yo sdud sna tshogs rdo rje ste⑦/ /lte bar gzhal yas rgyan gyis mdzes/ /dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma babyed| /rang nyid 'dod lha'i thig le can/ /lan gsum du bskor ⑧bcu pa brjod| /ting nge 'dzin gyis ⑨sgo dbye ste/ /gsang sngags 'di yang brjod 14—887

par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra dha rod badz+ra sa ma ya swā hā/ steng dang phyogs bzhir legs brgyan nas/ /mchod pa la sogs dgod par bya/ /'dod yon bdud rtsir skad cig mas/ /ye shes byin gyis brlab par bya/ /de nas sgrub thabs las gsungs ①ltar/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa rdzogs byas nas/ /mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bya/ /brtan ⑤skyong rnams la gtor ma ste/ /phyi rol 'byung po rnams la sbyin/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung ①du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor duske/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar rjoslob ma ni/ /kun gyis dri ma med mthong shog /de nas spyod mdzes khrus byas la/ /de la de yis 'di skad du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /ma mthong snod dang mi ldan la/ /su la'ang ston par ma byed cig /bdud rtsi lnga la byin brlabs pas⑤/ /yi ge gsum brjod de la sbyin/ /'di ni rdo rje dam tshig chu/ /srungs shig ma bsrungs sreg par byed/ /bsrungs na dngos grub ster bar byed/ /bdud rtsi 'di ni myang bar gyis/ /oṃ pañtsa rjo.a mṛ ⑦ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha⑧/ des ni de ltar byin gyis brlab/ /gdong g.yogs rdo rje dril bu gtad/ /rdo rje nas gzung ⑨ha ha ṭī'i/ /sngags brjod bskor nas yol ba'i nang / /phyag 'tshal lha la me tog gtor/ /gang la phog pa blta bar bya—/ /dud btang ⑩thugs ka'i ⑪yi ge a/ /snying gar ⑫gzhug bya bde ba bsgom—/ /rtags ldan brtan pa'i yan lag bya/ /de nas yum nyid de'i spyi bor—/ /spyan drangs sa bon yi ge ste/ /de las phyag mtshan bu gar zhugs/ /14—888

snying ga'i ①dbus su rje btsun no/ /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re chu maṇ+ḍa ④la badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun ma/ /khrod kyi snying du yang dag zhugs—/ /rtag tu yi dam lha gyis shig /tshul 'di smra bar ma byed cig /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /nga ni 'phags ma sgrol ma ste/ /nga yis bsgo ①ba'i las nyon cig /ma mos brnyas par ma byed cig /gal te khyod kyis ④smras na ni/ /dam tshig 'di yis sreg ⑤par byed/ /tsha ba chen po'i gnas su sregarjo /rang bzhin rnam dag bdag nyid lus/ /dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo'i gnas/ /dri med rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni lta ⑦bar gyis/ /gdong g.yogs bkrol ⑧nas de bstan bya/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dam chos snod/ /dbang bskur dam pa mdzad du gsol/ /rnam rgyal du ni bsdus pa'i chu/ /dam tshig ye shes las byung ba'i/ /rigs bdag cho ga rdzogs pa las/ /snga ma'i rang bzhin bsgyur byas nas/ /slob ma la ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra a dar ⑨sha dz+nyā na a ⑩rnyi ṣiñtsa spyormā/ de ni mi bskyod ⑫par byas nas/ /mchod pa rnam lnga dbul bar bya/ /'di ni chu yi dbang yin par/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsungs/ /cod pan rdo rje dril bu dang / /ming gi dbang ste bzhi po dang / /gong ma gsum dang slob ma nyid/ /mi dmigs pa las de dag ni/ / slo dang dz+rī ⑫dang khaṃ dang u④/ /de las phyag mtshan yi ger bcas/ /de las sangs rgyas bzhi bdag nyid/ /cho ga'i yan lag rdzogs par bya/ /mchod nas snga mar gyur pa yis/ /slob ma la ni dbang bskur nas/ /sangs rgyas tshul gyis de mchod bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mān+ta dz+nyā spyon rat+na hūṃ/ a 8rnyi ṣiñtsa māṃ⑩/ oṃ badz+ra pra t+ya bek+ṣa ṇa skedz+nyā na a ⑪rnyi ṣiñtsa 14—889

rmā①| oṃ kṛ t+yā nuspyon dz+nyā na badz+ra a rnyi ṣiñtsa māṃ②/ oṃ tsakra a mu ka ④tshwa na badz+ra swa rjobhā ba a ⑤bhi ṣiñtsa māṃrjo/ bla mas spos dri ⑦sbyor ba yis/ /mchod bya yi ge bcu pa bzlas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis byin brlabs pas/ /'di la 'go dubar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal ⑨du gsol/ /me tog gtad la sngags bzlar ⑩gzhug /de nas de yis de dag la/ /me tog phul la 'di skad ces/ /bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis/ /bdag la 'go bar ⑪mdzad du gsol/ /de yis de la rdo rje sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ⑪/ a rnyi ṣiñtsa māṃ⑫/ rgyan dang cha lugs kyis bskon te④/ /lha yi nga rgyal ldan par bya/ /oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re he he/ slob dpon nyid kyi cha lugs kyang / /de la bskon la bsrung bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ⑫/ bu khyod ⑫'khor lo'i dbang bskur gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin/ /srid gsum ma lus sgol mdzad ma/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i ⑩lung bstan tospyo/ /khams gsum bdag por rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas//bdud kyi sde rnams bcom zin gyis/ /khyod ni grong khyer mchog tu zhugs/ /oṃ tā ⑪re tuṭ+wā re tu re sirnyi ⑫sa ma ya s+t+waṃ swa bhā ba a rnyi ṣiñtsa rmā⑥/ mtshan ma med par 'gro ba'i don/ /gang dag bdag gis byed nus pas/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che/ /dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsoladu/ /dkyil 'khor mchod nas khri yi khar/ /slob ma bzhag ⑫la dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a ④bhi ṣe ka a bhi ṣiñtsa rmā⑫/ sgrar bcas glegs bam lag gtad de/ /chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur bya/ /de yis de yi snying ga ⑪ru/ /'khor lo bcug la ye shes bstem—/ /dbang gi bar du rdzogs par bya/ /rnal 'byor de nyid ⑦shes pa 14—890

yis① / /mi bya ba ni gang yang med/ /dpa' bo chen po nga yi bkas①/ /'dod yon lnga la spyad par bya/ /oṃ su pra ①tiṣ+ṭha swā hā/ rjes su gnang ba'i dbang bskur phyir/ /'di nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis/ /lus dang srog la mi phangs dupar/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /'gro ba'i don ni dpag med byos/ /sems can gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /rten cing 'brel ba'i chos dang ldan/ /khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /sems can don ni mtshungs med byos/ /de dag slob ma'i dbang bcu ste/ /phal cher bum pa la brten ⑤pas / /bum pa'i dbang zhes brjod pa yin/ /phyir mi ldog dang rjes su gnang / /rdo rje slob dpon dbang yin no/ /nyon mongs dri ma 'khru ba dang / /sa ni dang po thob par byed/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur phyir/ /tshogs dang dpa' bo'i sbyor byas nas/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i shes rab ma/ /sta gon gnas byas bla ma'i mdun/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pas mnyes byas nas/ /slob dpon khrod ni dgongs su gsol/ /gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yisadu/ /shes rab chen po'i snod gyur ⑦phyir/ /dbang bskur chen po mdzad du gsol/ /gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yisaske/ /shes rab bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /bdud rtsi chen po myang bar byus/ /dbang bskur 'di la khyod spro 'am/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /lha mo 'di ni khyad par can/ /yon tan mtha' yas ldan pa ste/ /gsang spyod thabs kyi sbyor ba las/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur mdzad du gsol/ /gzhal yas nang du de bzhag ⑨nas/ /'od kyis 'phags rnams spyi bor drangs/ /bu gar zhugs nas pad+mar zhugs/ /slob dpon nyid la'ang de bzhin no/ /mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /14—891

gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba bya/ /yab yum 'khril pa'i rang bzhin las/ /ye shes gsal ba byang chub sems/ /phab nas mtshan ldan blugs par bya /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /dam tshig 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /khams lnga yi ni ro yis gang / /bde ba chen po skyang bar gyis/ /slob ma'i lce ①la de bzhag ②nas/ /a ho su kha skal chen po/ /dngos grub dam pa gsal bar mdzod①—/ /'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni yid 'ong bas/ /de bzhin bu spyod dbang bskur ro/ /'di ni gsang ba'i dbang yin te/ /sa bcu'i ye shes thob par byed—/ /de nas shes rab ye shes dbang / /shes rab ma yi lus brgyan nas/ /lha mo 'di ni khyad par che/ /bde ba mtha' yas ster byed ma/ /blangs nas rnam pa thams cad du/ /bu yis bla med mchod par gyis/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /bu yis de ring za nus sam/ /phyag rgya lnga las byung ba yi/ /rig rjom dad pas mchod nus sam/ /bshang gci khu ba rak+ta sogs/ /'di nyid du ni za nus sam/ /nga yi ⑤gsang ba'i pad+ma yis/ /bde ba'i myu gu skyed par byed/ /khyod kyis rtag tu mchod nus sam/ /ji skad bshad pa'i dam tshig rnams—/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi nus/ /lha mo'i pad+ma mchod par bgyi/ /thabs dang shes rab g.yas dang g.yon/ /de yis dar gyi mdud pa bya/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol khri las bskyod/ /g.yon pas g.yon pa'i mkhal ma nas/ /g.yas pas gsang ba'i pad+ma ru/ /snying po btsal la rdo rje gzhug /shes rab bum pa'i mgul chings kyis/ /slob ma bum pa'i mgul pa cing / /bde ba kha sbyor bsgom par bya/ /bde gsal mi rtog ye shes skyes/ /rim gyis nyams su 14—892

de blangs nas/ /dal bar ldang bya byang chub sems/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin phyir/ /lce yis bzhibs shing ①sems la bstem/ /gnyis med ye shes gsal bar 'gyur/ /shes rab ma yi rkang pa g.yon/ /slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ④nas ni/ /nga ②dang rdo rje slob dpon dang / /mched dang lcam dral thams cad dang / /khams gsum sems can ma lus la/ /ma mos brnyas par ma byed cig/gzhan yang dam tshig bshad pa rnams/ /rtag tu khyod kyis srung rjobar gyis/ /deng nas bzung nas bu spyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob par sems can kun gyi don rnams ni/ /rtag tu rmi lam bzhin du byos/ /'di ni shes rab ye shes kyi/ /dbang yin mi shes kun sel zhing ⑤/ /bde gshegs sku gsum thob byed par/ /rdo rje 'chang gis yongs su gsungs/ /bzhi pa de nyid tshig gi dbang / /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /rjes la bya ba'i cho ga yirjo/ /mchod sogs byas nas dkyil 'khor bsdu/ /yi ge brgya pas bskang ⑦bar bya/ /tshogs dang dpa' bo'i ston mo yis/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs mnyes par bya/ /de nas gzhan du gsungs pa yi/ /dam tshig rnams la bslab par bya/ /'phags ma sgrol ma mya ngan thams cad sel bar byed ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste dgu pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ⑧'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlan dang mi ldan pad+ma bzhin/ /gang gi dbang gis rgud ⑨pa yi/ /nyes pa bsal phyir pad+ma 'am//bil pa'i 'thas bu de bzhin du/ /ka ra bī ⑩ra'i me tog la/ / me yi ⑪las ni ⑫rgyas par bya/ /yang na pa la sha yis so/ /gzhong bu gnyis sam bzhi yis so⑫/ /14—893

bum pa bzang po lta bu yi/ /snod chen nang du lnga tshan lnga/ /rin chen kyis bris snying po gzhug① /longs spyod phyir ni gter bzung ②ste/ /'bru dang rin chen phyugs longs spyod/ /zhing dang mdzod dang phyugs lhas su/ /go rims ①bzhin du shes par bya/ /des ni rnam thos bu bzhin 'gyur/ /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re dze+e rjobhe mo he ⑤swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma 'gro ba thams cad 'gugs shing phongs pa thams cad sel ma rjozhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag longs spyod spel ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste bcu pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ⑦'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub kun kyi rtsa ba ni/ /mnyes las yin phyir de yi thabs/ /dus dang sa phyogs shis rnams su/ /sa yi cho ga legs byas par/ /khru gang byed dang bzhi dpangs brtsigs⑧—/ /dri zhim dkar po byugs ⑨byas te/ /kha khyer ut+pal phreng bas bskor—/ /dbus su sa bon yi ge'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon du sreg ⑩rdzas dang / /mchod pa'i rdzas rnams rim gyis dgod/ /ba lang ⑪gi 'am 'o ma can/ /srog chags med pa'i bud shing ni/ /mar dang spra tshil la sogs pa'i/ /yam shing rnams ni sta gon bya/ /rin chen las byas khru gang ba/ /bzhi dang gnyis dang re re dang / /gcig dang phyed dang rdo rjes mtshan/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar rdo rje dril/ /rnal 'byor mdun du gzhag par bya/ /rdzas rnams byin kyis brlabs ⑫byas la/ /thab rtsig ⑫bsrung phyir ku sha dgram/ /rgyun gzhag pa'am bram ze'i me/ /bsags la rlung g.yab ④kyis sbar bya/ /'bar ba'i ched du gsum gsum mo/ /thab khung bdag med chu skyes te/ /byin za zhal 14—894

gcig phyag bzhi dkar/ /dbyug pa skyabs sbyin phreng gudhe/ /tshangs sku dar skyes gdan can no/ /me yi mtshalas nas rang bzhin dgug /bsang gtor dang ni zhabs bsil dang / /mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas bstem/ /bsang gtor byas nas pad+ma yi/ /'dug stangs nang du lag gnyis so/ /bdun dang bdun gsum lan gsum du①/ /mar gyi dgang blugs sbyin ②par bya//oṃ asna me chu dī bya ā dri bya①/ a rnyi sa ma ya/ ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya/ bā hā ④nā ya swā hā/ me yi mtshan ma legs brtags te/ /ngan na bgegs bskrad ⑤bzlog par bya/ /oṃ ā be+e:n+ta kṛta rjohūṃ phaṭa/ zhal dang phyag dang me 'od la/ /yam ⑦shing mar dang 'o ma zho/ /til la sogs pa rim pa bzhin/ /bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig dbul/ /oṃ a bha ba ga asna ⑧ye ma ma shārnyi ⑨ku ru swā hā/ de rjes dgang blugs byas nas ni/ /zhabs bsil sbyin la bstod pa dang / /'dod pa'i don ni bslang bar bya/ /'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa 'am de yi snying gar ⑩sa bon las/ /'dod pa'i lha ni skyed par byed⑩/ /ye shes bkug la bsang ⑫gtor bya/ /zhal bsil ba dang mchod byas nas/ /gnyis su med par bstem ⑫pa yi/ /ngag gi lam la hūṃ yig steng / me yi ⑫sa bon gyis mtshan ma⑫/ /de la dgang blugs dbul bar bya/ /de nas rdzas rnams rim gyis dbul/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ⑩āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ⑩ya/bo dhi satā ⑫ya/ ma hā satā ya/⑪ ma hā ka ru ṇi phyukā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tā ⑥re tut+tha ⑫re tu re ma ma shāsnya ⑫ku ru swā hā/ dgang blugs phul la bstod pa dang / /bzod par gsol la 'dod pa bslang / /ye shes gshegs la dam tshig bsdu④/ / thab khung bsangs ⑫la me lha bskyed/ /dgang blugs sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /14—895

sreg ①rdzas lhag ma dbul bar ②bya/ /dgang blugs byin nas bstod pa dang sge/ /bzod par gsol zhing 'dod pa bslang / /ye shes me lha gshegs byas la/ /dam tshig thab tu mi dmigs so/ /yi ge brgya pas bskang byas nas/ /thab khung bsdus te dben pa dor⑦/ /'di ni zhi ba'i cho ga ste/ /rgyas dang dgug dang mngon spyod kyang / /shugs kyis gnas par shes par bya/ /'dis ni mnyes par byed pa ste/ /sdig dang log 'dren zhi ba dang / /dngos grub ma lus kun 'byung ba'i/ /phrin ⑤las thams cad mdzad par 'gyur/ /'phags ma sgrol ma bkra shis thams cad sbyin ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma rjo'aphags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo 'bar ba'i me la sbrang ma ltar/ /gang gi stobs kyis gang ldog pa/ /gser mdog nor bu in+d+ra dang / /sbur long 'phags pa rnams kyi gdung / /sa dang mkhris pa chu mu zi/ /'bras bu gsum dang bh+ri ⑦ha ra/ /sbrang rtsi mar dang bdud rtsi lnga/ /dri lnga gu gul sogs sbyar spos/ /shin tu yun ring skyur dang mngar/ /mkhas pas ri lu dulegs byas la/ /rnal 'byor lha yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /spos des rab tu bdug spubyas na/ /rang bzhin gyis sam sbad pa yi/ /gang dag dbang du byas rnams kyang / /rnam par 'jig cing ltung 'gyur te/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu ⑩po/ /klad ⑪pa rnams ni rab 'gas shing / /lus kyang dum bu dum bu ste/ /mig ljongs ⑫yan lag nyams pa dang / /rlung gis ⑫nags bzhin g.yo bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa la sogs srog chags dang / /rims nad la 14—896

sogs gnod gzhan yang / /gang du dri 'di yod gyur der/ /nam yang gnas pa ma yin no/ /'di ni zhi bsrung sgod pa ste/ /gal te gsad par 'dod gyur na—/ /drag po'i rdzas las byas pa yi / /gzugs brnyan la ni bdug ②pa dang //rtsub mo'i shing las byung ba'i mes/ /shes pa rten snedang phral nas ni/ /liṅga gtubs ④nas bsreg bya ste/ /gang yin ming smos de 'og tu/ /de la las sbyor byed pa yin⑤/ /yi ge bris nas rab tu brtsam/ /bsnyen pa gsang sngags brgyad stong ste/ /las la brgya dang brgyad du gsungs/ /oṃ tā rjore tuṭ+wā ⑦re tu re badz+ra dharmā dhā ⑧hūṃ/ sgo ṭa ⑨ya bhami ku ru hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma yongs su smin par byed pa zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag 'byung po bzlog pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ⑩'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor byang chub bsgrub ⑩pa la/ /'khor los bsrung ba'i thabs gsungs pa/ /shin tu dkar zhing 'jam pa yi/ /dar la dri zhim byug par bya/ /dbus su pad+ma'i ze 'bru la/ /oṃ dang swā hās mtha' brten pa/ /'dab brgyad la ni lhag ma'o/ /de yi mtha' yig rten 'brel can/ /de nas sna tshogs rdo rje ni/ /rigs lnga'i snying pos brgyan pa'o/ /ā li kā li rim pa bzhin/ /mu khyud gnyis la dgod par bya/ /mthar byed sngags dang ral gri yi/ /ra ba phyi rol gnyis la dgod/ /de nas 'bar ba'i ra ba ste/ /rab tu shis pa'i snag tshas bya⑫/ /de nas ye shes 'khor lo dgug /mchod cing cho ga'i yan lag rnams/ /rdzogs par byas la bsnyen ⑫pa bskyal/ /mi dmigs 'khor lo'i rang ④bzhin te/ /bar 14—897

chad bsrung phyir gdags ①par bya/ /gang la bsrung ba 'dis brgyan pa/ /rdo rje rin chen lta bu ste/ /de la bar chad gang gis kyang / /nam yang tshugs pa ma yin no/ /'phags ma sgrol ma 'gugs pa'i khro mo zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag bsrung ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ①'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs dang yams nad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir/ /chu 'gram shing drung bzhi mdo 'am/ /khang stong la sogs dben par bsdad/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lham par bya/ /sna tshogs pad+ma lnga yi dbus/ /nyes pas ma gos bum pa bzang / /cho ga ldan pas bcud rgyan ④bcas/ /phyi rol rdo rje'i ra bas mdzes/ /phyogs skyong 'jig rten dbang phyug rjodang / /bkra shis rtags kyis mdzes par bya/ /sgo ni lho 'am nub tu gdod⑤/ /mda' dang me long ral gri dang / /rma bya tshon skud dag kyang ste/ /gdugs dang bla re ba dan dang / /me tog phreng ba sogs dgram bya/ /mchod dang gtor ma rgya cher bsham/ /rje btsun ma yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /de las rin chen khang brtsegs te/ /nang du bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i steng / /sa bon las ni bcom ldan ma/ /cho ga gsum gyis rjobaskyed par bya/ /de las ⑦ye shes sems dpa' gzhug /mchod dang bstod pa byas nas ni/ /'dod pa'i don yang gsol ba btab⑧/ /de nas lan grangs ⑨brgya stong snyed/ /bsnyen pa rdzogs byas g.yas skor byas⑩/ /de nyid de la thim gyur te/ /de yi yid du mi 'ong ba⑪/ /ba spu'i ⑫khung sogs las 'thon par/ /dmigs pa'i tshul gyis khrus byas te/ /rma byas byab cing 14—898

bkra shis gdon/ /nad pa la ni logs su ste/ /gos bcas bkrus nas dor bar byas①/ /lhag ma la ni lhar bskyed de/ /mchod dang bstod dang 'dod pa'i don/ /gsol ba btab la bzod par gsol/ /de nas gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /'jig rten skyong sogs de bzhin no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor legs par bsdu/ /dben par dor la bskang ba ②bya/ /'dis ni bkra shis thams cad sbyin/ /yid du mi 'ong sel bar byed/ /gang yang mi 'byung med pa'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rtag tu bya/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma āt+yā ①ba lo ki te shwa rā rjoya/ bo dhi ⑤satā ya/ /ma rjohā satā ya/ ma hā kā ⑦ru ṇi kā ⑧ya/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re/ sarba gra he/ sarba byā ⑨dhi/ sarba dz+wa re⑩—/ sarba bīr+ya⑪/ sarba dur swa ⑫ba ni bh+yaḥ⑫/ sarba pā paṃ ④pra sha ma na ye ⑫ṭ+wā hā/ 'phags ma sgol ma zhi ba chen mo zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag khrus kyi cho ga'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ⑩'phags ma sgrol ma la ⑩phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba rgongs pa steske/ /de bsal bya phyir shes rab bskyed/ /thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin sku/ /gcig tu phan mdzad dngos grub ste⑪/ /ngag gi dbang phyug zhi phra ma—/ /bdag bsam g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab tu/ /yid gzhungs rjodran pa shes rab dang / /blo yi rang bzhin lha mo bzhi/ /snga ma lta bur bsgom par bya/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo zla ba'i dbus/ /rnam snang las byung dag rang bzhin/ /rgyun mi 'chad 'byung de dbus gnas/ /mi smra'i sbyor bas gsang sngags bzlas⑪//'o ma gser mdog tsha ba gsum/ /pad+ma 3shu dag rgyam tsha 3la/ /lan bdun 14—899

bzlas pas bcom ldan 'grub/ /'o ma bye bzhi srang gcig sman/ /mar bye gang sbyar me la gdu①/ /zla ba gcig gis lan med cing / /drug gis mngon sum mthong bar ⑪'gyur/ /shu dag shing mngar sernya ba/ /gser mdog dong gra ①la la phud/ /zi ra ru rta rjopi pi ling / /lan bdun bzlas nas zos gyur naske/ /zla ba drug dang gsum dang gcig /go rims ⑤bzhin du thos 'dzin cing du/ /sa bdag nyid dang blo ldan zhing / /tshangs pa'i nga ro thob par 'gyur//gangs las skyes pa'i gser mdog dang / /shu dag tho rangs lan bdun bzlas//zla ba gcig bsten ⑦de nyid du/ /⑧bdag nyid yid gzhungs dbyangs snyan cing zha/shes rab ldan de ⑩zla drug gis/ /ngag gi dbang phyug rang bzhin thob/ /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re spyo ⑪ma hā ma yo ge ma hā swa ras h+ye ṭ+wāṃ ma ⑫ma pra kṛ t+ya ⑫ba ri shudhe sarba dharma pra kṛ ④ta pa ri shurnyolha⑫haṃ sa basbya a pa yan+ta ra swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma chags pa thams cad 'joms ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag blo 'phel bar byed pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste bco ⑩lnga pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir/ /dbe+en pa'i phyogs su chag chag dang / /maṇ+ḍal gnyis dang mchod sogs gnyis/ /bsham bya rje btsun rten yang gzhag⑩ /stan spyobade la gnas sems can la/ /snying rje che bskyed 'di rnams ni/ /rje btsun gnas dgod dam bcas nas/ /de yi spyogator ma gtang ⑩bar bya/ /de nas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis/ /thun mong khyad par spyan drangs te/ /mchod pa cha res mchod par bya/ /de nas bdag gi spyi bor a/ /de las zla ba de steng t+t+waṃ⑩//14byed900

gsum po yongs su gyur pa las/ /rje btsun zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /mi 'jigs ut+pal g.yas dang g.yon/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /mgul chings gdu bu do shal can/ /sku gsung thugs mtshan ye shes sems/ /skye mched rnam dag dbu rgyan mdzes/ /phyag gi bdud rtsis ①bdag rgyas par/ /bsam zhing gsang sngags gdon par bya/ /phyi yi phyag rgya rdzas kyis sdebasdu/ /nang gi nang du bsdu bya'i tshe/ /bsgrub bya bsdus shing tshim par ④bsam/ /de nas gtor ma cig ④shos btang / /'gro ba'i phyogs su bcom ⑤ldan ma/ /zhal bzangs bdag0la gzigs par bsam/ /de nas bstod dang bzlas pa bya/ /des ni 'jigs pa kun skyob 'gyur/ /oṃ ⑦na ma āt+yā ⑧ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/bornyi satā ⑨ya/ ma hā satā ⑩ya/ ma hā kā ⑪ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā⑫/ oṃ tā ⑫re tuṭ+wā re tu re sarba duṭī na/ pra duṭī ⑫na ma ma kṛ ⑫te/ rdza bha yas/ s+t+waṃ bha ya / mo ha ⑫ya/ brnya ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭha spyon sto bha ni tā re swā hā/ 'phags ma sgol ma bde ba thams cad bsgrub pa'i lam gyi ⑪yan lag chos rkun bcing ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste bcu drug pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma du'aphags ma sgrol ma la ⑪phyag 'tshal lo/ /bag med la sogs mi durnams la/ /gdug pa'i yid ldan dud 'gro'i rigs/ /yid dang ⑫bltas dang 'tshe ④ba dang / /rig pa'i sgo nas 'tshe bar byed/ / grog po ⑫phug dog mo yi sgor/ /lha khang 'dam rdzab mi sdug gzugs/ /ri gzar 'jeg dang dud 'gros 'tshe/ /mtsho 'gram 'dug sogs gnod pa'i rtags/ /glu la dga' dang nub mo na⑩/ /yan lag mi bde lus lci zhing / /shu ba g.yan pa 14—901
