bas ldag ①dang / /'brum bu la sogs thebs par 'gyuraske/ /mi dga' ba dang za 'phrug dang / /sha mdog nyams dang me ris gdang / /res 'ga' chu grang blugs bzhin dang / /bas ldag rjosha bkra 'byung ba yin/ /sha 'phrig byud dang be+ems por 'dug /mig ni tsha zhing zlum pa dang / /smin ma la sogs byi ⑤'gyur te/ /lag sor skam por rjogyur pa'o/ /lus la dri nga 'byung 'gyur zhing //chu bur dang ni nya ldang ⑦can/ /rnag dang chu ser rul dri mnam/ /ro stod ⑤dag kyang zug par 'gyur/ /phyi yi sha skam mdog 'chor zhing / /sha yi mdangs med zug dang bcas/ /gos kyang mdangs dang bral 'gyur te/ /glog pa char yag ma bzhin no/ /de dag bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /lha yi sbyor bas ⑨gnas pa yis⑩/ /gu gul gla rtsi shu dag dang / /ru rta btsan dug shing kun dang / /da lis rnams la gsang sngags che/ /'bum phrag gsum bsnyen byas pa yis⑪/ /de bsrung gla rtsi mi bskyod ⑩sbyor/ /gnas lngar byug cing bkru bar bya/ /'di ni sbyor ba zab mo ste/ /mi la ri dwags ji bzhin du/ /gang la bsrung ba 'dis brgyan pa/ /de la sdang ⑫ldan 'bros par 'gyur/ /gnyis pa la ni shu dag dang / /gla rtsi ru rta gu gul dang / /mu zi ro ras rgya tshil dang //shi ba'i dri chen phag pa'i bcud/ /sgog skya dang ni ma du dang / /mi yi bcud dang rus pa'i bye/ /mi bcud kyis bsdus ri lu ste/ /snga ma nyis ④'gyur bsnyen pa yis/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams bdug bya ste/ /nyi ma'i 'od la mun pa bzhin/ /dug can rnams ni nam du yang ⑫/ /'ong bar nus pa ma yin no/ /gsum pa la ni sum ⑩'gyur te/ /gong ma'i rdzas kyi ⑩sbyor ba dang / /klu yi dug dang bdud rtsi bsten/ /'bar ba'i me yis nags tshal bzhin/ /des gzhan nad 14—902

rnams 'tshig par ①'gyur/ /bzhi pa la ni bya ⑧ba ste/ /gong ma'i rdzas kyi ④sbyor ba dang / /klu yi dug dang rnam rgyal bstenarjo/ /rtsa mig dag kyang bsal bar bya/ /nyi mas gangs bzhin de 'joms so/ /lnga pa la yang de bzhin te/ /khyad par du ni a ru ra/ /dri chu gla rtsi bsten ⑤par bya/ /rdo rje yis ni rin chen bzhin/ /thogs pa med par 'jig dupar 'gyur/ /oṃ ⑦tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re ku ru ⑧kul+le/ sarba sha t+t+waṃ bak+ṣa ya bak+ṣa ⑨ya/ hūṃ hūṃ nā ⑩ga s+t+waṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya—/ brnya ya/ yo ram̐ khaṃ ⑪sum̐ ne+e ra la ⑫ne+e hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag klu nad gso ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ⑫'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi yi dbang po la sogs pas/ /shin tu dam par bsdams pa rnams/ /rab tu thar bar bya ba'i phyir| /ba lang ④lci bas ⑫dkyil 'khor bya/ /dbus su phyag mtshan sa bon bcas| /de la de nyid spyan drangs la/ /mchod pa sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /dang po bsnyen ⑩pa rdzogs par bya/ /de nas sbyor gzhan rab spangs te/ /bcom ldan mchod nas brgya phrag brgyad/ /gsol ba'i mchod pa dang bcas pas//legs par bzlas na grol bar 'gyur/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma āt+yā ⑩ba lo ki te shwa rā ⑫ya/ bo bye satā ⑪ya/ ma hā satā ⑥ya/ ma hā kā ⑪ru ṇi kā ⑫ya/tar+ya ⑫thā/ ri dzu ka dharnga / nir ya ⑫te/ tā re tā rā ya⑪/ bha ga ba ⑫ ti tut+ta ⑫re/ blu ma blu 0ma/ mo tsa ne+e tu re swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba'i ⑫las kyi yan lag khri mon las thar bar byed pa'i cho 14—903

ga'i le'u ste bco ①brgyad pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ②'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis ①gang la rab bsngags pa/ /dngos grub de nyid bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mig dang lce dang mkhris pa rnams/ /rin chen ga'u'i nang du gzhug /bdud rtsi 'khyil pas bsrung byas nas//'grub par byed pa'i bsnyen pa brtsam/ /chog par shes nas pad rtsar sba/ /dag pa'i mig las dben par 'gyur/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma āt+yā ④ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bodhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ⑤ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tā re tā ra dza yārjo/ dza ye dza ye/ tut+ta re dza ya/ bha ye ⑦tu re swā hā/ 'phags ma sgol ma dngos grub thams cad ster bar byed ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag mi snang ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ⑧'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthong ba'i chos la 'og min du/ /'phags rnams spyod yul dang gcig cing / /yid kyi shugs kyis skyong ⑨byed pa/ /zangs dang lcags dang gser dag las/ /'bar ba'i ral gri byas nas su/ /yu ba gzhung dang go rims ⑩bzhin/ /gnyis dang bcu gcig sor du ldan/ /ā li kā li g.yas g.yon te/ /yi ge bcu pa dbus su'o/ /gnas skabs gsum du sku sogs gsum/ /sgra dang me stag 'od 'phro ba/ /rab 'bring rtags ⑪dang ldan pa las/ /chags med yid kyis bskyod byas te/ /'dab gshog rgyas pa'i bya bzhin du⑩/ /gang dang gang du bsam pa yi / /zhing khams dag tu 'dod pa'i don—/ /thams cad de yi dbang du gyur/ /oṃ ⑫tā re turtswa re tu re a mo gha 14—904

sidhi—/ khaṅge pra ①srid rnyi/ lo ka ā lo kā②/ tiṣ+ṭha ②rat+na tsa la tsa la/ hūṃ hūṃ baṃ baṃ a ti ④swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma yongs su rdzogs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag mchog bsgrub ⑤pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma rjo'aphags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser brtsegs ⑦ rab mdzes snod dag tu/ /'o ma mar dang sran chan dang / /la phug mngar dang me tog spos/ /dge ba'i chu dang chang la sogs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge yis/ /sbyangs ⑧nas 'byung po rnams la sbyin/ / oṃ a kā ⑨ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ ā da nut+pan na tā ta oṃ āḥ⑩hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gtor ma'i cho ga'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtsho'am khron pa 'bab chu gtsang / /bcom ldan mchog sbyin bdud rtsi yis/ /gdung bral 'phags pa'i rang bzhin du/ /bsgyur nas gsang sngags rgyal po ni/ /bdun phrag gsum gyis yi dwags rnams/ /rab tu tshim pa'i cho ga bya/ /oṃ tā re turtswa re tu re sarba pre te bh+yaḥswā hā/ chu sbyin pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa sdogs so// //rje btsun ma ⑪'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri zhim dkar ba'i sa rnams la/ /rigs lngar sbyangs nas de'i rang bzhin/ /de las ⑫mchod rten gdab byas la/ /de dag gnas su dam tshig ste/ /de la ye shes de dbang 14—905

bskur / /de la byin ①brlab de nas mchod/ /rab tu gnas byas de nas ni/ /dge ba'i gnas su bzhugs ②par bya/ /oṃ ①tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re sarba ta ④thā ga ta z-i rjod ya a dhiṣ+ṭha na rjo.a dhiṣ+ṭṛ ⑦te swā hā/ tsha tsha gdab pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma ⑧'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gso sbyong ⑨dag la gnas pa yis⑩/ /ka ti ka yi thal ba la/ /stong phrag bcu yi bsnyen pa bya/ /chu shel spyospyod yul yar ngo la/ /dri dbang phyed g.yas seng ge'i tshul/ /rtse gcig 'dod pa'i don rnams te⑫/ /'dod pa'i lha dang dus gsum gyis⑫/ /skye ba'i gnas rnams ston par mdzad/ /oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re tar+ya thā/ oṃ ④mug shi ri pra ma dadhe skekhargo ya sha /sho ma dha ra tsa ra phye ma hā ⑩ni swā hā/ ⑩dus gsum brtag pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun ma spyo'aphags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbrum ma dang ni mgo mjug ⑪log /mo gsham 0bu ni skyed byed dang / /sri'u ⑥bsrung dang 'byung po bzlog3 /las gang byed pa'i lhar gyur bya/ /dang po go ro tsa na dang / /yung ba ba bla'i ri lu las⑫/ /snag tsha snyebyas la sngags bris la/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang 'bru ⑫sna lnga/ /rin chen lnga dang sman ⑪sna lnga/ /bum par bcug la gsang sngags 'di/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas byin brlab/ /sngags chus nam phyed yol ba'i dus/ /mchod pa byas la sbrum ma des⑥/ /khrus byas bde bar btsa' zhing 'byung / /gnyis pa mar dag lag mthil ⑫du/ /bzhag ⑥la gsang sngags nyi 14—906

shu gcig /bzlas la mgo lus bha gar ①byug /de ltar byas na bde bar skye/ /gsum pa bo bye ②tse yi 'brum/ /bye ma dag dang ba dmar ser/ /'o ma bsres la bum par blugs/ /gsang sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ /zla mtshan byung dus tha ma'i tshe/ /blud na bu dag myur du ①skye/ /bzhi pa 'phral skyes byis pa de/ /khrus byas bde bar 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /lnga pa gsang sngags de nyid kyis/ /yungs kar nyi shu gcig bsngags nas/ /gdong du rjobrabs na 'byung po ldog / oṃ tā re ni ta rā ⑤ya—/ oṃ mo tsa ni mo tsa rjoya/ oṃ mok+ṣa ni mok+ṣa ⑦ya dzi ba bar bhi ④swā hā/ bskyed cing bsrung ba la sogs pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa rdzogs so// //bde gshegs bskyed ⑨mdzad rje btsun gyi/ /rnal 'byor byang chub yan lag bzang / /thabs kyi khyad par mdor bsdus pa/ /zhi ba la sogs las bzhi'i tshul/ /bdag gzhan don du ⑩sgrub byed pa/ /thugs rje chu skyes las byung ba'i/ /sbrang rtsi 'di ni bdag gis gzhibs⑪/ /'gro la phan phyir 'dir bkod do/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba yis/ /'gro ba ma lus byang chub che/ /sku gsum rang bzhin mthar phyin pa/ /myur ba nyid du thob par shog /rje btsun ma ⑫'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i las kyi yan lag dang bcas pa mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ kha che'i slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa zhes bya bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po mdzi shrī dang / bod kyi lo tsā ⑫ba mal gyo blo gros grags pas bi kra ④ma shī la'i gtsug lag khang chen po de nyid du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //14—907
0〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉5/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉kabartsar 'bras re'u mig da/ (515)14—913

༄ga /sgol ma'i sgrub thabs man ngag gi rim pa/①༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ tā ra sā dha ṭ+wāṃ u pa de sha kra ma/ bod skad du—/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs man ngag gi rim pa/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun sum tshogs ldan dpal 'byor dri med yon tan kyi/ /gzhir gyur 'gro la dam pa'i lam ster rgyal ba'i yum/ /sgrol ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs te 'gro ba la/ /phan phyir brtse bas sgrub skepa'i cho ga bshad par bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon yon tan mtsho/ /ji bzhin sbyor bas bsten byas nas/ /cho ga'i rim pas dbang bskur ba'i/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rnam par bsgom/ /ji ltar bshad bzhin rnam bsams la/ /sa bon gyis ni bskul ba yi/ /bla ma rdo rje rnams mchod la/ /gus pa'i bsam pas rtse gcig tu/ /btud la phyi nas rang lus gzhug /slar yang dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bya/ /bu dza o a go ra de mā①/ kā rjo.o tri ko ka la kā ⑤hi bre gri sau rjosu na si ma ku/ spyi bo'i gnas su 14—914

pul+lī ①rar/ /myur zhing dpa' ma ②dran par bya/ /spyi gtsug 'bar ba 'dzin pa ru/ /ston zla lta bur ③dri ma med/ /gser gyi mdog can rna ba ni/ /g.yas pa o t+yan ④nyid du bsam/ /arbu da ni ltag pa ste/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal bar grags/ /go da ba ri rna ba g.yon/ /hūṃ sgra sgogs pa'i lha mo'o/ /smin dbus ra me shwa ri ste/ /rdo rje sku yi sgrol ma'o/ /'khor lo dang ni cher sgrogs pa'i/ /dril bu g.yas dang gzhan du bsam/ /dbang mchog de bī ⑤ko ṭi ste/ /khams gsum rnam par rgyal byed do/ /gzhan 'joms lha mo dpung par rjonges/ /mā ⑦lar sgrub po dam pas bsam/ /mchan khung kā ma rū ⑧pa ste//bdud 'joms dam pa sbyin pa mo/ /o ṭi zhes bya nu ma ste/ /'khor los sgyur ⑨byed 'dod ster ma/ /tri sha ku no ⑩lte ba ru/ /mya ngan kun 'joms bsam par bya/ /dri 'dzin gnas su ko sa lar/ /'gro ba kun 'gugs phongs pa sel//ka liṅga ni kha yin te/ /lha mo bkra shis thams cad ster/ /mgrin pa'i gnas ni lam pa kar⑪/ /lha mo gsung gi sgrol ma ste/ /pad+ma dril bu 'dzin pa ru/ /mnyam par bzhag ⑫la rtag tu bsam/ /kāspyo ⑫snying gi grong khyer te/ /rdo rje thugs kyi sgol ma'o/ /mig sman gyi ni kha dog can/ /rdo rje dal bus 'gying ba yin—/ /kha ba'i rir ni smin byed ma/ /sum mdo'i gnas su bsam par bya/ /yi dwags grong du 'gugs byed ma/ /khra mo rtags kyi rtse mo la/ /zhi ba chen mo khyim gyi lhar/ /'og gi phyogs su bsgom par bya/ /brla gnyis sau rāṣ+ṭa ④yin te//'dod chags thams cad 'joms pa mo/ /gser gling byin pa zung gi tshal/ /lha mo bde ba sgrub ⑫byed do/ /sor mo phal ba na ga rar/ /rnam par rgyal ma bsam par bya/ /sdug bsngal sreg byed sirtse ste/ /rkang pa'i bol du rnam par 14—915

dgod—/ /rgan po ma ru dngos grub kun/ /legs 'byung lha mo bsgom par bya//ku lu tar ni yongs rdzogs ma/ /pus mo'i dkyil 'khor gnyis la gnas/ /de ①ltar cho ga rdzogs pa dang / /phyis ni rdo rje sgol ma yi/ /dkyil 'khor bcas pa'i lha rnams kun/ /rang gi lus la gzhug par bya/ /dri ma thams cad sbyang ba'i phyir/ /spyan drang mchod nas gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin thub pas dbang bskur la/ /dbu rgyan rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod cho ga dang / /mtshan ma kha dog la sogs pa/ /gzhan du bshad bzhin mkhas pa yis/ /mnyam par gzhag pas rtag tu bya/ /zab mo'i don la skye bo 'i / /blo gros rnam par 'khrul gyur kyang / /dam pa'i bla ma las byung ba'i/ /man ngag rim pas ①bris pa yin/ /bsod nams 'di yis nyes pa'i dba' ༷klong g.yo ba'i chusarjo/ /rnam par dkrugs te 'khrigs pa'i nor 'dzin brtan pa dang / /des skyed dudage legs snye ma'i me tog 'bras ldan pa'i/ /skye bo'i don du dpag bsam ljon shing byed par shog /dpal u rgyan nas byung ba'i man ngag gi rim pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po nyi ma sbas pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //man ngag gi rim pa'i sgrub thabs 'di dang po ma 'gyur ba las phyis kha che'i paṇ+ḍi tas kha ba can gyi ljongs su spyan drangs pa'i dpe las bod skad du dpal sa skya'i dben gnas dam par bsgyur ba'o// //14—916

bsdur mchan/914 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gag /sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs man ngag gi rim pa zhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsgrub/ ②〈〈pe 〉stab/ ④⑤〈〈pe 〉〉ka du〈〈pe 〉she /915 ①〈〈pe 〉sngagalbi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉smo/ ③〈〈co 〉〉gu/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉spyon/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bo du〈〈pe〉〉pa'i ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉ma/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉du/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉tha bsgyur/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉ni/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sngagar/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉gzhag ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉na / tso〈〈pe 〉〉raji/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉bsgrub/916 ①〈〈pe 〉〉da/ ②〈〈pe 〉stabs/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ rjo〈〈pe〉skab/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉ji/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉bskyid/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (516)14—917

༄ga /bcom ldan 'das ma sgol ma la bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga ba ti tā ④ra de bī e ka ③dzi sha ti sto ④tra no pi ya pos /bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma sgol ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed rjomadzad yum/ /shes rab pha rol phyin bdag nyid/ /sna tshogs sprul pas kun skyob ma/ /lha mo mchog de'i zhabs btud bshad/ /de nyid skyabs song sems bzang pos/ /sras bcas rgyal bas yongs bskor ba'i/ /'phags ma nyid mdun mkhar bzhugs mchod/ /sdog bsal bsod nams yongs rdzogs bya⑦/ /rnam dag sngags kyis ⑧dri bsal la/ /sku gsung thugs dngos bskyed dang rdzogs/ /cho ga ji bzhin ji snyed par/ /ma 'khrugs 'khrul ba med par bsgom/ /'phags ma sgol ma che nyid sku/ /yongs gyur 'dod sbyin sna tshogs gzugs/ /sna tshogs ⑨nor bu'i tshul bzhin du/ /gdul bya'i ⑩14—918

dbang can yongs gyur blta①/ /ye shes gzhug cing byin brlabs la/ /dbang bskur mchod cing rgyas gdab bya/ /'od zer 'byor pas 'gro skyob skedang / /dngos grub blangs te bzlas pa skebya/ /phyag 'byed sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo/ /sbyan ni skad cig glog dang 'dra ma/ /'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes zhal gyi/ /ge sar bye ba las ni byung ma/ /sbyan ras gzigs mgon thugs rje ma/ /chu skyes zhal gyi ge sar las/ /chu 'dzin las skyes glog 'gyu ④bzhin/ /byung bas rab dga'i sgol ma bsgom/ /mkha' dkyil gser mdog chu skyes gdan/ /zhal gcig phyag brgyad chos sgogs dang / /mda' gzhu 'khor lo ral gri dung / /rdo rje zhags bcas me tog brgyan/ /de yi phrin las gzhan gyi mthu/ /phyir bzlog bsten ⑤phyir lha mo bsnyen/ /bsgrub bya'i rjes la dkyil 'khor bya/ /de dbus ho0khung drag gzugs dgod/ /snying gar ⑦rtsibs brgyad spel tshig sngags//man ngag bzhin ⑧bkod thi ⑨gus drang / /sbu gu snying gtang ⑩lha sbyor gyis/ /sbod byed rten bral yang yang gzhug /lha mo khros pas mchod rten ni/ /nag po khri 'phang bzhi ldan brtsig /rgod gsung rna ba ⑪mgul dang thos/ /snom pa'i sdud ⑫byed shes par byed⑫/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i lha spyor gyis/ /dgug gzhug bstems nas mnan bya ste/ /mtshan ma rnyed nas sngar gzugs sreg⑫ /rang gnas slar yang tsi tas ⑫mnan/ /nus ldan stong gis gcig brnag ⑫kyang / /mtshon cha'i sbyor ba slar nyes bzhin/ /bdag nyid bdag gis phung bar byed/ /mchod bstod snying rjes mi gtong zhes⑩/ oṃ ⑫tā re tut+ta re tu re ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ⑪ṭ+wā hā/ oṃ ⑥tā re turtswa re tu re che ge mo kṛ ṇ+ḍi kṛ ṇ+ḍi⑥/ brnya badhe/ ha na ha na/da ha da ha/ bi dhad+ma ⑫ya/ bi dhad+ma duya/ ā mu ④ka mā ⑫ra ya phaṭa/ mā ⑫14—919

ra ya tu re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ①swā hā/ oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re ma hā pañtsa yak+ṣa ste bha ya hri baṃ hril ma ra ya ⑤phaṭa ku ru ku la bh+yoske/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma ④sgol ma myur ma dpa' mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal ston ka'i zla ba kun du/ /gang ba brgya ni brtsegs pa'i zhal ma//skar ma stong phrag tshogs pa rnams kyis⑤/ /rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma /ston zla brgya yi zhal mdangs mnga'/ /stong phrag skar mas rab phye ba'i/ /bkrag 'byin rjogazi mdangs yid 'ong ma/ /mi shes mun sel bsgom par bya /ji bzhin cho gas rab sprul yum/ /zhal gsum dkar sngo gser mdog can/ /bcu gnyis phyag mnga' mnyam gzhag dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo rin chen nyid/ /rdo rje me tog phreng 'dzin g.yas/ /ril ba ut+pal dril bu dang / /bum pa dang ni po ti g.yon/ /sna tshogs lha mo'i ⑦rgyan gyis spras/ /sku spros gsung bzlas phyag mtshan thugs/ /rang rang rjes mthun phrin ⑧las sgrub/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pas/ /mnyam gzhag rjes 'gro rtse gcig bya/ /phrin ⑨las yams nad zhi ba'i phyir/ /dkar ⑩phyogs maṇ+ḍal maṇ+ḍal ⑪dgod/ /dbus su yum bcas 'od dpag med/ /phyogs mtshams rigs bzhi yum bzhi dgod/ /khor yug phyogs skyong bcas dkyil 'khor/ /ma lus rgyan gyis mdzes par bya/ /mchod dang gtor ma sngon song bas/ /gso sbyong ldan pas gsang sngags bzlas/ /khri phrag mchod gtor ldan pas 'bum/ /bzlas te lha yi sbyor ldan pas/ /nad sogs zhi bya gtsang sbras so/ /yams bdag mang po chim par bya/ /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re sarba byā dhi ⑫pra sha ma na shās ⑫ku ru swā hā/ rje btsun ma sgol ma 14—920

ston zla lta bu zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshad gser ①sngo chu nas skyes kyisasne/ /pad+mas phyag ni rnam par brgyan ma/ /sbyin pa brtson 'grus dka' thub zhi ba/ /bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul nyid ma/ /shes rab bdag nyid phar phyin lnga/ /yongs rdzogs 'phags ma cho ga bzhin/ /rim gnyis bsgom zhing bzlas bya ste/ /rgya skecher mchod bstod bsngags par bya/ /pad nyir skyid krung gser mdog zhal/ /gcig rjomada' phreng ba ral gri mda'/ /rdo rje dbyi ⑤gu dar dbyangs rjozhags/ /pad+ma dril bu gzhu 'dzin bcu'o/ /rjes mthun cho ga sngon song bas/ /tshe bsring phrin ⑦las dogs med bsgrub/ /gzhan srog tshe yang bsrungs nas ni/ /tshe dpag med bkug mchod bstod gsol/ /oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re ā ⑧yu tshwa na dha ra dha ra bi ⑨dha ra bi ⑩dha ra ya ma bra hi dā ya de hi ⑪swā hā/ rang lo'i grangs kyi ⑫brgya rtsa brgyad/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos tshe yi dpal/ /grangs te nyi shu gcig bstod bya⑫/ /zhag re zla re las tshe 'phel/ /rje btsun ma sgol ma pha rol ⑫phyin ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor/ /mtha' yas rnam par rgyal ma skespyod ma/ /ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis ⑫shin tu bsten ma/ /gtsug tor yid bzhin nor bus mtshan/ /bdud dgra 'tshe ba kun las rgyal/ /pha rol phyin kun yongs rdzogs pas/ /bdag nyid che rnams kyis mchod bsgom/ /gser mdog chu ⑫skyes ri mo can/ /zag med chags 14—921

med rnam gnon zhing / /gser ri ltar brjid phyag bzhi mdzes/ /mchog sbyin phreng ba ril ba dbyug① /de las srog g.yo rnams ②'jil ba/ /kharga ①ne+e tra asgo ④bh+ya/ /garba ⑤su kha gcig pu skyes/ /ma ghi be+e ro tsa na sbyar/ /lha mor yid brtan mang bzlas nas/ /gnas lngar gdab cing khong du sbyin/ /rtse dugacig ha las 'tsho sgos ⑦byab/ /rang bzhin bcos sogs sel don med/ /oṃ ⑧tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re na ma⑨/ sha re ⑩sha re bi sha re sarba brah+ma ⑩gha ṭa swā hā/ rje btsun ma ⑫sgrol ma gtsug tor rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal tuṭ+wā ra hūṃ yi ges/ /'dod dang phyogs dang nam mkha' gang ma| /'jig rten gsum po zhabs kyis mnan te/ /lus pa med par 'gugs par nus ma/ /mthu chen sngags kyi hūṃ sgra yis/ /khams gsum rgyas 'gengs srid gsum gnon/ /kun bdag bkug nas dbang sdud ma/ /dbang bsgyur che nyid rnam par bsgom/ /zla steng rdo rje'i zhabs gnon cing ⑫/ /skyabs sbyin gser kyi pad lcug 'dzin/ /ting 'dzin mchog gzhug 'gro skyob ma⑫//ma chags gdul bya kun skyong mdzad/ /phrin las bsgrub phyir lhar bsnyen ma⑫/ /ras la rtsibs bzhi 'khor lo bri/ /bsgrub bya'i gzugs sogs ⑫mig dang ldan/ / wa shaṃ ⑫ku ru khrag gi spyobri/ /oṃ ⑪gsum rim pa'i rgyal mo'i dbus/ /skye mched gsal rdzogs spra tshil gzugs/ /lha mos bsdus te snying gar dugazhug /dus gsum dus drug seng ldeng bsreg /sgo gnyis zangs ma'i thur mas bru⑥/ /sa bon 'od dmar shugs drag gi/ /lcags kyus bkug ste zhags pas bcings/ /skra yengs ⑫gcer bu rkang 'dud bsam/ /dur khrod rjes ⑫gsum rdo rje'i chus/ /14—922

sbyar te sngags ①bcas sbyin par bya/ /de rjes ske ②tshe ming dang bcas/ /dbang sdud yid kyis sbyin sreg bya/ /bdun phrag zhag ni gcig dang gnyis/ /de bzhin bdun gyi ④mi mo dang / /mi pho lha mo sogs dbang bskur/ /oṃ ④tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re lam+bha lam+bha so sā tik+ṣa ⑤si u kro si ba shaṃ rjoka ra ya a mu shaṃ ⑦su rgyarma ⑧gha ḍa ni ra ha tra tsa ma na ba ⑨bh+yaḥsi ⑫da ha da hasbri ⑪rmya ma mas+dza ⑫ka dha ha ⑫lo pa na ④be+e ru ti pa la ṇa ⑫pa tsa ti rasne haṃ ba lan dar+ya ma ⑩rgo nyi ku to ni ⑩ku ku tro ro tro ⑫tri ya ti ba sa de nyi ba lan ⑪ba dha phu ra sa kri lta/ oṃ ⑥tsitri tsi tro bi lo li la bi lo la ⑥swā hā/ ya/dumu rka sā dha dz+wa pa ra ⑫pa tā ④m+bi da sa ma na ye ⑫swā hā/ oṃ ⑩ku ru kul+le s+thāḥ⑦swā hā/ 'bum phrag rnal 'byor rtse gcig gis/ /me tog bdug pa bza' btung dag /byin na brgya byin yang dbang byed/ /me tog dmar po'i sbyin sreg gces/ /yungs kar skyes bu mchog la bsngags/ /'khar ba'i sdod du sbrang rtsi mar/ /sngags dang bcas gus dus gsum du/ /mchod pa ②bcas pas don rnams 'grub/ /kham phor ram ni dung phor du/ /sbrang rtsi sogs la brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bzlas so mig byugs ⑪dgra bo yang / /bu sdug bzhin du sems par 'gyur/ /dur khrod gnas su snod chen ni/ /pad+ma dkar dang chen po'i snum/ /brgya dang bcu bzhi bsgrub byas pa'i/ /mig sman gyis ni gzhan dga' byed/ /rje btsun ma sgol ma srid gsum 'gugs pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshangs pa/ /rlung lha sna tshogs dbang phyug mchod ma / /'byung po ro langs dri za rnams dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mdun nas bstod ma/ /'jig rten las 'das 'jig rten kyi/ /che ⑩rnams dbang 14—923

phyug dpal ldan ma/ /'jigs chen sdig sbyong srid zhi yi/ /dngos grub ster mdzad mkhas pas bsgom/ /pad+ma nyi ma la gnas dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi rdo rje gri/ /sdigs mdzub zhags ①snams rjes mthun bsgrub②/ /lha tshogs kun la skyon ①sel ma'o④/ /las sgrub 'gro la phan yid kyis/ /dbe+en par dkyil 'khor bzang byas te/ /bgegs bsal phrin ⑤las gtor ma byinarjo/ /lha mo spyan drangs mchod bstod gsol/ /brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas bsgom par bcas/gnas gsum lus ngag yid sdig skyon⑦/ /sdig gzugs bsams ⑧la byab par bya/de rjes bkru dang ⑨bsreg par bya⑩/ /lus bkrus 'dam skyes sdud dang skyes/ /mkha' la rgyu dang rtsod las rgyal/ /ngan skyugs rgal sogs ⑪ltas 'thon nas/ /sdig ldan gzhan yang sbyang bar bya/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ /na ma āt+yā ⑫ba lo ki te shwa rā ⑫ya/ bo dhi satā ⑫ya/ ma hā satā ⑫ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ⑩ya/oṃ ⑩tā re tut+ta re tu re ma ma sarba pā paṃ⑫/ sho dha ya/ sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya/bi sho dha ya/ sarba bha ba sa mu dhi ⑩stso sha ra yi ⑦swā hā/ dngos sam gzugs sam gzugs brnyan la/ /mi dge kun bsdus stobs bzhir bcas/ /'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs bden pas/ /bdag dang 'di kun sdig bsal bya/ /rje btsun ma sgol ma sdig pa las rnam par rgyal ma'i ⑥sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal traṭa ⑫ces bya dang phaṭa kyis/ /pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis mnan te/ /me 'bar 'khrug dum shin tu 'bar ma/ /ma lus rgol bla'ajoms lha mo che/ /traṭa blaphaṭa sgra yis pha rol gnon/ /pad+ma ser dang nyi ma la/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang 14—924

stang ①stabs mdzes/ /byed rngam gnag cing khros pa'i bzhin/ /na bza' ser bsnams ②lto 'gros brgyan/ /phyag bzhi 'khor lo ral gri dang / /skye gnas steng zhabs sdig ①mdzub mdzad/ /rjes mthun las kyi 'chi bslus la/ /de las gong mar 'pho bar bya/ /phyi nang gsang bas 'gro ba la/ /srog sbyin tshogs bsags ④mchod rten ⑤bsgrub/ /lha mo 'dod sbyin yid kyi bltasadu/ /sgo gnyis 'jug ldog rlung sbyangs la/ /gnyug ⑦mar gnas pa'i yi ge gsum/ /gcig tu bsdus ⑧te steng du 'phang / /nyi stikas lam phye t+t+waṃ gis ⑩drangs/ /'og min longs spyod rdzogs skur 'gyur⑪/ /dri med chos sku las ma g.yos/ /sna tshogs gnas su sprul sku 'phro/ /rje btsun ma ⑫sgrol ma gzhan 'joms 'pho ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya/ /sor mos thugs kar ⑫ rnam par brgyan ma/ /ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor los brgyan pa'i/ /rang gi 'od kyi tshogs rnams 'khrug ma/ /sangs rgyas chos las legs skyes shing / /dge 'dun kun skyong brtse chen ma/ /phyogs dang phyogs bral 'khor lo'i bdag /rang skyes 'od kyis kun skyes bsgom/ /pad+ma dmar dang zla steng du/ /ban+d+ra ④ltar dmar phyag bzhi ma/ /gnyis dang gnyis las ⑫rab dga' yi/ /rang bzhin mya ngan med shing 'dzin/ /rjes mthun las kyi don bsgrub ⑩cing de la ⑩mabyed tshogs sngon dgo bas/ /bsnyen cing bsgrubs ⑫nas tshogs bsags te//de nyid gsum gyis ⑪byin gyis brlabs⑩/ /byin brlabs ma brlabs yon tan don / /shes gsal mi gsal bsrung byas te/ /yongs rdzogs maṇ+ḍal gsum 14—925

pa'i tshad/ /maṇ+ḍal stegs bzhugs dus bzang brtag /mchod bstod gsol btab ①gtor ma sbyinasde/ /lha yi rnal 'byor rdzogs ldan pas/ /dkyil 'khor bris te bum par ni/ /dbang bskur phyir ni lha rnams bsgrub/ /oṃ ①sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣa duka ta ⑤sa ma ya shri rjoye hūṃ/ bum pa la dze+ebazlas pa bya'o⑧/ / zlo dze+e dz+rī ⑨khaṃ hūṃ bskyed la/ /slar yang phyag mtshan lha sbyor las⑩/ /rigs lnga bsgoms te dbang mchog ⑪bskur/ /khrus byas dris byug kun rdzogs sbyar/ /oṃ ⑫sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne+e ⑫hūṃ swā hā/ sku phyi ba'i sngags so/ / oṃ āX⑩hūṃ dzaḥ⑫hūṃ baṃ hoḥ⑩/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang / ye shes pa spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /de nas man ngag ldan pa yis/ /mchod nas ⑩ sngags bzlas spyan phye la/ /be+er yang rab tu rgyas pa'i las/ /mchod cing sbyin sreg bcas mnga' gsol/ /oṃ byedatā re put+pa sgru paṃ dī pa gaste ne+e bi t+ya spyobadz+ra hūṃ mchod pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ ⑩tsak+ṣu tsaspya sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ya swā hā/ thur mas spyan dbye ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ⑩su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re ⑪swā hā/ me tog la bzlas pa dang gtor ma'i sngags so/ / oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ⑫khaṃ badz+rī ⑫bha ba dṛ phyo tiṣ+ṭha zlo ④khaṃ/bzhugs nas maṇ+ḍal dbul pa'i sngags so/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ⑫las kun byed/ /bstan skyong mchod pas srung ⑫bar byed/ /srung ⑦'khor ldan byas gnod med byed—/ /gtor ma rgyas byin rgyas par byed/ /mchog gi mnga' gsol rab gnas kyis/ /byin brlabs 'bar dang rgyun ring ⑫gnas/ /gang 'dod dpal ster mthu stobs 'phel/ /gang bsgrubs de 'drar sangs rgyas 'byed/ /rje btsun ma ⑥sgol ma mchog byed ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //14—926

phyag 'tshad tu re 'jigs pa don mo/ /bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms ma/ /chu skyes zhal ni khro gnyer ldan mdzad/ /dgra bo thams cad rab tu gsod ma/ /'jigs chen las skyob 'jigs chen mo/ / dpa' bo las kyang dpa' mo che/ /①khros pas dgra gsod dgra chen dgra/ /dbang bskur kun sbyin dbang bdag bsgom/ /pad+mar zla gdan ②chu srin gdan/ /gser mdog skyil krung phyed zhal gcig /a shwa ①ka dang rin chen mchog /pad+ma bum las ④dbang mchog ster/ /rjes mthun las byed nyon mongs kyis/ /⑤nyon mongs kun sel dbang bsgrub bya/ /rigs gsum las skyes smin byas te/ /cho gas spu gur snying po drang / /nyi zla nam mkha' sbrang rtsi'i rjobacud/ /lhan cig skyes zhes mi 'bral bsgom/ /zag dang bcas las zag pa med/ /zhi la ⑦'od gsal dmigs bral dag /mkhas pas lus dang lus med las/ /me tog rtsi'am til mar ltar/ /thabs ldan thabs bral skelegs blangs bstan⑨/ /mthar ni yang ⑩dag mkha' mnyam nyid/ /rje btsun ma ⑩sgol ma bdud 'joms dbang ster ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' ba ⑫brjid pa'i/ /dbu rgyan 'od kyi phreng bas spel ma/ /bzhad pa rab bzhad tuṣ+ṭha ⑫ra yis/ /bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma/ /ting 'dzin dam pas thugs bltams te8/ / dgyes shing dgyes ⑫pas rol pa'i stangs/ /dbu rgyan lnga yi lha 'od kyis/ /bzhad cing rab bzhad bsgom par bya/ /pad+mar ⑫zla steng byi ⑩ru'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang po gnyis/ /spyi bor bcings dang ral gri 'phyar/ /a shwa ⑫14—927

ka yi yal ga 'dzin/ /rjes mthun las rnams bsgrub ①mdzad ma/ /mnyes byas du mas gsol btab pas②/ /bgegs bsal ①gtor ma sngon byin la/ /sa blang dustegs bu bzang po bya/ /ri rab steng gnas gzhal yas khang / /bum pa lnga ldan mchod bstod gsol/ /dam tshig bskyed la rdzogs par bsgrub/ /'bum phrag gsum du bzlas pa bya/ /mig gnyis nyi ma zla ba yis/ /phyogs kun bsregs nas lha mo yi/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa mkha' la blta/ /badz+ra uts+tsha ṭa hūṃ brjod⑤/ /'khyil pa'i sngags brjod gom pa pyabargyar/ /rngam par bya ste klu dra gur bya/ /'byung chen lha mo dbang bzhag ⑧nas/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni rgyas par bri/ /phyogs bzhi nas gus tshig bzhi yis/ /gsol btab dam tshig ye shes kyi⑨/ /dkyil 'khor bskyed dang gzhug sogs bya/ /bu dang bla ma'i dris lan brjod/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon song so shing sbyin/ /sngags bcas nyal bas rmi brtags la/ /lha yid kun ldan rdul tshon dgod/ /mchod bstod bsgom zhing bzlas sogs bya/ /oṃ dha rod badz+ra sa ma ya ⑩swā hā/ gsang bar bsdams ⑪te mna' dor la/ /byin brlabs chu sbyin gdong ⑫g.yogs nas/ /me tog dor te dkyil 'khor gzhug /rtags ldan brtan pa phyag rgyas ⑫gdab/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re tsit+ta ⑫maṇ+ḍa la badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃske/ dkyil 'khor bstan ⑩cing gsol btab la/ /sangs rgyas kun bzhu lha mo yi/ /rnal 'byor kun ldan ye shes lnga'i//dbang bskur slob ma mchog la sbyin/ / oṃ ā ⑩badzā dar+sha ⑫dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ⑪/oṃ badz+ra sa ma ta ⑥dz+nyā na rat+na a rnyi ṣiñtsa rmā⑥/ oṃ ⑫badz+ra pra t+ya ⑫bek+ṣa ṇa ④dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa rmā⑫/ oṃ kṛ ⑩t+ya a nu ⑥ṣ+ṭha na dz+nyā na 3badz+ra a rnyi ṣiñtsa rmā⑫/ oṃ ⑩tsakra a mo gha dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa rmā⑥/ de nas rdo rje sbyin te/ oṃ ⑫badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a 14—928

bhi ṣiñtsa rmā①/ de nas rgyan dang srung ba sbyin ②la/ oṃ sdebadz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ④hūṃ a bhi ji rmā⑤/ lung bstan rjocing dbugs phyung la/ oṃ ⑦tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re sirnyi ⑧sa ma ya s+t+waṃ swa bhā ba a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ⑨/ rdo rje slob dpon nyid du dbang bskur la/ oṃ ⑩tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re he ho a rnyi ṣiñtsa rmā⑪/ phyir mi ldog par dbang bskur la/ oṃ ⑫badz+ra be warti a rnyi ṣe ka a rnyi ṣiñtsa rmā⑫/ chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur la/ oṃ dharmā rā dzā ⑫pra ti swā hā/ rjes su gnang ba'i dbang bskur la/ dze+ebadz+ra a nuñtsa a sgyi ji rmā⑫/ 'di dag slob ma'i dbang bcu ste//phal cher bum pa la gnas phyir/ /bum pa'i dbang du brjod pa yin/ /dang po yang ⑩ni thob par byed/ /de bzhin gsang ba shes rab kyi⑩/ /dbang bskur bcu yi ⑫ye shes dang / /sku gsum ⑪thob byed bla ma'i zhal/ /bdud rtsi bzhi pas rdo rje 'dzin/ /rje btsun ma ⑩sgol ma mya ngan sel byed kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i yan lag ces bya ba rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal sa gzhi skyong ba'i tshogs rnams/ /thams cad 'gugs par nus pa ⑥nyid ma/ /khro gnyer g.yo ba ⑫yi ge hūṃ gis/ /phongs pa thams cad rab tu sgol ma/ /dpal ldan sa skyong phyogs rnams dang / /phyogs bral ma lus 'gugs byed ma/ /de nyid snying po rab g.yo bas/ /phongs pa mtha' dag sel mdzad bsgom/ /rjes mthun cho gas ⑫las bsgrubs nas/ /pad nyi la bzhugs g.yas brkyang rol/ /mun mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas/ /lcags kyu blagaza' 'gugs zhags bsnams ⑫'ching / /dpa' mo bsnyen pas 'gro phan yid/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni gus bsgoms ⑪la/ /pad+ma'am bil 'bras 14—929

de bzhin du/ /ka ra bī ①ra'i mes mchod bya/ /bum bzang snod du lnga phrag lnga//rin chen gzugs spras snying po gzhug /gang 'dod bzhir ⑦ni bgegs bsal la—/ /lha mo nor gyi dbang phyug brten①/ /oṃ ༷tā re turtswa re ⑤dze+e bhe mo he swā hā/ rje btsun ma rjosgol ma 'gro ba 'gugs shing phongs pa sel ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal zla ba'i dum bus dbu brgyan⑦/ /brgyan pa thams cad shin khrutu 'bar ma/ /ral pa'i khur nas ⑨'od dpag med las/ /rtag par shin tu 'od rab 'dzag ⑩ma/ /gang gis gsol btab bkra shis dang / /dge legs rgyas mdzad zla tshes brgyan/ /'od dpag med las 'od 'dzags ⑩pas/ /bsod nams 'od dpung 'bar mdzad bsgom/ /mtshan mas rjes mthun las bsgrubs ⑫nas/ /slar yang chu skyes ri bong can/ /rdo rje'i dngo krung ⑫gis gnon dpal/ /gser mdog zhal gcig ④phyag brgyad blta/ /rtse gsum lcags kyu rdo rje gri/ /rin chen lcags kyu dbyu gu ril⑫/ /thugs rjes tshar gcod rjes 'dzin ma/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod ster ma'o/ / shis pa'i ⑩ phyogs su thab brtsigs te/ /dbus su t+t+waṃ ⑫ldan byedal bskor/ /sreg ⑫rdzas g.yas dang mchod rdzas g.yon/ /'o ma can shing sbrang rtsi mar/ /bsangs te so sor byin gyis brlabs⑪/ /rin chen las byas tshad ldan gyisadu/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar rdo rje dril/ /bsangs te ku shas gcal bkram 0bya/ /rgyun bzhag ⑫bram ze'i mes sbar la/ /bsang zhing rlung yab kyis babyed bya/ /'bar ba'i ched du lan gsum gsum/ /bdag med byin za mchod nas ⑫bstem//14—930

pad+ma'i 'dug stangs lan gnyis te/ /gsum gsum gyis ni lan bdun du/ /mar gyi dgang blugs gus pas sbyin/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas rtse gcig go/ / oṃ asna ①ye a di bya a bi ②sa ma ya rā shri ④ye ha bya ka bya ④ma hā ka na swā hā/me bltas ⑤ngan na bgegs dgra bzlog /bzang na gsol btab dngos grub blang / /sdog ldan spangs nas gso sbyong can/ /gus shing snying rje ldan par rjomachod—/ /o ⑦a rnyi bha k+ṣa asna ⑧ye ma ma shārnyi ⑨ku ru swā hā/ de ⑩rjes dgang blugs zhabs ⑪bsil bya/ /mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ /de rjes lha bskyed sogs mchod nas/ /dgang blugs phul la rdzas rnams mchod/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ⑫ya/ na ma āt+yā ⑫ba lo ki te shwa rā ⑫ya/ bo dhi satā skeya/ma hā satā pas/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ⑩kā ya/ oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re ⑫ma ma shārnyi ⑪ku ru swā hā/ dgang blugs dbul zhing mchod bstod ⑩la/ /slar yang me lha bskyed ⑥rdzas dbul/ /mchod bstod bshags ⑫shing byang chub bsngo/ /kun don phrin ⑫las thams cad grub/ /rje btsun ma chasgrol ma bkra shis thams cad sbyin ma'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal bskal pa dutha ma'i me ltar/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba'i ⑪dbus na gnas ma/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum kun 'khor dga' ba'i⑦/ /dgra yi dpung ni rnam par 'joms ma/ /smin byed rlag ⑫byed dpa' mo ni/ /mi bzad me dpung dbus na brjid/ /rten ⑥byed sdang byed dga' mdzad cing / /'joms byed dgra gzugs can de bsgom/ /pad+ma dmar dang nyi ma la/ /bzhengs pa'i dor stabs brkyang bskum ma/ /mi bzad rā ⑥ga ltar dmar mdog /14—931

kun du 'phro zhing kun bsreg ①mdzad/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi mchu byun g.yo/ /ral gri mda' dang 'khor lo gzhu/ /gcod 'bigs gshag ②cing bsnun byed las—/ /bgegs dgra phra rab rdul mi gnas/ /gser mdog nor bu in+d+ra dang / /spur long 'phags pa'i gdung thal dang / /bri sneha ti ④dang gu gul dang / /bdud rtsi lnga sogs sbyar ba'i spos/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas bdug byas na—/ /stong phrag brgyad cu'i ma lus bgegs/ /nags mes shing skam ji bzhin 'joms/ /rims ⑤sogs dug sogs de bzhin no/ /bsgrub bya'i gzugs la lha mo yisadu/ /nga rgyal gyis bkug rtsub ⑦mo'i shing / /rten phral ling ga gtubs ⑧nas bsregs⑨/ /bsnyen bsgrub las la ⑩go rims ⑪bzhin/ /'bum phrag stong phrag brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bzlas te khro mo'i rtswa ⑫khung zhal/ /phul nas ⑫gsum bdun nyi shu gcig /zhag gis tshangs par gyur kyang gsod/ /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re dhe ma ⑫dha res ⑫hūṃ/ sbo ⑩ṭa bhasmi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rje btsun ma ⑩sgrol ma yongs su smin pas dgra bgegs gzhom pa'i sgrub ⑫thabs ⑪rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal sa gzhi'i ngos la phyag gis⑥/ /mthil ⑪gyis bsnun cing zhabs kyis brdungs ⑫ma/ /khro gnyer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūṃ gis/ /rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma/ /'gugs byed snun ⑫byed rdung cibyed ma/ /yig mchog 'dzin rim gnyis bdun 'gems/ /lha mo nyid bsnyen gus pa yisabya/ /zhe sdang dang bral khro bas bsgrub/ /stong ⑩zil gnag mdog zhal gsum ma/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khros pa'i zhal/ /thod ⑦pa'i do shal rgyu ma gsol/ /14—932

sgrul brgyad kyis brgyan stag wags gsol/ /phyag drug ral gri lcags kyu dang / /dbyu ①gu de bzhin thod khrag bkang / /zhags pa ②tshangs pa'i mgo 'dzin ma/ /khams gsum rim bdun ñtsag car ①'gems/ /rjes mthun las rnams sngon song bas| /dar dkar dril ④byug lha sbyor gyis/ /chu skyes ge sar oṃ ⑤dang a'i/ /mtha' rten mda' dubargyad 'bru brgyad bri/ /bden bzhi'i rten 'byel mtha' skor ⑦dang / /rigs lnga'i snying pos brgyan pa yi/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes ⑧mdzes pa dang / / ā li kā ⑨li mu khyud bskor⑩/ /mthar byed sngags dang ral gri yi//ra ba phyi rol rim gnyis dgod/ /de nas 'bar ba'i ra ba ste/ /shis pa'i snag tshas mnyam gzhag bri/ /mchod cing ye shes 'khor lo gzhug /nga rgyal ldan pas rgyas btab la/ /bdug pas bdug cing mgul du gdags/ /'di yis mi srung ⑩gang yang med/ /rje btsun ma ⑫sgrol ma 'gugs byed mas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zhi ma/ /mya ngan 'das zhi spyod yul nyid ma/ /swā hā oṃ dang yang dag ldan ma/ /sdig pa chen po 'joms pa nyid ma/ /lha mo bde mas mtho ris sbyin/ /dge mas thar pa sbyin pa ste/ /de bzhin zhi mas sdogs sangs rgyas/ /sbyin mdzad sdig 'joms bsgom par bya/ /pad+ma dkar dang zla ba la/ /rdo rje'i ⑫skyid krung kun+da'i mdog /phreng ba mchog sbyin dbyu gu dang / /pad+ma spyi blugs po ti 'dzin/ /rtsa ba'i bsnyen ldan khrus byas te/ /bgegs bsal bsod nams spel phyir ro/ /lha sbyor ldan dang rdzas tshang dang / /dad dang snying rjetsobartson pas yid⑫/ /nyams dga'i phyogs su stegs bu bcagyi//14—933

sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab bzhi ldan/ /rdo rje me phreng ①mdzes bskor zhing / /phyogs skyong bkra shis rtags ldan bri②/ /ral gri me tog gemada' dang dar/ /rma bya tshon skud dung dkar sogs/ /ba dan bla re ④rgyal mtshan gdugs/ /me tog phreng sogs mchod gtor bsham/ /lha mo'i ting 'dzin las sprul pa/ /rin chen khang brtsegs rgya chen nang / /dngos grub mtsho skyes bcom ldan ma/ /cho ga gsum gyis bskyed gzhug mchod/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ /na mo āt+yā ⑤ba lo ki te shwa rā rjoya/ bo dhi satā ⑦ya/ ma hā satā ⑧ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ⑨kā ya/ oṃ tā ⑩re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re sarba gra te⑪/ sarba bya dhi⑫/ sarba tso ra/ sarba ba s+t+ya⑫/sarba dur supa ni bh+yaḥ⑫ sarba pā baṃ sha ma nā ⑫ya swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal mo'i mtha' skor du/ /gzugs ⑩mdzes kyis ni brgya stong grangs/ /bskor zhing 'phro ⑫'du'i 'od 'bar bas/ /bzhu ste bdud rtsi'i rdzing bur byas/ /dug sel sgros byab sdig gdon sogs/ /mi sdug gzugs su phyung ⑫byas khrus/ /rig ⑪sngags bkra shis bcas te gdon/ /rjes la mchod bstod dubazod par gsol/ /lan cig ⑥lan gsum lnga dang bdun/ /khrus byas nad sel gdon zhi byed/ /sdig 'joms don kun 'grub du'agyur te/ /rtag tu byas na ⑫dngos grub thob/ /rje btsun ma ④sgol ma zhi ba chen mo phyi khrus kyi cho ga'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i/ /dgra yi dpung ni rab tu 'gems ma/ /yi ge bcu pa'i sngags ni bkod pas/ /rig pa hūṃ las sgrol ba nyid ma/ /yid gzhungs ⑫dran sogs kun nas bskor/ /mi shes dgra dpung rab 'joms ma/ /blo gros yi ge bcu bkod pas/ /hūṃ las srid zhi'i mun 14—934

sgol bsgom/ /pad+ma'i ge sar nyi ma la/ /sems dpa'i skyis krung byu ①ru'i mdog /dgra 'joms rtse gsum thugs kar sde'adzin/ /'bras bcas shing bsnams ③sdigs mdzub 'phyar/ /thugs kyi snying po reg pa mchog /yi ge bcus bskor 'dod pa yi/ /dngos grub kun ster blo gros spel/ /thams cad snying gi dbus ④gnas ma'o/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin shes rab mchog /gcig tu phan mdzad dngos grub sbyin/ /ji ltar gzhan blo spel de ltar/ /bdag gi ⑤blo mchog rgyas par mdzad/ /ngag gi dbang phyug zhi phra dmar/ /bdag gyur g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab tu/ /yid gzhungs 0dran dang shes rab dang / /blo 'phel lha mo bzhi bsgom bya/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo zla ba'i dbus/ /rnam snang sgol ma las byung dngos/ /rtsa rig 'od kyis ⑦mun sel bskyed⑧/ /mi smra'i sbyor bas gsang sngags bzlas/ /oṃ tā ⑨re tuṭ+wā re tu re spyo⑩ཿ /ma hā ma yī ga pra1 pri dh+wa ⑪ma hā sa ra sa s+t+ya ⑫na ma pra kṛ ⑫ta pa ri shudha sarba dharmā pra kṛ ta pa ri shurnyolha⑫haṃ/ sarba ma hā bha ⑫yan tā ⑩ra swā hā/ sman rnams sbyar ⑩bas bzlas ⑫nas ni/ /zla ba drug dang gsum mam gcig /zos nas ⑪thos mang 'dzin pa dang / /tshe ldan tshangs pa'i nga ro thob/ /de bzhin gser mdog dri ldan sngags/ /zla gcig zla gsum zla ba dudrug /bsnyen pas yid gzhungs ⑥dran ldan zhing / /blo 'phel ngag gi dbang phyug 'gyur/ /rje btsun ma ⑫sgrol ma dgra 'joms mas blo 'phel ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal tu re zhabs kyis brdabs pas/ /hūṃ gi rnam pa'i sa bon nyid ma—/ /ri rab man+da ⑫ra dang 'be+egs byed/ /'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba 14—935

nyid ma/ /bde ldan lha mos zhabs brdabs pas/ /'jig rten gsum g.yo 'jigs par byed/ /hūṃ yig sa bon las skyes mgon/ /ri rab kun bskyod ①dbang sdud ②bsgom/ /rab dkar pad dbus nyi ma la/ /hūṃ yig las skyes kun bde ster/ /sems dpa'i skyil ①krung dmar ser mdzes/ /phyag gnyis ri bong 'dzin bsnams pa'o/ /de bsnyen dben par gtsang khang bsham/ /zhi mdzad lha la me tog gi/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod bcas gtor mar bcas/ /de bzhin gtum mo me sdemachod bcas/ /chos rkun la sogs snying brtse bas⑤/ /lha mo gtor ma 'dod byin la/ /yan lag dgu ldan mchod byas nas/ /zhi drag gnyis kar rjogasol ba gdab/ /snying ga'i ⑦'od kyis sems can khams/ /kun khyab ⑧slar yang thugs rje yi/ /a ⑨las bsil zer de steng t+t+waṃ⑩/ /yongs gyur sngar ⑪gzugs lha mo yi/ /g.yas g.yon mi 'jigs ut+pal can/ /sna tshogs rgyan mdzes lha rdzas kyi⑫/ /mchod sprin dbus bzhugs che dgus ⑫ mchod—/ /mgul rgyan gdu ④bu do shal 'dzin/ /'bru ⑫gsum gyis brgyan 1nam mkha' yi/ /tshon gzugs dang bltas gsal bar bya/ /phyag gi bdud rtsis bdag skyong bar/ /bsams la gsang sngags lo grangs gdon/ /na mo āt+yā ⑩ba lo ki te shwa rā ⑫ya/ bo dhi satā ⑪ya/ ma hā satā duya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā stsoya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re sarba duṭ+wāṃ pra duṭ+wāṃ ⑫ma ma kṛ tā blun—/ dze+e bha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya/ brnya brnya ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa sarba s+t+waṃ bha ni tā re swā hā/ phyi yi phyag rgya zhabs 'og mnan/ /nang blagi dbugs kyis drangs te bsreg /bsgrub ⑫bya'i 'khor lo bcings te dril/ /de skyong lha ni gtor mas bskrad/ /gang 'gro'i phyogs su dpal chen mo/ /zhal 14—936

bzang ①bdag la gzigs par bsam/ /de la bstod dang bzlas gsol bya/ /des ni 'jigs pa kun skyob sde'agyur/ /rje btsun ma 'phags ma ④sgrol ma bde ldan mas chos rkun bcing ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub rjothabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i/ /ri dwags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma⑤/ /tā ra gnyis brjod phaṭa kyi yi ges/ /dug rnams ma lus par ni sel ma/ /'phags ma lha yi ngang pa rjo'adzin⑦/ /zag med bde rgyas dug sel ma/ /mnyes byas rdzas ⑧dang sngags sbyor bas/ /dug rnams las rgyal bsgom par bya/ /pad+ma dkar steng zla dbus su/ /'dab bzang khri steng skyil krung bzhugs/ /gnyis kyi ⑨spyi bor lcags kyu 'dzin/ /gzhan gnyis mchog ⑩sbyin po ti bsnams/ /lha mnyes rnal 'byor ldan pa yis/ /gdon rigs lnga yis ⑪dug brtags la/ /rdzas rigs lnga la gsang sngags lnga/ /'bum phrag gsum bzlas gnas lngar byugs⑫/ /oṃ ⑫tā re tut+ta re tu re ku ru kupre s+thā⑫ཿ/sarba sha hūṃ bhaskek+ṣa ya hūṃ hūṃ nā ⑩ga ste bha ya mo hā ya brnya ⑩ya re yo khaṃ sum̐ ne+e ra ⑫pa ne+e hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dam tshig rdzas ni ⑪dang po la/ /gu gul gla rtsi shu dag dang / /ru rta btsan ⑩dug shing kun nyid/ /gla rtsi mi ⑫bskyod bcas sbyor ba'o//gnyis pa gnyis du'agyur shu dag bla⑫/ /ru rta gu gul mu zi nyid/ /ro ras rgya tshil gshin dri chen/ /phag bcud sgog skya ma dhu blur/ /mi yi bcud dang rus pa'i phye/ /mi yi bcud bsdus ⑫ril bu'o/ /snga ma'i gnyis ⑪'gyur bsnyen pa yis—/ /rig pa nyid dang lha sbyor nyid/ /gsum pa la ni gsum ⑫'gyur nyid/ /gzhan yang klu dug bdud rtsi bsten/ /bzhi pa yang na bzhi 'gyur nyid/ /klu 14—937

dug rnam rgyal bsten ①par bya/ /lnga pa lnga 'gyur a ru ra/ /mi bskyod gla rtsi khyad par bsten②/ /nyi 'od mun pa mi yi snerdul/ /ji bzhin dug rnams 'joms par byed/ /rje btsun ma sgol ma rnam par rgyal mas klu nad gso ba'i sgrub rjothabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams ⑤rgyal porjo/ /lha dang mi 'am ci yis bsten ma/ /kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis/ /rtsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ma/ /sa gsum dbang pos rab mchod cing / /kun nas dga' bskyed ⑦'bar ba yis/ /gzi yis ltas ngan ⑨sdug bsngal sel/ /brtson pas dus drug bsgom par bya/ /pad+ma dkar dang nyi steng du/ /g.yas brkyang skyil krung kun+da'i mdog /sna tshogs 'od phreng sku brgyan nas/ /me thab ⑩bsnams shing sdug bsngal bsreg /ltas mthong bsnyen pas 'phags ma nyid/ /skyabs song spyosbyor gzhan spangs nas ni/ /ba lang lcis ⑫byugs dkyil 'khor bya/ /dbus su gsung thugs sku bskyed bya/ /de nyid spyan drangs mchod sngon ⑫'gro/ /gsol btab snying brtses bsnyen pas so④/ /khri brtson lo grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/ /mchod bstod gsol ba ma yengs bya/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo āt+yā ⑫ba lo ki te shwa rā ⑩ya/ bo dhi satā ⑩ya/ ma hā satwa ⑫ya/ ma hā kā ru be+e ⑪kā ya/tar+ya thā/ ri ⑫dzu gha dhazas/ ni ra ya tedu/ ta re ta ⑫ra ya/ bha ga ba ti ④tut+tha re ⑫bha ya mo tsi tu re swā hā/ rje btsun ma ⑩sgol ma sdug bsngal bsregs ⑦pas khri mon 3las thar pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //14—938

phyag 'tshal nyi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i/ /spyan gnyis po la ①'od rab gsal ma//tā ②ra gnyis brjod tuṭ+wā ra yis/ /shin tu drag po'i rims ni sel ma/ /ye shes lha mo ye shes spyan/ /rab gsal bsgribs dang mi ①bsgribs gzigs/ /ngan 'gro dang ni srid pa'i nad/ /nyon mongs bcas 'joms bsgom par bya/ /'dab skyes dmar steng zla ba la/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung gser zangs mdog /phyag gnyis thugs kar ⑦gser bum 'dzin/ /nad 'joms dngos grub kun ster mdzad—/ /'dab bzangs mig lce mkhris pa bsnams⑤/ /ri rab kyis bcas ga 'ur gzhug /lha mo nyid sku gsung dang thugs/ /yi ge gsum bskyed bsrung ba'i mchog /rig pa'i rgyal mo t+t+waṃ yi gerjo/ /mig sman bsdus nas kun mthong zhing / /gzhan mthong mi mthong sbyin par byed/ /sbed byed gzungs ⑦ni 'bum phrag bzlas/ / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/⑧ na mo āt+yā ⑨ba lo ki te shwa rā ⑩ya/bo ⑪dhi satā ⑫ya/ ma hā satā ⑫ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ⑫kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ ⑫tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re ⑩ya dza ye dza ye tuṣ+ṭha re ⑩dza ya bo dhi tu re ⑫swā hā/ rje btsun ma ⑩sgol ma dngos grub 'byung bas mi snang bar byed pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //phyag 'tshal de nyid gsum rnams bkod pas/ /zhi ba'i mthu dang yang dag ldan ma/ /gdon dang ro langs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams/ /'joms pa tu re rab mchog nyid ma/ /lha dang sngags dang ting 'dzin gyis/ /de nyid gsum bkod mthu ⑩chen mo/ /gnas gsum gnod pa'i tshogs 'joms ma/ /yi ge gnyis ldan bsgom par bya/ /cho ga kun ldan rjes mthun pa'i/ /lha bsnyen mchod bzlas goms pa yis/ /de nyid gsum ni rtag tu dran/ /yongs 14—939

rdzogs mkha' ①spyod 'grub par 'gyur/ /ha skyes khyu mchog pad zla la/ /skyil krung ②phyed bzhugs stag sham can/ /zhal gcig rnam thar spyan gsum phyag /mu tig phreng dang mdung rtse gsum/ /skar mdog rab dkar mun sel byed/ /gsang sngags sgra ④yis srid gsum 'gengs/ /dug gsum mdung rtse gsum gyis bsnun—/ /sgrub rjol dngos grub kun rdzogs mdzad/ /de yis mkha' ⑤spyod mthong ster rjom/ /lha bsnyen yid kyi shugs goms pas/ /zangs lcags gser las ⑦ral gri bya/ /tshad ldan ā kā bcu phreng brgyan/ /sngags bzlas rab 'bring tha ma'i rtags/ / me tog 'od zer 'phro ba dag⑧ /mthong nas chags med yid kyis bskyod/ /de bzung 'dab gshog ⑨bya bzhin 'gro/ /oṃ ⑩tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re a mo gha sidhi khazhe pa lo ka ā lo ka tiṣ+ṭha ⑪rat+na tsa la tsa la hūṃ hūṃ baṃ baṃ s+thā swā hā/ rje btsun ma ⑫sgrol ma yongs su rdzogs byed mas mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //'phags mchog lha mo yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po 'di/ /nyi shu gcig bcas bstod pa'i rgyal po'i spyorjes sgrub thabs/ /sgol ma mngon 'byung le'u lnga brgya bdun cu par/ /gang gsungs ④gsal byas de dges ske'agro yid mun sel shog /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun lha mo mchog nyid kyi skus rjes su bzung ba'i slob dpon chen po nyi ma sbas pa'i ⑩zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dpal chos kyi rje ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas gsum par grags pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bsod snyoms pa kha che shākya shrī bha dra dang / lo tsā ⑩ba byams pa'i dpal gyis—/ bod yul dbus kyi gtsug lag khang chen po sol nag thang po che dang /14byed940

pho brang dam pa khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o// // rje btsun sgol ma/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma ①gung pa/ dgra bcom pa sha na'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa kṛt+ta'i gos can/kha che nyi ma sbas pa/ rā hu la /sa/ bi na da shrī/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i ①dpal/ bla ma bson nams rgyal mtshan/ rin po che ba tshad ma'i skyes bu/ des bu ston la'o// // ④brtsar mchan/91/ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag /bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// sde〈po ra 〉〉ta/ ④〈〈pe 〉ṭha e ga④〈'ar 〉skod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉dz+ra ge/ 〈'ar 〉tsā ke/ rjo〈〈pe 〉miskye/ 〈'ar 〉〉skyed/ dze+e〈'ar 〉7sa/⑧〈〈pe 〉7/ ⑨〈'ar 〉7t+ya/ ⑩〈'ar 〉tha'i/919 ①〈'ar 〉rdza/ ⑦〈'ar 〉mas / sne〈'ar 〉7ra/ ④〈〈pe 〉thabyung / ⑤〈〈pe 〉sngashar 〉thastan/ du〈〈pe 〉rdza/⑦〈〈snar 〉khir/ ⑧〈'ar 〉mizhi/ ⑨rte〈pe 〉༅/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉thatang / ⑪〈'ar 〉ra dang / ⑫〈〈pe 〉thadud/⑫〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7/ ④〈shar 〉risreg ⑫〈sar 〉〉tis/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉thasnags/ 〈〈snar 〉7rnags/ ⑩〈'ar 〉〉btang ces/ spyo〈'ar 〉ye ⑪〈〈pe 〉7ཿ/ du〈'ar 〉ye ⑥〈'ar 〉〉tu/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉8 sgrisna/〈〈pe 〉tsāsna gri / ⑫④〈〈pe 〉〉dhā chu/ 〈'a ra 〉wān sa/ ⑫〈'ar 〉rab/ ⑫〈snar 〉zab/92༷ ①rte'ar 〉7phaṭa/ sde〈〈pe 〉zo re/ dze+e〈'ar 〉d+ku ku stsoḥ/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7'phags ma/ ⑤〈'ar 〉〉kyi/ rjo〈'ar 〉thadzin/ ⑦〈'ar 〉jo/ ⑧⑨〈'ar 〉thaphrin/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ragar/ ⑪〈'ar 〉7maṇ+ḍal/⑫〈'ar 〉pho rgya/ ⑫〈'ar 〉8 shan ti/921 ①〈shar 〉dz+rar/ sde〈'ar 〉tha/ ⑦〈shar 〉7sa te/ /brgya/ rjo〈〈pe 〉theg ⑤〈'ar 〉rabyigadu〈zhar 〉mkhas/ ⑦〈'ar 〉tsāngs 'ab / ⑧〈'ar 〉sngag sti⑩〈'ar 〉8/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉7 ma pra nyi ya de nyi/ 〈'ar 〉zo mā pra dha ra de snya/ ⑫〈'ar 〉7sa/ ⑫〈'ar 〉7bya/ ⑩〈shar 〉mi/ ⑫〈〈pe〉tha/8〈'ar 〉d+ku/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉d+kus/14—941
brtsar 'azas re'u migargyud/ (517)14wa 946

bstod pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba/①༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ de bī ②tā re e ka bir+sha ti sto tra bi shuste tsuṇ+ḍa ①ma ṇi nā ma/ bod skad du/ rjolha mo sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la bstod pa/rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal rab tu dpa' ba'i sgrol ma/ /spros med rnam dag nam mkha'i dkyil na/ /pad+ma gser mdog gdan la bzhugs pa'i/ /sku mdog dmar mo me yi 'od can/ /phyag 'tshal zhal gcig ⑤phyag brgyad spyan rgyas/ / dga' ba'i pyaphyag rgya dang po gnyis ni/ /rdo rje dril bu spyi bor bsnol nas/ /g.yas 'og mda' gzhu thugs kar 'dzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal gsum pas 'khor lo bsnams ⑦te/ /bzhi pa shes rab ral gri 'debs tshul/ /g.yon gyi gsum pas thugs kar dung 'dzin/ /bzhi pa na ⑧ni zhags pas brgyan ma/ /phyag 'tshal dkar mo zla mdangs sgrol ma//14—947

sku gsum rdzogs pa'i zhal gsum g.yas sngo/ /g.yon zhal 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser mdog /rten 'brel dag pa'i phyag ni bcu gnyis/ /phyag 'tshal dang po mnyam pa'i phyag rgya/ /gnyis pa na ni kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams①/ /'bar ba'i 'khor lo gsum pas legs 'dzin/ /bzhi pa ④yid bzhin nor bu ④bsnams ma//phyag 'tshal lnga pa dhirdo rje rab 'chang / /drug pa na ni me tog phreng 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi gnyis pa ril ba spyi blugs/ /nyon mongs dri ma ma lus 'khrud ma/ /phyag 'tshal gsum pas byedal legs 'dzin/ /stong pa'i sgra sgrogs ⑤bzhi pa dril bu—/ /lnga pa dugater gyi bum pa thogs ma/ /drug pa po tis ⑦'gro la chos ston//phyag 'tshal gser mdog can gyi sgrol ma/ /sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i ⑧gdan la/ /rdo rje skyil krung shin tu mdzes brjid⑨/ /phyag bcu pha rol phyin bcu dag ma/ /phyag 'tshal dang po thugs kar phreng ⑩'dzin/ /gnyis pa na ni shes rab ral gri//gsum pa mda' 'phen nyon mongs 'bigs ma/ /bzhi pa rdo rje lnga pa dbyu ⑪gu/ /phyag 'tshal g.yon kyis ⑫dar dpyangs rab bsnams⑫/ /gnyis pa zhags pa gsum pa pad+ma/ /bzhi pa'i phyag gis dril bu dkrol ma/ /lnga pa na ni ⑫snying rje'i gzhu thogs/ /phyag 'tshal gtsug tor rgyal ba'i sgrol ma/ /chu skyes pad+ma skeser po'i steng du⑩/ /zag med bde ⑩rgyas zla ba'i gdan steng ⑫/ /sems dpa'i dngo krung brtan par bzhugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal dge ma gser gyi ⑪mdog can—/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin 'gro la rab brtse⑥/ /zhal gcig ⑥phyag bzhi bdud bzhi ⑫'joms ma/ /g.yas kyi dang pos ⑫dngos grub mchog spyod/ /phyag 'tshal rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bsam gtan/ / gnyis pa na ④ni phreng ba 'dzin ma—/ /g.yon gyi dang po phyag mtshan gudhe⑫/ /gnyis pa rin don dbyu gu ⑪14—948

bsnams ma/ /phyag 'tshal hūṃ sgra sgrogs pa'i sgrol ma/ /dri med zla ba'i gdan gyi steng na/ /nyon mongs skyon bral dag pa'i sku mdog /btso ma g.ya' bral gser gyi mdangs ldan/ /phyag 'tshal dpa' mo shes rab bdag nyid/ /thugs rjes ①'khor ba zhe la ②mnan nas/ /ma rungs 'dul phyir hūṃ gi sgra sgogs—/ /dug ④gsum srid pa'i g.yul las rgyal ma/ /phyag 'tshal bden gnyis rjodag pa'i phyag rgya/ /'gro rnams thugs rjes rab tu bzung ⑤phyir/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis mchog rjosbyin mdzad cing / /g.yon pas pad+ma ser po 'dzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrol ma/ /chu skyes pad+ma dmar po'i steng du⑦/ /gti mug dag phyir nyi ma'i gdan steng ⑧/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung 'gro la gzigs ma/ /phyag 'tshal lha dang drang srong rnams kyis/ /khyod zhabs pad+mo ⑨spyi bor blangs nas/ /thugs rje che mnga' khyod la rab bstod⑩/ /'gro ba kun gyi re gnas gyur ma/ /phyag 'tshal pad+ma rā ⑪ga'i mdangs ldan/ /phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po nyid na⑫/ /rdo rje 'phyar zhing de 'og ral gri/ /g.yon gyis ⑫sdigs mdzub zhags pa bsnams ma/ /phyag 'tshal rgol ba 'joms pa'i sgrol ma/ /pad+ma ser dang ⑫nyi ma'i gdan la/ /dpa' ba'i stang stabs 'gying bag g.yon brkyang ⑫/ /tsham rngam ⑩nag mo khros pa'i bzhin 'phyar/ /phyag 'tshal na bza' gser mdog gos gyon⑩/ /dbu skra gyen badze+es ltos spyo 'gros brgyan ma⑪/ /rin chen cod pan ⑥mkha' la rab 'phyar/ /phyag zhabs rin chen gdu bus brgyan ⑪ma/ /phyag 'tshal phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po/ /'khor lo 'dzin cing gnyis pa ral gri/ /skye gnas ⑫steng du zhags pa bsnams nas—/ /g.yon gyi tha mas sdigs ⑫mdzub rab gdengs④/ /phyag 'tshal 14—949

dbang mchog ster ①ba'i sgol ma/ / nyi ma pad+ma dkar po'i steng du/ /gdugs khrupa 'dul phyir chu srin ⑦gdan steng ④/ /skyil krung phyed ma gser gyi mdog can//phyag 'tshal 'khros pa'i ⑤gnyer ma dang ldan/ /brjid pa'i sku mdog 0zhal gcig ⑦phyag bzhi/ /g.yas na mya ngan med pa'i yal ga /gnyis pa rin chen bsnams shing mchog stsol/ /phyag 'tshal g.yon gyi dang po pad+ma/ /nyon mongs skyon gyis ma gos phyir bsnams⑧/ /g.yon gyi tha mas ⑨bum pa legs thogs/ /'gro ba kun la dbang mchog ster ma/ /phyag 'tshal seng ldeng nags kyi sgol ma/ /yi ge t+t+waṃ ⑩las 'khrungs pa'i lha mo/ /⑪chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mtshon pa'i/ /skra 'khyil me tog gis brgyan mdzes ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yas brkyang zhabs la g.yon pas⑫/ /thabs dang shes rab mi 'bral 'khril bas⑫/ /pad+ma zla ba'i steng na bzhugs ma/ / zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ba'i gzugs can/ /④phyag 'tshal g.yas pas 'gro la mchog stsol/ / g.yon na ⑫ut+pal rgyan rnams yongs rdzogs / /sngo ⑩ljang 'gying bag ras ma'i ⑫mdog can/ /gzhon nu spyan yangs ⑫nu ma rgyas ma/ /⑪phyag 'tshal mya ngan sel ba'i sgol ma/ /ma chags pad+ma dmar po'i steng du⑥/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhabs kyis mnan te⑪/ /rol pa'i 'dug stangs ⑫'gying bag mdzes ma/ /phyag 'tshal 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma/ /sku mdog pad+ma rā ⑫ga ltar dmar/ /bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs ④tut+ta ra yis⑫/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs ⑩ma lus sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal zhal gcig phyag bzhis ⑦bdud 'dul/ /dang po gnyis ni spyi bor thal sbyar/ /g.yas 'og ral gri ⑫phyag rgya dang ldan/ /g.yon na mya ngan med pa'i yal ga /phyag 'tshal 'gro ba 'gugs pa'i sgol ma/ /gzi brjid phung po nyi ma'i steng na/ /14—950

pad+ma'i gdan la rol pas g.yas brkyang / /'gying bag nag mo dbang gi las mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal dpa' mo gyad kyi cha byad/ /mtshan mo sprin rum mun pa'i mdog can/ /shin tu 'jigs rung bdud dpung zil gnon/ /nor gyi char 'bebs phongs ①pa sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal yi ge hūṃ gi sbyor bas/ /phyogs mtshams rnams nas gza' chen brgyad 'gugs②/ /zhal gcig ⑦phyag gnyis g.yas pa ④lcags kyu/ /g.yon pas rol pa'i ⑤zhags pa bsnams ma/ /phyag 'tshal bkra shis ster rjoba'i sgrol ma/ /sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la/ /rdo rje skyil krung gser gyi mdangs ldan/ /zhal gcig ⑦phyag brgyad zla tshes brgyan ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yas kyi ⑧dang po rtse gsum/ /gnyis pa na ni thugs rje'i lcags kyu//gsum pa ⑨rdo rjes bdud kyi dpung ⑩'joms/ /bzhi pa ⑪shes rab ral gri bsnams ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yon gyi dang po nor bu⑫/ /longs spyod spel phyir thugs kar bsnams nas / / 'gro ba kun la bkra shis ster ma/ /8gnyis pa lcags kyu gsum pa dbyu skegu/ /bzhi pa ⑫nor gyi bum pa bsnams ⑩ma/ /phyag 'tshal smin par byed pa'i sgol ma/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus su—/ /nyi ma pad+ma dmar po'i ⑫gdan la/ /bzhengs pa'i 'dor stabs ⑪g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum/ /phyag 'tshal sku mchog dushin tu mi bzad⑥/ /pad+ma rā tsog lta bur dmar zhing / /dpa' ba'i cha byad zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ /drag mo chen po dgra dpung 'joms ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yas kyi dang po ral gri/ / gnyis pa mda' yis nyon mongs 'bigs ma/ /g.yon pa ⑫'khor lo gnyis pa ④gzhu thogs/ /mchu dang smin ma khro gnyer tsogyen bzlog /phyag 'tshal khro gnyer g.yo ba'i sgol ma/ / nyi ma pad+ma dmar po'i ⑩gdan la/ /g.yas brkyang 14—951

gar gyis mi ro mnan nas①/ /sku mdog nag mo 'jigs gzugs ldan mkhru/ /phyag 'tshal zhal dang smin ma rab bsdus②/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khro gnyer dang ldan/ /dmar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig rab bgrad④/ /mi yi rgyu ma zhal du gsol ma/ /phyag 'tshal sbrul dang stag gi gos gso'agyu/ /thod pa'i cod pan rjomago bo'i do shal/ /ral gri dbyu gu lcags kyu bsnams nas⑦/ /g.yon pa mgo thod ⑧zhags pa 'dzin ma⑨/ /phyag 'tshal dge legs zhi ba'i sgol ma/ /pad+ma dkar po ⑩zla ba'i gdan la/ /rdo rje'i ⑪skyil/ krung zla ba'i ⑫mdog can/ /zhal gcig phyag drug sdig pa 'joms ma/ /phyag 'tshal don rtogs ⑫g.yas kyi dang po/ /rgyal ba'i spyod yul thugs kar phreng 'dzin/ /gnyis pa na ni legs pa'i phyag rgya④/ /gsum pa'i phyag gis dbyu ⑫gu 'dzin ma//phyag 'tshal g.yon gyi dang po pad+ma/ /gnyis pa na ⑫ni ril ba spyi blugs⑩/ /gsum pa 'dab rgyas ut+pal steng du⑫/ /'gro ba'i lam ston po ti bsnams ma/ /phyag 'tshal chags pa 'joms pa'i ⑪sgol ma/ /pad+ma dmar po dunyi ma'i gdan la//spros med sems dpa'i skyil krung mdzes brjid⑥/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum byi ⑪ru'i mdog can/ /phyag 'tshal hūṃ gi rig ⑫pa dang ldan/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa'i phyag gnyis/ /g.yas pas cirtse gsum thugs karatsobasnams nas/ /dgra yi ⑩lus la rab tu bsnun ⑦ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yon pas sdigs tsomadzub rab 'phyar/ /snying po 'bras bur bcas pa'i ⑥shing 'dzin/ /thugs kyi snying po yi ge bcu pas/ /dgos pa'i dngos grub ma lus ⑩'byung ma/ /phyag 'tshal bde ba sgrub pa'i sgol ma/ /pad+ma dkar po 'bar ba'i steng du⑪/ / zla ba'i bladakyil 'khor nyi ma'i ⑫gdan la/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dpa' bar bzhugs 14—952

ma—/ /phyag 'tshal bde ba'i sku mdog dmar ser/ /zhal gcig ①phyag gnyis hūṃ gi phrin ②las/ /'jig rten gsum ⑦po dbang du bsdus nas/ /bde ba thams cad grubatsopar mdzad ma/ /phyag 'tshal thogs med nam mkha'i lus can/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar ⑤'dzin pa'i phyag rgya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu bsnams nasarjo/ /rin chen du ma'i rgyan gyis mdzes ma/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrol ma/ /pad+ma dkar po'i steng gi zla ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor dbus na 'dab bzangs ⑦ngang pa'i/ /steng du sems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs ma / /phyag 'tshal zag med bde chen rab rgyas/ /sku mdog dkar mo dung gi mdangs ldan⑧/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi tā ra ⑨gnyis brjod/ / yi ge phaṭa kyis ⑩dug rnams sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal dga' ba'i phyag rgya dang ldan/ / phyag gnyis ⑪spyi bor lcags kyu rab 'dzin/ /g.yas 'og mchog sbyin g.yon kyi gnyis pa / /ut+pal steng du po ti bsnams ma/ /phyag 'tshal sdug bsngal sreg ⑫byed sgol ma/ /pad dkar zla ba'i ⑫dkyil 'khor dbus ⑫na/ /bde ba'i stan la ⑫sems dpa'i skyil krung / /cung zad g.yas brkyang bar ni ⑩bzhugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal dkar mo dung gi ⑩mdangs ldan/ /sna tshogs dkar dmar 'od zer phreng bas/ /'gying bag sku la rab tu brgyan nas/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs ma lus spyosel ma/ /phyag 'tshal bden gnyis dag pa'i ⑪phyag rgya/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar me thab ⑩bsnams nas/ /sdug bsngal ma lus bsreg ⑥par mdzad cing / /'gro rnams thar pa'i lam la 'god mablu/ /phyag 'tshal dngos grub 'byung ba'i ⑫sgol ma/ /sku mdog dmar ser las kyi rigs ④mtshon/ /pad+ma dkar po steng gi ⑫zla ba'i/ / dkyil na phyusems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs ma/ /14—953

phyag 'tshal dpal ①mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel ①pa'i phyag rgya/ /thugs kar sdegaser gyi bum pa bsnams marjo/ /dngos grub ma lus par ⑤ni ster ma/ /phyag 'tshal bum pa bzang dang nor bu/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam shing chen/ /spyod zhabs dran pas 'dod dgu du'abyung 'gyur/ /gang la ci 'dod re ba skong ⑦ma/ /phyag 'tshal yongs su rdzogs byed sgrol ma/ /ha ⑧las skyes pa'i khyu mchog steng dusti/ /pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gdan la/ /phyed byed rol pa'i 'dug stangs mdzes brjid⑩/ /phyag 'tshal dkar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum ⑪gzigs ma/ /zhe sdang ma spangs gnas su dag phyir/ / dur khrod ⑫stag gi sham thabs bcings ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yas pas ⑫mu tig phreng 'dzin/ /thugs rje mi bzad ⑫rab tu khros pas⑫/ / g.yon pa'i phyag ⑩na rtse gsum mdung thogs/ /dug gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu ⑩la bsnun ma/ /zla ba yar ngo'i tshes brgyad dag la/ /gang gis rnam dag gtsug gi ⑫nor bu/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po gus pa'i ⑪blo yis/ /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod na/ /rgyal po sbrul dang srin po mi rgod/ /me dang chu dang stag dang seng ge/ /'jigs pa chen po brgyad las grol ⑫'gyur/ / mu ge ⑪nad dang 'byung pos 'tshe ba/ /sdug bsngal yid mi bde las grol 'gyur/ /sdog pa chen po rnams dang skal ngan//'khrug dang 'thab rtsod nyes pa mi 'byung / /nyon mongs mya ngan gdung ba rnams sel—/ /sa 'og gter dang mig sman ri lu/ /rkang mgyogs la sogs dngos grub brgyad thob/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi dbang phyug /rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas la sogs pa'i/ /dbang phyug las la dka' ba ma yin/ /bdag 14—954

por byed dang dga' mgur bsgrub pa'i①/ /'dod dgu 'byung ba'i dngos grub 'grub ②pa/ /de bzhin yon tan brgyad kyang thob 'gyur/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing dang / /dpal ldan 'dod 'jo'i ba dang bum mchog /bde ba dang bcas nor rnams 'grub ①'gyur/ /mtshan mo rgyu dang lto 'phye 'byung po/ /sha za'i tshogs kyis glags rnyed mi 'gyur/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug don po/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bdag po rnams kyis/ /dgos dupa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzad ⑤cing / /bar du gcod pa rnams ni sel 'ashar / /rjogang du tshe yi 'du byed btang dus/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du skye 'gyur/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas ⑦rje btsun sgrol ma'i④/ /lha mchog rnams la bdag gis bstod pas/ /dge ba dri med zla ba rgyas 'dra'i⑨/ /'od ltar dkar ba thob pa des ⑩ni/ /'jig rten rtsod ⑪pa'i skyon bral rdzogs pa'i⑫//sangs rgyas thob nas sems can rnams la/ /bde chen char pa 'bebs par shog cig /sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u ⑫bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa④/rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi nang nas/ lha'i rnam grangs bstan pa'i le'u bcu gsum pa/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas gsungs pa dang mthun par/lha mo sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la skebastod ⑩pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba⑩/sgob dpon chen po srur+ya gup+ta'i zhabs kyis spyomadzad pa rdzogs so// // rgya gar gyi mkhan po dri paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges mtho lding gser gyi lha khang du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la 'didab— byed14—955

〉zo/⑩〈'ar 〉〉lta/ ⑪〈'a ra 〉〉gal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ba'i gzugs can/ / ⑫〈'a ra 〉stab ges mtshar pag /phyag mtshan skad dkyil me tog gis rgyan/ /mdzes ma g.yas rkyang zhabs la g.yon pas/ ⑫〈'a ra 〉〉ngab 'khril/④〈〈snar 〉〉〈la gcig phyag gnyis zhi ba'i gzugs can// ⑫〈'ar 〉phosag g.yon/ ⑩〈'a ra 〉〉sden/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉zo mi'i/ ske〈'ar 〉d+kung / ⑪〈〈be+e 〉7phyag 'tshal 'khor lo bsgyur zhing 'dod pa/ /thams cad rab tu ster ba'i sgrol ma/ /yi ges las khrungs pa'i lha mo/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa yi gzugs can/ /sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar/ /pad+ma dmar dang zla ba'i gdan la/ /rin chen la sogs rgyan gyis brgyan te/ /zhabs gnyis bgrad pa'i gyad kyis bzhugs ma/ /thabs dang shes rab mi 'bral phyag gnyis/ /dang pos rdo rje 14byed956

dril bu bsnams te/ /rab tu 'ga' bas spyi bor bsgo ma/ /g.yas 'og gar gyi phyag rgya dang ldan/ /g.yon gyi gnyis pa skesha ka dze+e /yal ga 'bras bur bcas pa bzung nas/ /'gro ba kun gyi rin chen char rgyun/ /mchog sbyin phyag gis rab tu 'be+eb ma/ /las kun bsgrub phyir rta mchog dbu rgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang ni nyid ma/ / 〈'a ra 〉ra phyag 'tshal 'khor lo bsgyur — g.yon gyi gnyis pa a sho ka ④〈〈snar 〉〉rgyar khro/ ⑩〈'ar 〉ra/ ④〈'ar 〉tshod/ ⑩〈'dir 〉m+wa bas/ ⑩〈'ar 〉stusmog ni g.yon/⑩〈'dir 〉〉〉na/ 8〈〈pe 〉stagos/ ⑩〈'dir 〉〉4sa/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉pa grol 〈po ra 〉〉pas thar/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉〉sbrul dang /955 ①〈〈snar 〉zoragur sgrug pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉dam/ ②〈po ra 〉〉pyob/ ④〈〈snar 〉7)/ 'dod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉grub par mdzad/ 〈'ar 〉thasgrub par byed/ 0〈'ar 〉sngalachog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur zhing / /⑦〈'ar 〉ras/ ⑧〈'dir 〉stab/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉toradra ba/ ⑩〈'dir 〉〉do/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉thartsod/ ⑩〈zhar 〉〉dang bral nas/ /myur bar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob ste/ /sems can ma lus pa ni kun la/ / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉'byung ba'i le'u lnga brgya/ 〈snar 〉ho/nga ba'i rgyud le'u lnga brgya/ ④〈'dir 〉〉pas/ ⑩〈'dir 〉〉walha'i rnam grangs brtan pa'i le'u — nyi shu rtsa gcig la/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉btus/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉〉sa chen po la gnas pa'i/⑫〈〈snar 〉〉nyi ma sbas pa'i zhal snga nas/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wargya gar gyi mkhan po — nus te gtan la phab/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (518)14wa 958

༄ga /phreng ba 'dzin pa'i bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ srasnya ra sto tra/ bod skad du/ phreng ba 'dzin pa'i bstod pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i snang ba ltar dmar lha mchog rnams kyi mgo yi gtsug gi nor bu'i dpal/ /phun sum tshogs pas dmar ba smug rtsi gsal po dngar bkod shin tu yun rings ma lon 'dra'i/ /'phags ma khyod zhabs dag la thal sbyar cod pan gyis mnan yan lag mchog btud ②bdag gis ni/ /gus pas sgrol ma phongs skyabs bstod pa gser gyi me tog phreng ba rnams kyis mchod par bgyi①/ /skad ngan ngu ba'i bzhin ldan rgal bar dka' ba'i sdug bsngal me la lus dag rnam thong ba/ /ci dang ci bya zhes rmongs lan gcig rjomin pa'i rtsom pa byas kyang 'bras dang bral bas skyo/ /mkha' la nyi zla'i dpal ni gzhan las mang du thos nas blta bar ⑤re ba bcas gyur pa'i/ /mig nyams gzhan gyi 'gro ba lta bu rjobadag ni sdig 14byed959

'joms khyed la gus pas rten ①par bgyid/ /khyed kyi thugs rje sems can rnams ni ②kun la bye brag med par 'jug pa ma lags sam/ /de dag gzung 1bas bdag 'dra yang ni de dag nang du gzung dhibar 'gyur la gdon mi za/ /mtha' dag 'gro ba'i sdig pa'i mun par tsha zer can gzugs nus pa la yang ⑤do zla med/ /de lta mod kyi kye ma bdag smad nyes byas ngan pas brjid cing sdug bsngal ldan pa nyid/ /skal ba zhan pa bdag smad smad pa zhig ste nyin byed bu'od zer gyis kyang mun pa ⑦sel/ /gangs can las byung 'jug ngogs chus dkrigs pa yi ④dum bu 'khyags shing bsil ba dag tu bsgom⑨/ /rin chen gling gi lam srang dang ni nor bu'i phug yangs khang pa dag gi nang du dbul/ /'jig rten kun gyi yum gcig ma khyod mgon du byas kyang mgon ma mchis so bcom ldan ma/ /nu ma'i rgyu las lan mang dag tu rnam par ngu ba'i bu la ma yang skyo bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma so sor dam pa ma yin don gnyer rnams la rab bskul pha yang khro ba 'dzin/ /'jig rten gyi ni ⑩re 'dod 'bras bus yangs ldan dpag bsam shing chen 'khri shing mchog ni khrod/ /mngon par don gnyer don rnams kun la stsol gyi nam yang rnam ⑪gyur de dag ci yang med/ /gang la nyon mongs tshogs kyi ⑫me 'bar lus can de dang de yis ⑫sgrol ma nga nyid cis⑫/ /bdag nyid zhal bzhes dam bcas sdug bsngal 'og tu bying ba bdag la 'bras bu ldan par mdzod/ /srog chags rnams kyi sdug bsngal shugs ni rtsub cing zil gnon 'di dag ji snyid 'phel gyur pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas theg par smon lam blo mnga' ⑫rnams kyi brtse ba'ang de snyed nyid/ /de ltar bstod pa'i tshig gi zol gyis cho nge'i sgra dag gsang mthon ⑩sgrogs shing ⑩lag bsgreng la/ /14—960

gzhan dag gis kyang btang snyoms bya bar 'os pa min na yum gcig khyod kyis lta yang ci/ /gzhan dag rnams kyis ①mngon 'dod 'byor par ②'dod pa khyed las thob pa rnams mthong bzhin/ /mi dge las byung nang gi gdung ba rgyun chags bzod blag ⑦med pas shin tu yang yang sreg /gal te kho bo sdig can lags na khyed la gus pa chen po 'di ni ci phyir 'phel/ /khyod nyid gcig pu'i mtshan gyis kyang ni thos dang dran pas 'phral la sdig pa sel bar byed/ /de lta na yang bdag gi bya ba'i khur dag dong rjob ji ltar lags zhes bden gsungs pa//nad pa 'chi bar 'gyur yang sman pa'i snying rje rgya chen phan pa khon ⑤par bgyid dam cirjo/ /sgyu mang ⑦ser sna nga rgyal phrag dog rang skyon tha chad rnams kyis dus mnyam rim par yang / /du ma dag gi thun mong char gyur tshogs khang rnga mo bzhin du bskor bar gyur pas na/ /khyed kyi zhabs pad mchod pa skad cig tsam yang ma rnyed gang de'i don du khyad par las/ /phongs pas yi ge dman par tshig 'di bkod do bdag gi 'dod pa don med ma gyur cig /dus mtha'i rlung rab 'khrugs pas dkrugs pa'i chu ni g.yo zhing 'gul ba'i rlung 'khor ral pa can/ /rab 'khrugs kun du ⑧bskyod cing rba rlabs ngos brdabs sgra grag gad rgyangs ⑨chen po sgogs pa las/ /gru chag chu ru snying rje ngu ba'i cho nge dang ldan g.yo ba med cing zhan gyur pa/ /lha mo khyed la bstod pa rnams kyis 'phral la chu gter 'gram du rang dga' thar bar 'gyur/ /du ba 'tshubs ⑩pa sprin 'dra khong ⑪nas rab byung me stag mkha' ⑫khyim nang du rnam par rgyu/ / me dpung me lce ⑫'phro zhing rab 'bar drag po'i byakhang par mal stan dag la rab ⑫'khod pa/ /thal sbyar cod pan ldan pas khyed la btud byas ldab ldib dag tu gsol ba 'debs pa 14byed961

rnams—/ /glog rab 'gyu ba'i rtse ①dga' rab 'bar chu 'dzin shugs kyis khruskad cig nyid la sgrib par byed/ /myos pa'i chu rgyas 'gram pa gnyis ka'i ngos la babs pas bung ba dag gi phreng ba can/ /hūṃ zhes bya bas bos par gyur pa'i gling ①chen zla bos zhe sdang me sbar gnyis 'thung gi/ /so rtse rab tu mtho ba'i khyogs la blangs pa'i lus can dag gis khyod rjes dran pa na/ /rtse mo che ldan mgo rtse'i rdzong la 'dug cing rab tu dga' bas 'chi bdag phyir zlog byed/ /mdung rjorings drag pos bsnun bsad ⑤mi yi mgo dang gsal shing dag gi 'khri bushing dga' ston can/ /nags tshal stong par chos rkun lag rtses ⑦ral gri g.yo zhing brdeg par gzas ⑧pas dregs rgyas pa/ /khro gnyer dang bcas thin 'khyog ⑨zur mig gis bltas mig can rnams ni khyed mtshan dpal kyi gzhi/ /gsal bar 'dri ba'i gnas la bsam pa'i sgyu gu skyo ⑩med rnams kyis bran du bkol ⑪ bar byed/ /rab rno sder mo'i rtse ni rdo rje lta bur bsnun pas glang chen myos pa'i klad 'gems nas/ /khrag mang rab tu zags pas bkrus pa'i ral pa gsal po 'jigs rung ya ngas phrag pa khebs/ /khros te rgyang nas steng du 'phyong ⑫'dod mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa'i kha can ri dwags dgra/ /khyod la 'os pa'i bstod pa don ldan tshig dag bkod pas skrag ste log nas 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gdengs can rnam 'gyur du ba'i khyem ⑫dang mun pa'i dbyibs can gsal bar phud sgra dag gi tshogs/ /byed pa dang ldan kha gdangs ④ro 'dzin thag pa gshin rje'i zhags 'dra che zhing g.yo ba dag /sdig pa las byung slar yang khyod skyong bdag nyid khyod kyi yon tan bgrang bar skelhur len pas/ /ut+pal phreng ba'i rgyan gyis 'byor pa bung ba myos pa'i phreng bas dkris ltar 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rje bo'i 14—962

smin ma bskyod pas 'jigs pa dag gis rgod cing 'phyag pas ①drangs la co do gzings / /g.yo zhing sgra sgrogs bran khol rnams kyis rtsub mor smra byed zhags pa'i mdud pa dam pos bcings/ /bkres skom dag gis kha dang mgrin skams gang zhig 'phags ma sgol ma'i zhabs la skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni byams pa'i gnyen kyis spangs ②kyang mtha' med rgud pa de dag 'phral du gtong bar 'gyur/ /sgyu ma 'phrul pa'i lam gyi ①rim pas rnam par 'gyur ba du ma dag gis ④chas byas shing / /log pa'i gzugs tsam rjes su 'byed pa'i mtshon cha'i 'od zer tshogs ni rab tu mi bzad ldan/ /mi ro las bton rgyu ma'i thag pa'i thag pa'i ⑤tshogs kyi phreng pas rnam par spras pa'i srin po rnams/ /dzad rgyud las btus gsang sngags dran pas snyig pa phrogs pa'i srung ma gzhom rjomed byed par 'gyur/ /glang chen sgra sgrogs char sprin las can myos byed chu bo'i rgyun dang ldan pas mun gtibs shing / /mtshon cha 'od zer rnams ni glog rab 'gyu ltar rab gsal mda' yi char 'bab g.yul ngo 'gyed pa'i tshe/ /rnam par snang ba'i dgra bo dpung pa'i stobs ni rab mchog ldan pa rnams kyis bkag gyur pa/ /byed kyi ⑦dgra bo gsod pa'i dpa' bo gcig gis 'phral du dgra yi sa gzhi phye mar zlog /sdig spyod dag gi rjes 'brang dze+ephol mig tshabs can dag las rnag khrag rul pa rab 'dzag cing / /sha lngags myags pa la chags rtsa yi ⑨sgo yi bu gar 'gul ba'i srog chags kyis bzos lus zad rnams/ /byed zhabs nye bar brten pa'i sman mchog ri lu ⑩gus shing chags pa yis/ /sa le sbram dang mtshungs pa'i lus dang pad+ma ⑪dkar po ltar yangs mig dang ldan par 'gyur/ /gang gi rna ba'i snod na bla ma rnams kyis gnang ba'i man ngag slong ⑫mo mi gnas shing / /thos 14—963

pa'i nor dang bral bas mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams dag tu lkugs pa nyid du khas len gang / /de yang khyed la gus pa'i nus pas rgyan rnams thams cad mdzes byed 'byor par bcas pa yis①/ /ngag gi dbang phyug thob nas mi bdag mdun ④sar rgol ba'i seng ge'i khri dag 'phrog par byed/ /sa gzhi mal stan rdul gyis ④lus bsgos skyed ngos ras ral yan lag dag ni rnam par mngon/ /shig gi ④tshe dag rab gtser gzhan gyi ⑤grong khyer mdun du gyo mor zas ni don gnyer ba/ /khyod mnyes rjobagyid la brtson pas na chung mchog gis bzung ba'i rnga yab 'dzum ⑦gyis rab mdzes shing / /stsos pas long ba'i gnyis 'thung ⑧sos gtams gdugs gcig gyen du bteg khyapa'i sa gzhi 'dzin par 'gyur/ /g.yog dang las mtha' bzo dang dbang po gso ba'i thabs kyi rnam grangs dag gis rab skyo zhing / /skye ba snga mar rab bsgrubs bsod nams bsags pa'i dge 'bras nor ni thob par ma gyur pa'i/ /nor med rnams kyis skye bo bkres ⑩pa'i yum gyur phongs las 'da' bar mdzad pa khyod la ⑪don/ /don du gnyer na slar yang gser gyi tshogs kyi gter dag sa las 'thon pa thob par 'gyur/ /'tsho ba chad las ngo tshar ⑫gyur cing gos zad chung ma dag gis rab tu spyo bar ⑫ byed—/ /bdag nyid gso phyir rang gi skye bo bu dang grogs po gnyen gyis ring du spangs pa yis/ /khyed la rang gi sdug bsngal zhus pas rang gi khyim thab bud med gdu bu'i sil sil sgras/ /gnyid log sad par 'gyur zhing rta rmig rtse mos mtshalas brkos ④khang khyim rnams kyi bdag po byed/ /'khor lo phyogs kyi 'khor lo la sbyor bud med mtshan brgyan 'od zer ⑫g.yo zhing che ba dang / /glang chen gtso bo mche ba drug ldan rta mchog spu kha ⑩sngo bsangs ⑩rma bya'i mgrin ltar 'tsher/ /14—964

nor bu nyi ma'i 'od zer ltar gsal dri med yon tan mdzod 'dzin mdzod khengs dang / /dmag dpon dpal sde ldan par bcom ldan 'das ma khyod kyi bka' drin cha shas phra las 'gyur/ /tsan+dan chu yis dri zhim nor bu'i rdo la mdzes mas dus btab rtse dga' la chags pas/ /sdu gu ma yi bde ba'i nyer spyad mgron du bya ba mngon par gsang ①ba rab bsgrubs shing / /ral gri 'od zer gyis sngo spom mtho dpung pa gtun shing dang 'dra dpung rgyan rol pa can/ /khyod kyi rigs drug rig 'dzin dbang po ma la ya yi me tog tshal du rang dgar 'gro/ /nu ma'i thon 'khor do shal gyis brgyan mig dkyus ring po rna ba'i ut+pal la 'gran cing / /lha mo yid 'ong man+da ②ra ba dang ldan ze 'khru gsar pa'i dris myos bung ba can/ /dril chung sgra yis rjes 'brel rab tu gsal bar rkang gdub ④yid 'ong sgra snyan sgogs par byed/ /'dod pas myos dga' gzhon nu ma rnams gus dang bcas par dzad mgon ldan pa don du gnyer/ /rdzing bu'i nang logs rin po ches spras gser gyi pad ldan ze'u ④'bru rdo rje phreng ba can/ /yongs 'du'i ljon pa las 'phro dri bzang ⑤dang ldan me tog rdul gyi bla re rjomathor byes te/ /pi wang gling bu sgogs mkhas lha yi grong gi dga' ba ⑦rnams kyis snyan par rab bsgrags pa'i/ /dga' ba'i skyed tshal bgrod pa khrod la mchod pa bgyid pas yun ring ⑧nyams su spyong bar 'gyur/ /nang gi byed pa khyod la gtad pa'i bsod nams mthu ni rab 'bar yongs su smin pa yis/ /ga pur e la li shi shun pa a ka ru dang na la da phye'i dri ldan chu/ /'dod pa'i dregs pas rab 'bur bud med nu ma'i skyibs su rba rlabs 'khyil gnas dal 'bab pa/ /sman min chu yi ⑨zer ma dang ldan chu rtsed ⑩mdzes ma dag dang lhan cig rtse bar 'gyur/ /tshig mtha'i gtso bo dul 14—965

ba'i khur gyis cod pan dud pa rnams kyis bka' la phyag byas shing / /mtho ris steng du lha yis ①glang chen khrol ②khrol rgyan gyis srud pa'i lus can la zhon te/ /spu lang rab rgyas lus can bde sogs lag pa'i thag pa khyogs kyis rgyun du bsgyil bhugyur pa/ /khyed rjokyi spyan ras phog pas dag byas lag pa rdo rje ldan pa'i ⑤lhas skyong byed/ /gtsug gi rin chen rgyan gyis mnan bzhugs bde bar gshegs pa nam mkha'i dpal 'byor bla re rjocan/ /nyi ma 'char ka bye ba lta bur rab gsal 'od zer rgyas pas 'jig rten gsum 'gengs shing / /brtan par g.yas brkyang zhabs gcig gis mnan khur gyis tshangs dbang drag po khyab 'jug rnams 'dud ⑦pa'iske/ /khyed sku bsgoms pa skye ba la brten rnams kyis srid pa'i 'jigs pa gcod pa'i slad du 'gyur/ /khro bo dang bcas mtshon cha'i 'od zer rab 'bar phyag dbyig ⑧cha yis nam mkha'i khongs ⑨dag khyab/ /gdu bu'i gdengs can dag gi ⑩gdengs ka mi bzad ⑪mi 'phrogs spyod ldan sdang rnams skrag mdzad bzhad—/ /cang te'u drag po tshabs cher brdungs pa'i ⑫tshe na ro langs rnams ni drag por pheg ⑫rdob cing / /bag med rgyas ④pas ca co chen po sgogs par byed pa'i drag mor la la dag gis mthong / /la las ba spu re re las byung nam mkha'i khyen gnas sa dang sa 'og dag na gnas/ /mtho ris la gnas tshangs dbang drag po la sogs mi dang lha dang grub pa'i ⑫dri za klu/ /phyogs tshogs khyab pa'i 'od zer la bzhugs bde gshegs brgya phrag sprul pa mtha' yas dag gi sku/ /ngo mtshar 'jig rten gsum gyi phyag 'os brtan g.yo bkod pa'i dngos po ma lus ngo bor ro/ /la las rgya skyegs li khri'i tshon dang nyi zhon dmar ba nyid ltar shin tu dmar ba dang / /de bzhin gzhan gyis snum zhing 'od ldan mthon mthing rdo 14byed966

bcag ①btags pa'i phye ma ltar sngo dang / /la las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i 'od ltar ches lhag dkar dang gser 'od lta bu ste/ /khyed sku sna tshogs ngo bo ②nye bar bzhag ①pa dang 'brel dbye bas tha dad shel bzhin no/ /kun mkhyen ye shes sgon mas shes bya mtha' dag gsal byas de nyid dag gi dbang gcig pu/ /kun rig nyid dam de yi sras kyis khyod kyi yon tan tshogs kyi grangs ni mngon sum mkhyen—/ /bdag 'dra gtor ma spyod pa sgrogs pa lta bur kha gdangs ku co che bar 'don pa gang / /de ni mi bzad sdug bsngal gdung bas nad bskyed sems kyi rgud pa bzhad rjogad dag gi rgyu/ /bdag gis ⑤zhu ba gang lags de ni nang gi dudang por khyed kyis khyad par du mkhyen te/ /'on kyang lhag par de brjod ngal ba'i sgrub byed mi mkhas bdag ⑦rang sems tshim pa yi rgyu/ /don shes zin yang gnyen ske'adun byams pa'i mdun du sdug bsngal ldan pas tshig gis sdug bsngal ni/ /dug bzhin skyugs par gyur na snying yang seng zhes byed cing rnam par gnas par tshor ba bzhin/ /dge legs kun dga'i rgya mtshor zla ba'i cha shas gsal po bsil ba'i gzigs par stsal du gsol/ /ye shes nyer bstan dag gis rgyas par mdzod cig thugs rjes sdig ldan nang gi mun pa sel/ /gang phyir 'gro ba dag na khyed bstod chu yis yid ni dag par byas pa kho bo la/ /skye dgu rnams kyi dge legs gnas ni don yod khyod kyi yon tan bstod tsam gcig pu mthong / /khyod kyi yon tan tshogs kyi cha tsam bstod nas ⑨bdag gis 'di tsam zhes par ma nges pa'i/ /bsod nams bkra shis 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ro myang 'gro ⑩ba'i bar du spyad bya ba/ /gang thob de yis 'jig rten 'di ni 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs mthil bkra shis kyi/ /bde legs 14—967

ra /rgya gar skad du/ srasnya ra sto ②tram̐/ bod skad du/ me tog phreng 'dzin gyi bstod pa/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phongs skyabs 'phags ma sgol ma khyed zhabs lha tshogs ④rnams kyi mgo bo'i gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i snang ba lta bur dmar ba'i phun sum tshogs pa phog pas dmar ba ni/ /sgrug rtsi dmar ba gsal po bkod nas shin tu yun ring ma lon pa dang 'dra dag la/ /mgo btud spyi bor thal sbyar bkod pa bdag gis bstod gsar me tog phreng bas gus mchod bgyi/ /rgal ④bar dka' ba'i sdug bsngal me nang lus lhung skal ⑤ngan phyogs gang zhig la brten snyam pa/ /blun zhing ci ci bkyi snyam lan cig ma lags rtsom bgyi don ma mchis pas dub pa bdag /mig nyams gzhan gyi 'gros kyis 'gro ba snang ba re bar bcas pas nam mkha'i nyi zla yi/ /'od ltar gzhan dag rnams las khums rjote sdig pa 'joms 14—970

par mdzad pa khyod la brten par bgyid/ /khyod kyi thugs rjes ①nges par sems can lam rnams kun la bye brag med par rab bzhugs shing / /de dag bzung bas bdag 'dra'ang de dag rnams kyi nang du gdon mi 'tshal bar bzung ②'gyur ba/ /nus mthu 'gro ba mtha' dag sdig mun nyi ma'i gzugs la'ang do zla mchis pa ma lags mod/ /de lta ③na yang kho bo sdug pa kye ma'o nyes byas ngan mkhas ngan pa rab tu brjid/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis kyang mun pa rab tu mi bsal ④ri bo gangs can klung ngogs kyi/ /shang shong kha ba'i rum grugs dkrigs pas bsil bar dbyar skam ⑤rin chen gling gi tshong khang gi/ /nor bu'i phug yangs khang pa'i nang na dbul zhing 'jig rten kun gyi yum gcig bcom ldan 'das/ /khyod kyis mgon du bgyis kyang mgon ma mchis pas skal nyams bdag ni smad cing smad pa'i gnas/ /ma yang nu ma'i ched rjodu rnam pa mang du ngu ba'i bu la skyo bar 'gyur ba lags/ /nyi ma re re dam pa ma yin don du gnyer la bskos pa'i pha yang khro sel na/ /khrod ni 'jig rten gsum 'dod 'bras bu yangs pa dpag bsam ljon shing yal ga mchog chen te/ /kun la mngon par 'dod don stsol yang khrod la nam yang rnam 'gyur 'ga' yang yod mi mnga'| /gang dang gang zhig sdug bsngal tshogs mes lus bsregs de dang de ni nga yis bsgral lo zhes/ /nyid kyi dam bca' zhal bzhes sdug bsngal sa 'og bying ba bdag la 'bras bu bcas par mdzod/ /ji srid srog chags rnams kyis ⑦zil gnon rtsub ldan sdug bsngal shugs de 'phel ba de srid du/ /yang dag sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas theg pa'i ⑧smon lam blo mnga' rnams la rjes brtse mnga' ba lags—/ /yum gcig de ltar lag bsgreng bstod pa'i tshig zol cho nge'i nga ro 14—971
