dpangs ①mthor 'don pa la/ /gzhan gyis kyang ni btang snyoms bya bar 'os pa min na khyed ②'dras lta zhig blos ci 'tshal/ /khyed las gzhan dag rnams kyis mngon 'dod 'byor pa don gnyer 'dod pa rnyed pa ma khums na/ /nang gi gdung ba rgyun chags mi dga'i sa gzhi sran du med pas shin tu yang yang bsregakhru/gal te kho bo sdig can lags na kho bo'i khrod gus chen po 'di dag ci phyir 'phel//bden gsung mtshan tsam khums shing dran pa yis kyang khyod gcig kho nas nan kyis sprug sel ba/ /de yi phyir na khyod kyi rjokho bo'i bgyi ba'i khur bu bor ba ji ltar lags pa gsungs/ /nad pa 'chi bar 'gyur na'ang sman pa snying rje rgya chen sman 'phro ⑤gcod par bkyid dam ci/ /gang gi phyir na 'gron gnas rnga mo cha shas du ma'i thun mong ba ltar rgyu dang ni/ /ser sna nga rgyal la sogs rang skyon tha chad rnams kyis rim dang dus gcig bskul bas na/ /nyin gcig ༷zhabs kyi pad+ma mchod pa skad cig tsam yang ma rnyed de phyir khyad par du/ /bkren zhing phongs pa'i tshig dang yi ger ⑦bkod 'dis bdag la 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /lha mo gru chag chur byeng snying rje dang bcas ngu ba'i cho nge g.yo med zhan pa rnams/ /khyod la mngon bstod lhur blangs pa yis 'phral du rgya mtsho dus mtha'i rlung gyen 'tshubs pa'i ⑧chu/ /gtsubs pa'i chu rlabs g.yo zhing 'gul ba'i stirol pas dkrugs pas bteg pa'i rba rlabs 'gram ngogs la/ /brdabs pa'i sgra grag ⑩gad rgyangs can gyi pha rol 'gram du rang dga'i ⑪nyams kyis rgal ⑫ bar 'gyur/ /du ba 'khyil pa'i sprin nang 'thon zhing nam mkha'i khyim du 'phro ba'i me stag can kyi me/ /me lce 'bar zhing 'phro ba'i shugs kyis nang du zhugs pa'i khyer na mal du nyal ba rnams/ /khyod la rab btud thal mo spyi bor sbyar 14—972

zhing ldab ①ldib gsol ba btab pas skad cig la/ /glog rab 'gyu ba'i sgeg pas dmar por gyur pa'i sprin gyi chu rlabs dag gis khebs par 'gyur/ /'gram pa'i gdu bu myos pa'i chu yis gang ba gnyis ka la brten bung ba'i phreng ba yi/ /dar dir sgra yis bab pa'i ban glang zla bos ②zhe sdang me lce sbar ba'i glang chen gyi/ /mche ba'i rtse mo 'do sdeli mthon po'i steng du lus po gzhag 0pa'ang khyod rjes dran pa yis/ /ri bo mthon po'i zom rtse'i mkhar la 'dug pa bzhin du dga' zhing 'chi bdag phyir zlog bgyid/ /mdung rings bsnun bsad mi yi mgo dang gsal shing ⑤can gyi gtor ma'i ston 'gyed rjo'abrog stong du/ /rkun po'i lag rtses ⑦bzung bas g.yo ba'i phub dang ral gris dregs pa shas cher 'thon 'gyur cing sge /mig ni khro gnyer bcas shing smin 'khyog ⑨zur mig lta dang ldan rnams bran du sgo ⑩byed pa/ /de ni khyod mtshan dpal gzhi bsam pa'i smyu gus skyo ba med cing gsal bar bris pa lags/ /rkang pa'i sbar mo rab rno rdo rje lta bus tshabs cher bsnun pas glang chen myos pa'i glad/ /bskams nas khrag mang zags pas bkrus pa'i ral pa gsal po 'jigs rung ya ngas gnya' khebs shing / /khros te rgyang nas mgo la 'dzin 'dod mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa'i kha can ri dwags dgra/ /khyod kyi 'thad pa'i spyod pa bstod pa'i don tshim ⑪mkhas la skrag ste log nas 'gro ba lags/ /du ba 'khyil 'dra ⑫mun pa'i gzugs can rnam 'gyur gdengs can phus 'debs grags pa'i 'gram dgang bar/ /bya ba'i ched du kha gdangs 'gyur ba'i lce can thag pa dang 'dra gshin rje'i zhags pa dang / /sdig dbang gis ⑫ phrad slar yang khyod kyi yon tan bgrang ba lhur len khyod bdag lhur byed pas/ /bung ba myos pa'i phreng ba'i gdub can ut+pal phreng ba'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa 'chang 14—973

par 'gyur/ /rje bos smin bskyod bskul te bkrabs pa rem zhing rtsub ①pas co to drangs shing gzings gyur pa/ /go khol bskyod pa'i tshig rtsub kyis spyos 'ching ba'i zhags pa rtsub mos nyer bcing bkres pa dang / /skom ②pas mchu dang mgul ba gang zhing sne'aphags ma sgol ma'i zhabs la skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni byams pa'i gnyen gyis spangs kyang ma rungs rgud pa de dag 'phral du spang ④bar 'gyur—/ /srin po sgyu ma sprul pa las tshul gyis byas bden pa ma yin gzugs brtsams cha lugs tshul/ /rnam 'gyur du ma dag dang rjes su 'tshal pa'i mtshon cha'i 'od zer tshogs kyis mi bzad cing / /mi ro brgyus pa'i rgyu ma'i tha gu'i tshogs dag phreng bar ⑤bkod pa rnams kyang khyod rgyus rjolas/ /btus pa'i gsang sngags dran pas sdig bsal bsrung ba pham pa ⑦byed par 'gyur/ /ches chem sgra sgogs char sprin lus can ban glang myos chu'i klung gis rgyun gyi mun gtibs shing / /mtshon cha glog ltar 'gyu ba'i 'od zer dang ldan mda' yi char 'bab g.yul ngo 'gyed pa'i tshe/ /phye mar rlog ⑧par byed cing dpung stobs che ba'i rnam par sdang ba rnams kyis bkag ⑨pa yang / /khyod kyi spros pa ⑩gsol btab dpa' bo gcig gis dgra bo'i sa gzhi nan kyis 'thag par byed/ /sdig spyod rgyun chags las byung phol mig tshabs chen dag las rnag khrag rul pa zags pa yis/ /myags pa'i sha lpags dang 'bral ⑪rtsa sgo'i bu gar srog chags 'gul bas zos pas lus zad rnams/ /khyod ⑫kyi zhabs la brten ⑫pa'i sman mchog ri lu goms par bsten la rab tu dga' ba yis/ /sa le sbram dang 'dra ba'i lus dang ldan zhing pad+ma dkar po ltar yangs mig can 'gyur/ /gang gi rna ba'i snod du bla ma rnams kyis nyer sbyar man ngag gleng ⑫mo ma lhung zhing / /thos pa'i nor 14—974

dang bral bas mkhas pa'i tshogs ①sar lkugs pa nyid du khas len gang yin pa/ /de yang khyod la gus pa'i nus pas rgyan rnams kun gyis ②mdzes pa'i 'byor pa dang bcas pa'i/ /ngag gi dbang phyug thob nas mi bdag mdun sar rgol ba'i seng ge'i khri dag 'phrog par byed/ /sar nyal rdul gyis lus gos skerked ngos mdoms dkris rjoras ral yan lag rnam par mngon 'gyur zhing / /shig gis ⑤tshe dag rab gtser rjogazhan gyi khyim sgor rdza chag dum bur zas dag slong ba yang / /khyod mnyes bgyis pas na chung mchog dal ⑦rnams kyis g.yabs pa'i rnga yab kyis 'dzum mdzes pa'i sa/ /glang chen stsos pa'i chu yis gdong pa'i mche ba gtams shing gdugs gcig gyen du bteg pa 'dzin/ /skye bo bkren pa rnams kyis yum gcig zhabs 'bring dang ni so tshis bzo ⑧yi spyod pa rnams/ /spong ba'i thabs kyis rnam grangs dag gis ngub cing skye ba snga mar nyer blangs bsod nams kyis/ /nyer bsags dge 'bras nor ma thob dang nor bral rnams kyis phya ⑨las 'da' bar mdzad khyod la/ /gsol ba btab pas phyi nas nor bu ⑩sa las gter ni gser tshogs 'byung ba thob par 'gyur/ /'tsho ba chad pas ngo tsha khyim thab gos zad ma yis spyo bar byed cing bdag nyid ni/ /gso bar byed phyir gnyen 'dab bu dang gnyen bshes rnams kyis rgyang rings ⑪spangs par gyur pa yis/ /khyod la rang gi sdug bsngal zhus ⑫pas rang gi khyim thab bud med gdu bu'i sil sil sgras—/ /gnyid log sad par 'gyur zhing rta mig ⑫rtse mos mtshams brkos khang khyim rnams kyi ④bdag po byed/ /gal te khyod kyi ⑫bka' drin cha shas tsam zhig mchis na phyogs tshogs khyab pa'i 'khor lo dang / /bud med mtshan brgyan 'og pag chen po g.yo dang glang chen don po mche ba drug pa dang / /rta mchog sru kha ⑩14—975

sngo bsangs rma bya'i mgrin ltar 'tsher dang yon tan dri med nor bu ni/ /nyi ltar mdangs ldan 'od can khyim bdag mdzod khengs blon po rtul phod dmag ldan 'byung bar 'gyur/ /khyod kyis rig pa'i grub pa thob pas tsan+dan chu yis dri zhim nor bu'i rdo steng du/ /sdu ①gu ma yis dus 'debs sdug pa dang rol rjes su chags pas bde ba'i nyer spyad gsar/ /gus par sbyar zhing lag spom mthon po ral gri'i 'od zer sngon pos dpung rgyan g.yo ba yis②/ /rig 'dzin dbang po rang dgar gyur te mā la ya yi me tog skyed mos tshal du 'go/ /nu ma'i thon ①kor do shal gyis mnan mig dkyus ring pos rna ba'i ut+pal la 'gran cing ④/ /skra bskyil man+da ra bas brgyangs pa'i ⑤ze 'bru sar pa'i dri yis myos pa'i bung ba dang ldan pa'i/ /lha yi bu mo rkang gdub rags pa'i sil snyan 'og pag sgra yi rgyun gyis rjoshin tu dpangs/ /bskyed pa'i ⑦'dod dran dregs dga' khyod mgon ldan pa dag la gus dang bcas pas gsol ba 'debs/ /rdzing bu'i nang logs rin po ches spras gser gyi pad mtsho ze ⑧'bru rdo rje'i tshogs ldan zhing / /yongs 'du'i ljon shing skye zhing me tog ze 'bru dri zhim rdul gyi bla re mthor bres te//lha yi gong khyen rangs ⑨bgyid lha mo pi wang gling bu sgogs pa mkhas pas sil snyan ni—/ /snyan par bsgrags pa'i dga' tshal lha mo khyod la mchod pa bgyid ⑩pas yun rings myong bar 'gyur/ /sems rgyud khrod la gtad pas bsod nams mthu 'bar rnams ni mdzes ma dag dang lhan cig tu/ /ga pur e la li shi shing tsha a ka ru dang spang spos bye ma'i dri chu can/ /glong 'khor rba rlabs ⑪bud med sdu ⑩ gu'i nu ma 'dod pa'i dregs pas 'bur ba'i skyibs 'khyil ba/ /dal 'bab gang gā'i chu la chu rtsed chu ni drag tu 'thor bas rtsed mo byed par 'gyur/ /khyod 14—976

kyi spyan ras mang du phog pas dag pa'i bka' la lha gtso dul ba'i khur bu yis/ /cod pan 'dud pa rnams kyis phyag byas mtho ris steng na lha yi glang chen thal gong ni / /khrol khrol rgyan gyis spud pa la zhon lus kyi ①ba spu shas cher langs pa'i bde sogs kyi/ /lag rings 'do skeli bar med ④babyed cing 'chang rjob rdo rje dang 'brel lha yi yul las skyong / /khyod sku gtsug gi rin chen rgyan gyi ⑤gdan bzhugs bde bar gshegs 'od mkha' khyab bla re can/ /nyi ma shar ka bye ba lta bur ches gsal 'od zer dag gis 'jig rten gsum 'gengs shing / /zhabs gcig g.yas brkyang gom stabs chen po'i brjid la tshangs dbang khyab 'jug drag po rnams 'dud pa/ /bsgoms pas skye ba la brten rnams kyis rjosrid pa'i 'jigs pa rgyun ni gcod par bgyid par 'gyur/ /la la khro ba dang bcas phyag tshogs phyag cha rnams kyi 'od zer dag dang 'brel pa yis/ /nam mkha'i khongs khyab sprul gyi gdu ⑦bu'i gdengs ka dag gis spyod pa mi 'phrogs skemi bzad pa'i/ /sdang rnams skrag mdzad gad mo'i cang te'u drag po brdungs pas brlang ⑨bskyed tshe na ro langs ni/ /thal mo'i sgra chen sgrogs pas babyungs shing bsnyems pa'i rol pa chen po'i ca co drags ⑩par khums/ /la las ba spu'i khung re nas byung nam mkha' khyab pa'i sar gnas sa 'og mtho ris gnas/ /tshangs pa ⑪dbang po la sogs lha dang klu dang dri za mi dang grub pa rnams gnas shing / /phyogs tshogs khyab pa'i 'od zer la bzhugs bde gshegs brgya phrag sprul pa mtha' yas kyis bkra dang / /ngo mtshar khams gsum phyag 'os brtan dang g.yo bar gnas pa'i dngos po ma lus ngo bor khums/ /la las ⑫rgya skyegs li khri'i tshon 'dra nyi ma gzhon nu ches dmar lta bur dmar bar ⑫'khums/ /de bzhin gzhan gyi dpal 14—977

ldan an+da rnyil du btags ①pa'i phye ma 'thul 'drar sngon por khums/ /la las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkrugs dang zho bas ches lhag dkar dang gser 'od ltar khums te / /khyod sku sna tshogs ngo bor shes sdebazhin nye bar gzhag pa dang 'brel dbye bas tha dad 'gyur/ /khyod kyi yon tan tshogs kyi grangs ni kun mkhyen ye shes sgon mes dze+erab tu gsal ba yi/ /shes bya mtha' dag de nyid dbang gcig thams cad mkhyen pa dngos dang de sras kyis mkhyen te/ /bdag 'dra bya rog sgogs rjoltar kha gdangs ku co cher ⑤'don gang lags rjode ni mi bzad pa'i/ /sdug bsngal rims nad dag gis bskyed pa'i nad can sems kyi rgyud la bzhad gad rgyu zhig lags/ /bdag gis ⑦zhu ba gang lags de ni nang gi dang por khyod kyis ⑧khyad par du mkhyen cing / /de bklag brjod pas ⑨ngal ba'i tshul ni mi mkhas rang sems tshim pa'i bye brag lags mod kyi/ /'on kyang sdug ⑩par don shes zin pa'i gnyen 'dun byams pa'i mdun du 'dug bzhin tshig dag gis/ /sdug bsngal phyung ste snying yang seng zhes byed pa ⑪nyid du gyur ⑫nas rnal mar gnas tshor bzhin/ /dge legs kun dga'i rgya mtshor zla ba'i cha shas gsal ma khyod bstod chu yis yid dag par/ /bgyis pa bdag la tshim byed ⑫mthong ba stsol cig ye shes nyer bstan dag gis rgyas par mdzod/ /thugs rje shas ches nang gi mun sol gang phyir khyod kyi ⑫bstod pa tsam zhig kyang / /don yod 'gro ba dag na skye dgu rnams kyi bde legs ⑫gnas ni gcig pu lags par khums/ /khyod kyi yon tan tshogs kyi cha tsam bstod nas bdag gis 'di tsam zhes bya ma nges pa'i—/ /bsod nams bkra shis 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mngar ba ro myang ma grol bar du longs spyad ⑩pa/ /gang thob de yis 'jig rten 'di ni 'phags pa 14—978

༄ga /'phags ma sgol ma'i me tog phreng ba 'dzin pa'i bstod pa/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā ra srasnya ra sto tra/ bod skad du/'phags ma sgol ma'i me tog phreng ba 'dzin pa'i bstod pa/ rje btsun ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khrusngar shar nyi ma snang ba dmar/ /lha mchog spyi gtsug nor bu dmar/ /de 'byar kha dog de la ni/ /tshos sar gyis ni bskus pa 'dra//'phags ma ③khyed kyi zhabs gnyis la/ /gus pa'i thal mo dbu rgyan gyis/ /de mdzes mgo yis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyes byung dus su bskyab pa ma④/ /de ni sgol ma dzad yin no/ /bstod gsar ⑤me tog phreng ba 'dis/ /mchod la bdag gis phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgal rjomi nus pa'i sdug bsngal me/ /de la rtag tu lus lhung gnas/ /skal ba ma ldan 'gro sa gang / /rmongs pa bdag gis ji ltar bya//de ltar rtag du smras nas ni/ /don med bdag ni stobs chung song / /mkha' la nyi zla dpal ldan grags/ /de ni gzhan kyi smra ba thos/ /de thos long ba'i 14—982

spyod pa ltar/ /mthong rten 'dod kyang gzhan khrid med/ /sdig pa 'joms ma spyod la ni/ /bdag ni skyabs mthong 'dod lags so/ /sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i phyir/ /de la snying rje mi mdzad dam/ /ma lus par ni snying rje mdzad—/ /de khongs bdag lta yod gyur na/ /khong la snying rje mdzad pa bzhin//bdag la de bzhin mdzad 'tshal lo/ /nus pa med pas mi mdzad dam/ /spyod bzhin nus la gnyis pa med/ /'gro ba rnams kyi sdig mun pa/ /de 'joms pa la nyi ma 'dra/ /de ltar yin kyang sdug pa bdag /mi dge las ni ma tshig pas—/ /ngan las byas pas bdag ni 'gyod/ /skal ngan bdag la skal ba med / /nyi ma shar yang mun pa gnag /gaṅgā'i chu ni shin tu bsil/ /de phyir 'gram du bsdad kyang ni/ /skom yang btung rgyu ma rnyed do/ /rin chen sna tshogs yod pa'i gling / /nor rnams kyis gang khang pa la/ /der 'dug kyang ni bdag phongs pas/ /bcom ldan 'das ma spyod la ni/ /mgon 'dod kyang ni mgon med bdag /'jig rten kun gyi yum gcig ma/ /ma la rtag tu ngus nas ni/ /nu ①ma'i don du bu slong na/ /de la ma yang skyo bar 'gyur/ /mi rnyed nyin re slong gyur na/ /pha yang bu la khro bar byed/ /'jig rten gsum kyis dze+ebaslangs ①kyang ni/ /khyed kyis ④'bras bu gang bar byas/ /dpag bsam shing gi yal ga mchog /de ni sgrol ma khyed yin no/ /thams cad la ni ma lus pa⑤/ /sbyin pa khyod kyis khyab par byas/ /nyon mongs kun gyi me des ni/ /bdag gi lus 'di rtag tu tshig /sa 'og sdug bsngal de la ni/ /bdag gi lus 'di nub tsam na/ /sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal ni/ /drag po 'phel bar gyur tsam na/ /khrod kyis rjodam bcas zhal bzhes pa/ /bdag gi steng du 14—983

grub par mdzod/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i smon lam ni/ /bdag gi sems la shar ba'i dus/ /sgrol ma phan 'dogs mdzad par zhu/ /lag bsgreng bstod pa'i tshig brjod cing / /don du drag por ngus pa yis①/ /gzhan la zhus kyang don 'grub bo/ /khyed lta bu la bdag gis zhus/ /kye ma sgrol ma khyed kyis ni—/ /bdag spangs par ②ni mi gsha'o/ /khyed kyi spyan gyis gzigs tsam na/ /gang 'dod thams cad rnyed par 'gyur/ /mi bde mi bzod sdug bsngal di/ /yang 'byung dogs ni mi 'byung ngo / /bdag ni sdig can yin gyur na/ /dad pa shin tu 'phel nas ni/ /khyed la dad pa skye mi gsha'/ /ming thos pa'am dran pa yis/ /khyed kyi sdig pa dbang med 'phrog /bdag don khyod kyis ①spangs pa de/ /bden par bdag la gsung bar zhu/ /spyod ni bden par gsung ldan ma/ /snying rje che ba'i sman pa yis/ /nad pa ma shi bar du ni/ /sman gyis phan 'dod che ru byed/ /sgyu ma ser sna nga rgyal sogs/ /ngan pa de rnams kyis khyer nas/ /ri mos khyer bas dal skabs med/ /gnas pa'i spyi nor rnga mo bzhin/ /skad cig dal ba med pas ni/ /sgol ma'i zhabs kyi pad+ma la—/ /bdag gis mchod skabs ma rnyed do/ /des ni yi ge du tshig 'don/ /de bton pas ni phan 'dogs re/ /dus mtha' rlung gis ④g.yas su 'khyil/ /des ni gtsubs ⑤pa'i chu rlabs 'byung / /g.yo zhing 'gul ba'i rol pas 'khrug/de rgyab dba' rlabs 'gram du ni/ /brdabs pas sgra grag rjoskad gdangs ⑦can//'jigs byed rgya mtsho de las ni/ /gru chag nub pa'i skabs de la/ /snying rje ngu skad drag po bton/ /skad cig dran med bems ⑧por gyur/ /lha mo khyod la bstod pa yis/ /bde bar rgya mtsho phar bsgral lo/ /sprin nag bskor ⑨zhing du 14—984

ba'i nang / /de la me stag can gyi me/ /me lce cher 'bar khyim du ni/ /ngal nas mal du nyal ba'i mis/ /khyed la rab btung ①thal mo sbyar/ /skad cig gis ni glog byung nas/ /myur bar sprin char gyis rgo bskor/ /smyo byed glang chen 'gram gnyis la/ /'dzag pa'i chu la reg nas ni/ /bung ba'i phreng ba bzhin du thal/ /de rnams kyis ni hūṃ sgra sgogs/ /sgra de thos nas zhe sdang las//glang chen 'thab tu byung mno nas/ /khros nas mche bas mi bteg nas/ /'do ④ṣā la rgo bsdad pa bzhin/ /khyed dran tsam gyis 'chi ba bzlog / pha rol rgal ④nas rin chen rnyed/ /de steng mkhar du bsdad du phyin/ /mi med stong pa nags gseb tu/ /shin tu rno ba'i mtshon rnams kyis/ /brgyab nas yod par rjomi ro'i mgo/ /tri shu la la bsad ⑤ro mang / /de 'dra nags gseb rjophyin tsa na—/ /ral gri phub dag bzung ⑦nas ni/ /mda' gzhu bkang nas byung ba rnams| /zur mig lta zhing khros nas byung / /rgol nas brdeg tu byung tsam na//khyed bsams skyo med smyu ⑧gus bris/ /khyed ming gsal por zis ma thag /dpal ldan khyim du bsdad phyin no/ /rkang pa'i ⑨sor mo rab rno ba⑩/ /rdo rje lta bus rab tu brkos/ /smyo byed glang chen mgo khrag byung / /'jigs byed seng ge byung tsam na/ /khyod ⑪bos bstod pa brjod pa yis/ /bred nas seng ge log nas thal/ /du ba 'khyil ba 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /'jigs byed gdengs byed shin tu 'bar/ /rtag tu phug ⑫byed kha gdangs ⑫pa/ /lce chen ston pa sbrul khro ba/ /gshin rje'i zhags pas bkyigs ④pa'i mi/ /sdig pa'i dbang gis de ltar byung / /de dus khyed kyi yon tan bsgrags/ /gus pas ⑩dad par khyed la byas/ /sprul de ut+pal phreng bar gyur/ /me tog mchod pa'i mi des thob//14byed985

dpon kyis mig mtshams 'gul ①dogs kyis/ /der ②bred dmag dpon rim pa yis/ /thag pas bkyigs ①nas skra nas drud/ /rtsub mos bkal nas khrid tsam na/ /khol po de ni na tsha che/ /ca co smra ba gtong 'dod nas/ /nye ba gnyen rnams kyis ni bor/ /ltogs nas skom nas mchu skams pa/ /sdug bsngal mtha' med byung tsam na/ /gang gis sgol ma'i zhabs la skyabs/ /skad cig gis ni grol nas thar/ /sgyu ma byas pa'i gzugs mi legs/ /mi ro'i rgyu ma bus pa des/ /phreng ba mang bas ske ④la btags/ /sus kyang dgag tu mi nus pa/ /de byung dus su khyod kyi sngags/ /brjod pa ⑤tsam byis sdig pa dag /srin po'i dran pa med tsam na/ /de rnams kyis ni srung bar byed/ /'brug byung ba yi sprin gyi gzugs/ /nga rgyal 'jigs pa rtsang po gsum/ /de rjoni mun pa gnag pa la/ glog bzhin mtshon cha snang ba yis/ /mda' yi char pa byung tsam na/ /'thab pa'i dus su bskor nas bkag /shin tu stobs chen ⑦dgra rnams kyis/ /khro zhing brdeg tu byung tsam na/ /sgol ma khyed kyis stobs byin pas/ /dpa' bo gcig gis de rnams bcom/ /sa ⑧ris rnams ni rang dbang byas/ /sdig pas gang ba mdze pho'i gzugs/ /lus po skrangs nas khrag rnag dang ⑨/ /chu ser de rnams 'dzag pa ni/ /rtsa sha pags ⑩pa phug pa nas/ /'bu rnams kyis ni zos pa na/ /sgol ma khyed kyi zhabs brten nas/ /rtag tu khyed la mos gus byas/ /mos gus de rang sman du gyur/ /gser gyi kha dog lus gyur nas/ /pad+ma dkar po rgyas pa'i spyan/ /des ni gzugs bzang lus thob bo/ /slob dpon rnams kyi ⑩bka' de la/ /rna ba snod du ma rung bas/ /thos pa'i nor ni phongs par 'gyur⑫/ /bshes gnyen gseb tu lkugs pa de/ /14—986

spyod la mos gus bstod bgyis pas/ /gsung ldan seng khri 'phrog par byed/ /de 'phrogs ①pa yang rgyal po'i mdun/ /rgyan cha sna tshogs btags nas ni/ /gsung gi dbang phyug seng khri sdod/ /sa la nyal bas rdul mas khengs/ /lus kyi kha dog du bar gyur/ /dug po gos kyis ②lus ma khyab/ /rtag tu shig dang sro ma gsod/ /gzhan gyi mdun du phor gog 'dzin/ /rtag tu slong ①mo byed pa de / /sgrol ma khyed la skyabs tsam na/ /nges par mdzes ma dgod nas ④ni/ /rnga yab mdzes pas g.yob ⑤par byed/ /stobs chen glang po che rnams kyis/ /bdag por gyur nas gdugs gcig pa/ /ras ris tsam gyis rgyal por gyur/ /gzhan g.yog las dang yon tan dang / /tshong dang thabs kyis nor tshol ba /tshe snga ma yis dge ba'i nor/ /ji ltar byas kyang nor med pa/ /su la bslangs kyang rnyed pa med/ /kye ma khyed la bslangs tsam na/ /sa gseb tu ni nor rnyed nas| /mi de phyug por gyur par byung / /'tsho ba med pas ngo tsha che/ /gos med pas ni chung mas brgal/ /phongs pa yin pas gnyen gyis bor/ /ster dgos mno nas thag rings su/ /kye ma sgrol ma khyed la ni/ /rang gi sdug bsngal bstan tsam na/ /rta rnams rmig pa sa la rkoX/ /de brkos sa yang khyim bskor nas/ /rang yid 'ong ba rgyal po'i khab/ /khyim der gnyid ni log pa las/ /mdzes ma rnams kyis ⑦lag brgyan grags⑧/ /des ni gnyid log sad pa rnyed/ /phyogs bcur gyur pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /shin tu 'od zer ldan pa dang ⑨/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bud med dang / /mche ba drug yod glang po che—/ /rma bya'i ske yi kha dog ldan/ /de ltar sngo ba rta bzang ⑩dang / /rin po che ni nyi ma'i 'od/ /dri ma med pa'i gter kyis bkang / /dmag gi dpa' bo 14—987

mang ba dang / /sgol ma khyed kyi ①bka' drin gyis/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur/ /ma la ya yi ldum ra ru/ /nor bu rin po che yi rdo/ /de la tsan+dan la sogs bskus/ /lha mo rnams kyang 'tshog sa byas/ /'gron sar mchod pa byas pa bzhin/ /shin tu chags nas rtsed mo rtses②/ /sgol ma khyed kyi rig pa grub—/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i lha dbang po'i/ /ral gri ①'od zer ljang gus ni/ /lag bzangs rjode la phrog ⑤pa de/ /yang nas yang du gsor byed pa/ /gzugs bzang lha ni thob par 'gyur/ /mu tig phreng bas mdzes par btags/ /de btags nu ma'i bar du byung / /rna bar ut+pal btags pa de/ /mig dang gang bzang 'gran ⑦pa 'dra/ /thor tshugs man+da ra ba btags/ /dri zhim bung bas bor ma nus/ /rked par g.yer kha mdzes par btags/ /zhabs gnyis legs pa de la rgo/ /sil sel sgra dang g.yer kha btags/ /sgol ma khyed la brlab ⑦tsam na/ /'dod pa'i lha la dga' ba tsam/ /de phrad lha mo bsnyen bkur byed/ /rdzing 'gram rin po che yis bskor/ /gser gyi pad+ma de la ni/ /ge sar rdo rje pha lam 'bar/ /pa ra dzā ga'i shing de ni/ /cung zad bkug pa dri zhim dmar/ / de nas ⑧bla re bzhin du khyab/ /tam bu ra dang rnga la sogs//lha rnams kyis ni snyan par bsgrags/ /sgrol ma khyod kyi ⑨bka' drin gyis/ /lha yi ldum rar yun rings rtses/ /bde ba shin tu nyams su myong / /ga bur dang ni ka ko la/ /a ka ru dang spos dang dri/ /de rnams btags nas chur bsres pas—/ /dri zhim chu rnams kyis ni brdeg /lha mo'i nu ma gnyis kyi bar/ /lha yi gtsang po chu mgyogs ⑩des/ /phar rdeg tshur rdeg rtsed mo byed/ /lha mo mdzes pa de rnams dang / /khyod kyi bka' drin bsod nams kyis/ /lha yul 14—988

du ni rtsed mo myong / /mtho ris gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /gus pas bka' ni spyi bos len/ /de lan ①phyag ni byas nas su/ /glang po che la zhon pa la/ /rgyan cha btags pa'i glang rdzi ②des/ /lag pa gnyis la gdu sdebu btags/ /des ni 'do le ④bsgyings tsam na/ /bkag mi nus pa ba spu ldang / /rdo rje pha lam lag rgyan rjobatags/ /khyed kyi spyan gyis gzigs tsam na/ /lha yi dbang po brgya byen thob/ /lha yi ris kyis srung bar rjobyed/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa de la ni/ /rin chen me tog spyi bor gnas/ /nam mkha' dpal gyi bla res khyab—/ /nyi ma shar ka'i 'od 'dra ba/ /des ni 'jig rten gsum po bkang / /g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang zhabs gcig gis/ /de mnan bkug pa tshangs pa dang / /dbang phyug chen po khyab 'jug go/ /khyed kyi sku ni bsgom ④bgyis pas//srid pa'i 'jigs pa phyis mi 'byung / /skye ba len pa chad nas yod/ /kha cig gis ni 'di ltar mthong / /nags tshal phyag gi ⑧mtshon chas bzung / /shin tu 'jigs pa stobs po che/ /nam mkha' khyab par lag gdu ⑨bu/ /de rnams 'jigs che sbrul du mthong / /kye ma'o khros nas skrag par byed/ /dgod ⑩pa'i sgra ni shin tu 'jigs/ /ma rungs pa yi spyod pa byed/ /ro langs ting ting shag ni brdung / /'jigs chen rtsed mo sgra chen bsgrags⑫/ /kha cig gis ni mthong ba la/ /sgrol ma'i ba spu re re las/ /'jig rten pa de 'tsho bar byed/ /bde bar gnas pa'i ⑫tshangs pa dang / /lha yi dbang po brgya byin dang / /dbang phyug chen po klu la sogs/ /lha dang mi dang grub thob dang / /dri za gnod sbyin sbrul rnams dang / /phyogs su rgyu ba'i 'khor lo yang tha med bde gshegs khyim der gnas/ /kye ma rab tu rdzu 'phrul che/ /'jig rten 14—989

gsum gyis phyag byas pa/ /kye ma 'gul mi 'gul gnas pa/ /sna tshogs lhag ①med dngos po ni/ /kye ma sgrol ma khyed yin no/ /kha cig gis ni mthong ba la/ /rgya skyegs dang ni sirtse ②ra/ /dkar dmar kha dog nyi ma ltar/ /dpal ldan in+d+ra — la 'dra/ /kha cig gis ni mthong ba la/ /'o ma'i rgya mtsho drubs dkar 'dra—/ /kha cig gis ni gser 'dra mdog /khyod kyi gzugs ni sna tshogs mthong / /shel dang 'dra bar gang 'dod gzugs/ /ye shes mar me thams cad mkhyen/ /des ni thams cad gsal bar mthong / /de nyid mkhyen pa dbang po gcig /nges par khyod kyi yon tan ni/ /grangs las thams cad mkhyen pas shes/ /yang na de yi ①sras kyis mkhyen/ /bdag gis kha gdangs byas nas ni/ /bya rog kha 'dra'i sgra dang ni/ /sdug bsngal tshad pas khyab tsam na—/ /de skyes na tsha byung tsam na/ /bdag gis pho rog smra bzhin bton/ /gzhan gyi sems la bzhad rjogad rgyu/ /bdag gis zhus pa'i don du ni⑤/ /ma zhus gong du lhag par mkhyen/ /khyod kyi mkhyen pa de la ni/ /bdag gis zhus pa medon med gleng / / 'on kyang ⑦rang sems dga' ba'i don/ /nye ba'i gnyen gyi mdun du ni/ /dug dag skyugs pa smras pa bzhin/ /sdug bsngal don de shes kyang ni/ /rang snying yang zhing bde ba bzhin/ /phan 'dogs dga' ba rgya mtsho nyid/ /rab tu gsal ba zla ba'i cha/ /kye ma mdzes mas gzigs par zhu—/ /gdams ngag ye shes gnang bar zhu/ /snying rje ⑧chen mo khyod nyid kyis/ /mun nag sems ni gsal bar mdzod/ /spyod kyi bstod pa'i chu des ni/bdag gi sems ni gtsang bar bkrus/ /phan nas byung sa gcig rnyed do/ /bstod pa 'dis ni 'gro ba'i don/ /'bras bu thob pa yod par mthong / /14—990

ras /'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā ra sto ②tra/ bod skad du/'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrol mdzad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa/ /stod pa las sgol thugs rje'i spyan skeyangs ma/ /bde gshegs yum gyur lha mo sgrol ma la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyed kyis rjomadzad pa'i phrin las rgya che ba/ /ma lus brjod par sus kyang mi spobs te/ /che long rags pas rnam brgyad mang po sogs/ /ngo mtshar legs spyad gtam snyan 'di skad thos/ /shin tu rmad byung yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter/ /dge tshogs nor bu dam pa rin chen gling / /sna tshogs pad+mo'i tshal ni ⑤dri bsung can/ /phreng mdzes tshig gi me tog mchod par bzhes/ /skal ldan rigs can lam mtshon med pa zhig /rang yul ma slebs 0ri dwags rgyal pos bdas/ /khom ldan skyes bus ⑦gsum la 14byed993

skyabs 'gro byas/ /sgrol mas rjes bzung seng ges gus phyag 'byed①/ /don gnyer 'gron ④la gdong dmar gangs ri'i mdog /rdul 'dzag rab khros khro gnyer mche ba gabyedas/ /byin rlabs ①mthar thug gzungs sngags bstod pa'i mthus—/ /de ma thag tu glang chen 'jigs las skyabs/ /shing skam rjokhri la tshe tshad tshubargya bzhag ste/ /log lta'i rgyal pos drang srong me lha mchod/ /thams cad mabyed pas me tog phreng 'dzin mdzad/ /dngos su zhal bstan bdud rtsi'i char rgyun phab/ /tshong dpon nor ldan shul rings lam du zhugs/ /'jigs pa'i thang la mi rgod byed rkun byung / /yi dam lha mos 'jigs med bde sar bskyal—/ /drin lan ma brjed rten la mchod pa phul/ /gzugs mdzes bu mos pha durol nags su phyin/ /dug sbrul gdug pa'i kha rlangs sprin ltar 'thibs/ /'bras ldan ljon pa'i shing gi bsil grib la/ /spyi bor phyag bzhag ⑦mi bzad nad las thar/ /sbyin pa'i 'bras med dbul phongs rkun po'i mis/ /dkor mdzod blangs pas btson khang ra bar bcug /dad ldan slob mas thugs dam rgyud bskul bas/ /thugs rje'i phyag gis lcags sgog mdud pa dkrol⑧/ /tsan+d+ra go mi dge bsnyen 'phags pa mchog /rgyal po'i chad pas gaṅgā'i chu la bskur⑨/ /gus ldan zhe sa bcas pa'i sdeb sbyor gyis/ /'dzum zhal dge mas sing ga'i gling la bzhag /rgyal brgyud lam 'khrul dur khrod gnas su 'arnams/ /log 'dren 'byung po'i gdon gyis zin gyur tshe/ /rig ⑩pa'i rgyal po rig sngags bcu bzlas pas/ /bar chad bdud kyi tshogs las rgyal bar gyur/ /seng ge glang chen me dang byed rkun dang / /dug sbrul btson khang chu dang 'byung po'i gdon/ /'dus byas rgya mtsho las 'bras 'jug ngogs can/ /byang sems klu dbang bden 14byed994

gnyis gtsug gi nor/ /pha rol phyin drug rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /lnga bcu lhun grub phrin las gzi brjid can/ /'jigs brgyad sgrol mas ①gzhan yang sems can gyi/ /phyi rol grub mtha' ngan pa log lta'i ri/ /lung rigs rdo rje'i mtshon gyis bcom nas kyang / /lus ngag yid gsum sku gsum dkon mchog gsum/ /yang dag mtha' bral lta ba ma rtogs na/ /tshig gi bsnyems pas don la mi rtogs skete/ /sems can gnas lugs nam mkha'i chos nyid la/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i dra ba bsal du gsol/ /bsod nams chung bas dge ba'i sems med cing / /mi dge'i dze+emun bsgribs yang dag lam ma rnyed/ /bdag 'dzin bdud kyi srid mtsho 'dir dgas rnams/ /bshes gnyen thabs mkhas gru gzings ded dpon kyis④/ /chu bzhi'i pha rol yid 'ong po ta la/ /bde mchog gnas chen lha yi pho brang du/ /'gro kun yan lag bdun ldan chos spyod cing / /nyer mapa'i yo byad bka' babs brgyad gnang nas/ /phrin las lha mos zhal bzhes ma bsnyel bar/ /bshes gnyen ngan pa'i bdud dang mjal ba rnams—/ /dal 'byor chud zos mi tshe stong 'dzad ⑤cing / /zas nor don med gnas su brlag gyur pa/ /lus sems sdug bsngal chu yi rba rlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i sems can ma lus dang / /bka' 'bangs tha ma bdag cag thams cad la/ /rnam dag thos bsam sgom gsum bstan du gsol/ /rnam dag thos bsam sgom gsum bstan nas kyang / /phan bde'i dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /byed kyi phrin las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de/ /chags sdang gti mug sprin gyi grib rjom yis/ /sgrib ⑦par ma gyur dpal ldan 'phags pa'i ⑧sku / /dge tshogs sprin chen lhun po'i rtser bzhugs la/ /sa 'dzin spo la rta 14byed995

bdun rgyal po ltar/ /lham me lhang nger ①gsal ba'i bkra shis shog /gtsang bdag bde dang rtag pa nyid thob pa/ /skye rga na 'chi ②med pa chos kyi sku/ /brnyes gyur lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas/ /bsam zhing brjod pa'i yul las 'das gyur kyang / /chu nang zla ba nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin du/ /sprul skus 'gro don mdzad par smon lam 'debs/ /klu sgrub pad+mo'i ③ge sar las④/ /nyi ma sbas pa bung ba yis/ /legs blangs ⑤bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyis/ /bu slob sgrang bu'i lus rgyas shog /kha che'i slob dpon nyi ma sbas pas rje btsun sgol ma la bstod pa rdzogs so—/ / //rgya gar kyi paṇ+ḍi ta sā dhu tīrti dang rjo/ bod kyi lo tsā ⑦ba ldan ⑧ma tshul khrims seng ges bsgyur ba las phyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du dag par byas so// //14byed996

rag /lha mo sgol ma la sme sngags kyi gsol ba 'debs pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ de bī sketā ra ku bā kyā gde sha nā ma sto tra/bod skad du/ lha mo sgol ma la smre sngags kyi gsol ba 'debs pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'jig rten kun sgrol ma/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs med phongs pa kun skyob rjom/ /phyag 'tshal yang yang dudran pas rjes 'dzin ma/ /de ring da lta mgon med bdag la skyobarjo/ /khyod sngon skyob ⑦pa rnam gzigs spyan chab las/ /gang 'khrungs de tshe de ma thag 'di skad/ /srid gnas gang su 'jigs pas 'jigs 'gyur yod/ /de kun ngas skyabs zhes gsungs dam bca' dgongs/ / mkha' ltar ⑧thugs zab mkha' 'dra yis/ /mdog 'chang 'gro la ⑩rjes brtse ma//srid gnas 'gro ba lag 'dzin par/ /zhal bzhes slu ba ⑪ma mdzad cig /khyod nyid rig 'dzin lha tshogs nang / /zag med dga' bdes rnam rol bkyid//14byed998

spyod 'bangs bu ni me nang bsreg /kye kye thogs med mkhyen ldan gzigs/ /bdag rang gis ni nongs bgyis nas/ /me chu dgra sogs 'jigs gyur pa'ang / /gal te khyod sku rjes dran gyur/ /skyob ①mdzad lags na bdag cis min④/ /nyid phyag mchod sbyin bdud rtsi yi/ /rgyun 'bebs yi dwags 'bum phrag kyang / /cig car chim bgyid kho bo mes/ /lus zhu thig le ④'be+ebs ma lags/ /yid 'ong phyag mtshan ut+pal rtsi/ /mngar bsil grib ma rjobaṅgal ldan pas/ /cung zad reg na'ang gdung sel ma/ /gus ldan bu bdag nyug mi mdzad/ /thugs rjes brkyang ba'i zhabs g.yas kyi⑤/ /mthe bong rgyun bzangs duthur 'bebs nas⑦//ngan 'gro'i gnas gsum tshim mdzad na/ /phongs pa bdag cag gi nar dor/ /ting 'dzin g.yon bskum skyil krung gi④/ /gar gyis sa gsum bde mdzad ma/ /sbrang bu mer bcug kho bo lta/ /gar stabs rlung gis cis mi bskyod⑨/ /'dzum zhal dgyes mas gang gzigs na/ /phag sdig gdol pa mdze can yang / /lha gzugs sdug mdzes sgyur spyod na/ /kho bo gcig spyan yul ma gyur/ /sgeg ldem 'gying mdzes gzi 'od ldan/ /khyod sku sus mthong de don 'grub⑩/ /don gnyer rtse gcig rjes slob bu/ /bdag la nyid gzugs ston ma lags⑪/ /spyod spyan ut+pal dkyus ring gis/ /zur gzigs ⑫'dod pa'i lhar ⑫'drar 'gyur—/ /rtag tu nyid kyi gdan ④gnas dag /ji ltar snang yang mkhyen ma lags—/ /lha snyan mda' ⑫ma sgra kun gyi/ /rjes zhugs yul dus kun rig ma/ /kho bo nyam ⑪thag nga ros 'bod/ /'brug sgra brag ri ltar gyur kyi⑩/ /skyob ma lha yi shangs dran ⑫pas/ /gaṅgā'i bye rgal spyodri rab bsrung / /bdag 'dir mes tshig sha tshil gsur/ /rgya chen phyogs khyab tshor ma lags/ /thub chen ma gcig ⑫14—999

zla ba'i ljags/ /bung ba'i mchu rtse'i ①ro mkhyen na/ /seng ge 'phrog byed mchod sbyin du②/ /ro bro ba la ljags rmongs srid/ / phra rab rdul brgya'i rdul bye ma/ /skerdo rje'i lus mnga' reg mkhyen ma/ /sdig rgyal khros pas me lha mchod//mi bzad reg byed cis mi reg /phyogs dus rnam kun thogs med par/ /ma chags ma 'dres ci dga' yang / /mkhyen ma de ring skal ngan bdag /gnas skabs 'di 'drar gyur ma dgongs/ / rang bzhin gnyis ④sdig rang spyod dam/ /gzhan stobs gzhan dbang gyur de yang / /thabs stobs brgya mnga' khyod skyabs mdzad—/ /bdag 'dir nongs pa gang mchis grang / /gcig tu gzhan la phan zhugs pas/ /mi ni brgya rtsa brgyad zhugs btsal/ /de dbus kho bo khyod 'bangs bsreg⑤ /kye ma yum gcig bdag g.yar tsha/ /sngon las 'bras bu rjes gcod pa'i/ /gnas gyur de dang de las kyang / /khyod thugs gsung dang sku 'jig bgyid/ /de las gzhan bdag nyid cir dgongs/ /kyi hud khyod lha zhabs pad drung / /bsil ba'i gnas nas 'bar ba'i mes mer dubartson ji bzhin dmyal mes 'tshed⑦/ /'di ci sus skekhur lags zhes ⑨gsung / /de bas mgon med mgon gcig ma/ /khyod thabs thugs rje thogs med des⑩/ /bdag dang 'gro ba ci dga' yang / /mdzad min mdzad srid spyod zhus pas/ /'on kyang kho bo 'dir tshig pas/ /lus can kun gyi zug rngu dang / /nyon mongs sdog las tshig ⑪gyur cig /da ni su la re bar bya/ /kha che'i slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen zhes bya ba/ mi brgya dang bdun gyis bskor ba la tsan+dan gyi mes bsregs pa'i tshe/ nyid kyi yi dam gyi lha rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la smre sngags kyi tshigs su bcad pa 14—1000
bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (522)

༄ga sgol ma dbo mchog gsum la bstod pa bzhugs/①༄pha /sgol ma dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa/ log rtog ②ma rig gnyid spangs shing / /blo mchog shes bya kun la khyab/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i mchog brnyes ma/ /sgol ma sangs rgyas khyed phyag 'tshal/ /bde chen zhi ba mya ngan 'das/ /dam pa'i chos mchog yi ge bcu/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu yi tshul①//sgol ma dam chos khyod phyag 'tshal/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs gsang ba④/ /'dus pa'i ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /sgol ma dge 'dun khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sgrol ma dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa/rgya gar phyi mkhan po dri paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā dhib nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bi kra ma shrī rjola'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa⑦/ //14—1003

rag /rgya gar skad du/ bo dhi (sto ma hā su kha s+t+waṃ klun ya/ bod skad du—/ byang chub kyi sems bde ba'i man ngag /bde ba chen po byang chub kyi sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang rgyud mtha' dag las man ngag gang ba'i don/byang chub kyi sems 'da' ka ma'i man ngag 'di ltar lags te/ 'chi 'pho dus su 'di ltar ro/ /da ltar bdag gi lus khyab par gnas pa'i sems 'di ni 'ubs kyis 'dus nas/ snying ga'i dkyil na 'od mtshon gang ba cig gnas so/ /yi ge shes pas 'od du mi lta ①ste/ hūṃ yungs 'bru tsam cig lhang nger gnas so/ /de nas tshor ba dang bral drod shor te/ 'jig rten pa'i spyod yul dang bral ba'orjo//de tsam na 'od mthing ga de snying gi dkyil nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi gsang ba'i lam g.yas kyi srog rtsa dar dkar gyi skud pa 'dra ba'i nang nas yar yengs kyis byung ste/ spyi bo'i ⑤gtsug tu byung / ril gyis dril nas/ lhang gis shar 14byed1005

tsam na/ de nas yar 'dom gang tsam gyis chod ①nas rnam par dag pa chos kyi pho brang / rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas na/ dpal kun du bzang po bzhugs te/ rang gis khyab gdal ba dang bzhin lhang nge bar te/ sku la mdun dang rgyab mi mnga' bar/ bde ba chen po'i nang du lhang nger ②bzhugs pa dang / bdag gi sems hūṃ ngam thig le yungs 'bru ①spyi bo nas yar byung ba gnyis kar spyin la sbrang bu chags pa'am/ chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa'i tshul du/kun du bzang po dang gnyis gcig tu lhang nger ༷gnas par gyur to/ /de ltar chos kyi dbyings kyis gar khyab par kun du bzang pos khyab/ kun du bzang pos gar khyab par bdag gi sems kyis khyab ste/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog dang bral nas chos kyi sku thob ste/ skyid pa chen po g.yung drung gi gnas su khyab gdal la lhang nge bar gnas so/ /de'i ngang las mi 'gyur lhang nger ⑤gnas pa ni—/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba mur thug pa'o/ /de'i ngang las sa ler rjoganas pa ni/ rdzogs pa chen po'i bsgom pa mthar phyin pa'o/ /de'i ngang las yud tsam par mi 'da' ba ni/ rdzogs pa chen po'i dam tshig mthar phyin pa'o/ /de lta bu'i don la sems rtse gcig tu bsgom mo/ /byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i man ngag rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ kā ra shrī dz+nyā na nyid dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ⑦ba dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pho brang byang chub 'od kyis zhus pa'o / / //14—1006

brtsar mchan/1༷༷5 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉3nga chub kyi sems bde ba'i man ngag bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉rig ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉blta/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉lo/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bo/1༷༷6 ①〈〈pe 〉sno) chod/ 〈〈snar 〉7) chod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉nge/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉netsam rjo⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈'ar 〉8/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉spo/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉〉phru/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (525) 14wa 1007

༄ga /me tog zeng 'dzin gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ srasnya ra sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ me tog phreng 'dzin gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ rje btsun ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo lha dang lha min nor lha'i cod pan ston ka'i nyi 'od 'bar ba'i tshogs kyis zhabs kyi rdul la reg /rnyog med gzigs pa'i shes rab mig ni snying rje'i rlan gyis rab tu gang zhing nyon mongs dra ba gcod/ /rmongs pa'i mthu yis srid pa'i mtsho chen mi zad skye 'chi'i dba' rgal skedrag pos kun nas g.yengs gyur pa/ /skyob pa'i gzings chen dri med gzugs mdzes dpal gyi snying po me tog phreng 'dzin de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig sngos bral mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings su ro gcig pa/ /bsam gtan sprin med a sogs yi ges snying gar ④rab brgyan cing / /gus pa'i sbyor bas sna tshogs mthu ldan yon tan rin chen gter/ /drang srong tshe 'dzin bla ma'i gsung las bdag gis 'dir brngod bya/ /rab tu zhi 14byed1008

la dga' ba'i bden 'dzin nags tshal lam/ /g.yeng ba'i rdul bral phug gam ljon shing dur khrod mchog /chu 'gram dben ①pa'i sa phyogs rang bzhin nyams dga' bar/ /chu gtsang spos kyi ②chag chag me tog dri zhim gtor/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs dam chos rin chen bzhugs pa dang / /me tog bdug spos snang ba dri dang zhal zas mchog /rgyal sras yum dang dkyil 'khor mchod phyir legs bzhag bya/ /ri dwags 'gan 'dzi sngon po legs par btags gyur pa'i/ /stan la 'dug nas bsam gtan bdag gis bsgom par bya/ /thog mar 'od gsal rten 'brel bde ⑦stong mi g.yo ba/ /gang zhig shar bas spyod pa'i dus na yul rnams dang / /dbang po'i tshogs dag rtog bral tshul gyis kun du dunub/ /rtog med rtog bral rdo rje'i mchog 'dzin kun du ⑤khyab/ /ji bzhin rtog pa'i mtha' las rjorang sems sa bon mchog /zla 'od dkar mdzes t+t+waṃ las phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar/ /shin tu rno ba'i 'od zer chen pos khams gsum gyi/ /myun pa'i tshogs bcom rgyal ba sras rnams nam mkha' la/ /bzhugs par bltas la bdag yid rtse gcig dri med kyi/ /gang zhig sna tshogs ro gcig dbang po'i gzhu 'dra ba/ /nyon mongs rdul bral zhi bde spros bral bde 'gro zhing / /ye shes rgyun 'bab rgyal ba'i sku mdzes pad+mo la/ /gus pa'i tshul dze+egyis mgrin pa smad nas bdag phyag 'tshal/ /kha dog sna tshogs dri zhim dbyibs mdzes me tog dang / /bdug spos a ga ⑧ru dang sbrul gyi snying po dang / /snod mdzes rin chen sgon ⑨ma snang ba drir bcas dang / /chu gtsang dri zhim snying po sbyor ⑩ba dpag med dang / /mdog bzang ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas mang po rnams/ /gus bcas yid 'ong rgyal sras khyed la 'bul lags kyis/ /sems can tshogs 14byed1009

rnams srid pa'i gdung ba zhi bar mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra pu ṣ+pe ①uhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ ②yasahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ltalo ke skezhwa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe yasahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e wi t+ya ā ④hūṃ—/ gnod pa byed rnams dge ba'i phyogs las nyams pa dang / /sdig pa'i gzhir gyur bsten du mi rung ji snyed las/ /dug gi gregs pas ⑤sems gdung gyur pa bdag sogs kyi/ /phra rjorgyas tshon chen zag pa'i tshang tshing zad par mdzod/ /gang zhig rgyal sras thub pa'i 'od tshogs mdzes pa'i tshal /'bras bu smin pa'i ljid kyi zug rngu gnon mdzad cing / /snying rje'i rgyun gyis nyon mongs tha ba brlan mdzad pa/ /dregs pa'i rdul bral skyong ba'i ⑦mgon la skyabs su mchi/ /yang dag lam bral lta ba'i dug gis myos gyur cing / /nyon mongs mtsho chen brgal dka'i ngogs su lhung ba rnams/ /shes rab gzings chen snying rje'i go ⑧cha mi 'gyur mchog /dri med yid 'ong zla ba'i mdangs gsal thob par gyis⑨/ /rab tu zab pa'i dka' thub dpal gyis ⑩'bar ba dang / /nyon mongs chags bral byams pa snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms yid brtan ⑪rim gro byed pa'i bde ba'i ⑫mchog /khams dang dbang po la sogs mkha' ltar ro gcig bde/ /bde gshegs byed pa sgyu ma'i yon tan dpag med rnams| /srid gsum 'gro ba dbang po'i dri ma sbyong byed pa/ /rab dga' ⑫ sems kyi gru chen nam mkha'i dbyings su 'gyur/ /nyi zla'i sbyor bas mun pa zad 'gyur grong mchog lam/ /bdud rtsi sgon mi byachu gter yid bzhin rin po che/ /rdul med rdul bral ye shes dbang phyug phyag rgya can/ /ye shes mthar son sna tshogs lus can kun ston pa/ /ting 'dzin dag pa'i lus can 'phags ma thob par shog /de nas byams pa snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms bsgom/ /gdod 14—1010

nas sems ni ma skyes rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba/ /nges don bdud rtsi nam mkha' las byung dag pa bsten/ /rtog pa rgyun chad sems nyid de nyid gzhan ma yin/ /chu tshod thun dang dbyu ①gu skad cig rim pa med/ /mi 'jigs sgro skur mi rtsol rgyal sras thu bo ste/ /gdod nas ma skyes chos rnams byed pa thig le yin/ /spros bral chos nyid yang dag nyid ni snang bas dbe+en/ /bskyed rdzogs theg pa'i mtha' bral rtog med bde chen po/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kopho②haṃ/de nas snying rje'i shugs kyis rab tu bskul gyur nas/ /rang snying paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma de steng ā ཿ/ /lte ba zla bas brgyan cing dbyangs dang gsal byed kyirjo/ /kun nas bskor ba'i t+t+waṃ las phyogs bcur 'od tshogs 'phros/ /'gro ba'i don byas tshur la bsdus nas t+t+waṃ la thim/ /de rnams skad cig nyid la sgol ma'i sku lngar gyur/ /sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi stag gi gos gyon ma/ /gri gug thod pa ral gri sdigs mdzub phyag rgya can/ /ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug g.yas sngo g.yon pa dmar/ /ral gri dgra sta mda' dang zhags pa gzhu dang dung / /zhal gcig phyag bzhi btsod ⑤kyi kha dog sna tshogs brgyan/ /mi 'jigs mda' dang gzhu dang ut+pal dmar po bsnams/ /sku mdog ljang ser chos kyi phyag rgyas thugs ka ru/ /ut+pal sngo 'dzin shar sogs go rims rjoji bzhin du⑦/ /sna tshogs rgyan ldan phyogs rnams sreg cing gsang sngags bzlas/ /rnam snang la sogs rgyal po'i rigs kyis dbu brgyan pa/ /nu ma rgyas shing mi 'jigs phyag dang ut+pal 'dzin/ /brtson pa'i lus ldan zla ba'i mdangs can dbus su bsam//oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re ⑧niṣ+ṭṛ dā ru ṇa pra ti ⑨ha ta ci ut+pa ⑩ha na swā hā/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re bha ya ha ra ṇa rak+ṣa ba ra be+e gu ba ti bi5 ⑪sa ma te swā hā/ oṃ tā 14byed1011

re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re ①a na bhi pratshwa pra san+da ta a rnyi pratshwa pra sā dha ṭ+wā hā/ oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re bha ya ha ra ṇa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ mṛkhyu daṇ+ḍa ya ma ②byu ta ṭ+wā hā/ de ltar gsang sngags bzlas pa'i 'od kyis phyogs khyab cing / /gzungs kyi snying po mthu chen 'di yang brjod par bya/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.āt+yā wa lo ki te shwa ra khruya| bo ④dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya tha⑤/oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re sarba duṣ+ṭan pra duṣ+ṭhan rjom ma kṛ ⑦te dze+e bha ya ste bha ya/ mo ha ya/ brnya ⑧ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭha ⑨ste bha na tā re swā hā/mang du bzlas la stobs babyed cho ga 'di ltar bsam/ /snod mdzes nang du 'bras sogs kha zas bzang po rnams/ /mngon par bshams pa'i cha gnyis pad+ma kha bye ba'i/ /phyag rgya bcing zhing sku gsung thugs kyi snying po mchog /lan bdun brjod pas kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs/ /oṃ na maḥsarba burtse ⑩bo dhi satā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ⑪ha ta shā⑫sa nā ṭ+wāṃ/ ho te bha ga ba ti me ⑫sa dā sarba ④burnya yangab lo ki te/ i rda pa dzi kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi/ a z-i ta kha kha khā nyi khā nyi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ⑫phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ ār+ya nut+pan+da twata oṃ yasahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ⑩a mṛ ta kha kha khā nyi khā hi tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi sgo ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya/ sarba bispyo bi nā ⑩ya/ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti ⑫dzī wi tān+ta ka rā ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/dpag med cha gcig rig pa'i lha mo rnams la 'bul/ /cha gcig nang du 'od zer spu gu bskyed byas te/ /nag po chen po tha skar ⑩dbyig gi snying po dang / /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin grul bum tshogs rnams la/ /'dod pa'i gsol ba btab cing gus pas dbul bar bya/ /brgyad dang bcu bzhi bcu dang nyi shu 14—1012

gsum rnams la/ /zhi ba rgyas pa dbang dang mngon spyod sbyin sreg dbul/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang nag po'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /rtse khru gcig dang gcig dang byed dang rtse khru gcig① /skum dang gru bzhi zla gam gru gsum bri bar bya/ /thams cad sor bzhi babyed cing 'od phreng phyi rol bri/ /'khor lo dkar dang sna tshogs rdo rje ser po dang / /pad+ma dmar dang gri gug sngon po thabs ②rnams kyi/ /rim pa ji bzhin legs par nang du dgod par bya/ /mar dang zho dang 'o ma sbrang rtsi ka ra dang / /'bras til gro dang nas sogs 'khru yi rnam pa dang / /drur ①ba ku sha la sogs cho ga gzhan bzhin bsogasadu/ /de las gzhan pa'i sreg rdzas khyad par mang po rnams/ /nye bar bshams la thog mar drang srong me lha mchog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog dkar po tshangs skud can/ /dbyug pa spyi blugs bgrang phreng mi 'jigs phyag rgya can/ /ral pa'i cod pan dka' thub lus ring zla ba'i steng / /mngon par babyed la dgang blugs bdun gyis rab tu mchod/ /dzaḥzhes brjod cing se gol gtogs la gshegs par bsam/ /oṃ bak+ṇi ⑤rā tshwa pra tīts+tsha rjoswā hā/ de nas rdzas dang me thab dri chab bzang pos bsang / /oṃ thrak+ṣu li ⑦bi shuste swā hā/ mchod pa'i yo byad snying po'i sngags kyis dbul bar bya/ /mnyes par gyur nas smon lam btab cing mi snang bsgom/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig sems can skyong / /ched du brjod la lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /spyod lam khyad par can kyis ④gnas bya zhing / /de las gzhan pa'i bsod nams mang po bsags⑨/ /drang srong tshe 'dzin bla ma'i gsung snyan bdag la bsnyad gyur pa/ /byang chub myu gu'i greng bas lus brgyan gzhan don 'brug sgra sgogs/ /snying rje'i shugs kyis bsod 14—1013
〈〈snar 〉〉bsag1༷14 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gru lo tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (526)14wa 1015

༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ shu n+ya tā bhā ba ②na/ bod skad du/ stong pa nyid bsgom pa/ me tog phreng 'dzin sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtum mo e yi sbyor ba yis/ /lus kyi ba spu cher ldang zhing / /yang dag lta ba goms gyur pa/ /de nyid chos rnams chos nyid mdzodasne/ /de ltar sgrub pa'i thabs lan mang du goms par byas la bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcu sngon du song ba'i gang zag gis ri'i phug la sogs pa dbe+en pa'i gnas su stong pa nyid bsgom pa'i rim pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de yang skad cig gis bdag gi snying gar rjopaṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ges t+t+waṃ ku mu ta dkar po lta bu la kun nas bskor ba las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas te slar log pa t+t+waṃ la thim par blta'o/ /de ma thag tu bdag nyid 'phags ma sgol ma me tog phreng 'dzin zhes bya ba sku mdog 14—1016

dkar mo ston ka'i sprin med pa'i zla ba lta bu lang tsho la bab pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa—/ g.yas mchog sbyin pa g.yon pa ut+pal sngon po kha du mar gyes pa 'dzin pa/rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis sku mdzes par byas pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du sku brtson pas bzhugs pa la sems gtad stide bsgom par bya'o/ /de nyid 'od kyi rnam pa las/ /rang rig rnam pa gzhan med de/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi lam gnyis dgag /rang sems dbu ma'i lam du gzhug /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las/ /bsam gtan gyis ni phyi rol dngos po btang nas sems de brtan par yang ni byed/ srog dang rtsol bas nyi zla spangs nas mun pa can du srog rlung rgyu bar byed/ 'dzin pa'i yan lag gis ni thig ler dbugs kyi 'byung 'jug dman par yang byas nas/ rjes dran rang gi gzugs las mkha' la ri bong can bzhin 'od zer chen po 'byung / 'od kyi phung po sku la thim/ /sku yang pad+ma zla ba la/ /de nyid dbyangs dang gsal byed la/ /de yang yi ge t+t+waṃ la bsdu/ /t+t+waṃ yang thig le nyid la thim/ /thig le stong pa'i yi ge med/ /de nyid sems kyi mtshan nyid do/ /rang sems gdod ②nas ma skyes phyir/ /rtag sogs brtags pa ga la 'jug /de nyid spros pas dben ①pa'i phyir/ /cung zad bsgom ④kyang bdag gzhan gyi/ /rtog pa sna tshogs 'gag par 'gyur/ /rgyun du ⑤bsgoms pa smos ci dgos/ /de ltar de bzhin nyid la blo/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i mthu chen bgyisarjo/ /yang dang yang du goms byas na⑦/ /myur du byang chub reg par 'gyur/ /stong pa nyid bsgom pa rdzogs so// //14—1017

bsdur ma na/1016 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /stong pa nyid sgom pa me tog phreng 'dzin bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉staṇ+ḍi bā/ ③〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉brjod/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉kar/1 17 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉thastan/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉toradod/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanabyen/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉bsgoms/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tu/ rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉sno)sa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/bsdur 'azas re'u migabyud/ (527)14wa 1018

༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ ku dṛṣ+ṭa rū ṣa ṇa/ bod skad du/ log par lta ⑦ba sun dbyung ba/ khro gnyer can gyi sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag lta ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /sna tshogs las kyi rnam pa can/ /ji ltar me yis bud shing bzhin/ /khro gnyer can gyi sbyor ba bri/ /re zhig sgrub pa'i thabs nas byung ba'i cho ga rnams dang bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcus mthu thob par byas la/dur khrod la sogs pa'i ①shis pa'i gnas su skad cig gis khro gnyer can sgrol ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma stag gi na bza' can rus pa'i phreng ba can sha ༷lus rgyas pa spyan dmar zhing gdangs pa⑤/ g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang sdigs mdzub bgreng ba/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bsgoms la/ /de yi thugs ka'i t+t+waṃ las 'od 'phros pas ma dag pa'i las can gyi skyes bu la thim zhing bkug par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+ta 14—1019

re tu re niṣ+ṭha dā rū ①ṇa pra ti ha ta/ mdo u ཿhā ni swā hā/ zhes pa'i gsang sngags bzlas shing / rkang gnyis kyi khrag dang / rtsi nag pos 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa bris la dbus su gzugs brnyan dang / rtsibs dang mu khyud la gsang sngags ming dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /de nas yungs kar gyis brab cing gsang sngags bzlas/ de'i rjes la sbyin sreg dang / gtor ma dang /mchod pas khro gnyer can lha mo la mchod la tsher ma can gyi mes spra tshil dang 'khor lo bsros la dug ha si nag po'i shun pa'am/ rnga mo'i rgyus pas dkris pa sa bdag gam klu chen po'i gnas su bskyal bar bya'o/ /smyo dang dbugs ni rtseg pa dang / /gyen du blta zhing rgyug par byed/ /lus po skem dang mig ser dang //lus la sha bkra me dbal 'byung / /gzhan yang mdze dang shu ba dang / /'brum bu bas ldag ②'byung 'gyur zhing / /tshe yi dus kyang byed par 'gyur/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba'i che ba yis/ /gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro snesems dkrugs shing / /las kyi myu gu zad byed pa/ /khro gnyer can gyi sbyor ba'o/ /lta ba ngan pa sun dbyung ba rdzogs so// //14—1020

bsdur mchan/1019 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉thalta/③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ④〈〈pe〉〉zhas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stanadang ba/1༷ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉du/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉rdogs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉'gros/brtsar 'bras re'u migargyud/ (528)14wa 1021

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tso ②ra brnya na①/ bod skad du/ chos rkun bcing bdu/ mya ngan med pa'i sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glang chen stag dang mi rgod dang / /chom rkun 'jigs pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rlung gi bum pas ⑤lus sbyong ba/ /mya ngan med pa'i sgol ma mchod/ /de yang sgrub pa'i thabs nas ji ltar bshad pa'i cho gas 'phags ma'i tshogs yongs su mnyes par byas la/ nags tshal lam ri khrod la sogs pa gnas khyad par can du ri dwags kyi pags pa'am/ 'gan 'ji rjosngon po legs par btags pa la 'dug la/byams pa dang snying rje chen po sngon du song bas bdag gi snying gar paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du t+t+waṃ ser po de las phyogs bcur 'od 'phros 'phags ma dgyes pa dang sems can gyi don byas la/ slar bsdus pas t+t+waṃ la thim pa dang bdag nyid mya ngan med pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog 14—1022

'dra ba rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan cod pan dang ldan pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas pas ral gri dang dgra sta dang mda'/g.yon pas zhags pa dang gzhu dang dung 'dzin par bsgoms la/ oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re bha ya ha ra be+e rak+ṣa ba ra r+ṇa gup+ta be+et+yāḥshā ①ma he swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzla zhing stag pa'i shun lpags la gur gum dang gi waṃ gis 'khor lo rtsibs bdun pa bris pa la snying po gzungs dang bcas pa lte ba la sogs pa la ci rigs pa bris la / sbyin sreg dang gtor ma'i cho gas mchod lasde/ sngags dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo dril ⑧la mgrin pa'am/ dpung pa la bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas 'brog dgon pa la sogs pa nyam nga ba'i gnas su sgol ma gsal bar bskyed la sngon du goms par byas pa'i rlung bsre rjozhing snying po dang gzungs sngags ⑤bzla zhing bdag gi rjogrib ma bzhin du g.yas su 'od zer can mya ngan med pa'i cha lugs—/ phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la bskyon nas mi 'jigs kyi sgras brgyan pa dang / g.yon logs na sdigs mdzub sgol ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pas sdigs mdzub/ g.yon ḍa ma ru'i sgra 'byin pa/ lus gos dang bral bas mi 'jigs pa'i dbyangs sgogs shing gshegs par bsam mo de nas bag tsha ba'i ⑦phyogs su thar pa dang me tog phreng 'dzin la sogs pa'i bstod pa bya'o/ /gcan gzan ⑧khro bo mang pos gang ba yis⑨/ /tshang tshing nags sam chom rkun 'du ba'i gnas/ /lam med nyam nga'i gnas su bdag lus pa/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyis ni yongs su sgol⑩/ /chom rkun bcing ba rdzogs so// //14—1023

༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ bi r+ya ②badz+nya ni/ bod skad du/ rig pa bskyed pa/ rig byed sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rmongs pas blo mdongs ⑦pa/ /rig byed sgol ma rig pa'i mchog /rgyal po khyim bdag mgu byed pa/ /blang phyir bdag gis bri bar bya/ /gzhan yang sgrol ma'i rig pa mchog blang ba'i slad du bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad du song ④zhing sgrub thabs ⑤cho ga blo 'dris pa'i rten kyi gang zag gis byams pa dang snying rje sngon du bskyed la skad cig gis rig byed sgol ma sku mdog tshos chen po lta bu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/g.yas kyi dang po mi 'jigs pa'i phyag dang / gnyis pas mda' dang /g.yon gyis rin po che'i gzhu dang / g.yon gnyis pas ut+pa la dmar po 'dzin pa—/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la skyis krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du t+t+waṃ dmar 14byed1025

po byi ①ru'i mdog lta bu las/ phyogs bcur 'od 'phros tshur bsdus nas bdag gi kun du rmongs pa'i tshogs thams cad zhi bar bsam zhing sems gtad la bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas skye khrubar gyur na gsang sngags rgyun mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bus sems sbyangs nas yar ngo'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin par nas mtshal 1dang gur gum dang gi ④waṃ rnams sbyar la pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa gnyis bris la/oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re ⑤a ni sgyi pradz+nyā rjosā dha na/ a rnyi pradz+nyā pra sā dha swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing bdag dang 'khor lo phan tshun thim zhing snying po dang gzungs dgod/'khor lo gcig la dbyangs dang gsal byed bri bar bya'o/ /de nas bco ⑦lnga'i mtshan phyed la zla ba la mngon du phyogs pas mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang sbyin sreg dang gtor ma rnams phul la/ me long g.ya' yongs su dag pa bu ga med pa la sin+tu ra dmar po maṇ+ḍal ④la gser ram zangs kyi thur mas 'khor lo ji lta ba bzhin du phyi nang du gnyis bris la snying po dang gzungs dang / phyi ma la dbyangs dang gsal byed bkod de cung zhig bzlas pa bya zhing mchod pa rnam pa lngas yang dag par mchod la 'khor lo ⑨gnyis dril te mgul du gdags par bya/ sin+tu ra legs par bsdus te dug lang ka wa ti'i sbu gur blugs la mchan ⑩khung g.yon par btags te thig le dmar po skra mtshams su bya zhing / bsod snyoms kyi phyir grong khyer du zhugs na rgyal po dang rnam bdag dad cing 'dun par 'gyur ro/ /sgra dang bstan bcos mang po dang / /rol mo sgyu rtsal ji snyed dang / /lha dang gnod sbyin bu mo sogs/ /rig byed mthu yis 'dun par byed/ /rig pa bskyed pa rdzogs so// //14—1026

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ mṛ khyujo ka sdeb/ bod skad du/ 'chi ba bslu ba/ dpal sgrol ma chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrol ma ljang ④ser cho ga yis—/ /'chi bdag chad pa zhi mdzad cing / mkha' 'gro srin po'i gnod pa rnams—/ /sgol bas rjosgol ma mchog yin no/ /re zhig rmi ⑤ltas dang lus kyi rnam 'gyur la sogs pa 'chi ba'i rtags rnams rmis rjoshing / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed pa rnams kyi 'jigs pa chen po zhi bar bya ba'i phyir snying po'i grangs bgrangs shing ma yengs pa'i bsam gtan mang du goms pa'i rnal 'byor pas dben pa'i sa phyogs su ⑦stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ lus kyi 'jug pa sngon du btang / byams pa dang snying rje chen po sems can la bskyed pa ⑧sgyu ma lta bu'i blo cung zhig goms par byas te/ skad cig gis dpal sgol ma chen mo sku mdog ljang ser rin po che sna tshogs kyis sku legs par spras pa/ phyag gnyis kyis ⑨14—1028

thugs kar chos smra ba'i phyag rgyas ut+pa la sngon po 'dzin pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du t+t+waṃ ljang ser de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas dus ma yin par tshe'i dus byed pa'i sems can rnams kyi 'chi bdag gi ①mthu med par byas la/ tshur la bsdus la sgyu ma lta bu'i blos sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa'i sems can rnams la dmigs shing snying po'i mchog 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re bha ya ha ra ṇi ①hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ mṛ 6 ①daṇ+ḍa ya ma daṇ+ḍa ya mā ④dhu na swā hā/ zhes pa bzlas shing ⑤/gzungs dang sbyin sreg dang gtor ma dang mchod pa phul la bstod pa bya'o/ /de'i rjes la gro ga la gur gum rjogyis 'khor lo rtsibs bdun pa bris la che ge mo'i sdog pa zhi bar gyur cig la sogs pa spel la snying po dang gzungs dgod par bya'o//de nas rin po che'am rdza sar pa kha sbyar ram/ rwa 'am shing gi za ma tog gi nang du 'khor lo dril la skud pa dmar pos sdod lan mang du bcing / dar ram ras dkar po'i na bzas ⑦g.yogs la dge 'dun gyi sde chen po'i gtsug lag ④gi shing ngam—/ mchod rten gyi shing la bcings la/ dus khyad par can la mchod pa chen pos mchod cing bsgom ⑨pa dang snying po dang gzungs dang bstod pa rnams brjod par bya'o/ /'phags ma sgrol ma stobs mo che/ /khyed kyi gsang sngags rjes dran pas/ /'chi bdag gnod pa zhi gyur nas/ /zhabs kyi rdul la reg par shog /'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis ⑩byin gyis brlabs pa/paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa 'chi ba bslu ba rdzogs so// //cog gru lo tsā ⑪ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //14—1029

bsdur mchan/1༷28 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈'dir 〉stan kyub ki/ ②〈snar 〉〉ljangs/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gig mis/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dmigs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wasu/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉sno)/1༷29 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stogos/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ṇi/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan khyu/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ning / me〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉kum/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bza'/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉khang / ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sgrosgom/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉7)/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉mi lo tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (531)14wa 1030

don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba bstod pa'i rgyal po/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+yā ②tā ra de bī ④sto tra sarba arba sā dha na nā ma sto tra rā dza/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma lha mo sgol ma'i bstod pa don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba bstod pa'i rgyal po/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba skar ma'i tshogs ltar rjomakha' la mdzes/ /mgon po sems dpas bskor cing 'gro na'ang ⑤mdzes—/ /zla ba dri med gdung ba sel ba bzhin/ /mi shes kun spangs 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / /bsam gtan ting 'dzin rnam thar mang po can/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyis brgyan pa la/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus rjorab tu brgyan/ /srung byed gsum dang ma 'dres dran gsum dang / /mi 'jigs bzhi brnyes yongs su dag bzhi mnga'—/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal ldan skye la thugs rje che/ /bag chags kun 14—1031

bcom mi bsnyel ①rnam kun bcom/ /rigs lngas sdenyon mongs lnga bcom ye shes lnga / /sku lnga mngon par byang chub rnam lnga brnyes/ /lam lnga sbyong mdzad sangs rgyas lnga yi sku/ /phung po lnga spangs zag zad mngon shes lnga/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi snying po khyod/ /yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas rgyu yi mchog /chags sdang bral yang ①'gro ba'i don gyi phyir/ /cha lugs rnam pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa khyod—/ /sna tshogs phrin rjolas sku mdog ljang gu ⑤can/ /dbu la 'od dpag med pas rab tu brgyan/ /'khor los rjosgyur ba'i rgyal po'i cha lugs can/ /'gro ba'i ded dpon sgol ma khyod kyi sku/ /mdzes pa'i ral pa dbu rgyan cod pan dang / /dar dpyangs zla tshes sna tshogs rdo rjes mdzes/ /rna rgyan mgul rgyan dpung rgyan gdu bu dang / /ska rags zhabs gdub ba da'i smad dkris mdzes/ /rin chen nor bus spras pa'i do shal dang / /dpung rgyan se mo dos ni shin tu brgyan| /bcos bu'i ras dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i/ /dar dang lha yi dar zab na bza' mnabs/ /pad+ma'i rigs ni pad+ma las 'khrungs can/ /sna tshogs pad+ma mchog gi gdan la bzhugs/ /chags dang ⑦zhe sdang gti mug la sogs kyis/ /ma gos pad+ma dmar po bzhin du dag /dbang po gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin dang / /'byung po me lha rlung lha srin po dang / /sa bdag steng gi lha tshogs ma lus rnams/ /phyogs skyong 'gro don sprul mdzad khyod kyi sku/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug lha chen dang / /drag po zhi ba u ma la sogs las—/ /rgyal gyur ⑧lha yi lha ste sgrol ma khyed/ /khams gsum kun gyi dbang phyug chen por grags/ /thod pa mi 'chang thugs rje'i thod pa can/ /ral pa rnam ⑨spangs shin tu dga' bas mdzes/ /g.yang gzhi dang bral mtshan dang dpe 14—1032

byad spras/ /thal bas ma bskus byams pas khyab pa'i bdag /dbyu ①gu gsum spangs bslab pa gsum dang ldan/ /dur khrod gnas der ④chos kyi dbyings su rol—/ /rked phran cang te'u la sogs sgra spangs nas/ /gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cus chos kun sgogs/ /tshangs skud mi bsnams mya ngan 'das pa'i sku//mtshan spyod spangs nas dus gsum ①mnyam par spyod/ /log sred las ⑦byung gdung ba'i dka' thub spangs/ /dam pa'i brtul zhugs ma lus rab tu ldan/ /mtshon cha dor nas shes rab mtshon cha bsnams/ /zhe sdang rnam ⑤spangs sgrub pa'i rtsa rgyun gcod/ /phyogs 'dzin mi mnga' grub mtha' kun gyi bdag /chags pa mi mnga' kun la mkha' ltar spyod/ /mtha' spangs nam mkha' lta bur byed kyi thugs/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad khyod kyi sku/ /sgra dang brjod par snang ba thams cad gsung / /sgrol ma chos kun bsdus 0pa'i snying po can—/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod dang / /dgug dang dgar dang sde rengs ⑦bskrad pa dang / /lkugs dang tshig 'phrog gzugs sgyur bsrung la sogs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi phrin ⑧las can/ /sku yi dbang phyug gsung gi dbang phyug dang / /thugs kyi dbang phyug 'dod yon dbang phyug ldan//rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro yon tan brgyad dang ldan/ /chos sku mkha' ltar dbyer med rtogs gyur kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon lta bur 'gro la ston/ /ji srid dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po mchog /sgol ma 'gro ba 'khor ba'i gzeb las grol⑨—/ /gang gis dran na ngan song 'jigs pa dang / /rgyal po rkun po me chus 'jigs pa dang / /seng ge stag sbrul srin po'i 'jigs las sgol/ /'byung ba 'a gas dang gdon gyis bskyed pa yis⑩/ /srog 'phrog nad kyi bye 14—1033

brag ma lus dang / /drang srong mkha' 'gro'i dmod gyur kun las sgrol/ /nor bu sngags dang sman sbyor 'dod pa bzhin/ /'gro la 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub kun/ /mos pas dran pa rnams la spyod ba yin/ /rgyal srid 'dod pas g.yul ngor rgyal ba dang / /longs spyod grags pa 'dod pa de dag dang / /bkur ba'i dri ngas bral 'dod spyod pa yin/ /gang gis bstod pas bde gshegs kun la bstod/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi babyed ①mdzad ma/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas ma lus khyod kyi sku/ /rje btsun sgrol ma yon tan phung po can—/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug la sogs dang / /drag po zhi ba u ma dkar sham ①sogs/ /skul byed lu gu rgyud dang khro gnyer can/ /mā ma khri dang spyan dang gos dkar mo/ /'gro ba gang gis 'dul ba de don du/ /ji ltar khyad 'phags brjid pa'i cha lugs can/ /thabs tshul rnam pa mtha' yas ston pa'i sku/ /'gro ba'i skyabs mchog rje btsun sgol ma mchog /spyi bor 'od dpag med bzhugs phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa brgyad skyob sgrol ma'i sku la 'dud—/ /grags pa mtha' yas sgrol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /'gro don sgrub pa sgrol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /sdug bsngal nges sel sgol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /phyag stong spyan stong sgol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /mkha' ltar mtha' yas sgrol ma'i sku la 'dudaske/ /mtshan dang gdapes brgyan sgrol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /zla 'dra'i yan lag sgol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /nyi ma ltar gsal sgrol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /dus gsum 'gyur med sgol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /sa ltar rten gyur rjosgrol ma'i sku la 'dudaske/ /chu ltar bsil dumadzad sgrol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /me ltar smin mdzad sgol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /rlung ltar rgyas mdzad sgrol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /sman 14—1034

pa'i rgyal po sgrol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /sman ltar nad 'joms sgol ma'i sku la 'dud—/ /thugs rje'i chu rgyun sgol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /'dul ba'i thabs mkhas sgrol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /sgeg kyang chags bral sgrol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /thar pa'i lam ston sgrol ma'i sku la 'dud/ /stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i chos kyi sgra—/ /'gro ba ma lus pa la nges sgrogs pas/ /mu stegs ri dwags skrag mdzad seng ge che/ /rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi phyed rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhags pa dang / /chos sgrogs dung dang shes rab mda' 'dzin dang / /'dren pa'i lcags kyu yid 'ong ut+pa la/ /snying rje gzhu dang lta ngan ①sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /thugs kyi rnam par dag pa brda tshul du/ /rdo rje la sogs rtag tu ⑦byin brlabs pa'i/ /phyag brgyad mtshan ma brgyad kyis rab brgyan pa'i//rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje sgrol ma rin chen sgrol ma dang / /pad+ma'i sgol ma las kyi sgrol ma dang / /bdug pa'i sgrol ma me tog sgrol ma dang / /mar me'i sgol ma dri yi ①sgol ma dang / /lcags kyu'i sgrol ma zhags pa'i sgrol ma dang / /lcags sgrog sgol ma dril bu'i sgol ma dang / /bcu gnyis 'khor lo'i tshogs kyis rab bskor ba'i/ /rje btsun sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na pad+ma spyod la phyag 'tshal lo//spyan ras gzigs dbang khyod rjol phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod zhags pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro rgyal rta mgrin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa brgyad skyob khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag stong spyan stong khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje bcu gcig zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang phyug chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje chos chen khyod 14—1035

la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid don mchog khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten dbang rab khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje spyan rgyas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ral pa gcig ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo khro gnyer can la phyag 'tshal lo//thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bud med sgyu 'phrul khyod la phyag 'tshal lo| /ku ru kul+le ①khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo gos dkar khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re swā hā/ gang zhig sdom pa de bzung nas/ /sgrol ma'i sku gzugs spyan sngar ni/ /khrus byas dang bas rtse gcig gis/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis bstod nas/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod 'di byas na//rje btsun sgrol ma zhal bstan nas/ /gdung ba thams cad sel ba dang / /dngos grub ma lus byin brlab 'gyur/ /zla ba yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la/ /lci ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rje btsun sgrol ma mchod byas nas/ /bstod dang gsang sngags 'di bzlas na/ /mgon po bzhin du bdag 'gyur te/ /sgrib pa rnams dang bral ba dang / /dri ngas skur ba dag pa dang / /rgyud gsum yon tan ma lus 'grub/ /rgyal po g.yul du 'jug pa'i tshe/ /spyi bor snying po 'di bcangs na/ /bstod dang gsang sngags 'di brjod na/ /dgra bo 'dod sbyin ②dbang du 'gyur/ /bud med gang zhig bud med kyi/ /dngos po las ni bral 'dod dang / /'jig rten dgos pa mchog dang ni/ /'jig rten 'das pa grub 'dod pas/ /khrus byas gos dkar bgos nas ni/ /bsnyen nas ⑧bsrung bar nges gnas te/ /yar ngo'i tshes brgyad mchod bstod bzlas/ /de dag the tshom rjomed par 'grub/ /'phags ma lha mo sgol ma la bstod pa/ don thams cad grub ⑤pa zhes bya ba rjobastod pa'i rgyal po rdzogs so// //⑦14—1036

bsdur mchan/1031 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉losnar 〉〉sngag /'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma'i bstod pa bzhugs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mo45/ ③〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stab/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉rang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉jang / 0〈〈pe 〉thacus/1032 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brnyes/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉snga/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉bul/ 〈〈snar 〉stab bral/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉'phrin/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skabu/ rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉tha/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sdung / ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉'gyur/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉rams/1022 ①〈〈pe mi'i'adir 〉stanabyug ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉dor/ ②〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉thun/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉—las/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉rams/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sdus/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉ringangs ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toraphrin/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stanaseb lam sgrol/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉bskyed pa yi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉skyed pa yi/1༷24 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉skyed/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉sku ma ka ra sham la/ ③〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉po/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉'gyur/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉skaradzin/1༷35 ①〈〈pe 〉'i〈snar 〉〉ba'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉muḥgs su/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉nyadil bu'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉de/1026 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉ku le/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzhin/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stananas/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉tsam/⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉toragrub/ 0〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉spra/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉〉slob dpon mā tre miṭas bstod pa'o// //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (532)14wa 1037

༄ga /'phags pa sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rim pas rje btsun sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya khrumā yā dzā la kra men bhaṭ+wā ra ka tā re ①sā dha na/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rim pas rje btsun sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /re zhig dang por rnal 'byor pas yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug la/ sems can thams cad la dmigs nas/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms kyi mtshan nyid kyi tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o//de'i rjes la rang gi snying gar sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge t+t+waṃ marka ta'i mdog can 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ 'od zer gyi rtse mo las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pas nam mkha' gang bar bsgoms la/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis go rims bzhin du/dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / gnas pa'i ngo bor 14—1038

gzhug par bya'o/ /bcug pa'i rjes la yi ge t+t+waṃ las byung ba t+t+waṃ gis ①byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang in+d+ra rī la'i 'od lta bu bsgoms la/ rdo rje de las rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i khams ②ma lus pa kun du ④khyab par spros pa bsgom mo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la yang / rdo rje de nyid las byung ba'i me tog dang / spos dang / mar me dang /dri dang / lha bshos dang / na bza' dang rgyan la sogs pa dag rgya che ba bsnams pa mtha' yas pas mchod nas/ de rnams kyi mdun du/ sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams ④la rjes su yi ⑤rang ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas par byas la/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas lta ba sna tshogs pa'i dra bas bcings pa'i sems kyi rgyun la dmigs nas—/ stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rang bzhin kyi dhibyang chub kyi sems bsgoms la sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa byed kolha⑦haṃ/ de nas rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba dang ⑧'di thams cad rang gi lus dang lhan cig tu nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsgom ⑨de nas sngags 'dis sngar bshad pa'i rdo rjer nga rgyal bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra byed kopho⑩haṃ/de nas yi ge hūṃ las rdo rje'i bdag nyid kha dog ser po'i sa gzhir bsgom mo/ /de nas steng du sna tshogs pad+ma la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yi ge tās byen gyis brlabs pa'i rdo rje/ de las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i ngo bor bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa nor bu marka ta'i mdog 'dra ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i cod pan can/ rtsa ba'i zhal don 14—1039

yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i ①skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o—/ /de la dbus ma'i zhal ni nor bu marka ta'i mdog can/ g.yas pa nag po/ g.yon pa dkar po'o/ /g.yas pa'i phyag dang po mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa| gnyis pa na ②rdo rje nag po/ gsum pa na mda'o/ /g.yon pa'i dang po sdogs mdzub mdzad pa/ gnyis pa la ut+pa la sngon po/ gsum pa la gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /ba spu'i khung bu re re nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyis nam mkha' gang ba sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas 'gro ba rnams kyi 'jigs pa thams cad sel ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma bsgoms la/ de nas byin kyis brlab ①par bya'o/ /de la spyi bo'i dbus su oṃ gyi ngo bo dkar po ④sku rdo rje'o / /mgrin par u'i ngo bo dmar po gsung rdo rje'o/ /snying gar hūṃ gi ngo bo nag po thugs rdo rje'o/ /brang la nor bu marka ta'i mdog can gyi yi ge t+t+waṃ ye shes sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bsgoms la/de nas sngags 'dis bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re swā hā/ bzlas pa byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spros la ji ltar nus pa ci yod kyis mchod par bya'oske/ /de la dkyil 'khor kyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun sgrol ma sngar bshad pa'i rim pas so/ /de la shar gyi 'dab ma la/ /oṃ satwa badz+re hūṃ/lho'i 'dab ma la/ oṃ rat+na badz+re hūṃ/ nub kyi 'dab ma la/ oṃ dharmā badz+re hūṃ/byang gi 'dab ma la/ oṃ karma badz+ra hūṃ/ me'i phyogs su/ oṃ mā le ⑤badz+re hūṃ/bden bral gyi phyogs su/ oṃ dhū pa badz+re hūṃ/ rlung gi phyogs su/ oṃ garnya badzi hūṃ/ dbang ldan gyi phyogs su/ oṃ rā sa badzi hūṃ/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su/ oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku shi hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pā shi hūṃ/ oṃ badzi sgo ṭi hūṃ/ oṃ 14—1040
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (523)14wa 1042

gyi sgrub thabs cho ga zhes bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+yā ②tā re maṇ+ḍa la bi dhi tsā ma sā dha ṭ+wāṃ/bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs cho ga zhes bya ba/dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi ni/ /pad+ma la gus phyag byas te/ /'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ /man ngag rgyud la brten pa bri/ /bla ma la gus dad pa che/ /byang chub sems dpa' snying rje che/ /rtog pa legs par 'joms pa des/ /rje btsun mnyes byas man ngag mnos—/ /dang por dbe+en zhing nyams dga' bar/ /nyer spyod yo byad rdzogs par bya/ /de nas byang chub sems bskyed la/ /phyag dang mchod dang gsol ba gdab / /rjes su yi rang bsngo ba sogs/ /byas te tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom—/ /de nas gzung 'dzin brtan g.yo kun/ /stong par byas te sngags bzlas bya①/ oṃ swa bhā ④ba shurtseḥsarba dharmāḥ⑤swa bhā rjowa shusto3haṃ/ zhes pas stong 14—1043

par bya'o/ /de yi ngang las hūṃ bsams te/ /ra ba gur dang phyogs mtshams bcing / /khro bo bcu yi srung 'khor bsgom/ /de steng e las chos 'byung bsam//lo baṃ re yi rnams ①las ni/ /sa chu me rlung dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de steng bye las 'khor lo 'o/ /der ni nā da babs pa las/ /bsgyur te gzhal yas khang bsam bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /ka ba brgyad mdzes rgyan ldan bsam/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ta la badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kopho②haṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nang paṃ las pad+ma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa 'phar ma gnyis/ /dbus su ā li kā li las/ /nyi zla ga 'ur bsam par bya/ /dbus su yi ge t+t+waṃ ser bsam /de ltar kā li ar gyur pas/ /mnyam sbyar de gnyis gyur par bsam oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rasto badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kolha①haṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar dbus kyi tā rjolas ni/ /shar gyi nyi ma'i bar du ni/ /yi ge oṃ gyi rnam par spros/ /lhor ni tā dang nub tu re/ /byang du rgyu yi yi ge spro/ /de nas sgo yi phyogs dag tu/ /tā re tu dang re bzhi rjospro/ /steng du tā dang re gnyis spro/ /'od zer 'phros pas sems can sbyangs/ /lhar byas sa bon thim pa las/ /rang rang sa bon gyis mtshan pa'i/ /rdo rje me tog phreng ba yis/ /mar me kong pyabu dung chos dang / /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgog dang / /dril bu rnams su gyur par bsam/ /de las 'od 'phros sbyang bsdus la/ /lha mo rnams su bsam par bya'o/ /de las dbus su lha mo sgol ma ni/ /phyag brgyad zhal bzhi kha dog ser—/ /rgyan ldan mdangs sdug lang tshor ldan/ /mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos brgyan/ /g.yo zhing pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /rdo rje de bzhin zhags pa dang / /mdung dang mda' ni g.yas na bsnams/ /rdo rje lcags kyu ut+pa la/ /14—1044

gzhu dang sdigs mdzub g.yon pa na/ /skyid krung byed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs/ /sa gsum dbang du sdud pa bsam/ /de yi shar du me tog gi/ /sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gcig ma/ /phyag gnyis me tog phreng ba 'dzin/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis spras par bsam/ /lhor ni spos kyi sgol ma ste/ /kha dog nag mo spos 'dzin ma//nub tu mar me'i sgrol ma ste/ /ser zhing mar me'i snod 'dzin ma/ /byang du dri yi sgol ma ste/ /ljang gu dri yi ①dung chos bsnams/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su bsgom ②par bya'o/ /de nas shar sgor sgo skyong dkar/ /lcags kyu 'dzin pa bsam par bya/ /lhor ser zhags pa ①bsam par rjobya/ /nub dmar lcags kyi sgog 'dzin ma/ /byang du ljang gu dril bu'o/ /de rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma—/ /rin chen rgyan gyis legs spras shing / /g.yo bcas gser gyi rna chas brgyan⑤—/ /spyan gnyis lang tsho phun sum tshogs/ /steng du rnam par sgrol ma ste//'og tu gnod mdzes sgrol ma'o/ /'khor lo sbrul zhags bsnams pa bri/ /de ltar thams cad mtshan nyid mtshungs/ /de nas skye mched dag la ni/ /mig gnyis rna ba gnyis dang sna/ /lce dang lus dang yid rnams su/ /me rda i dang re saṃ rgo/ /gti mug zhe sdang ser sna la/ /'dod chags phrag dog bdag med la—/ /gnag dang dmar dang ser mo sngo/ /ljang khu 0dkar mo rnams bsams te—/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ldan pa'o/ /sku la oṃ las mkha' spyod ma/ /sa spyod bdag med ma gsum las/ /rdo rje gsum po bsam par bya⑦/ /de nas 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ /rang bzhin gyi ni zhing khams nas/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs lha mo rnams/ /'gugs pas dgug gzhug bcings mnyes bya⑧/ /de nas sems dpa' gsal bar lta/ /14byed1045

slar yang 'od zer 'phros pa las/ /sangs rgyas rigs lnga spyan drangs la/ /mchod bstod gsol ba gdab par bya/ /de nas dbang bskur rgyas btab ste/ /rtse mo rigs lnga rnam par mtshan/ /gzhan rnams rang gi rigs kyis gdab/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣe ka badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kolha①haṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o//de nas sa bon las spros pa'i/ /lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū skedza me gha badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kolha⑧haṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rigs kyi rjos bon las/ /bdud rtsi lce la blangs byas te/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ⑤a mṛ rjota badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kolha⑦haṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas bstod pas legs bstod de/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ⑧badz+ra swa bhā ba nā kolha⑨haṃ—/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gsal la yang dang yang du blta'o/ /de nas sngags bzlas pa ni/ na maḥ āt+yā wa ⑩lo ki ti shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tā re turtswa re tu re/ sarba duṣ+ṭhan⑪—/ bra duṣ+ṭhan⑫/ ma ma kṛ ⑫te/ dze+e bha ya/ ste bha ④ya/ mo ha ⑫ya/brnya ⑫ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭan ⑩ste bha ⑫ni tā re swā hā/oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ phar phyin bcu yi lha mo la/ /yi ge bcu pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /bsnyen pa bye bas 'grub 'gyur zhing / /las la rang sngags khri bzlas so/ /de nas skyo na rnam dag bsgom/ /gtor ma byas te lha gshegs la/ /ci bde ba yi spyod pas gnas/ /de ltar yang dang yang goms pas—/ /gcan gzan ⑪bsrung dang dbang du bya/ /bskrad dang bud med dgug pa dang / /bcings pa grol dang tshar bcad dang / /bsreg dang mnan pa bsrung ba sogs/ /rgyud thos man ngag ldan pas bsgrub/ /bla ma mnyes pa 14—1046
bsdur 'bras ze'u mig da/(534)14wa 1048

ske — —ma' sgrub pa' thabs zhas bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+yā ②bi d+dhi shwa ri sā dha rgo ①tsā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma gnas kyi dbang phyug ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ /'phags ma gnas kyi dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gsang ba bdag gis bshad/ /gsang ba'i de nyid man ngag ste/ /cho ga snga dro langs nas ni/ /snying rjes brlan pa'i sems kyis su/ /yid ni g.yo ba med bya ste/ /sems can thams cad gnod rjobya'o/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni blangs nas su/ /thod par rtog med sems kyis bzhag⑤ /rlung dang me yi steng du ni/ /dag dang khol dang tshos par bya/ /nor 'dzin maṇ+ḍal byas nas ni/ /byang chub yan lag rab tu sbyin/ /'jam pa'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /rab brtan rdo rje skyil krung bcas—/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya yang dag bya/ /khams gsum stong pa nyid du bltarjo / /'di ni thams cad rmi lam 'dra/ /nye bar rnyed pa gang yang med/ /14byed1049
