dri za'i grong khyer rnam pa 'dra/ /'gro ba sgyu mar bltas pa'o/ /thugs ka'i nam mkha'i dbus gnas par/ /ye shes zla ba dri med bya/ /dbus su tai ①yig bsam mi khyab/ /'od zer lnga ldan 'bar ba yis/ /phyogs bcur gnas pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sgol ma'i gzugs rnams rnam bsgom bya/ /de rnams spyan drangs byin gyis brlab/ /ye shes sku ni rjes su dran/ /de na ②sems can thams cad la/ /ye shes 'od zer rnam dag bya/ /sangs rgyas de nyid rab gnas bya/ /byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /myur du sangs rgyas sgrol ma can//nam mkha' yi ni mdun du blta/ /ye shes mchod pa sna tshogs pa/ /ye shes las ni skyes pas bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /sems can thams cad don byas te/ /cho ga gsum gyi sbas pa'i sdig /bla ma'i mdun du rab tu bshags/ /sdig pa thams cad grol bdag nyid/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'o/ /bdag nyid sgol ma'i rnam par bya/ /'gro kun de bzhin sgrol ma ru//bltas nas sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /byin brlabs sa bon de rab bzhugs/ /chos rnams rnam ①rtog bral ba dang / /rang bzhin med cing bdag med rnams/ /dbyer med rnal 'byor pas gzigs bya/ /sngags 'di dag ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥrjoswa bhā wa shurnyophohaṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shu ⑤n+ya tā sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shurnyo3haṃ/ oṃ shu 0n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kophodze+ehaṃ/ nam mkha'i khams zla dbus gnas par/ /stong pa nyid kyi ye shes mchog /de yi lte ba'i dbus na ⑧ni/ /zla bar haṃ yig ye shes so/ /rdo rje'i rlung dang me dang chu/ /de nas sa yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /ri rab dang ni hūṃ ⑨las byung / /gzhal yas khang ni rnam par blta/ /de yi dbus su pad+mar gnas/ /lte ba ge sar 'bar 14—1050

ba'o—/ /'dab ma brgyad ldan dga' ba'o/ /rnam pa sna tshogs yid 'phrog pa'i//de phyir 'bar ba'i 'khor lo ste/ /rtsibs ni bcu gnyis shin tu mdzes/ /thig ni lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /de yi sgo ni bzhi pa la/ /lha yi rta ①babs rnam bzhi'o—/ /me long la sogs rnams kyis brgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa'o/ /gnas skyes rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'o/ /phyogs skyong mgon po rnams spyan drangs/ /byang sems de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /ye shes rlung gis dgug par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma kun dga' byed rnams/ /kun mkhyen til gyi gang bu ②rnams/ /zla bar rab tu zhugs par bsgoms①/ /de gyur pa las bdag nyid ni/ /lha mo sgol mar bsgom par bya/ /sku mdog dmar la zhal bzhi pa/ /phyag ni brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /nyi ma 'char ka brgya yi ngang dhi/ /dang po'i zhal ni dran par bya/ /dri med nam mkha'i rang bzhin sngo/ /g.yas kyi zhal ni dran par bya/ /sha ka sa la sha bzhin ljang / /g.yas kyi zhal ni yid dga' bas/ /de ltar dkon mchog gsum drag po/ /rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal 'jigs byed/ /cung zad mche ba gatshigs pa po/ /mi sdug de nas bsgom par bya/ /ser po zhi ba steng gi zhal/ /rgyan kun kyis ni brgyan pa'o/ /thod pa'i phreng bas dbu brgyan pa'o⑤/ /ye shes lnga ni nye bar mdzes—/ /de ltar de ni gzi brjid che/ /zhal bzhi par ni bsam gtan bya/ /thod pa rdo rje ral gri dang / ḍa ma ru g.yas phyag na bsnams/ /yid bzhin nor bu kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /dril bu de bzhin ut+pal dmar/ /de yi g.yon par bsgom par bya/ /de yi brla la yod pa ni/ /stag gi sham thabs gyon pa'o/ /skyil krung ⑦phyed pa'i gar byed pa/ /sna tshogs pad+ma zla dbus gnas/ /rnying rje'i khro 14—1051

ba 'jigs byed ma/ /spyan gsum dmar po bgrad pa'o/ /drag po g.yon phyogs lta bar byed/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la rtag gnas/ /gnas rnams kyang ni dgug pa'i mchod/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs dbus gnas par/ /bde ba thams cad rab sbyin pa'o/ /pū ①dza o ⑦a go ra de ma/ /ka o tri ko ka la 1nyi| /pre gri rjosau su na si ma ku/ /de ltar yi ge nyi shu bzhi/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams ⑤dkyil 'khor rorjo/ /lus la cho ga'i cho ga yis/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rab tu 'grub/ /mtshog ⑦kha spyi bo rna ba g.yas/ /ltag pa g.yon gyi rna ba dag /smin mtshalas dang ni spyan dang ni/ /dpung pa'i rtsa gnyis de bzhin no⑧//mchan khung gnyis dang nu ma gnyis/ /lte ba'i sna yi rtse mo dang / /kha dang mgul la go cha bya/ /snying ga ⑨dang ni mdoms ⑩dang ni/ /gsang gnas bshang lam de bzhin brla/ /pus mo go rims ⑪ji bzhin no/ /dang po su ra te shwa ri ti/ /gnyis par su ra ta ⑫son+ta ri/ /gsum pa su ra ta tsan+d+ra ⑫dang / /bzhi pa su ra ta ma li ⑫ni/ /lnga pa su ra ta bha k+ṣi'o/ /drug pa su ra ta ka mi ni//bdun pa su rata u gra dang / /brgyad pa su ra ta ut+ta ⑫ma/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas song bsgom/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rab tu gyur/ /dkar dang ljang dang sngo ba dang / /bzhi pa sku mdog ser po dang / /ser dang dkar dang dmar ba dang / /sku mdog sngon po brgyad pa'o/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin//dril bu ḍa ma rus brgyan pa'o/ /thod pa'i phreng bas dbu brgyan pa'o/ /rgyan ni thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ /rin chen ye shes steng dbus brgyan/ /de rnams pad+ma'i 'dab mar gnas/ /shi khi bhi ma shi khaṇ+ḍi⑩/ /ke rā lī ⑩de bzhin dza ti li/ /u ṭi dzi ṭa de bzhin tsaṇ+ḍi/ /moṇ+ḍi ⑫bi ka ḍo u ⑪ti/ /ki ri ḍi 14—1052

na ra te ki dang ngo / /zhing dang nye zhing tshan do ha/ /de bzhin nye ba'i tshan do ha / /'du ba nye ba'i 'du ba'o/ /gnas ni de rnams gnas pa yi/ /lha mo bcu gnyis bsgom par bya/ /phyed dmar phyed ni ljang ba rnams/ /thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa rnams/ /skra grol ba dang khro gnyer can/ /rtag pa'i mchog ni dbu rgyan rnams/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag gzhan 'khor lo rdo rje'o/ /shaṃ pu tsi dang puk+ka ste / /ḍom+bi de bzhin ma tai gi/ /bzhi ni sna tshogs mdog rnams so/ /sgo srung skekhro gnyer chen mo'o/ /mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal mnga' ba/ /g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang nges par gnas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /mi bskyod pa yi dam tshig ste/ /dbu rgyan steng du rgyan rnams so/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ /phyag mtshan ①gri gug mgo bo bsnams/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis ④lus brgyan pa/ /bdud bzhi'i steng du yang dag gnas/ /thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa rnams/ /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod rnams/ /dad sogs dbang po rnam par dag /snying rje ldan pa bsgom par bya/ /thams cad gcer bu 'dzin pa rnams/ /snying rje'i dga' ma mdzes pa rnams/ / lte ba'i ⑤dbus su yang dag gnas/ /lha mo sgrol ma rnam par bsgom/ /pur ti shwa ra'i sde rnams ni/ /rim dang rim min bskor ba'o/ /'khor lo rtsibs chen bcu gnyis la/ /shi khi la sogs nor bur dhibar/ /rim dang rim pa min pa'o/ /'gro ba'i bdag mo rnam par ⑦dgod| /rkang pa bkug dang brkyang ba dang / /yang ni brkyang dang dgug pa'i bar/ /kai pu tsi sogs sgo rnams su/ /g.yon du bskor bar rnam par dgod| /de ltar rdzogs pa'i sgrub pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor gnas dang yang 14—1053

dag 'brel/ /de nas cho ga rab tu phye/ /rigs lnga po ni bsgom ①par bya/ /spyi bor bye yig dkar po ste/ /mgrin pa'i byāḥni nyi ma'i mdog /bye yig nag po thugs ka ru/ /a ni lte bar gser gyi mdog /gsang ba'i gnas su khaṃ ljang gu—/ /bsgoms ④shig rnam pa'i ④cho ga'o/ /'khor pad rdo rje rin chen mchog /sna tshogs rdo rje 'di rnams gnas/ /rnal 'byor ma ni thams cad la//cho ga des ni cho ga bya/ /thugs ka'i sa bon 'od lcags kyus/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'khor lor dgug /ba spu'i sgo rnams pad+ma gnas/ /mchod pa'i lha mo rang las sprul/ /dad pa mchog gis yang dag mchodarjo/ /yang ni rang la gzhug par bya/ /de nas dbang bskur gsol ba gdab/ /bde gshegs rnams ni dngos grub ster/ /ji ltar bltams ⑤pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yisadu/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ/ sarba tiṣ+ṭha ⑦a rnyi ṣe ka sa ma ya hri dze+eye hūṃ/ oṃ sarba tiṣ+ṭha ⑨a bhi ṣe ka ta sho dhi sho dha ā ki sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sarba burtse a dhiṣ+ṭṛ te swā hā/ ma lus sems can thams cad rnams/ /sgrol ma'i gzugs su nges lta bar/ /sgom sbyor gyis ni sgom gyis shig /bsgom pa sgom min skad cig tsam//gnas kyi man ngag rim gyis dang / /bla ma'i rnal 'byor ma rim gyis/ /man ngag dam tshig rnyed pa ste/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi mchog sbyin gyis/ /ye shes rtog pa bsgom bdag nyid/ /ye shes rtog pa sgom gyis shig /rtog pa bral ba med pa ni/ /ye shes ma yin rtog pa min⑩/ /chos kyi bdag nyid mnyam pa nyid/ /rang gzhan med cing yi ge med/ /sku mdog 'das dang rnam pa med/ /ring po ma yin klum po min/ /de nyid 'byung po thams cad rnams/ /rnal 'byor 14—1054

ye shes yid med pa/ /de ni de nyid bzlas pa yis/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug thob pa'o/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re hūṃ phaṭa/ de ltar dam tshig sngags yin te/ /bcom ldan 'das mas rab tu bshad/ /dang po oṃ dang de nas ming / /hūṃ phaṭa yi ge yang dag ldan/ /zlos shig lha mo rnams kyi sngags/ /thams cad la ni mchod pa'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs rim pa bzhin/ /sgo ①rnams la 'ang dran par bya / /oṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sngar bshad pa yi ming ldan pa/ /cho ga 'di yis yang dag bzla②/ /oṃ t+t+waṃ twe sdekhaṃ hūṃ lo me saṃ tram̐ dza/ phung po khams rnams dag pa'o//oṃ 66hūṃ lus ngag yid gsum dag pa yi/ /sngar bshad cho gas bsngags pa yis/cho ga 'bum phrag gcig bzlas bya/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam dag don/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zad don du/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams rtag tu ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni lha bshos te/ /dus kun rnal 'byor rnams kyi ni/ /dud 'gro bsad nas mchod par bya/ /sngags pas tsā ru'i bsgrub pa rjobya/ /rnal 'byor ma ldan bza' bar bya/ /bza' dang bza' min bza' bar bya/ /btung dang btung min rtag tu btung ⑤/ /bya dang bya min bya ba'o/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs dkyil 'khor du/ /sdig pa yis ni mi reg go/ /mnyam nyid bstan pa'i chos nyid do/ /rnal 'byor bla med nor bu'o/ /gsang ba bla med bla med do/ /rab snang min pa bshad min bya/ /skye ba 'di la grub pa thob/ /srog gcod la sogs spangs pa ste/ /brdzun dang phra ma dumi bya'o/ /blo ni sems can don du bya/ /de ni rnal 'byor thob pa'o/ /dge ba bcu ni nges par bya/ /de bzhin tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang / /sbyin pa la sogs gtong la dga'/ /mnyes shing mchog ni sgrub pa'o/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor bla med bsgom/ /ji ltar blo yi rim pa ltar//14—1056

rnal 'byor sogs bdag —la 'byor ma/ /rigs rim ji ltar bstan bcos so/ /ri dwags thogs pa sna tshogasapad nyi la/ /sgrol ma bdag nyid bsgom bya ba/ /sna tshogs mdog dang zhal bzhi pa/ /g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang gnas pa ste/ /dbus kyi zhal ni ljang gu la/ /g.yas ni ser bar blta bar bya/ /g.yon gyi zhal ni sngo ba la/ /steng gizhal ni dkar ba'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mche ba gatshigs / /thod pas dbu la brgyan pa mo/ /dbu la don yod grub pas brgyan—/ /mi yi rus pa'irgyan gyis ①brgyan/ /skra grol mig ni yangs pa mo /spyan gsum dmar mo mdzes ma ste/ /ral gri rdo rje gsor ba ste/ /'khor lo lcags kyu 'dzin pa mo/ /driwa bu thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /gri gug mgo bo'i lag pa gzhan/ /ut+pal thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /tshangs pa'i pags ②pa steng du gnas/ /khyab 'jug dbang phyug che zhabs dag /mnan pas gdan ①la 'jigs rung 'gyur/ /sngor sgos rnal 'byor ma tshogs rnams/ /reg gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /de rnams thams cad sna tshogs mdog /gcer bu 'jigs pa'i rjes su song / /gsang ba zab mo bla med sngags/ /dbu rgyan dpal rim lasabyung ba/ /rnal 'byor ma gnas thams cad la/ /rim pa yang dag spyod pa mazog /gnas kun bla med mnyam sbyor te/ /rnal 'byor ma thugs bla na med/ /lha mo'i las ni thams cad byed/ /dag pa sdig pa sel bar byed/ /mnyarmugozhag med pa'i sgrub pa yis/ /rnal 'byor bsgom pa sgom pa ste/ /sngags 5sa rtag tu bsam gtan gang / /nyon mongs ma lus zad par 'gyur/ /g.yodang si g.yo sa gzhir ro/ /de yi rnal 'byor che rnams spyod/ /gnas kyi jo ga grub bdag nyid/ /ji ltar bde bas spyad par bya//14—1056

hūṃ thugs kar ro/ /oṃ mtshog ①khar ro/ /dz+rīḥspyi bor ro/ /hūṃ spyan la'o/ /hūṃ go cha'o/ /phaṭa phyag mtshan la'o/ /go cha'i go cha 'dir shes bya/ /rim pa'i rjes su rim pa ni/ /bdag nyid yi dam lha grub bdag /'gro ba ma lus de ltar blta/ /srid pa'i dba' rlabs sgrol sgrol ma/ /bsgom pa bzlas pa rtag tu bya/ /dur khrod dam ni shing gcig gam/ /ri yi rtse mo sa phug khyim/ /khyim mam smad 'tshong gnas su 'am/ /gzhan yang / rgyal po'i khab tu'am rtags gcig ⑤drung / /phyi yi nags tshal shi ba'i gnas/ /rgya mtsho dang ni chu mig rnams / /ma mo'i gnas su nges par gnas/ /gang yang lon med grub pa'o/ /thogs med rtag tu sbyang bar bya/ /rnal 'byor de yis sgom pa rnams/ /gnas kyi sde yi rnal 'byor ma/ /rigs kyi rdo rje skyes pa 'ang rung / /ye shes rdo rje'i sgom pa 'ang / /rim pa sde yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /bla yi sde yi ③rjes rim pa'o/ /byang chub sems ni rab brtan ༷bya/ /thams cad shin tu rab brtan ⑤blo/ /bden ༷min rnam par rtog pa bral/ /yul chos rnam par spang bar ⑦bya/ /lus dang ngag yid sde yis ni/ /myur du de gsung dngos grub ⑧thob/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /oṃ yig dag ni rnam par bsgom/ /spyi bo'i steng du song bar lta/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi char phab po/ /ji ltar rnal 'byor rab tu bya/ /u pa ha ra dbul bar bya/ /der ni rnal 'byor rnal 'byor gyis//skad cig tsam gyis gzi brjid 'grub/ /rnal 'byor thams cad sel bar byed/ /ji ltar rdo rje sems dpa'i ⑨gtam/ /sgrol ma'i gzugs ni gzugs chen mo/ /bsgoms shig de nyid yang dag don/ /baṃ yig khar song bsgom par bya /oṃ ni lce yi rtse mor blta/ /thams cad bza' ba'i gnas yin cing / /yid 14—1057

bzhin nor bu mchog bzhin no/ /zhi ba thams cad sdug bsngal sel/ /ye shes sems dpa' rab bsgom bya/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig 'di bsgom de/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags pa che/ /gnas gsum grub pa thob par 'gyur/ /sgol ma'i lha mo rnal 'byor ldan/ /rdo rje gsang rgyud bla med du/ /rdo rje ldan mas bris pa'o/ /sems can ye shes 'phel ba'o/ /'phags ma gnas kyi dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyud las mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje ldan mas phyung ba rdzogs so// //thugs rje chen pos dbang lan gsum bskur ba'i grub thob wa ni ta bha dra'i slob ma saṃ gha ①shrī bha dra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ②ba 'jam dpal sgeg pa'i rdo rjes bsgyur ba'o/ /rdo rje ldan ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta ba ra he ta/ wa ni ta bha dra/ saṃ gha ①shrī bha dra/'jam dpal sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ mkhas pa sa phug pa// //14—1058
bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (525)14wa 1060

rtogs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī o ḍi ya na ②tā re kra mā ①nyi sa ma ya nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal u rgyan gyi sgol ma'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba—/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdug bsngal srid pa'i mun pa ni//sel bar byed pa'i nyi 'od can/ /thugs kar snying rjes ④brlan pa la/ /rtag tu bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig rnal 'byor pa'am rnal 'byor masaske/ bsam gtan gyi khang pa yid dang mthun par 'jam pa'i stan la 'dug nas—/ rang gi snying gar a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la t+t+waṃ yig dmar po las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas ma lus pa'i nam mkha'i ⑤'khor khyab par bsgom rjopar bya'o/ /de nas 'od zer gyi zhal mthong bar bya ba'i ma lus pa'i bla ma dang / yi dam gyi ⑦lha dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bltas te/de rnams la sems kyis mchod pa byas la/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 14—1061

'gro ba la sogs pa brjod de/ de nas brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i 'gro ba rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i bdag nyid dang ldan par blta'o/ /sngags brjod par bya'o//oṃ shu n+ya tā ①dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ②a kopho①haṃ/ de'i rjes su nam mkha' la pad+ma dang nyi ma gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las skyes pa'i khro ba'i rdo rjes bgegs rjobaskrad do/ /rdo rje ra ba bsgom par ⑤gnas pa'i chos 'byung gi dbus su gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ zla ba'i dbus su haṃ yig bltas te de nas haṃ yig las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spro bar bya ste/ bdag nyid sgrol ma'i gzugs su bsgom par bya'o/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal bzhi pa phyag brgyad pa gar byed pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pas smad g.yogs pa/ /rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi dbus na gnas pa/ spyan gsum ma—/ zhal khro gnyer can/ de'i dang po'i zhal dmar po g.yas kyi gnag pa/g.yon pa'i ljang pa/ steng du zhi ba ser po'i rjogayas pa'i phyag rnams na/ ḍa ma ru dang / thod pa dang / ral gri dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa na ut+pa la dang / rin po che dang / dril bu dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas tshogs pad+ma la lha mo brgyad/ su ra ti shwa ri dang / su ra ta son+ta ri/⑦su ra ta tsan+d+ra⑧/ su ra ta ma li ni/ su ra ta bha k+ṣi/ su ra ta ka mi ni/ su ra ta u gra/ su ra ta ut+ta ⑫ma/ dkar mo/ ljang gu/ sngon mo/ ser mo/dkar mo/ dmar mo/ sngon mo/ ser mo/⑩ ji ltar g.yas kyis ḍa ma ru dang ka pā la 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis ⑪dril bu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/khro gnyer can/ thod pa'i phreng ba can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/de'i phyi rol du ⑫'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa la shi khi rnyi ma/ shi khaṇ+ḍi/ ka 14—1062

rā lī/ dza ①ṭa lī/ ra u dra/ dzo ②ṭī/ tsatho/ ma u dhi/ bi ka ta/u ta ka ta/ ki ri ṭi/ narta ki/ de dag thams cad g.yon phyed dmar ba/g.yas phyed ljang gu/ g.yas na 'khor lo dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon na thod pa dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ zhal khro gnyer can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ skra grol ba/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dang / g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang gi gar gyis g.yas pa/ dang po g.yon dang / g.yas su 'gro ba/gzhan yang de'i phyi rol du sgo ④bzhi ma/ kai pu tsi/ puk+ka sīrjo/ ḍo bi nī⑤/ma tai gridu/ g.yas na gri gug dang ⑦thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas ⑧mgo bo dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ mche ba gcigs ⑨pa'i zhal/ sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ nyi ma'i gdan la g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang pas bdud bzhi'i steng du g.yon du bskor ba/ kha dog sna tshogs bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas gnas kyi cho ga bya ste/ de la mtshog ⑩kha/ spyi bo⑪/ rna ba g.yon/ ltag pa/ sog ⑫phrag /rna ba g.yas/ byun ma'i bar/ mig gnyis/ dpung pa/ mchan khung gnyis/ nu ma gnyis/ lte ba/ sna rtse/ kha/ ⑫thugs ka /lte ba'i 'og /gsang gnas/ bshang lam/ brla gnyis/ ngar gdong gnyis/ /rkang pa'i rting / rkang pa'i 'og /rkang pa'i mthe bong / pus mo gnyis la rim pa ji lta bar/ pu dzā o a/ go rā de mā/ kā ④o tri ko/ ka ⑫la kā hi/pre gre ⑩sau su/ na si ma ku/ pul+lī ⑩ra ma la yo/ dzā larnya spyoram̐/ oḍā yan⑩/arbu rda/ gnas dubazhi'o/ /go dā wa rī⑪/ rā ⑫me shwa ra/ de wī ko ṭi/mā la la / nye ba'i gnas bzhi'o/ /kā ma rū pabla/ o tre+ebla/ zhing gnyis so—/ /tro sha ku ne+e/ ko sa lo/ nye ba'i zhing gnyis so/ /ka lo ga⑪ /lo 14—1063

bā ①ka/ 'du ba gnyis so/ /kābye / nyi mā ①la yo/ nye ba'i 'du ba gnyis so/ /pre ta pu ri/ kṛ ④ha de ba ta/ ma la ya gnyis so/ /sau rāṭaṃ⑤/su war+ṇa dī rjopa/ nye ba'i ma la ya gnyis so/ /na ga re/ sirtse/ ⑦dur khrod gnyis so/ /ma ru ⑧di shaṃ/ ku lu tā⑨/ nye ba'i dur ⑩khrod gnyis so/ /mtshog ⑪kha/ thugs ka /lte ba/ gsang gnas⑫/ brla gnyis/ byin pa la rim pa bzhin du/ hūṃ hūṃ a hri khaṃ zhes bya ba ni go cha'o/ /de rdo rje pad+ma 'khor lo'i dbus su hūṃ s+dza.oṃ/ de ltar ye shes/ ye shes can gyis bsgom par bya'o—/ /de nas dbang bskur ⑫bar bya'o/ /lha mo'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa lnga④/ su ra ti shwa ri la sogs pa la/ dbu la rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /shi khi la sogs pa rnams la dbu la rnam par snang mdzad/ ka bu tsi la sogs pa rnams la dbu la mi bskyod pa'o/ /de nas ar+ghaṃ sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi myang bar bya'o/ /de la yi ram̐ las dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du pad+ma'i snod bdud rtsi lngas bkang nas sha /go ⑫ha a ma oṃ āḥhūṃ des byin gyis brlab po//de nas sngags bzlas pa ni/ yi ge bcu ⑩phaṭa mthar sbyang swā hā mthar spangs pa'o—/ /lha mo la bzlas pa byas pa thams cad la oṃ sngar ming gi yi ge mthar hūṃ phaṭa sngags bzlas so/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdang ldan pa sgo'i lha mo rnams la'o/ /bsgom pa las langs nas lha mo'i gzugs su 'dzin par ⑩bsgom par bya'o/ /ji ltar nus pas mchod pa'o/ /gtor ma sbyin pa'o/ /de la gtor ma'i sngags 'di'o—/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā hūṃ ār+ya nut+pan+d+ra tāta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba rtag tu byas na grub pa thob po/ /de la the tshom ma byed cig /bcom ldan 'das ma u rgyan gyi sgrol ma'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa rdzogs so// //14—1064
bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (536)14wa 1066

༄ga /u rgyan gyi sgol ma'i rim pa/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ o ḍān tā re ②kra ma/ bod skad du/ u rgyan kyi sgrol ma'i rim pa/ sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha rnams kun nam bcu gsum mam/ /dgu 'am lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /gtso bo 'ba' ①zhig bsgoms nas ni/ /sngags ni 'di rnams bzlas pa bya/ /oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra rjote shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra ta ⑤son+ta re hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra ta ⑦tsan+d+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra ta ka mi ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra ta u gra hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ su ra ta ut+ta ⑦ma hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shi khi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rnyi ma hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shi khaṇ+ḍi ⑧hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kā rā li hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzā ṭi li hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra u tri hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ dza ṭi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma urnyi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rnyi ka ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ uta sha ṭa ⑨hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ke re ṭi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ narte ki hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzaḥrka pu tsi hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ hūṃ puk+ka sī ⑩hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ me ḍom+bi ⑪ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ho ma lta gi ⑫hūṃ phaṭa/14byed1067

gsang sngags 'di rnams yang dag brjod/ /snying gi dbus su gtso mo ste/ / mtshog kha ①la sogs gnas rnams su/ /lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi bsgoms/ /slob ma rnams la nges par ni/ /lha rnams kun gyis byin gyis rlob/ /u rgyan gyi sgol ma'i rim pa gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta saṃ gha shrī sdedang / lo tsā ①ba 'jam dpal sgeg pa'i rdo rjes bsgyur ba'o// //oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re ④hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra te shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa la sogs pa'o/ /oṃ a sha pu tsa hūṃ phaṭa oṃ hūṃ la sogs pa'o/ /oṃ tā re turtswa re da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa⑤/ ma tha ma tha/ i me ba lo kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa ma ma sarba kar+ya ni/ swa da ya/swa da ya/ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gtor ma'i sngags so/ /ḍā ki ni rdo rje ldan ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta pa rjor nye ta/ grub thob — ni ta bha dra/ ⑦kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta saṃ bha ma he bha dra⑧/ 'jam dpal gsar ma des sa phug pa// //14—1068

༄ga /dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ maṇ+ḍa la a bhi ṣe ka ta bi dhiḥ⑤/ bod skad du/dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga /rje btsun sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang gis gang gsungs shing / /bla ma'i man ngag las 'ongs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad par bya/ /bsnyen pa sngon du song ba yis/ /sa rnams sbyang sogs byas nas ni/ /khro bo chen po bzlas bya zhing / /cho ga shes pas dkyil 'khor bya/ /rab tu drag pa'i gsang sngags dang / /go cha srad bu 'khor lo dang / /dum gcig rdo rje ra ba dang / /rab 'bar me dang khro bos srung ①/ /sa yi lha mo lhag gnas dang / / slob dpon spyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /bla ma dam par gsol 'debs kyis/ /bdag gi bla ma mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas maṇ+ḍal dbul ba lan gsum mo/ /rjosems bskyed pa dang gso sbyong dang / /14byed1070

nyi shu bzhi yis ①sdom pa drug /so shing dor dang rmi lam brtag /ngan na 'bad pas de bzlog bya/ /srad bu mdung pa gsum ldan pa/ /gsang sngags bzlas pas lag g.yon la/ /legs par bcings te bsrung bar bya/ /sa gzhi bstar bar bcu phyed byugs/ /man ngag ldan pas thig gdab bya/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /kun gyi nang rol nag por gnas/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ①ni rnam par brgyan/ /'dod yon la ni lha mo mdzes/ /dra ba dra phyed nyi zla dang / /me long rnga yab rin chen phreng / /pad+ma dur khrod rdo rje dang / /me 'od 'bar ba legs par bri/ /dbus su pad+ma ge sar 'bar/ /'dab brgyad kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /phyi rol 'bar ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /mdzes pa'i rtsibs bzang bcu gnyis pa/ /dbus bu zla bar uXl dmar/ /'dab mar thod pa'am dril bu ni/ /dkar ljang sngo ser phyogs g.yon skor①/ /ser dkar dmar sngo mtshalas rnams su/ /g.yas su skor ༷ba zla ba la'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs la 'khor lo ni/ /bcu gnyis zla bar gnas par bya/ /sgo bzhir gri gug rab 'bar ba/ /nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa bri/ /bsam gtan gyis ni bsam gtan bsgom/ /phyi nang gsang bar bcas pa yi/ /mchod pa rim bzhin legs mchod bya/ /rdo rjes bltams par rjobyas nas ni/ /slob mas gsol ba btab pa la/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis dbang bskur/ /nam mkhar thabs dang shes rab rnams/ /snyoms 'jug khu ba mi bskyod pa'i/ /dbur bzhugs rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon/ /shes rab pad+mar lhags gyur te/ /nam mkhar spros te dbang bskur ro/ /mi bskyod rang bzhin chu yis so/ /oṃ ubadz+ra ud ka ṭha rjo.a rnyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra ta two haṃ/ /14—1071

sangs rgyas rnams — thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba gsum las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po byin/ /cod pan rgyal ba lnga bstems te/ /mgo bo'i gnas lngar dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra dhā tī ①shwa ri a rnyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ sarba satwa badz+re a rnyi ṣiñtsa bye/ oṃ rat+na badzi a bhi ṣiñtsa gas/ oṃ dharmā badzi a rnyi ṣiñtsa byāḥ/ oṃ sarba bi shwa a bhi ṣiñtsa t+t+waṃske/ oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ twe ④aḥsngags 'di dar dbe+engs dpral bar bcings/ rin chen 'byung ldan gnas pas so/ /'od dpag med par gnas pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi rdo rje'i dbang / /di ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /shin tu grub phyir rdo rje zung / /zhes brjod gnas gsum reg ste sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra a rnyi ṣiñtsa thos/ rta mchog tu ni gnas pa yis oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa a aḥkṛ nyi so se bha ga wa na ma ye san+da ni hi to bha ba ti/ g.yon par yongs su gtad par bya/ /rtag par rdo rjes gnas pa yis/ /rdo rje dril bu mgor bzhag dhiste/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ a rnyi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra a rnyi ṣe ⑦ka ta/ khyed ni rdo rje che ge mo/ /me tog lhung ba'i rjes 'gror brjod/ /slob dpon dbang sogs brjod na yang / /kye yi rdo rje ji bzhin brjod/ /dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bsdus pa pa ra te ta paṇ+ḍi tas sbyar ba rdzogs so// //kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta saṃ gha ⑧shrī bha dra dang / 'jam dpal sgeg pa'i rdo rjes bsgyur ba'o// //oṃ tā re turtswa re tsa la pra tsa la shrī ⑨n+t+ra gā mi ni de ba tat+ta uts+tsha tra ya hūṃ/'di bya rog gi sgros lan ⑩sum cu rtsa gcig bzlas nas bsgrub bya'i sgo la sbas pas 14—1072

zhag bdun gyis sgod par 'gyur ro/ /sgol ma'i gzungs kyis srin lag la lan bdun bzlas la/ bdag gi ①mig gnyis phyis te/ de nas rgyal po'i drung du phyin na rgyal po de slob ma lta bur 'gyur bas dad pa byed pa dang / ngag tu mi smra/spyin pa ster/ khol ltar 'gyur ro/ /khros kyang dbang du 'gyur ro/ /'di ni yid ches pas ngo mtshar ro/ /bdag nyid sgrol mar bsgoms te/ tsha ba'i ②mar khus lus byug pa bya/ sngags khri bzlas/ bzlas pa'i rjes su 'bras mkhar ma can gyi ma dag pa snedri ma bton④/ de la snum khur byas la bsgrub bya la byin na nges par the tshom med pa'o/ /gos kyi thu ba nas bzung ste gang du 'gro ba'i phyogs kyi gnod byed bkug la thu bar gtums ⑤te mdud pa byas la sngags 'di lan bdun bsngags la/ 'jigs pa'i sa gang du 'gro yang 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /stag dang / chom rkun dang / sbrul dang / glang po che dang /ma te dang / dred la sogs pas kyang gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /dbang gi thab tu ut+pa la dmar po'i sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad byas na gang 'dod pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /spra tshil dang ske che'i 'bras bu dang / po so ducha dang / a sho ka'i lo ma rnams mar dang sbrang rtsi'i lde gu dang bcas pas stong phrag lnga'i sbyin sreg gis nyi ma bdun gyis rang 'dod pa'i bu mo thob bo/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re a myu ka bhe dha na ku mā ⑦ri ma hā musnya he na ta be+e pi tā pra yats+tsha du me swā hā/ rgya shug gi tsher ma stong phrag lnga rang byung gi me tog dang bcas pas sreg blugs byas na/skyes pas skyong ba'i bu mo yang 'gugs so/ /sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re a mu ka bhaṭ+wā rgo swā tha na ta pas ka rā ya ma ma na ke dza/ zla mtshan 'dzag pa'i ras la bcom ldan 'das ma phyag gnyis zhal gcig ma lcags kyu dang ut+pal 14—1073

zhags pa dang bcas pa rnams bri/ de'i mdun du mchod pa byas nas/ phyi nas bsgoms ldan sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /oṃ tā re tuja re tu re a mu ki ma ma i pis tai swasgo ka thā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ stong phrag lngas 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhags pas a mu ka'i mgrin pa bcings/ lcags kyus drangs nas bsgrub bya rkang pa'i 'og tu bsams te/ khol mo'i tshul gyis bza' bar bya'o/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ/me sbar bsangs nas ①thab bskyed/ byen brlabs spyan drangs pad gdan dbul//chu bzhi phul la phyag rgya bstan/ /dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya/ /ku sha byon zan me ltas brtag /sreg rdzas phul nas mchod bstod bya/ /nang mchod hūṃ tra dz+wa yis bsang / /'das pa'i dam tshig bskyed cing gzhug /dbang bskur mchod bstod byon zan dbul/ /sreg rdzas mchod bstod gsol ba gdab—/ /bzod gsol gshegs shing dam tshig bsdu/ /me lha gsol gdab sreg rdzas kyi/ /lhag ma phul la dgang blugs gsum/ /yon bdag lag pa nas bzung dbul/ /gtor ma mchod pa bstod pa dbul/ /gsol ba gdab cing me lha gshegs/ /dam tshig bsdu zhing lhag chad bskang // //14—1074

bsdur mchan/1༷7༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waḥ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉thasrung / 0〈〈pe mi'i'ar 〉〉waslob dpon khyod ni — lan gsum mo//1༷71 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe〉྾'dir 〉〉bzhi/ ⑧rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskor/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bltam pa/rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waṭha/1༷72 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sta1/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉ཿ/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tre/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tre hriḥ/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉41ཿ/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stanazhag ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉ṣa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 ma/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉glo⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgo la/1༷73 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gis/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bas/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉pas/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanaton/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtsams/ rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉son/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/1༷74 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 rdzas/bsdur 'azas re'u migargyud/ (538)14wa 1075

༄ga /dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byer ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ e ka bī ra yo gī ni ⑦sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpa' bo ④gcig pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/zhing chen gyi durje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po stong pa'i byang chub ste/ /gnyis pa sa bon yang dag bsdus/ /gsum pa gzugs rten yang dag rdzogs/ /bzhi pa yi ge rim bzhin dgod/ /ces gsungs pa/ dang po sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i snying rje chen po sngon du dmigs la/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kolha⑤haṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog pa'i stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o—/ /gnyis pa ni stong pa chen po'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ a las zla ba/ de'i steng du re las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor che ba bsam mo/ /de'i dbus su t+t+waṃ dmar mo de gyur pa las pad+ma rjodamar po yu 14—1076

ba la t+t+waṃ gis mtshan pa'o/ /gsum pa ni ①de las 'od zer 'phros pas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs—/ tshur 'dus nas thim pas rje btsun ma'i sku ru bdag nyid bskyed par bya④—/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma g.yas kyi zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang gu/dbus dmar po/ steng zhi ba'i zhal ser po/ khro zhal gsum po la spyan dmar po zlum pa gsum gsum mche ba gcigs pa'o/ /phyag brgyad kyi dang po na rdo rje/gnyis pa na ral gri/ gsum pa na ka pā ①la/ bzhi pa na ḍa ma ru'o/ /g.yon pa rjodang po na ut+pal/ gnyis pa na rin po che/ gsum pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ⑤ga /bzhi pa na dril bu'o/ /sku mdog shin tu dmar ba don yod grub pas dbu brgyan rjobyas pa'o/ /dpral ba'i steng na thod ⑦pa lnga yod pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu tham pa'i phreng ba'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham skethabs can/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang zla ba nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ni spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/mgrin par pad+ma dmar po'i steng du lhadamar po/ snying gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i steng du hūṃ sngon po bsgom mo/ /bzlas pa ni snying ga'i ⑨smad du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ut+pal dmar po'i yu ba la t+t+waṃ dmar po bsam/ de la sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer dmar po dang bcas pa spros pas/ sems can kyi sprug pa sbyangs la/ bde ba mtha' dag thob par bya'o/ /tshur 'dus kha nas ⑩mar zhugs phyag mtshan sa bon la thim/ nang du rang la rtogs pa skyes par bsam mo—/ /de bzhin du yang nas yang du bsam zhing / oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re hūṃ phaṭa—/ ces pa nus tshad bzlas so/ /'jog tsa na sems can thams cad 14—1077

kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig bya'o/ /de nas spyod lam thams cad sgrol ma'i nga rgyal gyis goms par bya'o/ /dpa' mo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta pa ra he ta dang / bod kyi lo tsā ①ba dge slong shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1༷76 ①mtshan byang 'di chos chan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag /dpa' mo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉to/ni/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉྾/du〈〈pe 〉nya)sa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉to/྅/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉po yongs su gyur pa las ut+pal/1༷77 ①〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉toradi/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉ste/ ③〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉tā pa/ 0〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉bopa/rjo〈'dir 〉tsā/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉〉na/ ⑦〈'ar 〉mgrid/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉shams/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ka'i/⑩〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉stan/1 78 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (539)14wa 1078

༄ga /u rgyan gyi rim pa'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ o ḍān ka ②ma tā re de bī ①sā dha rgo rjonā ma⑤/bod skad du/ u rgyan gyi rim pa'i rjosgol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo 'phags ma sgrol ma gnas chen gyi dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /gsang ba'i rgyud du rdo rje'i tshig 'di gsungs/ /de kho na nyid rtogs dka' man ngag 'di/ /spros pa dang bral rnam par rtog med las/ /dang po nyid ⑦rjes langs te bshad par bya/ nyam nga spangs pa'i sems kyis sa gzhir bris⑧—/ /maṇ+ḍal byas te bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i/ /thod pa rlung mes dag bsgom bdud rtsi 'bar ba yis/ /lus la khyab byugs phyi nang dag byas nas/ /'bol ba'i stan la rdo rje skyil krung dang / /ye shes phyag rgyas brtan pas rab 'dug nas/ /stong kyang snang ba'i 'gro gsum thams cad la/ /rmi lam sgyu ma dri za'i grong 'drar blta/ /snying nang mkha' dbus ye shes dri bral ba'i/ /zla 14—1079

ba'i steng du t+t+waṃ yig 'od zer lnga/ /'bar ba 'phros te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / /sgrol ma dang bcas thams cad grub pa rnams/ /kun nas ye shes sku can dran par bya/ /ye shes 'od zer dag gi phyogs bcu yi/ /sems can thams cad bla med byang chub ni/ /sangs rgyas sa la rab bkod ①mkha' dbyings dang / /'gro ba thams cad sgol mar rab bltas te/ /ye shes mchod pas sna tshogs gnyis med mchod/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi ba dang / /sems can kun gyi don byas gsum po yis/ /dbye bas mi shes dang bcas sdig pa bshags/ /sprug las rnam grol myur du sangs rgyas shog /bdag nyid 'gro ba sangs rgyas sgrol ma dang / /snang ba'i yul rnams thams cad sgrol mar bya/ /rnam par rtog pa ma lus bcom pa yis/ /chos rnams rang bzhin stong zhing bdag med do/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kolhakhruhaṃ/nam mkha'i khams su zla ba'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /de la stong pa'i ye shes kyis mnan pa/ /zla ba'i dbus su t+t+waṃ gi yi ge las/ /rdo rje rlung me g.yo ba'i rnam dag pa'i/ /ye shes byin brlabs sangs rgyas kun zhing gi/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma dang de bzhin gshegs/ /byang sems mgon po kun nas g.yo ba yi/ /ye shes rlung gi gnyis med yi ge la/ /thim snepas ye shes ma lus thams cad mkhyen—/ /de khengs 'dres las gyur pas bdag nyid dang / /'gro ba mtha' dag sgrol ma'i sgur dubaskyed de/ /dmar dang sngon po ljang gu cung zad khro/ /dpa' bo zhi ba ser po steng gi zhal/ /thod pa'i ⑤phreng bas dbu brgyan ye shes lnga//rgyan rnams ma lus thams cad brgyan pa yi/ /rdo rje ral gri ut+pal rin po che/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bu ḍa ma ru/ /'dzin cing bde ba'i ye shes 'bras bu 'byung / /14—1080

stag lpags sham thabs phyed krung gar gyis gnas/ /sna tshogs pad zla'i dkyil brtan snying rje ①khros/ /spyan gsum dmar bas kun la gzigs g.yon du/ /blta zhing rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /zhing du sgos pa mchog gi rnal 'byor ma tshogs dbus/ /'jug cing bde ba thams cad rab ster bzhugs/ /pu dzā o a go rā de mā kā o tri ko ka la kā hi pre kṛ sau su nā si ma nas/ yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'di ①dag kyang / /rnal 'byor ma gnas 'khor lo lus la dhidagod/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dbang phyug rab tu bsgrub/ /spyi bo spyi gtsug rna g.yon ltag khung du / /rna g.yas smin mtshams mig dang lag gnyis la/ /de bzhin mchan khung gnyis gnas nu ma gnyis/ /lte ba sna rtse kha mgrin snying ga rnams/ /pho kha gsang gnas bshang lam de bzhin brla/ /rje ngar bol gong rkang mthil rkang sor dang / /pus mo rim bzhin 'di dag lus la dgod/ /de nas lha yi rim pa dgod par bya/ /dang po lha mo su ra te shwa ⑤ri/ gnyis pa su ra ta sarnyo rjori/gsum pa su ra ta tsan+d+ra⑦/ bzhi pa su ra ta ⑧ma li ni/ lnga pa su ra ta bhak+ṣi ⑨dang / drug pa su ra ta ⑩ka mi ni/ bdun pa su ra ta u gra ⑪dang / brgyad pa su ra ta ut+ta ma⑫/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas nas lha mo bsgom/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dbang phyug rab tu bde/ /dkar po ljang gu sngo ser kha dog bzhi/ /ser dkar dmar sngo kha dog de brgyad do/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bu ḍa ma ru/ /phyogs 'dzin brgyad po thod pa'i phreng ⑫ba dang / /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis brgyan khro bo yi/ /shi k+ṣe rnyi ma shi khaṇ+ḍi ④dang bcasaske/ / ke rā ⑩li dza tra lī ⑩de bzhin du/ / u dra dzo tī de bzhin tsan+d+ra dang / /moṇ+ḍi bi ka ta u ste bcas/ /ki ri ṭi ⑫na rta ki ka bu dzī/ /puk+ka sī ḍom+bi nī ⑩ma lta ge ni/ /yongs bskor ⑥ 14—1081

'di dag zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / /tshad nye ba'i tshad 'du ba nye 'du ba/ /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod lha mo ni/ /bcu gnyis phyed dmar phyed lngang thod phreng gis//dbu rgyan sna tshogs rgyan ldan skra grol ba/ /cung zad bsgyings shing cod pan rnam ①snang ldan/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo rdo rje bsnams/ /sgo skyong bzhi ni sna tshogs mdog can la/ /mche ba gcigs shing g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum bzhugs/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng dbus na/ /mi bskyod pa yi dam tshig thor tshugs brgyan②ske/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ gri gug mi mgo 'dzin/ /sbrul gyi ④rgyan can bdud bzhi'i busteng gnas pa/ /thams cad phyogs kyi gos can snying rje yis/ / dag pa ⑤bde ldan rin chen ye shes kyis/ /bdag pos spyi bor spras pa rjornam par brgyan—/ /bde chen dbang phyug lte ba'i dbus bzhugs pa'i/ /bzang zhing che ba'i sgol ma rnal 'byor ma/ /dga' bde'i dbang phyug ma kun 'dab ma la/ /g.yon skor ④g.yas skor ⑧dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i/ /'gro ba'i bdag mo'i 'khor lo mang po ni/ /shi k+ṣe nas bzung ⑨tsan+d+ra mtha' ma ni/ /nirti rkang stabs gar gyis bskor ba'o/ /sgo bzhi rka bu la sogs g.yon skor ⑩gnas/ /spyi bo snying ga lte ba gsang ba brla/ /pus mo'i rim bzhin rang gi mtshan ma'i dbus/ /shin tu bzang ba ye shes lnga yi rigs / /lus la dgod pa bye hūṃ s+t+waṃ t+t+waṃ ⑪khaṃ/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'khor lo la sogs dbus/ /sems la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid bkod nas ni/ /ye shes 'od zer gyis ni 'khor lo dgug /mnyam pa'i sems kyis mchod yon ⑫la sogs dang / /ye shes bdud rtsi lnga yi mchod yon gyis/ /mchod cing bstod nas ye shes bdag la zhugs/ /rang gi spros ⑫nas ye shes chu rgyun gyis/ /dbang bskur shin tu spros shing ye shes kyis/ /mchod pa spros nas 14—1082

sangs rgyas rnal 'byor pa/ /sems can mtha' dag sgol ma'i gzugs su mthong //bsgom par bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma yi bsgom pa yi/ /ngo bo mchog gi de nyid zhing rnams rim pa ltar/ /rnal 'byor ma yi man ngag dam tshig rim/ /bla ma'i rjes 'brangs ①bdag gis thob pa'o/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin las rtogs pa / /ye shes rtogs pa'i bdag nyid ngo bos rtogs/ /ye shes rtogs ④pa'i dri bral ye shes med/ /rtog med chos kyi bdag med mnyam pa nyid/ /kha dog dbyibs dang yi ge rang bzhin med/ /ring med chos rnams kun gyi de kho na/ /mchog gi dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor ye shes gnas/ /de kho na yi bzlas pa mchog gi mchog /de ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rab tu bsgrub/ /bdag gi de nyid bzang po rab grub pa'i/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dkyil 'khor 'di dag gi/ /ming gi yi ge dbus gnas thams cad la/ /dang po'i sa bon dang sbyar mtha' ma ru/ /hūṃ phaṭa sbyar bas sgo bzhi'i lha mo bsdus/ /de steng dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsbyar ba yis/ /dus rnams kun du rnal 'byor bya ba'o/ /phyugs dag bsad ④nas g.yos byas lha bshos bzhin/ /rnal 'byor ma gogs bzang dang sgom pa po④/ /rtag tu bza' dang bza' min de bzhin du/ /btung dang btung min bgrod bya bgrod min spyod⑤/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs dkyil 'khor 'di dag ni/ /sdig pas ma gos mnyam nyid brtan pa'i chos/ /rnal 'byor gong ma rnal 'byor ster gsang brjo//shin tu gsang ba 'og ma'i gong ma 'di/ /sba zhing mi brjod skye ba 'di la 'grub//dge ba bcu dang tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi ldan/ /sbyin sogs mang po gtong ba'i snying stobs can/ /mchog dang mchog min ⑦gong du bsgom/ /ji ltar rigs kyi rim par son ⑧pa yi/ /gang la mos pa sna tshogs rnal 'byor ma/ /ri 14—1083

dwags gdan can sna tshogs pad nyi la/ /bdag nyid rje btsun sgrol ma'i gzugs 'dzin ma①/ /sna tshogs mdog can zhabs ②bzhi brkyang bskum du/ /yang dag brtan bzhugs ljang gu ⑦ser po dang / /dmar po steng zhal g.yon dkar mche gtsigs zhal/ /thod pa zhal gyi steng gnas don grub gyi/ /dbu rgyan mi rus rgyan 'dzin skra grol ba/ /spyan gsum dmar bas mdzes pa'i gzugs can la/ /ral gri rdo rje gsor ba 'khor lo dang / /lcags kyu dril bu snying gar rjosdigs mdzub 'chang / /gri gug ⑤mi mgo mchog tu ut+pal thod/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin tshangs pa'i pags rjosteng g.yogs/ /dbang phyug chen po khyab 'jug gi steng du/ /zhabs kyi pad+mar dze+ebazhugs shing thugs 'a ga pa/ /sngon du brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus na bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs thams cad sna tshogs mdog /phyogs kyi gos 'dzin gsang ba sbas pa yis⑧/ /gang gi dpal ldan rnal 'byor byang phyogs kyi/ /rim pa'i rim pa gong ma'i rnal 'byor mchog /brgyud pa'i rim pa thams cad bla na med/ /bsam gtan rnal 'byor ma snying bla na med/ /'dis ni bzang po'i las rnams thams cad byed—/ /sbyangs pas sdig spyod ⑨spros med bsgom par bya/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor gang gis sa 'og dang / /sa steng ⑩sa bla ma lus phyi nang kun/ /lus kyi zhing gi ngo bo'i bdag nyid ni/ /gnas su ji ltar bde bar snying gar hūṃ/ /dpral steng ⑪oṃ dang spyi bor haṃ mig tu/ /hūṃ dgod lus kun haṃ phaṭa yan lag kun—/ / lus kyi zhing gi ngo bo'i bdag nyid ni/ /⑫mda' spro ⑫he ho nyi haṃ phaṭa//snying ga dpral ba spyi bo mig lus kun/ /yan lag thams cad yan lag drug lus la—/ /cho ga rim bzhin 'gro ba'i rim par dgod/ /yi dam lha yi ngo bo'i 14—1084

bdag nyid du/ /'gro ba thams cad bltas te srid pa las/ /sgol ba'i sgrol ma'i bzlas bsgom de mchog yin/ /dur khrod shing gcig ri khrod gnas gzhi ①phug /mchod rten mtha' 'khob rnal 'byor ma yi gnas/ /smad 'tshong ②ma gnas lam dang rgyal po'i grong / /chu 'gram don po'i drung dang rtags gcig pa//dbang phyug che gnas rdzing bu lteng ①ka 'am/ /'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma yi gnas sam gang rung du/ /brtson pas gcig tu grogs med ngo bo'i bdag nyid duske/ /yid dga' rnal 'byor brgyud rjopa zhing brgyud ⑤rigs brgyud pa'i/ /rnal 'byor ma yi bdag mo shin tu za/ /'khor lo brgyud pa ye shes brgyud pa bsgom—/ / rim par rjobargyud pa bla ma'i rim brgyud pa/ /mi phyed byang sems ngo bo brtan pa 'di/ /legs par mi phyed nges pa'i shes pa yi/ /mi bden yul chos rnam par rtog pa spangs/ /lus ngag yid kyi rgyud las bsgom 'grub pa//spyi bo'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /steng na bdud rtsi lnga 'bab yang dag 'phro—/ /gang zhig brtan pas oṃ yig bsgom par bya/ /mi byed byas pa ji ltar rnal 'byor gyis/ /steng nas 'bab pa 'byung bar byed pa yi/ /'di yi rnal 'byor ma yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /rang gi ngo bo gzi brjid bcas pa dang / /kun nas sdug bsngal thams cad rnam spangs shing ⑦/ /mchod gnas chen po rje btsun sgol ma'i sku/ /bsam gtan de kho na nyid don phyug pa'i/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpas gang gsungs pa'i/ /mchu la baṃ yig dag gi lo gyi lce la a bzhag ⑧ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'di mchog sdug bsngal thams cad 'phrog cing zhi—/ /ye shes de nyid rang bzhin mthong ba 'di/ /gang zhig 'di bsgom rnal 'byor byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /grags pa don pos zhi gsum 'grub par shog/14—1085

lha mo sgrol ma'i rang bzhin rnal 'byor ldan/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyud du sgrol ma yi//sgrub thabs gong du bris pa rdo rje'i tshig /sems can ye shes thob byed gang yin 'di—/ /ma dad pa'am ma ①sbyin bya ba ngan pa dang / /chags can khro ba can min slob min bu la min/ /sdug bsngal blo can la min slob dpon gyis/ /gzhan la sgrub thabs 'di sbyin byang phyogs kyi/ /u rgyan nas 'ong ②bram ze'i gnas kyi nang / /zhing gi bu mo'i rnal 'byor ma tshogs rdo rje'i tshig de grub/ /bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo sgol ma u rgyan gyi rim pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje ldan mas gsungs pa'o/ /ma hā ā tsar+ya rat+na shrī'i slob ma paṇ+ḍi ta pa ra te ta dang / lo tsā ④ba nag tsho dge slong shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1༷79 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ /u rgyan gyi rim pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rab/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dz+ra / rjo〈〈pe〉sko' ra 〉ra / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉7ཿ/ rjo〈〈snar 〉7lha/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉8nga / ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsās/1༷8༷ ①〈〈pe 〉ragod/ ①〈〈pe 〉ma' ra 〉7lha/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉thims/ rjo〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉ra ra ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉7/1spyo81 ①〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉mjes/ ②〈〈pe 〉ma u a go ra de ma ka u te ku ka la ka nye bri sī sa na si ma ko/ 〈'a ra 〉〉( u a go ra de ma ka u tre ku ka la ka ho bri sī so na si ma ko/ ④〈〈pe 〉snga' ra 〉〉gi'adi/ du〈〈pe 〉snga' ra 〉zo lus/ dhi〈〈pe 〉skosar 〉7 ra sha ti sha rjo〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉ti son dha/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉te tsan tra khyo'o/ /sge〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ti/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ti bakhri/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉〉ti/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉ti gra ha/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉〉ti muta ma/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉skoraphreng / ④〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉skabaṇ+ḍi/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ma pa ⑩〈〈be+e〉〉〈'ar 〉ra ra/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉'a/ spyo〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉༅tra dza — de bzhin tsan+d+ra dang / /mi ḍi bka kyu 14byed1086

ka ste bcas/ /ko ro tra/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉stan khom bi ni/ 〈〈snar 〉stan kham bi ni/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snosgor/1༷82 ①〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉garnams/ ②〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉〉spyon/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7)sa/ du〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉〉rtse'i/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanaga' ba/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉te/ ⑦⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskor/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gzung / ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉bskor/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉mi traṃ/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sngagayon/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉spras/1༷83 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉75gengs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉startog ni〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉kasad/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉thasgom pa'o/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉spyod/ du〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉ba'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉〉ma khengs/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉ban/1༷84 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉rin/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉smonal/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ronugs ljang khu/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kar/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉gu/ bya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉togags/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pad mas/ ni〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉yi/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉yongs/ ⑩⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉stongs/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi lus kyi zhing gi ngo bo'i bdag nyid ni/ / ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi ha/1085 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉bzhi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉thang / ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉steng / dhi⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spyod/ du〈〈pe 〉〉ri paṃ/ 〈〈snar 〉stare ba/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉gsungs shing zhi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉sngagazhag1༷86 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa mi/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉rongs/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (54༷)14wa 1087

༄ga /gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu /①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba lo ②alpa bi rnyiḥ①/ bod skad du/gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu / gnas chen kyi dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ ci 'byor pa'i rdzas sngon du bshams la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shurtseḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyophohaṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong pa'i ngang las yi yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ der gnas pa'i ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du a las thod pa che ba cig rjobasam mo—/ /de'i nang du ma ra be+e shu mu las/ dbus su ma las sha chen/ shar du ra las khrag /bi las lho ru dri chen/ nub tu shu las byang chub kyi sems/byang du mu las dri chu/ de dag zhu ba las hūṃ oṃ t+t+waṃ āḥ⑤khaṃ lngar gyur par bsam mo//de dag zhu ba las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rang bzhin gyi gzugs su dmigs la/de rnams zhu bas bdud rtsi dkar po'i rnam par bsams te/ steng du rim par 14byed1088

hūṃ u.oṃ rnam par bsams te sbyar ba dang sbar ba dang rtogs par bya'o/ /de nas snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rnal 'byor me'i ①'khor lo bltas te—/ oṃ k+ṣiṃralbi ⑤hoḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsarba tsak+ṣa yo gi nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa rī ye i me ba ①lo pra tits+tsha rjos ma ya ma nu sma ra ma ma sarba sā dha nā ⑤nañtsa shārnyi puṣ+ṭi sarba tra rak+ṣu bā ra na gulta ku ru hūṃ/ zhes rjopa lan gsum brjod la dze+edabul lo/ /de nas snying ga'i t+t+waṃ gi 'od zer las/ mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos⑧/snang gsal/ dri chab/ tsan+dan/ gur gum ⑨la sogs pa dang / zhal zas/bla re⑩/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ na bza' la sogs pas mchod do/ /de nas de ma thag tu dngos grub gang 'dod pa la gsol ba btab la gshegs su gsol lo/ /rang gi snying la rjes su zhugs par bsam mo/ /gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //14—1089

bsdur mchan/1༷88 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gag /gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉yi/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sngagacig⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tre zhwa/1༷89 ①〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉staga'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mos ra li/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉wab/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾'ar 〉〉tīts+tsha/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉gli/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉rtses/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉4/ 〈〈snar 〉〉pas ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zo/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉kum/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉ge/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (541)14wa 1090

༄ga /zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i mchod pa'i rim pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ pi thi shwa ra pū ②dza kra ma/ bod skad du/zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i mchod pa'i rim pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje sdigs mdzub bsnams/ /kha dog nag po khro bos mjes/ /bong ①thung yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan/ /smin ma sma ra skra ser gyen/ /spyan gsum sdigs mdzub snying gar 'chang / /bgegs mthar byed pa dang po ru/ /sang nas stan las langs byas te/ /skad cig ma yi rnal 'byor bya/ /dang po gtsug lag khang la sogs par zhugs la/ phyag byas pa'i rjosngags ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka cisto pra ṇa me ⑤na badz+ra ban+da rgo ka ro mi zhes byas rjoso/ /stan gyi steng du 'dug ste/ gong gi bgegs mthar byed kyi nying nge 'dzin gyis phyogs bcur se gol gtogs shing ⑦/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na sarba bihūṃ da ha da ha sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas bgegs bskrad do/ /14—1091

oṃ bihūṃ ta kṛta sa ma ye tam+me yats+tsha a ཿhūṃ hūṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ni swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis lhung bzed dang / dri dang / bdug pa'i 'khor lo yis bya'o/ /de blugs la bdud rtsi'i bsgom pa yis byin gyis brlab po/ /bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung bar bya'o/ /zhing gi sgrol ma'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bya'o//de nas rdo rje dril bu'i bsgom par bya ste/ de nas g.yon du dril ②gnas la 'di ltar bsgom mo/ /oṃ shun+ya tā 1 na badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kopho④haṃ/ zhes pas stong pa'i ngang las gru gsum pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma'i ④dkyil 'khor kyi dbus su hri gi sa bon yongs su gyur pa las sku mdog dkar mo bsgom mo/ /phyag bcu zhal lnga sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phreng ba can/ dang po'i zhal dkar po—/ g.yas ser po/ rgyab dmar po/ g.yon in+d+ra rtswa la/ steng gi nag po g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ lcags kyu/ chos 'byung ngo / /g.yon pa rin po che/ pad+ma/ dril bu/ zhags pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi pu ste'o⑤/ /de las spros pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi gzugs kyis bkug par bsams rjonas/bgegs gdug pa can thams cad dang / sdug bsngal gyi bye brag dang bcas pa gcod pa'i rdo rje ral gri'o/ /sems can sgol ma'i mchod pa'i sngags zhal nas/oṃ na mo bha ga ba ti sarba ta thā ga tā ṭ+wāṃ sarba satwa a pra ti ha ⑦ta snyo ṣā ⑧ṭ+wāṃ oṃ gadhe a/zhes so/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das ma bdag nyid kyi sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ⑨ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ ⑩pra ra be+e ⑪ta sarba burtse k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta nā da swa bhā ba be+e shusne/ badz+ra dha ra z-i da yā sarnyo ṣa ba hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/thams cad rab tu bsgul la ⑫de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang / byang 14—1092

chub sems dpa' dang khro bo'i rgyal po dang bcas pa sgras yang dag par bskul ba ①byas pas/ mchod pa'i dus su rtag tu spyan 'dren pa ste/ gang zhig gis bdug pa dang bcas pas bgrol ②bas so/ /dril bu 'dis spyan 'dren pa myur du bskul ba dkyil 'khor gyi nang du brtan par byed pa'o/ /cho ga 'di'i ⑦sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo myur du thob pa dang / mthong ba dang dge ba dang /thos pa gang gis sdig pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba dang / byang chub kyi sems skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bkrol ④ba des sdug bsngal thams cad med pa dang /nad dang / de bzhin du 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang / gdug pa'i sprin gyi gnod pa dang / rlung dang char ches pa dang / chung ba yang spang bar ⑤'gyur ro/ /bdud dang bgegs dang log 'dren dang / de bzhin du gnod sbyin dang srin po dang 0mche ba can ⑦dang bcas pa de thams cad skrag nas g.yo zhing brgyal ba dang phyogs bcur 'phros par 'gyur ro⑧/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / lha dang rdo rje khro bo dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / lha chen po rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po dang /'phags skyes po la sogs pa rgyal po chen po dang / 'phrog ma dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar la sogs pa rang bzhin gyis 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /byin gyi rlabs stirab tu byed pa'o/ /grub pa chen po'i dngos grub ster ro/ /'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub par byed pa'o/ /tshe ring ba dang / nad med pa dang / mi sdug pa dang bral ba dang / sdug pa dang bde ba chen po bla na med pa'i ye shes ster ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad sangs rgyas nyid du sgol ba'o/ /mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dus dang / rab tu gnas pa byed pa dang / sbyin sreg 14—1093

gi las byed pa dang / de bzhin du gzugs brnyan mchod pa rab tu spyod pa'i dang por 'di blangs te phyag bya'o/ /de bzhin du de nas rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur ro—/ /lag pa g.yon pa byin gyis brlab ste/ oṃ ābyuhūṃ ṭ+wāṃ khaṃ sor mo rnams la rim par yi ge mthe'u ①chung gi bar du bkod lasde/ de nas phyag byas rdo rje khu tshur gyis gzung ba g.yas su 'dug pa'i dri 'khor lo'i dung bzung la 'dis spyan drang ba'i dus dang ④/ de bzhin du gshegs su gsol ba gnyis la rdo rje dril bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dkyil 'khor dubar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' dang / lha dang khro bo de bzhin du gang gi rigs kyi cho ga la / mtshan ma gang gis mtshan pa ⑤de mngon du byas te ༷dril bu dkrol bar bya'o—/ /zhi ba la 'khor lo mngon spyodu byas te dkrol lo/ /rgyas pa la rin po che mngon skedu byas la gzung ngo / /chags pa dang / dgug pa dang / dbang du bya ba la pad+ma mngon ⑨du byas te myur du dkrol bar bya'o/ /drag po'i las thams cad la sna tshogs rdo rje mngon ⑩du byas te dkrol lo/ /gang gis las kyi rjes su 'jug pa de'i 'od ⑪spros te 'ong / gnas gzhi'i gtsug lag khang dang rang gi khyim du de bzhin du bzung ⑫ba dang mchod pas/ rtag tu longs spyod chen po'i rgyu dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung ⑫'di'o/ /sngags thams cad kyi gnas dran pas thams cad 'grub par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la mos pa 'dis bcom ldan 'das ma'i rdo rje dang dril bu las gang gi rjes su 'jug pa 'dzin pa'i cho ga de'i bsam gtan bsgom pa'i rim pa'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon chen po lha'i rigs lha nyi ma dpal gyi zhal gyis mdzes ⑫pa las mtshan nyid la sogs pa 'dir ma brjod do/ /g.yas su gnas pa'i rdo rje las oṃ shun+ya tā dz+nyā 14—1094

na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā ①kolhahaṃ/ zhes stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūṃ gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pa thugs kar rdo rje/ g.yon pa dril bu dkur brten pa/ /skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa zhi ba'o/ /rin po che'i rgyan dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i dar gyis dkris pa bsgom mo/ /de las 'od zer spros pas sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs par gyur te thim pas rdo rjer gyur pa g.yas pas bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra rā dza hūṃ/ zhes pas mchod pas mchod do/ /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags brjod pas maṇ+ḍal bdud rtsi lngar gtor la/ oṃ ma hā maṇ+ḍal bi dhi hūṃ/de bzhin du sgol ma'i sgrub thabs las 'byung ba bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags kyis mchod pa la sogs pa/ bsang sgegator bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra 1ar+ghaṃ swā hā/oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū be+e swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dī dupe swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e byu ⑤bye swā hā/ dril bus rjomachod par byas la srin lag gi sor mos rdo rje bzung ba/ oṃ mi di nī badz+rī bha dze+eb hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ardza ni gri he hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra su ka sa na hūṃ/ sngags gsum po 'dis byin gyis brlab pa⑧/ bdag nyid mchod pa ni g.yon pa'i srin lag mthe bos dri zhim po bsnams shing / lha mo'i 'khor lo'i sngags kyi gnas chen gyi lha ⑨rnams la mchod pa ma lus pa yid kyis byas so⑩/ /de nas bdud rtsi lnga'i mchod pa ⑪btung ngo / /de nas thang sku la sogs pa'i rten la mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod do/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu bzung la ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drang ba'i ⑫sngags brjod do/ /de bzhin du yi ge brgya pa dang dril bu'i sngags dang / de nas sgol ma'i 'khor lo'i sngags rnams bzlas/ de nas lha mo rang rang gi sngags kyis mchod yon 14—1095

la sogs pa'i mchod pa thams cad dbul lo/ /bdug ①pa'i dus su dril bu dkrol zhing / de nas sgrol ma'i 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /gtor ma dang bdud rtsi lngas mchod do/ /de nas bstod pas bstod pa dang /yan lag bdun pa dang smon lam gdab po/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa brjod la/oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub sprul//sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon ③par mdzad du gsol//zhes ༷pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyir gshegs su gsol/ bsgoms pa rnams rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las nang du gshegs su gsol/ zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i mchod pa'i rim pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta pa ra he ta dang / lo tsā ⑤ba dge slong shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'o// //ba3ra mchan/1 91 ①mtshang byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i mchod pa'i rim pa bzhugs so// sde〈〈pe 〉ra / ①〈〈pe 〉masam/ rjo〈'a ra 〉ra ba'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉ra ya bākyi pra na mi/ rjo〈〈be+e 〉snga'ar 〉mis/ ⑦〈〈be+e 〉sko'ar 〉'itog cing /1 92 ①〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉ra ske〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7bu/ ⑧〈〈pe〉snga'ar 〉7lha/ ④〈〈pe 〉dzeshar 〉mkhang du zla ba'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉ya ti'o/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉thasam/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉thā/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉snga/ ⑨〈'ar 〉raṇ+ḍar ni/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉8 ta/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉8/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉thathab pa/1 9 ①〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉thar/ ②〈〈be+e 〉sko'ar 〉rapo / ③〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉thadi yig ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉dkrol/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉d+kungs pa dang / sgongs par/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉༅'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉—can/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉thags bcur 'phros par 'gyur ro/ /skrag nas g.yo zhing brgyal ba dang /⑨〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉chus brlabs/14—1096

༄ga /de kho na nyid kyi tshig le'ur byas pa/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tatwa kā ri kā/ bod skad du/ de kho na nyid kyi tshig le'ur byas pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtog pa'i dra ba spangs pa yi/ /zab mo rnam pa kun la khyab/ /kun nas 'phro ba grangs med pa/ /kun tu bzang po phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig snying gi pad+ma'i ⑤lte ba la gnas pa/ /mar me 'bar ba phra ba lta zhing mi bskyod sems/ /yul la mi 'jug khams gsum thams cad gnyis med 'byung / /chos dbyings yang dag nyid la phyag 'tshal bdag mchog go/ /nang du zhugs ①pa dbang po thams cad g.yo ba'i rta/ /ye rjoshes ma lus rgyal ba mnyam 'byung khams gsum la/ /phan pa bskyed pa rab tu 'byung ba mthong ba 'di/ /'byung ba rtag tu nam mkha'i ⑤dri ma med pa'i dpal/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran rnal 'byor pa/ /chos rjes dran pa'i sgom ⑦pa pos/ /chos rjes dran pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /chos sku'i rang 14—1098

bzhin 'byung ba po/ /dbus su mar me'i rnam par shes/ / shes mchog gi ni ①rtogs pa yi/ /rgyun du 'bar bsgom rtag par ni/ /'bar ba de la the tshom med—/ /snying la rtag tu gnas pa yis②/ /yi ge rnam med thig le gcig /de nyid bsgoms ①pa'i skyes bu de/ /ye shes bskyed pa mchog gi gnas/ /gnas 'dir rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /snying rje'i sems kyis rol cing gnas/ /gnas 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba gsum / /de dag thams cad mchod pa 'di sngon lam/ /de rnams gsal bar de nyid rtag tu 'dir/ /mchod pa 'di ni rgyal ba thams cad dang / /nang gi bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor la/ /rnal 'byor rdo rje 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje mchod 'byung ba/ /mchod pa'i lam 'di 'byung ba'o/ /mchod pa lnga yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /myur bar sangs rgyas nyid thob bo/ /lnga yis mchod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /de dag rgyud du bshad pa yin/ /phyi yi mchod pa'i sems ni gzhan/ /nges pa'i rang bzhin sems goms bya/ /lha yi 'byung gnas bsgom pa la/ /de ni yid kyi mchod pa chen po ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab tu brtse bar dgongs/ /bshad pa chung ngu yang dag 'byung ba 'di/ /rgyun du don dam med pa de nyid dorjo/ /don dam bde ba yang dag 'byung ba 'di//bshad dam ma bshad ci yang med pa'o/ /gnas chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bye brag kun//zhing chen 'di dag tu ni yang dag zhugs/ /zhing dag tu ni 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /ngal dub las ni de yin de nyid min/ /de ni de kho na nyid thob pa min/ /mi bden de dag kha cig tsam yang med/ /des na de ⑤kho na yod skyes bu de/ /mi bden de dag kha cig tsam yang med/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang tshad rnams/ /14byed1099

der ni phyin pas dri ma med pa 'byung / /des na khro'am grags par 'dod pa yis//skyes bu zhing du 'gro bar byed pa de/ /bdag gi gong du brjod pa de nyid do/ /sems can mos pa'i sems kyis rnal 'byor pas①/ /bsam gtan mchog las bde ba gzhan na med/ /khams dug de dag phyi rol rnal 'byor yin/ /de bas 'di ltar bsam gtan las bya'o/ /khams dug 'di dag bskor ba ni/ /phyi rol pa yi rnal 'byor yin/ /des na phyi rol spang bar bya'o/ /gnas dang rnal 'byor rol pa yis/ /mthong ba rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma/ /rnam par dag pa'i ye shes spyan/ /dpal ldan rnal 'byor rab tu brtan/ /snying rje chen po'i sems kyis so/ /de yis mchog gi dngos grub dag /ji ltar 'dod pa ster ba 'grub—/ /ye shes chags bral rnal 'byor pa/ /sgrub pa rab tu nges pa 'di/ /sna tshogs 'bad pas yang dag ldan/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa cung zad tsam/ /de nyid byas pas brtul zhugs gnas/ /gang dag sderab tu spyod pa byas/ /bza' ba brtan pa brtul zhugs can/ /bsam gtan bza' ba yid skyes pa/ /smyon pa'i spyod pa'i ①gzugs can de/ /de ④ltar gcer bu'am gcer bu ma yin⑤//gang dang gang yin de dang des/ /rang gi lta sgom rjobyed pa rnams/ /de kho na nyid rnam par bsam/ /zla drug rim pas ⑦bden pa la/ /lkugs pa lta bur rab tu gnas/ /rnal 'byor chen po mar me 'bar/ /ye shes mchog 'bar des mthong nas/ /rnal 'byor ma nges g.yog byed do/ /ji ltar pad+ma bzang po la/ /ngang pa dga' bas gral ⑧du gnas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje yang dag par/ /the tshod med par 'byung bar 'ayid/ /gzugs brnyan lta bur 'jig rten 'di/ /sems can kun gyi don byed pa/ /'dir ni bdag gis sems can don⑨/ /14—1100

dag pa'i sems kyis byas pa yis①/ /'di dag snying rje cung zad tsam gyis ni/ /gang brjod des ni ④'byung bar 'gyur ba yi/ /de nyid sbas pa bdag gis rgyas ma byas—/ /bla ma'i drin bzung yang dag mtha' la mos/ /sems srid ①dge ba'i dubasags stobs kyis/ /bshes gnyen mi 'gyur mngon par rjes yi rang / /de kho na nyid man ngag yang dag bris/ /'phel ba bdag gis gang thob 'di yis sems can gyi/ /snying po'i sgom mchog spyod bzang myur du bdag⑤ /rin chen 'od zer 'jig rten kun la shog /de kho na nyid kyi duman ngag rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta pa ra he ta dang / lo tsā ④ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1༷98 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag /de kho na nyid kyi tshig le'ur byas pa bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉thad+ma/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉sngazhug rjo〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉〉gang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉zabakha'/ rjo〈〈pe 〉ra sgom/1༷99 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉rab shes mchog gi/ sde〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉༅/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasgom/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉de/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉7de/11༷ ①〈〈pe 〉ra'ar 〉mi/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉rang / ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉mi/ rjo〈〈be+e 〉skosnar 〉༅/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈shar 〉dz+ran/ durte〈pe 〉skosar 〉rdza bsgom/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ral/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉8 don du/11 1 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉than/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉tsād/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7rtsa ba/⑤〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉raga'/ du〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉thas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉༅/14byed1101
brtsar 'bras re'u migargyud/ (542)14wa 1102

spre — —man ngag ga 'gral pa zhas bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tata twa kā ri kā u pa de sha thrasti nā ma②/bod skad du/ de kho na nyid kyi tshig le'ur byas pa'i man ngag gi 'grel pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig snying gi pad+ma'i lte ba la gnas pa/ /mar me 'bar ba phra ba ①lta zhing mi bskyod sems/ /yul la mi 'jug khams gsum thams cad gnyis med 'byung / /chos dbyings yang dag nyid la phyag 'tshal bdag mchog go/ /gang zhig ces pa chos kyi dbyings so//phyag 'tshal chos kyi dbyings yang dag pa'i mtha' la'o/ /gang zhig chos kyi dbyings ni khams gsum thams cad gnyis med du 'byung ba'i yang dag pa'i mtha'o—/ /yul la mi 'jug de la phyag 'tshal te/ /snying ga'i rjopad+ma'i lte ba la gnas pa/ /zhes ⑤pa/ snying ni snying la'o/ /pad+ma ni rjopad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'o—/ /kha dog dmar po 'byung ba bzhi'i ⑦rang bzhin ni/ ⑧lte ba'i dbus 14—1103

su zla ba nyi ma'i mchog gnas pa'o/ /'byung ba chen po bzhi'i rang bzhin de la zla ba sa dang chu'i rang bzhin nyi ma ①dang rlung gi rang bzhin no/ /de ltar lte ba'i dbus su gnas pa de bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyengs de bzhin nyid yang dag pa'i mtha'o/ /mar me 'bar ba zhes pa gnyis su med pa 'bar ba rab tu mthong bar song ba'o/ /ci 'dir ⑦gsungs pa phra bar lta zhing zhes ③pa/ phra ba ni bcom ldan 'das te shin tu phra bas kyang ches phra ba'i rdo rje chos kyi dbyings tshul gcig pa'o/ /lta zhing zhes ༷pa pad+ma'i rtsa ba lta bur gsal bar ro mi bskyod sems pa zhes ⑤pa des sems rtse rjogacig pa'i rgyun du 'bab pa rtag tu bya'o//ci 'dir gsungs pa khams gsum zhes pa 'dod pa dang gzugs dang gzugs med pa dag gnyis su med par song ba yang dag par bsdus pa mnyam pa nyid kyi tshul gcig dang / thams cad nam mkha'i rnam par rab tu mthong ba'i don to⑦//gong du brjod pa'i bsam gtan gyi yid rang gi tshul gcig pa yang dag par bsdus pa ⑧'di'o/ /yang dag pa ⑨brjod par byas te/ 'gro ba'i don ⑩de kho na nyid gcig pu 'di gnyis su med pa nyid song ba kha cig cung zad spros pa med par mar me 'bar ba de las ⑪yon tan 'di 'byung ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal te/ zhes pa nyid la phyag 'tshal nas ci byed na 'di gsungs pa/ nang du gzhug pa dbang po thams cad g.yo ba'i rta/ /ye shes ma lus rgyal ba mnyam 'byung khams gsum la/ /phan pa babyed pa rab tu 'byung ba thob pa 'di/ /'byung ba rtag tu nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i dpal/ /zhes pa'o/ /nang du gzhug pa zhes pa rnam par g.yeng bar 'gro ba'i spangs pa brjod pa'o/ /ye shes yang dag pa'i mtha' mthong ba'i sbyan 'byung ba'o/ /14—1104

rang 'byung gi rnal 'byor dri ma med pa'i dpal 'di shes pa de/ dpa' bo mchog gang yin pa'i dbang po de nam mkha'i rnam par 'byung ba'i rnal 'byor gang yin pa'o/ /nang du zhes pa'i ①phyi rol du sdegayeng ba thams cad kyi sems nang du gzhug pas 'phro ba'i g.yo thams cad bcings pa ni sde drug gi dbang po'i rta'o| /rang gi yul 'dod pa'i sems 'di ni byed pa bcings pa'i rnal 'byor bya ba'i dngo mo krung ngo / /de nas phyis dri ma dang bral bar 'byung ngo / /ye shes gang 'byung gsungs pas ye shes ma lus sogs pa kun nas rgyal ba las rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'byung ba'o/ /mnyam 'byung ni skad 'byung ba lhung bzed ltar 'byung ba'i gnas pa 'di gsungs pa 'byung ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes brnam pa/ gzhan ma yin pa'i mchog rgyal ba'o//de'i rigs khams gsum pa'o/ /khams gsum pa 'di dag thams cad bskyed pa'i rgyu 'byung ba rnams so/ /gsung gi ngo bo ye shes su byed pa 'di'i don yin no / /'di na ⑦'byung ba gzugs phra ba de 'byung ba'o/ /sgom rjopa po ⑤nam mkha'i de nyid dri ma med pa'i dpal lo/ /bzang po gang zhig de kho na nyid gsum pa'o/ /rnam par rtog pa bsdus nas 'dzin pa de nyid gnyis kyi byed gyis 'gro bar mthong ba gang brjod pa'o/ /rmongs pa chen po'i rnam par rtog pas 'khor bar lhung rjoba'o/ /rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa de/nam mkha'i rnam par mthong ba 'di rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran rnal 'byor pas/ /chos rjes dran pa'i sgom ⑦pa pos/ /chos rjes dran pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /chos sku'i rang bzhin 'byung ba'o/ /ci brjod pa des 14—1105

bcom ldan 'das bsgom pa 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran zhes pa la sogs pa ni/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'phel pa 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i tshud gyis rang bzhin de'i dbus na chos kyi dbyings kyi bcom ldan 'das so/ /de'i grogs rnal 'byor pa 'di'i sgyu ma rnal 'byor ji skad gsungs pa ni/ chos rjes su ①dran pa'i sgom ⑦pa pos zhes pa chos 'di bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i lte ba'i dbus su gnas pa/ gong du brjod pa de dag ①bsgom pa ni/ de nas rnal 'byor pas chos kyi dbyings yang dag par bskyed la nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rjopar rab tu 'byung bar song ba'i chos sku 'byung ba'o/ /de'i don ni 'di'i pad+ma'i ⑤steng du thig le bzhi rnams dulha mo bzhi rdzogs pa'o/ /lte ba'i thig le las bcom ldan 'das rdzogs par ro /rang gi yi dam gyi lha bsam par bya'o/ /de'i thugs kar pad+ma'i lte ba la chos kyi dbyings bsam mo/ /gnas pa de bul ba bul bar khad kyis rim gyis ji ltar rnal 'byor bsgom pa goms par bya'o/ /de nyid zhi ba'i rnam par 'jug pa zhugs pa ⑦gang du rtsa gnyis 'gog pa de dag gis 'gog pa'i rnam par rang bzhin med pa nyid goms par bya ba 'di de brjod pa/ gong nas gong du khad kyis rim par rang bzhin med pa nyid 'byung ba'o/ /man ngag 'dis zhi ba gcig pu'i bde ba thob par ro⑦/ /dbus su mar me'i rnam par shes/ /ye shes mchog gi rtog pa yi/ /rgyun du 'bar bsgom rtag par ni/ /'bar ba de la the tshom med/ /ces pas dbus su mar me la sogs pa 'di dbus kyi mar me 'di bskyed pa mthong ste/ dbus kyi mar me rnam par shes pa'am/ sems dang yid shes gang gsungs pa de rnam par shes pa 'di'i rnam grangs so/ /de ni 14—1106

dbus su mar me'i rnam par shes pa snying ga'i pad+ma'i ge sar gyi dbus su song ba bsgom pa'i yid g.yo ba med pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings ①ye shes 'byung ba'i phyir gsungs pa'o/ /mchog gi rtogs pa de kho na nyid kyi dpe 'di nyid rgyun du mi g.yo bar rnal 'byor bsgom pa bsam par bya'o/ /de dag bsgom pa goms par ④rgyun byed med pa'i byed du bsgom pa'i yid nyid do/ /de lta bas na byed pa 'bar ba 'di snying gi mar me ③don 'di'o/ /bum pa can gyi byed par gnas pa'am myur du ye shes kyi gtum mos 'gog pa'i rnal 'byor 'di brjod pa/'byung rngub 'gog pa'i 'bar ba'i bsam gtan 'dis/ de nyid med pa kun nas byed pa la the byed ma byed cig /thams cad mabyed pa'i gsung ji lta ba yin no / /snying la rtag tu gnas pa yisarjo/ /yi ge rnams med thig le gcig /de nyid bsgom pa'i skyes bu de/ /ye shes bskyed pa mchog gi ⑤gnas/ /zhes pa la snying la zhes pa/ snying gi pad+ma'i ge sar gyi dbus su phra ba'i thig le rdo rje'i ༷rang bzhin du gnas pa/ dus thams cad du brtan par gnas pa ci yang med pa rnams/ rang gi ngo bo med pa yi ge med pa/ g.yo ba med pa/ rang gi ⑦rnam par shes pa nang du gnas pa'i rang bzhin no/ /nam mkha'i rnam par rab tu snang ba de nyid 'di'i rnam par bsgom pa ste ye shes skye ba'o/ /ci nyan thos la sogs pas mi ⑧rtogs pa de/ mchog tu rnam par mi rtog pa de bzhin gshegs pa'o—/ /gnas 'dir rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /snying rje'i sems kyis rol cing gnas/ /gnas 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba gsum/ /zhes pa ni/ phyag 'tshal ba sngon du byas nas—/tshigs su bcad pa lnga'i de kho na nyid du bstan pa'o⑨/ /da ni phyi rol gyi 14—1107

mchod pas g.yengs par 'gyur bas de spangs par gsungs te/ 'di ni de'i snying ga'i pad+ma'i ge sar gyi dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa dang bcom ldan 'das so/ /rtog pa'i dra ba rnams ①bsal ba/ /snying rje chen po'i rigs kyis gnas/ /gnas 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /sems kyi rang bzhin de nyid mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /de ni rig pa gang zhig rtog pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad ces pa rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes ④pa byams pa la sogs pa'o/ /byang chub ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /sems gang la mos pa 'di dag de nyid du gsung gis gsungs pa'o/ /byang chub med cing ming med pa/ /gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid kyi rtog pa las grol ba'i ye shes kyi sems ni 'di byang chub dran pa 'di'o/ /gcig min pa'i 'gro ba gsum byung ba ni/ de gsungs pa 'gro ba gsum ste de'i rnam par snang zhes pa 'byung ba'o/ 'di ltar khams gsum 'di thams cad sems kyis byas pas 'byung ba'o/ /phyi rol dang nang gi 'gro ba'i bdag nyid med par rab tu snang ba'o/ /rgyal ba'i sras po'i rnam par khams gsum pa 'di rnal 'byor 'byung ba gong du gsungs pa'o/ /de dag thams cad mchod pa 'di smon ③lam/ /de rnams mar me de nyid rtag tu 'dir/ /mchod pa de 'dir rgyal ba thams cad dang / /zhes rjopa la sogs pa gang zhig nges pa'i rang bzhin thig le'i rgyal po'i mchod pa des/ dus thams cad du ⑤sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod pa'o/ /gzhan gyi don gyi phyi rol gyi mchod pa spangs la/ de nyid rnal 'byor pa g.yeng ba de dag gong du brjod pa 'di dag phra ba'i rdo rje mgon po bcom ldan 'das snang ba'o/ /rnam par blta zhing rab tu blta ba'i 14—1108

gnyis su med pa'i lha mchod pa'o/ /ci phyi rol gyi mchod pa g.yeng bar byed pa'o//nang gi bdag nyid rnal 'byor la/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje mchod 'byung ba/ /mchod pa lnga yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /'di dag mchod pa med par ①nang gi bdag nyid 'di brjod pa bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor brjod de/ thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa 'di gsungs pa/dman pa'i bsam pa 'di gsungs pa'o/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms par 'jug pa 'di dang mthun par rdo rje mi 'jigs pa'i rnal 'byor byed pa rdo rje'o/ /de gsungs pa'o/ /de nas yang rdo rje mchod pa 'di'i bdag nyid mi 'jigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa yid la byed pa ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro'o②/ /mchod pa lnga yi rnal 'byor pa/ /myur bar sangs rgyas nyid thob bo/ /de dag rgyud du bshad pa yin/ /phyi rol mchod pa'i sems ni gzhan/ /shin tu byas pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyis zung du bshad pa'i rgyal ba'i mchod pa'o/ /mchod pa lnga'i me tog la sogs pas phyi nang gi bdag nyid gong du brjod pa'i mchod pa des ni myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob pa'o/ /yod pa 'di dag rgyud du gsungs pa'i phyi rol du 'di bsdus pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /nges pa'i rang bzhin sems goms bya//lha yi 'byung gnas bsgom pa la/ yid kyi mchod pa chen po ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab tu brtse bas dgongs/ /'di mchod pa zhes pa gzhan med pa'o//de nyid med pa'i ngo bo mtshan nyid ci yang med pa 'di brjod do/ /rang bzhin med pa'i ming gi sgra ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba yin/ de rang bzhin med pa'i ngo bor gnas pa dze+ede ltar goms par byas pa las de byed par rang gi lha'i rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de ni rang gi yid kyi mchod 14—1109

pa chen po yi/ de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma brtse bas thugs dgyes par byed pa'o/ /cis na phyi rol gyi mchod pa g.yeng bas byed pas so—/ /bshad pa cung zad yang dag 'byung ba ni/ /rgyud ①du don dam min pa de nyid de/ /don dam bden pa yang dag 'byung ba 'di/ /bshad dam ma bshad 'di la ci yang med/ /bstan bcos su med par brjod pa dag gi rnal 'byor brtan par gnas pa 'di gsungs pa'o/ /yod pa 'dir bshad pa 'jig rten pa 'dul ba'i don du sangs rgyas kyi rgyud du gsungs pa'o/ /de nyid med par yang don med ④par de/ nga ③de nyid sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rigs rgyas par mdzad pa 'di rnam par mi rtog pa nyid do/ /gnas chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bye brag kun/ /zhing chen 'di dag tu ni yang dag zhugs/ /zhing dag tu ni 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /ngal dub las yin de ni de nyid min/ /phyi rol gyi g.yeng bas yid g.yeng ba'i rjobasam pa dang ldan pas mi bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi zhes pa la sogs pas 'di nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bye brag tu byed pa zhing bzhi'i bye brag ces pa la sogs pa dpag tu med⑤/ de'i zhing la sogs pa'i byed pa sems kyi rdo rje rnam par bzhugs pa'o/ /'di'i zhes rjopa nye bar mi bskor ba gsungs pa/ de skad bskor bas khams ngal dub sdug bsngal gyi bya ba 'ong bar byed pas de kho na'i rnal 'byor chen po rnams gang des ni de thob pa'o/ /de ma yin pa mi bden pa/ /de dag kha cig tsam yang med/ /des na de kho na yod skyes bu de/ /mi bden de dag kha cig tsam yang med/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang tshas rnams/ /der ni phyin pas dri ma med pa 'byung / /de nas khro ba'am grags pa 'dod pa yis/ /skyes bu zhing du 'gro bar byed pa ste/ /med de rang 14—1110

'byung bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ zhing la sogs pa bskor bas dri ma med par 'byung ngo / /de la bdag rgol ba'i sems 'di dag zhing la sogs pa dang zhing dang nye ba'i zhing gi mchog tu byed pa dri ma med pa 'byung zhes pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dgongs pa yang dag par 'byung ba 'di ngo mtshar che'o de nas gang la bskor bas stobs nyams par byed pa'i bya ba/ khyim mang po'i ①bya ba gang g.yeng ba'i sems gnyis med par zhi ba la sogs pa'i ming gi grags pa thob kyi bzang po ma yin par 'byung ba'o/ /bdag gi gong du de nyid de/ /sems can mos pa'i sems kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /bsam gtan mchog las bde ba gzhan na med/ /de bas 'di ltar bsam gtan las bya'o/ /stobs kyis de dag bskor bas brjod du med pa dri ma med pa mthong zhing myong ba de don dam par yang med pa'o/ /bsam gtan zhes pa 'di bsam gtan gyi sems rtse gcig pa de las byung ba'i bde ba gzhan ci yang med de/ de nyid bsam gtan gyi bya ba nyin mtshan du bya'o/ /khams dub de dag bskor ba ni/ /phyi rol pa yi rnal 'byor yin/ / de nas ②phyi rol spang bar skebya/ /gnas bya rnal 'byor rol pa yis/ /dub pa zhes pa de dag phyi rol pa mngon par gnas pas khams dub nges par ster bar 'gro ba'i phyi rol gyi bya ba phar la spang ngo / /de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa rnam par gnas pa rnal 'byor rol pa'i bde ba'o/ /mthong ba rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /rnam par dag pa'i ye shes spyan/ /skal ldan rnal 'byor rab tu brtan/ /snying rje chen po'i dhisems kyis so/ /brtse ba'i dbang gis gnas pa 'di la bsam gtan pas mthong ba 'dis bskor ba'i bya ba med pa'o/ /de yis mchog gi ⑤dngos grub dag /ji ltar 'dod pa ster ba 14—1111

'grub—/ /ye shes chags bral rnal 'byor pa/ /bsgrub pa rab tu nges pa 'dis—/ /de dag ci yi ①ngo bor mthong / /zhes pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje ma brtse ba'i dbang gis ④bden pa mchog gi dngos grub ye shes ji ltar 'dod pa 'byung ba'i rnal 'byor pa'o/ /gzhan yang ral gri la sogs pa ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa gang yin pa ye shes bsgrub pa thams cad rab tu byed pa'o/ /sna tshogs 'bad pas yang dag ldan/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa cung zad tsam/ /de nyid byas pa brtul zhugs gnas/ /gang gang rab tu spyod pa bya/ /ye shes chags bral bsgrub pa yis/ /ci brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa 'di btang snyoms 'di zhes pa/ sna tshogs zhes pa 'di rab tu byed pa'i theg pa'i lus g.yeng ba'i spyod pa mi brjod de①/ 'di ltar rgyun du gnas pas bskor bar mi bya'orjo/ /de kho na nyid kyi brtul zhugs ⑤spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bzang po'i dbang du brtul zhugs rjokyi spyod pa gsungs pa'o/ /gang gang rab tu spyod pa byas/ /bza' ba brtan pa brtul zhugs can/ /bsam gtan bza' ba yid bskyed pa/ /smyon pa'i spyod pa brtul zhugs can/ /med par ston pa'i rgyud ⑦du ji ltar bza' ba la gnas pas 'di la ci bya zhes brjod do/ /gang gang zhes pa rab tu bza' ba'am rab tu bza' ba min/ bslangs pa'am ma bslangs pa'am/ mos pas byin pa'am/ mos pa med pas byin pa'am/bza' bar gnas pa bza' ba'i bya ba bya/ /brtul zhugs ⑧can gyis brtul zhugs ⑨so/ /bstan bcos nas bzung ba'i spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyi sdom pa mi bya'o/ /nyin mtshan du bsam gtan kyi bza' ba 'di bza' ba'o nges par 'byung ba brtan par smyon pa'i rnam pas gnas par bya'o/ /gzhan kyi drung 14—1112

du 'gro ba g.yeng ba'i ngo bo'o/ /de ltar gcer bus gcer bu min/ /gang dang gang yid de dang des/ /rang gi lta sgom byed pa rnams/ /de kho na nyid rnam par bsam①/ mgo la sogs pa'i slong ②mo g.yeng ba'i spyod pa brtul zhugs dze+ekyi gtam la rtog pa'i rtsa ba phyed pa 'di gsungs pa/ bya ba'i rgyud la sogs par gcer bu la sogs pa spang ba dudang / ci ltar drung du gnas pa'i rgyud 'dir gsungs pa'o/ /bzhi mdo la sogs par gang dang gang du gnas pa'i de la skyil krung bza' bas/ nyin mtshan dus thams cad du bzlas pas de dag gis lus dka' ba 'di'o/ /de dang de la sogs pa ngang ⑤gis gnas kyang yang dag par spong ba bzhi'i de nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /zla drug rim pas bden pa la/ /lkugs pa lta bur rab tu gnas/ /rnal 'byor chen po mar me 'bar/ /phyortog pa mang po 'di yis ci zhig bya/ /ye shes dang rnam par shes pa 'di gsungs so/ /zla drug ces pa la sogs par bden par ⑦zla drug gis sangs rgyas kyi dngos grub bo/ /ci'i phyir 'gro ba dang 'grogs par dka' ba 'di gsungs pa mi smra ba la sogs pa dngos po'i dbang du byas pa mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dis/ rnal 'byor chen po 'bar bas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma drung du byon dus ⑧bzang por byed do/ /ye shes mchog 'bar des mthong nas/ /rnal 'byor ma des g.yog byed do/ /ji ltar pad+ma bzang po la/ /ngang pa dga' ba gral ⑨du gnas/ /ye shes pa la sogs pa ye shes de rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs pa'i rnam pas 'bar ba'i snang gsal de bzang po de la gsal zhing snang ngo / /ji ltar pad+ma 'byung ba la rgyas pa la ngang pa gral ⑩du 'jug pa ltar mkha' 'gro'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin yang dag /the tshom med par 'byung 14—1113

bar 'gyur/ /gzugs brnyan lta bu'i 'jig rten 'di/ /sems can kun gyi don byed pa'o/ /dpal ldan la sogs pa 'dis 'bras bu bstan te/ dpal legs par rtogs pa'o/ /'di — bdag gis sems can gyi don du/ /dag pa'i sems can rnams kyis ①gang byas pa/ /'di dag snying rje cung zad tsam gyis ni/ /gang brjod des ni 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /nges par bzung ba'i dgongs pa brjod pa'o/ /'di dag la sogs pa bde bar rtogs pa'o/ /de nyid sbas pa bdag gis rgyas ma byas/ /bla ma'i drin bzung yang dag mtha' la mos—/ /sems bzang ba yi dge ba bsags stobs kyis/ /rgyas ma byas zhes pa la sogs pa dze+ede cig snyam na③/ de nyid med ༷pa'i de kho na nyid ma brjod kyi/sbas pa'i don ⑤bla ma'i drin gyis sems can bzung ba'o/ /bshes gnyen mi 'gyur rjes yi rang / /de kho na nyid man ngag rjobris/ /dge ba bdag gis gang thob 'di yis sems can gyi/ /snying po sgom mchog spyod bzang myur du dga' / /ma 'ongs pa na mi brtan pa la gsol ba ⑦'debs 'di brjod/ /sems kyis bsags pa zhes pa ni bsags pa'i sems ni dus ring por dge ba 'phel ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i lam byas pa'o/ /de dag thob par gnas pa 'di yis ⑧sems kyis rlabs 'phel ba 'di ltar byas pa sred cing zhes ⑨pas grub pa thob pa'o/ /stsong ba gang yin pa byung ba brtan pa mi rtog pa byed pa 'di la yid la byed pa bzang po 'di thams cad du thams cad rlabs byed pa'o/ /de kho na nyid kyi man ngag yang dag par bris pa'i bdag gi ⑩bsod nams 'phel ba des 'jig rten thams cad la de kho na nyid kyi rin po che ltar gsal ba rab tu 'byung bar gyur cig /de kho na nyid kyi man ngag bris pa'i bsod nams gang des thob 14—1114
