༄ga /gnas chen gyi rim pa'i lha mo sgol ma'i bstod pa/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ pi thi kra ma tā ra de bī ②sto tram̐/ bod skad du/gnas chen gyi rim pa'i lha mo sgol ma'i bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye dang mtha' dbus rnam pa med/ /e yi yi ge'i rigs las skyes/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i khu bas myos/ /zhing gnas lha mo nyid phyag 'tshal/ /bco lnga'i dus kyi rnam pa med/ /dus med thig le'i tshul gnas pa/ /byas krung phyed pa'i gar kyis gnas/ /zhing gnas lha mo nyid phyag 'tshal/ /dang po mtha' dang dbus ma'i tshul/ /rigs lnga'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yi/ /ye shes lnga ni gcig gi tshul/ /zhing gnas lha mo nyid phyag 'tshal—/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /nam mkha' rnam pa thams cad du/ /khams lnga yi ni rnam pa'i tshul/ /zhing gnas lha mo nyid phyag 'tshal/ /ā li kā li las byung ba/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed thams cad la/ /yi ge med pa'i 14—1117

rnam pa thob/ /zhing gnas lha mo nyid phyag 'tshal/ /sku gsum rigs la 'jug pa'i tshul/ /thar lam rab tu 'byung ba yis①/ /rigs kyi tshul med lhag pa'i tshul/ /zhing gnas lha mo nyid phyag 'tshal/ /stong phrag bdun cu gnyis gnas pa'i/ /rtsa yi bu ga'i sbubs kyi nang / /a wa sgru ④tī'i dbus gnas pa/ /zhing gnas lha mo nyid phyag 'tshal/ /stong pa shin tu stong pa dang / /stong pa chen po gang du gnas/ /thams cad stong pa steng na gnas/ /zhing gnas lha mo nyid phyag 'tshal/ /brjod pa tsam las skye 'gag med/ /brjod pa'i mtha' la gnas pa dang / /tshig bzhi dag gi gang du 'pho/ /zhing gnas lha mo nyid phyag 'tshal/ /nang du rang la gnas pa yi/ /'khor lo bzhi yi rnam par gnaso//byang chub lhag pa'i tshul gnas pa'i/ /zhing ④gnas lha mo nyid phyag 'tshal/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi dag gi yul/ /zhing gi 'dren pa'i lha mo de/ /zhing bzhir snyoms par gnas pa yis/ /zhing gnas lha mo nyid phyag 'tshal/ /mu stegs lta ba khyab 'jug ma/ /nyi ma tshangs pa'i rang bzhin kun/ /ci yang med pa'i gzugs 'dzin ma/ /zhing gnas lha mo nyid phyag 'tshal/ /oṃ gyi gsang sngags 'di nyid la/ /bdag gis mos pa'i sems kyis ni/ /mi bskyod rdo rje byas pa yis—/ /sems can rjes su 'dzin par shog /gnas chen kyi lha mo sgol ma la bstod pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta pa ra te ta dang / lo tsā rjob tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'o—/ / //14—1118

bsdur mchan/1117 ༅mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gag /gnas chen gyi rim pa'i lha mo sgrol ma'i bstod pa bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉da bi/1118 ①〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉stago ②〈〈pe 〉ra'adir 〉41/ ③〈zhar 〉stani/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (545)14wa 1119

༄ga /zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i bstod pa/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ pi thi shwa ra sto tra/ bod skad du/ zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das zhing gi dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun rtog thams cad yang dag 'phrog /dngos rnams rang bzhin ngo bo ni/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /snying rje'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo / /'khrul pas khyab pa thams cad du/ /zhabs kyis mnan nas rnam par spangs—/ /nyon mongs thams cad bsal ba yi/ /zhing gi dbang phyug phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thams cad gnyis med mchog tu spangs/ /don rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /rnam pa can ni rnam pa med/ /byang chub gzugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sku mdog dmar mo zhal bzhi ma/ /dga' ba la sogs gzigs pa yi/ /khro mo'i zhal gsum 'od 'phro ma/ /zhi ba'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag 'tshal mgo bo'i phreng ba ma/ /lnga lnga steng du yongs su 14byed1120

'dzin/ /byas krung byed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /g.yon du gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /snying gi pad+ma'i dbus su ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yang dag gnas—/ /snying rje yis ni khros pa'i thugs/ /zhing gi dbang phyug phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /lhung bzed ral gri rdo rje dang / /ḍa ma ru ni g.yas su gnas/ /g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bu dang / /rin chen ut+pal bstod phyag 'tshal/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor nang du ①gnas/ /stag gi skepags pa'i sham thabs can/ /sna tshogs pad zla'i dkyil na gnas/ /spyan gsum ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rtsa gsum pa yi nang nas ①gnas/ /dgug pa gsum ni yang dag 'phrog /ngo bo gsum ni yang dag ldan④/ /sku gsum bsnyems la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nyid gsum gyi gzugs mdzes ma/ /sdug bsngal gsum po spangs pa yi/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla khyab/ /rang bzhin ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing rnams su/ /rnal 'byor ma ni nyi shu bzhi/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas na bzhugs/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pul+lī ⑤ra ma la pa'i zhing / /legs dga' rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma/ /lha mo dkar mo phyag bzhi ma/ /spyi bor gnas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /legs dga' 'dzin ma rnal 'byor ma/ /dzā larnya dhir spyi gtsug ⑦bzhugs/ /ljang gu mgo bo'i phreng ba can/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug phyag 'tshal bstod/ /u rgyan du song ze'u ⑧'bru la/ /legs par dga' ba zla ba ma/ /sku mdog dkar mo arbu'i ste/ /legs dga' phreng ba ser mo ni/ /go dā ba rī stinye ba'i zhing / /rna ba g.yas la yang dag gnas—/ /legs par dga' ma zar ma ni/ /sku mdog ser mo phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /rā ⑩me shwa ri ⑪smin mtshams su/ /dkar mo legs dga' 'dod ma 14—1121

ni—/ /de bī ①ko ṭi mig gnyis la/ /dmar mo legs dga' khro mo'i gzugs/ /dpung pa'i rtsa gnyis yang dag gnas/ /mā ②la zhing gi 'dren pa mo/ /lha mo sku mdog sngon mo'i 'od/ /phyag 'tshal legs dga' ①bla med ma/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang brgyad/ /zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi ma'o/ /thams cad thod pa'i phreng ba 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal bla med rnal 'byor ma/ /spyan gsum thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /dril bu ḍa ma ru 'dzin ma/ /thams cad ngo bo rang bzhin bdag /phyag 'tshal rnal 'byor ma phyag 'tshal/ /phyag 'tshal kā ma rū dupa la/ /zhing dang 'thung ⑤gcod ces bya ba/ /mchan khung gnyis la gnas pa'o/ /lha mo gtsug tor bstod phyag 'tshal/ /phyag 'tshal o tre du'athung gcod la/ /nu ma gnyis na gnas pa yi/ /zhing na yang dag ye shes gzugs/ /rnal 'byor 'jigs ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /nye zhing tro ⑦sha ku — ru/ /gtsug tor cung zad ces bya ba'i/ /rnal 'byor lte ba'i yul na bzhugs/ /phyag 'tshal thams cad 'dod ma la'o/ /ko sa la ni nye ba'i zhing / /rnal 'byor ma zhes bya ba yi/ /sna rtser gnas pa'i yid kyis bsam/ /phyag 'tshal mchog ni dbang phyug ma/ /ka ling ka ni kha la gnas/ /phyag 'tshal rnal 'byor ral tshogs ma/ /tshab bzhugs pa'i lha mo la/ /phyag 'tshal lhan cig skyes ma la'o/ /'thung gcod tshasdo la pā ⑧ka /drag mo mgrin par gnas pa ste/ /ral can nye ba'i tshasdo la/ /kā— ⑨snying ga bla na med/ /li dha nyi mā ⑩la yi gnas/ /u pa tshajor gnas pa'o//phyag 'tshal rnal 'byor gtum mo la/ /yang dag rtog pas thams cad sreg⑪ /'du ba pre ta pu ri pa/ /thod can ma ni gsang bar gnas/ /srin po'i zhal ni gnas pa yi/ /rnam par 'gyur byed ma phyag 'tshal/ /sau rāṣ+ṭa ⑫nye 'du ba/ /14—1122

thor tshugs brla gnyis yang dag gnas/ /gser gling rje ngar gnyis su ni/ /nye ba'i 'du ba gar mkhan ma'o/ /phyag 'tshal sku gsung thugs bdag la/ /rnal 'byor ma ni bcu gnyis dran/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin ma/ /'khor lo rdo rje kun du bsnams/ /thams cad mgo bo'i phreng ba 'dzin/ /spyan gsum skra rtse 'bar ba can/ /gar ma dpa' mo chen po ni/ /bzhad pa'i gsung gi 'od zer can/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gyis/ /phyed ni dmar la phyed ni ljang / /skra ba)sa legs pa'i spyan mnga' ma/ /phyogs kyi gos can mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag 'tshal phyogs skyong ma rnams la/ /rka bu dzi la sogs pa bzhi//zhal gcig spyan ni gsum ma'o/ /phyag bzhi ma ni mdzes ma ste/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng na gnas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /bdud bzhi yi ni gdan la bzhugs/ /sna tshogs mdog can phyogs kyi gos/ /rngam pa'i zhal can 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis yang dag bzhugs/ /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod gnas/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas kun nas brgyan/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ①ga 'dzin pa/ /gri gug snemi yi mgo bo bsnams/ /rkang pa'i bol gong ①yul du ni/ /rka bu dzi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal lha mo puk+ka thug/ /rkang pa'i mthil du kun nas bzhugs/ /sin ⑤dhu'i zheng du bzhugs pa ni/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de bzhin ma ro'i yul song ba/ /phyag 'tshal rnal 'byor lto ba me/ /pus mo gnyis ka'i yul gnas pa'i/ /ma tai gi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ze'u rjo'abru'i dbus na bzhugs pa yi/ /'khor ba'i 'dren pa rnal 'byor ma/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i nang na gnas/ /sgol ma'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor lo bzhi yi ting 'dzin gnas/ /14—1123

tshangs pa yi ni gnas bzhi ma/ /snying rje chen po yi ni thugs/ /rang bzhin med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dang po'i yi ge man ngag zhal/ /lnga/li kā li la gnas gzhan/ /ro ma brkyang ①ma a bi na/ /gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /rdo rje pad+ma yang dag bsdus②/ /snying gi gnas las bzhengs pa yi/ /stong pa snying rje gnyis su med/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bsam pa ④thams cad zla phyed spangs/ /ngag bzhi po rnams rtogs pa yi/ /skra rtse brgya cha'i rnal 'byor ma/ /mtshan nyid med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rtog med mtshams med brten pa med/ /rtog med gnas pa med pa yi/ /thogs med yon tan rim kyis rjolegs/ /rgyu ⑤med rnam pa phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par mi rtog brten pa med/ /bsam gtan bzlas brjod spangs pa yi/ /spangs pa nga rgyal med pa yi/ /rtag rjotu shar la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rtog med bcom pa rnam bcom med/ /spang ⑦bya med cing gnas pa med/ /rang bzhin med pa snang ba med/ /the tshom med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchog tu zhi ba phra rags med/ /mchog dang bar dang tha ma spangs/ /kun nas ngo bo thams cad bzhugs—/ /thams cad 'das ma phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thams cad sems kyi gzugs can ma/ /thams cad mchog tu yongs su ster⑧/ /bgegs rnams rab tu zhi ba ma/ /bgegs med ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tshad med longs spyod med pa la/ /sa 'og sa bla rnam par khyab/ gnyis med 'chi med lha mo ni//mthong ba med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sngon nas spangs pa med pa 'dzin/ /gnyis su med dus gzi brjid can/ /tshad med kun nas rang gi ⑨rig /ngo bo med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /grangs med pa yi mi bzad pa/ shes mig 14—1124

'jigs pa spangs pa'o/ /'chi ba spangs pa'i dbang phyug mtha'/ /dga' ba ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bla ma'i drin gyis gdul bya bzhin/ /rnal 'byor ma mos spyod lam gyis/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /zhing gi rnal 'byor phyag 'tshal lo/ /mos pa chen pos rjes su chags/ /bstod pas bstod pa'i rkang pa 'di/ /sgra dang sgra med shes pa med/ /bzod pa mchog gi dbang phyug ma—/ /bdag ni byis pa rmongs pa ste/ /mos pas bstod pa shin tu dga'/ /zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i bstod pa 'di blon po'i rigs shin tu dga' ba'i paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes rdo rje dang / lo tsā ①ba nag tsho chen pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/112 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag /zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i bstod pa bzhugs so/ /1121 ①〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉ra/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉8sa/ sne〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉ra/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉'an/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉7 li/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉'a —/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉ratsugs/ ⑧〈'ar 〉ṭha/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉ta ba ri/ ⑩⑪〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉d+ku/1122 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉la/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉zo/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7dga'/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈shar 〉zothun/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉snye/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉8/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉phrospa/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉snga /⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zo/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉thasreg ⑫〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉thaṣ+ṭa/1123 ①〈〈pe 〉〉1/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉thug ①〈〈pe 〉shesas/ du〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉7)/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉'byu/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈shar 〉'a/1124 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉d+kung / ②〈〈pe 〉7sdu/ sde〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉sngatan/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉d+kum mis/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉rgyud/ ༷〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉rkog ⑦〈〈pe 〉rdzangs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ste/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rgas/1125 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉tsa/ 14—1125
bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/(546)14wa 1126

༄ ga /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa lak+ṣa ṇa tsā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i grub pa bshad par bya'o/ /de 'dzin pa la rtag bstan ②pa/ /sor bzhi pa ④dang bcu pa dang rjobacu gnyis pa dang / bcu drug pa dang / brgyad pa dang / nyi shu'i tshad kyi gser kyi rdo rjes sa'i gtso bo'i rig pa 'dzin pa nyid dang /rtag tu rab tu bzang po thob po/ /rgyal po rab kyi ⑤rgyal po gong ma nyid zangs kyi rdo rjes 'dod pa 'grub bo/ /rdo'i rdo rjes lha ma yin gyi dbang po kun dang /gnod sbyin rnams kyang bskyod pa'o/ /don thams cad 'grub par 'byung ba lcags kyis te/ lcags gcig gis dpal cherjo/ nad med⑦/ nor kun thob pa'o—/ /gza' thams cad la ⑧seng ldeng gis so/ /ma du ga'i stishing gis gnod sbyin bsgrub bo/ /des chos kyi don bsgrub bo/ /lha'i shing gis dgra ⑩14—1127

med par 'gyur ro/ /mi'i rus pas mi'i srog 'phrog go/ /shel gyis thams cad dbang po'i gzhu ltar snang ngo / /zhe sdang gi las la rgom pa yis so/ /wa'i bhu ①shing gis gsad pa dang / skams pa dang / sha za 'grub rtag tu rab tu bzang ba'o/ /dri za gnod sbyin kun 'grub bo/ /su ru tsan+dan gyis so/ /sa yis gzugs gzhan du rnam par 'gyur ro/ /srin pos skye gnas 'grub bo/ /mya ngan med pa'i shing las byas pa'i rdo rjes nor 'phel lo/ /dmar po'am dkar po tsan+dan gyis gang 'dod pa rab tu thob bo/ /rtse lnga pa sran te shel gyis rtag tu bsrung ba rgyal ba'i zhabs drung bzlas pa byas nas 'grub bo/ /dri zhim pos mchod pas zhi ba'i sems dang ngag gang bzlas pa rdo rjer bzung nas byas na 'grub bo/ /sgrub pa pos sngags pa ⑧gzung ngo / /ming med pa rdo rje bcang ba byas te sems rtse gcig pas so/ /rdo rje'i rgyu gang las byung ba'i mtshan nyid rab tu btus te phyag 'tshal nas shes rab ye shes zhib sketu bri ba med pa'o/ /rdo rje'i mtshan nyid brjod nas dril bu'i mtshan nyid 'og nas 'byung bas shes so/ /gser gyis byas pa rtse lnga pa 'od bzang po cha gsum pa bzung 0ba'o/ /rtse mo bye ba rnams bye brag tu'o/ /dang po dril bu'i ⑤gdong bshad pa ni/ dpal gyi gdong dang / pad+ma'i gdong dang / ba lang gi gdong khog pa bsel ba'i dbyibs su'o/ /de lta bu'i dril bu phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ngo / /dpal gyi gdong gis rgyas pa'i las thams cad 'grub bo/ /pad+ma'i gdong ni pad+ma'i dbyibs su byas tedu/ dbang gi las byed pa'o⑦/ /ba lang gi gdong du byas pa'i dril bus zhi ba'i las ster bar byed pa'o⑧/ /sor bdun pa dang /brgyad pa dang / sor bcu gnyis pas shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid kyi'o//14—1128

rang byung gi shes rab kyi rnam pa ni dril bu'i kha dog ①pa chos 'byung ba'i dbyibs dran pa'o/ /ye shes ldan pa lnga'i thabs kyis rdo rje steng na gnas pa'o/ /chos 'byung gi nang du hri gi yi ge las de bsgom par bya'o/ /dril bu de chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum mo/ /yi ge hūṃ las ②rdo rje ye shes lnga'i ngo bo dran par bya'o/ /de ni rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas so/ /'di skad 'byung ba'i dril bu de lus ngag yid gsum gyi rnam pa'o/ /khog pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i gnas dran pa'o/ /de'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gsung rdo rje'o/ /de'i steng du bum pa'i bsam gtan te byang chub kyi sems kyis yang dag par gang ba'o/ /de'i steng du sems kyi rdo rje bsgom mo/ /pad+ma'i steng du de zhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan pa'i ①rnam pa'o/ /'khor lo/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /lnga pa spyi bor yang dag par gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa rang gi rnam pa'o/ /sa gzhi khog pa'i rnam pa ni lha mo sangs rgyas spyan yang dag par gnas pa'o/ /chu'i rnam pa ni mā ma tī bum pa yang dag par rjoganas pa byas pa'o/ /me'i rnam pa ni gos dkar mo'i rang bzhin no/ /khong pa'i rlung gi rnam pa dbus su bltas pa sgol ma'o/ /stong pa'i dbus na rdo rje lce g.yo ba'i gsung ngo / /nam mkha'i ni bum pa'i steng na rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mgon po yang dag gnas pa'o/ /sa'i snying po dang 'jig rten dbang phyug mgon po ni rdo rje 'dzin pa gzhan no/ /mtshan ma'i steng du phreng bas bskor ba ni gsum po de'i tshul gyis brjod pa'o/ /spre'u'i gdong ni byang chub sems dpa'i lha'o/ /de'i gdong ni steng du rdo rje'i phreng ba'i rnam pa ni sgo skyong dang dpa' bo chen po khro bo bcu drug ⑤pa'o/ /sangs rgyas 14—1129
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (547)

༄ga /thod pa mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ ka pā la byu dzi bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/thod pa mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ zhing chen gyi rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo//lhung bzed chen po'i mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nyid bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i snod dang / gzhan gnyis kyang bshams la/ rang rang gi cho ga ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ de'i steng du mchod pa'i gnas la/ rang gi yi dam lha gang yin pa'i gdan pad+ma dang / nyi ma'am zla ba'am bdud dam ro la sogs pa la/rang rang gi sa bon gyi yi ge las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de las spros bsdus pas yongs su gyur pa las/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'am/ lha rkyang ②pa bskyed la/ ye shes pa dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du bya'o/ /dbang bskur nas rigs kyi ①bdag pos rgyas gdab bo—/ /g.yon gyi lha rjoyi dam gyi lha gzhan bsgom/ g.yas kyi ⑤paṃ las pad+ma/14—1132

ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las spros bsdus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das bdud rtsi 'khyil pa zhal gsum ①pa g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus sngo/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ mche ba gshigs pa/ dbu skra dang sma ④ra ser ba/ g.yas dang po na sna tshogs rdo rje/gnyis pa na ④'khor lo/ gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon dang po na sdigs mdzub dang dril bu/ gnyis pa na zhags pa/ gsum pa na dgra sta/ zhabs g.yon bskum pa/ g.yas brkyang ba/ stag gi pags pa'i rjosham thabs can—/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa bsgom mo—/ /de nas me tog la sogs pas mchod do/ /de nas bar chad zhi bar gsol ba gdab bo/ /mthe bo dang srin lag sbyar ba ⑤bcug la/ oṃ gisahūṃ lan gsum bzlas pas bdud rtsir zhu bar bsgom mo/ /de nas dbus ma'i ma ḍal la me tog la sogs pas mchod do/ /de nas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa'i rang gi lugs ltar bzla zhing dbul lo/ /yang lha gzhan gyi la me tog la sogs pas mchod pa dang / yang bdud rtsis ⑦mchod do/ /de zhu bas yang dbus ma la mchod do/ /de ltar ma 'byor na yang ci 'byor pa'i snod gcig tu bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs la⑦/lhung bzed la mchod do/ /de nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/ /thod pa mchod pa'i rim pa rdzogs so// //14—1133

bsdur mchan/1132 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gag /thod pa mchod pa'i cho ga bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brkyang / ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉4)sa/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 la/1133 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉nephyag drug ②〈〈pe 〉mus/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wan/ du〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉mi pagasapa'i/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wab du〈〈pe 〉sta ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉pa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (548)14wa 1134

༄ga /rmi lam sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ swasna tā ra no bi ka /bod skad du/ rmi lam sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma rmi lam sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprin bral mkha' dkyil zla rgyas gzugs/ /rab dkar bsil ba'i 'od ldan ma/ /ma lus rmi lam gsal mdzad de'i/ /zhabs la mgos btud de bsgrub bshad/ /dge bas rab tu sngar langs te/ /gdong sogs dag byas dri zhim byugs②/ /rje btsun de rten mdun bdar la/ /yid 'ong mchod pas mjes par byas/ /skyabs gsum lha mor bcas pa la/ /skyabs gsum 'gro la phan yid kyis/ /mi dge med pa'i sems ldan pas/ /thog mar bsod nams tshogs bsags snebya/ /oṃ a mṛ ④ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na sarba bispyo ⑤ta ḍa nyi rjota ḍa ha sarba bā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā—/ 'khyil pa khros pa'i sngags 'di yis/ /rmi lam bar chad bgegs bsal la—/ /dri med bai ḍūr+ya ⑦'dra yis⑧/ /mkha' la 'phags ma bsgom par bya/ /14—1135

rab mdzes paṃ las chu skyes snum 'jam gsal zhing gsar pa'i 'dab tshogs rgyas/ /de steng dkar bsil ri bong 'dzin 'arnal de dbus khams gsum rgyas 'gengs t+t+waṃ//kun nas mun sel skar ma'i rgyal po 'od bzang mdog can rab 'phros las /yongs gyur 'phags ma mi lam sgol ma zhi ma dge ma mdzes ma blta/ /rab dkar lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzugs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mchog sbyin mdzad/ /ut+pal sngo 'dzin 'akying tshul sgeg /mtshungs med gcig pos kun khyab ma'o/ /dri zhim dbu skra bzang 'khyil li/ /lha rdzas rin chen du mas brgyan/ /mthing ga'i ①dar gyis stod g.yogs shing / /sna tshogs kha dog sham thabs mnabs/ /mu tig phreng ba'i dra ba yis/ /mnyam par mdzes pa'i ska rags dang / /ga sha se ral khar bcings shing / /cod pan don yod grub pas brgyan/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dngo krung gis/ /srid dang zhi la mi gnas shing / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /spu sgo kun nas rab 'phro ba'o /ci 'dra'i ye shes lha mo 'di/ /bkug la mchod pas mnyes byas bstem/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /byin rlabs ②phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bsngags/ /de rnams ④maṇ+ḍal mchod bcas pas/ /gus par phul la gsol ba gdab/ /zhal zas btung ba bzang ldan pa/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum me tog dbul/ /rin chen phreng ba dkar thogs te/ /ma yengs blo yis 'phags ma la/ /rtse gcig yid gtad rjogasang sngags mchog /'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhir bzlas/ /oṃ swasna tā ⑤re swā hā/ de nas zang zing med par ni/ /rang gzhan don du rmi ltas brtag /grong pa'i chos kyis ma sbags pa'i/ /bu mo dus bzang dag la mchod—/ /dri zhim khrus byas gos rgyan bumadzes/ / rol mo'i ⑦grangs sam 14—1136

brgyad dam bdun/ /ar+gha la sogs mchod sngon 'gros/ /zas dkar zho dang 'o ma sbyin/ /'gron bu dar sogs yon byin la/ /dung chos chus gtor ci bder dengs/ /de rjes byi dor dril ①ldan pa'i/ /khang par tshangs spyod brtul zhugs gnas/ /sngags ①su me tog dri zhim gyis/ /byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal bzang byas la/ /mchod pa lnga dang khyad par du/ /gu gul mar me dbul bar bya—/ /'jim ril sran ma'i tshad bcos te/ /kuṇ+ḍa li yi sngags bdun gyis/ /btab la nyi shu rtsa gcig ni/ /phyogs bcur gtor bas bar chad zlog /gsum bdun gcig ni rin po cher/ /bsgoms pas maṇ+ḍal steng du dbul/ /stan la dgram dang gzung bar bya/ /de rjes gang 'dod gsol btab nyal/ /oṃ swasna tā ra swasna a ba lo ki ni/ tre+e lokya ni rdar+sha ①ni/ tre+e lokya badz+rer rjoni/byu tai bha baṃ bha ba si sha ma/ shu bha shu tai mi sad bye ka tha ya swā hā/ brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyi shu gcig /yang na lan bdun bzlas par bya/ /gsol btab sngags 'dis yid ches pas/ /lan cig bzlas kyang mi 'grub med/ /de tshe 'phags ma bdun gye mtha' ⑤las phyogs bcur 'od mdzad thugs ka las byung bubasil zer gyis/ /bdag snying gdung pas la ⑦thab thib dra ba ma lus spangs te sprin med mkha' ltar dag byas nas/ /glang chen sna 'dra'i phyag mdzes ring brkyang bdud rtsi can las bdud rtsi'i rgyun phab snying sogs bkang / /de mthus lus kun kun nas dri med shel bum mchog ltar gtsang zhing rab dag yid 'ong 'gyur / /de 'og rtsa ba'i rig pa brgyad/ /lha mo mchog la rtsa skegacig tu/ /ma yengs ⑨sems kyi dal bus ni/ /ji srid gnyid log bar du bzlas/ /seng ge'i nyal stabs dge bas nyal/ /bag yod dran dang ma bral ba/ /dngos sam 14—1137
bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (549)14wa 1139

༄pha /rje btsun sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam zhig 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i tshe/ /ltos ④pa thams cad rab spangs te/ /ci 'byor mchod pa sngon du bya//byang chub sems ni brtan par bsgom/ /'byung bzhi thim pa lha bzhir bsgom/ /rnam shes thim pa yid kyi lha/ /'od gsal la thim 'od gsal te/ /bskyed rim thim pa rdzogs rim bsgom/ /lus kyi shed nyams smig rgyu snang / /snying gar bla ma bsgom par bya/ /sgo dgu skams na skedu ba 'byung / /lte bar rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom—/ /drod brtul rjosrin bu me khyer 'dra/ /gsang bar don yod grub pa bsgom//dbugs chad mar me 'bar ba mthong / /smin mtshams rta mgrin bsgom par bya/ /srog bral nam mkha' 'dra ba la/ /thams cad 'dus pa lhag pa'i lha/ /de rjes ma bcos 'gro 'ong med/ /rang gis ⑤ji ltar bzod ltar bsgom/ /mthar ni pha ma'i sa bon gnyis/ /dkar dmar thig le nyi zlar gyur/ /kha sbyar dbus su rang gi 14—1140

sems/ /srog gi sa bon tsā ①yig blta/ /sna tshogs 'od zer 'phro 'du yis/ /'phags tshogs mchod cing 'gro don byas/ /bcu gnyis mdzad pa mthar phyung ste/ /gang 'dod zhing du 'tshang rgya'o/ /gson tshe srog rtsol la brten nas/ /thim pa bdun ni rim bzhin bsgom/ /'chi kur dngos su thim 'gyur bas/ /ma brjed tsam gyis 'grub par bzhed/ /rje btsun ār+ya tā ra'i man ngag la brten nas 'chi ka ma'i nyams len dpal chos kyi rje sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i kha che shākya shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas lo tsā ②ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/114 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉ri〈snar 〉thaltos/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉ras/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉mitul/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉rga/1141 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉lta/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉5/bskur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (550)14wa 1141

༄ga /'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā re ④sā dha rna ⑦nā ma/ bod skad du/'phags ma sgol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /'jig rten sgol mdzad sgol ma che/ /de la phyag 'tshal de sgrub thabs/ /mdo tsam slob ma la phan phyir/ /'dir bri sgrub pos grub gyur cig /dang por re zhig snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la t+t+waṃ rjoljang gu bsams ⑤la/ de'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang sangs rgyas la sogs pa spyan drangs te/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs can du bsams nas/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod de/me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa'i yan lag bdun rgyas par bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdog pa ma lus so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub bar du bdag 14—1142

skyabs mchi/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bdag gis bzung ①/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod pa yid 'ong spyad par bgyi—/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces ②brjod cing de dag gi don dran par bya'o/ /de nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom par byas tesne/byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms dag go/ /de'i rjes la chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudha rjosarba dharmā ⑤swa bhā wa shurnyophohaṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas pad+ma dang zla ba rang nyid kyi ngo bor bsam pa'i yi ge t+t+waṃ rjolas 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud 'od du zhu nas t+t+waṃ la thim pa'i bar dang de yang rim gyis zhu zhing thim nas thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom mo/ /yang sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran pas pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la t+t+waṃ sngon por langs la/ de yongs su gyur pa las ut+pal ljang gur blta zhing /de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros tshur 'dus ⑦yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur blta'o/ /de yang sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs skyil krung dang / phyag g.yas mchog sbyin par mdzad pa dang / g.yon u la'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing cha byad phun sum tshogs pa me long gi gzugs lta bur bsam par bya'o/ /de nas rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes bstems la/ thal mo gnyis sbyar ba las gung mo gnyis rgyab tu mdzub mo'i rtser sbyar te/ yid kyis snying ga'i pad+ma la t+t+waṃ ljang gu 'od zer 'bar bas don thams cad mngon par bsgrubs nas/ oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag bcus 'grub par 14—1143

'gyur ro/ /rigs pa dang yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad sdud par byed do/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i blos nam mkha' lta bur bsgom pa ni rim pa bzhin no/ /de las byung ba'i dge bas yongs su bsngos nas dge ba'i spyod pas gnas par bya'o/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1142 ①mtshan byang 'di'i chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉ring/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉warna/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉rta/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉bsam/1142 ①〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉〉kazung / ②〈〈pe 〉sngapo ra 〉7nos/ ①〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉skrun ste/ 0〈〈pe〉skopo ra 〉ṅkaḥ/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉〉〉ཿ/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉rta/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉〉pa/bskur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (551)14wa 1144

༄ga /'phags ma sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā ra sā ②dha ṭ+wāṃ/ bod skad du/'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'i yan lag rnams byas la/ byams pa dang /snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms te tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shusgoḥsarba snedharmāḥswa bhā wa shurnyophohaṃ/zhes brjod pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du mos par byas te/ de'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du yi ge t+t+waṃ ljang gu yongs su gyur pa dang / ut+pa la t+t+waṃ gis mtshan pa las 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig /phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pa mchog sbyin dang / g.yon pa ut+pa la'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil rjokrung gis gnas pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis nye bar mdzes pa/ me long dngas pa'i ⑤gzugs brnyan lta bur bsgom par bya'o/ /14—1145

de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du mtshon ①gang gi sku tshad dang ldan pa'i sgrol ma/de'i thugs kar ut+pa la'i steng na sa bon gyi yi ges mtshan pa bsam par bya'o/ /de'i 'od kyis 'og min nas ye shes sems dpa' bkug la mchod pa bya zhing /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / mnyes par bya'o/ /de nas spyi bo dang / mgrin pa dang / snying ga rnams su oṃ tshihūṃ zhes pa'i yi ge gsum po dkar po dang dmar po dang mthing nag gi kha dog can kyis sku gsung thugs byin kyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas yi ge t+t+waṃ gi 'od zer kyis ②de bzhin gshegs pa lnga la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs pa la mchod pa dbul ba dang / dbang bskur ba bya ste/ oṃ ā sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣe ①ka sa ma ya shri rjoye hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas de dag gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun phab pa dang / bdag nyid kyi sku gsung thugs yongs su tshim par 'gyur te/ bdud rtsi de'i rgyun phyi ma las grub pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub pa spyi bo'i steng du bsam par bya'o/ /yang t+t+waṃ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros te/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sgrol ma'i skur ⑤gyur nas slar de nyid la 'dus par bsam mo/ /de ltar yang dang yang rjospro bsdu byas te/ de la skyo bar gyur na oṃ tā re tuja re tu re swā hā/zhes bya bas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /'phags ma sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas byung ba rdzogs so// //14—1146

brtsar mchan/1145 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉tshog/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dzepo ra 〉stagablo/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stand/⑤〈〈pe mi'izhar 〉rang ba'i/1146 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉yekhyen/ ②〈'dir 〉4)/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉smon/ du〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉〉glo ⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈'ar 〉lhu ru/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉jidu/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (552)14wa 1147

༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bā rā tī ②tā ra sto tram̐/ bod skad du/rdo rje phag mo sgol ma la bstod pa/ rje btsun ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje phag mo che/ /sgol ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra bsam brjod med pha rol phyin/ /sgrol ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri med ye shes zla ba'i thugs/ /sgrol ma'i ⑦thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla 'od srid pa'i mun sel ba/ /'joms byed nyi ma'i dkyil dang mtshungs/ /thabs dang shes rab yon tan ldan/ /sgol ma la ni rtag tu 'dud/ /'gro la bu bzhin rtag tu gdung bu/ /srid gsum rnam thar gsum la 'god/ /seng ldeng nags la rab gnas shing / /'jigs pa brgyad las shin tu skyob/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod⑤/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror ⑥skur ston cing / / 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis sbyong mdzad pa/ /⑦sgol ma la ni phyag 14—1148

'tshal bstod/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams su/ /rin chen mkha' 'gror skur ston cing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal nad sel mdzad/ /sgol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gror skur ston cing / /bde ba chen po'i ngang la gnas/ /sgol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /las kyi mkha' 'gror skur ston cing / /phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad/ /sgol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i zhing khams su/ /pha rol phyin ma'i skur ston cing / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas tshogs dang bcas/ /sgol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dur khrod brgyad kyi zhing khams su/ /rdo rje phag mor skur ston cing / /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /sgol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba grags pas bstod pa mdzad pa rdzogs so// //14—1149

bsdur mchan/1148 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gag /rdo rje phag mo sgrol ma la bstod pa bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉tor nyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉stab/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stanadungs/⑤〈〈be 〉sko〈snar 〉skosgo/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉(1/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa'agro ba'i sgrib gnyis spyong mdzad pa//bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (553)14wa 1150

ras /sgol ma sde mo la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ u dre tā rā rū la tan+t+ra snesto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ sgol ma khro mo la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bstod pa/ jo mo byin rlabs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal ral pa gcig 'chang khro mo ni/ /mi ro dmar po'i steng na brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /rgyas pa'i lha mo stag dang sbrul gyis brgyan—/ /shin tu khros pas gad rgyangs ④cher sgogs pa/ /g.yas pas ral gri mthing gser rtse la me 'bar zhing / /'og ma gcod byed gri gug rab tu 'phyar/ /g.yon gyi dang po ut+pal rab rgyas shing / /'og ma thod pa skra bcas rak+tas bkang //ral pa'i thor cog dbu la rab tu mdzes/ /spyan gsum sa gsum gzigs pas rjodri med tshul/ /mgo bo'i thod phreng skam rlon spel mas mdzes de lta'i gzugs ni gzhan min bdag nyid do/ /dpal ral pa gcig ma'i rtsa ba'i sngags don 'gyur du bsgyur ba'i bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa rkang pa bcu gnyis 14—1151

༄ ga /rgya gar skad du/ u gra tā ra de wī sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/lha mo u gra tā ra'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab gsal byed u gra tā ra la phyag 'tshal lo / /'di nyid kyi bsgrub pa nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/gnas kyi khyad par/ ling ga gcig pa'am/ dur khrod dam/ khang stong la sogs pa'i gnas su/ ro ma nyams pa'am/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/gnas gsum du ②rdo rje gsum bsam par bya zhing / yi ge gsum las 'od zer 'phros—/ srid pa gsum po thams cad snang bar byas/ slar tshur 'dus nas thim par bsam mo/ /de nas stong pa nyid kyi don bsam zhing / oṃ swa bhā wa shu—ཿsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shustophokhruhaṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i gnas su ā ཿyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dmar po/de'i steng du t+t+waṃ ⑤yig yongs su gyur pa las ka pā la mtshan dang ldan pa'o/ /14—1153

de'i steng du hūṃ yig sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ gri gug sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma u gra tā ra nyid du gyur pa ni/ sku mdog sngon mo 'jigs su rung ba①/ mi mgo don pa'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ sku lus sbom thung /gsus khyim che ba/ ut+pa la'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhal gcig ma/ lha'i gzugs can ma/ bzhad ②pa'i gad rgyangs can/ dgyes par mdzad ma/ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ lang tsho gzhon sha dang ldan pa/ phyag rgya lngas yang dag par brgyan pa/ ljags 'dril ba—/ mche ba drag tu gdags pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang /thod pa thugs kar 'dzin cing / 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang / ut+pa la 'dzin pa/ dmar ser dang ldan pa'i ral pa gcig ma'i skekhrod na rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur pa'i lha mo'i ④skur bsam par bya'o/ /de ltar lha mo'i skur bsgom pa nyams su blangs pa nyid kyis sgrub pa po ni snyan dngags mkhan chen por 'gyur ro/ /de nas bzlas pa bya ste/ dz+rī rjoṭī hūṃ phaṭa/ces pa snying ga'i gnas su 'od zer rnam pa lnga dang ldan par ⑦bsams nas/yi ge rnams kyi 'od zer lngas mi shes pa'i bud shing bsregs shing / ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed par bsam mo/ /g.yas ral gri'i gnas su mi rus kyi phreng ba 'chang bar mos la bzlas pa bya'o/ /de ltar 'di'i sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa tsam gyis 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung gi dbang phyug thob par 'byed ro//'od zer spro bsdu'i sbyor ba nyid kyis yid rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag la bsgom ⑦14—1154

zhing / rang nyid snyan dngags ①mkhan chen po'i ②rig pa'i gnas lnga pa chen po'i paṇ+ḍi ta yin snyam du nga rgyal bya'o/ /de ltar bsgom pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pa nyid kyis the tshom med par snyan dngags mkhan chen po dang / gnas lnga pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por 'gyur ro/ /gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na/ gtor ma bsang ①sbyangs nas/ āḥlas byung ba'i thod par oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bsams la/ sngags 'di nyid kyis gtor ma dbul lo/ /oṃ dhīḥ.e ka dza ṭi/ ma ma u pa nī tā ya/ sarba satā rjoṭ+wāṃ/ shārnyi ku ru/ puṣ+ṭi ⑤ku ru/ rak+ṣ-i ku ru/༷ ma hā tak+ṣa ka /nā gā dhi pa ta ye/ i rma ba lo kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi gre2 ⑦pa ya kṛza skepa ya pa ra bi byā kar+ṣa ya kar+ṣa ya/ tra ṭa tra ṭa/ ts+tsha da ts+tsha da / ts+tsha da ya ts+tsha da ya/ oṃ yasahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis so/ /mchod pas mchod nas/ hūṃ gi yi ge las byung sngo zhing sgom thung ral pa'i thor tshugs ldan/ /g.yon brgyad ⑨mchog gis mi ro mnan cing mi bzad ⑩mchog gi gad rgyangs can/ /ral gri ut+pal dang ni gri gug thod 'dzin klu chen rgyan ⑪dang ldan/ /'gro ba'i mi shes mun pa 'joms mdzad sgrol ma drag mo khyod la 'dud/ /ces pas bstod do/ /gal te dngos dang rmi lam la sogs par 'byung po dang / sha za 'jigs su rung ba dang / bud med shin tu rid pa dang / sbrul la sogs pas 'tshe ba dang / yid mi phebs pa dang / bsgrub snying mi 'dod pa rnams byung na gegs yin pas/ 'di'i gtor sngags kyis gtor ma gtong ⑫zhing / rje btsun lha mo'i rnal 'byor la yid brtan pas thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam zhing / nyam nga ba dang /bag tsha ba nyid du mi bya'o/ /de dag thams cad rang bzhin par ⑫'gyur ro/ /14—1155

sgrub ①pa po yid spro ba dang / sems dpa' ba dang / bsgrub pa la blo brtan pa dang / rmi lam du ma dang / sring mo dang / rje mo la sogs pa'i bud med rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / lus sgom zhing brjid pa dang / dri ngad ldan pa khrul sogs pa'i bud med kyi tshogs kyis phyag mtshan puste ③la sogs pa ster ba dang /rang gis rnyed pa dang / nyi zla shar ba la sogs pa'i mtshan ma ni grub pa'i rtags so/ /rjes su yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags shing / dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can thams cad dang thun mong du yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /lha mo'i nga rgyal la gnas pas spyod lam thams cad yongs su bskyang bar bya'o/ /lha mo u gra tā rjora'i sgrub thabs rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī ba na rat+na'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang chos 'khor lo tsā ⑤ba 'jam dpal ye shes zhes bya bas dpal 'khor bde chen du bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //14—1156

—sgrub thabs zhas bya ba/①༄ ga /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya u gra tā ra sā dha rgo ④nā ma/ bod skad du—/ 'phags ma sgrol ma drag mo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrol ma srid pa gsum sgrol u gra tā ra la btud de/ /pad+ma'i ⑦man ngag ji bzhin de yi sgrub thabs bdag gis brjod/ /ling ga gcig dang de bzhin dur khrod yang na khang pa stong par ni/ /gnas der srid gsum grol ba'i rig ma rnal 'byor pa yis bsgrub/ /'jam par gyur pa'i byis pa'i ro 'am yang na 'jam pa yi/ /stan la sogs la mnyam gnas dngos grub mchog ni bsgrub par bya'orjo/ /thog mar kha gdong dag par rab byas gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /mdun gyi nam mkha' bla ma mchod la sdig pa bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bsod nams yongs bsngo lam ni rab tu bsten/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rjes su dran par ༷byang chub sems ni bskyed/ /skad cig rnam pa'i 14—1158

sbyor bas rdo rje gsum ni bde mnyam bzhag /de ni gnas gsum bsam bya de las 'od zer rab 'phros nas/ /srid gsum spyod pa'i sems can gsal bar mdzad nas slar yang ni/ /khams gsum mtha' dag bsdus nas stong pa nyid du bsam par bya/ /de nas shu n+ya tā sogs rang bzhin rgyal ba'i gsang sngags brjod—/ /de nas nam mkha' ①a yig las byung chu skyes dmar po bsam/ /slar yang de steng t+t+waṃ ④yig las ni pad+ma'i steng ④bsam bya/ /de dbus hūṃ yig mthon mthing dag dang mtshungs pa bsams nas ni/ /hūṃ yig de las skyes pa'i gri gug sa bon kyis brgyan parjo/ /gri gug yongs gyur bdag nyid sgrol ma mtshungs par bsgom pa ni/ /g.yon brkyang zhabs can mi bzad mgo bo'i phreng ba rab tu 'phyang / /chu skyes sngon po ⑤rnam par brgyan cing thung zhing lto 'phyang 'jigs byed ma/ /bzang mo rjozhal gcig phyag bzhi ⑦spyan gsum gad rgyangs 'od dang ldan/ /rab tu dgyes shing ro mnan klu brgyad kyis ni rnam par brgyan//dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan can stag gi pags ⑧pa rked la bsnams/ /lang tsho gzhon zhing phun tshogs phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /ljags ni rab 'khyug mche ba gcigs shing 'jigs chen 'jigs byed ma/ /phyag g.yas ral gri gri gug g.yon na ut+pal thod pa bsnams/ /ral gcig dmar ser gyen bsdes mi bskyod pa yis dbu brgyan ma/ /bsgoms pas stobs ni rab rdzogs rnal 'byor snyan dngags chen por 'gyur/ /gal te blun rmongs gyur kyang bsgom ⑨pa'i ro la 'bad byed na/ /bzlas pa 'bum phrag gcig gis 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid thob par 'gyur/ /snying gar yig gsum sngags chen rab bkod phaṭa yig mtha' ru'o—/ /yang dag 'od zer lnga ldan mi shes bud shing rab tu bsreg /rnal 14—1159

'byor spyod pa'i rjes 'brang de nyid btu ba'i cho ga brjod/ /dang por sa yi pha rol dbyangs yig bzhi pas rnam brgyan cing / /ra yis bzhon ①zhing 'od 'phros zla ba'i ②thig le yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin bzhi pas ta yig brgyan te rnam par yang dag sbyin/ /slar yang haṃ yig las sbyor yang dag u yig ring por ldan/ /phaṭa yig de nas sbyin zhing yongs rdzogs sgrub pa'i sngags nyid do/ /ral gri'i gnas su mkhas pas mi mgo'i phreng ba rnam par bsam/ /yang dag sngags mchog bzla zhing spro dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /brtan pa'i sems kyis brtag byas bdag nyid mkhas shing snyan dngags che/ /rab tu bsgom la goms pas de nyid the tshom med par 'grub/ /hūṃ gi yi ge las byung sngon zhing sbom thung ral pa'i thor tshugs ldan/ /g.yon brkyang mchog gis mi ro mnan cing mi bzad ①mchog gi gad rgyangs ④can/ /ral gri ut+pal gri gug thod pa 'dzin cing klu chen rgyan dang ldan/ /'gro ba'i mi shes mun pa 'joms mdzad sgol ma drag mo khyed la 'dud/ /sgol ma'i sgrub thabs rab byas dge ba bdag gis gang bsags pa/ /de yis 'gro ba ma lus rgyal ba'i bstan la mkhas par shogade 'dir rtag pa'i rdo rjes blo 'phel sgrub thabs byas pa yis⑤ zab mo la ni mkhas pa rnams kyis 'di la bzod pa mdzad rigs so/ /'phags ma sgrol ma drag mo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so—/ / //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī ba ༷na rat+na'i zhal snga nas dang /lo tsā ⑦ba mdzi shrīs ⑧slad nas bsgyur ba'osti// //14—1160

—sgrub thabs zhas bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ārlo gra tā ra sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du/'phags ma sgol ma drag mo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das ma ral gcig ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ yig las byung g.yon brkyang zhabs ni ro yi snying ga la gtad cing / /mchog tu drag tu bzhad pa'i phyag gis ral gri ut+pal gri gug bsnams/ /nag mo sbom thung cher yangs dmar ser ral pa'i lan tshar drag po yi/ /klus brgyan ka pā lar bkod 'jig rten gsum rmongs bdag la bzhon par mdzod/ /srid gsum sgol mdzad rgya nag rim pa'i sgol ma la btud de—/ /bla ma'i man ngag ji bzhin de yi sgrub thabs cho ga brjod/ /ling ga gcig pa'am dur khrod rtag tu stong pa'i khang pa yi/ /gnas der srid gsum las grol rig ma rnal 'byor pa yis sgrub/ /byis pa'i ro ni 'jam po'i stan nam gzhan yang 'jam pa yis/ /stan la yang dag 'dug ste dngos grub mchog ni 14—1162

bsgrub par bya/ /skad cig rnam pa'i sbyor bas rdo rje gsum po gnas gsum du/ /mnyam par gzhag pas bsam byas de las 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ /srid gsum spyod pa'i sems can rnams ni yang yang gsal byas nas/ /sna tshogs slar yang bsdus te kun nas stong pa nyid du bsam/ /de nas shu n+ya tā sogs rang bzhin rgyal ba'i gsang sngags brjod/ /de nas nam mkha' lhayig las byung chu skyes dmar po bsam/ /slar yang de steng t+t+waṃ yig las ni pad+ma'i snod bsam bya/ /de yi dbus su hūṃ yig mthon mthing dang mtshungs bsam byas nas//hūṃ yig de las byung ba'i gri gug sa bon gyis brgyan blta/ /gri gug yongs gyur bdag nyid sgol ma dang mtshungs bsam bya ste/ /g.yon brkyang zhabs can mi bzad mgo bo'i phreng bas rab tu brgyan/ /sbom thung 'jigs ma gsus pa 'phyang zhing chu skyes sngon pos mdzes/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum drag tu bzhad pa'i bzang mo 'od bzang can/ /rab tu dgyes pas ro mnan klu brgyad kyis ni rnam brgyan ma/ /dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan can stag gi pags pas smad dkris la—/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rab brgyan lang tsho gsar pa phun tshogs ldan/ /bskyod pa'i ljags dang mche ba gcigs pas 'jigs byed phyag bzhi yi/ /g.yas pas ral gri gri gug g.yon na ut+pal thod pa bsnams/ /dmar ser gyen badze+es ral gcig cod pan mi bskyod brgyan/ /bsgom pa'i stobs ni rdzogs las rnal 'byor snyan dngags chen por 'gyur/ /gal te rmongs shing blun pa'ang bsgom pa'i ro la 'bad byed na/ /sngags bzlas 'bum phrag gcig gis 'jam pa'i tshig nyid thob par 'gyur/ /snying gar yig gsum sngags chen 'di bkod phaṭa yig mtha' ru'o—/ /'od zer lnga dang ldan pas mi shes bud shing bsreg byed pa/ /rnal 14—1163

'byor spyod pa'i rjes 'brang de nyid btu ba'i cho ga brjod/ /dang por sa yi pha rol bzhi pa'i dbyangs nyid byin pas brgyan/ /ra yig la zhon 'od 'phro zla ba thig ler yang dag ldan/ /de nas bzhi pa steng du byin pas brgyan pa'i t+t+waṃ yig dang / /ring po'i u dang sbyor ba'i slar yang haṃ yig dang ldan pa/ /de nas phaṭa yig byin pas yongs su rdzogs pa'i sngags grub bo/ /ral gri mi rus phreng ba'i gnas su mkhas pas bsam bya ste/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis rgo yang dag sngags mchog bzlas/ /brtan pa'i sems kyis rang nyid mkhas dang snyan dngags chen por brtag /rtag tu bsgom pa goms las the tshom med par 'gyur ba nyid/ /sgol ma'i sgrub thabs bdag gis byas las dge ba gang bsags pa/ /de yis srog chags rnams ni rgyal ba'i bstan la mkhas gyur cig /'di ni rtag pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa dag ste 'dir/ /nongs gang mchog gi skye bo rnams kyis bzod par mdzad pa'i rigs/ /ral pa gcig ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin chen kyi zhal snga nas/dge slong chos smra ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes bsgyur ba'o// //oṃ 1ཿe ka dzā ṭī ma mo sa nī tā ya sarba satā māṃ shārnyi ku ru puṣ+ṭi ku ru rak+ṣe ku ru ma hā tak+ṣa ka nā gā dhi pa ti ye i me ba lo kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi grisnro pa ya kṛsnra pa ya pa ra bi t+yā kar+ṣa yā kar+ṣa taṭa tra ṭa ts+tsha da ts+tsha da/ ts+tsha da ya ts+tsha da ya oṃ ldihūṃ phaṭa swā hā/gtor ma'i sngags so// //14—1164

bsdur mchan/1162 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing /chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉pozhar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas dpe sdur byung med/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (557)14wa 1165

༄ga /ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ e ka dzā ṭi sā ④dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs/ ral gcig ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis ro yi snying dang rkang mnan khro bo'i gad mos bsdigs mchog ma/ /ral gcig ut+pal gri gug thod pa g.yas g.yon phyag ldan hūṃ yig sa bon las byung mchog /mi thung thod mo ral pa kham pa rgyas pa'i thor cog drag mo klu yis rab brgyan ma/ /'gro ba gsum gyi mun pa la bzhag rol ldan ⑧sgrol ma drag mo rang gi gsod ⑦par shog /rgya ⑤nag las byung srid pa gsum—/ /grol rjobyed sgol ma la btud de/ /bla ma rnams kyi man ngag bzhin/ /de yi sgrub thabs bdag gis brjod/ /mtshan ma gcig gam dur khrod dam/ /dus kun du ni khang stong du/ /rab tu mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /srid pa mthar phyin rig ma sgrub/ /bu chung ro 'jam la gnas sam/ /yang na gdan 14—1166

'jam 'bol ba la/ /kun tu gnas te rnal 'byor pas/ /dngos grub mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /skad cig rnam pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /yang dag rnal 'byor la 'dug nas/ /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum bsgoms la/ /de nas 'od zer spro ①bar bya/ /srid gsum spyod pa'i sems can rnams/ /gsal bar byas la tshur dgug cing / /bsdus rjes yang ni bsgom par bya/ /sna tshogs kun las stong pa nyid/ /de nas rgyal ba'i sngags brjod de/ /stong nyid bsgom zhing de dang las/ /a las mtsho skyes dmar po ltar②/ /de yi steng du yang bsgom pa/ /ṭ+wāṃ yig las byung pad+ma'i snod/ /de yi dbus su yang ni bsgom/ /hūṃ mdzad yi ge sngon po ste/ /de nas hūṃ mdzad las skyes pa'i/ /gri gug sa bon gyis brgyan pa/ /gri gug yongs su gyur pa las/ /bdag nyid sgol ma rab tu bsgomaske—/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang 'jigs su rung / /mgo yi phreng ba 'phyang ba mo/ /mi'u thung 'jigs byed gsus pa sbom/ /sngon mo mtsho skyes kyis brgyan ma/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum ldan ma ni/ /khro bzhad sdigs byed shin tu gsal—/ /kun nas dga' byed ro la gnas/ /klu brgyad rnam par brgyan pa ste—/ /spyan rtsa dmar zhing klum pa'o/ /sku smad stag gi pags pas rjogayogs/ /lang tsho dar bab phun tshogs ma/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /zhal nas ljags 'dril 'jigs ldan ma/ /mche ba gcigs shing g.yon du gzigs/ /g.yas pas ral gri gri gug 'dzin/ /g.yon pas ut+pal thod pa 'dzin/ /dbu skra kham pa drag pos brgyan/ /spyi gtsug mi bskyod rnam par brgyan/ /sgom kyi stobs kyis ⑤rdzogs pa na/ /rnal 'byor mkhas pa chen por 'gyur/ /gal te rmongs pa bems po yang / /sgom gyi ro la dbang gyur nasarjo/ /'bum phrag 14—1167

sngags kyi ①bzlas pa yis/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /sngags chen 'di ni yi ge gsum/ /phaṭa yig mtha' can snying la gnas/ /'od zer lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /mi shes bud shing sreg byed pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod pas rjes 'brangs nas/ /de yi ④bsdu ba'i cho ga brjod/ /dang po sa yi phyi ma bzung ④/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bzhi pas brgyan/ /gsal zhing 'bar ba ra la zhon/ /zla tshes thig les rnam par brgyan/ /de nas t+t+waṃ ④yig sbyin par bya⑤//dbyangs kyi yi ge bzhi pas brgyan/ /haṃ yig dbyangs yig drug pas brgyan/ /yang dag nyid du sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas phaṭa yig sbyin par bya/ /grub pa'am sngags ni yongs su rdzogs/ /mkhas pas ral gri stod sa ru/ /mi rus phreng ba bsgom par bya/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sngags mchog yang dag bzlas pa bya/ /brtan pa'i sems kyis bsam par bya/ /paṇ+ḍi ta bdag snyan dngags rjomakhan/ /sgom stobs rgyun ni ma chad na/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /sgol ma'i sgrub thabs byas pa yis/ /bdag gi ⑦bsod nams gang bsags des/ /rgyal ba'i bstan par skye bo rnams/ /snyan dngags ⑧mkhan du 'gyur bar shog /'di ni blo gros rab bsgrub ma/ /rtag pa'i rdo rjes byas pa yin/ /mkhas pa chen po paṇ+ḍi tas/ /'di la shin tu bzod par 'os/ /rgya nag las ni byung ba yi/ /sgol ma'i sgrub thabs yongs su rdzogs// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dā na shī las 'on 'di'i ⑨sku grong du lha'i skad las bod kyi brda ⑩la 'khrul pa med par bsgyur ba'o// //14—1168

bsdur ma na/1166 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gzha /ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / 〈〈snar 〉〉sku / /ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉su/③〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stanazhag ro yi gdan/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bsod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉sta5na/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgol/1167 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skaraphro/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉blta/ ni〈〈pe 〉〉bsgoms/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas pags pa/⑤〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉4)/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sdud/1168 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stani/ ②〈〈pe 〉stabs/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanazung / rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rta/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyas/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngarag ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stanas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngarag ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉tshoda'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉tharda'/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (558)14wa 1169

6 2༄ga /sgol ma sdes pa'i ba lo gi gtor ma/①༄7/ /lha mo ral gcig ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgol ma khro mo'i ba bo gi gtor ma la sngags 'dis lan gsum mam/ bdun gyis dbul te②/sngags ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ khyuḥ.e ka dz+dza ṭi sa ma ①ya/ ma rjobā na sa ha na swā gri khyaku ru puṣ+ṭi duku ru ma te tak+ṣa ⑦ka nā gā rā ⑧pa ta yas/ i rma ba shā kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi⑩/kṛrje ⑪pa ya kṛza ⑫pa ya/ pa ra mir+ya kros ⑫bru ṭa bru ṭa/ tshin+da tshin+da/④ bin+da bin+da—/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas phul la/ de nas rdo rje dbyangs can ma la bdag gi ⑫don la gsol ba gdab/ rjes mi dmigs pa'i ⑩rgyas gdab/dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo/ sgol ma khros pa'i ba li gi gtor ma rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dā na ⑩shrī las/ 'gren gyi 'phyang sar ⑫du rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //14—1170

༄ga /sgrol ma ral gcig ma'i blo 'phel bzhugs/1༄pha /'phags ma sgrol ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma/ /ba lo gtor ma phul ba bzhes nas su/ /'gro rnams ma rig ②mun pa bsal nas su/ /shes rab blo yi pad+ma kha 'byed shog /dmar mo rab 'jigs nam mkha'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi stang stabs mdzes/ /mi shes yid 'joms la btud de/ /gzhung don sgom ①rim 'di gsal bya/ /dang po kho nar rig pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ dur khrod dam phyi nang gi rten stobs ldan bzhugs pa'am/rab tu dga' zhing dbe+en pa'i sa phyogs su gnas khang byi dor bya/ rten dang mchod pa dngos sam yid kyi rnam 'phrul gyis bkod de/ bu chung gi ro 'jam zhing mnyen pa dri zhim po'i chus bkrus la/ me tog gi phreng ba btags la/rang nyid bde bar gnas pa 'am/ de med na yang stan 'bol ba la gnas te/bdag gis ral gcig ma bsgrubs la/ rang gzhan gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa rnam 14—1172

par gzhom par bya'o snyam du bsam mo/ /de nas skad cig gis rnam pa kun tu rtog pa'i tshogs rang sar dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag go/ /①jes la spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du/ oṃ dkar po dang / byedadamar po dang / hūṃ sngon po dang gsum shin tu gsal bar blta zhing / 'od zer gyi tshogs spros pas 'gro ba'i mi shes pa'i mun pa rnam par bcom nas gnas gsum gyi yi ge la bsdus la/ sku gsung thugs rnam par dag cing 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya'o/ /dngos po'am mtshan ma thams cad rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i don de nyid blta bar bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba byed kopho②haṃ/ zhes brjod cing / dngos po dang mtshan ma'i bag la nyal phra mo tsam yang med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas par bya'o/ /de'i ngang las t+padang ṭ+wāṃ ④rim kyis gyur pa las/ pad+ma dmar po dang thod pa khrag gis bkang ba/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ sngo zhing dngas pa blta par bya'o/ /hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las gri gug gi yu ba nas nyi ma'i steng na hūṃ gnas pa'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig ma sku sgom zhing thung ba/ mdog bai ḍūr+ya ltar sngo zhing dngas pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis ral gri dang ut+pal bsnams pa/ 'og ma gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas dbugs bral gyi snying dang rkang pa mnan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang / brgya phyed dang / stag lpags dang / klu brgyad sbrul sngon po'i gzugs kyis dbu rgyan dang / rna rgyan dang / mgul rgyan dang / dpung rgyan dang / phyag gdub dang rjo/ zhabs gdub dang / ska rags dang / se ral kha rnams kyis rab 14—1173

tu dpa' ba'i chas su zhugs pa/ spyi gtsug na thub pa mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa/spyan gsum me mdag ltar dmar zhing 'khrug pa cung zad g.yon du gzigs pa/ ①lce glog ltar 'a ga pa/ gad rgyangs chen po sgrogs pa/ phyi nang gi bdud thams cad rlag ②par byed par bsgom mo/ /de'i thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūṃ sngon po blta zhing /mdun gyi 'dab ma nas g.yas skor ⑦du/ 1 rjo— hūṃ phaṭa rnams bsgom zhing yig 'bru de dag las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas 'gro ba'i mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bsreg par bsam zhing / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan blo gros kyi snang ba thams cad tshur 'dus te rang la bstem zhing bdag nyid yon tan dang blo gros kyi snang ba thams cad phun sum tshogs pas brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas bzlas pa bya ste/ g.yas dang po'i ral gri mi rus kyi phreng bar bsgyur la/ thugs pad+ma nyi mar rig ⑤sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin la rjom g.yos pa'i ngang las 1 ⑦tro hūṃ phaṭa ces ci nus ⑧bzlas so/ /de las skyo na pad 'dab kyi yi ge hūṃ la bsdu/ bdag gzhan gyi blo gros ngan pa'i mun pa thams cad gtan nas dag par gyur cig snyam pa'i don lam drag po gdab po/ /rjes shes kyi skabs su yang rtag tu dpa' mo'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /de 'dra'i ting ⑨'dzin bzlas par bsam/ /brtan zhing tshad du skyol gyur na/ /mi shes sprin tshogs dpag med rnams/ /dbyar zad bzhin du dengs par 'gyur/ /sgrol ma'i blo 'phel slob dpon klu sgrub kyi man ngag snyan dngags ⑩mkhan rtag pa rdo rjes tshig le'ur byas pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dā na shrī la'i gsung lhag chad med par bkod pa rdzogs so// //14—1174

bsdur ma na/1172 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sdo 〉྾〈co 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉mthus/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉bsgom/1173 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzhag go/ /de'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉mi hwa/ ③〈〈pe 〉7cadang ṭa/ 〈po ra 〉risadang ṭa/④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉bodang /1174 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉khamache ba gcigs pa/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brlag ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskor/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyam/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉rigs/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉pas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉m+wa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉〉〉su/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sngasnar 〉〉〉nge / ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mi snyan dngags/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (56༷) 14wa 1175

༄ga /ral gcig ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ shukla e ka dzā ṭi sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ral gcig ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ ral gcig ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+mar gnas pa'i snod mchog la ni yi ge hūṃ las byung ba'i dkar mo ni/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum zhabs kyis gnas ma nu ma rab rgyas spyan gnyis yang dag dmar—/ /g.yas pas mi rus phreng 'dzin g.yon pas kha ma bye ba'i ut+pa la sngon po bsnams/ /ral pa kham pa dang ni ldan pa'i lha mos rtag tu khyed la skyong gyur cig /klu brgyad 'jigs rung dang bcas sems kyi dbang phyug dbu rgyan ②can//snying rje ro yis kun nas gang ba'i ljags bskyod bzhad mdzad ma/ /ri dwags dgra bo'i ④yi ni pags pa'i na bza' 'chang ba mo/ /de lta'i sgol mas mi shes mun pa gsod par byed par shog /dpal ldan gnyis med rdo rje yis/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi chu skyes la/ /btud de rol pa sbas pa yis/ /sgol ma'i sgrub 14—1176

thabs brjod par bya/ /dang por re zhig ①sngags pas kha bshal ba la sogs pa byas te stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug nas me tog dri zhim po bkram pa'i sa phyogs su ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa bshams la/ rang gi snying gar hūṃ dkar po nye bar blta'o/ /hūṃ dkar po de las rang gi ba spu'i bu ga dang / kha la sogs pa'i sgo las 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phro bar bsams te/ 'od zer de dag gis gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten kyi ①khams mtha' yas pa snang bar byas nas| de nas 'og min na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma 'chad par 'gyur ba'i sku mdog la sogs pa dang ldan pa/ gang yang bdag la gsol ba 'debs pa'i sems can de dag la byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /zhes pa cig car ①mdun na 'dug par ④bsams la/ de nas yi ge hūṃ las me tog bdug spos dri dang phreng ba la sogs pa spros pas mchod do/ /de nas byams pa dang /snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / mchod pa dbul ba dang / sdog pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe a ཿhūṃ zhes pas bsngags pa'i me tog la sogs pa ming spel dang bcas pas dbul lo/ /de nas bdag dang chos thams cad gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid bsgom par bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaḥrjosarba dharmāḥ⑦swa bhā wa shurnyolha⑧haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba byed kopho⑨haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas rngon lam gyi dbang gis ⑩yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dmar ⑪po dang / de'i dbus su yi ge ṭaṃ yongs su gyur pa las thod pa nor bu chu shel lta bu'i 'od can khrag gis yongs su gang ba/ de'i dbus su yi ge hūṃ dkar po 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa/ shin 14—1177

tu mdzes pa de yongs su gyur pa las ut+pa la sngon po kha ma bye ba yi ge hūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs par bltas la/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ sku mdog dkar mo stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can phyag g.yas pas mi rus kyi phreng ba 'dzin pa/g.yon na ut+pal sngon po kha ma bye ba bsnams pa/ ral pa kham pa gyen du badzes ①pa tshangs pa'i gnas kyi bar du shin tu khyab pa/ klu gdug pa can brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ karko ṭa sngon pos thod byas pa/ 'jog po dmar po'i do shal can/dga' bo dang nye dga' bo ser po dag gis skerna cha dag dang ldan pa/ mtha' yas dkar po'i tshangs skud can/ nor rgyas dkar po'i ska rags dang /dung skyong dkar pos phyag gdub byas pa/ pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po dmar pos zhabs gdub byas pa/ do shal dang / zhabs gdub dang / dbu rgyan dang /se ral khas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pas ro'i steng du gnas pa/ shin tu 'jigs su rung ba zhal mche ba cung zad gatshigs pa/ljags 'dril ①ba/ dpal mi bskyod rdo rje'i cod pan gyis spyi bor brgyan pa/byams pa dang snying rje chen po'i sems dang ldan pa cig rjobasgom mo/ /rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ dkar po'i 'od zer kyis ye shes sems ma'i dkyil 'khor dgug par bltas te/ de nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang /bcing ba dang / dbang du bya ba ste/ ye shes sems ma dang chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa ltar dbyer med par blta'o/ /de nas rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i pad+ma'i steng du yi ge 1 shel dag pa'i mdog ⑤lta bur 'od zer brgya stong 'phro 0bar bya'o/ /bsgoms ⑦pa las dub na sngags don dang ldan pa gzhal du med 14—1178

par myur ba dang / bul ba dang / mi gsal ba dang / ma tshang pa spangs nas yid kyis dmigs te bzlas par bya'o/ /de la sngags btu ba ni sde tshan bdun pa'i bzhi pa la mes yang dag par ldan pa'i yi ge i yis brgyan cing zla tshes dang thig les ①mdzes par byas pa'o/ /ji ltar 'dod pas bzlas pas ④so//lte ba'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du yi ge hūṃ shin tu 'bar ba blta'o/ /de nas phreng ba'i rdog po rnams yi ge 1 ①gi gzugs su bltas la/ de rgyun ma chad par rang gi kha nas 'thon te lte ba'i lam du zhugs shing kha nas byung bar bsams la/ sngags kyi rgyal po yig 'bru gcig po 'dis yid bzhin nor bu ltar sdig pa dang yams thams cad 'jig pa dang / dbang du bya ba dang /dbab pa dang 'gro ba 'khrug par byed pa'i sngags sangs rgyas kyi gsung blo gros du brtan pas bzlas par bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas snyan dngags mkhan du 'gyur ro/ /'dzin par nus pa dang / rdo rje lta bu'i tshig dang ldan pa dang / nor che ba dang / tshe ring ba dang / bstan bcos thams cad la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /khyung gi dbang po ltar srid pa gsum gyi dug med par byed pa dang / myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur bar gdon mi za'o/ /oṃ u1 hūṃ haṃ ⑤ha/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi rgyal po 'dis sangs rgyas nyid kyang sbyin par byed na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/oṃ āḥ1 duhūṃ ghā ta ya sarba bispyon hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ sngags 'dis gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma ral pa gcig ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/dpal gnyis med rdo rje las byung ba slob dpon rol pa'i sbas pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //14—1179

rgya gar shar phyogs pa ren+d+ra ṭī ga ta ①la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dā na shī las yul dbus kyi grub pa thob pa'i gnas drang srong srin po rir bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1176 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag /ral gcig ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈snar 〉〉brgyan/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bo/1177 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gig ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉wagyi/ ni〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉car/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉bzhugs par/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉gakhri 0〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉7stsa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ ⑧⑨〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉bo3/⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ston/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dkur/1178 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sta)sa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stabasgril/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanig⑤〈〈snar 〉zongag rjo〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉phro bar blta/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgom/1179 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pas/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wapas/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉nyam/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉gsungs blo/0〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉〉haḥ/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉nyam/118 ①〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉pe/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (561)14—1180

༄ga /ral pa gcig ma dmar mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ rak+ta e ka dzā ṭi sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ ral pa gcig ma dmar mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das ma ral gcig ma dmar mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ā snying gar ⑤oṃ yig las pad+ma dmar po lta bu las/de'i dbus su be+er yang bsam par bya ba a yig las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du/de'i steng du slar yang bsam par bya ba ①a yig las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang /de la hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje thod par bsam par bya/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi rjokhrag gis gang ba'i yi ge gsum gyis khyab par ro/ /slar yang nam mkha' la sna tshogs rdo rje bsam par bya zhing / de yongs su gyur par bcom ldan 'das ma bsam par bya ste/ zhal bzhi pa thung zhing lto ba 'phyang ba chen por 'jigs pa'i klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing cung zad 'dzum pa'i ro'i steng du lang tsho gsar pa yang dag par thob pa/ lo brgyad gnyis lon par bsam zhing /14—1181

mgo bo gsar pa'i phreng ba rab tu 'phyang bar byed pa dang / skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa yang ngo / /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dkris pa/ zhal dang po dmar po ya ba'i me tog dang mtshungs pa/ zhal g.yas pa kun+da dang zla bar sdematshungs pa/ zhal g.yon pa nag po sna tshogs dang / ut+pa la gsar pa sngon po lta bu'o—/ /steng zhal zhi ba bong bu'i zhal du ba'i tshogs 'dus pa nye bar 'bar bas rab tu mtshon pa'o/ /phyag brgyad la ral gri dang / gri gug dang / rdo rje lcags kyu dang / mdung 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhan la byed la sngon po dang / thod pa dang /gzhu dang / rdo rje zhags pa'i sdigs ④mdzub dang ldan pa'o/ /mchog tu dga' bas yang dag par mos ④par 'khyud par byed pa'i mi bskyod pa 'dzin pa rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan ④pa'o/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das ma spro ba'i gzugs su rnam pa dang bcas par mkha' la bsam par bya zhing / rnal 'byor ni ji ltar man ngag las tsan+dan dmar po'i 'bru'i phreng bas bgrang bar bya'o/ /blo dang ldan pa'i sngags chen po ni/ hri ghā khaṃ shrī byā ⑤yaḥbargyad lhag pa'i brgya bzlas pa las sgrub pa po tshigs su bcad pa byed/ khri tsho gcig bzlas pa las chos kyi phung po rnam par dbyed pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /ma thos pa rnams 'dzin zhing shes par byed do//'bum bzlas pas ral pa gcig ma dmar mo'i sgrub pa yang dag par ldan pa'o/ /'di mdzad pa ni kun spangs rdo rje zhes pas kyi'o/ /rang gi snying gar ut+pa rjol 'dab ma bcu drug pa bsam/ dbus su hūṃ yig dang 'dab ma la s+thāḥyig bsam/ hūṃ gi yi ge nas spros te bsgrub bya'i yid bkug cing slar yang 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i juḥyis spros te/ bsgrub bya'i mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings te sgrub pa po'i rkang pa la phyag byed par bsam te/ dhi hriḥ shrī twe⑦ཿ14—1182

che ge mo dbang du gyis ①ya/ de ltar bsgom zhing sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /gal te 'ongs par ma gyur na nges par 'chi'o /rgya gar shar phyogs paṇ+ḍi ta/ /mi dbang bzang po'i zhal snga dang / /dam chos smra ba'i btsun pa ni/ /legs pa'i blo gros bdag gis bsgyur/ /'di las byung ba'i dge ba ni/ /rnam par dkar ba'i bsil zer 'dis/ /gzhan sde'i ku mud tshogs rnams la/ /rtag tu dbugs 'byin byed par shog/ //bsdur mchan/1181 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa / /ral gcig ma dmar mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉〉kar/ ①〈pornor 〉to/ba/ 0〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉4)sa/1182 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉phob ba/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bsdigs/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉skospyos/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉skyun/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉nyarme/ 0〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉〉kar ad+ma/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉tri/1182 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bgyis/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (562)14wa 1183

༄ga /ral pa gcig ma dmar mo'i byin brlabs kyi cho ga①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ e ka dzā ṭi a dhiṣ+ṭha ④na bi dhiḥ④/ bod skad du / ral pa gcig ma dmar mo'i byin brlabs kyi cho ga /bcom ldan 'das ma dmar mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po pad+ma 'dab brgyad byas la/ de nas bum pa gcig rin po che la sogs pas yang dag par bkang ste/ de'i dbus su bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas slob mas bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal byas la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /de'i rjes su bcom ldan 'das ma'i maṇ+ḍal byas la skyor chur sbyangs te/ bdag bsrung ba la sogs pa byas nas/ dbus su me tog gcig dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes ④ pa'i sngags kyis me tog re la bsngags nas dbus su lan gsum dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas lha mo'i sngags kyis lan gsum dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ tā rā ma na sdemaḥ sngags 'dis lan gcig dang / oṃ asgo sgyu rjoya na maḥ14byed1184

zhes ①pas lan gsum dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ twe②ཿgu ṇa badzā ma ⑦na maḥ shar du'o—/ /oṃ khaṃ badz+ra tsakrā ⑪ na maḥ lho ru'o/ /oṃ gi badz+ra gaṇ+ḍa duyi na maḥdabus su'o/ /oṃ byāḥbi shwa badzā ⑤li na maḥ byang du'o/ /oṃ pradz+nyān+ta kā ya na maḥ bden bral du'o/ /oṃ pad+mān+ta kā rjoya na maḥ rlung du'o/ /oṃ bispyon+ta kā ya ⑦na maḥ dbang ldan du'o/ /dbus su yang bcom ldan 'das ma'i sngags kyis lan gsum du me tog dbul lo/ /mdun du maṇ+ḍal byas nas byin kyis brlab par bya'o/ /oṃ tā ⑧re gu ṇa badz+ra tsakra badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa badz+ra biṣ+ṭha badz+ra na dz+rī khaṃ gi byāḥs bā bi gha haṃ gu ⑨ru swā hā/ sngags 'dis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ sarba bhū ta rak+ṣan+tu ⑩swā hā/ spyi bor bsrung ba rnam par sbyin par bya'o/ /oṃ dzā ṭo dzā ⑪ṭo/u da ke na kā ⑫yash+tsa ka tsa tai bi sho dha ya tweḥ 'dis chu 'thung du gzhug ste lus ngag yid rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ dzā ṭi dzā ṭi i na nir ⑫dza ṭā ya kā yi bi sho dhā ya swā hā/ 'dis ral pa spyi bor bcing bar bya'o/ /lus rnam par sbyang ba'o/ /oṃ twe ṭaṃ ma ④le ma le a ne+e ⑫kā ma la wāg bi sho dha nā ya swā hā/'dis phreng ba sbyin no/ / ngag rnam par sbyang ba'o/ /⑩oṃ dzā ṭi dzā ⑩ṭi ma hā rak+ṣa karta ri ka pā ⑫la dha nuḥ⑩sha ra ya tsit+t+waṃ rjobi sho dhā ya swā hā/ 'dis gri gug dang thod pa dang gzhu dang mda' sbyin par bya ste/ sems rnam par sbyang ba'o/ /oṃ hūṃ snying ga ⑫la'o/ /twe 3mgo bor/ phaṭa spyi bor/ tram̐ mig la'o/ dh+rig phrag blula'o/ /khaṃ yan lag thams cad la'o/ /'dis yan lag drug bsrung bar bya'o/ /oṃ e bye hi e ka dzā ④ṭi ra ṇa ra ṇa ⑫da sha dika ⑪saṃ r+ghaṃ ku rudz+dza ghā bi nā ⑫ya ka na nirma thā nirma thā bi dz+nyā ⑫sa ya/ kha da kha da mā ra ya mā ra ya/ he bha ga wa tī sarba swa ⑫dha ni swā hā/ 'dis phyogs bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas sngags 14—1185

bshad la/ bu kye nga ni mi bskyod pa/ /mkha' la bcom ldan 'das ma bzhugs//gal te byin brlabs med pa la/ /sngags 'di bshad nas de yi tshe/ /khyod ni dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur/ /zhes ①rnam par brjod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i man ngag bsgom pa la sogs pa sngar bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /ral gcig ma dmar mo'i byen brlabs kyi cho ga /nag po spyod pa pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta mi dbang bzang po dang / lo tsā ②ba gzhon nu shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1184 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa /ral gcig ma dmar mo'i byin brlabs kyi cho ga bzhugs so// ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉8—/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7ཿ/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉〈shar 〉ṭhas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉〉〉 rā ye nā/ 0〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉ra /1185 ①〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉7 ces/ ske〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉hri/ ①〈〈pe 〉skozhar 〉ra badz+ra a/ bu〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ngortse/⑤〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉thadz+ra/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mid t+pā ta ka ⑦〈'ar 〉ṭha7rnya ka yā/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉ta/⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dzo/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉 ta rak+ṣa na du/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ra ṭo dza/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ka ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉ra ṭi dza ṭi a ni nar/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉hri ṭa ma le/ ske〈'a ra 〉ra/ ⑩〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ngag rnam par sbyang ba'o/ / ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉jo ṭi dza/ ske〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉༅rka ti ka pā/⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈sar 〉7ཿ/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉tsi te/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉khi/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉hri/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8 phrag pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉rab ka dza/ 〈shar 〉ra ka dza/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉ra/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7 rnyi ka ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ra/ spyo〈〈pe 〉skozhar 〉〉tha nor ma tha bi rnyi/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉skosar 〉sngag1186 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thes/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉tsha/14—1186

—man ngag ga sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ a gra tā ri ②ka dzā ṭī u pa de sha sā dha rgo/bod skad du/ mchog gi sgrol ma ral pa gcig pa'i man ngag gi sgrub ④thabs/bla ma dam pa rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rmongs pa'i blo ldongs dang / /tshe thung nad dbul dgra bgegs sogs/ /'jigs kun sgol mdzad sgol ma'i mchog /de yi bsgom rim 'dir gsal bya/ /dang po kho nar bsnyen pa tshad du son cing / sgrub thabs la blo 'dris pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dur khrod dam phyi nang gi rten stobs dang ldan pa la sogs pa bzhugs pa/ yid dang mthun zhing shis pa'i gnas khang byi dor byas la/ rten gsum dang / mchod pa lnga ci rigs pa dngos sam yid kyis bshams la/ nyal ba'i ras rjo'ajam dri bzangs kyis byugs pa'am/ yang gdan gzhan der bsgom mepa'i steng du/sems gnas pa'i yan lag tu lus skyil krung dhigis 'dug la/ legs lam kyi 14—1188

gzhi ma nas brtsams te/ chos thams cad kyi mchog gi blo sngon du btang nas/rang lus tha mal par gnas pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar lo gyur pa las sa'i dkyil 'khor—/ sna bug g.yas pa nas rngubs pa las/ rlung mkhris bad kan la sogs pa'i nad gzhi thams cad dang / nang khrol ①ljan ljin mi gtsang ba'i rdzas thams cad ded pas bshang lam nas 'thon te/ 'og gi zhing khams dpag tu med pa blos chud rjotshad du bskyal/ yang mdun gyi baṃ gyur pa las chu'i dkyil 'khor sna bug g.yon ①nas rngubs pas/ lus kyi nang gi dri ma thams cad dag par bkrus te/ chu lam nas bton rjonas snga ma bzhin du bskyal lo/ /de nas rlung kha sbyor gyi 'og nang du lud pa'i lte bar yi dang / rtsa gsum gyi mdud mdor ram̐ gyur pa las/ me dbal sran ma tsam cig bsgom mo/ /de'i 'og sgo'i yi las rlung g.yos pa las me lce dar skud tsam cig dmar nar gyis 'bar te de las 'od zer dus mtha'i nyi ma ltar tsha ba du ma 'phros pas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas lus rjokyi sdig sgrib thams cad bya sgo la me mched pa ltar skad cig gis bsregs—/ me lce snying gar slebs rjopas snying gi pad+mo'i ⑦dbus kyi hūṃ spros pas/de las ④'od zer nyi ma shar ba ltar 'phros ⑨pas lus kyi nang thams cad du khyab pas—/ sgrib gsum gyi gnas ngan len bag chags dang bcas pa ⑩thams cad kha sna dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rlung gi spyotshul du 'thon nas/ lus shel dkar gyi gzhal yas khang bzhin du dag par ⑫bsam/ de nas me lce mgrin par slebs ⑫pas/ aX④las 'od 'phros pas/ spyi bo'i oṃ zhu ba'i dngas ma'i thig ⑫pas thugs kar 'bar 'dzag gi ting nge 'dzin brtan par bsgom⑩/ de nas thugs ka'i ⑩hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pas 14—1189

dpa' bo ①brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i bla ma rnams spyan drangs te/ rang gi spyi gtsug gi steng nas mar rim gyis zhugs pa la bdun rnam dag sngon du btang la/gsol ba drag tu btab pas pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa de steng thod khrag /de'i steng ram̐ las nyi ma/ de steng hūṃ las gri gug rdo rje'i yu ba hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros pas don gnyis byas pa las/ tshur 'dus pas bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma sku mdog sngo bsangs bai ḍūr+ya ltar dngas pa/ me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na/ nyi ma dngas pa dang / ma dang dbugs bral kyi ro'i ②steng na zhabs g.yas bskum pas ro 'jam pa'i long bu mnan pa/ g.yon pa cung zad brkyang bas snying gar ①brdzis pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod lang tsho ④dang gzi brjid kyis mdzes pa/ shin tu 'khrugs pa mi'u thung gi sha tshugs can/sku sbom la rags pa gsus khyim che ba/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/mgo rlon klad khrag 'dzag bzhin pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang / ut+pa la pustes ⑤brgyan pa bsnams pa/zhal mche ba bzhi gcigs pa/ ljags bar snang gi glog ltar 'khyug pa/ ha ha dang / nyi hi'i gad rgyangs chen po bsgrags pas phyi nang gi rjobadud thams cad skrag nas 'byer ba/ sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'tshub pa/ smin phrag dang dpral bar khro gnyer bsdus pa/ spyan gsum po ⑦dag me'i phung po ltar dmar shig ge bgrad ⑧nas cung zad g.yon du gzigs pa/ ral gcig kham ser gyen du badze+es pa/ thod skam lnga yis skra mtshams brgyan pa/ me tog sna tshogs mdzes pas spras pa/ dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/14—1190

zhabs gdub/ se mo do rnams klu chen brgyad kyis rigs lnga'i kha dog tu dpa' ba'i chas su btsugs ①pa/ rgyan drug po de dag ④kyang rus chen dang / rin po che dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa gsal btab la/ cig car ④chu nang gi zla ba'i rjogazugs ltar mi skyo ba'i ⑤bar du bsgom par bya'o/ /bsgoms rjopas skyo na bzlas pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /de'i rang thugs pad+ma nyi ma'i dbus kyi hūṃ sngon po la/ mdun nas g.yas skor ⑦du 'dab ma bzhi la twe ⑧tho hūṃ phaṭa/ces pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bag chags dang bcas pa bcom nas/ sdig pa'i tshogs thams cad ye nas yang dag par brjod de/ 'od des bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa dang / rigs lnga yab yum phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ma lus pa bskul te/bdag la dbang bskur pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i lhag ma lus ⑨pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /yang de las 'od 'phros pas don gnyis byas/tshur 'dus pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan ma lus pa bdag gi thugs kar thim pas/ phyogs bcu nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas ⑩ gyur pa nga yin snyam pa'i sems pa yang bya'o/ /gang na yang phrin las tshad med kyi 'khor lo dang / sgrol ma 'od lus kyi 'pho ba dang / bar do nyi ⑪lam gyi man ngag dang / phan brtson byang chub kyi spyad rlabs ⑫la sogs pa thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad ⑫yin pas skabs gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar sngon 'gro'i sgom thabs ④rdzogs pa dang / g.yas ral gri/ g.yon ut+pa la'i puste'i ⑫rgyab tu bshags ⑩pa'i tshul du phyag gug gi dung chen ⑩gyi phreng ba bzung la/thugs pad+ma 'dab can ban+d+ra'i me tog ltar dmar ba la yi ge 'bru bzhi btso ma'i 14—1191

mdog can mdun nas chos skor du bkod la/ bskyed rim ①las ma g.yos shing /phrin las kyi rnal 'byor gyi ngang las bzlas so/ /'jog khar yig 'bru las 'od zer dkar sngo dmar ser nag po lnga las/ tshe dang longs spyod 'khor dang grags pa ye shes lnga bsdu bar bya'o/ /'chi med dbang phyug mi zad gter kha bye/ /sa gsum kun khyab 'gro kun 'dren pa'i mchog /lnga rig kun mkhyen nga snyam nga rgyal gzung / /sems nyid yid bzhin mchod na 'dod dgu 'grub/ /ces so//de nas yid skyo na pad 'dab kyi yi ge hūṃ la/ de thig le la bsdus pa/ thig le stong pa yi ge med ces so/ /spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang grol te/ bdag gzhan gyi blo gros ngan pa'i tshogs thams cad dag par bsams nas/ 'dod pa'i don gzhan la gsol ba drag tu btab ste/ rang bzhin med pa'i ngang las bsngo ba'i rgyas btab ste/ rjes shes kyi gnas skabs su'ang spyod lam thams cad phrin las kyi rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /de ltar bsgom bzlas kyi rnal 'byor 'dris pa dang / dngos sam rmi lam gyi rtags rnams 'byung ②/ yid gzhungs ④dran bzang ngag rgod snyan dngags memakhas/ /gzhan byams nad zhi stobs dang longs spyod 'phel/ /zhing mthong phyag yul rin chen ri rjodang khri/ /chu 'thungs rgyun dhiganyis zag pa mi rtag brgyad⑦/ /de ltar rtags rnams ma byung na sbyin sreg bya zhing sngags kyi bsgrub pa ④'bad par bya'o/ /chos rnams gdod nas ye stong phyir/ /bsam brjod bral ba'i don 'di la/ /sna tshogs lta ba kun spangs la/ /mchog gi rnal 'byor yid la gyis/ /mchog gi sgrol ma ral pa gcig pa'i man ngag gi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi ⑨bdud rtsi bdag nyid chen po klu sgrub kyi mchog gi rim pa che'i dngos grub brnyes ⑩ 14—1192

pa 'chi med go cha las brgyud pa/ snyan dngags ①mkhan po rtag pa'i rdo rje'i man ngag /lnga rig skol ②du gyur pa bha gu paṇ+ḍi ta'i ①khyad chos/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇa chen dā na bushī la las/ shākya'i dge slong rig pa 'dzin pa khu rnal 'byor pas 'on dmar ⑤saṃ skṛ ta'i skad las rang 'gyur du gsungs so/ /bsdur mchan/1188 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod ras /sgol ma lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tā ra de ba pañtsa sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/sgol ma lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ thugs rje che ldan ma yi dpal ldan ye shes ma/ /gsal ba'i thugs rje 'gro la ston/ /bdud bzhi tshar gcod ston pa'i mchog /lha mo brtse sneldan ma la nyer btud de/ /'gro ba'i gdugs gcig ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi sgrub ④thabs cho ga bshad/ /bas mtha' shing gcig lha yi gnas—/ /dur khrod dbe+en pa bkra shis pa/ /dad ldan dbang thob dam tshig ldan—/ /gsang thub gus la shes rab che/ /dpa' la brtson 'grus blo ldan pas—/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod pa bdud rtsir ldan/ /rten dang mchod pa'i yan lag bcas—/ /lha gsal buspyan drangs phyag 'tshal te/ /mchod pa bdun po tshad sked gsal/ /'od spro bsdu dang stong par gsal/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na swa bhā ba ā ko3⑤haṃ/ de las t+t+waṃ gi rjos bon las/ /yi dang baṃ gyis rlung dang chu/ /14byed1195

lo ①dang ram̐ gyis ②sa dang me/ /de steng hūṃ ①las gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan/ /mu khyud lte ba rtsibs bzhir ldan/ /gru chad sgo bzhi rgyan dang ldan/ /dbus su pad+ma dur khrod gdan/ /rtsibs la dur khrod pad+mas mdzes—/ /de steng t+t+waṃ rjozhu hūṃ du gsal/ /de la thod pa hūṃ gis mdzes/ /spro bsdu sbyor bas sku bskyed do/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ /spyan gsum rngam pa'i nga ro can/ /sbrul dang stag lpags ⑤rus pas brgyan/ /ral gri rus phreng gri gug bsnams/ /ut+pal thod pa g.yon par 'dzin/ /thod phreng bong dhithung 'gying pa ⑦can/ /nu 'phyang bcu drug lo ltar mdzes/ /me ri phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /dbu skra dud kha thod pas brgyan/ /shin tu gsal bar mdangs ldan bskyed/ /de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /shar gyi rtsibs la oṃ 'phros pas/ /dkar po 'od ldan gsal bar bsam/ /zhu bas rdo rje sgrol ma bskyed—/ /mdog dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /rus pa'i rgyan dang sbrul gyis brgyan/ /stag lpags thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pa ni—/ /ut+pal dkar po 'dzin pa bskyed/ /lho phyogs rtsibs la twe④ཿ'phros pas//ser po 'od ldan zhu ba yis/ /rin chen sgol ma gser mdog la/ /rgyan ldan phyag g.yas rin po che/ /ut+pal ser po 'dzin pa ste/ /brkyang bskum khro mo'i cha lugs la/ /dgyes ⑨pa'i gar dang ldan pa bskyed/ /nub phyogs rtsibs la tri 'phros pas⑩/ /pad+ma'i sgol ma thugs rje can/ /mdog dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /phyag g.yas pad+ma dmar po 'dzin/ /g.yon pa ut+pal rang rtags te/ /rgyan ldan gong dang mthun par bskyed/ /byang phyogs rtsibs la phaṭa 'phros pas/ /las kyi sgrol ma sna tshogs mdog /phyag g.yas ral 14—1196
