gri 'bar ba ste/ /g.yon pa ut+pal rang rtags te/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan—/ /bskyed la ye shes spyan drangs la/ /mchod bstod byas la gnyis med bstem/ /byin brlabs dbang bskur rdzogs byas la/ /mi gsal bar du gsal bar bsgom/ /skyo na bzlas pa 'bad par bya/ /snying ga'i dkyil du yig 'bru lnga/ /kha dog lnga ru gsal byas la/ /lnga las 'od lnga spro byas la/ /lnga sbyangs tshur 'dus lnga ru gsal/ /rab 'bring tha ma gsum dang drug /bcu gnyis bar du 'grub par 'gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab gsal bar bsgom/ /bzhi po sreg gso bde ba rgyas/ /rdo rje nor bu'i rtse la drang / /bsgyil zhing bde ba nyid la blta/ /mtshan ldan snod du bzang pos dgang / /lnga las 'od 'phros 'dod lnga dgug /gnyis med bsnyims la longs spyod bya/ /mi rgod sa dang ske tshe dang / /sngags dang ting 'dzin bcas pas bcing / /oṃ a mu ki pra shā ma ①nā ya swā hā/ zhi ba dkar po 'phro 'dus sbyar/ /rgyas pa ser po bsod nams rgyas②/ /mi rmongs dbang du dmar pos bsdus/ /mngon spyod nag po'i las skekyis gsad/ /shes rab 'phel ba'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /nyi shu bar du bsgrub par byadu/ /dkar gsum chu gtsang sgyur rtsis dgang / /sngags bzlas tho rangs dus nyid du/ /gsol btab de dus bza' bar bya/ /oṃ pradz+nyā pa ra tā dhir sa ta sum̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab lta bur 'gyur/ /brtson 'grus ldan pas sbyar bar ⑥bya/ /lha nye 'dod pa'i sbyor ba yispyo thang ka lugs sku ras ris la/ /rab gnas byas la lhar bskyed la/ /ye shes bstems la mchod bstod bya/ /bdag nyid tha mal nyid du ste/ /bzlas pa bri ⑧bya gsol btab 'grub/ /oṃ rat+na si tu bī ra ste hūṃ phaṭa/ mig ni ⑨gsal 14—1197

bar 'dod pa yi/ /rin chen snod du 'o mas dgang / /na le sham gyi rdzas kyang blugs—/ /rten gyi mdun du bzhag ①byas la/ /lhar bskyed gsang sngags 'bum du bzlas/ /oṃ tā ②ra tsagru sa ma ti hūṃ phaṭa/ srid gsum gsal ba'i shes rab 'char/ /lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po dang / /ro langs mkha' 'gro mi ma yin/ /gnod par mi 'gyur dbang du 'du/ /bdud dang mu stegs pham par byed/ /'jigs chen brgyad las rnam par thar/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod zla bzhin rgyas/ /shes rab nyi ma lta bur 'gyur/ /nyon mongs bag chags mkha' bzhin 'gyur/ /gang 'dod thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri rnams dang / /ro dang reg las phun sum tshogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod las/ /skad cig ma lus 'grub par 'gyur/ /nad kyi rigs su gang gtogs pa/ /me dang rtsi bur ④lta bur 'gyur/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug grags dang ldan/ /shi 'phos bla med zhing du skye/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro'i spyan snga ru/ /lo gcig zla ba gang bsgrub pa/ /smod ⑦du btsugs ⑤te 'bad par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la/ /rab gnas dbang ni bskur byas la/ /dus bzang mchod dang gtor ma dbul/ /me tog sngon pos maṇ+ḍal dbul/ /de ltar lha rnams lung ston 'gyur/ /'bad par gyur kyang rtags med na/ /nyams dang sdig pa che ldan pas/ /sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor maṇ+ḍal dang / /sku gzugs bzhengs la bshags pa bya/ /lha yi spyan sngar gsol ba gdab/ /bzlas pa gnyis rjo'abum bskyar la 'bad/ /bdag la bri ba'i mthu med kyang / /sgrol ma ral gcig gtso bcas la/ /mos pa'i gang zag dngos grub 'dod/ /de yi don du rnam 14—1198

par bkod/ /dngos grub lha yi zhal mthong shog /sgol ma lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rin po che gsal ba zhes bya ba/ slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta ra ta na dha ti dang / bod kyi mo tsā ①ba rma ban chos 'bar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //༄4/ /rgya gar gyi yul shar phyogs na/ slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rje chos bshad kyin yod pa la/ phag rdzi ma rgan mo zhig ②der btud nas/ res zhing ni ngu / res zhing ni dgod ④pa la/ slob dpon gyis mkha' 'gro ma cig yin par shes nas/ khyod res ngu res dgod ④pa ci nyes byas pas nga dgod ⑤pa khyod phyin ci ma log par bshad pa la dga' nas dgod rjopa yin/ngu ba khyed rang gi rgyud la mang ⑦ma thebs par 'dug /slob ma la yang khyed grags phyir la nyan gyin 'dug pa la ngu ba yin zer/ der phyag dang bskor ba byas—/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas gang las ⑧zhu byas pas/ nga phag rdzi ma rgan mo cig la chos ci la yod/ ngas stikhyod la lung bstan gyis/ zangs gling ⑩phyi'i yul na rnal 'byor pa jo mo sgrol ma bsgom pa cig yod kyis/ der song la gdams pa zhus shig ⑪zer nas/ slob dpon gyis gser mang bar bsnams nas byon pas zangs gling ⑫gi rgyal po cig la 'di na jo mo sgrol ma bsgoms ⑫pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig yod par 'dug pa/ gang na yod dris pas/ de nga'i mchod gnas yin lung pa'i phu ya gi na yod zer/ der rgyal po la gser zho gcig phul nas—/ nga dang mjal ④bar zhu skeba'i zhu ba 'bul dgos byas pas ⑩de byar mi 14—1199

'dod khong gi nga ma shi bar du mchod gnas byas par ①chad/ ngas khong la chos zhu ba la sogs pa ci byung yang ngo mi byed par chad pa yin zer/ 'phrad pa'i thabs yod dam byas pas yod kyis/ dgon par song ②de'i sgo na jo mo sgrol ma'i sku cig yod kyis bskor ba byed du nang par 'ong gis/ bskor ba zin zin du sdod la zin pa dang / rdo gru bzhi cig gi steng du cung zhig sdod kyis/ der maṇ+ḍal phul la zhus shig ①zer ro/ /der byon nas bsdad pas nang par byon nas mdun ④la bskor ba mdzad nas rdo'i steng du bzhugs pa la gser phul nas gdams pa zhus pas/ gser bsnams nas slob dpon la phyi rgan rgyab nas nang du gshegs so/ /der zhag gsum la gsol ba 'debs kyin bsdad pas/ zhag gsum nas byon nas khyod ci 'dod gsung / bdag sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag zhu byas pas/ jo mo sgrol ma dngos grub brtan par gzigs pa'i rgyud la brten nas gdams pa gnang nas bsgrubs pas lo gsum gyis zhal gzigs/des sgrub thabs las tshogs thams cad mdzad/ de'i slob ma a mo gha badz+ra chen po/de'i slob ma bla ma rdo rje gdan pa/ des snyeb ri lo tsā spyob dang / rma chung lo tsā 7 ba la gnang ngo tsa// dū//14—1200
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (565)14wa 1202

༄ga /dus mtshams srang mda'i las/①༄4/ /dus mtshalas nag mo zhes bya ba dang / bdud kyi srang mda' nag po zhes bya'o/ /srog gnad la dbab pa nag po de ba ta la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde brgyad 'thab pa'i nyi ma la/ /'brub khung gru gsum pa brtsigs la/ /dur khrod sol bas byugs pa la/ /ming dang rus su bcas pa bri/ /'brub khung nag po'i nang du gzhug /bya nag mo yi sgong la/ /dgra yi ming rus bris pa la//rkang gis srang brgyus pa yi thag /thod tshal khung du gzhag byas la/ /dug dang mi khrag yungs kar la/ /stsong byed yu yis byugs byas la/ /sgyug sdong nang du blugs byas la/ /zhag gsum bar du sngags 'dis gdab/ /nyi badz+ra ma hā kā la ni sa la te rak+ṣa hu snur pa ha na dha ru mā ra ya phaṭa/ 'od dang sgra ni de la 'byung / /de nas sgo nga'i drag sngags so/ /hi sha rā ra ga ma sā d+mā klu sha la ma rā ya phaṭa/ he ma tsa sa ma ya dz+dza dzā/ sgo nga nga la drag tu gdab/ chod de ④14byed1203

brdung dang sgo brdung dang / /mi nag mgo nas 'then pa 'byung / /rma bya'i sgro yi klad la skor/ /de yis cho 'phrul zhi bar 'gyur/ /sngags des sgo nga lci bar 'gyur / /'brub khung nang du lhung ba dang / /thun brab gsad pa'i sngags 'di'o//sa ma yā che ge mo mā ra ya sod/ bdud po srog la yaṃ he dza dza/ bdud po srog na dha ru na/ hi ma hā kā la sa ma ya dza dza/ zhag bdun bar du gsad pa brtsam//de nas de ni chu la dor/ /de yis bzas pa brlag par nges/ /dus mtshams srang mda'i las/ /gu ru lhu sho ris mdzad pa'o// //bsdur mchan/12༷2 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉stajong nge /bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (566)14wa 1204

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā ru ṇa tā ra sadha ④rna/ bod skad du/thugs rje sgol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ thugs rje nye 'gyur khro mo lha mor ston//mtho ris thar pa'i bgegs rnams sgol mdzad ma/ /'jigs pa chen po brgyad skyob cing / /'dod yon lnga yi gdung ba sel/ /phrin las bzhi yis 'gro don mdzad—/ /rtag tu sems can mdun du bzhugs①/ /gsol ba btab pas mi bsru ba'i/ /sgol ma ral gcig ma la 'dud/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i bka' drin gyis—/ /snyan brgyud rjozhal nas lung bstan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis dhigasungs pa ni/ /gnyis po 'brel 'dod don du bri/ /gsang ba las ⑦kyang ches gsang ba/ /zab pa bas kyang zab pa nyid/ /mchod pa bzhin du 'dod pa yis/ /theg chen rigs ldan smin pa des/ /lha yi mtshan ma dur khrod dang //khang stong dben la bkra shis par/ /mchod yon zhal zas ldan pa la/ /bsdam 14byed1205

bya bsdams ①par byas nas kyang / /'jam pa'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /skad cig legs nyes ④bdun po gsal/ /'od kyis ①srid gsum gsal nas su/ /bsdus te thams cad stong sngags gsal/ /dang po pad+ma dmar po'i steng / /sa bon pad+ma nang du hūṃ/ /gri gug hūṃ bcas byung ba ni/ /ral gcig sgol ma rje btsun ma/ /g.yon brkyang mgo bo'i ⑦phreng bas brgyan/ /thung zhing gsus pa 'phyang ⑤ldir 'jigs/ /pad+ma sngon po ro yi gdan/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i sku mdog 'chang / /zhal gcig spyan gsum te he bzhad/ /klu brgyad stag gi pags pas dkris/ /bcu drug gnas dupa 'o mas brgyan/ /lngas brgyan ljags 'dril mche gcigs 'jigs/ /rus chen phreng ba ral gri gug /rang rtags bde skyong kham ral gcig /dmar zlum me stag phung po can/ /dbu rgyan dur khrod rin chen spras/ /dgug dang gzhug dang mchod ston ⑦nas/ /yi ge gsum ni sngags chen po/ /phaṭa ni mtha' ru snying gar ⑧gnas/ /'od zer lnga dang mnyam du mtshungs/ /mi shes ⑨bud shing bsregs ⑩pa'o/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /de yi btu ba'i cho ga bshad/ /dang po sa yi phar phyogs sbyin/ /dbyangs yig bzhi pas rnam par brgyan/ /ra la zhon cing 'phro ba'i 'od/ /thig le zla tshes yang dag ldan/ /de nas t+t+waṃ ⑪yig sbyin par bya/ /bzhi pa nyid kyis ⑫rnam par brgyan/ /ring po dag dang yang dag ldan/ /hūṃ yig yang ni sbyin par bya/ /phaṭa kyi yi ge de nas sbyin/ /yongs rdzogs grub pa'i sngags nyid do/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /drug pa gsum na 'grub par 'gyur/ /gsum kha gsal zhing brtan pas so/ /mchog thugs gsum ste kha dog lnga/ /lnga sbyangs lnga gsal lnga ru 'grub/ /nam mkha' 'brug 14—1206

sgra sprin sangs nas①/ /nyi ma zla ba gsal bzhin sdergyas/ /shes rab ngos na gnas pa nga / /'byung ba'i lha mo gshegs byon nas/ /rang nyid dbyebs kyi rnam pa yi/ /gnyis kyi gcig tu gtubs la rol/ /lnga las lnga 'phros lnga bkug la/ /bha gar thim pas rjolongs spyod bde/ /yid du 'ong ba thams cad la—/ /dbyibs dang ngag ni brtan pas bya/ /rgyu ba'i bar chod mi rgod dang / /sa dang rnal ma ske tshe rjoyang / /dbang po'i ting 'dzin sngags dang bcas/ /gsal na the tshom mi bya'o/ /gcig nas phyed du 'jam dbyangs bsgrub/ /chu gtsang dkar gsum sgyur rtsi la/ /sngags bzlas bsgrubs te tho rangs btung / /rigs gsum gtso bo melta bur 'gyur/ /oṃ pradz+nyā puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā/ phan yon bzhin du 'dod pa yis/ /sku gzugs spyan sngar mchod pa dbul/ /rgyu ba bzang dus gsol btab ④'grub/ /bar chad ④gzungs kyis ⑨zhi bar 'gyur/ /a mu ki pa sha ma nā ⑩ya swā hā/ tshangs pa khyab 'jug nyi zla dang ⑪/ /drag po phyogs skyong 'dod lhas kyang / /ba sru'i rtse mo'i ⑫gnod mi nus/ /'chi bdag las rgyal 'gro ba bzhin/ /skra dkar gnyer ma skad ngan nad/ /dbul ba la sogs mdor bsdus pa/ /nad sogs 'jigs pa che brgyad dang ⑫/ /sdug bsngal rab tu 'joms par byed/ /bskul ba med par gos btung dang / /khang bzang rin chen sogs kyang ④'du/ /ral gri dang ni mig sman dang / /rkang pa bum pa bzang sogs 'grub/ /tshigs bcad mkhan dang snyan dngags ⑫mkhan—/ /blo rno shes rab dri med 'gyur/ /gzhan yang ci 'dod dngos grub la—/ /'khor lo las ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bdag la bri ⑫ba'i mthu med kyang / /bka' dang bla ma'i gdams pa yis/ /ral ⑩gcig ma yi sgrub thabs 14—1207

༄ga /sgol ma'i nang gi gtor chog bzhugs/①༄7/ /rje btsun ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pa yis/ /mtshan ldan bkra shis snod du ni/ /sha dang bdud rtsi sna lnga dang / /khrag dang chang sna tshogs kyis dgang / /rlung dang sgyed pu me yis bskolarka/ /sku gsung thugs sngags sbyangs nas ni/ /rang mdun ⑤'khor lo mchod nas ni/ /sngags kyis btab la 'dod gsol gdab/ /bshags dang dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ /namaḥsarba budha bo dhi satā na①/ /he he bha ga rjob ti/ma hā satwa sarba rjobudha/ a ba lo ki ti/ ma bi lo pa tā rjor e ka dzā ⑦ṭi/i rda ba bo ⑧kṛ1 pa ⑨ya hūṃ/ sarba bi sa re swā hā/ hūṃ pad+ma rigs kyi lha tshogs dang / /thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs/ /rje btsun sgrol ma ral gcig ma//mchod pa dam pa 'bul ⑩ba ni/ /dkar mo dang ni stobs chen mo/ /rtsub mo dang ni rlag ⑩byed ma/ /nag mo mtshan mo nag mo dang / /srung ba mo dang sbed ⑫14—1210

byed ma/ /tshangs mo dang ni rig ①byed ma/ /gsang ba mo dang bkra shis ma/ /ri khrod ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /grub ma gtum ma bdud rtsi ma/ /bsod nams gter dang mthar byed ma/ /drag mo brtul zhugs chen mo dang / /phan mdzad ma dang skyabs byed ma/ /don grub dang ni nor ster ④ma/ /ral pa gcig ma 'khor dang bcas/ /dur khrod brgyad kyi ①mkha' 'gro ma/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro ma lus dang / /lha dang lha min thams cad rnamasarjo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/ /bdag la dngos grub gsol 'debs pas/ /zang zing lo tog 'bras bu rnams/ /rin po che ni sna tshogs kyidhi/ /dud 'gro rkang 'gros pyami nor phyugs/ /ro brgya'i zas dang sna tshogs zas/ /btung ba kha mngar chang sna tshogs/ /gos bzang srab 'jam sna tshogs dang / /cang shes glang chen 'dod 'jo'i ⑦ba/ /zhing dang khang bzangs ④'dod 'jo bar⑨ /'jigs pa brgyad dang bral bar mdzod/ /bcud len tshe ring ⑩nad med mdzod//phyogs skyong sde ⑪brgyad tshogs rnams dang ⑫/ /'chi bdag bdud las rgyal bar mdzod—/ /ral gri mig sman bum pa bzang / /rkang mgyogs gter dang longs spyod dang / /blo rno shes rab tshigs ⑫bshad dang / snyan dngags ma ④ thos chos shes shog /rgyal rigs la sogs rigs bzhi rnams/ /'gro ba dbang du 'du bar shog /rigs drug ngan song lcags grol shog /gnod dang bdud rnams bar chod zhi/ /tshe dang stobs dang 'khor rgyas shing / /tshe dang chos dang bstan pa dang / /bla ma'i sku dgra skad cig sgrol/ /rtag tu gar skyes gar gnas kyang / /gsang sngags lam dang mi 'bral zhing / /chos kyi 'khor lo longs spyod shog /mdor na rang la ci 'dod pa/ /bsam pa yid bzhin 14—1211

'grub ①pa dang / /mi 'dod thams cad myur bral nas/ /sems can kun gyi don grub shog /thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs/ /rje btsun sgol ma'i zhal mthong shog /ral pa gcig pa'i dngos grub gnyis/ /bsams shing bsgrub ④pas myur thob shog /rje btsun sgrol ma'i nang gi gtor ma'i cho ga /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //yul bal po rdzong du bsgyur ba'o①// //bsdur mchan/121༷ ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉sko〈co 〉rdzar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sngag /sgrol ma'i nang gi gtor chog bzhugs so// ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skoradun/ ①〈〈pe 〉sngapo ra 〉〉 ma a pra ) ha ta swā su ṭ+wāṃ/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉ra// rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zasablo/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉 saṃ lo bha ta/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉ma / ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉7pa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉tha dbul/ 〈shar 〉phro dbul/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mirlag⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉spong /1211 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'gas/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉'iter/ ①〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉d+kus/ pya〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉rang /du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rang / bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉〈/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thajo/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉ra'ar 〉thazang /⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tha/ ⑩〈〈co 〉(4na chen rin/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thade/ ⑩〈〈co 〉phro ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ga ④〈〈pe 〉zogs ma/ 〈〈snar 〉thags mang /1213 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉yib/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉thasgrubs/ ga〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉7ba lags gsung ngo /14—1212
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (568)14wa 1213

༄ga /phyir zlog pa'i 'khor lo/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ta lis ti tsakra/ bod skad du/ phyir zlog pa'i 'khor lo/ /rje btsun ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsnyen pa yongs sdogs rnal 'byor pas/ /bar chod bzlog pa'i cho ga brtsams⑤/ /dbe+en pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal dang / /mchod pa gtor ma bshams la ni①/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa rdzogs bsgoms la/ /mchod pa bstod pa dus gsum dbul/ /de nas snying gar rtsa bsams la/ /zhu bas 'khor lo rtsibs bzhir gyur/ /lte ba stong pa'i nang nyid du/ /bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor gnas/ /rtsibs gnyis rtse la gri gug bsam/ /gnyis pa ral gri me 'bar bsam/ /'bar ba me dang 'od 'khrugs nas/ /'khor lo de la mtshon cha ni/ /char pa bab pas gsod par bsam—/ /de nas sngags 'dis 'khor lo bskor/ /oṃ 1 rjotri dha ra dha ra/tsa kra lo ka ⑤mā ra ya mā ra ya/ rgyu rgyu/ tsi ri tsi ri/ ta ra ta ra/ phaṭa 14—1214

phaṭa swā hā/ de ltar drag po'i sngags bzlas pas/ /'khor lo skad cig mi sdod 'khor—/ /mtshon cha'i char dang 'od 'khrugs pas/ /gzhan gyi rig ①sngags smod pa dang / /gdon dang bar chod gang yin pa/ /bkug la 'khor lo mtshon chas gtub②/ /ting 'dzin gsal dang bzlas pa ni/ /brtson pas rab tu 'bad par bya/ /de ltar zhag ni lnga 'am bdun/ /gsum gsum bar du byas gyur na/ /phyag na rdo rje'i stobs kyang rdugs/ /phyir bzlog 'khor lo slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //mkhas pa chen po rma ban chos 'bar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bldur mchan/1214 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ / /phyir zlog pa'i 'khor lo dang sgrol ma'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra rtsam ④〈〈co 〉〉na/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉21/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra/1215 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sdegs/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra tul/14—1215
bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (569)14wa 1216

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tā ra gu h+ya ②sā dha rna/ bod skad du/sgrol ma'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo//mchog dang thun mong 'dod pa dang / /bar chod nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang / /'dod pa'i yon tan 'phel 'gyur zhing / /phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub pa'i phyir//lha mo gsang ba'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /dang po nyams pa'i skyon bral zhing / /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/ /shin tu dbe+en pa'i sa phyogs su/ /maṇ+ḍal khru gang tshad du bya/ /dri chen dri chus chag chag gdab/ /mchod pa lnga ldan ras ris dgram/ /phyi nang bar chod zhi bar blta/ /stan la legs 'dug nub tu blta④/ /skad cig lha bsam 'od kyis su/ /srid gsum zhing sbyangs rjosbyan drangs la/ /yan lag bdun pos rgyud dag byas⑤/ /tshad med bzhi bsam stong nyid bsgom/ /a las me byung gru gsum dbyibs/ /dkar po 14—1217

bsams la de stengs su/ /a bsam zhu bas lha mo bskyed/ /mdog smug bong thung thod phreng can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dgod ①pa'i gdangs/ /rus pa'i phreng bas sku brgyan cing / /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /phyag g.yas mda' gzhu rab tu 'dzin/ /ut+pal thod pa byang sems gang / /g.yon pa thod dkar 'dzin pa bskyed/ /snying gar e yi cha byad la/ /a yi mtshan ma 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes drangs pa mchod pa ni/ /tshig tu ma yin blo yis dbul/ /bzhis bstem byin brlab ④dbang bskur bya/ /bskyed la gsang sngags yid la bzlas/ /kha dog lnga ldan snying gar bsam/ / ched du labazlas pa bya ba ni/ /oṃ u a dhi mesi tu hūṃ/ 'bru bdun dngos grub 'byung bar byed/ /bzhi'am gcig dang bdun pa grubabu/ /thun par gtor ma yang yang dbul/ /ming dang gtam yang gsang spyod bya/ /bzhi las me sur bde ba dbabarka/ /bdango rjol lhan skyes bde ba bsgom/ /e yi a las 'od 'phros pas//'dod pa'i yon tan de bkug ⑦la/ /mtshan ldan snod du bkug byas la/ /rtags rdzogs longs spyod gzhan du min/ /phrin las rnam bzhi skabs dang sbyar/ /rin chen dang 'dra sgrub ⑧pa'i thabs/ /'jigs pa kun sgrol bde ba ster/ /nad med gnod ⑨rnams rang bzhin 'gyur/ /phongs pa kun sgrol 'byor par ldan—/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ⑩dbang bskur 'gyur/ /sgrub thabs 'gro la phan phyir bkod/ /lhag pa'i lha yi zhal mthong shog /bar chod nye bar zhi gyur nas—/ /'gro rnams de yi zhal mthong shog /sgol ma gsang ba'i sgrub thabs/dpal rtag pa'i rdo rje lung bstan pas bkod pa/ gsang ba za ma tog ces bya ba rdzogs so// //14—1218

rgya gar gyi mkhan po ra ta ladha ra dang / lo tsā ②ba mas bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1217 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'ar 〉〉〉ཿ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rto/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉sbyang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉po blo yis bya/1218 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉skod/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bstan la/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bstod la/ du〈〈pe〉〉 rnyi/ 〈〈snar 〉sta sgri/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉na 'grub/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉bskyil/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉btug 〈〈co 〉〉dgug ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stanadon/ 〈〈co 〉〉nand/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉nya)/1219 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ringasna/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉rgya/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (570)14wa 1219

༄ga /thugs rje sgol ma las sna tshogs pa'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā ru ṇa sā ④dha rgo karma bi shwa/ bod skad du/thugs rje sgrol ma las sna tshogs pa'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbe+en pa'i gnas sam sa phyogs su/ /srog chags spangs pa'i sa la ni/ /rin chen 'bru la dri dang bcas/ /chu gtsang la ni sngags ni bzlas/ /oṃ s+thā ①tri hūṃ phaṭa oṃ āḥhūṃ/ brgya rtsa brgyad dang bzlas la gdab/ /de nas 'jim pa sbyang byas la/ /rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ /snying ga'i sngags la lnga 'phros pas/ /'jim pa 'od lnga dag tu 'gyur/ /de las 'od 'phros 'jim pa yi—/ /byin brlabs bsdus te de la bstem/ /de nas 'bi 'bi bya ba dang / /skol rjophor sngags kyi ⑤'od kyis sbyang / /sngags 'dis sāts+tsha dugadab par bya/ /oṃ s+thā ⑦tro hūṃ phaṭa tweḥ.ā yuḥsgebadz+ra kā ya tsit+ta hūṃ/ sgol ma 'od kyis ⑨skor gsal nas—/ /ye shes dgug dang gzhug pa dang / /mchod pa bstod pa rgyas par bya/ /14—1220

me tog la ni rten 'brel sngags/ /lan bdun bzlas te gtor bas na/ /rab tu gnas par bya ba'o/ /rten la bskor ba byed pa ni/ /lha yi nga rgyal ldan pa yisaske/ /snying ga'i sngags las 'od 'phros pas/ /rten de stong pa nyid du bsam—/ /stong pa'i ngang las rma las ni/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bsam par bya/ /de steng hūṃ sngon zhu ba las/ /thod pa gri gug sku ru bsam/ /snying gar sngags kyi 'khor lo las/ /'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad dgug /bstem la mchod pa bstod pa bya/ /de nas bskol ①ba tha mal gyis/ /bstod dang sngags bzlas gus par bya/ /ting 'dzin lha yi thugs ka nas/ /'od byung bdag la phog pa yis—/ /sgrib dag sgrol ma'i sku ru gsal/ /sngags 'dis rab tu bskor bar bya—/ /oṃ 1 ②tro hūṃ phaṭa oṃ ābyuhūṃ sa ti sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de ltar bsgom pa'i ④cho ga'o/ /sbyin sreg cho ga bya ba ni/ /yar rmi ngo yi tshes brgyad nas/ /nya yi bar du brtsam par bya/ /snod gtsang ras kyi sdong bu'odu/ /mar dkar gyis ni mar me spar/ /me long khud du til la ni/ /sdig pa yi ni gzugs byas la/ /mdun du bzhag la spyi bor ni/ /shaṃ bsam ⑤zhu bas lus la thim/ /de yi 'od kyis bdag gis ni/ /sdig pa thams cad bshad pa yi/ /lam nas sdig gzugs de la bstem/ / mar me rjohūṃ las sgol mar bskyed/ /ye shes dgug la sogs pa ni/ /sngon gyi ji bzhin shes par bya/ /de nas sdig pa sngags 'dis bsreg /oṃ 1 ⑦tre+e hūṃ sarba pā paṃ ⑧da ha na shārnyi ku ru ⑨swā hā/ mtheb srin gnyis kyis ⑩sdig pa bsreg /brgya rtsa brgyad du bya bar gsungs/ /ser ba srung ba'i cho ga ni/ /bsnyen pa mngon rdzogs rnal 'byor pas/ /yungs kar me tog sngon po la/ /sngags btab nam mkha'i phyogs su gtor/ /oṃ trī ⑪tre+e hūṃ 14—1221

rak+ṣa sa ma ya bh+yo ta ①dha re hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ②phaṭa phaṭa①/ lha yi nga rgyal ldan pas su/ /sku gzugs mngon rjodu mchod pa dang / /gsol ba gdab cing 'bad pa bya/ /khro mo lha la bstod pa ni⑤/ /chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang las kyang / /mdzes ma khro bo rjosgrol ma mchog /ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /sku mdog drag po'i khro tshus can—/ /bong thung gsus 'phyang 'gying bag can/ /mgo phreng brgya yis sku la brgyan—/ /dur khrod ro yi dkyil na bzhugs/ /sku gsum 'chang ba'i lha mo khyod—/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum he nye dze+esgra/ /yan lag klu brgyad ldan ⑧dang ldan—/ /sku smad stag gi pags pas dkris/ /ljags sde'adril mche ba rab tu gcigs—/ /phyag bzhi dang po phreng ba ste/ /thugs rje 'gro 'dren gri gug gis//nyon mongs bag chags rtsad nas gcod/ /mdzes pa'i rang rtags ut+pal dang / /thod pa dug lnga rnams ⑩'joms rtags/ /khro mo khyod la dus gsum du/ /bdag ni dran bkyid skyabs su mchi/ /dus rnams gdug pa'i bar chad rnams/ /zhi bar khro mo khyed kyis mdzod/ /rgya gar bsil ba'i seng ldeng phug tu slob dpon rtag pa'i badz+ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //mkhas pa chen po ba ri lo tsā ⑪bas bsgyur ba'o// //14—1222

bsdur mchan/122 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ / /thugs rje sgrol ma las sna tshogs pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sa/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉nyam/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉skoskol/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sno)sa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉tsa tsha/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉nyam/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉boḥ/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉tsho〈snar 〉ste)/1221 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskor/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉nyam/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskor ba'i/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bu la/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsams/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stab mar/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉nyamaḥ/ 〈〈snar 〉nyam/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉swaṅgā bha ba/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉zhasto /// 〈〈snar 〉〉shāsto ku/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sngo/1222 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉skya ti/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tu/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉nephaṭa/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉mdun/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉boni/ 0〈〈pe mi'i〈snar 〉glo/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉te'i/ 〈〈snar 〉teḥ/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉phon/ ⑨〈〈co 〉rdzangs/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ram/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (571)14wa 1223

—zhas bya ba bathags/①༄4/ /dur khrod 'jigs pa'i gnas nyid du/ /drag po bdud kyi nyi ma la/ /dkyil 'khor bca' dang thun rdzas bsog /lha mo srang mda' bca' byas la/ /bdag nyid gtso bo'i nga rgyal bya/ /sgo nga'i bya ba rdzogs pa dang / /thun rdzas rnams la sngags 'di gdab/ /oṃ khā tar warti rbad dza dza/ zhag bdun bsngags la thun rdzas 'di/ /dkyil 'khor byang gi phyogs su bzhag② /de nas sgo nga'i steng nyid du/ /kha las lha mo bskyed byas la/ /gdug ①pa'i sngags rgod 'di yis gdab/ /te khā ta he badz+ra ma nu sarba thang rbad/ sgo nga la ni zla phyed bar—/ /drag po'i sems kyis gdab par bya/ /sgo nga brub rjokhung lhung ba dang //gri gug dag gis brtol ⑤byas la/ /thun gyis brab cing sngags 'dis gsad/ /dzā dza thang thang rbad/ he mugs srog mā ra ya thun ni rbad hūṃ hūṃ srog la te kha ta badz+ra rbad/ bcu gcig bar du thun gyis brab/ /de nas mnan dang bsreg 14—1224

par bya/ /lha mo ngan song ①las la sbyar/ /khā'i ②gdong ba srang mda' nag po ②zhes bya ba slob dpon rtag pa'i badz+ras mdzad pa'o④// //bsdur mchan/1224 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈0sdo 〉྾〈co 〉〉rtor bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanazhag ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stanadugs/du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉751ba/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan btol/1225 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanasang gi/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skab yi/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (572)14wa 1225

—pa zhas bya ba bathags/①༄7/ /rje btsun sgrol ma thugs rje sgrol/ /dngos grub sgrol ma gus btud derka/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs 'gro byen gyis rlobs②/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /rje btsun sgrol ma dngos grub bla na med pa'i gsang ba ④ltar bsgrub pa'i sgrub thabs kyi man ngag me tog gi phreng ba lta bu rjoni/ 'dir chos 'di la mos shing gus pas skye ba 'di nyid la sgol ma'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pas/ rgyu bzhi ste 'khor ba la gshed mar mthong ba dang / zas nor la dug tu mthong ba dang / 'khor ba'i las 'bras bu ngan song gsum du mthong ba dang / byas pa don med cing 'bral zhing mi rtag par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos 'dod pa tshad pas gdungs pa chu 'dod pa lta bu brtson 'grus can de las ⑤'byung gi/gzhan la ma yin pas kun la spel zhing rjorang gi dam tshig ⑦nyams shing dngos grub ring la don med par 'gyur ro/ /de yang sdom pa gsum gyi lung sgrub thabs 14—1226

ji lta ba bzhin du byas la/ lam du blangs nas sangs rgyas sgrol ma thob par 'dod pa la don gsum ste/ bskyed pa'i rim pa thun mong ma ①yin pa'i tshogs lam dang /sdogs pa'i rim pa thun mong ma yin pa ye shes kyi lam dang / gzhan ma dad pa bzlog pa las tshogs yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu dang gsum mo/ /sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed rim rdzogs nas rang gi thugs ka'i nyi zla'i steng du t+t+waṃ ⑧lngang sngon mtha' mar dpa' mo 'bru lnga'i 'od zer kha dog lnga'i 'od kyi ①'ja' tshon ltar bsams nas sngags bzlas te/ dmigs pa de la gtad rjopas 'od 'phros te/ 'go ba lnga'i rgyud sbyangs pa dang / rang gi dug lnga sbyangs bsregs te/ 'gro ba drug gi sa bon ye shes lnga'i 'od kyis bsregs pas sems can gyi don tha mi dad pa'o/ /slar 'dus pa las/ rang gi phung po lnga rdo rje sgol ma dang / 'khor lo sgol ma dang / rin chen sgrol ma dang / pad+ma sgrol ma dang / las kyi sgol mar gyur pa dang / snang la rang bzhin med pa dang /gsal la 'dzin pa med pa bsgom/ thun bzhi'i sbyor bas bya'o/ /de'i grogs gtor ma dang / mchod pa dang / bskor ba dang / maṇ+ḍal dang / bstod pa dang / gzungs dang sāts+tsha ⑤gdab pa la sogs pas bskangs te/ bskyed rim nang budu bslang ba'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la don bzhi ste/ sna tshogs lam khyer dang /nyi ma lam rnam dang / nam mkha' lam khyer ro/ /sna tshogs ni rgya che ste/skar ma ltar snang ba sna tshogs 'di/ gzung ba'i yul chags sdang gnyis la brten ⑦nas/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong bar byed pas/ de zil gyis 14—1227

mnan pa ni chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya'o/ /mya ngan las ①'das pa'i chos kyang rmi lam lta bur shes par bya/ de las ches lhag pa'i chos gcig ②yod na'ang sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam lta bur shes par bya'o/ /dngos por rang brgyud ①pa'i zhen pa log ste/ sgyu mar shes pas gzung bas stong zhing 'dzin pas dbe+en pa thabs lha'i rnal 'byor dang / shes rab stong pa de rgyu stong pa dbyer med pa lam yin par rgyal ba'i bka' las gsungs so/ /de bas na lha'i lus sgyu ma lta bu dang / ngag sngags 'brug sgra lta bu dang / sems ting nge 'dzin gsal ba nam mkha'i ngo bor 'das pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i lam dang po'o/ /lam gnyis pa nyi ma ni/ lus kyi sgrol ma bsgom ste/ 'byung ba rim par brtsegs la sgo phyi ma rjoganyis bcad rjol/ bdag po nang du bsdad la khang pa dbus mar me sgon btang la gdugs kyi 'od phab la/ lam po che nas 'thon te/ yul bzhi ru gnas la/ phyi rol thams cad la mi sprad par byas tegamar me rlung gis bskyod par byas la/ rang gi dgos pa nor bu rin po che de la rkun mas ⑦mi khyer ba'i mel tshe la brtson par byas na ⑧dbul phongs ⑨par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa thabs khyad par can gyi lam gyis sangs rgyas myur du thob par bya ba ni/ mi'i bu mo shes rab sgol ma bsten la bya ste/ dbang po 'bring po rtog pa zil gyis mnan pa ni tshad dang ldan pa'i bu mo dang / dam tshig tu ldan pa gsang spyod kyi rten dang / bā ⑩yu las su rung ba'i pho nyas steng 'og las thams 14—1228

cad bya ste/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems skye chu bzhin phab nas/ don dam dang gnyis su med pa'i sems rdzing bzhin du babyed la/ phyi nang gzung 'dzin sna tshogs thams cad skad cig ma ye shes kyi 'od du bsdus nas bde ba chen por bsgom—/ sgo lnga yul thams cad bzhi ru bsdus la de yang gcig gi ngo bor gsal ba thun dang thun mabyedas su bcad la bsgom mo/ /dbang po rab kyi dbang du byas na nam mkha' lam khyer bsgom par bya ste/ rten med lam du 'jug pa ni nam mkha' rnam pa gsum ste/ nang gi nam mkha' dang / phyi'i nam mkha' dang / bar snang gi nam mkha'o/ /nang gi nam mkha' la gnyis te/shes par bya ba la gsum dang / gzhag ①par bya ba la gsum mo/ /shes par bya ba gsum ni/ phyi nang bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems su shes par bya ba dang / sems nyid spros pa nye bar zhi ba dang / de bde chen zung 'jug 'od gsal ba'o/ /gzhag snepar bya ba gsum ni/ nang zab mo'i gtan tshigs gsum ste/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis thog ma bar gsum dbyibs dang kha dog ngos bzung rten brtsam pa ④la sogs pa dang / zab mo dbang gi dus dang / snang stong dbyer med kyi mtshalas ni gnyug ma'i sgrol ma ste/'khor ba las sgol ba'i sgrol ma'o/ /phyi'i nam mkha' la bzhi ste/ dpe don la bsre ba dang / don dpe la bstem pa dang / de gnyis dbyer med du gnas la gnas pa dang / nyid gsum gcig tu go bar bya ba'orjo/ /bar snang gi nam mkha' la drug ste/ bems po'i sna rtse dang / 'od kyi ⑤sna rtse dang / dran pa'i sna rtse dang / dus kyi sna rtse dang / dbyibs kyi sna rtse dang / myong ba'i sna rtse dang / thun du bcad la bsgom pa'o/ /de dag la 'bad pas bskyed pa'i 14—1229

rim pa brtan zhing zhal mthong ba dang / snang rtags thams cad sgyu mar myong ba dang / ngo bo ma skyes pa'i chos la mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob nas mthong ba dag nas sa dang lam la 'jug ste mthar phyin par 'gyur ro/ /da ni gsum pa las kyi tshogs kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas 'gro ba ma dad pa dad par bya ba dang / dad pa phyir mi ldog par bya ba dang / skye bo ngan pa bstan pa la sdang ba tshar gcad ①par bya ba'i phyir phan gdags par ①tshar gcad gapar bya ste/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i gdams ngag gi rjes su 'brang ste/ snod dang mi mtshungs pa rnams la bstan pa na rang ngan song du 'gro ste/ sngon kyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams song ba'i gtam rgyud las shes par bya'o—/ /mtshams med pa byed pa'i skye bo bla ma dang chos kyi bar chad byed pa de/kha sbyor dbye bar 'dod na/ bdag rje btsun ma'i bskyed rim rjobartan pa dang /thugs ka'i 'khor lo 'bum tsho drug 'thon pas de ⑤shes rab dang rjoni dus kyi gnad dang sbyar ba ste/ rje btsun ma 'byung ba lnga'i lha mo des yang me lha gtam gyi ngo bor rgyu ba na khro mo chen mo'i dbyibs kyis 'od kyi ⑦gri gug gis snying nas dral—/ sngags la che ge mo a mu rka mā ra zhes pa ni gnyis zhes bya'o/ /bkug ste ka ⑧pā lar bcug ste/ ral gris gtubs la kho'i srog rlung gi don snying lnga srog ⑨rtsa nas drangs nas/ khro mo'i zhal du gsol te/ sha zos khrag rngubs rus pa 'chos/ shes pa rlung la bstems ⑩pa ste lha mo'i thugs nam mkha' stong par phyal gyis gtong ⑪ste/ nam phyed ⑫na brgya'am stong du bya/ nyin byed dang tho rangs su byas na bsgrub bya lus sems kha sbyar phyed par 'gyur ro/ /14—1230

da ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ste bza' ba dang btung ba dang / dri zhim pa dang / gos dang / yul dang / mi yid du 'ong ba dang / dgra ①thams cad dbang du rang ji lta bar bsgrub pa ni/ yid bzhin nor rnyed pa lta bu ste—/ rnal 'byor pa chos kyi bar chad 'tsho bas mi 'byung ba ni/ sngar bstan pa lta bu thugs ka nas nyi zla'i steng na 'od zer lnga'i 'khor lo gnas pa las/'od zer lnga 'phros te rang gar 'dod pa'i rang gi ka pā la dum bu gcig pa mjes shing rgya che ba'i nang du 'ong bar ⑦bsams te/ thams cad rang gis sirnyi hūṃ zhes 'ongs par bsam ①pa tsam gyis rgyal po'i bsod nams tsam yang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bas na yid du 'ong ba thams cad la zhes bya ba'orjo/ /de gang gis 'grub na lha gsal ba dang / ngag brtan pas te bzlas pas 'grub pa dang / dus kyi gnad la ngal so nus pa nges so/ /da ni rnal 'byor pa 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang / mi rgod ma rungs pa bcing zhing bzlog par bya ste/ dben par bag yangs rjosu rgyu ba ni/ bdag gang yang rung ba'i lam du rgyu ba'i dus su gom pa 'bor khar rje btsun sgol ma yid la dran par wal gyis bya ba dang / g.yas pa'i rogs po spangs la/ de ma yin pa'i rogs kyi thad kar/ spyi gtsug ut+pa la'i phyag rgya bcings rjol/yi dam gyi gsol ba gdab/ gos kyi gsham ⑦gyi sna la nang gi yi ge paṃ las pad+ma'i steng du t+t+waṃ skeljang sngon bsams la/ de'i 'od kyis 'jigs pa brgyad gang 'od du nye ba ⑨de gos de'i gos ⑫khud du hril gyis ⑪dril la/ rgyu ba gnyis ka 14—1231

bcad la/ bsgrub bya mtshalas tshun chad phyag mtshan rus phreng gis ①bcad de 'gul mi shes par byas nas lam gyi sa tshums cig gtums sdel sngags bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod do/ /mdud pa dmar po bcings la sngags a mu ka bā shaṃ ma nā ya swā hā/ de rnams re ④'jog ma yin par dus gcig tu bya ba'i man ngag go/ /'jigs pa las rjothar nas mdud pa ma bkrol na sdog pa che'o/ /rten 'byel de rnams tshang na the tshom med do/ /da ni shes rab blo 'phel bsgrub par bya ste/ yang sngar bstan pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ chos kyi shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med par bya ba ni/tshes gcig nas bzung nas tsan+d+ra rul ⑤pa'i bar du bsgrub dupar bya ste/ zhag lngar chu gtsang la sngags btab ste ⑦tho rangs dus kyi gnad la sbyar te skebatung ngo //de nas zhag lngar dkar gsum la btab ste ⑨dus gsum du btung ngo / /de nas zhag lngar sgyur rtsi gzhan gyis ma 'bags pa la sngags btab la btung ste de'i sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ pratshwa puṣ+ṭi ⑩ku ru swā hā/ zhes mthar rten gyis bzlas te tho rangs 'thungs na 'grub bo/ /na ma ⑪re la sh+lau ka sum stong zin no/ /gal te ma grub na yon tan la sogs pa ste sngar bstan pa ltar bsnyen pa grub nas rang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'dod pa thams cad bsgrubs nas/ rten lha mo byin rlabs ⑫ldan pa la g.yon pa'i sa dang / me'i dus ⑫mchod pa dang gtor mas mnyes par byas la/ bstod pa dang gsol ba btab ste/ ⑫de ma tā ⑫re e ka dzā ⑩ṭi ma rgo sirnyi hūṃ zhes pas 'grub bo/ /shel ⑩chu shel gyi sbyor ba bzhin no/ /gzhan yang 'gro ba thams cad dbang du bsdu bar 'dod na/ sngags 'di mthar 14—1232

rten ①bya ste/ na mo bha ga te u: 1ṣa sa dha re dha ra na tri ye swā hā/ gi waṃ la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bsngags nas dpral bar thig le byas na gang la bltas ④pa de dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /mig rdzas la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bsngags te mig la bskus ༷na gang 'phrad pa de dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /chu khyor gang la sngags lan bdun bzlas te 'thungs na ma bslangs par rjozas rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /tshogs kyi nang du 'gro na rang gi gos kyi mtha' ma nas lag pa g.yon pas bzung la nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te phyin na tshig btsan zhing bden par 'gyur ro/ /shags 'debs na lan thebs shing mi 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /lam du 'gro na dus dang sbyar na don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs ring rjortag tu bzlas na bdud dang nag po'i phyogs kyis memi tshugs shing dgra dang bgegs kyis mi thub par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang phan yon dang phan yon kyis nyams su blang ba'i man ngag bla ma dam pa rnams las ji ltar shes par bya'o/ /las tshogs pa'o—/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje nyer bsdus pa/ /rje btsun sgol ma dran pas 'dod sgrub ma/ /de yi sgrub thabs dka' 'grel man ngag nyams su blang thabs mdzub ⑧tshugs 'dis/ /mun pa bsal nas 'gro ba'i don bkod bdag gis zlob ⑨par shog /rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i man ngag me long dwangs pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //be+ems po'i sna rtse dang / 'od kyi dang / dran pa'i dang / dus kyi dang / dbyibs kyi dang / myong ba'i sna rtse'o/ /rtag pa'i badz+ra nas brgyud pa'i dngos grub brtan gzigs kyi rgyud skor ⑩'di/ rma dang ba ri gnyis kyi lugs—/ / dhas+thā tīrti ⑪zhes bya bas/ /dbe+el ⑫dang bla ma gus ston la/ /14—1233

ma'i rang byung gi longs spyod dur khrod kyi rtog pa zhes bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ se darnya shrī ④yo ga yo gi ni swaspyo ta saṃ bho ga shra ①shā na kalpa nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal u rgyan gyi rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i rang byung gi longs spyod dur khrod kyi rtog pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar kyi dur khrod dbang po rjogatum drag dpag tshad bcu gnyis khor yug la/dpag tshad lnga zheng du gnas pa/ dbyibs ni shing rta rkang pa gsum pa lta bu/gtso bo klu sgrub snying pos dubyin gyis brlabs/ /shing ni gser mdog lo ma brgyar gyes shing / /zhing skyong dkar po gri thod glang chen gdong / /phyogs skyong brgya byin glang chen gdan rigs bcas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro pre ta yi dwags za—/ /byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyis rjos 'dzin/ /mtha' yas sngon po'i klu ni 'dud byed cing / /thod pa brtsegs pa'i ⑦spyil bus kun bkang zhing / /14—1236

de na rnal 'byor pa'i rgyal po ār+ya de ba la sogs pa shin tu mang ba bzhugs so/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mdzes ma dang snying stobs can ma la sogs pa'o/ /de dag ni rgyud gsang 'dus kyi rjes su 'jug cing klu sgrub yid la byed pa'o/ /lho'i dur khrod gshin rje 'bar ba'i nags tshal/ dpag tshad drug cu gnyis khor yug① /dpag tshad bco lnga rgyang grags gcig /dbyibs ni 'khor lo 'dra/ ḍom+bi he ru ka sneyis byen gyis brlabs/ /be+e ḍūr+ya mdog lo ma brgyar gyes shing / /zhing skyong nag po gri thod ma he gdong / /phyogs skyong gshin rje ma he'i gdan rigs ①bcas—/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro kang ka dbang bskur byed/ /cho 'phrul ston pa'i mchod rten gyis sa 'dzin/ /dung skyong dkar po'i klu ni 'dud par byedarjo//thod pa rus pa dum bu'i spyil bus bkang / /rnal 'byor pa ni a wa dhū tī ⑤dang /phyag rjomo la sogs pa'o/ /de dag ni gsang 'dus dang / gshin rje gshed nag po'i rjes su 'jug cing ḍom+bi te ru ka yid la byed do/ /nub kyi dur khrod chu bdag thod pa can dpag tshad bzhi bcu brgyad khor yug la/ dpag tshad bcu gnyis zheng du gnas/ dbyibs ni ban ⑦lang spyod lta bu zlum po ste/ mkhas pa rta dbyangs kyis ni byin gyis brlabs/ / shing ni ⑧byi ru'i mdog can lo 'dab rgyas/ /zhing skyong dmar po gri thod chu srin gdong / /phyogs skyong chu lha chu srin gdan rigs ⑨bcas/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro chos ston kun dha ra/ /lha las babs pa'i mchod rten gyis sa 'dzin/ /dmar po dga' bo'i klu rnams 'dud byed cing / /ro rnams brtsegs pa'i spyil bus kun bkang zhing / /de ni rnal 'byor pa ni ku ku ri pa dang / rnal 'byor ma ni snying po'i rgyan ma dang /de dag thams cad ni rgyud sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rjes su 'jug cing slob dpon rta 14—1237

dbyangs yid la byed pa'o/ /byang gi dur khrod lus ngan 'jigs byed dang / /dpag tshad brgyad cu pa khor yug la/ dpag tshad nyi shu zheng du gnas/ dbyibs ni shing rta rkang pa bzhi pa lta bu/ slob dpon pad+ma can gyis byin kyis brlabs/ /margad ljang mdog lo ma brgyar gyes shing / /zhing skyong ljang gu gri thod khyu mchog gdong / /phyogs skyong gnod sbyin khyu mchog gdan rigs ①bcas/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro las 'byor dam tshig la/ /bkra shis brtsegs pa'i mchod rten gyis sa 'dzin/ /ljang gu karko ṭa yi klu rab 'dud/ /ro yi spyil bus kun nas bkang ba'i zhing / de na rnal 'byor pa ni bzang po dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni brdung ma la sogs pa'o/ /de dag rgyud dgyes snepa rdo rje'i rjes su 'jug cing slob dpon mtsho skyes rjes su dran par byed do/ /shar lho'i dur khrod me mtshams dpal 'dren dpag tshad bcu gnyis khor yug la/ dpag tshad gsum ni zheng du gnas/ dbyibs ni skyes pa gzhon nu'i lag mthil lta bu ste/ gtso bo sa ra ha yis byin gyis brlabs/ /shing ni a mra'i mdog can lo 'dab rgyas/ /zhing skyong ser po gri thod ra skyes gdong / phyogs skyong me lha ra skyes gdan rigs khrubacas—/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ro langs sbyin sreg byed/ /pad+ma spungs pa'i mchod rten gyis sa 'dzin/ /dkar po pad+ma chen po'i klu rab 'dud/ /yi dwags ro yi spyil bus kun bkang zhing / /de na rnal 'byor pa ni ghu na ka na ka dang / rnal 'byor ma ni pad+ma rdo rje la sogs pa'o/ /de dag ni rgyud bde mchog 'khor lo'i rjes su 'jug cing dpal sa ra ha pa rjes su dran par byed pa'o//lho nub kyi dur khrod dbang ldan ha ha sgogs zhes pa dpag tshad drug khor yug la/dpag tshad bzhi ni zheng du gnas/ dbyibs ni pad+ma dkar po kha bye ba lta bu ste/14—1238

dpal mchog nag po zhabs kyis byin kyis brlabs/ /in+d+ra nī la'i shing ni lo 'dab rgyas/ /zhing skyong nag po gri thod mi yi gdong / /phyogs skyong srin po yi dwags gdan rigs ①bcas/ /dam tshig mkha' 'gro kyang rnams nye bar ston/ /bdud 'dul chen po'i mchod rten gyis sa 'dzin/ /gzi can dkar dmar mdog can klu rab 'dud/ /keng rus yi dwags lo ma'i spyil bus gang / /de na rnal 'byor pa ni bram ze stobs can gyi bu rnal 'byor pa gser mdog can dang /rnal 'byor ma ni bzhin khro ma la sogs pa'o/ /de dag ni rgyud snying po gnyis dang / rta mchog gi rgyud kyi rjes su 'jug cing dpal nag po zhabs rjes su dran par byed do/ /nub byang dur khrod bden bral mun chen zhes pa dpag tshad bcu bzhi pa khor yug la/ dpag tshad bcu gnyis zheng du gnas/ /dbyibs ni chu'i ri mo 'khyil ba lta bu ste/ mkhas pa ku ku ri pas byin gyis brlabs/ /shel kyi mdog can shing ni lo 'dab rgyas/ /zhing skyong sngon po gri thod sha ba'i mdog /phyogs skyong rlung lha sha ba'i gdan rigs ②bcas/ /thams cad mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i chos ston cing / /gtsug phud dag pa'i mchod rten gyis ①sa 'dzin/ /pad+ma dkar po'i klu ni rab tu 'dud/ /rtswa rjospyil rus pa'i rgyan spras kyis gang zhing / /de na rnal 'byor pa ni rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / rnal 'byor ma ni zhing la sogs pa'o/ /de dag ni rgyud rnal 'byor ma'i rjes su 'jug cing dpal ku ku ri rjes su dran par byed do/ /byang shar gyi dur khrod rlung du ca co sgrogs zhes ⑤pa dpag tshad nyi shu khor yug la/ dpag tshad lnga ni zheng du gnas—/ dbyibs ni dge slong gi lhung bzed lta bu ste/ mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mos byin gyis brlabs/ rin chen dung mdog dushing ni lo 'dab rgyas/ /14—1239

zhing skyong dkar sham gri thod rta yi gdong / /phyogs skyong 'byung po rta ①yi gdan rigs ⑤bcas/ /'jig rten mkha' 'gro bskyod cing gtor ma 'dzin/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i mchod rten kyis sa 'dzin/ /nor 'dzin na ros mdog can klu rab 'dud/ /so phag brtsegs pa'i spyil bus kun bkang zhing / /de na rnal 'byor pa ni dpal he ru ka pa dang / rnal 'byor ma ni bdag med ma dang bdud rtsi ma la sogs pa'o/ /de ni rgyud mā hā mā ①ya nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rjes su 'jug cing rdo rje phag mo rjes su dran par byed do/ /dpal u rgyan gyi burnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma'i rang byung gi longs spyod dur khrod kyi rtog pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon birlu ⑤pas mdzad pa las btus pa/rnal 'byor pa pradz+nyā shrī dz+nyā na tīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //14—1240

bsdur ma na/1236 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /dpal u rgyan gyi rnal 'byor ma'i rang gi longs spyod kyi rtog pa bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉ye ⑧〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po ga ni mtha/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉ba/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉bas/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉staba'i/1237 ༅〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉mi pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉to/ka ③〈〈pe 〉stanag rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgod cing / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉 ti/〈'ar 〉mdu ti/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉4ga ⑦〈'ar 〉tha/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉boshing ni/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉'ag1238 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉rig ②〈〈snar 〉〉dgis/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉rig1239 ①⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rig ①〈〈snar 〉nyam rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rtsa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sgrosgog ces/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉bzlog124༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉sta/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉rig ③〈〈pe 〉dzepo ra 〉skab sa ma/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanabu rgyan gyis/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉༅ra ba/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyad/ (574)14wa 1241

༄ga /rjes chags kyi spyor bas de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byer la 'jug pa'i man ngag bzhugs/①༄4/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khrul pa mya ngan bluthang chen la/ /nyon mongs nyi mas rab gdungs pa'i/ /'gro ba 'tsho ba'i klung lagyur pa/ /srog 'dzin mgon la nyer btud nas/ /gang gis nyon mongs zhi byed pa/ /rtogs dka' thabs mang rgya mtsho las/ /mchog gyur mgon pos gsungs pa'i don/ /bla ma'i gsung las blangs pa brjod/ /'di na gang dag nyon mongs can/ /rjonyon mongs spong ba nyon mongs 'gyur/ /ji ltar bkres pas kha zas dang / /skom pa chu la rgyab phyogs bzhin/ /dper na me yi bud shing dang / /ma phrad sdud cing mi gsal zhing / /'chi 'gyur de ltar 'gro ba'i sems/ /'dod pa spangs na rung 'gyur bzhin⑤/ /yul la shin tu chags pa'i sems/ /'dod pa spangs pas zlog byed pa/ /de ltar mi 'gyur thabs dman phyir/ /nyon mongs 'phel ba kho nar zad/ /gang dag shin tu 14—1242

bcings pa'i mi/ /'dug na ①gzhan du 'gro ba yi/ /bsam pa rtag tu sten phyed ②cing / /lus sems bde bar mi 'gyur bzhin/ /sems mi bde ba don gnyer bas/ /de rnyed par ni ma gyur par/ /kun du rtogs pa rgyas 'gyur zhing / /gnyug ma'i yid gnas mi 'gyur ba/ /dper na glang chen ma rungs pa//gang tshe chang gis rab myos pa/ / phyi nas ngang gis dul 'gyur ba①/ /de ltar sems kyi glang po yang / /yul kyi chang gis rjorab myos na/ /dmu rgod rtog pa dul 'gyur zhing / /gnyug ma rnal 'byor pa yis len/ /gang dag spros pas ma spros pa'i/ /gnyug ma'i sems yid ma rnyed na/ /rtog pa'i dra bas 'chad min te/ /rtog las 'khor ba sna tshogs 'byung / /de phyir yang dag gnyug ma'i yid/ /mthong bar 'dod pas lus dang sems/ /kun rtog rlung rnams zhi bya'i phyir/ /nam yang gdung bar mi bya'o/ /de ltar gdung ba spangs pa las//sems ni bde ba'i ngo bor 'gyur/ /'khrul pa'i sprin stug ⑤'gag 'gyur zhing / /'od gsal dri med nam mkha' mthong / /bde de 'dod pa kun las 'byung / /yang dag bla ma'i man ngag gzhanarjo/ /thabs dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rtag tu 'dod pa'i yon tan bsten/ /gti mug 'khrul pa las kyi sbrusadze+e/ /sdug bsngal dba' ⑧klong cher 'khrugs pa'i/ /'khor ba'i chu bor bying ba yi/ /'gro la brtse ba chen po bskyed/ /'dir ni 'di don 'dis mi nus/ /yang dag ye shes snang ldan pa'i/ /yi dam rgyal po'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sems can skyabs la brtson par bya/ /rang gi bskyed pa yi ge'i gzugs/ /de nyid snying gi dkyil du gzhag /'od kyis ⑨sdig pa zad byas te/ /'gro mang sdug bsngal zhi bar bya/ /btus pa'i sbyor bas lha gang gi /gnas la dad pas de nyid 14—1243

bsam—/ /byin gyis brlabs ①dang dbang bskur ba/ /gzhug dang mchod sogs thams cad bya/ /de nas bzhin bzangs mig yangs ma/ /lang tsho rgyas bhushing skye gnas dang / /nu ma mkhrang zheng sha rgyas pa'i/ /bu mo yid 'ong mdun du bzhag④ /gtsug tu mdzes dang ro rjoldan dang / /bu ga 'phen dang bskyod pa dang / /mtshams su mdzes par gyur pa yis/ /mdzes pa mdzes par bya ba dang / /rnal 'byor la ni rtag gus shing / /lhag par zab mo'i chos la dad/ /khro med rnam rtog spangs pa'i bdag /yongs su smin byas byen gyis brlab/ /gtso nyid gang gi rig ma rurjo/ /cho ga 0mkhas pas bsgoms nas kyang / /de ru ye shes 'khor lo gzhug /mtshan ma gnyis kyang sngags kyis sbyang / /ling ga brtan por gyur pa ni/ /skye gnas dbus su gzhag par bya/ /dam por 'khyud pas gnas nas ni/ /yang dang yang du tsulnga bya/ /sen mos cung zad brud ⑦pa dang / /ma mchu so yis ⑧btsir bar bya/ /mig ni rab tu bsgyur bya zhing / /lce yang lce yis bskyod par bya/ /mgrin par nga ros dgang ba dang / /gshugs ⑨pa'am yang na gsal po ru/ /chags pa'i tshig gis sbyor ba yis/ /kha sbyor bde ba dang po bsgom/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis 'dab ldan pa'i/ /rlung gi rang bzhin pad+ma las/ /mgrin par 'bar ba'i ye shes —/ /bya ba grub pa nyon mongs 'joms/ /de ru rdo rje nub gyur nas/ /rked pa bskyod ⑩pa spangs nas ni/ /lus ngag sbyor dang ldan pa yis/ /dgram zhing bsdu ba dag tu bya/ /mig ni sna rtser phab nas su/ /gzugs sogs yul la ma zhen par/ /de dag las skyes bde ba mchog /yang dag ye shes gnyis pa bsgom/ /brgyad gnyis 'dab mar bcas pa yi/ /chu yi ngo bo pad+ma las/ /snying gar 'bab pa'i ye 14—1244

shes ni/ /so sor kun du rtog par ①brjod/ /sgyu rtsal mkhas pas bskyod bya zhing / /bu mos kyang ni rked pa bskor/ /dbugs kyang cud zad cung zad bsdamadze+e/ /dal gyis sgyu rtsal thams cad spyad/ /mig ni mi 'dzums par gyur pas—/ /reg la rtog cing ma zhen par/ /bde ba'i ye shes gsum pa ni/ /rnal 'byor mkhas pas rtogs ④par bya/ /bcu drug phyed kyi 'dab mar bcas/ /chu yi rang bzhin pad+ma las/ /lte bar 'bab pa'i ye shes ni/ /me long lta bur yang dag brjod/ /rigs kyi mtshan ma dus bon bcas/ /nor bur chud par bsam bya zhing / /rlung dang yid ni mi rgyu bar/ /byas te mkhas pas 'dod pa gzung / /gos med rtog pa nyer zhi ba/ /mig gnyis rab tu gdangs pa yis/ /rang byung gzhon ⑤med mkhas mnyam pa'i/ /ye shes bzhi pa gsal por bsgom/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i 'dab ldan pa'i/ /'dab skyes sa yi rang bzhin las/ /de 'dab de ru zin gyur pa'i/ /ye shes mnyam pa nyid du brjod/ /gal te der ni ma zin na/ /bde ba chen po mi gsal zhing / /phung po skye mched nyams pa dang / /gnyis med ye shes rtogs mi 'gyur/ /dar ras las byas skud pa drug/sor bcu drug gis rked pa bsdams/ /bu mo'i khrag gis bsgos pa dang / /sbrul gyi rjoshun par yang dag ldan/ /sor bcu gnyis ldan shing bu la/ /mtha' ru sor gnyis dor ba dang / /dkyil du srad bus bcings nas ni/ /sor drug rdo rje'i mdud pa byas/ /sor gnyis mtha' ⑦ru dz+rel byas nas/ /mkhas pas rang gi rked par bcing / /mdun kyi shing bus phra ⑧bkod de/ /lte ba'i phyogs su gzhag ⑨par bya/ /bu mo'i byin pa g.yon pa ni/ /skyes bu'i drug khug g.yas pas blang / /dbugs bsdams pa dang ldan pa yis/ /rtag tu thur sel 14—1245

brkyang bar bya/ /glang po'i sna yi sbyor ba ni/ /lag pa glang po'i sna lta bu/ /sna lnga sbyar bar byas pa yis/ /de ru sems 'gag the tshom med/ /spu ①yi rtsa ba brdungs pa ni/ /lcags kyi snod du yun ring ②btsos/ / rtsig pa ①phud de ka ra dang / /til dang sbyar ba mkhas pas bza'arjo/ /'di ni zos pa tsam gyis kyang / /stobs 'phel mdangs dang ldan pa dang / /thig le 'dzin pa'i thabs kyi mchog /sman kyi sbyor ba dam pa'o/ /ba 'am ra yi 'o ma ru/ /ka ra ha sa de bar sbyar/ /'di ni bcud len mchog tu bshad/ /thig le 'dzin pa nyid yin no/ /bya yi brun dang mi khyi yi/ /rus pa bzhibs pa'i lde gu yis/ /rdo rje rtag par bsku byed pa'i/ /sa bon 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /khyim bya'i tshil bu til mar dang / /byi'u yi sha rnams yang dag sbyar/ /de yis pad+ma la bskus na/ /che ba'ang zum nas thig le 'dzin/ /lcum gyi rtsa ba brdungs pa yis//pad+mar bskus na de 'dzin to/ /sa bon mi 'byung thabs kyi mchog /khyad par rdzas kyi sbyor ba'o/ /sna tshogs thabs la ma rmongs pas/ /nan tan byas te bzung ba de/ /myur du 'bad pas lus ngag dang / /sems kyi rtsal gyis bzlog par bya/ /lus kyi rjortsal gyis lte ba brdebs/ /de tshe ngag stobs yi ge hūṃ—/ /lam̐ yig phreng bar brgyud ma rjoni/ /drangs par bsams pa sems kyi stobs—/ /mnyam gnas bskyod pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /dgu po lus stobs hūṃ yig gi—/ /nga ro drag pos mgrin par dgang / /oṃ yig phreng ba sems kyi rtsal/ /snying gnas lus stobs sprug pa dang / /ngag gi 'dren pa ā yig 'don⑦/ /paṃ yig phreng bar bsams pa yin/ /gsung gi dbang phyug gnas su drang / /lus kyi rtsal gyis mgrin par dgug /ngag ni oṃ yig 'dod la brtson/ /t+t+waṃ ⑤14—1246

yig phreng bar bsam pa yis/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas su drang / /sgo dgu dag ①pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rlung dang de bsres rtsa mag dgang / /sdigs mdzub 'phen pa'i rtsal gyis kyang / /yang dang yang du spro bar bya/ /de ltar sbyor ba de ngag gis/ /spu yi khung bu'i gnas su yang / /bde ba'i ye shes g.yos gyur te//kun rtog rdul dang bral bar 'gyur/ /de nas rnal 'byor mkhas pa yis/ /byu tī dkar po stong pa ru/ /snying gi lam nas sems bcug pas/ /sna tshogs rtog pa nub par bsgom/ /byu tī'i nang du rang gi sems/ /thig le'i gzugs kyis gnas pa ni/ /thur du bab dze+este nor bu yi/ /nang du yang dag gnas par bsgom/ /thams cad stong pa bde ba che/ /brjod med rang bzhin shes dka' zhing / /rnam rtog dba' ①rlabs nyer zhi ba/ /gsal ba'i ro ldan nyams su myong / /ba spu gyen du log pa dang / /lus ni drag tu 'bar ba dang //'dar dang g.yo 'gyur mchi ma 'dzag /rngul bar 'gyur ba de dag rtags/ /yang na rtag par dgod ༷pa dang / /ngu ba'am brgyal zhing 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /reg pa la sogs rkyen dag las/ /bde ba bzod dka' skye bar 'gyur/ /rtog med nyam nga rnam par spangs/ /dga' ba rgyas shing ngo tsha med/ /glu len sgra 'byin 'dod pa'i sems/ /rang 'byung bde ba'i ros myos rtags/ /de ltar yang dag goms pa las/ /snang ba ye shes chen por 'char/ /phyag rgya ma la ltos ⑤med par/ /sgrib rjobral bde ba rgyas par 'gyur/ /bzang ngan bdag dang gzhan la sogs/ /yod dang med pa'i sbyor nyid dang / /⑦'dir ni skyon dang yon tan sogs/ /bde ba che la mi mnyam med/ /bstod grags rnyed ldan bder gyur pa/ /'dir ni smad cing ma grags dang / /dbul po sdug phongs ⑧14—1247

gang gyur pa/ /bye brag med pa rtog pa'i gdeng / /mdor na gang tshe rnal 'byor pas/ /rtsol dang mi rtsol nyer zhi zhing / /blang dor med par gang spyod pa| /byang chub spyad ①pa rlabs chen po/ /de ltar ma nyid bde ba che/ /mtha' bral rgyun mi 'chad pa yi/ /nyams su myong ba ma bstan par/ /sgyu 'phrul phyag rgya bzang mo bstenasde/ /mi mo mtshan nyid rab ldan zhing / /rigs kyi dbye bas phye ba ④ni/ /rgyud las gsungs bzhin rnal 'byor pas/ /kha dog mtshan ma kun shes bya/ /'gro tshogs chags sogs nyon mongs dang / /sdug bsngal gdung ba bsil byed pa/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi rgyud rnams las/ /rgyal bas gcig tu bka' stsal pa④/ /dam pa'i man ngag la brten te/ /gsang chen theg pa'i lam gyi tshul/ /yang dag sbyar ba byas pa las/ /'jig rten 'khor ba nub par shog /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po don yod rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rjes chags kyi sbyor bas de kho na'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i man ngag ces bya ba rdzogs so// //14—1248
bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (575)14wa 1250

—ngag cas bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ /karma mu dra pa rīk+ṣa sde.u pa de sha ①nā ma/bod skad du/ las kyi phyag rgya brtag pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi mo dung gi rnal bkod dang / /ba lang pad+mo'i rigs las byung / /bye rjob sum cu rtsa gnyis las/ /tha ma rnam par spang bar bya/ /de dag so so'i spyod pa dang / /kha dog dbyibs dang mtshan ma dang / /ngang tshul rnams las so so yi/ /rigs kyi mtshan nyid shes par bya /ser zhing dmar pa'i bud med gang / /tshig snyan rtag par spyod lam mkhas/ /skad gdangs mthon pos smra byed byung / / cog cog ⑤por ni 'dug la dga'/ /lta ba zur gyis gsal por 'dzin/ /tshig kyang zur gyis nges rtogs pa'i/ /bud med blo mchog de lta bu/ /rtag par dngos grub rnams kyi rgyu/ /ser zhing dkar ba'i bud med gang / /lus ni dgye min sgu bo min/ /byin du yan lag 14—1251

thams cad legs/ /khyad par du yang smin phrag mdzes/ /bzhin 'phel chung zhing rngom chung la/ /o sko'i dbyebs ni chung dgye yi/ /mdza' bo rtag tu sdug gyur pa/ /dbang phyug mi mo gnyis pa yin/ /bud med ①ser ba'i mdog ldan zhing / /rtag par de'i mig po ma che/ /bya byed mang zhing 'gro 'dug dga'/ /nam yang de yi tshig mi brtan/ /dbang po rno zhing brjed ngas chung / /yid du 'ong ba'i skyes bu la/ /lta brtson byed kyang chad mi btsan/ /mi mo bsten ③bya min par gsungs/ /yid 'ong sngo bsangs kha dog can/ /mig dkyus ring zhing de rab mdzes/ /byad kyi gzang ①ring mchu skor che/ /bzhin dang lag par 0ri mo mang / /dul zhing ngag snyan mnyen des che/ /chos sam 'jig rten mthun 'jug gis/ /'dris pa rnams la gzhungs ⑤bzang zhing / /bkra shis yan lag mi mo mchog /bud med ut+pal mdog 'dra zhing / /lus gzar 'dril zhing sen mo zlum/ /mig yangs dkar zhing yid du 'ong / /skra mnyen smra ba nyung ba'i bdag /skyes bu rnams la gus byed cing / /brtson rjopa mthar phyin byed la brtson/ /khong yangs ston la mkhas gyur pa/ /bsten na dngos grub 'phel bar 'gyur/ /byin du mdog nag ⑦dpral ba ser/ /mtshams mtha' dma' zhing rdzi ma mthugaske /bong thung yan lag rtsub pa dang / /mig mi sdug cing smra ba mang / /'dum kha yang zhing chags la dga'/ /gang la skyes bu bzang ngan med/ /dri dang mi bzad par ldan pa'i/ /bud med bsten pa nyams par 'gyur/ /bud gang zangs 'od rab mdzes shing / /gang gi mgul pa yan lag ring / /thung ngu ring po ma yin zhing / /smin ma phra zhing byun phrag yangs—/ /khong dal rtag par spyod lam gcig⑨ /rna ba bzang dang rab ldan 14—1252

zhing / /so thags mnyam pa'i bud med ni/ /rtag tu yon tan ring mi 'gro/ /dmar pa'i zangs kyis mtshon pa yi/ /bzhin bzangs sdom ①zhing cung zad sbom| /drang zhing lus khyim legs pa dang / /shin tu brla dang ro smad rgyas/ /rang don nyams pa rnam par spang / /bslu bar ①mi nus khong shes che/ /skra dang ba sru ring ldan pa'i/ /bu mo longs spyod pa ①zhig yin/ /mdog dmar spyod lam chos la dga'/ /mtho dman tshig dang spyod lam can/ /rtag par smra la dga' byed cing / /phyin ci log tu ston par byed/ /brnab sems rtag tu sten byed cing / /gtong dang mi ldan 'jungs pa dang / /chags dang sdang ba mang ba yiX/ /bud med skyon gyi ⑤dri ma can/ /dmar zhing dkar ba'i bud med gang / /sbom zhing phra ba'i skabs dang ldan/ /nu ma brla dang ro smad rgyas//ske dang rked rjopa sor mo ring / /so dang sen mo mnyam ldan zhing / /tshigs ⑦zlum byin pa bags kyi phra/ /lte ba'i 'og phyogs drang ldan pa'i/ /ba spu'i phreng ba gyen du langs/ /lte khung zab cing pad dbyibs 'dra/ /skye gnas mtho zhing bu ga rub/ /dal gyis mig ni rdeb byed pa'i/ /mi mo dbang phyug dpal gyi gzhi—/ /bud gang kun+da ltar dkar zhing / /rus pa rags shing lus stobs can—/ /rtag par mngal du bu pho 'chags/ /spyod lam dal zhing mdzes dang ldan| /'jig rten bya ba 'jug mkhas shing / /phrad par dka' zhing bral dka' ba'i/ /bu mo gsang thub blo gros can/ /sngags pa rnams kyis smad mi bya//bud gang dkar zhing dregs dang ldan/ /de ni ngo bzhin skyon med kyang / /skyes bu rnams kyis ⑧sgong bar 'gyur/ /phra zhing mig ni bsgyur la dga'/ /rked rags rked pa sbom pa dang / /byad sogs 'chos shing byi dor brtson/ /14—1253

rgod cing bslu bar sla ba yi/ /bu mo bsten par ma gsungs so/ /rigs rnams las ni thams cad la/ bsten dang bsten min shes byas nas/ /yon tan ldan pa'i skye gnas su/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bde ba btsal/ /de rnyed gyur nas rnal 'byor pas/ / 'du longs ①g.yeng ba kun sdangs sdenas/ /kun stong rab tu zhu mnyam pa/ /man ngag can gyis rtag tu bsam/ /'jig rten kun nas khyab gnas pa'i/ /ji snyed mi mor 'gyur ba yi/ /bha ga rtsa yi khyad par gyis/ /bcu phyed du ni rnam par grags/ /rlugs dang ④dung dang khwa ④gdong dang / /za byed gdong dang pad+mo can/ /gang dag ⑤pad+ma'i rtsa sbubs ni//shin tu yangs ma rlugs mar rjobarjod/ /rtsa sbubs 'bros shing dog pa yis/ /zug rngu skye 'gyur dung can ma/ /bud med gang gi pad+ma'i nang / /tsub cing tsha ba khā ⑦gdong can/ /bde ba yod dang med pa'i bdag /rtsa sbubs zha bo za byed gdong / /bha ga pad+mo ltar sdud cing / /pad+ma ⑧snal ltar phra mo ⑨can/ /de ltar pad+ma'i khyad par las/ /bha ga rab 'bring tha mar 'gyur/ /pad+mo can mchog rlugs ma dang / /dung can ma ni bar ma'o/ /za byed gdong dang khā ta'i ⑩gdong / /skyon rnams spang bar ⑪dka' ba'i phyir/ /bha ga rnams las tha mar 'gyur/ /tha ma smad pas mi blang ngo / /bha ga'i nang na gnas pa yi/ /rtsa yang rab 'bring gsum du 'gyur⑫/ /rab tu shin tu phra ba'i rtsa/ /ring po 'bring du gsungs pa yin/ /de ltar rigs dang bha ga dang / /rtsa rnams rab 'bring tha ma las/ /rab dang 'bring po'ang bsten bya zhing / /tha ma rtag tu spang bar bya/ /tha ma rtags ⑫kyis lus zungs nyams/ /de nyams bde ba nyams par 'gyur/ /de yis ting 'dzin mchog las nyams/ /de phyir mkhas 14—1254
brtsar 'bras re'u mig sgro/da/ (576)14wa 1256

༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ dharma a bhi ṣi ②ka ma ra ga sa hi/ bod skad du / dbang chos rten 'brel 'gro ldog /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro rdo rje 'chang dbyer med/ /gar bsgom ①gnad kyi yul der 'dud/ /bla med rgyud rnams bcud bsdus pa'i/ /dbang chos rim pa bshad par bya/ /dbang bzhi'i gdams pa zab mo yis/ /rang gzhan lhan cig skyes pa des/ /gzhan rnams dbang du sdud pa yi/ /srog sngags zab mo 'di nyid la/ /dbang bzhi'i gdams pa med pa yis/ /rnam rtog dbang du rnam rtog song / /rang nyid gzhan gyi dbang du 'gro/ /rang srog gcod pa'i sta dure yin/ /dbang po gcig dang tshe gcig la/ /gang zag bzhi dang rigs can bzhin⑤/ /mchog dbang bzhi yis the tshom med/ /dug gsum lam dang rnam rtog lam/ /mchog thun dngos grub gang bsgrub pa/ /bsnyen sogs bzhi 14—1257

dang bcu gnad gces/ /rang rkyen dag las gzhan rkyen 'byung / /ltas gcig rtags bzhin shes byas la/ /bsgrub dang ldog gzhag gdams ngag gces//bla ma sangs rgyas dbyer med mchog /gar bsgom rigs lnga'i skor ldog sogs/ /mchog thun gnyis kyi ①bye brag gis/ /ting 'dzin lnga ldan gdams pa bcasasne /gzhan yang ting 'dzin du ma las/ /'jug par byed pa ma shes na/ /mchog dang thun mong de la med/ /de bas gdan gyi ④gdams pa gces/ /lus ngag yid gsum rten 'brel kyang / /ye shes gcig gis 'gro ldog nges/ /dad gus bdag gzhan 'gro ldog nges/ /gcig rjol gcig brten rjomatshungs ldan 'grub/ /phrin rjolas bzhi dang bsdu ba bzhi/ /rigs lnga ye shes lnga la sogs/ /stan thog gcig tu bsgom ⑦pa gces/ /bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po gces/ /khyad par ting 'dzin lnga ldan gces/ /mi 'gyur bla ma gdams pa gces/ /'khrul 'khor nyes nad dgra gdon 'byung / /zhi dang dngos grub 'byung ba la/ /lus rtsa ngag rlung sems thig le/ /dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /dbang bzhi dag las skyes pa'i bu/ /gegs ⑧sel bogs 'don ngag ⑨tu 'gyur/ /phyag rgya nyer gnas phyi 'khor sogs/ /lus ngag yid gsum ⑩'dra mthun dang / /kha dog dbyibs sogs rgyud sde bzhin/ /gang la gang shis rten 'brel gnad/ /rnal 'byor blo sems mthun pas 'grub/ /ci bsam 'grub pas blo re bde/ /rang lus gzhan lus gdams pa gcig /rang sems gtso bor gyur pa las/ /rnal 'byor pho rang bya mi dgos/ /bla med theg pa chen po ⑪yin/ /bde shas ⑫che ba'i rigs kyis ni/ /rigs ldan shes dang sgyu rtsal shes/ /'khrul 'khor gnad dang yon tan sogs/ /tha mal spangs pa gnad du gces/ /bla 14—1258

med snod rung snod byas nas/ /nyon mongs rang dbang lam dang 'dres/ /srid sel rigs rgyud spel zhes bya/ /bzhi ldan gdan ①dang mthun pas bsgyur/ /mthon ④dman skyon yon bzang ngan sogs/ /'dun ①pa'i sems kyis ④bsgyur bar bya/ /spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med dang / /phyogs las rnal 'byor don gyi spyod pa bya/ /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid rig ma yin/ /bsten thabs dus tshod gnas skabs 'dod ⑤yon dang / /khyad par ro drug rig ma gnad kyis bcad/ /'bras bu bzhi dang dbyer med phyag rgya'i gnad/ /la la nyon mongs 'bur 'joms byed/ /la la nyon mongs 'gyod rjes gcod/ /nyon mongs che ba dubade ba che/ /de phyir stong pa'i rgyas 'debs gnad/ /gzhan don slob pa'i zung 'jug yin/ /bya byed bral sogs lhun grub yin/ /dam tshig bzhi dang sdom pa bzhi/ /dam bca' bzhi bcas mchog dbang bskur/ /phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /'dus na dzā ⑦larnya rar thim/ /pad+ma bzhi la thig le bzhi/ /bde ba bcu drug skye bar 'gyur/ /rang snang ye shes gzugs can gyis/ /pad+ma lte ba'i dbus na gnas/ /nor bu'i rtse mor gnas pa'i tshe/ /mar me lta bur mya ngan 'das/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang sku bzhir bstan/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni chos sku yin/ /gsang sngags tshul chen theg pa 'dir/ /bla ma bzang pos bzung ba rnams/ /zla ba drug la sogs pas ni/ /'grub pas su zhig 'dir mi 'jug /rten 'brel rdo rje'i tshig drug 'di/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /tshig don 'byel pa'i rten 'byel 'di/ /thabs shes gnyis su 'brel byas nas/ /mchog thun gnyis su 'grub 'gyur zhing / /mkha' 'gro'i dmod bzhin da ltar de ⑧'grub shog /dpal nā ro pas mdzad 14—1259

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ mṛ kyu thāñdza ②no ba de sha /bod skad du/'chi ba bslu skeba'i man ngag /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan stug po bkod pa nyid du don dam thugs chud cing //dga' ldan skye bo'i don mdzad phyir ni dam pa tog dkar gyur/ /de nas 'dir ni 'gro ba'i don du shākya'i tog gyur gang / /'chi bdag las rgyal sgyu ma kun ston de ni rgyal gyur ④cig /rga dang 'chi ba med pa brnyes/ /rga shi med par mdzad pa las/ /rga shi med pa thob pa'i phyir/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la gus par 'dud/ /blo dman rnams kyis rtogs dka' zhing / /g.yo ba'i sems la dka' ba yi/ /'chi bdag slu ⑤ba 'chi ltas bcas/ /bstan bcos dang 'brel bshad par bya/ /'chi bdag rnam kun slu rjob ni/ /grol ba nyid la rigs pa yin/ /ma grol ba ni thams cad kyi/ /cung zad dus su bsring ba ⑦14—1261

yin—/ /tshe dang dbang po rnams dang sems/ /'gag pa 'chi ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ /thabs kyis ①yun ring 'tsho ba ni/ /'chi ba bslu ②ba zhes bshad do—/ /chos spyod dbang po thul ba ni/ /'khor ba ru ni ji srid 'tsho/ /de srid bsod nams la sogs tshogs/ /byang chub sgrub byed rab tu skye/ /'khor bar srog las gces pa ni/ /ci yang yod par ma mthong ste/ /de bas myur du thabs mang pos/ /'chi ba bslu gab kun du spyod④/ /gang phyir rigs par thabs sbyar ba/ /dka' ba cung zad yod ma yin/ /nor bu sngags dang sman rnams kyi⑤/ /mthu ni thams cad 'dod pa yin/ /'chi ba'i mtshan nyid las ring nas/ /shes par byas nas rigs pas bcosadu/ /spyi bor thog ni 'bab pa la/ /rab tu mkhas kyang ci byar yod/ /phyi dang nang gi dbye ba yi/ /'chi ba'i mtshan nyid rnam pa gnyis/ /gang gis ⑦'chi bar 'gyur ba ni/ /shes 'gyur brtson pas de shes bya/ /gal te 'ga' zhig 'chi ba yi/ /mtshan nyid shes par 'dod gyur na/ /der ni bder gnas lus las ni/ /shes bya gzhan du yid gnyis 'gyur/ /khams mi snyoms dang 'dod chags dang / /rab rib la sogs dbang gyur dang / /'jigs dang mya ngan sogs pa'i rgyus/ /gang phyir gzhan du so sor snang / /lha dang 'byung ba gnyis ka sgeni/ /'khrugs pas ⑨'chi ba'i mtshan nyid gsum/ /'thob las 'chi ltas byung gyur pa'i/ /dbye ba de bas shes par bya/ /phyi dang nang gi dbye ba yis/ /lha 'khrugs pa ni gnyis su 'dod/ /de bzhin 'byung ba 'khrugs pa ni/ /rnam pa gnyis su brtag par bya/ /lha rnams kun 'khrugs las 'chi ba/ /lha las gyur pa yin par bshad/ /lha 'khrugs pa las mu ge sogs/ /thog babs la sogs mtshan 14—1262

nyid yin/ /'byung ba 'khrugs pas 'chi ba ni/ /'byung ba las gyur zhes bya bshad / /'byung ba 'khrugs pas mkhris sogs dang / /me dang chu sogs 'tshe ba yin/ /gnyi ga 'khrugs pas 'chi ba dang / /gnyi ga las gyur pa zhes bshad| /gnyis ka 'khrugs pas thog 'bab sogs/ /mkhris pa bad kan sogs gnod pa'o/ /'chi ltas rnams ni mtha' yas phyir/ /cig ①car 'byung bar mi 'dod pa②/ /kun la'ang rim gyis ma yin gyis①/ /'on kyang gcig sogs grangs kyis so/ /gang du mtshan nyid mthong gyur kyang / /la lar 'chi bar mi 'gyur snang / /'khrul med der ni chos la sogs/ /gnod pa'i bar chod yin par brtag /gang du mtshan nyid ma mthong bar la lar 'chi ba snang gyur pa/ /der ni nges med par nges kyi/ /mtshan nyid med pa nyid ma yin—/ /'chi ba thag ring nas des byed/ /grags pa chen po nyid du gyurarjo/ /ci nus par ni yongs gtong dang / /gso ba'i thabs la'ang 'jug par byed/ /rtag tu mnyam par bzhag ⑤gyur pas/ / de ltar ༷rtse gcig yid du bya/ /dang po re zhig phyi yi ni/ /mtshan nyid nye bar rtag par bya/ /mtshan nyid kyis ni yongs nges pa'i/ /dus ni rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /de yang nges dang ma nges pa/ /zhes bya 'bad de shes par bya/ /'pho ba dang ni bco lnga sogs/ /nang pa ⑦la sogs skad cig bdag /dus ni nges pa zhes bshad de/ /go bzlog pa las ma nges pa'o/ /'gram pa'i mtshams ni rab g.yo na/ /'chi bar rab tu ston pa yin/ /rlung dang grang sogs phrad pa las/ /mtshan nyid 'di las gzhan du brtag /dbyar zla 'bring po karka'i khyem/ /dgun zla 'bring po chu srin 'dod/ /karka ṭa dang chu srin la'ang / /'chi ba'i mtshan nyid 'byung 14—1263

ba yin/ /dbyar zla 'bring po 'pho ba'i zhag /nyi ma byed la rkang pa'i tshad/ /byang du bltas te gnas pa yi/ /grib ma rang gi rang bzhin yin/ /dgun zla 'bring po 'pho ba'i zhag /de nyid rkang tshad bdun du 'gyur/ /sprin med nam mkhar nyin phyed na/ /grib ma dag ni brtag par bya/ /zla ba re re rkang re 'phel—/ /zla ba re zhing rkang re 'grib/ /'di las gzhan du 'gyur na ni/ /'chi ba'i dogs pa rab tu bskyed/ /dbyar zla 'bring nas chu srin par/ /rkang pa re re 'phel ba yin/ /chu srin nas ni karka'i ①bar/ /rkang pa re re 'grib par 'gyur/ /dbyar zla 'bring nas rim gyis ske'aphel/ /de bzhin dgun zla 'bring rim 'grib/ /grib ma'i 'gyur ba mthong nas ni/ /zla ba gcig na 'chi bar nges/ /'grib pa'i dus su 'phel ba dang / /gal te 'phel ba'i dus su 'grib—/ /dus de nyid nas brtsams nas ni/ /zla ba gcig na 'chi bar nges//'phel ba'i dus su rab 'phel na/ /sna tshogs nad kyis gtses par 'gyur/ /'grib pa'i dus su'ang rab 'grib ①na/ /'chi ba nyid du the tshom med/ /dbyar zla dgun zla 'bring gi mthar/ /dang po karka ṭa dang nya'i/ /nyi ma drug drug gang yin 'dir/ /dus dang dus min nges par brtag /dbyar zla 'bring sogs nyin zhag dus/ /dbyar zla tha chungs rjosogs bzang ngan/ /dgun zla 'bring po'i zhag lhag la'ang / /dgun zla tha chungs ⑤sogs bzang ngan//rkang mthil dag tu phug snyam dang / /gang tshe lte ba phug snyam gyur/ /nyin zhag gsum gyi 'og tu ni/ /'chi ba nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /rkang pa dag ni mthil phug nas/ /gal te mig kyang phug snyam na/ /de tshe zla ba gsum gyi rjoni/ /rjes la gshin rje'i khrim du 'gro/ /gal te rkang mthil gnyis phug nas/ /sna 14—1264

rtse'i bar du phug snyam na/ /de tshe nges par zhag gsum nas/ /gcig tu 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /bshang dang gci ba'i dus dag tu/ /dus mtshungs sprid pa byung gyur na/ /dus ni de nyid nas bzung ste/ /de ni lo gcig dag na 'chi//ltag khung dag tu phug snyam na/ /zhag lnga nas ①ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mig gis lce rtse ma mthong na/ /zhag gsum na ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sna rtse rgyun du 'bigs snyam na/ /zla ba bzhi na ②'chi bar 'gyur/ /mdzod spu'i gnas su phug snyam na/ /nges par ske'aphral du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe g.yas dang g.yon par ni/ /dus mtshungs par ni zug 'gyur ba/ /de tshe zla ba gcig na 'chi—/ /de bas bsod nams dag ni bsag /mtshan ni gnyi ga sbyor ba na/ /bar dang tha mar sprid pa dang / /mnyam par 'byung 'gyur de yi tshe/ /zla ba lnga na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /lag pa rkang pa nyid dag gi/ /mthe'u chung dag gi tshigs rnams ni/ /bzhi po dus gcig zug snyam pa/ /de ni zla ba gcig na 'chi / /gang tshe snying ga dulkog ma ya/ /bar du dus mtshungs par ⑤zug 'gyur//gal te chos la mi brten na/ /zla ba phyed dang gnyis na 'chi/ /gal te mthil gsum yang dag rjoyang / /dus mtshungs par ni zug 'gyur na/ /gal te brgya byen mtshungs pa yang / /zhag gsum na ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang gis mig ni g.yon pa yi/ /gzugs ni me long la ma mthong / /gal te 'chos par mi byed na/ /zhag bdun na ni nges par 'chi/ /'khrig spyod tshe na dril bu yi/ /sgra ni rna ba dag gis thos/ /gal te tshangs pa dang mnyam pa'ang / /de tshe zla ba gsum gyis 'chi⑦/ /yar ngo yi ni tshes gcig la/ /gal te khu ba nag por mthong / /de tshe zla ba drug na 'chi/ /dmar pos nad kyis 'debs par ston/ /14—1265

sna rtse dang ni smin ma'i bar/ /spyi bo'i rtse mor so sor ni/ /zug 'gyur gal te zlog mi byed/ /de tshe 'phral du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rkang pa'i mthe'u nas brtsams nas/ /lte ba yi ni mthar thug par/ /zug cing tsha bar bcas 'gyur te—/ /zla ba drug na nges par 'chi/ /rkang pa'i mthe bo nas snying ga① /sgog ma'am yang na mgo mthar zug /rim bzhin zla phyed zla ba gsum/ /nyin zhag gcig gis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sna rtse'i sha ni lhod gyur na/ /zhag bdun na ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mkhur tshos sha ni chad gyur na/ /zla ba lnga na 'chi bar 'gyur—/ /mig dang sna gong dag gi bar/ /mgul ba mthong bar ma gyur na/ /zhag lnga nas ni 'chi 'gyur bas/ /chos kyi rgyags ni bskur bar bya/ /mig gnyis mig 'bras dri ma chags/ /gal te 'phral du 'byung 'gyur na/ /be+er 'chos ②par ni mi byed na/ /zla ba drug gi nang du 'chi/ /glo bur du ni sna yo zhing / /rna ba rang gi gnas nas bskyod/ /mig kyang rlum por gyur na ni/ /zhag bdun nas ni 'chi bar ston/ /glo bur du ni snying ga dma'/ /de tshe zla ba phyed na 'chi/ /mgrin pa'i ngos gnyis rtsa dag ni/ /chad pa dag kyang zla phyed na'o①—/ /gal te lce yi dbus su rjoni/ /ri mo nag po glo bur byung / /so dag dam du 'thams pa ni/ /de tshe nyin zhag gnyis na 'chi/ /rna ba'i 'khor nang rgyab kyi ni/ /rtsa ni chad par snang gyur na/ /nyin zhag de 'am yang na ni/ /zhag lnga na ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sen mo'i kha dog dmar po dag /'phral du med par 'gyur na ni/ /gal te sngags sogs la ma sbyangasaX/ /de tshe zla ba drug na 'chi/ /glo bur du ni spom 'gyur dang / /deg cing khro dang 'jigs pas 'khrugs/ /gal te chos ni ma bsten gang / /de ni lo gcig dag na 'chi//14—1266

dbang po rnams ni rang gi yul/ /ji bzhin 'dzin par mi byed dang / /tshig ni yang yang 'khrul pa dang / /blo yang yang dang yang du 'khrul/ /mig las rtag tu 'dzag pa dang / /gzugs mthong na yang 'khrul pa dang / /me long ngam ni yang na chur①/ /rang gi grib ma ma mthong dang / /mtshan mo'i dus su gzha' dang ni/ /nyin par skar ma'i tshogs mthong dang / /sprin med par ni lho phyogs na/ /gnas pa'i glog 'gyur mthong ba dang / /nyin par grib ma'i lam dang ni/ /de bzhin skar ma lhung ba mthong / /ngang pa bya rog rma bya ni/ /gcig ni 'dres par mthong ba dang / /zla ba gnyis dang nyi ma gnyis/ /de bzhin rang gi mgo bor 'bar/ /shing rtse ri bo'i rtse la ni/ /dri za'i grong khyen mthong ba dang / /yi dwags sha za 'jigs rung ba'i/ /gzhan dag kyang ni mthong 'gyur dang / /shin tu 'dar bar 'gyur ba dang / /yang dang yang du brgyal ba dang / /skyugs pa bshang dang gci ba na/ /gser ram dngul gyi mdog tu mthong / /de yis re re mthong 'gyur na'ang / /zla ba gcig gis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /lkog ma mchu dang rkan dang ②lce/ /chod dang bu ga de bzhin lus/ /mthong na de bzhin zla drug gi/ /nang du nges par 'chi bar 'gyuraske/ /gre ba mchu dang rkan dang ①lce/ /rgyun du so sor skams na ni/ /de ni zla drug nang du ni/ /nges par 'chi bar ston pa yinarjo/ /skar ma'i tshogs dang drang srong bdun/ /phyogs su mtshan mo ma mthong ngam/ /lus ni glo bur 'bar 'gyur na/ /zhag bdun na ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sgrib med dang ni snar ma dang / /bstan dang de bzhin grib pa'i lam/ /mtshan mo glo bur du ba ⑦mthong / /zla ba drug la 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zla ba ra ri med pa dang / /nyi ma 14—1267

'od dang bral ba dang / /me ni sna tshogs 'od bcas dang / /zla ba yang ni 'od zer bcas/ /mtshan mo nyi ma nyin par mtshan/ /de bzhin rang mig 'bar ba dang / /skar ma ri rab dag gi tshad/ /rgya mtsho chu bo lta bu dang / /lte ba'i skyibs ①su bshang sgo la/ /sprid pa bzhin mdog pad+ma dang / /skog mar 'brum pa dmar po dang / /lus la kha dog sna tshogs dang / /snying ga ③nas smre mchi mar bcas/ /yang na rkan ni 'gul pa dang / /zla zer me ltar 'tsher ba dang / /nyi zer kha ba lta bur bsil/ /zla ba nyi ma'i bu ga dang / /sa dang gnam gyi bu ga dang / /gang zhig bdag nyid kho nas mthong / /de ni zla phyed rngunas 'chi rjomathong / /khu ba dang ni bshang gci rnams/ /dus ni mtshungs par 'bab 'gyur na/ /lo gcig nas 'chi de la ni/ /sman pa'i thabs kyis gso bar bya/ /gang gi lus ni byed dag ni/ /grang zhing de bzhin phyed dro na/ /zhag bdun nas ni 'chi 'gyur gyis/ /'jig rten pha rol rnam ⑤bsam bya/ /ha zhes bya ba grang bar tshor/ /phu ni me dang 'dra 'gyur na/ /gang gis ①nyams su myong ba de/ /zhag bcu nas ni gshin rje mthong / /srin lag gi ni rtsa ba ru/ /ri mo nag po mthong 'gyur na/ /zhag ni bco brgyad 'og tu ni/ /sngon las nges par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang gi ⑦mgo bor rtsangs ⑧pa ni/ /kha dog gsum pa 'dzegs nas su/ /myur du 'gro bar byed pa na⑨/ /zla ba lnga las nges par 'chi/ /lag pa gnyis kyis mnyes pa yi/ /lus kyi sgra ni mi thos shing / /yan lag thams cad grang gyur pa⑩/ /zhag bcu na ni 'chi bar 'gyur//gang gi ⑪byin pa lag pa ni/ /cig ⑫car bskyod cing 'gro ba dang / /tshangs pa'i skud pa med gyur ⑫na/ /de ni lo gcig dag nas 'chi/ /'dam mam sa 14—1268

rdul phyogs su ni/ /rkang pa'i mdun nam yang rgyab na/ /rkang rjes dum bu ma tshang ba/ /zla ba bzhi nas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /skyes bu gnag dang dmar ser gyi//mdog can glo ①bur dag tu mthong / /gal te 'khrul 'gyur ma yin na/ /lo gsum 'das nas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /snying ga rkang pa bkrus ma thag /skams na zla ba gnyis na 'chi/ /mi sdug par snang dri nga ba/ /byung na nyin zhag gsum na 'chi/ /nyi ma tsha bar chu yis ni/ /kha yi nang ni bkang nas kyang / /nyin re phu ni 'debs pa na/ /rim gyis de dbus gnas pa yi/ /dbang po'i gzhu ni sna tshogs mthong / /skyes bu rtag tu tshe ring zhing / /zla drug tshe yod de mi mthong / /de ltar mtshan ma sna tshogs nyid/ /mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbus su ni//mu tig phreng ba chad pa 'dra'i/ /mu tig rdog mas brgyan pa ni/ /nyi ma gsal ba'i tshe ni mthong / /mthing ga'i ②nor bu mdog 'dra la/ /skra shad 'dzengs pa lta bu ni/ /mthong bar gyur pa'i phyogs nas ni/ /phyogs gzhan du ni 'gro ba ①dang / /klu ni du mar gtser ba dag /rtag tu mthong bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de ma mthong na zla drug gis/ /'chi ba ru ni nges par bsgragasarjo/ /snga dro'am yang ni ⑤phyi dro 'am/ /zla zer dag la yun ring du/ /dpung pa brgyangs pa'i rjogrib ma la/ /bltas ⑦te rim gyis mkha' la blta/ /der yang grib ma mi gzugs ni/ /grib ma skya bo mthong 'gyur la/ / de mi ④mgo bo ma mthong na/ /lo gcig gi ni nang du 'chi/ /lag pa g.yon pa ma mthong na/ /bu dang chung ma brlag ⑨par 'gyur/ /lag g.yas ma mthong ba yis kyang / /pha dang spun zla sogs chen 'chi/ /lag gnyis pus mo'i steng bzhag pa/ /byas nas spyi bor thal sbyar ba/ /de gnyis dbus na chu shing gi/ /'bras bu lta bu'i grib ma 14—1269

mthong / /gang tshe de las 'dab ma gcig /yongs su kha bye snang gyur pa①/ /nges par chos ni de nyid kyi/ /zla ba drug na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rlung ni nyi ma'i lam 'gro las/ /rna ba mgo dang mig las ④ni/ /sgra dang du ba de bzhin 'od//gsum po 'di dag brtag par bya/ /rna ba shin tu dam por dgab/ /zab cing 'ur 'ur sgra grag pa/ /nyin zhag lnga'am bcu'am ni/ /bco lnga nyin zhag nyi shu 'am/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga nyid kyi ni/ /bar du thos par ma gyur na/ /mda' dang rgya mtsho yon tan mig /zla lor ①go rims bzhin du 'chi/ /'di rnasas kyi yang bar rnams su/ /nyin zhag bcu drug dor bar bya/ /lo nyid kyi ni cha lnga yi—/ /go rims bzhin du bskyed rjopas so/ /spyi bo'i steng nas byung ba ni⑤/ /du ba'i phreng ba zhag bdun ni/ /gang gis mthong bar ma gyur de/ /lo gsum nas ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rang mig dag gi phyogs bzhir ni/ /sor mos mnan na byi la yi/ /mig dang 'dra ba'i snang ba ni/ /yud kyi rim pas mthong bar 'gyur/ /ma btsir dubar yang de mthong na/ /zhag brgyad na dze+eni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'di dag spyir ni shes bya ste/ /khyad par 'di yang brjod par bya//zla ba'i 'og dang de yi steng / /rna ba sna dang nye bar ni/ /snang ba ma mthong mdor bsdu na/ /drug gsum gnyis gcig zla bas 'chi/ /nyi ma'ang gal te zla ba yi/ /rim 'gyur de tshe snga ma bzhin/ /phyogs mda' yon tan mig gi ni/ /nyin zhag rnams su 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rang gi rang bzhin 'gyur ba las zla ba drug ma ⑧'chi bar 'gyur/ /sna yi rtse mo ma mthong na/ /zla ba lnga na 'chi bar 'gyur—/ rna ba gnyis ni 'on gyur na/ /zla ba bzhi — 'das nas 'chi/ /dbang po dar gnas pa las 'gyel/ /zla ba gsum na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /byun 14—1270

mtshalas bar du snang ba mthong / /zla ba gnyis na gshin rje mthong / / 'khrig pa'i ①'bras bu zad 'gyur ④na/ /zla gcig 'das nas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi mig la gzugs brnyan ni/ /ma mthong zla ba phyed na 'chi/ /lce ni bskyod par mi nus na/ /zhag bcu nas ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /lto ba ldog gyur zhag lnga nas/ /'chi bdag dang ni phrad par 'gyur/ /rtsib ④logs gnyis las drangs rjosnyam na/ /zhag gsum nas ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /lus kun rengs par gyur na ni/ /zhag gcig na ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dpral bar gnas pa'i ri mo gsum/ /med 'gyur zhag ni gsum nas 'chi/ /bde bar gnas par lce'u chung ni/ /reg pa mi tshor skams pa ni/ /nyin zhag lnga yi bar 'gyur te/ /nyin zhag lnga bcu dag ni 'chi/ /ro sgyur ba la sogs pa dang / /kha dog las ni sngo la sogs/ /khu ba gcin rjoni 'gyur ba las/ /zla ba drug na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /cig car rgyun ni lnga pa 'am/ /g.yon nas 'khor zhing dri nga bar/ /gang gi gcin ni 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de ni zla ba drug na 'chi/ /zla ba yar ngo'am mar ngo la/ /gal te khu ba nag por 'gyur⑦/ /'on te be+er gsor ma byas na/ /zla ba drug na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /nag po'i cha ni yongs spangs te/ /dkar po'i cha nas blangs nas su/ /sna bug ⑦g.yon nas rlung rgyu'i tshe/ /bcug nas slar gsor 'gyur ba yin/ /rang gi lus ni brtan 'gyur kyang / /gal te grib ma yo na ni/ /zla ba bzhi na 'chi 'gyur zhes/ /lung la mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad/ /grib ma lho phyogs 'gro bar ni/ /gal te bdag nyid kyis mthong na/ /bdag nyid de nyid 'chi'o zhes/ /de ltar mi rtag pa nyid mthong / /don med pa dang bslu ba dang / /log pa la sogs par 14—1271
