bshad pas/ /rmi lam thams cad bden min yang / /de la ma dang rigs ma yin—/ /rmi lam dag tu lhas bstan dang / /yang na rmi lam bden mthong mis//rmi lam yid ches byas nas su/ /'chi ba'i mtshan ma blta ①bar bya/ /rgya skyegs ko bi da ra dang / /ka ra bī ⑤ra me tog rgyas/ /mi lam mthar ni gang zhig 'dzeg /de ni zla ba drug na 'chi/ /mi ni gang zhig rmi lam mthar/ /lha gang gi ni mchod sdong ngam/ /bye ma'am thal phung la 'dzeg dze+epa/ /de ni snga ma bzhin du 'chi/ /bong bu la ni zhon nas su/ /lho phyogs su ni rab song nas/ /slar yang ldog par ma gyur pa/ /de yi srog kyang de bzhin no/ /gang yang spre'u la zhon nasadu/ /lho phyogs su ni ⑤'gro byed cing / /der gnas bzhin du sad na ni/ /de ni snga ma bzhin du 'chi/ /shing rings mchod rten srog shing ngam/ /grog mkhar phyag dar khrod phrang la/ /mi ni gang zhig 'dzeg 'gyur ba/ /de ni zla drug las mi 'tsho/ /bu mo nag mo rab khros nas/ /gang zhig bcings pas 'chi ba ni/ /de ni dus mtshan yin zhes bya/ /zhag bdun nas ni 'chi byed yin—/ /bud med gang zhig gos gnag cing / /mdog gnag mi ni 'dod spyod la/ /ka ra bī 0ra'i phreng ba mis/ /de ni gshin rje'i gnas su 'gro/ /rmi lam du ni mun pa 'am/ /g.yang sa'am de bzhin btson rar 'jug /rmi lam du ni shing las lhung / /de ni 'chi bdag gan ⑦na gnas/ /gnyid log lus dang mgo bo la/ /ljon shing rtswa 'am shing dag ni/ /'bras bu med par khrugang gis mthong / /zla drug las ni mi 'tshom/ /mi ni gang zhig spre'u yi/ /bzhon ⑨pa la zhon ⑩shar phyogs 'gro/ /sad par gyur na de yi ni/ /mtshan mo tha ma yin zhes bya/ /khyi khā bya rgod ce spyang dang / /srin po yi dwags sha za yis//14—1272

zos dang bong bu phag rnga mo/ /ma te sbyon ①te khyer ba ni/ /de ni nges par lo gcig nas/ /'chi ba ru ni ston pa yin/ /rmi lam mtshan ma mthong na ni/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i blos zhi bya/ /mi ni lcags kyi dbyig pa thog④ /gnag cing gos ni nag po gyon/ /gnyid log pa yi mdun na mthong / /zla ba gsum na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /lus ni dri dmar gyis byugs shing / /phreng ba dmar pos rnam par brgyan/ /til mar gyis bskus shin tu skrag /skra bregs gos ni dmar po gyon—/ /bong bu zhon te mgyogs par ni/ /lho yi phyogs su 'gro 'gyur bar/ /bdag nyid 'di 'drar rmi lam nasde/ /mthong na zla ba drug la 'chi/ /dri dang phreng ba dmar po 'am/ /yang na gos ni dmar po 'am/ /gang gi rmi lam dag tu rnyed/ /de ni zla ba brgyad na 'chi/ /phyi rol gyi na 'chi ba yi/ /mtshan ma grangs las 'das pa ni/ /lo brgyad yang ni kha cig gis/ /smra bar yang ni su yis nus/ /'chi bar ston par byed pa yi/ /phyi yi rtags ni ji ltar bshad/ /'di dag shes byas sngags sogs kyis/ /bslu rjoba'i 'bad par myur du bya/ /slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas sbyar ba'i 'chi ba bslu rjob bstan pa las le'u dang po'o // //dhid ni nang gi 'chi ba yi/ /mtshan nyid gsal bar brjod par bya/ /de ni rlung byung las shes bya/ /rlung ni ⑦kha dang sna spyod yul/ /ji srid nang gi mtshan nyid ni/ /legs par ⑧nges par ma byas par/ /phyi yi mtshan nyid tsam gyis ni/ /'chi ba'i nges pa ⑨legs mi rnyed/ /'chi ba'i nges pa gnyi ⑫ga ni/ /sdes byas yongs su gsal ba yin/ /phyi rol blo ni phyin ci log /nad la 14—1273

sogs pa'i dogs pa skyed/ /dgun zla 'bring sogs 'pho ba yi/ /zla ba nya sogs thams cad la/ /'chi ba'i mtshan nyid spyi yi ni/ /nang par thog mar brtag ①par bya/ /mi ni rtog ④byed nyin zhag ni/ /gang la nges par rtog par byed—/ /nyin zhag de nas brtsams nas ni/ /dus 'das pa ni ④'chi bar 'gyur—/ /rang bzhin tha mal dang ldan pa'i/ /srog chags kun la rtag tu ni//sna khung g.yas dang g.yon pa la/ /so sor brten 0pa'i rlung rgyu ba/ /nyi ma zla ba zhes bya ba/ /rlung ni thun phyed dag tu rgyu/ /de las bzlog ⑦pas 'chi ba sogs—/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis rjobartag par bya/ /tshes gcig nas ni brtsams nas su⑦/ /zla bar gtogs pa dkar por rgyu/ /rlung ni nyi ma gsum yin te/ /de nas zhag gsum nyi ma yi⑧/ /slar yang zla bas nyin gsum ste/ /de nas nyi mar zhag gsum mo/ /yar ngo'i zla ba nya yi bar/ /go rims 'dis ⑨ni nges pa ⑩yin/ /de bzhin mar ngo nas brtsams te/ /nyi mar rlung rgo rgyu ba yin—/ /cig shos kyi ni bco lnga'i bar/ /nyi ma gsum gsum snga ma bzhin/ /go rims ⑪'di las bzlog par blta/ /zla ba phyed dang gnyis par nges zla ba drug nas 'chi 'gyur ba/ /de phyir chos ni dran par bya/ /zla ba gcig ni go bzlog pas/ /gnyen dang bshes ni rgud par 'gyur/ /zla byed phyin ci log gyur pas/ /nad ni mi bzad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /nyin gcig nyin gsum bzhi dang lnga/ /zhag drug go ni bzlog pa ru/ /rlung ni gal te rgyu gyur ⑫na/ /de tshe rtsod dang skye sogs 'byung / /rang bzhin yongs su spangs na ni/ /lam gsum rtogs par rlung rgyu na/ /slar gso ba ni nus pa ⑫min/ /nyi ma phyed ni 'das nas 'chi/ /rlung ni 'pho ba med pa ru/ /lam ni gnyis po dag las 14—1274

kyang / /zhag bcu'i bar du rgyu gyur na/ /'pho ba'i tshe na de 'chi yis/ /nyin zhag mnyam 'dra skad cig 'thob/ /gang gi mig ni 'gul gyur paske/ /de yi srog ni nyin zhag ni/ /gcig na 'jig par gdon mi za/ /thun phyed kyi ni bar dag tu/ /phan tshun du ni lam mang zhing / /rlung rgyu de las mchod pa dag /thob pa nyid du shes par bya/ /gang gi 'pho ba lnga po ni/ /'das par kha ru rgyu gyur pa/ /rlung de las ni nor brlag pa'am/ /mi dga' ba 'am 'jigs sogs sde'abyung / /sna yi khung bu g.yon pa'i rlung / /'pho ba yang ni bcu gsum ni/ /'das par gang gi rgyu gyur pa/ /de la nad sogs skye bar 'gyur/ /sna khung gnyi ga'i yongs spangs te/ /gang tshe khar ni rgyu gyur rjon/ /gal te rdo rje 'dra na'ang 'di/ /nyin zhag de las 'tsho ma yin/ /dgun zla ra ba'i 'pho ba yi/ /dus nas brtsams te rlung dag ni/ /nyi mar zhag lnga rgyu gyur na/ /lo ni bco brgyad nyid nas 'chi/ /ston zla 'bring po'i 'pho ba yi/ /dus nas brtsams te rlung dag ni/ /zhag lnga'i bar du rgyu gyur na/ /lo ni bco lnga nyid nas 'chi/ /dbyar zla tha chungs ⑤yang de bzhin/ /lo ni bcu gnyis nyid nas 'chiske/ /dbyar zla ra ba'ang de bzhin 'gyur/ /lo dgu nyid nas 'chi bar 'gyur—/ /dpyid zla 'bring po'i 'pho ba yi/ /dus nas brtsams te gal te ni//zhag lnga'i bar du rgyu gyur na/ /de tshe lo drug nyid nas 'chi/ /dgun zla 'bring po 'pho ba yi/ /rlung ni zhag lnga rgyu gyur na/ /lo gsum 'das nas 'chi bar ni/ /de ltar dus la mkhas pas bshad/ /thams cad du ni zhag gnyis gsum/ /bzhi yi bar du rlung rgyu na/ /go rims dudag ni ji bzhin du/ /lo yi cha yis de des bya/ /zla ba ru ni de bzhin du/ /rlung rgyu na ni 'chi ma rtogs⑦/ /nad 14—1275

dang mu ge'i dgon pa dang / /mya ngan brgyal sogs 'tshe ba 'byung / /spyi yi dus ni legs rtogs pas/ /gsal ba 'di ni bstan pa yin①/ /khyad par du zhuni brtag pa'i phyir/ /rgyu ba gzhan dag bstan par bya/ /mnyam po mdun ⑦du nyi ma song / /gal te skye ba'i skar zla ba/ /dus ni rgyas pa zhes bya ste/ /'chi ba'i nges pa byed pa yin/ /mi ni khyim gang las skyes pas/ /de dang gzhan la mdun rjogang yin/ /mnyam po bdun zhes bya bar bshad/ /der ni nyi ma mnyam bdun rtogs⑤/ /khyim de nyid du zla ba ni/ /skye ba'i skar mar song 'gyur ba/ /rgyas pa'i dus zhes bya ba ste/ /der ni 'chi bar brtag par bya/ /rlung ni nang du rtogs pa dag /nyi ma'i lam ni thams cad du/ /cig shos 'dir ni dus min par/ /mkhas pas dus ni brtag par bya/ /rlung ni skad cig dus gang la/ /bgrod pa gzhan du 'jug 'gyur na/ /dus 'dir skad cig rdzogs 'gyur na/ /'chi 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /gal te rlung ni nyi mar rtogs/ /rgyas pa'i dus su nyin phyed rgyu/ /de tshe lo ni bcu bzhi nas/ /'chi ba nyid du shes par bya/ /nyin gcig tu ni nyin mtshan medang / /nyin zhag gnyis dang ⑦gsum dang bzhir/ /gal te rgyu na nyi ma phyogs/ /ri bo lo drug rig byed 'chi/ /zhag lnga de bzhin zhag bcu dang / /nyin zhag bco lnga'i bar du ni/ /gal te rgyu na go rims ⑧bzhin/ /lo gsum gnyis dang gcig gis 'chi/ /de bzhin nyi shu nyi shu lnga/ /gal te rlung ni rgyu gyur na/ /go rims ⑨bzhin du zla drug dang / /zla ba gsum gyis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gal te nyi shu drug bdun brgyad/ /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa dgu rgyu/ /zla ba gnyis gcig zla phyed dang / /zhag bcus rim gyis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gal te nyin zhag sum 14—1276

cu dang / /sum cu gcig dang sum cu gnyis/ /de tshe go rims ①ji bzhin du/ /nyin zhag khrugasum dang gnyis nas 'chi/ /nyin zhag sum cu rtsa gsum bar/ /gal te nyi mar rlung rgyu na/ /nyin zhag de nyid la 'chi bar/ /khyab 'jug yin yang the tshom med/ /nyin zhag lnga nas nyi shu lngar/ /bar bar gyi ni nyin zhag la//grangs ni bcu drug ma bshad par/ /dor ba de rnams brjod par bya/ /zhag gsum rgyu na lo gsum nas/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir dor bas so/ /nyin bdun rgyu bas lo gsum nas/ /sngar bshad nyis 'gyur dbri bas so/ /gal te zhag brgyad bar rgyu na/ /gnyis dang zhag ni bcu gnyis dbri/ /zhag dgu rgyu na lo gsum las/ /nyin zhag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dor/ /rlung ni nyi ma'i spyod yul du/ /gal te zhag ni bcu gcig rgyu/ /lo gnyis nyin zhag nyi shu bzhis/ /ma tshang ba na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhag ni bcu gnyis lo gnyis las/ /snga ma nyis 'gyur gyes chung bas/ /zhag ni bcu gsum lo gnyis las/ zla gnyis zhag ni bcu gnyis dbri/ /zhag ni bcu gnyis lo gnyis las/ /zla gsum zhag ni drug gis dbri—/ /nyin zhag bcu drug rgyu na ni/ /lo gcig zhag ni bcu gnyis dbri/ /rlung ni nyi ma'i spyod yul du/ /nyin zhag bcu bdun rgyu gyur na/ /lo gcig zhag ni nyi shu bzhis/ /ma tshang ba ni 'chi bar ①'gyur/ /zhag bco brgyad kyi dhilo gcig ni/ /zla ba gcig drug dor bas so/ /bcu dgu rgyu na lo gcig las//bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad phri ⑤bas so/ /nyi shu gcig zla drug las ni/ /zhag drug ⑥ma tshang ba yis so/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis zla drug las/ /zhag bcu gnyis ni dor bas so / /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa gsum rgyu/ /bco brgyad rnam par dor bas so/ /zhag ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi rgyu/ /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa bzhis so/ /nyin zhag sum cu 14—1277

gsum de bzhin/ /'chi ba'i mtshan nyid 'byung ba yin/ /rlung 'byung dbang las shes bya ba/ /de yan chad ni yod ma yin/ /'dir bshad pa/ dang po nyi ma phyed byas nyi ma rangs pa yang ni nyin mtshan dag gi bar du rgyu/ /de las zhag gnyis dang ni zhag gsum 'on te zhag bzhi khyab pa'i bar du ni/ /nyi ma la ni g.yon pa min la rlung ni rngubs la sdebarten te gang zhig rgyu gyur naske/ /de las gnas dang nyi ma phyogs dang bkra shis drug dang bzhi ni 'di shes bya/ /lnga lalas nyi shu rtsa lnga dunyin zhag lnga lngas 'dzegs par 'gyur las ⑤ji bzhin 'phel/ /de las re re bskyed pa'i chu ni sum 'gyur byas pa gsum gyis lhag pa kho na'i bar/ /rgyas pa'i dus su de la lo ni gsum mig zla ba rjodrug gsum zung dang zla ba ru/ /lhag ma tshes dang phyogs dang zla ba yon tan zung dang zla bar 'tsho ba yin/ /'khor lo rim ⑦gsum bris nas ni/ /re mig sum cu rtsa gsum bcas/ /tshe dang srog gi rlung dag dang / /nyin zhag mtshan ma rim bzhin bri/ /de ltar bdag gis nang gi 'chi ba'i mtshan ma ni/ /ming gzhan 'chi ltas zhes bya 'dir ⑧ni bshad pa yin—/ /de rnams shes par byas la mod la myur du ni/ /bsam gtan sogs kyis ⑨'chi ba bslu ⑩nyid 'bad de bya/ /slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas sbyar ba'i 'chi ba bslu ba bstan pa las le'u gnyis pa'o// //phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can/ /'chi ltas tshogs ni shes byas las⑪/ /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid la'ang / /bslu ⑫ba'i bsdus pa shes par bya/ /lus dang ngag gi las kyi phyir/ /bsam gtan las kyis nang gi yin/ /nor bu sngags sman phyi yi ste/ /rnal 'byor nus pas nang yin no/ /'chi bdag bslu ⑫14—1278

ba 'bad pa ni/ /dad pa yis ①ni byed par nus/ /de bas dad pa brtan par bya/ /gzhan du ngal ba don med 'gyur/ /dad dang bral ba lha yis kyang //lus kyis sdesdug bsngal sna tshogs dang / /nor gyi phung po rnams kyis kyang / /chos ni phra mo thob mi 'gyur/ /dad pa mchog tu phra ba'i chos/ /dka' thub sbyin sreg ye shes la/ /dad pa mtho ris thar pa yin/ /'gro ba 'di kun dad pa yin/ /gal te nor srog thams cad kyang / /de bzhin dad pa med las min—/ /de bas 'bras bu cung zad kyang / /dad pa med na thob mi 'gyur/ /'chi bdag bslu ⑦bar 'dod pa yisarjo/ /dang por dad pa mchog gzhol bya/ /chos kyis ⑤'chi las skyob byed cing / /'chi ba bslu pyab yin par bshad/ /chos min dga' zhing bag med pas/ /skad cig kyang ni gnas mi bya/ /tshangs pa yang ni chos min par/ /'chi bdag bslu ⑦dbang ma yin/ /dam pa rnams kyi chos ni bden/ /sbyin dang dka' thub bzod la dga'/ /gang la mchog tu brtse yod de/ /chos gzhan mang pos ci zhig bya/ /gang zhig rtag tu sems can la/ /snying rjes snying ni 'dzag gyur pa⑧/ /ye shes thar pa de yin gyi/ /chos gzhan mang pos ci zhig bya/ /mi tshe chos kyi mchog yin par/ /grub pa'i mtha' ni kun las 'dod/ /rtag tu de nyid la babe+ebs na/ /'chi bdag rim gyis ⑨thag bsrings ⑩yin/ /bya dang nya dang ri dgas sbrul/ /rkun po ⑪gsad pa'i phyogs gtogs rnams/ /srog skyabs pa yi ⑫'phral du ni/ /tshe thung ba yang tshe ring 'gyur/ /rkun ma nya dang ri dgas sbrul/ /bya sogs srog ni 'dod pa rnams/ /'di dag bsad na 'phral du ni/ /tshe ring ba yang tshe thung 'gyur—/ /mi dge bcu ni spangs pa dang / /de bzhin gsum la skyabs 'gro 14—1279

dang / /bslab pa lnga dang brgyad bsrungs na/ /'chi bdag thag ni bsrings par 'gyur/ /btson rar bcug dang ①nad chen gdungs/ /de bzhin 'jigs pas nyen pa rnams/ /bskyab ②byas na ni nges pa ru/ /tshe ring 'chi bdag slu byed 'gyur/ /dman dang mgon med ngo tshar bcas/ /tshul khrims ldan la gus par ni/ /'dod pa'i don ni rab ster bas/ /tshe ni nges par 'phel bar ske'agyur/ /pha dang ma dang bla ma rgan/ /shes pas rgan sogs la gus shing / /mchod dang bkur ④ste byin nas kyang / /'chi ba dag ni nyer mi 'gyur—/ /rang gi 'dod lha de la gus/ /dka' thub can la gus pa yis/ /rtag tu nang par lha dad phyag /byas pas tshe ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /mchod rten gas dang 'jig pa la⑤/ /so phag la sogs kyis bcos na/ /tshe thung tshe ni ring 'gyur la/ /dge slong bsod snyoms pa dang mtshungs/ /lha khang sku gzugs mchod rten sogs/ /byed dang kun dga' ra ba 'dzugs/ /mchod rten che brgyad mchod sogs kyis/ /rtag tu tshe ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /'dun pas slong ba la rnyed pa/ /rdzas kyis rjodage 'dun mchod ston ⑦gsol/ /zhag bdun tshe ring tshe thob 'gyur/ /chos rgyal mya ngan med dang mtshungs/ /bye ma'i mchod rten byed pa dang / /de bzhin tsha tsha 'debs pa dang / /mchod rten la sogs phyag byas pas⑧/ /tshe ni nges par 'phel bar 'gyur/ /'dus pa chen po'i mdo dang ni/ /a ta na ti ya ka'i mdo/ /phra mor bcas dang sprin chen dang / /shin tu bkra shis tshigs ⑨bcad rnams/ /gus pas dge slong 'don 'jug pa'am/ /rang nyid kyis ni rab bton na/ /de bzhin tshe ring 'thob 'gyur zhing / /'chi bdag bslu ⑩bar 'gyur ba yin/ /theg pa chen po ston 14—1280

byed dang / /sdong pos ①brgyan sogs mdo sde rnams/ /rtag tu rtse gcig pas bklags na/ /'chi bdag bslu ①bar 'gyur ba yin/ /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs rnal 'byor gyi/ /rgyud sogs ma lus bklags pa 'am/ /bsrung ba lnga yi cho gas kyang / /'chi bdag bslu ④bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gtsug tor btsugs pa'i mchod rten sogs/ /bskor ba dag ni byas pa dang / /gzungs ni bzlas par byas pas kyang / /'chi bdag gi ni brtson pa 'joms/ /de yi cho ga sngon 'gro bas/ /gza' rjosogs ma mo bklags pa dang / /gzungs sngags stong du zlos pa dang / /dkon mchog sgron ⑤ma bzlas pa dang / /gzungs kyi tshogs las gsungs pa yi/ /gzungs zlos pa la brtson pa yi/ /mkhas pa rnams ni 'chi ba dang / /nyi ma'ang rjoring du gnas par byed/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri dang sbyin sreg dang / /phyag rgya 'ching bar byed pa dang / /gtor ma dang ni tshogs 'khor lo/ /rab sbyin 'chi bdag slu ⑦ba yin/ /phyogs bzhi'i dze+e'aphags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /mchod ston mal cha tshogs sbyin dang / /chos gos tsam zhig ⑨'chang ba la⑩/ /sbyin pa 'chi bdag slu ⑪byed 'gyur—/ /de la sogs te bya ba rtsom/ /chos dang bsod nams mtshan nyid 'gyur—/ /bsod nams kyis ni tshe 'phel zhing / /de bzhin 'chi bdag bslu ⑫ba yin/ /de ltar chos ni cung zad cig⑫ /ston gyi de yi rgyas pa ni/ /rang nyid kyis ni rjes dpag pa'am/ /'chi bdag bslu ④mkhas de las bslabasag/de ltar chos la brtson byas nas/ /grub pa'i sngags dang sman sogs ni/ /'phral du yid ches byed pa yis⑫/ /'chi bdag rnam par bsal bar bya /nor bu sngags dang sman grub dang / /bcud len stobs kyis rang nyid ni/ /14—1281

'chi bdag pha rol gnon mthong ste/ /rig 'dzin grub pa ji bzhin no/ /rin chen brtag pa'i bstan bcos gang / /rtog la mkhas pas rdo rje 'chang / /tshe yi nor bu 'chang ba'ang rung / /de bzhin sna tshogs nor bu 'chang / /in+d+ra nī la rin chen sogs/ /nor bu chen po gzhan dag kyang / /'chang bar byed pas ①'chi bdag kun/ /bzlog par 'gyur ba sdethe tshom med/ /gang phyir nor bu'i ④mthu las ni/ /som nyi byed par rigs min te/ /nor bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /mthu dang ldan par thams cad 'dod/ /dbe+en pa'i gnas su ras ris sogs/ /mdun du mchod pa byas nas ni/ /sngags rnams bzlas pa tsam gyis kyang / /'chi ba bslu rjob 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dang por yi ge ā ⑤brjod la/ /de nas ro loka rjoces gsal ba/ /rig 'dzin sde snod las gsungs te/ /'di ni khams gsum rgyal zhes bya/ /sngags 'dis 'jig rten dbang phyug la/ /dad pas de mdun nges par ni/ /yi ge'i grangs kyis 'bum bzlas na/ /'chi ba bslu ⑦ba thob par 'gyur/ /dang po rnam par snang mdzad '-ibarjod—/ /de 'og tā re lan gsum ⑨brjod/ /tut+tha re gnyis tu re gnyis/ /swā hā'i mtha' can ⑩'chi ba bslu⑪/ /sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsungs/ /sngags ni yi ge'i 'bum pa ⑫ru/ /sgrol ma'i spyan sngar bzlas nas ni/ /zho dang sbrang rtsi las sngar btags/ / drur ba'i ⑫myu gu shar dang ni/ /byang du rtse bstan sbyin sreg ⑩bya/ /sngon gyi las mtha' ⑫las byung ba'i/ /'chi ba nges par zlog ⑩par byed/ /slob dpon la ni yon phul nas/ /oṃ yig de las ru ru ste/ /de nas sru ru'i tshig gi rjes⑩/ /dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirta dang / /lo tsa na zhes bya tshig gsum/ /sar+pārbaspyosā dha ni/ swā hā'i ⑩sngags a sho ka 'dab mar/ /14—1282

gtsang mar tsan+dan chu yis ni/ /'bum mam ①bye bar bris nas kyang / /dag cing dad pa'i cho ga yis/ /chu med 'o mas bkru ba 'am/ /drur ba la sogs sbyin sreg byas/ /'chi ba bslu ②ba ma lus pa/ /nges pa kho nar byed pa yin/ /nad kyi tshogs ni ma lus pa/ /zhi bar byed pa'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sdecho ga bshad/ /'phags pa yi ge brgya zhes bya/ /sngags kyi mthu ni bsam mi khyab/ /mthu ni rnam pa du ma mthong / /bzang spyod yi dam bcas pa yi/ /cho ga yis ni 'bum bzlas na/ /thar pa'ang nges par skyed byed na/ /'chi ba bslu rjob smos ci dgos// //na maḥste ya dhī ⑤kā ṭ+wāṃ/ /de nas ta thā ga tā māṃ/ /sarba tā pra ti ha ta/ /ba ba ta rjodharma ta'i tshig /ba li māṃ zhes ⑦tshig gi mthar/ /de nas a sa ma sa ma—/ /⑧man+ta to a nan+da⑨/ /ta ba bā ti 'og shes ni/ /ha ra ha ra sma ra sma ra⑩// ṇa ra ⑪bi ga ta rā ga /de nas budha dharma te/ /sa ra gnyis ma ⑩ma ba la /ha sa gnyis dang tra ya gnyis/ /ga ga na ma hā ba ra/ /la k+ṣa ṇi de bzhin dz+wa la/ /dz+wa la na sā ⑫ga re'i mthar/ /swā hā'i tshig ni sbyar bya ba/ /gsang sngags yig brgyar 'gyur ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po yin par rab tu bshad/ /'phags pa so sor 'brang ma'i sngags/ /'bum phrag gcig ni legs bzlas la/ / drur ba'i ④sbyin sreg bcu chas ni/ /'chi bdag nges par bslu ⑫ba yin/ /oṃ smras bi ma le dza ya/ /ba re a mṛ te hūṃ hūṃ/ /phaṭa gnyis de nas swā hā yi/ /tshig ni mtha' ru brjod par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad bha ra gnyis/ /saṃ bha ra gnyis brjod ⑫bya la/ /ibyu ⑩ya ba la yi sgra/ /bi sho rnya ni zhes brjod do/ /hūṃ hūṃ ru ru tsa le dang / /swā hā sngags 'dis ⑫14—1283

'chi bdag bslu①/ /'phags pa so sor 'brang ma yi/ /snying po dngos grub kun spyod yin/ /'jig rten dbang phyug spyan snga ru/ /'chi ba las rgyal zhes bya ba'i/ /gsang sngags yi ge bcu pa ni/ /'bum phrag bcu bzlas de 'og tu/ /me tog dkar po mar btags pa'i/ /sbyin sreg grangs ni 'bum bya'o/ /sngags mthus khrude 'og nges par ni/ /'chi bdag bslu ①ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /thog mar oṃ ste de nas saṃ/ /de 'og oṃ saṃ rjozhes bya ba/ /oṃ mṛ kyu dza ya de nas//oṃ 'di sngags 'di yi ge bcu/ /bskal pa sogs su 'tsho ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gang gsungs pa/ /de yis tshe ni bsrings ba 'grub/ /de bsrings 'chi ba bslu ⑤ba yin/ /sngags gang zhi ba'i las byed pa/ /de yis tshe 'phal 'gyur ba nirjo/ /de ni 'chi ba bslu ⑦bar 'gyur/ /sngags rnams kyi ni mthu la yang / /the tshom bya bar rigs ma yin/ /gang phyir sngags kyi mthu dag ni/ /bsam mi khyab par kun nas 'dod/ /'jig rten na ni dngos gzhan gang / /sngags kyis mi 'grub de yod min/ /yang dag dad dang mngon brtson las/ /sngags rnams yid bzhin nor bur mtshungs/ /rtogs pa las bshad cho ga 'am/ /ci 'dod pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /bkres shas che ba'i sa phyogs su/ /sle tres ⑧rab tu spyod ⑨par bya/ /gcig pu'am yang na gzhan pa yis⑩ / /sman dang lhan cig rtag tu spyad/ /de nas lus — brtan 'gyur la//gshin rje'i sgo ni mthong mi 'gyur/ /grub pa'i sman ni gzhan dag kyang / /nges par bsten ⑪par gyur ba yis/ /tshe 'phel nad dang rgas pa ni/ /zad pas 'chi ba ma mthong ngo / /dngul dang gser sogs ldan pa cha / /dngul chu cho ga bzhin zos na/ /bcud kyis len gyi ⑫rang bzhin can/ /'chi ba bslu ⑩14—1284

ba 'byung ba yin/ /tshes gcig zla ba'i phyogs sogs par/ /rang gi khams ni thob pa na/ /sna sman gtang ba'i ①cho ga yis/ /'chi ba bslu ②ba 'byung bar 'gyur—/ /kha sbyor la sogs rgyud las gsungs/ /mi 'chi lnga dang ldan pa ni/ /man ngag ji bzhin bsten skepa yis/ /'chi ba bslu dub 'byung bar 'gyur/ /steng dang 'og dang kha sbyar sbyor ba ni/ /gang zhig phan pa'i rnal 'byor dag tu byedaske/ /de la gshin rje'i rgyal po rtag tu ni/ /khros par gyur kyang ci'ang byed mi nus/ /la lar thabs kyis 'chi ba yang / /slar 'tsho bar yang 'gyur ba mthong / /lus ldan bu mo mi dang ni/ /phan ⑤tshun bsrubs las 'gyur ba mthong rjo/ /khrag dang lus zungs bsres ⑦pa ni/ /khams ni shin tu drangs ⑧min pas/ /gang zhig 'phral du 'chi nyid la/ /thigs pa gnyis ni gtig par bya—/ /mar bskus pa yi sbu gu las/ /de ni blud pas gzhug par bya/ /bdag nyid sna khung las byung ba'i/ /sna khung rim gyis bgre gyur ba/ /slar yang 'tsho bar 'gyur mthong ste/ /'dir ni 'gag par bsngags pa yin/ /nus mthu mngon du mthong bas na/ /sbyor ba 'di ni mang por bsngags/ /'bras bu gsum ni spyir bsdus pa'am/ / po so z-iṅga ra ⑨dzar bcas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ⑩rtag spyad na/ /phan zhing bdud rtsir 'gyur ba yis⑪/ /gnyer ma skra dkar rnams dang bral/ /rdo rje lus ni gzugs bzang ldan/ /bskal pa yi ni grangs snyed ⑫du/ /'chi ba nges par bzlog pa yin/ /dri chu rnam pa mang zhig ni/ /lus la bsrung ba ⑫grub pa 'dis/ /bza' ⑫dang bsku bas 'phral du ni/ /'chi ba bzlog par 'gyur ba yin/ /'di dag sbrang rtsi mar ldan pas/ /rtag tu goms par byas na ni/ / dus dang dus min las byung ba'i/ /⑫'chi 14—1285

ba zlog ①par byed pa yin/ /sman rnams kyi ni mthu la yang / /som nyi bya bar rigs min te/ /gang phyir sman gyi nus pa ni/ /bsam mi khyab par kun tu snang / /de ltar phyi yi bya bas gus byas pas/ /ji bzhin stobs kyis 'dir ni 'chi bdag bslu⑧/ /'chi ba stobs ldan 'jigs pa cher dogs la/ /de ltar de yi nang gi bya ba yin/ /slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas sbyar ba'i ①'chi ba bslu 0ba bstan pa las ⑤le'u rjogasum pa'o// //da ni 'chi ba bslu ⑦ba la/ /mkhas pa nang gi bdag nyid can/ /gang gis brtson pas 'chi ba ni/ /nges par bslu ⑧ba bshad par bya/ /rgyal po rkun po bdud chen po/ /stag la sogs pa'i 'jigs dang bral/ /'du 'dzi dang bral ri bo sogs/ /yid 'ong la lar gnas par bya/ /tshad tsam za zhing smra nyung la/ /shin tu 'chag ⑨par dga' ma yin/ /gnyid chung bsam gtan la mang gnas/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa la rab brtson/ /rang gi 'dod lha mchod ⑩ sogs dang / /dam chos bklag ⑪pa'i bya ba dang / /gtor ma sbyin sogs byams pa nga / /sems la sogs pa dus gsum brtson/ /bsod nams kyis ni 'dod pa 'grub/ /de bas 'du 'dzi spang bar bya/ /dad pas thams cad yang dag 'grub/ /de phyir dad pa rnam 'phel bya/ /brtson 'grus kyis ⑫ni brtsams pa 'grub/ /de bas brtson 'grus sngon 'gro bya/ /bsam gtan gyis 'dod 'bras brtan pas/ /bsam gtan la sems gcig tu 'bad/ /'du 'dzi spangs pas nyams len 'gyur/ /de bas 'du 'dzi rnam spang bya/ /yang dag shes ldan thams cad 'grub/ /de bas shes dang kun ldan bya/ /'chi ba 14—1286

las ni sdug bsngal mthong / /'tsho ba las ni chos 'gyur mthong / /som nyi ma lus dang bral bas①/ /'chi ba bslu ②ba kun du ①spyod/ /de la dang por bsam gtan bcas/ /bgegs dgra'i gsang sngags 'bum nyid ni/ /legs bzlas sbyin sreg khri byas pas/ /bgegs ni thams cad bzlog par bya/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya/ /de nas bārtsit+ta'i tshig /badz+ra r+ṇa na mo badz+radhi/ /kredha ⑤ya zhes tshig brjod la/ /ma hā rdasbyoṅka ṭa'i rjorjes/ /rnyi ra ba ya a si brjod/ /mu sa la pa ra shu pa⑦/ /kṛ nyi ta hasta ⑧ya yin/ /oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa ⑨li/ /kha kha khā nyi khā hi'i tshig /tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha tshig de nas/ /brnya gnyis dang ha na gnyis/ /da ha gnyis dang gardza gnyis/ /de nas bi spo ⑩ṭa gnyis te⑪/ /sarba badz+ra tshig dang ni/ /bispyo ⑫bi nā ya kān brjod/ /ma hā ga ṇa ba ti'i tshig /⑫dzi bi tān+ta ka ra ⑫ya/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā yi/ /sngags 'di bgegs rnams zlog byed yin/ /yang na 'di yi snying po yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad zlog spyo par byed⑩/ /sngon bzhin bzla dang sbyin sreg gis/ /'di yi mthu yang de 'dra yin—/ /oṃ sngar hu lu hu lu dang / /de 'og tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha'i tshig /ha na gnyis dang da ha gnyis/ /gardza gardza de 'og tu/ /bi spo ⑩ṭa ya lan gnyis brjod/ /sarba bismyo bi nā ⑫ya kā na⑪/ /oṃ a mṛ ⑩ta hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ma ma rak+ṣa ⑫ku ru swā hā/ de ltar bdud dang bgegs rnams ni/ /ma lus rnam bsal 'khrug med pas/ /ji ltar mngon 'dod rnal 'byor ni/ /gcig cig nyin mtshan bsgom par bya/ /stug po bkod pa'i gnas bzhugs te/ /zhi bas sangs rgyas mdzad pa mdzad/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan stengs su⑫/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyar ldan/ /'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 14—1287

'phro ba/ /rnam snang dkar po bsgoms na ni/ /'khor ba srid du 'chir 'os min—/ /mi bskyod la sogs de bzhin gshegs/ /rang mdog phyag rgya cha lugs ldan/ /nga rgyal brtan pas bsgoms na ni/ /rdo rje'i lus su nges par 'gyur—/ /nyi zla kha sbyar nang na bzhugs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug ①mi 'jigs pa/ /zhi zhing zla ba dang 'dra la/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis yang dag brgyan—/ /'od dpag med ni sku mdog dmar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rab 'chang / /rdo rje skyil krung bcas pa yi/ /zhabs kyi pad+ma gnyis kyi steng / /phyag gnyis dag ni mi sde'achol bar/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgyar legs gnas pa/ /sems can kun don rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /sku las thugs rje'i rgyun 'dzag pas/ /bsams la ①de yi thugs kar ni/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gzhan de bzhin/ /slar yang de yi thugs ka ru/ /de bzhin rtse gcig yid kyis ni/ /ji srid grangs ni bye bar 'gyur/ /ji srid bsam gtan 'di 'dra rjobya/ /de nas phra zhing rab phra'i mtha'i/ /'jig rten dbang phyug la gtad ⑤sems/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis bsams na/ /'chi bdag rang nyid 'chi bar 'gyur/ /phung po las skyes nad gzhan yang / /rang nyid 'jig par gyur pa yin/ /pad+ma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan stengs surjo/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /mchog sbyin pa dang ut+pal bsnams/ /ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs 'dra ba'i/ /zla ba la ni rgyab brten pa/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras/ /mchog spyin sku ni 'chang ba'i yum/ /'phags ma sgol ma'i snying gar bsgoms/ /de yi 'khor lo'i 'od zer dkar/ /rtsibs 14—1288

brgyad la ni yi ge ni/ /brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba la/ /lte bar oṃ dang ha'i yi ge/ /dbus nas bsgrub bya'i ming dang ldan/ /zla drug brtan cing nges pas ni/ /rtse gcig pa yi sems kyis bsgom/ /yi ge bcu pa'i sngags 'di ni/ /skyo bar ma gyur sems kyis bzla/ dang por oṃ ni bzhag ①nas su/ /de 'og tā re rab tu sbyar/ /de 'og tuja re tu re/ /swā hā'i mtha' can las kun byed/ /tshangs dbang khyab 'jug nyi zla dang / /drag po phyogs skyong 'dod lhas kyang / /spu rtse tsam yang ma nyams par/ /'chi bdag lta bur 'chi las rgyal/ /skra dkar gnyer ma ngan pa ②dang / /nad dang dbul ba kun zad byed/ /seng ge la sogs 'jigs chen brgyad/ /sdug bsngal tshogs ni 'jig par byed/ /ma bslangs par ni zas skom sogs/ /kha zas gos la sogs pa rnyed/ /ral gri mig sman rkang byug pa/ /bum bzang sogs dang dngos grub rnams/ /snyan dngags smra mkhas nyid kyi blo/ /shes rab gcig pu dri ma med/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub gzhan dag kyang / /'khor lo 'di nas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /spyan dang skul sdebyed mā ma tī/ /lha mo dkar mo chen mo ni/ /rang mdog cha lugs phyag rgya yis/ /bsgoms na 'chi bas mi tshugs so/ /rang gi 'dod lha'i rnal 'byor nyid/ /nga rgyal brtan pa dang ldan pa/ /yid bzhin nor ltar ma lus pa'i—/ /'dod pa'i don ni rab sgrub byed/ /dung dang kun+da ④zla ba 'dra/ /bsdu ba'i rim gyis yang dag gnas/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bslabs ⑤na des/ /'chi ba bslu dubar 'gyur ba yin/ /'khor lo bde mchog rgyud las gsungs/ /te ru ka yi rnam par bsgom/ /byas nas de yongs gyur pa las/ /ka pā la yi rnam par bsgom/ /ka ka la yi gzugs bsams pa'am/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ⑦gar ni rnam 14—1289

par bsgom/ /gsad ①par 'os pa ma yin phyir/ /'chi ba 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /spyi bo ru ni zla ba'i gzugs/ /bdud rtsi thigs pa 'dzags ②pa yis—/ /ba spu'i bu ga kun nas ni/ /yan lag thams cad tshim par byed/ /'du 'dzi thams cad rnam spangs pasti/ /rnal 'byor pa yis zla drug bsgom/ /nad kun las ni rnam rgyal nas/ /'chi bdag lta bur 'chi las rgyal/ /mgo bo pad+mo 'dab ma stong / /dkar po'i kha ni thur du bltas/ / zla ba'i rim dubasams bskal sogs par/ /'chi ba 'jig ⑤par byed pa yin/ /de nyid nag po'i gzugs nyid padu/ /nag po'i gzugs kyi 'od rnams kyis⑦/ /kun du ⑧khyab par bsams na ni/ /skra dkar la sogs 'jig ⑨par byed/ /lce ni rkan la gzhar bya zhing / /so ni so la ma reg par/ /rgyu yi nus pa bsam mi khyab—/ /dad pas byas pa 'di brtsam bya/ /sgog ma'i bu ga'i steng dang sbyar/ /lce chung thur du bstan ⑩nas ni/ /lce yi rtse mor kun reg par/ /bdud rtsi'i ro ni myong bar byed/ /des ni 'phral du 'chi ba sel/ /skra dkar la sogs pa yang 'jig /de byas nas ni rgud pa dang / /'jigs pa kun las bsrung 'gyur ba/ /dbugs dbyung ⑪rngub pa dran pa yang / /rnam pa gzhan pa brtsam par bya/ /grangs 'phel de las nges pa ni/ /rga dang 'chi ba med par 'gro/ /sems can rnams kyi nyin mtshan du/ /dbugs ni nyi khri chig ⑫stong dang / /drug brgya dag gis lhag par rgyu⑫/ /grangs ni yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /gang phyir bdud rtsi sngags yin pas/ /rlung ni 'jug pa sngags yin te/ /bdud rtsi gson pa'i thabs yin pas④/ /de yis 'chi bas mi tshugs so/ /'jug pa'i rlung ni bgrang bya zhing / / rim gyis ⑫'bum sogs grangs kyis ni/ /14—1290

rtse gcig sems kyis cho ga bzhin/ /sgra med pa yi bzlas par bshad/ /sgra med bzlas pa 'bum du ni/ /cho ga bzhin du rdzogs gyur ①na/ /mi ni tshe nyams gyur pa yang / /lo lnga'i bar du 'tsho bar nges/ /nyes 'bum la sogs zlos pa nyid/ /tshe 'phel bar ni bsgre bar bya/ /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang / /rlung gi bzlas la brtson par bya/ /nang par langs nas stong phrag gcig /rtag tu legs par bgrangs nas ni/ /nad kun las ni rnam gol zhing / /nyi zla gnas kyi ②bar du 'tsho/ /bslab dze+el mi gnas mi dga' zhing / /yud tsam yang ni gnyid ma log /'bad de gnyid las rgyal byas la/ /bza' dang btung yang kha zas sogs/ /lus dusu 'byung ba rgyu byas pas/ /rlung rgyu ba la brtson par bya/ /lugs mthun la 'bad rnal 'byor pa/ /nges par 'chi ba las rgyal 'gyur/ /rmongs la longs spyod la gcig gzhol/ /lugs mi mthun pas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rang gi ngo bo lugs mthun 'gyur/ /de las bzlog pas lugs mi mthun/ /seng ge rnam rol phyag rgya ni/ /bcings pa yis ni rlung dag gnyid/ /yang na dgag par sbyor bas rgyal/ /dgag pa'i ⑤'chi ba slu byed yin/ /rkang mthil gyi ni mthar thug par/ /rlung gis rjorim kyis dgang bar bya/ /dgag pa kusbra ka zhes bya/ /de shes rim pa brjod bya ste/ /steng gi dgag pa'i sbyor bas ni/ /dgag par byed pa rgyal bar 'gyur/ /chung dang 'bring sogs dbye ba yis/ /steng dgag rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /steng dgag ces ⑦ni bya ba 'di/ /'og nas bshad pas don ston byed/ /chung ba tshad ni sum cu drug /'bring ni de bzhin nyis 'gyur yin/ /chen po sum ⑧'gyur yin zhes bya/ /dgag pas de ⑨ni rgyal bar 'gyur/ /dgag pa yis ni 14—1291

tshad byas la/ /phyi nang rang gi pus lha ngar/ /'dir ni lag pa nyug byas la/ /de nas se gol drug gdab po/ /mdo ①ni mkhas pas yongs 'chad pa'i/ /dus kyi tshad ni yin par bshad/ /ji srid sum cu drug tshad 'gyur/ /de srid dgag pa'i bya ba yin/ /steng dgag 'di ni dman pa ste/ /de nas bar ma nyis 'gyur nyid/ /steng dgag chen po sum 'gyur te/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni tshad yin no/ /'chi ba slu ②bar 'dod pa yis/ /'bad pas de nyid las rgyal bya/ /steng dgag chen po'i mtshan nyid ni/ /ji srid dag ①pa rab 'jigs pa'o/ /rgyun du dgag par 'gyur ba rjoyang / /de tshe legs par gnas pa yin/ /nyi ma de las 'chi sogs nyid/ /dgag pa la ni gang gnas pa/ /de tshe bskal pa stong du yang / /'chi bdag nye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha' ba ni bzhos pa las—/ /bdud rtsi gsher rjob dag gi tshogs/ /bum pas mtshan pas chu zhes bya'i—/ /dkyil 'khor las ni 'od zer 'phrosarjo/ /sna rtser byung ba'i rlung gis ni—/ /blangs ⑦pa yang yang brtag par bya/ /snying gar sgepad+mar thim pa yis/ /sems kyi bung ba'i phru gu gso/ /nam mkha' bzho ba'i bsam gtan dag /'di ni rtag tu spyad par bya/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'chi bdag gi /mthong bas mthong ba ma yin no/ /yang na rlung ni yongs spangs la/ /de bzhin nyid la rtag tu spyad/ /de bzhin nyid kyi 'chi dang 'dud⑨/ /dgra rnams gzhan la rgyal byed nyid/ /nyes pa ma lus rab tu zhi/ /yon tan ma lus 'byung bar 'gyur—/ /skyes bu de nyid kyis rgyal zhing / /mngon par 'dod pa rnams kyang 'grub—/ /de bzhin nyid ni stong nyid bshad/ /rnam pa kun mchog bdag nyid can/ /de kho na nyid ⑩rtag bslabs na/ /'chi ba bslu ⑪bar 'gyur ba 14—1292

yin—/ /chos dang longs spyod sku sogs dang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs dbyer med/ /dmigs pa kun gyi sbyor ba ni/ /dmigs pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /rnam pa kun mchog ldan pa yi/ /stong pa rgyal ba rnams kyis ①gsungs| /bsam bya bsam par mi bya zhing / /bsam pa min pa'ang mi bsam mo/ /bsam dang bsam min ma bsams na/ /de nas stong nyid thob par 'gyur/ /mkhas pas ⑦dngos po mi bsam zhing / /dngos po med pa'ang ①mi bsams rjol/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs⑤/ /sgom pa de ni bsgom dudang bral/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /stong nyid 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa'i/ /stong pa nyid ni rtag bsgoms na/ /'chi bdag gis ni mthong mi 'gyur—/ /kun rtog tsam las byung ba yi/ /'chi ba de yang mthong mi 'gyur/ /gzhan yang bdud ni mang po dang / /'khor ba yang ni mi mthong ngo / /de yang /'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog 'di/ /dngos po kun la yod min te/ /so so'i skye bo'i rnam 'phrul gyi/ /rnam par rtog pas bcom pa yin/ /rnam rtogs sdug bsngal thams cad de/ /rnam par rtog pa bdud ces bshad/ /de bas rnam par rtog gzhom cing / /rnam par mi rtog nyid du bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gus pa la sogs khyad par gyis/ /rgyun ⑦du bsgoms pa gang gang yin/ /de dang de ni gsal 'gyur te/ /'dod dang mya ngan blo dang mtshungs/ /bstan bcos rnams ni rnyed sla yi/ /de yi sbyor ba rnyed par dka'/ /sbyor ba shes pa'i 'jig rten las/ /sbyor ba rnyed par dka' ma yin/ /sbyor ba rnams la mkhas shing dang / /bzod dang brtson 'grus la rab gnas/ /bsgrub la brtson pa'i shes rab can/ /'chi ba bslu ⑧ba'i snod yin no/ /ngal ⑨dang 14—1293

smin dang btung sogs kyis①/ /pho ba'i me ni 'bar 'gyur la/ /me ni rab tu 'bar ba'i ②zas/ /yongs zhu bar yang nus pa yin/ /yongs su zhu bas lus rgyas shing / /rgyas pas stobs ni rnam par 'phel/ /stobs las tshe — 'phel 'gyur zhing / /de 'phel ba yis ring du 'tsho/ /kun gyis ④mngon sum nyid du 'grub| /'di la som nyi ji ltar yod/ /de bzhin man ngag gis bskal sogs—/ /'tsho bar yang ni the tshom med/ /mar dang snying po zad sogs kyis//mar me la sogs 'jig phyogs la/ /slar yang 'bru mar la sogs las/ /bskal pa'i bar du gnas pa yin/ /de bzhin du ni lus 'di yang / /rgas sogs kyis ni 'chi bzhin pa/ /grub pa'i man ngag legs rnyed na/ /bskal ba'i mthar yang cis mi gnas/ /dper na khang rjopa rnying pa dag /bcos pa yis ⑤ni yun rings gnas/ /de bzhin rnying pa'i lus dag kyang / /bcos pas gnas par cis mi 'gyur/ /'bad pas dka' ba ci yang med/ /de bas gces la stsol rjob dor mi bya/ /rtag tu 'bab na chu ⑦rgyun 'jam pos kyang / /dus su rdo leb dag kyang rnam par 'bigs/ /gtsubs ⑧na shing las me ni 'byung 'gyur zhing / /brkos par gyur na sa las chu 'byung 'gyur/ /mis ni rtsol ba byas na mi 'grub med/ /'bad pas rigs pas brtsams kun 'bras bcas 'gyur/ /'di na 'chi ba bslu ⑨ba rnams/ /shin tu mang po shes nas kyang / /nyams ma blangs na mal du ni/ /bshang bas gos te khyod 'chi 'gyur/ /gang zhig sbyor ba la mkhas shing / /bstan bcos la byang mkhas pa rnams/ /nyams ma blangs pa'i nyes pa yis⑩/ /so ni ston cing 'chi ba yin/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni bstan bcos dang / /sbyor ba du ma shes na yang / /deng ngam sang 14—1294

ni bya'o zhes/ /de ltar sems ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'di bya nang par slar yang 'di①/ /de nas gzhan yang 'di bya zhes/ /srid pa g.yo ba'i rang bzhin ma shes don med yid rton ②tshol bar byed/ /skye dgu 'chi bdag khar ni chu srin kha ru gru ni zhugs pa ltar/ /bya ba mthar ma phyin par ①yul gyi chu yi dba' klong dag tu lhung / /de ltar 'chi bdag dgra bo ni/ /slu duba'i thabs ni bshad pa yin—/ /rang gzhan gzhung las 'grub pa yi/ /bsam gtan las ni rab bsgrub bya/ /brtse med 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las/ /thar pa'i thabs ni 'bad de bya/ /gang phyir 'di ni rjoyid 'ong ba/ /srog las gzhan pa yod ma yin/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro gdan bzhi dang / /sangs rgyas bla gab la sogs dang rjo/ /dus kyi phyi ma dus ⑦phreng ba/ /dus kyi lnga bcu pa dang ni/ /'tsho ba lnga bcu pa la sogs/ /bstan bcos 'bad de brtags nas ni/ /'chi bdag rnam par bslu ba 'di/ /'gro la rjes su brtse bas bshad/ /nam mkha' yongs dag ston ka'i zla 'dra bar/ /dag cing nam mkha'i las kyang mi shong ba'i/ /dge ba 'di las mi 'chi gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro ba 'chi bdag las thar shog /nyon mongs yi ge pa rnams ni/ /brtsi ba yis ni ngal gyur na/ /gzhung 'di'i tshad du gyur pa ni/ /sum brgya drug cu tham pa'o/ /slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa'i 'chi ba bslu ⑧ba bstan pa las le'u bzhi pa'o// //ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa 'chi ba bslu ⑨ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so—/ / //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / lo tsā ⑩ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //14—1295
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (578)14wa 1300

ras /sma lam brtag pa/①༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ swabhā ②u hā nakhru/ bod skad du/ rmi lam brtag pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rmi lam sna tshogs las byung ba/ /de yi brtag pa bshad par bya/ /dang po'i thun la rmi lam byung / /lo gcig nang du 'bras bu 'byin/ /thun gnyis zla ba brgyad bar rjol/ /thun gsum zla ba gsum gyi bar/ / thun bzhi zla ba phyed bar ⑤du/ /mthong bar 'gyur ba 0the tshom med/ /skya rengs ⑦shar ba'i dus nyid la/ /zhag bcu'i nang du 'bras bu 'byin/ /de rjes rab tu bshad bya ba/ /nyon cig dge dang mi dge'i las/ /bzhon pa ba lang dang ni glang chen zhon pa dang / /khang bzangs ri rtse dang ni nags kyi ljon shing dang / /gru nang 'dug ste pi wang 'dzin par byed pa dang / /kha zas za zhing du byed rtag par dngos po 'thob/ /mtshon chas rdeg dang srog chags phra mos lus khebs dang / /de bzhin lus kyi ljan ljin rnam par dag pa 14—1301

dang / /bshang ba'i rjes su 'jug dang lus las ①khrag 'dzag dang / /rmi lam rnams na bgrod min la zhugs shis pa'o/ /rgyal po glang chen rta mchog dang / /'gron bu glang dang ba rnams dang / /gang gis gnyid kyi mtha' mar mthong /de yi nye du mang por 'gyur/ /shing ljon 'o ma 'bras bu can/ /gang gis gcig pu ②de la 'dzegs/ /de la 'dug nas gnyid sad na/ /myur du nor ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /gang gis khang ①bzangs 'dug nas zos/ /de bzhin rgya mtsho brgal ba'i mi/ /dman pa'i rigs su skyes kyang ni/ /de ni rgyal por 'gyur bar 'ong / /gang zhig rdzing bu'i dkyil du ni/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma chen po'i nang / /zho dang 'o thug za byed pa/ /sa bdag 'thob par the tshom med/ /mar me rgyal mtshan shing rta gdugs/ /bu mo shing lo 'bras bu zan/ /gnyid 4 kyi mtha' mar gang gis mthong / /bla na med pa'i dpal thob 'gyur/ /mi dag gi ni sha rnams ni/ /btsos sam ma btsos gang yang rung / /rmi lam du ni gang gis zos/ /nyon cig dude yi yon tan gang / /rkang pa zos na lnga brgya ste//lag pa zos na stong phrag gcig /stong phrag brgya 'am rgyal mesrid ni/ /mgo bo zos na thob par 'gyur/ /gang gi ⑦rgyu mas grong dang ni/ /yang na grong khyer dkris pa ni/ /grong gcig dkris na rgyal phran thob/ /grong khyer dkris na rgyal po thob④/ /lham gnyis dang ni gdugs dang ni/ /ral gri rnon po dri med dag /thob nas gang zhig gnyid sad na/ /de ni lam du bgrod par bshad—/ /gang zhig gru la zhon nas ni/ /zhig pa yin yang yang dag sgrol/ /de yi lam bgrod shes par bya/ /de yang myur du ldog ⑨par nges/ /gang gi sa rnams rnam par 'chag /rab tu g.yo ba'i rmi lam ni/ /de yi nor ni brlag 14—1302

par ①'ong / /yang na lus la na tsha 'byung / /gang la rnam par gnod byed pa'i—/ /rwa can rnams dang mche ba can/ /spre'u 'am yang na phag pa byung / /de la rje bo'i 'jigs pa 'byung / /gang la til mar mngon par byug① /'o ma'ang yang na mar gyis bskus/ /de dang 'dra ba gang yang rung / /de ni nad du rnam par bshad/ /shing rta bong bu rnga mor ldan/ /gang zhig gcig pus de la 'dzegs/ /de stengs 'dug nas gnyid sad na/ /myur du 'chi ba thob par 'gyur—/ /bud med gos dmar 'dzin pa dang / /phreng ba byug pa ①dmar po can—/ /gang la 'khyud byed rmi lam byung / /de yis mtshan mo phyi ma med/ /bud med gos dkar gon pa dang / /rjes su byug dhiphreng dkar por ldan/ /rmi lam du ni gang la 'khyud/ /de yis rjodapal ni thams cad 'byung / /nag po'i gos can bud med ni/ /phreng ba byug pa nag por ldan/ /gang la 'khyud byed rmi lam byung / /de yis rjodapal ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /ser po'i gos can bud med gang / /ser po'i phreng dang byug pa can/ /rmi lam du ni gang la 'khyud—/ /de yis rgyal srid thob par 'gyur/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rmi lam du—/ /yang na zla ba gang gis mthong / /nad can nad las grol ba dang / /nad med yin na dpal ldan 'gyur/ /gang zhig dkar po'i sbrul gyis ni/ /lag pa g.yas pa bzung ba na/ /gang la yang dag bcu yi bar/ /de yis nor ni thob par nges/ /rgod ma khyim bya kra da / /thob nas gang gi gnyid sad na/ /de yis de dus snying sdug 'thob/ /chung ma nye du ⑧smra ba can/ /gang gis bzung nas bcings pa dang / /yang na lag pa zhags pas btab/ /de las bu ni thob par 'gyur/ /yang na gnas pa chen por 'gyur/ /bram zer phyugs 14—1303

dang ①glang chen lha/ /gzhan dag nag po shin tu ngan④/ /thod pa ras bal thal ba rus/ /gzhan rnams dkar po mngon par dga'/ /rta bla ④mo dang lto 'phye dang / /chu gnas srog chags bzung ba ni/ /rnam par rgyal ba'am dngos po 'thob/ /yang na bu thob rnam par bshad/ /gang zhig khrag gi btung ba 'thungs—/ /yang na chang ni rab tu 'thungasarjo/ /bram ze yin na rig pa thob/ /de las gzhan ni nor thob 'gyur/ /gal te rmi lam 'o ma 'am ba yi ⑤'o ma bzhos nas 'thungs/ /de yis 'o ma'i btung ba thob/ /yang na sbyin sreg byed par 'gyur/ /zho mthong bas ni bde skyid 'byung / /grong mthong nor dang ldan par 'gyur/ /nas kyi sbyin sreg shes par bya/ /yungs kar kyis ni thob par 'gyur—/ /me tog ldan na me tog shes/ /'bras bu ldan na blo ༷med blo/ /me 'bar du ba can mthong na/ /me 'bar ba ni 'jigs par bshad/ /stan dang mal stan bzhon pa dang / /lus po shing rta khrim rnams ⑦ni/ /me 'bar 'dug tshe gnyid sad na/ /de yis de yi dpal rnams 'phel/ /rtags la mngon par mchod mthong na/ /de yis bsam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /bye brag tu ni sku mthong na/ /de yis ⑧lugs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /lha rnams bram ze can rnams dang / /pha dang rtags can bud med rnams/ /rmi lam du ni mchog gang smras⑨/ /de ni de ltar rnam par bshad/ /gang la lha nyid gar byed dang / /⑫ gzhogs stegs rgyug par byed pa rnams/ /de rnams yul bgod rnam par bshad—/ /tsan+dan dmar po'i shing dag la/ /mar gyis byugs la sbyin sreg bya/ /ga ya tri ni stong phrag bzlas/ /de yis zhi ba thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni ngag dbang dgongs pa ste/ /gang gis nang par klog pa de'i/ /rmi lam ngan pa 14—1304

zlog par 'gyur/ /rmi lam brtag ①pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta bi bhū ti tsan+d+ras rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o—/ / //bsdur mchan/13༷1 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag /mi lam brtag pa bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉skusna/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rna/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉gethun bzhi zla ba phyed bar/ 0〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉thar/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉'ang /1302 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pus/ ②〈〈pe 〉skab/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉gnyis/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gcig du〈〈co 〉〉rgyu/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stonas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉po'o/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉zlog1303 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉torabyug ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉byung ba/ ④〈〈co 〉〉phyug rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉yi/ du〈〈snar 〉stan/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉posan gi ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dus/13༷4 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ze rta phyugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉du ngam/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉pa/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉thungs/⑤〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉tonas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉smra/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉〉smra 'am rab tu deg pa dang / /1305 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ngan pa bzlogabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (579)14wa 1305

༄ga /pad+ma dra ba 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs/①༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pad+ma dzā lor+bha ba sā dha ni/ bod skad du/pad+ma dra ba 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul rnams/ /sku gsum rnams kyis rnam par gnas/ /stong nyid snying rje'i rang bzhin can/ /pad+ma spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal/ /lha nyid rnam pa du ma ni/ /de ④nyid spangs pa min pa gang / /thugs rjes mchog tu chags gyur pa/ /'jig rten mgon ni ④rgyal bar byed/ /chos bdag med pa dam pa'i dngos/ /rmad byung mthar gnas pa gang ④de/ /du ma'i dkyil 'khor pa gang nyid/ /thugs rje chen po rnam par 'jog /phun sum tshogs pa kun gyi rgyu/ /pad+ma dra ba dpal la brten/ /ji ltar bla mas nyer bstan pa/ /de yi sgrub thabs rim par brjod/ /ye shes shes rab thabs rang bzhin/ /sgrub thabs sems la kun phan pa/ /tshig don 14byed1306

phal cher rnam gsal ①ba/ /bdag dang blo ②mnyam rnams la phan/ /dang po re zhig yang dag pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas sems can gdon pa la kun du dmigs te pelam sngon du bya'o/ /'jig rten 'di thams cad nyid bdag gis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bton rjonas sangs rgyas nyid la nges par sbyar ba dang / sangs rgyas nyid thob pa'i rgyur sngags kyi theg pa chen po theg pa thams cad kyi ⑤mchog bla ma'i drin kyis nye bar bstan pa las yang dag par rtogs te/thos pa dang / bsam pa dang bsgom pa'i rim pas ji ltar rig pa dukun du spyod pa la rab tu 'jug pa brtsam par bya'o/ /sngags kyi tshul chen po nyid gang las byang chub sems dpa' rnams thams cad kyi byang chub thob bo/ /gang gsungs pa/sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas lam gsum yang dag byung / /yang dag gsang sngags rab bsgoms pas/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag thob/ /ces so/ /de'i phyir sngags kyi tshul brjod pa bsgoms ⑦pa'i stobs las dus yun mi ring ba kho nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par byas na⑧/ bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang ⑨thob par byed do/ /de la/byams dang snying rje mnyam par sbyor ⑩las yid ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub las⑪/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi shin tu zab pa'i tshul du'ang lhag par mos par ldan/ /sbyin pa tshul khrims la sogs kun rdzogs srid pa'i longs spyod las phyir phyogs/ /sems la sdug bsngal dang ni dub pa med par lha nyid mnyes par byed/ /chu dang /cod pan dang / rdo rje dang / bdag po dang / ming dang / gsang ba dang / shes rab ye shes dang / brtul zhugs dang / dbugs dbyung ba la sogs pa ⑫dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dang ldan pa/ tshogs par sbyor ba bla ma'i 14—1307

drin gyis byin zhing rjes su gnang ba/ gnyug ma'i gsang sngags dngos su byas pa'i bsod nams ①dang rjes su mthun pa'i sa 'dzin la sogs par ⑧gang yang rung bar bde ba'i stan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis ①'dug ste/ bdag dang rnal 'byor srung rjoba'i don du/ rje btsun bgegs mthar byed yud tsam gyis dran par bya'o/ /oṃ a mṛ ta ha na ha na sarba bispyo da ha da ha sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ de nas rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum rnam par sbyangs nas/ byams pa la sogs pa bsgoms rjopa sngon du 'gro bas rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la byāḥ'i rjoyi ge bsams nas nam mkha'i mthil du rdo rje til gyi gang bu bzhin du bar mtshams med par rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang de dang tha mi dad pa'i bla ma rnams kyi sku dang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang yongs su gang bar kun tu dmigs nas tweḥ'i ⑦yi ge de las gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya rdo rje'i lha mo dang phyi rol gyi rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i me tog la sogs pa thams cad kyis mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros nas yang dag par mchod nas bdag nyid de rnams kyi mdun du 'dug ste gus pa dang dul ba'i sems kyis thal mo sbyar ba byas te/ pus mo'i lha nga btsugs nas phyag 'tshal bar blta'o/ /'di ltar sngar brjod gzugs sogs dang / /de bzhin rin chen sogs phung pos/ /mchod pa rnam par brtag byas nas/ /sngags pas de rnams 'bad pas mchod/ /de ltar de rnams mdun 'dug nas/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar byas te/ /sdig pa la sogs mi dmigs pas/ /bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /bdag gi sdig kun bshags par bgyi/ /dge la mchog dgas rjes yi rang / /ji srid 'gro gnas gang don du/ /bcom ldan dam 14—1308

chos rin chen dang / /dkon mchog gsum la mngon par skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub yid la bzung zhing de yi lam/ /yang dag bsten zhing dge ba'i gter rnams ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub ched du yang dag bsten/ /de bzhin dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs so/ /zhes pa la sogs thams cad bklags ①nas so / /de nas sems can thams cad la lha nyid kyi bde ba nye bar bsgrub ②pa'i byams pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas de rnams kho na la sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba'i rnam pa snying rje dang / de nas de rnams kho na la bde ba dang mi 'bral ba'i rnam pa dga' ba dang / de nas de rnams kho na la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba thams cad nye bar sdud ④pa'i rnam par rjobatang snyoms so/ /de nas gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba stong pa/ de'i rnam pa'i ye shes nang gi skye ba med pa'o/ /de bzhin kho nar khams gsum pa'i mthar thug pa las zlog pa'i sems can med pa'i phyir mtshan ma med pa'i ye shes tsam mo /rnam par rtog pa med cing sems pa med pas gang la yang smon pa med pa gang yin pa de las rgyu ba dang bcas pa dang / rgyu ba med pa'i dngos po ma lus pa la smon pa med pa'o/ /de ltar rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo'i rang bzhin rang gi sems la rang gi so sor rig pas bltas nas slob dpon kyis 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gsang sngags kyi don la lhag par mos pas byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā rjob shurtaḥsarba dharmā ཿswa bhā ⑥ba shusgopho⑦haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā ba shu n+ya sarba ⑧dharmāḥswa bhā ba shu zlolha⑨haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kolhahaṃ⑩/ stong nyid ro gcig ma sbyar bas/ /byang chub mchog tu mi 'gyur ba⑪/ /de phyir rang yid rtag tu ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid bya//14—1309

nam zhig sangs rgyas kyi ni zhing / /rnam par ma dag sangs rgyas med/ /de nas ①dang por zhing dag phyir/ /rang sems nyi ma bsgom par bya/ /de la gzi brjid phung po'i gzugs/ /rang gi sems rgo blta bar bya/ /hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ /skyes pa'i rdo rje phra mo rnams so/ /de rnams kyi ⑧'og dang steng gi phyogs bzhir rdo rje'i ra ba dang gur bsam par bya'o/ /de phyir thog ma dbus mtha' grol/ /de snedang zad pa spangs pa yi/ /ye shes rtsa la gnas pa'i chos/ /thams cad dag pa'i go 'phang gnas/ /'di ltar ji skad bshad ye shes/ /rdzogs pa yongs su 'jug pa ni/ /chos 'byung phyag rgya gru gsum pa/ /dkar po steng du gnas bsam bya/ /sna tshogs chu skyes rdo rje'i dbus gnas pa/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug pa yi gzugs can no/ /de nas rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /a yig yongs gyur zla ba de la de'i/ /steng du zla bar paṃ yig ser po ni/ /yongs su gyur pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma'o/ /de yi ze 'brur zla ba la hūṃ thuyig las skyes pa'i 'khor lo/ de yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang gi ngo bo ye shes kyi mchod rten khang pa brtsegs pa blta bar bya'o/ /ji ltar/gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis brgyan pa dang / /dra ba dra phyed me tog phreng / /me long la sogs pas brgyan pa/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa yi / /chos kyi dbyings las skyes pa'i phyir/ /nyer spyod lnga yis brgyan pa'o⑥//'gro ba ma lus pa shin tu rnam ⑦dbyer med par brjod pa'i phyir/ /der gyur pa'i nyes pas rjes su gos pa med pa'i phyir sdong bu gcig la rim pa gsum 'dab ma sum cu rtsa drug pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan nye bar mdzes pa'i lha'i gnas sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i kun du gdung ba zhi bar byed pa'i phyir 14—1310

dang dge ba'i rtsa ba nye bar bsags pa'i phyir dang / thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin nyid kyi phyir/ 'dab ma so sor zla ba'i gdan la rjes su son pa ma rig pa'i mun pa rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir dang / mi dge ba'i 'dab ma ①skems pa'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi myu gu smin par byed pa'i phyir dang ④/shes rab kyi rang bzhin can nyid kyi phyir sgo dang zur du nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o—/ /thugs rjes brlan pa nyid kyi phyir dang bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su sdogs pa nyid kyi phyir bum pa gang ba rnams kyis yongs su brgyan pa'o/ /ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyis rin po che lnga'i rang bzhin no/ /de bzhin du rang gi sems de rnam par dag par ④gyur pa/ khang pa brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin khang pa ru/ /de la dbus su zla ba'i gdan la ni/ /bcu drug nyis 'gyur gyi ni dbyangs rnams kyi / /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan rmis tshogs pa yi/ /nus pas rdzogs par byed par blta rjobar bya/ /lugs su 'byung ⑤dang lugs las bzlog pa yi/ /phreng ba gnyis su nges par gnas pa yis/ /dag pa zla ba shel gyi rnam pa yis/ /rnam par 'phro ba'i 'od zer phreng rnams kyis/ /de nas ka la sogs pa'i sum cu bzhi—/ /de rnams ḍa bhā ༷da dha ya la dang bcas pa rnams 'bad pa chung ba dang ldan pa nyid kyi phyir rab tu bcug nas bzhi bcur bya'o/ /de rnams kho na nyis 'gyur du bya ste/ dpe byad brgyad cu po rnams so/ /de rnams las skyes pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ sku yi byin rlabs la grub ⑦pa//de ni gang las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ḍa bye da dha la ya bdag /bcug nas nyis ske'agyur ka sogs bya/ /de las kyang zla bsam byas nas/ /dpe byad sgrub par byed pa'o/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin phyir/ /snying rje'i rtsa ba las 14—1311

byung drags①/ /de'i phyir kun gzhi rnam par shes pa dang / nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dang 'jug pa'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pa/ me long dang mnyam pa nyid dang / so sor rtog pa dang / bya ba rjes su sgrub pa dang /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings te/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin tweḥ'i shuyi ge'i sa bon yongs su gyur pa las rang ①nyid dpal pad+ma spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug thub pa'i mchog rdul phra rab kyi lus tshad med pa dang / bsdus pa'i dudangos po dang skad cig dang dga' ba bzhi rnam par dag pa yang dag par gsal ⑦bar byed pa'i zhal bzhi par blta bar bya'o/ /'gro ba tshim par byed pa po nyid kyi phyir rtsa ba'i zhal dang lus gang ba'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ g.yas pa dang rgyab dang g.yon pa'i zhal sngon po dang dmar po dang ljang gu'o/ /sngags dang bdag dang lha'i de nyid gsum gsal bar byed pa po nyid kyi phyir spyan gsum rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi tshul gyi phyir phyag brgyad do/ /stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen po dag mnyam pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dngos po'i rjophyir dang shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid dam pa'i sku gsal bar byed pa po nyid kyi phyir rnam pa gnyis sgron mas kun du snang mes ⑦byed pa ltar rang snang gi rig ma gos dkar mo g.yon gyi pang du phyag gis 'khyud de 'dzin pa'o/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las tshugrol ba'i phyir dang / ting nge 'dzin rnam par 'chad pa yang dag par bsrung ba'i phyir skyil krung phyed pa'o/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po lnga rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin kyi phyir dang / me long la sogs pa'i ye shes lnga rnam par dag pa'i phyir g.yas pa'i phyag dang por gnas pa'i rtse mo lnga pa'i rdo rjes g.yon gyi phyag dang por gnas pa'i pad+ma 'byed bzhin pa'o/ /ji ltar pad+ma dmar po ni/ /14—1312

gnas kyi nyes pas mi gos pa/ /de bzhin grub pa'i rnal 'byor ldan/ /gnas nyes sna tshogs kyis kyang ngo / /de phyir pad+ma zhes brngod do/ /gdul dka' ba 'gags ①par byed pa'i phyir pad+ma'i lcags kyu gdengs pa'o/ /gdul bya ma yin pa 'ching bar byed pa nyid kyi phyir pad+ma'i zhags pas mtshan pa'i ②phyag go/ /don dam pa las chos thams cad bdag med pa'o zhes gsal bar byed pa'i phyir ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa phyag tu'o/ /skye mched drug la sogs pa'i lus 'jog pa spangs pa'i phyir ro/ /mgo bo la sogs pa rkang pa'i mthar thug pa'i rnam par dpyad pa las/ /stong pa nyid ⑦ro gcig cing dbye ba med pa'i mgo bo'orjo/ /g.yo ba med pa'i dngos po'i phyir dag pa'i shel dang dung dang kun+da dang zla ba ltar dkar ba'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa dam pa'i chos ⑤kyi phyir phyag tu rin po che'o/ /spros pa med pa'i shes rab kyi bdag nyid dang bcas pa nyid kyis lha mo'i nu ma la reg cing dga' ba'o/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis gzir ba'i 'gro ba la so sor rtog pa'i mchog nyid kyi phyir 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can no/ /bcud len yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang ye shes kyi zla ba'i cha'i myu gu can kyi ral pa'i tshogs kyis brgyan pa de kho na nyid kyi cha shas bsdus par bcas rjopa rnam par 'joms pa po ma yin pa nyid kyi phyir pad+ma dkar pos dbu la mtshan pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ sems can rjes su 'dzin pa yidze+e/ /thugs rjes rjes chags yang dag byung / /yang dag rdzogs pa'i dge chos kyis/ /nyon mongs thams cad nges 'dul byed/ /kun gyis brgyan pa'i gzugs rnams kyis/ /zhi dang sgeg pa 'chang ba po/ /shes rab thabs bdag dam pa'i sku/ /mtshan mor byed pa mchog 'bar byed/ /ces pa ⑧dang / gzhan yang / bcom ldan 'das 14—1313

ma'ang thams cad du/ /bcom ldan 'das mtshungs bsam par bya'o/ /①zhes so—/ /yang na phyag gnyis pad+ma dmar po rnam par rgyas par byed bzhin pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ sna tshogs sprul pa'i rnam g.yeng gis/ /ma lus 'gro don bya de mchog /bcom ldan 'das gzugs bdag nyid ni/ /bsams nas bsgom par ①brtsam par bya/ /zhes ①de lta bu ni dang po sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rang gi don sgrub byed do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /gzhan gyi don du so sor bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su 'gro ba mtha' dag la thugs rjes bstan nas/ snying gar ye shes sems dpa' twerjoḥyig gi sa bon las 'od zer kun tu spros nas phyogs bcur gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag nyid rnams bkug nas rab tu bcug nas bsam par bya'o/ /de rnams kyang mthar de'i gzugs kyi ⑤rnam pa yongs su gyur pas 'gro ba rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rab tu phyung nas 'di ltar rjogazugs kyi rnam pa ⑦yongs su gyur nas sngar brjod pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams la ka yig la sogs pa'i sa bon dang mtshan ma rnams su gnas pa bsam par bya'o/ /de bzhin du/ sangs rgyas tshogs rnams bkug nas ni/ /rang gi sa bon nang gzhug bya/ /slar yang yid kyis phyung nas ni/ /gnyug ma'i sa bon rim ji bzhin/ /'di yi dgod pa'i rim pa ni/ /dang po'i 'dab ma brgyad kyi rim pa la/ /shar du pad+ma spyan ma lha mo bsgom pa blo ldan pa⑧//lho ru rin chen pad+ma zhes/ /nub tu pad+ma rdo rje can/ /de bzhin g.yon du pad+ma ⑨sgrol ma/ /me ru pad+ma gos ma ste/ /pad+ma 'bar ba ⑩bden bral du/ /pad+ma 14—1314

sngon mo'i khro gnyer can/ /rlung gi zur du yang dag gnas/ /pad+ma rtse mo dbang ldan du'o/ /drug gnyis 'dab ma'i rim pa'i ①lha mo rnams so/ /de rnams ming ni rim par bshad pa ni/ /pad+ma skar mda' pad+ma sgyu ma dang / /de bzhin pad+ma 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma/ /pad+ma ldan pa ④pad+ma mtshungs ma dang / /de bzhin pad+ma gtum po'i dbang phyug ma/ /pad+ma gsang ma pad+ma chen mo ③dang / /pad+ma zla ba phyi mar bshad pa'o/ /pad+ma snang ma pad+ma gau rī ༷ma/ /pad+ma mdzod ma dang ni bcu gnyis ⑤so/ /de nas gsum pa 'dab ma bcu drug pa de la lha mo rnams rim pa ji lta ba bzhin te/ pad+ma dbang phyug pad+ma'i gdong ma dang / /pad+ma gtum mar rab tu grags pa dang / /pad+ma rig pa mchog ma'i mchog rjodang ni—/ /slar yang pad+ma rgya mtsho ma dang ni/ /pad+ma snang byed ma zhes rab brjod ma⑦/ /de bzhin pad+ma yid bzhin nor bu dang / /pad+ma 'dod ma pad+ma 'gro ma dang / /⑧nga/d+ma nag mo pad+ma bde ma dang / /bcu bzhi ma ni pad+ma can ⑨ma ste/ /gzhan yang pad+ma sngon ma'i gter ma dang / /pad+ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma ni mdzes/ /zhes pa rim pa gsum pa'i lha mo rnams/ /'di ni kun+da zla ba ba mo ⑩dang / / ga pur ⑪gang ba lta bur yan lag gsal/ /dga' ba'i tshogs rnams rnam rgyal ⑫dgod pa dang / /mkhur ba'i ri mo cung zad dkar dmar te/ /rnam bkra spyod ma sgeg pa rgyun chags par/ /gar sdud glu yis rten la rab tu 'jug /ut+pal rnam par rgyal ba'i ⑫rdzi mas mtshan/ /spyan gsum kun nas mdzes pa'i zhal gcig pa/ /thod pa'i phreng ba mthil du 'byar bye ba/ /rnam rgyas ge sar dam pa'i 'dab bkra ba/ /mtsho ⑫las skyes pa rnam par kha bye ba/ /dag pa mgo la cod pan du 'chang ba/ /bsnyems bcas gyen du drang ⑫por bgreng ba'i 14—1315

lus—/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la cung zad gzigs par bcas/ /g.yas min la dang g.yas pa'i phyag gnas pa/ /thod pa'i do shal ①'od dang rnam sgeg pa/ /phyag gi rtse mor rnam bkra'i zhags pas rol/ /phyag gzhan du ni drag po'i lcags kyus brel—/ /dga' ba dga' bcas mi dal gar byed do/ /khor yug kun du nyams dang bcas pa skedrag /ces pa bskyod pa'i nyams kyis 'khor lo bcings pas gar bya'o/ /①de bzhin du glu rgo rjoblang bar bya ste/ ji ltar/ oṃ de bzhin gshegs kun la sogs rnam pa sna tshogs mchog gis rjogazugs 'chang ba/rnam pa sna tshogs rnam bkra sems can 'dul ba mchog tu grub pa mchog /sems can dag pa pad+mo rjomachog gi ⑦dga' ba blta bar gyis/ /a la la la ho/pad+ma spyan ras gzigs pa yi ni dbang phyug thar pa'i dga' ba'o/ /oṃ sangs rgyas spyod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod/ tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug chen po khyod/ /zla ba nyi ma khyod/ a la la la ho/ pad+ma dzā wa ⑧shrīḥzhes glu blang / be+er yang pra kṛ stita'i skad kyis glu len pa/ /rnam pa mang po 'dul ba'i rnam pa yi ni gnas/ /rab las ⑩gar gyis sdud pa'i sangs rgyas gar dbang phyug /tshogs ni rnam sad yid ni rnam par rmongs pa'i gar/ /gar gyi ⑪gar kyis ma 'dres gru 'di blar ⑫gsang bcas/ /zhes pra kṛ ⑫ta'i glu yis gru len par byed do/ /phyi rol du pi wang ma la sogs pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu pad+ma pheg rdob kyi rol mos bcom ldan 'das la yang dag par bstod cing pheg rdob rjod ⑫par byed do⑫/ /oṃ pad+ma pad+ma s+thā⑩ཿ oṃ pad+ma pad+ma shrīḥ.oṃ pad+ma pad+ma dhi⑩/ oṃ pad+ma pad+ma trī/ oṃ pad+ma pad+ma sh+lau/ oṃ pad+ma pad+ma hūṃbā/oṃ pad+ma pad+ma ṭ+wāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma pad+ma shrī/ zhes pas ⑪pad+ma 'dab ma byabargyad pa'i snying 14—1316

por gar byed do/ /'di ltar gsal byed sum cu rtsa drug gi rang bzhin gyi lha mo rnams bsam mo/ /ci ltar mthar gnas la sogs pa'i rab tu ①dbye ba las ra yig spangs pa rjes su sna ldan la sogs pa dang bcas pa rjes su sna ldan la sogs pa dbyangs thung ngu ni thabs so/ /ring po ni shes rab kyi rang bzhin no/ /de'i phyir rnal 'byor mtha' yas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spro bar byed pa'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'dren pa dbus kyi ze 'bru la blta bar bya'o/ /de la 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa rnam par dag pa pad+ma brgyad pa'i nang gi rim pa'o/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa gnyis pa'o—/ /stong pa nyid bcu drug rnam par dag pa gsum pa'i ②zhes khong du chud nas de'i rjes su dīḥyig las khams gsum pa khyab pa'i 'od zer gyi tshogs spros nas—/ chos ston pa la sogs pa mtha' yas pa'i thabs rnams kyis sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la so sor bkod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams bkug nas de'i sa bon nang du bcug nas ④dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsrung ba'i ched du khro bo'i gzugs kyis dbyung bar bya'o/ /de la/ ma dad phung po 'jig lta dang / /shes bya'i sgrib pa zad pa dang / /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po ni/ /shar sgor pad+ma lcags kyu'o/ /kha dog dkar po chen po'i sku—/ /rab spyos khro bos kun tu 'khrugs/ /sngon po dmar por snang ba'i zhal//spyan gsum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can te/ /lcags kyu tho ba 'khor lo dang / /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ sdogs mdzub rnams/ /'chang zhing nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /son cing rtag tu bzhugs pa'o/ /le lo nyon mongs pa yi bdud/ /mthar 'dzin lta ba mi mthun phyogs/ /rnam dag brtson 'grus yang dag byung / /14—1317

'bar ba'i gser kyis mtshungs pa ste/ / ge sar ①sngon po'i zhal la ni/ /spyan ni gsum po 'chang bar byed/ /dbyug pa zhags pa thod pa dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ sdogs mdzub nor bu'o/ /ma lus sangs rgyas rnams kyi tshogs/ /'dul ba'i don du yang dag gdengs①/ /nyi ma'i gdan ni kun du gnon/ /pad+ma zhags pa'ang lho phyogs su'o/ /'chi dang brjed ngas log lta dang / /chos kyi sgrib pa mi mthun phyogs/ /rnam dag dran pa yang dag byung / /pad+ma lcags sgrog dze+enyi ma'i 'od/ /dmar gnag dkar ba'i spyan gsum kyi④/ /dmar ser me yi 'od rnams kyis/ /gsal ba'i zhal gyis khros pa yi/ /'od kyis nam mkha' kun rtogs mepa/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams shing / /sdigs mdzub 'khor lo 'chang ba po/ /g.yas brkyang gnas su gnas pa'odhi/ /lcags sgrog pad+ma phyag gis bsnams⑦/ /nub kyi phyogs su kun song ste/ /nyi mar thugs rje'i gter bsam bya/ /rnam g.yeng lta ba mchog 'dzin dang / /lha yi bu bdud bya ba'i sgrib/ /rnam par g.yeng bas rab gtum 'od/ /dam pa'i ting nge 'dzin rang bzhin/ /ljang gnag dkar ba'i rnam pa yi⑧/ /zhal gyis kyang ni rnam par brgyan/ /bai ḍūr+ya 'od spyan gsum pa/ /pad+ma 'bebs pa pad chen po/ /rdo rje ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /sdigs mdzub snod kyis brgyan par bya⑨/ /de nas 'gro ba'i bya byas nas/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs zad skyes/ /de bsdus brtan par bltas nas rgo/ /byang gi sgo ru nyi ma la'o/ /khros pas stag gi pags pa'i gos//sbrul kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan can/ /thor cog lnga ni 'chang ba dang / /dgug dang gzhug dang ⑩'ching ba dang / /de bzhin du ni mnyes par byed/ /rnam par gzhom du med pa'i las/ /gzhan ni ⑪14—1318

khyad par las shes bya/ /zur ma ①rnams su mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /spyan gsum kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /gcigs pa'i zhal gyis 'jigs par byed/ /snod dang cang te'u kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /dril bu zhes pa 'chang zhing bstod—/ /sna tshogs chu skyes zla dbus gnas/ /de bzhin phyogs rim g.yas brkyang bcas/ /ro langs drag po'i sgra ldan ma/ /rdo rje mche ma stobs chen ma/ /yan lag thams cad bsdus ②pa'i rgyus/ /kun du 'khod cing rnam gnas pa/ /dkyil 'khor pa nyid bsam par byas①/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po la mngon phyogs / /de'i rjes su 'di rnams kyi sa bon gyi yi ge rnams ni/ oṃ t+t+waṃ rjohūṃ khaṃ hūṃ māṃ māṃ dzā t+t+waṃ hūṃ ⑤khaṃ hri hre hūṃ baṃ oṃ hūṃ rjo.oṃ ābyuhūṃ zhes pa phung po dang ⑦skye mched dang khams dang lus dang ngag dang yid rnams thams cad du ji ltar rigs par thams cad dgod par bya'o/ /gzhan yang gsungs pa⑧/ rbu hūṃ slo ⑨hri khaṃ māṃ māṃ spru t+t+waṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ kha ram̐ spyo rdzu k+ṣ-i ⑩ḍa saṃ khaṃ zhes pa de lta bu'i ⑪rang gi sa bon tsā re khaṃ hūṃ ⑫dang mtshan ma rang gi rten la brten ⑫pa'i sku'o/ /gzugs la sogs pa ni gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'o/ /sa la sogs pa ni spyan ma la sogs pa'o/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po lnga po ni rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams so/ /de bzhin du mig la sogs pa rnams su bcug pa'i sa'i snying po la sogs pa rnams kyang ngo / /legs brtan nyid kyi sems dpa' yis/ /dang por ⑫thar pas shes byar grags/ /zhes pa de ltar kun nas grub/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor bltas nas ni/ /snying ga'i ⑫ye shes sems 'od kyis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dgug par bya/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin du yongs su grags pa'o/ /14—1319

de nas snying ga'i ①sngags kyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bkug nas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor kyi 'khor lo la 'o ma la 'o ma bzhin gcig tu 'dres pa'i dngos pos rab tu zhugs par bsam par bya'o/ /shes rab dang thabs las byung ba bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis ④mchog tu ro myang ba dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mtha' dag blta bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes su mchod yon gyi snod du me tog dang tsan+dan la sogs pa sbyor bar bsams nas/ pad+ma lcags kyu la sogs pa'i khro bo rnams kyis ①dkyil 'khor ༷'khor lo la srung ⑤ba byas te mchod yon dang me tog dang tsan+dan la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod pa'i 0lha mo spros pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod nas dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas de rnams ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyis gang ba'i nor bu'i bum pas/ dkyil 'khor kyi bdag po dang dkyil 'khor la mngon par dbang bskur bar bsam spyopar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa ⑧ka sa ma ya shri ⑨ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du rnam par bsams nas mchod par bya ba dang /mchod pa po dang mchod pa'i bdag nyid sems tsam mo zhes rnam par bsams nas sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza ⑩badz+ra swa bhā ba byed kophohaṃ⑪—/ be+er yang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la sngar brjod pa'i rim pas mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su sgra brnyan bzhin du sgra'i tshogs mtha' dag nges par brtags ⑩nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha mo rnams 'chad bzhin pa'i bstod pa zhal nas brjod par bsams nas/ rdo rje chen po phyag 'tshad 'dud/ /bde ba 14—1320

chen po phyag 'tshal bstod①/ /dga' ba chen po phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phrin las chen po phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sgekhyod las rdo rje dang sems dpa'/ /khyod las pad+ma legs sprul pa/ /khyod las rin chen lha mo che/ /sna tshogs rdo rje de bzhin nyid/ /khyod las sangs rgyas dpa' bo che/ /yang dang yang du yang dag 'byung / /khyod las chos dang dge 'dun yang / /khyod las pha rol phyin pa'i tshogs—/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /khyod las gzugs kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /khyod las phyag rgya dang sngags kyang / /slar yang khro bo'i rgyal po'i tshogs/ / slar yang pra kṛ sneta'i skad kyis bstod pa/ /yon tan mchog thob shin tu dga'/ /bde ba chen po mchog tu gyurarjo/ /a la la ⑤hoḥ/mtha' dag bde chen de bzhin gshegs/ /mthong zhing nyams kyis rjoganas pa'o//bde ba chen po bsams pa las/ /de ring bde ba chen po yi/ /ro yis gang bar byed pa'o/ /a la la ⑦hoḥ/ mchog tu bde ba chen po ni/ /khyod la phan par rab tu byed/ /pad+ma'i gnas kyi nang du ni/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'di 'grub byed//ces ④bstod pa dang mchod pa byas la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams lha'i lus la rab tu zhugs par bsams nas de'i rjes su thog mar ya yig gis rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyebs can bsams nas de'i steng du ra yig gis me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba'i thod pa bsams nas bdud rtsi de hūṃ yig gis spar ba dang / āḥ⑫yig gis bsil bar 'gyur ba ⑩dang / oṃ yig gis bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du rnam par bsgoms nas lce la hūṃ yig gis rdzogs pa'i rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs par bsams la ⑪snying gar gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mtha' dag 14—1321

bdud rtsis tshim par bya'o/ /de nas twe①ཿyig de las 'od zer 'phros nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bkug ste gnyug ma'i snying ga'i nang du bsgom par bya'o/ /yongs su rdzog snepa bsgom pa'i don du rnam par dpyad pa brtsam par bya ste/gcig dang gcig min sogs brtags pas/ /phyi rol dngos po mi 'grub ste/ /de nyid phyir na de gzung dang / /rnam par shes pa'ang yod ma yin/ /des na 'di dag rang nyid tshul/ /rang la rag las gdan la khyab/ /ji bzhin yin dang ji bzhin min/ /'gro ba 'di dag rtogs par bya/ /'di de dam pa'i don can kyi/ /byang chub sems so 'di de ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i dngosaske/ /'di nyid mchog gi stong nyid kyi/ /ye shes de las de bzhin du/ /rnam dag gzugs nyid de yi gzugs/ /med pa nyid phyir de dbyer med/ /dge ba'i sems byung sems rang bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor pa kun shes par bya/ /zhes pa las rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin to④/ /de'i rjes su snying ga'i zla bar pad+ma phra mo la gnas pa'i byuḥyig thig le dang bcas pa yungs kar kyi 'bru'i tshad tsam gzi brjid kyi gzugs thams cad yang dag par bsdus nas rang gi nga rgyal gyis bsam par bya'o/ /de la rjosems brtan par byas nas dub pa skyes pa la sems de la nga rgyal dang bcas par byas nas yud tsam gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsam par bya'o/ /gzi brjid dang thig le las ⑤skyes pa'i 'od zer gyi phung pos lce dang mgo la ngag dang lus la sogs pa spros nas thig le la gzi brjid 'phrog par byed par bsams nas thig le tsam gyi rjong rgyal byus gnas par bya'o/ /slar yang gzi brjid 'phrog 14—1322

par ①byas nas rang gi lus las nges par snang bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du yang nas yang du 'phro ba dang sdud par ②byed pa nyid kyis thig le'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa ni rgyal ba dang / /mngon par shes pa dang grub pa rnyed do zhes pa man ngag go/ /yang na sna'i rtse mor rang gi lha'i mtshan ma phra mo de'i nang du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mtha' dag bsgom par bya'o/ /snying rje dang shes rab ma bral bar sgom ④par byed pa 'di ni phra mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya'o/ /ji srid brtan par gyur par blta bar bya ste/ brtan par gyur pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor spro ba dang sdud par rjobyed pa ni myur du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i dngos grub thob par byed do zhes pa dgod pa'i nus pa ji lta ba bzhin du gsungs pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa la/ /de'i nang du gnas bsam rjopa/ /dang por smig rgyu'i rnam pa ste/ /du ba'i rnam pa gnyis pa can/ /gsum pa mkha' snang dang mtshungs pa//bzhi pa sgron rjom lta bu ste/ /lnga pa rtag tu snang ba na⑦/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /de ltar rim par byas pa 'am/ /so so re rer nges med pa/ /srog ni spro zhing dbyung bar bya/ /de ltar mtshan ma lnga yis ni/ /sems ni brtan par gyur pa yi/ /'gro ba'i don ni rab bsgrub ④byed/ /rnal 'byor pa ni phul du rngubyung / /zhes pa thig le'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa bsgom pa'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa rang dang sngags dbyer mi phyed par byas pa las phan tshun ma 'khrug pa ⑩gsal ba myur ba ma yin pa thogs pa ma yin par gsang sngags gdon par bya ste/ da ltar oṃ yig la sogs pas khyab par bya'o/ /de la 'di ni sngags te ṭ+wāṃ ⑪hūṃ ā rmes kha su hā ma re shwa re ⑫ki 14—1323

lo barmā sa ba hri oṃ/ zo ①ni ṅgawaḥraṇ+ḍa pā paṃ oṃ zhes so/ /lha mo thams cad kho na yi④/ /ming dang sngags ni nges sbyar bya/ /oṃ yig dang por spel ba yis/ /phyi nas de la trī ①dgod bya/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro ma dag ④kyang / /hūṃ phaṭa yi ge yang dag ldan/ /khro bo rnams kyi ming oṃ dang / /hūṃ phaṭa yi ges brgyan pa'o/ /de bzhin dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrjornams/ /sa bon rim pa'i mthar thug dgod/ /lha mo'i hri baṃ rjoyang dag 'byung / /mkha' 'gro ma rnams hūṃ phaṭa 'byung / /phyi yis pad+ma'i ④pi wang sogs/ /sngar brjod cho gas dran par bya/ /de bzhin de rnams kho na'i tshogs/ /sngar brjod gsang sngags brjod par bya/ /de bzhin rim par bya ba ni/ /re re 'am 'khrul med ma yin par/ /'byung kyezhing spro ba'i bsam gtan dang / /sngags kyi mthar yang ⑨yang dag bsdu/ /rtsol ba'i rlung gis bkug nas ni/ /rang gi sa ⑩der nges par ⑪gzhag /byang chub rang sa bon der blo/ /bsam gtan bzlas pa'i go char ⑫gnas/ /zhes pa bzlas pa'i cho ga'o/ /bsam gtan nam bzlas pa byed pa gang gi tshe bying ba dang rgod pa'i sems la blta ⑫ba de'i tshe bying ba'i sems la lha mo'i glus bskul ba bzhin du 'khor lo mchod par bya ba dang bsgom pa brtsam par bya'o/ /rgod na thig le'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa sgom ⑫par byed pas dngos po rnams kyi gcig ⑩dang gcig min la sogs pa rnams ⑫dpyad par bsam/ de bzhin du bying ba'i sems la ni le lo dang rgod pa ⑩zhig nas zad do zhes pa zhum par nges par bzung ⑫ba las lha mo rnams kyi ⑪glus yang dag par bskul ba sa dang rgod pa la thig le'i rnal 'byor la sogs pas de kho na nyid bsgoms pas som ⑫dngos po rnams kyis rnam par dpyad 14—1324

pas stong pa nyid kun du dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du ①rnal 'byor pa'i sems yod pas chung ngu nas 'khor ba nyid blta bar bya'o/ /de'i tshe mgo bo las mtho gang tsam du ①a yig gis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i steng du bdud rtsi'i gzugs can gyi oṃ yig bsams nas snying ga ④dang mgo bo las sngags kyi 'od zer spros nas oṃ yig zla ba dang bcas pa de zhu bar bltas nas de'i bdud rtsis lus kyi nang bum pa bzhin du yongs su gang bar bsams nas—/ bdud rtsis nang dang phyi rol ba spu'i khung rnams su gang bas zil pa bzhin du gang bar bsams pas budub pa nye bar zhi bar bya'o/ /de ltar ngal ⑤sos pa dang skad cig gcig la bde ba'i tshogs ma 'khrugs rjopa'i thig le la sogs pa bsgoms pas sngar bzhin du gsang sngags ma 'khrugs pas ⑦bzlas par bya'o—/ /de nas bsgoms skepa dang bzlas pa dag gis dub par gyur na phyi rol gyi mchod pa'am cho gas yud tsam du ⑨stong pa nyid du bsgom par byas nas rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i lus kyis langs te phyi rol mchod pa'i dus su rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor dmigs te bris sku la sogs pa'i mdun na bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du dkyil 'khor byas nas bdag nyid la mchod de/ dkyil 'khor ba rang gi snying ga nas gzugs brnyan lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spros ⑫nas gsang ba dang phyi'i lha sprul pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas rang gi snying ga'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la mchod par bya'o/ /de nas zas kyi dus su yud tsam gyis rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor byas nas zas la oṃ yig la sogs pa'i yi ge gsum gyis rim gyis bdud rtsir byas nas mchog tu rnam par dag pa'i sems kyis tshim par bya'o/ /thun mtshams kyi dus su yud tsam gyis rang gi lha'i 'khor 14—1325

lo bsgom par ①byas nas sngar brjod pa'i cho gas bsgom pa byas nas bzlas pa bya'o//de nas zla ba'i snying gar bsams nas rnal 'byor pa bde bar gnyid log par bya'o—/ /slar yang tho rangs rab tu sad par gyur pa na lha mo'i glu rnams kyis bskul bzhin par bdag nyid bsam ④par bya'o/ /langs nas sngar brjod pa'i cho gas bsgom pa byas nas bzlas pa byas so④/ /de bzhin du ji srid pa'i ④srid du rgyud las gsungs pa'i mtshan ma thob pa de srid du nyi ma so sor ro/ /de nas de bzhin du ji ltar nus pa dang ji ltar tshogs pa bzhin du mchod pa'i tshogs ⑤byas nas mthar gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /bde ba'i sgrub thabs dam pa'i gzhung rigs rjobyas gang 'dir/ /bsod nams las byung grub ⑦pa thob pa las pad+ma—/ /dra dpal sgrub pa kho na nye bar spangs pa ⑧des/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams byang chub mchog bde thob gyur cig /ces pa pad+ma dra ba dpal 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs rgyal ba dpal ye shes kyis ⑨mdzad pa rdzogs so// //kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta su ma na shrī dang / bod kyi lo tsā ⑩ba dge slong rin chen grub kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa⑪// //14—1326

༄ga /pad+ma spran ras gzigs dbang phyug gi pad+ma dra ba'i rim bas bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor du mchod pa'i cho ga①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ pad+ma ā ②ba lo ki ①te shwa ra su pad+ma dzā la kra me ṇa bha ga ba te maṇ+ḍal pū dzā bi dhiḥrjo/ bod skad du/ pad+ma spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi pad+ma dra ba'i rim pas bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑤dkyil 'khor du mchod pa'i cho ga /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug pad+ma dra ba la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho yi/ /nang du rgyu ba'i 'jig rten rnams//mnga' bdag thugs rjes non pas 'don/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal gyur cig /kun mkhyen gyis kyang legs shes min/ /zab cing rgya che'i chu gter ni//pad+ma'i phyag gis thugs rjes mkhyen/ /brling bar rjomadzad pa la phyag 'tshal/ /ban+d+ra ka dang se 'bru mtshal bzangs pad+ma rā ga dang / /rgya skyegs khu ba zhu ba dmar po'i gdan dang pad+ma gser/ /snang las rnam par rgyal nas thugs rjes tsodamar po'i ⑧mchog gi sku/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bla ma 'di rgo mchog gsal 14—1330

rnam snang byed/ /de ni sems can thams cad yon tan phun tshogs kun 'dzin pa—/ /'jig rten dbang gi dbu la rtag tu yang dag gnas bcas pa /'dod chags la sogs nyes pa bzhi ①ldan bde bar gshegs pa'i gtso/ /yon tan mang po yang dag gnas pa'i 'od dpag med la 'dud/ /pad+ma rā ga rnam par bdar dang gser dang snang byed 'od/ /tshogs rnams rab 'dzag byu ru'i sdong po zangs ④dang mtshal bzangs mdzes/ /mkha' mnyam snang ba mtha' yas yon tan rgya che 'od dpag med/ /bcom ldan 'jig rten mgon po'i cod pan rgyan gyur la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis kyang mi shes pa'i spyod pa ni bdag gi pags pa'i mig gi sku bzhi'i ngo bo'i ①rang gi ngo bo dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i cho ga brjod par bya'o/ /de yang dubadag nyid bzhad gad du byed pa gal te yang / de lta na yang de'i drin 'dis/ /tshogs rnams bdag la chen por 'char/ /gang ⑤gi rgyu mtshan de rnams ni/ /nor lha'i phrin las bzang po rnams/ /de phyir gzhan la phan don du/ /ji bzhin pa ni rjom yin yang / /yongs su ngal gang legs pa yi/ /shin tu chung gyur kyang mdzes byed/ /mchod pa'i cho ga dam pa'i lam/ /legs pa de 'di mnyes gyur cig /cung zad ci yang shes byed pa//las thams cad pa bdag gis spyobarjod/ /dang po re zhig ⑧tshangs pa'i yud tsam la rdo rje slob dpon stan las langs nas gos yongs su bgos te lha'i ngag gi tha snyad bya zhing 'jig rten pa'i phal pa'i skad kyis 'dris pa yongs su spangs pa'am/mi smra bar ⑨byas pa phyi rol gyi sar gtsang sbra'i phyed ⑩du yang dag par brten par bya'o—/ /de la nyi ma snga dro kha shar la ⑪phyogs pa dang / nyi ma gung la lhor 14—1331

phyogs pa dang / dgongs ①mo nub tu phyogs pas nye bar 'dug ste langs nas rtags la gcig dang bshang lam la gsum dang de bzhin du lag pa g.yon pa ①la bcu dang gnyi ga la bdun ④sbyin par bya bas dag par mngon par 'dod do zhes pa'i rim pas gtsang sbra bya'o/ /de nas slar yang kha bshal nas rjodal gyis dkyil 'khor gyi khang par 'jug par bya'o/ /zhugs nas oṃ sarba ⑤ta thā ga tā māṃ 4pā da ban+da ⑦rgo kā ro mi/ oṃ na maḥsarba budha bo rnyi satwe khyuḥd sha dika ⑧lo ka dhā tu bya basbi ⑨te bh+yaḥs sra ⑩ba ka pra ⑪te ka buste bh+ya⑩/ zhes pas shar dang lho dang nub dang byang du bskor bas phyag bya'o/ /de nas 'jam pa'i stan la yang dag par nye bar 'dug nas/ bla ma bdag nyid gang du bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi char kha nub ⑫phyogs pa'am gal te ma yin te bris pa'i dkyil 'khor med na de'i tshe ston pa po blo bzang pos gal te sa la kha shar du phyogs par gyur nas ye shes kyi lha la mchod pa ⑫bya'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la oṃ badz+ra u da ka skehūṃ zhes khyor ba'i chu la mngon par bsngags te chu'i nyes pa bsal nas lan gsum du mgo la mngon par bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra u da ka ma mā ⑩shrī pad+ma a wa lo ki te shwa ra mu ne+e ba ra ma pa ra ma a nu ta no ā ⑩na na ā di shudhe gu ru swā hā/zhes pas lag pa dang gdong khrus bya'o/ /de nas bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya bcings la⑫/ bcom ldan 'das ⑩pad+ma spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pas bstod par bya'o/ /skyon med yon tan gyis mdzes pa/ /rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyis brgyan⑥/ /cod pan bkra shis sbyin pa po/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud/ /pad+ma mchog gi 'od kyi lus/ /pad+ma mchog gis ⑥ 'dzin pa dang / /pad+ma'i dpal gyi gter gyi phyag /pad+ma chen po'i gdan la 14—1332
