thog bi dza pū ra 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa na ne+e'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin pa/ me tog gi shing ta la'i steng na 'dug pa'o/ /bde byed dkar po phyag gnyis pa/ glang gi steng na stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu la thod pas brgyan pa/ral pa'i cod pan zla bas brgyan pa/ g.yas pa na rtse gsum pa/ g.yon pa'i phyag gis dkar mo'i nu ma la reg pa/ mgrin pa sngon po can/ spyan gsum pa/dkar mo sku mdog ser mo/ phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas bde byed la 'khyud pa—/ g.yon pa me long la lta ba'o/ /me lha ral pa gsum sa/ phyag bzhi pa/'bar ba'i phreng ba can/ lto ba rgyas pa/ rgyan dang bral ba/ ra la zhon pa/g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa dang bgrang phreng / g.yon pas dbyug pa dang spyi blugs so| /bden bral drag po phyag gnyis pa/ gcer bu ro'i stan la 'dug pa/ /rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa/ skra grol ba/ thod pas dbu la brgyan pa| g.yas pa na gri gug /g.yon pa na thod khrag go/ /rlung lha ser po ri dgas la zhon pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ ba dan sngon po gnyis 'dzin pa'o/ /zla ba dkar po 'khor lo'i steng na/ phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas ku mu ta 'dzin pa / g.yon pa rol pas gnas pa/ mdzes pa'i gzugs can no/ /rta bdun gyi steng na nyi ma dmar po phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa pad+ma'i steng na rdo rje 'dzin pa / g.yon pa pad+ma'i steng na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa dkar po ngang pa la zhon pa/ ral pa 'dzin pa/ phyag bzhi pa/gcig na pad+ma/ g.yas pa skud pa'i phreng ba/ g.yon pa na pad+ma dang spyi blugs so| /sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo pad+ma'i steng na g.yas pa na pad+ma/ g.yon pa na rol pas gnas pa'o/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags bzangs ris/ shing 14—1613

rta'i steng du gnas pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa na ral gri/ g.yon pa rol pas gnas pa'o/ /zhabs kyang rol pa'o/ /gnod sbyin dang dri za dang yi dgas dang / srin po la sogs pa/ klu dang / klu'i rgyal po dang bcas pa thams cad rtsol bas bsgom par bya'o/ /phyi nas dbang po la sogs rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor gyis yul du mthong bar bsam ste/ thog mar de dag gi lus rdul lta bur byas la/ rang gi sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun lta bus lus bkrus te yongs su rdzogs par bsam mo/ /rang rang gi ljags rdo rje'i as mtshan pas drangs par bsam mo/ /de ltar bdud rtsi la gsol bas/sgrub pa pos ji ltar yid la bsams pa'i don thams cad grub par bsam mo/ /g.yon pa dril bu dkrol zhing / g.yas pas bdug spos bzung la/ gnas brgyad du g.yon pas dril bu dkrol bar bya ste/ sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ in+d+ra ya/ su pa ta ya swā hā/ oṃ asna ye ha bya ka bya bā hā na ya swā hā/ oṃ dza ma ya pra ta a dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ nairje t+yā ya rak+ṣa pā ti pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ ba ru ṇa ya nā ga a dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ bā ya bai an+ta rik+ṣa tsa ra swā hā/ oṃ ku be+e rā ya dzak+ṣa a bye pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ i shā nā ya byu ta a dhi pa ta ye swā hā/steng du/ oṃ so ma ya na k+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ srur+ya gra ha a rnyi pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ brah+ma na yi be+e ta a dhe pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ bi ma tsi tra ne+e swā hā/ oṃ a dh+wa ya sru re byu swā hā/ sngags 'di dag brjod pa'i rjes la gtor ma'i sngags brjod par bya'o/ /de la gtor ma'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ shring tī ma hūṃ phaṭa—/ ta ma ta ma sa/ pube+e/ sgru pa/ rak+ta/ ta la pā ta li/ aṣ+ṭa nā ga /de ba/ yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sā/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa/ i rda ba bo ha ha ha hūṃ khā hi khā 14—1614

ti—/ kha kha hūṃ dza/ phu dze ma hā aṣ+ṭa hā sa/ gardza gardza/ kṛṇ+ḍa war+ṇa ya/ dze tse hūṃ swā hā/ dang po lte ba/ snying ga /nu ma/ mgrin pa/ gdong pa/rna ba g.yas pa/ mig /spyi bo/ de dag ni gnas brgyad du shes par bya'o/ /de rnams ni gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la — hri hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /hriḥbacom ldan 'das me'i snying po'o/ /hriḥnye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā lī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ kā li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ kā ra li ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bā rā lī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/oṃ be+e tā lī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas ras ris kyi cho ga ni go sla'o/ /rang gi khyim du lha la mchod pa bya ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa byas pas ni las thams cad grub par 'gyur la/ rdzogs ldan dus na gcig yin te/ /gsum ldan la ni gnyis 'gyur ro/ /gnyis ldan la ni gsum 'gyur ro/ /rtsod ldan dus na bzhi 'gyur ro/ /dgod cing bzlas pa rtse zhing yengs/ /za zhing 'khrig pa spyod pa'i tshe—/ /dus rnams kun la bzlas par bya/ /de tshe bdud kyi las dang bral/ /rnam par rtog pa thams cad kun/ /sgra rnams nag po chen por sgrogs/ /thams cad sngags su shes par bya/ /yid la bsams pa'i 'bras bu thob/ /kun la 'di ni mi sbyin te/ /slob ma'i snod rnams brtags la sbyin/ /sngags 'di 'jig rten kun na dkon/ /'jig rten gsum na gces pa'i mchog /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sgol ba yi/ /skye ba dang ni 'chi ba la/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'jigs shing zab/ /chags pa zhe sdang chu srin 'phyo/ /sems kyis 'gram gnyis bde ba la/ /phra ma ser sna phrag dog gis/ /byed pa nag po chen po yis/ /bde chen sgyu ma'i grong khyer na/ /byas pa sems can kun gyi don/ /bdag 14—1615

gis bsags pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /nyon mongs thams cad gcod par shog /'jig rten 'das pa'i grub pa 'thob/ /dpal nag po chen po'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i zhabs kyi slob ma/ slob dpon li ka ri'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī na ren+d+ra bha dra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba u rgyan pa rin chen dpal gyis ri bo chen po spu tra'i mgul du/ bde chen gling gi pho brang chen por bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1594 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas dpe sdur byung med/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (587)14wa 1616

༄ga /dpal nag po chen po yum can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ sdi ②pradz+nyā shrī ①ma hā kā la sā dha rgo menā ma/bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po yum can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gyel ba'i ro la zhabs mchog mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing sbom thung drag la gsus khyim yangs/ /klu chen brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan zhing dbu skra dmar ser gyen badze+es gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /phrag par shes rab ma yis 'khyud cing zhal gcig dang ldan dpal ldan chos skyong rtag par dga'/ /rang bzhin shin tu gnag pa'i khyad par 'phags sku spyan gsum ldan pas khyed la ⑤rtag tu bsrungs/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'joms don dang / /dam tshig bskyang bar bya ba'i phyir/ /nag po chen po'i rjosgrub pa'i thabs/ /man ngag brgyud pa bshad par bya/ /de la dur khrod dang liṅga gcig pa la sogs par 'jam pa'i stan la 'dug la/14—1617

skad cig gis stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la hūṃ yig kha dog nag po'o/ /de las grub pa'i rje btsun dpal ldan nag po chen po/zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog nag po/ spyan gsum pa/ mgo bo'i phreng ba ske la 'phyang ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/ ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ klu brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ sku thung ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ thod pa lnga yis ⑨cod pan byas pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan ④zhing phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa'o/ /phyag g.yas pas gri gug 'dzin pa/g.yon pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ nag po chen mo ①dang snyoms par sbyor bar bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das ma ni/ sa bon hri rjoyig las skyes pa'i sku mdog nag mo/ sku gcer mo rgyan dang bral ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/phyag g.yas pas gri gug dang / g.yon pas thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi sku la 'khyud pas bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du sa bon rka las skyes pa'i nag mo sku mdog nag mo'o/ /lhor sa bon rka las byung ba'i gcigs rjoma'o/ /nub tu baṃ las byung ba'i phag mo'o/ /byang du bo las byung ba'i ro langs ma'o/ /'di rnams thams cad phyag rnams rjogri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ sku gcer mo/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/spyan gsum ma/ rngam pa'i zhal/ sku mdog nag mo'o/ /snying ga'i pad+ma dang nyi ma'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyi lcags kyus ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/mngon par mchod la/ dam tshig pa la bstem pa byas nas/ de 'dir nag po 14—1618

chen po bdag /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /'od gsal bar ni rab zhugs so/ /bdag ni rnam kun yongs su bkang / /zhes so/ /de nas nag po chen po la mchod pa phul nas/ de la lag pa thal mo sbyar ba bstan nas/oṃ shrī ma hā kā la/ sa ma ya/ mā ti krā ①ma ya/ sa ma ya rak+ṣ-i ④tu/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /lha mo rnams la yang rdo rje'i thal mo sbyar ba ①bstan nas/de rnams kyi ming bcug pa rnam pa lnga po la'ang bklag rjopar bya'o/ /rang gi 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab par bya'o zhes pa dam tshig gzung ba'o/ /de nas dug dang khrag chen dang yungs kar rnams kyi bdug spos phul nas/ sran ma/dzasru ti ⑤ka /chang me tog /bdug spos/ sha lnga rjobadud rtsi lnga'i ⑦gtor ma ni—/ bdud rtsir bya ⑧la/ oṃ shrī spyo i rda ba lo ⑨kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi hūṃ phaṭa/ ma hā oṃ sa—/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ dī pa/ rak+ṣa/ ta la pā tā le/ aṣ+ṭa nā ga /de ba/yak+ṣa—/ rāk+ṣa sa/ kṛsnra pa ya kṛsnra pa ya/ i rda/ ba lo/ hā hā/ hūṃ hūṃ/kha kha/ khā hi khā nyi/ hūṃ dzaḥdze ma hā ṣ+ṭa ⑩hā sa/ gadz+dza ya gadz+dza ya/ tadz+dza ya tadz+dza ya/ oṃ kṛ: baṇ+ḍi ya/ dze dze phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags kyis dbul lo/ /mngon par mchod cing bstod par bya'o/ /snying gar sngags brtan por dmigs pa byas nas bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o—/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa no pa hā ⑪ri ṇi/ e ṣā pabyu ma kā lo a yo i rda pra ti dz+nyā⑫/ sma ra se ta dā māṃ⑫/ rat+na tra yā yā ④pa kā ri ṇi/ duṣ+ṭṛ kha khaspyo/ khā hi khā nyi/ ma ra ma ra/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ⑩ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ⑩pa gzungs sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ⑫ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa⑪/ nag po ⑩chen mo'o/ /14—1619

oṃ kā lī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nag mo'i 'o/ /oṃ kā ①rā li ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/gcigs ma'o②/ /oṃ wā rā ṭī ①ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ wā rā tī'i 'o0/ /oṃ be+e tā lī ⑤ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ro langs ma'i 'o/ /ji srid mtshan ma ma thob kyi bar du bzlas par bya'o/ /de'ang dngos sam rmi lam du/ bud med nag mo chen po dang / bya dang khyi nag po dag dang / ce spyang rnams dga' ba byed par 'gyur ro zhes pa ni bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o / /rjod ni sgrub thabs kyi cho ga bri bar bya ste/ 'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod du/sngags pas chas gos nag po 'chang bas/ nag phyogs tshes bcu bzhi'i mtshan mo/stan nag po la 'dug la/ ba byung lnga/ bdud rtsi/ dri bzang / mi'i khrag dang zhag gis byugs pa'i stegs bu la/ gzhon nu ma'i rdul kyis chag chag dang thig le byas la/ dur khrod kyi sol bas byugs nas/ chos 'byung nag po la me tog gi tshom dze+ebu lnga bkod par bya'o/ /de'i mdun du sngon du bshad pa'i bdug spos dang / gtor ma dang / gzhan yang mchod pa'i rdzas rnams bsham nas bsgrub pa brtsam par bya'o/ /de la 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i chang gis dkyil 'khor la gtor bas bsangs shing rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par 3mos la/ sngags bzlas shing / de'i ngang las rang rang gi sa bon las skyes pa'i dpal nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa/ sngon du smras pa bzhin du bdag nyid rdzogs par bya'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ rab tu gzhug pa la sogs pa phyag rgya dang bcas pa byas nas/mchod pa dang gtor ma phul lo/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa'i mthar thug par bya'o/ /14—1620

tshogs kyi 'khor los tshim par byas shing ①lhag ma rnams lhag gtor du sbyin par bya'o—/ /de ltar sngon du 'gro ba byas nas/ de nas bzung ste/ nyi ma ⑤so sor thun bzhir sngon du smras pa'i cho ga rdzogs par bya'o/ /khyad par du 'dir bstod pa dang / bya ba la bskul ba'i tshig dang bcas pa slar nas slar du bya'o/ /dub par gyur na/ gos nag po dkyil 'khor la g.yogs la/ oṃ yisahūṃ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs la/ ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /rim pa 'di yis ji srid mtshan ma ①ma thob kyi bar du bsgrub par bya ste/ 'dir mtshan ma ni rab nag po chen po'i sku mngon sum mam rmi lam du'am nyams snang du'o/ /'bring dkyil 'khor la 'od zer du snang ba'o/ /tha ma rmi lam du rang nyid go bgos rjopa/ mtshon cha thogs pa/ dpung gi gtso bo byed pa/ gdug pa gsad pa/ mi sha zos pa rnams so zhes bya ba ni sgrub thabs kyi cho ga'o/ /las la sbyor ba bri bar bya ste/ slob dpon la gang rtag tu sdang bar sems pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa dang / sems can mang po la gnod par gyur pa rnams nag po chen pos de'i sha za bar mdzod cig /bcad par mdzod cig /khrag btung bar mdzod cig /yang rjon spyi bo nas phug nas/til tsam du phye mar mdzod cig ces bupa ste/ bdag gis gal te bla ma la sogs pa la gnod par byed pa'i gdug pa la/ mngon spyod kyi ⑦las bya bar 'dod pa de'i tshe/ de'i rkang rjes kyi rdul lus kyi dri mar bcas pa dang / rdo dang lcags dang zangs dang / tsha ba gsum dang / gro phye rnams phye mar byas la gdug pa'i gzugs byas pa'i snying gar/ dug dang / ske tshe dang / tshos 14—1621

dang / mtshon gyis bsad pa'i khrag rnams kyis mi'i pags pa la 'khor lo ni/lte bar bsgrub bya'i ming bkod pa'i gzungs ring ①bri'o/ /i rda duṭ+wāṃ di na ②me ke na mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa rtsibs drug la bri'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā li ①ye/ che ge mo duṣ+ṭṛ di rjon me ke na mā ra ya ⑤phaṭa swā hā/ zhes sogs lha mo lnga'i sngags dhimu khyud la bri'o/ /de skad cig gis rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par mos la/de'i ngang las 'khor lo pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa la/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi spyokhams na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la gzhug par bya zhing / rab tu gnas pa dang /mchod pa byas la/ de nas gzungs rings kyi sngags las/ mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa'i khro bo'i tshogs 'phros pas bsgrub bya bkug nas/ de'i ming la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ④zhes pas rab tu gzhug pa la sogs pa byas la/ gdol pas phyir 'khal du bkal ba'i skud pas phyogs nas dkris te snying gar bcug par bya'o/ /de'i steng spra ⑨tshil gyis bkag go/ /de'i rtsa ⑩ba'i sgo nas lcags kyi rtsang gis 'khor lo la ma reg par btsugs ⑪nas lho phyogs su thad ka ⑫dang mthon ⑫dman la sor bcu gnyis pa'i khung bu zur gsum pa la/ dur khrod kyi sol bas byugs pa ④bcug la sna tshogs rdo rjes ⑫mnan par bya'o/ /de nas sngags pas sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i cho ga dang rjes su mthun par dpal nag po chen po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rang nyid drag po chen po'i thugs las 'phros pa'i mi 'dres pa las—/ mtshon cha thogs pa'i khro gzugs mtha' yas pa 'phros pa'i zer dang ldan pas/ snying po'i sngags dang gzungs rings dang / lha mo'i sngags bzla zhing / khrag sna tshogs thal chen/ yungs ⑩kar rnams bzung la/ sna 14—1622

tshogs rdo rje bsal ①nas/ rabs chad kyi thod par bcug pa'i dgra gzugs la/bsgrub bya rab tu bkug pas bcug go/ /khyab bdag gis rab tu bskul ba las/rnal 'byor ma lnga po rnams rol pa chen po'i gzugs can/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa rnams rlung gi shugs kyis son te/ de'i sha gtub par byed/ khrag 'thung bar byed/ rgyu ma gcod par byed/ lte ba'i rtsa ba nas dbyung bar byed/nag po chen po'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i char phab pa lhung bas de'i lus thal ba bzhin du byas te/ rnam par shes pa ni mi bskyod pa'i zhing du song ba'i mos pa bya zhing / gzungs sngags bzlas so/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa bzlas so/ /de nas lha mo'i sngags spel tshig dang bcas pas gsad ④par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su sprul pa rnams de la bcug nas/ gtor ma dang mchod pa la sogs pas tshim par bya zhing bzod par gsol nas/ liṅga sna tshogs rdo rje dang gtor mas mnan par bya'o/ /de ltar thun bzhir bsgrubs pa las/ 'gul pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma 'byung ste/ nag po chen po la gtor ma la sogs pas mngon par mchod nas/ de'i rjes su liṅga lag pa g.yon pas lcags kyi rtsang ①gis bzung la—/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces g.yab rjopas bzlas pa bya'o/ /nag po chen po la sogs pa'i thugs ka'i ye shes kyi me/ 'bras kyi phub ma la dung khrod kyi me spar ba'i ro mnyam pa la bdug par bya'o/ /mtshan phyed du bya ba zhag bdun gyi bar du'o/ /'on kyang 'bras phub kyi me ma shi bar bya'o zhes pa'o/ /yang na sngon du smras pa'i liṅga gtor ma'i dbus su bcug nas/bsgrub bya'i ming spel tshig can gyis gzungs rings bklag cing / dpal nag po 14—1623

chen po la gtor ma dbul lo zhes pa'o/ /nag phyogs bcu bzhi'i mtshan mo/drag po'i sbyin sreg gis bsgrub bya la gzir bar bya ba ste/ de dag gi cho ga ni gzhan du shes so/ /gang zhig byang chub thob pa'i rgyu phyir rang skyabs song ba'i bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms/ /gang zhig 'khor bar las kyi zhags las sems can rnams ni snying rje dam pa bsrungs/ /deng 'dir rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ni mtha' dag 'gro ba'i sdig mun phung po chos/ /dpal ldan rdo rje nag po chen po rab dga'i snying pos dge ba khyed la stsal du gsol/ /dpal nag po chen po yum can ①gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs las byung ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ba ②na rat+na'i zhal snga ①nas dang chos 'khor lo tsā rjob 'jam dpal ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o// //14—1624

༄ga /dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①༄ na /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la sā dha dz+wa ②nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung 'gro ba'i mgon/ /lha mo dang bcas 'khor lo la/ /btud de nag po chen po yi/ /sgrub pa'i rim pa bri bar bya/ /dbang gis ④smin byas dam tshig ldan/ /bla ma la gus snying brtse gtong / /shes rab bzod ldan brtson 'grus che/ /sgrub la dpa' ba'i sngags pa yis/ /yid 'ong dbe+en pa'i gnas dag gam/ /ri bo dur khrod ma mo dang / /gshin rje 'jigs su rung ba yi/ /gnas su nag po bsgrub par bya'o/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod dang gtor ma bsham/ /rten bshams bde ba'i stan 'dug ste/ /rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor du/ /zhugs te cho ga rdzogs pa dang / /bla ma la smod rjobastan la sdang / /de dag rab tu zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag gis nag po bsgrub par bya'o/ /snyam du blo ni bskyed bya ste/ /phyi dang 14—1627

nang gi dngos po rnams/ /skad cig stong par bsgom par bya/ /mdun du pad+ma nyi ma la/ /gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ nag po/ /bltas te de yi 'od zer gyis/ /gdug pa ma lus zhi stibyas te/ /'gro kun bde ba la bzhag nas/ /be+er 'dus hūṃ la thim gyur te/ /yi ge gyur pas skad cig gis/ /bya rog ming can nag po che—/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas pa na/ /dang po be+e tsa'i 'bras bu dmar/ /gnyis pa ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon gyi dang po khrag chen gyis②/ /rab tu gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin/ /gnyis pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin pa'o/ /stag gi pags pas smad dkris shing / /dbu skra ag tshom smin ma ser/ /spyan gsum mche gcigs 'jigs par byed/ /thod pa rin chen sbrul gyis brgyan/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi steng du/ /dpa' bo'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa'o/ /de nas rang gi thugs ka yi/ /sa bon las 'phros 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la—/ /mchod la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥyis/ /dgug gzhug bstem ①dang mnyes par bya//spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga ru/ /pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan stengs surjo/ /hūṃ dang s+dzadang oṃ gsum gyis/ /sku gsung thugs gsum byin gyis brlabs/ /legs mchod bstod de de nas ni/ /oṃ ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba'i sngags ci nus par/man ngag bzhin du bzlas par bya/ /skyo na gtor ma byin brlabs te/ /rang sngags kyis ni bsngo bar bya'o/ /legs par mchod la de nyid kyi/ /rkang pa brgyad pas bstod par bya/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyirjo/ /las rnams gang yin de rtsol rjobya/ /ye shes gshegs la dam tshig bsdu/ /blo ldan mtshan ma ma byung gi/ /bar du 'bad de bsgrub par bya/ /mtshan ma byung nas bla ma yi/ /man ngag bzhin du las la sbyor④/ /bla ma'i gsung gi rjes 'brangs 14—1628

te / /bdag gis ①nag po sgrub ②pa'i thabs/ /bris pa'i bsod nams thob pa des/ /bgegs zhi thub dbang thob par shog /dpal nag po chen po sgrub ⑧pa'i thabs 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rjomadzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta a bha yā ka ra dang / lo tsā ⑤ba tsa mi chen pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1627 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ / /dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gli/ ni〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dmod/1628 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉sno)/ ②〈〈pe 〉skemam/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉steng du/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nya)sa/ me〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcol/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sbyar/1629 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉ston/ ②⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ du〈〈pe 〉྾pornor 〉4)/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (589)14wa 1629

༄ga /dpal mgon po'i nang sgrub ces bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la bi ta ra sā dha rna nā ma④/bod skad du/ dpal mgon po'i nang sgrub ces bya ba/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nag po bsgrub 'dod rnal 'byor gyis/ /yid dang mthun pa'i dbe+en gnas su/ /rten dang mchod pa'i rdzas bshams te/ /dang po byang chub sems bskyed la/ /mdun du skad cig 'dab brgyad steng / /dpal ldan nag po chen po la/ /lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba yang / /bya rgod mgo dang khyung gi mgo/ /khwa yi gdong dang 'ug pa'i gdong / /de bzhin phyogs kyi lha mo'o/ /phag gi gdong dang khyi gdong ma/ /spyang ki stag gi gdong can bzhi/ /mtshams kyi lha ①ni shes par bya/ /kun kyang nag po gri thod thogs/ /pad+ma ro dang nyi steng na/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /de la bdun po rnam dag gis/ /mchod la gsol ba btab byas la/ /rang bzhin gnas su 14—1630

gshegs su gsol/ /rang nyid yi dam gsal ba'i mdun/ /stong pa'i ngang las paṃ dang ram̐/ /pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/ /'phros 'dus gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan—/ /'od 'phros don byas slar 'dus nas/ /sa bon phyag mtshan gyur pa las/ /dpal ldan ①mgon po'i skur gyur te①/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum smin ma 'khyog /khro gnyer zhal gdangs mche ba gatshigs/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar/ /phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis gri gug dang / /ral gri 'bar ba 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon gyi phyag gnyis thod khrag dang / /mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs gnyis phyed skyil 'gying bag can/ /stag sham mgo phreng do shal byas①/ /phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa la/ /klu chen brgyad kyis sku la brgyanarjo—/ /de ltar dam tshig gsal bskyed la/ /ye shes spyan drangs ⑤mchod cing bstod/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsarjodagug gzhug bya/ /sku gsung thugs gsum byin kyis brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra ka lha ba ma hā kā la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ man ngag bzhin du bzlas par bya/ /skyo na gtor ma phul byas la/ /mchod bstod gsol btab ye shes gshegs/ /dam tshig bsdus la dge ba bsngo⑦/ /dge rtsas bar chad kun bsal ༷nas/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /mgon po bya rog gdong can gyi nang sgrub rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta a bha yā ka ⑨ra dang / lo tsā ⑩ba tsa mi chen pos bsgyur ba'o// //14—1631

bsdur mchan/163 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉rag /dpal mgon po'i nang sgrub sogs sgrub thabs bskor bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾pornor 〉stan nā maḥ/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉lhar/1631 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waldan/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉to/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉bon/ du〈〈pe 〉〉spyon/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉drang / du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉toḥ/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bsngos/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanasal/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ca kā/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (59༷)14wa 1632

༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ 1ma hā kra la sā dha khrudz+wa tsā ma/ bod skad du/dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo//bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /tshul khrims sogs ldan bsdu dngos bzhis/ /sems can don byed brtson 'grus ldan/ /rtag tu bsgrub la dga' ba yis /slob dpon la smod ⑦bstan la sdang / /dam tshig la 'phya mtshalas med byed/ /de rnams bsgral bar bya ba yin/ /gzhan du dam tshig nyams par 'gyur/ /dang por bdag nyid yi dam lha/ /rim pa thams cad rdzogs bsgoms la/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir nag po mchod/ /brag steng dkyil 'khor gru gsum gnas/ /hūṃ skyes 'bar ba nag po che/ /gri dang ka pā la lag na 'dzin/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /mche gcigs gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /kha nas khrag 'dzag khros tsam na/ /rang gi yan lag sha gcod ④byed/ /khrag gi rgyun yang 14—1633

'dzag par byed/ /dkon mchog gsum khro bla ma brnyas/ /mtshams med la sogs byed rnams kyi/ /de rnams mgo nas til tsam za/ /de ltar gsal bar byas nas ni/ /rang gi gnas nas spyan 'dren bya/ /rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru//ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /myur du 'ongs nas de la thim/ /mon sran gre'u dang 'dzam bu'i ti/ /me tog bdug ①spos sha lnga dang / /bdud rtsi lnga sbyar gtor ma sbyin/ /oṃ ma hā kā khā ②ya shā sa no pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣā pa— ma kā lo a yo i rda/ rat+na ④tra yā yā pa ka ri shā⑦/ ya di pra tī ⑤dz+nyā sma ra si ta dā rjo.i rda duṭaṃ ⑦kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ⑧ra/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya ⑨hūṃ phaṭa/nag po khyod kyis sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa bzhin du ngas ⑩ci bcol ba'i las kyis shig /de ltar ma byas na mgo a rdza ka'i dog pa ltar 'gas so/ /dam chu blud/ lag tu rdo rje sbyin/ de nas bstod pa/ hūṃ srin po'i ⑪gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid can/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas//g.yon pa gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod phreng can la bdag bstod do/ /khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yos/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel⑫//dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /de nas bskul ba/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar sems bskyed pa/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i 14—1634

gzugs—/ /ral pa nag po gyen du g.yengs/ /steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed/ /spyan bgrad ①ljags 'dril bar kyi lha gdon sdigs②/ /g.yas pa gri gug gnod sems can la sdang / /g.yon pas thod ①pa gnod sems khrag bkang gsol/ /zhabs brdabs gnod sems can gyi lus la nyed/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum khro dang / /bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'tshe/ /bdag gis bsgo ba kun rjokhug la/ /liṅga ⑤'di la myur du chug /'di yi sha zo khrag la 'thung / /rus pa klad pa nang grol zo/ /rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /mdza' ba kun dang phrol la shog /bdag gis bsgo ba ma nyan rjon/ /nag po khyod ni nyams par 'gyur/ /zhes bskul/ gong gi sngags sam yang na/oṃ ma hā kā la che ge mo hūṃ phaṭa/ stong rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de nas sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /tsha ba gsum la gzugs brnyan bya/ /dug dang ske tshe lan tshwa dang / /tshwa ⑦gsum smyo byed srin lag khrag /gro gar sngags spel snying gar gzhug /gdug pa'i tsher mas lus la dgang ske/ /dur khrod me la gdungs stibazlas na/ /de ma thag tu med par 'gyur/ /yang na rabs chad thod pa ru/ /bcug la dgra yi dur bcug na/ /the tshom med par gang bsgo 'grub/ /klu yod gnas su'ang ⑩gang bsgo 'grub⑪/ /nag po'i 'phan nam rgyal mtshan la/ /sngags dang ming spel byas nas ni/ /mchod rten la btags gang bsgo 'grub/ /gang 'dod yul gyi lha rten nas/ / nag po ⑫bskyed la gtor ma sbyin/ /gong gsungs bzlas pa tshang bar bya/ /yul du ser ba myur du phob/ /bsgo na myur du 'be+ebs par byed/ /de ru gtor ma gter du sba/ /yul lha'i steng du nag po bzhag⑫ /nag po'i sngags bzlas ④phur bu ni/ /yul lha'i snying gar gdab 14—1635

༄ga /byin gyis brlabs pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a ②dhiṣ+ṭha na ma hā kā la sā dha dz+wa nā ma①/bod skad du/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i nag po chen mepo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ga ⑤mnan/ /nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can/ /phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pa phreng ba bar ma gri gug 'dzin/ /tha ma ḍā rjom ru ni drag tu 'khrol/ /g.yon pa thod pa dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ /de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'dzin par byed/ /drag po'i zhal la mche ba rnam par gcigs/ /spyan gsum drag po dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /dpral bar sen+tu ra yis legs par byugs/ / rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /⑦spyi bor mi bskyod pa yis rgyas btab brtan/ / khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor steng / /ye shes me dpung 14—1638

'bar ba'i dbus na bzhengs/ /①shing las byon nas gtor ma len par dmigs / /skyes badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣi k+ṣe tra bisgyun bi na ya ②lha/ lha/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/lan bdun brjod la gtor ma gtang ⑧/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po sha ba ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1638 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉rig ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉〉ཿ/ 0〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉bopo chen/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sngasnar 〉〉spru 1 0〈〈pe 〉ja/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ḍa/⑦〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉borin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/1629 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉wakhrag 'dzag mi mgo — dbus na bzhengs// ②〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉zo'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉btang /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (592)14wa 1639

bskur ba'i cho ga①ra ga /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la a rnyi ṣiñtsa bi rnyiḥ②/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga /dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srung ma'i mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /bla ma'i mchog la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po yi/ /dbang bskur cho ga bri bar bya/ /slob dpon dbang dang ldan pa yis/ /slob ma'i nus pa babyed phyir ro/ /de la don — gsum yin te/ /bsnyen dang dngos gzhi rjes nyid do/ /de la bsnyen pa ni slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la/ slob ma snod dang ldan pas mchod pa dang gtor ma dang yon dbul ba rnams rdzogs par byasage/ slob dpon gyis bdag la dpal mgon po nag po'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i mthu dang / dngos grub kyi dbang bskur ba dang / rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol zhes lan gsum brngod do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis gnang ba byin nas/14byed1640

gnas dben par dkyil 'khor la sogs pa dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i dam rdzas tshang bar bkod la/ nag po chen po bskyed par bya ba la sogs pa byas te/ sngags nyis stong ngam 'bum phrag brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i cho ga la 'jug par bya ste/ sa gzung ①ba dang /sta gon dang / dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi khang par sa bslang ba ②la sogs pa byas nas chag chag btab ste/ bgegs la bka' bsgo ba byas nas/ bgegs kyi rgyal po rnams la/dpal rdo rje nag po chen ⑧pos phur ba btab la/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dang / lha dang / bum pa dang / slob ma rnams sta gon du gnas par bya ste/ /dpal nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha nam dumakha' la bkug ste/ mchod pa la sogs pa byas nas/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po che/ /sngon gyi dam tshig dran byos la/ /bdag dang slob ma'i don du ni//sa 'dir byon par mdzad du gsol/ /ces ⑤brjod la bzhugs su gsol lo/ /de nas bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par sman la sogs pa blugs nas/nag po chen po nang du bskyed pa la sogs pa byas te/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la che ge mo rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ stong ngam/ khri'i bar du bajod pa'i bum pa lnga dag dkyil 'khor gyi nang du dgram mo/ /las thams cad pa'i bum pa ni shar phyogs su gzhag rjogo/ /de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag dang mchod pa byas nas/ kha bshal zhing so 14—1641

shing dor la/ oṃ uhūṃ gnas gsum du bsams te mchod cing srung skud kyis bsrungs la/ ku sha'i chun po sngas stan tu sbyin par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi sngags ni—/ oṃ ma hā kā la oṃ byedahūṃ a dhiṣ+ṭa na zhes ①pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi lngas byugs la ②'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i thig btab la/ tshon rtsi lnga la rigs lnga'i sa bon bsams ④te/ dbus kyi gru gsum nag po/ zla gam dmar po/ 'khor lo'i ④rtsibs mtshan kha dog sna tshogs par bya/ mu khyud dmar po/ thod pa'i ra ba dkar po bya/ dur khrod ljang gu ser po ⑤bya/ rdo rje'i ra ba sngo ba/ me ri dmar po bya'o/ /de nas nag po chen po'i sku dang / gri gug dang / thod pa rjodang phur bu dang /bum pa dang / lha'i grangs kyi mchod pa dang gtor ma la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su bkram nas/ yol ba dang bla res ⑦byes te/ mda' dang ral gri la sogs pas brgyan par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis lha rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya ste/ nag po chen po'i ⑧sngags kyis bgegs bskrad nas/ dkyil lakhor gyi dbus su brag gi steng du hūṃ dang gri gug las byung ba'i rdo rje'i ⑨gur bgegs la me 'phro ba dang bcas pa bsgoms nas/ de'i nang du gzhal yas khang dang lha bskyed pa la sogs pa dang / bskur ba'i bar rdzogs par byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lhas bdag la dbang bskur bar dmigs nas/ slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug ⑩par bya ste/ de'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du bla ma la yon legs par phul nas—/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi la sogs pas sems bskyed ⑪de—/ sngags kyi che ba brjod la gdong g.yogs nas/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su 14—1642

gsol—/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor du//bdag nyid gzhug ①par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyi bar du brjod pa dang / slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi khang par khrid do/ /dkyil 'khor la bskor ba dang / phyag byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo'i nang du phyin par bsams te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi stegs bu la gzhag go/ /de nas slob mas 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ bdag la dpal nag po chen po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan dang phrin las kyi ye shes dbab tu gsol zhes lan gsum du'o—/ /slob dpon gyis ④slob ma'i snying gar bye las 'khor lo dang nyi ma'i steng du nag po chen po bskyed pa la sogs pa byas nas ye shes dbab ste/ spos ⑧bsregs nas nag po chen po'i sngags brjod pas brtan par byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog dor nas/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsakyu pa ṭa lo s+thārjoḥgaser gyi thur mas mig phye la/ lha bstan pa ni dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'o/ /de nas dbang gi phyir yon phul nas/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol//dpal ldan nag po chen po yi/ /sku gsung thugs dang phrin las kyi/ /dbang rnams bdag la zad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab po/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /lha yi ting 'dzin rab gsal bas/ /bum pa cod pan rdo rje dang / /dril bu ming dang slob dpon dbang / /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bo yin⑤/ /nag po chen po lngar rjobarnam la/ /slob ma la ni sbyin par bya//ji ltar bltams pa tsam kyis ni/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /mi bskyod pa yi chu yi dbang / /di ring khyod 14—1643

la bskur bar bya/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā khā ya kā ya wāka byusto ①karma a bhi ṣiñtsa yasahūṃ/de ma thag tu phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo nag po chen por bsams la slob ma'i spyi bor bstem mo/ /de nas dbu rgyan dang / rdo rje dang /dril bu dang / ming la yang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan nas bshad pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /sngags kyi mthar t+t+waṃ ②dang / twe ①dang / logaspyor bar bya'o/ /de nas nag po chen po'i sku dang / gri gug dang / thod pa dang / phur bu'i dbang rnams bskur bar bya'o⑤/ /sku byin la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku yi rtags—/ /gang zhig bsgoms pa tsam gyis kyang / /dngos grub myur du thob 'gyur ba/ /di ring khyed la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā khā a a dhijo rjon a bhi ṣiñtsa ā hūṃ⑦/ de nas gri gug lag pa g.yas par byin la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs kyi rtags/ /gang zhig bcangs pa tsam gyis ni/ /gdug ⑧pa'i nyon mongs gcod byed pa/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ 1ma hā kā khā ya byu1 dhijo na a ⑨nyi ṣiñtsa ā hūṃ⑫/ de nas thod pa lag pa g.yon du byin la—/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi ⑪gsung gi rtags/ /gang zhig bzung ba ⑫tsam gyis ni/ /snying rje ldan zhing bdud skrag pa/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya ⑫wāka a dhiṣ+ṭha na a ④bhi ṣiñtsa āḥhūṃspyo/ de nas phur bu byin la/sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las rtags/ /gang zhig bzung ba ⑩tsam gyis —/ /dgra bgegs thams cad rlag ⑩byed pa/ /de ring khrod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ ṭīm hā kā lā ya ⑫karmā dhijo na a ⑪rnyi ṣiñtsa ā ཿhūṃ/ de nas slob ma la brjod par 'gyur ba'i sngags kyi ⑪rjes su gnang ba sbyin ⑫no/ /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i phyir rnal 'byor pas ⑫nga rgyal brtan pas/14byed1644

tshogs kyi rdzas rnams me chu rlung gsum gyi ①sa bon gyis sbyangs lal 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ dkyil 'khor dang rnal 'byor pa rnams mchod par bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa dang bskor ba byas te/yi ge brgya pa lan bdun ①gyi bar du brjod de/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus nas/ /lha gzhan mi dmigs par dumos la/ rdul tshon rnams chu bor dor bar bya'o/ /bdag gis ⑤nag po chen po yi/ /dbang bskur cho ga bkod pa yi/ /dge bas mgon po bsgrub ༷pa kun/ / dpal ldan mgon ⑦po 'dra bar shog /dpal nag po chen po'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga/bram ze mchog sred zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta nag po chen po ro 'dzin dang / lo tsā ⑧ba gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //⑨14—1645
brtsar 'bras re'u mig da/ (592)14wa 1647

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī nā tha ②kā la sā dha ṭ+wāṃ/ bod skad du/dpal mgon po nag po'i sgrub ④thabs/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /tho rangs mal nas langs nas gdong bkru ba la sogs pa sngon du song bas—/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su sngags pa ⑦stan bde ba la 'dug ste/rang gi snying gar a las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ ⑤yig de nyid sngon po rnam par bkod nas/ de'i 'od zer gyis bdag nyid kun du snang bar byas te/mdun gyi bar snang la bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams yid kyis bltas nas/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyis mchod pa rnams kyis mchod la/bdud rtsi lnga yang dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas phyag 'tshal nas don mngon du byed pa sngon du ④'gro bas 'di brjod par bya'o/ /sdig pa thams cad 'jigs pas 'chags ⑦par bkyid/ /'gro ba'i dge la dga' bas yi rang ngo / /dkon 14byed1648

mchog gsum po la yang skyabs su mchi/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de nas sems can ①bde ba la nye bar sdud pa'i rnam pa can gyi byams pa dang / sdug bsngal dang ②sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mtha' dag las bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi snying rje dang / zag pa med pa'i bde ba rgyun mi 'chad ①par mos pa'i rnam pa can gyi dga' ba dang / 'jig rten pa'i chos brgyad spong ba'i rnam pa can gyi rjobatang snyoms bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la mchod bya dang / mchod pa rnams dbyer med par dmigs nas/ oṃ swa dh+wa wa ⑤shurnyaḥrjosarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shustolhahaṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pa sngon du song bas dper na rmi lam gyi shes pa ltar rang gi ⑦sems nyid de dang de'i rnam pas gzung ⑧ba med pa'i phyir de la 'dzin pa'i yid kyang med ces thog mtha' med pa nas rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag par yid kyis dmigs pas stong pa nyid mngon du bya'o//de'i rjes la sngon smon lam rjes su dran pas skad cig gis bar snang du yi ge paṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma'i steng du/ a las grub pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ ⑨gi de nyid kha dog nag po las byung ba/ rje btsun dpal nag po chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog nag po spyan 'bar ba chen po g.yas ⑩g.yon gyi phyag na gri gug dang ka pā ⑪la 'dzin pa/ mgo bo'i phreng bas ⑫dbu la brgyan pa/dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ 'jigs pa'i mche bas 'jigs par byed pa/sku la thams cad ⑫sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ yan lag thung ba zhal nas khrag gi ④rgyun 'dzag par skad cig gis bskyed par bya'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ de nyid kyi 'od zer rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu byas la sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /de la 'di ni sngags yin te/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/14—1649

dug dang khrag dang sgog skya dang nyungs ①kar rnams kyis bdug spos nag po la phul nas/ sran ma la sogs pa'i chan dang / chang dang / me tog dang /byug pa dang / sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams kyis gtor ma sngags 'dis nag po chen po la dbul bar bya'o/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ ma hā kā khā ②ya/ shā sa tsā/ a pa— ma ①kā lo ya mi tata rat+na tra meya/ a pa ka ri r+ṇa/ ya di pra ti dz+nyā sma ra si ta dā⑤/i rda dubye rjokha kha khā nyi khā nyi/ ma ra ma ⑦ra/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na ⑧me ke na mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/de la nye bar spyod pa ni/ tsha ba gsum kyis bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan byas te/yan lag thams cad tsher mas bkang ste/ dug dang khrag gis ⑨cho ga bzhin du mngon par byugs shing / gang gi ⑩ming nas smos te/ me la gdung ⑪ba ste de'i mod la mi snang zhing 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du gang zhig rtag tu bla ma la ⑫'khu ba dang / dkon mchog gsum 'jig pa dang / gang zhig sems can du ma nyams par byed pa de/ nag po chen pos de'i lus la sha bcad nas za bar 'gyur zhing / khrag kyang 'thung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mgo bo la zhugs nas til 'bru tsam du byed do zhes bya ba la sogs pa cho ga rgyas par shes par bya'o/ /yang na dur khrod kyi ⑫ras la dug dang khrag dang / dur khrod kyi sol ④bas mi rus kyi sgyu skegus gri gug gi chang gzungs ⑫la rtsibs brgyad kyi 'khor lo bris la shar nas brtsams te rim pa bzhin du sngags 'di bzla bar bya'o/ /spyo.a mu ka mā ⑫ra ya swā hā zhes pa nas rtsibs gzhan la yang lte ba la ni hūṃ gnyis spel lo/ /mu khyud kyi re khā gnyis kyi bar du ni sngar gyi phreng ba'i sngags so/ /'khor lo 'di rab tu gnas pa sngon du song bas ⑪skud pa sngon pos ⑩dkris te/14—1650

thod pa kha sbyar du bcug ste thal bas bkang ste/ yang tha ①gu sngon pos bcings/dur khrod du sa mtho gang tsam du brkos pas sba bar bya'o/ /de'i steng du rang nyid nag po chen po'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ kha lhor bltas te khro ba dang bcas pas sngags 'di bzlas ②par bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā ③la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa a mu rka mā ra ya hūṃ swā hā/ de ltar nyin re bzhin byas na ④zhag bdun nas 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te shi bar ma gyur na/ 'khor lo de nyid dum bu dum bur byas te ⑤thal ba de dang / mi'i sha dang lhan cig rjotu chang gis byugs/ de mngon ⑦spyod kyi thab khung du sbyin sreg byas na/ gdon mi za bar 'chi bar 'gyur roske/ /dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs ⑧dang bcas pa/ slob dpon chen po bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal su mā ⑨ti tīrti dang / lo tsā ⑩ba dge slong pradz+nyā ⑪tīrtis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1648 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈be+e 〉skosnar 〉zo hā/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉po batha pa'i/ 〈'a ra 〉ge sgrub/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉mis/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉ra ཿ/ bu〈〈pe 〉7du/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉d+kuchag1649 ①〈〈pe 〉skozhar 〉7thamasacad/ ske〈〈pe 〉skozhar 〉7sdug bsngal dang / sne〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉sngar/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉7)sa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉ṅkawa/ rjo〈〈pe〉skosnar 〉7ཿ/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉lkes/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉rizung / ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7ཿ/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7dang / ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ra pa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉mi/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉7du/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉8sa/165 ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉thungs/ ②〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉〉la/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉pa sa na u pa hā ri ṇi e tā pa— ma hā/④〈〈pe 〉〉ti rat+na tā/ 〈'a ra 〉〉te rat+na 7/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉ra/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉duṣ+ṭa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉14—1651

〈'dir 〉sta'i ra mā/ ni〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ṇa/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stan/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉stanas/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bdung / ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉mi la/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉4)sa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉stanasol/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gasgri/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉stanazung / ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉 cham/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉ba'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉du mos/1651 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thag ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toradas/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉ka du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sprer bzhi byas nas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉〉wate/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉stanacig ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉sngon/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉gyis brlabs/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉tsa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pradzha/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (594)14wa 1652

rag /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la ba dzi te ②su tsā masne/ bod skad du / dpal mgon rjopo'i gtor ma zhes bya ba/ dpal lcam dral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dur khrod la sogs pa'i ⑤yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su/ byang chub kyi dusems sngon du btang la/ bam bsgrub bam gtor ma dbul te/ gtor ma la gsum/ bdag khyad par du bya ba dang / gtor ma khyad par du bya ba dang /mgron khyad par du bya ba'o/ /dang po ni rang nyid ⑦skad cig la bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo bar bsgoms la/sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes ⑧byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni brnya 'am thod pa'i nang du mi'i sha chen nam sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i mgon po'i gtor ma bzang po bshams⑨/ de med na snod gzhan du mar 14—1653

gyis brgyan pa bsham mo/ /gtor ma bshams zin pa dang / oṃ swa bhā wa bi shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shurnyolha①haṃ zhes bya ba snelan gsum brjod pas gtor ma mi dmigs par stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ sngon po cig ①yongs su gyur pa las/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngo skyar 'dug pa'i dbyibs gzhu bzhin nar mor 'dug pa/ gzhu mchog gnyis ni mda' ⑦dar gyi ba dan gyis mtshan pa cig bsgom⑤/ de'i steng du re las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar ba tsha ba cig dubasgom/ de'i steng na a ⑦yongs su gyur pa las thod pa shin tu yangs shing che ba cig ⑧bsam mo/ /de'i steng du —⑨ཿdkar po de las 'od zer 'phros gtor ma la mar ⑩'phros song bas/ gtor ma'i mi gtsang ba dang /snod kyi dri ma dag par bsam mo⑪/ /der trīḥyang bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam de nas gtor ma bas khru gang gis mtho ba'i steng du re las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūṃ ⑫mthing nag de yongs su ⑫gyur pa las rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa khong seng can cig ⑫bsam/ de'i steng du re yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag cig bzhengs nas bzhugs par bsam—/ hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros nas rdo rje khong seng nas song / rdo rje'i ra ⑫'og ma nas gnyis su gyes nas song bas/ gzhu mchog gnyis kyis ba dan la brgyab pas/ ba dan gyis rlung g.yab pas ⑩rlung gis me sbar ⑩mes thod pa khol/'od yar 'phros nas spyosong bas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga ⑪char 'bab par bsams la/ ngag tu oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṭ+wāṃ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ uhūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags lan lnga'am bdun brjod/ u⑪hūṃ dang de bzhin 14—1654

brjod rdo rje'i steng gi nyi ma dang / 'og gi nyi ma gnyis hūṃ dang gsum 'khyag ① pa'i zar bu zhu ba gtsug ①tu bdud rtsir zhu bar bsams la/ de nas rang gi lag pas rdo rje blangs nas lan gsum dkrugs pas bdud rtsi dkar chil gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi lag pa'i rdo rje mi dmigs par bsgom mo④/ /de ni gtor ma khyad par du bya ba'o④/ /mgron khyad par du bya ba ni gtor ma'i mdun gyi nam mkha' la re yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ⑤hūṃ mthing nag cig rjobasam/de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad la phog /sdig sgrib dag /thams cad dpal mgon po'i skur gyur/ de slar 'dus pas dpal mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas g.yon na ⑦mi shes pa gcod pa'i ral gri dang thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/ mche ba gcigs pa mi mgo don pa'i do shal dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can cig ⑧bsam/ de'i thugs kar ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng na hūṃ mthing nag las g.yas su phaṭa dmar nag cig chad song ba las nyi ma'i gdan la dpal legs ldan nag po sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas g.yon na tsan+dan gyi be+e con dang thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon pa cung zad brkyang ba/ g.yas pa cung zad bskum pa'i 'gying bag can/ rus pa'i ze phrog can 'jol be+er sum brtsegs g.yel ⑨ba gser gyi ska rags ⑩bcings pa cig ⑩tu bsgom mo/ /de nas rang gi ⑫thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ ri rab kyi byang phyogs kyi bang 14—1655

rim nas mgon po dpon g.yog ①spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bstem mo/ /dpal legs ldan la yang de bzhin du bstem mo/ /sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab bo/ /yang mgon po'i g.yon phyogs su yi sngo skya yongs su gyur pa las/rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng na bh+yoḥsgrug nag dze+ede las 'od 'phros sems can la phog sdig sgrib dag thams cad dpal lha mo'i skur slar 'dus pas dpal lha mo sku mdog sgrug nag bong bu ga dmar la bcibs pa zhal gcig snephyag gnyis parjo—/ g.yas g.yon na ral gri dang thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa/mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du bsdes pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha can| gong smed gong thag sbrul las ⑤byas pa/ snga sha phyi sha la mi ro btags ༷pa / nad kyi rkyal ⑦pa dang / mtshon gyi dru gu thogs pa cig ⑧bsgom mo/ /de'e thugs ka nas ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng na bh+yoḥsmug nag ⑨de las g.yon phyogs su byoḥ⑩nag po cig ⑪chad song ba⑫/ dpal re ma ti sku mdog nag mo re ba'i gos gyon pa dre'u nag po la chibs ⑫pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas g.yon na ral gri dang thod pa thogs pa/ mche ba gcigs paspyo/ skra gzings pa/ gong smed ⑫gong thag sbrul las ⑫byas pa/snga sha phyi sha la mi ro btags pa/ nad kyi rkyal bu dang mtshon gyi dru gu ⑩thogs pa cig ⑫tu bsgom mo/ /de nas rang gi thugs ka ⑪nas 'od 'phros song bas/sum cu rtsa gsum gyi rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzangs ⑩kyi byang shar mtshams kyi mtsho mu le ldings ⑪nas ye shes kyi lha mo 'khor bcas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bstem mo/ /lha mo drel zhon ma la yang de bzhin du bstem mo/ /de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab ⑫po/ /de nas bzlas pa byed na/ rang gi 14—1656

snying ga nas ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na hūṃ mthing nag bzhengs nas bzhugs pa la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā kā la badz+ra rdaṣ+ṭi ①na hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ② phaṭa ces bya ba'i sngags kyis g.yas skor du bskor nas yod par bsams la/de rang gi kha nas thon ①mgon po'i zhal du song / lte ba nas thon rang gi lte bar yang rang gi kha nas thon mgon po'i zhal du de bzhin du khor yug tu 'khor bar bsams shing rjobazlas par bya'o/ /dpal lha mo'i zlas ⑤pa byed na khor yug gi bzlas pa mi bya bar dpal lha mo la dmigs la/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri butsa pa la a shug dze+eme ma hūṃ bh+yoḥdz+dzasgo⑧zhes bya ba'i bzlas pa bya'o/ /bzlas pa mi byed par gtor ma btang ⑨na/ bskyed pa bzhi po la ⑩mi dmigs te ⑪lce'i steng du hūṃ re yang btab po⑫/ /hūṃ bzhi po de yongs su gyur pa las/ lce stod rdo rje lce smad sbu ⑫gur yod par bsams la/ mgon po la stobs ④na hūṃ zhes brjod pas/gtor ma la dar ⑫btsugs nas gsol bar bsams la/ hūṃ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā kā la kha kha ba lo ta khā nyi zhes bya ba ⑩lan gsum gyis bstabs so⑩/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa de ba ma hā kā la ba lo khā hi khā spyohi zhes bya ba lan gsum gyis lha mo dpon g.yog la bstabs so⑪/ /de nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /be+er yang sems can don la gshegs//oṃ uhūṃ muḥzhes bya bas ye shes sems dpa' gshegs/ bskyed pa bzhi po mi dmigs par bsgom/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar bskyal lo/ /dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā nas mdzad pa/ lo tsā ⑪ba 'brom ston gyis bsgyur ba'o / /stso.oṃ shrī ma hā kā la tri yi dza/ oṃ trag rag sha ma'i thun bh+yo ma hā yag sha tri ṇa 14—1657
⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tsa/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉ska/ //1658 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kar/brtsar 'bras re'u migargyud/ (595)14wa 1659

0669༄ga /dpal lha mo nag mo sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga①༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ shrī de wī ②kā li sā dha no pi ka /bod skad du/dpal ④lha mo nag mo sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga /dpal lha mo nag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal lha mo nag mo bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ yo byad phun sum tshogs pas lha bsams la⑦/ de nas gnas dur khrod dam/shing budrung ngam/ gcong rong ngam/ khang stong ngam/ dben pa'i sa phyogs su phyin la/ de nas dang po rjophyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa 'jig rten pa thams cad la gtor ma ④rgyas par btang / de nas e'i ⑧maṇ+ḍal kun du khru re ba la dpangs su yang khru gang gi tshad du bya/ de la stegs bu rim pa gsum du bya'o/ /bar ma la zla gam gsum gsum du bya/ tha ma la gru gsum dang / dang po la gru gsum du bya/ rabs chad kyi thod pa re re'am/ yang na gang yang rung ba'i thod pa re re bzhag ste/ de yang thod pa'i steng du ⑨mngon par byas nas/14byed1660

thod pa'i nang du yang ①nag po re re ro sol gyis bri/ thod pa'i phyi yang ④dmar po re re mi khrag gis bris/ zla gam gsum gsum ①yang dmar por byug /gru gsum nag pos tshon rjobatang ste/ tshon btang ma legs na skyon 'di lta bu yod do / /tshon sgoms na slob dpon dang / slob ma nad mang du 'ong / tshon phras na nad mang bar yong ⑤/ yo bar gyur na yul du 'khrug pa yong rjo/bar chad par gyur na slob dpon slob bu myur du 'chi bar 'gyur/ de bas re khā sgyug ma 'bring po tsam du byas la/ g.yas nas bskor zhing ⑦bri ste/ tshon dgye ba yang gru gsum nyis 'gyur du dgye ste/ nang gi ⑧gru gsum nag por bya/ phyi gru gsum de dmar por byug /nang dang phyi ⑨gru gsum re re la rdo rje phyed ma re res mtshan pa bri/ thal chen dang khrag skam bsres pas/ e'i dbus su sngags sa bon gyi hūṃ bri/ nang gi zur gsum la ma ⑩mo thams cad kyi srog gi snying po bh+yoḥ⑪re re bri bar bya ba yin no/ /de yang da du ⑫ra'i khu ba dang dur khrod kyi sol ba dang ra khyi'i khrag dang / bya nag mo'i khrag dang / de rnams cha bsnyams la bsres te ⑫zhib tu btags la ④tshon rtsi dang sbyar bas dur khrod kyi ras la lha ⑫mo'i sku bris la/ e'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol te/de nas spos la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad lnga tshang bar bshams te mchod pa dbul—/ de yang bdag dam tshig gi lha mo bsgom pa ni/ dang po rang gi snying gar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi'am/ yang na 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dang bcas pa cig ⑩bsam/ pad+ma de'i ge sar gyi dbus su yi ge e klad kor dang bcas pa 'od 'bar ba cig ⑩bsams la/ de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ rang gi gzi brjid kyis rang nyid me ltar 'bar ba cig bsgom⑫/ me des bdag nyid rnam par ⑪rtog 14—1661

pa can gyi lus bsregs nas thal bar gyur par bsam mo/ /yang thal ba de'i dbus su zhi ba'i 'od ①kyis bsam par bya ba/ sngon gyi pad+ma'i snying po la gnas pa—/ srog gi rang bzhin gyi yi ge go de'i steng du baṃ bsam mo/ /de nas yi ge baṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ bum pa gang ba ①dkar po'i kha nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab pa cig ④bsam/ de nas srog tu bshad pa'i yi ge oṃ de yis bdud rtsi'i duchu rgyun 'bab cing steng bas⑤/ yi ge kun gyi mchog srog tu bshad pa'i yi ge a zhes dhipa'i chu des lhag par ⑦brtan zhing brtas par byas nas/gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur nas/ zla ba dang / kha ba dang / kun+da dang /sprin dkar po dang / dung lta bur bsam par bya'o/ /de nas dpal lha ⑧mo'i mtshan sngags oṃ ma hā kā li de wā kā stili/ tran+t+ra kā la ⑩ti tsaṇ+ḍa rū ⑪pi ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ces brjod pa'i sgo nas/ sngags kyi sa bon yi ge a de las lhar bsgrubs ⑫te/dpal lha mo nag mo'i ⑫skur bsgyur zhing bsgom par bya ba ni/ sku mdog nag mo char sprin nam/ bung ba ltar gnag pa/ shin tu rid pa/ keng rus kyi rus can/⑫ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhabs gnyis pa/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ 'og ma na bharnya byadamar gyis bdango ba/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkrol ba ste/g.yon na shasti/ 'og mas tri shu ⑩la'i dar dpyangs 'phyar ba thogs pa/ mi ro rengs pa ⑩khar bcug nas mche ba gatshigs pa/ spyan dmar po gsum bzlog nas lta ba/ dbu'i ral pa gyen du badze+es shing len bu skegayon du 'khyil pa/dbu skra'i ral pa la thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ snyan cha g.yas pa sbrul gyi mgul nas dril bu gsil ba/ snyan cha g.yon pa seng ge'i ⑪ral pa dmar ba/rna ltag ⑩gnyis na me tog dang dar ⑥dmar nag gi cod pan 'phur ⑫ba/ lha 14—1662

ma yin la sogs pa'i thod pa'i do shal byas pa/ glang po che'i ko rlon stod g.yogs su byas pa/ ba lang gi ko rlon chen po dral ba ①la re lde ser pos sham bu byas pa sku smad dkris pa/ khrag dang zhag gi thig les tshom ②bur bris pa/klu'i rgyal po gnyis ①gshibs pas ska rags su byas pa/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgog gis brgyan nas/ bong bu ga ④pa'i steng na rtsen ⑤skyil du bzhugs pa/ dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus na skad dung dang dhi'abrug gi sgra ltar sgogs shing / ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za thams cad dbang du sdud pa cig ⑦tu bsgom mo/ /de ltar gsal ba dang de'i snying ga'i dbus su/ thugs mar me 'dra ba la rang gi sor bzhi'i tshad la dbyebs sgo nga'i gzugs 'dra ba cig ⑧gsal bar bsgom mo/ /sgo nga de'i nang gi dbus su hūṃ nyi ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa cig ⑨bsgom mo—/ /de'i yang hūṃ gi thig le ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du bsam/ hūṃ gi zla tshes zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsam/ de'i 'og tu hūṃ de las 'od zer byung bas ⑩bzlas pa'i yig 'bru rnams phreng bar gyur nas/ hūṃ de nyid la blta ⑪zhing gsal ba dang / 'dris shing goms pa'i sbyor bas rtse gcig kho nar bsgom mo/ /de ltar bdag dam tshig gi lha mor gsal ba dang / grub pa'i gnas nas rang bzhin gyi lha mo sngar gyi de dang 'dra ba zhig la/ 'khor ma mo gcer bu ral pa can thod pas se ral khar ⑫brgyan pa/ lag pa g.yas pas mi'i snying thogs pa/lag pa g.yon pas bharnya ⑫rak+tas bkang ba 'dzin pa/ snying gi dkyil na srog gi snying po bh+yoḥ⑫re re yod pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa byon par bsam mo / /de nas nam mkha' la spyan drangs ⑫nas/ mdun du e'i dbus su sngags kyi sa bon hūṃ spyodang byoḥ⑩la so sor thim pas sku phyag rgyar ⑫bzhengs par 14—1663

bya'o—/ /de la dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba ① sngags 'dis bya'o/ /dṛ byash+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod nas de nas gzugs la mngon du sku ston pa cig ①bsgom mo/ /de ltar mi ston na/oṃ hūṃ bh+yoḥ.e ā ra ⑦li byāḥdzaḥzhes brjod cing gzir ro/ /mngon du ma byung na bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa ⑤ni khyed kyis sgrub rjopar gyis shig ces bsgo ba'o⑦//de yang las byed pa'i tshe rig sngags kyi dam tshig sbyin te/ dam tshig kyang gur gum chu la sngags kyis btab la sbyin no/ /dam tshig gi sngags 'di'o/ /oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra sa ma ya a dhi kra ma nan hūṃ phaṭa/ dam tshig gi chu sbyin nas bsgo ba/lha mo khyod dam tshig 'di las 'das nas sgo ba bzhin du ma byas na ⑧rab tu gzir ba chen po byed pa dang / dam tshig gi chu 'di yang ha la ha la chen por 'gyur te/mthong bas khrag skyugs ⑨pa dang / rdo rje za byed ⑩chen pos snying ⑪dral te dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur ba dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis ⑫gsod pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /khro bo za byed chen por 'gyur te/ rdo rje me dpal ⑫'bar bas ⑫tshig nas lus ⑫thal bar byas te/ so so rang gi rnam pa gsal bzhin du dmyal ba 'bod sgrogs su skye bar ⑫'gyur ro zhes dam tshig bor⑩/de nas lha mo la mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma dbul lo/ /oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de bī ⑫kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ byoḥ⑪/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū ⑥dza spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa ces brjod de me tog dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe pū stsodza sga ra ṇa ⑫sa ma ye hūṃ zhes ⑫brjod de bdug spos shangs la dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra dī pe pū ④dza spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes brjod de mar me spyan la dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra gadhe pū dza spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes brjod de dri thugs kar dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra ne+e wi bye pū ⑫dza sga ra ṇa sa ma ya ⑩14byed1664

hūṃ zhes brjod de lha bshos phyag tu dbul lo/ /de nas ra rog po'i sha khrag dang /bya ①nag mo'i sha khrag dang / gzhan gyi yang sha khrag sna tshogs gang 'byor pa dang /chang la sogs pa bza' ba ⑦sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ma hā me sa khā ①nyi/ ma hā go ro tsa na ④khā nyi/ ma hā byusto khā ti/ ma hā ba su ta khā nyi/ i rda ba lo kṛ7 sa ma ⑤ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes brjod de gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /de ltar mchod pa rdzogs par phul nas bstod pa bya'o/ /gling bu 'bud 0pa'am/ mi rkang 'bud ⑦pa'am/ cang te'u'am/ mi thod kyi rnga brdung zhing dbyangs snyan pos bstod pa bya ste/ oṃ dpal ldan nag mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rang don grub cing rnam thar sgor gzhol kyang / /snying rje'i dbang gis ⑧gzhan don rjes thob cing / /shes rab sna tshogs dag gis 'gro don byed/ /lha mo sku mdog nag mo char sprin mdog /mtshan mo nag mo shin tu gtum pa'i gzugs/ /shin tu rid cing keng rus lus can ma/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis brjid pa'i sku/ /ral pa gyen 'greng lan bu g.yon du 'khyil/ /skra rked sbrul dang thod pa'i phreng thod can/ /rna ltag me tog dar nag cod pan can/ /khrag gi ⑨chang gis ra ro spyan rtsa dmar/ /mi ro rengs ⑩pa khar bcug mche ba gcigs⑩/ /rnam par gcigs nas khrag la shin tu dgyes/ /snyan cha g.yas pa ⑫sbrul gyi mgul nas dril bu gsil⑫/ /gdug pa btul nas tshangs pa'i sgra sgrogs ma/ /snyan cha g.yon par ⑫seng ge ral pa dmar/ /dpa' bo khams gsum seng ge'i sgra sgrogs shing / /phyag bzhi g.yas kyi ⑫dang po ral gri 'dzin/ /'og ma bharnya ⑫rak+ta dmar bskyil ⑩'dzin/ /g.yon gyi dang po shak+to mtshon cha 'dzin/ /'og ma tri shul mgul na dar dpyangs 14—1665

'dzin—/ /shat+ta ral gri mtshon kyis bsad pa yis/ /lha ma yin gyi mgo bos skedo shal byas/ /glang po che yi ko rlon stod g.yogs byas/ /smad ni ba lang ko rlon dras pa la/ /byed ni re lde ser po'i sham bus dkris/ /klu yi dbang po gzhibs pa'i rked chings can/ /zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog sdedag gis mdzes par brgyan/ /khrag zhag mang po dag gi rjotshom bus thig ler bris/ / bong bu ga zhon mtshan mo dur khrod rgyu/ /⑤bong bu'i rmig rjopa glog gi shugs can ma/ /khams gsum skad cig tsam kyis skor ⑦bar byed/ /skad ni dung dang 'brug gi sgra ltar sgrogs/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dbang du sdud/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i pho brang dag na gnas⑧/ /dam pa'i sa nas gzugs sku gnyis gzigs ma//ting 'dzin dbang thob gzugs khams gnas su byon/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po la sogs phyag byas ma/ /gzhan la dbang bsgyur ⑨'dod khams ya mthar byon/ /dbang phyug chen po'i sku la dgyes 'khril ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum tshal du ⑩byon pa'i tshe/ /lha rnams dbugs phyung brgya byin phyag byas ma/ /lha ma yin rnams phung bar byas pa'i tshe/ /lha min dbang po kun gyis phyag byas ma/ /sku mdog ⑪ri rab che dang 'gran pa'i tshe/ /lte ba'i thad ka'i phyogs nas nyi zla 'char/ /rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pas phyag byas ma/ /rgya mtsho'i gting nas me sbar mtsho skems nus/ /sa 'og dbang po kun gyis ⑩phyag byas ma/ /lha mo khyod kyis cho 'phrul 'di bstan ⑫pas/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i rgyal po 'dar zhing 'dud/ /ma mo srin mo'i tshogs rnams rngam zhing rgod/ / dam sri'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing dam la 'dud/ /⑫tsit+ta'i rin chen gur phub gzhal yas nas/ /nyi zla'i ⑫dkyil 'khor brtsegs ⑫pa'i 'od zer 'bar/ /phyogs bcu ⑩'jig rten dag 14—1666

gi ①bcud bsdus nas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim mdzad ma/ /dug gi ②rlangs pas nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams slong mdzad ma/ /de phyir nad kyi bdag mo dam la 'du/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus nas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim mdzad ma//bdud rtsi'i rlangs pas dkar po'i phyogs rnams kyi/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyi rtsad gcod ma/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo dam la 'du/ /gang zhig khyod la dad na ①ma bas byams/ /de phyir nad bdag ma gcig sman gyi gtso/ /bdud rtsi ④lha mo khyod la rtag tu bstod/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i spyan snga ru/ /bdag gi deng nas 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi nad dang sdug bsngal sogs/ /zhi bar bya phyir tshe dang bsod nams spel/ /nag po'i phyogs ni bkug cing dbang du sdud⑤/ /smyo 'bog bsad la sogs pa'i las 'di rnams//bstan pa srung 0phyir las 'di bsgrub par bgyi⑦/ /'di las 'gal na rgyal ba'i sku bslus pas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rdo rjes mgo 'gems shog⑧ /de skad rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dam bcas pas/ / khas blangs bzhin du dam tshig dgyes dgongs la/ /⑨dam bcas bzhin du phrin las myur du mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag gi 'khor bcas la/ /zhal nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi char phob ⑩la—/ /nad sogs sdug bsngal tshogs rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang dbang thang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /zang zing lo tog 'bru yi phung po dang / /rin chen rkang 'gro phyugs rnams 'phel bar mdzod/ /bla ma smod cing dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod/ /bdag gi dge ba'i bar chad byed pa rnams/ /che ge mo zhes bya ba'i las ngan 'di/ /khyod kyi khong nas dug gi rlung bus la/ /'du 14—1667

ba rnam bzhi'i nad rnams khong nas slong / /pags ①gzhi sa la lhung la rdebs su chug /don snod lnga po khong khrag skyug tu chug /las ngan 'khor bcas brang chen brdung ②du chug /smre sngags cho nge gnam du 'bod du chug /'chi bdag gsad sto 'bogs pas gsad ①par mdzod/ /gcan gzan rjomakha' lding la sogs ltas ngan phob/ /bstan pa srung ⑤ba'i las 'di myur du mdzod/ /oṃ ro duru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba bye sgri ka mā la rak+ṣa sī hūṃ bh+yoḥ⑦/ che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bzlas shing dam bdar⑧/ gtor ma phreng zhing brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ yang na nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ gzhan yang lha mo'i gzungs la sogs ⑨bstod pa mtha' dag bya'o/ /de nas lha mo'i rnal 'byor ⑩la gnas nas/ don thams cad grub par byed pa'i snying po'i sngags 'dis ⑩bzlas par bya ste⑫/ myur bar ma yin bul ma yin⑫/ /mi gsal ma yin gsal bar min/ /gug skyed ④nyams pa ma yin pa/ /g.yeng ba'i rtog pa spangs pas bzlas/ /oṃ hūṃ shri byaya de wī ⑩kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yoḥ⑩/ ā ra li zo skedzaḥzhes yig 'bru gsal bar ⑪byas te—/ sngags kyi bzlas pa thams cad kyang lha ⑥mo'i tshig yin par che ba'i nga rgyal bya zhing / rang gi sprul pa'i lha mo thams cad kyi zhal nas kyang sngags kyi sgra 'byung bar bsam zhing bzlas pa la sogs pa bya ste/ de lta bu thams cad kyis bzlas par 'gyur/ de ni sngon du bya ba sngags te/ 'bum phrag bdun bzlas pa'am—/ yang na gsum bzlas pas las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de yang sngags khri phrag bzlas nas gtor ma re re btang ste/ khu tshur bcings te mdzub mo gnyis bgrengs ⑥la/ kha 'gram g.yas g.yon du mche ba ltar byas la/oṃ bya bā bat+tha li che zhes ⑫lan bdun nam gsum bzlas nas 'di skad du/ dur 14—1668

khrod ma mo dngos grub zhal/ /gtum mo gcigs byed yi dgas kha/ /dam tshig srung ma khrag dga' mo/ / lha chen dgyes mdzad khyed la bstod/ /①ki li sgra sgrogs sbyor 'dzin ma②/ /dur khrod ro yi mtsho dbus na/ /tshogs dang pho nya bcas pa ru/ /gcigs byed gtum bdud mdzad la bstod①/ / las bzhi'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ /shin tu rid pa'i 'jigs gzugs can/ /lus la lpags gyon bong bu zhon/ /gnas gsum bdag mo khyed bstod do/ /ske cha lus rgyan thal bas mtshan/ /phyogs bzhi nyul zhing srog gi bdag /ya mtshan gyur nas de mtshan gyis/ /sngon chad la sogs 'dud la bstod/ /rjogasol cig bzhes shig ⑤dam tshig lha/ /gnas nas gnas su mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi rjobasam pa ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyod kyis 'grub par gyis/ /bdag gi las 'di ci byed kyang / /de la kun kyis grogs kyis shig /kṛṇ+ḍi greṇ+ḍa/ sarba duṣ+ṭṛ⑦/pra duṭ+wāṃ⑧/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ thru bye bye ⑨phaṭa swā hā zhes brjod de/ se gol lan gsum brdabs la gtang ⑩bar bya'o/ /sngags ⑪ma rdzogs kyi bar du de ltar shes par bya'o/ /ji srid skyo bar ma gyur gyi bar de srid du bzlas la/ skyo bar gyur na yang bstod pa byas la mchod yon phul te mchod la phyag byas la/ lha mo slar gshegs su gsol⑫/ dpal lha mo la sngon du mchod pa phul zhing bsnyen pa rdzogs par byas la/ lha mos lung bstan cing mtshan ma thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas kyang dang po nyid du snying po'i sngags 'bum bzlas te/ de nas bzod ⑫ las la sbyar ro/ /de la ⑫smyo zhing bsad pa'i las bya ste/ grog mkhar gyi sa dang / chu 'gram gnyis kyi sa dang / dur khrod kyi sa dang / dur khrod kyi thal ba dron po dang / dur khrod kyi sol ba dang / rdzas de dag gcig tu 14—1669

bsres te/ zhib tu btags la/ lung bong gi gcin gyis sbrus te/ bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan byas la ①ldum bu med na yang / lung tang tse'i ②'bras bu dang / dug dang / ske tshe dang / lan tshwa dang / ra khrag sbyar la mi de'i rus rigs bla gang yin pa'i gzugs gro ga gal bris la/ bla de'i lus la de'i ming rus dang / sod cig pa'i bskul tshig dang ldan pa bris te/ 'di skad du/hūṃ che ge mo mā ra ya mā ra ya ④un man+ta ku ru hūṃ phaṭa ces bri/ bla rdo dang sbrags la gzugs brnyan gyi snying gar gzhug /gzhan yang gong gi rdzas dang / tsha ba gsum dang / mu zi nag po bsres te zhib tu btags la/ lung bong gi gcin dang sbyar te/ gzugs brnyan la ⑤khyab par bsku'o/ /de nas gcan gzan rjogyi thod par bcug la maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su gzhag /de nas gang la bya ba de bkug cing gzugs brnyan la bstems te/ mi de yin pa kho nar bsams la de la las ⑦bya'o—/ /gsal shing la bskyon la gsad pa'i tshul du/ 'dir lcags las gsal shing rtse skegacig pa brdungs la bya'o/ / de ltar ⑨byas pa ni ⑩lha mo yin te/ gzugs brnyan rmi ⑪rkub nas gyen du btsugs par ⑫phyung la gzugs so—/ /de nas sngags 'bum phrag gsum bzlas na ⑫dgra bo brlag par 'gyur ro—/ /de dbus bsam par bya ba ni/ bsgrub bya de'i snying ga'i dbus su yi ge rka las gyur pa'i sdog pa kha dog nag po mi sdug pa cig /snying gi mar ⑫me'i dbus su zhugs nas/ snying khrag 'thung zhing sha za bar bsam mo/ /gzhan yang dpal lha mo nag mo bsgoms ⑫pa'i thugs ka'i mar me la/ nang gi hūṃ gi 'od zer las dzaḥ⑩ dmar po sgril mar phyogs bcur 'phros 'dus ⑩de yongs su gyur pa las/ lcags kyi spyang mo ral pa can cig spyotu bsgom mo/ /des 14—1670

bsgrub bya'i snying rtsa'i dbus nas khrag rngub par bsam zhing sngags bzlas te/ oṃ hūṃ ṭīde wī kā ①li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yoḥ②/ ma ma sha rgyu ā ④mu ka mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ces brgya rtsa re bzlas nas/ rdzos ni ka na ka'i rtsa ba dang / zi ra nag po dang / dbang po'i lag pa dang / gnod sbyin gyi lag pa dang / be'u rgyug pa dang / skye ba dmar po dang / dur khrod kyi sol ba dang / lan tshwa'i bye rjom rnams zhib tu/ btags pa'i bye ma sbyar ba byas la/ sngags bzlas nas gzugs brnyan la gdab⑤/phur pa dmar dulhang nge ba ⑦bsregs la snying gar gdab/de ltar mtshon rnon pos gzugs dum bur gtubs la/ phye mar byas la da du ④ra'i 'bras bu yod na rab/ med na yang lung tang tse'i ⑨'bras bu brgya rtsa brgyad blangs la/ rtsab mo'i nang du btsags nas gzugs brnyan gyi phye ma dang bsres nas/ dpal lha mo'i sbyor bas skra bshig ⑩gcer bur phyung nas/ kha lho phyogs su bltas te tsher ma la sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas sngags la/ oṃ hūṃ shrī de wī ⑪kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yoḥ⑫/ ma ma sha hūṃ ā ⑫mu rka mā ra ya un man+ta ku ru hūṃ phaṭa ces ④brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing / rdzas dang bstun zhing skebasreg par bya'o—/ /de ltar byas na ⑩smyo nas 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /haṃ gis thal ba de nyid blangs te/ de nyid spyi bor btab na lo nyi shu rtsa gcig tu smyo bar ⑩'gyur ro zhes kyang bshad do/ /gzhan yang bdag gi rmi spyoltas su/ / bud med ⑪nag mo khros pa yis/ /gang zhig 'ching bas ⑥bcings gyur na/ /mtshan mo spyonag mor de shes bya/ /bsgrub bya nyi ma bdun na ni/ /'chi ste gshin rje'i yul du 'gro—/ /gal te re zhig cung zad 'gor na yang / /nyin zhag bdun du bsam gtan 'di bya'o/ /bsgrub bya lus po skams la ⑫rid pa/ skra 'dzings pa/14—1671

srub pa/ khu ba dang / rdul dang khrag 'dzag pa/ 'dar ①ba'i cha byad can zhig mdun du ②mngon sum du bsam mo/ /bdag lha mor ③gnas pa'i hūṃ las 'od zer nyi ma dang me stag lta bu 'byung ba las/ bskal pa'i me bzhin 'bar zhing / 'ur 'ur dang / tog tog dang / ches ches can du drag po'i yi ge hūṃ du gyur nas/ hūṃ de las rdo rje'i ④khab tu gyur par bsam mo/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i khab de dgra bo'i ⑤bshang khung gi sgor zhugs rjote/ snying phug nas kha'i nang nas sam/ spyi gtsug gi ⑦tshangs pa'i ⑧bu ga nas phyung nas cher 'bar bar ⑨bsams te/ snying po'i sngags kyi mjug ⑩la/ che ge mo ha na ha na—/ da ha da ha/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ces pa'i sngags kyis khas bub tu lhung bar bya'o/ /de lta bus bsam gtan gyi lha yang 'chi na 'khor ba na ⑪gnas pa'i mi rnams la ⑫lta ci smos/ lha mo mu stegs kyi sgrub lugs/ slob dpon lo ka shrī yis bsgyur ba rdzogs so// //14—1672

༄7/ /oṃ swa ste/ re ma ti'i dmag zor gyi man ngag 'di la/ man ngag gcig la khungs gnyis te/ dang po ā tsar+ya dmar po la lce 'byung gnas bzang pos gser srang lnga phul nas zhus/ dge bshes lce la zhang shes rab ②dang / snubs rgya le gnyis kyis stag dze+egacig spyi mar phul nas zhus/ snubs la snubs kyi ma mo khrag mig ces par grags so/ /gnyis pa ni lo tsā rjob shes rab bla mas gu ru ā tsar+ya dmar po nyid rgya gar du gshegs pa la bal po tshun chad skyel thung mdzad nas zhus nas khyad byung ste/ zhal gyi man ngag ma lus pa yid ches par gnang ste khungs ⑤gnyis so/ /dmag zor zhes pa'i nges tshig gtam dhider rtsad chod do/ /gzhung ni sdom brgyad po 'di nyid yin te khungs mthun no/ /man ngag 'di ⑦bya thabs la/ /mchod pa bshams te ⑧bca' ba dang / /ma mo bskyed cing ye shes dgug /mchod sbung bzlas pa bya ba dang / /bstod cing 14—1676

las sbyor ①bsdu ba'o/ /de la mchod pa bsham pa ni/ /dur khrod la sogs dbe+en pa'i sar/ /maṇ+ḍal khru gsum chag chag bya/ /mdun du gru gsum mi ris bcas②—/ / slar brtag① /maṇ+ḍal steng du sogs rjopa'i rdzos/ /phud dang gtor ma rak+ta bshams⑤/ /khram shing byang dmar nad rkyal dang / /sho rde'u rjotshon gyi dru bu sogs/ /sha sna rnyed tshad mi dbang sha /bsur ⑦chen ma mo mnyes par bya/ /de nas rten gyi bya thabs ni/ /dkyil 'khor dbang ldan mtshams su nirka/ /'bru nag 'jim nag bsres pa las/ /dre'u ⑧rta la zhon nag mo ni/ /mthing nag rgyan gyis ⑨brgyan pa mo/ /rma bya'i gdugs kyis phub pa ste/ /bdud phrug mtshon thogs mang pos bskor/ /'jigs su rung bas bskor bar bya⑩//da ni ma mo bskyed par bya/ /rang gi cho ga rdzogs byas la/ /byang shar mu le dngos ⑪su bsam/ /rlung nag 'tshub ⑫ma'i nang shed du/ /k+ṣa zhes brjod pas skad cig gis/ /dmag zor nag mo re ma ti/ /dre'u rta la zhon jod pa can/ /phyag g.yas be+e con 'dzin pa la/ /phyag g.yon thod pa khrag bkang ⑫bsnams/ /dmod mo'i mtshon cha lnga dang bcas/ /sga yi snga sha nad rkyal la/ /sga yi phyi ru dru bu ste/ /khram shing rked la gzir ba dang / /byad dmar sho rde'u ④snga sha la/ /dar nag gos kyis sku stod ⑫brgyan/ / bya yi ⑩gdugs 'og chud par bsam /bdud phrug tshogs ni dus mnyam du/ /g.yon pa thod khrag yungs kar can/ /g.yas pa mtshon cha sna tshogs can/ /de ltar dam tshig bskyed byas la/ /rang bzhin gnas nas ⑩gzhug par bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ zhes ni sngags la gdags/ /byang shar nas byon rang rang thim/ /bzhugs su gsol ba'i tshig 'di brjod/ /hūṃ nag mo gdug can dregs pa can/ /kun du khyab pa'i gzugs ston ma/ /nag 14—1677

mo gtso mo dre'u rta chibs/ /'dir spyon dre'u rta'i gdan la bzhugs/ /raglo dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod do/ /de nas de la mchod par bya/ /za byed nag mo mche ba can/ /dgod ①byed ha ha nag mo khyod/ /gsod la dga' bar byed pa mo/ /bdag ni brda yi phyag byed do/ /raglo a ti pū gadza ho/ phra mo spom po ①las byung ba'i/ /bdud rtsi bran pa'i dza gad 'di/ /dmag zor nag mo la 'bul lags/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /yi ge sum cu gcig pa la/ /pañtsa a mṛ ta khā nyi gdags so/ /sha khrag la sogs bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyoradhi/ /'bru sna lnga la sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'di/ /dmag zor nag mo khyod la dbul⑤/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /sngags kyi mjug pyal ba bo ta la kha re khā hi zhes gdags so/ /chu dang ma 'dres dngas ma'i khrag /dngas ma yi ni khrag chen po/ /dmag zor nag mo la dbul lags/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /sngags kyi mjug la ma hā rak+ta ⑦kha re khā nyi zhes so//lha mo'i sngog ⑧mi yong bar bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar lce la bzhag cing mchod do/ /de ni dam bsres so⑨/ /de nas smon lam gdab pa ni//bdag cag dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bu dang tsha bo rgyas pa dang / /longs spyod thams cad rgyas pa dang / /log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /thams cad rtag tu rlog ⑫par byed/ /da ni bzlas pa brtsam par bya/ /rten gyi lha mo'i thugs ka ru/ /rgyus ⑪pa'i sred bu de la gdags/ /rnal 'byor snying ga'i sa bon las/ /'od zer dkar po 'phros pa yis/ /lha mo'i thugs kar ma la thim—/ /'od zer sngags kyis mchod par bsam/ /'od zer dkar po sngags kyi gzugs/ /bdag la slar thim dngos grub byin/ /de ltar yang dang yang du 14—1678

bsam| /de yi thun smad dag la ni/ /bdag dang ma mo bdud phrug bcas/ /thams cad dus mnyam sngags zlos pa'i/ /'od zer dug mda' 'dra ba yis/ /'brub khung yungs thun khrag thun bya/ /gzas ①pa'i lus kyang brlag par bsam//mgon po de la gzungs thag gtad②/ /bstod pa cung zad cung zad bya/ /re ma ti yi ①spyi dang mthun/ /de nas las la bsdu ba ni/ /bdud phrug tshogs dang khrag rnams ni/ /sle'u khung du khyer nas ni/ /bsgrub bya'i phyogs su kha bltas la/ /skra bcings 'gram pa sol bas byug /dpung pa g.yas pa phyung nas su/ /yugs skras byas pa'i 'ur rdo 'am/ /yang na lag pa rang gis te/ /zor lam spyi dang mthun par dbye/ /dmag gi tshogs ni mi thub sbyin/ /dug lngas bkang ba mang po dang / /yungs thun thogs pa mang po dang / /mtshon cha thogs pa mang po yis/ /dgra lus yul 'khor bcom pa dang / /thams cad gsod cing za bar bsam/ /g.yang gzhi drag tu brdab par bya/ /log la lha mo la yang mchod/ /bdud phung mang po phangs rjopa'i tshe/ /bdud phrug gzugs rnams mi snang na/ /las rnams 'grub par gdon mi za/ /bdud rnams 'dug na cung zad dka'/ /cung zad bstod pa byed pa ni/ /hūṃ bh+yo dpal gyi gzugs can 'dod khams gtso mo khyod/ /rta mchog ⑤zhon nas dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyugarjo /be con thod pa dam pa rang rtags 'dzin/ /re ldes stod dkris sgrul gyi sham bu can/ /lte bar nyi shar gtsug na zla rgyas ma/ /khrag nad bdag mo dbyings phyug dpal 'bar ma/ /lha mo ri ma ti la bstod pa 'bul//raglo bh+yoḥ⑦/ raglo bh+yo ཿbh+yoḥ⑧/ raglo thun bh+yoḥ⑨/ kha la rag che na ma/ raglo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ⑩/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yoḥ⑪hūṃ/ che ge mo mā ra ya/ 'bod 14—1679

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a nu dz+nyā bi dhiḥ/ bod skad du/ rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga /dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod ma'i mgon la rab btud nas/ /nā ro'i zhabs las rim 'ongs pa'i/ /dud sol ma yi rjes su gnang / /da ni bdag gis bshad par bya/ /de yang re zhig dang por bza' ba dang bca' ba dang 'jib pa dang bldag pa dang btung ba la sogs par ldan pa'i gtor ma 'dus byas la/ 'chad par gyur pa'i cho gas bcom ldan 'das mdud pa'i sol ba la mchod cing bstod pas yang dag par mnyes par byas nas mngon par 'dod pa'i bya ba stsol bya'o/ /de nas rjes su gnang ba nod par 'dod pa'i slob ma skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis bla ma la maṇ+ḍal phul te/ mgo bor me tog gi phreng ba dang bcas pas pus mo sa la btsugs shing thal mo sbyar te/ dkyil 'khor dbang phyug phyi dang gsang ba gzhan 14—1682

pa las byung ba/ /bdag dang sbyor ba nam mkha'i de nyid gdan bzhugs rig mar bcas/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i zhabs kyi chu skyes la ni grub pa yi/ /rjes su 'gro ba'i blo ni rgyal ba'i ched du bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bya ba 'di brjod pa'i mthar/ /kye 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi bdag po rnal 'byor nam mkha' / sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor gyur pa'i srid pa rab tu gzhom pa dang /mchog gi bde ba chen po'i mya ngan las 'das pa mngon du ma byas pa de srid du/bar du gcod pa nye bar zhi ba'i ched du/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das ma dud pa'i sol ba ma'i rjes su gnang ba dang byin gyis brlab pa 6) du gsol zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab tu gzhug go/ /de ma thag par de dag rnams/ /bla ma sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas skyabs su 'gro ba dang /sems bskyed pa la bkod nas/ de rnams kyi mgo bor lha'i rang bzhin gyi gtor ma yang dag par bkod pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang nyi ma la hūṃ yig las skyes pa'i dud pa'i sol ba ma/ du ba'i mdog can zhabs g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhal spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i ral gri 'phyar ba/g.yon khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/dar dmar po'i smad dkris can/ phyag rgya drug gis nye bar brgyan pa/ sgal tshigs kyi phreng ba 'phyar ba/ 'jigs pa'i gzugs can ma/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba can du blta bar bya'o/ /de nas oṃ dhu māṅgā rī ye s+t+waṃ swā hā/ zhes bya bas lan nyi shu gcig tu bsngags te/ /sems can sgrol mdzad sbyor ba'i bdag mo khyod la 'dud/ /skal mang sems can rgal bar mdzad ma khyod la 14—1683

'dud—/ /kun bdag gcig pa'i rang bzhin ma la bdag 'dud do/ /gcig pu'i de nyid nges gyur bdag nyid ma la 'dud/ /ces bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa bla mas lan gsum du brjod cing / gu gul la sogs pa'i spos kyis bdug pa dang / rnga la sogs pa'i rol mo'i sgras byin dbab par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan yang dag par bsgrags nas—/ kye bcom ldan 'das ma rnal 'byor nam mkha' dud pa'i sol ba ma/'di dag rnams kyis bka' las ma 'da' bar dam bca' ba rjes su dran pas dam tshig srungs shig /bstan pa skyongs shig /slob ma che ge'i dgra dang bgegs thams cad gzhom par mdzod cig /che ge'i rjes su 'jug par kyis la ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i don thams cad phun sum tshogs par byos shig ces bsgo bar bya'o/ /de nas des ji ltar bka' stsal pa de bzhin du bgyi ste/dzad rnams kyis mngon par 'dod pa'i don phun sum tshogs par bgyid do zhes khas len pa ni/ de rnams kyang mnyan du gzhug go/ /de nas gtor ma sngar gyi gnas de nyid du bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'das ma la yang dag par mchod cing mngon par bstod de/ nges par dgyes par gyur par blta bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes su 'chad par 'gyur ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs brjod par bya'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya/ /rdo rjes dud sol dgyes bya zhing / /dge 'dun mchod ston gyis mgu dang / /phongs dang mgon med rnams tshim bya/ /'di ni rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga'o/ /dngos grub brnyes pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī ba na rat+na'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'o// //14—1684

bsdur mchan/1682 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing /chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas dpe sdur byung med/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (598)14wa 1685

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ byu maṅgā ri sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ dud sol ma'i sgrub thabs/ dud sol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por gdug pa'i bgegs tshogs rnams/ /'joms mdzad dud sol mar btud nas/ /gzhan la phan phyir bdag gis ni/ /'di yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /de la dang por re zhig sngags pas rang gi yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i yul dang gnas su bde ba'i stan la nye bar 'dug nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa sngon du song bas gang ci yang rung ba'i lha'i khyad par gyi rang gi cho ga shes pas/ 'dod pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang sngags bzlas pa la sogs pa rdzogs par bdag nyid kyis bya'o/ /mdun gyi phyogs su skad cig gis sku mdog dang phyag dang / /dbyibs la sogs pa sngon du bshad pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma dud sol ma blta bar bya ste/ de yang / rno ba'i ngar ldan ral gri g.yas pa'i 14—1686
