phyag gis steng du 'phyar/ /g.yon gyi lag par 'gro la gnod byed rnams kyi khrag gi snod bzung zhing / /tshangs dbang khyab 'jug sogs kyi bsnyems pa drag po rab tu gzhil ba ma/ /dud pa'i sol ba ma 'di shin tu brtan pa'i yid kyis rab bsgom bya/ /bdag nyid kyi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor kyis rang gi snying gar bzlas bya'i sngags kyi yi ge shin tu gsal ba rnams las rang rang gi kha dog dang rjes su mthun pa'i sngags kyi 'od zer rno zhing rtsub pa drag cing gdug pa bzod par dka' ba'i 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pa rnams kyis dus sol ma'i snying gi chu skyes la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi hūṃ gi sa bon du ba lta bu shin tu gdung bas gdungs te/ yang nas yang du bskyod cing bskyod pas rab tu bskul bar bya'o/ /de las kyang 'di ltar bzod par dka' ba'i 'od zer drag pos de'i snying gdungs shing gdungs pa ma bzod pas/ sgrub pa po'i mngon par 'dod pa'i don rig nas/ rang gi snying gi sa bon las/ de lta bu'i 'od zer ches drag po spros pa rnams kyis sgrub pa po la gnod par byed pa bgegs gdug pa can ma lus pa thams cad la bsnun cing bskrad de bcom nas/ sgrub pa po bgegs dang bral ba nyid du shes pa las gang dang gang 'dod pa'i bya ba de dang de rdzogs par bya zhing / ji ltar bka' sprul ba de dang de thams cad kyis rjes su 'jug pa dang khas len na/ ci zhig bgyi zhes bka' nod cing 'dug par mngon par mos nas 'di skad du sngags bzla bar bya ba ni/ oṃ dhū maṅgā rī ye hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba ji tsam nus par bzlas so/ /dub par gyur pas langs par 'dod pa na/ rang gi 'dod pa'i lha la phyag byas nas/ mngon par mchod cing yang dag par bstod de/ dge ba gang zhig thob pa dag sems can thams 14—1687

cad kyi ched du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba dang / bzod par gsol la ye shes sems dpa' gshegs par bya'o/ /dud pa'i sol ba ni/ cho ga ji lta bar gtor ma dang mchod pa dang bdud rtsis tshim par byas pas yang dag par mnyes pa las/ rang gi 'dod pa'i don gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas chos thams cad rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba tsam pa stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du mos par byas nas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta ces bya bas spros pa med pa'i ngang du gnas par bya ba 'di ni dud pa'i sol ba ma sgrub pa'i thabs yin no/ /dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po dpal nags kyi rin chen zhabs kyis mdzad pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1686 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas dpe sdur byung med/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (599)14wa 1688

༄ ga /rgya gar skad du/ ba lo bi snyiḥ/ bod skad du/ gtor ma'i cho ga dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'i rjes su 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi bdag nyid kyi sngags pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma dud pa'i sol ba ma la gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ de la sngon du smras pa'i tshul gyis bshams pa'i gtor ma nyid dam/ yang na lhag ma'i skabs su/ 'khor lo pa rnams kyi lhag ma'i dum bu bsdus pa/ snod chen por blugs te/ 'khor lo'i gtso bo'i spyan sngar bzhag la/ de'i steng du 'bras chan dang / tshod ma dang /myos byed la sogs pa cung zad cung zad kyang byin nas/ rang nyid kyi mdun gyi nam mkha'i khams su rnal 'byor nam mkha' dud pa'i sol ba ma blta bar bya'o/ /mchod yon la sogs pa sbyin pa sngon du 'gro ba'i me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya ba 'dis lhag ma'i steng du dgug pa la 14—1689

sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas zhu ba'i bdud rtsi khar blugs nas/ ho paṇ+ḍi'i sngags/oṃ su mi shudha dhan+d+ra hūṃ a ā saṃ uswā hā zhes bya ba 'di brjod cing / rdo rje khu tshur gyi phyag rgya gnyis bcings pa'i gru mo gnyis bkug ste mthe'u chung bgreng ba mdog dkar po'i mche ba'i rnam par sbyor ba'i phyag rgya bcings la/ sngags 'dis gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ba ta li ba ta li/ sau ha mu khi thra shā na wa si ni pra te mu khi tsaṇ+ḍa ka rā li/ ru dhi ra pri ya sa ma ya rak+ṣi ta yo gāsba ri ki li ki li rā be+e pi tri ba na ma khye/ bhuñdza ha bhak+ṣa ha dzi gha sa ha ga ṇa/ dru te jo maṅgā rī tsaṇ+ḍa kā rā li tiṣ+ṭha sī ku ru hūṃ kṛṇ+ḍa sarba du ṣ+ṭṛ bha k+ṣa sum̐ sum̐ dzi phaṭa swā hā zhes bya'o—/ /slar yang mngon par mchod cing yang dag par bstod par bya'o/ /de nas 'dis bzod cing gsol ba bya ste/ gtso mo bdag gis ma shes dang / /yongs su ma rnyed nus ma mchis/ /lhag dang ma tshang gyur pa gang / /de kun mgon pos bzod mdzod rigs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /tshangs sogs lha dang 'jig rten skyong / /theg mchog cho gar nongs bgyis pa/ /bzod par stsal nas bdag dang ni/ /sbyin bdag rnams la zhi ba dang / /rgyas dang bde legs mdzad du gsol/ /zhes bsngo'o/ /de nas sngags pas dmigs pa med pa nyid du ci bde bas gnas par bya'o/ /'di ni gtor ma'i cho ga'o—/ /bla ma'i man ngag bskyud par gyur pa'i nyes pa dang / /rmongs pa las ni 'khrul pa'i nongs gang 'dir chags pa/ /rnam dag thugs rje shin tu zhi zhing gshin gyur pa'i/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la yang dag 'chags/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i sgrub thabs rnam dag bgyis 'di las/ /bsod nams gang zhig bdag gis rab tu thob gyur pa/ /de yis 'jig rten dka' ba med pa'i bde 14byed1690

ba dang / /yang dag ldan pa kun du bzang po nyid gyur cig /'di ni dud pa'i sol ba ma'i cho ga ste dpal nags kyi rin chen zhabs kyis mdzad pa'o// //grub pa'i zhal gyi sbrang rtsis rab tu myos pa yis/ /gar byed de ni dpal ldan rgya tsho'i sde zhes pa/ /bsnyengs bral sgreg pa'i bkra shis yi ge'i kā ma lar/ /chags pas kun dgar gyur pa'i glu dbyangs 'di blangs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po de nyid kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i btsun pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1689 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas dpe sdur byung med/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (6༷༷)14wa 1691

༄ga /dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la sā dha rna/ bod skad du/dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar gsungs pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i ngang las/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la hūṃ yig nag po de nyid las yongs su rdzogs pa'i rje btsun dpal nag po chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku ②mdog nag po spyan gsum pa 'bar ba chen po phyag g.yas pa gri gug g.yon gyis thod pa 'dzin pa/ mi mgo'i rgyan can—/ skra kham pa gyen du badze+es pa①/ smra ra kham pa can/ mche ba gcigs dupas 'jigs par byed pa/ yan lag thams cad la sbrul gyis brgyan pa bong thung ba/ zhal nas khrag 'dzags ⑤par bdag nyid skad cig tu rdzogs par byas nas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /de la sngags ni 'di lta rjoste/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dug dang khrag dang ⑦sgog pa yungs kar rnams kyi spos phul 14—1692

nas—/ sha dang sran chen myos byed pa/ /me tog bdug spos byug pa dang / /sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi lnga①/ /nag po chen po'i gtor ma bya/ /de yi sngags ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ ma hā kā la ya shā ②sa no pa ka ra ①yā sar+ya muṣ+ṭa bushra shā ṇa bubā si nā rjoskyi tā ya e sngo a pagyi ma kā lolha⑦yo ya ti t+t+waṃ pra ti skedz+nyā sma ra si ti dā ⑨i mi rat+na tra yā ⑩ka ri ṇa mā mu ka na duṣ+ṭṛ ⑪kha khā hi kha ⑫khā hi/ ma ra ma ra⑫/kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na—/ mā ra ④ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa byu ⑫ta pre ta pri shā tsa ⑫na/ba la ⑩kṛṇ+ḍa mā ma sirnyi ku ru shārnyi ku ru rak+ṣa ku ru zhes bya ba gtor ma'i sngags so/ /de la nye bar spyod pa 'di yin te/ ku sha las bsgral ⑫bya'i gzugs brnyan la/tsha ba gsum dang dug dang ske tshe ma ⑪rnams ra tsi ka cho ga bzhin du bskus ⑦nas rtsang gis khrag tham par btsugs te gang gi ming gis me la bdugs na de ni skad cig de nyid la mi snang ba dang nyams par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin/ gang zhig slob dpon la sdang dang / /rtag tu dkon mchog gsum la smod/ /sems can du ma 'joms byed pa/ /nag po chen pos gsol bar mdzad/ /de bzhin mgo la 'dug nas su/ /til 'bru tsam du gtub par byed/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa dpag tu med pa rtogs ⑥par bya'o/ /dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub ⑫thabs rdzogs so// //14—1693

bsdur mchan/1692 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs sto// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wasku/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toragreng ba/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉bcigs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉toradzag rjo〈〈pe 〉〉ltar/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wadang /1693 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sngas/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ga ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉/ dhi〈〈pe 〉musak+ta/ 〈〈snar 〉tshogakra/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉da/ 0〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉tsho'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wa3/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stedi two pri ta/⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉༅ da ha/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉tri yā pa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉graṭaṃ kha/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wakha/⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉〉 ma rā/ ④〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉zo rā/ ④〈〈pe 〉lopo ra 〉〉barba bhu/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉〉tso/⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉be/ tso〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉sgrub/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wam/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskul/⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rtog ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (6༷1)14wa 1694

༄ na /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po'i sgrub ①thabs/ nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nisbyi shi la nag po bya ste gri gug dang thod pa bsnams ①pa skra gyen du langs pa/ thod pa'i cod pan can/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ spyan dmar ba/ mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal/stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can mi mgo'i phreng ba'i do shal dang ldan pa/ yi dgas kyi gdan la bzhengs par gnas/ mun pa mi bzad pa'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la nag po'i tshes nas sgrub pa bcas bute/ de'i zhal lhor bstan la gzhag /kha shar du bstan la gzhag /kha shar ⑤sngags stong phrag bcu bzlas par bya'o/ /dam tshig gi rdzas kyi rjogator ma phul la/ gu gul gyi ⑦bdug spos dbul bar bya'o/ /me tog sna tshogs pa gtor nas/ oṃ ā si mu sa la tri shu ④la—/ e bye hi ma hā kā la saza sha hūṃ nirga ta ya nirga ta ⑨ya/ dz+wa ra ṇa/ kṛrje 14—1695

pa ya kṛsnra pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bza' ba spangs la bzlas pa bya'o/ /tshangs par byas la mngon du phyogs pas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /sngar bzhin gtor ma dbul lo/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+ra ṇa swā hā zhes bya ba 'bum phrag gcig bzlas par bya'o/ /①oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+ra ṇa e ta ta ②pre ṣa yā mi ka ra ṣe thā swā hā zhes 'bum phrag gsum bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la nyi ha ①na ha na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bha kṛṇ+ḍa kabye ku ru dza dza zhes bya ba gtor ma'i sngags so/ /④rnal 'byor ma dang sgrub pa byas la nag po chen po bsgrub ⑤par bya'o/ /nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //brtsar mchan/1695 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈rtepe 〉ra sa/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉rnams/ rjo〈〈pe 〉mis pa brtsams/ 〈shar 〉mas pa brtsams/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7gzhag /kha shar/rjo〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉7)sa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉7)sa/ ⑧〈dz+wape 〉sko' ra 〉ra mu sa sha la tri shu/ ⑨rte〈pe〉〉〈'ar 〉〉hūṃ nasgo da ya na da/1696 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7cham hā kā la ha na ha na badz+ra ṇa ma ma ka5ku ru ku ru ga hā/ zhes 'bum phrag gnyis bzlas par bya'o/ / ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉rad/ ①〈dz+wape 〉sko'ar 〉7ha/ ④〈〈pe〉skoshar 〉7rdo rje/⑤〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉mas/14—1696
bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (6 2)14wa 1697

rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la myu ṣ+ṭa pa da sdesto tra nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen ①po'i bstod ⑦pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ grub par gyur cig /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces drag po'i sgra yis ⑤srid pa gsum gyi khongs ni ma lus 'gengs nus pa'i/ /ha ha ṭa ṭa zhes brjod gang zhig dus kun du ni bdud sde rjoshin tu 'jigs mdzad cing / /ka rka ka zhes thod ⑦pa'i phreng bas dbu la spras shing nag po'i mchu dang mtshungs pa'i sku/ /bye bye bye zhes khros pa'i mchog gi khro gnyer 'jigs mdzad 'jigs pa kha gdangs sha za zhing / /dbu ⑧skra dang ni sma ra ches ser nye bar spyod pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis srung ⑨bar mdzod/ /re ram̐ ram̐ zhes spyan dmar 'khyug cing bsgyur ⑩mdzad rkyu rku sum̐ zhes rab sgrogs spyan kyis gzigs/ /smin ma ser zhing mche gcigs ro yi gdan la dgyes pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis zhing skyong 14—1698

mdzod / /ha ha hūṃ dang tī li tī li zhes sgogs phyag g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ gar bcas thod pa bsnams/ /ru ru ru zhes khrag gi rgyun 'bab phyag gis bsnams shing gsol ba 'thung ba la dgyes shing / /khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ zhes gtum mo'i ①phyag g.yas gri gug ral gri bgegs rnams la ni rol mdzad pas/ /ḍi ḍi ḍi zhes ḍa ma ru can 'di yis 'dul mdzad 'khor bcas zhing skyong khyod kyis srungasaske/ /rab tu rngam zhing mgo bo rnams kyi phreng bas gshin rje dang mtshungs 'jigs pa'i sku brgyan cing / /spyo khye ṭ+wāṃ zhes bzod pa'i shugs ①can ca co sgrogs par byed pa'i gdug pa rnams bzung ste/ /gcig pus sna tshogs mnan nas ka ka ha ha ④brjod mdzad char sprin sngon po lta bu'i mdog /sku la mi yi sha dang rgyu mas bril ba'i rgyan gyis ⑤kun nas brgyan cing zhal du gsol/ /drag shul phyag gis 'dod pa'i gzugs dang mi sdug rjogazugs can kyi ni 'byung po ro langs tshogs/ /ma lus bzung ⑦nas myur du bsad pa rnams kyi mgo bo'i khrag rgyun 'bab pa rab tu gsol/ /s+thā k+ṣu khrushrī zhes sngags kyi gsungs ⑨can pa tsa pa tsa' sngags kyis bgegs rnams rab tu bsregs⑩/ /rol pas rol pa sel zhing ⑪mi yis gang ba'i mtsho la zhing skyong khyod kyis bsrung ba mdzad/ /phe phe phaṭa ces sgogs pa so sor bskyod pa'i me dpung chen po'i dbus su bzhugs nas su/ /rigs kyi lus can srung bar ⑫ mdzad cing sgrub ⑫pa rnams kyi zhing rnams nges par zhing skyong mdzod/ /phyugs rnams kyi ni nyin re bzhin du bgegs dang sdig ⑫'joms dri med brnyes ⑫pa chu nyi bzhin/ /rtsa rtsa rtsa zhes gtum pa'i shugs kyis rab dbye rmad byung 'od kyi 'jig rten snang mdzad pa/ / kre kre kre ⑩zhes gshegs pas dgra bo nyon mongs pa rnams nges par nyon mongs 'joms mdzad cing / /saṃ saṃ saṃ zhes tshogs pa'i 14—1699

bdag nyid dam tshig thos 'dzin zhing skyong gang yin byed kyis skyongs/ /baṃ baṃ baṃ zhes gshin rje ltar 'gro dri ma med pa'i sna tshogs chu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing / /yam̐ yo yo zhes rlung gi shugs kyis myur du rgyu zhing nyon mongs 'jig rten gnod byed mkhyen / / klo klo klo ①zhes gdug pa'i gzugs kyis srid gsum nyin mtshan dus kun nyon mongs gyur pa gang / /paṃ paṃ paṃ zhes thugs rje'i zhags pas byol song rnams 'dzin phyag gis gdul bya rnams skyong la/ /sngags bdag sngags kyi lus can thugs kyi sngags pa rnams la 'bras bu blo gros mtshungs med ster/ /zhing rnams skyong bar mdzad pa byed kyis ②'gro ba'i lus rnams ma lus yun ring skyong snedu gsol/ /sgrub pa po 'am slob dpon 'ga' zhig thos 'dzin gang zhig blo ldan nus pa dang / /thun gsum du ni sngags rnams brgyad po klog byed de ni bsod nams ldan par 'gyur ba dang / /tshe dang dpal dang grags dang 'byor pa 'dzin dang gzi rgyas pa dang mtshungs med dang / /sa stengs rjodang ni mtho ris su 'ang de yi bgegs kyi tshogs rnams rtag tu nyams par 'gyur/ /dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //14—1700

bsdur mchan/1698 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /dpal nag po'i stod pa bzhugs sto// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sna mas man+t+ra/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wapo chen/ ④〈〈pe 〉snostod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉stab/ 0〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉bobadud sde/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉smrad/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉stanabus/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉thasrung / ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ska/ra/1699 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stapo'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bsrungs/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gzugs/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉ka ha ka ha/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉'brel bas/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stanadug ⑦〈〈pe 〉stanazung / ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉te// ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanasung / ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsreg ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ཿnga / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gsad par/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉thasgrub/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stesdigs/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bsnyems/tho)〈〈pe 〉〉gro kri kri/17༷ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nyari klo gla/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉ste)/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bskyang / du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉steng /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (6༷3)14wa 1701

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la sto tra/ bod skad du/dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste//grong khyer sum brtsegs ④'jigs byed pa'i/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid can/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas//g.yon pa gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod phreng ④can la bdag bstod do/ /khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'phyin pa/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /hūṃ zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /gri gug thod pa lag na 'dzin/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyil/ /spyan gsum me yi mdog 'dra ba/ /mche ba zla ba tshes pa 'dra/ /thod pa'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /gsus khyim che la 'phyang ba 14—1702

po—/ /mi thung khros pa'i gzugs 'dra ba/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /bstan pa srung ①bar zhal bzhes pa/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen badze+es pa/ /steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed/ /spyan bgrad ②mche gcigs ljags 'dril bas//bar gyi gdon tshogs bsdigs par byed/ /g.yas na gri gug bsnams pa ni/ /dgra bgegs 'dul zhing bdud mgo gcod/ /g.yon pas ①thod pa bsnams pa ni—/ /gnod sems can gyi khrag bkang ༷gsol/ /khros pa'i zhabs gnyis brdab rjopa yis/ /gnod sems can gyi lus la nyed/ /khyod kyis rjothub pa'i bstan ④pa srungs/ /rnal 'byor pa yi bar chad srungs/ /chos dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /dpal nag po chen po la bstod ⑧pa slob dpon bram ze ⑨mchog sred kyis ⑩mdzad pa rdzogs so// //14—1703

bsdur ma na/17 2 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa bzhugs sto// ②〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉sa ga ①〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉toraphreng /17 2 ①〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉〉bsrung / ②〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉dgrad/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾sha ra 〉〉pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rkang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brdabs/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉snyan/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉snostod/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉bobram ze/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉4)/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (6༷4)14wa 1704

༄ ga /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la sto tra/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po la bstod ②pa/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan dpal chen grags pa yi①/ /sku gsung thugs las sprul pa yis④/ /nyid kyi thugs ka nas byung ste/ /sprul pas 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ gi de nyid las bzhengs pa'i/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /sku mdog nag po 'bar ba che/ /bstan pa srung ⑤la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thod pa rnam gsum 'bar ba yi/ /gzhal yas gur gyi nang na bzhugs/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bdud rnams mnan/ /'gying bag brjid la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ma chags thabs kyi pad+ma mdzes/ /shes rab ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil/ /hūṃ las skyes pa'i dpa' bo ni/ /bstan pa bsrungs rjol phyag 'tshal bstod/ /g.yas kyi gri gug gdengs pa yis/ /dgra bgegs 'dul zhing bdud mgo gcod/ /14—1705

nyon mongs dug gsum rtsad nas 'joms/ /dpa' bo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod//bdud kyi thod pa bdud rtsis bkang / /nyid kyi zhal du gsol bar ①mdzad/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol/ /byin rlabs ④'bebs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhal nas khrag gi rgyun 'dzag pa/ /bstan pa la gnod dal yams 'be+ebs /dam tshig bsrungs ④la dngos grub stsol/ /thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /dug lnga rtsad nas gcod pa ste/ /dug gsum 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mche ba gtsigs pas bstan pa la/ /gnod pa'i klad pa 'joms par mdzad/ /til tsam dag tu brlag par mdzad/ /mi mthun 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gdug pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rkang med 'gro bas sku la brgyan/ /zhe sdang rtsad nas gcod rjopa ste/ /klu chen 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /stag ni dpa' brjid rngam pa'i chas/ /sham thabs sked rjol bcings pa yisadu/ / dregs pa ④lha chen zil gyis gnon/ /dpa' chen bdud ske'adul phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /bskal pa me dpung 'bar ba yi/ /srid pa'i rtse mor rab tu 'bar//bstan pa la gnod sgol mdzad pa/ /'bar ba'i rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /tha ma'i bstan pa srung mdzad pa/ /thad ⑨pa lnga yis ⑩dbu la brgyan/ /'jigs 'god gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyil/ /bstan pa phun sum tshogs pa yis⑪/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i rtags/ /rtags lnga ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /spyan gsum dug gsum rtsad nas 'joms/ /'dul ba rnam pa bzhi gzigs nas//gang la ci ⑫'dul ji bzhin du/ /de 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /74—1706

dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa slob dpon chen po a wa dhū tī ①pas mdzad pa cardogs so// //bsdur mchan/17 5 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉ltod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staspris/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ ⑤du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsrung /17༷6 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabarlabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bsrung / rjo〈〈pe 〉to/nas gcod/〈〈snar 〉stanas bcod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rted/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stan/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉grags pas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉wabadud/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉thod/ ⑩⑩〈〈pe 〉snga0rdor 〉stan/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉tses/17༷7 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mud+ma ti/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (6༷5)14—1707

rag /rgya gar skad du/ shrī bhaṣ+ṭa rā ④ka ma hā kā la sto tra/ bod skad du—/ rje btsun dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs kyi sems can ma lus myur du tshar bcad bsad nas khrag rgyun gsol mdzad nag po chen po ni/ /rab 'jigs mdog gnag gzugs thung gsus pa 'phyang zhing dbu skra dmar ser 'jigs pa'i me dpung nang bzhugs khros pa'i gad mos dze+eni/ /ha hūṃ dze gyi rjosgra yis lha dang lha min tshogs ni 'dar zhing 'dud pa'i 'khor gyis bskor nas ⑤mnan pa drag po'i tshul/ /bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs kyi sems can ma lus myur du tshar bcad bsad nas khrag rgyun gsol mdzad nag po chen po ni/ /ske rags dril bu g.yer ka rjosil sil ḍa ma ru mi ṭi ṭi ⑦hūṃ ha rnga sgra ⑧thog gi nang gi thog ltar ⑨ni—/ /sgra rnams sgrogs shing mnyam dang mi mnyam gar byed pa yi lha dang lha mo'i 14—1708

tshogs kyis bskor nas dur khrod gnas su rol/ /bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs kyi sems can ma lus myur du tshar bcad bsad nas khrag rgyun gsol mdzad nag po chen po ni/ /thung zhing sbom la ①spyan gsum me tog ban+d+ra ka ②ltar dmar bas bgegs rnams skrag cing sngang ①mdzad ljags ni glog ltar 'khyug /mche ba rnam par gcigs pas ma rungs ④gdug pa can gyi sha dang rus pa k+shi rkyu 'cha' zhing lha ba zhag 'jib pa/ /bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs kyi sems can ma lus myur du tshar bcad bsad nas khrag rgyun gsol mdzad nag po chen po ni/ /phyag rgya lnga dang klu brgyad kyis brgyan stag lpags ske rags dang ni sku smad dkris shing mi bskyod pa ni spyi bor bzhugs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams sku las spro zhing mi yi rgyu mas stel ba'i mgo yi ⑤phreng ba rab 'phyang do shal byas/ /bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs kyi sems can ma lus myur du tshar bcad bsad nas khrag rgyun gsol mdzad nag po chen po ni/ /drag po dang ni chu bdag bzlog par dka' ba'i tshogs rnams rjozhal du gsol mdzad phyag g.yon rtse gsum 'dzin cing thod khrag 'thung / /gshin rje'i lce 'dra'i gri gug dang ni ral gri phyag g.yas bsnams⑦—/ /gdug pa can rnams rlog ⑧mdzad sdig pa ring du sgong / /bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs kyi sems can ma lus myur du tshar bcad bsad nas khrag rgyun gsol mdzad nag po chen po ni/ /rig byed ces pa'i lha mo brgyad dang rol ba'i rje btsun rdo rje nag po chen po ⑨sangs rgyas grags pas bskul ba ni/ /gang gis ⑩nyin mtshan rtag tu 'di bton bsgrub pa'i don rnams grub dang sems can ma lus khyad par sa la gnas par mdzod// //14—1709

bsdur ma na/17༷8 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉rdzaskyo ra/ 〈'ar 〉stortse ra/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ du〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉stan/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab skrag nas 'bros shing 'gyel ba'i mgo bcad zhabs kyis/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉skab/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stani ḍi ḍi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ma'i sgrogs/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/17 9 ①〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉〉pa sbom zhing / ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉brtse ra/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉sdongs/ 〈〈snar 〉stanangangs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉dung / ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stabago bo'i/ 0〈'dir 〉〉〉rgo ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉shing / ni〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlag ⑨〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉〉po'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stago/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (6༷6)14—1710

can dang gdong can la bstod pa/1༄4/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bong ②thung gsus 'phyang mdog gnag ral pa kham nag gyen du badze+es/ /'bar ba'i tshogs kyis lha min dgra bgegs ma lus sreg par byed/ /drag po'i zhal gyis bdud rtsi gsol mdzad mgo bo gcod mdzad pa/ /bzhad pa'i tshul kyis khro zhing gdug pa'i dgra rnams skrag mdzad pa/ /rked pa byen pa dril bu g.yer ga'i ④tshogs kyis sgra sgogs shing / / ṭi ṭi rjodang ni hūṃ ha ṭa ⑤ru yi sgra sgrogs pa/ /zhal nas tor ke na ni rjotor ra ki ṇi ⑦ki sgra ni/ /sgrogs ⑧shing zhabs kyis mnyam dang mi mnyam tshul du gar mdzad cing / /ma mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bkor cing ⑨dur khrod gnas na rol/ /ha ka hūṃ ka dze ka'i sgras ni lha dang lha min sregs④/ /ma lus dgra bgegs tshogs kyi srog la myur du sogs ⑪byed cing / /nag po'i phyogs kyi dgra bgegs khrag gi rgyun ni zhal du gsol/ /nag po chen pos sgrub 14—1711

pa po yi bsam pa myur du sgrubs/ /spyan gsum me tog byi ru'i mdog ①ltar dmar zhing smin ma 'khyog /ljags ni glog ltar 'khyug pas bgegs kyi tshogs ni 'jigs shing skrag /zhal nas mche ba rnam par gcigs pas dgra bgegs ma lus pa'i/ /sha rus rkang dmar sum̐ rku gsol zhing lha ba zhag ni 'jib/ /stag gi pags ②pa'i sham thabs kyis ni sku smad yongs su dkris/ /phyag rgya lnga dang klu brgyad kyis brgyan spyi bo nas/ /mi bskyod la sogs de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par 'phro bar byed/ /rgyu ma mi mgo rlon pa'i phreng bas sku la do shal byas/ /nag po drag pos snechu bdag la sogs zhal du gsol bar mdzad/ /rtse gsum dang ni gdug pa'i khrag bkang thod pa g.yon na bsnams/ /gnod sbyin lca rjo 'dra'i gri gug ral gri g.yas kyi phyag na 'dzin/ /gdug pa'i dgra rnams ring du spong zhing rlog rjopar mdzad pa khyod/ /lha mo brgyad kyis bskor zhing 'dir ni gar gyi tshul gyis bzhugs/ /nyin dang mtshan du sgrub rjopa'i don rnams ma lus mdzad pa la/ /sangs rgyas grags pa yis ni 'jig rten mgon po la zhus pa/ /ma lus sems can 'di dag rdo rje sa la rab 'god mdzad/ /rje btsun dpal nag po chen po bya rog ming can dang gdong can la bstod pa mkhas pa chen po rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags kyis bstod pa rdzogs so// //'di dag pra kri ta'i skad du yod pa las se lo tsā ⑦bas bod skad du bsgyur ba'o—/ / //14—1712

bsdur mchan/1711 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉gung / ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈zhar 〉tha'/ ④〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉〉'i ḍi/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze'ar 〉〉stob/ 0〈cha〉sngazhar 〉zini/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉ra/ni〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skusgog ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉thaskor nas/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾05ra 〉〉bsreg ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snosgong /1712 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brtse ka ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nosags/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉po/ me〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉〉/ ⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlag rjo〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉bsgrub/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (6༷7)14—1713

༄ga /dpal lha mo nag mo chen mo la bstod pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la de wī byasto tra aṣ+ṭa nā ma①/bod skad du/ dpal lha mo nag mo chen mo la bstod pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /til mar gyis bskus lan bu gcig pa ro nye'i rna chas sgeg cing cha lugs ma lus 'chang / /rgyan du rkang sgrogs rjolcags las byas pa cig ⑤gis rang gi rkang pa mdzes par byas pa de/ /gcer bu bong bu zhon zhing 'gro ba 'di na rgyu ba de ni lha mo khyod nyid kyis/ /bdag nyid mdzes par shes kyis gzhan ltas khrod kyi spyod pa'i mtsho chen don dag su yis shes/ /'khor ba 'jig pa'i tshe na mi lus dag las khrag dang zhag 'dzag dud pa 'thul ba na—/ /lha mo mche ba mi bzad khyod kyis zhal du 'gro kun skad cig tsam gyis zhugs par 'gyur/ /nag mo mi thod thogs pa khyed ni rnal 'byor grub pa'i rnal 'byor can te dur khrod dgyes/ /spyod ni g.yo byed mnan cing nad chen 'chi 14—1714

ba'i 'jigs pa bsal zhing ①mi bzad dril yang sgogs/ / khyod ni ④dpa' bo dag gi mgo bos ①cod pan gyis ni legs spras g.yul du mtshon gyis bcad pa yi//phreng ④ba thogs shing gar byed lag pa mnyen brkyang rkub tshos che la klu dbang gshibs ⑤pa yi/ /ska rags 'ching zhing lag na mdung dang ral gri thogs la khrag gi chang gis myos par rjo'agyur/ /mig rtsa dmar por gyur cing mtshan mo dur khrod 'gro ba 'byung po phal chen rnams kyis ④mthong / /ko rlon chen po dral te brgyangs pa'i gos kyis mnabs shing phyed g.yogs phyed ni re ldes dkris/ /mi yi rgyu ma gsar pa'i sbubs kyis zhal gyi zla ba brgyan cing dril bu 'gram ⑧par 'khrol—/ /lus ni snum gyis gsar du byugs shing khrag dang zhag la sogs pa'i thig les tshom bur bris/ /mi yi sha la so yis chem chem gcod byed thod pa can ni bdag la skyong ⑨gyur cig /drag po drag mo mi bzad mi sha kha na thogs pa sngon chad ma byung khyod mthong nas/ /ma mo rnams kyang skrag cing brtabs ⑩la rngam pa 'thon ⑪cing mig rtsa rig rig khyod la 'dud/ /nag mo bzang mo lus mdog gnag cing bzod par dka' ba khyod la brgya byin la sogs kyang / /nyin gcig bzhin du bstod pa byed de gshin rje nyid kyang rtag tu 'dar zhing 'dud par byed/ /mi rnams dang ni 'gro ba ma lus pa dag mjug brtul ⑫ba ni rna ba ya gcig la/ /brang gis 'gro ba 'go bo'i gdengs ⑫ka stong dang ldan pa rgyab nas rgyan du ⑩byas nas gnas/ /ya gcig la ni seng ge mtshungs med thogs shing rgya mtshos bskor ba'i sa gzhi ma lus gnon/ /steng na rgyu ba'i nyi ma 'od zer stong ldan khyod kyi lte ba'i thad ka'i phyogs su gzhag⑫ /rgya mtsho'i klong nas me 'bar khyod/ /chu rnams skems par nus pa ste/ /bud med thams cad zhi 14—1715
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (608)14wa 1717
brtsar 'bras re'u mig da/ (608)14wa 1717

༄ga /dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā khā ṣ+ṭa man+t+ra ②sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ grub par gyur cig /'byung po ro langs tshogs rnams ha ha hūṃ dang ki li ki le zhes sgogs ①myur bar ni/ /sku la rgyu ma'i phreng bas kun nas bklubs 0shing zhal du mi yi sha ni gsol mdzad cing / /'dod pa'i gzugs dang mi sdug gzugs can kha ṭ+wāṃ gar bcas rjophyag g.yon mi yi thod pa bsnams/ / spyan dmar ④smin ma ser zhing mche gcigs ro yi gnas la dgyes ⑦pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis srungs⑧/ /phe dze tse zhes sgrogs par byed cing so sor bskyod pa'i ⑨me dpung chen po'i dbus na ni/ /mgo bo ⑩rnams kyis mgo yi phreng byas rab gsal 'jigs pa'i skur ⑪brgyan gshin rje dang mtshungs shing / /drag shul phyag gi dang po rnams kyis mi mgo ⑫ma lus 'dzin cing khrag 14—1718

skyugs bab ①pa gsol/ /rol pas rol pa sel zhing me ⑧yis gang ba'i gnas la zhing skyong khyod kyis srung bar mdzod/ /k+ṣ-i k+ṣ-i k+ṣ-i zhes bzod ④pa'i sku can ca co sgrogs par byed pa'i gdug pa rnams bzung sterjo/ /gcig pu gnon ⑤cing mnan nas ka rjoha ka ha brjod cing char sprin sngon po yi ni ⑦mdog /hri spyo shrī yi sngags kyis gdug ⑧can pa tsa pa tsa' ⑨rigs kyi sngags kyis kun nas sreg⑩ /bgegs rnams rab tu bskrad par mdzod cig sgrub po rnams kyi zhing gnas nges par zhing skyong mdzod/ /gang zhig dus rnams ⑩kun du hi ṭa ṭa ⑫zhes bzhad pa'i sgra yis ⑫shin tu 'jigs mdzad cing / / phyugs rnams kyi ni sngags ⑫dang bgegs ⑫'jig nyi ma re re dri med brnyes ⑩pa chu 'dzin mdog /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces drag po'i sgra yis srid pa gnyis po'i khong ni ma lus 'gengs nus shing / /dbu skra dang ni sma ra ser zhing ⑩nye bar spyod pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis srung ⑫bar mdzod—/ /khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ zhes phyag g.yas gri gug ral gris bgegs rnams la ⑩rol khrag 'thung ba la dges⑩/ /re re re zhes spyan dmar ⑪du ru ru zhes phyag ni khrag gis brgyan ⑫cing gtum ⑫pa'i shugs/ /sum̐ sum̐ sum̐ zhes khros pa'i spyan gyis ④ gzigs par mdzad cing ⑫bgegs rnams khyod kyis ⑪sgyur bar mdzad/ / rda rda rda rtezhes 'di yis 'dul mdzad rngam dang gtum ⑫dang bcas pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis srungs/ /kri kri k+shi zhes mnan pas dgra bo nyon mongs pa rnams nges par nyon mongs par mdzod cig /rka shaṃ rka zhes thod pa'i phreng bas ⑪sku la spras shing nag po'i mthu ⑩dang 'dra ba'i sku/ /rtsa rtsa ⑪rtsa zhes gtum pa'i shugs kyis rab g.yo rmad du byung bas ⑫'jig rten snang mdzad cing / /saṃ saṃ saṃ zhes tshogs ⑫ pa'i bdag nyid dam tshig ④thos 'dzin zhing skyong gang yin khyod kyis skyongs/ /14—1719

yi yo yo zhes sna tshogs ①gshin rje ltar 'gro dri ma med pa'i chu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing / /baṃ baṃ baṃ zhes rlung gi shugs kyis myur du rgyu zhing nyon mongs 'jig rten skyong ba mnyes/ /baṃ baṃ baṃ zhes 'jig pa'i khro gnyer mchog gi 'jigs mdzad nus pa'i kha gdangs ②sha za zhing / /k+ṣ-i k+ṣe k+ṣ-i zhes phan par mdzad cing gnod pa skad cig gis sel zhing skyong khyod kyis skyongs/ /kle kli rlu zhes gdug pa'i gzugs kyis skesrid gsum nyin mtshan dus kun nyon mongs gyur rjopa gang / /paṃ paṃ paṃ zhes thugs rje'i zhags pas byol song rnams 'dzin phyag gis gdul bya rjornams skyong ba/ /sngags bdag sngags kyi sku can blo yi ⑦sngags pa rnams la blo gros 'bras bu mtshungs med ster/ /zhing rnams srung ⑦bar mdzad pa khyod kyis 'gro ba'i lus rnams ma lus yun ring bskyang du gsol/ /sgrub ⑧pa po yi slob dpon blo ldan dam tshig ⑨thos 'dzin gang zhig ⑩gus pa dang ldan pas//thun gnyis su ⑪ni sngags rnams brgyad po klog byed de ni bsod nams ldan par 'gyur ba dang / /sa stengs dang ni mtho ris su ni de yi rtag tu bgegs rnams rtag tu ⑩nyams 'gyur zhing / /tshe dang dpal dang grags dang 'byor 'dzin stengs ⑫dang mthu dang gzi brjid rgyas par mtshungs med 'gyur/ /dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa ④rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis ⑫mdzad pa'o// //14—1720

༄ga /dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la su ṣ+ṭa ⑧man+t+ra sto tra nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ grub par gyur cig /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces drag po'i sgra yis srid pa gsum gyi khong ni ma lus 'gengs nus pa'i/ / ha ha ṭa ṭa ①zhes bzhad sgra yis bugang zhig dus kun du ni shin tu 'jigs mdzad cing du/ /rka ka shaṃ zhes thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la spras shing nag po'i mthu rjodang mtshungs pa'i sku/ /rgyu rgyu rgyu zhes khros pa'i mchog gi khro gnyer 'jigs mdzad 'jigs pa'i khu ⑦gdangs sha za zhing / /dbu skra dang ni sma ra ches ⑧ser nye bar spyod pa'i zhing skyong spyod kyis srung bar mdzod/ /re ram̐ ram̐ zhes spyan mar ⑨'khrug cing bsgyur ⑩mdzad sum̐ sum̐ sum̐ zhes rab sgrogs spyan gyis gzigs/ /smin ma ser zhing mche gcigs ro yi gdan la dgyes pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis zhing skyong 14—1723

mdzod—/ /ha ha hūṃ dang tī li tī ①li zhes sgrogs phyag g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ gar bcas thod pa bsnams/ /ru ru ru zhes khrag rgyun 'bab pa phyag gis bsnams shing gsol ba 'thungs pa ④la dgyes shing / /khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ zhes gtum pa'i phyag g.yas gri gug ral gri bgegs rnams la ni rol mdzad pa'i/ /ṭaṃ ṭaṃ ṭaṃ sdezhes ḍa ma ru can 'di yis 'dul tshad ⑦'khor bcas zhing skyong byed kyis srungs/ /rab tu rngam zhing mgo bo rnams kyi phreng bas gshin rje dang mtshungs 'jigs pa'i sku brgyan cing / / k+ṣ-i k+ṣe k+ṣe ⑤zhes bzod pa'i thugs rjocan ca co sgrogs par byed pa'i gdug pa rnams bzung ⑦ste/ /gcig pus sna tshogs mnan cing mnan nas ha ka ha ka sdebarjod mdzad char sprin sngon po'i mdog /sku la mi yi sha dang rgyu mas brel ⑨ba'i rgyan gyis ⑩kun nas brgyan cing zhal du gsol/ /drag shul phyag gis 'dod pa'i gzugs dang mi sdug gzugs can kyi ni 'byung po ro langs tshogs⑪ske/ /ma lus bzung ⑫nas myur du bsad pa rnams kyi mgo bo'i ⑫khrag rgyun 'bab pa rab tu gsol/ /hri spyo shrī ④gi sngags kyi gsungs can pa tsa pa pa'i sngags kyis bgegs rnams rab tu sreg /rol pas rol pa sel zhing mi yis gang ba'i mtsho skel zhing skyong khyod kyis srung bar mdzad⑩/ /dze dze phaṭa ces sgogs pa ⑩so sor bskyod pa'i me dpung chen po'i dbus su bzhugs skenas su/ /rigs kyi lus can skyang bar ⑪mdzod cig sgrub po rnams kyi ⑫zhing rnams nges par skyong mdzod cigaspyo /phyugs rnams kyis ni nyin re bzhin du bgegs dang sdig 'joms dri med brnyes ⑫pa chu nyi bzhin/ /rtsa rtsa rtsa zhes gtum po'i shugs kyis rab g.yos rmad byung 'od kyis 'jig rten snang mdzad pa/ / kri kre kri ⑫zhes gshegs pas dgra bo nyon mongs pa rnams nges par nyon mongs 'joms mdzad 14—1724

cing / /saṃ saṃ saṃ zhes tshogs pa'i bdag nyid dag thos cing ①'dzin zhing skyong gang yin khyod kyis skyongs/ /baṃ baṃ baṃ zhes gshin rje ltar 'gro ④dri ma med pa'i sna tshogs chu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing / /yi yi yi zhes rlung gi shugs kyis myur du rgyu zhing nyon mongs 'jig rten gnod byed mdon/ / kle klo rlu ④zhes gdug pa'i gzugs kyis srid gsum nyin mtshan dus kun nyon mongs gyur pa gang / /rjopaṃ paṃ paṃ zhes thugs rje'i zhags pas byol song rnams 'dzin phyag gis gdul bya rnams skyong ba/ /sngags bdag sngags kyi lus can thugs kyi ⑤sngags pa rnams la 'bras bu blo gros rjomatshungs med ster/ /zhing rnams skyong bar mdzad pa byed kyis 'gro ba'i lus rnams ma lus yun ring bskyang du gsol/ /sgrub pa po yi slob dpon 'ga' ⑦zhig dam tshig skegang zhig blo ldan gus pa yi⑨/ /thun gnyis su ⑩ni sngags rnams brgyad po klog byed de ni bsod nams ldan par gyur pa ⑩dang / /tshe dang dpal dang grags dang mthu stobs 'byor ba 'dzin dang gzi brjid rgyas pa mtshungs pa med⑫/ /sa steng dang ni mtho ris su 'ang de yi bgegs kyi tshogs rnams rtag tu nyams par 'gyur/ /dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal mnga' ⑫ nas mdzad pa'o// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī ④bai ro tsa na badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ⑫ba ban+de ldi ⑩ri chos grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //14—1725
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyad/ (610)14wa 1727

༄ga /rdo rje nag po chen po'i bstod pa brgyad pa/①༄ ga /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra ma hā kā la aṣ+ṭa ka sto tra/ bod skad du/rdo rje nag po chen po'i bstod pa brgyad pa/ oṃ nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo /hā hā hūṃ mdzad ki li ki li sgogs pa'i sgra ④yis 'byung po'i tshogs pa rnam par 'thab—/ /hūṃ hūṃ sgogs pa'i zhal rnams kyis ni mi yi sha za rgyu ma'i phreng ba 'khrug pa'i sku/ /phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang mdung ①thung mi yi lag pa'i mtshan pa 'dzin cing mdzes pa'i gzugs/ /mi sdug gzugs can spyan dang dbu skra dmar ser dur khrod la dgyes zhing skyong kun nas srungasarjo/ /zhal dang zhal nas dze phe phaṭa ⑤ces sgogs pas so sor bskyed pa'i me dpung chen po yi/ /phreng ba rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing sgu la brgyan pas yan lag nye bar mdzes/ /gsod byed drag po'i phyag gis mi yi khrag 'dzag rgyun du btung zhing sbrul gyi phreng bas brgyanaske/ /dmyal bar bsreg pa sel zhing sa steng zhing rnams skyong ba khyod ni 14—1728

rol zhing rol par mdzod/ /dri med rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes kyang srid pa gsum po khengs ①par 'gengs nus 'o dod ④kyis/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces ma rungs dgra yis nyin bzhin 'jig rten phyugs rnams kyi ni bgegs 'joms shing / /hā hā aji dgod pa yis ④ni dus rnams kun du shin tu rab tu 'jigs par byed//mgo skyes ④ral pa sma ra shin tu dmar ser nye bar 'phro ba'i zhing skyong srung rjo bar mdzod/ /sgeg cing rol pa'i 'jo sgeg dang ldan gsus pa 'phyang ba phyag na ral gri khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ/ /rak+ta 'thungs pa'i spyan dang phyag ni khrag ltar dmar ba ram̐ re ti dudang ru ru ru/ /ngo mtshar snang mdzad gtum po'i shugs can khro bo'i lta bas khro gnyer mdzod cig k+shi sum̐ k+shi⑦/ /'khor bcas skyong ba'i zhing skyong ma lus bdud dang ro langs 'dul bar mdzad pa ṭaṃ ṭaṃ ṭaṃ⑧/ /nges par gnod pa'i bdud dang nyon mongs bag chags gcod byed gri gug 'dzin pa — hri —/ /nag po'i mchu dang 'dra ba'i sku ni rtsod ⑨dang nyes 'phrog thod pa'i phreng can rka rka shaṃ/ /rmad byung 'od kyis 'jig rten g.yo zhing snang bar mdzad pa gtum po'i shugs can rtsa rtsa rtsa/ /lha mchog dam tshig ldan pa khyod kyis tshogs kyi ⑩mchog dang zhing rnams skyongs shig saṃ saṃ saṃ/ /'gro ba sna tshogs dri med chu bzhin gzigs nas nges par gshin rje 'gog byed yo yi yi/ /rlung gi shugs bzhin myur du rgyu bas nyon mongs 'jig rten snang bar mdzad pa baṃ baṃ baṃ/ /smin ma gya gyu'i khro gnyer bsnyer bas 'jigs par mdzad kyang 'jigs las thar byed rgyu rgyu rgyu/ /sgrub po rnams la phan dang bde mdzad gnod pa'i sgo rnams bsrung ba'i zhing skyong k+ṣe k+ṣe k+ṣ-i//bzod pa'i lus can k+ṣiṃ spyo sgo zhes gdug pa rnams kyis bzod par dka' ba'i ca co sgog /ka ha ka ha'i gsung gi rgyun dang char sprin sngon po'i lus can gcig 14—1729

bus thams cad gnon/ /1 1 shrī ①gis sngags dang ba tsa ba tsa'i sngags rnams kyis ni lus can thal bar byed/ /sgrub po rnams la kun du gcod pa'i gegs ④rnams nye bar zhi bar mdzod cig zhing skyong che/ /kle kle kle zhes rtag tu nyon mongs gyur pa'i lus can srid gsum 'gro ba'i nyon mongs rnams/ /rnam par bsal ①nas phyag gi zhags pas skyong zhing srung ba la phan phyugs bdag paṃ paṃ paṃ /sngags kyi bdag nyid sngags kyi sku can sngags myos sngags kyis zhi ba'i bde ster 'bras bu'i phyag /mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sku bzhin mdzes pa zhing rnams skyong bar mdzad pa khyod kyis de rnams srungs/ /sgrub pa po 'am slob dpon gang zhig dam tshig dge mchog mkhas pa'i blo can thun gsum du/ /sngags kyi bstod pa brgyad po klog byed de rnams bsod nams ldan zhing rgyal bar 'gyur ba dang / /tshe dang dpal dang grags dang 'byor ldan mnyam med stobs kyis rnam par gnon pa'i gzi brjid rgyas/ /thams cad shes shing de yis ④nyin mtshan rtag tu bgegs kyi tshogs ni myos shing nyams par 'gyur/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i bstod pa brgyad pa slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'o// //14—1730

bsdur mchan/1728 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉skozhar 〉〉ga /rdo rje nag po chen po'i bstod pa bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dgra/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉stanadung / du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsrungs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉pho waṃ bai ta/1729 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skabang / ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skorod 'dod/ ③〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mosasta rgod pa yi/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshe ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsrung / du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ri/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉ste/ nu nu/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉ḍi ḍi ḍa/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sta / ⑩〈〈pe 〉4) tshogs kyi/ 〈po ra 〉ste) tshogs kyis/172 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉go ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tu gnod pa'i bgegs/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanasal/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉〈'dir 〉stan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (611)14wa 1731

༄ga /dpal lha mo nag mo'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ya de wī ④kā li sā dha no pi ka /bod skad du—/ dpal lha mo nag ④mo'i sgrub thabs/ dpal lha mo nag mo ④la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal lha mo sgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bshams la/ de nas dur khrod dam shing gcig gi drung ngam/ gcong rong ngam khang stong ngam dbe+en pa'i gnas su phyin la/ de nas dang po phyogs skyong bul sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre thams cad la gtor ma sbyin rjozhing / gser skyems rgyas par gtong ngo / /de nas e'i maṇ+ḍal kun du khru re la/ 'phangs su khru gang gi tshad du bya'o/ /de la stegs bu sum rim du bya'o④/ /bar ma la ⑧zla gam gsum du bya'o⑨/ /tha ma gru gsum du bya'o⑩—/ /tha ma'i gru gsum re re la rabs chad kyi thod pa'am/ yang na gang yang rung ba'i thod pa re re bzhag ⑪ste/ de yang thod pa steng du ⑩mngon par 14—1732

byas la/ thod pa'i nang du yi ge ya nag po re re ro ①sol gyis bri'o/ /thod pa'i phyi la yang ④yi ge ma dmar po re re khrag gis zi'o/ /zla gam gsum yang dmar pos ①byug /gru gsum dmar por tshon btang ④ste/ ma legs na yang 'di lta bu'i skyon yod de tshon sbom ⑤na slob dpon dang rjoslob bu la nad mang du yong / tshon phras ⑦na slob dpon dang ⑧slob bu la ⑨nor yal ba 'ong ngo ya yor gyur na yul du 'a ga pa 'ong ngo / /bar chad par gyur na slob dpon slob bu myur du 'chi bar 'gyur/ de bas re khā ⑩sgyug ma 'bring po tsam pa byas ⑪la/g.yas nas bskor zhing bris te/ tshon dgye ba yang gru gsum nyis 'gyur gyi bar du dgye ste/ nang gi gru gsum nag por bya/ phyi'i gru gsum dmar por bya/nang gi gru gsum gyi rtse mo re re la/ rdo rje phyed pa re res mtshan par bri/ thal chen dang khrag skam po ⑫bsres pas e'i dbus su sngags kyi sa bon hūṃ bri/ nang gi zur gsum la ma mo thams cad kyi srog gi snying po phul ba bh+yoḥ⑫re re bri bar bya'o//de nas da du ra'i khu ba dang ra rog po'i khrag dang / bya mo nag mo'i khrag dang / de dag cha bsnyams nas bsres la zhib tu btags la tshon rtsi dang sbyar nas/dur khrod kyi ras la dpal lha mo'i sku bris la/ e'i ma zal gyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol te/ der yang spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad lnga tshang bar bsags la mchod pa 'bul te/ de yang bdag dam tshig gi lha mor bsgoms te/dang por rnal 'byor pa'i snying ga'i dbus su pad+ma ⑫bzhi pa'am/ yang na pad+ma ⑫'dab ma brgyad pa snying po dang bcas pa zhig bsam/ pad+ma de'i snying po'i dbus su yi ge oṃ ⑩klad kor dang bcas pa las 'od 'bar ba cig bsam mo⑩/ /de'i steng du yi ge re re gyi gzi brjid kyis re nyid me ltar 'bar ba cig ⑫bsam/14—1733

me des bdag gi rnam par rtog pa can gyi lus bsregs nas thal bar gyur bar bsam mo/ /de nas yang thal ba de'i dbus su zhi ba'i yid kyis ①bsam par bya ba—/ sngon gyi pad+ma'i snying po la gnas pa srog gi rang bzhin yi ge e/ de'i steng du yi ge baṃ bsam mo/ /de nas baṃ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bum pa dkar po kha nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab pa cig bsam/ de nas sngon gyi srog tu bshad pa'i yi ge e de las ⑦bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab cing byungs pas yi ge kun gyi mchog tu bshad pa'i e zhes pa chu des lhag par yang brtan zhing brtag ⑧par byas nas gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur nas/ zla ba dang kha ba dang 'o ma dang /kun+da dang sprin dkar po dang dung lta bur bsams te/ de nas dpal lha mo'i mtshan gyi sngags/ oṃ ma hā kā li de wī kā rā lirjo/ bi krirnya/ kā la ra ⑤tri tsaṇ+ḍa rū pi ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod pa'i sgo nas/ sngags kyi sa bon oṃ de las sa bon lhar bsgrubs mete/ dpal lha mo chen mo'i skur bsgyur zhing bsgom par bya ba ni/ ⑦sku mdog nag mo nag po srin ⑧dang bung ba lta bur gnag pa/shin tu sgeg ⑨pa/ keng rus kyi lus can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ zhabs gnyis pa/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ 'og ma na bharnya ⑩dmar gyis bskyi ba—/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ⑪'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang po'i phyag na shat+ta/ 'og ma na tho shu la'i mgul du ⑪dar dpyangs phyar ba thogs pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba bzhi gatshigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar po bzlog nas blta ba/dbu skra ral pa gyen du badze+es shing len ⑫bu g.yon du 'khyil ba/ dbu skra la sbrul dang thod phreng gis brgyan pa/ ④snyan cha g.yas na sbrul gyi mgul na dril bu gsil ba/‘ snyan cha g.yon pa na seng ge'i ral pa dmar ⑫ba/ rna ltag gnyis 14—1734

na me tog dang dar dmar po'i cod pan 'phur ba/ lha ma yin la sogs pa'i thod pas do shal du byas pa/ glang po che'i ko rlon gyis stod g.yogs byas pa/ba lang gi ko rlon chan pas dras pa la/ re lde ser pos ①sham bur btags sdepas sku smad dkris pa/ khrag dang zhag gi thig les dze+ebris pa/ klu'i rgyal po gshibs pas ska rags byas pa/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis brgyan pa/bong bu ga ④pa'i steng na rtsen ⑤skyid du bzhugs pa/ dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus na skad dung dang 'brug gi sgra lta bu sgogs shing / ma mo dang mkha' 'gro dang /sha za thams cad dbang du sdud pa cig rjotu bsgom mo/ /de ltar gsal ba de'i thugs ka'i dbus su/ thugs me'am me stag 'dra ba la/ rang gi sor bzhi'i tshad tsam du/ dbyibs sgo nga'i gzugs dang 'dra ba cig ⑦gsal bar bsgom mo//sgo nga de'i dbus su hūṃ nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa cig skebasgom mo//de yang hūṃ gi thig le ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du bsam/ hūṃ gi zla tshes ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsam mo/ /de'i 'og tu hūṃ de las 'od zer byung bas/⑨bzlas pa'i yig 'bru rnams kyi phreng ⑩bar gyur par bsam/ hūṃ de nyid ⑪mtha' ma ⑫bskor bar bsgom shing ⑫/ hūṃ de nyid la ④blta zhing gsal ba dang 'dris shing goms pa'i sbyor bas rtse gsum ⑫pa kho na bsgom mo/ /de ltar bdag dam tshig gi lha mor gsal ba dang / grub pa'i gnas nas rang bzhin gyi lha mo sngon gyi dang 'dra ba zhig /'khor nag mo gcer bu ral pa can/ thod pa se ral khar brgyan pa/ lag pa g.yas pa na mi'i snying thogs ⑩pa/ lag pa g.yon pa na bharnya ⑩rak+tas bkang ba 'dzin pa/ snying gi dbus na srog gi snying po yi ge byoḥ⑫re re yod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te byon par bsam mo/ /de ltar 14—1735

nam mkha' la spyan drangs nas/ mdun gyi e'i dbus su ①sngags kyi sa bon hūṃ dang bh+yoḥ②la so sor thim pas sku phyag rgyar zhes pas snebya'o/ /de yang dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba'i sngags 'dis bya'o/ /dṛ byu 0dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥzhes brjod nas/ de nas gzugs dngos su ston cig par bsgom mo⑤/ /de ltar mi ston na oṃ hūṃ bh+yoḥrjo/e a ral+li s+thāḥ⑦dzaḥzhes sngags de brjod cing gzir ro/ /mngon sum du ma byung na yang nga'i sems la ci 'dod pa de ni khyod kyis grub par gyis shig par bsgo'o/ /de nas kyang sngags kyi ⑧las byed pa'i tshe rigs kyi dam tshig byin te/ dam tshig kyang gur gum gyi chu la sngags kyis btab la sbyin no/ /dam tshig gi sngags 'di'o//oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra sa ma ya ma ⑨ti kra ma nan hūṃ phaṭa/ dam tshig gi chu byin nas bsgo ba/ lha mo khyod dam tshig 'di las 'das na/ bsgo ba ⑩bzhin du ma nyan gyi bar du gzir ba chen por byed pa dang / dam tshig gi chu 'di yang dug ha la ha la chen por gyur te/ mthong bas khrag tu skyug pa dang / rdo rje za byed chen pos snying drangs te dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur ba dang / gnod sbyin gyis gsod par 'gyur ba dang / 'gas pa dang khro bo za byed chen po dang 'jigs byed chen por 'gyur te/ dpal chen po'i ⑪rdo rje chen pos snying dral te/me dpal rdo rje 'bar bas tshig nas lus thal bar byas te/ so so rang rang gi gnas ⑫bor ba bzhin du dmyal ba 'bod 'grogs ⑫su skye bar 'gyur ro zhes dam tshig bor ro/ /de nas dpal lha mo la mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma dbul te/oṃ hūṃ shri ye de wī ⑫kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod de me tog dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra sgru ⑫pa pū 14—1736

dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod de bdug spos shangs ①la dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra dī pa pū ②dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ ces mar me spyan la dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra ghadhe ①pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa—/ ces dri chab thugs kar dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra nai bir+ya ⑦pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod de lha bshos phyag tu dbul lo/ /de nas ra rog po'i sha khrag dang / bya mo nag mo'i sha khrag dang / gzhan gyi yang ⑤khrag sna tshogs gang du'abyor dang sha ⑦chang la sogs pa bza' ba sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i gtor ma dbul bar byas te/ ma hā oṃ sa khā hi⑧/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi⑨/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi⑩/ i rda ba dzi kṛṇ+ḍa kṛsnra pa ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/zhes brjod de gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa rdzogs par phul nas| bstod de gling bu'am mi rkang 'bud/ cang te'u 'am mi thod kyi rnga brdung zhing dbyangs snyan pas bstod par bya ste/ oṃ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham ⑪srid gsum bdag /rang don bsgrub phyir rnam thar la gzhol kyang / /snying rje'i dbang gis rjes la thob pa yi / /shes rab sna tshogs dag gis ⑫'gro don byed—/ /lha mo sku mdog nag mo char sprin mdog /mtshan mo nag mo shin tu gtum pa'i gzugs/ /shin tu sgeg cing keng ④rus lus can ma/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis brjid pa'i sku/ /ral pa gyen 'greng lan bu g.yon du 'khyil/ /skra rked sbrul la ⑫thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /rna ltag me tog dar nag cod pan can/ /khrag gi chang gis ra ro srun rtsa dmar/ /mi ro red pa khar bcug mche ba bzhi/ /rnam par gcigs ⑩nas khrag la shin tu dgyes/ /snyan g.yas sbrul gyi mgul nas dril gsil zhing / /gdug pa btul nas tshangs 14—1737

pa'i sgra sgrogs ma/ /snyan cha g.yon pa seng ge'i ral pa dmar/ /dpa' bo khams gsum seng ge'i ①sgra sgrogs ma/ /phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang pos ②ral gri 'dzin—/ /'og ma bharnya rak+ta snedamar bskyil 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi dang pos shak+ta'i ⑦mtshon cha 'dzin/ /'og ma tri shu'i mgul na dar dpyangs 'phyar/ /shat+ta ral gris ⑤mtshon gyis bsad pa yi/ /lha ma yin gyi thod pas 0do shal byas//glang po che yi ko rlon stod g.yogs 'dzin/ /smad ni ba lang ko rlon dras pa la/ /phyed ni re lde ser po sham bur dkris/ /klu yi dbang po gshibs pa'i rked bcings can⑦/ /zhabs gnyis lcags sgog dag gis ⑧mdzes par brgyan/ /khrag zhag dmar ⑨po'i tshom bus thig ler bris/ /bong bu gwa ⑩zhon mtshan mo dur khrod rgyu/ /bong bu'i rmig pa glog gi shugs can ma/ /khams gsum skad cig dag gis skor bar byed/ /skad ni dung dang 'brug gi sgra lta bus/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dbang du sdud/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i pho brang rtag tu gnas/ /dam pa'i sa nas gzugs sku gnyis gzigs ma/ /ting 'dzin dbang thob gzugs khams gnas su byon/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po la sogs phyag byas ma/ /gzhan la dbang sgyur 'dod khams sa ⑪mthar phyin/ /dbang phyug chen po'i sku la dgyes 'khril ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas bzhir byon pa'i tshe/ /lha rnams dbang phyug brgya byin phyag byas ma/ /lha ma yin rnams phung bar byas pa'i tshe/ /lha min dbang po kun gyis phyag byas ma/ /sku mchog ri rab che dang bsgril ba'i tshe//lte ba'i thad kyi phyogs nas nyi zla 'char/ /rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pas phyag byas maske/ /rgya mtsho'i gting nas me 'bar mtsho skems nus/ /sa 'og dbang po kun gyis phyag byas ma/ /lha mo khyod kyis cho 'phrul 'di bstan pas/ /bdud 14—1738

dang mu stegs rgyal po 'dar zhing 'dud/ /ma mo srin mo'i tshogs rnams rngam zhing dgod/ /rin chen gur phub ciX'i gzhal yas nas/ /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor brtsegs pa'i 'od zer 'bar/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dag ①gi bcud bsdus nas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim par mdzad/ /dug gi rlangs pas nag po'i phyogs rnams kyis⑧/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams slong byed ma/ /de'i ①phyir nad kyi bdag mo dam la 'du/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus nas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim par mdzad / /bdud rtsi'i rlangs pas dkar po'i phyogs rnams kyi/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad ni rtsad gcod ma/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo dam la 'du/ /gang zhig khyod la dad na ma bas byams/ /de phyir ma gcig nad bdag sman gyi gtso/ /lha mo khyod la bdag gis rtag tu bstod/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i spyan snga ru/ /bdag gis 'di nas 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi nad dang sdug bsngal sogs/ /zhi bar bya phyir tshe dang longs spyod spel/ /nag po'i phyogs ni dgug cing dbang du bsdu/ /smyo 'bog gsad dul sogs pa'i ⑤las 'di dag /bstan pa bsrung phyir las 'di grub par bgyi/ /'di las 'gal na rgyal ba'i bka' rjobaslus pas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rdo rjes mgo 'gems shog /de skad rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa/ /dam bcas bzhin du phrin las myur du mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag gi 'khor rnams la/ /zhal nas bdud rtsi char pa'i rgyun phob la/ /nad sogs sdug bsngal tshogs ni zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang dbang dang ⑦longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /zang zing lo thog ⑧'bru yi phung po dang / /rin chen rkang 'gro'i phyugs rnams 'phel bar 14—1739

mdzod—/ /bla ma byed cing dkon mchog dbu 'phang byed/ /bdag gi dge ba'i bar chad byed pa'i dgra/ /che ge mo zhes bya ba'i las ngan 'di/ /khyod kyi khong nas dug gi rlung bus la/ /'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rnams khong nas slong / /bag bzhi sa la lhung nas brdebs su chug /don snying smad lnga'i khong khrag skyug tu chug /las ngan 'khor bcas brang chen brdung du chug /smre sngags cho nge ①gnam du 'bod du chug /'chi ba'i dug mda' ④smyo 'bog gsad par mdzod/ /gcan gzan mkha' lding la sogs ltas ngan phob/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du mdzod/ /oṃ ru ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba sgot+t+waṃ/ kā ma la rāk+ṣa sī hūṃ bh+yoḥ④/che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas shing / dam brdar/0 gtor mar sbreng zhing / brgya rtsa brgyad dam yang na nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la gzhan yang lha mo'i gzungs la sogs pas ⑤bstod pa mtha' dag bya'o/ /de nas lha mo'i sbyor ba la gnas nas/ /thams cad don ni grub byed pa'i/ /snying po yi ni gsang sngags 'di/ /rtag par bzlas pa byas pa rjoste/ /myur ba yang ni ma yin pa/ /'thogs pa yang ni ma yin pa/ /mi gsal ba yang ma yin pa/ /gug skyed ⑦nyams pa ma yin par/ /g.yeng ba'i rtog pa spangs la bzlas pa'o/ /oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī ⑧kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yoḥ⑨/ oṃ a ralbi ⑩zo dzaḥzhes yig 'bru gsal bar lha mos bzlas te/ sngags kyi bzlas pa thams cad kyang lha mo'i tshig yin ⑩ par che ba'i nga rgyal bya zhing / rang gi sprul pa'i lha mo thams cad kyi zhal nas kyang sngags kyi sgra byung bar bsam zhing / bzlas pa brtson par byas pas de lta bu thams cad kyis bzlas par 'gyur ro/ /des ni sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba'i sngags te—/ 'bum phrag bdun bzlas pa'am/ yang na 'bum phrag gsum bzlas 14—1740

pa'am / yang na 'bum phrag lnga ①bzlas pas las thams cad 'grub bo/ /de yang na ②sngags khri phrag re re bzlas nas gtor ma re re gtang ste/ khu tshur bcangs snemadzub mo gnyis bsgrengs rjol/ kha 'gram g.yas g.yon du mche ba ltar byas la/ oṃ bh+ya ba ba ⑤ta li ba rjota li tshe/ zhes lan bdun nam gsum bzlas nas/ 'di skad du/ dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal/ /gtum mo 'jigs byed yi dwags kha⑦/ /dam tshig srung ma khrag dga' mo/ /ki li sgra sgogs sbyor zin mokhru/ /dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus na/ /tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa ru/ /gcigs byed gtum mo dud sol ma/ /gsol cig bzhes zhig dam tshig lha/ /gnas nas gnas su mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyod kyis grub par mdzad/ /bdag gis ⑨las ni ci byed kyang / /de la kun gyis grogs rmis shig /hūṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa na ⑩sarba duṣ+ṭṛ/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa—/ phroṃ phroṃ phroṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes brjod de/ se gol lan gsum gdab ste gtang ⑪bar bya'o/ /'dzab ma rdzogs kyi bar du rgyun de ltar shes par bya'o/ /ji srid skyo bar ma gyur gyi ⑫bar du de ltar bzlas la/ skyo bar gyur na yang bstod pa byas la mchod pa phul nas⑫/ phyag byas te lha mo be+er gshegs su gsol lo/ /dpal lha mo nag mo la sngon du mchod snyepa chen po dbul zhing /bsnyen pa rdzogs par byas la/ lha mos lung bstan cing mtshan ma thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas kyang / dang po nyid du snying po'i sngags la 'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas la/ de nas bstod cing las la sbyar ro/ /de nas smyo zhing gsad pa'i las bya na/ grog mkhar gyi sa dang / chu ⑫'gram gyi sa dang / dur khrod kyi sa dang / dur khrod kyi thal ba dron mo dang / dur khrod kyi sol ba dang /14—1741

rdzas de dag gcig tu bsres te zhib tu btags la/ bong bu'i gcin gyis sbrus te bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan bya'o/ /ldum ①bu dang / ldum ②bu med na lung thang tse'i 'bras bu dang dug dang ske tshe dang lan tshwar ①khrag dang sbyar bas/ mi de'i ming rus rigs kyi bla gang yin pa'i bla gzugs go ga la bris la/ bla de'i lus la dgra bo de'i ming rus dusod cig pa'i bskul ⑤tshig dang bcas pa bris te/'di skad du hūṃ che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ un man+ta ku ru phaṭa/ ces bris la bla rdo dang sbrags la gzugs brnyan gyi snying gar gzhug /gzhan yang gong gi rdzas dang tsha ba gsum mu zi nag po rnams bsres te/ zhib par btags te bong bu'i gcin dang sbyar te/ gzugs brnyan gyi kun du khyab par bsku'o/ /de nas gcan gzan rjokyi thod pa'i kha nang du bcug la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su gzhag /de nas gang la bya ba de bkug cing gzugs brnyan la bstem/ de yin pa kho nar bsams la de la las bya'o/ /rgya gar phan chod na mi gsod pa'i gsal shing rtse gcig pa byed pasadze+e/ 'dir yang ⑧lcags las gsal shing rtse gcig pa brdungs la bya'o/ /byas pas ni lha mo yin te/ gzugs brnyan gyi rkub nas gyen du btsugs te khar phyung la ⑨gzugs so/ /de nas sngags 'bum phrag gsum bzlas na dgra bo brlag par 'gyur ro/ /de'i dus su bsam par bya ba ni bsgrub bya de'i snying ga'i dbus kyi yi ge ka las gyur pa'i sdig pa kha dog nag po mi sdug pa zhig gis/ snying gi ⑩mar me'i dbus nas snying khrag 'thung zhing sha ⑪za bar bsam mo/ /gzhan yang bdag dpal lha mo bsgoms pa'i snying ga'i mar me'i nang gi hūṃ gi 'od zer las dzaḥdamar po ⑫bsgril ma phyogs bcur 'phros 'dus pa las/ de yongs su gyur pa las lcags kyi spyang ⑫mo ral pa can cig 14—1742

tu bsgom/ des bsgrub bya'i snying rtsa dbu mar thon ①nas khrag 'thung bar ② bsam zhing sngags bzlas te/ oṃ hūṃ shri ye de wī ①kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yoḥ/mā ma sha hūṃ ④a mu ka mā ra ya mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ brgya rtsa ⑤re bzlas nas/rdzas ni ka na ka'i rtsa ba dang / zi ra nag po dang / dbang po lag pa dang /gnod sbyin lag pa dang / byi'u rug pa dang / skye rjob dmar po dang ⑦/dur khrod sol ba dang / lan tshwa ④bsregs pa'i phye ma de rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma'i sbyor ba byas pa la bsngags nas gzugs brnyan la gdab/ phur bu rdo rje drag po dmar lhag ge bsregs la snying gar gdab/ de nas gzugs brnyan mtshon rnon pos gtubs la phye ma byas la/ smyo shing gi ⑨'bras bu yod na rab/ med na lang tang tse'i 'bras bu brgya rtsa brgyad rtsab ⑩mo'i nang du btags nas gzugs brnyan gyi bye ma dang bsres la/ dpal lha mo'i sbyor bas skra bshig gcer bur phud ⑫nas/ kha lho phyogs su bltas nas tsher ma'i me la sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de'i sngags la/ oṃ hūṃ shri ⑫ye de wī ⑫kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo—/ ma ma sha hūṃ ⑫a mu shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ u rnya ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ rdzas dang bstun zhing brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na smyo bar 'gyur ro/ / saṃ gi ⑩thal ba de nyid blangs te/ de nyid kyi spyi bor btab na lo nyi shu rtsa gcig tu smyo bar 'gyur ro zhes kyang bshad do/ /gzhan yang bdag gi rmi ltas su/ /bu mo nag mo khros pa yang ⑩/ /gang zhig 'ching bas ⑩bcings gyur na/ /mtshan mo nag mor der shes bya/ /bsgrub bya nyi ma bdun na ni/ /'chi ste gshin rje'i yul du 'gro/ /gal te cung zad 'gor na yang / /nyin zhag bdun du bsam gtan 'di bya'o/ /bsgrub bya'i 14byed1743

lus po skams pa rid pa/ mdog nyams pa dri ma can/ skra 'dzings pa snum pa/khu ba rdul dang khrag 'dzag pa/ 'dar ba'i cha byad can zhig tu bsam/ yang na mngon sum du bsams te/ bdag lha mor gnas pa'i snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer nyi ma'i zer dang me stag lta bu las/ bskal pa'i me bzhin du 'bar zhing 'ur sgra dang tog tog dang / chem chem can du drag po'i yi ge hūṃ du gyur te—/ hūṃ de las rdo rje 'bar ba'i khab tu gyur par bsam/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i khab de dgra bo'i gzhang kha'i sgor zhugs te/ snying phug ①nas kha'i nang ngam spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar phyung nas cher 'bar bar bsams te/ snying po'i sngags kyi mjug la/ che ge mo ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ hūṃ hūṃ skephaṭa phaṭa kyi sngags kyis kha sbub tu lhung bar bsam mo/ /de lta bu'i bsam gtan gyis/ lha chen po yang 'chi na/ 'on kyang 'khor ba na gnas pa'i mi lta smos kyang ci dgos/mkha' 'gro ma dud sol gyi sgrub thabs mkhas pa chen po nā ro ①pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //lo ka shrīs bsgyur ba'o/ /rje mar pa lo tsā'i phyag dpe las zhus pa dag go// ④//14—1744

༄ga /gtum chen drag po'i mngon par rtogs pa/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa rnyi sa ma ya/ bod skad du/gtum chen drag po'i mngon par rtogs pa/ bla ma dang dpal gtum po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gtum chen drag po bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dang por re zhig yid dang rjes su mthun snepa'i dben pa'i gnas 'ga' zhig tu thog mar bde ba'i stan la nye bar 'dug nas ral gri'i phyag rgya bcings te/ snying ga dang mdzod spu dang mgrin pa dang spyi bo rnams su lan gsum bzhag la/ na maḥsar+pā shā pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥsarba skethā ga te bh+yaḥsarba thā ha ra ha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sarba bihūṃ dudz+nyā na khasga hūṃ phaṭa ces rjobarjod do/ /de la ral gri'i phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ mdzub mo dang gung mo drang por byas la ming med dang mthe'u chung mthe bong gis mnan pa'o/ /des phyogs bcur 'khyam pyapa'i bgegs rnams drungs phyung bar blta'o/ /de nas spyi bor bzung ⑦nas muḥ14—1748

yig gis gshegs su gsol nas/ oṃ yisahūṃ zhes bya ba dag spyi bo dang mgrin pa dang snying gar bsams la lag pa g.yon gyis reg nas lan gsum brjod do/ /de bzhin du spyi bor oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badzi ni ①ma hā pra ti sa ra ②rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rmā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes brjod do/ /oṃ s+dzabadzā sa ne+e hūṃ zhes pas stan byin gyis brlabs te/ de dag gis bsrung ④ba byas nas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nyi ma rnam par bsgoms nas/ de'i steng du 'od zer dang bcas pa'i hūṃ yig bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas 'od zer des lus rnam par sbyangs nas/ 'og min gyi mthar thug pa'i sa gsum po khyab par byas rjol/de dag na bzhugs pa'i dpal gtum chen drag po spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bltas te/ 'od zer me tog la sogs pa'i gzugs su bsgoms nas mchod yon dang zhabs bsil sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa bya'o/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni rnam pa bdun yin te/ 'di ltar bdag gis sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi'o/ /skye bo gzhan dag gis ⑤dge ba la mchog tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das zhugs rjopa'i don gyi phyir dang / dam pa'i chos dkon mchog gnas par bya ba'i slad du/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /byang chub kyi rgya mtsho yid la byas nas/ de'i lam la gnas shing / dge ba'i cho gas byang chub kyi ched du 'jug par bkyi'o zhes bya ba 'dis so—/ /de las bcom ldan 'das thugs dgyes pas legs so zhes bya ba gnang nas sgrub ⑦po dbugs 'byin par mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ⑧la phyag byas nas bzod par gsol te rang gi gnas su gshegs par blta'o/ /de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shusnyaḥsarba dharmā⑨ཿswa bhā wa shustopho⑩haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā tshwa na badz+ra 14—1749

swa bhā wa ā kolha①haṃ/ zhes bya ba 'di dag gis ⑦don mngon du byas la stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /dang por byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms bsgom ④par bya zhing / 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'gyur bar shog /ces bya ba'i smon lam yang btab nas so/ /de nas stong pa nyid sgom rjopa'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ brtan pa dang g.yo ba rnams sa bon la gzhug la/bdag nyid kyang zla ba dang nyi ma la/ zla ba dang nyi ma dag kyang hūṃ la/ lca yang ha ⑤la/ ha yang mgo bo la/ mgo bo yang zla tshes la/ zla tshes kyang thig le la/thig le yang nā da la/ nā da ni nam mkha' la thim ste/ de nas cung zad kyang rtog par mi bya'o/ /de la 'dis skad cig dang rjopor gnas nas/ smon lam dran pa sngon du 'gro bas rtsa dmar ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas/ de'i dbus su a yig dang re pha las skyes pa'i zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ sngon po rtsa dmar ba'i 'od zer can bsams nas/ zla ba la sogs pa 'dres shing dngul chu'i rnam pa de yongs su gyur pa'i dpal gtum chen drag po sngon po rtsa dmar ba'i 'od zer can/ yon por lta ba/ mche bas ma mchu 'tshir zhing /g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i phyag dag gis zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang / ral gri 'dzin pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rus sbal gyi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa/ zur phud lnga pa/gzhon nu sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ shin tu mkhrang ⑦ba'i sku snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i spyan gnyis rtsa dmar ba/ rin po che'i cod pan can bsgom par bya'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i rim pas/ spyan ma dkar mo pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ mā ma tī sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dkar mo dmar mo 14—1750

pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa/ sgol ma ljang gu ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa rnams so/ /'di dag ni rdo rje skyilta krung ①gis bzhugs pa/ sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lo ②bcu drug lon pa'i nyams can/ g.yas pa dag mchog sbyin par mdzad pa ste/ chos 'byung ba'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das lta bur zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi lus las 'od zer dmar po rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab par bya ste/a bhi ṣiñtsan+tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ①zhes pas so/ /de rnams kyis bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa rnams kyis dbang bskur bar bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā rnyi ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ zhes bya ba 'dis so/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i chus khru rjob na shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma yang dag par 'phags te bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud nas dam du 'tshir zhing / sku mdog dang gzugs shin tu dmar rjob dang ldan pa/ lo bcu drug gi phyed kyi na tshod gcer bu sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yon pas pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas de dang rtse bar bya ste/ de las nam mkha' la rnga bo che'i sgra grag go/ /gur kum rjol sogs pa'i char 'bab po/ /de nas de ⑦ni bcom ldan 'das dpal gtum byed skedrag po rnal 'byor ma lnga'i 'dren pa'o zhes bya ba 'dis ji srid ⑨skyo bar ma gyur pa ji ⑩srid du nga rgyal bar bya'o/ /skyo na de'i nga rgyal gyis sngags bgrang bar bya ste/sngags ni oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ji tsam 'dod pa'i nges pa mthar son pa na/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/⑪ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ sarba sirnyid+me ⑫pra 14—1751

yats+tsha—/ sarba karma su tsa me cilta gre yaḥku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā ①me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa tshosazhes brjod nas/lha'i nga rgyal gyis ji tsam 'dod par gnas par bya'o/ /'dis thun gsum mam thun bzhir bsgom par bya ste/ bsgom pa dang bzlas pa'i cho ga'o/ /rnam par dag pa ②phyi rol du srung ba ni bgegs nyams pa'i ched du'o/ /mchod pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs so/ /stong pa nyid ni ye shes kyi tshogs so/ /lha'i gzugs ni sangs rgyas nyid do/ /lha mo bzhi ni tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi'o/ /shes rab ma ni ④rang bzhin yin no/ /nang du rjo'od gsal ba ni 'chi ba'o /chos 'byung ni bha ga dang zla ba dang nyi ma ni ⑤khu ba dang / khrag dang sngags ni bar srid kyi sems dang dngul chu'i rnam pa ni nur nur po dang mer mer po dang mkhrang 'gyur dang nar nar po rnams kyi rang bzhin du yongs su gyur pa'o/ /rgyan dang bcas par 'gyur ba ni rkang lag 'gyus pa'o/ /lha mo bzhi ni sa dang chu dang me dang rlung ngo / /thams cad kyi bsam du med pa'i gzugs ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'o/ /de la 'di dag rjoni thams cad kyi sangs rgyas nyid du gyur pa kho na'o zhes bya ba yin te/ 'on kyang ma rig pa dang nyon mongs pas ⑦dbang byas pa yin no/ /sems can sgrol ba'i phyir zung du 'jug pa nyid ni sdigs mdzub yin la/ ral gris ⑧ni ma skog pa 'joms la zhags pas ni nyon mongs pa 'joms pa yin no/ /zla ba dang nyi ma ni dngos po dang dngos po med pa las 'das nas chos 'byung gi zhing du byams pa chen po'i khro bor bzhugs so—/ /rnam par dag pa'o/ /de nas sngon du bsnyen pa'i don du 'bum bzla bar bya ste / nag po'i 14—1752

tshes gcig nas brtsams te/ zla ba nya'i bar du bsgom zhing sum 'gyur du bzla bar bya ste/ nyi ma so sor stong phrag bcu rnams so/ /nya'i nyin mo yongs su gyur pa'i mthar ji ltar nus pas mchod pa byas nas gtor ma phul te/ dben par mtshan thog thag ji srid nyi ma 'char ba'i bar du bzla bar bya'o zhes pa ni sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o/ /gtor ma'i snod a yig gis pad+ma'i snod du bsams nas/ der gnas pa lha'i bdud rtsir bltas shing / oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa na i rda ba lo kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi ①ma ma sarba sir+ghaṃ ④ku ru hūṃ phaṭa kyis lan bdun du mngon par bsngags nas bcom ldan 'das la gtor ma dbul lo zhes pa ni gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /de nas sngon du bsnyen pa'i mthar rgyal la/ lcags las byas pa'am/grub pa'i shing las byas pa yang rung ste/ ral gri'i rnam pa mthe bo'i sor gyi tshad la me tog ①phreng bas nye bar mdzes rjopa'i rnam lnga dang dri thams cad kyis ⑤bkrus la—/ ras bris yang dag par brtsams pa'i sku gzugs kyi mdun du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bklag cing / gtor ma dang mchod pa rgya chen po phul nas nya'i dunyin la lag pa gnyis kas bzung ⑦nas zla ba gcig tu bzlas par ⑧bya'o/ /de nas nya'i nyin mo rdzogs nas mtshan thog thag bzla'o/ /de nas 'bar ba'am gsal bar gyur ⑨na de nas nyi ma 'char ba na de grub par ⑩te/sha'i bza' btung spangs nas so/ /'ga' zhig skra 'khyil ba lo bcu drug gi rnam pa can nam mkha' la 'gro zhing lo stong phrag bcu rnams su 'tsho bar 'gyur ro zhes pa ni ral gri'i dngos grub kyi cho ga'o/ /de nas dgra bo rims kyis 'debs par 'dod na/ oṃ da ha da ha/ pa 14—1753

tsa pa tsa/ ma tha ma tha/ dz+wa ra dz+wa ra dz+wa ①la ya dz+wa la ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa ②dz+wa la dz+wa la oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes pa ste/ dur khrod kyi ras la dug dang skye tshes bsgrub bya sor brgyad pa'i tshad du bris nas phreng ba'i sngags kyis bskor te/ phyi nas spra tshil gyi nang du gzugs brnyan bcug la yang bse shing gi nang du gzhug ①par bya'o/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa che ge mo la dz+wa re ṇa kṛṇ+ḍi pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags 'di dag yongs su bzla zhing dur khrod kyi me la gdungs na rims kyis 'debs par 'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med do/ /oṃ bi kri tā na na pa ra pa la bhañdza ne+e rjobhañdza ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya badz+ra pā she na brnya brnya hūṃ phaṭa gdu /khaḥkhaḥkhaḥha hā nyi tī phe oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/sngags 'di dag gro ga la ba bla dang yung bas bris nas spra tshil gyis btums 0nas leṅga'i nang du bcug la yan lag brgyad la phur bus btab ste/ gzugs bsnyan kha 'og tu bstan nas dong du gzhug go/ /'di dag gis ni dmag lhags pa la phur bus btab par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ dza ya dza ya pa rā dza ya nirdza ta ya— ⑦tī ṭī hā hā — ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya sa da ya u da ya shī rgyu ma rmi ku ru ku ru oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags 'di dag dur khrod kyi ras la bris nas srad bu sngon pos dkris te dpung par bcings na pha rol gyi 'khrul 'khor 'joms par byed do/ /oṃ e ⑧tsa le sañtsa la kri ⑨la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ spra tshil gyi ⑩liṅga sor bzhi'i tshad byas la/ gro ga la bsgrub bya'i ming dang bcas pa ba blas bris nas de'i khar bcug la/ de nas phur bus btab ste lam bzhi mdor dong du bcug na phas kyi rgol ba'i kha la phur bus btab par 'gyur ro/ /14—1754

oṃ sarba mā ra bhañdza ni hūṃ phaṭa/ sngar bshad pa'i cho gas bsgrub bya'i ①ming dang spel ba byas nas/ rkang pa dag la phur bus btab na 'gro ba dang 'ong ba rengs par byed do/ /oṃ san+ta sdes ne+e mo hā na g.ya hūṃ phaṭa sngags 'di spyi bor bcings na srung bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ya ma marda ne+e marda ya marda ya oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni sdig pa'i nad sel ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ kro dha ne+e kro ṣa be+e bhe da nā ya hūṃ phaṭa ces pa ni zug rngu sel ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ya mārnya ka hriḥṣ+ṭṛ rjohūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tā sa ya tā sa ya tsaṇ+ḍa pra tsaṇ+ḍa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod na ma te 'bros so/ /oṃ ⑤hi li phuḥphuḥzhes brjod na sbrul 'bros so/ /mamyu rjomasmra gri ⑦dhi ṇi khā nyi bi ṣa tsa ru gī ni kha kha kha dze+eha ha saḥsaḥsaḥtsaṇ+ḍa ma hā se nā tshwa pa ya te swā hā/ oṃ saṃ kā ri ṇi t+t+waṃ tī hūṃ ⑨haḥzhes pa ni mkha' lding gi sngags te/ stong phrag bcus grub par 'gyur ro—/ /oṃ sbeṭ+wā ra phe tse ha ha ha ⑩hā hā phaṭa ces pa ni ⑪dur khrod du rtse bar byed pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bit+yā dhi pa ta ye pa ra yan+t+ra nā sha na ⑫sarba ḍā ki nī māṃ tā sa ya ⑫brnya brnya mu khaṃ tī la ya tī la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni grong khyer dang zhing du 'jug pa'i sngags so/ /yang bya rog ⑫khrag blangs nas zangs ma'i glegs bu la sngags bri zhing /gang gi ming yin pa de nyid kyi bshang bar btums ⑫te bya rog gis zos na blo dman yang mi g.yo ba'i sngags kyi sbyor ba las te/ oṃ kā ka ku ta ⑩ni kra ba ni swā hā—/ che ge mo kā ke na ban k+ṣu ⑩pa la tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā se nā tshwa pa ya ti hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags bya rog gi mig gis bris nas/ dur khrod kyi gos sngon por btsos pas 14—1755

gzugs brnyan sor bcu drug pa dril te/ dur khrod du dbyug pa la bcings shing /tsog pu'i 'dug stangs kyis ①dur khrod du mtshan thog thag bzla'o/ /de mthong na ②pha rol gyi sde rengs ①par 'gyur la/ phyung na grol bar 'gyur ro/ /'di'i phye mas lus dang rkang pa la byugs ④na rgyug par mi nus shing ⑤brgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di'i sngags ni/ oṃ ā kardzu ā kardzu mo ha ya rjoche ge mo ba shi ku ru swā hā/ lto ba'i srin bu blangs nas bye mas ⑦zhib bar byas te/ 'od dpag med dang ming med kyi khrag dang lhan cig ril bu byas nas sngar bshad pa'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags te/ bza' ba dang btung bar byin na/ gal te na nga rgyal dang dregs pas bsnyems pa'i mi mo dbang du 'gyur ba la the tshom med de/ma shi'i bar du rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /'di dag thams cad ni bsgoms pa'i bdag nyid can kho nas grub par 'gyur te/ phyung na ni grol lo/ /de nas dbang du bya ba bshad par bya ste/ 'phur bzhin pa'i sbrang ma'i gshog pa gnyis dang / so dbus ma gnyis dang / ro'i me tog phreng bas te/ dbang du bya ba la dze+esngar rengs pa la bshad pa'i sku mdog gser ⑨por bsgom mo/ /bskrad pa la du ba'i mdog dang bsad pa la mdog nag po'o/ /las gzhan dang gzhan la nye bar gnas pa ⑩dang dgrol ba ⑪sngon por bsgom par bya'o//las thams cad mi g.yo ba la rim pas ⑫gus shing bsgoms pa'i bdag nyid can gyis rgyal po lta bur spyod do/ /oṃ dzā lā ka ⑫rā la ba da ne+e ha sa ha sa ha la ④ha la/badz+re su badz+re sga ra spa ra sga ra ya sga ⑫ra ya sarba me gha ta nyi ta rnyiṭaṃ stam+bha ya stam+bha ⑩ya sgo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya yaḥyaḥsarba pā bhā yi ⑩sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags 'di bzlas nas kun du bltas na rlung dang sprin 'thor bar 'gyur ro/ /14—1756

de nas 'dir bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa'i slad du mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal bshad par bya ste/ de la dang por kha la sogs pa dag par byas nas/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+re ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni srung ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ hri①ཿswā hā zhes pa 'di ②lag pa dang rkang pa bkru ba dang / 'thor 'thung gi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ zhes pa ni khrus kyi sngags so/ /de bzhin du 'dis gtsang mar gyur pa'i me tog byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags kyis ④me tog byin gyis brlab pa'i ched du me tog gcig bzung nas dri bzangs sam/ ba byung gi chus zla ba lta bur maṇ+ḍal bya'o/ /oṃ sarba bispyo na a ra hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ badz+ra re khe hūṃ zhes pa 'dis kyang ngo / /de nas ā re khe rjosarba ta thā ga tā tiṣ+ṭhan+tu swā hā/ zhes pa 'dis me tog phul te/ lag pa bkrus nas/ de nas dbus su ri rab dang / shar du lus 'phags la sogs pa bsam zhing / 'di steng du hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa'i dpal gtum chen drag po/ /lo māṃ paṃ but+t+waṃ/ rnams yongs su gyur pas lha mo lngas yongs su bskor ba'i phreng ba rnam par bsams la/ thog ma med pa nas grub pa rnams spyan drangs nas de la bcug ste/ bcings shing dgyes par bya ba ni dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya ba 'di dag gis so/ /me tog la sogs pas mchod par bya ste/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lo tsa ne+e puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha lo buswā hā/ mā ma kri la sogs pa rnams la yang de bzhin du rtogs par bya'o/ /puṣ+pe bzhin du ju paṃ/ gadhe⑦/ mā sum̐ bi le paṃ/ na bu shaṃ/ nai be+ebye/ dza la la sogs pa rnams la rig par bya'o/ /de nas ral gri'i phyag rgyas dgyes par bya zhing bstod nas phyag byas te/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyis ⑧mchod pa bya zhing /14—1757

rnam pa bdun dang bla na med pa'i mchod pa yang byas te①/ be+er yang phyag byas nas bzod par gsol te/ tshul khrims tsan+dan gyis byugs lus/ /bsam gtan kyi ni gos bgos shing / /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /ji ltar bde bar dgyes par mdzod/ /slar yang bdag la brtse ba yis/ /zhabs dag ji bzhin 'byon par 'tshal/ /oṃ muḥmuḥ②swā hā zhes chu gtsang ④me tog dang bcas pa zhabs la dbul lo/ /de nas mchod pa bsdus nas gshegs so snyam du bsgom zhing / de nas dri ma med cing dben par dor bar bya'o/ /de nas gtsang mar gyur nas ci bder bya'o/ /0oṃ ṭ+wāṃ 1 phroṃ ⑤tsaṇ+ḍa rū pe tsa ṭa tsa ṭa rjopra tsa ṭa ka ha ka ha pra spa ra/ pra spa ra ⑦ya ha na ha na gra sa gra sa brnya brnya/ dzam+bha ya dzam+bha ya stam+bha ya stam+bha ya ④mo ha ya sarba sha zlo ⑨mu khaṃ brnya rna ku ru ku ru sarba ḍā ki nī ṭ+wāṃ gra ha bhū ta pi shā tsa byu dhi yak+ṣa hūṃ tā sa ya tā sa ya ma ra ma ra mā ra ya mā ra ya ru ru tsaṇ+ḍa ku ⑩ka rak+ṣa rak+ṣa tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā se nā sarba mā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags 'di dag gro ga'i 'dab ma la pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i dbus su gur kum dang gi wang dang rgya skyegs kyis ⑩bris te srad bu nag pos dril ⑫nas dpung pa'am/ mgrin par bcing ⑫bar bya'o zhes pa srung ba'i cho ga'o/ /yang kha lhor bltas nas yungs kar ⑫la brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags nas mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas zin pa la brdeg par byas na gtong bar 'gyur ro—/ /yang na so rtsi'i 'dab ma la gru gsum pa gnyis kha sbyar ba'i dbus su tsher mas bris nas pho ba ris lnga dang lhan cig sbyar nas zos na nyin gcig pa la sogs pa'i rims thams cad 'joms par bya'o⑫/ /14—1758

oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā se ṭ+wā gra sa gra sa kha kha khā hi khā nyi sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya ①mā ra ya mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ stsos byed kyi lasor bzhi pa'i tshad kyi gzugs brnyan byas nas de'i snying gar sngags 'di dag dur khrod kyi ras la ④dug dang skye tshes bris pa bcug ste/ sor gcig pa'i tshad kyi rus pa'i phur bus gdab par bya'o/ /dur khrod du khung bu brkos ④nas kha sbub tu bzhag na nyi ma bdun gyis 'chi ba bsgyur ⑤bar the tshom med do/ /nim pa dang bya rog gi tshang rjoblangs nas yi dwags kyi me la bsregs pa'i thal ba la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ⑦ṇa che ge mo uts+tsha ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa brgya rtsa brgyad du bsngags nas sgo la gtor na khyim nas sgod pa la the tshom med do/ /khyi 'thab pa'i sa de dag gi rkub nas blangs la/ phan tshun sdang ba'i gzugs brnyan la 'thor na 'byed par ⑧byed pa la rnam par brtag mi dgos so/ /sngags ni/ oṃ dwo ṣa ṇi dz+wa ṣa badz+re ⑨che ge mo pi dwo ṣa ya oṃ ⑩tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa—/ ces pa dbye ba'o/ /gro ga la ba blas sor drug pa'i rus sbal bris nas rkang pa ⑪bzhi la hūṃ khar ṅgi ⑫dbus kyi lto bar tai gnyis bris la/ sgrub pa pos rgyab tu phreng ba'i sngags kyis spyophyi rol du bskor ba la/ mchod pa dang bstod pa yang dag par brtsam zhing / so phag gi steng du bskor ④rus sbal gyi khog pas bkab ste/ srad bu dmar pos dkris nas rkang pa phyis pa'i gos kyis btums ⑫te rkang pa g.yon pas brdeg par bya zhing / che ge mo ⑩ba shaṃ bha ban+tu zhes pa lan bdun gyi mthar thug pas dgra bo thams cad kyi kha bcing bar 'gyur ro/ /de la phreng ba'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ twe hre hri 14—1759
